70050000031296.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance
70050000031296.description:
PRAY FOR REPENTANCE AND BE REBORN

Experience the modern classic, The Binding of Isaac, like you've never seen it before. It's a game too big to be called a sequel: Repentance takes Isaac to new heights of roguelike dungeon adventure, as the brave boy descends into the basement for his greatest challenge yet! Isaac's new quest takes him to unknown places he's never been, filled with horrible new enemies and bosses, weapon combos you've never synergized before and items he's never seen... unholy terrors from his wildest dreams and worst nightmares!


BIGGER THAN A SEQUEL

The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is so huge, so new and so feature-packed that it makes previous updates look like prequels. There are more features, improvements and new secrets, too many secrets, than most games would include in an official sequel! It's an immense amount of new content to explore, even if you're at 1,000,000%!


THE "FINAL" UPDATE TO THE AWARD-WINNING CLASSIC

The Binding of Isaac: Repentance features hundreds of new features and quality-of-life improvements. It’s the ultimate edition of the genre-defining roguelike, now with OVER 500 HOURS of new gameplay!

KEY FEATURES:
- 130+ new items (more than 700 items in total)
- A full alternate path with brand new chapters and a new final boss and ending
- 100+ new enemies
- 25+ new bosses
- 2 new playable characters
- 5 new challenges
- 100+ new achievements
- 5,000+ new room designs

Expand your wardrobe with four exclusive outfits for Alex, with unique designs that celebrate Valkyrie, the feline fury of the record store, and the other cats of Haven Springs. 

The Alex Outfit Pack adds 1 optional outfit to your wardrobe in each of the first four chapters.

CHAPTER 1 – CURIOSITY IN RED
Catch a glimpse of a black cat peeking out from Alex’s dark denim jacket.

CHAPTER 2 – HIT THE DECKS
This grey cat gets all paws to the dance floor with an unforgettable remix.

CHAPTER 3 – HISS-STORY REPEATING
Commemorate Valkyrie’s ‘charming’ personality with this allover print shirt.

CHAPTER 4 – PURPLE POCKET

This content requires the base game Life is Strange: True Colors in order to play.

This content will be available to purchase after the release of Life is Strange: True Colors.

70050000031358.name: Life is Strange: True Colors - Life is Strange Hero Outfit Pack
70050000031358.description:
Change up Alex's look with 4 new outfits inspired by past Life is Strange protagonists. 

The pack includes clothing inspired by Chloe’s Misfit Skull, Sean’s Wolf Squad, Daniel’s Space Mission, and Max’s Jane Doe outfits.

The Life is Strange Hero Outfit Pack adds 1 optional outfit to your wardrobe in each of the first four chapters.

CHAPTER 1 – MISFIT SKULL
Indulge your punk rebellion with this outfit inspired by Chloe’s iconic ensemble from Life is Strange.

CHAPTER 2 – WOLF SQUAD
Howl at the moon with this sweater based on Sean’s characterful hoodie from Life is Strange 2.

CHAPTER 3 – SPACE MISSION
Blast off with this chic shirt incorporating Daniel’s unforgettable rocket from Life is Strange 2. 

CHAPTER 4 – JANE DOE
Get dressed to the nines to solve crimes, with this t-shirt of Max’s classic Jane Doe design from Life is Strange.

This content requires the base game Life is Strange: True Colors in order to play.

The Life is Strange Hero Outfit Pack is only available as part of the Deluxe Upgrade, Deluxe Edition, or Ultimate Edition. It is not available separately.

70050000031359.name: Life is Strange: Wavelengths
70050000031359.description:
Play as Steph Gingrich in the year before Alex came to Haven Springs, in an exclusive standalone story set in the iconic Rocky Mountain Record Traders store and KRCT radio station. Spin records, host a radio show, and face your future. 

Step into Steph's booth as the all-new radio show host for KRCT: Haven's best - and only - radio station. Over four seasons, discover more about Steph's past and her relationships as she makes her mark on the record store, uncovers its secrets – and decides her future.

LIVE ON AIR
You're the DJ: choose records for the playlist, 'ad lib' your way through local commercials, and help Steph compose an own original song. 

ROLL THE DICE
Give D20-powered advice to callers with problems both serious and mundane, GM a tabletop RPG, and reach out to reconnect with an old friend.

SMALL TOWN PRIDE
Swipe left or right on Steph's dating app matches, and join Steph as she reminisces about formative Prides past.

A ROOM OF HER OWN
See the record store change over the seasons as Steph asserts her personality, and discover its hidden history and surprising spaces as you explore.

ALL-NEW SOUNDTRACK
Hits from Girl in Red, Alt-J, Portugal, The Man, Foals, Hayley Kiyoko, Maribou State, and more set the tone for Steph's journey, each packing an emotional punch.

This content requires the base game Life is Strange: True Colors in order to play.

Wavelengths is included with the Deluxe Edition and the Ultimate Edition.

If you have the boxed game or the Standard Edition, you can purchase the Deluxe Upgrade to gain access to Wavelengths. The Deluxe Upgrade contains both Wavelengths and the Life is Strange Hero Outfit Pack.

Wavelengths is not available for standalone or separate purchase: only as part of the Deluxe Upgrade, Deluxe Edition, or Ultimate Edition.

70050000031630.name: Monster Camp Character Pack - New Blood
70050000031630.intro: ADD EVEN MORE GORGEOUS MONSTERS TO THE PLAYABLE CHARACTER ROSTER!
70050000031630.description:
We all love the original color crew. But it’s time to spice things up… by bringing you 4 new options for playable characters.
Let us introduce the 4 characters you will unlock by acquiring the “New Blood” Character Pack DLC:

Sawyer may be your choice if you’re more of an introvert who enjoys a little peace and quiet.

Abdu is super chill and may be the perfect choice if you just want to go with the flow.

Susanne brings a loud, electrifying personality that lets you go full badass.

And Noodles… is just Noodles. Pure, unadulterated derp energy.

Now you will have more ways to answer the age-old question: WHO ARE YOU?

70050000031631.name: Monster Camp Character Pack - Zoe
70050000031631.intro: PLAY AS EVERYONE’S FAVORITE ELDRITCH CUTIE!
70050000031631.description:
We all love Zoe, don't we?

She's passionate about her interests. She's excited 24/7. She's a lover of many fandoms, always writing a fanfic or drawing fanart. 
She's snarky, chaotic, and ultimately good-hearted. She's more than ready to explore her own truth and be unapologetically herself.
We love her partly because she's like us. We love her partly because she's what we'd like to be.

That's the charm of our beloved and adorkable eldritch cutie.
In a way, she IS us.

70050000031791.name: Rento TEAMS
70050000031791.description:
Rento TEAMS will add allow you to play the game in 2 teams of 2, 2 teams of 3, 3 teams of 2 and 4 teams of 4 people.
Teams can be played online or offline (in Pass To Play mode)
Robots are also team enabled so you can create online room and join a robot in it.

Key differences in Team games

- Money are common across teams
- Land properties are also common across teams
- If one of the team goes to jail and "jail rent" setting is OFF - the whole team does not receive rents while team member is in jail
- Teams are chosen by room creator
- Robots can join multiplayer team games
- When people trade across teams, they can choose which player of the team to send the offer to (if offer is rejected, player can try with a different member of the same team) 
- When one player bankrupts, other player(s) from this team has one more roll (so if he is before start and cross it, he will get $200 which may save him from bankrupting)
- Game ends when other team(s) bankrupt and all players from winning team are the winners

Just like the deep board, this team feature is paid only if you want to create team games.
You can join team games for free in the main Rento game (but you have to wait until you see open team games).

Good luck team!

70050000031804.name: Asphalt 9: Legends -- Christmas Pack
70050000031804.description:
Ho ho ho!
Feel the Christmas spirit and enjoy yourself with this limited-time DLC treat. Unlock the Porsche 911 Targa 4S, the Mercedes-Benz AMG GT S and the Dodge Viper ACR, plus a load of resources to accelerate and boost your drive to become a Legend!

This pack contains:

- 220,220 Credits

70050000031805.name: Dead by Daylight: Portrait of a Murder Chapter
70050000031805.description:
Behold the Portrait of a Murder. The Dead by Daylight Chapter includes a new Killer – The Artist – and a new Survivor, Jonah Vasquez. The new Forsaken Boneyard Realm will be opened for all players. Purchasing this add-on also unlocks an exclusive cosmetic for Jonah: The Crimson Shirt. 

The new Killer is The Artist. Carmina Mora’s surrealist paintings were both compelling and controversial. After a brutal encounter left her maimed, The Artist was taken by The Entity. Twisted into a grotesque vessel of vengeance, she turned anyone in her path into carrion for the flock. Screams will fill the Forsaken Boneyard, a surreal nightmare drawn from her dark imagination. The new Survivor is Jonah Vasquez. Deciphering math equations and the secrets within was second nature for the seasoned codebreaker. Now, he sees the ominous truth at every turn. A formula pointing to a haunting reality beyond comprehension. But as Vasquez knows better than most, there’s strength in numbers.

70050000031822.name: My Friend Peppa Pig: Pirate Adventures
70050000031822.intro: It’s a pirate’s life for Peppa and you! Open the door to new places and faces, including Danny Dog’s party and Captain Hog’s hunt for treasure. And try over 30 more new interactions,
70050000031822.description:
More of your favourite characters are coming to Peppa’s world – and they have exciting adventures to share with you! So open the door to new places, new faces, and more ways to play in My Friend Peppa Pig: Pirate Adventures.

Let’s set sail on this very special pirate adventure where you can ride aboard Captain Hog's boat and hunt for hidden treasure! Explore new locations such as Molly Mole's underground burrow, or visit Belinda Bear’s house for breakfast! 

There's a whole world of new stories to experience, from dancing at Danny Dog's birthday party to play pretend on Treasure Island! Along the way, you can try activities like hula hooping, flying a kite, raising a pirate flag, talking with Polly Parrot, and over 30 more new interactions.

Your adventure awaits – what will you and Peppa Pig do next?

BECOME A PIRATE – Danny Dog’s party is the start of a treasure hunt across the sea!

 PLAY IN NEW WAYS – Buzz like a bee, find a fossil, play with seashells, and try over 30 more interactions 

FIVE NEW LOCATIONS – Including Captain Hog’s Hideout, Belinda Bear’s House, Treasure Island and more

70050000031849.name: Elyrion
70050000031849.intro: The mysterious Elyrion defend their woodland homes with colorful magic and the ferocity of fire-breathing dragons!
70050000031849.description:
Elyrion is Polytopia’s second Special Tribe! Emerging from isolation in a mystical forest, the Elyrion will stop at nothing to uncover the magical secrets of the Square. The Elyrion are known for surrounding themselves in the magic of the forests, using their powers to lure woodland denizens to their Sanctuaries for profit, bargain with awesome dragons, and enchant animals into soldiers to help them fight.

Unlike the other tribes, the Elyrion have a unique style of gameplay. First, the Elyrion get markers in the Fog of War showing where ruins are, meaning they don’t need to scout as much for them. Also, the Elyrion consider nature divine, and their worship of nature prevents them from deforestation for a quick profit or hunting animals for food. Instead, the Elyrion  can build Sanctuaries, which will provide resources based on the amount of adjacent animals. The Elyrion are also unable to harvest whales for resources, and instead will use their magic to transform them into the fearsome Navalon, which can obliterate a navy single handedly! In addition to whales, the Elyrion can enchant animals in their territory into Polytaurs, which can be used to supplement an army or work as part of an early game rush. Lastly, the Elyrion don’t get Giants, but get flying Dragons, instead, which must grow up from an egg before they can be used.

If you like tribes that are against the grain from what you’re used to, or you simply want to fly on the back of a majestic Fire Dragon, then the Elyrion are the tribe for you!

70050000031850.name: Polaris
70050000031850.intro: The Polaris have lain trapped in the far reaches of the freezing tundra for eons with the power to expand their unnatural icy terrain farther than the weather permits.
70050000031850.description:
Polaris is Polytopia’s third Special Tribe! From the frozen wastes emerge the Polaris, servants of the mysterious Gaami, who are hellbent on freezing the Square into a new frigid paradise. Imbued with icy powers granted by their overlords, the Polaris construct adorable Mooni, freeze the waters, shatter their foes, and diligently work their way toward an unforeseen fate...

Unlike the other tribes, the Polaris have a unique style of gameplay. Their most prominent trait is their ability to freeze terrain, transforming the land and water into frozen versions, and replacing terrain features with their own. Due to being able to transform water into ice, the Polaris do not have access to a navy, and are instead given replacements, the Battle Sled and Ice Fortress for Ships and Battleships, respectively, which can effortlessly skate across the ice. Instead of beginning the game with a Warrior, the Polaris start with a Mooni, an adorable ice construct which can freeze adjacent terrain or nearby units, rendering them helpless until they thaw. The Polaris replace their normal Archers with Ice Archers, which deal no damage but freeze units from a distance. The Polaris also replace their Giants with Gaami, physical avatars for their extradimensional masters, which can instantly freeze nearby terrain and bring an entire army to its demise. Lastly, due to not having waters or ports, the Polaris replace their Customs Houses with the singular Ice Bank, which provides stars based on the amount of frozen terrain on the Square.

The Polaris take everything you know about naval combat and throw it out the window, as their lack of a navy means that they’ll have to get creative when conquesting over the seas. Using Mooni and Gaami in conjunction can stop an opposing navy from even leaving the harbor! The ice will grant the Polaris forces movement bonuses and allow for their sleds to operate, which are designed to defend the land they’ve frozen. Freezing the terrain will also provide the Polaris with an income, should they acquire their Ice Bank. Freezing a unit will stop it completely, preventing actions such as movement or counter attacks, allowing Polaris forces to destroy opposing units with impunity.

Polaris Features:

* Send the Square into an eternal winter with the magic of the Polaris!

* Build adorable Mooni and spread the snow far and wide!

* Skate on the ice with the formidable Battle Sleds!

* Construct Outposts to help your people navigate the ice and snow!

* Reap the rewards from the Ice Bank!

* Fortify your borders with Ice Fortresses!

* Use Ice Archers to freeze your opponents solid for easy kills!

* Study under the tutelage of the mysterious Gaami!

* Bring about a new ice age from which the Square will never recover!

If you like tribes with incredibly powerful ice magic that freezes their foes, or simply want to spread a world-wide Winter Wonderland, then the Polaris are the perfect tribe for you!

70050000031851.name: Cymanti
70050000031851.intro: The Cymanti are a group of Polytopians who moved to the swampy forests and learned to live with the Ciru Bug, which attaches to their faces and merges with their brains
70050000031851.description:
Have you ever felt that the cute denizens of the Polytopian world needed more bugs in their lives? Well, you’re in luck, because the Cymanti have come from the heart of the wetlands to infest the Square through the power of gigantic bugs and poisonous fungus! 

The Cymanti are a breakout group of Polytopians who moved to the swampy forests long ago and learned to live in symbiosis with the incredible Ciru Bug, which attaches to their faces and merges with their brains! These bug-loving Polytopians cultivate fungus that they use to feed their population and defend themselves from invaders! Led by a mystical Shaman, the Cymanti train gigantic bugs, use their enemies to fertilize their fungi farms, and bathe their foes in crippling poisons to vanquish all who would threaten their marshy home!

Cymanti Features:

* Bring the horrors of brutal insectoid warfare to the Square!

* Outfit massive bugs for war!

* Douse your opponents in a steady stream of sickening poisons!

* Grow fields of toxic fungi, fertilized by the corpses of your enemies!

* Unleash nimble Hexapods for hit-and-run tactics!

* Create bridges of Algae that let your units walk on water!

* Release huge swarms of flying venomous Phychi!

* Create huge Centipedes that can grow and span over several tiles!

* Splash armies with toxins through long-range bombardment from the Exida!

* Tame the mighty Doomux which can EXPLODE into a cloud of toxic death!

* Release the hydrophilic Rachi to decimate an enemy armada!

* Defend your cities with the exceptionally hardy Kiton!

* Boost your already formidable forces with the magic of a Shaman!

* And much, much more!

No need to wish you were just a fly on the wall, you can buy the creepy, crawly Cymanti right now!

70050000031872.name: Cyber Clock

70050000031884.name: Keys to the Museum
70050000031884.intro: Discover and solve fascinating 3D puzzles full of mystery and play with all controller modes!
70050000031884.description:
Machinika Museum is a mystery game where you discover beautiful and mysterious alien machines in an atmospheric, galaxy-spanning 3D puzzle game.

STORY
In a distant future, finding machines from unknown civilizations is not unusual, especially in a museum dedicated to them. Your job is to receive these devices and to understand how to repair them. 
But this time, something is different. You have not been given any information, and this seems to be rather urgent... What are these machines? Who sent them? Why won't anyone give you any answers? You will have to find for yourself which secrets and stories are hidden behind these mechanisms.

KEY FEATURES
•	Fully intuitive and playable controls: play however you want
•	Mind-bending Puzzles: use your sharp logic skills and your sense of observation
•	Mysterious sci-fi atmosphere and story: there is so much to unveil…
•	Wonderful visuals – cryptic alien machines have never looked better
•	Up to 3 hours of gameplay and mystery

CONTROLS
Machinika Museum has been fully optimized and adapted to give you the best playing experience. You can choose to relax and explore the game on your TV using one Joy-Con like a remote controller. Not playing on a TV? You can always put your Nintendo Switch on a table and play. Need to be mobile? The standard Handheld mode will give you what you need. Finally, if you are looking for precision and fluidity, the Touchscreen is the ideal mode.
To top it all off, you can switch from one control mode to another on the fly…

Welcome to the Museum!

70050000031885.name: PJ MASKS: HEROES OF THE NIGHT - MISCHIEF ON MYSTERY MOUNTAIN
70050000031885.intro: Battle mischievous Munki-Gu, explore new areas in high-speed Rovers, and team up with martial arts hero An Yu in three new PJ Masks missions!
70050000031885.description:
Mischievous Munki-Gu is up to monkey business – and only the PJ Masks, with help from martial arts hero An Yu and their speedy new Rover vehicles, can stop him!

Munki-Gu doesn’t care if he thwarts the PJ Masks or other night-time villains… he just loves causing mayhem wherever he goes! So it’s time for an adventure deep within Mystery Mountain, on three exciting new missions. Hop on your sleek new Rover and race through the narrowest caves and streets. Search for mystical objects in the Bamboo Forest, the Secret Cave, and ancient battleground The Pagoda. And call on your new ally An Yu, holder of the Magic Staff and protector of Mystery Mountain, when you need assistance in a tight spot or a boss battle!

Catboy, Owlette, and Gekko have never faced a villain like this before. Can you step into their famous PJs and become Heroes of the Night?


•	EXPLORE LOST WORLDS – Take on three new missions in the Secret Cave, Bamboo Forest, and The Pagoda

•	GO SUPER FAST – The PJ Masks’ new Rover vehicles zoom through tight tunnels and caves

•	MONKEY AROUND – New villain Munki-Gu makes mischief everywhere. But heroic An Yu will help you save the day!

Once again, your favourite party of unlikely heroes are in a bit of a pickle: arrested by the Dungeon's Fund, they have to accomplish a dangerous mission to earn back their freedom.
 Join them in their new adventure across time and discover the secret behind the construction of the wackiest of dungeons, the dreaded Dungeon of Naheulbeuk.

 Prepare to fight the nefarious - and drowzy - cult of Dlul, the God of Sleep, to prevent the world from being stuck in an Eternal Nap. Even worse: if you don't succeed, you could lose all your XP and your loot!

Features:
	- Play through 4 brand new story chapters (half as much as the original game!)
	- Discover new legendary items and skills!
	- Help your characters become stronger, up to lv16
	- Perfect your tactics with new gameplay mecanics
        - Lots and lots of chickens!

・Yukemuri TamaOnSen / TamaOnSen / Original Song: Walking the Streets of a Former Hell

・Solar Sect of Mystic Wisdom　~ Nuclear Fusion / Demetori / Original Song: Solar Sect of Mystic Wisdom　~ Nuclear Fusion
・An Unconscious Requiem / Shinra-Bansho / Original Song: Youkai Girl of Hartmann

■6 Challenge Stages

・Lv6 Marisa's Success Story (The fear is oneself)

70050000032114.name: Rento DEEP Board
70050000032114.intro: Play Rento in bigger 2 level deep board with many new properties
70050000032114.description:
Rento Deep Board is a special map extension to Rento game, in which you play on two levels (inner and outer).

Subways
When you land on an owned subway station, the game moves your pawn to the inner circle, in which you can enjoy more lands, gifts and two new companies.

4 Companies
The game now has Hospital, Internet, Electricity and Water companies.
When you own 1 company, every player who lands on your company pays you  dice sum multiplied by 4
When you own 2 companies, every player who lands on your company pays you dice sum multiplied by 10
When you own 3 companies, every player who lands on your company pays you dice sum multiplied by 25
When you own 4 companies, every player who lands on your company pays you dice sum multiplied by 50

13 land colors
Rento Deep Board adds 4 new color groups, which allow many players (up to 8) to play on all 13 lands, which makes the game so much more fun.

Multiplayer
As always, this map is multiplayer enabled so you can play it online with your friends and family (or in solo/pass to play modes)

Everyone can play it
Even if you don't own this DLC, you can still play on this board, but will have to wait for someone to create such room (and then you can join it for free).

Cheers

This is the Way.  Play as the iconic characters from the hit series The Mandalorian Season 1.  Travel around the galaxy as The Mandalorian protecting Grogu at all costs. The character pack includes:
- The Mandalorian 
- Cara Dune
- Greef Karga
- IG-11 
- Kuiil

70050000032323.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: Solo: A Star Wars Story Character Pack
70050000032323.description:
Experience the galaxy with the characters from the prequel "Solo: A Star Wars Story." Play as the young scoundrels and blast your way through the epic saga. The character pack includes:
- Han Solo (Young)
- Chewbacca (Young)
- Lando (Young)
- Qi'ra
- Tobias Beckett
- Enfys Nest

70050000032324.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga Classic Character Pack
70050000032324.description: Play as the classic LEGO variants of Luke, Leia, Han, Lando and Darth Vader in LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga. Explore the galaxy as iconic characters based on the original LEGO® minifigures from 1999.

70050000032325.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Character Pack
70050000032325.description:
It takes an unlikely band of heroes to save the rebellion.  With their blasters, a staff, a heavy repeater cannon, and more, these heroes (and a villain) are ready for battle. The character pack includes:   
- Jyn Erso 
- Cassian Andor
- Baze Malbus 
- Bodhi Rook
- Chirrut Îmwe
- Director Krennic
- K-2SO

70050000032326.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Bad Batch Character Pack
70050000032326.description:
Be a clone unlike any other.  The elite Clone Force 99, also known as The Bad Batch, each have their own exceptional skills making them a formidable crew. The character pack includes:  
- Hunter
- Echo
- Wrecker
- Tech
- Crosshair

70050000032327.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Mandalorian Season 2 Character Pack
70050000032327.description:
Get into more action with the fan-favorite characters from Season 2 of the hit series "The Mandalorian." Play as Ahsoka Tano, Anakin Skywalker's former padawan with her dual lightsabers, and Boba Fett with his recovered armor.  The character pack includes:  
- Ahsoka Tano 
- Bo-Katan Kryze
- Boba Fett (Re-armored)
- Fennec Shand
- Moff Gideon

70050000032328.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga Trooper Pack (Preorder)
70050000032328.description:
Pre-order now to get day one access to the Trooper Pack. Play as the soldiers of the Empire from Rogue One: A Star Wars Story, Solo: A Star Wars Story, and The Mandalorian. 
- Imperial Death Trooper 
- Incinerator Stormtrooper 
- Range Trooper 
- Imperial Shoretrooper 
- Mimban Stormtrooper

70050000032329.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga Trooper Pack
70050000032329.description:
Play as the soldiers of the Empire from Rogue One: A Star Wars Story, Solo: A Star Wars Story, and The Mandalorian. 
- Imperial Death Trooper 
- Incinerator Stormtrooper 
- Range Trooper 
- Imperial Shoretrooper 
- Mimban Stormtrooper

70050000032330.name: LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga Classic Obi-Wan Kenobi
70050000032330.description: Get the digital version of LEGO® Star Wars™: The Skywalker Saga and enjoy playing as Classic LEGO Obi-Wan Kenobi character based on the original minifigure from 1999.

70050000032521.name: Prison Architect - Perfect Storm
70050000032521.description:
Prison Architect: Perfect Storm makes it rain with grants, emergency services, staff training, and Calamities. 

Key Features:

Riot Before the Storm - “Calamities,” like Deep Freezes, Heatwaves, Rat Infestations, and Lightning Storms can cause structural damage, lower prison ratings, and wreak havoc in the compound.

Come Cell or High Water - Pest Control, Plumbers, Repairmen, and Road Maintenance Emergency Services are available for immediate relief from calamities. Electrician, Cold Control, Fire Safety, First Aid Training, and Pest Removal training allow staff to mitigate damage and keep things running smoothly.

Granted Refuge - Grants for Disaster Relief, Heatwaves, Emergency Protocol, Subsidence, Advanced Staff Training and Utility Retrofit Grant fund much-needed preparations to help ride out Calamities. 

Raining Rats and Dogs - Check current and forecasted weather conditions, and use weather prediction objects, to stay apprised of any impending disasters.

70050000032534.name: WRC 10 Subaru Impreza WRC 1997
70050000032534.intro: Get behind the wheel of the legendary car driven by Colin McRae and Nicky Grist in 1997, and relive their victory at the Rallye Sanremo in the same year.
70050000032534.description: The 1997 Subaru Impreza WRC driven by rally legend Colin McRae is certainly one of the most iconic cars of the past 50 years of the World Rally Championship. In this car, Colin McRae finished as runner-up in 1997, behind the Finn Tommi Mäkinen, who was also driving a Subaru Impreza WRC. With its iconic blue colour, this spectacular car is instantly recognisable. The DLC also includes an additional historic event for Anniversary mode: the Rallye Sanremo, won by Colin McRae and Nicky Grist.

70050000032535.name: WRC 10 Arena Panzerplatte SSS
70050000032535.intro: Experience the acclaimed German WRC super special stage Arena Panzerplatte at 1:1 scale, famous and loved for its surface changes and many hazards!
70050000032535.description: Following the roads of a military tank training base, Arena Panzerplatte is one of the WRC's most iconic super special stages. Reproduced at 1:1 scale, it has also been a favourite special stage among WRC players in recent years. Traction is a constant challenge because of the frequent surface changes, while the many hinkelsteins – huge concrete slabs lining the road – leave drivers with no room for recovery if they crash.

70050000032536.name: WRC 10 Mitsubishi Lancer Evo V 1998
70050000032536.intro: Take the wheel of the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo V driven by Tommi Mäkinen, WRC World Champion in 1998, and relive his victory at the Rallye Sanremo in the same year.
70050000032536.description: The winning car of the manufacturers' title in 1998, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo V also gave Tommi Mäkinen his third drivers' title. He won four rallies with this car in 1998, including the Rallye Sanremo, which is included in the DLC as an Anniversary mode event for WRC 10.

70050000032537.name: WRC 10 Career Starter Pack
70050000032537.description: Start your career with 6 Crew cards available immediately to help you build your crew and lead you to victory. The DLC also includes a pack of exclusive graphics to create your own livery!

70050000032542.name: Death's Gambit: Afterlife - Ashes of Vados
70050000032542.intro: Death’s Gambit: Afterlife - Ashes of Vados serves as an epilogue to Death’s Gambit’s epic story with new features and play modes galore.
70050000032542.description:
Death’s Gambit: Afterlife - Ashes of Vados serves as an epilogue to Death’s Gambit’s epic story with new features and play modes galore.


New Boss Fights: A new boss encounter against Ash will continue the main story - defeating him unlocks a drastically different and more challenging heroic version of this boss encounter where the player will face off against the "The Eldritch Hand"

New Platforming Challenge: Halls of Cruelty will test your reflexes and platforming skills in a grueling new level

New Combat Arena: Test your endurance in the new Horde mode fighting wave after wave of enemies

Boss Rush: The new Boss Rush mode allows you to fight all the game’s bosses back to back in normal or heroic

New Game Modes: Randomized Items (receive a random item with every pickup), Heroic Forced (all bosses are fought in heroic mode), Madness Mode (all equipped items except weapons get destroyed upon dying) and Fink Mode (Fink will ambush you at various points throughout the game)

New Rewards: Completing the Ash boss fight, Halls of Cruelty, Boss Rush mode and arena challenges grants all new items

70050000032543.name: Furi - Onnamusha
70050000032543.intro: New fighter, new skills, new challenge!
70050000032543.description:
Rediscover Furi with the Onnamusha Rider:  a powerful fighter that alternates between two stances: fast and agile or slower but lethal, until she's able to unleash the devastating power of the Star. 

A completely unique and redefining way to play Furi!

70050000032551.name: "Felyne Stealth Hood" Hunter layered armor piece
70050000032551.intro: Hunt in style with this special layered armor!
70050000032551.description:
Hunt in style with this special layered armor!

After purchasing, speak to the Courier and select Add-on Content to receive the content. You will then be able to use it in the Layered Armor Settings menu of the Item Box.

Note: This item is cosmetic only and does not confer any status benefits.

70050000032552.name: "Pretty Present" Cohoot outfit
70050000032552.intro: Dress up your Cohoot pet with this special outfit!
70050000032552.description:
Dress up your Cohoot pet with this special outfit!

After purchasing, speak to the Courier and select Add-on Content to receive the content. You will then be able to use it in the Change Clothes section of the Pet menu.

Note: This item is cosmetic only and does not confer any status benefits.

70050000032553.name: "Special Stickers 8" sticker set
70050000032553.intro:
Cohoots are so cute! Too cute? Hoot, hoot!
Have fun communicating with other players using stickers!
70050000032553.description:
Have fun communicating with other players using stickers!

This add-on contains:

"Special Stickers 8" sticker set
Cohoots are so cute! Too cute? Hoot, hoot!

After purchasing, speak to the Courier and select Add-on Content to receive the content. You will then be able to use it in the Chat menu.

70050000032582.name: Ghostrunner: Project_Hel
70050000032582.intro: Welcome to the future. It's gonna kill you.
70050000032582.description:
"Dive into the brutal and violent story of Hel, the Ghostrunner boss, in the upcoming DLC, Project_Hel.
Fight your way through Dharma Tower to crush the Climbers' rebellion. Beat new levels, defeat new bosses, experience a brand-new story, and play as a new brutal character. Remember, if it moves, it can be killed.
"

70050000032587.name: Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak
70050000032587.description:
The world of Monster Hunter Rise gets bigger and deeper with this massive expansion featuring new monsters, new locales and more!

Note: You must own Monster Hunter Rise in order to play this expansion. Sunbreak content is accessible after completion of the 7-star Hub quest “Serpent Goddess of Thunder”.  If you purchase this content while the game is open, you must restart the game in order to access the content.

70050000032592.name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE: SUNBREAK Bonus Add-on Content
70050000032592.intro: MONSTER HUNTER RISE: SUNBREAK Bonus Add-on Content
70050000032592.description: Includes the "Loyal Dog Costume" Palamute layered armor set and "Striped Cat Costume" Palico layered armor set.

70050000032598.name: Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak Deluxe Kit
70050000032598.intro: Enjoy a bundle of great additional content!
70050000032598.description:
Enjoy a bundle of great additional content:

• "Dragonsbane" hunter layered armor set
• "C Hound" Palamute layered armor set
• "F Devout" Palico layered armor set
• "Take Aim" gesture set (4 gestures)
• Fight Pose Set (3 poses)
• "Elegant Eyes" makeup
• "Fluffy Curls" hairstyle

Note: Layered armor is a "skin" which changes the appearance of the character without affecting their stats and abilities. The additional content included in this Deluxe Kit is the same as that included in the Deluxe Edition. Monster Hunter Rise required; can be used without purchasing Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak.

70050000032602.name: Pirate City
70050000032602.description:
Ahoy Captain!

We would like to inform you that the Pirate City DLC, full of adventures and mystical secrets, is moored at the docks of the Nintendo Switch™!

We're sure that years spent at sea have left their mark on you. Endless fights with pirates and sea monsters, the struggle for survival, the loss of the ship and crew members... But it's time to relax!
Get off the ship, forget about the battles for a little bit, and relax in the pirate city! The DLC adds a long awaited feature: the ability to build and develop your own settlement. Get ready to provide your new home with proper defenses, do favors for fellow traders and be generously rewarded, set out in search for missing people, and punish a thief among your crew. Sounds like some great adventures are waiting for you, captain!

*Develop your own settlement
As a savvy manager, you can transform your village into a thriving city. Become the richest and most famous pirate of all the time!

*Find a mysterious ship
Legend tells of a sinister ship, roving the ocean for countless decades. Capture it, and you'll have a choice of 4 extra decorative figureheads: wolf, tiger, bear, and lion. Do you have the courage to uncover its dark secrets?

*Buy a share in any shop
Improve your financial situation so you can invest even more funds in your city. Let your city stand out from others!

*Become a champion in the battle arena
We're introducing a land battle arena! Now the only one you can rely on during the fight will be yourself. Will you be able to survive the battle against pirates and resurrected skeletons?

70050000032606.name: Cozy Grove: New Neighbears
70050000032606.description:
Word of your legendary scouting deeds has spread throughout the spirit world... and that means more ghosts want your help. The "New Neighbears DLC" adds four new ghost bears, each featuring lengthy personal stories and no long waits between their requests. Bring peace to Cozy Grove's original bears to unlock these special visitors from afar!
 
 The New Neighbears DLC also features:
 - A new critter type, butterflies, to catch and collect during the Spring and Summer seasons.
 - Unique new clothing that you'll automatically receive upon purchasing the DLC
 - A new song added to the game's soundtrack.
 - Bonus: some free expansions for your clothing closet, as an extra "thank you" for supporting us with your purchase.

70050000032611.name: Experience x3 - Sword of Elpisia
70050000032611.description:
All characters' experience gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the Option section of the menu.

70050000032612.name: Damage x2 - Sword of Elpisia
70050000032612.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the Option section of the menu.

70050000032613.name: No Skill Cost - Sword of Elpisia
70050000032613.description:
Skills no longer consume MP / AP in battles.
Settings can be changed in the Option section of the menu.

70050000032619.name: Jeopardy! PlayShow: College Championship
70050000032619.description: A fierce competition featuring colleges from across the country! The Jeopardy! College Championship promises to be a competition like you’ve never seen before.

70050000032638.name: Deluxe Up Grade Kit
70050000032638.intro: Introducing DLC that includes three-player Mahjong, three-player Hanafuda, Shisen Mahjong Solitaire, and additional Shogi problems.
70050000032638.description: Try your hand at different ways to play in this downloadable set available for a special price! This set includes the  popular three-player Mahjong (Standard/Kansai/Kyoto rule sets), the fun and exciting 3-player Hanafuda, brain-crunching Shisen Mahjong Solitaire, 500 one-move Shogi problems, and 150 three-move Shogi problems.

70050000032670.name: VOCALOID Pack 6
70050000032670.intro: A new pack featuring 10 Vocaloid songs, navigators, and avatars!
70050000032670.description:
A DLC pack for GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!! that includes 10 Vocaloid songs, navigators, and avatars!

This pack includes the following content.
■Song Pack (10 songs)
・Kokoro / Toraboruta
・Double Lariat / Ago Aniki
・Ametokusari / otetsu
・Crazy ∞ nighT / Hitoshizuku×Yama△
・Dreamin Chuchu / emon
・Positive Dance Time / konoshita
・Good-Bye Declaration / Chinozo
・The Vampire / DECO*27
・Groove Groove melo-melody♪ / konoshita
・???(Secret)

■Navigator
・Luka Megurine *with voice
・Una Otomachi(GuruGuru) *with voice
・Rin Kagamine(GuruGuru) *with voice

■Avatar
・LUKA MEGURINE(V4X, 2D)
・Una Otomachi(Positive, 2D)
・RIN KAGAMINE(Positive, 2D)
・Una Otomachi(Guruguru, 2D)
・RIN KAGAMINE(Guruguru, 2D)

*Some content will be unlocked via missions after downloading.

70050000032672.name: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers Rise of SH1FT3R - Arctic Challenge
70050000032672.intro: Become a cool combat racer with four Arctic-themed circuits - Snow Stadium, Forest Hazard, On Thin Ice, and Undisclosed Heights – plus new drivers, vehicles, and spy gear.
70050000032672.description:
Take your combat racing career to cool new places, with the Fast & Furious: Spy Racers Rise of SH1FT3R: Arctic Challenge DLC – including four sub-zero new tracks, most-wanted characters, new vehicles, and spy gear that will give you the edge! 

Get ready to drift and slide around Snow Stadium and Forest Hazard, get a grip and avoid spinning out On Thin Ice, and brave the mountainous terrain of Undisclosed Heights! Drive as the secretive Ms. Nowhere or bionic-armed villain Matsuo, and put their powerful Energy Screen and Laser Cannon spy gear in your arsenal. And, drive new vehicle styles inspired by the Universal Pictures and DreamWorks Animation series Fast & Furious: Spy Racers, including Tony Toretto’s Ion Thresher. 

>  Cool new tracks – Test your skills on four Arctic-themed circuits 
>  New playable characters – Race as Ms. Nowhere or Matsuo and use their vehicles and spy gear 
>  New vehicle skins – Ride with new styles for Tony, Layla, Echo, and Cisco-Frostee 


The Fast & Furious: Spy Racers Rise of SH1FT3R: Arctic Challenge DLC contains: 

>  4 tracks: Snow Stadium, Forest Hazard, On Thin Ice & Undisclosed Heights 
>  2 drivers and vehicles: Ms. Nowhere & Matsuo 
>  2 spy gear items: Energy Screen & Laser Cannon 
>  4 vehicle skins: Ion Thresher (Tony), Astana Hotto (Layla), Hyperfin (Echo) & Rally Baja Crawler (Cisco-Frostee)

70050000032678.name: METALLIC CHILD x Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin Crossover Custom 'Kokorowa'
70050000032678.intro:
METALLIC CHILD x Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin
[Science Fiction x Japanese Style] [Robots x Rice] [Outer Space x Mother Earth]
70050000032678.description:
The first DLC of METALLIC CHILD is a crossover with Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin!
An additional Kokorowa Custom with exclusive weapons!

-A robotic Kokorowa!
A Custom to dress up Rona like Kokorowa!
Kokorowa, always poised and dignified!

-Battle with finesse!
This crossover Custom also includes exclusive weapons.
Bring Kokorowa-style finesse to the battlefield of METALLIC CHILD!
Will the powers of enlightenment prove to stand against machines of the future??

-Look out for the changes in the field!
It's not just a matter of looks, many changes can be found in the field, so don't miss them!

-A fierce boss!
"Black Shadow" will be waiting for you as the Keeper.
But, wait! What's that on its sides?
An onslaught of melee and energy ball attacks!!

70050000032684.name: Seasonal Decorative Pack
70050000032684.intro: If you miss your favorite seasonal backgrounds and would like to have them permanently in the game, we have something for you!
70050000032684.description:
In the Seasonal Decorative Pack for Wingspan, you'll get unlimited access to the 7 seasonal backgrounds that have appeared in 2021, along with brand new matching avatars, only available with this pack! With this DLC, you will be able to play on your favorite background whenever you want to. Be it a winter background in the middle of summer or an Easter background in winter - you don’t have to wait for a specific season to use it; you are free as a bird and can choose what and when you want!

The package includes all-year-round access to the following backgrounds:
- Valentine's day
- Sakura
- Ramadan
- Easter
- Summer solstice
- Halloween
- Holiday

Only owners of the Seasonal Decorative Pack will be able to use the avatars below, which were previously unavailable in the game:

- Swans
- Green pheasant
- Lion
- Hare
- Rusalka
- Bat
- Reindeer

Choose your favorite background and avatar and have them always ready to use!

This content offers no advantage against other players. If you decide not to purchase the Decorative Pack, but you want to play with friends or other players who did buy the Decorative Pack, you will still be able to join a multiplayer game or server with them and enjoy the game. Seasonal backgrounds will also be available periodically, like before, for all players.

70050000032698.name: SOL CRESTA Dramatic DLC
70050000032698.intro: Experience another mode that unravels the mysteries of SOL CRESTA!
70050000032698.description:
Stand up, Sol Cresta, and take back the sun from the clutches of evil! The galaxy-sized SOL CRESTA Dramatic Mode has docked!

In SOL CRESTA's new Dramatic Mode, you'll unlock the secrets gone untold during Arcade Mode, like the true identity of the mysterious rival ship, the true motivations behind Mega Zofer's conquest of the solar system, and the hidden pasts of Yamato pilots Sho, Luna, and Dril. Watch them grow and mature during their desparate struggle against a universal evil, and see their true potential unleashed in this robust and lovingly crafted tale!

A Story That's Ready to Go Supernoval with Excitement!
・A parade of unique and expressive characters
・A story penned by Hideki Kamiya, the force behind Bayonetta and The Wonderful 101
・A dense Database filled with images of and information about every friendly and enemy character, ship, and device
・The continuation of the Cresta saga began with 80s classics Moon Cresta and Terra Cresta
・A story that unfolds differently from Arcade Mode, with a true ending that awaits the truly bold!

70050000032703.name: TamaOnSen Song Pack
70050000032703.description:
A masterful mixer who needs no introduction, TamaOnSen's original pack has arrived!
In addition to super-popular hits like "Uki Yomichi (feat. Ranko, Uten-Kekkoh)" and "Monosugoi Vibes de MARISA ga Monosugoi Rap (MASPA!! Remix)," Sanae Kochiya's VA Kanae Itoh sings the vocals on an original song: "Yururu Toumeido (feat. Sanae Kochiya [CV: Kanae Itoh], Rapbit)"!

This pack contains the following:

■6 songs
・Monosugoi Vibes de MARISA ga Monosugoi Rap (MASPA!! Remix)
・Uki Yomichi (feat. Ranko, Uten-Kekkoh)
・Amanojaku Reverse（feat.ｙｔｒ)
・Warabe Matsuri (feat. AO)
・Tairin no Soul (feat. AO, SBF)
・Yururu Toumeido (feat. Sanae Kochiya [CV: Kanae Itoh], Rapbit)

■6 Challenge Stages
・Lv5 Kappas (Warabe Matsuri (feat. AO))
・Lv6 A Fuss For Two (Uki Yomichi (feat. Ranko, Uten-Kekkoh))
・Lv7 Blue, Yellow, Red...then Green? (Tairin no Soul (feat. AO, SBF))
・Lv8 Gensokyo All Shaken Up (Yururu Toumeido (feat. Sanae Kochiya [CV: Kanae Itoh], Rapbit))
・Lv9 Who're You Calling "Weak"?! (Amanojaku Reverse（feat.ｙｔｒ))
・Lv10 An Awesome Spell Bubble and an Awesome Combo (Monosugoi Vibes de MARISA ga Monosugoi Rap (MASPA!! Remix))

* Internet connection required for purchase.
* Game must be restarted after songs are purchased in order to use them.

70050000032704.name: Character Pack Suwako Moriya
70050000032704.intro: Character Pack Vol. 1! Enter Suwako Moriya!
70050000032704.description:
The new character pack is here at last!

Our first installment contains the Highest of Native Gods, Suwako Moriya!
She has the ability to turn Blank Bubbles into the more user-friendly Awakening Bubbles, and she's got three special spell cards. She also comes with the popular song, "Mishaguji Empire"!

Pack contains the following:

■One character

Suwako Moriya

・Ability: Mix Awakening Bubbles among the Blank Bubbles

・Spell Cards
①Party Start: "Two Bows, Two Claps, and One Bow"
Change bubbles on the left side to red, and bubbles on the right side to blue.
②Divine Tool: "Moriya's Iron Ring"
Change opponent's bubbles to Blank Bubbles in a ring shape
③Native God: "Froggy Braves the Wind and Rain"
Bubbles in your Blank Bubble stock turn green right after your next shot.

■One Song
・Mishaguji Empire / Sekkenya

■1 Challenge Stage
・Lv.8 Suwako Moriya Enters the Arena!


* Internet connection required for purchase.
* Game must be restarted after purchase in order to use the purchased content.

70050000032705.name: The Blood Moon Expansion: Legendary Deck
70050000032705.intro: The Blood Moon shines brighter than ever before, bathing the land in an eerie sanguine glow. New creatures stir in the night, and the dark grows deadlier.
70050000032705.description:
Want to add some challenge to your next Talisman: Digital Edition adventure? With this Legendary Deck, you can increase the difficulty of cards you’ll encounter from The Blood Moon Expansion. This expansion replaces selected cards from the adventure deck of the Blood Moon Expansion, redesigned to offer extra challenge for hardcore Talisman players.

Please note: You need to have the original Blood Moon Expansion in order to use this Legendary Deck.

Changed by the Blood Moon, these creatures are stronger than ever, ready to pounce on unsuspecting adventurers who wander too far into the dark of the night.

Champions of the Moon, some creatures have been turned into hulking monsters who will only be defeated by the mightiest of adventurers.

By playing with this Legendary Deck enabled, your adventure cards will be replaced with new, more challenging cards. This includes cards providing less support, making surviving each night even more treacherous. All Legendary Deck cards also come with a shiny new look, to help you spot them as you play.

Purchasing this Legendary Deck adds it to your Talisman: Digital Edition collection. It is then available to choose in all game modes.

70050000032706.name: Touhou Eurobeat Pack Vol.2
70050000032706.intro: Vol. 2 of the popular "Touhou Eurobeat Pack" is here!
70050000032706.description:
The Touhou Eurobeat Pack was so popular last time, we've released a Volume 2! Enjoy a collection of Euro remixes that hold their own against Vol. 1!
The new artists for this volume include 3L's NJK Record
and chocofan, famous for their superfast Kouryuudou arrangements.

Pack contains the following:

■6 Songs
・No Life Queen [DJ Command Remix]
　 / SOUND HOLIC Vs. Eurobeat Union feat. Nana Takahashi
・Bloody Knife / A-One
・YORU NO KAZAGURUMA / CrazyBeats feat. HaNaTaN
・SUMMER ENERGY / Eurobeat Union feat. Aki(Honey Pocket)
・LUCKY CAT / chocofan
・Spring of Dreams / NJK Record

■6 Challenge Stages
・Lv5 Ice Fairy Waits For Springtime (Spring of Dreams)
・Lv6 Business is Booming! (LUCKY CAT)
・Lv7 Round-n-Round! (YORU NO KAZAGURUMA)
・Lv8 Gensokyo's Delicate Flowers (SUMMER ENERGY)
・Lv9 Go Home Shrine maiden
　(No Life Queen [DJ Command Remix])
・Lv10 Bloody Training!? (Bloody Knife)

* Internet connection required for purchase.
* Game must be restarted after songs are purchased in order to use them.

70050000032707.name: The Frostmarch Expansion: Legendary Deck
70050000032707.intro: A wind blows through the land of Talisman that chills adventurers to the bone. The Ice Queen has weaved new magic to bring an eternal winter. Will you be left frozen by her touch?
70050000032707.description:
Want to add some challenge to your next Talisman: Digital Edition adventure? With this Legendary Deck, you can increase the difficulty of cards you’ll encounter from The Frostmarch Expansion. This expansion replaces selected cards from the adventure deck of the Frostmarch Expansion, redesigned to offer extra challenge for hardcore Talisman players.

Please note: You need to have the original Frostmarch Expansion in order to use this Legendary Deck.

Given new power by the Ice Queen herself, the monsters of the Frostmarch are more threatening than ever.

Some of the deadly creatures that make up the Frostmarch have been given favour by the Ice Queen, granting them the ability to destroy any adventurer who stands in their way.

By playing with this Legendary Deck enabled, your adventure cards will be replaced with new, more challenging cards. This includes cards providing less support, making your journey through the Dungeon even more treacherous.

All Legendary Deck cards also come with a shiny new look, to help you spot them as you play.

Purchasing this Legendary Deck adds it to your Talisman: Digital Edition collection. It is then available to choose in all game modes.

70050000032710.name: The City Expansion: Legendary Deck
70050000032710.intro: The residents of the city lock up their doors at night, and don’t answer when anyone knocks anymore… the streets are meaner, and they aren’t as safe for the rich as they once were.
70050000032710.description:
Want to add some challenge to your next Talisman: Digital Edition adventure? With this Legendary Deck, you can increase the difficulty of cards you’ll encounter from The City Expansion. This expansion replaces selected cards from the adventure deck of The City Expansion, redesigned to offer extra challenge for hardcore Talisman players.

Please note: You need to have the original City Expansion in order to use this Legendary Deck.

Times are harder in the City, and everyone needs to make ends meet - so the shops have adjusted their prices to be higher.

Two of the creatures who stalk the roads of the city have been given strength and craft beyond the mightiest adventurers. Beware if you draw these cards!

By playing with this Legendary Deck enabled, your adventure cards will be replaced with new, more challenging cards. This includes cards providing less support, making your journey through the City even more treacherous. All Legendary Deck cards also come with a shiny new look, to help you spot them as you play.

Purchasing this Legendary Deck adds it to your Talisman: Digital Edition collection. It is then available to choose in all game modes.

70050000032713.name: The Sacred Pool Expansion: Legendary Deck
70050000032713.intro: The war between light and dark becomes even more ferocious. Each side is dedicated to eradicating the other, and those caught in the crossfire will have to fight to survive.
70050000032713.description:
Want to add some challenge to your next Talisman: Digital Edition adventure? With this Legendary Deck, you can increase the difficulty of cards you’ll encounter from The Sacred Pool Expansion. This expansion replaces selected cards from the adventure deck of the Sacred Pool Expansion, redesigned to offer extra challenge for hardcore Talisman players.

Please note: You need to have the original Sacred Pool Expansion in order to use this Legendary Deck.

The cards in the Sacred Pool have had an overhaul, making them deadlier to any adventurer unlucky enough to stumble across them.

A Champion has risen up for both the forces of light and darkness. Make sure you’re on the right side when you encounter these creatures, otherwise you’ll be sure to meet your end.

By playing with this Legendary Deck enabled, your adventure cards will be replaced with new, more challenging cards. This includes cards providing less support, making the battle between light and dark even more treacherous. All Legendary Deck cards also come with a shiny new look, to help you spot them as you play.

Purchasing this Legendary Deck adds it to your Talisman: Digital Edition collection. It is then available to choose in all game modes.

70050000032721.name: Zombie Army 4: Mission 4 - Damnation Valley

Can the deadhunters find their allies in time, or will the mountain take its toll?
Damnation Valley is the first mission in Death From Above, a chilling three-part Zombie Army 4: Dead War Campaign!
Ascend to new terrifying heights in this 1-4 player mission, complete with new sinister locations to fight through, collectibles, achievements and more! The Hell Cult may be defeated – but the terror lives on!

70050000032802.name: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
70050000032802.description:
Treachery in Beatdown City - Ultra Remix is the massive 2.0 update to Treachery in Beatdown City featuring all new enemies, attacks, levels, music, and more! Join Bruce, Lisa and Brad on a DLC add-on thrill ride that takes them into new depths of treachery against hordes of new enemies with all new levels of strategy. From angry tourists, obnoxious influencers, and washed up MMA fighters, all the way to the heart of evil, the ninja dragon terrorists themselves! The heroes are getting big upgrades as well, and you’ll unlock a bunch of new attacks and defensive options that will truly change the way you fight! 

• From piledrivers to backflip kicks and distance closing dashing strikes, Brad, Bruce and Lisa will all get gameplay redefining attacks. 

• Introducing fighting game favorites - rolls and parries - to the defensive arsenal. Use these wisely!

• Featuring a massive new cast of new enemies bringing all new weapons and elemental attacks which brings an all new level of difficulty and strategy to the fights. 

• Traverse all new levels, spanning big city blocks, tight offices, TV stations, subway stops, and more! 

• Find loads of new items to help you overcome enemies!

70050000032845.name: "SNOW MIKU 2022" Downloadable Content
70050000032845.intro: "SNOW MIKU 2022" downloadable content is now available! Solve puzzles together with SNOW MIKU!
70050000032845.description:
The new stages have SNOW MIKU themed eggs, birds, and berries! The birds in the puzzles are SNOW MIKU themed as well.  
Collect exclusive berries to find SNOW MIKU design birds and birds with special items! 

◆What is "SNOW MIKU"?

"SNOW MIKU" is the character who enlivens the wintery Hokkaido.

The design is based on "a pure white snow sculpture of 'Hatsune Miku,'" that was created for "Sapporo Snow Festival 2010." Since then, a "SNOW MIKU" festival using "SNOW MIKU" as a main character has been held in Hokkaido every year.

The costume design for "SNOW MIKU" is selected in an online competition on different themes every year.

Nowadays, "SNOW MIKU" has been serving as an ambassador for various events to enliven Hokkaido, and has collaborated with other characters and companies to this day.

* To use the download contents, you need to update to ver1.1.0.

70050000033129.name: NERF Legends - Stego-Smash Pack
70050000033129.description: Smash into the game with the NERF DinoSquad Stego-Smash blaster and custom suit  featuring awesome Stegosaurus detailing.  Load out with this spiked blaster and suit in both single player and multiplayer modes. The blaster and suit each come with 4 additional skin variations to customize your Stego-look! Upon downloading these items, they will be available from the customization menu.

70050000033132.name: NERF Legends - Rex-Rampage Pack
70050000033132.description: Take a major bite out of your opponents with the NERF DinoSquad Rex-Rampage blaster and custom suit featuring awesome T-Rex detailing.  Load out with this King of the Dinos blaster and suit in both single player and multiplayer modes. The blaster and suit each come with 4 additional skin variations to customize your T-Rex-look! Upon downloading these items, they will be available from the customization menu.

70050000033133.name: NERF Legends - Elite Blaster Combo Pack
70050000033133.description: Expand your arsenal with two powerful blasters - the NERF Elite Triad and the NERF Elite Strongarm. Additionally, this pack comes with a color-shifting iridescent skin and four unique blaster effects which can be applied to any blaster in the game, and you can load out with these in both single player and multiplayer modes.  Upon downloading these items, they will be available from the customization menu.

70050000033136.name: NERF Legends - Mega Thunderhawk Blaster
70050000033136.description: Unleash the NERF Mega Accustrike Thunderhawk blaster which can be used in both single player and multiplayer game modes.

70050000033137.name: UNO® Valhalla DLC
70050000033137.description:
Enjoy your favorite card game at the table of a warm Norse tavern, where clans, mead, and the desire for exploration mingle. Follow Eivor’s path to glory: explore, collect resources, battle against other players, and play all your cards to be worthy of Valhalla.

For the first time in UNO®, the board becomes part of the gameplay:

• Discard your cards wisely to travel across the board and collect precious cargo to unlock exclusive perks. 
• Collect cargo to engage in card fights with your opponents to slow them down and use your longboat to discard several cards at once. 
• Immerse yourself in the Viking fantasy: play your cards to the rhythm of the epic Assassin’s Creed® Valhalla soundtrack.

In UNO® Valhalla DLC, only true Vikings can claim the victory!

70050000033165.name: Pinball FX3 - Indiana Jones™️: The Pinball Adventure
70050000033165.intro: Relive iconic scenes from the movies in Indiana Jones: The Pinball Adventure, the 1993 Williams classic.
70050000033165.description:
Relive iconic scenes from the movies in Indiana Jones: The Pinball Adventure, the 1993 Williams classic.

Features:
- Indiana Jones: The Pinball Adventure combines a fan-favorite Williams machine with everyone’s favorite adventurer – enjoy the original music, sounds, rules, and look of the machine brought to the digital space for the first time.
- Relive the most iconic movie scenes like the escape from Castle Brunwald, the Rope Bridge standoff, and finding Marion on the Streets of Cairo.
- Experience the table just as you remember it, with true-to-life Pro Physics simulation, only found in Zen’s Pinball tables.
- Enjoy the table in a new way with extra 3D effects in the ‘Enhanced’ version that includes side wall art, ball trailer effects, particle effects and a whip-wielding Indiana Jones.
- Play at home, with friends, or compete online with Single Player, Local Multi-Player, Challenge, and Tournament Modes.

70050000033168.name: Legend of Keepers: Feed the Troll
70050000033168.intro: Including new master, new monsters, new game mechanics and more!
70050000033168.description:
This DLC includes:

- Shaman master
- 5 missions
- 3 Conjurations to choose from when getting a Promotion including a passive and two random spells.
- 10 Spirits monsters
- Exclusive game mechanics: Sun and Moon Blessings giving passive abilities to Spirits monsters. Each Blessing is also increasing a specific type of damage for every monsters.
- 3 traps
- 5 artefacts

70050000033188.name: Dead by Daylight: Sadako Rising Chapter
70050000033188.description:
From the depths, a dark presence stirs. Spread the curse to Dead by Daylight, with a new Chapter inspired by Kōji Suzuki’s novel Ringu and the original film adaptation. Sadako Rising features a new Killer – The Onryō – and a new Survivor, Yoichi Asakawa. Purchasing this add-on also unlocks an exclusive charm: Cursed Videotape. 

The Killer is Sadako, The Onryō. With immense powers and a fearsome temper, Sadako was left to perish in a watery grave. Her violent wrath manifested into a cursed videotape that condemns its viewers to a chilling fate. No stranger to Sadako’s fury is Yoichi Asakawa, whose young life was forever altered by The Onryō’s rage. Now a marine biologist, his story continues as his search for answers drove him through treacherous waters, deep into a realm beyond rational understanding.

70050000033198.name: FM Synthesis style BGM pack
70050000033198.description:
This is the "FM Synthesis style BGM pack" that can be switched in the game.

After purchasing the pack,
you can switch the BGM from below 2 styles.

"PSG Style" - the default one
"FM Synthesis Style" - included in this DLC

70050000033199.name: Zombie Army 4: Weapons Bundle
70050000033199.description:
Sten MK2 SMG Bundle
Bomb Lance Shotgun Bundle
7.65mm Polizeipistole Pistol Bundle
Black Ice Weapon Skins

70050000033200.name: Zombie Army 4: Mission 7 - Terminal Error
70050000033200.description:
You may have taken down an Undead Zeppelin, but the fight never ends in the most expansive Zombie Army 4 campaign mission yet! Battle through a massive, open-ended area as you discover the destination of a horrifying transmission – a mysterious base on the Italian coast! Can the squad put a stop to these sinister machinations, or will the coast claim another victim?
Terminal Error is the first mission in Return To Hell, a haunting three-part Zombie Army 4: Dead War Campaign!
Explore a terrifying new location in this 1-4 player mission, complete with new enemy types, collectibles and more! You might have defeated the terror of the skies – but the dead don’t die!

70050000033201.name: Zombie Army 4: Mission 8 - Abaddon Asylum
70050000033201.description:
Abaddon hope, all who enter the asylum! The nefarious Baron Umbra has been revealed as an occult mastermind, and hidden away in heavily fortified cultist territory! The only way in…is through the catacombs, lead by a survivor known only as ‘The Angel.’ Can the Resistance reach the asylum, stop the Baron and put an end to his evil? Or will the catacombs get a few extra corpses!
Abaddon Asylum is the second mission in Return To Hell, a haunting three-part Zombie Army 4: Dead War Campaign!
Explore a terrifying new location in this 1-4 player mission, complete with terrifying enemies, collectibles and more! You may have survived a damned facility – but the dead don’t care!

70050000033202.name: Zombie Army 4: Mission 9 - Return to Hell
70050000033202.description:
It’s time to finish this! Learn the sinister secrets that set the Zombie apocalypse in motion and venture deep into Hell itself as you sprint to rescue a fallen ally from a fate worse than death – a space known only as the Void. Will the forces of the occult have their final victory, or will the bell toll for them?
Return to Hell is the third and final mission in Return to Hell, a horrifying three-part Zombie Army 4: Dead War Campaign!
Explore the realm of the damned in this new 1-4 player mission, complete with horrifying enemies, collectibles and more! You’ve come this far, but can you live through hell itself?

70050000033203.name: Zombie Army 4: Left 4 Dead Bundle
70050000033203.description:
This Character Pack contains 8 Characters* ;
• Bill
• Francis
• Louis
• Zoey
• Coach
• Ellis
• Nick
• Rochelle
*Please note that the Left 4 Dead Characters do not come with character voices, players must select a pre-existing voice in order to play as these characters.

70050000033204.name: Zombie Army 4: Undercover Marie Bundle
70050000033204.description:
In the French Resistance, Marie was a master of disguise! She could infiltrate any party, take out her targets and get out without anyone ever noticing. Of course, in an undead apocalypse disguises aren’t really necessary – but who’s going to tell her? 

Undercover Marie Outfit
Zombie Headgear Pack
M1934 Pistol Bundle
Elemental Weapon Skins
Zombie Charm Pack

70050000033205.name: Zombie Army 4: WW1 Josiah Bundle
70050000033205.description:
Play as Josiah, dressed in his WW1 outfit!

Josiah’s past is something of a mystery – but as a young man he served in the First World War, and still has the uniform to prove it. These garbs are what remains of his service – a time he’d rather put behind him.  

WW1 Josiah Outfit
WWII Headgear Pack
MP.1940 SMG Bundle
Zombie Tank Weapon Skins

70050000033206.name: Zombie Army 4: Herman Wolff Werner Bundle
70050000033206.description:
Clearly one of those people who can’t walk by a hat without trying it on (even if it’s mysteriously covered in blood), Werner discovered this uniform in a Resistance safe house. Judging by the personal effects in the pockets, he senses something of a kindred spirit in this fellow deadhunter, one Captain Hermann Wolff.

Herman Wolff Werner Outfit
Horror Headgear Pack
Flare Gun Weapon Bundle
Van Helsing Weapon Skins
Horror Charm Pack 2

70050000033207.intro: 10 original songs, including Grated songs composed by Massive new krew and Shohei Tsuchiya are now available! With navigators and avatars!
70050000033207.description:
A DLC pack for GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!! that includes 10 songs, navigators, and avatars!

70050000033208.name: Zombie Army 4: Desert Rat Shola Bundle
70050000033208.description:
Shola sports khaki shorts and sandy accoutrements inspired by various British divisions, including the Desert Rats, famous for their role in the North African Campaign. It might seem like a recipe for a grazed knee but the shorts and rolled sleeves are perfect for the hellish climate…

Desert Rat Shola Outfit
MAB 38 SMG Bundle
Zombie Wrapped Weapon Skins
Story Charm Pack

70050000033209.name: Zombie Army 4: Occult Karl Bundle
70050000033209.description:
With occult symbols shining on his deathly pale skin, something nasty flowing in his veins, and hollow eyes glimmering with an ominous light – you might say Karl’s had something of a glow-up, but you’d be dead wrong.

Occult Karl Outfit
Strange Brigade Headgear Pack
Blowtorch Weapon Bundle
Bandages Weapon Skins
Tarot Charm Pack

70050000033210.name: Zombie Army 4: Mission 5 - Alpine Blitz
70050000033210.description:
They’ve escaped Damnation Valley, but can the deadhunters survive this brand-new Zombie Army 4 campaign mission? Fight your way through a zombie-infested train carrying precious cargo, but beware – a zombified zeppelin is en route to lay waste to the track! Can you get to a nearby Resistance airfield for help, or will the high-flying terror get there first? 
Alpine Blitz is the second mission in Death From Above, a chilling new three-part Zombie Army 4: Dead War Campaign!
Ride the rails of fear itself in this 1-4 player mission, complete with new sinister locations to fight through, collectibles, achievements and more! The Hell Cult may be defeated – but the terror lives on!

70050000033211.name: Zombie Army 4: Mission 6 - Dead Zeppelin
70050000033211.description:
The resistance airfield might have been saved, but a killer Zeppelin is still on the loose! The deadhunters’ only option is to chase that damned dirigible back to its lair and send it back to whichever Hell it came from! Will you make it on time, or will more of the living fall to its horrifying weaponry?
Dead Zeppelin is the third mission in Death From Above, a chilling new three-part Zombie Army 4: Dead War Campaign!
Buy now and take to the terrifying skies in this 1-4 player mission, complete with new sinister locations to fight through, collectibles, achievements and more! The Hell Cult may be defeated – but the terror lives on!

70050000033214.name: Zombie Army 4: Gentleman Hector Bundle
70050000033214.description:
A gentleman’s duties never end – even in death! From time to time, Hector does his best to boost morale in the Resistance by putting on his full dress uniform – a stylish getup complete with a full suite of medals!

Zombie Gentleman Dress Uniform Character
Halloween Headgear Bundle
Lee No. 4 Bolt-Action Rifle Bundle
Occult Ritual Weapon Skins
Halloween Charm Pack

70050000033215.name: Zombie Army 4: Berserker Boris Bundle
70050000033215.description:
While Boris is usually stoic and dry, sometimes he needs to unleash his primal side. After escaping the Gulag into a zombie-infested wilderness, he became a zombie killing wildman, doing whatever it takes to survive!

Berserker Boris Outfit
SVT-38 Rifle Bundle
Holiday Season Headgear Bundle
Holiday Weapon Skins
Holiday Season Charm Pack

70050000033216.name: Zombie Army 4: Night Ops Jun Bundle
70050000033216.description:
Jun is skilled at moving quickly and quietly, all while exhibiting deadly efficiency. In this outfit – complete with beanie, black sweater and face paint - she’s all set for demo squad night ops!

Night Ops Jun Outfit
Nagant M1895 Pistol Bundle
Toxic Hazard Weapon Skins
Horror Charm Pack
Bucket Headgear Bundle

70050000033217.name: Zombie Army 4: Armour Plated Shola Bundle
70050000033217.description:
Shola has put her blowtorch to deadly use! Repurposing old Armoured Giant and assorted metal pieces into a scrappy suit of armour, she truly has an iron heart!

Armour Plated Shola Outfit
Classic Sports Headgear Bundle
Grease Gun SMG Bundle
Armoured Giant Weapon Skins
Sports Charm Pack

70050000033218.name: Zombie Army 4: Afrika Karl bundle
70050000033218.description:
Karl’s ready to turn up the heat! Sometimes you need military attire that is a little more…breathable. Decked out in his Afrika outfit, Karl’s ready to break a sweat while breaking necks!Karl’s ready to turn up the heat! Sometimes you need military attire that is a little more…breathable. Decked out in his Afrika outfit, Karl’s ready to break a sweat while breaking necks!

Afrika Karl Outfit
Desert Damaged Weapon Skins
M1903 Springfield Rifle Bundle

70050000033273.name: Curious Expedition 2 - Highlands of Avalon
70050000033273.description:
The Highlands of Avalon DLC features a brand new island type (the Highlands) with new tile types, items, locations, enemies, recruitable characters and more. Once the DLC is activated it will expand possibilities across the entire game, both in Campaign Mode and Director Mode.

Full feature list:

New island type: Highlands, with a completely new set of tiles, a new game mechanic related to traversing hills and valleys, a new tribe called the Picts and a new artwork for shrines

8 new Recruitable characters: Grail Knight, Precious Clydesdale (horse), Kobolds (3 variants: Bard, Scoundrel, Shaman), Picts islanders (3 variants: Spiritual Druid, Pictish Outrider, Tattooed Warrior)

4 new Enemies: Stone Golem, Kobolds, Lake Serpent, Black Wolves

6 new Locations: Giant Horn, Wishing Well, Pointing Statue, Wild Kobolds, Lake Serpent, Precious Clydesdale Herd

7 new pieces of Equipment: Pictish Spear, Pictish Crossbow, Bag Pipes, Legendary Blade, Magnifying Glass, Cuirass, Armoured Boots

6 new Items: Granola bar, Fairy Stones, Kobold Ear Wax, Stone Fragment, Bird call, Sea Monster scale

4 new Levels to unlock at the Royal Avalon Society Explorer Club in Paris, giving access to 1 Recruitable character and 3 pieces of Equipment

70050000033275.name: The DioField Chronicle Early Purchase Bonus Content
70050000033275.description:
■The DioField Chronicle Standard Edition Early Purchase Bonus Content
・Weapon: Rhopasto Knife (Standard Edition Early Purchase Exclusive Colour)
・Accessory: Recruit's Bangle
※The same items cannot be obtained while progressing through the game. 
Early Purchase Bonus Claim Period: Until December 31, 2022

70050000033279.name: Yaga: Roots of Evil
70050000033279.description:
Oakvale - a village under siege by corrupted beasts. The fleeing refugees suspect Leshy, the forest spirit, and wish to have him destroyed. The Woodsman thinks otherwise and comes to our hero, pleading for a more peaceful way.

Will Ivan bow to the anger of the people, listen to the Woodsman's plea or decide Leshy's fate all on his own?

Find out if he's strong enough to defeat the festering corruption, while also crossing paths with vibrant characters such as the fabled Kuma Lisa, the Trinket Kid and Gigi the Loan Shark inside sidequests of their own.

70050000033282.name: Character Unlock Key (Kimetsu Academy Tanjiro Kamado)
70050000033282.description: This unlock key allows immediate access to play as Kimetsu Academy Tanjiro Kamado in Versus mode.

70050000033289.name: Om Nom: Delicious Dots
70050000033289.intro: Connect the dots in 20 new boards and discover hidden images featuring the world's cutest monster!
70050000033289.description:
Had fun discovering characters hidden in the sets of dots? Follow the dots as Om Nom follows the candies and discover more:
• 20 more dots puzzles to connect
• Lovely characters from Om Nom Toons series
• Simple and fun!

70050000033290.name: Om Nom: Tasty Toons
70050000033290.intro: Watch additional 49 episodes about Om Nom’s adventures with this DLC!
70050000033290.description:
Continue watching episodes from the life of the cutest green monster! 5 more seasons to enjoy:

SEASON 2 will take you traveling in time to the most exciting eras.

In SEASON 3 Om Nom leaves the house and goes on an adventure to explore the world. 

SEASON 4 is all about Magic!

During SEASON 5 our curious green monster is traveling around the world.

SEASON 6 follows Om Nom’s video blog!

70050000033291.name: Om Nom: Sweet Coloring Pages
70050000033291.intro: Get 36 more pictures with Om Nom to color with this DLC!
70050000033291.description:
Put some color into Om Nom stories!
• 36 new pictures to color
• 6 narratives: Jungle Adventure, Backyard Activities, Joyful Room, Relaxing Picnic, Playground Fun, Forest Trip
• Various characters to discover

70050000033292.name: Om Nom: Flavorful Puzzles
70050000033292.intro: Discover 16 more jigsaw puzzles to assemble in this DLC with the Cut the Rope character!
70050000033292.description:
Enjoyed Om Nom’s adventure in Toons? You will surely like this DLC:
• 16 new jigsaw puzzles
• Stories seen in Om Nom Toons
• Various puzzle complexity: 8-150 pieces each
