  He will join your group when you clear his Divine Paralogue.
・ Emblem Soren has been added.
  He will join your group when you clear his Divine Paralogue.
・ Emblem Camilla has been added.
  She will join your group when you clear her Divine Paralogue.

《Support Items》
  These include the following consumable items and materials:
・ 5 novice books, 3 adept books, 1 expert book, 1 silver sword, 1 silver lance, 1 silver axe, 20 silver ingots, 5,000 bond fragments, and 30,000G.
  Note: You will receive these the first time you visit the Somniel after Chapter 5.

《New Accessories》
  These include the spirit set, spirit mask, spirit ears, dog ears, bunny ears, and fox ears.
  Note: You will receive these the first time you visit the
  boutique after Chapter 6.

70050000039031.name: DLC Wave 3
70050000039031.description:
Adds Veronica, Chrom and Robin Emblem characters to your team, giving you even more ways to Engage.

Release date: 3/7/2023
This DLC contains the following contents:

《Additional Emblems》
・ Emblem Chrom (with Robin) has been added.
    They will join your group when you clear their Divine Paralogue map added after chapter 7.
・ Emblem Veronica has been added.
    She will become available after clearing her Divine Paralogue map added after chapter 7.

70050000039032.name: DLC Wave 4
70050000039032.description:
Experience a brand-new story called the Fell Xenologue in Wave 4. Meet new characters and complete the story to unlock them (and new classes) in the main game. Conquer even more battles as this gripping tale unfolds.

Release date: 4/4/2023
This DLC contains the following contents:

《New Story》
The Fell Xenologue will be added. It's a separate story from the main game and is comprised of several chapters and introduces new characters.
*After completing Chapter 6 of the main game, you'll be able to exchange items at the ancient well on the Somniel and start the Fell Xenologue. 

《New Allies》
After completing the Fell Xenologue, not only will allies which appeared in the Fell Xenologue join you in the main game and fight by your side, you'll be able to have support conversations with them at the Somniel too.

《New Classes》
Two special classes will be unlocked and it will be possible to change to these classes by using a special item.
・Enchanter
・Mage Cannoneer

70050000039075.name: The Good Life - Behind the secret of Rainy Woods
70050000039075.intro: 12 brand new quests with the residents of Rainy Woods. YEAH BABY!
70050000039075.description:
Elizabeth is alive, and no one remembers what happened in the GODDAMN HELLHOLE, that is Rainy Woods.
It's time to find out what’s really going on… And maybe enjoy some time in the countryside along the way.

Take on a slew of new side quests from the residents of Rainy Woods and come across some new faces along the way. Help them learn photography! Cook together! Set up secret dates! Save someone’s life...?

Note: Some side quests included in the "Behind the secrets of Rainy Woods" DLC can only be played after clearing the main story. For more details on how to unlock each DLC side quest, please refer to the official PLAYISM page for The Good Life.

Plus the addition of Noah Gragson’s no. 16 car for Kaulig Racing and legendary driver Bill Elliott. 70050000039130.name: Fitness Boxing 2: EDM Workout

70050000039130.description:

All songs also allow you to record your own gameplay footage with the video recording option.

70050000039131.name: Fitness Boxing 2: Rock Workout
70050000039131.intro: Rock your workout with more original music for the Fitness Boxing 2: Rhythm & Exercise game!*
70050000039131.description:

All songs also allow you to record your own gameplay footage with the video recording option.

70050000039132.name: Fitness Boxing 2: Nature Stages
70050000039132.description:
Nature-themed backgrounds have been added to the Fitness Boxing 2: Rhythm & Exercise game!* Try them out when Stage Animation is set to "Light."

Jab and cross in 3 added backgrounds** inspired by the great outdoors! 

Float above a peaceful lake reflecting the sky in "Lagoon." Take in the trees in "Forest"—you can almost feel the fresh air. Enter a pristine, white snowscape in "Snowfield."

The backdrop of nature can be your virtual gym as you exercise (and relax) with these added backgrounds.

● Heartwarming scenes from daily life of diverse families
● Happy homes of your fluffy friends: dogs, cats, mice, rabbits and bears
● Calming daily chores such as cooking, cleaning and gardening

…and many more!

70050000039169.name: Coloring Book: Vehicles
70050000039169.intro: Are you ready to race? Warm up the engine and tune your dream vehicle with 29 new pictures to color!
70050000039169.description:

● Sport cars, motorcycles, quads and bikes
● Motorboats, ships and yachts
● Planes, helicopters or even a tank

…and many more!

70050000039171.name: Purple Fur
70050000039171.intro: Kong got himself dirty once again. Help him escape for as long as possible.

70050000039180.name: Coloring Book: Costume Party
70050000039180.intro:

to color!
70050000039180.description:

● Pirates, cowboys, firefighters and policemen
● Sweet princesses and their gallant knights
● Elves and other fantastical creatures

…and many more!

70050000039181.name: Banana
70050000039181.intro: Enjoy your new headgear for the cow with the newest DLC.
70050000039181.description: Fly through levels with your new banana.

70050000039186.name: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT + A NEW POWER AWAKENS SET - BARDOCK - Alone Against Fate
70050000039186.intro: BE THE HOPE OF THE UNIVERSE
70050000039186.description:
Experience the story of Goku's father, Bardock, who fought alone against his fate in this New Story Arc!

This is the story of one who stood alone against the scum of the universe. Bardock, warrior of Saiyan race, spent his days invading planets with his fellow soldiers. But an incident on Planet Kanassa would bring to his attention a calamity set to befall his home, Planet Vegeta.

The DLC includes:
- New Story Arc
- New Super Attacks
- New Soul Emblems
- Others

*BARDOCK- Alone Against Fate can be played without clearing the Main Story.

70050000039187.name: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT + A NEW POWER AWAKENS SET - 23rd World Tournament
70050000039187.intro: BE THE HOPE OF THE UNIVERSE
70050000039187.description:
Experience the story that leads to the main plot of DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT and the 23rd World Tournament, where many upheavals took place! This additional scenario allows you to enjoy DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT even more.

Three years have passed since the battle with King Piccolo plunged the world into terror. Goku, who has grown into a young man, is confronted by Ma Junior, the reincarnation of King Piccolo. Ma Junior had entered the Tenkaichi Budokai (World Tournament) to take revenge on Goku, who had destroyed him in the past. The fight for the fate of the world and the title of Tenkaichi (top of the world tournament) begins now!

The DLC includes:
- New Story Arc
- New Super Attacks
- New Soul Emblems
- Others

*The content can be played without clearing the Main Story.
*This product is also included in Season Pass 2. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.

70050000039188.name: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT + A NEW POWER AWAKENS SET - Goku's Next Journey
70050000039188.intro: BE THE HOPE OF THE UNIVERSE
70050000039188.description:
A story beyond DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT's main story...experience the final episode of the DRAGON BALL Z anime!

10 years have passed since the epic battle with Majin Buu. Goku is about to participate in the World Tournament for the first time in a while when a mysterious boy named Uub appears before him. He is the reincarnation of Majin Buu and an opponent Goku has been looking forward to!
Uub, who still doesn't know how to use his Ki or how to fly, grows up during the fight and begins to compete with Goku on equal footing. How will the match between Goku and Uub turn out?

The DLC includes:
- New Story Arc
- New Super Attacks
- New Soul Emblems
- Others

*The content can be played without clearing the Main Story.
*This product is also included in Season Pass 2. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.

70050000039205.name: Train Life - Supporter Pack

- A handcar, doubtless the most efficient form of rail transport ever invented

A DLC for every player who wants to do a little bit more to support the game and our team!

70050000039209.name: Train Life - 1920's Orient-Express Train
70050000039209.description:

The 1920's ORIENT-EXPRESS TRAIN DLC contains: 
- The Orient-Express train of the 1920s, operated by the Compagnie Internationale des Wagons-Lits
- The 231C Nord steam locomotive
- The historic route of the Orient-Express train, from Paris to Vienna
- 6 exclusive scenarios in which you are at the controls of the Orient-Express train
- 2 new cities: Strasbourg and Vienna

70050000039372.name: DREDGE - Blackstone Key
70050000039372.description:
The mysterious workshop on Blackstone Isle is locked tight. Inside are otherworldly creations, products of cruel machinations by the previous occupants. Now they lie idle and abandoned.

With this key you can put them to some use.

This grants access to the following items:

Arterial Engine
The bony blades of this grotesque engine are driven by a pulsing heart. It beats in time with your own.

Sign of Ruin
A symbol of the deep is carved into this small talisman. It's sure to draw the attention of those attuned to it.

70050000039373.name: DREDGE - Custom Rod
70050000039373.description:
Give yourself an advantage with this improved starting rod. You'll start the game with this stylish piece of equipment, decorated with the company colors of its creator. But it's not all just looks. Unlike other equipment you might find in DREDGE, this rod is in reasonable condition and should allow you to get the edge on other anglers - for a while at least.

This grants access to the following item:

Custom Rod
This rod replaces the normal starting rod when beginning a new save. It can catch fish more effectively than some other rods of its size.

70050000039724.intro: The nation of Sarkoris was destroyed by the demons, yet the last of its people is ready to fight back. Explore a new region, and fight new enemies... And maybe even find new love!
70050000039724.description:
Meet Ulbrig Olesk, one of the last scions of the shattered nation of Sarkoris. Armed with the ability to transform into a mighty griffon, he can become a formidable warrior in your party, a trustworthy friend — and maybe even more.

●	New playable class with 6 archetype variations. Become a shifter and use animal aspects and forms to decimate your enemies with the fury of a wild beast!
●	New companion for your party: a Sarkorian tribal chief who has mysteriously survived the ravaging of his homeland.
●	A brand-new, previously unavailable area, which you will be able to explore with your new ally, fight new enemies, and uncover some old secrets.

Fluffy white clouds against an indigo sky make a striking combination.

■Kanna's Kimono: Indigo Fiber

70050000039772.name: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia - The Rise of Evil
70050000039772.description:
Embark on a new adventure and delve deeper into the lands of Nostalgaia, with the arrival of The Rise of Evil DLC expansion. Go where the integrity of nostalgia, tradition, and progress converge, awaiting your heroism to mould the landscape anew. 

Stand against the onslaught of mighty adversaries, their imposing presence a testament to the fierce trials that await your fearless soul. 

Challenge the fabric of nostalgia, shattering the chains that bind progress, and unravel the mystery of its hold. Unearth the chilling tale of the fallen heroes entangled in the clutches of corruption as you unearth the missing fragments that eluded the old-fashioned ways of the past. 

- Get crafty in the all-new areas awaiting adventurers. 
- Obtain new armour and weapons like the Abomination Spear or the Degraded Shield  to aid in your quest.
- Face off against powerful new foes and epic new bosses
- Invite your friends to join you for free in multiplayer if you own this DLC 

The winds of destiny call out to you, beckoning you to rise above the mundane and embrace the extraordinary. Will you seize this epic adventure, forging your legacy as a harbinger of change, or shall the allure of the past bind you in shackles of stagnation? The choice, noble champion, is yours to make as you march towards the edge of eternity.

70050000040133.name: Monster Roadtrip Hitchhiker Pack - The Color Squad
70050000040133.intro: GET TO KNOW THE COLOR SQUAD ON THE ROAD!
70050000040133.description:
Amira Rashid is a fierce woman who's always ready to take on any challenge.
Oz is a nervous smol bean who's trying his best.
Vicky Schmidt is an energetic dork who's always ready to help other people.
Brian Yu is... just Brian -- and we love him because of it! Such a chill dude.

You've probably known them for a long time, but only as avatars for players to control. And yet... they're their own people too. They're fully fleshed-out characters with their own fears and dreams.

Haven't you ever wondered what they think and feel when they're not just playable characters?

This DLC turns the tables and brings these four beloved characters on as hitchhikers you can pick during your road trip. Thanks to their conversations, road events, endings, and deep conversations, you might get to REALLY know them in whole new depths.

Also... this character pack includes a brand new song. Warning: you may love it.

You've played as them; you've related to them; you've even become them... but are you ready to date them?

70050000040135.name: Wave 1 - Inkopolis
70050000040135.description: Make Inkopolis from the first Splatoon™ game your stomping (err...splatting?) grounds with the first wave of the Splatoon 3 Expansion Pass paid DLC*! Another major metropolis of the Splatoon universe, Inkopolis has changed a bit in the past several years with some new shopkeepers. Ready to jam? Then come to Inkopolis to see some fresh Squid Sisters performances during Splatfests**.

70050000040136.name: Wave 2 - Side Order
70050000040136.intro: Splat Into the Spire of Order!
70050000040136.description:
A new single-player campaign, Side Order, super jumps to Splatoon™ 3 in the second wave of this DLC*. Step into the role of Agent 8, a young Octoling who defected from the Octarians. See what’s become of Inkopolis Square, the central area featured in the Splatoon 2 game, and...hey, what’s Pearl doing here? And why is she a flying drone?

Splat your way up the Spire of Order, where you never quite know what each floor will bring. Build your Palette of color chips to expand your arsenal and abilities as you go. Each floor gets increasingly tough, but don't worry—Side Order is meant to be played through again and again. With each run, you'll acquire more Prlz (pronounced pearlz) to spend on permanent upgrades to make the next run a little easier. You'll need every edge you can get if you want to survive to the 30th floor!

70050000040137.name: Battle-boosting bonuses
70050000040137.description: When you purchase Splatoon™ 3 Expansion Pass, whether in advance or after launch, you’ll receive immediate access to additional in-game currency, plus food and drink tickets.

70050000040172.name: NINE TILES
70050000040172.intro:
In only 10 seconds to explain the rules,
everyone can have fun. Kids and adults!
This is a speedy-party-puzzle game.
70050000040172.description:
You can now play “NINE TILES” in “Let’s Play! Oink Games”

When playing with friends, as long as 1 person owns the game, the other players do not need to own it to play.

● NINE TILES
Move or flip over your 9 tiles as much as you want and try to be the fastest to rearrange your tiles according to the theme. The rules are simple enough, but if you don't pay attention to the pattern on the backside of your tiles too, you won't be able to complete you set smoothly. This is a speedy-party-puzzle game that is fun for all ages, from kids to adults!

- Supported Players: Offline 1-4 Players, Online/Local 1-8 Players (Playable with CPU opponents)

70050000040285.name: Dead by Daylight: Tools Of Torment Chapter
70050000040285.description:
Dreams are free. Innovation requires sacrifice. Dead by Daylight’s Tools Of Torment Chapter features a new Killer – The Skull Merchant – and two new Survivors, Thalita Lyra and Renato Lyra. The Shelter Woods Map has also been updated to include The Skull Merchant’s Hunting Camp. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 3 exclusive Cosmetics: The Skull Merchant’s Slipshod Prototype, Thalita Lyra’s Golden Ambition, and Renato Lyra’s Golden Touch.

The Killer is The Skull Merchant. Forever driven to hunt a worthy target, her reign is built on a mountain of bone. With eyes patrolling from above, her pursuit is relentless. Dead by Daylight: Tools of Torment also includes two Survivors – siblings Thalita and Renato Lyra. Once beloved pillars of the community, their kite-flying dreams came crashing down, swept into a blanket of nightmarish Fog.

70050000040328.name: Unmatched: Digital Edition - Baskerville Manor
70050000040328.intro: Unlock this DLC to get Baskerville Manor as a playable map for all your games!
70050000040328.description:
Baskerville Manor -  a home full of mystery and dangers – uses the secret passageways for a sneak attack!
This DLC unlocks a Baskerville Manor - map for both 1v1 and 2v2 games with a special "Secret Passages" rule.

Secret Passages:
Secret passages can be used by fighters to move quickly across the battlefield. Their occurrence depends on the map. These passages are indicated by the special icons on certain spaces. A fighter can move from one space with a secret passage to any other space with a secret passage as if they were adjacent.
Spaces with secret passages are not considered adjacent for any other purpose besides moving (e.g. fighters can’t attack through them).

70050000040493.name: Two Point Campus: School Spirits
70050000040493.intro: Tackle a paranormal pest problem, learn what it means to be dead, and help those looking for a new lease on the afterlife.
70050000040493.description:
Welcome to Lifeless Estate, where the usual eerie silence has been interrupted by signs of undead life.  The new lodgers are restless spirits, big on wailing and generous with the ectoplasm. No one knows how to die tastefully these days. Where's the subtlety? These are the dangers of jumping into anything, even death, uneducated.
Haunted by unwelcome and undead spirits, the estate needs your help for a new lease on the afterlife.

WHAT’S INCLUDED
•	A New Campus Location
•	2 New Courses 
•	2 New Fully Animated Classrooms
•	2 New Student Archetypes
•	A New Challenge Mode Level
•	And Lots Of New Items

NEW LOCATION

Lifeless Estate
The lawn may be lacklustre, and the surfaces strangely gooey, but all of the problems come back to the ghosts. You could say that possession is nine tenths of its flaws. There, I've said it. 
The last heir to the estate, Lady Lifeless had hoped to spend her after-years catching up with her reading and floating tastefully around the garden. Instead, her rest is routinely ruined by rude spirits with even worse table-manners.
Tackle the paranormal pest problem, learn what it means to be dead and help the estate rest, peacefully, once again.

NEW COURSES

Paranormal Detection
There was debate in the County for a number of years, surrounding the existence of ghosts. Thanks to science, that debate is now long finished: ghosts are a real and genuine nuisance. You can't wipe away the regrets and resentment of vengeful spirits, but now you can bottle them up… a bit like they did.

School Spirits
Being dead isn't as easy as everyone makes it seem. It's hard to rest in peace with a life & death's worth of questions on your mind. "Where am I?", "Why did I say that one thing when I was 24?", "Did I leave the oven on?" etc. Fortunately, you can learn anything in Two Point County, even how to be dead.

ALSO
• Expulsion Ceremonies - Have students cleanse a new area for campus construction by running an Expulsion Ceremony to remove the unwelcome spirit residing there.
• Hauntings - Some ghosts may haunt a specific room, causing unnecessary student suffering. Send in your trusty trained janitors to de-haunt the room and capture the ghost. 
• A brand new Challenge Mode level - train janitors and de-haunt rooms to capture as many ghosts as possible in a year-long battle with the dead.

70050000040578.name: Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning - Fatesworn
70050000040578.description:
After decades of conflict, the disastrous Crystal War has finally ended, and the Tuatha warlord Gadflow has been defeated. As the people of Amalur’s ravaged Faelands turn their gaze toward a welcome peace and the work of rebuilding, a new threat rises in the west… Beyond icy peaks and impassable cliffs lies the mountainous region of Mithros, an ancient Almain refuge offering new hope to settlers, refugees, and war veterans displaced by the fires of war. It is here that Telogrus, God of Chaos, has emerged to claim his mortal kingdom and tempt the people with promises of freedom from the shackles of Fate. Only one has the power to challenge the will of this risen god: you, the Fateless One.
 
Journey to a brand new Amalur environment filled with snowy tundras, deep caverns, and treacherous enemies, and visit mountain villages and the ancient lakeside city of Crownhold. Master the unstable power of Chaos with a unique new non-combat Skill and class of weapons and armor. As the fabled Fatesworn, you will wage a last battle against the Niskaru and their Chaos brethren, as Chaos dungeons turn every region in Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning into a potential battlefield.

The mysterious pathogen is mutating Xenomorphs and local wildlife on planet LV-895. It’s up to you and your fireteam to battle through a slew of mutated enemies and eliminate the source of the corruption

The Pathogen expansion brings all new environments, maps, weapons, and more to the AFE experience. Explore Engineer ruins around the mystery of the infection, delve deep into enemy hives, and avoid the deadly hazards around each corner. Do you have what it takes to survive?

70050000040924.name: Myths & Outcasts
70050000040924.intro: Explore your dark side with four monster classes, and four new races to add even more variety to your next dungeon dive!
70050000040924.description:
Each monster race has a signature class that human characters can also play as. These monsters are hated by humans, but they still seek to slay liches in the dungeons! Monsters can either be played as their signature class, or they can be played as any of the stock classes in Barony! Once you finish the game as a monster, you unlock its signature class for play as any race.
You can also just wear the monster skin as a costume without any gameplay changes if you prefer, and don't worry, you can still play with anyone who doesn't own the DLC.

The Skeleton requires a patient approach, which works since you don't get hungry!

The Conjurer starts with a new spell, allowing them to summon helpful allies who increase in power throughout the adventure.

The Succubus hates blessings and loves curses! She'll also start with some demonic powers.

The Mesmer has a staff, and eventually can learn a spell, which allows her to enlist the service of foes to protect her. Use your wiles to survive!

The Vampire can't eat normal food and must feed on blood instead! Vampires also start with vampiric powers!

Accursed adventurers have a voracious hunger, but also have increased speed and the ability to turn invisible. The Accursed must move quickly to survive.

The Goatman eats tin cans with no need for a tin opener, and can sniff out extra potions from fountains, which is great since they gain some unique buffs from certain brews!

The Brewer starts with a handy-dandy backpack which increases their inventory space. They also have an Alembic which allows them to brew powerful potions!

70050000040925.name: Legends & Pariahs
70050000040925.intro: Adds four specialized new classes and four new playable races, giving you access to unique playstyles for your adventures!
70050000040925.description:
Each monster race has a signature class that human characters can also select. Except for one, these monsters will be hostile with humans as they attempt to destroy liches in the dungeons! 

Monsters can either be played as their signature class, or they can be played as any of the stock classes in Barony. And once you finish the game as a monster, you unlock its signature class for play as any race!

The Automaton's doesn't need food, instead requiring fuel for their furnace to keep their boiler powered. They're also friendly with humans and some other races!

The Mechanist showcases the Tinkering skill. By using the Tinkering Kit, survive by building sentries and traps to dispatch foes.

Goblins can't memorize spells, and are unfocused in martial training. But they are resourceful with equipment, making them highly adaptable.

The Shaman learns unique spells as they level up, which allows them to shapechange into monster forms with versatile abilities and advantages.

The Incubus hates blessings and loves curses! He'll also start with some demonic powers.

With spells to abuse and confuse victims, the Punisher also frustrates foes with the whip, just out of reach.

Insectoids will eat anything, and they love sugar. They use Energy from food to power their spells instead of MP. Their wings also give them extra mobility powers!

Starting with a magic boomerang, and new quivers full of special ammunition, hunters are adept at tracking and killing enemies from a distance.

This DLC features an exciting local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70050000041039.description:

70050000041068.name: Cowboys and Critters DLC
70050000041068.intro: Embark on new Journeys, cook for real cowboys, and discover the legends of fearsome critters
70050000041068.description:
Get ready to blaze a trail with brand-new content in the Cowboys and Critters DLC! This exciting addition brings a wagon-load of fresh adventures for a true traveler to enjoy:

NEW JOURNEY—THE CHISHOLM TRAIL

● The year is 1867 and the cattle industry is booming; embark on a cattle drive up north from Texas, and see how many longhorns make it to Kansas!
● Take care of your cattle-herding trio of real-life cowboys: ""Cattle Queen of Texas"" Lizzie Johnson, Mexico-born, Comanche-raised Vicente Chisholm, and honored trail driver George Glenn.
● Traverse 10 all-new locations from the Spanish architecture of San Antonio to the river-dense trail in Oklahoma, to the prairies of Kansas.

COOKING FOR COWBOYS

● Expand your palate on the trail and cook up a storm in America's first food truck, the ""chuck wagon.""
● Feed a variety of hearty meals, from cornbread to grits, to the cowboys and keep them in peak condition.
● Hunt, gather, and fish for all-new ingredients, such as maize, offal and fish heads, to create your gastronomic specialties.

NEW QUEST—FORLORN HOPE

● A new path to California has been forged, getting emigrants there faster than ever before! But is it really the way of the future, or will it lead to one unfortunate party's demise?
● Follow the Donner-Reed Party's journey and maybe even help them along the way!   

NEW QUEST—HORSE CREEK TREATY

● Help the Lenape family get to Horse Creek in time for Black Beaver to carry out his role as interpreter during the proceedings.
● Defuse a tense encounter between Thomas Fitzpatrick and Mato Oyuhi before they meet for the final treaty signing.

NEW CHARACTER CLASS: COOK

● Cooks, also known as ""cookies,"" are arguably one of the most important roles on the trail, or at least the heart of the party.
● Equipped with the Spice Set as a starting item, every cookie is ready to spice up their next dish.
● Successfully complete the Chisholm Trail to unlock enlisting Cooks on other journeys.

NEW WAYPOINT! MYTHS, CRITTERS & LEGENDS, OH MY!

● Visit storytelling campsites and listen to tales of fearsome critters from folklore.
● Learn about 16 creepy critters, such as the venomous Hoop Snake and the fierce Hodag.
● Sit by the fire with Sarah Winnemucca as she shares stories from her own writings.

AND LOTS MORE! 

● NEW Achievements
● NEW pieces of Artwork
● NEW Characters

Note: You must own The Oregon Trail in order to play this DLC.

Ladies and Gentlemen!
Introducing "Hong Meiling" the gatekeeper of the Scarlet Devil Mansion! 
Utilize her Charge Shot ability with the R Button to increase her attack power! 
She's an aggressive character with unique spell cards!

70050000041380.name: Kao the Kangaroo: Bend the Roo'les
70050000041380.description:
Rules are meant to be broken, but rooles are meant to be played. Turning Kao the Kangaroo upside down, “Bend the Roo'les” is a whole new way to experience the neck-stretching, snoot-booping furry icon. It’s the only way you can bend all the rules without doing something illegal! You’ve never seen Kao like this before!

The Eternal Warrior may have been defeated, but the influence of the Eternal World remains! The largest—and grumpiest—of crabs has become infused with the power of the Eternal World. He seeks to use it to rid the island of all kangaroos and thus be able to indulge in his favorite hobby… sleeping. This power bestowed in the giant crab has granted him physical abilities that he uses to control all the crabs and small creatures around him to become… THE CRAB KING. 

Only Kao has what it takes to stand up to the click-clacking menace!  Will Kao be able defeat the Crab King?! Will the Enteral World ever be truly banished!?! Find it out in Kao the Kangaroo: Bend the Roo’les!

70050000041401.name: Devil Slayer Raksasi: Incarnation of Darkness
70050000041401.description:
The first lord of the Pavilion of Spirits passed away, and it fell under the control of the three of them. The Reincarnation Trials became radical and weird everywhere. Those scholars who were focused on research also began to feel uneasy, as if something uncontrollable was happening.

A hidden plane exists at the Pavilion of Spirits, the secret base of three mysterious persons. Countless arcane implements brimming with energy riddle the area. This plane is called the [Pavilion of Darkness], the Reincarnation Trial's greatest secret.

A mysterious person used an ancient technique to create eight beings from Soul Crystals. These beings became known as the Charim.

While possessing their original memories, the Soul Crystals have distorted the Charim into beings of pure hatred and violence. The trial they undergo within the dark dimension is known as the Incarnation of Darkness. Should a Charim grow powerful enough, they can break free and cross the boundaries between dimensions to exact the revenge they so vehemently seek.

[Incarnation of Darkness]
The Incarnation of Darkness DLC comes with its own difficulty level. Anything can happen as the difficulty intensifies; the possibilities are endless.

[8 Charim Characters]
These brand-new characters come with unique weapons and talents. They are mighty indeed. But with great power comes great responsibility—the trials they face are even more terrifying.

[16 New Relics]
As the Charim gains further strength, each will unlock 2 new relics for a total of 16.


The Reincarnation Trial to save the world is going in a strange direction, will it bring hope or destruction?

70050000041402.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Multiplayer Mode

This DLC features an exciting local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70050000041437.name: Ninjala Story Pack: Chapter Four
70050000041437.intro:

Complete ninja missions to earn a host of special items!
70050000041437.description:
Story Mode is a single-player mode that can be experienced offline.
Enjoy a tale of ninja intrigue told through dynamic graphic novel-style cut scenes and intense action-packed gameplay. In the action sequences, you'll battle sinister space ninja and perform other special missions. The final stage features a thrilling battle against a giant boss monster, testing your ninja skills to the max!
■ Special Items
The Ninjala Story Pack: Chapter Four will give players the opportunity to earn exclusive rewards not obtainable anywhere else.
■ The Story
Leonard suddenly appears before Genryusai with reports of treasure deep within the ancient ruins of Sphinx Valley.
Just around the corner, three young ninja eavesdrop on their conversation...
Join Kappei, Van, and Lucy as they race to Sphinx Valley to claim the treasure first!
But can this chaotic trio overcome the series of dangerous traps and enemies as they run deeper into the ancient ruins?

70050000041438.name: Serial Cleaners - Dino Park

70050000041656.description:
This is no place to make friends. Escape from imminent death, find the safe spot and push other sausages into the deadly beam! 
With this DLC you will get access to a new Laser stage in each local multiplayer mode.

70050000041658.name: Sausage Wars: Burning Death
70050000041658.intro: Have you ever played floor Is lava? It's almost the same, only deadlier.
70050000041658.description:
Wait for the right moment, push the sausage homies in the fire and watch them cook well. Just don't get roasted! 
With this DLC you will get access to a new Burning stage in each local multiplayer mode.

70050000041660.name: Run Sausage Run: Coins, Bugs and Chicken
70050000041660.description:
Three new sausages: Fly, Cockroach and Plucked Chicken
and 15,000 coins to unlock your favorites sausages with powerups.

70050000041663.name: Overwatch® 2 - Hero Pack
70050000041663.intro: Jumpstart Your Roster of Heroes and Dominate the Battlefield!
70050000041663.description:
This bundle includes: 

- 1000 Overwatch Coins 
- Instant Access to Sojourn, Junker Queen, Kiriko, and Ramattra 
- Instant Access to all Overwatch 1 heroes 
- 3 popular OW1 legendary skins 

Blackhardt Reinhardt 
Imp Mercy 
Nevermore Reaper 

With your Overwatch Coins, you can buy in-game cosmetic items to customize your heroes.

70050000041667.name: Pocket Pool: Adventure
70050000041667.intro: Explore new worlds and conquer new challenges!
70050000041667.description:
In this DLC you will get 25 new levels with five ancient cultures themes.
Rediscover pocket pool by exploring the entire world in mini scale.

70050000041671.name: Color Set
70050000041671.intro: Choose your favorite color set in the latest DLC.
70050000041671.description: You get 50 new colors for your cat's fur, backgrounds, and decorations.

70050000041678.name: Golf With Your Friends - Corrupted Forest Course
70050000041678.description: An unusual meteor strike has seeped corruption into our beloved Forest. Journey through the challenging 9-hole course and delve into the dark side of the woods. Can you complete the course under-par and earn the exclusive crown?

70050000041683.name: Golf With Your Friends - Horrifying Headgear Pack
70050000041683.description:
Transform your ball with supernatural energy and become fiends of the fairway with these 5 brand new animated hats. 

The Horrifying Headgear Pack pack includes the following customizations:

Fun Guy Hat
Thursday’s Friend Hat
Gothic Top Hat
Cursed Helm
Twisted Tentacle

70050000041688.name: Touhou Youyoumu Arrangements Pack Vol.2
70050000041688.intro: Phase 2 of the popular "Touhou Youyoumu Arrangements Pack” is here!
70050000041688.description:
"Touhou Youyoumu Arrangements Pack Vol.2" is a collection of popular arrangement tracks from the rhythm game including "What about progress?", "Necrofantasia ～Arr.Demetori" and more.
Enjoy all the lovely songs as good as vol.1!

A new artist has been added to this set: 
FULING CAT MARK!

This pack contains the following: 

■6 Songs
　・What about progress? / sumijun(Halozy) feat. nanahira(Confetto)
　・MARIONETTE METROPOLIS / FULING CAT MARK
　・Sissou Ensemble / beatMARIO(COOL&CREATE)
　・Genuineness Almeria / Shinra-Bansho
　・Fallen Cherry Blossom / Yuuhei Satellite
　・Necrofantasia ～Arr.Demetori / Demetori

■6 Challenge Stages
　・Lv.5 What's the progress now?! (What about progress?)
　・Lv.6 I'm not a waitress! (MARIONETTE METROPOLIS)
　・Lv.7 The fastest of all!(Sissou Ensemble)
　・Lv.8 Almeria (Genuineness Almeria)
　・Lv.9 Kanzashi (Fallen Cherry Blossom)
　・Lv.10 The doorkeeper proxy (Necrofantasia ～Arr.Demetori)

* Internet connection required for purchase. 
* Game must be restarted after songs are purchased in order to use them.

70050000041690.name: Super Mega Baseball™ 4 Peril Point Stadium
70050000041690.description: This cozy inlet town might seem quiet at first, but Peril Point can be downright terrifying when it comes to baseball pride. Step up to the plate and hit dingers in the shadow of a monstrous bridge, just across the cool, dark water from the looming specter of a retired naval cruiser.

70050000041691.name: Super Mega Baseball™ 4 Ciudad de Colores Stadium
70050000041691.description: A modern monument to baseball around the globe, Ciudad de Colores is a vibrant, colorful stadium filled with art that celebrates the joining of old and new in the heart of a massive city. Feel the energy as you step up to the plate and admire the excitement of the crowd, picture-perfect natural landscape outside its walls, and an atmosphere made for baseball.

70050000041692.name: Super Mega Baseball™ 4 Castillo Arena Stadium
70050000041692.description: Perched high above the waves, a centuries-old fort stands guard over an epic stadium known as Castillo Arena. But as players smash dingers over the historic ramparts and the fans yell their battle cries, the real battle is waged on the diamond.

70050000041693.name: Dessert DIY: Nasty ingredients
70050000041693.description:
Help customers with sweet revenge! Unlock mean ingredients and prepare desserts with a nasty surprise for the bad guys. 
With this DLC you will get cockroaches, ants, worms and many other disgusting things to put in your ice cream and popsicles!

70050000041695.name: Dessert DIY: Premium ingredients
70050000041695.description:
Do you want to satisfy the most demanding customers? Unlock prestigious ingredients and prepare desserts that pastry chefs never dreamed of! No VIP will leave your store disappointed.
With this DLC you will get rainbow cakes, salty pretzels, yummy jelly and many other premium things to put in your delicious desserts!

70050000041699.name: Pinball FX - The Machine™: Bride of Pin·Bot™
70050000041699.description:
Here comes the Bride! Awaken the Machine by activating her vocal circuits and eyes. Or go even further and bring her to life! A legendary table from the PIN-BOT trilogy.

Table Features: 

- Shoot the Shuttle Ramp to reach Metamorphosis
- Go for the 1 Billion point shot to join the Billionaire's Club
- Activate the PIN-BOT himself and score big on the mini-playfield
- Hit the Heartbeat Ramp 4 times for a huge combo

70050000041700.name: Sushi Assortment Recipe and Ingredients Set
70050000041700.description: Receive a recipe to make "Sushi Assortment."

70050000041701.name: Salt-Crusted Monster Meat Recipe and Ingredients Set
70050000041701.description: Receive a recipe to make "Salt-Crusted Monster Meat."

70050000041702.name: Rainbow Jam Recipe and Ingredients Set
70050000041702.description: Receive a recipe to make "Rainbow Jam."

70050000041703.name: Fruit Punch Salad Recipe and Ingredients Set
70050000041703.description: Receive a recipe to make "Fruit Punch Salad."

70050000041704.name: Tapioca Milk Tea Recipe and Ingredients Set
70050000041704.description: Receive a recipe to make "Tapioca Milk Tea."

70050000041729.name: Piczle Lines 2 Flora & Fauna
70050000041729.description:
"Flora & Fauna”adds the following puzzle packs to Puzzle Mode.
Flora			20 puzzles of sizes 36x50 to 50x49
Baby Animals 		20 puzzles of sizes 30x48 to 50x56
Safari			20 puzzles of sizes 50x31 to 48x54
Venemous Critters	20 puzzles of sizes 48x21 to 60x46

70050000041735.name: Unlock All Skins
70050000041735.description: "Unlock All Skins" grants you all the items in the game, including clothing, hairstyles and accessories!

70050000041740.name: TT Isle Of Man 3 – John McGuiness 100th Start Livery
70050000041740.description: Relive the legendary John McGuinness's 100th start with the perfect reproduction of the unique livery created for the occasion. For many riders and fans, John McGuinness, MBE, is considered one of the greatest racing legends: with 23 victories and 47 podiums,  he was the first rider to achieve an average speed of over 130 mph (209km/h) in 2007. This pack contains unique golden livery and an outfit celebrating John McGuinness's history with the TT Isle of Man.

70050000041754.name: Character Skin Pack
70050000041754.intro:
Customize your character!
Change up your look with over 20 different skins!
70050000041754.description:
The Character Skin Pack, the latest downloadable content for Party Party Time, is here!
Transform your character's appearance with over 20 different skins!
Get the party going with a fresh look!

The Character Skin Pack includes the following content:

[21 New Skins]
- 21 new skins to choose from in the Character Selection screen.

70050000041770.name: Forklift Extreme: Docks
70050000041770.description: Play 10 brand new levels and get special operator skin. Unique environment and challenges awaits!

70050000041773.name: The Wonderful 101: Remastered - The Wonderful One: After School Hero (Part 1)
70050000041773.intro: SUPER-DUPER-FUN SIDE-SCROLLING LASER SHOOTING ACTION!!! JOIN LUKA IN HIS JOURNEY TO BECOMING A FULL-FLEDGED HERO!
70050000041773.description:
Important note: The Wonderful One: After School Hero free DLC is divided in TWO parts. You will need to install The Wonderful One: After School Hero (Part 2) free DLC separately to play the second part of this experience. This DLC was made possible by reaching the stretch goal of our February 2020 crowdfunding campaign. We would like to extend our sincerest gratitude to the 33,199 amazing fans who supported us on this journey.


Get ready for a unique side-scrolling experience in the world of The Wonderful 101: Remastered! This free DLC lets you enjoy a brand new episode in which you experience Luka's story!

As the latest member of the CENTINELS, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

Thrilling SIDE-SCROLLING action
Jump into classic side-scrolling action with a PlatinumGames twist. Get ready for a super-exciting experience as you blast away a bunch of enemies with your awesome lasers!

Super-fun LASER shooting
Luka uses his trusty Stingy Eye goggles to shoot a variety of lasers that decimate his foes. Use the Right Stick to freely shoot lasers in any direction! 2-D shooting has never felt so simple, fun, and intuitive! You have three laser types at your disposal. Blast away, young recruit!

A variety of MODES to keep you enticed
Go hands-on with The Wonderful One: After School Hero in two different modes. The Arcade Mode lets you experience the story of how Luka became the full-fledged hero Wonder Goggles. The Challenge Mode lets you select and play any Drill of your choice. Try to clear all the unique missions set in each Drill and see if you can find some hidden areas on each stage. Re-play the game to your heart's content to explore every nook and cranny!

70050000041787.name: Extra Mission Pack
70050000041787.description: "Extra Mission Pack" is a collection of 4 additional game levels that extend the fun of "Theft Ride Legacy"!

70050000041789.name: Extra Color Pack
70050000041789.description: "Extra Color Pack" is a collection of additional motorcycle looks that makes the fun in "Theft Ride Legacy" more interesting!

70050000041791.name: UnderDungeon Soundtrack
70050000041791.intro: Enjoy the unique atmospheric soundtrack in the latest DLC.
70050000041791.description: Sink into the music of UnderDungeon at any time you want.

70050000041796.name: Decorations Pack 11
70050000041796.intro: It's time to return into the fantastic world of Clumsy Rush: Ultimate Guys.
70050000041796.description: Enjoy new decorations in the eleventh official DLC.

70050000041798.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival Shin Japan Heroes Universe Pack
70050000041798.description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

Includes:
Song: Crime and Punishment - Those who are unwilling to pray / YOKO TAKAHASHI
Easy★3 Normal★5 Hard★6 Extreme★7
Mini Characters: Godzilla, Evangelion Unit-01, Ultraman, Masked Rider
*Mini Characters can be used in My Room -> Outfits -> Mini Characters

Additionally, an exclusive background with Shin Japan Heroes Universe characters will be shown in 1-Player Taiko Mode when playing the song Crime and Punishment - Those who are unwilling to pray.

*This product is not compatible with Taiko no Tatsujin: Drum'n'Fun!
*This product is not available for online modes.
*The Mini Characters included in this product are not available for online modes.
*An internet connection and a Nintendo Account is necessary for use. A Nintendo Switch™ Online membership is not required.

70050000041799.name: Borderlands 3: Director's Cut
70050000041799.description:
Borderlands 3 gets even bigger with the Director's Cut add-on content! Test your mettle against the most fearsome of all Varkids, scour the galaxy to solve a string of murders, experience never-before-seen content and insights from the creation of Borderlands 3, and complete challenges to earn XP and score loot with three new Vault Cards that let you earn Borderlands 3 loot.
 
 What's New
 • Go toe-to-pincer with Hemovorous the Invincible, a gargantuan Varkid raid boss who drops some of the best loot in the game (provided you can actually kill her)
 • Visit new locations on multiple planets to investigate a series of seemingly paranormal murders and help Ava launch her Mysteriouslier podcast
 • Enjoy a collection of behind-the-scenes content from Borderlands 3's development, including concept art, storyboards, clips, and more
 • Work your way through three Vault Cards featuring themed loot and powerful gear! Collect tons of added cosmetics, including new Vault Hunter Heads and Skins, weapon skins and trinkets, lively emotes, ECHO Device skins, and room decorations to display proudly aboard Sanctuary III

70050000041807.name: Skin Pack #2
70050000041807.intro: Skin Pack #2 - Imperius, Xin-xi & Luxidoor skins, that will change an entire tribe's look and music!
70050000041807.description:
Skin pack #2 includes the following skins: 
- Imperius Lirepacci 
- Xin-xi Sha-po

Imperius Lirepacci
The scholarly Lirepacci have ventured out of Imperia to gain new perspectives on life through warfare, the study of other cultures, and hours of philosophical debate.

Xin-xi Sha-po 
In the misty hills around Mt. Xin-xi resides the Sha-po, a secretive legion of assassins trained in the arts of dealing a silent death to anyone who opposes the Xin-xi Empire.

70050000041808.name: Mechanic 8230: Escape From Ilgrot Soundtrack
70050000041808.intro: Enjoy the unique atmospheric soundtrack in the latest DLC.
70050000041808.description: Sink into the music of Mechanic 8230: Escape From Ilgrot at any time you want.

70050000041812.name: Mechanic 8230: Escape From Ilgrot Artbook
70050000041812.intro: Look through the lens of a post-apocalyptic world in the latest Artbook.
70050000041812.description: This remarkable DLC includes sketches of characters, machines, and other elements that marvel at the unique style you know from the main game.

70050000041816.name: SnowRunner - The Mastodon
70050000041816.description:
Expand your vehicle collection with The Mastodon DLC to receive the ZikZ 612H "Mastodon", a super-large, super-heavy beast of a truck with 3 built-in trailer slots!

The Mastodon DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2 or Year 3 Pass.

70050000041851.name: Character Set 06: TAIZO KIYOKURA
70050000041851.description:
Set including Fighter "TAIZO KIYOKURA" and sleeves.

[INCLUDED]
- Fighter: TAIZO KIYOKURA
- CPU: TAIZO KIYOKURA
- Character Sleeve: TAIZO KIYOKURA
- SD Character Sleeve: TAIZO KIYOKURA

70050000041871.name: HORSE CLUB Adventures 2: Secrets of Skeifa
70050000041871.intro: A ferry has docked at Hazelwood’s harbor that brings you and the girls from HORSE CLUB to a new island! Sail across the sea and discover a long-kept secret!
70050000041871.description:
All aboard! In this downloadable content (DLC) upgrade for Horse Club Adventures 2, Captain Francis has docked his ferry at Hazelwood’s harbor and brings you and the girls from HORSE CLUB to a new island.

You meet old acquaintances of Sofia there and make friends with their horses that are allowed to roam freely on the island. But the island also has a secret still waiting to be revealed.

Set off on a quest to find a mysterious ghost horse: There is a mystical thrilling story on Skeifa that revolves around an ancient legend. However, the people living on the island have missions for you too, ones that lead you all over the island.

You’ll find new race courses and the popular balloon games scattered across the island, as well as a new minigame in which you make friends with freely roaming horses!

The lovingly designed setting, new customizations for you and your horse, music specially composed for the island and fully recorded texts set to voices draw you into the HORSE CLUB gameworld and guarantee a unique gaming experience.

Sail across the sea and discover the Mystery of Skeifa!

70050000041873.name: The Wonderful 101: Remastered - The Wonderful One: After School Hero (Part 2)
70050000041873.intro: SUPER-DUPER-FUN SIDE-SCROLLING LASER SHOOTING ACTION!!! JOIN LUKA IN HIS JOURNEY TO BECOMING A FULL-FLEDGED HERO!
70050000041873.description:
Important note: The Wonderful One: After School Hero free DLC is divided in TWO parts. You will need to install The Wonderful One: After School Hero (Part 1) free DLC separately to play the first part of this experience. This DLC was made possible by reaching the stretch goal of our February 2020 crowdfunding campaign. We would like to extend our sincerest gratitude to the 33,199 amazing fans who supported us on this journey.


Get ready for a unique side-scrolling experience in the world of The Wonderful 101: Remastered! This free DLC lets you enjoy a brand new episode in which you experience Luka's story!

As the latest member of the CENTINELS, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

Thrilling SIDE-SCROLLING action
Jump into classic side-scrolling action with a PlatinumGames twist. Get ready for a super-exciting experience as you blast away a bunch of enemies with your awesome lasers!

Super-fun LASER shooting
Luka uses his trusty Stingy Eye goggles to shoot a variety of lasers that decimate his foes. Use the Right Stick to freely shoot lasers in any direction! 2-D shooting has never felt so simple, fun, and intuitive! You have three laser types at your disposal. Blast away, young recruit!

A variety of MODES to keep you enticed
Go hands-on with The Wonderful One: After School Hero in three different modes. The Arcade Mode lets you experience the story of how Luka became a full-fledged hero, Wonder Goggles. The Challenge Mode lets you select and play any Drill of your choice. In Caravan Mode, you have 5 minutes from the start of the Drill to see how high of a score you can get.
Try to clear all the unique missions set in each Drill and see if you can find some hidden areas on each stage. Re-play the game to your heart's content to explore every nook and cranny! Upload your scores to Online Ranking and compete with friends around the world to see who can get the highest scores!

70050000041874.name: Golden Idol Mysteries: The Spider of Lanka
70050000041874.description:
The conspiracy deepens
The Spider of Lanka begins in 1741, one year before the first scenario in The Case of the Golden Idol, and uncovers the awful origins of this five-decade tale of betrayal, greed, ambition and death.

Three scenarios to untangle
Set in the fictional Kingdom of Lanka, this DLC offers three brand new scenarios that will demand the utmost of your deduction powers to unravel.

The web of deceit begins with The Spider
Encounter characters old and new during your expedition to Lanka. Among these faces hides the Spider of Lanka, puppeteering events to shape the future

70050000041875.name: MK1: Shang Tsung
70050000041875.description:
Included in Pre-Order.

Play as the powerful sorcerer Shang Tsung.

70050000041876.name: MK1: Tanya Funkeira Skin
70050000041876.intro: Tanya Funkeira Skin, inspired by Brazilian funk music
70050000041876.description: This pack includes a playable skin that reimagines Mortal Kombat 1 Tanya with a touch of Brazilian Funk music.

70050000041877.name: MK1: Sub-Zero Día de Muertos Skin
70050000041877.description: This pack includes a playable skin that reimagines Mortal Kombat 1 Sub-Zero, ready to commemorate Día de Muertos.

70050000041878.name: MK1: Jean-Claude Van Damme Skin
70050000041878.intro: Lights, Camera, Fight! with Jean-Claude Van Damme Skin
70050000041878.description:
A playable skin for Johnny Cage, inspired by the legendary martial artist Jean-Claude Van Damme. 

Included in Kombat Pack

70050000041879.name: MK1: Omni-Man
70050000041879.description: Omni-Man soars into the Mortal Kombat™ Universe joining the roster as a new Kombatant. This pack includes playable character Omni-Man, including all new move-sets inspired by the Invincible animated series

70050000041880.name: MK1: Quan Chi
70050000041880.description:
A Demon of the NetherRealm, Quan Chi has mastered black magic to harness the power of the dead. Now a master of the Netherrealm's most vile sorcery, Quan Chi plots with Shang Tsung to conquer the realms. He will not be denied.

This pack includes playable character Quan Chi including all new move-sets.

70050000041881.name: MK1: Peacemaker
70050000041881.description:
Christopher Smith, the Peacemaker, cherishes peace with all his heart. So much so, that he will kill anyone and everyone necessary to get it.

This pack includes playable character Peacemaker, based on DC's Suicide Squad, including all new movesets.

70050000041882.name: MK1: Ermac
70050000041882.description:
No longer Quan Chi's slave, nor bound to a royal family, Ermac must find a future worth fighting for.
 
This pack includes playable character Ermac including all new movesets.

70050000041883.name: MK1: Homelander
70050000041883.description:
Homelander, the ultimate patriot and leader of The Seven, descends upon Mortal Kombat™. As a narcissistic sociopath with an insatiable need for validation, love and power, Homelander unfolds a new Era of tyranny in Mortal Kombat 1. 

This pack includes playable character Homelander, from 'The Boys', including all new movesets.

70050000041884.name: MK1: Takeda Takahashi
70050000041884.description: Seeking to right the wrongs of his past, Takeda swears to rip up Earthrealm's underworld by the roots. This pack includes playable character Takeda Takahashi, including all new move-sets.

70050000041885.name: MK1: Tremor
70050000041885.description:
Tremor, Ninja of the Black Dragon Clan, returns to the new Mortal Kombat™ Universe. 

Purchase this pack and receive Tremor as a Kameo Character to assist you in fight.

70050000041886.name: MK1: Khameleon
70050000041886.intro: Khameleon Stealths Her Way to Mortal Kombat™ 1
70050000041886.description:
Khameleon, the only ninja to possess the powers of every female ninja, returns to the new Mortal Kombat™ Universe. 

Purchase this pack and receive Khameleon as a Kameo Character to assist you in fight.

70050000041887.name: MK1: Janet Cage
70050000041887.description:
Janet Cage, an alternate version of Johnny Cage, comes to the Mortal Kombat™ Universe. 

Purchase this pack and receive Janet Cage as a Kameo Character to assist you in fight.

70050000041888.name: MK1: Mavado
70050000041888.description:
Mavado, a commanding leader of the merciless Red Dragon Clan, returns to the Mortal Kombat™ Universe. 

Purchase this pack and receive Mavado as a Kameo Character to assist you in fight.

70050000041889.name: MK1: Ferra
70050000041889.description:
Ferra, the small but nimble barbarian of Outworld, returns to the Mortal Kombat™ Universe. Despite not having her usual partner, she wont hesitate to make you her mount.

Purchase this pack and receive Ferra as a Kameo Character to assist you in fight.

70050000041907.name: Experience x3 - Onigo Hunter
70050000041907.description:
All characters' experience gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000041908.name: No Encounters - Onigo Hunter
70050000041908.description:
Enables the feature to configure the encounter rate.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000041909.name: Damage x2 - Onigo Hunter
70050000041909.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000041910.name: No Skill Cost - Onigo Hunter
70050000041910.description:

Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000041943.name: Skin Pack #1
70050000041943.intro: Skin Pack #1 -  Vengir, Hoodrick & Bardur, that will change an entire tribe's aesthetic from the ground up!
70050000041943.description:
Skin Pack #1 includes the following skins: 
- Bardur Baergøff
- Hoodrick Yorthwober
- Vengir Cultist

Bardur Baergøff
Bardur who have survived the 5 Tests of Strength are given the rank of Baergøff, meaning “Elite Baerion Hunter”. The sanctified Baerion pelt is thought to let the wearer channel the animal's raw ferocity in battle.

Hoodrick Yorthwober
Can you hit a BuzzFly with an arrow from 2 tiles away? Then you might be ready for the Hoodrick Yorthwober. These expert sharpshooters have been personally trained in combat and survival by Yorth, the legendary archer, and comprise the most elite force the Hoodrick can muster.

Vengir Cultists
Vengir of the fanatical Burzgor Cult will perform the visceral Thdkrkr Ritual, shrugging off their mortal flesh and gaining power directly from the God of Blood, themself. Their zealous display of devotion isn’t taken as seriously as they’d like by the other tribes, however.

70050000041945.name: Cassette Beasts: Cosplay Pack
70050000041945.description:
With six cosmetic items that will allow you to express yourself even more, this Cosplay pack will dress you up for wherever the adventure in New Wirral takes you. Look absolutely stunning in this costume line inspired by renowned darlings and troublemakers! This pack includes:

* Bansheep Hat
* Candevil Hat
* Traffikrab Hat
* Springheel Hat
* Pombomb Poncho
* Pombomb Shorts

70050000041951.name: Arcade Paradise - Vostok Inc. Pinball
70050000041951.intro:
Do you like money? How about Arcades?
Then you'll LOVE Vostok Inc. Pinball!!
70050000041951.description:
Do you like money? How about Arcades?
Then you'll LOVE Vostok Inc. Pinball!! 

Celebrate space capitalism with the latest DLC expansion for Arcade Paradise that gives you the opportunity to fulfil your pinball wizard dreams with tilt functions and missions designed to test your reflexes to the max! Based on cult hit twin-stick shooter sharing the same name! Test your skillshots with a host of missions and features to increase your multipliers and hit the multiball for MAXIMUM MOOLAH! 
Including :

- Multiple camera angles
- Kickback function
- Ball Saving targets
- UFO destruction for extra balls!
- Various Multipliers
- MULTIBALL! 
- And more!

And if it comes to it you can always give the table a careful tilt (or 3..)

Vostok Inc. Pinball also contains new in game goals and Global Online Leaderboards!

70050000041952.name: Fae Farm: Cozy Cabin Variety Pack
70050000041952.description:
You can already book your crossing to Azoria! Pre-purchase Fae Farm between June 8, 2023 and the release in September and receive the Cozy Cabin Variety Pack, an exclusive digital pack of items to customize your character’s outfit and decorate your homestead, including:

    • The Cozy Casual Farmer’s Outfit, a three piece stylish yet comfy shirt and overall set, accompanied by a beret hat and chewing straw for casual farming vibe!

    • The Farmhouse wallpaper, flooring and rug, to customize your room in a traditional cabin style. 
    • The Farmhouse wallpaper, flooring and rug to style your cozy homestead with farm life features. 

    • The Log Bench and the Garden Birdhouse, to welcome all your visitors whether their wings are of the feathered or the fae kind.

    • The Animal Portrait, a picture frame to add a nice finishing touch to your new home away from home.

70050000041969.name: House Flipper: Garden DLC
70050000041969.intro: Have you ever thought of becoming a gardener? Thanks to Garden Flipper DLC it is now possible!
70050000041969.description:
Become a gardener!

Have you ever thought of becoming a gardener? Before you'll start planting trees and plants you'll need to get rid of trash and rubble.
Mow the lawn, hew unwanted trees, tear out weeds and prepare your garden for a complete makeover! Map paths out, plant new trees and bushes and set flowerbeds.

Explore completely new orders and discover innovative mechanics, which we've designed in association with professional gardeners!
Step by step, sink into the world of plants. Transform desolated gardens into beautiful masterworks - let them shine under your management.
And when you'll be ready to create your own garden…

Don’t limit yourself!

In Garden Flipper, you're the one who decides how your garden looks!
Do you prefer the widespread gardens of the Palace of Versailles or the minimalistic style of Zen gardens?
Don't limit yourself! Let your garden shine for you and make your neighbors jealous of it! Make appraisers fight for it!
And if you like, put your feet up and relax in the sanctuary of silence and peace which will calm your senses and will give you the energy to implement new ideas in the next house!

The new expansion is not only about plants and flowers. We've prepared hundreds of new items which will make your garden look even better!

70050000041970.name: House Flipper: Pets DLC
70050000041970.intro: Will you find a place for someone special in your property? Thanks to Pets DLC you'll have a chance to take care of a lovely companion and have a wonderful time together!
70050000041970.description:
Adopt a Pet!

Your new furry buddy represents one of thirteen popular dog or cat breeds, but that's not the end of great news! The DLC will also allow you to choose between other animal species like rabbits, turtles, parrots, or hamsters!

Take in your new pet, look after it and make it feel loved.
Be sure to involve plenty of playtime, teach it, and make it feel comfortable in a new home! Create a unique relationship with your adorable housemate

A Unique Style!

Access an exclusive set of items and decor elements, which will let you design a cozy countryside house for you and your pet.
Comfortable sofas, plushy pillows, and tons of decorations will help you on your journey!

Don't forget about preparing a nice and warm spot for your sweet companion! A specially designed room and a play zone in the backyard should be wonderful. The new location and large open spaces will bring lots of pleasant memories. Discover new properties, from houses with cozy attics and terraces to huge 2-story countryside homes!

Your own animal hotel!

Take care of an animal hotel in of the 11 special orders you can stumble upon in the breathtaking region of Cozy Village. Make sure all the requirements like play areas, water feeders, and food dispensers are present, and prepare yourself for more unique jobs! Create and design interiors not only for your clients but also for their beloved pet companions!.

Were you always dreaming of standing in front of your cozy countryside home with an adorable pet by your side?
If the answer is "yes", then this DLC is here for you!

70050000041989.name: "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening" Scenario "Brotherly Revolt"
70050000041989.intro: The "Fool of Owari" succeeds his father, and challenges the world.
70050000041989.description:
Additional scenario available for "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening".

The Tiger of Owari, Nobuhide Oda, succumbs to illness, leaving his eldest son, the Fool of Owari, Nobunaga, to lead the clan.
Nobunaga sets his gaze firmly on the future, far beyond the immediate infighting of the clan members and the threats of neighboring countries.

- Additional Scenario
Brotherly Revolt

- How to Play the Scenario
Select "New Game", and choose "Brotherly Revolt" to play the scenario.

Note: This product has been previously available(pre-order Bonus).
Please be careful to avoid making an unnecessary or redundant purchase.

70050000041991.name: "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening" 40th Anniversary "Series Collection of Officer Face Graphics" (set of 20)
70050000041991.intro: A collection of 20 officer graphics celebrating the 40-year history of the game.
70050000041991.description:
Officer graphics available for "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening". A collection of 20 officer graphics through out the 40-year history of the series.

- Additional Officer Graphics
Collection of 20 officer graphics from the 40-year history of the "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION" series, including Nobunaga Oda from Zenkokuban, and Shingen Takeda from Sphere of Influence.

- How to Use Additional Graphics
Select "Custom Officers" or "Historical Officer" under the "Edit Officer" command, and set the added graphics.
The "Add" tab is located under the "Face" command inside both "Create New" and "Edit" for ”Custom Officers", and inside "Edit" command for "Historical Officer".

70050000041993.name: "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening" Scenario "Battle of Tetorigawa"
70050000041993.intro: The dragon of Echigo makes his move to defeat Nobunaga.
70050000041993.description:
Additional scenario available for "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening".

Yoshiaki Ashikaga's requests to join him in destroying Nobunaga have finally prompted Kenshin Uesugi to move. 
Making for the capital, the Uesugi Army attacks Nanao Castle. The Oda Army marches to save the castle, but after crossing the Tetorigawa River, the troops are met with the dragon banner flapping in the wind. 
The castle has already fallen into Kenshin's hands. When the blade of the God of War glints in the light, the heavens cry and the earth trembles.

- Additional Scenario
The Battle of Tetorigawa

- How to Play the Scenario
Select "New Game", and choose "The Battle of Tetorigawa" to play the scenario.

Note: This product was released in the past as an early purchase bonus.

70050000042009.description:
A weapon (longsword) for Claude that can be of use in the first part of the story.

70050000042010.name: Forest Knuckles
70050000042010.description:
A weapon (knuckle) for Rena that can be of use in the first part of the story.
Boosts the wielder’s INT by 10%.

70050000042011.name: Sunrise Ring
70050000042011.description:
A ring (accessory) that has been blessed by the sun.
Increases max. HP and MP by 10%, and makes it easier to stun enemies.

70050000042012.name: Set of recovery items
70050000042012.description:
Mixed Berries x20: Berries from a special plant that sooth injuries of both the body and the soul. Recovers 15% of HP and MP. 
Resurrection Potion x20: Enchanted medicine that resurrects all fallen comrades when used. Resurrects all allies and heals 5% of their HP.

70050000042017.name: Foxy Akane
70050000042017.intro: Check the newest appearance of Akane, one of the girls from the main game, in her new foxy look.
70050000042017.description:
Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all of the puzzles. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" Foxy Akane. Every success on your part will make her happier!


Key Features:

- Rewarding premise

70050000042019.name: Puppy Nanami
70050000042019.intro: Check the newest appearance of Nanami, one of the girls from the main game, in her new puppy look.

70050000042030.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Rust and Fast Pack
70050000042030.description:
Get a classic and take it to a whole new level of style and power. Here is the philosophy that drives the Hot Rods—street monsters with super-sized engines that literally can't fit in the car body! An excess of power ready to be unleashed on the track to whizz at full speed and leave everything behind you. Especially your opponents!
In the Rust and Fast Pack you will find nothing less than two legends like Mod Rod and the futuristic FusionBusta™. Mod Rod combines a classic look with modern details, combining the best of both worlds for a result that is all style and energy, with its signature all-round windows that makes it even more badass. And when modern isn't enough, get behind the wheel of the futuristic FusionBusta™ and its super-powered engine, that takes the hot rods towards new horizons of evolution!

This DLC includes:
- Mod Rod
- FusionBusta™

This DLC is not included in any Season Pass.

70050000042031.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Unstoppables Pack
70050000042031.description:
Talk about the opposites attract. On the one hand, a car with elegant slick lines, with a super aerodynamic profile to destroy limits and your opponent’s hope. A racing car born for the track and pure speed. On the other, a massive concentration of unstoppable power, ready to easily overcome even the most challenging conditions: the tracks that would put even the most daring to the test. They are F1 Racer and Sand Burner™, the fierce protagonists of the new Unstoppables Pack. Their unique features and personalities will be extremely useful for tackling the most technical challenges, when a hundredth of a second makes all the difference on the track or you need to overtake obstacles to leave your mark even off the track. 
Add them to your collection now!

This DLC includes:
- F1 Racer
- Sand Burner™

This DLC is not included in any Season Pass.

70050000042032.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Speed Kings Pack
70050000042032.description:
A statement of style and speed on the track. Two absolutely jaw-dropping designs, with killer performance. Of course, we are talking about Impavido 1™, a stunning exotic car that embodies the spirit of the best supercars and, as the name suggests, is not afraid of anything or anyone thanks to its truly unrivaled capabilities that will lead it to dominate your races. And Electro Silhouette™, a futuristic racing car powered by an electric engine that has nothing to envy to traditional engines in terms of performance. This jewel of technology may be eco-friendly, but it is certainly not rival-friendly. Winning will be even more electrifying! Supercharge your collection with the new vehicles of the Speed Kings Pack!

This DLC includes:
- Impavido 1™
- Electro Silhouette™

This DLC is not included in any Season Pass.

70050000042033.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Just a Scratch Pack
70050000042033.description:
OK, you might think these cars have seen better days… and you might even be right, but never judge a book by its cover alone, or actually, a car by its body alone. What they don't give you in design and aesthetics, will all be rebalanced by performance that will crush the dreams of glory of any of your opponents! With the exclusive Just a Scratch Pack you can immediately add Speed Bump™ and Sudden Stop™ to your collection, two cars ready to hit the track with you for your most daring races, with the most impossible jumps, and the hardest crashes. And honestly, what other damage can you actually do to them? They were born for your crash tests! But these ugly ducklings might even end up bringing you the most beautiful victories!

This DLC includes:
- Speed Bump™
- Sudden Stop™

This DLC is not included in any Season Pass.

70050000042034.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Twin Mill™ Unleashed Edition
70050000042034.description:
It’s an icon of style and unparalleled creativity, the first completely original design by Hot Wheels™, so famous that a full-size version was even made, making this awesome car even more epic. We are obviously talking about Twin Mill™, the legendary Hot Wheels™ twin-engine racing car that today becomes even cooler thanks to the new, exclusive “Unleashed” livery. get behind the wheel of this iconic concept car that combines style and power, to dominate every race like a legend. If there's a car that really can't be missing in a great collection, this is definitely the one!

This DLC is included in the HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Season Pass Vol. 1.

70050000042035.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - AcceleRacers All-Star Pack
70050000042035.description:
AcceleRacers fans, make room in your collection: 4 super stars are about to arrive at full speed! Directly from the enigmatic Team Silencerz comes Carbide™, a futuristic vehicle with extremely aerodynamic lines, characterized by a super-light body made from the mysterious “unobtainium”. RD-09™ is a monster that came out of a nightmare and it will be just that for all of your opponents! With Rollin’ Thunder™ you'll find out how an SUV can be unexpectedly fast on the track (and everywhere)! Finally, SpecTyte™ completes this incredible AcceleRacers All-Star Pack, a hybrid-engine racing car from the Team Teku. The only question is: which one will you drive first?

This DLC includes:
- Carbide™
- RD-09™
- Rollin’ Thunder™ 
- SpecTyte™

This DLC is included in the HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Season Pass Vol. 1.

70050000042036.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Speed and Style Pack
70050000042036.description:
The recipe for success on the track? The perfect mix of speed and style. So it won't be hard to understand how the Speed and Style Pack can easily become your secret weapon to dominate every race! Four extraordinary racing cars are ready to make their engines roar and impress with the beauty of their iconic designs: 
- the 2016 Ford GT Race endurance champion; 
- the Audi R8 LMS, one of the most successful cars in Gran Turismo history; 
- the Corvette C8.R with its 500 hp of pure power;
- the Nissan GT-R R35 Liberty Walk Silhouette Works 35GT-RR, by the legendary designer Ryu Asada. 
Just one of them would make any collector happy… imagine having all four!

This DLC includes:
- 2016 Ford GT Race
- Audi R8 LMS
- Corvette C8.R
- Nissan GT-R R35 Liberty Walk Silhouette Works 35GT-RR

This DLC is included in the HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Season Pass Vol. 1.

70050000042037.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Manga Free Pack
70050000042037.description:
Directly from the Japanese comics comes the craziest and funniest cars, made up of huge spoilers and exaggerations from every point of view. Like Mad Manga™, an oversized speedster from the Land of the Rising Sun ready to make every race a new story full of powerful victories. Only the madness of another all-spoiler racing car like Track Manga™ can - maybe - keep up with it. Track Manga™ is a roadster born for drifting, ready to draw the most daring trajectories on the track! With the Manga Free Pack, everything is oversized, the fun included!

This DLC includes:
- Mad Manga™
- Track Manga™

70050000042040.name: Kizuna AI - Touch the Beat! DLC Costume 1: hello, world 2020
70050000042040.description:
This DLC adds the costume that Kizuna AI wore during her "hello, world 2020" second live concert on January 23rd, 2021.

70050000042041.name: Kizuna AI - Touch the Beat! DLC Costume 2: A.I. Party! 2018
70050000042041.description:

70050000042051.name: Kitty Rose
70050000042051.intro: Check the newest appearance of Rose, one of the girls from the main game, in her new feline look.

Key Features:

- New art pieces to unlock
