70050000044457.name: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - The Lord of Nothing
70050000044457.intro: The Lord of Nothing is the fifth premium DLC for Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous, wrapping up the story of the second DLC, Through the Ashes.
70050000044457.description:
The Lord of Nothing is the fifth premium DLC for Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous, wrapping up the story of the second DLC, Through the Ashes. Explore new and unique locations, make new friends, and face a powerful demon lord in order to bring Sendri and Rekarth's story to its long-awaited finale. The outcome of your adventure — and for the characters, depends solely on you and your choices. After all, there are more than five unique endings in the DLC.

In The Lord of Nothing DLC you will have to survive frozen lands, uncover the secrets of a mysterious wizard's tower, help some Kellids in blooming caves, and even delve into the Shadow Plane! But you won't be alone: an angel of Sarenrae with a tragic past and a captivating new android companion will join you as you confront the evil flourishing in the remote corners of Golarion. And don’t think your commander is being left out — a new quest and dungeon will be available to complete in the fifth chapter of the base game.

Continue your journey with a character from Through the Ashes DLC or create a new one: 15 new archetypes, new spells and new feats await you. All of these will also be available in the main campaign when creating a new character or retraining one.

• Over 40 challenging puzzles to keep you solving!

The Collector has new challenges for the King of Darkness, some of them known, others not so much... Will you answer his call?

New game mode

Aeterna Noctis: Virtuoso features the long-awaited boss rush mode. Now players can repeat the boss fights from the base game including new enemy behaviour and attack patterns.

During these battles, your powers will be restricted to ensure a fair duel, this way, you will also be able to perform feats that you may not have achieved in your first encounter: defeating bosses in a particular way or without getting hit.

If you prefer an even greater challenge you can face them one after the other.

The Collector is the NPC that introduces the boss rush mode to players. Visit his true collection and overcome the different challenges and boss groups until you defeat all of them in every modality.

New boss fight

The Clockwork Twins are the new bosses included in the DLC. They can be found (and beaten) in the boss rush mode, offering an encounter only recommended for the most skilled players.

This brand-new final boss features unique mechanics that will put your reflexes to the test. You must face these monstrosities in an exclusive arena.

70050000044825.name: WINGSPAN: Oceania Expansion
70050000044825.intro: Learn about birds from around Australia and New Zealand and all-new resources and mechanics that will enrich your adventure of creating a wildlife preserve.
70050000044825.description:
Attract nearly 100 new birds to your wildlife preserve
Birds from the Oceania region await you in the second expansion to Wingspan. Get to know them better with interesting facts written on cards and recordings of their real sounds. Many of them have brand new skills, including a yellow 'end game' ability that activates when the game is over.

Feed your birds with new food - nectar
The digital version of Wingspan has never been sweeter! A new food type - nectar - will appear in your inventory. It is one of the most essential ingredients in the nutrition of the birds of Oceania. It’s also an excellent substitute for other types of food for birds from different parts of the world. 

Take on new challenges
Along with new bird abilities, Oceania Expansion offers new bonus cards and end-of-round goals. Now you have to pay attention to more details: not only to the sets of birds and nests, and their wingspan but also to which way your bird's beak is facing on the card. There may also be times when a round has no end goal. All these challenges, and many more, will add variety to your subsequent games.

New alternative player board
The player board now presents a new design and functionalities. You will find on it not only a place for your nectar but also options for resetting the bird feeder and card tray. The board also enables you to get more food and cards quicker than before while laying eggs is reduced. All these changes diversify the dynamics of the gameplay.

Listen to some more relaxing music
In Wingspan: Oceania Expansion we continue to expand the game with new tracks composed by Paweł Górniak. Let yourself be carried away by a soothing soundtrack that will make the game even more enjoyable.

New backgrounds and portraits inspired by Oceania
The beauty and diversity of Oceania have also inspired us to create picturesque backgrounds where you can play your games and portraits that relate to the local fauna. Choose your favourite graphics and get close to the nature of the continent.

70050000044990.name: DREDGE - The Pale Reach
70050000044990.intro: Take your DREDGE adventure into unchartered territory
70050000044990.description:

In The Pale Reach, you’ll navigate the treacherous ice fields to discover a mystery frozen under the ice. Retrace the steps of the last crew that came before you and unearth a story of bitter betrayal. Key Features

Uncover a brand new side-story
Discover 4 new pieces of equipment to catch 11 new fish and crab species

70050000045085.name: Clue - Black Adder Crime Scene
70050000045085.intro: Experience the aftermath of Tudor Mansion in an all-new tropical crime scene!
70050000045085.description:
The tale continues beyond the shadows of Tudor Mansion and into the dazzling sunlight of the Black Adder Resort!

Mr Callan Coral, the manager of the Black Adder Resort and former business partner of Mr Boden “Boddy” Black, has invited everyone suspected of his business associate’s murder to lie low on his exclusive tropical island. Eager to get away from prying eyes in the aftermath of the party, everyone accepts the offer. However, things take a turn for the worse when they once again find themselves at the heart of another murder mystery!

Shortly after revealing his plans to his guests, Callan Coral is found dead in the hotel lobby…

The Black Adder Resort:
Mr Callan Coral, a former business partner of Mr Boden “Boddy” Black, has invited everyone suspected of his business associate’s murder to lie low on his tropical island. However, things take a turn for the worse when they once again find themselves at the heart of another murder mystery! 

This crime scene includes a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a snake dice set and 12 new tokens.

The Black Adder Resort: Case File Revisited #1:
A hyacinth blooms in death once more, bringing shades of gray to the Black Adder Resort crime scene! Agent Gray and Analyst Hyacinth join the suspect roster, but are either of them the real culprit? Or has the true murderer dragged them in to muddy the waters?

This additional content includes two new suspects and four more tokens. 

INCLUDES:
The Black Adder Resort Crime Scene
The Black Adder Resort: Case File Revisited #1

Close another case and boost your detective credentials with Clue/Cluedo!

A good-natured blacksmith and an enlightened apprentice of a high-land monastery will join the team of the Heroes' Guild. The first is excellent with clubs and hammers, while the second is skilled with a spear.

Boss Items

Defeating bosses allows you to get their weapons or equipment in subsequent runs. Ever dreamed of fighting with Barry the Axe's cleaver or Black Hood's three-shot crossbow? Now you have that opportunity!

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your support - we really appreciate it!

70050000045354.name: Pinball FX - Star Trek™ Pinball
70050000045354.intro: Boldly go, where no one has gone before in Star Trek™ Pinball!
70050000045354.description:
Boldly go, where no one has gone before in Star Trek™ Pinball! Explore 3 tables based on the fan favorite movies and TV series of the franchise ranging from classics to the present day, and live long and prosper on the leaderboards!

This pack includes: 

Star Trek™ Pinball: Kelvin Timeline: Experience the vision of the newest trilogy of Star Trek blockbuster movies in this epic table. Join Captain James T. Kirk and the crew of the Enterprise on their mission to discover new civilizations, form alliances and neutralize threats to the Federation. 

Star Trek™ Pinball: Discovery: Michael Burnham and the shipmates of the U.S.S. Discovery rely on your pinball prowess, as you play through iconic moments from the first four seasons of the series. Make contact with the residents of 10-C and utilize the time loop for victory!

Star Trek™ Pinball: Deep Space Nine: Travel to the edges of the final frontier and arrive at the space station Deep Space 9! Use your pinball skills to lead the crew and Captain Benjamin Sisko in ending the Dominion War.

70050000045355.name: Pinball FX - Game Night Pinball Volume 1
70050000045355.intro: Just like with the dice, a single flip can change everything.
70050000045355.description:
Get ready for a game-changing experience as Zen Studios partners up with Asmodee to bring you three tables based on the best tabletop games. Step into a new realm of pinball, and remember, just like with the dice, a single flip can change everything.

Terraforming Mars Pinball: The race for taming the Red Planet has begun! Run one of the mega-corporations and use your pinball skills to raise the oxygen level, heat up the planet, and create vast oceans on your way to the top of the leaderboards.

Gloomhaven™ Pinball: Delve into the world of Gloomhaven as mercenaries! Infiltrate the Inox Encampment, defeat Jekserah’s army of corpses among other adventures to enter the Void and confront The Gloom!

Exploding Kittens®: A Pinball Cat-astrophe: Complete main modes inspired by the kitty-powered card game, clean the Transdimensional Litter Box, and collect famous Tacocat, Cattermelon, and other cards to get the highest scores.

70050000045356.name: Pinball FX - Charity Pack
70050000045356.intro: Support pinball charities and play two classic tables.
70050000045356.description:
Your purchase of Epic Quest and Excalibur brings joy to those in need & helps preserve pinball culture. 70% of the purchase price less VAT will be donated to Project Pinball Charity (United States 46-3417202) and The Budapest Pinball Museum (Hungary MK/20980/2013). This means Zen will donate 100% of our proceeds.

Project Pinball: The Project Pinball Charity Group, Inc. is a non-profit organization that places pinball machines in Children’s Hospitals, Ronald McDonald Houses, and Assisted Living Facilities to provide recreational relief to patients, family members, and hospital staff. 

Budapest Pinball Museum: The museum - by now with over 160 pinball and arcade machines - has opened its doors in Budapest on April 10, 2014. The Museum is considered to be Europe’s biggest interactive pinball museum in continuous operation. The machines exhibited in the museum span the entire history of the game from the 1800s to date.

70050000045360.intro: Dress up your golfer as a Knight or a Magic boy and try out a new sword bat!
70050000045360.description:

- Magic Boy character skin

Conquer golf courses in new fantasy outfits and beat your opponents with a brand new bat!

70050000045376.name: Mob Control: Champions
70050000045376.intro: Grow your card collection in the armory with Knight mobs, Explodon champions and a new Rocket Barrage ultimate!
70050000045376.description:
With this DLC you will unlock:

- new Knight mobs that fight with the strength of many Normie mobs thanks to a large amount of health and strength
- new Explodon champion with Jump & Crush primary skill and Final Boom area skill
- new Rocket Barrage ultimate which nukes your enemies with bombs!
- additional 12 booster packs with cards 
- extra 25000 coins to spend on upgrading your cards in the armory

Launch your new mobs, grow a massive army, and when it gets tough, use your new ultimate to finish off the enemy!

70050000045377.name: Colour Palette 4
70050000045377.intro: Experience a dystopian future in a new colour palette and bring down the government and evil cults.
70050000045377.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening! Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness. 

This DLC includes 2 new colours of your game: Glittering Galore and Whirling Whimsy.

Key Features:

- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70050000045379.name: Mob Control: Triple Backup
70050000045379.intro: Grow your card collection in the armory with Soldier mobs, Triple cannon and a new Mass Abduction ultimate!
70050000045379.description:
With this DLC you will unlock:

- a new Triple cannon that fires three mobs at once! It is so powerful and fast that it should require a license
- new Soldier mobs that have great strength and health and at the same time good speed of movement 
- new Mass Abduction ultimate which kidnaps enemy mobs! 
- additional 10 booster packs with cards 
- extra 30000 coins to spend on upgrading your cards in the armory

Launch your new mobs and cannon, grow a massive army, and when it gets tough, use your new ultimate to finish off the enemy!

70050000045401.name: Additional mini-game "Magic Soda"
70050000045401.intro:
Captivating hospitality that moves hearts!
Pour the soda right up to the edge!
70050000045401.description:
We're adding the "Magic Soda" mini-game to "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of "Viviter"! Let's not be too formal. Allow me to pour it for you, so let's take a big gulp to start!
The essence of hospitality lies in serving delicious soda! No matter who the guest is, if they enjoy their drink, they might just agree to a contract happily.
Now's the time to showcase your skills! Determine the perfect pour, right up to the brim—It's now or never!

70050000045403.name: Additional mini-game "Kiss Game"
70050000045403.intro:
I'm not a werewolf!
Stop the kiss at the last moment!
70050000045403.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, and we're adding the "Kiss Game" mini-game!
Stranded survivors tremble in fear of werewolves at the snowy mountain lodge.
In the midst of this, the "Purple Butterfly" Lilian stands tall!
Werewolves sneakily attack people at night because they're cowards.
If you're not a werewolf, prove it by playing the chocolate bar game with me and showing you're not afraid!

70050000045404.name: Additional mini-game "Flightless bird"
70050000045404.intro: Save that girl! Fly at the last moment!
70050000045404.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, and we're adding the "Flightless bird" mini-game!
Hehehe, that girl is so cute.
Oh no! Someone help me!!
A voice cries out for help. Here comes the ocean hero, Penguin Jumper!!
The runway is clear. Now, time your leap just right. Straight to her!

70050000045405.name: Additional mini-game "Flying Juliet"
70050000045405.intro: To the beloved prince! Fly, Juliet!
70050000045405.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, and we're adding the "Flying Juliet" mini-game!
The power of love can overcome any distance. Both the distance of the heart and physical distance. Even if fate separates two people.
Oh Romeo, I feel your longing for me. I will come to you right away.
Lovers seek each other today as well, and they soar――

70050000045406.name: Additional mini-game "Full Throttle"
70050000045406.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, and we're adding the "Full Throttle" mini-game!
I'll show you what real courage is all about!
I'll ride this bike right up to the nose of our sleeping boss.
If I make him mad, it's all over. But if I chicken out and don't go all the way, my reputation will be ruined.

70050000045407.name: Additional mini-game "Just barely:impossible"
70050000045407.intro: Spy mission! Lower it to the floor!
70050000045407.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, and we're adding the "Just barely: impossible" mini-game!
The mission this time is to steal data from the computer.
However, the security is flawless, so the only way is to sneak in from the top floor!
That's where you come in!
Quickly infiltrate from the top floor and lower the rope to the floor!
You can do it! Note that this switch will automatically disappear (just kidding).

70050000045408.name: Additional mini-game "Fly Me to the Moon"
70050000045408.intro: Aim for the moon! Inflate it to the limit!
70050000045408.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, and we're adding the "Fly Me to the Moon" mini-game!
Right now, a lone astronaut is about to take off from the X Space Center to reach the moon!
It's a direct one-way flight to the lunar surface. Whether you can make it depends on your judgment!
While the button is pressed, the balloon will be filled with air and dreams! And when you release the button, the journey to the moon begins!!!

70050000045409.name: Additional mini-game "Death Proposal"
70050000045409.intro: Harness the power of love!? Stop the truck!
70050000045409.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Death Proposal" mini-game!
I love you. How can I make you believe in this feeling?
Hmm? A cat, a truck... Ah! I've got it!
Watch this! In the face of my love, even that truck will stop!
Can you believe that I offer you an eternal love, undisturbed by trucks?

70050000045410.name: Additional mini-game "Halo Jump!"
70050000045410.intro: Infiltration mission! Open your parachute just in time!
70050000045410.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Halo Jump" mini-game!
Listen up, rookie! The key to infiltrating enemy territory is timing the parachute deployment!
Deploy it too early, and you'll be spotted by the enemy, but if you wait too long, you won't land safely. Press the button at the last possible moment. Understood?
Sir! Yes, sir!

70050000045411.name: Additional mini-game "Matrlympics"
70050000045411.intro: Score high in artistry! Dodge bullets at the last moment!
70050000045411.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Matrlympics" mini-game!
And so it begins, the Matrlympics!
In this competition, contestants compete to narrowly dodge bullets fired directly at them.
Now! As the referee signals, the bullet has been fired!
Ohh, what a dodge! Could this be the work of a the one?!

70050000045412.name: Additional mini-game "Hole-in-one"
70050000045412.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Hole-in-one" mini-game!
I'm Tiger. I'm a genius pro golfer who's sunk a hole-in-one on even the toughest courses.
Today's hole... right on the edge of a cliff, huh? And there's some wind, too.
Alright, I accept this challenge!
The key here is power. Gather your strength, factor in the wind... and now's the moment!

70050000045413.name: Additional mini-game "Top Hairstylist"
70050000045413.intro: Cut to the exact length of the order!
70050000045413.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Top Hairstylist" mini-game!
Welcome! How much are we cutting today?
Being a top stylist means accurately fulfilling the customer's wishes.
We don't need any rigid rulers here. I remember everything by feeling.
What length are you ordering? Alright, got it!

70050000045414.name: Additional mini-game "Lightning Shoot"
70050000045414.intro: Match-winning shot! Aim for the corner just inches from the post!
70050000045414.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Lightning Shoot" mini-game!
It's the climax of the match! A perfect free kick opportunity to aim for the goal! If you score this, victory is assured!
The target? Right at the corner of the goalpost! Can you elegantly score without anyone touching it!?
Now, kicker, steady your breath, pick your direction, and let's go, shoot!!

70050000045415.name: Additional mini-game "Chicken Race"
70050000045415.intro: There's no reason for a fight! Stop just in time!
70050000045415.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Chicken Race" mini-game!
For a man, there are times when he must fight.
The reason? It's unnecessary.
Just, now. It's about determining who's stronger. That's all.
And the resolution? The moment you hit the brakes.
Now, buddy, let's settle this!

70050000045416.name: Additional mini-game "Hunter of Love"
70050000045416.description:
In Viviter's multiplayer mode, where you can play "Chickempic" with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Hunter of Love" mini-game!
I'm the best hunter in the forest. When it comes to handling a bow, there's no one better than me.
And the prey I'm aiming for now is a beautiful yet courageous lady.
Shoot an apple placed on your head with my bow? Haha, that's a piece of cake. Leave it to me.
Along with the apple, let me also capture your heart!

70050000045417.name: Additional mini-game "Chicken Ranger"
70050000045417.intro: Defeat the monster! Kick at the last moment!
70050000045417.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Chicken Ranger" mini-game!
That monster is causing havoc as it pleases.
Alright, it's my time to shine!
Here comes the Rider of Justice, ViviterV3!!
Your mischief ends here, monster! I'll defeat you with my kick!!
Gathering my strength... Here I go! Take this! Haaaaaaa!!!!

70050000045418.name: Additional mini-game "UNITED ROBOT"
70050000045418.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "UNITED ROBOT" mini-game!
So, the enemy is giving it their all, huh? Well then, we'll do the same—
VIVITTIZER, activate the unite formation!
Let's synchronize our breaths! Uniting is the highlight of being a robot! Transforming into the strongest, coolest giant robot with perfect precision!
Alright! Timid unite! VIVITTIZER!! Victory will be ours!!!

70050000045419.name: Additional mini-game "Vivid ViviCure"
70050000045419.intro: Rub and charge up! Thunder Energy!
70050000045419.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Vivid ViviCure" mini-game!
You're cornered now, Bad Guy! It's time to finish you off with my special move!
Rubbing vigorously to charge up the thunder! Gathering thunder energy right up to the limit!
Here we go! Vivid Thunder Blast!!!
Will the finishing move land?! The outcome of the battle is—

70050000045420.name: Additional mini-game "Back to the Chicken"
70050000045420.intro: Back to the original era! Match the speed and dash through!
70050000045420.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Back to the Chicken" mini-game!
To return to the original era, you must pass through the power lines at a specific speed.
That's right, I'm no longer a coward. I'll do it. I'll make it a success no matter what.
There's no more need for the past. Let's go back to where I belong. To the place where my loved ones are waiting!

70050000045421.name: Additional mini-game "Shoot That Star!"
70050000045421.intro: Save the Earth! Charge up the main cannon energy!
70050000045421.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Shoot That Star!" mini-game!
A massive comet is approaching the Earth! If we don't do something, it will collide with us!?
But in this dire situation, the space battleship Vivito stands up to it!!
With Vivito's laser cannon, we should be able to destroy the incoming comet!
Charge up the energy! At 100%――Fireeeeeeeeeeee!!!!
The fate of the Earth hangs in the balance――

70050000045422.name: Additional mini-game "Leaning Tower"
70050000045422.intro: Godly Business?! Lean the Tower to the Limit!
70050000045422.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Leaning Tower" mini-game!
It seems the people down below are feeling quite down, but what could be the reason?
Hmm――It appears that the leaning tower is not leaning enough. That's certainly a serious issue.
Understood. Let's use the power of the heavens to lean the tower to the absolute limit.
Alright, here we go!

70050000045423.name: Additional mini-game "Bull Bull Swing"
70050000045423.intro: Ferocious Dog Challenge! Fly as Close as You Can!
70050000045423.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Bull Bull Swing" mini-game!
Oh no! The ball is over there!
That dog looks so ferocious. It's impossible to approach normally.
Don't worry, Bear Jim. Leave it to me.
I'll use the swing to get close quickly and snatch the ball back in a flash.

70050000045424.name: Additional mini-game "Ninjutsu FUSUMA"
70050000045424.intro: Lord's Peaceful Slumber! Close Silently and Securely!
70050000045424.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Ninjutsu FUSUMA" mini-game!
It seems the lord has once again fallen asleep without closing the fusuma... This won't do; it must be quite chilly.
If by chance the lord were to catch a cold, it would be quite troublesome. Leave it to us, the shinobi.
The art of stealthily closing the fusuma is a ninja technique. With this, the lord should be able to sleep soundly without even noticing.

70050000045425.name: Additional mini-game "Chicken Jones"
70050000045425.intro: Ancient Ruins Challenge! Draw Equal Weights!
70050000045425.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Chicken Jones" mini-game!
As we ventured into the depths of the ruins in search of treasure, the final puzzle to guard the treasure revealed itself.
A balance scale, stone statues... Ah, I see.
We need to place something on the other side of the scale that's the same size as the stone statue.
Once we understand that, it's simple; just draw it. Isn't that right, Junior?
The treasure is just around the corner.

70050000045426.name: Additional mini-game "Parley!"
70050000045426.intro: Treasure Hunt! Pierce Right Up to the Edge!
70050000045426.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Parley!" mini-game!
"I won't tell you where the treasure is!!
But, if you poke that sword right up to the edge, I might just spill the beans?"
Do you know who I am? You're asking for trouble...
I'll make you understand the fear of being just a hair's breadth away!
Uh, was that close enough for a near miss?

70050000045427.name: Additional mini-game "MILK IN BLACK"
70050000045427.intro: The Perfect Cup! Balance the Strength!
70050000045427.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "MILK IN BLACK" mini-game!
The café au lait on this planet is all about the perfect ratio of coffee to milk.
Make me a cup with this exact strength.
The instructed barista adjusts the ratio by pressing buttons on the server.
Eventually, the café au lait is ready and handed over.
Now, let's see if it's made just the way I ordered.

70050000045428.name: Additional mini-game "Unstoppable"
70050000045428.intro: Stopping the Oncoming Train! Just in the Nick of Time!
70050000045428.description:
In "Chickempic," the multiplayer mode of Viviter where you can play with up to 8 players, we're adding the "Unstoppable" mini-game!
Next stop, end of the line~ End of the line~
Thank you for your daily commute. I'll be sure to bring this commuter train to a perfect stop at the end station as always.
No, no need to worry. It's just a simple one-button operation...
Absolutely fine. Probably... Definitely... Whoa~~!!!!

70050000045429.name: Brainy Smurf Hidden Story
70050000045429.intro: Try to find all hidden objects and Smurfs in the newest hide and seek DLC.
70050000045429.description: Get access to 12 new hide and seek levels featuring stories of Brainy Smurf.

70050000045430.name: Personal Boards 1
70050000045430.intro: Create your own colorful stories with the latest DLC!
70050000045430.description: Unlock 6 new boards where you can draw your own stories.

70050000045431.name: Pinball FX - A Charlie Brown Christmas™ Pinball
70050000045431.intro: Find the real meaning of Christmas in A Charlie Brown Christmas™ Pinball!
70050000045431.description:
Find the real meaning of Christmas in A Charlie Brown Christmas™ Pinball! Join the Peanuts crew in putting on a play and decorating the most perfect tree there is.

Table features: 

- Snowflakes fall on the playfield, shoot the ball to eat them before they melt
- Feed Snoopy a snack by shooting his bowl
- Choose the perfect Christmas tree by shooting the right lanes
- Decorate Snoopy's house in Multiball to win the Lights and Display contest
- Direct the play in the Wizard mode and bring the Peanuts crew together to celebrate!

70050000045434.name: Kawaii Pack
70050000045434.description:
Get into the groove with cute Japanese music and accessories in the Kawaii Pack! This pack features:

Three songs
- “Idol” by YOASOBI
- “ABC de Daijoubu!” from Love and Berry
- “Milky Star,Shooting Star” from maimai

Love and Berry Fashion Set
- Love T-shirt
- Bob cut hair Accessory
- Tambourine Maracas
- Tambourine Sound Effect
- Love and Berry Icon

70050000045437.name: Track Pack 2
70050000045437.intro: We're back with another expansion for Conduct TOGETHER! Expand your world with more levels and trains!
70050000045437.description:
The Conduct TOGETHER! Track Pack 2 expands and changes your conducting journey with 25 new levels spread across 5 new worlds.

Some of these levels will include new features and tracks to challenge you in different ways.

One such example is the new railway turntable that will let you rotate tracks to connect in new ways.

The HQ has also doubled in size as this track pack includes a whole 28 new trains for you to collect. Collect the new trains by completing all new challenges and earning achievements!

70050000045478.name: Tricky Taps: Paint Power DLC
70050000045478.intro: Roll the ball down the twisty roads while using new epic skins and power flower trail!
70050000045478.description:
With this DLC you will be able to unlock:
- Love Struck ball skin 
- Star Eyed ball skin 
- Mr. Sunglasses ball skin 
- Youful ball skin 

Unlock instantly:
- PAINT BALL skin
- Flower Power trail skin
- additional 10000 gems to spend on ball skins and trails

Change the look of your ball, put on your new trail and roll!

70050000045480.name: Astro Miner: Moons DLC
70050000045480.intro: Explore 12 moons and collect all the treasures using your new vehicles!
70050000045480.description:
With this DLC you will unlock:

- 12 bonus levels with moons on which you will find great cash rewards that will help you buy upgrades much earlier! 
- new Red Carpet vehicle 
- new Rainbow Cloud vehicle 

Embark on a journey to different moons, collect lots of cash and try out riding new vehicles!

70050000045482.name: Astro Miner: Caves DLC
70050000045482.intro: Explore 12 caves and collect all the treasures using your new vehicles!
70050000045482.description:
With this DLC you will unlock:

- 12 bonus underground mines where you can find lots of extra gold coins to spend on power-ups or skins much earlier!
- new Flying Boat vehicle 
- new UFO vehicle 

Embark on a journey to different mines, collect lots of cash and try out riding new vehicles!

70050000045488.name: Bandle Tale: Bigger-On-The-Inside Pack
70050000045488.description:
The Bandle Tale: Bigger-On-The-Inside Pack includes:
Poro Closet: Dress up your fluffy little poro pal in two exclusive (and ultra-cute) outfits.
Stand Behind Poro!
Buzzy Poro
Home Sweet Backpack: Two eye-catching exteriors for your bigger-on-the-inside backpack home.
Honeycomb Hive
Purple Prism Bungalow
Strut with Style: Three pathway effects for your character.
Busy Bee
Zip-Zap!
Full Speed Ahead 
Secret Menu: Order up! Fresh out of the oven, three additional recipes to add to your cookbook.
Rainbow Egg
Almost-Perilous Pie

70050000045520.name: Fitness Boxing Fist of the North Star Expansion Pack
70050000045520.intro: Two new modes for post-apocalyptic workouts!
70050000045520.description:
A brand new DLC Expansion Pack that enhances the Fitness Boxing Fist of the North Star experience!

- Heart Mode gauges how many consecutive hits you can make
One of Shin's henchmen, Heart the Destroyer of Fists, enters the ring! Heart Mode includes two new kinds of content: the Hundred Blows Challenge, where you must throw a set number of quick punches within the time limit, and the Hundred Blows Test, where you deliver as many hits as you can within ten seconds. Brace yourself and hit Heart with a furious flurry of punches!

- Raoh Mode tests the sheer strength of your fists
Raoh Mode includes the Single Hit Challenge, where you pummel outlaws with quick, well-timed punches, as well as the Punch Speed Test, which measures just how fast you can swing your fist. Step into Raoh's shoes and give your foes a taste of the legendary power of his fists!

- All-new music and outfits!
Eight exclusive music tracks and two different sets of outfits per instructor have been added. Playing Heart Mode and Raoh Mode nets you points that can be used to obtain new music and instructor outfits.

Take your post-apocalyptic workouts to the next level with this brand-new Expansion Pack!

*In order to play the additional content, you will need to own the base game Fitness Boxing Fist of the North Star.
*The languages supported are the same as in the base game, but the character voices are only available in English.
*Heart only appears in Heart Mode and does not appear as an instructor.
*Statistics such as play time or number of punches thrown do not affect Today's Record or My Data.

70050000045521.name: High Octane Moto Pack
70050000045521.intro: Add motorcycles to your garage with the High Octane Moto Pack.
70050000045521.description:
Unleash the unstoppable energy of two-wheeled racing with the "High Octane Moto Pack" for Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure. Experience the roar of engines and the rush of wind against your face as you commandeer three unique motorcycles, each boasting its own distinct characteristics and designed to redefine your racing experience.

• Sandstorm: A rugged dirt bike built for off-road dominance. 
• Blade 1000R: A turbocharged street beast that's all about speed and precision. 
• Pulsar: A fusion-powered superbike featuring magnetic-suspension and a glowing powerframe.

All new motorcycles come unlocked and ready to play! Complete the vehicle missions to unlock an exclusive gold skin for each bike and brag about that bling.

The High Octane Moto Pack enhances every twist and turn of the racetracks you know and love with the heart-stopping excitement of two-wheeled racing. Are you ready to kick into high gear?

70050000045522.name: Turbo Titans Car Pack
70050000045522.intro: Inject a powerful shot of adrenaline into your Island Adventure with a diverse fleet of five incredible vehicles.
70050000045522.description:
The Turbo Titans Car Pack injects a powerful shot of adrenaline into Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure with a diverse fleet of five incredible vehicles. Each machine is crafted with a completely unique persona, designed to refresh your game with a variety of new racing experiences and tactics.

• Javelin: This dragster’s streamlined body and powerful engine make it the epitome of straight-line speed.
• X-Stream: A futuristic dune buggy with a flexible open suspension, the X-Stream turns desert dunes into thrilling playgrounds.
• Extinguisher: With the Extinguisher monster fire truck, you'll tower over the competition, combining raw power with a heart of service.
• Killawatt: A sleek electric supercar that hums with power, the Killawatt embodies pure speed.
• Warhawk: Made from the fuselage of an old fighter plane, this rugged three-wheeler thrives in rough terrain.

All new cars come unlocked and ready to play! Complete the vehicle missions to unlock an exclusive gold skin for each car and brag about that bling.

With a range of fast, powerful, quirky and bold car designs, the Turbo Titans Car Pack offers exciting new racing experiences for your favorite off-road kart racing game!

70050000045562.name: Clue - Whispering Pines Retreat Crime Scene
70050000045562.intro: Interrogate suspects at the recently opened Whispering Pines Retreat, where the vibes are relaxation and revenge!
70050000045562.description:
A new story unfolds at Whispering Pines Retreat! A group of six supposed strangers seek refuge in the brand-new forest wellness centre, but things take a dreadful turn when they become entangled in a shocking crime…

Mr Boden “Boddy” Black personally invited each guest to his state-of-the-art retreat for some much-needed R&R away from their personal struggles – so which of them would decide to manifest his murder? And did it have anything to do with the true nature of Whispering Pines Retreat?

Six suspects, multiple motives and one victim – solve the case and become the ultimate detective in this all-new crime scene for Clue/Cluedo! 

INCLUDES:
A BRAND-NEW CRIME SCENE – Check in to Whispering Pines Retreat, Mr Boden “Boddy” Black’s wellness retreat, and take in the beautiful sights.
THEMED COSMETICS – This crime scene includes a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a leafy dice set and 12 new tokens.
MORE STORY TO EXPLORE – Discover new backstories, motives and clues in an original Clue/Cluedo tale!

70050000045564.name: Clue - Polar Research Station Crime Scene
70050000045564.intro: Melt away the lies and discover the truth behind the chilling murder at the Polar Research Station!
70050000045564.description:
At the frozen ends of the Earth, a cold-blooded murder stains the ice crimson!

Take refuge from the howling blizzard and head to the Polar Research Station, a remote outpost founded and funded by the victim himself, Mr Boden “Boddy” Black. 

Search for clues in the claustrophobic confines of the building and examine six new weapons exclusive to the Polar Research Station crime scene.

Did Security Chief Mustard silence Boddy with the Shovel, or did Journalist Scarlett sever ties with the Ice Axe? Did Climatologist Plum use the Harpoon Gun to hunt new prey, or did Consultant Peacock crack under Boddy’s scrutiny and reach for the Microscope? 

Maybe Environmental Minister Green took Boddy’s final breath away with the Oxygen Tank, or perhaps Pilot White used the Welding Tool to seal his fate…  

An all-new location, original tale and wintry cosmetics make this a must-have crime scene for any Clue/Cluedo fan! 

INCLUDES:
A BRAND-NEW CRIME SCENE – Brave the cold and make your way to the Polar Research Station to investigate the snowy scene of the crime.
THEMED COSMETICS – This crime scene includes a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, an icy dice set and 12 new tokens.
MORE STORY TO EXPLORE – Learn more about the eclectic cast as they come under pressure at such a remote location…

70050000045606.name: From Space Mission Pack: Molten Iron
70050000045606.description:
This From Space DLC provides additional content for Horde Mode only.

Things are warming up! Well, that’s fine by us, because we know you’re ready to bring the heat. Deploy into two new maps and fend off rounds of relentless aliens with brand-new equipment, items, and perks.

2 New Maps
The ‘Crucible’ is our last bastion against the invaders. It’s a vital facility where we forge weapons to help defend earth, and it must be protected at all costs. It’s a great opportunity to make use of the scorching environment and submerge our little pink friends in molten iron. Mwahaha. 

‘Steelworks’ is an industrial arena where the towers of the blast furnaces are located. Navigate yourself around carefully while luring aliens into overflow points where superheated steam and fire are being vented. Aliens are best served with a seasoned crisp! 

New Weapon – Plasma Shotgun
Our latest invention the ‘Plasma Shotgun’ is an incredibly powerful weapon that afflicts plasma damage on our pink foes. It’s great to be armed with this beast of a weapon when you find yourself in a tight spot. 

New Item – Bear Trap
It’s a bear trap but for aliens. This item deals immense damage while holding enemies in place temporarily, making for easy targets. 

New Item – Napalm Mine 
Things are getting serious. The general has just dropped us a Napalm Mine. This new item will inflict burning damage over a huge area. It’s equal parts epic, chaotic and fun. 

New Perk – Protective Coveralls
Don’t find yourself in a sticky situation! Our scientists have been hard at work, and they’ve provided us with blueprints for a new type of outfit that will protect you against elemental damage types.

70050000045607.name: From Space Mission Pack: Concrete Jungle
70050000045607.description:
This DLC provides additional content for Horde Mode only. 

Prepare yourself, the invasion is expanding into the depths of the city. Deploy into two new maps and fend off rounds of relentless aliens with brand-new equipment, items, and perks. 

2 New Maps 
Welcome ‘Rooftop’ and ‘Hospital’. Take the fight to the picturesque city skyline or defend the wounded as aliens infest the hospital. These two stunning maps will see you repelling the invasion using intuitive built-in features. 

New Weapon – Medic Gun 
This gun will restore health when you shoot it at one of your buddies, but don’t worry – it still afflicts damage when you fire at your enemies. Talk about multi-purpose, eh? 

New Item – Decoy Soldier 
This item will deploy a cardboard cut-out of a soldier that attracts aliens. The General let us in on a secret - it’s a fantastic way of grouping aliens for your explosive weapons. 

New Item – Ice Maker 
Fun fact - these aliens really dislike the cold. Too bad for them. The ‘Ice Maker’ is a surefire way of slowing down the horde while causing freeze damage. 

New Perk – Resurrection perk 
Perfect for solo players, with this perk you no longer must wait for a friend to revive you. This will resurrect you instantly, meaning you can join the fight once more!

70050000045608.name: Operation: Clear Skies
70050000045608.description:
This DLC provides additional content for Story Mode. 

Attention, Specialists! Welcome to our latest operation, ‘Clear Skies’. We need you to rally the gang together once more. There’s a remote settlement located in the furthest reaches of our world, and it’s in dire need of our extensive expertise. This could turn the tide in our fight against the aliens... 

Gorgonville is the name of a settlement of improvised buildings, where survivors and resistance fighters make a living by scavenging downed Alien aircraft for anything of value to trade on the black market. 

During this expedition, you’ll find immersive new characters that will provide you with dangerous tasks. Among the survivors is Doc Vestergaard, a scientist who has discovered a powerful weapon in one of the vessels. The device was damaged in the crash, but thankfully it can be repaired. Once the weapon is operational, it can be used to launch a surprise attack, and tip the scales of the battle in favor of the resistance! 

This is where you come in. Specialists like you are being called in to find and retrieve the missing parts, but to do so, you must scavenge downed vessels that are loaded to the brim with traps and enemies. Will your team endure? 

Operation: Clear Skies includes: 

- Embark on a journey to three beautiful environments overrun by aliens 

- Fight for survival with crashed alien vessels to explore and unique challenges to overcome 

- Immerse yourself in a heart-pounding, all-new soundtrack that'll have you grooving as you obliterate wave after wave of extraterrestrial foes! 

- Interact with a multitude of characters, each with their own secrets waiting to be unraveled! 

New exciting storyline to uncover 

- Harness the power of two brand-new specialists: The cunning Scavenger and the Xeno Expert, both armed to the teeth with specialist weapons and game-changing perks!

70050000045610.name: Seekers of the Storm
70050000045610.description:
A Soul, born without purpose, locked away and forgotten. The prison was both her sanctuary and shackle. Her fate: doomed by her flawless design. Millennia passed. Her desperation grew, and from the depths of her solitude, she brought another into the world she lost. Now, The False Son walks Petrichor V, bound by the betrayal of his forebearer and the corruption of a King’s blind ambition.
Only one player is required to own Seekers of the Storm to enable the expansion for the whole lobby. Players without Seekers of the Storm will be unable to select the new survivors or permanently unlock new items, logbooks, or other content. 
Conquer the Path of the Colossus 
Prepare for an expedition deep into Petrichor V’s lost regions! Ancient Lemurian temples and crashing waterfalls lead the way across new stages. Explore the caverns and take in the suspicious smell of strawberries in Verdant Falls. Fend off scores of Lemurians within their Reformed Altar. Or drop into the lush green canopy of the Treeborn Colony. 
But the true threat towers overhead… Travel the path of the Colossus and ascend its levels in a race to confront The False Son. Defeat him and unlock the true power of his Soul!

70050000045614.name: Dead by Daylight: Chucky Chapter

70050000045797.name: CATAN® - Console Edition: Cities & Knights
70050000045797.description:
Your success on Catan has brought prosperity and wealth – along with unwanted attention. A merciless barbarian horde can smell the riches and is descending on Catan’s shores. Can you still come out on top as the winning Catanian with this threat looming over the island? Will your knights be strong enough to stem the tide alone, or can you put aside your differences with other cities in the greater defense of Catan? Every decision counts, and the clock is ticking.

- Develop a Civilization
Cities & Knights provides players with the opportunity to develop their cities into burgeoning metropolises by introducing new commodities to the game: paper, coin, and cloth. These commodities are essential for upgrading your city’s development in three areas: trade, politics, and science. These upgrade requirements increase per level of city improvements. 

- Make progress
Cities & Knights introduces the progress card mechanic. Gather and play progress cards to give your cities an advantage. Play a ‘Master Merchant’ progress card, for example, to look at another player’s resource and commodity cards, who has more victory points than you, and select two to add to your own stockpile.

- Shore up your defenses
Build and promote your knights to defend against the barbarian horde, and work to inhibit other players as they try to improve their own cities. Continue development, and you can eventually transform your city into a metropolis, making your city immune to barbarian attack!

- Repel the barbarians
When the barbarians attack, the size of their horde depends on the total number of cities on the board. Combine your knights’ strength with those of other players, but be warned, should your gallant knights fail in the defense of Catan, the weakest player will see their city sacked and reduced to a settlement.

70050000045801.name: Edge of the World
70050000045801.intro:
New Main Character [Fiona], New Sailor [Marlene],
Exclusive Port [Reykjavik]and Enemy [The Hanseatic League],
and New World Boss [the Fermor]!
70050000045801.description:
"Leave Stockholm for Reykjavik."
"It's your mother's hometown and where we first met."

The World's End DLC comes with the following content:

New Main Character [Fiona]
Fiona, a Swedish merchant of Viking descent inherited her family's failing business and huge debts brought about by the Hanseatic League's sanctions. Despite the pain from losing her father, Fiona is determined to keep her family's hard work away from the hands of their creditors, and she is desperately in need of a large sum of money to turn things around.

New Sailor [Marlene]
Marlene, an outstanding but grumpy shipwright and craftsman. She was raised by Fiona's father after losing her parents and treats Fiona like her own elder sister, even though they are of the same age. Upon hearing that Fiona plans to set sail in search of an opportunity to repay her family's debts, Marlene decides to join the adventure and contribute her outstanding skills as a shipwright.

DLC Story-Exclusive Port [Reykjavik]
Fiona follows the clues and things her father left behind and discovers a port linked to her mother's origins, Reykjavik. In order to help Reykjavik prosper and thrive into a busy commercial port, Fiona decides to crush the Hanseatic League's monopoly rule...

New Story-Exclusive Enemy [The Hanseatic League]
In the bustling trade center known as Lübeck, a powerful business alliance was born—the Hanseatic League.
They took the reins of the entire business world through carefully planned trade routes and commodities. Any port that refused cooperation with them would be hit with heavy sanctions and suffer being forcefully blocked off from all trade.
Meanwhile, the Hanseatic League secretly built a powerful armed maritime force in preparation for any resistance they may face.

Twenty years ago, Fiona's father attempted to resist them, yet their trade restrictions led to his debts piling up and eventual bankruptcy.
Twenty years later, today, history is about to change by your hand...
New World Boss [the Fermor]
Gladio, a former admiral in the navy, was "forced" to become a deserter during a decisive battle, and the bounty on his head threw him into the abyss.
Unlike his subordinates whose hearts are clouded with greed, Gladio has his own code, even after becoming a pirate.

70050000045893.name: Easy Red 2: Ardennes 1940 & 1944
70050000045893.intro: Command history in Easy Red 2: Ardennes 1940 & 1944! Blitz through the early chaos of WWII's Invasion of France, then brace for the brutal winter battles of the Ardennes campaign. W
70050000045893.description:
Dive into the heart of history with the Easy Red 2 expansion, introducing two thrilling new campaigns:

Blitzkrieg on Stonne - 1940:
Witness the early chaos of World War II as you embark on the French Invasion in 1940, centered around the strategic Stonne area. Can you rewrite the fate of this pivotal battle?

Ardennes Bulge - 1944:
Shift gears to the late stages of the war in the Ardennes campaign, set in the unforgiving terrain of Bulge. Forge your path through the icy battlegrounds in a bid for victory.

What's New:
•Immerse yourself in two fresh maps and tackle 13 historically accurate missions, available for both attackers and defenders.
•Take control of an impressive array of vehicles, including the Panzer II, Char B1 bis, FT-17, Citroen 23R, and more for the French campaign. Plus, unleash the Jagdpanther G1, M4A3E2 Sherman, and winter variants of base game vehicles in the Bulge campaign.
•Arm yourself with authentic early war French infantry weapons, including the MAS36, MAS38, Lebel 1886, FM 24/29, and the Ruby pistol.
•Experience revolutionary destructibility design, witnessing buildings crumble in a more realistic and immersive way than ever before in Easy Red 2.

70050000046097.name: SnowRunner - Season 13: Dig & Drill
70050000046097.description:
Dig & Drill is Season 13 of SnowRunner. Included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

Local authorities in the region of Almaty, Kazakhstan need your help to kickstart a new mining venture. Conduct geological surveys, supply the quarries with essential equipment and reopen the cargo airport with the use of 2 new vehicles.

The Season 13: Dig & Drill expansion includes:

•	A new 2km² map set in Almaty. A rugged, remote corner of Kazakhstan where sprawling mountain ranges meet dense coniferous forests and giant mineral quarries.
•	Two new vehicles: the PLAD 450, an 8x8 powerhouse equipped to handle any job, and the AAC-58DW, a wide-body scouting SUV fit for any terrain thanks to its superior stability.
 
New activities: Help the local government rebuild their mining infrastructure by conducting geological surveys, rebuilding the cargo airport, delivering equipment and transporting valuable raw materials.

70050000046101.name: SnowRunner - Season 14: Reap & Sow
70050000046101.description:
Reap & Sow is Season 14 of SnowRunner. Included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

Austrian officials need you to renovate their region’s Renaissance castle and kickstart a new season of farming with 4 vehicles across two new 4km² maps. Rehabilitate bridges, maintenance sites and solar panels to breathe new life into the region’s tourism and agricultural industries.

The Season 14: Reap & Sow includes:

- Two new 4km² map set in Austria. Complete missions through a picturesque region in the heart of the Alpine valleys.

- Four new vehicles: the Earthroamer SW and Earthroamer LTI, two incredible fleet support Scout vehicles equipped with sizable repair modules, and two powerful and versatile tractors, the Futom 7290RA and Ankatra 1160, both equipped with their own logging crane!

- New activities: Help Austria revive its tourism and agricultural industries by renovating historical castles, supplying a Renaissance fair as well as by fixing bridges and maintenance infrastructure to support local farmers.

70050000046105.name: SnowRunner - Season 15: Oil & Dirt
70050000046105.description:

Québec is bursting with exciting projects, and they need you to construct an oil platform by delivering building materials and a massive anchor. Link roads together to form a new highway network, help organize a major fishing festival and more, with 2 new trucks across 2 brand new maps.

Season 15: Oil & Dirt includes:

• Two new 4km² maps set in Québec, Canada. Complete new missions across a new winter region traversed by tall mountains and frozen rivers.
• Two new vehicles: the Sleiter ST 816 “Elephant”, a 6-wheel Heavy Duty tractor able to pull even the heaviest loads, and the Mercer K520, an agile and versatile Off-road truck with exceptional capabilities in exploration and rescue scenarios. 
• New activities: Help Québec companies with major infrastructure projects after the Canadian winter had them grind to halt, and celebrate the region’s angling industry by helping organize a major fishing festival.

70050000046109.name: SnowRunner - Season 16: High Voltage
70050000046109.description:
Welcome to Washington! High Voltage tasks you with building a hydropower plant across 3 large maps with the help of 3 new trucks. Repair Washington’s infrastructure to deliver the super-sized equipment needed at the dam, patch up the region’s small towns to welcome new workers and more!

• Three new 4km² maps set in Washington. Take on new challenges in the lush forests and hilly terrain of the northwestern USA.
• Three new vehicles: the H.I.B Billert 1980, an Off-road truck with excellent suspensions and a wide range of available add-ons, the PLAD 440 “Buddy”, a nimble Off-road truck with switchable AWD and differential lock capabilities and the Sleiter ST833 “Chimera”, a formidably durable workhorse with superior torque and great ground clearance.
• New activities:  Repair and modernize Washington’s infrastructure following a streak of extreme weather events to assist in the construction of the state’s newest hydropower plant. Rebuild river crossings and tunnels, patch up local small towns to house new workers and prop local industries back up to operation before delivering a super-sized turbine to the dam.

Season 16 is SnowRunner’s fourth expansion and is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

70050000046123.name: Starward Rogue: AuGMENTED
70050000046123.intro: AuGMENTED is Starward Rogue, but bigger, better, and coated with gold.
70050000046123.description:
AuGMENTED is Starward Rogue, but bigger, better, and coated with gold. Newly added Gold Floors mysteriously appear throughout your run. Inhabited by rare enemies, unique treasures await those who can overcome the challenges within.

* A new gold floor with unique challenges and rewards
* 4 new music tracks composed by Pablo Vega and The Overthinkers
* 3 new mechs: The Zephyr, The Paladin, and the Warhog
* 90+ new items
* 30+ new enemies
* 125+ new rooms
* 8 new room obstacles such as the pulse trap and the flamethrower turret
* 10+ challenge rooms (a new room type exclusive to the gold floors)
* 6 new minibosses
* 9 new bosses

70050000046128.name: Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Soundtrack
70050000046128.description:
You’ve played the game, you’ve smashed the balls, you’ve explored the worlds. But have you listened to the music? The Bang-On Balls: Chronicles soundtrack is a musical masterpiece that will take you on a sonic adventure through time and space. From the ancient Norse sagas to the modern cyberpunk dystopia, from the cosmic disco to the pirate rock, this soundtrack has it all.

Enjoy 40 original tracks composed by Łukasz Salomon Bryła and Matthew Chilleli - Two talented musicians who have poured their hearts and souls into creating a musical experience that matches the game’s humor and charm.

There’s no time to waste. Get the Bang-On Balls: Chronicles soundtrack today!

70050000046129.name: The Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Survival Guide
70050000046129.intro: The Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Survival Guide
70050000046129.description:
You’ve conquered the world of Bang-On Balls: Chronicles, but do you have what it takes to survive as an unpaid intern in a cutthroat industry? Doesn’t really matter if you answered yes or no, because you are gonna need the Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Survival Guide anyway!

The Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Survival Guide is a digital artbook that gives you an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the insights of Bang-On Balls: Chronicles.

You’ll follow the adventures of a new intern who joins Bang-On Studios and has to deal with crazy deadlines, demanding bosses, eccentric coworkers, and of course, balls.
For all the art lovers - the Survival Guide is filled with concept art and drawings, so there’s something for everyone to enjoy!

70050000046133.name: Hamster Playground - Hamster City DLC
70050000046133.intro: It's time to get to work!
70050000046133.description:
It's time to get to work! 
Hamster City is a DLC pack for Hamster Playground - a fresh dose of content that adds new gameplay elements.  It's time for the hamsters to experience what real work is, right?
Please help them decorate their home in urban style, dressing them up in new costumes reminiscent of urban occupations. Perform new tasks and learn new professions related to typical urban elements. 

Hamster City DLC includes:
New urban-style items for the hamster's home;
Costumes refer to jobs like nurse, and construction worker.
Brand new tasks with unique rewards;
New jobs to do for your Hamsters.

70050000046135.name: Hamster Playground - Doll House DLC
70050000046135.intro: Every girl dreams of a dollhouse, right?
70050000046135.description:
Every girl dreams of a dollhouse, right? 
Doll House is a DLC pack for Hamster Playground - This time it is strongly related to the theme of just a doll house.  Among other things, this set will allow you to dress up your hamsters as a band of rock musicians! 
It's time to relate to this element by changing your house to a truly rock style. 

Doll House DLC includes:
New Costumes for your hamster rock stars.
Items for your house allow you to turn it into a doll house. 
Brand new quests with unique rewards;
New jobs to do for your Hamsters

70050000046137.name: Hamster Playground - Kawaii DLC
70050000046137.description:
Domo Arigato, Mr. Hamsta! 
Kawaii is a new DLC pack for Hamster Playground - a pack of content that relates strongly to the land of cherry blossoms. This set will allow your hamsters to impersonate samurai, don kimono, etc. 
Put your hamsters in a good mood by decorating their home in a truly Asian style, Performing new tasks, and doing new work in an over-glamorous Japanese-referenced place. 

Kawaii DLC includes:
New Japanese-style matching items for the hamster's home;
Costumes that let you embody your Asian roots.
Brand new quests with unique rewards;
New jobs to do for your Hamsters.

70050000046140.name: Hamster Playground - Spooky Hamster House DLC
70050000046140.intro: Introduce a bit of spookiness to the party!

70050000046143.name: Golf With Your Friends - Teams Mascot Hat Pack
70050000046143.description:
Teams from around the world have arrived to stake their claim as the greatest putters in all the land, and they brought merch! This pack features 12 unique hats based on Golf With Your Friends’ biggest teams including:
Nimble Gnomes Hat
Cursed Corrupters Hat

70050000046144.name: Golf With Your Friends - Teams Mascot Sticker Pack
70050000046144.description:
Teams from around the world have arrived to stake their claim as the greatest putters in all the land! This pack features 12 free unique stickers based on Golf With Your Friends’ biggest teams including:
