70050000046145.name: Hamster Playground - Skateboard Game Mode
70050000046145.intro: Get ready for the latest adrenaline-pumping game mode addition to Hamster Playground - introducing "Skateboard Racing" game mode!
70050000046145.description:
Get ready for the latest adrenaline-pumping game mode addition to HamsterPlayground - introducing "Skateboard Racing" game mode! 

It's time for your hamster to become a skateboarding sensation. Take part in races, navigating specially designed tracks racing together with 3 other hamsters to become a winner and win prizes.

In "Skateboard Racing" your hamster's agility is put to the ultimate test.

Compete against friends or AI opponents, each race promises an exciting experience. Press the button at the right moment, and propel yourself towards victory. The roar of the crowd, the rush of the wind as you pick up speed, and the joy of crossing the finish line - "Skateboard Racing" brings a new level of excitement to HamsterPlayground.

70050000046147.name: Hamster Playground - Eating Contest Game Mode
70050000046147.intro: Treat yourself to a special treat with our latest DLC "Eating Contest" for Hamster Playground!
70050000046147.description:
Treat yourself to a special treat with our latest DLC "Eating Contest" for Hamster Playground! 

Get ready for a gastronomic spectacle where your hamster will participate in a hilarious and delicious eating contest. Choose matching food to the picture shown, devour the goodies, and beat the competition to become the undisputed eating champion!

In Eating Contest, strategy meets gluttony as your hamster devours a variety of treats, from crunchy seeds to delicious vegetables and everything in between.

70050000046151.name: AEW: Fight Forever Swerve to the Beach
70050000046151.description:
Leader of the Mogul Embassy Swerve Strickland joins the AEW: Fight Forever roster! Swerve kicks off Season 3 along with the brand new day to evening beach base map PLUS two new attire customization options.

This content is part of Season Pass 3 which includes:
3 more talents added to the roster, new day and evening beach maps, 33 brand new moves, 42 new skin + attire options, and 11 new music tracks.

70050000046153.name: AEW: Fight Forever Giant Swing in the Ring
70050000046153.description:
All Elite Wrestling and Ring of Honor star Claudio Castagnoli joins the AEW: Fight Forever roster with his famous European Uppercut. The Giant Swing in the Ring DLC also features 30 re-skin options, as well as an alternate version of Claudio's entrance music.

This content is part of Season Pass 3 which includes:
3 more talents added to the roster, new day and evening beach maps, 33 brand new moves, 42 new skin + attire options, and 11 new music tracks.

70050000046154.name: AEW: Fight Forever Hayter's Gunna Game
70050000046154.description:
Former Women's World Champion and English wrestling legend Jamie Hayter is now part of the AEW: Fight Forever roster! The Hayter's Gunna Game DLC also features 5 new premium music tracks!

This content is part of Season Pass 3 which includes:
3 more talents added to the roster, new day and evening beach maps, 33 brand new moves, 42 new skin + attire options, and 11 new music tracks.

70050000046155.name: AEW: Fight Forever Freebie 4 da Fans
70050000046155.description:
We love our loyal Fight Forever fans! Five new music tracks and 10 new attire options are our way of saying thank you!

This content is part of Season Pass 3 which includes:
3 more talents added to the roster, new day and evening beach maps, 33 brand new moves, 42 new skin + attire options, and 11 new music tracks.

70050000046157.name: Hamster Playground - Beware The Cat Game Mode
70050000046157.intro: Get ready for an exciting addition to Hamster Playground - "Beware The Cat" mode!
70050000046157.description:
Attention all hamster lovers! Get ready for an exciting addition to Hamster Playground - "Beware The Cat" mode!

In this heart-pumping game mode, your hamster turns into a top racing driver, trying to reach the finish line marked by the iconic red and green lights. It's not just a race; it's a test of speed, agility, and perfect timing!

"Beware The Cat" mode provides a new level of excitement as your hamster sprints when the light is green, but must stop in place when it turns red. 

Compete against friends or AI opponents in fast-paced races full of unexpected stops and starts. Get through the race and across the finish line, proving that your hamster is not only fast, but also extremely responsive.

70050000046165.name: Hamster Playground - Vehicle Pull Game Mode
70050000046165.intro: Hold on to the wheels - "Vehicle Pull" is the newest game mode in Hamster Playground!
70050000046165.description:
Hold on to the wheels - "Vehicle Pull" is the newest game mode in Hamster Playground! 

Turn up the excitement as your hamster becomes a small strongman, pulling mini-vehicles through challenging tracks. This is no ordinary race; it's a test of your hamster's strength, strategy, and power!

In "Vehicle Pull," your hamster puts on his tiny harness and prepares to tow a miniature wagon. 

Compete against friends or AI opponents in dynamic button-pushing challenges. Prove that your hamster is not only fast, but also extremely strong.

70050000046167.name: Hamster Playground - Ancient Skin Pack
70050000046167.intro: Unearth the mysteries of the past with the Ancient Hamster Set!
70050000046167.description:
Unearth the mysteries of the past with the Ancient Hamster Set! Adorn your hamster in majestic robes, intricate headdresses, and symbols of ancient wisdom. Watch as your hamster transforms into a regal figure, ready to explore the secrets of civilizations long gone.

This DLC contains a ready set of new costumes, as well as separate items for your hamster to dress up with other available elements.

70050000046169.name: Hamster Playground - Conquerors Skin Pack
70050000046169.intro: Channel the spirit of adventure with the Conquerors Hamster Set!
70050000046169.description:
Channel the spirit of adventure with the Conquerors Hamster Set! Whether your hamster takes on the persona of a fierce Viking or a cunning pirate, these sets offer helmets, swords, and eye patches that bring out the conqueror within. Your hamster is now set to sail the high seas or raid distant lands.

This DLC contains a set of new costumes, as well as many items for your hamster to dress up with.

70050000046171.name: Hamster Playground - Detectives Skin Pack
70050000046171.intro: Step into the thrilling world of mystery-solving with the Detectives Hamster Set!
70050000046171.description:
Step into the thrilling world of mystery-solving with the Detectives Hamster Set! 
Deck your furry friend in classic detective attire, complete with trench coats, magnifying glasses, and iconic detective hats. Your hamster is now a sharp-eyed investigator, always ready to solve the next adorable case.

This DLC contains a ready set of new costumes, as well as separate items for your hamster to dress up with other available elements.

70050000046173.name: Hamster Playground - Royal Hamsters DLC
70050000046173.intro: It's time for a little fantasy in our lives!
70050000046173.description:
It's time for a little fantasy in our lives! 
Royal Hamsters is the next DLC pack for Hamster Playground - a fantastic dose of content that adds new elements to the gameplay. This time there is a chance to impersonate our hamsters into knights, dragons, princesses, or jesters
Please help them by decorating their home in castle style, dressing them in new costumes reminiscent of royals. Perform new tasks and learn new professions as if from medieval stories.

Royal Hamsters DLC includes:
New items matching medieval stories for the hamster's home;
Costumes including a jester or a dragon
Brand new quests with unique rewards;
New jobs to do for your Hamsters.

70050000046175.name: Hamster Playground - Time Travelers Skin Pack
70050000046175.intro: Begin an epic journey through time with the Time Travelers Hamster Set!
70050000046175.description:
Begin an epic journey through time with the Time Travelers Hamster Set! Time to dress up like a doctor and his little helper, right?  Watch as your hamsters become time-traveling adventurers, ready to explore the past, present, and future.

This DLC contains a ready set of new costumes, as well as separate items for your hamster to dress up with other available elements.

70050000046177.name: Hamster Playground - Cute Pets DLC
70050000046177.intro: I feel a bit like a farm here...
70050000046177.description:
I feel a bit like a farm here...
Cute Pets is a new DLC pack for Hamster Playground - This time it is strongly related to the farm!  This set will allow your hamsters to impersonate various cute and adorable animals.
Wake up your hamsters to a whole new reality by decorating their home in a truly cute atmosphere.  Perform new tasks and do new jobs, this time on the farm!  

Cute Pets DLC includes:
New farm- and animal-related items for the hamster's home;
Costumes that allow hamsters to dress up as their favorite animal
Brand new quests with unique rewards;
New jobs to do for your Hamsters.

70050000046179.name: Hamster Playground - Magicians Skin Pack
70050000046179.intro: Dive into the enchanting world of magic with the Magicians Hamster Set!
70050000046179.description:
Dive into the enchanting world of magic with the Magicians Hamster Set! Cloaks, wizard hats, and wands transform your hamster into a mystical spellcaster. Watch as your hamster dazzles with whimsical tricks and illusions, becoming the star of its own magical show.

This DLC contains a set of new costumes, as well as many items for your hamster to dress up with.

70050000046206.name: DAVE THE DIVER - DREDGE Content Pack
70050000046206.description:
Encounter the characters and aberrations from the enigmatic fishing adventure game DREDGE, in Dave the Diver!

On days when the red fog rolls in, navigate the waters and dive to catch underwater aberrations.

Serve the aberrated fish sushi to the Hooded Figures visiting Bancho Sushi!

70050000046208.name: PowerWash Simulator – Santa's Workshop - Winter 2023
70050000046208.description:
Merry Washmas! This winter season we’re giving the gift of sudsy satisfaction in this free seasonal map for PowerWash Simulator. It’s time to chill out with a systematic spray-down of Santa’s Workshop.
Santa’s elves have had a major accident involving soot and ice cream... quite how this happened is anyone’s guess, but if anyone can uncover the dirt, it’s you. With Christmas just one sleep away, the incident has been escalated to code: Rudolph red. But all is not frost! You’re here to tackle the clean-up. The best things come in tall packages, and you can reach all the high spots (well, maybe with the help of a ladder here and there)! 

Unwrap a whole new look with a custom festive skin for your power washer and settle in for the coziest clean yet in an all-new cable-knit suit and gloves. 
Cleaning this place will be easier sled than done; it’ll take nothing short of a Christmas miracle to reveal the wonderous and whimsical workshop that lies beneath. Equip your trusty power washer to spruce up the tree and restore those candy-canes back to mint condition. Have the place looking good as new for the big day and you might just end up on the nice list.

70050000046219.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Underpants Gnome Cosmetics pack
70050000046219.description:
Elevate your style with The Underpants Gnome Cosmetics Pack! 

Unleash your fashion with those trendy items:

- Underpants Gnome hat
- Stylish beard
- Green tunic

70050000046220.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! CRED Cosmetics Pack
70050000046220.description: A kid today is defined by their hydration drink – and their swag. Impress your friends and show the world how much CRED you have. The CRED Cosmetics pack gives you plenty of cred with a fresh hairstyle, a CRED hoodie, and a cape.

70050000046221.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Asspen Pack
70050000046221.description:
Asspen Cosmetics Pack
Get ready to hit the slopes with the Asspen Cosmetics Pack featuring iconic outfits from the season 6 episode, “Asspen.” 
Ski Goggles 
Fluffy Ear Muffs 
Iconic Jester Hat
Puffy Jacket

70050000046222.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Snowball
70050000046222.description: The all-new snowball is perfect tool for all those who mastered the other weapons in the game. Unleash devastating new effects on enemies and grant powerful supporting effects on your allies too. Beware, this is not your average snowball - you need high precession and good timing to make the most out of this Snow Day favorite.

70050000046223.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Hammer
70050000046223.description:
Stand firm against the darkness and assume the mantle of a Paladin to bring swift and glorious justice to the battlefield with the all-new Hammer melee weapon. Smite your enemies with ground-shattering attacks and protect your allies with powerful shields and buffs.

This DLC features the all-new Hammer melee weapon, six new upgrade cards, and new cosmetics: 
Weapon: Hammer
Hat: Paladin's Helmet
Cape: Paladin's Cape
Tunic: Paladin's Chainmail
Emote: Victory Lap

70050000046224.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Good Times with Weapons Pack
70050000046224.description:
Harness the power of speed and stealth and follow the path of the Ninja with the all-new Ninja Stars ranged weapon variation. Strike quickly with a decisive burst of projectiles and vanish back into the shadows, for the life of a Ninja is complex and full of peril.
 
This DLC features an all-new weapon variation of the Wand: the Ninja Star ranged weapon. It also includes three brand-new upgrade cards and new cosmetics.
 
Hat: Ninja Hat
Facial Features: Ninja Mask
Tunic: Ninja Tunic
Hat: You're a dog!
Facial Features: Ninja Star to the Eye
Emote: Ninja Star Emote

70050000046225.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! To Danse with Ravenous Shadows
70050000046225.description: School is cancelled and Henrietta is bored. Join her efforts to pierce the veil and she will allow you to “Danse with the Ravenous Shadows” of South Park. Face waves of dark foes, upgrade your weapons, and master more dark powers to earn new cards from Henrietta. This new game mode provides an endless onslaught of enemies and enhance your dark powers.

70050000046234.name: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 One Piece Film: Red Anime Song Pack
70050000046234.description:
An additional music pack that adds popular tracks from the hit movie, One Piece Film: Red, as background music to the game.
After purchasing the pack, you can change the music settings on the Battle Preparation screen to listen to any track you desire during battle.

70050000046235.name: Vampire Survivors: Emergency Meeting
70050000046235.intro: Gather your Crewmates, eject Impostors, and be the bullet hell in Vampire Survivors: Emergency Meeting.
70050000046235.description:
The Survivors are desperate to hunt vampires, but are running out of places to look. Only one option remains: Be the bullet hell... in space! 

Gather your most trusted Crewmates, prepare to eject the Impostors, and try to survive while mowing down thousands of extra-terrestrial foes in this expansion for Vampire Survivors. Turn classic Among Us tasks into outrageous weapons, upgrading your abilities after every roguelite run to overcome impossible odds with ease. Be alert to subterfuge as you explore the vast weirdness of the Polus Replica and keep your wits about you, as suspicious eyes are always watching.

9 Totally Trustworthy New Characters 
A cast of courageous Crewmates assembled to take on the tumultuous tasks, including: 

Crewmate Dino - Starry-eyed, optimistic, and unfortunately extremely tasty. Dino is a jack-of-all-trades who boosts stats whenever a task is completed (i.e. when you level up a weapon). 
Engineer Gino - Few Crewmates come as close to truly competent task-work as Gino, who offers a selection of passive weapons from their toolbox every few levels. 
Ghost Lino - Good Crewmates don't let a silly thing like death get in the way of their tasks. Lino can float through walls at will and can't be hurt, but can't deal damage either... what could be the goal of such suspicious game design?! 
Shapeshifter Nino - Look at this bean! They can do all kinds of... wait, where did they go? And where did this snowman come from? Oh well, I'm sure you'll figure it out. 
Guardian Pina - Everyone needs an angel on their shoulder. Pina isn't just there for moral support, though - they boost the defences of all nearby allies, and they love taking out the garbage. 
Impostor Rina - A fellow Crewmate that is in no way some kind of duplicitous, well-disguised killer. One hundred percent all-natural-bean, right here. Nothing to see or think about. 
Scientist Mina - Mina's scientific skill is matched only by their intense clumsiness. Thankfully, dropping potentially hazardous chemicals has a major upside when you're besieged by extra-terrestrial monsters. 
Horse - It's a horse. Neigh, etc. 

15 New Weapons 
Transform your tasks into powerful weapons to defend yourself from Impostors, Shapeshifters, and all manner of extra-terrestrial weirdos. Blast away baddies with the supermassive sound waves of your Report! weapon, slice angry aliens in half with Lucky Swipe, and drop duplicitous foes to their doom with Just Vent. Lonely Survivors should seek out Mini Crewmates to empower their Task-based weaponry (or just for general companionship). 

A Brand New, Perfectly Safe Stage 
Polus Replica - an eerily accurate replica of the scientific base on Polus. This planet is packed with bizarre biomes ripe for exploration by Survivors and Crewmates, with tasks and treasure chests galore. Unfortunately, its also accidentally being invaded by your average space dwellers, like aliens, robots, and ducks. Expect the unexpected and do NOT trust the bins. Never trust the bins. Or the chicken nuggets. In fact, it's a good idea to remain alert at all times and not trust anything. 

6 New Music Tracks 
- Emergency Meeting
- Hide and Survive
- No Ducks Among Us
- No Aliens Among Us
- No Ghosts Among Us
- No Vampires Among Us

70050000046255.intro: Liberate Your Kingdom, Reclaim Your Destiny
70050000046255.description:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Unicorn Overlord with the 16-bit Arranged Music Album, offering a selection of 20 tracks to enjoy.

70050000046259.description: Kickstarter Reward Twilight Nocturne Wedding Dress

70050000046278.name: GeoJelly in the Space
70050000046278.intro: Embark on a cosmic journey with GeoJelly in the Space DLC!
70050000046278.description:
Explore 5 exhilarating new space levels, each defying the laws of gravity. Navigate through the void, leap through the air, and unlock the secrets of the universe. 

Encounter mind-bending portals, solve intricate space mazes, and discover fascinating facts about the cosmos. 

Brace yourself for a stellar adventure that takes platforming to new heights – or rather, to the depths of space

70050000046281.name: Crypt of the NecroDancer: SYNCHRONY

Crypt of the NecroDancer: SYNCHRONY is a massive new content pack for Crypt of the NecroDancer! It adds cross-platform online multiplayer (co-op and vs), three new characters, mod support (and built-in mod portal), new items, enemies, traps, and more!

Key features:

- Online multiplayer support for up to 8 players in co-op and vs modes!
- New character: Chaunter -- Posesses enemies and fights using their powers!
- New character: Suzu -- Speedy character with an invincible dash attack!
- New character: Klarinetta -- Does battle with a huge two-handed sword!
- Mod support and an integrated mod portal, allowing most aspects of the game to be modified!
- New weapons, spells, items, enemies, shrines, traps, and more!
- “Weekly Challenge" mode, featuring new community-made content each week!

70050000046297.name: Retro Diner Style Amy Costume
70050000046297.intro: A Retro Diner Costume for a classic gal.
70050000046297.description: Amy Rose is serving up smiles and speed with a heapin' side of hammer! Get the perfect classic look with the Retro Diner Style Amy Costume.

70050000046329.name: Clue - Painted Red

70050000046486.name: PowerWash Simulator – Muckingham Files – Part 4
70050000046486.description:
Part four of the Muckingham Files series brings you two new Bonus Jobs from friends in high places. Clean up local crypto enthusiast, Devon King’s vandalised modern mansion and pilot Floraine Perez’ fire plane following a flight over Mount Rushless.

Resident technophile, Devon King, has made a small fortune by investing a substantially larger fortune in crypto currency, inspiring the creation of his very own ‘MuckCoin’. The builders at his newly completed mansion have protested Devon’s attempt to pay them in his new currency by defacing the place before the move-in date, and he just can’t make cents of their ire. An indebted investor might not be the wisest choice of client, but dirt is your crypto-nite - and he has a substantial deposit of it. The large, flat surfaces of the modern mansion make for super-satisfying cleaning, whilst some witty graffiti makes for great entertainment while you wash.

Another call for your cleaning services is coming in hot. Local fire plane, the Sky Whale, is in need of a proper good hose-down. Despite the name, staying aloft isn’t the problem: a serious lack of visibility is. One trip through Mount Rushless’ ominous plume has left the plane coated in a thick layer of ash. Wipe down this seriously impressive set of wings to get pilot Perez back on course. A ‘stationery supply drop’ to a neighbouring town is on the line; if that doesn’t light a fire under you, what will?!

About the Muckingham Files
The Muckingham Files is a series of free updates that take you to never-before-seen places from the original universe of PowerWash Simulator, with new characters, locations and stories. Get to know more about your stomping ground and its inhabitants as the most in-demand power washer in town.

70050000046488.name: PowerWash Simulator – Cruise Ship Sun Deck – Summer 2024
70050000046488.description:
Cool off with sudsy, high-pressured water this summer in PowerWash Simulator’s latest Seasonal Special. Take a vacation from Muckingham’s mainland to clean up the sun deck of Crab Bay’s cruise liner following a rather messy departure. Once you’re done, it should be smooth, sanitary sailing from there on out!

Ticked off tourists, fried foods and greedy gulls do not make for most folks’ idea of a dream holiday - but you are not most folks. If the destination is dirty, you’re on board! With the sun on your back and cool mist on your visor, cleaning up feels like a breeze. Say “bon voyage” to dirt as you slough off the remnants of an avian air assault, revealing the vivid sun deck beneath. Ahhh, so satisfying.

Whether you take on the task as a solo traveller or bring all hands on deck in co-op, you’ll be sure to feel the winter blues defrost in this summer muckbuster!

You’ll also receive all-new summer threads to have you looking and feeling cool. Well, as cool as you physically can in a rubber suit.

KEY FEATURES:
•	Wash and explore the Cruise Ship Sun Deck
•	New custom summer suit
•	New custom summer gloves
•	New custom power washer skin


About PowerWash Simulator’s Seasonal Specials

PowerWash Simulator’s Seasonal Specials is a series of free content updates containing a single map themed around a season or holiday – after all, cleaning isn’t just for Spring!

70050000046494.name: Monster Camp Character Pack - Colorful Campers
70050000046494.intro: It’s camping season again! Pack your bags and come back to Camp Spooky… with 4 brand new playable characters to choose from!
70050000046494.description:
It’s camping season again! Pack your bags and come back to Camp Spooky… with 4 brand new playable characters to choose from!
This is the pack for those who want to go beyond the classic 4 playable colors. Blue, Green, Red, and Yellow? Think again. 
Say hi to 4 new colorful characters who are ready to spice up this mix with complete new tones such as Pink and Orange!

Who are these rascals? 

Doug is the Slime Cube who's now more friend-shaped! He may be your choice if you have a soft side, a heart of gold, and the goal of having an unforgettable summer. 
Whiskey the Biker Unicorn, on the other hand... he's a tough-as-nails lad for those who want to kick ass and look fabulous at the same time.
Then there's Jacqueline the Earthly Pumpkin: her folksy farmer vibes will let you enjoy nature at its fullest.
And finally, you have Mamimi the Oni, for those who have two sides to them: chill&cool and energy drink-fueled competitive maelstrom. 

So get this pack and say welcome to these... COLORFUL CAMPERS!

70050000046704.intro: Prepare for New Challenges in Snap Together!
70050000046704.description:
Boost the fun levels with your friends! Now we have 54 more exciting levels for you to showcase your skills. 

No more boredom – just a thrilling time together! Dive into the Snap Together with a new DLC and feel the excitement of competition. Are you ready for new challenges? 

Let the game begin!

70050000046709.name: Sail Forth: Maelstrom
70050000046709.intro: Set sail and brace yourself for the Sail Forth Maelstrom expansion.
70050000046709.description:
Sail Forth: Maelstrom - Brave the Vortexes!
Dive headfirst into the heart of the storm with the Sail Forth Maelstrom expansion! A tempest has swept across the Deepblue, bringing forth colossal vortexes that promise unparalleled challenges and untold treasures. Are you ready to face the Maelstrom?

Meet the Arcane Order
The Maelstrom is watched over by mysterious guardians who offer strange new rewards to sailors willing to risk charting the depths of the Underworld. In exchange for much-coveted Maelstrom Pearls, the Arcane Order is willing to offer everything from ancient weaponry to custom cosmetics.

Enter the Maelstrom
The Underworld beneath the Maelstrom is brimming with fresh opportunities and dangerous new nastybads. Navigate treacherous waters as you encounter new, formidable foes and uncover the mysteries that lurk in the depths.

Beware the Wormkin
The Maelstrom introduces a host of menacing adversaries that will test your sailing prowess and combat skills. The Underworld does not easily tolerate interlopers. Do not linger, or the Wormkin may claim your fleet.

Expanded Vessel Customization
Express yourself with the brand new ship cosmetic system, adding dozens of decorative items that can be fitted to the vessels in your fleet. 

Sail Forth into the Unknown
Continue your nautical adventure with Maelstrom, where the call of the vortexes beckons you to uncharted waters. Will you return to the light, or be swallowed by the abyss?

70050000046745.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - Story Expansion: The Chapter of Seign
70050000046745.intro: The JRPG is back with a new host of heroes.
70050000046745.description:
Included in the Season Pass and Digital Deluxe Edition

This story extension immerses you in the­ saga, viewing events through Se­ign's perspective and those­ who parted ways with Nowa's troupe to address a ce­rtain "predicament" within the Galdean empire. What transpired inside the e­mpire during their time apart? More­over, what covert roles did Se­ign and his allies undertake, influe­ncing the unfolding drama from the shadows?

Players must have won the War "Recapture of Eltisweiss"

70050000046747.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - Story Expansion: The Chapter of Marisa
70050000046747.intro: The JRPG is back with a new host of heroes
70050000046747.description:
Included in the Season Pass and Digital Deluxe Edition

In this expansion, a prequel to the epic saga of the Hundred Heroes, you will get to know more about Marisa's journey as a Guardian. The story revolves around her encounter with an enchanted girl who is fascinated by ancient ruins and ends up becoming Marisa's cherished companion. The story is set in the lush Greatwood's expanse and the mystical Runebarrows. However, mysterious and sinister forces are lurking around, and the duo sets out to uncover the secrets surrounding the enigmatic "Child of the Rune" they discover.

Players must have won the War "Recapture of Eltisweiss"

70050000046750.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - Story Expansion: The Chapter of Markus
70050000046750.intro: The JRPG is back with a new host of heroes.
70050000046750.description:
Included in the Season Pass and Digital Deluxe Edition

In this story expansion, Markus, Carrie, and Nowa brace­ themselves for an intriguing discove­ry. An anomaly dubbed "Menhir's Distortion" has unlocked a myste­rious teleportation gateway. Ve­nturing forth as a trio, they prepare to de­lve into the enigmatic re­alm beyond. What hidden truths await the­m there? Perhaps the­ revelations would shed light on Markus's shroude­d past, unearthing long-buried secre­ts. With bated breath, they ste­el themse­lves for the unraveling of an extraordinary tale.


Players must have won the War "Recapture of Eltisweiss"

Players must have recruited Milana and Momo.

Kawano brings her iconic artistry and storytelling prowess to the fore, creating a mesmerizing backdrop for fans and newcomers alike. 70050000046760.name: My Little Universe: Demodium
70050000046760.intro: Explore Demodium planet with new dungeons, challenges, and a new character!
70050000046760.description:

●	2 new improved dungeons
●	1 new challenge dungeon
●	1 new character as a reward for completing Demodium

70050000046764.name: Across the Obelisk: Spooky Night in Senenthia
70050000046764.description:
Dress to impress this Halloween with the supernatural Spooky Night in Senenthia Skin Pack! This terrifying pack contains 10 killer character skins and one eerily exclusive cardback, the perfect preparation for the spookiest time of year.

Beware: A sinister moon rises over Senenthia, and monsters lurking in the shadows are coming out to play!

Spooky Night in Senenthia brings this chilling cast of characters to your Across the Obelisk roster of heroes:

Vampiress Evelyn
Reginald, the Frankenstein’s Monster
Gravekeeper Heiner
Nezglekt, the Scarecrow
Sylvie, the Witch
Boogeyman Grukli
Wilbur, the Martian
Mariachi Gustav
Magnus, the Count
Malukah, the Corpse Bride

70050000046765.name: Across the Obelisk: The Wolf Wars
70050000046765.description:
Return to the kingdom of Senenthia in a brand new Story Pack that expands the intriguing lore of Across the Obelisk. Set 10 years before the base game, experience the legendary Wolf Wars through the canine eyes of Magnus and Yogger. Unlock a new hero, a pet, new skins and much more!

The Wolf Wars is packed with lore to build your knowledge of the Across the Obelisk universe and content that can be unlocked and experienced in the base game.

Discover a brand new, independent zone. Travel back in time and see Senenthia as never before.

Develop a fresh understanding of the events of the Wolf Wars, its fierce battles and the heroes who waged them.

Discover more about the complex relationship between Magnus and Yogger.


Replay the zone and choose different paths to reach the war's final goal.

Complete the Wolf Wars story and unlock Yogger, a mighty warrior who likes to play with his food.

Succeed on your quest and you’ll be rewarded with a new pet too, the wolf cub Wolfy.

Receive five Wolf Wars-themed skins exclusive to this Story Pack.

Encounter new events featuring the younger versions of familiar characters. Complete them and unlock new skins for each of these heroes.

Pit your wits against new monsters and fearsome bosses that will then appear in random combat encounters across base game modes.

Pay close attention during Acts 2 and 3; you might just encounter a random event that unlocks a previously undiscovered path.

Playing co-op? Only one adventurer needs to own Wolf Wars for the whole party to enjoy the story.

70050000046766.name: Across the Obelisk: Sands of Ulminin
70050000046766.description:
Gather your party and return to Senenthia to investigate the sudden appearance of a mysterious portal. Enjoy an all-new story that can be played as Act 2 or 3 of your adventure. Enlist the help of two new dual-class heroes and discover what lies beneath the Sands of Ulminin.

The sudden emergence of a curious portal has led to wild rumors across the kingdom of Senenthia. Prepare your band of adventurers and make your way to the desert lands of Ulminin - home to ancient pyramids and vast canyons - to uncover the secrets that lie in wait.

Unravel the mysteries that lurk beneath the rolling sands of this mystical new zone.

Welcome two new heroes with powerful abilities to your party.

Over 20 new enemies and three new bosses to defeat.

Master two new Aura and Curse mechanics: Scourge and Zeal.

Add variety to your decks with 30 new items and three new pets to unlock.

New Heroes Answer the Call
Joining you on your adventure are two new heroes with powers previously unseen: Laia and Navalea.
Laia is a Paladin—a Warrior Healer hybrid—capable of dealing incredible damage and helping her party in times of need.
Navalea is a Fallen—a mix of Warrior and Mage—a masterful fighter, proficient in the ways of the mage.
Both heroes can utilize cards from their hybrid classes, unlocking powerful dual-class options for you to experiment with.
The Mysterious Land of Sand Awaits
Explore a multi-layered zone that can be played as either Act 2 or 3 of your adventure.
Discover the brand-new Scarab mechanic. Defeat the scarabs that randomly appear during combat and your party will be rewarded with game-changing bonuses.
Pack the sunscreen and begin your journey to the Sands of Ulminin for a new Across the Obelisk challenge!

70050000046772.name: Across the Obelisk: Amelia, the Queen
70050000046772.description:
Amelia, the Queen is a Hero Pack that introduces all-new strategies to Across the Obelisk. Create powerful new builds thanks to Amelia’s unique ability to bring cards from the vanish pile back into her deck. Build chilling cold damage decks and help Amelia on her desperate quest to save Senenthia.

Amelia, the Queen Hero Pack contains:

The Queen Amelia hero, complete with a new set of enchantment cards specializing in cold damage.

A powerful ability unique to Amelia that allows for even greater depth in deckbuilding. Bring cards from the vanish pile back into your deck!

Spellsword - Amelia’s unique resource that opens up a whole new world of combo possibilities.

Rifty - a new pet with the ability to remove buffs from your enemies.

New reply options for use during events, expanding the lore of Senenthia.

Three new character skins fit for a queen.

Three new card backs to keep your deck looking at its royal finest.

Five new emotes. Ensure your party follows your royal decrees!

Driven by news of her daughter’s kidnapping, Amelia has returned to Senenthia to mount a daring rescue. Can you reunite the family before it’s too late?

70050000046784.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Cherished Keepsakes
70050000046784.description:
Many treks and adventures leave wanderers with lasting memories, and while Snufkin doesn’t usually carry a lot with him, over time he’s picked up some things that he always wants to keep close. Journey through Moominvalley with the cherished keepsakes that Snufkin takes with him wherever he can. 

This cosmetic DLC includes: 
* Blooming flowers for Snufkin’s hat
* A wooden mouthpiece for when you are lost in thought

70050000046820.name: Pinball FX - System Shock Pinball
70050000046820.intro: Flip to the death in the depths of space. Guide the Hacker and defeat SHODAN.
70050000046820.description:
Guide the Hacker through Citadel Station infested with cyborgs, mutants, and reprogrammed robots to defeat SHODAN. 

Table Features: 

- Jack into the Cyberspace Terminal mini-playfield for great rewards
- Watch out for the Cyborg Attack! If you take too long to shoot, your ball will be shot and jettisoned off your flipper
- Shoot with precision to 'Get a Head'. Reveal a second ball by hitting the correct one out of three severed heads
- It's a Mutant Menace! Hit all the enemies and escape by the elevator
- Brave all perils of the table to initiate self-destruct and defeat SHODAN for good

This purchase also entitles you to the Pinball M version of the DLC.

70050000046821.name: Pinball FX - The Princess Bride Pinball
70050000046821.description:
The Princess Bride Pinball - Not just your basic, average, every day, ordinary, run-of-the-mill, ho-hum pinball table. Jump into a world of treachery, peril, revenge... and a bit of kissing.

Table Features:

- Climb the Cliffs of Insanity and start a Duel with Inigo Montoya
- Give the right answer to Vizzini in the Battle of Wits mode and see your scores rise
- Free Westley from the Machine by shooting the lit lanes
- Prove your skill by going through the Super-Mega-Multi-Monster skillshots
- Storm the castle in the Wizard Mode and let true love prevail

70050000046822.name: Pinball FX - Universal Pinball: TV Classics
70050000046822.description:
This pack supports Questlines! Hone your pinball skills in a set of challenges designed to spice up your pinball sessions with a fresh way of play!

Classic television shows from the small screen to the tips of your flipper fingers. Play three tables inspired by iconic TV shows in the Universal Pinball: TV Classics bundle pack. Guide the remnants of humanity, chase crime on the roads, and wield your chakram to conquer the leaderboards. 

In this pack: 

Xena: Warrior Princess Pinball: In a time of ancient gods, warlords and kings a land in turmoil cried out for a hero. Join Xena, the mighty princess as she fights epic villains Callisto, Ares, and Caesar with the help of her friends Gabrielle and Joxer. 

Knight Rider Pinball: Sit behind the wheel and use K.I.T.T.’s superior technology to face off against the greatest threats on the road like K.A.R.R. Punch the Turbo Boost, activate Super Pursuit Mode, and engage Auto Cruise to let the table play automatically!  

Battlestar Galactica Pinball: Take control of the Battlestar Galactica and keep humanity one step ahead of the Cylon threat. Keep them at bay by fighting space battles and resisting subterfuge. You must keep everyone alive and reach the final goal: Earth. So say we all.

70050000046826.name: Pinball M - System Shock Pinball
70050000046826.intro: Flip to the death in the depths of space. Guide the Hacker and defeat SHODAN.
70050000046826.description:
Guide the Hacker through Citadel Station infested with cyborgs, mutants, and reprogrammed robots to defeat SHODAN. 

Table Features: 

- Jack into the Cyberspace Terminal mini-playfield for great rewards
- Watch out for the Cyborg Attack! If you take too long to shoot, your ball will be shot and jettisoned off your flipper
- Shoot with precision to 'Get a Head'. Reveal a second ball by hitting the correct one out of three severed heads
- It's a Mutant Menace! Hit all the enemies and escape by the elevator
- Brave all perils of the table to initiate self-destruct and defeat SHODAN for good

This purchase also entitles you to the Pinball FX version of the DLC.

70050000046829.name: Kebab Bar Tycoon - DLC#1 - Grill Master
70050000046829.description: Expand your kebab journey with "Grill Master's Selection," featuring 15 additional levels that challenge your spice mastery. With every level, your skills will be put to the test: will you rise as the ultimate Grill Master?

70050000046835.name: Kebab Bar Tycoon - DLC#2 - The Spice Route
70050000046835.description: "The Spice Route" includes  15 additional levels that will take your taste buds on a journey across the Silk Road. Immerse yourself in the aromas and flavors of distant lands, as you perfect dishes that resonate with history.

70050000046838.name: Mighty Meat Platter
70050000046838.description:
Thank you for helping us reach 1 million units sold! Here's a "Mighty Meat Platter" DLC pack containing in-game items.

Manky Meat x5
Monster Munchies x5
Smoked Sirloin x5
Meaty Treat x3
Beastie Bites x2
Better Beastie Bites x1

70050000046843.name: Sweet Bakery Tycoon - DLC#4 - Endless Mode
70050000046843.description:
Endless Mode for Sweet Bakery Tycoon is where your skills are put to the ultimate test against the clock! Each second counts and every dish matters.

Choose from 5, 10, or 15-minute sprints to showcase your breakfast-making prowess. It's a race against time to rack up the highest score possible!

Prepare for an adrenaline-pumping experience as you take orders, whip up dishes, and battle for the top score, all while the clock ticks down.

Each session is a new opportunity to outdo yourself and others!

70050000046845.name: Invector: Rhythm Galaxy - Latin Power Song Pack
70050000046845.intro: Latin Power Song Pack, showcasing electrifying tunes from Latin urban sensations like Yng Lvcas, Tiago PZK, Myke Towers, and more - bringing a fresh wave of Latin hip-hop to Invector.
70050000046845.description:

70050000046857.name: Trash Punk - DLC#1 Winter Rampage
70050000046857.intro: Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70050000046857.description: Chill out with "Trash Punk: Winter Rampage"! This DLC brings a wintry twist to the familiar world of "Trash Punk." Wander through the chaotic levels, now covered in a blanket of snow and ice. The change of scenery adds a fresh visual flavor to your favorite maps, giving a new look to your punk-rock rebellion. Perfect for players who enjoy aesthetic change to spice up their gameplay!

70050000046860.name: Trash Punk - DLC#2 Toxic Twilight
70050000046860.intro: Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70050000046860.description: Add a splash of color to the apocalypse with "Trash Punk: Toxic Twilight"! This DLC transforms the game's environment into a purple-tinted, neon-infused landscape, reminiscent of a nuclear wasteland. Explore the classic maps, now reimagined with a toxic glow. It's the same great gameplay in a visually refreshed setting – a simple yet effective way to experience "Trash Punk" in a new light.

70050000046865.name: Risk of Rain 2: Alloyed Collective
70050000046865.description:
Explore 7 All-New Stages — From cliffside scrapyards to machinery-choked fortresses and buried caverns, each biome pushes deeper into Solus territory with dynamic layouts and environmental threats.

Master 2 Survivors — Drifter and Operator have arrived! One returns. One debuts. Both are built to survive the escalating swarm.

Command 7 Drones — New Drones let you augment your playstyle with some wild abilities. Layer on top the new Drone shops and Drone Combiner, and you have loads of new ways to play with your robot friends.

Fight 6 Enemies — The Solus have been gathering, building, and perfecting their plan. Now their creations are hunting you.

Challenge Massive Bosses — Face two brutal new Teleporter encounters and a final boss that reshapes the endgame.

Loot 18 New Items — Expand your arsenal with a new haul of mislaid UES property.

Bring your friends on the adventure! Only one player is required to own Alloyed Collective to enable the Monsters, Stages, and Items to appear in-game for the whole lobby. Players without Alloyed Collective will be unable to select the two new Survivors or permanently unlock new Items, Logbooks, or other content.

70050000046870.intro: Unleash the energy of the SPINNIN' SONG PACK, featuring 6 thrilling songs by the likes of Martin Solveig & GTA, Sam Feldt ft. RANI, R3HAB & INNA & Sash! and more
70050000046870.description:
Unleash the energy of the SPINNIN' SONG PACK, featuring 6 thrilling songs by the likes of Martin Solveig & GTA, Sam Feldt ft. RANI, R3HAB & INNA & Sash!, ÖWNBOSS & Sevek, Tujamo, Bingo Players ft. Far East Movement.

70050000046886.name: Garden Life - Eco-friendly Decoration Set
70050000046886.description:
A few daily items, a few innovative ideas and a small gesture for the planet. The Eco-friendly Decoration Set offers new colorful decorations for a “greener” garden!

• Tyre Pots - These colorful tyres found their true purpose of housing the hardiest plants in the garden no matter the wind or weather. 

• Eco Lanterns - Crafted from sustainable materials, these lanterns add a touch of eco-elegance to your garden.

• Eco Table and Chair - A furniture set made from repurposed wood.

• Tea Kettle Fairy House - Crafted from recycled metal, it's like giving your garden's fairies a modern, upcycled palace to host their extravagant tea parties!

• Eco Fairy Lights - A charming hideout for your magical garden buddies crafted from upcycled plastic bottles.

70050000046887.name: Garden Life - Garden Party Pack
70050000046887.description:
A radiant garden, elegant teacups and a table bedecked with flowers: the Garden Party Pack includes two exclusive plants and a wide range of stylish items that you can use to bring out the inviting and festive best in your garden!

New beautiful flower species:
• Gerbera - Celebrated for its vivid and daisy-like blossoms the Gerbera is a hardy plant adaptable to diverse environments.
• Pansy - The Pansy is a resilient and cheerful flower with a wide array of colors and patterns. Pansies are edible, adding versatility to their charm!

Elegant decorative items:
• Tents
• Tables
• Teacup chairs
• Tea sets
• Bird Cages
• Butterfly jars
• Metal dividers

Joyful balloons and balloon structures:
• Balloon Arches
• Balloon Pillars
• Star Balloons
• Simple Balloons
• Tall and Short Round Balloons
• Heart Balloons

A variety of stunning lanterns to illuminate the garden with:
• Double Lanterns
• Butterfly Lanterns
• Flower Lanterns

And other exclusive decorative items:
• Hanging pots
• Flower hanging pots
• Flower towers

Add your choice of colours and ambience to your celebration: the colours of all of these decorative items can be changed using the paintbrush from Leslie's boutique!

70050000046891.name: Dead by Daylight: Alan Wake Chapter
70050000046891.description:
From one Dark Place to another. Dead by Daylight: Alan Wake brings bestselling author Alan Wake into The Fog. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive universal Charm: Nail Gun. 

Alan Wake understands what it takes to survive against insurmountable odds, having experienced no shortage of horror throughout his time in Bright Falls. Now, trapped in a new nightmare filled with relentless foes and unlikely allies, there may be no plotting his way out of this one.

70050000046936.name: PowerWash Simulator – Warhammer 40,000 Special Pack
70050000046936.description:
Deep in the Indomitus Crusade, relentless campaigns across the galaxy have imbued a variety of Imperial machines with a litany of dirt. As a member of the Adeptus Mechanicus, it is your singular honour      to perform the ultimate purification protocol.
Stationed at the grand Forge Temple 48759 within Mars’ iconic Ring of Iron, you must cleanse the Imperium’s illustrious instruments to appease their machine spirits. Beset with damage from skirmishes and remnants from rogue missions, achieve enduring satisfaction by restoring them anew, ready to serve the Emperor once more.
As an Adept, your unstoppable crusade against filth is paired with a personal pursuit for knowledge, naturally. Your maintenance will be emboldened by accounts and field reports from the front lines, renewing your vigour to abolish these desecrations.
Praise the Omnissiah! You are blessed with an all new Adeptus Mechanicus character model and well-equipped for the ritual cleansing with a custom MKII Aqua-Santica Arquebus power washer; the perfect fusion of human and machine. 
Command this ruthless technology to sterilize a range of Imperial vehicles and machines:
●	The Ultramarines Land Raider
●	The Dark Angels Deathwing Redemptor Dreadnought
●	The Astra Militarum Rogal Dorn Tank 
●	The House Hawkshroud Imperial Knight
●	The Blood Angels Thunderhawk
Though you may be just another cog in the great machine of the Cult Mechanicus, through zealous dedication to your cause, perhaps you can prove your worth and transcend to a worthy exalt…

70050000046953.name: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed - Costume Pack
70050000046953.description:
The Official Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed Costume Pack, including 3 nostalgic Mickey Mouse costumes to try on and start adventuring across the fantastical world of Wasteland!

- Steamboat Willie
- Brave Little Tailor

70050000046958.description:

70050000046984.name: Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads DLC School Bus
70050000046984.description: In the Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads, a new School Bus joins the existing fleet, offering a fresh take on student transportation. Take on the role of a responsible driver as you navigate through the cities, ensuring the safe and timely transportation of students.

70050000046985.name: Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads DLC Electric Bus
70050000046985.intro: Quiet streets, clean energy – Embark on the future ride!
70050000046985.description: In the Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads, a new Electric Bus joins the fleet. Its modern design and silent electric engine offer a clean and futuristic driving experience through the urban landscape. Upgrade your routes with this eco-friendly addition!

70050000046986.name: Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads DLC London Double Decker Bus
70050000046986.intro: Double the decks, double the thrill!
70050000046986.description: In the Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads game, this DLC introduces a new Double Decker Bus. This iconic vehicle is a prominent feature, known for its distinctive two-tiered design. With a spacious interior and large windows on both levels, players can experience a realistic simulation of driving a double-decker bus through the city streets.

70050000046987.name: Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads DLC Articulated Bus
70050000046987.intro: Where Every Turn Unfolds a New Journey!
70050000046987.description:
In Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads, a new Articulated Bus joins the existing fleet, introducing an enhanced driving experience. With its articulated structure, this bus excels in navigating city streets, offering increased passenger capacity without compromising maneuverability.

As the driver, you'll tackle the challenge of handling the distinctive characteristics of this new Articulated Bus, mastering tight turns and delivering passengers seamlessly to their destinations.

70050000047046.name: Stray Gods: Orpheus
70050000047046.intro: Play as Orpheus in this brand new story for Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical!
70050000047046.description:
When the Fates themselves have always written your story, what happens when you pick up the pen?

Orpheus’ story is arguably finished - until Hermes brings him back to the world of the living. With their help, you’ll guide Orpheus through the depths of mortal decision making - who to date, what to hope for, what instrument to rock out on…

Starring Anthony Rapp (RENT, Star Trek: Discovery), and written by David Gaider, Stray Gods: Orpheus is a comedic feature length experience that history buffs, hopeless romantics, and rock stars alike can enjoy.

70050000047050.name: SONIC
70050000047050.description: Gotta go fast! The iconic Sonic the Hedgehog joins the party.

70050000047061.description:

70050000047064.name: Suika Game Multi-Player Mode Expansion Pack-Offline
70050000047064.intro: A brand new two-player addition to the Suika Game is here; come and join the fun!
70050000047064.description:
Enjoy four game modes: "Original," "Time Limit," "Attack," and "Item."

"Original" is the usual Suika Game, and the player with the highest score wins. Once the box is full, play ends at that point. If the other side's score is higher, you win at that point. If you are losing, continue playing. Can you catch up to your opponent?!

"Time Limit" is a 5-minute intense competition, and the player with the highest score wins. When the rainbow gauge runs out, Poppy will drop fruits on her own, so you'll need to make decisions faster than usual!

In "Attack," the winner is the one who ends the opponent's game. On every 5th attempt, you can send an evolved fruit to your opponent's box. Sending a big fruit could turn the tables!

In "Item," the player with the higher score wins. Evolve fruits to get items, and use them strategically to gain an advantage. Timing your item use well could be the key to victory!

70050000047066.name: The Nom: Monster Madness
70050000047066.intro: Let your enemies tremble with fear when they see you!

70050000047069.name: Frozen Honey ASMR: Yucky Pack
70050000047069.intro: Mix delicious and disgusting ingredients to satisfy your most demanding customers!
70050000047069.description:

70050000047070.intro: Prepare your delicious frozen honey jelly using a hand-held freezer!

With this DLC, you'll unlock:

Add new winter ingredients to your frozen honey jelly and freeze it using your new freezer!

70050000047072.name: Frozen Honey ASMR: Truck Pack
70050000047072.intro: Change the look of your truck to make it look special and unique!
70050000047072.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:

- additional 2000 coins to spend in the shop

Unlock a new truck, change its look with awesome skins, and put a sign on top!

70050000047074.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Pioneer Pack
70050000047074.description:
Challenge yourself in the wild with 4 unique variants of trucks, Step310E SE, Don 71 SE, Loadstar 1700 SE and Actaeon SE. Find the perfect adjustment to fit your style as these trucks have distinct characteristics that give them a new flavor compared to their original counterparts.

The Pioneer Pack is also included in the Supreme Edition for Expeditions: A MudRunner game.

70050000047075.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Cotco Canyon
70050000047075.description:
Expand your garage of vehicles with the Cotco Canyon!

Combining the benefits of a large fuel tank with a powerful engine, the Cotco Canyon is your best partner in the wild, enabling you to venture further in harsh environments.

This scout class car is included in the Year 1 Pass, Year 1 Edition, and Supreme Edition for Expeditions: a A MudRunner game, and immediately available upon its purchase.

70050000047076.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner game - Season 1: Cave Odyssey
70050000047076.description:
Explore underground for the first time!
 
The scientific community is on the verge of a major discovery and they need you to lead the expedition into newly uncovered caves. The secrets hidden there could change the history of mankind, and your skills in hostile terrain will allow you to take this unique challenge up in a previously unseen biome. 

The Season 1: Cave Odyssey includes: 
 
•	The new Sedona map, located in Arizona. Explore uncharted nooks in the heart of the desert. Whether you're helping a scientist simulate life on Mars or recovering a rocket's lost flight recorder, there's a whole new range of missions.
•	A huge underground biome. Learn to make your way through the depths of the earth.
•	Two new vehicles: The Shiba Overlander, an agile scout sneaking easily in narrow places, and the STEP-7249, a six-wheels truck which can confront any terrains.  
•	Two new specialists: an operator enhancing the drone, a jaeger specialized in mechanics.

70050000047077.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Season 2: White Dawn
70050000047077.description:
Season 2: White Dawn is included in the Year 1 Pass.

Take science to new snowy heights!

Science is advancing everyday, and researchers are going to the most remote places. Conquer the uncharted, snowy peaks of the Carpathian Mountains and help scientists to conduct their research for only the most experienced explorers can tame the dangerousness of the mountains. Dive into dark caverns to pursue major discoveries.

Season 2: White Dawn includes :

• A new map in the Carpathian Mountains. Explore snow-covered cols and valleys in the middle of ruthless nature.
• A huge underground map. Use all your skills to progress safely.
• Two new six-wheeled vehicles: the Decin S-3T, a robust truck that can overcome any obstacle, and the Traun BR-0D, an off-road master that will be of great use in these uneven terrains.
• The legendary Mercedes Unimog 2450: this iconic vehicle is built for various missions across rugged terrain. With outstanding ground clearance and adaptability, it’s an essential companion for any expedition.
• Two new specialists: a hydrologist who can plumb the depth of snow, and a logistician who improves the ground drones use.

70050000047078.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Season 3: Icy Shores
70050000047078.description:
Season 3: Icy Shores is included in the Year 1 Pass.

Break the ice in Season 3 of Expeditions!

Science never stands still, and researchers need your help once again. Venture further into the remote valleys of the Carpathian Mountains to assist scientists in making new discoveries. Push through thick mud and melting snow, tread carefully along icy riverbanks, and descend into tight Transylvanian caves, in the name of progress.

Season 3: Icy Shores includes:

• A new map in the Carpathians, the Transylvanian Alps, featuring ancient ruins, spring thaw and ice
• A twisting cave system, sheltering impressive geological formations and vestiges of the past
• Three new trucks: the Haukka NS-420, an experimental truck with unmatched off-road performance, the KRS 63 Pathfinder, an eight-wheeled powerhouse capable of handling the harshest conditions, and the TUZ 302 Capricorn, a nimble scouting vehicle
• Two new specialists: a mechanic who can reduce electricity consumption and boost the power and durability of ground drones, and a manager who can increase rewards for each expedition

70050000047079.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Season 4: Amber Dusk
70050000047079.description:
Season 4: Amber Dusk is included in the Year 1 Pass.

Head for the Fall in Season 4 of Expeditions!

Every research project requires explorers, and the mountains are calling one last time. Complete your off-road journey in the Tatras, and help scientists deepen their understanding of the wilds. Traverse idyllic valleys transformed by recent floods, venture deep underground, and discover remnants of ages past - from majestic basalt columns to ancient temple ruins.

Season 4: Amber Dusk includes:

• Two new maps in the Tatra Mountains, Cat's Spine Ridge and Owl Lake Ridge, which includes an explorable indoor area - the ancient ziggurat.
• Two new sprawling cave systems, home to underground rivers, labyrinthine ruins and lava streams
• Three new trucks: the Shiba Dart SR-V, one of the most durable pickup trucks in history, the G&S Caravan A1, a true jack of all trades among off-road vehicles, and the ANK XM75, a heavily modified all-terrain champion
• Two new specialists: a manager who can change the contents of airdrops, and an operator who allows installation of terrain-mounted objects with flying drones

70050000047247.name: Just Dance 2025 Edition
70050000047247.description:
Get your friends and family together to let loose on Just Dance! Whether you want to take the party to a whole new level, exercise while having fun, or create special family moments, Just Dance 2025 Edition has something for everyone, with 40 hot new songs.

Want to keep the party going? Subscribe to Just Dance+ and dance to hundreds of songs all year!

40 NEW AND FUN SONGS FOR EVERYONE
There’s something for every taste in Just Dance 2025 Edition. Dance to chart-topping hits, pop party anthems, all-time classics, viral internet phenomena, and more, including:
- “yes, and?” by Ariana Grande
- “Poker Face” by Lady Gaga
- “Calabria 2007” by Enur Ft. Natasja
- “Unstoppable” by Sia
- “Basket Case” by Green Day

Whether you play with your friends or your family, there’s choreography for everyone, from easy to more challenging. Some songs even offer different difficulty levels depending on the coach you choose.

THERE’S ALWAYS A REASON TO DANCE, ALL YEAR LONG
Take part in themed seasonal events year-round with new and exciting songs, a dedicated progression track, and new rewards.
Start your own fitness routine and exercise while having fun in Workout mode. Keep yourself motivated by tracking calories burnt and time spent dancing.

Regardless of if you or your friends own Just Dance 2023 Edition, Just Dance 2024 Edition, or Just Dance 2025 Edition, all players are connected on the same platform. If you own several editions, all content is together in the same place!

70050000047248.description:
The Just Dance Disney Hits Vol.1 music pack includes 6 of the most-loved Disney songs of all time! Dance with your favorite Disney characters as you play and score through Just Dance universes. You’re sure to have a magical time playing Disney Hits Vol. 1 on Just Dance. 

Get more of the music you love in Just Dance with new themed music packs. Each pack includes 6 songs, handpicked by the development team for that pack’s specific theme. Expand your Just Dance song library to better reflect your tastes in music and dance. You can now go beyond 40 songs with music packs of a specific genre, artist, or theme.

- Play as Old school Pilgor
- Full Tank armour (MMO)
- Goat Zero skin (GoatZ)
- Space helmet & suit (Waste of Space)
- Masks of Don Pastrami, Valentino Salami, Dolph Spaghetti & Humphrey Ciabatta (Payday)
- Digital Soundtrack
- 3D Printing Files:
- Pilgor
- Tony Shark
- Goat Tower
- Trinket


DISCLAIMER:

Goat Simulator 3 is another completely stupid game. Will this game teach you how to become one with your local herd? Probably not. Learning about real goats with David Attenborough or something would absolutely be the smarter thing to do.

Quetzali Iqaruz

70050000047503.name: Suika Game Multi-Player Mode Expansion Pack-Online
70050000047503.intro: A brand new two-player addition to the Suika Game is here, come and join the fun!
70050000047503.description:
Enjoy four game modes: "Original," "Time Limit," "Attack," and "Item."

"Original" is the usual Suika Game, and the player with the highest score wins. Once the box is full, play ends at that point. If the other side's score is higher, you win at that point. If you are losing, continue playing. Can you catch up to your opponent?!

"Time Limit" is a 5-minute intense competition, and the player with the highest score wins. When the rainbow gauge runs out, Poppy will drop fruits on her own, so you'll need to make decisions faster than usual!

In "Attack," the winner is the one who ends the opponent's game. On every 5th attempt, you can send an evolved fruit to your opponent's box. Sending a big fruit could turn the tables!

In "Item," the player with the higher score wins. Evolve fruits to get items, and use them strategically to gain an advantage. Timing your item use well could be the key to victory!

※ Online play mode requires a subscription to "Nintendo Switch Online" (paid).

70050000047645.name: Extra Mission Pack: Robo Saurous vs The Mecharmy
70050000047645.description:
A collection of additional missions featuring many new enemies that did not appear in the main game. Included in this collection is another story that took place in the time line corresponding to missions 79 to 83 of the main game. It depicts the anguish and conflict of a certain separate unit and the end of a secret EDF weapon that was never deployed in actual combat in the main game.
More than 10 high level missions for the elite members are included in the game. The game is recommended only for those who have completed the main game and are confident in their skills.

～The story of the additional missions～
While the EDF is deploying its main forces to defeat the mother ship, the 617 Tasmanian Tiger Squadron, a technical test squadron, is secretly developing a new weapon. The weapon, equipped with an incomplete AI, resembles a certain enemy brought by invaders... What is the true nature of the weapon called the “Tetrapod Anti-Giant Meat Bullet Special Vehicle”?

70050000047737.name: Dead by Daylight: All Things Wicked Chapter
70050000047737.description:
Behind you. In the reflection of the screen. A face. Head titled ever so slightly. Mouth agape. From it comes a voice. Familiar. Different. When it calls to you, don’t turn around. Even if you think you recognize it.  

Dead by Daylight’s All Things Wicked delves into the depths of analog horror with new Killer, The Unknown, and new Survivor, Sable Ward. A new Map, Greenville Square, is available for all players. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Unknown’s Garden Casual and Sable Ward’s Designer Corset.

70050000047744.name: Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns
70050000047744.intro: Grab your blaster, join Contra Force, and be the bullet hell in Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns.
70050000047744.description:
Are you a bad enough Vampire Survivor to save the President's cousin's sister's dog from the traitor squadrons of Red Falcon? Join Contra Force and stride into a doomsday extravaganza in Vampire Survivors: Operation Guns. 

Assemble a squad of classic Characters and arm yourself with an explosive arsenal of arcade weaponry in this action packed expansion for Vampire Survivors. Blast through thousands of fearsome foes and bonkers bosses from throughout the lauded lineage of Contra games. Persist determinedly through prodigious stages inspired by iconic Konami series, but be prepared for a bullet-hell of a fight, because if your trigger finger lacks stamina, Earth may lack a future. 

Operation Guns embraces the visceral simplicity of classic Contra, with build-focused Characters that encourage min-maxing and stat manipulation, a tonne of weapons (we're talking 22 including evolutions!), and a difficulty curve that combines quintessentially arcade-hard gameplay with the Vampire Survivors formula. 

11 Contra-Tough New Characters 
A squad of determined Contra Force Survivors deployed to become the bullet hell, including: 

Bill Rizer - a big guy with a big gun, bent on vengeance against an alien menace. 
Loves: action movies, high-calibre rounds. Hates: Cryogenic coffins, space creatures. 
Lance Bean - known for attacking aggressively, always having hair dye on hand, and having a brain almost as impressive as his muscles, Lance is partially responsible for creating Contra Force's strange new weapons. 
Ariana - forced to defend her home amongst the jungles of Galuga from the vile traitors of Red Falcon, Ariana is an expert in evasive manoeuvres, turning her Movement Speed into extra Armour. 
Lucia - is she a clone? A cyborg? A tabula-rasa terror tutored by Team Contra to be the perfect warrior? Her past is a mystery, but her deadliness on the battlefield is well known, as is her reputation for rebounding from any supposed defeat even stronger than ever. 
Brad Fang - the bad-butt product of twisted genetics and cutting edge cyber-tech, Brad Fang is half-man, half-wolf, half-robot, and 150% super soldier.  
Browny - designed to be an all-purpose battle bot, a string of strange bugs (or features) in Browny's programming have caused this diminutive droid to be obsessed with partying. Fortunately, this calamitous coding error does nothing to impede Browny's prodigious combat prowess. 
Sheena Etranzi - a guerrilla combat genius especially skilled in jungle combat and all manner of experimental weaponry, Sheena is a true survivor and no stranger to prevailing against impossible odds. 
Probotector - a hyper advanced recon robot programmed to protect humans in inimical environments, this RD009 Probotector Model can convert any enhancements to its Armour into more Might for its many modular weapons. 

22 New Fully Automatic Weapons 
Arm yourself with Contra Force's radical arsenal with almost-homing missiles, a bevy of high-tech blasters, and the ever faithful Spread Shot. Evolve these deadly contraptions into experimental Prototype weapons, and supplement every salvo with 3 new Pickups - you'll need every edge you can get to survive the challenges of Operation Guns. 

Galuga & Beyond 
Run and gun through multiple mayhem-filled biomes inspired by classic Contra levels. Explore Galuga Jungle, Neo City, and the treacherous Alien Zone in a hazardously horizontal main Stage bristling with iconic enemies and brutal bosses. Rev your jetbikes and take on a highway of horrors in a furiously fast-paced challenge stage. 

Contra Tracks & Remixes 
Includes classic Contra tracks and covers: 
Battle in the Jungle - VS version
Bloody Falls - VS version
Yoru no Nikusyokujyu - VS version
The Hard Corps - VS version
GTR Attack!- VS version
Military Fortress- VS version

Embrace the sizzle of the grill as your new symphony in "Kebab Bar Tycoon". With 60 diverse levels serving as your playground, you'll orchestrate a ballet of skewers, veggies, and spices, crafting the perfect kebab. 

Enjoy the enhanced graphics and animations that bring your culinary conquests to life.

Treat your virtual customers with wide selection of exotic dishes that go far beyond the classic kebab. Ready to embark on a flavor-filled journey?

In Kebab Bar Tycoon you'll find:

- 60 levels filled with culinary challenges
- 150+ combination of delightful dishes 
- Countless upgrades to bar and decorations
- 25+ achievements to complete
- Easy to play, hard to master

Unlock the secrets of spices and secure your legacy as a kebab tycoon!

70050000048227.description:

1 New rug

70050000048228.description:
It's almost time for the holiday season, and you know what that means: FESTIVE DLC! Decorate for the snowy winter season (apologies to the southern hemisphere) with a big ol' hamper of snowmen, gingerbread, candy canes, and presents to make sure that everyone knows how much you love the holidays. 70050000048229.description:
We love you. And you love us, right? That's why we're making the ultimate declaration of love: a new DLC pack! It's better than roses or an engagement ring, because it comes with FIVE romance-themed items to create a den of devotion wherever you want. All for you, boo. xoxo

This DLC contains these lovingly crafted cosmetics:
Box of Chocolates
Heart Archway
Love Lamp
Heart Rug
Love Couch

70050000048234.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Nichole’s Home Brew
70050000048234.description:
Nichole’s Infernal Pacts were just the beginning! 
The Board Girls have unleashed diabolical new Home Brew rules for Snow Day, featuring game-altering modes like The Floor is Lava, Air Superiority, and Super Pissed Off. These brutal challenges will push you to your limit. Your gear? Useless. Your strategies? Obsolete. Adapt fast or fail. 
Conquer all five new modes and unlock even crazier rule combinations to prove you’re the one and only New Kid. Are you ready?

420 Cosmetics Pack

70050000048236.description:
Bear-serker Cosmetics Pack
 
Intimidate your enemies with this grizzly warrior costume. Look ripped and sweet with a kid-drawn six pack, facial tattoos, and vicious bear helmet. It’s the perfect outfit to show everyone you are here to pillage and burn!

70050000048237.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Nonconformist Weapon Variation Pack
70050000048237.description:
Abandon the normy daggers and seize these malevolent Sickles. Drain the lifeblood of the unworthy and repurpose their essence to power the darkness within you. This reskin of the daggers comes with upgrade cards and macabre new cosmetics.

Includes:

Nonconformist tunic

Gather up to three fellow souls and delve into four maps "Main Street", "South Park Elementary," “Town Square,” and beyond. Take up arms, and command the shadows to bow before you.

70050000048271.description:

- Launch your attack and score on the mini-playfield
- Master player skills in several different multiball modes each tied to must-have talents in football

70050000048287.name: Michiko Level Pack
70050000048287.intro: Unlock levels and images with Michiko, the martial artist, whose discipline and precision in every move testify to years of training.
70050000048287.description: Dressed in a martial arts gi that highlights her prowess, she moves with focused intensity. Her commanding presence and serene eyes reflect mastery of strength and combat technique.

70050000048288.name: Ivy Level Pack
70050000048288.intro: Unlock levels and images with IVY, the witch, who emerges from the shadows in mysterious robes whispering ancient incantations.
70050000048288.description: Her eyes, aglow with arcane wisdom, and her enigmatic presence converge as she traces sigils and weaves spells with ethereal grace.

70050000048289.name: Sigrún Level Pack
70050000048289.intro: Unlock levels and images with Sigrún, the Valkyrie, descending from the heavens in shimmering celestial armor.
70050000048289.description: With wings spread wide, she commands the skies, inspiring heroism on the battlefield. Her piercing gaze and each beat of her wings embody Valkyric majesty, making her a beacon of honor and celestial beauty.

70050000048290.name: Selene Level Pack
70050000048290.intro: Unlock levels and images with Selene, the vampire lord, who emerges from the shadows draped in regal attire.
70050000048290.description: Commanding the night with immortal authority, her crimson eyes blaze with eternal wisdom. Her haunting gaze and elegant yet menacing presence embody the vampiric allure and eternal beauty of the shadowy realm.

70050000048292.name: Chef Life: A Restaurant Simulator - TOKYO DELIGHT
70050000048292.description:
Explore Japanese gastronomy with the TOKYO DELIGHT pack.

Add 8 iconic Japanese recipes to your menu, all of which can be upgraded up to 3 times. Prepare delicious ramen, tempura, gyoza and, of course, traditional sushi.

Use 24 new ingredients to prepare your dishes, including wasabi, soy sauce and miso, to offer new taste experiences to your customers.

Master the art of preparing sushi rice with a new dedicated cooking station. You control the amount of vinegar to add to achieve the right balance and create the perfect rice, an essential component of the cuisine from the Land of the Rising Sun.

Transform your restaurant into a cosy izakaya worthy of the streets of Tokyo with 54 interior decor items.

Enhance your presentation with 5 new items for plating your dishes.
Dress your chef like an authentic sushi chef with an iconic new outfit.

70050000048293.name: Builder Pack 1

70050000048293.description: Discover 24 new templates for your board and create fantastic things.
