70050000048331.name: BackySoftie Level Pack
70050000048331.description:
Known for its charismatic TV personality, BackySoftie seamlessly blends resilience and charm, creating a unique and unforgettable presence. With brown hair that frames a face telling tales of triumph and eyes that reflect a journey of strength, BackySoftie stands as a symbol of unwavering spirit in the world of visual storytelling. Ready to explore the captivating world of this extraordinary visionary?

This DLC contains:
- three new levels to beat
- three new artworks to your gallery

70050000048332.name: Gisele Level Pack
70050000048332.description:
As a celebrated dancer, Gisele has graced prestigious stages around the globe, leaving an indelible mark with each performance. The stage becomes a canvas for her artistry, where every pirouette and arabesque paints a vivid picture of beauty and expression. Gisele's magnetic presence, characterized by a cascade of flowing hair and a gaze that commands the audience's attention, has made her an icon in the world of dance.

This DLC contains:
- three new levels to beat
- three new artworks to your gallery

70050000048335.name: Gas Station Simulator - Party Time DLC
70050000048335.intro: The party is about to start with new content in this free DLC.
70050000048335.description:
Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

More Popularity
Parties are also a great tool to boost your popularity, especially for those struggling with increasing popularity at higher levels. Each upgrade of your venue spot opens new opportunities for popularity boots as an added bonus to all the other rewards.

Ice Cream Time
Party Time introduces the ice cream stand with its own mini-game and interactions to not only complement the party time theme further, but also give you another thing to do at your gas station. The more variety the better.

And More
There is more. Little things and not so little ones, like a tablet type device allowing you access the PC from anywhere. No more running halfway across the gas station to check on something or set something up. And we are introducing collectables that can be found throughout the game.

70050000048336.name: Gas Station Simulator - Can Touch This DLC
70050000048336.intro: Get some new tools and redecorate your gas station.
70050000048336.description:
Rebuild & Reconstruct!
Take matters into your own hand. Almost literally. With the help of your new, trusty hammer, 
it's time to redecorate like you've never done before. Refurbish walls to your heart's content, 
changing their features and decor as you see fit. Decide where to put trash cans or where to 
move the cash register to. Direct the crowd. Show your customers the right way to orderly 
queue without taking too much space. It's time to take interior customisation to a completely 
new level.
Paint & Spray!
No need to stare at an empty canvas any longer! Grab your spray can and add a little 
personal touch to any surface you can lay your hands on. With adjustable scale and rotation,
you can spray anything from large murals to tiny easter eggs hidden somewhere in the 
corners of your station. Combine existing decals with each other, creating even more 
elaborate and complex pieces of art. And whenever you start feeling like you're running out, 
more designs lie hidden all around for you to unlock!
Warehouse & Workshop
Did you ever feel like your station was missing something? That flair didn't quite measure up 
to par when looking beyond your main building? Have no fear for the future is here. From 
tables to desks to banners and lights, your Warehouse and Workshop now possess a full 
suite of purchasable customisations! Make the diamond in the sand shine even brighter than before.

70050000048337.name: Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC
70050000048337.intro: Build a small airstrip at your gas station and  help Joe with his air routes.
70050000048337.description:
It is more story-driven than what we did in the past and it allows you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.
Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day 
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the 
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you 
in on his deals.
The Airstrip
You have plenty of space and as it turned out, there used to be an old military landing strip 
during WWII close to your gas station. Should be that hard to make it work again, right? You 
might even go a step further, order some aviation fuel and some parts for planes. A 
windsock wouldn’t probably hurt and some lights might turn out to be useful, since you will 
on occasion also need to help him land. Let’s see how things develop and what Joe is up 
to...
The Plane
Joe’s plane is like its pilot: old. It’s also simple. The most advanced technology on this thing 
is the LED reading light Joe uses to find his way on the chart. How hard can it be to fix some
simple things on a small plane? And it’s not like you are doing it for free.
The Gameplay
The Airstrip DLC brings new game mechanics and content to Gas Station Simulator based 
on events. Unlike the content we introduced in the past, it does not require your constant 
attention, it is more something that happens every now and then.

70050000048596.name: Classic II: Dominique's Curse
70050000048596.description:
Classic II: Dominique's Curse brings retro-gameplay action to Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night! Defeated by Miriam, Dominique has been cast into Limbo, a realm that does not gladly endure those who have misused demonic powers. Lost and filled with rage, Dominique must fight and survive in this new world. If she can steal Bael’s power, she will return to the land of the living and fulfill her revenge…but only if she can do so before her curse destroys her.

Expanding on the gameplay of the original Classic Mode, Dominique’s Curse features a larger map than its predecessor, an all-new canon Bloodstained storyline and brand-new gameplay!

Your journey will take you to a variety of locales, from deserts and forests to graveyards and beyond. Towns along your route are populated with NPCs and merchants. Sell treasure to upgrade your equipment and purchase health potions. The further you travel, the more powerful the upgrades.  You are going to need them. Speak with the locals to get guidance on your journey...if they can be trusted. These are demons, after all.

Beware the Dead moon! Enemies become stronger when darkness falls and friendly demons quickly become deadly enemies.

It's a brand new, old-school adventure. Which ending will you get?

70050000048623.name: Across the Obelisk: Nenukil, the Engineer
70050000048623.description:
Nenukil, the Engineer is a Hero Pack that introduces a brand new Scout class character with a powerful gameplay mechanic and a unique dynamic skin. Unlock a pet with a potent debuff ability and discover untold tales of one of the heroes of The Obsidian Uprising.

Nenukil, the Engineer Hero Pack contains:

• The Nenukil hero: a Scout-class dwarf character with an exclusive gameplay mechanic.
 
• An adaptable hero. Reach level 3 with Nenukil and choose between his Double Barrel or Mounted Cannon traits—focus on dealing damage or prioritize defense.

• A new type of dynamic character skin that changes in-game depending on whether you select Nenukil’s Double Barrel or Mounted Cannon abilities.

• Three additional skins in total for your new hero.

• Floaty, Nenukil’s trusty robot sidekick—a standalone pet that can remove enemies' Taunt and Powerful abilities.

• Three new themed card backs.

• Five emotes for swift co-op collaboration with your party.

• Custom replies for in-game events—learn more about Nenukil, his heroic deeds during the Obsidian Uprising and his deep friendship with Queen Amelia.

Bring all-new deckbuilding possibilities to the world of Senenthia with Nenukil, the Engineer.

70050000048630.name: Across the Obelisk: The Obsidian Uprising
70050000048630.description:
In The Obsidian Uprising, you’ll travel 30 years back in time to the dwarven city of Black Forge and discover a thrilling new Across the Obelisk story. Disaster looms over Black Forge. Gather your band of heroes, restore peace and battle your way back to present-day Senenthia.

The Obsidian Uprising Story Pack builds the lore of Across the Obelisk and introduces a host of new items and unlockables to transform your gameplay experience.

• Upon investigating a mysterious rift in Velkarath, your party is thrown 30 years into the past to the ancient dwarven city of Black Forge to relive the events of the Obsidian Uprising.

• Team up with young versions of familiar heroes, quell the uprising and right what once went wrong. Can you find your way home, or will you remain stuck in time?

• Explore a sprawling multi-layered map. Travel back in time and discover the secrets behind a once glorious city.

• Unlock Scrappy, a new robot pet with previously unseen customization options. Progress through the story and craft Scrappy piece by piece. Choose from five different chassis and five different arms for a total of 25 unique combinations.

• Experiment with four new items exclusive to this Story Pack and unearth powerful new combos.

• Ensure your heroes are ready for this industrial adventure with seven steampunk-themed character skins.

• Give your deck a makeover with a beautiful new card back.

• Share the story with your co-op party. Only one adventurer per party needs to own The Obsidian Uprising to enjoy this time-traveling tale.

70050000048659.intro: A Dance of Masks is the sixth and final premium DLC for Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous in Season Pass 2, one last love letter to the Knight Commander and their loyal c
70050000048659.description:
A Dance of Masks is the sixth and final premium DLC for Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous in Season Pass 2, one last love letter to the Knight Commander and their loyal companions. Gather all your companions and travel back to where it all started – the city of Kenabres, destroyed and now risen from the ashes. Visit a festival, celebrate your victories, socialize with friends and loved ones, watch the fireworks… And thwart the plans of villains trying to spoil the fun!

- A new adventure will take you back to Kenabres and beyond: to a new enemy's stronghold
- Personal events for every companion — you’ve seen them fight, now watch them have a day off
- A new romantic event with every romanceable companion
- An otherworldly arena where you can test your might against some truly mythic enemies
- 11 new character archetypes, a new weapon type and the ability to switch your grip on the weapon from one-handed to two-handed
- Fully voiced dialogues

70050000048667.name: Only Way Up! Parkour Jump Simulator: Character Customization DLC
70050000048667.intro: Customize Your Thrills: New Character Customization DLC Takes Parkour to New Heights!

   Customize your character with the all-new Character Customization DLC and embark on a thrilling parkour journey through urban landscapes! Feel the adrenaline rush as you jump, hop, and roll through various cityscapes, each filled with exciting challenges.
    Tie your shoelaces tight, customize your character, and let the gravity-defying adventure begin! Remember, the only way is UP!

70050000048696.name: Mod Pack 1: Quality Fun
70050000048696.intro: A collection of fun and quality-of-life mods for Crystal Project.
70050000048696.description:
Mods must be activated in-game using the mod selection menu to take effect. To activate mods, open the mod selection menu from New Game or Continue using the "Mods" button shown at the bottom-right of the screen. Enabled mods are then tied to save data and are automatically enabled when save data is loaded.

Mod Pack 1 contains the following mods:
- Appearance Passives: Allows setting a character's appearance to that of any class.
- Pointier Hat: Hides a bonus late-game hat somewhere in the world.
- Golden Quintar High Jump: Increases the jump height of the Golden Quintar from 2 blocks high to 3 blocks high.
- Cheap Maps: Reduces the cost of all maps.
- Cheap Teleport Shards n' Stones: Reduces the cost of all teleport shards and teleport stones.
- Learnable Innate Skills: Causes all innate class passives to become learnable.
- 1 PP Passives: Reduces the cost of all passives to 1 PP.
- Unrestricted Weapon Skills: Removes weapon type restrictions from all Weapon Skills.
- Free Maps: Speak with Nan at Old Nan's Watering Hole to optionally obtain all maps.
- Modern Kids: Modernizes the youthful vocabulary of the children in Capital Sequoia.

70050000048734.name: UNO® Party! Mania™
70050000048734.description:
Enjoy a fresh UNO® experience with UNO® Party! Mania™. Dive into the classic game with a twist, as extra action cards and special rules have been added to spice things up!

Brace yourself for bursts of laughter, nail-biting tension, and epic comebacks with three new chaotic cards. Link opponents together, point to make players draw cards based on votes, and create a second pile where players must match colors to pass. Feel the suspense build as you witness the mini pile grow, heightening the stakes with each passing turn.
Don’t forget to shout “UNO!” when you’re down to your last card!

Get ready for noisy, crazy fun! UNO® Party! Mania™ is the perfect addition to any party or game night.

POINT TAKEN CARD
When this card hits the table, all players must cast their votes on a target player and then each player must draw as many cards as there are votes against them. Will you form alliances against your fiercest rival or simply revel in the chaos? The power is in your hands with the Point Taken card!

WILD DRAWN TOGETHER CARD
With the Wild Drawn Together card, you get to link two players’ fates together! Moving forward, whenever one must draw cards, the other gets to share the action!

WILD PILE UP CARD
Introducing tension and strategy to every turn, be prepared for the exciting Wild Pile Up card! When this card is played, a mini pile forms and players must match colors to pass. The more it piles up, the higher the stakes get!

70050000048821.name: Kyukyoku TigerHeli - Console Ports + Get Star Pack
70050000048821.description:
This DLC includes various console ports of Tiger-Heli and Kyukyoku Tiger.
On top of that, it also includes the rare beat-‘em-up Get Star and its Western version Guardian, both released outside the arcades for the very first time!
*You must have a copy of the digital download version of Kyukyoku Tiger-Heli in order to play the content of this DLC.

Seven console ports 
Various console versions of Tiger-Heli and Kyukyoku Tiger were made in and outside Japan, and seven of them are included in this collection. Each of them tackles the difficult mission of recreating the arcade experience in its unique and inventive ways. This is the ultimate way to study the different aspects of the Tigers in their diverse habitats!

Get Star: an arcade rarity
Originally released in 1986, Get Star is an arcade side-scrolling beat-'em-up, where you play the role of the titular robot, combating enemies with punches, kicks, and occasional special weapons. Free six planets from the oppressive rule of Big Demorr!

Installing this DLC makes the following titles playable in the base game:
• Kyukyoku Tiger FC Ver. (1989)
• Kyukyoku Tiger PC Engine Ver. (1989)
• Kyukyoku Tiger Mega Drive Ver. (1991)
• Twin Cobra NES Ver. (1989)
• Twin Cobra Genesis Ver. (1991)
• Tiger-Heli FC Ver. (1986)
• Tiger Heli NES Ver. (1987)
• Get Star (1986)
• Guardian (1986)

70050000049052.name: The Serpent King's Domain
70050000049052.intro: The Serpent King's Domain will introduce players to the vast expanse of the Violet Ocean and the mysterious southern continent of Ankon-Konu.
70050000049052.description:
With this, we've now brought all the published material to life, completing the series in its current form. That's right! This DLC will feature not one, but two whole books of content! The sheer volume of this update is almost as big as the base game!

Venture into The Serpent King's Domain. Navigate through the dense, trap-filled jungles, ascend the unexplored Plateau of Dragons, unravel the haunts of Tarshesh, and challenge the immortal Serpent King. Beyond the treacherous seas, discover mysterious islands, confront pirates and supernatural threats, and seek fortune among the perilous ports of Ankon-Konu and the sorcerer's city of Dweomer. Adventure and danger await in every shadow and wave, promising untold riches for the daring.

A Game Richer Than Ever

This DLC isn't just big in size; it's colossal in content. The word count jumps to an astounding 400,000, enveloping you in a narrative depth like never before. Here’s what you can expect:

* Over 180 New Items: From mystical artifacts to practical gear, your inventory is about to get a whole lot more interesting.
Engaging New Quests: Each quest is designed to challenge your wit, courage, and strategy.
* Innovative Mechanics: Brace yourself for unique challenges including heat penalties in the desert, spirit combat, new blessings to aid your journey, crafting opportunities, and intriguing puzzles to solve.
* Formidable Enemies and Encounters: Prepare to face a diverse range of foes and unexpected situations, each requiring a unique approach.
* Elevate Your Prowess: The rank cap ascends to 15, unlocking new heights of power for your character.
* 33 New Objective goals: For those who like to trully explore and leave no stone unturned.

70050000049055.name: New Character: Rossweisse

Light up your missions with the Neon Strike DLC for S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope, adding a splash of color to every mission. This pack features an eclectic trio of weapons:

SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.

Upgrade to the Neon Strike Arsenal and turn the battlefield into your own vibrant canvas!

From juicy fruits to mouth-watering desserts, each model is designed to inspire your imagination and add vibrancy to your creativity. Also included is a set of juicy stickers that you can use to embellish your creations. Create, experiment and share your culinary masterpieces!

70050000049378.name: Highway Moto Racing Rush 2023 Simulator - Grip Upgrade DLC
70050000049378.intro: Take control of the road with our latest DLC, boasting innovative motorcycle handles for a heart-pounding, adrenaline-fueled race!
70050000049378.description:
It's time to embrace the thunderous roar of engines, ignite the spark of competition, and embark on an unforgettable journey that redefines the essence of speed enthusiasts. Revolutionary DLC introducing a groundbreaking expansion with brand-new features, including innovative motorcycle handles, adding an extra layer of excitement and allowing players to experience new speeds and intense thrills, pumping up the adrenaline.
       So, why wait? Strap on your helmet, rev up your engine, and hit the road!

70050000049409.name: Off-hand Item Skin Pack
70050000049409.intro: Customize your party with all new item skins with the Off-Hand Item Skin Pack!
70050000049409.description: Light the way with the Drauven Torch skin, or arm yourself with a net made from the thickest of Thrixl silk. This DLC provides customization options for a treasure trove of 10 off-hand item skins, such as plethora of shields and other items inspired by Wildermyth's monstrous factions.

70050000049412.name: Let's Sing 2025 - International Hits
70050000049412.intro: Extend your playlist with more songs!
70050000049412.description:
Let's Sing 2025 brings the ultimate karaoke experience straight to your living room! Sing along with your family and friends to the latest hits, as well as a generous selection of all-time classics.

Complete your journey to stardom with a brand-new career mode, or join the VIP ranks to gain access to even more tracks. Perform at home or online with a global cast of singers!

•	good 4 u - Olivia Rodrigo
•	Love Yourself - Justin Bieber
•	Lose Control - Teddy Swims
•	You Are The Reason - Calum Scott
•	Hakuna Matata - The Lion King

•	If We Ever Broke Up - Mae Stephens
•	Queen of Kings - Alessandra
•	This Year (Blessings) - Victor Thompson x Ehis 'D' Greatest
•	Evergreen (You Didn't Deserve Me At All) - Omar Apollo
•	Waffle House - Jonas Brothers
•	Remember - Becky Hill, David Guetta

•	Dancing in the Moonlight - Toploader

•	Eastside - Benny Blanco, Halsey & Khalid
•	You Proof - Morgan Wallen
•	Black Velvet - Alannah Myles
•	Summer - Calvin Harris
•	Desire - Calvin Harris, Sam Smith

This product is not sold on its own.

70050000049422.name: Let's Sing 2025 - VIP Pass Free Trial
70050000049422.intro: Expand your song library with access to more than 150 hit songs with the VIP Pass!
70050000049422.description:
The Let's Sing VIP Pass is an online subscription service that provides access to more than 150 songs with the launch of Let's Sing 2025.

Awards for one month. 
No automatic renewal
Online Music is not rated by ESRB.

70050000049443.name: DREDGE - The Iron Rig
70050000049443.intro: The Iron Rig is the second official expansion for DREDGE - a cosmic horror fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent.
70050000049443.description:
This content adds a new constructable destination with its own story, items and adversities that can be experienced at any stage in your playthrough. 

Gather, craft and deliver your way through the mysteries of The Iron Rig, revisiting areas from DREDGE to investigate ancient disturbances stirring in the deep. Assist the Ironhaven Corporation in constructing facilities that unlock items, gadgets and more, but what are they truly here for?
 
Key Features:

2-5 hours of content playable at any time in your playthrough
Uncover a brand new side-story
Craft a new tier of equipment with 8 new pieces of gear
Catch more than 50 new fish
Advance to a new tier of boat hull, bigger and better than before
Research enhanced versions of some abilities

70050000049448.name: Moonstone Island: Arcane Artifacts DLC Pack
70050000049448.description:
So. We heard you all like Magic Man. A lot more than we ever imagined, in fact! So perhaps you would enjoy... a Magic Man-themed update? Our next free bumper pack of goodies is entirely centered around that mysterious weirdo that you love to love, with new dialogue, new events, and lots of Magic Man-themed furniture to make a shrine out of. We see you. 

This DLC contains these magically attuned cosmetics:

"Magic Hat" House Exterior 
Magic Hat Rug
Lectern
Candelabrum
Summoning Circle
Tattered Curtain

70050000049450.name: Zoo's Puzzle Pack 1
70050000049450.intro: Help wacky animals to relax in the pool by matching them on the floatie!
70050000049450.description: Unlock 24 new puzzles full of adorable animals and try to fit them all!

70050000049455.name: Experience x3 - Astrune Academy
70050000049455.description:
All characters' experience gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000049456.name: Damage x2 - Astrune Academy
70050000049456.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000049474.name: Rocket Car - Wheel Rim Collection
70050000049474.intro: Experience the ultimate rush of speed and skill in the thrilling world of cars featuring the game-changing New Rim for Wheel with Spokes!
70050000049474.description:
Embark on an electrifying adventure with the new one DLC that seamlessly integrates the thrilling addition of the New Rim for Wheel with Spokes, that makes you immerse yourself in the game and in intense soccer action, the perfect blend of fast cars and the possibility of customization, makes you feel the game in the true sense of the word. Choose from a variety of stylish vehicles, each equipped with its own unique abilities. Whether you prefer lightning-fast sports cars or commanding machines, here you have the perfect ride to suit your style.
      Get behind the wheel and start your thrilling journey today

70050000049479.name: The GhostX: Sniper Simulator - Arsenal Expansion DLC
70050000049479.intro: Gear up for action-packed missions with the DLC – featuring new military rifle skins for unparalleled customization!
70050000049479.description:
Immerse yourself in the breathtaking action of the DLC, where you embody an elite sniper in critical missions. Experience cool and unique thrills by taking advantage of the 5 new military rifle skins that help you customize your arsenal for improved gameplay and style. Embark on challenging missions in various environments, mastering new tactics such as shooting from helicopters and targeting moving trains. With stunning visuals and immersive sound, the "GhostX: Tactical Sniper" DLC offers an immersive and unique gaming experience.
     Are you ready to prove your skills in the best sniper simulator?

70050000049482.name: WARZONE CHRONICLES - Night Vision DLC
70050000049482.intro: Face the darkness and survive the night, equip your night vision goggles and dive into the Night Stalker DLC.
70050000049482.description:
Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter returns with the Night Stalker DLC, introducing a thrilling new dimension to the game with night vision capabilities.
     Experience the adrenaline rush as you navigate the pitch-black corridors of the abandoned building, where every shadow hides a potential threat. The night vision goggles reveal obstacles and enemies with eerie clarity, transforming the familiar battleground into a suspenseful nightmare.
    With the cover of darkness, the stakes are higher and the tension is palpable. The green glow of your goggles amplifies the gritty VHS aesthetic, immersing you deeper into the haunting atmosphere. The combination of intense survival gameplay and the strategic use of night vision ensures that every encounter is a heart-pounding test of skill and nerve.

70050000049498.name: Golf With Your Friends - Legends of Olympus Pack
70050000049498.intro: Dress to impress with the brand new Legends of Olympus Pack.
70050000049498.description:
Honour the storied past of the Gingy's homeland with the Legends of Olympus Pack! Olympus is a land of myths and monsters, warriors and heroes, and some pretty good golfers too! This pack contains the following cosmetic items for your ball:

Gorgon
Minotaur
Corinthian Helmet
Winged Hat of Hermes
Olympian Wig
Trireme
Charon's Ferry
Zeus' Lightning
Souls Trail
Olympian Vase

Dress to impress with the brand new Legends of Olympus Pack. After thousands of years its safe to say these items will never go out of style, and all in a monstrously good selection.

70050000049503.name: Golf With Your Friends - Olympus Odyssey Course
70050000049503.intro: Golf among the Gods with the all new Olympus Odyssey Course!
70050000049503.description: You and your friends have been summoned to the fabled mini golf course in the sky! Home to the Gingy race who oversee all things golf in the world, Olympus is a proud and storied city located high up in the clouds. 18 high altitude holes brimming with magic and wonder are available now!

70050000049529.name: Midnight Skin (Elyrion)
70050000049529.intro: The skin for Elyrion is mystical, fueled by darkness and will change the entire tribe's looks and music!
70050000049529.description:
Elyrion Skin
The special Midnight skin for Elyrion allows you to create graves, build crypts, and summon demons from the graves in the dark forests. 

This group of Elyrion has been corrupted by the Shard of D’Naeh, a mystical relic fueled by darkness. They’ve set their twisted hearts on spreading their influence across the Square with the help of vicious wolves, fiendish ghouls, and tainted dragons!

The Midnight cult has been corrupted by the Shard of D’Naeh, a mystical relic fueled by darkness. Through necromancing practices they can summon demons from the graves in the dark forests.

70050000049532.name: Moonstone Island: Chef's Kiss DLC Pack
70050000049532.intro: Create the kitchen of your dreams with a set of cooking-themed cosmetics!
70050000049532.description:
Are you the kind of hopeless home-cook that burns water, or are you the kind of chef that uses teeny-tiny tweezers to adorn your steak with microgreens? Either way, we won't judge you, because this DLC is for cooks of all skill levels! 

The Chef's Kiss DLC comes with six premium cooking-related items:
- Bakery House Skin
- Donut Rug
- Cloche
- Pot Rack
- Marble Counter
- Marble Counter with Sink

So even if you've never cracked an egg successfully and all your frozen pizzas come out looking like charcoal, you can at least project an air of baking mastery. Happy cooking!

Note: The cooking activity is part of a free update for all. These items are cosmetic-only.

70050000049533.name: Moonstone Island: Autumnal Accessories DLC Pack
70050000049533.description:
Celebrate the vibrant colours of the best season of them all with these foresty, fall-themed decorations! Make your island feel like a magical fairy paradise with an autumnal archway, spookify your house with Ghostshroom decor, or treat your Spirits to a cute house of their own with the new Mushroom Barn!

The Autumnal Accessories DLC Pack includes:

Mushroom Spirit Barn Skin
- Autumnal Archway
- Electricone Rug
- Leaf Stool
- Ghostshroom lamp
- Ghostshroom Rug

70050000049563.name: More Missions Pack (Making Sweets, Maiko Dance)
70050000049563.intro:
Our Field Trip Adventure is not over yet!
Get ready for 2 all-new missions!
70050000049563.description:
Experience 2 new missions, "Making Sweets" and "Maiko Dance," in the "More Missions Pack," an additional content pack for Our Field Trip Adventure!
These additional quests will also be available in Field Trip Master Mode!

The "More Missions Pack" includes the following content:
・Additional missions "Making Sweets" and "Maiko Dance"
・Collection Coins for the new missions

70050000049569.description: Unlock 24 new puzzles full of adorable animals and try to fit them all!

70050000049592.name: Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons
70050000049592.description:
Listen closely to the whispers in the darkness, for the secrets you’ve been eying are now within reach. At long last, it’s time to open the Book of Vile Darkness. 
 
Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons brings the realm of fantasy horror into The Fog with new Killer, Vecna and new Survivors Aestri Yazar and Baermar Uraz (one character with 2 playable options). A new Map, Forgotten Ruins, is available for all players. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 3 exclusive Cosmetics: Aestri’s Gilded Elven Bodice, Baermar’s Gilded Brocard Shirt, and Vecna’s Blade of Mayhem. 
 
New to The Fog? Check out Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons Edition, which includes the base game, the Dungeons and Dragons Chapter, and 2 Dungeons & Dragons Outfits: Baermar’s Roadside Ambush and Vecna’s Whispered One.

70050000049593.name: Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons - Cosmetic Pack
70050000049593.description: This pack contains 2 Dungeons & Dragons Outfits: Baermar’s Roadside Ambush and Vecna’s Whispered One. Please note this pack can only be obtained when buying the Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons Edition.

70050000049708.name: A Frog's Job - Level Pack 1
70050000049708.description:
A Frog's Job - Level Pack 1.

Try to save 12 new frog souls in this DLC, and use the time-stopping mechanic to solve a new set of challenging levels.

The level pack doesn't follow the main game level order, you can start them right-away.

Don't let the poor frog souls in limbo and save them now!

70050000049710.name: A Frog's Job - Level Pack 2
70050000049710.description:
"A Frog's Job - Level Pack 2.

Try to save 12 new frog souls in this DLC, and use the time-stopping mechanic to solve a new set of challenging levels.

The level pack doesn't follow the main game level order, you can start them right-away.

Don't let the poor frog souls in limbo and save them now!"

70050000049711.name: Pinball M - Texas Chainsaw Massacre Pinball
70050000049711.description:
Put on the mask and rev the chainsaw - Leatherface returns to slaughter in pinball form! Aim your shots and use all your skills to take out your victims in one of the most brutal pinball tables ever created.

Table features: 

- Play as Leatherface and terrorize the new arrivals who dare come into your town
- Sneak up on unsuspecting victims by shooting the right targets to maim and massacre them
- It's a Bloodbath in the Bus! Lock 3 balls then watch the mayhem unfold
- RNN RRNNN RRRNNN! Keep revving the chainsaw to start a frenzy mode for increased points
- Complete all Main Modes to face off against the last survivors in Wizard Mode. Don't let anyone escape!

70050000049712.name: Summer
70050000049712.intro: Start your Summer with the biggest DLC ever added to the game!
70050000049712.description:
Here is the list what comes with Summer DLC:
- 3 new biomes: Sand, Stone and Jungle Islands you can explore during your adventures!
- 2 new base resources: Cactus and Bamboo
- New furnitures you can craft with new materials
- Fish trap for automatic fishing process
- Cactus fruit maker and cactus salad
- 3 new species of fishes: Stone Fish, Sand Fish and Jade, each one unique for new biome

70050000049720.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges Of Corruption Expansion
70050000049720.description:
Requires the base game Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun to run.

YOUR FAVORITE ULTRAMARINE IS BACK!

You had a hell of a blast purging the heretics? Grab your holy chainsword, trusted bolter, and prepare for another adrenaline-pumping shootout, because your favorite Ultramarine is back!  Bring Boltgun’s bloodfest to another level with its new DLC: Forges of Corruption. Dive into a brand new campaign consisting of 5 levels with varied environments inspired by the grim dark lore of Warhammer 40,000. 


•	Explore new environments: Venture forth the Graia Battlefields, navigate the corridors of the Manufactorum, and hunt the heretics hidden within the Daemonic Forge. Stop Chaos' corruption before it spreads its vile mark on the entire world!
•	Exterminate new enemies:  Dodge the missiles of the vicious Black Havok Legion, prepare to face the terrible Helbrute in duels of epic proportions, and try not be gored by the Terminator and its Lightning Claw. Beware, for the scum of Chaos has grown even more formidable!
•	Purge with new weapons: Expand your holy arsenal with two brand new weapons. Burn hordes of foes with your Multi-Melta or blow them away with the Missile Launcher. 

Complete the purge and show no mercy!
Death to the heretics.

70050000049725.name: Lively Party Pack
70050000049725.intro:
The party is more lively than ever!
Enjoy 10 new minigames!
70050000049725.description:
New downloadable content (Lively Party Pack) is coming to Party Party Time 2!
Enjoy a mix of 10 all new competitive and co-op minigames!
Feel the life of the party!

The "Lively Party Pack" includes the following content:
10 New Minigames:
6 Competitive Games
- Perfect Sugoroku
- Grab the Cake
- Running Derby!
- Flag Race
- Ghost Crossing
- Survival Squash
4 Co-op Games
- Memorize and Place
- Catch the Big One!
- Ghostly Parade
- Spinning Ship

70050000049736.name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack
70050000049736.description:
When transported to an unknown dimension, Shadow must race through the streets of modern-day Shibuya to defeat the forces of G.U.N.
 
Take on a new look as Shadow and play through a unique level inspired by the new movie, Sonic the Hedgehog 3, featuring the voice of Keanu Reeves!

©2024 Par. Pics. ©2024 SEGA. TOKYO SKYTREE®. All Rights Reserved.

70050000049812.name: SnowRunner - Rezvani Tank
70050000049812.description:
The SnowRunner garage keeps on getting bigger and better with a new scout looking as mean as it is powerful, the Rezvani Tank!

Fitted with the same engine as its big brother the Rezvani Hercules, it separates itself with softer suspensions, a lighter chassis and maximum ground clearance giving it incredible agility and power-to-weight ratio.

70050000049883.name: Magical Bakery Deluxe Content
70050000049883.intro: Experience the entirety of Magical Bakery and access exclusive extras, including a digital copy of the concept art and the in-game soundtrack.
70050000049883.description: Experience the entirety of Magical Bakery and access exclusive extras, including a digital copy of the concept art and the in-game soundtrack.

70050000049890.name: Everdell - Glimmergold
70050000049890.intro: Glimmergold introduces three new ways to play Everdell that you can mix-and-match to your perfect fit!
70050000049890.description:
Embark on an extraordinary journey in the enchanting world of Everdell!

Glimmergold introduces three new ways to play that you can mix-and-match to your perfect fit:

Extra! Extra!
The carnival has come to Everdell, and we’re spreading the news! Test your wits and entertain your citizens with new cards to bring your city to life.

Legends
Your reputation has spread, and notable characters from around the woodland are popping by for a visit! Legendary critters and constructions are powerful new cards that can super-charge your city!

Rugwort
Hide your valuables! The mischievous Rugwort has arrived with three new cards that will allow you to interfere with your opponents plans like never before!
…and Rugwort has brought friends! Rugworts Minions are a new style of worker that you can send scurrying off to help your city grow!

New Achievements and Challenges!
Prove your mastery of Everdell and push your ability to govern your city! Whether you’re a seasoned player or just starting out, three new Glimmergold Challenges and five Achievements give you lots to discover!

A new season is dawning in Everdell – write your own tale of woodland glory in Glimmergold!

70050000049931.name: Parking Jam: Snow Rush DLC
70050000049931.intro: Experience parking jam with a sleigh skin and icy trails!
70050000049931.description:
With this DLC you'll unlock: 
- New sleigh skin for your cars!
- Snow trail!
- Blue flame trail!
- 25000 coins!

Get ready to clear some jams with a brand new look!

70050000049933.name: Parking Jam: Fast Food DLC
70050000049933.intro: Experience parking jam with a food skin and fiery trails!
70050000049933.description:
With this DLC you'll unlock: 
- New food skin for your cars!
- Flame trail!
- Green fire trail!
- 25000 coins!

Get ready to clear some jams with a brand new look!

70050000049935.name: Coach Bus Driving Simulator - DLC Comfort Long Road Vehicle
70050000049935.description: Upgrade your travels with this new coach bus! This bus provides a smooth and enjoyable ride, making it perfect for any journey. Experience the difference with a spacious and well-designed interior that ensures a relaxing trip every time. Whether you're heading across town or embarking on a long-distance adventure, this coach bus is the ideal choice for comfort and convenience.

70050000049936.name: PAWfectly Designed - Extra Mission
70050000049936.intro: Design, Play, Imagine - PAWfectly Designed lets kids create enchanting worlds for their furry friends and design their dream spaces!
70050000049936.description:
Embark on a creative adventure with PAWfectly Designed, a game for children that unleashes the magic of creativity. Immerse yourself in a world where lovable animal characters need your help to create enchanting spaces for their unique professions. But that's not all! Get ready to explore your imagination and design your own dream room, adding a touch of personalisation to your creative journey.

• Freedom of creativity: Create imaginative spaces for a variety of animal professions, from cozy artist studios to bustling pizzerias.
• Dream Room Design: Design the room of your dreams, pouring your creativity into every nook and cranny.
• Engaging gameplay: Embark on a delightful journey through 15 levels filled with charming locations, challenges and touching stories.
• Immersive Adventure: Spark your imagination in an immersive and engaging adventure that encourages exploration and imaginative thinking.

70050000049946.name: Touhou: New World - Gensokyo Dreaming
70050000049946.intro: Adds Sumireko Usami, Koishi Komeiji, and a whole host of familiar Touhou faces for a total of 8 playable characters in a whole new adventure!
70050000049946.description:
◆New Scenario
Experience a brand-new story from the perspective of Sumireko Usami. After the appearance of the evil spirit Mima, Sumireko travels throughout Gensokyo gathering allies to face this new threat!

◆Additional Playable Characters
The following Touhou favorites will be added to the game as playable characters:
Sumireko Usami
Koishi Komeiji
Reisen Udongein Inaba
Youmu Konpaku
Remilia Scarlet
Sakuya Izayoi
Flandre Scarlet
Yukkuri Reimu

◆New Stages
Hop aboard abandoned trains, visit stations enshrouded by fog, venture through factories once used by the kappa, and even find yourself exploring the inside of a UFO! Get ready to experience newly added areas like Youkai Mountain, Genbu Ravine, Remains of Blazing Hell, and the Ice Cavern to expand your adventures in Gensokyo.

◆New Boss Characters
A slew of new enemies and bosses make an appearance too! Defeat the daunting foes that stand in your way and bring peace back to Gensokyo.

70050000049958.name: Aimi's Secrets
70050000049958.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess?! In this visual novel divinely beautiful girls will steal your heart!
70050000049958.description: Discover the Aimi's secrets with a unique collection of 12 illustrations.

70050000049964.name: Doomsday Hunters: Boss Rush Mega Pack
70050000049964.intro: Fight endless supply of bosses in the Boss Rush mode! Try new relics, guns and familiars.
70050000049964.description:
Doomsday Hunters: Boss Rush Mega Pack is the first expansion to our beloved roguelike shooter, offering an even more extensive array of content. If you find yourself craving more of the exhilarating synergies and ugly monsters, this DLC is for you! We're thrilled to introduce a brand-new game mode: Boss Rush. As the name suggests, you'll face off against a succession of challenging bosses, all while accumulating incredible power! 

 • 50+ cool new items, relics and familiars. All unlocked by default, so you don't have to grind to try them.
 • Boss Rush mode with some new locations you haven't seen before.
 • 40+ Completely New Bosses with some crazy attacks and patterns - more than double the original content, these will be available in classic game mode as well.
 • 10 new guns to add to your arsenal.

70050000049970.name: Cards Pack 1
70050000049970.intro: Pull an ace out of your pocket and check what challenges await you!
70050000049970.description: Unlock 8 stunning covers for your deck featuring charming girls.

70050000049972.description: Unlock 10 colorful themes for your background and switch them to your liking.

70050000049988.description:

Note: These are not new content, but part of the game content will be unlocked directly to help you experience the fun of the game faster.
Please note: Before installing the DLC, please update the game to the latest version

70050000049989.name: Game Speed x2
70050000049989.intro: This DLC can double the speed of the game as a whole.
70050000049989.description:
After installed the DLC, when you are in level,  you can find a setting of "Speed x2" in the Pausing panel.
Notice: if you set the game speed to x2, all of the speed will be set to x2. If some levels also have the x2 effect, then it will became x4. So, it's will make game more exciting but more difficult.
Please note: Before installing the DLC, please update the game to the latest version

70050000049990.description:

Let's travel around the beautiful cities of the world with puzzles!

Beautiful Okinawa nature in motion

70050000050027.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Law & Disorder
70050000050027.description:
One is the most striking Monster Jam™ truck on the Monster Jam™ circuit. Classified as a "SUV from the future", 14 times Monster Jam™ World Racing Champion and ready to destroy everything in its path. The other was created in late 2013 to encore a futuristic police vehicle. Together, they are Maximum Destruction™ (in its Original Body version) and New Earth Authority™ (N.E.A Police). And they are ready to battle on the dirt of Monster Jam™ Showdown.

This DLC includes:
- New Earth Authority™
- Maximum Destruction™

This DLC is not included in the Season Pass.

70050000050028.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - The Odd Couple
70050000050028.description:
Have your surfboard ready, grab a coconut, and get ready to cheer on one of the most fan-favorite trucks in the Monster Jam™ universe. Big Kahuna is taking his surf style on the track, and is ready to make you explode like an adrenaline volcano! Or do the opposite of everything and get ready for the weirdest driving experience. This will make you wonder which way the world turns, because Backwards Bob™ is ready to make your head spin, in this incredible challenge on the tracks of Monster Jam™ Showdown!

This DLC includes:
- Big Kahuna
- Backwards Bob™

This DLC is not included in the Season Pass.

70050000050040.intro: Dig deep and make it big!
70050000050040.description:
Explore a brand new map and storyline set in the arctic! Magnetic waves have been detected underground, and it's up to you to dig down and investigate!

Includes:

• A new map
• A new storyline
• 14 new resources
• 5 new mechs

70050000050054.name: Coach Bus Driving Simulator - DLC Fast Long Road Vehicle
70050000050054.description: Long roads become an enjoyable experience aboard this new coach bus, transforming travel into a delightful adventure! With its reliable construction and versatile features, this coach is perfect for staying punctual on both short hops and extended trips.

70050000050092.description:
This is an outfit set for Loid, Anya, Yor, and Bond to use in SPY×ANYA: Operation Memories.

70050000050100.name: Best Stories 1
70050000050100.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.
70050000050100.description: Relive your favorite stories from Brazil with 8 amazing illustrations featuring the best scenes from the game.

70050000050102.name: Best Stories 2
70050000050102.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.

70050000050103.name: Best Stories 3
70050000050103.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.
70050000050103.description: Relive your favorite stories from Brazil with 9 amazing illustrations featuring the best scenes from the game.

70050000050110.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Experience Multiplier
70050000050110.description:
Race. Jump. Destroy. Repeat. If you enjoy crashing around and pushing incredible tricks with your favorite Monster Jam™ truck, you'll love this Experience Multiplier. In the end, in a game where experience, boost and giant tires are everything, what's better than a x2 XP Multiplier to double the fun?

This DLC is included in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Season Pass.

70050000050111.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Soldiers & Pirates
70050000050111.description:
Soldier Fortune Black Ops™ is the special forces-inspired spinoff of Soldier Fortune™, a truck created to pay homage to US military members. And it's ready for a mission with two real buccaneers: The Black Pearl and Captain's Curse™. The first one debuted in 2017, and quickly proved to be one of the most successful independently-owned trucks on the Monster Jam™ circuit. The second, debuting in 2007, competed in every Monster Jam World Finals until 2015, and was one of the most beloved trucks by the fans, until its retirement in 2016. Together, they are ready to leave on an incredible adventure. 

This DLC includes:
- Soldier Fortune Black Ops™ with 3 liveries
- The Black Pearl with 3 liveries
- Captain’s Curse™ with 3 liveries

This DLC is included in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Season Pass.

70050000050112.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Grave Digger™ Legacy
70050000050112.description:
The Grave Digger™ dynasty is truly unstoppable and it proves it once again with these 3 incredible commemorative versions, returning to dominate the tracks with Monster Jam™ Showdown. Kick up some dirt with Grave Digger™ 30th Anniversary, straight from 2012! Dig a hole for your opponents with Grave Digger™ 25th Anniversary, the truck that competed in the 2007 season, and swipe off the dust of time with Grave Digger™ Encore: the 2022 truck inspired by the very first design of the 1982 vehicle.

This DLC includes:
- Grave Digger™ 30th Anniversary with 3 liveries
- Grave Digger™ 25th Anniversary with 3 liveries
- Grave Digger™ Encore with 3 liveries

This DLC is included in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Season Pass.

70050000050113.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Aloha Expansion
70050000050113.description:
Can you feel the call of Hawaii? These dream islands are ready to welcome you and offer you tons of new challenges. In this Expansion Pack, you will find a new environment inspired by the lush and wild Hawaiian nature, where you can explore 6 new tracks and a new arena.
Furthermore, in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Aloha Expansion you will also find the perfect adventure companions in this new tropical experience: 5 trucks ready to let loose in the jungle! The first one is Wreckreation: an RV monster truck always ready for destruction, which, as the quote on its roof goes, invites you to “Go Outside and Play”. Then comes Lumberjack, who debuted in 2015 and will definitely feel at home among the Hawaiian logs. For sure even Fire Rescue and Full Charge, two trucks coming straight out of the toy world, will know how to make their way through the mud and foliage of the islands. Finally, last but not least, a true legend will join the journey, the first version of Grave Digger™'s body ever to showcase a spooky paint job: the Grave Digger™ "Grandma"!

This DLC includes:
- 1 new environment: 6 tracks and 1 arena
- Wreckreation with 3 liveries
- Lumberjack with 3 liveries
- Fire Rescue with 3 liveries
- Full Charge with 3 liveries
- Grave Digger™ "Grandma" with 3 liveries

This DLC is included in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Season Pass.

70050000050114.name: Bug & Seek: Isopods Expansion
70050000050114.intro: Now catch even more bugs with the Isopods Expansion!
70050000050114.description: The Bug & Seek: Isopods Expansion includes 20 new isopods to discover and catch + a new mastery category to level up! Once downloaded, these critters show up as unknown bugs in your codex, and like the other 180+ bugs in the base game, each isopod comes with its own unique tagline and codex description based on its real life characteristics and behavior.

70050000050115.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Off The Leash
70050000050115.description:
Keep the kibbles ready! The Monster Jam™ Showdown kennel has flung open its doors and these three doggos are ready to play in the dirt. The pack leader, Monster Mutt™ Retro, has competed in eighteen World Finals. His littermates are different versions of the truck inspired by two of the world's most appreciated dog breeds: Monster Mutt™ Dalmatian Retro and Monster Mutt™ Rottweiler. Unleash them on the tracks!

This DLC includes:
- Monster Mutt™ Retro with 3 liveries
- Monster Mutt™ Dalmatian Retro with 3 liveries
- Monster Mutt™ Rottweiler with 3 liveries

This DLC is included in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Season Pass.

70050000050116.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Always On Duty
70050000050116.description:
Clock in and start your shift of destruction with three of the most dedicated trucks in the Monster Jam™ toy universe. Get busy with Ranger Rescue, themed after the emergency vehicles used by the U.S. National Parks Service. Send your opponents back to school by driving the incredible Fuel Academy school bus, or look down on everyone from the top of 2021 truck Double Decker.

This DLC includes:
- Ranger Rescue with 3 liveries
- Fuel Academy with 3 liveries
- Double Decker with 3 liveries

This DLC is included in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Season Pass.

70050000050117.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - DIGatron™
70050000050117.description:
Designed in conjunction with JCB’s engineering team, the DIGatron™ truck isn't afraid to get its wheels dirty. And it's ready to go the extra mile to ensure that its yellow bodywork, inspired by the iconic JCB construction equipment, will triumph on the tracks of Monster Jam™ Showdown.

This DLC includes:
- DIGatron™ with 2 liveries

70050000050118.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Mega Bite
70050000050118.description:
Monster Jam™ championship tracks are no stranger to trucks that know how to show their teeth. But when it comes to teeth, no one is like Mega-Bite: a canine-inspired truck that debuted in 2012 and knows a trick or two to hype its fans.

This DLC includes:
- Mega-Bite with 2 liveries

70050000050119.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Yeti™
70050000050119.description:
If you suddenly feel a chill, don't blame the window or a new ice age. It could simply be Yeti™, ready to get back on track on Monster Jam™ Showdown. But don't worry skiers and hikers, the only ones this abominable snow truck will take on, are its opponents.

This DLC includes:
- Yeti™ with 2 liveries

70050000050120.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Bad News Travels Fast
70050000050120.description:
Good news travels fast, but bad news travels even faster. And this truck is well aware of that. Originally born in 1998, Bad News Travels Fast is now roaring on the Monster Jam™ Showdown tracks.

70050000050180.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - TOP GUN: Maverick Aircraft Set
70050000050180.description:
A special set in collaboration with the movie Top Gun: Maverick, featuring 6 aircraft (with originals), as well as nicknames and emblems.

TOP GUN: Maverick Aircraft Set includes:

• Playable Aircraft: F-14A Tomcat
A large carrier-based fighter that replaced the F-4 in handling fleet defense. Its striking twin engines and variable-sweep wings are iconic. Its nickname is Tomcat.
This aircraft can equip the LAAM, SAAM, or SFFS as its special weapon.
Includes 6 skins (with specials).

• Playable Aircraft: F-14A Tomcat | Top Gun: Maverick
A special aircraft based on the F-14A. Deadly at any range.
This aircraft can equip the LAAM, SAAM, or HPAA as its special weapon.
Features 8 skins from Top Gun, including Maverick and Iceman skins.

• Playable Aircraft: F/A-18E Super Hornet
The latest single-seat variant in the F/A-18 series. Like the F-type, its nickname is Super Hornet.
This aircraft can equip the HCAA, 4AGM, or LAGM as its special weapon.
Includes 6 skins (with specials).

• Playable Aircraft: F/A-18E Super Hornet | Top Gun: Maverick
A special aircraft based on the F/A-18E. Possesses well-balanced maneuverability.
This aircraft can equip the HCAA, HVAA, or GPB as its special weapon.
Includes 6 skins (with originals).

• Playable Aircraft: 5th Gen Fighter | Top Gun: Maverick
A 5th-generation fighter with superb versatility. It is highly maneuverable and can be fitted with a variety of parts.
This aircraft can equip the 4AAM, HCAA, or LACM as its special weapon.
Includes 6 skins (with originals).

• Playable Aircraft: DarkStar
A supersonic stealth fighter with extraordinary high-speed flight capabilities that set it apart from other aircraft.
This aircraft can equip the SASM, XSDB, or PLSL as its special weapon.
Includes 6 skins (with originals).

• Collaboration Emblems　
The VF-1 squadron emblem and the VFA-213 squadron emblem from the movie Top Gun.
The adversary PHOENIX: The phoenix emblem of F-14A Tomcat, an enemy aircraft in Top Gun: Maverick.
The 2 logos of the movie Top Gun: Maverick.
5 character emblems, including Maverick, Hangman, Payback, Rooster, and Bob.

• Collaboration Nicknames
12 nicknames, such as Goose and Cougar, exclusive to the TOP GUN: Maverick Aircraft Set.

• Multiplayer Mode BGMs
Top Gun Anthem (Keiki Kobayashi Arrangement)
Danger Zone (Keiki Kobayashi Arrangement)

*F-14A Tomcat | Top Gun: Maverick, F/A-18E Super Hornet | Top Gun: Maverick, 5th Gen Fighter | Top Gun: Maverick, and DarkStar are special aircraft that are part of a collaboration with the movie Top Gun: Maverick.

*Skins and emblems can be viewed by choosing Select a Skin, or Select Emblem respectively.
*Skins and emblems can only be changed in campaign mode after completing campaign mode once.
*In multiplayer mode, skins and emblems can be changed from the beginning.

70050000050182.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F-2A -Super Kai- Set
70050000050182.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: F-2A -Super Kai-
A modernized multirole support fighter based on the F-2.
It retains the F-2's excellent strength in interdictions at sea, but has been improved to handle both aerial and anti-surface combat, making it great for a variety of mission types.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Tiger Skin.

This aircraft can equip the LASM, 6AAM, or IEWS as its special weapon.

70050000050183.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F-15 S/MTD Set
70050000050183.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: F-15 S/MTD
This new-and-improved experimental F-15 is equipped with 2D thrust vectoring nozzles and large canards for increased air combat maneuverability. This aircraft takes even greater command over the battlefield than its predecessor, overwhelming both air and ground targets with its sheer offensive power.
The S/MTD in its name stands for Short Takeoff and Landing/Maneuver Technology Demonstrator.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Sorcerer Skin.

This aircraft can equip the HPAA, FAEB, or HIVAA as its special weapon.

70050000050184.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - ASF-X Shinden II Set
70050000050184.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: ASF-X Shinden II
A cutting-edge support fighter built to handle a variety of situations.
Its two-tiered jet engine and variable forward-swept wings give this aircraft excellent versatility and flight stability. Its nickname is Shinden II.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Nagase skin.

This aircraft can equip the 6AAM, RKT, or LASM as its special weapon.

70050000050187.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - XFA-27 Set
70050000050187.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: XFA-27
A carrier-based stealth fighter designed for ultimate performance.
Its variable sweptback wings, canards, and unique wing construction featuring four tail wings grant it overwhelmingly superior mobility, making it a powerful force in any battle.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Scarface skin, and the new special weapon MSTM.

This aircraft can equip the SOD, MSTM, or IEWS as its special weapon.

70050000050191.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - CFA-44 Nosferatu Set
70050000050191.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: CFA-44 Nosferatu
A next-generation carrier-based stealth fighter optimized for solo raids.
Nicknamed Nosferatu (meaning undying), its acceleration and mobility far outclass other fighters.
Equipped with versatile weaponry, this aircraft is formidable against both air and ground targets.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Strigon skin, and the new special weapon ADMM.

This aircraft can equip the ADMM, EML, or IEWS as its special weapon.

70050000050194.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F-16XL Set
70050000050194.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: F-16XL
A prototype bomber based on the F-16. With cranked-arrow wings, it boasts greater mobility and more weaponry than the original. Its excellent maneuverability at low speeds makes it a formidable force against ground targets.
Its mobility retained from the original model also allows it to perform well in close-range combat.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Wizard Skin.

This aircraft can equip the UGB, 4AAM, or 4AGM as its special weapon.

70050000050199.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - FB-22 Strike Raptor Set
70050000050199.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: FB-22 Strike Raptor
A stealth fighter based on the F-22 with improved explosive firepower.
Its main delta wings allow it to take on a greater weaponry load, improving its anti-ground offensive capabilities over the original model without losing any of its anti-air capabilities.
With an expanded weapon bay, this improved fighter now boasts greater heavy bomber capabilities and can endure protracted battles.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Flash Skin.

This aircraft can equip the XSDB, LAAM, or SFFS as its special weapon.

70050000050200.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F/A-18F Super Hornet Block III Set
70050000050200.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN.
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: F/A-18F Super Hornet Block III
A modernized carrier-based fighter modeled after the F/A-18.
It has improved engine performance and stealth capabilities, making it excel at everything from low-speed ground target missions to high-speed combat.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Aggressor Splitter Skin.

This aircraft can equip the LACM, 8AGM, or 4AAM as its special weapon.

70050000050202.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - MiG-35D Super Fulcrum Set
70050000050202.description:
An add-on for ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN. 
This set contains the following:

Playable Aircraft: MiG-35D Super Fulcrum
A multirole jet fighter developed as a variant of the MiG-29.
In addition to an expanded wing area, the craft boasts reinforced parts and has been retrofitted with a new thrust vectoring turbo engine, giving it greater maneuverability and offensive capabilities compared to the original model.
This set also includes 7 skins, including the special Tiger Skin.

This aircraft can equip the SAAM, 6AAM, or 4AGM as its special weapon.

70050000050203.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN - Experimental Aircraft Series Special Bonus Set

70050000050206.name: Tracks - Winter Wonderland DLC
70050000050206.description: Tracks is a toy train set builder which gives you the tools to play without limits. Enhance your winter wonderland with an exclusive Christmas train, train carriage and characters.

70050000050209.name: Dungeons 4 - The Good, the Bad and the Evil
70050000050209.intro: Dwarves, steam locomotives, and a showdown at high noon – what could possibly go wrong?
70050000050209.description:
Dungeons 4 – The Good, the Bad and the Evil awaits the Absolute Evil and his more or less dedicated General Thalya with (train)wagon loads of evil work to do. Led by their fearless queen, Brynnhild, those pesky dwarves have infiltrated a new part of the Overworld, the West, and kidnapped the Council of Little Snots. This is unmistakably screaming for a proper treatment of Evilfication™!

In this latest adventure, the Only-too-familiar-with-hardships Evil has to face new enemies equipped with pistols, sniper rifles and rotary guns, and … a beer-brewing beast of a dwarf. But of course, the Cunning Evil is prepared and leaves you well-equipped with new traps and building options to protect your stony dungeon heart!
 
• Wicked Wild West: Dungeons 4 – The Good, the Bad and the Evil takes you into ‘the West’ with 5 new fully voiced missions in a brand-new setting. Thalya must pursue the Dwarven Queen Brynnhild and prepare for an epic showdown at high noon!

• Reinforcement of The Good™: Four new dwarven units spice up the battle between Evil and Good – the Pistolero, the Machine Dwarf, the Crack Shot and the Brewmaster.

• The Train-loving Evil rejoices: Steam locomotives roar through the prairie, filled to the brim with dynamite-throwing, gun-slinging dwarves. Crack their armour and unleash your inner train enthusiast, building your own train to punch the dwarves' final ticket.

• Vermin alarm! Manavores, Spiders and Lavalumps are joined by the “delightful” Giant Scorpions that skulk through your dungeon and the overworld.

• Home Sweet Home: The Forces of Evil have enhanced your dungeon with new traps, like the lava-spitting Hydro-Lava-non or the Steam trap cooking heroes like dim-sum, and building options, like Floor Grates enabling you to build on lava or water.

• The return of the Dwarf Queen: Brynnhild is back in the game (and gosh, she even has a twin) and she’s using that steamy steel monster train against YOU!

• Dressed to kill: Thalya takes this literally! She goes full Wicked Wild West and even brings some new passive skills into the fight against the Good.

70050000050210.name: Dance
70050000050210.intro: Start your musical fun and create a catchy beat with the Music Box!
70050000050210.description: Add Dance genre sounds to your range and create new beats.

70050000050211.description: Customize your equipment with 2 new skins for: billiard cue, background and pool table.

70050000050214.intro: Survive the apocalypse with The Walking Dead Pack.
70050000050214.description:

70050000050217.name: Bug & Seek: Weevils Expansion
70050000050217.intro: Now catch even more bugs with the Weevils Expansion!
70050000050217.description: The Bug & Seek: Weevils Expansion includes 20 new weevils to discover and catch + a new mastery category to level up! Once downloaded, these critters show up as unknown bugs in your codex, and like the other 180+ bugs in the base game, each weevil comes with its own unique tagline and codex description based on its real life characteristics and behavior. Grab your 8-bit bug net, and go catch those boots and snoots!

70050000050250.name: Ticket to Ride: Nordic Expansion
70050000050250.intro: Next stop, the chilly north! Head to the Nordic Countries in Ticket to Ride!
70050000050250.description:
Hello! Hei! Halló! Hej! Hallå! Hallo!

It’s time to set off on a brand-new adventure with the Ticket to Ride Nordic Expansion! Ride across the northern reaches, connect colourful cities, and complete tickets from the top of Iceland to the southern border of Denmark!
 
Chase the Globetrotter Bonus, awarded to the player with the most completed tickets. Strategise with 40 train pieces instead of 45 to make connecting the Nordic cities more challenging, and tackle the Murmansk-Lieksa route, a new nine-train-long route! Plus, you can swap three coloured railway car cards for one locomotive card. 

INCLUDES: 
TWO NEW CHARACTERS – To guide you across the Nordic countries.
TWO NEW TRAINS – The charming Arctic Express and the titanic Frosthammer locomotives!
TWO NEW CARRIAGES – The Snowdrifter and the Hearthside double-decker carriage! 

Take on new horizons with the Nordic Expansion!

70050000050251.name: Ticket to Ride: 1910 & 1912 Ticket Pack Bundle
70050000050251.intro: Make history with the Ticket to Ride 1910 & 1912 Ticket Pack Bundle!
70050000050251.description:
Travel through the history of Europe and America with the 1910 & 1912 Ticket Pack Bundle! 

Each Ticket Pack contains three additional game modes and a host of new Tickets to add to your base decks. Make your journey one for the ages!

Europa 1912 Ticket Pack:
Enjoy three fresh game modes and multiple new cards! In Europe Expanded, you’ll get 55 new Tickets to add to your Europe Expansion* base deck! Then, grab the Big Cities Ticket deck and get ready to connect the most famous names in Europe in Big Cities of Europe. For the ultimate challenge, Mega Europe combines Long Routes, Regular and Big Cities Tickets!

USA 1910 Ticket Pack: 
Travel across America’s history in USA 1910 and aim for the Globetrotter Bonus as you complete new Tickets from the 1910 deck! Or, go big with the Big Cities game mode. Here, you’ll be dealt four Big Cities Tickets at the start of the game. These special Tickets all connect to the same major cities. Finally, create the ultimate historic experience and combine all existing Tickets in one game to achieve impressive high scores in Mega Game!

Your railway empire is history in the making!

70050000050252.name: Ticket to Ride: India Expansion
70050000050252.intro: Make memories in the magnificent land of India!
70050000050252.description:
It’s time to head to India in Ticket to Ride! With shorter ticket routes, the India Expansion presents new opportunities to get creative with connecting cities. 

Make use of ferry routes or stick to land as you chase the unique Mandala Bonus – awarded to players who link up the same cities in multiple ways! Meet two new characters and add two more locomotives and carriages to your ever-growing fleet. 

INCLUDES:
TWO NEW CHARACTERS – Join Bhaskar Singh, an aspiring poet, and Aanandi Johri, an inspiring doctor, as they journey across India! 
TWO NEW TRAINS – Head out in the iconic Star Royale, or live it up in luxury in the Maharaja’s Chariot! 
TWO NEW CARRIAGES – Bring a little elegance to your railway with the Lotus Wagon, or indulge with the Maharani’s Palace. 

A new chapter of your travel diary calls to be written!

70050000050259.name: PowerWash Simulator – Alice’s Adventures Special Pack
70050000050259.description:
The once vivid kingdom of Wonderland has found itself doused in detritus - the calamitous aftermath of the biggest threat the realm has ever seen… a curious little girl.

Take a trip down the rabbit hole to uncover a topsy-turvy, swizzy, whirly world of psychedelic colours, maximalist décor and larger than life locales.

You’ll not always be sure what it is you’re washing – is it a carpet or a clock? A carrot or a cup? Sure, you’ll wash walls and tables and floors, but here even the doors have doors. And if you find your mind wander as you power wash and ponder “what does a caterpillar wear to bed?”, you might just look up to find the answer directly ahead. 

Fact is fickle, but fiction is fate – your destiny is fixed for big things. Royal things. Big, royal things, as you clean your way through quirky and quaint homes, you’ll tread a muddy path all the way to throne, visiting:

•	Wonderland’s Entrance Hall
•	White Rabbit’s House
•	Caterpillar’s Mushroom
•	Mad Tea Party
•	Queen of Heart’s Court 

An all-new outfit, gloves and power washer skin await you in Wonderland, you wouldn’t want to be underdressed for the tea party of the century! Or late, for that matter – what are you waiting for?

Can you clean up and find favour, or will the Queen’s malice for Alice extend to you?

70050000050273.name: Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter - Augur of the Draugr Armour Pack
70050000050273.intro: Go to war against the Dark Wings with this ancient selection of armours
70050000050273.description:
Gear up in the ancient armours of old with the 'Augur of the Draugr' pack for Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter. This unique collection of upgradable Draugr equipment includes three new helms, three armours, and three pauldrons, together with three new shields and three new axes.

Forged amidst the heat of battle during the elder wars between Rat and Bat, they will help Arlo - heir to the Warden of the North - to inspire the animal folk of the Ratdom's winter swept northern frontier to rise against the ice-cold armies of the Dark Wings.

70050000050328.name: Love Chronicles
70050000050328.description:
The "Love Chronicles" DLC brings a wealth of romantic content to My Time at Sandrock. This exciting expansion allows you to delve into deeper romantic stories with four beloved characters: Logan, Fang, Nia and Mi-an. Immerse yourself in captivating new storylines and romantic chronicles, all brought to life with emotionally rich voice interactions. Discover these unique quests, making your romantic journey even more vibrant and colorful!

Logan: Beneath his tough exterior lies a gentle heart. Through new storylines and chronicles, explore Logan's past in Sandrock, experiencing his joys, sorrows, and the innocence and confusion of his childhood.

Fang: Enjoy a unique romantic date and special moments with Dr. Fang. This reserved doctor will reveal more of his deep emotions. Uncover his hidden past, a childhood filled with both warmth and pain.

Nia: As you help develop the town, you and Nia can build a deeper connection and understand each other better. From the beginning of your bond to your first separation during school days, these memories hold the infinite friendship of childhood sweethearts.

Mi-an: A surprising discovery in the desert sparks a romantic development, nurturing blossoming love and supporting Mi-an in her personal growth. Discover the special opportunity that led this once obedient girl to become a builder.

The "Love Chronicles" DLC not only introduces new stories and touching memory chronicles but also adds rich voice interactions. Enjoy sweet conversations with the NPCs, seek their comfort, companionship, and advice, bringing warmth and joy to your daily life and ensuring you never feel alone.

NOTE: This DLC only supports single-player mode.

70050000050330.name: Character Outfit：Summer Candy
70050000050330.description:

70050000050331.name: Live Event Pass DLC
70050000050331.intro: Battle it out for seasonal exclusive skins!
70050000050331.description:

70050000050496.name: Yamat - The Breach Traveler
70050000050496.intro: Play as Yamat, a powerful dark mage summoning creatures, fighting with a bow and great sword!
70050000050496.description:
YAMAT, THE BREACH TRAVELER
Play as Yamat, a powerful Breach Traveler who has wandered through countless astral prisons created by the Master. She seeks to challenge the strongest fighters and prove her worth.

This new prisoner has a bold personality and harbors many mysteries. Her motivations and personal goals will unfold with each escape attempt.

WEAPONS
Yamat can use 3 different weapons types for different playstyles:
- Dark Energy Fists: Close-range quick attacks of dark matter, unleashing flaming magical creatures.
- Two-Handed Dark Sword: Long-range powerful slashes that can hit multiple enemies at once.
- Dark Bow: Long-range attacks that shower enemies with arrows.

SPELLS, PERKS AND PASSIVES
- 16 unique spells: Summon powerful wild creatures, unleash spinning giant blades, and more!
- Forbidden Power: With this Signature Spell, Yamat transforms into her flying draconic form, allowing her to move freely while shooting magic missiles at nearby enemies.
- 37 associated perks: Modify her Signature Spell to suit your playstyle.
- 9 weapon passives: Each weapon comes with 3 unique passives, making Yamat an even deadlier fighter.

OTHER CONTENT
- New Papa Yalee stories: 4 new stories that delve deeper into the mysterious Yamat.
- 1000+ new lines of dialogue: Interact with Yamat and all the other characters in the Garden, including heroes, fully voiced in English and Japanese.
- Cinematics and ending screens: New cinematics and a new ending screen has been added for Yamat!

HOW TO ACCESS YAMAT
If you have not yet met Yamat in the Garden, she will appear after a couple of escape attempts.

ADDITIONS TO THE BASE GAME
Even without owning this add-on content, you will still be able to:

- See Yamat hanging out in the Garden.
- Collect and use 2 Yamat Echoes during runs.
- Fight Yamat's Shadow Clone.

70050000050580.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Xerxes (The Achaemenid) Persona

Xerxes, The Achaemenid - Unique Ability
Silk Road: Increased Trade Route limit with all other leaders. Creating a Trade Route or Road with a Merchant provides Culture and Gold per Age. Increased Culture and Gold per Age on Unique Buildings and Unique Improvements.

Xerxes, The Achaemenid - Agenda
Lord of Coin: Decrease Relationship by a Medium Amount if player has a greater or equal number of Trade Routes compared to Xerxes. Increase Relationship by a Small Amount if player has fewer Trade Routes than Xerxes.

Friedrich, Baroque - Agenda
Parisian Sensibilities: Increase Relationship per built Wonder in the Capital by a Medium Amount. Decrease Relationship per Building in the Capital by a Small Amount.

Ashoka, World Conqueror - Unique Ability

70050000050584.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Himiko (High Shaman) Persona

Note that if you already own Civilization VII Founders Edition, then you already own this content.

The queen of Yamatai, an early Japanese state, Himiko used her political and religious authority as, possibly, a shaman of the sun-goddess Amaterasu to rule. Other accounts claim she had enthralled her subjects by magic. Whatever the truth behind Himiko's legend, her charisma was a powerful force, and resonates until the present day.

Attributes: Cultural, Diplomatic

Himiko, High Shaman - Unique Ability
Miko of Amaterasu: Increased Happiness per Age on Happiness Buildings. Increased Production towards constructing Happiness Buildings. Gain increased Culture but slightly reduced Science, with increased effects during a Celebration.

Himiko, High Shaman - Agenda
Shaman Queen: Decrease Relationship by a Small Amount per Settlement with constructed Science and Gold Buildings. Increase Relationship by a Small Amount per Settlement with Culture and Happiness Buildings.

70050000050659.name: PowerWash Simulator – Muckingham Files – Part 3
70050000050659.description:
The third instalment of the Muckingham Files is the ultimate clean-up for aquatic fanatics, expanding PowerWash Simulator’s in-game universe with two nautical new Bonus Jobs. In this update, dredge up new lore on local personalities and native sea creatures. The best part? These jobs were suggested and voted for by the PowerWash Simulator community!

Return to Crab Bay, where a freak wave has wreaked havoc on the aquarium and its research submarine. Help get Muckingham’s sea life conservation programme back on its feet (or rather, fins) by taking these maritime monuments from briny and grimy to gleaming and shiny.

Feel a sense of calm wash over you as you restore the aquarium’s fish tanks from encrusted enclosures to serene sea life showcases, and blast barnacles off the hull of Rowdy C. Life, Caldera University’s research submarine. If all goes swimmingly, the fishes will have you to thank!

About the Muckingham Files

The Muckingham Files is a series of free Bonus Job updates that take you to never-before-seen places from the original universe of PowerWash Simulator, with new characters, locations and stories. Get to know more about your stomping ground and its inhabitants as the most in-demand power washer in town.
