70050000050749.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII Tecumseh and Shawnee Pack
70050000050749.description:
The Tecumseh and Shawnee Pack is included as part of the Sid Meier's Civilization® VII Deluxe and Founders Editions.

This content pack adds the leader Tecumseh and the Shawnee civilization to Civilization VII!

Tecumseh specializes in diplomacy and defense. His unique ability, Nicaakiyakoolaakwe, increases food, production, and combat strength based on the number of allied city-states.

Shawnee is an Exploration Age civilization that excels at utilizing natural resources. Their unique ability, Nepekifaki, gives more food for settlements built on river tiles but slightly reduces food for any cities not built on rivers. Its associated wonder is the Serpent Mound.

70050000050754.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Crossroads of the World Collection - Cosmetic Bonus

70050000050755.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Carthage Pack
70050000050755.description:
Add the Carthage civilization for The Antiquity Age to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

This content is available for individual purchase, but is also available as part of the Crossroads of the World Collection DLC bundle featuring two leaders, four civilizations, and four Natural Wonders.

From humble colony to economic hegemony, Carthage rose from the shores of North Africa to dominate the Mediterranean Sea. Its sleek ships ferried goods and riches all over the known world, while at home, the city of Carthage was famed for its master craftsmen and deep agricultural knowledge. Competition with first Greece, then Rome, honed renowned generals and a powerful navy. But war was Carthage’s undoing, and the city was destroyed in 146 BCE.

Attributes: Militaristic, Economic

Unique Ability - Phoenician Heritage: Can only have one City. Towns cannot use Convert to City. When you create a Merchant or Colonist Unit, gain a copy of that Unit.

Unique Civilian Unit: Colonist (Unique Settler Unit)

Unique Military Unit: Numidian Cavalry (Unique Cavalry Unit) 

Associated Wonder: Byrsa

70050000050756.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Ada Lovelace Pack
70050000050756.description:
Add the leader Ada Lovelace to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

This content is available for individual purchase, but is also available as part of the Crossroads of the World Collection DLC bundle featuring two leaders, four civilizations, and four Natural Wonders.

From childhood, Ada Lovelace inspected the world through a scientist's eyes. Forging a path between intellectualism and imagination, she applied her mathematical mind to the nineteenth century's most cutting-edge experiments. Working with mechanical computers, which made calculations using gears and punch cards, she designed the first computer program, establishing the field of computing over a century before technology caught up to her vision.

Attributes: Scientific, Cultural

Unique Ability - Enchantress of Number: Cities receive increased Science per Age when you complete a Civic Mastery. This resets at the start of each Age. Gain Culture equal to a percentage of your total Science per turn when you complete a Technology Mastery.

Agenda - Analytical Engine: Increase Relationship by a Small Amount for the leader with the most Masteries. Decrease Relationship by a Small Amount for the leader with the fewest Masteries.

70050000050757.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Great Britain Pack
70050000050757.description:
Add the Great Britain civilization for The Modern Age to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

This content is available for individual purchase, but is also available as part of the Crossroads of the World Collection DLC bundle featuring two leaders, four civilizations, and four Natural Wonders.

The sun never set on Great Britain's vast empire. Its territories spread across all continents, funneling raw materials from colonial holdings to the factories of the metropole. Foreign policy was conducted through economic strategy, extensive diplomacy, and threat of war. The British navy dominated the seas, while at home, society found a new order amid the explosion of industry. Under Pax Britannica, the world followed Britain's lead.

Attributes: Economic, Expansionist

Unique Ability - Workshop of the World: Buildings are a set percentage cheaper to produce or purchase. Converting Towns into Cities costs a set percentage more.

Unique Civilian Unit: Antiquarian (Unique Explorer Unit)

Unique Military Unit: Revenge (Unique Naval Unit) 

Associated Wonder: Battersea Power Station

70050000050758.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Simón Bolívar Pack
70050000050758.description:
Add the leader Simón Bolívar to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

This content is available for individual purchase, but is also available as part of the Crossroads of the World Collection DLC bundle featuring two leaders, four civilizations, and four Natural Wonders.

As the Napoleonic Wars weakened Spain’s presence in the Americas, Simón Bolívar, "El Libertador," led forces to liberate the region. With tenacity and charisma, he led his armies to victory, and the people to independence. The instability of newfound freedom proved difficult to overcome. First president and then dictator of Gran Colombia, he failed to fully enact his ambitions. Yet Bolívar remains an enduring example of South American defiance.

Attributes: Expansionist, Militaristic

Unique Ability - El Libertador: Gain a free amount of Support on your wars. When you conquer a Settlement for the first time, it can purchase a Building for free. Can purchase items when in the Unrest status.

Agenda - Cornerstone of Freedom: Increase Relationship by a Medium Amount for having the least Unhappy Settlements. Decrease Relationship by a Small Amount for the leader with the most amount of Unhappy Settlements.

70050000050759.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Bulgaria Pack
70050000050759.description:
Add the Bulgaria civilization to your collection for The Exploration Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

This content is available for individual purchase, but is also available as part of the Crossroads of the World Collection DLC bundle featuring two leaders, four civilizations, and four Natural Wonders.

In the seventh century, the Bulgars crossed the Danube and made the Balkans their own. Their warriors used the mountains to their advantage, scattering larger armies through skill and stratagems. The First Bulgarian Empire ran on conquest, expansion, and the growth of trade. The Second Empire saw the rise of art, literature, and architecture alongside spirituality and monastic traditions. All came crashing down when the Ottomans invaded.

Attributes: Militaristic, Expansionist

Unique Ability - Krum's Dynasty: Receive Food in all Towns when pillaging Improvements equal to a percentage of the HP or yields gained.

Unique Civilian Unit: Tarkhan (Unique Commander Unit)

Unique Military Unit: Bolyar (Unique Cavalry Unit) 

Associated Wonder: Rila Monastery

70050000050760.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Nepal Pack
70050000050760.description:
Add the Nepal civilization to your collection for The Modern Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

This content is available for individual purchase, but is also available as part of the Crossroads of the World Collection DLC bundle featuring two leaders, four civilizations, and four Natural Wonders.

Nestled high in the Himalayas, and incorporating both highland Buddhist and lowland Hindu populations, Nepal has clung to its sovereignty despite its precarious location. 19th century Nepal was governed by an autocratic group of families, and guarded by the fierce Gurkha warriors. Following an agreement with the British, they maintained a degree of independence at the crown of the world. 

Attributes: Diplomatic, Cultural

Unique Ability - Roof of the World: All Warehouse Buildings apply to Mountain tiles, but they cost increased Food and Happiness Maintenance.

Unique Civilian Unit: Sherpa (Unique Scout Unit)

Unique Military Unit: Gurkha (Unique Infantry Unit) 

Associated Wonder: Boudhanath

70050000050867.description: Customize your profile in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII using the special badge cosmetic item included with the Right to Rule Collection!

70050000050868.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Genghis Khan Pack
70050000050868.description:
Add the leader Genghis Khan to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Born Temüjin, Genghis Khan accomplished a seemingly impossible feat for a man with humble origins – to unite the nomadic Mongol tribes under his singular leadership. His ambitions did not stop with the Mongols, however, and he embarked on campaigns that brought under his control northern China and the eastern portion of the Silk Road. The nature of Genghis Khan's death remains a mystery, unlike his inimical accomplishments.

Attributes: Expansionist, Militaristic

Unique Ability - Chosen of Tengri: Increased Combat Strength to Cavalry Units, increased when in an Army Command Radius. Army Commanders have full movement with zero packed Units. Once per Age, Army Commanders can use the Convert Independents Action to Convert adjacent Independent Powers' Military Units to your control.

Agenda - Tümen: Increase Relationship by a Medium Amount for the leader with the least Cavalry Units. Decrease Relationship by a Small Amount for the leader with the most Cavalry Units.

70050000050869.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Dai Viet Pack
70050000050869.description:
Add the Dai Viet civilization to your collection for the Exploration Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Vietnamese history is a dance of resistance and expansion. The medieval Đai Viet kingdom, especially under the Tran Dynasty, stood against Mongol invasions, even as it expanded southward into Cham lands. This dialectic of resistance and conquest led to the creation of a unique Vietnamese culture, one influenced but not dominated by Chinese sources, and a strong sense of identity.

Attributes: Expansionist, Cultural

Unique Ability - Hich Tuong Sĩ: When you create a Fortification Constructible, receive a set amount of Culture for every urban Population in that Settlement (effect scales based on game speed).

Unique Civilian Unit: Quan Vuong (Unique Settler Unit)

Unique Military Unit: Voi Chien (Unique Ranged Unit)

Associated Wonder: Thành Hue

70050000050870.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Lakshmibai Pack
70050000050870.description:
Add the leader Lakshmibai to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

The Rani of Jhansi, the queen of a state that challenged the might of the British, Lakshmibai became an emblem of courage and resistance. Flouting norms, Lakshmibai picked up fencing and shooting at a young age, and when the British attempted to establish direct rule, Lakshmibai held Jhansi against repeated incursions. She remains a symbol of defiance today.

70050000050871.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Silla Pack
70050000050871.description:
Add the Silla civilization to your collection for the Antiquity Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

The three kingdoms of ancient Korea – Silla among them – vied for dominance of the Korean peninsula for centuries. The states would sometimes ally with one another, as well as with Japan and China, to stay in power, but Silla finally unified the peninsula in the seventh century CE. An era of architectural brilliance followed, and it was three hundred years before the Goryeo kingdom could issue a successful challenge to Silla's supremacy.

70050000050872.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Assyria Pack
70050000050872.description:
Add the Assyria civilization to your collection for the Antiquity Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Nestled in the Fertile Crescent, Assyria was one of the earliest states to dominate the region. From beginnings in the city of Ashur to the rise of the great Neo-Assyrian Empire, a long succession of kings would oversee the bloody conquest of Babylon, Egypt, and others – acting as a conduit for Mesopotamian culture throughout the lands. These conquests would later spell doom for Assyria, as a Babylonian revolt ended the empire in 609 BCE.

Attributes: Militaristic, Scientific

Unique Ability - Treasures of Nineveh: Gain a Technology upon capturing a Settlement for the first time. Codices are not awarded from Technologies.

Unique Civilian Unit: Turtanu (Unique Commander Unit)

Unique Military Unit: Magarru (Unique Cavalry Unit)

Associated Wonder: Dur-Sharrukin

70050000050873.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Qajar Pack
70050000050873.description:
Add the Qajar civilization to your collection for the Modern Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Out of the chaos of the eighteenth century, the Qajars emerged to lead Iran into modernity. Their tenure oversaw the growth of cities, the construction of grand palaces, and an artistic renaissance merging old and new mediums. Amid a rapidly globalizing world, the Qajars played a furious game of diplomacy with European powers that delayed critical growth. Yet major reforms transformed the nation's identity, giving rise to a new Iran.

70050000050874.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Right to Rule Collection - Wonder Pack
70050000050874.description: Explore new possibilities for your personalized empire with four new Wonders: Grand Bazaar, Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, Ubudiah Mosque, and Wat Xieng Thong!

70050000050877.name: Parking Masters - Big Rig
70050000050877.description: Embark on a thrilling trucking journey with 50 new levels designed specifically for the ultimate parking experience! Each level presents unique challenges as you maneuver through tight spaces, sharp turns, and intricate layouts with different types of trailers. Whether you're threading the needle in a tight parking space or carefully backing, your skills will be pushed to the limit. Get ready to park like a pro and prove you have what it takes to handle the biggest rigs on the road!

70050000050878.name: Parking Masters - Bus Driver
70050000050878.description: Take on the role of a bus driver in 50 all-new parking levels! Each level challenges you to maneuver your bus into increasingly difficult spaces, honing your ability to maneuver a large vehicle with finesse. Each level is designed to test and improve your parking skills. Are you ready to perfect your parking skills and become the ultimate bus driver?

70050000050885.name: OnlyUP! The car
70050000050885.intro: Have a fun and remember, the path in this game is only up
70050000050885.description:
Test yourself how well you drive the car, how you feel the dimensions and the road. At your disposal not only acceleration and braking but also jumping.  Drive the car through a difficult rugged route to the top.

You will come to try out yourself skill and ingenuity and you will be in an attempt to climb up by diffrent things to the most mystery and danger point. This is the black hole. You can find a diffrent paths wich you can use to climb up. The game doesn`t forgive any mistakes. If you fall down, you start from the beginning. So you have to be careful and make right decisions that you minimize risks of the fall down

70050000050886.name: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid: Broadcast Over Sunset
70050000050886.intro: Go explore the many mysteries of Sunset Island!
70050000050886.description:
This is paid downloadable content for Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid, featuring a brand new area to explore and new events to experience.

■ New area "Sunset Island"
Set sail with the kids of the Trumpet Forest Detective Agency to uncover the secrets of Sunset Island, a mysterious island off the shore of Yomogi Town. 30 new fish and bug species have been added, as well as a dungeon with new mechanics.

■ New character "Tobiyama-san" and new events
Tobiyama-san, a member of the circus troupe, arrives in Yomogi Town. The new story revolves around a small radio station run by her and DJ Tei-kiatsu. New events and interactions have been added for the people of Yomogi Town as well.

Full version of game required to use DLC. Sold separately.

70050000050899.name: Moto Rush GT Grip Collection #3
70050000050899.description: Get ready for a new level of racing experience with "Grip Collection #3" for MotoRush GT. Included in this pack are four pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control. Outshine and outpace your rivals!

70050000050902.name: Street Drag Racing: Millionaire's Boost DLC
70050000050902.intro: Achieve peak performance in racing experience with 1,000,000 coins at your disposal!
70050000050902.description:
Boost your racing game with our latest DLC which gives you an astonishing 1,000,000 coins! This Street Drag Racing: Millionaire's Boost DLC delivers a substantial increase in your in-game wealth, allowing you to unlock top-tier vehicles, customize with exclusive parts, and dominate every race.
         Feel the adrenaline surge as you upgrade your cars to peak performance and take on the fiercest competitors. With 1,000,000 coins at your disposal, you'll have the edge to transform your racing experience and prove you're the ultimate drag racer. Are you ready to elevate your game and leave your rivals in the dust?

70050000050930.name: Dicefolk: Will Chimeras Pack
70050000050930.description:
The Will Chimeras Pack expands Dicefolk’s gameplay by introducing the Will Talisman, a brand new path for aspiring Summoners to tame never-before-seen Chimera and master a collection of mana-based move types which introduce new combat possibilities.

Dicefolk legend speaks of an ancient Talisman with the ability to tame rare, mana-wielding Chimera. Though thought to be lost to time, the Will Talisman’s actual existence and location was kept hidden, protected from falling into the hands of evil.

After years of secrecy, the Will Talisman was entrusted to Alea to aid in her fight against Salem’s corruption.

Included Content:

- 1 New Talisman Power
The unique Will Talisman attracts Chimeras with great magic capacities! These awesome mana abilities add a whole new layer of strategy and depth to the game. You can also play with this talisman through its own trial mode & the newly added special mode!

- 21 New Chimeras
Recruit new spellcasting allies such as Axund, Galmoly, Ashigaeru, Varasaurus and more to strengthen your roster and defeat your foes!

- 10 New Equipment Pieces
Add brand new abilities to your Chimera team and strategize your path to victory!

70050000050939.name: Shiren the Wanderer: The Mystery Dungeon of Serpentcoil Island Plus Part 1

70050000050940.name: The Long Dark: Tales from the Far Territory
70050000050940.description:
Welcome to the Far Territory

Deep along the spine of Great Bear tracks a steep mountain range that bisects the island. 

This is the Far Range, an imposing wall of rock that stands vigilant over Great Bear’s priceless resource riches. 

Over the decades, many have tried, few have succeeded to crack open the wealth within these rocks. And mysteries abound. Dark stories told around campfires, about abandoned mines and remote airfields that hold many secrets. 

Now, with the aurora blazing across the sky, is the Far Territory ready to surrender its stories? Will you survive long enough to wrest any truths from the rocky grasp of this old, dark territory?

70050000050960.name: Drift Master Simulator 2024: Rich Racer DLC
70050000050960.intro: Unlock 500,000 coins to upgrade, customize, and dominate the racing scene!
70050000050960.description:
Experience the Ultimate Drift Master Simulator 2024: Rich Racer DLC!
Immerse yourself in the high-speed excitement of "Drift Master Simulator 2024" and take your game to the next level with an additional 500,000 coins. Customize your vehicles, upgrade with premium parts, and dominate the competition. Unlock new possibilities and become the ultimate driving maestro. Are you ready to seize the advantage?

70050000050963.name: Trouble-Free Travel Kit
70050000050963.description:
Anyone who pre-orders the digital version of DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake will receive a free trouble-free travel kit in the game.

The trouble-free travel kit contains:
• One pair of elevating shoes
• Three seeds of strength
• Three seeds of defence
• Three seeds of agility
• Three seeds of life
• Three seeds of magic

All these items can also be obtained by playing through the game.
Players can reclaim their bonus items by opening a treasure chest in Patty's Party Planning Place.

70050000050964.name: Conjurer Essentials Kit
70050000050964.description:
The conjurer essentials kit contains:
• One wizard's staff
• Two phials of magic water

All these items can also be obtained by playing through the game.
Players can reclaim their bonus items by opening a treasure chest in Patty's Party Planning Place.

70050000050965.name: Warrior Essentials Kit
70050000050965.description:
The warrior essentials kit contains:
• One steel broadsword
• Two phials of Oomph powder

All these items can also be obtained by playing through the game.
Players can reclaim their bonus items by opening a treasure chest in Patty's Party Planning Place.

70050000050966.name: Marvellous Makeover Kit
70050000050966.description:
The marvellous makeover kit contains:
• One copy of "Words of Wisdom"
• One cat suit

All these items can also be obtained by playing through the game.
Players can reclaim their bonus items by opening a treasure chest in Patty's Party Planning Place.

70050000050967.name: Adventurous Accessory Kit
70050000050967.description:
The adventurous accessory kit contains:
• One strength ring
• One dragon scale

All these items can also be obtained by playing through the game.
Players can reclaim their bonus items by opening a treasure chest in Patty's Party Planning Place.

70050000050983.name: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven Bonus Accessory Set
70050000050983.description:
・Cat's Amulet
An amulet made by a certain renowned thief. Boosts the revenue gained after victorious battles by 10% until the end of the Imperial Year 1001.

・Shiyuan's Tactical Primer
A tome recording the wisdom of a brilliant military strategist. Boosts the amount of Technique Points gained after victorious battles by 10% until the end of the Imperial Year 1001.

70050000050986.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredders Revenge - Radical Reptiles
70050000050986.intro: A powerhouse duo teams up with the Turtles for another bodacious ride!
70050000050986.description:
TIME TO ROCK!

A powerhouse duo teams up with the Turtles for another bodacious ride! 

In this final content update for Shredder’s Revenge, your favorite ninja squad are joined by two fan-favorite characters from the classic 1987 TV show, Mondo Gecko and Mona Lisa! The radical reptiles are finally ready for their playable debut in a beat-em-up video game and a long-awaited reunion with the gang.


GONNA KICKFLIP SOME BADDIES!

The coolest reptile on wheels, Mondo Gecko, joins the fight: use his skateboard tricks to shred through Foot soldiers and rack up extreme scores! Mondo can perform mid-air dodges with his board, making him the only character with this unique skill. 

Easy Steezy! Get ready for the Gecko Grind, Shred-head! 


READY FOR A SCIENCE LESSON?

The fearless lizard lady Mona Lisa also leaps into action! Whether it’s ballet, or beakers, she’s using it all to support the Turtles in their quest! Perform her backflip moves in close combat or throw chemical solutions to keep enemies at bay. Her special dodge unleashes a massive blowfish mace, adding a smashing twist to the battlefield. Prepare to smash through obstacles with these brilliant and bold maneuvers!

Let's catch these flying legs!


Together, these fan-favorite characters bring fresh, exciting abilities to the roster for a great new level of fun and action. Time to rock!

70050000050990.name: New Floor Pack
70050000050990.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70050000050990.description: Unlock 3 new meowtastic floors to decorate your board.

70050000051004.name: Ticket to Ride®: Poland Expansion
70050000051004.intro: Search for Country Coins in the Ticket to Ride: Poland Expansion!
70050000051004.description:
Play the Ticket to Ride: Poland Expansion digitally for the first time!

Meet talented make-up artist Regina Kamińska and energetic drummer Kacper Pawlak as you journey across Poland, connecting its neighbouring countries and collecting Coins as you do so. Those Coins will come in handy at the end of the game, as they add bonus points to your score! 

Ride the noble Polonaise train, or set off aboard the historic Copernicus. Attach the Kujawiak carriage for comfort, or use the Orbiting Greatness to carry your cargo across Poland. 

Enjoy your Polish adventure in Ticket to Ride today!


INCLUDES:

• TWO NEW CHARACTERS – Head out with make-up artist Regina Kamińska and drummer Kacper Pawlak.

• TWO NEW LOCOMOTIVES – Expand your fleet with the Polonaise and the Copernicus. 

• TWO NEW CARRIAGES – Use the Kujawiak or the Orbiting Greatness carriage in your next game. 

Collect those all-important Country Coins as you play the Ticket to Ride: Poland Expansion!

70050000051007.name: All You Need is Help: The Lively Friends Pack
70050000051007.description:
Get the 'The Lively Friends Pack' and head out with your favorite character!

This downloadable pack includes four characters with special voices and four pieces of furniture.

Characters:
Pippy Pops
A cheerful and party-loving penguin, with an optimistic, up-beat personality.

Jr junior
A slightly timid wolf but a leader who, when push comes to shove, guides everyone along to success.

Rockee
A laid-back and easygoing raccoon. Takes things at their own pace and stays unfazed, no matter what.

Snifty
A detective Shiba Inu who loves solving mysteries. Suffers from rhinitis and struggles with a stuffy nose.

Furniture:
Shaved Ice Machine
BBQ Grill
Chabudai (low table)
Telescope

To use this content, the full version of 'All You Need is Help! is required, which is sold separately.

70050000051020.name: DLC #1
70050000051020.description: Expand Voxelgram with this puzzle pack, featuring 82 puzzles spread across 6 distinct dioramas.

70050000051021.name: GigaBash - Mighty DLC: R.O.J.A.K & Balzarr
70050000051021.intro: This DLC adds “R.O.J.A.K.” and “Balzarr”, 2 original GigaBash characters to the game, both featuring unique abilities and playstyles.
70050000051021.description:
Nicknamed the Demon Star, “Balzarr” is a new Titan that crashed into Earth as a meteor from outer space. Use its massive blade tail and agility to dart around the battlefield while cleaving through enemies with great ease. It can also enter its signature Predator Stance, perching on its own tail or on the side of a building to prepare more follow-up attacks against its prey.

5 minds in 1 body; “R.O.J.A.K.” is a super battle mech piloted by the Mighty Warriors. This ragtag team of heroes stands as mankind’s last line of defense against the terrifying “Balzarr.” Chomp down your foes with your T-Rex torso, kick enemies into the sky with your cannon-powered boots, snipe foes from afar with your Dragon arm, launch Durian bombs at your enemies, and more. Landing an attack with each body part will allow the pilots to synergize and activate the mech’s full potential.

So will you help the “R.O.J.A.K.” team protect humanity from this celestial invader, or will you play as “Balzarr” and unleash hell on Earth?

70050000051028.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - Bonus Side Quest Collection: Shopping
70050000051028.description:
Bonus content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles  Digital Deluxe Edition: 

Bonus Side Quest Collection: Shopping

70050000051029.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu
70050000051029.description:
Bonus content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles Season Pass: 

Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu

70050000051030.name: Istanbul: Digital Edition - Mocha & Baksheesh
70050000051030.intro: The Mocha & Baksheesh DLC adds Coffee, Guild Cards, and four new locations to Istanbul: Digital Edition. Master the art of trade and unlock new tactics in the bustling Bazaar.
70050000051030.description:
In Mocha & Baksheesh, the Bazaar now has a new favorite: Coffee! As an astute merchant, you’ll seize the opportunity to trade this sought-after commodity. Navigate four new locations, including the bustling Tavern and the strategically essential Guild Hall, to gain additional resources and advantages.

Key Features:
- Introduce Coffee into your trading repertoire and master its market to get Rubies.
- Explore four new locations: the Tavern, Guild Hall, Roasting Plant and Coffee House.
- Exchange collected resources or Lira during encounters with the Coffee Trader.
- Perform a single action for double the profit, gain increased amounts of resources or more when using 20 unique Guild Cards.
- Expand your card arsenal with the introduction of 9 new types of Bonus Cards.
- Faithful to the original board game rules and design. 

Join the Coffee trading frenzy, outwit your opponents, and rise to the top as the ultimate Merchant in Istanbul with the Mocha & Baksheesh DLC!

70050000051035.name: Spy Guy Dinosaurs Bundle
70050000051035.intro: Explore the prehistoric world of dinosaurs in the latest installment of the Spy Guy game!
70050000051035.description: Dinosaurs are fascinating! In our game you'll discover their secrets, learn interesting facts about them and uncover lots of hidden objects on the prehistoric map!

70050000051040.name: Shopping Mall Girl: Classy Look
70050000051040.intro: Need something for a special occasion? Shop at ZaZa!
70050000051040.description:
A new store just opened up! With it you'll unlock:
- 120 pieces of premium clothing!
- 24 stylish accessories to make you shine!
- 6000 coins to spend in the new shop

Pick out a new classy style with the help of ZaZa!

70050000051042.name: Shopping Mall Girl: Summer Time
70050000051042.intro: Need something to beat the heat? Shop at Surf'N Style!
70050000051042.description:
A new store just opened up! With it you'll unlock:
- 160 pieces of casual clothing!
- 24 beautiful swimsuits!
- 24 accessories to help you stand out!
- 8000 coins to spend in the new shop

Pick out a new summer look with the help of Surf'N Style!

70050000051044.name: Fashion Friends DLC#3
70050000051044.description:
Introducing new levels for the arcade action puzzle classic, Fashion Friends!
Dive deeper into the fashion world with additional levels that challenge your puzzle-solving skills and creativity. With more opportunities to collect unique outfits, mix and match accessories, and perfect your photography skills, you'll be one step closer to becoming the ultimate fashion icon. Experience enhanced gameplay, more complex puzzles, and a richer fashion experience.
Play more, try more, and elevate your style to new heights with the latest levels in Fashion Friends!

70050000051045.name: Fashion Friends DLC#4
70050000051045.description:
Get ready for even more fashion fun with the new levels for the arcade action puzzle classic, Fashion Friends!
Immerse yourself in fresh challenges and stylish puzzles that push your limits and test your fashionista prowess. With these additional levels, you'll have more chances to showcase your fashion sense, earn new outfits, and experiment with countless combinations. Each new level brings you closer to mastering the game and becoming a true fashion icon.
Play more, try more, and achieve your fashion dreams with the latest levels in Fashion Friends!

70050000051054.name: Ticket to Ride®: Germany Expansion
70050000051054.intro: Gather up Passengers in the Ticket to Ride: Germany Expansion!
70050000051054.description:
The Ticket to Ride®: Germany Expansion arrives with carriages full of Passengers! 

Set off across the country alongside atelier owner Franziska Braun and scholar Reinhard Hofmann, connect cities and countries with Long and Short Tickets, and pick up Passengers to earn bonus points.

When you set up a game of Ticket to Ride®: Germany Expansion, 60 Passengers are distributed across various cities on the map. Build the most connected routes while also gathering the most Passengers of a given colour – red, black, green, yellow, blue or white – to win!  

Wrap around the rails with the swift Schlange train, or choose the Immer Zuverlässige train for reliability. Attach the cosy Gemütlichkeit carriage or the double-decker Neue Höhen carriage. 


INCLUDES:

• TWO NEW CHARACTERS – Journey across Germany with atelier owner Franziska Braun and scholar Reinhard Hofmann. 

• TWO NEW TRAINS – Add the Schlange train and the Immer Zuverlässige train to your train collection!

• TWO NEW CARRIAGES – Gather your Passengers into the comfy Gemütlichkeit or impressive Neue Höhen carriages. 

Show the world your strategic skill when you play the Ticket to Ride®: Germany Expansion!

70050000051055.name: Ticket to Ride®: Heart of Africa Expansion
70050000051055.intro: Explore challenging terrain in the Ticket to Ride: Heart of Africa Expansion!
70050000051055.description:
Head to the Heart of Africa for the first time in digital Ticket to Ride! 

Meet festival organiser Blessing Kipruto and griot Nnamdi Okpara as you travel across a variety of new terrains, building your train network on this vibrant map. 

Utilise the new Terrain cards to double your points on a completed route! There are three types of Terrain cards to master – Desert and Savanna, which covers yellow, orange and red routes; Jungle and Forest, which covers purple, blue and green routes; and Mountain and Cliff, which covers white, grey and black routes. 

Set off in the historic Fahagola railbus or the Safari Sights car, coupled with either the Animal Trails or the Stately Travels carriages! 

Get ready for the adventure of your life in Ticket to Ride: Heart of Africa Expansion! 


INCLUDES:

TWO NEW CHARACTERS – Explore Africa with festival organiser Blessing Kipruto and griot Nnamdi Okpara.

TWO NEW VEHICLES – Traverse the tricky terrain in the Safari Sights car or Fahagola railbus!

TWO NEW CARRIAGES – Take your animal buddies along for the ride with the Animal Trails carriage, or relax in the Stately Travels carriage.

Can you successfully navigate different terrains and double your points? Find out when you play Ticket to Ride: Heart of Africa today!

70050000051056.name: Ticket to Ride®: Japan Expansion
70050000051056.intro: Build the Bullet Train network together in Ticket to Ride®: Japan Expansion!
70050000051056.description:
For the first time ever, play Ticket to Ride: Japan Expansion in digital form! 

Join two new characters – travel blogger Nakanishi Kimiko and Gyōji Moriyama Isamu – as you explore the beautiful map of Japan, connecting cities and scoring points. 

Will you help to build the Bullet Train network across the country? Doing so will open up more routes for you – but also for your opponents! However, if you opt to stay out of the project, you’ll be giving up the chance to score bonus points…and you’ll be docked an eyewatering 20 points too! Decisions, decisions! 

To help you on your journey, you’ll also get the Ichi Eki Saki and Tsuki Sleeper train and carriage, along with the Isogaba Maware and Hayai Carriage. 

Enjoy your next adventure in Ticket to Ride: Japan Expansion! 


INCLUDES:

- TWO NEW CHARACTERS – Travel across Japan with travel blogger Nakanishi Kimiko and Gyōji Moriyama Isamu.

- TWO NEW TRAINS – Zoom to your next destination with the Ichi Eki Saki, or settle aboard the Tsuki Sleeper!

- TWO NEW CARRIAGES – Relax in the Isogaba Maware, or take it up a notch in the Hayai Carriage!

You’ve never played a game of Ticket to Ride quite like the Ticket to Ride: Japan Expansion. Experience the strategic-yet-cooperative twist on your favourite digital board game today!

70050000051057.name: Ticket to Ride®: Switzerland Expansion
70050000051057.description:
Take in the stunning sights of nature’s very own masterpiece as you strategise your way across Ticket to Ride’s most competitive map yet – the Switzerland Expansion! 

You’ll need to plan several moves ahead when you play this uniquely challenging map. Not only will you connect cities to cities, you’ll be connecting neighbouring countries to one another. With limited nodes available to do so, you’ll have to think fast to keep up!

The new country-to-country tickets offer a list of countries to attempt to connect. Build at least one of the requested routes to complete the ticket and score points – but if you fail to do so, you’ll have points deducted. 

Are you ready to take on the unique challenge of the Switzerland Expansion? 

INCLUDES:
- TWO NEW CHARACTERS – Join professional photographer Ayla Vogel and artisan watchmaker Elias Hartmann as they journey across Switzerland and beyond.
- TWO NEW TRAINS – Climb aboard the Splendid Smokestack or take on any weather in the Blizzardblaster!
- TWO NEW CARRIAGES – Go at your own pace in the Golden Wanderer or enjoy the quirky vibes of the Barrelbahn!   


Put your railway-building skills to the test and get Ticket to Ride: The Switzerland Expansion today!

70050000051059.name: Ticket to Ride®: The San Francisco City Expansion
70050000051059.intro: Get your groove on and cruise through San Francisco in the Sixties!
70050000051059.description:
Howdy! How’s it hanging? What’s shakin’? 

Travel back in time and explore San Francisco in the Sixties as this fan-favourite expansion gets the digital treatment for the first time! 

By rail or road, take in the city sights and gather Souvenirs from your trip as you go. Meet fashion designer Summer Ashbury and silver-screen icon Felix Woods as you embark on the ultimate city break. 

Plus, to celebrate San Francisco coming to the video game version of Ticket to Ride for the first time, we’re giving away a free bonus token to every player – with or without the San Francisco City Expansion! 


INCLUDES:

TWO NEW CHARACTERS – Seek out inspiration with fashion designer Summer Ashbury or enjoy a life of luxury with movie star Felix Woods.

MULTIPLE NEW VEHICLES – Travel by rail or by road! This expansion introduces trams and cars to your usual line-up of trains and carriages.

SOUVENIRS – Make sure to pick up those trinkets as you travel the city! The more Souvenirs you pick up, the more points you’ll earn at the end of the game.

The city break of your dreams awaits!

70050000051065.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - New Adventurer's Starter Kit
70050000051065.description:
The New Adventurer's Starter Kit  includes:
- Early unlock for Rimu-Burger and Curry-Muru building types
- 3,000GD which can be used to construct buildings
- 3,000GP which can be used to boost character abilities

70050000051066.name: Special Item Pack (Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Pre-Order Bonus)
70050000051066.description:
Pre-Order Bonus: 
Below are the benefits given to players that purchase Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars at an early time.
- 57300 potch
- Fortune Orb x1
- Prosperity Orb x1

Players can choose whether to start the game with the "DLC pack (57,300 potch / Fortune Orb / Prosperity Orb)" in your possession at the beginning of the "NEWGAME" for both Suikoden I and II
*potch: in-game currency
*Fortune Orb: Doubles the experience gained by the character that bears it
*Prosperity Orb: Doubles the "potch" gained when winning a battle with the character that bears it
*Suikoden I's MC cannot bear both runes

70050000051076.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - DLC 1: A Strange Fate
70050000051076.description:
DLC 1: A Strange Fate includes new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles!

Delve into Additional Scenario: A Strange Fate.

Additional Character Hinata joins in Rimuru’s story.

Further adventures with Rimuru with Additional Subquests: Robot Action Figure, Legendary Sword, The Safe, Zegion's Gift, Whiskey, City of Nature, Trading Card Game 3, Idol Concert, Motor Car, Clock Tower.

Grow Tempest with Additional Building Types: 3-Star Luxury Restaurant, Super Rimuloo, Dryad Flower Shop, Chateau Rimuru, Swords of Tempest, Tempest Museum, Tempest Herbs.

*DLC 1 may be included in other editions or bundles. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.
*Main game must be cleared before DLC can be accessed.

70050000051077.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - DLC 2: The Fairy Queen's Labyrinth
70050000051077.description:
DLC 2: The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth includes new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles!

Explore Additional Scenario: The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth.

The Storm Dragon Veldora joins as an Additional Character.

Encounter more with Additional Subquests: Festival, Stalls, Tearoom, River Wizard, Bar.

Brighten Tempest with Additional Building Types: Golden Phantom Fish Statue, Jura Bar, Sunny Weapon Shop, Sunny Second-Hand Shop, Sunshine Tavern, Sunbeam Mansion, Tearoom.

*DLC 2 may be included in other editions or bundles. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.
*Main game must be cleared before DLC can be accessed.

70050000051078.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - DLC 3: Martial Arts Tournament
70050000051078.description:
DLC 3: Martial Arts Tournament includes new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles!

Campaign through the Additional Scenario: Martial Arts Tournament.

The party livens with Additional Character, Milim.

Experience events with Additional Subquests: Valentines Day, Blumund Cooking Contest, Prepackaged Curry, Beer.

Sharpen Tempest with Additional Building Types: Edgy Liquor Store, Edgy Tool Shop, Baron Goblin, Edgy Apartment Complex, Edgy Armory.

*DLC 3 may be included in other editions or bundles. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.
*Main game must be cleared before DLC can be accessed.

70050000051079.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - Bonus Side Quest Collection: Commemorative Statues
70050000051079.description:

70050000051083.name: Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown - Mask of Darkness
70050000051083.description:
Mask of Darkness is a story DLC that adds a thrilling new chapter to Sargon’s saga. 
Experience a new story around Radjen, the assassin of the Immortals, as she traps Sargon in her Mind Palace, a nightmarish dimension created with her dark magic.

Dive into a new world born from the shadow assassin’s dark past and soul. Discover four surprising and surreal new biomes with more than ten totally new types of platforming elements, including deadly traps and merciless mechanisms. In between platforming sequences, face six otherworldly new enemy archetypes inspired by Radjen’s surreal dreams, as well as three epic bosses. Use newly acquired combat abilities to overcome them. 

• Experience Sargon's darkest quest yet: step away from Mount Qaf to dive into a brand-new story of loss and danger. 
• Uncover Radjen's fate in a story that resolves hanging questions from The Lost Crown's main story.
• Use Sargon’s abilities and Time Powers to navigate this intricate and interconnected new dimension. 
• Experience an improved combat experience with new Amulets to complement Sargon’s arsenal.
• Gain a new outfit for Sargon, inspired by the Immortals’ best. 

Uncover the secrets that lie behind the Mask of Darkness, buried deep within Radjen’s mind!

70050000051087.name: Hamster Playground - Fun & Challenge Games Pack
70050000051087.description:
Step out of the maze and make sure that fun times last even longer by unlocking four additional game modes for Hamster Playground - put your hamsters to the test by entering Truck Pulling, Eating Contest, Skateboard Race, and Beware The Cat competitions. New modes can be enjoyed both offline and online, and allow for up to four players, so grab more of your friends and show them who’s the boss across all the games. 
In "Vehicle Pull”, your hamster puts on his tiny harness and prepares to tow a miniature wagon.
In “Eating Contest”, strategy meets gluttony as your hamster devours a variety of treats, from crunchy seeds to delicious vegetables and everything in between.
In "Skateboard Racing" your hamster's agility is put to the ultimate test.
"Beware The Cat" mode provides a new level of excitement as your hamster sprints when the light is green, but must stop in place when it turns red.

70050000051088.name: Mod Pack 2: New Challenges
70050000051088.intro: A collection of mods with new tools and challenges for Crystal Project.
70050000051088.description:
Mods must be activated in-game using the mod selection menu to take effect. To activate mods, open the mod selection menu from New Game or Continue using the "Mods" button shown at the bottom-right of the screen. Enabled mods are then tied to save data and are automatically enabled when save data is loaded.

Mod Pack 2 contains the following mods:
- Passive Trainer: Adds three new NPCs around the world each teaching passives for a cost.
- Doge Shield: Adds a shield that triggers a counter when you're attacked, similar to the Duelling Shield.
- Equipment Expansion: Adds more equipment to Crystal Project, ranging throughout the entire game. Many new chests to find!
- Moonlight Project Custom Classes: Adds four custom classes. Their masters have been spread across the world.
- Bloodmage: A magical class focusing on Mind and that can use HP for buffs and debuffs.
- Additional Boss, Yasha Tar: Adds an additional boss and a new piece of equipment.
- Additional Boss, Pinga: Adds an additional boss and a new piece of equipment.
- Tempest: A physical class focusing on Agility and Mind.
- Forcemage: A magic-using class focusing on Spirit that is capable of being a tank, support or damage-dealer.
- Barbarian: A physical class focusing on Vitality and high HP that is capable of being a tank, support or damage-dealer.
- Additional Boss, Quintar Husk: Adds an additional boss.
- Additional Boss, Elder Entities: Adds an additional boss and a new piece of equipment.

70050000051166.name: RetroRealms: Halloween Add-On
70050000051166.intro: Cross into the RetroRealms and see if you have what it takes to make it out alive!
70050000051166.description:
Enter the RetroRealms, a 16-bit Pixel Art world as horror icon Michael Myers! Become The Shape and slice your way across multiple levels of terrifying platformer gameplay filled with familiar sights and sounds from the original Halloween film. Test your skills, upgrade your abilities, and confront twisted and fiendish versions of iconic Halloween characters. Engage in epic encounters to overcome the ultimate evil in this sprawling adventure filled with over-the-top action!

Special Features:

Play as Horror Icon Michael Myers
Use brute strength and wickedly sharp weapons to help Michael Myers vanquish opponents across multiple levels of retro arcade action! Connect Halloween with select RetroRealms titles (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock additional abilities and achievements in the ultimate retro horror mash-up! 

Go to Hell
Journey into worlds where Hellish nightmares manifest, filled with treacherous landscapes and unspeakable horrors. Overcome obstacles, enemies, and bosses that lay in your path to save Haddonfield from eternal damnation!

RetroRealms Arcade:
RetroRealms includes access to the RetroRealms Arcade that connects select RetroRealms games with other titles in the series that you own (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock new areas and abilities and create the ultimate mash-up of horror legends!

Retro Aesthetic
Immerse yourself in the golden age of gaming with Pixel Art-styled 16-bit visuals and a hauntingly nostalgic horror soundtrack. RetroRealms: Halloween pays homage to classic side-scrollers while delivering a fresh take on platformer gameplay.

Secrets, Upgrades, and Unlockables
Discover hidden relics and collectibles. Unlock new power-ups and abilities to enhance your character’s prowess, and find all-new ways play!

See where you Stand:
Check out the RetroRealms leaderboards to see how you stack up against other players. Do you have skills to get your name on the high score list?

70050000051262.name: Scenario "The Coalition Against Cao Cao"
70050000051262.intro: A hero amidst the chaos, now under siege.
70050000051262.description:
A bonus scenario added to "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE."

In October of the year 199 AD, with the Battle of Guandu nearing, Yuan Shao rallies forces from across the land to form an anti-Cao Cao coalition and ensure an overwhelming victory against him.
Then the "Overlord" Sun Ce closes in on Runan, forcing Cao Cao on the defensive. Thus the warlord branded as "a hero in times of chaos" faces an unprecedented challenge.

Additional Scenario:
"The Coalition Against Cao Cao"

How to Play:
Accessible via New Game, Scenarios, and then "The Coalition Against Cao Cao."

Note: May become available for purchase or for free separately at a later date.

70050000051264.name: Scenario "Valor Triumphs"
70050000051264.intro: A struggle between valiant warriors in Zhongyuan.
70050000051264.description:
A bonus scenario added to "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE."

In January of the year 198 AD, Yuan Shao is defeated by Gongsun Zan in the conflict over Hebei. Gongsun Zan then takes in the officers who once served Han Fu and gains power over Hebei.
Meanwhile, Cao Cao fails to defeat Lu Bu, who thus occupies the Huainan region ruled Yuan Shu.
After his defeat in Hebei, Yuan Shao takes in Yuan Shu and barely manages to escape to Runan. And so begins the struggle between valiant warriors Gongsun Zan and Lu Bu in Zhongyuan.

Additional Scenario:
"Valor Triumphs"

How to Play:
Accessible via New Game, Scenarios, and then "Valor Triumphs."

Note: May become available for purchase or for free separately at a later date.

70050000051266.name: Bonus Scenario "Liu Bei's Three Tacticians"
70050000051266.intro: Three prodigious tacticians join the ranks.
70050000051266.description:
A bonus scenario added to "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE."

In January of the year 209 AD, Liu Bei assumes control of northern Jing Province following Liu Biao's death, and three strategists—Zhuge Liang, Pang Tong, and Xu Shu—join Liu Bei's ranks.
Cao Cao's invasion of Hebei is slowed down by these three military strategists, and his standoff with Yuan Shang's army continues.
Meanwhile, southern Jing Province is controlled by Liu Cong, who has defected from Liu Bei, and warlords in different regions are taking steps to achieve their own ambitions.

Additional Scenario:
"Liu Bei's Three Tacticians"

How to Play:
Accessible via New Game, Scenarios, and then "Liu Bei's Three Tacticians."

70050000051288.name: Atari 50: The Wider World of Atari
70050000051288.description:
THE WIDER WORLD OF ATARI introduces a new timeline with more games, historical artifacts and video interviews that explore the creation of Atari games. From early arcade games through fan-made homebrew titles, you'll learn why passionate Atari fans are loyal for life.

Features:

- 19 new games including Berzerk, Atari Football (the first Trak-ball game), and underappreciated gems of the 2600 library

- New timeline with eight new video segments, including: Al Alcorn’s story on the creation of Breakout, the search for rare prototype games, and a spotlight on artist Evelyn Seto, who helped create the famous Atari Fuji logo

70050000051289.name: Atari 50: The First Console War
70050000051289.description:
Well before the current day console wars dominated social media and message boards, Atari's VCS and Intellivision collided in the first major video game rivalry in 1979. The battle only intensified when Intellivision started making games for the VCS, its fiercest rival's machine! In a series of exclusive interviews, the game makers who lived through the first console war explain how and why this unique chapter of video-game history unfolded.

Features:

- 19 new games including several rare M Network prototypes available here for the first time 

- New timeline video interviews with M Network programmer Jane Terjung, Activision’s David Crane & Garry Kitchen, homebrew programmer Dennis Debro, and historians Leonard Herman & Mike Mika

Deadly as the wolf. Swift as the bat. Embody the face of gothic horror as The Dark Lord, Dracula, whose abilities manifest as the vilest denizens of the woods. Standing against such evil is Trevor Belmont, drawn once more to stand against the intruding shadow of his nemesis.

70050000051617.name: Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus
70050000051617.intro: Explore islands of ancient legends, seek the favors of the gods and defend against Greed of epic scales in this major expansion set in ancient Greece!
70050000051617.description:
“Sail forth and explore other lands
Restore the gods and fulfill their demands” - Oracle

In faraway lands, Mount Olympus stands tall among the islands, casting an eerie shadow of unease. A sinister force has seized the divine realm and as a Monarch, you are setting out on a journey to stop it from consuming the world. Mediterranean warmth touches your skin as you slowly ride through dark woods and along beaches with glittering turquoise waters. Your quest is clear and the gods’ presence is palpable, but will they aid you against the Greed attacking at night?

Kingdom Two Crowns: Call of Olympus is a major expansion for Kingdom Two Crowns. Set out and build your Kingdom, alone or in co-op with a friend, in a completely new setting featuring legends and mythos inspired by ancient Greece.

A Quest to Free Mount Olympus

- An Epic New World: Call of Olympus features a reworked map with an epic conclusion at Mount Olympus, and you choose how to get there!
- Temple and Quest Islands: These new islands present unique challenges, hidden treasures and powerful artifact rewards - prove your worth to Artemis, Athena, Hephaestus and Hermes to open the path to Mount Olympus.
- Mythological mounts: Discover and unlock powerful new mounts, like the fierce three-headed Cerberus, the terrifying fire-breathing Chimera, the majestic winged Pegasus, or the trusty Donkey… and many more!

Fight Greed of Epic Scales

- Face Your Fears: Muster steadfast defences to protect your crown, the Greed threat is more challenging than ever before, with multi-phased boss battles against the sinister Serpent.
- Raise Your Banner: Shift the momentum and lead from the front. Bring the fight to the Greed with new siege mechanics, where the Hoplites will join you in Phalanx formation.
- Assemble Your Fleet: Fight on land and at sea - build a fleet with devastating ship-mounted ballistas to join your battle. Once victorious, use your armada to ferry your army across the seas and combat the growing threat of Greed.

Discover Godly Powers and Abilities

- Powerful Artifacts: Unlock four unique artifacts bestowed by the gods. Whether you choose a bow with a powerful directed attack, or a hammer that boosts your troops’ prowess, these items grant you new offensive and defensive abilities against the Greed.
- Guided by the Oracle: Never stray from the task at hand. At your request,the Oracle will provide you with wisdom and directions for the next step of your Odyssey!
- Set the Greed Ablaze: Wield powerful fire technology granted by the new hermit. It's as if it was gifted by Prometheus himself!

70050000051628.description:
Suit up with Dally's mighty Catastrophe Armor and crush the competition! This DLC unlocks Dally for use in-game as a fully playable character a full suite of unique weapons.

Dally Features:
- 15 new Primary Weapons, 9 new Powers, and 8 new Supers, powerful finisher Powers
- Mighty NRG restore mechanics - Dally's weapons each have higher NRG restore than Nina's do, allowing her toolkit to be used freely
- Unique Charge mechanics - Dally's weapons cannot be charged! Instead, attack hits build Charge that fuels her mighty Charged Powers, and effects that impact Charging affect these instead
- Brilliant Bells: Instead of normal Character Augs, Dally finds Bells, which are upgrade items that can be applied to *any* of her abilities (Weapons, Powers, or Charged Powers) to boost their effects! Attach the Homing Bell to grant any of your other ability projectiles homing properties, the Bell of Novae to make any ability fire more projectiles in random directions, or the Vengeful Bell to make her abilties free to use when taking damage!
- Between the 11 upgrade Bells, 15 Weapons, and 17 Powers (8 Supers, 9 Normal) Dally has access to, her loadout variance is near-limitless.

70050000052062.name: Vampire Survivors: Ode to Castlevania
70050000052062.intro: Everyone is here in Vampire Survivors: Ode to Castlevania
70050000052062.description:
The Vampire Survivors have come a long way in their honorable hunt, and after joining forces with the Belmont Family, they are the closest they've ever been. Finally, within their grasp... A vampire. Possibly, at least. 

The sun has set on Dracula's Castle once more, and as the moon rises a hellish horde of murky Mudmen, ghastly ghosts, and frightening Fleamen take the stage as the battle of good and evil rages once again. Unleash an arsenal of new Vampire-vanquishing weapons upon these beasts and leave a trail of doom in your wake before attempting to rid the world of the unspeakable terror himself. Do not be blind to the shadow that looms over you Survivors, as your quest has only just begun! It's all very serious stuff, so now let's pump up the volume and let's go, this is Castlevania in Vampire Survivors, baby! 

20+ New characters 
What a horrible night to have a curse, especially if you are: 

The Belmonts, your favorite whip-obsessed family of vampire hunters, including Simon, Richter, Trevor, and even Sonia. 
The Belnades, a myriad of legendary witches from throughout the history of the occult clan. Sypha, Yoko, and even distant relatives like Charlotte Aulin and Maria Renard have their spellbooks ready. 
Other Heroes, not just Jonathan and Charlotte, but Jonathan Morris AND John Morris?! Amazing allies abound, from Shanoa to Eric Lecarde. 

40+ New weapons 
Fighting the forces of evil is hard as hell: 
 
Whips: Whole lot of whips. More whips than we can count (it's eight).
Spells: elemental magic has finally made its way in Vampire Survivors, offering a wide array of spells inspired by Portrait of Ruin, Harmony of Dissonance, and Order of Ecclesia 
Magic weapons: not any sword, but Alucard's Sword. And Alucard's Spear. Also Alucard's Shield. Etc. 
Projectiles: do you remember that time the Morris' were throwing javelins and iron balls? 
Glyphs: Confodere, Vol Confodere, Melio Confodere, but also plenty of non-Confodere, we swear. 

SPECIAL WEAPON SELECTORS 
Some of these characters are famous for having a large amount of different abilities, so we probably all had a different experience in playing them in their original games. It would be silly of us to force you using these characters with an unchangeable weapon, so... well we ARE actually going to force a weapon on you, but not for long! 
You'll be able to unlock at least one Weapon Selector for every single character; for example the Morning Star will let you choose any whip as a starting weapon for your friendly neighborhood-Belmont: 

A monstrously large Stage 
Enchanting mysteries and danger await those who enter: 

The largest map Vampire Survivors has ever seen, stacked with sinister secrets and a bunch of baneful bosses. 

30+ New Music Tracks 
A ridiculous amount of remixes of Castlevania tracks from Vampire Survivors historic composers Daniele Zandara and Filippo Vicarelli, but also from fan-favorites Evelyn Lark and Keygen Church! 

Vampire Killer, Bloody Tears, Simon's Theme, Leon's Theme, a lot of themes. 
Moonlight Nocturne, Lost Paintings, Dance of Pearls, but like you've never heard them before. 
Aquarius, The Beginning, Divine Bloodlines, everything that screams ""this is Castlevania"". 
An Empty Tome, Invitation of a Crazed Moon, Pitch Black Intrusion, so many hits from the more recent entries in the series. 
Amber Scenery, Sarabande of Healing, Jaws of a Scorched Earth, and many others you didn't know the title of! 

On top of that we have borrowed several dozens original tracks from Castlevania games. There is so much music we revamped the music selection panel for the occasion. 

-
And the cherry on top: a man.

70050000052243.name: PowerWash Simulator – Shrek Special Pack
70050000052243.description:
Playtime is ogre. Get to work cleaning up five fairy tale maps inspired by DreamWorks Animation’s Shrek. It’ll take more than pixie dust to restore these iconic locales to their former lustre, but thankfully, happily ever after is in your hands!

Like onions, dirt has layers. And boy, this particular brew of filth is potent enough to rival even the Fairy Godmother’s strongest concoctions. A sprinkle of soap, a touch of elbow grease and a large dose of ‘DING’s make for the perfect antidote potion! Wash it all down with a swish of high-pressure water and you’ll have these enchanting locations looking as spotless as the Magic Mirror.  

An all-star cast of beloved characters invites you to reinstate Duloc back to the seemingly pristine place it’s known to be, breathe life into Dragon’s Lair and restore Shrek’s Swamp to, well, just the right amount of muck! All these places and more are yours for the rescuing.

Your great and noble quest takes you across five charming maps from:

•	Duloc
•	Hansel’s Honeymoon Hideaway
•	Shrek’s Swamp
•	Fairy Godmother’s Potion Factory
•	Dragon’s Lair

Arise, Washer! You’ve officially been dubbed a knight in shining armour in order to defeat dubious debris in this Special Pack – a task befitting a true hero. The Shrek Special Pack features a custom knight character model armed with a sword-themed power washer that lets you go forth and conquer grime!

70050000052285.description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale – Magical Edition includes 10,000 Moonstones and the following exclusive digital items:
· Autumn Manor House style  
· Baby Pegasus Animal Companion and Companion House
· Storybook Vale Dress and Ensemble

Once upon a time, the Storybook Vale was a land made up of fabled stories, where myths and fairy tales sprang to life… until Maleficent and Hades tore the Vale apart. With the guidance of the Lorekeeper, journey to the Vale and meet heroes and villains who will bring epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover.

Resolve the Conflict Between Maleficent and Hades
A struggle for power between the Mistress of All Evil and the lord of the Underworld tore the Vale apart. Ink spilled over the land and the Tales were scattered to the winds, now lost in the form of mythical creatures made of paper called Snippets. Things aren't so happily ever after in the Vale… It's up to YOU to reclaim these stories and restore peace. 

Explore a Magical New Storybook World
Discover a world sewn together from myths, fables, and folklore as you uncover the three new Biomes that make up the Storybook Vale. From the Bind, where books are woven into the landscape, to Everafter, a land of fairy tales where Maleficent's castle stands tall, and Mythopia, a world inspired by Greek myths, where Mount Olympus looms large—each Biome contains a fully customizable layout to decorate and make your own with exclusive furniture. 

Restore Magical Stories with the Royal Net
Equip yourself with the new Royal Net (crafted by fairies) and wield its magic to catch Snippets around the Library of Lore. Assemble these Snippets together to rewrite the Storybook Vale and restore a legacy of Disney and Pixar stories.

Befriend Five New Villagers
Help Merida uncover a lost treasure of Clan DunBroch, execute an epic heist with Flynn Rider, beware you don't become Hades' minion… and face off with the Mistress of All Evil herself, Maleficent. Create a home for your new friends in the Vale… or bring them back to live in Dreamlight Valley!

70050000052476.description:

Features
- 20 new waves with new enemies, elites and bosses
- 14 new characters
- 16 new weapons
- 30+ new items

70050000052484.name: Clue - Halloween Records
70050000052484.description:
LIMITED-TIME EVENT

Everyone is invited to the Halloween party at Tudor Mansion – see the sumptuous building kitted out in gothic finery this October for a limited time. 

Plus, for those of you who want to take the party to scary new heights, the Halloween Records Pack allows you to permanently unlock new clues and haunting cosmetics. You’ll need to be quick, though, as this pack is only available to purchase during the Halloween season!

Dig up new clues and investigate suspects as you figure out how much they’re really hiding from one another. Motives and blackmail lurk in the shadows, and they culminate in the frightful murder of Boden “Boddy” Black.

Steel yourself and enter the Tudor Mansion for this limited-time event!

INCLUDES:
THE TUDOR MANSION GETS A MAKEOVER – Candlelit against a stormy sky, even the classic mansion is getting into the Halloween spirit!
GHOULISH NEW COSMETICS – A new dice set, avatar, card back and clue sheet arrive in suitably spooky fashion…
SKELETONS COME OUT OF THE CLOSET – Sink your fangs into new character lore, motives and more!

70050000052488.name: SOS OPS! - TRIALS
70050000052488.intro: An obstacle course. You'll be fine. For sure.
70050000052488.description:
Welcome to SOS OPS: Trials – the most exciting addition to your favorite game! 

Get ready for endless adventures, because you are waiting for mind-blowing challenges that will make you scream with delight. Are you ready? Then let's go to the obstacle course!

Immerse yourself in a world where every obstacle is a mini-show. Here you will find the most unexpected challenges, from the ridiculous to the completely ridiculous. Jump, dodge, slide and roll – you have to show all your dexterity and ingenuity to overcome them all.

Compete with your friends and prove who is the most dexterous and brave of you. 

SOS OPS: Trials is waiting for its heroes!

70050000052494.name: SOS OPS! - GUNS N' OPS
70050000052494.intro: GUNS N' OPS! is an explosive party in the world of shooters that'll flip your perception of strategy and fun upside down. Are you ready to dive into the chaos?
70050000052494.description:
You've been waiting. You asked for it. And now it's here. The explosive mega-expansion SOS OPS!, where GUNS have arrived!!

We crafted a brand-new, massive location, inspired by a legendary game. Honestly, you already know what needs to be done here.

A massive arsenal of weapons. Machine guns, rifles, pistols, grenade launchers. And all this with the proprietary SOS OPS physics. Awesome!

Rescue hostages held by treacherous enemies. Survive and become the hero of the arena.

The classic chaos returns. Invite your friends online and compete in accuracy and total mayhem. Tear apart the map and unload your entire clip on each other! Yeah, whoever paid for you is gonna regret it.

Jump into the GUNS N' OPS DLC right now!

70050000052499.description: Sometimes you need to fight fire with fire and blood with blood. Use the Order's own demonic weapons against them by equipping this weapon skin pack.

70050000052500.intro: Fight darkness with sword and wit
70050000052500.description: Fight darkness and the Order by proudly wearing the Brotherhood of Light cosmetic pack. It contains a unique helm for each of your classes, a new skin for your weapons, and the Sacred Emblems pack to customize your squad and banner.

70050000052531.name: LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE - SPOOKY OUTFIT PACK
70050000052531.description:
SPOOKY OUTFIT PACK
Dial up the shivers and indulge your ghost-hunting, monster-wrangling passions with these outfits perfect for Halloween – or for witching hours all year round! This pack contains the Just Haunt It! coat and four indoor outfits: Maxidermy, Ragdoll Max, Max Ghoulfield, and Max O’Lantern.

70050000052532.name: LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE - DECADES OUTFIT PACK
70050000052532.description:
DECADES OUTFIT PACK
Confront the inexorable passage of time and celebrate your colorful past, with iconic outfits that pay homage to 90s Grunge, 50s Rockabilly, 70s Flower Power, the 80s Mallrat, and 60s Psychedelia.

70050000052533.name: LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE - FAN FAVORITE OUTFIT PACK

70050000052534.name: LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE - FINAL FANTASY VII OUTFIT PACK
70050000052534.description:
FINAL FANTASY VII OUTFIT PACK

70050000052535.name: House Flipper: Farm DLC
70050000052535.intro: Immerse yourself in the charming countryside, enjoy its warmth, and embrace all the everyday joys of farm life.
70050000052535.description:
Have you ever dreamed of becoming a happy owner of a prosperous farm, leading a peaceful life in harmony with nature? With the House Flipper – Farm DLC, your dreams will come true! Immerse yourself in the idyllic countryside, bask in its charm and deal with all the usual aspects of farm life. Enjoy a wide range of new crop plant species and grow them. An abundant harvest will help you take care of your animals, such as sheep, cows, horses or alpacas… you can choose your companions from many breeds!

Animal Companions
Experience fresh farm vibes, thanks to the latest addition to the House Flipper family.
Let your surroundings be filled with the sounds of the life of your animal companions!
Build homesteads and look after swine, sheep, chickens, and more!
Your very own farming adventure begins now!

NEW TOOLS
Wouldn’t an extra room in your perfectly designed house be a handy addition?
Do you dream of a garage for your brand new car?
It’s now all possible, thanks to the Farm DLC
A revolutionary house extension mechanic will forever change your everyday renovations.

Plant and Harvest
Hungry? It's thyme for dinner! Lettuce celebrate!
No matter what you plant, you better take care of creating the right conditions for your vegetation!
A selection of unique tools and a set of farming skills will help you with that!
Prepare the soil, spare no water, and you shall be harvesting plentiful crops in a blink of an eye!

Horseback Riding
Keeping your farm in check is not just a responsibility, but also a pleasure!
Whistle for your favorite steed, hop in the saddle, and go for a ride around your land.
Keep in mind that this is just the beginning of your adventure, farmer.
Maplebloom Village awaits you!

70050000052536.name: LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE - PAW PRINTS CAT OUTFIT PACK
70050000052536.description:
PAW PRINTS CAT OUTFIT PACK
Leopard Print Camo coat and four indoor outfits: Awesome Pawsome, Peek Purple, Feline Fine, and Hang In There.

70050000052537.name: LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE - EXCLUSIVE CAT CONTENT
70050000052537.description:
EXCLUSIVE CAT CONTENT
When Max discovers a lost cat, she knows she must reunite it with its owner!

70050000052545.name: Banners of Ruin - DLC Pack
70050000052545.intro: This DLC pack includes all the Banners of Ruin DLCs: Powdermaster, Moonstone, and Iris.
70050000052545.description:
The Powdermaster:
This character has a unique hero ability; mixing powder cards. When you have powder cards in your hand (Red, Pink, Yellow or Black), you can discard them to gain stacks of 'Boom' - a new status effect specific to the Powdermaster! Pro tip: you'll gain more Boom for discarding powders of more than one colour.
The Powdermaster's Grenade deals stacks of Boom as damage - racking up some crazy numbers - and many of his Talents use this status in various interesting ways.

Moonstone:
In combination with her Lute, Moonstone's unique hero ability allows her to apply temporary passives to all of her allies! New passives are made available every time Moonstone uses her ability. Those passives can then be applied by playing her Lute, and last until the next time Lute is drawn.
Moonstone is the ideal support character, with her abilities and talents built to aid and augment her team, but make sure you keep this hero alive, or your run will be over!

Iris:
Iris possesses the ability to summon spirits from beyond her mortal plane. These spirits can block attacks from opponents, or possess her and your fellow party members to augment their abilities. Alongside her unique Talent and Passive pool, this adds a wildly new flavour of gameplay to Banners of Ruin!

70050000052577.name: GigaBash | Ultraman: Rising DLC
70050000052577.description:
This DLC adds “Ultraman & Emi” from Ultraman: Rising to the game, featuring iconic abilities from the animated feature film and a unique skill set that combines Ultraman and the newborn kaiju, Emi, as one character.

As Ultraman, you are star athlete Ken Sato, who reluctantly returns home to take over his father's duties as Ultraman. But, he quickly finds more than he bargained for when heʼs forced to raise a newborn Kaiju he later named Emi. Like all infants, she’s curious yet temperamental, sweet yet demanding; even her cries are like weaponized tantrums.

Enter the GigaBash arena as this dynamic duo as they pull of powerful (and sometimes accidental) combos to defeat their enemies; sweep the battlefield clean as you converge Ultraman and Emi’s ultimate to form one powerful beam attack and more!

So, will you rise up and discover what it truly means to be a hero?

70050000052589.name: The Art of Chernobylite
70050000052589.intro: Explore the art of Chernobylite, from early concept designs through to real-world photography captured within the actual Chernobyl Exclusion Zone
70050000052589.description: Journey into Chernobyl’s Exclusion Zone with The Art of Chernobylite, a digital artbook from developers, The Farm 51. In the artbook you’ll find concept artwork of characters, locations, weapons, and monsters, as well as 3D scans and real-world photography from Chernobyl’s Exclusion Zone.

70050000052590.name: The Music of Chernobylite
70050000052590.intro: The digital download for the official Chernobylite soundtrack and additional in-game music with the Zone Bard Pack.
70050000052590.description:
Get a deeper appreciation for the haunting and atmospheric sounds of Chernobylite with the complete soundtrack by award-winning composer Mikolai Stroiński.

The Chernobylite Zone Bard Pack allows you to customize the music in your hideout to match your mood. Choose freely from the full official soundtrack and exclusive compositions created specifically for your journey in the Exclusion Zone.

70050000052591.name: Chernobylite - Seasoned Scavenger Weapon Skin Pack
70050000052591.intro: Collection of unique skins to customize your entire arsenal of weapons.
70050000052591.description: A collection of unique skins to customize every weapon type in the game. Enhance your arsenal with a variety of styles, from elegant white roses and radioactive sinister smiles to icy blue finishes. A touch of style can remind us of our humanity, even this twisted wasteland.

70050000052592.name: Chernobylite - Irradiated Hideout Skin Pack
70050000052592.intro: Collection of unique skins to customize the look and feel of your base.
70050000052592.description: Collection of unique skins to customize the look and feel of your base/hideout. Choose to add some calming blue glow to any part of your craftable base items, or maybe some imposing 1980s industrial-style smoke-spewing machinery. Want something a little more natural? Opt for a rustic red, wooden look inspired by the Red Forest from the real-life Chernobyl Exclusion Zone.
