70050000052760.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler's Courtship
70050000052760.description:
In this heartfelt novella-like story of romance, newfound friend Fuddler needs a helping hand to express his feelings. 

Join Snufkin and his best friend, Moomintroll, as they embark on a camping trip deep into the wilds before winter sets in. What should have been a relaxing excursion for two, turns into a chaotic and romantic journey, with many new and old friends.

Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler’s Courtship is a brand new pocket-sized adventure filled with wonderful encounters set amongst the striking watercolor visuals of autumn. 

●   Gone camping: Yet again the friends in Moominvalley find themselves in need of Snufkin and his best friend, Moomintroll. Head out on this pocket-sized adventure with a cast of your favorite characters, and make new friends in a journey sprinkled with surprises.
●   Pushing the right buttons: Meet the charming yet shy Fuddler, and help him on a journey of the heart, exploring the complexities of love and romance in Moominvalley.
●   Something’s in the air: Anticipation is in the air when the foliage changes color as Moominvalley welcomes the fall in all its splendor. Join Snufkin for a new atmospheric experience.

70050000052770.name: Fly Corp – Quick scenarios DLC Pack
70050000052770.intro: There’s no time to lose: test your managing skills in Fly Corp – Quick Scenarios DLC Pack!
70050000052770.description: In Fly Corp – Quick Scenarios DLC Pack 6 new scenarios await you. Earn a specific amount of money before the time runs out, or try to keep up when the cities start appearing in the blink of an eye. All this and many other speed challenges await!

70050000052802.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Volume 1
70050000052802.description:
Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Volume 1 is a dazzling collection of three authentic classics. Play THE GETAWAY: HIGH SPEED II™, JUNK YARD™ and MEDIEVAL MADNESS™ in two exciting ways -- as arcade-perfect simulations in their original form or as remastered videogame experiences enhanced with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features.

- THE GETAWAY: HIGH SPEED II™: "Okay, buddy... Pull over... Pull over NOW!!!" Time to press pedal to the metal and shift into high gear!
- JUNK YARD™: The meanest game in the whole darn town! Sneak in and rummage through Crazy Bob's Cosmic Salvage. Collect junk and pick up fireworks to build your flying jalopy!
- MEDIEVAL MADNESS™: Behold the Renaissance of Pinball! Defeat the king and all his men to stop the madness and restore order to this great land.

70050000052803.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 2
70050000052803.description:
This stunning collection of three authentic Bally™ tables includes BLACK ROSE™, ATTACK FROM MARS™, and THE PARTY ZONE™. All available to play both in their classic original form and as remastered tables with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features.

- BLACK ROSE: The queen of the high seas sets sail for the world's greatest treasures, firing cannons and braving the whirlpool ramp!
- ATTACK FROM MARS: Blast those Martians! It's Big-O-Beams, flying saucers, and more in this ode to 1950s sci-fi.
- THE PARTY ZONE: When it's time to party, there's no better place than Bally's Party Zone. Escape to a parallel universe that's way beyond Wisconsin!

70050000052804.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 3
70050000052804.description:
This stunning collection of three authentic Bally™ tables includes THEATRE OF MAGIC™, SAFE CRACKER™, and THE CHAMPION PUB™. All available to play both in their classic original form and as remastered tables with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features!

- THEATRE OF MAGIC: You have the magic! This classic table presents a ravishing magician who morphs into a tiger and a bird, along with pinballs that levitate or suddenly change direction, plus a magic trunk packed with tricks and surprises.
- SAFE CRACKER: You're almost in the vault! Safe Cracker™ combines two games into one. Work against time to break into the bank, then make your way around the board game in the backglass to break into the vault!
- THE CHAMPION PUB: Welcome to Champion Pub, kid! Train hard and battle brawler after brawler in front of a packed house. Knock out five in a row and you'll be crowned Pub Champion!

70050000052805.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 8
70050000052805.description:
Dive into 3 tables of Williams retro goodness of some of the most action-packed tables ever created! Black Knight 2000, Banzai Run and Earthshaker! take you back to the arcades of the 80s for hours of silver ball fun. 

In this pack: 

Black Knight 2000: He rides again! Prepare yourself for a colorful and musical extravaganza as you use your flippers to defeat the iconic Black Knight. You've got the power, you've got the might!

Banzai Run: Be the King of the Hill! Embark on a unique two-playfield pinball experience with this one-of-a-kind Williams classic! Get first place and beat all other racers to climb Banzai Hill and the leaderboards!

Earthshaker!: In the seismic world of Earthshaker, the earth quakes hard and your machine with it! Shake up your play on this 1989 Williams masterpiece.

70050000052806.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Universal Monsters Pack
70050000052806.description:
Two scarily authentic Williams™ and Bally™ pinball tables—and a whole party of iconic Universal Monsters!—comprise this collection: MONSTER BASH™ and CREATURE FROM THE BLACK LAGOON. Both are available to play in their classic original form and as remastered tables with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features.

- MONSTER BASH: Reunite the creatures of the night and get ready to rock! Rebuild FRANKENSTEIN, dig out THE MUMMY, unleash a full moon for THE WOLFMAN, spell D-R-A-C-U-L-A, lure the CREATURE FROM THE BLACK LAGOON up from the slimy depths of his beloved lagoon, and get the BRIDE OF FRANKENSTEIN to wail about her ball and chain!
- CREATURE FROM THE BLACK LAGOON: All the excitement of Universal Studios' classic monster flick with the fun of a drive-in movie date! When nostalgia meets high-tech pinball wizardry, the results are breathtaking!

70050000052818.name: RPG Alchemy Bestiary I
70050000052818.intro: RPG Alchemy Bestiary I offers additional 30 connections.

RPG Alchemy is a variation on the Alchemy genre, but instead of trying to connect water to sand and fire to air you will start with a basic adventurer and just as a basic mob... then the two meet and the fun begins. Discover nearly 200 unique team members, enemies, and locations. Try and see if you can defeat all the monsters.

70050000052859.name: Commemorative CG Portrait & Scenario Set for "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS" Day
70050000052859.intro: A set consisting of 25 CG portraits from "RTK VIII" and 2 new scenarios.
70050000052859.description:
A "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS" Day commemorative set of 25 CG portraits from "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS VIII" that can be used in the Editor, along with 2 new scenarios, "Lady Power" and "Those Loyal to the Han."

Two new scenarios
- Lady Power
- Those Loyal to the Han

Additional CG portraits
- CG portraits of 25 officers, including Zhuge Liang, Lu Bu, and Diaochan, from the original version of this game, "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS VIII."

How to access:
- New scenarios
Access New Game and then Scenarios, where you can select "Lady Power" or "Those Loyal to the Han" to begin playing.
- CG portraits
Set officers' CG portraits via Edit Original Officers or Edit Historical Officers.
To view the portraits, access Edit, Edit Original Officers, Create Original Officers or Change Original Officers, and then Portrait. Alternatively, access Edit, Edit Historical Officers, Edit Historical Officers again, Portrait, and then the "Special" tab.

70050000052868.name: PowerWash Simulator - Halloween House - Halloween 2024
70050000052868.description:
Something filthy this way comes in PowerWash Simulator’s latest Seasonal Special. You’ll have to hose off more than a few cobwebs to take the Halloween House from mortifyingly mucky to party-ready perfection.

Get ready for a grave encounter with dirt in this spooky Seasonal Special. Atop an isolated hillside bathed in pale moonlight, sits a house covered in so much grime, it’s scary. Venture through its sprawling grounds, washing everything from wishing wells to al fresco apothecaries along the way. Oh, and pumpkins. So many pumpkins.

Nothing short of a miniature castle, the house itself is a large stone-walled haunt, belonging to a local witch. With turrets, stained-glass windows and an orangery to boot, it’ll take you all night to get this place spotless. Lucky for you, the sun never seems to rise here.

With a swish of your power washing wand, you’ll soon put all that filth behind you. Just like that ghosty there. Made you look!

And to top it all off, this Seasonal Special also comes with a new custom suit and power washer skin that’s so covetable it would make a witch turn green with envy. If they weren’t already green to begin with, that is.

70050000052891.name: Bubble Shoot Farm DLC#1
70050000052891.intro: Bubble puzzler full of farm animals!
70050000052891.description: Expand your bubble-bursting adventure with the Bubble Shoot Farm DLC! Featuring brand-new levels set in the charming countryside, this DLC offers more bubble-popping fun without introducing new content. Dive into fresh farm-themed challenges, from popping bubbles over rolling fields to shooting your way through barns and tractors. Get ready for more levels, more strategy, and even more bubble-shooting excitement!

70050000052916.name: Across the Obelisk: Bernard, the Alchemist
70050000052916.description:
Bernard, the Alchemist is a Hero Pack that introduces the scout-healer multiclass to Across the Obelisk. Devise new party compositions and create advanced strategies thanks to Bernard’s unique class. Bernard is joined by a new pet, Inky, his faithful octopus friend.

Bernard, the Alchemist Hero Pack contains:

• Bernard, a scout-healer hybrid, best placed to take advantage of Flask and Rust, the tag and curse introduced in update 1.5.

• A deceptive hero. Bernard might have the speed of a turtle, but his powers are much mightier! Use his mastery of Rust to inflict powerful effects on unsuspecting enemies or reduce the impact of negative effects on Bernard.

• Inky, the octopus, a pet with the ability to shoot ink and apply the Wet, Poison and Dark status effects.

• Three unique skins, each fit for adventuring on the high seas and beyond.

• Three new cardbacks with a Sahti Islands flavor.

• Custom replies for random events. Discover more about Bernard’s personality, backstory and hopes for a longer life.

Thanks to Bernard, the Alchemist and Inky, his eight-legged friend, you can discover powerful new combinations previously unseen.

70050000052919.name: Tales of Graces f Remastered - Super Adventuring Assistance Set
70050000052919.description:
Unlock the in-game item Super Adventuring Assistance Set early for Tales of Graces f Remastered.

Includes:
• Apple Gel x 10
• Grape Gel x 10
• Life Bottle x 10
• Panacea Bottle x 10

*This set can be obtained through game progression.

70050000052920.name: Tales of Graces f Remastered - Super Growth Support Herb Set
70050000052920.description:
A set of red herbs that can permanently boost a character’s stats in Tales of Graces f Remastered.

Includes:

• Red Savory×15
• Red Rosemary×15
• Red Lavender×15
• Red Verbena×15

70050000052921.name: Tales of Graces f Remastered - Battle BGM pack
70050000052921.description: This pack allows players to change the normal battle music of Tales of Graces f Remastered to BGM from past Tales of series.

70050000052924.name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Survivalist Youngho
70050000052924.intro: 'After all, he becomes the master of survival.’
70050000052924.description: What about this Youngho? He's watched too many books and videos about survival and the wilderness. Watching the survival stories of adventurers he admires has taught him what outfits can help him be ‘Tactical’. He's prepared for any eventuality with military gear, and his bulletproof vest keeps him protected. His Necroblade... no, Flare Gun, will be able to take out Swordman Ghosts with a powerful blast of light.

70050000052925.name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Gamer Youngho
70050000052925.description: Meet Youngho! This guy spends all of his time outside of school hours gaming! His knowledge of the game helps him navigate this ‘horror game’ like situation. When he rolls on the floor, he can ‘Evade’ like a game character to avoid enemy attacks. Remind you of a blue hedgehog? Or a squinty-eyed spy agent when he hides? That's Youngho, and his Necroblade... no, his magical lightsaber will transform him into a valiant Dark Lord in an instant!

70050000052926.name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Child of Destiny Youngho
70050000052926.intro: ‘The chosen boy dropped into a strange world.’
70050000052926.description: It's going to be interesting to meet this Youngho, because this Youngho is... a wizard! According to prophecy, a Korean high school freshman with a scar on his forehead will save the school in The Coma. His chosen colour is green, so he must be calm and intelligent. While the other students are dressed in their tacky Korean school uniforms, this Youngho will work his magic with his magic pen, opening doors, solving riddles, and destroying Swordman Ghosts once and for all with his Necroblade... er, I mean, magic pen!

70050000052949.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: Spooky Pack
70050000052949.intro: Elevate Your Chill with Haunting Decor
70050000052949.description:
Transform your lofi experience with the "Lofi Chill Sessions: Spooky Pack." Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Halloween with a collection of atmospheric objects designed to enhance your chill sessions.

Discover a variety of hauntingly beautiful decor, from flickering candles and mysterious potions to ghostly silhouettes and whimsical jack-o'-lanterns. Each object brings its unique charm, setting the perfect backdrop for a cozy evening filled with smooth beats and relaxing vibes.

As you explore this spooky pack, let the ambiance transport you to a world where the ethereal meets the melodic. Ideal for studying, unwinding, or celebrating the spirit of Halloween, this DLC adds an extra layer of charm to your lofi playlist.

Create the ultimate chill environment and invite the magic of the season into your space with the "Lofi Chill Sessions: Spooky Pack." Embrace the vibes and let the atmosphere inspire your creativity and relaxation.

70050000052950.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: Haunted Vibes
70050000052950.intro: Chill Out with the Haunted Duo
70050000052950.description:
Unlock a new layer of chill with the "Lofi Chill Sessions: Haunted Vibes" DLC! Dive deeper into the haunted atmosphere as you discover two new characters that will elevate your lofi experience.

Character 1: This undead companion brings a groovy twist to the afterlife. With a laid-back demeanor and a passion for classic beats, this character embodies the essence of chill. Shuffling through the graveyard, they’ll introduce you to a fresh selection of tracks that blend the eerie and the mellow, ensuring your vibes are always on point.

Character 2: Mysterious and alluring, this enchanting figure radiates an air of mischief. With a flair for the dramatic, they sprinkle a bit of magic into every session. Their unique playlist combines haunting melodies with irresistible rhythms, setting the perfect mood for late-night relaxation or creative pursuits.

Together, these new additions will enhance your lofi journey, bringing a blend of spookiness and serenity. Immerse yourself in their world as they guide you through chilling soundscapes that are sure to inspire and unwind. Embrace the haunted vibes and unlock a captivating experience in "Lofi Chill Sessions: Haunted Vibes".

70050000052971.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Old Acquaintances
70050000052971.description:
Two savants from largely disparate backgrounds: one born a slave, the other into Imperial nobility. Fate saw their paths inextricably intertwined, and neither escaped unscarred. Both of their journeys are filled with trials and tribulations, but while Sedarias, the now Undead Knight of the Black Sun, will walk a path that shall shake his very faith in the Empire, Javek, the Tarkian sorcerer, will undertake a discovery of the past; an inward journey, possibly taking players to the ends of their wits.

Vagrus – The Riven Realms: Old Acquaintances, reintroduces Sedarias and Javek, companions known to those familiar with the ‘Pilgrims of the Wasteland’ campaign, but now they are over a decade older. Each has changed drastically and each is equipped with new abilities, individual and specific loyalty quests that explore their own stories, with new enemies and rewards that accompany them. The DLC also introduces the Freelancers’ Guild, a new independent organization of mercenaries that can bolster or aid vagri looking for specialized skills.

70050000052972.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Sunfire and Moonshadow
70050000052972.description:
Occupying the northwestern corner of the continent of Xeryn, a desert older than the Calamity lies between the Brown Mountains and the River Lethe: the Bronze Desert. It is a realm torn by war in more than one way. The Empire rallies its immense legions here, sending them north toward the Green Continent to lay waste to its lush lands while the elite Chimera Legion remains behind to oversee this arid staging ground. Deep in the desert, however, lurks a different threat – that of the Ahari. Birthed by the native Bandul and tempered by their unwillingness to yield in the face of Imperial oppression, the Ahari seek to win back their sacred oases and holy sites, fighting an impossible campaign of terror. Amidst it all are the Handjari, sworn allies of the Empire and stewards of the greatest city in all the Bronze Desert – Kabur, the Jewel of the North.

The stage is set, the stakes are high. Who will you, a mere vagrus, align yourself with? The mysterious Ahari and their Sun God or the cruel Chimera Legion and their ruthlessly pragmatic leader, the Legate? Your decisions will shape the fate of the region writ large, paving the way for a new, uncertain future throughout the Realms.

And yet, dear vagabond, how will you reach such a land, cut off from the outside by raging winds and deadly geography? Surely, you will need to traverse the Realms in a new, peculiar way rarely ever used by other vagri.

Sunfire and Moonshadow offers a new, vast region to explore complete with a swathe of new settlements, new enemies to conquer, new stories to be a part of, a large cast of characters, and new quests to complete through which the vagrus may make their mark on Xeryn. With all this, as well as the introduction of a central conflict involving three new core factions – the Ahari, the Chimera Legion, and the Handjari – the expansion features content roughly one-third the size of the core game.

70050000052973.name: Video Game Store: Cash Flow
70050000052973.description:
Take your video game store to new heights with the Cash Flow DLC, where success and fortune are just a click away! Start with a hefty boost of 5000 coins, giving you the capital to upgrade your store, purchase rare inventory, or enhance your gaming setup. Whether you're aiming to attract more customers, invest in cutting-edge gear, or outpace your competitors, this coin infusion provides the perfect launchpad.

Upgrade your shelves, stock exclusive titles, or optimize your store's layout to skyrocket your profits. With Cash Flow, the possibilities are endless, and your path to becoming a gaming retail tycoon is paved with gold. Will you expand your empire and build the ultimate gaming destination? The choice is yours - let the wealth roll in and watch your store flourish!

70050000052974.name: Supermarket Simulator: Storage Backroom
70050000052974.intro: Storage Backroom: Expand Your Space, Stock Up, and Maximize Your Store!
70050000052974.description:
Unlock the full potential of your supermarket with the Storage Backroom DLC! Expand your store’s capacity by gaining access to a dedicated storage room, giving you more space to stock and manage inventory like never before. With the backroom at your disposal, you can store extra goods, keep popular items in supply, and ensure your supermarket is always well-stocked for eager customers.

Take control of your store’s flow by optimizing inventory management and making sure your shelves are always full. Ready to handle the demand and maximize your supermarket's profits? Expand your storage, stock up on more goods, and watch your business thrive!

70050000052981.name: Formula Racing: Cash Boost
70050000052981.description: Rev up your race with the Cash Boost DLC! Instantly add 1,500,000 in extra cash to your wallet, giving you the ultimate edge in car upgrades, customizations, and top-tier performance parts. Build the car of your dreams or tune up your existing rides to dominate the competition. Whether it’s upgrading your speed, enhancing handling, or adding some style, this cash boost brings you one step closer to victory.

70050000052984.name: Placid Plastic Duck - Hippospace Download
70050000052984.intro: Placid Plastic Duck - Hippospace Download brings you and the ducks on a relaxing tour of the deep space!
70050000052984.description:
With this additional location, you'll enjoy a funfair experience in space, a lazy river of lights, and a calm, solitary ride in orbit. Come check the cockpit and meet 3 special spatial ducks!

What you'll find:

- 1 new space location

- 5 points of view (a record!)

- new unique actions and combos

- 3 special ducks

- increased chilling

- support for further development

- the ducks' gratitude

- an astronaut

70050000052988.intro: Help babes in fantasy outfits find their missing piece.

Can you find your way into their hearts?

70050000052994.name: Calico: Neat Things
70050000052994.intro: New quests, a new character, new mini-games, and, of course, cuddly new friends to invite to your cafe!
70050000052994.description:
There's even more to explore in the world of Calico with the Neat Things DLC, including:

-New Quest — Neat Things Scavenger Hunt: Your beloved aunt has a mission for you that takes you across the whole island in search of some really neat things!
-New Area and NPC — Mermaid’s Cove: Visit Clover Cove to uncover a new area, and meet a mythical new friend — Nahla the Mermaid!  
-New Animal Companions: Become best buds with new cuddly friends, including a mischievous raccoon, a smiley axolotl, a playful elephant, a loveable golden retriever, and, of course, a very familiar cat!
-Two New Mini-Games: The Cutie City arcade has two new activities to enjoy, so be sure to pay it a visit!
-New Café Decorations: Create your dream aquatic-themed cafe with furniture!
-And More to Discover: Have a wander around the island and explore the world around you to uncover some fun new interactions such as playing in piles of fallen leaves, making a wish on dandelions that have gone to seed, and more!

70050000053001.name: Costume "Twinkle☆Christmas!!"
70050000053001.description:
The costume "Twinkle☆Christmas!!" includes the following elements:

- Costume "Twinkle☆Christmas!!"
A charming costume for Yohane to celebrate the holy night is here! 
The cute drawers peeking out from beneath the red skirt are simply adorable! 
Change into this dazzlingly cute ! Christmas outfit and embark on an adventure in the mirror world!

* Costume will be added to the closet after purchase.

70050000053010.name: New Character: Belial
70050000053010.description:
This is a warrior-type demon, excelling in both offense and defense. She comes with a brand new skill tree and talent tree. She has the ability to weaken the power of her enemies.

After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete the character's story quest in-game to recruit the character into your team.

70050000053011.name: New Character: Asmodeus
70050000053011.description:
This is an offensive-type demon, skilled not only in seducing her opponents but also in using unique methods to heal her allies. As for everything else about her, it’s up to you to discover.

After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete the character's story quest in-game to recruit the character into your team.

70050000053012.name: Giant Rush: Brave DLC
70050000053012.intro: Strike down your foes in brave style!

70050000053028.intro: Rococo art, which began in 18th century France, spread throughout Europe. This puzzle pack features elegant and delicate paintings.

70050000053030.intro: Healing time decorated with beautiful flower arrangements. Relaxation time with jigsaw puzzles.

70050000053033.name: Sweet Survivors: Spooky DLC
70050000053033.intro: Stop the cats and save the haunted café!
70050000053033.description:
In this spooky DLC, things are about to get a little… scary. 

Unlock:
- A brand-new haunted level!
- Meet the mysterious new character "Ophelia"!
- Discover a magical new toy, the enchanted "Book"!
- Serve up the strong, dark "Robusta" coffee!
- Face a new horde of unique spooky cats!

No café is too spooky when there’s a swarm of needy, ghostly kitties around! Can you keep them at bay and save the café?

70050000053036.name: Sweet Survivors: Flashy DLC
70050000053036.intro: Stop the cats and save the disco café!
70050000053036.description:
In this flashy DLC, things are about to get a little… dazzling.

Unlock:

- Discover a refreshing new toy, "Water"!
- Serve up the smooth and rich "Mocha" coffee!

No café is too groovy when there’s a swarm of needy, dramatic kitties on the dance floor! Can you keep up with the rhythm and save the café?

70050000053037.name: Sweet Survivors: Fancy DLC
70050000053037.intro: Stop the cats and save the elegant café!
70050000053037.description:
In this elegant DLC, things are about to get a little… refined.

Unlock:

- Meet the stylish new character, "James"!
- Discover a delicious new toy, "Cat Food"!
- Serve the exclusive and rich "Kopi Luwak" coffee!
- Face a new horde of unique, classy cats!

No café is too fancy when there’s a swarm of needy, high-class kitties around! Can you keep the elegance intact and save the café?

70050000053042.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms At the Heart of Ruin
70050000053042.description:
Vagrus’s second expansion, At the Heart of Ruin, offers a tight but multi-layered and dense region fraught with conflict and rich with opportunities. Vagri who decide to brave the forsaken paths of this broken realm will be challenged not only by new foes and villains, but also by the very nature one must traverse the mountainous terrain.

New Content and Features

- A fresh, dangerous region unfettered from Imperial dominance and brimming with peril
- A dark narrative adventure with several overarching stories as well as shorter adventures
- Deep quests with multiple outcomes and a plethora of personalities
- Many new opportunities and challenges for traders, mercenaries, and explorers
- A host of new enemies, be they crazed scavengers or creatures cursed beyond recognition
- A large cast of NPCs, some new and some old, who can be a part of your story
- New minor factions the likes of which few vagri have ever had the chance to befriend or fight against
- New obstacles, rewards, lore, and more of our signature visual art

70050000053053.name: SnowRunner - Kenworth Dual Pack
70050000053053.description:
The Kenworth Dual Pack brings two new Kenworth trucks to your SnowRunner garage - the Highway-class T880 and the Heavy Duty-class C500 - as well as one vinyl wrap for each.

As a Highway truck, the Kenworth T880 benefits from exceptional range thanks to a wide choice of engine options, allowing it great fuel consumption and speed on roads. It also comes with permanent differential lock and has access to high suspensions.

The Heavy Duty Kenworth C500 shines with great maneuverability and great traversal capabilities in off-road environments, making it a very reliable and comfortable heavy hauler for your toughest assignments, despite only having access to stock suspensions.

The Kenworth Dual Pack also comes with two unique sideboards specifically fitted for the T880 and C500 frames, with respectively 3 and 2 cargo slots.

This DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 or Year 4 Passes.

70050000053056.name: Green Dragon Set
70050000053056.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70050000053056.description: Unlock the new design for the plate set in your restaurant featuring a traditional green dragon.

70050000053074.name: New Feline Friends
70050000053074.description: Introducing an exciting add-on for Little Strays that brings a variety of adorable new cats, each with unique colors. New Feline Friends enhances your experience with more  companions to rescue!

70050000053077.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 - FUTURE SAGA Chapter 2
70050000053077.description:
The second chapter in the FUTURE SAGA series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history!

70050000053159.name: Seasonal Decorative Pack 2
70050000053159.intro: Seasonal Decorative Pack 2 adds 6 backgrounds & exclusive player portraits!
70050000053159.description:
It's time to start or complete your collection of beautiful Wingspan backgrounds! We’re introducing Wingspan: Seasonal Decorative Pack 2! Grab another set of backgrounds, many of which you may be familiar with from seasonal events. With this pack, they can become a permanent part of your background collection! And new, matching portraits land along with the backgrounds, and are available exclusively with this DLC!

Immerse yourself in a vivid feast of colorful flowers in the meadow of the Automa background, or feel the call of adventure by bringing your birds to the Scout forest familiar from the online challenges.

If you're in the mood to celebrate, the Lunar New Year or Wingspan Anniversary backgrounds are also available, spreading an aura of mystery under the evening sky and the magic of nature.

You’ll also be able to play on the whimsical background created to celebrate the release of our second board game adaptation, Quilts and Cats of Calico. This unusual background is full of adorable cats and soft fabrics.

Last, but not least, there's something with a completely different mood. A post-apocalyptic swamp background! Dive into the bog mist and explore the artifacts hidden in the high grass. Maybe you will learn their secrets?

But that's not all! New player portraits are waiting for you! On the background of Automa, you can meet the famous Automa bird wearing a crown of flowers. In the scout forest, a charming duck scout greets you. The Lunar New Year, every year graced with a relevant patron is also accompanied by a mighty oriental dragon, and the background of Wingspan's anniversary - the famous Wingspan Scissor Flycatcher, known as a Wingspan poster bird, with a small birthday gift.

From the portrait for Quilts and Cats of Calico background, a little kitten with a cute mlem stares at you playfully. And from the swamp mist emerges a long-necked Common snapping turtle with its unusual shell.

Wingspan's extraordinary hand-painted backgrounds and portraits are waiting for you to reach for whenever you want! Why not grab them now?

This DLC includes 6 game backgrounds along with 6 matching portraits:
Automa Background with Automa Bird Portrait
Scout Background with Duck-Scout Portrait
Lunar New Year Background (with a relevant yearly patron) with Oriental Dragon Portrait
Wingspan Anniversary Background with Birthday Scissor Flycatcher Portrait
Quilts and Cats of Calico Background with Kitty Portrait
Post-apo Swamp Background with Common Snapping Turtle Portrait 

This content does not give you any advantage over other players. If you decide not to purchase the Seasonal Decorative Pack 2 but want to play with friends or other players who have it, you can still join a multiplayer game or a shared server and fully enjoy the game. Seasonal backgrounds will also appear periodically, as before, for all players. The exception is the post-apo swamp background and its matching portrait, which are exclusive to this pack only.

70050000053165.name: Across the Obelisk: Sigrun, the Valkyrie
70050000053165.description:
Sigrun, the Valkyrie is a Hero Pack that brings the scout-mage multiclass to Across the Obelisk for the first time. Develop new strategies using Sigrun’s unique capabilities and reveal the secrets of her forgotten past. Sigrun is accompanied by a new pet, Jelly, the jellyfish.

Sigrun, the Valkyrie Hero Pack contains:

• Sigrun, a mage-scout hybrid capable of summoning lightning and thunder to torment her foes.

• An agile, rapid hero. Thanks to her Spellsinger talent, Sigrun receives Elemental spells from the mage class for free and at zero cost.

• A new pet. Jelly the jellyfish is a master of lightning, just like her Valkyrie friend.

• Three unique skins suitable for any goddess who may find herself far from Valhalla. 

• Three new Sahti Island-themed cardbacks.

• Custom replies for random events. Learn more about Sigrun’s mysterious past and noble quest to protect the Sahti people.

Discover an intriguing story and bring new strategies to bear with Sigrun, the Valkyrie.

70050000053170.name: Across the Obelisk: Shores of Sahti
70050000053170.description:
Set sail for the Sahti Islands in this all-new pirate-themed adventure. Powerful factions are vying for dominance in this once-peaceful archipelago. Will you defend the indigenous people, exploit their natural resources or battle to emerge as king of the pirates? The choice is yours!

The Shores of Sahti Story Pack introduces a classic pirate setting to Across the Obelisk alongside an array of new items, enemies and secrets to discover.

• Explore a tropical paradise thrown into chaos by the awakening of an ancient obelisk.

• Formidable foes have emerged from the depths of the ocean, threatening the existence of the spiritual Sahti people.

• Amid the turmoil, three powerful factions wrestle for control of the islands: the navy seeking to defend the locals, the greedy Company of Overseas Trade and feuding bands of pirates. Who will you side with?

• Face-off against 20 new enemies, three champion enemies and three new bosses, including the legendary Kraken.

• Bring two new pets to the party—Matey the parrot, and Mimy a mimic chest with a mouthful of teeth!

• Do battle in a gorgeous nautical combat theme.

• Thrilling new locations are yours to discover. Explore a mighty dreadnought, investigate a fearsome pirate fortress and solve the secrets of the briny deep.

• Navigate your way through a host of new events.

• Get to grips with 35 new items.

• Add a touch of seafaring flair to your deck with a new cardback design.

• Share the story with your co-op party. Only one person per party needs to own this Story Pack to play through the adventure.

70050000053192.name: Railway Empire 2 - Journey To The East
70050000053192.intro: In Railway Empire 2 – Journey to the East you’ll embark on a mission that promises unimaginable riches.
70050000053192.description:
Starting out in Vienna, your enterprise will expand through the towering mountains of the Carpathians and the rough terrain of the Balkans before finally reaching the legendary city of Constantinople.

As a maverick entrepreneur of the late 1800s this challenging endeavour is rewarded with unimagined riches! Deploy new locomotives, produce and transport new goods, and attract wealthy travellers with the brand-new Luxury Rail Line mechanic, transporting them back and forth from the Danube river to the Bosporus.

• Constantinople Calling: The first DLC for Railway Empire 2 introduces the new, fully voiced scenario, „Journey to the East“ (1881-1890).

• Journey Eastward: Expand across Eastern Europe in the new regional map "Balkan", with new city buildings, plus a new station building for the southern regions of the map.

• New and exotic luxuries: More than 10 new products including mediterranean olives, golden honey, and carpets of the finest fabrics.

• Moving Through Mountains: 6 new powerful locomotives, such as the Bavarian S 3/6 and the CFR 142 Carpathian pride.

• The Glamour of the Fin de Siècle: The new feature „Luxury Rail Line“ can be researched from 1870 onwards and provides you with new luxury wagons. You can also adjust the pricing for those lines to receive a higher revenue per passenger.

• Ride with the Vibe: 10 new themed music tracks and 19 jingles to build immersion in the new campaign and map.

70050000053193.name: Railway Empire 2 - High Voltage
70050000053193.intro: Strap in and turn up the power! Railway Empire 2 – High Voltage is ready to charge into the age of railway electrification.
70050000053193.description:
With 10 brand new electric locomotives, tycoons become well-equipped to conquer the steep mountains and impressive gorges of the Swiss Alps – but you will need more than electricity alone to convince the railway administration of the advantages of these new engines.

Once you’re able to break down the traditionalist’s resistance, prepare to electrify the whole country and direct the current of industry to make yours the largest and best electrical railroad system of the railway age.

• The Age of Electrification: Railway Empire 2 – High Voltage vaults players into a new age, as the Steam behemoths begin to lose ground to the new electric power houses of the era.

• Fully Charged: Utilize 10 authentic reproductions of electrical locomotives, such as the Ce 6/8 III Krokodil and the PRR GG1 Blackjack, including 3 new electronic locomotive sounds.

• Wired In: The DLC introduces 2 comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios, “High Voltage” (starting 1914) and “Power to the People” (starting 1920).

• Rise to the Peak(s): Expand through the middle of Europe in the 5 new regional maps for Switzerland.

• Swiss Craftsmanship: Transport 10 new unique regional products from iconic Swiss Pocket Knives and Herbal Candies to delicious Cheese Fondue.

• Fresh Frequencies: 20 new themed music tracks and jingles to get you in the mood for the new environment and locomotives.

70050000053194.name: Railway Empire 2 - India
70050000053194.intro: Revel in the abundance of colours and the enchanting landscape: Railway Empire 2 – India whisks you into a gorgeous new era.
70050000053194.description:
Discover vast, vibrant plains, roaming elephants and bustling mega-cities, all waiting to be transformed by the blessings of the railroad.

Beginning in the Golden Era of the East India Company, you will help establish a vast railway system within the Indian subcontinent. Should you succeed, your network will become a roaring motor for growth, trade, administration and military control over India. However, a few decades later, the grip of the East India Company is waning. Work together with the British Crown while forging your own path for a prosperous railway infrastructure in the west.

• A new look: Railway Empire 2 – India takes players into the vast Indian subcontinent, filled to the brim with exotic and colourful treasures and buzzing mega-cities that wait to be explored.

• Steaming Goodness: Utilize 4 new authentic Indian locomotives such as the “Fairy Queen” and the BNR class N, plus 5 imported locomotives that are reimagined to fit the new region.

• Bangalore, Calcutta and Bombay: The DLC introduces 3 comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios, “Foreign Regency” (starting 1840), “Karmic Justice” (starting 1854) and “Colours of India” (1865).

• Explore & Expand: Plough through the vastness of the Indian countryside on 4 detailed regional map sections of India.

• Treasures of India: Transport 16 new regional products from Raw Silk and traditional Naan bread to spiced Chai tea. Some versatile locations will also now allow you to swap between two possible productions, allowing you to further shape how the Indian economy develops.

• Sitars & Strings: 20 new themed music tracks and jingles to get you in the mood for the new setting.

70050000053199.name: Formula Racing: Supercharged Duo
70050000053199.intro: Unleash Double the Speed with the Ultimate Supercar Duo!
70050000053199.description:
Take your racing experience to the next level with the Supercharged Duo Pack! This DLC brings two high-performance supercars to your garage, each engineered for blistering speed, precision handling, and ultimate style. Whether you’re conquering straightaways or mastering tight corners, these supercars are designed to dominate the track.

Push the limits of power and agility as you feel the thrill of racing like never before. With cutting-edge aerodynamics and powerful engines, this duo will leave competitors in the dust and have you cruising straight to the podium!

70050000053200.name: Bookshop Wonderland: Cash Boost
70050000053200.intro: Fuel Your Bookshop Dreams with a Bounty of Cash!
70050000053200.description: Enhance your bookshop experience with the Cash Boost DLC! Instantly receive 5,000 coins to invest in new inventory, decor, and exciting promotions. Whether you’re expanding your collection of rare titles, upgrading your shop’s ambiance, or attracting more customers, this cash boost gives you the financial freedom to make your literary dreams a reality. Turn your bookshop into a thriving haven for readers and watch your success soar!

70050000053201.name: Bookshop Wonderland: Storage Boost
70050000053201.intro: Unlock More Space to Grow Your Literary Wonderland!
70050000053201.description: Expand your magical bookshop with the Storage Boost DLC! This upgrade unlocks additional storage space, allowing you to showcase a wider variety of books and enchanting items. With newfound room to breathe, you can curate your collection, attract more customers, and create the ultimate literary haven. Whether you’re storing rare tomes or popular bestsellers, this storage boost will help you transform your bookshop into a wonderland of literary delights. Get ready to grow your inventory and watch your dream bookshop flourish!

70050000053202.name: UNPACKING: NEW CHAPTERS
70050000053202.description: Get ready to dive back into the world of unpacking with "Unpacking: New Chapters"! This exciting DLC introduces fresh objects and eerie new environments to explore. Uncover mysterious treasures, unlock hidden secrets, and transform each new space into a home—one item at a time. Whether it’s a spooky attic, an abandoned house, or an unsettling new location, each chapter adds depth and atmosphere to the story as you piece together the past. Can you handle the thrills, chills, and discoveries waiting to be unpacked?

• Warrior Skin – Strong and ready for any challenge
• King Skin – Rule the bridge race like royalty
• 15000 Coins – Extra coins to help you on your journey

Show off your medieval might and knock your foes off their feet with these epic skins!

• Clown Skin – Bring a cheerful and quirky touch to your character
• Ghost Face Skin – Mysterious and cool, perfect for any race
• Skeleton Skin – A timeless look for Halloween fans
• 10000 Coins – Extra coins to help you on your journey

Knock your foes off their feet with your new look!

70050000053207.intro: Forge your baseball journey in The Show™
70050000053207.description: This bonus content for MLB The Show 25 includes 15 The Show Packs, 5 Gold Choice Packs, 1 20th Anniversary Choice Pack, 1 Diamond Choice Pack, 1 Equipment Pack, 1 Cover Athlete Bat Skin, 20,000 Stubs™, and Double Daily Rewards. Once acquired, items should be redeemed upon booting the game.

70050000053210.name: River City Girls 2: Double Dragon DLC
70050000053210.intro: The Double Dragons - Billy & Jimmy Lee - join the fight as playable characters!
70050000053210.description:
LET'S GO, BROS! The legendary Double Dragons, Billy and Jimmy Lee, are busting out of their dojos and joining River City Girls 2 as playable characters! These twin brothers jump into battle as distinctive fighters, ready to throw down with bone-shattering punches, kicks, slams, and special attacks - including trademark moves such as the Hurricane Kick and Rising Knee! The bros are fully integrated into River City Girls 2's story mode, complete with full voice overs, plus this premium DLC also adds an epic new vocal song and a new dojo master!

Contents:
• Playable Billy Lee
• Playable Jimmy Lee
• Full story integration with new voiceovers by Dan Avidan (Billy) and Arin Hanson (Jimmy)
• New vocal song performed by Hanson and Avidan with music by RCG series composer Megan McDuffee
• New dojo master Boro

*The full River City Girls 2 game (available separately) is required to use this content.

70050000053216.name: HEAVEN SEEKER - MIKADO PACK
70050000053216.intro: This is additional content that allows you to use special skills that change the character's appearance: "Mikado Form" and "Rock Form."
70050000053216.description:
After purchasing this DLC, a special NPC will appear at the entrance. By viewing the conversation event, the skill that changes the character's appearance will be unlocked.

■Mikado Form
　・You can change the appearance of the Seeker.
　・The initial Grimoire will be changed to "Mikado Shooter."
　・You can start your exploration with the artifact "Mikado's Partition" already in your possession.

■Rock Form
　・You can change the appearance of the Seeker.
　・The initial Grimoire will be changed to "Rock Shooter."
　・You can start your exploration with the artifact "Favorite Cigarette" already in your possession.

Additionally, the Grimoires "Mikado Shooter" and "Rock Shooter," as well as the artifacts "Mikado's Partition" and "Favorite Cigarette," will now appear within the dungeon.

※To use this content, a separately sold full version of the game is required.
※This content does not include additional characters.
※The changes made by the skill will only affect the appearance and items held. In event scenes and Sky Castle history, the original character will be referenced.

70050000053228.name: Street Drag Racing: Rise of GELENVAGEN
70050000053228.intro: Challenge yourself with new adventures, hit the road with your new GELENDVAGEN.
70050000053228.description: Dive into a new experience with this exciting DLC! Which brings a powerful bonus to your collection, and unlock the powerful GELENVAGEN by navigating to Main Menu → Garage → My Cars and take it for a spin on the streets or off-road. If this machine is already in your collection, you'll receive coins as compensation, the equivalent value of the car into shop.       Push your limits with new challenges, upgrade your rides, and show your rivals who's boss. Whether you're fine-tuning engines or mastering every curve in online multiplayer, the GELENVAGEN will take your gameplay to the next level!

70050000053282.name: Hamster Playground - Adventure & Style DLC Pack
70050000053282.description:
Enhance your Hamster Playground experience with the Adventure & Style DLC Pack, featuring six exciting expansion packs that add new themes, costumes, quests, and jobs for your hamsters. Dive into a world of fun and let your hamsters explore new adventures in style!

Included DLCs
- Spooky Hamster House DLC: Introduce a bit of spookiness to the party! This DLC adds haunting decorations, scary costumes, and spooky quests to your hamsters' world.

- Hamster City DLC: It's time to get to work! Bring urban-themed content, occupational costumes, and city-inspired quests to your hamsters.

- Kawaii DLC: Domo Arigato, Mr. Hamsta! Embrace the charm of Japan with Asian-themed decorations, traditional costumes, and new quests in a glamorous setting.

- Doll House DLC: Every girl dreams of a dollhouse, right? Transform your hamsters' home into a dollhouse with rock musician costumes and fun new quests.

- Royal Hamsters DLC: It's time for a little fantasy! Add medieval magic with castle-themed items, royal costumes like knights and princesses, and quests inspired by medieval stories.

- Cute Pets DLC: Feel like you're on a farm with this adorable DLC! Introduce farm-themed decorations, animal costumes, and farm-related quests for your hamsters.

70050000053287.name: Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter - Hair to the Throne Pack
70050000053287.intro: Personalise Arlo's revenge-hungry look with these six new hair & beard styles.
70050000053287.description: Strike cold-blooded fear into the icy hearts of the Dark Wings with the 'Hair to the Throne' cosmetic pack for Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter! This collection of six beards and hairstyles gives you further choices to customise Arlo, heir to the Warden of the North, as he embarks on a treacherous 'tail' of revenge across the wintery northern fringes of the Ratdom following the destruction of his home and the slaughter of his people.

70050000053312.name: Variante livery bundle
70050000053312.intro: 10 customized liveries to refresh the look of your favourite single-seaters!
70050000053312.description:
The Variante livery bundle is here! It contains 10 customized liveries (one for each car). You are a good driver, but you don't have time to create the livery of your dreams in the livery editor? Don't worry, we got you covered!
Refresh the look of your cars with these amazing liveries!

70050000053319.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cash Cargo
70050000053319.intro: Take your aviation business to new levels with a $350,000 boost!
70050000053319.description: Unlock new opportunities in "Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business" with an impressive $350,000 in-game currency bonus as soon as you enter. This strategic advantage empowers you to invest in top-tier aircraft, enhance your hangar facilities, and expand your business reach. Tackle daring missions with upgraded resources, optimize your cargo transport capabilities, and soar through the skies with unmatched intensity. Elevate your journey from small-scale operations to a formidable aviation empire, and make each flight an experience filled with greater rewards, challenges, and excitement.

70050000053323.name: Dead by Daylight: Doomed Course
70050000053323.description:
The scars of vengeance run jagged, never to heal. The mind breaks, gripped by the jaws of a nightmare. Such is the course, doomed though it may be.  

Embark on Dead by Daylight’s Doomed Course with new Killer, The Houndmaster, and new Survivor, Taurie Cain. Each one tainted by The Entity’s presence, both were shaped by tragedy, interwoven by the cruel whims of fate. 

Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Houndmaster’s Titanium Skull and Taurie Cain’s Gold Tier.

and Grozz's LIFE DAY WOOKIEE Costume, LIFE DAY CLUBS Weapon Wrap, REVERENTIAL ORB Emote and LIFE DAY Avatar, and 500 CRYSTALS

Gear up for battle and pick a Hunter that suits your playstyle from a regularly updated roster of new characters including nefarious bounty hunters, heroes of the Rebellion, Imperial stormtroopers, and everything in between. 70050000053421.name: Tank vs Tank: War Paint
70050000053421.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70050000053421.description:
The "War Paint" DLC brings you 4 unique tank skins and 4 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

Grab it now and roll out in style!

70050000053423.name: Car Cops: Drip Patrol
70050000053423.intro: Dress up on the job and make your home your own!
70050000053423.description:
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- Teddy Bear outfit
- Harley outfit
- Superhero Girl outfit
- Ice Queen outfit
- Maid outfit
- Pilot outfit
- Rabbit Ears outfit
- extra 5000 cash to buy furniture and make your home the perfect place to relax after a hard day at work

Unlock 7 unique outfits for your police officer, perfect for every undercover mission or just adding flair to your beat!

70050000053425.name: Video Game Store: New License
70050000053425.description: Get ready to take your supermarket to the next level! With the New License DLC, unlock fresh opportunities to grow your business with expanded product lines, larger store layouts, and advanced management tools. Master the art of pricing, promotions, and customer satisfaction as you dive into new challenges and discover untapped markets. Customize your store’s look, train your staff for efficiency, and become the ultimate supermarket mogul. Are you prepared to dominate the aisles and turn your store into a shopping paradise?

70050000053427.name: Spy Guy Memory Roma
70050000053427.intro: Train your memory in ancient Rome!
70050000053427.description: The time machine takes us to ancient Rome, where missing objects must be paired up!

70050000053431.name: Formula Racing: USA Horizon
70050000053431.intro: Rev Up Your Engines – New Tracks, New Challenges!
70050000053431.description:
Get ready to race like never before with the Formula Racing: USA Horizon – New Tracks DLC! Experience the thrill of high-speed racing across iconic locations in the USA. This DLC introduces brand-new tracks, each offering unique challenges and breathtaking views. From the winding curves of mountain roads to the wide open stretches of coastal highways, each race will test your skill and precision.

Unlock new environments, compete in fresh challenges, and push your car to the limit in the ultimate test of speed. Are you ready to conquer the USA and take your place on the podium?

70050000053433.name: Block Jam: Fancy Power
70050000053433.intro: Boost your game with power-ups and stylish hats!
70050000053433.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- 6 fancy hats for the blocks that live on your dioramas!
- 15 of each power-up for an easier time!

Get ready to match, clear, and decorate with flair!

70050000053436.name: Block Jam: Cute Power
70050000053436.intro: Boost your game with power-ups and lovely hats!
70050000053436.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- 6 cute hats for the blocks that live on your dioramas!
- 15 of each power-up for an easier time!

Get ready to match, clear, and decorate with flair!

70050000053438.name: Bookshop Wonderland: New License
70050000053438.intro: Unlock New Stories – Expand Your Bookshop
70050000053438.description:
Take your bookshop to the next level with the New License DLC for Bookshop Wonderland! This DLC unlocks exciting new opportunities, allowing you to expand your store with exclusive licenses that bring in rare and high-demand books. Attract new customers with specialized genres, limited-edition collections, and unique author signings.

With the New License DLC, you'll be able to customize your shelves with new titles, offer special promotions, and watch your bookshop grow into a literary haven. Expand your inventory, boost your reputation, and create a place where readers can find exactly what they're looking for. Ready to make your bookshop the go-to destination for book lovers everywhere?

70050000053439.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: New Anime Girl
70050000053439.intro: Meet Your New Chill Companion for Every Vibe
70050000053439.description: Bring fresh vibes to your lofi sessions with the New Anime Girl DLC. This character adds a serene, artistic touch to your chill-out scenes, with unique animations and cozy, relaxing poses that perfectly match your lofi beats. Whether she’s studying by a window or sipping a warm cup of tea, her calming presence enhances your space, creating the ultimate backdrop for unwinding. Set the mood with new, dreamy aesthetics and let this companion elevate your lofi journey to new levels of relaxation.

70050000053440.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: Dreamy Girl Beats
70050000053440.intro: Escape into Serenity with new beats
70050000053440.description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate relaxation with the Dreamy Girl Beats DLC for Lofi Chill Sessions. This expansion brings a collection of soothing, melodic tracks featuring an enchanting anime-inspired girl character, perfect for setting the mood while you study, work, or unwind. With calming rhythms, gentle melodies, and a dreamy aesthetic, these beats are designed to transport you to a peaceful world where focus and relaxation go hand in hand. Unlock new tracks, exclusive animations, and a serene atmosphere to make your Lofi Chill Sessions even more magical.

70050000053441.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: Decor Anime Girl Collection
70050000053441.description: Enhance your Lofi Chill Sessions experience with the Decor Anime Girl Collection DLC! This expansion adds a stunning selection of anime-inspired décor elements, allowing you to customize your virtual space with charming, dreamy characters. From cozy rooms to relaxing outdoor scenes, each piece of décor brings a touch of tranquility and aesthetic beauty. Whether you're studying, working, or simply unwinding, create the perfect environment to match your mood with exclusive anime girl designs. Let your surroundings inspire focus and relaxation, making every session a visual and auditory escape.

70050000053442.name: Candivity: North Pole DLC
70050000053442.intro: Merge your way through the sweetest holiday adventure!
70050000053442.description:
Dive into a winter wonderland where merging holiday-themed treats leads to enchanting surprises!

With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- A new North Pole map, with brand new christmas ornaments to merge!
- 5 cute reindeer characters in various colors, spreading holiday cheer!
- 3 festive hats to customize your character: Santa's hat, an elf hat, and reindeer antlers.
- 6 special holiday accessories including a reindeer nose, Santa’s beard, a gift sack, and more!

Join the holiday fun, score big, and discover the magic of merging!

70050000053444.name: Car Parking: Ultimate Riders
70050000053444.intro: Two New Drivers, Twice the Challenge - Are You Ready to Park Like a Pro?
70050000053444.description: Get ready to rev up your engines and meet two new expert drivers in Car Parking: Ultimate Riders! With fresh challenges, unique skills, and a whole new level of parking precision, these two new characters are here to push your parking skills to the limit. Navigate tricky new parking zones, dodge obstacles, and master the art of tight parking with the dynamic duo. Are you ready to rise to the challenge?

70050000053445.name: Car Parking: Money Rush
70050000053445.description: Get ready to turbocharge your earnings in Car Parking: Money Rush! This exciting DLC unlocks a brand new way to boost your coin collection as you conquer even more challenging parking scenarios. With each successful park, you'll rack up extra coins to unlock new cars, customization options, and upgrades. The faster you park, the more you earn—so get in the driver’s seat, hit the accelerator, and cash in on your parking skills. Ready to turn your parking mastery into a fortune? The rush is on!

70050000053450.name: UNPACKING: HAUNTING LOCATIONS
70050000053450.intro: Unpack the past... but beware what lies within.
70050000053450.description:
Step into the shadows with "Unpacking: Haunting Locations," the chilling new DLC that invites you to uncover the dark secrets hidden within eerie, forgotten places. Explore a variety of spooky environments—from abandoned mansions to haunted attics—and unpack unsettling objects that tell stories of the past. Each item you reveal brings you closer to the haunting mysteries that lurk beneath the surface. Will you brave the eerie silence and unravel the secrets of these cursed spaces, or will the fear be too much to bear?

This DLC is perfect for those who love a spine-tingling twist on the unpacking experience—where every box opened could hold a new scare.

70050000053451.name: UNPACKING: CHILL MUSIC PACK
70050000053451.intro: Relax, unpack, and let the soothing beats set the mood.
70050000053451.description:
Set the perfect vibe for your unpacking journey with the Chill Music Pack! Immerse yourself in a relaxing soundtrack of mellow beats and smooth melodies, designed to enhance your unpacking experience. Whether you're carefully placing items in a cozy new home or simply enjoying the act of discovery, this soothing music will help you unwind and enjoy every moment. With a variety of calming tracks to choose from, it's the ideal companion for those who love to unpack at their own pace and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of their surroundings.

This DLC pack offers the perfect backdrop for a more serene, laid-back unpacking experience. Let the music guide you through every box and every new space.

70050000053454.name: The Stone of Madness Special Edition content
70050000053454.description:
Take a deep dive into the amazing art and music of The Stone of Madness with the Special Edition!
The Stone of Madness Special Edition includes:
- Digital Artbook
- Original Soundtrack

Bring the spirit of the past to life in a modern twist with Retro Fits. Whether it's '70s chic or '80s glam, this expansion is your ticket to a stylish journey through fashion history.

Bring the joy of painting to Funko Fusion with the iconic artist and pop culture icon Bob Ross!

The Bob Ross Pack introduces everyone’s favourite artist to Funko Fusion and contains:

70050000053587.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam
70050000053587.intro: Casey Jones joins the fight in this fast-paced, action-packed DLC! Battle through the Junkyard, face new enemies and bosses, and collect new powerful artifacts.
70050000053587.description:
CASEY JONES, OFF THE BENCH!
The Turtles can use all the help they can get as they go up against Shredder and try to get their father back. Thankfully, their friend and fellow vigilante Casey Jones is always ready to pick up his hockey stick and do some damage. What's more, he happens to know a shortcut to the rooftops of NYC! Strangely, their path takes them straight through the Junkyards and Punk Frog turf. Could this have anything to do with Casey’s missing ride?

What Casey lacks in finesse he more than makes up for in raw power. His Slapshot becomes the first ranged attack in the game, taking down punks left and right.

WELCOME TO THE JUNKYARD
After defeating Karai, you have your choice to enter the Streets, or try your luck in the Junkyard. The Junkyard brings an all new narrative starring Casey, the Punk Frogs, their mechanic, Gigi, and a surprise Punk Frog encore.

While a junkyard wouldn’t normally feel homey, the Punk Frogs have settled in and made it their own. The warmth from the blazing barrel fires, the completely non-toxic pools of water, the artistry of Frog graffiti peppering the landscape. What could be better?

NEW ENEMIES AND CHALLENGING BOSSES
The Punk Frogs continue to test your patience while you make your way through the Junkyard. The crafty Attila has cobbled together repurposed versions of Stockgen robots to wreak all kinds of havoc. Gigi, the vivacious toad mechanic, wields her sawblade with ferocity to make for a challenging mid-run foe. Your ultimate Junkyard challenge will be Ghenghis’ mech bot, The Junkinator, wielding every weapon the Frogs can find.

NEW WAYS TO PLAY
Earn 5 new Artifacts and explore using Casey’s inspirations, masteries, and tool across your runs with other characters! Artifacts include some helpful additions for Multiplayer runs and new ways to stun enemies. Casey’s suite of powers help him excel with Final Strikes, Guard Break, and many more surprises.

CO-OP MADNESS
Your friends don’t own Casey Jones & the Junkyard yet? No problem. Everyone can play the Junkyard in Online Play when the match host has access to it, or you can invite them over for a good old-fashioned game night couch co-op. Get your friends and family excited to share in the experience of Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam!

70050000053611.name: PowerWash Simulator - Ice Rink - Winter 2024
70050000053611.description:
Put all your plans on ice, this is no rinky-dink clean up. With the grand reopening of the Ice Rink just around the corner, and the place nothing short of a glacial grime-fest, you’re the power washer wielding hero Muckingham needs this holiday season.
Get your skates on and thaw off that power washer for the most chill clean yet. Peel back the muck with each swipe of high-pressure water and shed a year’s worth of messes to unwrap a wondrous winter wonderland beneath, giving Muckingham’s townsfolk the gift of their favourite festive pastime. 
Yuletide cheer and cosy cleaning await, under a magical aurora-mottled sky, spangled with gnome constellations that sparkle like the twinkliest of fairy lights - don’t worry, there are plenty of those too! The Ice Rink is also home to some cute animal mascots, that have been perfectly crafted for maximum heart-melting with minimal ice-melting.
Dress for the occasion with all-new gifted garments, from us to you. Snuggle up in a suave snowflake suit and deck out your power washer in a new candy-cane themed cosmetic, for minty fresh cleaning!
About PowerWash Simulator’s Seasonal Specials 
PowerWash Simulator’s Seasonal Specials is a series of free content updates containing a single map themed around a season or holiday – after all, cleaning isn’t just for Spring!

70050000053621.name: Pinball FX - Indiana Jones™: The Pinball Adventure
70050000053621.description:
Relive iconic scenes from the movies in Indiana Jones: The Pinball Adventure, the 1993 Williams classic.

Features:
- Indiana Jones: The Pinball Adventure combines a fan-favorite Williams machine with everyone’s favorite adventurer – enjoy the original music, sounds, rules, and look of the machine brought to the digital space for the first time.
- Relive the most iconic movie scenes like the escape from Castle Brunwald, the Rope Bridge standoff, and finding Marion on the Streets of Cairo.
- Experience the table just as you remember it, with true-to-life Pro Physics simulation, only found in Zen’s Pinball tables.
- Enjoy the table in a new way with extra 3D effects in the ‘Enhanced’ version that includes side wall art, ball trailer effects, particle effects and a whip-wielding Indiana Jones.
- Play at home, with friends, or compete online with Single Player, Local Multi-Player, Challenge, and Tournament Modes.

70050000053622.name: Pinball FX - Williams Pinball Volume 4
70050000053622.description:
This stunning collection of three authentic Williams™ tables includes WHITE WATER™, RED AND TED'S ROAD SHOW™, and HURRICANE™. All available to play both in their classic original form and as remastered tables with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features.

- WHITE WATER: Ride the Spine Chiller down Insanity Falls, returning via the Boomerang Bend and passing through Big Foot's Cave. Just go with the flow!
- RED AND TED'S ROAD SHOW: Wreck roads across the U.S., from sea to shining sea. Make it to the California and visit up to 18 great American cities!
- HURRICANE: With all the thrills and chills of an amusement park, this table dazzles the crowd from pie-in-the-face antics and scoring hoopla to the revolving backglass wheel!

70050000053623.name: Pinball FX - Williams Pinball Volume 5
70050000053623.description:
This stunning collection of three authentic Williams™ and Bally™ tables includes TALES OF THE ARABIAN NIGHTS™, CIRQUS VOLTAIRE™, and NO GOOD GOFERS™. All available to play both in their classic original form and as remastered tables with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features.

- TALES OF THE ARABIAN NIGHTS: Your wish is granted. Ride the magic carpet, bash the evil genie, rub Aladdin's wonderful lamp, and rescue the princess! 
- CIRQUS VOLTAIRE: Battle the crazed ringmaster, hit the oversized Menagerie ball, fire the cannon, and pump up the high-voltage BOOM balloon. Electrifying excitement!
- NO GOOD GOFERS: Hit a hole-in-one with the innovative Slam Ramp™, get a Spinning Whirlwheel™ award, play golf, and battle Buzz and Bud, the cheeky gofers. You'll really go'fer this one!

70050000053624.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 6
70050000053624.description:
This stunning collection of three authentic Williams™ and Bally™ tables includes FUNHOUSE™, SPACE STATION™, and DR. DUDE AND HIS EXCELLENT RAY™. All available to play both in their classic original form and as remastered tables with updated graphics, animated toys, and a host of new features.

- FUNHOUSE: Starring Rudy, pinball's most iconic ventriloquist dummy antagonist! Don't let his relentless taunting get to you.
- SPACE STATION: Prepare for liftoff. We have ignition. It's time to launch this classic.
- DR. DUDE AND HIS EXCELLENT RAY™: Drop in to Dr. Dude's Kinetic Clinic! Get hip! Earn respect! Be the envy of your friends! Advance the DUDE-O-METER from Plain Dude to Super Dude for the ultimate dude-o-riffic reward. Way cool pinball has finally arrived!

70050000053625.name: Pinball FX - Williams Pinball: Whirlwind™
70050000053625.description:
Storm Alert! Blow away the highest scores on Williams Pinball: Whirlwind™ while battling the elements and capturing the wonders of our powerful nature.

Table features:

- Shoot the left ramp for a progressive Million Plus multiball reward
- Survive the havoc of the three spinning discs
- Collect points with 6 (!) power-packed jet bumpers
- Enter the Super Cellar for an incredible Mega-Door Bonus
- Sound the siren with a precise 3-Way Combo

70050000053626.name: Pinball FX - Swords of Fury™
70050000053626.description:
Unleash the fury of this 1988 solid state classic! Join the legendary Lion Man and prove your might! All in a world of sword and sorcery full of heroes, villains, and mythical monsters.

Table features: 

- Adventure through the Ogres Alley, but be cautious -- it might cost you
- Collect the AVENGER targets, then shoot the ramp for big scores and an extra ball
- Brave the Titan Tunnel to lock balls and start multiball
- Once you reach 2 million, your skills will be greatly tested as the table adapts in difficulty
- Battle foes on the mini-playfield for a big jackpot
- Enjoy one of the best soundtracks in pinball history

70050000053627.name: Cat MeowMart: Cash Boost
70050000053627.description: Need a little extra kitty cash to take your Cat MeowMart to the next level? The Cash Boost DLC is here to help you supercharge your profits and grow your supermarket empire with extra 6000 coins! Unlock new ways to earn, manage, and maximize your store’s revenue with fresh cash-infusion features, exclusive promotions, and powerful upgrades. With this DLC, you'll have everything you need to boost your bottom line and leave your competition in the dust!

70050000053628.name: Cat MeowMart: New License

With more room to grow, you’ll be able to expand your inventory, manage demand more effectively, and ensure your customers never leave empty-handed.

70050000053630.name: Cat MeowMart: Christmas Mood

Transform your store and the surrounding city into a winter wonderland filled with holiday cheer. Deck the halls with sparkling lights, snowy decorations, and seasonal touches that will attract more customers and boost sales. The holiday season is the perfect time to bring in new shoppers and create a warm, cozy atmosphere that keeps everyone coming back for more!

70050000053631.name: All-Star Vinyl Vibes: Coin Flip

70050000053632.name: All-Star Vinyl Vibes: Storage Pack
70050000053632.intro: Expand Your Collection, Amplify the Groove!
70050000053632.description: Take your vinyl obsession to the next level with the Storage Pack! Organize, expand, and showcase your growing collection of tracks and accessories like never before. With sleek new storage solutions and customization options, your setup will be as stylish as your performances.

70050000053633.name: All-Star Vinyl Vibes: License Star
70050000053633.intro: Spin the hits, own the Stage!
70050000053633.description: Unleash your inner superstar with the All-Star Vinyl Vibes DLC! Step into a world of retro glam and musical mastery as you license chart-topping tracks and build your stardom. Featuring a curated collection of vibrant vinyl aesthetics, exclusive outfits, and electrifying stage designs, this DLC lets you take center stage like never before.

Life finds a way. And now Dr. Ian Malcolm from Jurassic World finds his way into Funko Fusion!

Whether you're battling in the dusty plains or defending the saloon, these new characters add extra firepower and personality to your team. Saddle up and take on the apocalypse together!

70050000053646.name: Cowboys vs Zombies: Killer Guns
70050000053646.description: Arm yourself with unstoppable firepower in the Killer Guns DLC! This pack introduces two powerful new weapons to help you take down the undead hordes with style and precision. Whether you're fending off zombies at the saloon or clearing out the dusty trails, these guns are the perfect addition to your arsenal. Gear up, take aim, and show the apocalypse who’s boss!

70050000053771.name: Tavern Talk: Tempest Tantrum
70050000053771.intro: Over a year after the events of Tavern Talk, young detective Melina is on a mission to capture the chaotic spirit she accidentally unleashed upon the world.
70050000053771.description:
What to Expect:
- A fresh adventure that takes place after the events of Tavern Talk 
- A new character
- A new recipe & infusion
- 3+ hours of new content
- Branching narratives
- Multiple endings
- Meet a new familiar: Dindi! 

Welcome back, Innkeep! 
Have you been wondering about what happened after you saved the world? How’s life in Asteria now that the dust has settled?

One and a half years after the events of Tavern Talk, young detective Melina finds a mysterious mechanism and breaks it, accidentally unleashing the chaotic spirit trapped inside. Melina and her friends must now race to fix the ancient apparatus, recapture the spirit, and stop a Primordial storm from causing devastating damage.

Meet Oleander Verifina! 
Introducing Fable’s long suffering brother, the chronically overworked ranger of the Ashen Grove. Oleander wants nothing to do with any dangerous exploits, but fate has other ideas... Let's show him the best hospitality the Wayfarer’s Inn has to offer!

Discover a new recipe & infusion! 
A new story brings a fresh breeze! Surf the turbulent waves of the tempest with the slightly frothy Ocean Fizz, and light up your mixtures with some Luminous Algae!

Multiple Endings 
Tempest Tantrum adds roughly three hours of new story to your first playthrough. It also includes four unique endings and three individual quests.

70050000053775.name: Wingspan: Asia Expansion
70050000053775.intro: Discover birdlife of the East in Wingspan: Asia Expansion! New challenges await!
70050000053775.description:
Wingspan Digital has arrived on a new continent. Discover the mysterious, diverse birds of the East along with their enchanting world in Wingspan: Asia Expansion. Here you’ll encounter new birds and bonus cards, expand your collection of backgrounds and portraits with new ones inspired by the region, and have the opportunity to play in an all-new mode that will bring a breath of fresh air and even more variety to your games.

Journey for Two: Duet Mode
Wingspan: Asia Expansion introduces a brand-new Duet Mode, where you compete with one other player for additional points using a special Duet Map. To come out on top, travel across the map, claim different habitat spaces with Duet Tokens, and achieve new end-of-round goals specific to this exciting head-to-head mode.

New Expansion – New Cards
As with every new addition, Wingspan: Asia Expansion comes with a collection of new birds to your game. Expand your atlas with region-specific species, discover fun facts about them, and learn to recognize their calls.

Besides the 90 new fascinating bird cards, there are also 13 new bonus cards - including two designed for Automa mode - which will diversify your games and, when used well, play a crucial role in your victories.

A Visual and Auditory Feast
Wingspan: Asia Expansion treats your eyes to a feast with 4 new digitally painted backgrounds inspired by breathtaking landscapes of the East. There are also 8 player portraits associated with local cultures to help you feel the continent's wondrous aura.

The soundscape hasn’t been forgotten either. Paweł Górniak, the composer behind the music for Wingspan, has created 4 soothing, relaxing musical tracks that will make your gameplay experience as relaxing as ever.
 
Enjoy All the Features of the Base Game
Wingspan: Asia Expansion keeps all the features available in the base version of the game. Play with both your flock and strangers in cross-platform multiplayer mode, test your skills in weekly challenges, and play against the demanding Automa.

The magical landscapes of Asia and its extraordinary avifauna await you.

70050000053893.name: Dungeons 4 - Not Another Multiverse
70050000053893.intro: In Dungeons 4 – Not Another Multiverse Tristan opens a gate… and all hell breaks loose.
70050000053893.description:
On his search for aid against Evil (HA!), this silly fool of a stepbrother stumbled across the Murky Portal and opened it (d’oh). Tristan and Thalya are thrown into yet another multiverse and Thalya makes an astounding discovery: The demonic and hordic inhabitants hate them BOTH. There is only one way out of this – and it’s by joining the forces of Evil and Good to find a way back into your own world where there’s still the natural order of things. Go on, brave heroes…uhm… evil minions… Whatever! Get us out of here!

• When Evil fights Evil and joins forces with Good, is Good being Evil? You can revel in this philosophical question while, for the first time in the series’ history, in Dungeons 4 – Not Another Multiverse you control Tristan, his spells and his hero minions to venture against a common adversary, who is somehow even MORE evil than Thalya. WHAT?

• A Multiverse Right at your Partly-Evil Fingertips: A new mini-campaign, spanning 3 new and fully-voiced missions leading you through the challenges of a new multiverse while working together with the pesky stepbrother of Thalya.

• Leave a new mark on the Overworld: With your freshly formed – and still bizarre, I care to add – bond, you are now able to build 15 hero buildings on the Overworld, where you can recruit and upgrade heroes to strengthen your Army of Good (did I really write this? Yuck).

• Skirmish Time: Train your freshly acquired “Team Good” skills and find out how to really work and slay together in a brand-new skirmish map “Dynamic Sibling Duo”.

• Blend in with the Good! To blend into the hero community (again, this is born out of pure necessity, we are forced to emphasize) Thalya gets a new, heroic (blurgh) outfit.

70050000053898.name: Forgotten Skin (Aquarion)
70050000053898.intro: The Forgotten can befriend swampy fauna, build structures on the water, create giant squids, ride crocodiles, tame toads and swim effortlessly!
70050000053898.description:
Aquarion Skin

A lone Aquarion outpost in the Ritiki Marshlands lost contact when the Aquarion Empire sank beneath the waves long ago. Believing themselves to be the last of their kind, the forgotten outpost attempted to carry out the Aquarion mission - monitor their land-dwelling siblings from afar and step in if a large-scale conflict erupted. It's been centuries since then, and the outpost has developed quite differently from their parent empire, befriending the swampy fauna and adapting to their environment in new and interesting ways. 

The Forgotten can befriend swampy fauna, build structures on the water, create giant squids, ride crocodiles, tame toads and swim effortlessly in their marshy terrain.
