70050000054003.description:
A set of items to make your sinner life more comfortable. 

Includes:
1. Lv4 Weapon Set

70050000054010.name: Bright Side: Quiz - Watch & Learn DLC
70050000054010.intro: Learn more about our planet with earth-themed videos!
70050000054010.description:
More of a visual learner? Put your memory to the test with questions about planet earth!

With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- 10 new earth-themed Watch & Learn videos

Prepare your eyes for amazing facts about our home!

70050000054032.name: Puzzle Pack 1
70050000054032.intro: Discover a piece of the forest with themed puzzles in the new Little Mouse's Encyclopedia DLC.
70050000054032.description: Select one of eight new puzzles featuring various species of animals, birds, and insects in 3 levels of difficulty.

70050000054033.name: Kuzunoha Village Trainings
70050000054033.description:
The first return to the village after becoming Raidou Kuzunoha XIV. 

Additional downloadable content featuring a set of three trainings designed for players who wish to "save time" when grinding for EXP, in-game currency, and stat increases.

- "Kuzunoha Village Trainings: Power" grants experience for Raidou and his demons. 
- "Kuzunoha Village Trainings: Wealth" grants "Yen" (in-game currency). 
- "Kuzunoha Village Trainings: Indulgences" grants Incense (increases the stats of Raidou and his demons) and Sake (increases the loyalty of your demons). 

*All of the above DLC can be used once access to the "Nameless Shrine" is unlocked. 
*For further information on their use, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal .

70050000054034.name: Demons of the Aril Rift
70050000054034.description:
Defeat demons to earn special items.

Additional downloadable content that grants a special book upon completing exclusive trials.

4 special Aril Rifts that trigger the "Trial of a Hundred Demons", will be added to the in-game "Training Hall".

1. Upon completion of "Trial of a Hundred Demons - Formation" you will receive a "Book of Lucky Capote".
2. Upon completion of "Trial of a Hundred Demons - Existence" you will receive a "Book of Mage's Craft".
3. Upon completion of "Trial of a Hundred Demons - Destruction" you will receive a "Book of Hero's Might".
4. Upon completion of "Trial of a Hundred Demons - Nothingness" you will receive a "Book of Destructive Joy".

*These trials can be challenged after starting Episode 3 and onwards. 
*For further information on their use, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal .

70050000054035.name: Guest Demons Pack
70050000054035.description:
Popular demons from the Shin Megami Tensei series have been added in this remaster!

Additional downloadable content that allows the players to recruit these demons as their allies.

The following six demons are included:
- Pyro Order: Fionn mac Cumhaill
- Frost Order: Artemis
- Volt Order: Zeus
- Wind Order: Huang Long
- Fury Order: Gozuki
- Fury Order: Mezuki

*Any of these demons can be recruited once access to the Goumaden is unlocked.
*For further information on how to recruit demons, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal.

70050000054036.name: Skill Book Pack
70050000054036.description:
Forbidden books that grant special abilites. 

Additional downloadable content that includes a pack of special skill books, which allows demons to learn high-tier skills. Recommended for those who want to “save time” enhancing their demons.

The following special skill books are included: 

- Book of Agidyne x1
- Book of Bufudyne x1
- Book of Ziodyne x1
- Book of Zandyne x 1
- Book of Tarukajaon x1
- Book of Makakajaon x1
- Book of Rakukajaon ×1
- Book of Diarahan ×1
- Book of Media ×1
- Book of State of Bliss ×1
- Book of Samarecarm ×1

*These special skill books can be obtained in-game without purchasing this additional content.
*For further information on how to utilize this DLC, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal .

70050000054037.name: Survival Pack
70050000054037.description:
Perfect preparation against powerful enemies. 

Additional downloadable content that is recommended for preparing before battle with strong opponents. 

The following items are included: 

- Renki x 2 (essential crafting material in Sword Alchemy)
- Balm of Life x 9 (revives Raidou after falling in battle)
- Survival Erudition x 10  (automatically revives Raidou once with full HP)

*Renki and Balm of Life can be obtained in-game without purchasing this DLC.
*Survival Erudition is only available as DLC. This item cannot be used in the "Sleuth" difficulty level, as Raidou and his demons cannot not die in this difficulty. 
*For further information on how to utilize these items, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal.

70050000054038.name: Demonic Designations: Summoner Titles
70050000054038.description:
Additional downloadable content that adds 10 more fan-voted titles for Raidou. 

*This content will be available once the player is able to manually change their title in-game by reaching the required rank. 
*For further information on how to change titles, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal. 
*Titles included in this DLC vary by language.

70050000054039.name: A Special Briefing
70050000054039.description:
The Ultimate Spoiler from Gouto, Raidou's Mentor

The ultimate spoiler about who the real culprit is will be added to the Detective Journal. 
It is not recommended to view this if you haven't completed the main game yet...

*This DLC can be used after the Detective Journal is unlocked in the game. 
*For further information on details added to the Detective Journal, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal.

70050000054040.name: Raidou Glasses
70050000054040.description:
As a special pre-order bonus, receive the cosmetic Raidou Glasses. With these glasses that were popular in the Taisho Era, his charm will increase beyond what one can handle.

*Pre-Order incentive available before 21:00 PDT time Wednesday, June 18, 2025.

70050000054050.name: Survival Pack Light Gear
70050000054050.description:
A set packed with our gratitude. 

To thank players for their continued support, we are offering useful in-game strategy tools for free: 

- Soma x 2 (fully restores Raidou's HP and MAG)
- Survival Erudition x 5 (automatically revives Raidou once with full HP). 

*Soma can be obtained in-game without purchasing this DLC. 
*Survival Erudition is only available as DLC. This item cannot be used in the "Sleuth" difficulty level, as Raidou and his demons cannot not die in this difficulty. 
*For further information on how to utilize these items, please see "How to Use Downloadable Content" in the in-game Detective Journal.

70050000054051.name: Dole Logo Sticker Ball
70050000054051.description:
A special ball decorated with the Dole logo!

This product adds the Dole Logo Sticker Ball as a DLC add-on to Super Monkey Ball Banana Rumble.

70050000054053.name: Puzzle Pack 2
70050000054053.intro: Discover a piece of the forest with themed puzzles in the new Little Mouse's Encyclopedia DLC.
70050000054053.description: Select one of eight new puzzles featuring various species of animals, birds, and insects in 3 levels of difficulty.

70050000054062.name: Sky Diving: Backpack Customization
70050000054062.intro: Style Your Gear, Rule the Skies!
70050000054062.description:
Sky Diving: Backpack Customization DLC lets you take your skydiving experience to the next level with brand-new ways to personalize your gear. Stand out in the skies with two exciting new backpack designs:

The Falcon Glide: Sleek, aerodynamic, and inspired by the agility of a falcon, this backpack combines style and performance for those who crave the ultimate edge.
The Solar Flare: Bright, bold, and blazing with fiery patterns, this backpack is perfect for divers who want to make a statement in mid-air.
Unlock these stunning designs and mix them with your favorite gear to create the perfect look for your dives. Whether you aim to soar with elegance or burst through the clouds in fiery flair, the choice is yours.

Get ready to dive in style!

70050000054063.name: Sky Diving: Cash Flight
70050000054063.intro: Dive, Earn, and Soar to Riches!
70050000054063.description:
Sky Diving: Cash Flight DLC takes your skydiving adventure to new heights with a chance to earn big! Jump into action and complete thrilling dives to earn up to 50,000 coins.

Take on challenging missions, conquer daring stunts, and explore exciting new locations while collecting coins that will boost your progress. Spend your hard-earned rewards on new gear, customization options, and upgrades to enhance your skydiving experience.

Ready to dive into the money-making rush? The skies are full of opportunities – and wealth!

70050000054065.name: Official Soundtrack
70050000054065.intro: Explore the Tower, meet its strange inhabitants, collect alchemical treasures, and discover twists around every corner.
70050000054065.description: Enjoy an incredible soundtrack with the new in-game music player, featuring 48 tracks.

70050000054067.name: ToyBox Christmas: Festive Fittings
70050000054067.description: Test your skills with a new level pack for ToyBox Christmas! See if you can put away all the Christmas toys with over 20 new toys and 40 levels to complete.

70050000054091.name: Beagle Training Pack
70050000054091.description: Bring the playful and curious Beagle to your Cute Puppy Academy! Train, nurture, and enjoy new adventures with this beloved breed in your growing puppy collection!

70050000054129.description: Unlocks “Bonus Story: Parallel Siblings”! Clear the story to add Castile the Chroma and Walnut from Phantom Brave to your party!

70050000054134.name: Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - Bonus Story: The Rat Who Demons Fear
70050000054134.description: Unlocks “Bonus Story: The Rat Who Demons Fear”! Clear the story to add Mad Rat & Heart from Mad Rat Dead to your party!

70050000054152.name: BlazeRush: Star Track DLC
70050000054152.description:
BlazeRush: Star Track is a dynamic arcade survival racing game in a new space-themed setting. Here you can gather a team of friends, playing in local or online multiplayer. Choose a car to your taste and chase, blow up and cut your opponents off — welcome to the world of racing and frantic fun!
 
The update features:
- A campaign that includes 30 missions
- New type of vehicles — spaceships 
- New types of weapons: laser, mines and chain lightning 
- Special space-themed race track for multiplayer 
- New powerful enemy — a massive spaceship

This content requires the base game ""BlazeRush"" in order to play.

70050000054154.name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals - Scenario "Prisoners of the Battles"
70050000054154.intro: Adventurers! Prove your worth by overcoming challenges and secure a future for the kingdom!
70050000054154.description:
Previously released on other platforms, Wizardry Gaiden: Prisoners of the Battles is now available as DLC for Wizardry: The Five Ordeals with some improved. Enjoy this classic adventure reimagined!

*The scenario to be played can be changed by selecting "STORY SELECT" on the title screen.
*After purchasing the item, you will be able to start scenario from the "Additional Scenario" item in "STORY SELECT".

- Three different labyrinths, and a bonus hard labyrinth with a roguelike flavor in a single scenario. (and more...?)
- Nearly 40 total floors
- Treasure hunting element that incorporates a random property system and each enchanted item as unique.
- Many balance adjustments from the 2006, plus new events and more.

70050000054158.name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals - Scenario "The Absence of Misericordia"
70050000054158.intro: Seeking relics that will bring spring in a never-ending winter.
70050000054158.description:
This DLC adds a new scenario "The Absence of Misericordia" to "Wizardry: The Five Ordeals".


*The scenario to be played can be changed by selecting "STORY SELECT" on the title screen.
*After purchasing the item, you will be able to start scenario from the "Additional Scenario" item in "STORY SELECT".

- A compact yet challenging traditional labyrinthine exploration in a single labyrinth of less than 10 floors, including a new look that differs from the "Prison of the Battles".
- Treasure hunting with a fixed item system instead of a random property item system.

70050000054163.name: Spy Guy Roma
70050000054163.intro: Go on a journey to Ancient Rome!
70050000054163.description: Meet Julius Caesar, find a calendar card on March 17, attend a Roman feast, or get a sneak peek at Leonardo da Vinci painting the Mona Lisa. Spy Guy Roma is another installment of the Spy Guy Hidden Objects game-this time the map of Ancient Rome will thrill you with 120 levels full of fascinating ancient hidden objects.

70050000054166.name: Atelier Yumia - Limited Photo Poses and Frames
70050000054166.intro: Enjoy photo mode even more with additional poses and frames!
70050000054166.description:
Includes poses and frames which can be used in photo mode.

List of Contents:
- Five photo poses
- Three photo frames

Note: 
This product has been previously available as a bonus.
Photo mode is available after base building has been unlocked.

70050000054168.name: "Athlete of Memories" Costume for Yumia
70050000054168.intro: Run around the open field with this sportswear!
70050000054168.description:
This early purchase bonus can be claimed up through June 23rd, 2026. The contents of this early purchase bonus are the same as the early purchase bonus released for Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land in March of 2025. Players who have already received these items will not be able to receive duplicates of them.


Adds the "Athlete of Memories" costume for Yumia.

Note: This content may become available for purchase or for free separately at a later date. Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room. This costume is included in the "Atelier Yumia - Aladiss Investigation Preparation Set." Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000054170.name: "Floating Object of Memories" Costume for Flammi
70050000054170.intro: Flammi cheers on Yumia while wearing a headband!
70050000054170.description:
This early purchase bonus can be claimed up through June 23rd, 2026. The contents of this early purchase bonus are the same as the early purchase bonus released for Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land in March of 2025. Players who have already received these items will not be able to receive duplicates of them.


Adds the "Floating Object of Memories" costume for Flammi.

Note: This content may become available for purchase or for free separately at a later date. Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room. This costume is included in the "Atelier Yumia - Aladiss Investigation Preparation Set." Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000054172.name: Exclusive Equipment "Training Wrist Weight"
70050000054172.intro: A useful accessory for your investigation!
70050000054172.description:
This early purchase bonus can be claimed up through June 23rd, 2026. The contents of this early purchase bonus are the same as the early purchase bonus released for Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land in March of 2025. Players who have already received these items will not be able to receive duplicates of them.


Includes three "Training Wrist Weight" accessories and the recipe for Training Wrist Weights. Training Wrist Weights increase the experience gained from defeating monsters by 3% while equipped.

Note: This content may become available for purchase or for free separately at a later date. Accessories can be checked from the container, and recipes can be checked after unlocking synthesis. This content is included in the "Atelier Yumia - Aladiss Investigation Preparation Set." Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000054175.name: Atelier Yumia - Colorful Collection
70050000054175.intro: A set of costume palette changes and the "Puni Badge" accessory.
70050000054175.description:
Costume palette changes for Yumia, Flammi, Viktor, Isla, Rutger, Nina, and Lenja (2 for each character, 14 total), three "Puni Badge" accessories, and the recipe for Puni Badges. While equipped, Puni Badges increase the experience gained from defeating Puni-type monsters by 50% and guarantee that they will drop items.

List of Contents:
- Exclusive Equipment "Puni Badge"
- "Bright Snow" Costume for Yumia
- "Isla Orange" Costume for Yumia
- "Sphere" Costume for Flammi
- "Tripod" Costume for Flammi
- "Shadow Knight" Costume for Viktor
- "Golden Soldier" Costume for Viktor
- "Mana Aqua" Costume for Isla
- "Yumia Navy" Costume for Isla
- "Meteor Fire" Costume for Rutger
- "Pure Soul" Costume for Rutger
- "Corundum Purple" Costume for Nina
- "Silver Hunter" Costume for Nina
- "Natural Leaf" Costume for Lenja
- "Mystic Eye" Costume for Lenja

Note:
- Accessories can be checked from the container, and recipes can be checked after unlocking synthesis. Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room (the relevant characters must also have joined your party).
- The contents of this set are included in the "Digital Deluxe Edition" and "Ultimate Edition" versions of the game.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000054177.name: "Black Rose Magician" Costume for Yumia
70050000054177.intro: A gothic dress costume for a slightly unique investigation.
70050000054177.description:

Note: Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room. This costume is bonus content included in the "Ultimate Edition" version of the game. Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000054179.name: Atelier Yumia - Additional Hair Color Set
70050000054179.intro: Change up the mood with a different hair color.
70050000054179.description:

List of Contents:
- Palette Change "White Lily"
- Palette Change "Sun Gold"
- Palette Change "Wine Red"
- Palette Change "Deep Blue"
- Palette Change "Forest Green"

Note: Hair color changes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room (the relevant characters must also have joined your party). This is included as bonus content in the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000054181.name: "Waterside Alchemist" Costume for Yumia
70050000054181.description:
Adds the "Waterside Alchemist" costume for Yumia.

Note:
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room.
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70050000054221.name: Christmas Tree: Magic Music Pack
70050000054221.intro: Fill the air with festive tunes and holiday cheer!
70050000054221.description: Get into the holiday spirit with the Christmas Tree: Magic Music Pack! This DLC adds a collection of classic Christmas songs and cheerful melodies to enhance your decorating experience. From jolly jingles to peaceful winter tunes, the perfect soundtrack accompanies your tree decorating session. Set the mood, spread the joy, and make your holiday season even more magical with festive music that brings warmth and cheer to every corner!

70050000054227.name: Christmas Tree: New Gifts and Decor
70050000054227.intro: Unwrap joy and sparkle up your tree!
70050000054227.description: Take your holiday decorating to the next level with the New Gifts and Decor DLC! This festive pack brings an array of sparkling ornaments, dazzling lights, and beautifully wrapped presents to make your tree truly magical. Create the ultimate Christmas atmosphere with brand-new decorative items and delightful gifts to place under the tree. Whether you're aiming for elegance, coziness, or pure holiday magic, this pack has everything you need to spread cheer and celebrate the season in style!

70050000054231.name: Lil Gator Game: In the Dark
70050000054231.intro: The world just got a whole lot bigger for this Lil Gator!
70050000054231.description:
Make way for Lil Gator Game: In the Dark. Lil Gator is back with an all new BIG DLC Expansion, doubling the size of Lil Gator Game.
In this charming DLC you’ll find that new adventures and friends are just beneath the surface—literally! Get ready to “cave in” to the fun and find that you’re stalag-right where you belong!

This BIG DLC is filled to the brim with all the charm and humour you loved in Lil Gator Game. There is a buddy in every cave and crevasse in this NEW, BIG, UNDERGROUND ADVENTURE!

A Gorge-eous location
Getting to the caves is as easy as following your nose. In the base game’s island, you’ll stumble upon a lil’ entrance that’s been there all along, to take you below ground.

Wander a beautiful cave network where glowsticks light your path and cozy tunnels host hidden nooks and crannies filled with cute critters, secret treasures, and places to relax and take in the peaceful atmosphere.

All new friends to discover
On your travels you’ll meet a bunch of new pals! But remember making new friends isn’t always easy, you just might need to complete a quest or two! 

Face your frenemies
In a narrative twist, Lil Gator will take on some teenage troublemakers looking to disrupt the wholesome fun. Can Gator use their relentless optimism to bring these angsty adolescents onside, and just who is their leader?

Bring on the brand new gear
This DLC has all sorts of new toys to play with, including never before seen item types. Lil Gator can now double jump their way across canyons with a flick of a gymnastic ribbon and slams into cardboard crooks from above.

Embark on an expedition of family friendly fun in this cosy conclusion to Lil Gator’s Epic Adventure.

70050000054234.name: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator - So Many Ducks
70050000054234.intro: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator - So Many Ducks brings 27 additional ducks to the pool! Each of them is a brand-new duck you have never met, with a unique personality.
70050000054234.description:
So Many Ducks brings 27 additional ducks to the pool! Each of them is a brand-new duck you have never met, with a unique personality and, in some cases, new interactions.

70050000054238.name: Artifact Seeker - DLC 1: The Legacy of Mortia
70050000054238.description:
Mortia, once the glory of the dwarven kingdom, birthed countless legendary master craftsmen. However, the dwarves never knew when to stop digging. Deep within the mines of Mortia, they unearthed something that should not have been awakened. Thus, Mortia sank into an endless darkness, never to see the light of day again.
The new DLC for Artifact Seeker, “The Legacy of Mortia” is coming soon! New characters, new maps, new boss, new Synergy, new artifacts, new events, and many more new contents await everyone’s exploration!

70050000054741.name: Memories of Dusk: Lucien
70050000054741.description:
A new tale of dusk told from the perspective of the four main love interests.
Experience the main story anew with additional scenes and get a glimpse into their thoughts in these two-part stories.

Lucien has lived alongside constant rejection due to being the son of a commoner mother. His only support through the isolation was memories of a red-headed childhood friend.
The story proceeds in the following order: "Flightless Wings""→ "Withering Flower" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."

I understand that, as a prince, my life should be used for the good of Hystorica.
...Or perhaps, I never truly understood at all.
I ceased being a prince the moment I met you again.
I returned to those precious days of my childhood... all alone.


・These stories include important information concerning the main story. It is highly recommended you save reading these for after clearing the main story.
・Please update to the newest version before playing.
・These stories are included in "Memories of Dusk: Complete Set." Please take care not to purchase duplicates.

70050000054742.name: Memories of Dusk: Crius
70050000054742.description:
A new tale of dusk told from the perspective of the four main love interests.
Experience the main story anew with additional scenes and get a glimpse into their thoughts in these two-part stories.

Despite being lauded as the nation's preeminent knight, Crius harbors a void in his heart. He's put on a front of smiles so that no one could pick up on this, but the violent passions burning within Anastasia slowly but surely lead to change.
The story proceeds in the following order: "Flightless Wings" → "Withering Flower" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."

I feel nauseous at the thick churning of desire in my chest. I feel anger, hate, and above all disappointment at myself.

This is desire. Is this... who I am?


・These stories include important information concerning the main story. It is highly recommended you save reading these for after clearing the main story.
・Please update to the newest version before playing.
・These stories are included in "Memories of Dusk: Complete Set." Please take care not to purchase duplicates.

70050000054743.name: Memories of Dusk: Tyril

A new tale of dusk told from the perspective of the four main love interests.
Experience the main story anew with additional scenes and get a glimpse into their thoughts in these two-part stories.

Tyril is at times an inquisitor who hunts witches, and at others...
His life of discomfort and misfortune turns on its head when Anastasia appears as a heretofore unknown choice. What future awaits the inquisitor and the wilder of a witch's powers?
The story proceeds in the following order: "Withering Flower" → "Flightless Wings" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."

But if we'd spent more time together, and I got to know her really well, I may have fallen in love with her.
If I'm to remain me, I can't be with her anymore.

70050000054744.name: Memories of Dusk: Zenn
70050000054744.description:

Experience the main story anew with additional scenes and get a glimpse into their thoughts in these two-part stories.

Zenn suddenly realizes he's reliving the same few days over and over again and finds himself unsettled by the chain of tragedies playing out before him. He begins to suspect the witch and Anastasia are to blame...
The story proceeds in the following order: "Withering Flower" → "Flightless Wings" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."

I hate how uptight she's being about all of this. There's no reason she needs to carry that burden alone or punish herself for this. Not when not a single person is blaming her for it.
At the same time, an affection of some kind takes root in me. Her pure, earnest personality sways my heart.
(I see... This is why you guys wanted to protect her.)

70050000054801.name: Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama
70050000054801.intro: Become a Showstopper of SaGa legend in Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama
70050000054801.description:
In a universe where a single level up choice can change everything, the SaGa: Emerald Beyond characters stand shoulder to shoulder with the Vampire Survivors, united to face their next adventure together. Will the Vampire Survivors be graced by the presence of a vampire? We doubt it, but never say never. 

As the Junction opens, the Vampire Survivors are thrust into a strange system of interconnected worlds, from a wondrous enchanted witchdom to a sinister realm of bloody nightmares. Equipped with the power of Glimmers and befriended by those that understand this strange universe better than anyone, onward they step in to the unknown; united in cause, wanting to survive, and bereft of fear. Well maybe a little bit of fear. 

12+ New Characters 
An eclectic cast of bizarre SaGa protagonists join the Survivors, including: 
Tsunanori Mido - A fate-forged master of Kugutsu combat puppets. 
Ameya Aisling - An undercover witch searching for her lost magic (and cats) 
Bonnie & Formina - A duo of daring detectives who fight side-by-side with fists and firearms. 
Diva No.5 - A songstress mech forsaken for singing a forbidden melody, travelling between different worlds (and robotic bodies) to rediscover her memories. 
And Many More! - including a teacher of heroes, an Emperor unthawed, and a Dismal King with some bloodthirsty tendencies... 

16+ New Weapons & the Glimmer mechanic 
40 new ways to attack, including base weapons, evolutions, and the sensational Glimmer mechanic from the SaGa series. Whenever you attack with these weapons, there's a chance to spontaneously learn a special technique through the Glimmer system. Swords, magics, punches, and missiles: all the variety of SaGa gets represented! 
Fleuret - stab enough encroaching enemies and you'll Glimmer the Crystalline Carve, letting you freeze foes whilst cutting them down.  
Pressure Point - unleash a barrage of martial arts blows at close range to Glimmer the far-reaching fire jab Shenlong Firefist. 
Hecaton Machine Gun - shoot a blistering salvo of interestingly inaccurate bullets to Glimmer the Bombarding Fire technique, blasting baddies with a massive upheaval of the earth.  
Hyperion Bazooka - master these high-power missiles that explode as they penetrate through hordes of foes to Glimmer the Cosmic Rave to massively multiply your firepower.  

Character parties 
No JRPG DLC is complete without a squad of odd allies to pal around with. Level up Tsunanori Mido to summon up to 4 Kugutsu combat puppets, fighting independently with their own weapons in a defensive cross formation. Pick either Bonnie or Formina to play as both intrepid investigators, combining punches and pistols for a powerful partnership. And in the darkness of Yomi, rumours swirl of a Dismal King who can enthral defeated foes to make his own army of allies... 
Showstopper 
Survivors never give up! When a SaGa character reaches critical HP they fight back from the brink with a Showstopper, a brief burst of bonus Might, decreased Cooldown, and a little extra Luck to help them survive whatever precarious situation you’ve put them in with a tempest of powered-up projectiles.    

A New World-Weaving Stage 
Follow the Emerald Wave through a diorama of interwoven worlds, the perfect setting to walk sideways while mowing down masses of unusual monsters and bonkers bosses.  

Remixes of Stupendous SaGa: Emerald Beyond Tracks

70050000055193.intro: Unveil the sound of terror with The Exit: Liminal Anomaly Horror Music Pack.

This pack includes a collection of haunting tracks designed to amplify the tension and dread as you navigate the distorted office corridors. Each composition intensifies the sense of isolation and suspense, drawing you deeper into the world of anomalies and terror. Perfect for players who want to fully immerse themselves in the game's chilling environment, the Music Pack brings the unsettling soundscapes to life and makes every moment even more unnerving.

70050000055194.name: THE EXIT: LIMINAL NEW ANOMALY PACK
70050000055194.intro: Discover New Horrors — The Exit: Liminal New Anomaly Pack
70050000055194.description: Dive deeper into the disturbing world of The Exit: Liminal Anomaly Horror with the New Anomaly Pack. This DLC introduces fresh, terrifying anomalies that will keep you on edge as you navigate the unsettling office corridors. Each new anomaly brings its own unique challenges, distorting reality in unexpected ways and pushing you to stay vigilant. With new twists to uncover and dangers lurking at every corner, the New Anomaly Pack expands the horrors of the game, ensuring that every step you take could lead to an even darker truth. 70050000055196.intro: Follow Detective Roy Samson through four brand new cases of his dealings with an organized crime syndicate plaguing the city. Drugs, death, and ancient Lemurian magic will make headli
70050000055196.description:
An old friend returns in The Sins of New Wells in which a new district means business as usual…

A City Consumed by Sin
Sinners, drugs, murder and journalists run rampant in the city of New Wells. Homicide detective Roy Samson has been transferred to the 9th District to unravel the corrupt underground network of the city.

Four New Scenarios to Investigate
Follow Roy Samson and his new partner, Cliff Savea, on the case to solve four brand new scenarios dealing with an organized crime syndicate plaguing the big smoke of New Wells.

A Deadly Pursuit
But, things aren’t as they seem, something unprecedented is happening. Lemurian magic is making headlines again.

Investigate Characters Old and New
Use your sleuthing skills to interrogate evasive witnesses, piece together murderous puzzles and read between the lines to uncover the truth.

70050000055306.intro: Bring retro charm to Fishing Valley with Pixelize It! – your pixel-perfect upgrade!
70050000055306.description:

Free to download and enjoy!
Dive into a whole new way to experience Fishing Valley with Pixelize It! – your journey just got pixel-perfect!

70050000055307.name: Fishing Valley - Angler’s Style Pack
70050000055307.intro: Fish in style with the Angler’s Style Pack – new looks for your adventures!
70050000055307.description:
Upgrade your look with the Angler’s Style Pack, a must-have DLC for every fashionable fisher! This pack introduces a brand-new set of outfits for your main character, perfect for reeling in catches while staying stylish.

Key Features:

Show off your new threads while exploring Fishing Valley!
Make every catch a stylish one with the Angler’s Style Pack!

70050000055331.name: PowerWash Simulator – Wallace & Gromit Special Pack
70050000055331.description:
Good grief, what’s all this mess? Things have gone a bit pear-shaped over at 62 West Wallaby Street following a mechanical malfunction, the biggest disaster since the cracker catastrophe of ’89! Help Wallace and Gromit with the most charming clean up yet and you might even earn yourself a “well done, lad!”
You’ll be piloting Wallace’s latest clever contraption, the WASH LAD. Expertly engineered with only the best technology to hose down dirt from all the nooks, cranny’s, bits and bobs in sight - just add elbow grease!
Wash and explore the home of the iconic British duo, hosing down every infamous invention from the Techno Trousers to the Soccomatic ‘til there’s no dirt left, not a bit in the house. Just be sure not to dampen the crackers. 
Begin this cracking cleaning adventure in Wallace and Gromit’s humble home, nestled in the North English suburbs and finish the spruce up with a trip among the stars – the sky really is the limit in this Special Pack, eh?
Fire up WASH LAD and prepare to commence Project Scrub Down in the following locations:
•	Wallace & Gromit's Dining Room & Kitchen
•	Wallace & Gromit’s House
•	The Knit-O-Matic
•	Wallace & Gromit’s Vehicles
•	The Moon Rocket

70050000055332.name: PowerWash Simulator – Muckingham Files – Part 5
70050000055332.description:
Treat yourself to a sweet clean-up! Muckingham’s Dessert Parlour is in a sticky situation after an unexpected visit from a rogue raccoon has left a lasting impression. Not just on the other patrons, but the counters, walls and ceilings too. 

Melt away goop by the scoopful and savour soft-serve satisfaction in the fifth instalment of The Muckingham Files. Restore the Dessert Parlour to its former knickerbocker-glory and indulge in a dirt-busting delicacy so good that you’ll want a second helping.


About the Muckingham Files

The Muckingham Files is a series of free Bonus Job updates that take you to never-before-seen places from the original universe of PowerWash Simulator, with new characters, locations and stories. Get to know more about your stomping ground and its inhabitants as the most in-demand power washer in town.

70050000055333.name: PowerWash Simulator – Muckingham Files – Part 6
70050000055333.description:
Soak up the culture while you soak off the dirt at the local Sculpture Park. Take it all in, become one with each piece. What does it inspire? A quiet respite to cleanse your mind, or a creative space to make your canvas? There are no wrong answers here, only art… and filth! Chisel off layers of crud and carve out some clean lines from some monumentally mucky installations, while receiving the guided tour from acclaimed sculptor, Darcy d’Arcy. 

Next stop – the subway! Muckingham’s residents have had their travel plans de-railed following a dirt-fuelled defacement. Get the subway system back on track by power washing the carriages to perfection – inside and out! This is one time you’ll not want to skip the ads, as the posters inside the subway train provide a glimpse at what lies ahead on PowerWash Simulator’s journey…

About the Muckingham Files

The Muckingham Files is a series of free Bonus Job updates that take you to never-before-seen places from the original universe of PowerWash Simulator, with new characters, locations and stories. Get to know more about your stomping ground and its inhabitants as the most in-demand power washer in town.

70050000055336.description: Money Boost DLC gives you an instant 150,000 in-game cash to kickstart your journey to racing glory. Upgrade engines, fine-tune handling, unlock high-performance cars, and customize your ride to perfection. Gain an edge over the competition, dominate every mode, and rise to the top. Whether you're perfecting drifts, setting record lap times, or conquering the circuit, this cash boost puts you in control. In Subway Simulator, the new DLC: Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Express Voyager Train introduces an elite train that will transform your gameplay with its speed and advanced technology. Add this exclusive train to your network and explore new routes and challenges.

“Express Voyager” will take your Subway Simulator experience to the next level, offering not only a fast train but also the opportunity to explore new challenges and routes. Get ready for a fast and efficient ride through the city!

70050000055428.name: Rail Route - Happy Passengers
70050000055428.intro: Keep passengers happy and on the move in this game-changing, expansive DLC!
70050000055428.description:
Bring a new element of strategy to your rail management skills with the Happy Passengers DLC! This expansion adds a massvie new challenge to Endless Mode—keeping your passengers happy. Their satisfaction now plays a major role in your success, adding a whole new layer of strategy to your growing rail networks.

What’s New?
-The Survey Office: Gauge and manage passenger demands, ensuring you're always one step ahead in your planning and execution. Track demand and adjust your network to keep things running smoothly.
-Passenger Demands: Stations now come with passenger demands! On top of balancing contracts and network expansion you'll now also need to ensure travelers are satisfied. So many of your decisions will impact passenger happiness, driving you to optimize routes and schedules continuously.
-New Rewards: If go the extra mile in passenger management you'll earn that coveted additional star for exceptional service.

70050000055733.name: Golden Idol Investigations: The Lemurian Phoenix
70050000055733.intro: Golden Idol Investigations: The Lemurian Phoenix
70050000055733.description:
Travel to Lemuria and investigate a deep reaching conspiracy that has infiltrated the upper echelons of Lemurian aristocracy and its King. Mingle with new age cults, gurus with potentially supernatural powers and charlatans that just want to scam westerners in Golden Idol Investigations: The Lemurian Phoenix.

Ancient prophecies, divine revelations, and royal decrees weave together this strange saga. Yet the truth behind the events that transpire remains a mystery…

Royal Celebrations Gone Awry
Amidst the Lemurian aristocracy's extravagant holiday celebrations, a murder ignites a complex conspiracy that reaches back to 1910. Return to the scene of the crime and uncover the truth.

Loyal Dedicants
As technology fades, spirituality flourishes. Charismatic gurus rise to power, drawing loyal followers with their divine messages. But even those of higher power have their flaws and can’t be relied upon to act morally. Under this reign those who sin face severe consequences. 

Blood is Spilled
Moral compasses aren’t always aligned leading to a power struggle. Alliances built on deceit fall creating a power imbalance. Only one can emerge victorious and rule the masses.

Unravel Five New Scenarios
Explore themes of deceit, wealth and power in five new scenarios spanning from 1910 to 1950. Your pursuit of the truth will lead you through decadent parties, ancient temples and dangerous rituals

Decipher the Prophecy
As you delve deeper into the conspiracy, you will be challenged to decode cryptic messages and piece together the threads of a mystery that will leads to a shocking revelation.

70050000055734.name: Golden Idol Investigations: The Age of Restraint
70050000055734.intro: Golden Idol Investigations: The Age of Restraint
70050000055734.description:
When reports of the unlawful use of Lemurian technology begin to surface, an inquisition squad is sent to investigate - but are they truly immune to the Idol’s influence? See the fabled civilization that created Golden Idol first hand and catch a glimpse at the world during the creation of the artifact itself in Age of Restraint.

Welcome to ancient Lemuria, a world where technology is widespread and lying is nearly impossible. Yet even in this era of advanced truth telling, the crimes of humanity remain unchanged.

Technology Rules
Unravel the mysteries of a vibrant high tech world filled with robots, abnormal creations and experiments that have run amok. But beware, Ancient Lemuria has entered The Age of Restraint and harsh punishments await those who use unapproved technology.

Sacred Statute
With Sentinels deployed to keep the public in check, their moral compasses are questioned as secret agendas run rife. Forbidden artefacts must be confiscated and those in charge must remain uncorrupted to uphold the sacred statute.

Dance of Deception
Technological advancements have led to human lives being irrevocably altered, with even the need for the simplicity of spoken language removed. But would technology deceive? When holograms are used to deliver secret messages, do you have what it takes to decode the Spieldance? 

Four Brand New Scenarios
In a world where technology reigns supreme, for the first time you will play in an alien setting. You will need to not only unpick motives from grotesque plots but also learn and immerse yourself in this strange setting. With four scenarios to solve, each click brings you closer to the truth.

Forbidden Artefacts
Exercise your deductive reasoning to decipher truth from fiction, unravel complex schemes, and analyze extraordinary artefacts to expose how good intentions can pave the road to ruin. The call of power proves too great to resist corruption…

70050000055735.name: Golden Idol Investigations: The Curse of the Last Reaper
70050000055735.intro: Shortly after the events of The Case of the Golden Idol a pirate captain hid mysterious treasure. Follow his tracks and a group of explorers 130 years later unearthing the lost curse.
70050000055735.description:
Split Timelines
Set sail on The Last Reaper in 1797 with pirates, hidden treasure and cursed artefacts. Then fast forward to 1927, by the press of a dubloon, and unearth the wreckage. Meticulously uncover the facts amongst the ruins as an intrepid historian.

Wavering Loyalties
Unrest lurks on cursed waters, when a disagreement erupts onboard. Uncover history from bone-chilling remains after a broadside mutiny leads to a deadly end and a murderous beginning.

Set Sail for Four New scenarios
Embark on a voyage through four new, intertwined scenarios shrouded in mystery. The narrative unfolds across diverse settings, journeying from a secluded island, where treasure lies buried, to the treacherous high seas aboard a pirate ship, where an inescapable curse awaits those who dare.

Compile the Treasure Map
To navigate the seven seas, you must first solve the puzzle and piece together fragments of ancient parchment to assemble a map allowing you to pilfer the coveted treasure.

Cursed Treasures
Traverse into the plundered treasures curses ripple effects over 130 years as stolen riches inevitably lead to ruin. Can this curse be broken or will it endure an eternity?

70050000055795.name: Bee Simulator: The Hive - Artbook

70050000055795.description:
See where the buzz is coming from and how with Bee Simulator: The Hive - Artbook!

Bee prepared to discover the secrets of the extended adventures of our pollen-loving friends! With 70 honey-glazed pages of goodness, this artbook is worth the sting 

Witness the creative process through storyboards, go back to your favourite, wholesome loading screens, give a hive five to your favourite bees and refresh your memory with the glossary of flora and fauna. Whether you want to take a look at the bigger picture or examine how the game's UI was built, it's a true honey pot of inspirations! 

From dramatic beehind-the-scenes materials to wholesome extras, it's all here. While it's not all roses, this time around it only means that your honey will have more flavour 

Whether you're a game design geek, love the game's artstyle or adore bees in general, this artbook will definitely make you bloom

To play this scenario, select New Game, Scenarios, and then "Tiger and Wolf Unleashed."

70050000055829.name: Scenario "Tiger Generals of the Three Kingdoms, Locked in Battle!"
70050000055829.intro: A scenario where Wei, Wu, & Shu are further split, returning the land to chaos.
70050000055829.description:
An additional scenario for "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE."

In October 214 CE, Liu Bei, Cao Cao, and Cao Pi fall one after another. Xiahou Dun takes over Cao Cao's former territories but fails to unify the people, causing Xiahou Yuan, Zhang Liao, and Cao Ren to take their forces in a separate direction. In Liu Bei's former territories, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei grow suspicious of one another and divide their forces, leading Zhao Yun to set out on his own. Meanwhile, Sun Shangxiang of Wu is inspired by the name "Tiger" and raises her own banner, expanding her forces with Jiangxia at the center. Thus, the power structure focused on the Three Kingdoms crumbles, returning the land to chaos.

Additional Scenario
"Tiger Generals of the Three Kingdoms, Locked in Battle!"

How to Play
To play this scenario, select New Game, Scenarios, and then "Tiger Generals of the Three Kingdoms, Locked in Battle!"

70050000055831.name: Contest-Winning Scenarios & Popular CG Portraits Set
70050000055831.intro: A set of 3 contest-winning scenarios and 10 CG portraits of "RTK 12" officers.
70050000055831.description:
A set consisting of the 3 scenarios that won the Fictional Scenario Contest held for Japan, Asia, and Europe/America, titled "The Tiger and the Soaring General Go to Zhongyuan," "Romance of the Four Kingdoms," and "The Three Kingdoms in Thirds," along with the CG portraits of the 10 most popular "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 12" officers as decided in the "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS" Day survey.

Three additional scenarios
- The Tiger and the Soaring General Go to Zhongyuan
- Romance of the Four Kingdoms
- The Three Kingdoms in Thirds

Additional CG portraits
A total of 10 CG portraits of "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 12" officers such as Zhao Yun and Zhuge Liang.

How to access:
・ Additional scenarios
Select New Game and then Scenarios, where you can choose "The Tiger and the Soaring General Go to Zhongyuan," "Romance of the Four Kingdoms," or "The Three Kingdoms in Thirds" to begin playing.

・ Additional CG portraits
Set officers' CG portraits via Edit Original Officers or Edit Historical Officers.
To view the portraits, select Edit, Edit Original Officers, Create Original Officers or Change Original Officers, and then Portrait. Alternatively, select Edit, Edit Historical Officers, Edit Historical Officers again, Portrait, and then the "Special" tab.

70050000055833.name: Yokoyama Mitsuteru's "Three Kingdoms" Collaboration: Fierce Leaders CG Portrait Set
70050000055833.intro: A Yokoyama Mitsuteru-collaboration set of 15 fierce leader CG portraits.
70050000055833.description:
This collaboration set was created to celebrate the 90th anniversary of the artist Yokoyama Mitsuteru's birth. It features a total of 15 CG portraits of 13 different fierce leaders, such as Lu Bu and Zhang Fei, from the manga "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," one of Yokoyama's representative works. These illustrations clearly demonstrate the appeal of the officers of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms."

Additional Officer CG Portraits
Xiahou Dun, Guan Yu, Jiang Wei, Xu Zhu, Huang Zhong, Sun Ce, Sun Shangxiang, Zhao Yun, Zhang Fei (2 types), Zhang Liao, Dian Wei, Ma Chao, and Lu Bu (2 types).

How to Access
Set officers' CG portraits via Edit Original Officers or Edit Historical Officers.
To view the portraits, select Edit, Edit Original Officers, Create Original Officers or Change Original Officers, and then Portrait. Alternatively, select Edit, Edit Historical Officers, Edit Historical Officers again, Portrait, and then the "Special" tab.
Note: This content will only be available for purchase by April 16th, 2025. You will still be able to enjoy the content you have purchased.

70050000055835.name: "The Ravages of Time" Collaboration: Liaoyuan Huo and Sima Yi Officer Data
70050000055835.intro: Liaoyuan Huo & Sima Yi officer data for "The Ravages of Time" collaboration.
70050000055835.description:
This content, created in collaboration with the animation "The Ravages of Time," enables players to use the officer data of Liaoyuan Huo and Sima Yi in game scenarios. Liaoyuan Huo, leader of the organization of assassins called "Handicapped Warriors," wields weapons like spears and throwing knives and concocts unconventional schemes. Sima Yi commands the members of the "Handicapped Warriors" like weapons, and makes use of a multi-faceted and ingenious intellect in his strategies, schemes, and management.

Note: The officer data of the two officers included in this DLC cannot be edited.

Additional Officers：
Liaoyuan Huo and Sima Yi

How to Access：
To play through scenarios with these officers, select New Game, Officers or Scenarios, Officer Settings, and then Add Original Officers.
Once the officers have been added, they can be assigned to a city and force via Place Original Officers.

70050000055838.name: Game & Console Supermarket: License Discovery
70050000055838.intro: Expand your catalog with exclusive games!
70050000055838.description: The license discovery dlc unlocks access to exclusive game titles and special edition consoles for your store. Expand your catalog with rare finds, attract more customers, and boost your sales with highly sought-after products. Stay ahead of the competition and become the ultimate gaming retailer!

70050000055839.name: Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator Cyber Storage
70050000055839.intro: Maximize your space and Stock Up for the future!
70050000055839.description: The Cyber Storage DLC unlocks advanced storage solutions to help you optimize your game and console inventory. With more space to store your products, you can stock up on the latest releases, rare items, and high-demand consoles, ensuring you never run out of stock. Keep your store organized, increase efficiency, and stay ahead of the competition with this essential storage upgrade!

70050000055840.name: Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator Money Bonus
70050000055840.intro: Extra funds to grow your gaming empire!
70050000055840.description: The Money Bonus DLC gives you a financial boost to help expand your gaming business! With extra funds at your disposal, you can quickly stock up on new consoles, games, and upgrades to attract more customers. Use this bonus to accelerate your growth, optimize your store, and take your gaming empire to the next level!

70050000055854.name: Anime Waifu Simulator: Sakura Spirit Songs
70050000055854.intro: Let the Melodies of Serenity Enchant Your Garden!
70050000055854.description: Sakura Spirit Songs DLC fills your garden with enchanting melodies that bring a new level of serenity to your peaceful retreat. With soothing tracks inspired by traditional Japanese music, you can set the perfect mood while relaxing with your waifus. Each song enhances the beauty of your sakura garden, making every moment feel more magical and tranquil. Let the spirit of nature and music blend harmoniously, creating a truly immersive experience that soothes your soul and elevates the charm of your garden. Enjoy the peaceful ambiance and feel the serenity flow with every note.

70050000055855.name: Anime Waifu Simulator: Sakura Coin Pack
70050000055855.intro: Unlock Special Items and Boost Your Garden's Charm!
70050000055855.description: The Sakura Coin Pack DLC gives you a boost in your journey to create the perfect garden! With these special coins, you can unlock exclusive items, beautiful decorations, and unique waifu outfits to enhance your peaceful retreat. Use your Sakura Coins to add extra charm to your garden, from elegant accessories to rare treasures that bring out the true beauty of your space. Elevate your garden and enjoy a richer, more immersive experience with new, delightful elements that make every moment even more magical!

70050000055856.name: Anime Waifu Simulator: Girls Passion
70050000055856.intro: Unlock New Waifus, Styles, and Heartfelt Moments!
70050000055856.description: Girls Passion DLC adds a new layer of excitement to your peaceful garden experience. Unlock a range of captivating waifus, each with their own unique personality, stories, and interactions. Dive into heartfelt moments as you bond with your new companions, uncovering their passions and dreams. Explore fresh, stylish outfits for your waifus and personalize their look to match the serene beauty of your garden. Whether you're relaxing or enjoying their company, Girls Passion DLC enhances your journey with more love, laughter, and captivating characters to enjoy.

70050000055910.name: Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle The Street Kings
70050000055910.intro: Rule the Streets with Style, Speed, and Passion!
70050000055910.description: The Street Kings DLC takes your JDM car passion to the next level! Unlock exclusive high-performance street racing cars, bold new customization options, and stylish upgrades to dominate the neon-lit city streets. Challenge rivals, earn respect, and prove you're the ultimate street king alongside stunning anime girls who share your need for speed. With new tuning parts, unique decals, and a thrilling atmosphere, this DLC brings even more excitement, style, and passion to your garage. Are you ready to claim the crown and rule the streets in style?

70050000055911.name: Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle Gearheads and Glamour
70050000055911.intro: Where High-Speed Performance Meets Stunning Style!
70050000055911.description: Gearheads and Glamour DLC brings the perfect fusion of raw power and irresistible style to Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle! Unlock high-performance JDM cars, sleek modifications, and dazzling customizations that turn every ride into a masterpiece. With stunning anime girls who live for speed and style, this DLC delivers the ultimate combination of horsepower, fashion, and attitude. Tune your dream car, show off your flair, and dominate the streets with elegance and adrenaline. Are you ready to rev up your passion and embrace the glamour of the racing world?

70050000055912.name: Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle Driven by Style
70050000055912.intro: Speed Meets Elegance – Drive with Passion, Rule with Style!
70050000055912.description: Driven by Style DLC brings a whole new level of elegance and performance to Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle! Unlock a collection of sleek, fashion-forward JDM cars, stylish body kits, and eye-catching decals that let you express your unique personality on the streets. With exclusive customization options and a fresh lineup of anime girls who embody confidence and charm, this DLC blends speed, beauty, and passion into the ultimate driving experience. Cruise in style, turn heads, and prove that true racers aren’t just fast—they’re unforgettable.

70050000055936.name: Pac-Man
70050000055936.description: The ever-hungry Pac-Man, who gobbles up everything, makes an appearance in the world of Super Monkey Ball Banana Rumble!

70050000055937.name: Red
70050000055937.description: Bird meets Ball – Red The Angry Bird is ready to roll.

70050000055960.name: Funko Fusion - Manchester City Pack
70050000055960.intro: City, City, the best team in the land and all the world!
70050000055960.description:
Are you ready to play like a Champion?

The Manchester City Pack is a must for any football fan.

Bring that winning mentality to Funko Fusion as Pep Guardiola, Erling Haaland, Phil Foden and Ederson and represent Manchester City in this all action DLC pack!



Pep Guardiola

We’ve got Guardiola 
We’ve got   
Guardiola

Twelve league titles, three Champions League wins – Pep Guardiola can’t stop winning. Football’s most iconic manager is now joining the fun as a playable character in Funko Fusion!

 Erling Haland

Erling
Erling Erling 
Erling Erling
Erling Erling Haaland

 Europe’s deadliest striker is now available in Funko Fusion! Blast your opponents with the football cannon whilst playing as Erling Haaland – goalscoring royalty!


Phil Foden 

He's one of our own 
He's one of our own 
Phil Foden
He's one of our own

Everyone loves a homegrown talent and Manchester City’s heartbeat Phil Foden is no exception! Jump into Funko Fusion as the England international right now!

 
Ederson

Brazilian international Ederson has had a glittering career with Manchester City and you can play as him in Funko Fusion! Target enemies with the football cannon and if a bad guy is too close, clobber them with your giant goalkeeper glove!


The Funko Fusion Manchester City Pack is a must for every Man City fan!

70050000055965.name: Clue - 2016 Suspect Pack
70050000055965.intro: The fan-favourite cast returns to Clue!
70050000055965.description:
The latest suspects to join Clue have been invited by…you! 

You asked, we delivered – the iconic 2016 Clue characters make their grand return to the digital board game. Play with your favourite suspect from the 2016 edition, taking them to the updated Tudor Mansion or any of the new crime scenes you own! 

The 2016 characters aren’t tied to any character tasks or crime scenes, leaving you free to enjoy them as an entirely nostalgic experience. 

Get the 2016 Suspect pack – with twelve tokens to choose from – and add a touch of timelessness to your next game of Clue! 

INCLUDES:
2 x MISS SCARLETT (2016) TOKENS – The beautiful long-time friend of Boddy returns to the board.
2 x COLONEL MUSTARD (2016) TOKENS – The decorated military officer marches into the modern Tudor Mansion!
2 x DR ORCHID (2016) TOKENS – Boddy’s adoptive daughter with a poisonous past comes home.
2 x REVEREND GREEN (2016) TOKENS – The reverend blesses Clue with his presence once more. 
2 x MRS PEACOCK (2016) TOKENS – Never one to miss a party, socialite Mrs Peacock joins the game again!
2 x PROFESSOR PLUM (2016) TOKENS – The archaeologist hopes to unearth more secrets in his next social excavation…

70050000055971.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Patronage Pack
70050000055971.description:
Vagrus - The Riven Realms was born out of our love for our peculiar pen-and-paper campaign setting and the desire to share it with more people in the form of a hardcore, story-rich, strategy RPG. We aim to continue working on the game, creating additional content in the form of DLCs and improving the game with regular updates.

This Patronage DLC is a contribution towards the cause of keeping Vagrus alive if you feel that our little team is worthy of support.

As a token of our appreciation, we created a humble package of digital goodies in return for your patronage:

- Digital Wallpapers Pack [available in the Extras Menu]
- Digital Chart of the Continent of Xeryn [available in the Extras Menu]
- Digital Art Booklet [38 pages of Vagrus art, available in the Extras Menu]
- The Patronage Pack also automatically unlocks a unique in-game banner

Thank you for your support. It matters a lot to us.
The Lost Pilgrims Team

70050000055975.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Soundtrack
70050000055975.description:
Eerily beautiful music from Vagrus - The Riven Realms by the amazing Humming Composer and Daniel Solyom. You can find and listen to the tracks under the Extras Menu (from the Main Menu) in-game.

A significant share of the proceeds of this OST goes to the composers, so if you like the music of Vagrus, this is a great way to support those who created it.

The Soundtrack also automatically unlocks unique in-game banners.

Thank you,
The Lost Pilgrims Team & The Humming Composer & Daniel Sólyom

70050000055979.name: Developer Supporter Pack
70050000055979.description:
Vault of the Void started as a small, solo developed project -- just me trying to learn to code! Since then, it's become so much more, and the community behind it has been so supportive every step of the way.

It's always been my intention to keep Vault as cheap as possible, and I’ve had numerous queries from community members, asking for more ways to show support, to help fund further development and additional classes. So here we are, say “G’day Mate!” to the Vault of the Void: Developer Supporter Pack!

Full of Australian Themed cosmetic unlocks, this pack brings my home country to you all! Everything included in this pack is cosmetic only, meaning no additional gameplay or functionality is included.

Included in this pack:
* Alternative artwork for the Seven Deadly Sins, all featuring adorable (and terrifying!) Australian Wildlife!
* A brand new battlefield, the great Australian outback!
* A new menu screen image, showing all four of the playable classes by the campfire, with the iconic Uluru in the background.
* 3 new animated deckbacks, including the fearsome Australian Dropbear!
* A new Purge effect -- the Southern Cross!
* Alternative artwork for the four token cards, Hidden Blade, Silent Shiv, Chant and Void Coins!

I truly appreciate all of you who choose to support myself and the team by purchasing this pack. I can’t wait to develop more content for Vault, and with your support we can continue growing the game, for now and into the future!

- Josh

70050000055981.name: Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul
70050000055981.description:
Teeth gnash, grinding and gorging until nothing is left. A black and scarlet eye blazes above a grotesque grin. The screams turn to gurgles as they plead for mercy that will never come. 

Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul, features new Killer, The Ghoul, a chilling reimagining of Ken Kaneki. 

Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Ken Kaneki badge and the Red Spider Lilies banner.

70050000055987.name: Yokoyama Mitsuteru's "Three Kingdoms" Collaboration: Rulers and Wise Leaders CG Portrait Set
70050000055987.intro: A Yokoyama Mitsuteru-collaboration set of 15 ruler & wise leader CG portraits.
70050000055987.description:
This collaboration set was created to celebrate the 90th anniversary of the artist Yokoyama Mitsuteru's birth. It features a total of 15 CG portraits of 13 different rulers and wise leaders, such as Cao Cao and Zhuge Liang, from the manga "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," one of Yokoyama's representative works. These illustrations clearly demonstrate the appeal of the officers of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms."

Additional Officer CG Portraits
Jia Xu, Sima Yi (2 types), Zhou Yu, Zhuge Liang (2 types), Xu Shu, Cao Cao, Sun Quan, Zhang Jiao, Diaochan, Dong Zhuo, Pang Tong, Lu Xun, and Liu Bei.

How to Access
Set officers' CG portraits via Edit Original Officers or Edit Historical Officers.
To view the portraits, select Edit, Edit Original Officers, Create Original Officers or Change Original Officers, and then Portrait. Alternatively, select Edit, Edit Historical Officers, Edit Historical Officers again, Portrait, and then the "Special" tab.
Note: This content will only be available for purchase by April 16th, 2025. You will still be able to enjoy the content you have purchased.

70050000055991.name: Songs of Conquest - Vanir
70050000055991.intro: Conquer the lands of Aerbor as the mighty raiders of Vanir
70050000055991.description:
Songs of Conquest's first new faction has arrived from the shores of the Bleak East. Conquer the lands of Aerbor as the mighty raiders of Vanir and witness their powerful transformation into the Vildra. Carve a path through the snow in five new challenging Conquest maps as you command new powerful Wielders such as the shapeshifted Gorm Aelgrim or Jarn Steadfast, the one who refused to Change.

Included in the Vanir faction DLC:
- A new biome with snow, ice, and ruins to explore
- 8 troops with new traits and abilities
- Upgrading Vanir troops often change the troop completely, mechanically and visually
- 9 Wielders with both new and old specializations
- Town and settlements with new buildings
- Access to Essence of Destruction, Arcana and Chaos
- New styles of play with more easily accessed dyads
- 5 new Conquest maps highlighting the Vanir Biome and faction
- 2 new Challenge maps to test your skills and knowledge of this new faction
- Artifact sets focused on Vanir gameplay, which also opens up tactics for other factions

70050000055994.name: Wild West Set 1
70050000055994.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70050000055994.description: Decorate your cozy land with 20 additional elements and add one extra layout to your collection.

70050000055995.name: Artisanal Walls & Floor
70050000055995.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70050000055995.description: Transform the place where your journey begins with beautifully crafted walls and floors. This upgrade brings a fresh, artisanal touch to your home's interior, enhancing the atmosphere of the room where you wake up each day. It's a subtle yet impactful way to make your space feel more personal and inviting.

70050000055997.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Celeste - "Scattered and Lost"
70050000055997.intro: Keep the musical combat flowing with “Scattered and Lost”, by the award-winning composer of Celeste, Lena Raine. (This track is part of the Celeste Music Pack.)
70050000055997.description:
This Rhythm Rift comes with:
- A fully-bopping Madeline character
- Celeste Background Visualizer with Strawberry Particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design.

70050000055999.name: WARRIORS: Abyss - Atelier Series Vacation Costume Set
70050000055999.intro: Set of 3 vacation costumes for Sophie, Ryza, & Yumia from the "Atelier" series.
70050000055999.description:
This set includes 3 extra vacation-themed costumes for Sophie, Ryza, and Yumia from the "Atelier" series. It will be added to the game in the second free update and will be made available once the player has completed the tutorial.

Note: Please see the official site for more details on costumes included in this set.

70050000056001.name: WARRIORS: Abyss - Atelier Series Academy Costume Set
70050000056001.intro: Set of 3 academy costumes for Sophie, Ryza, & Yumia from the "Atelier" series.
70050000056001.description:
This set includes 3 extra academy-themed costumes for Sophie, Ryza, and Yumia from the "Atelier" series. It will be added to the game in the second free update and will be made available once the player has completed the tutorial.

Note: Please see the official site for more details on costumes included in this set.

70050000056003.name: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator Storage Craft
70050000056003.intro: Expand, Organize, and Master Your Library Storage!
70050000056003.description: Storage Craft DLC takes your Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator experience to the next level! Maximize your bookstore’s potential with expanded storage options, new shelving systems, and smarter inventory management. Organize books more efficiently, create a seamless browsing experience for customers, and ensure your bestsellers are always in stock. With enhanced customization and strategic storage solutions, this DLC helps you build the perfect book empire. Get ready to sort, stack, and succeed like never before!

70050000056004.name: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator License Pack
70050000056004.intro: Expand Your Collection with Exclusive New Titles!
70050000056004.description: License Pack DLC brings a fresh wave of excitement to Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator by adding a variety of new licensed books, rare editions, and exclusive collections to your store! Stock your shelves with sought-after bestsellers, classic literary masterpieces, and niche publications to attract a wider range of customers. Expand your inventory, boost sales, and become the ultimate book retailer. With this DLC, your bookstore will be the go-to destination for every reader’s dream collection!

70050000056005.name: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator Cash Grow
70050000056005.intro: Boost Profits and Grow Your Bookstore Empire!
70050000056005.description: Cash Grow DLC helps you take your bookstore to new heights in Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator! Unlock new ways to increase profits, manage finances, and reinvest in your store for bigger and better expansions. With smart strategies to attract more customers, improve sales, and optimize your pricing, you'll watch your bookstore empire flourish. Whether it's boosting your inventory or upgrading your space, this DLC gives you the tools you need to grow your business and create the ultimate book destination. Time to turn your library into a profitable powerhouse!

70050000056033.name: More Toppings & Skins Pack
70050000056033.intro:
Freshen up your gameplay with an all-new Sushi Set!
Enjoy new background skins and BGM as well!
70050000056033.description:
Introducing new content for SUSHI Shot in the "More Toppings & Skins Pack"!
Challenge yourself to set new high scores with your favorite Sushi Sets!
Switch up the background and BGM whenever you like!

The "More Toppings & Skins Pack" includes the following content:
・Added Sushi Set C
・Added 4 background skins + BGM

70050000056036.name: Journey To Chaos
70050000056036.description:
In Girls of The Tower: Journey To Chaos",players can choose a character to embark on the adventure of chaos. In battles, players can use original monsters as minions to fight, and equipped items will gain more powerful abilities through enchantment. In towns, players can access the Chaos Shop through the central obelisk to obtain new magic cards and enchanted equipment, and even use the Subjugation Contract to enslave bosses and add them to their lineup.

Brand New Challenges!
The Path of Chaos brings forth brand new challenges. At the journey's end, you will uncover the twisted truth of this chaos and witness Jeffrey's new form, warped by chaos!

More Minions and New Bonds
In the Path of Chaos, players can select original monsters as minions, and even acquire monster bosses in the Chaos Shop! Experience the new bonds of monster minions awaiting you!

Harness the Power of Enchantment
The Path of Chaos is filled with enchanted artifacts. Utilize the power of enchantment to strengthen your equipment and magic cards!

70050000056040.name: Seasons of Love Bundle
70050000056040.intro: New romance scenarios for Cuilang & Pilika, plus alternative swimsuits for all marriage candidates!
70050000056040.description:
Love is blooming in Azuma! With the Seasons of Love DLC Pack, you can unlock the romance scenarios for Cuilang and Pilika. Explore compelling romance scenarios and forge deeper connections as these enigmatic characters open their hearts to you.

Cuilang
Although he speaks little and socializes even less, the other villagers can always rely on him, and he never turns away a soul in need.

Pilika
A quiet, plain-spoken hunter who hails from Azuma's far north. Her hunting skills know no peer, and she feels deep respect for every living thing.

Because love is about enjoying life's little moments, this DLC also unlocks a ‘Marvelous Swimsuit’ for each marriage candidate, offering an alternative seaside style with bespoke designs for each character.

70050000056041.name: Festive Attire & Dark Woolby Bundle
70050000056041.intro: A striking dark color palette for our heroes—and Woolby!
70050000056041.description:
Celebrate in style with this elegant Festive Attire for Subaru and Kaguya. With a striking dark colour palette, this refined yet timeless look is perfect for any special occasion.

Even Woolby joins the festivities with a dramatic makeover—introducing Dark Woolby, sporting sleek black wool!

This set includes the following items:
Festive Attire - Subaru
Festive Attire - Kaguya
Dark Woolby

70050000056042.name: Rune Factory 4 Hero Outfit Bundle
70050000056042.description:
A touch of Selphia style! Don outfits inspired by Lest and Frey, the heroic protagonists of Rune Factory 4 Special! Subaru can wear Lest’s classic outfit, while Kaguya takes on Frey’s signature look. 

This set includes the following items:
Rune Factory 4 Outfit - Subaru
Rune Factory 4 Outfit - Kaguya

70050000056043.name: Rune Factory 4 Bachelorette Outfit Bundle
70050000056043.intro: Fashion meets nostalgia as a new trend sweeps through Azuma, bringing a touch of Selphia’s iconic charm to its shores!
70050000056043.description:
Fashion meets nostalgia as a new trend sweeps through Azuma, bringing a touch of Selphia’s iconic charm to its shores! Dress Azuma's bachelorettes in stunning outfits inspired by the fan-favorite cast of Rune Factory 4 Special.

This set includes:
Margaret’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit for Ulalaka
Xiao Pai’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit for Iroha
Clorica’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit for Hina
Dolce’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit for Clarice
Forte’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit for Matsuri
Amber’s Rune Factory 4 Outfit for Kanata

70050000056044.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Celeste - "Reach for the Summit"
70050000056044.intro: Keep the musical combat flowing with “Reach for the Summit”, by the award-winning composer of Celeste, Lena Raine. (This track is part of the Celeste Music Pack.)

This Rhythm Rift comes with:

70050000056045.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Celeste - "Confronting Myself"
70050000056045.intro: Keep the musical combat flowing with “Confronting Myself”, by the award-winning composer of Celeste, Lena Raine. (This track is part of the Celeste Music Pack.)

This Rhythm Rift comes with:

70050000056046.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Celeste - "Resurrections"
70050000056046.intro: Keep the musical combat flowing with “Resurrections”, by the award-winning composer of Celeste, Lena Raine. (This track is part of the Celeste Music Pack.)

This Rhythm Rift comes with:

- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design.

70050000056066.name: Rose-Hued Uniforms
70050000056066.description: This DLC includes three character skins. After installing the DLC, please restart the game. These character skins will be automatically unlocked after clearing specific stages in the game. Each skin will change the character's appearance, mech, and visual effects.

70050000056096.name: Golf With Your Friends - Soaring Eagles Cosplay Pack
70050000056096.description:
