70050000056100.name: Against the Storm - Keepers of the Stone
70050000056100.description:
As the struggle for survival against the Blightstorm continues, Against the Storm - Keepers of the Stone introduces a new species, two new biomes, and a selection of new buildings, orders, risks, and opportunities for any Viceroy up for the challenge. The Frogs join the effort to push back the storm, bringing their skill with stone masonry and love for water with them. Meanwhile, a changing of the tides has unlocked new potential in the distance – the Coastal Groves have finally become accessible after countless cycles spent under the deluge. Though they remain isolated and hard to reach, the ancient, submerged settlements of the area hold great treasures waiting to be uncovered. Meanwhile, unique opportunities present themselves in the once-thriving forests left barren by the march of industry – the Ashen Thicket is littered with broken trunks and remnants of a past age, awaiting a masterful Viceroy to restore its forgotten glory.

Against the Storm - Keepers of the Stone includes:
- Welcome the dignified Frogs to your settlements and take advantage of their proficiency with stone masonry, the comfort they take in rainwater, and their ability to increase the rate at which new citizens join your settlements.
- Explore the new Coastal Grove biome where settlements start along the water, far from the easy reach of royal envoys and the benefits they provide. Rely instead on the Strider Port building – unique to the Coastal Grove biome, it allows you to launch expeditions seeking treasures buried in the surrounding waters. The Strider Port offers a fresh way to seek out new building designs with each expedition simply requiring a supply of food for the Water Strider and its rider alike – the more you’re willing to invest in supplies, the better your potential finds might be.
- Brave the new Ashen Thicket biome, ravaged by industrial exploitation and the Blightstorm alike. The barren lands here are home to the rare Thunderblight Shards – lightning-infused crystals that can be mined at great cost, crucial for forging Cornerstones using the Ashen Thicket’s unique Cornerstone Forge building. With only a limited number of opportunities to produce your own Cornerstones, you must strategically choose which conditions and rewards go hand-in-hand, with the option to take on penalties in the hopes of bolstering their benefit.
- New rewards are added to the upgrade tree in the Smoldering City to benefit the new Frog species alongside 3 new Legendary Cornerstones, 1 new Epic Cornerstone, 3 new Rare perks, and 5 new Uncommon perks.
- The new biomes will appear on the world map after the current cycle ends. To unlock Frogs as a playable species, you must reach level 9.

70050000056121.name: Railway Empire 2 - Bella Italia
70050000056121.intro: Railway Empire 2 – Bella Italia offers spirited challenges from the Alps to the Gulf of Taranto.
70050000056121.description:
Ciao Bella: From the snow-capped Alps in the north, along the Apennine Mountains, to the sun-soaked Gulf of Taranto, Railway Empire 2 – Bella Italia offers beautiful landscapes and spirited challenges. Uniquely Italian locomotives allow you to steam through any mission, be it economical or more… familial in nature, as you expand your railroad network set against the majestic backdrop of the Colosseum and ancient aqueducts.

Start your railway business in Rome and the Papal State, where waves of tourists await seamless connections to see the wonders of Antiquity. Down south, a different kind of challenge awaits as you discover the many branches of La Famiglia – and work to make yourself a name among them. Meanwhile, the north desperately needs help after a devastating war, with new railways required to fuel its financial recovery.

• Bella Italia: With the new Railway Empire 2 DLC, players experience the beauty of Rome, the Tuscan and Umbrian landscape, the relentless sun of Sicily and the magnificence of Milano, tackling various challenges from financial crises to ‘creative’ ways to avoid them.

• Classic Chique: Choose from 8 new locomotives such as Mastodonte dei Giovi and Signorine FS Class 640 II.

• Rome, Naples and Milano: The DLC introduces 3 comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios with varied approaches: “Bella Roma” (starting in 1850s), “Per la Famiglia” (starting 1870s) and “Milano Magnifico” (1880s).

• Buckle down: Explore the Italian countryside on two highly detailed maps covering northern and southern Italy.

• Gourmet Heaven: Transport 22 new regional products from pasta and grappa to the rare white marble.

• Dolce Vita: 19 new jingles and tracks will transport you right into the sweet life in Italy.

70050000056554.name: Cats Defense Robots: Meow Legends PREMIUM PLAYLIST

Dive into the ultimate tower defense experience with the Meow Legends PREMIUM PLAYLIST DLC! Unlock exclusive content, featuring powerful new heroes, legendary towers, and unique gameplay modes designed to take your defense strategies to the next level.

This DLC introduces exciting new playlists filled with challenging levels, special events, and special robot foes to face with your friends. Test your teamwork and tactics in brand-new scenarios, from intense survival modes to high-stakes boss battles, all while defending the Milk Base!

With Meow Legends PREMIUM PLAYLIST, the adventure never ends—strategize, defend, and conquer the most epic challenges yet. Are you ready to lead your squad to victory? The ultimate challenge awaits!

70050000056562.name: ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Eternal Light
70050000056562.intro: A guiding light in a place of no escape.
70050000056562.description:
Light the Way Through the Darkness
With the Eternal Light DLC, survival in the twisted Backrooms becomes a little less hopeless. Navigate the endless maze with a flashlight that never runs out of power, giving you a constant source of light in the suffocating darkness.

Key Features:
	•	Infinite Flashlight: A powerful flashlight with unlimited battery life is now available in your inventory, ensuring you’re never left in the dark.
	•	Automatic Upgrade: Already have a flashlight? After installing the DLC, it will be instantly upgraded to unlimited power.
	•	Enhanced Exploration: Venture deeper into the eerie maze with a reliable light source, revealing hidden details and lurking horrors.

Will light be your salvation...or simply reveal more nightmares?

70050000056567.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Tactical Pistol Skin
70050000056567.intro: Your weapon, your style – stand out in every firefight!
70050000056567.description:
Elevate your combat experience with an exclusive, high-quality skin for your pistol. Designed for operators who want to combine deadly precision with a striking visual upgrade, this skin adds a bold, intimidating touch to your sidearm without compromising the tactical realism of BODY CAM SHOOTER.

Every encounter is a test of skill and strategy—why not face it with a weapon that looks as sharp as your reflexes? Whether you’re clearing rooms, engaging in tense firefights, or making every shot count, this unique pistol skin ensures you stand out in the heat of battle.

Equip your new skin, lock in your loadout, and step into the action with style!

70050000056606.name: Decotine
70050000056606.intro: The new character "Decotine" from "Girls of The Tower" is now officially released!
70050000056606.description:

The new character 'Decotine' comes with twelve new minions, covering various classes including healer, mage, warrior, archer, and shield. Additionally, there are more new exclusive bonds under the 'Empire' category, which can be combined with other bonds to create different styles and distinctive team systems. 
The new character is also applicable to both the 'Endless Mode' and 'Journey of Chaos' modes.

Brand-New Minion Equipment, More Powerful Assistance
The new exclusive equipment tailored for the new minions enhances their attributes significantly. Additionally, there are corresponding bond equipment items that help form your lineup more quickly.

Unlock New Elemental Magic Cards, Freeze the Enemy
The new character "Decotine" hails from the Yuga Empire and specializes in using freezing magic attacks, featuring brand-new magic card animations and effects.

Four New Storylines, Different Combinations Lead to Different Endings
This update continues the established feature of different storylines based on character combinations. Decotine has unique storylines and branching endings with Lesley, Holy, Aska and Kamisari.

JOY-CON™ MODE
Thanks to the motion sensor, you can tilt the Joy-Con like a magic wand to move the pointer! This innovative system makes the gaming experience even more interactive and engaging.

PLAY WITH THE TOUCHSCREEN
Children can interact directly with the touchscreen, tapping and coloring in a simple and natural way.
PUZZLES FOR EVERYONE

Kids can enjoy easy and intuitive puzzles. Drag and drop the pieces into place to complete the image, and at the end, discover delightful background animations.

COLOR WITH CREATIVITY
Different drawing modes are available. The Magic Border mode is perfect for younger children, as colors automatically stay inside the lines for a relaxing experience. They can also use pencils, spray, and bucket tools to create vibrant masterpieces.

A SAFE AND EDUCATIONAL GAME

Discover the magic of the farm with a game designed for learning through play, perfect for boys and girls ages 0 to 7.

70050000056776.name: Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator CASH BUSINESS
70050000056776.intro: Turn Your Aviation Dreams into Profit – Build, Fly, and Thrive in Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator!
70050000056776.description:
Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator - CASH BUSINESS puts you in the pilot’s seat of your own aviation empire. Build and manage your flight academy, train aspiring pilots, and grow your aviation business. Start with a fleet of aircraft, perfect your flying skills, and expand your operations to dominate the skies.

From managing resources to creating successful flight paths, every decision you make impacts your business. Earn money, invest in new planes, and rise through the ranks to become a renowned aviation mogul. With realistic flight simulation and strategic business management, Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator - CASH BUSINESS offers a unique blend of piloting excitement and entrepreneurial challenge.

Will you be able to soar to success or crash under the pressure? The skies and your fortune await!

70050000056777.name: Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator WINGS 2025
70050000056777.intro: Elevate Your Journey – Soar to New Heights with Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator WINGS 2025!
70050000056777.description:
Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator WINGS 2025 takes your flight experience to the next level! Explore a brand-new collection of advanced aircraft, cutting-edge flight technology, and exciting new missions. Whether you’re perfecting your skills or tackling challenging scenarios, WINGS 2025 delivers an unparalleled level of realism and excitement.

With stunning visuals, enhanced flight dynamics, and expanded training programs, this DLC opens up a world of new possibilities. Fly through diverse environments, master sophisticated aircraft, and push your limits in the ultimate aviation challenge.

Prepare for takeoff – WINGS 2025 is your gateway to becoming a true legend in the skies!

70050000056778.name: Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator NEW AIRPLANE

Get behind the controls of cutting-edge aircraft, featuring the latest in design, technology, and performance. Whether you’re an experienced pilot or just starting, these new planes offer a fresh, exhilarating flying experience with enhanced flight dynamics and stunning detail.

Explore new missions, tackle unique flight challenges, and test your skills in a variety of weather conditions and terrains. With every new aircraft, your training gets more advanced, and your flight capabilities expand.

Take your skills to the next level and soar into the future of aviation with the NEW AIRPLANE DLC. The sky’s the limit—are you ready to fly the next generation of aircraft?

70050000056938.description: Get ahead in Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator with the Coin Pack DLC! Instantly boost your shop’s growth with a generous supply of extra coins, giving you the power to expand your inventory, upgrade your store, and enhance your trading empire. Whether you're looking to restock rare goods, improve your shop's layout, or unlock new opportunities, this Coin Pack is the perfect way to fast-track your success. With more coins at your disposal, you’ll be able to tackle challenges more efficiently and build your legendary merchant empire in the medieval world!

70050000056941.name: Drift Master Simulator 2024 - 4 Ultimate Cars Pack
70050000056941.intro: Four iconic cars, one epic drift!
70050000056941.description:
In Drift Master Simulator, the new DLC “4 Ultimate Cars Pack” gives you the chance to add four legendary cars to your collection, by either opening an exclusive Cars Pack or receiving compensation in virtual currency. Choose how you want to complete your garage and enjoy the drift experience!

Cars Pack (4 Legendary Cars)
Open a Cars Pack that includes four iconic cars, each with unique drifting abilities and a distinctive style.
The cars included are:
- Haklenger SS
- Manhacklis
- I8
- Prodigy RTX

If you already own some of these cars or prefer to personalize your progress, you can choose to receive an equivalent amount in game currency. This will allow you to upgrade your existing cars or purchase other upgrades and customizations for your vehicles.

70050000056958.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Art Book and Soundtrack
70050000056958.description: A Digital Art Book and Soundtrack App featuring 134 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, monsters, and development materials. Enjoy all 56 music tracks from Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma at your leisure.

70050000056960.name: The Legend of Zelda™: Tears of the Kingdom – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000056960.intro: Upgrade your adventure through Hyrule—only on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000056960.description:
Enhance your experience in Hyrule with this upgrade pack. The Legend of Zelda™: Tears of the Kingdom – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features improved framerates, faster load times, and enhanced resolution and textures. This epic sequel to The Legend of Zelda™: Breath of the Wild game has never looked better.

Import your save data from the Nintendo Switch version of the game using the Nintendo Switch Transfer Your Save Data function or the Nintendo Switch Online Save Data Cloud feature. You can also start your journey anew, without losing your data—this version of the game supports two separate manual save data files!

If you have a paid Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership*, you don’t need to purchase this upgrade pack. You already have access to it at no additional cost.

Support your journey with ZELDA NOTES on the Nintendo Switch app

Introducing ZELDA NOTES—a game-specific service found in the Nintendo Switch app** on compatible smart devices that’s exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Streamline your adventure by using voice-assisted navigation to find elusive shrines and Koroks. Hear Voice Memories of Princess Zelda and some additional characters—stories that were not in the original game—as you visit certain locations around Hyrule. 

With ZELDA NOTES, you can also gain daily in-game bonuses, compare your play data to others around the world, decorate your in-game photos for social media, transfer items and Autobuild designs to other players by QR Code®***, and more!

A Nintendo Switch Online membership is not required to use ZELDA NOTES.

70050000056961.name: Super Mario Party™ Jamboree – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Jamboree TV Upgrade Pack
70050000056961.intro: Enhance your jamboree with better visuals and even more minigames—only on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000056961.description:
Introducing a brand-new mode for the Super Mario Party™ Jamboree game: Jamboree TV! Exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition you’ll unlock with this upgrade pack, Jamboree TV casts you and your friends as contestants in a game show hosted by Toad. Take on a variety of challenges along with Mario and friends that use the Joy-Con™ 2* controller for mouse controls, the system's built-in microphone to respond to your sounds, and more. Add a USB-C® camera** accessory (each sold separately) and other players’ faces will appear during gameplay—you’ll get to see your friends get crowned for winning minigames, for example, or surrounded by the coins they’ve won!

Jamboree TV supports higher resolution in both TV and handheld mode, so you can enjoy the world of Mario Party with a higher level of detail. You can also play 78 of the original Super Mario Party Jamboree minigames in Jamboree TV mode to experience them in higher resolution!

Get hands-on with Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive features in Carnival Coaster and Bowser Live

Lock in and go on the co-op Carnival Coaster! Use the Joy-Con 2 controller’s mouse controls to aim at flying baddies and try to blast ‘em down. Work together to improve your score and play a minigame each time the coaster rolls into a pipe.

In Bowser Live, you can get on stage and become the star of the performance! Compete in two teams and take on wild minigame challenges focused on sound and movement. Connect the Nintendo Switch 2 camera accessory or a compatible USB-C® camera to project you and your buddies into the in-game venue!

Chat with family and friends while sharing your screen online using the Nintendo Switch 2 system’s GameChat feature 

Chat using the system's built-in microphone and go on-camera with a compatible USB-C® camera. Some modes even let you put your face in the game along with fun special effects!

Share part of the game with anyone who has a Nintendo Switch or Nintendo Switch 2 system

If you have the Nintendo Switch 2 system and the Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV game, you can share part of the game with anyone who has a Nintendo Switch or Nintendo Switch 2 system using GameShare.

With one game, up to four people can play the Mega Wiggler's Tree Party board and 30 minigames in Mario Party mode.***

70050000056983.name: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona - The Jewel in the Skull
70050000056983.intro: Embark on a mysterious adventure where the shadows of the past intertwine with the threats of the present.
70050000056983.description:
You will venture into the labyrinth ship of the mad genius Mardek in search of a legendary artifact – “The Jewel in the Skull”. Using this artifact, you can enter the Ghost World and uncover the truth about Demagrass, the brother of Queen Aurora, whose fate is enshrouded in mystery and intrigue.

Keep an eye out, though! Mardek's ship is not just an iron hulk, but a living nightmare where every step can be your last. Each step will lead you to dangerous traps, monsters, and mad scientists' experiments.

Do you think you have what it takes to step on the shaky line between worlds, challenge fate itself, and discover the secret that could change your life forever? It's time to make a choice, for "The Jewel in the Skull" awaits not just the adventurer, but the one who dares to look into the abyss and not falter.

The DLC gives you access to the following new content:
- 4 new biomes
- More than 20 new enemies
- 5 unique bosses
- New weapons and equipment

How can I access new content?
This DLC is seamlessly woven into the main game. New regions can be explored in the following ways:
- While progressing through the main storyline after reaching a key point.
- After defeating the final boss, without having to start New Game+
Dive into new lands, unravel the mysteries of the past and uncover the truth behind the veil of the Ghost World!

70050000057300.name: SnowRunner - Freightliner & Western Star Dual Pack
70050000057300.description:
The Freightliner & Western Star Dual Pack brings two new trucks to your SnowRunner garage: the Heavy Duty-class Freightliner FLD 120 and Heavy-class Western Star 6900XD.
The Freightliner FLD 120 will put its exceptional power-to-weight ratio on display and become a staple of any garage thanks to its All-Wheel Drive and switchable Differential Lock capabilities.

On the other hand, the 10-wheeler Western Star 6900XD differentiates itself with its sheer power. No matter the terrain, its enormous 53” tires, switchable All-Wheel Drive and built-in Differential Lock are sure to make it an instant must-have for all your off-road endeavours.

This DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 or Year 4 Passes.

70050000057303.name: ESCAPE BACKROOMS: DARKNESS HORROR CHARACTER REPLICAS
70050000057303.intro: They look like you. They move like you. But they’re not you.
70050000057303.description:
They know your every move—because they are you.

In Character Replicas, the nightmare beneath the parking garage evolves. Mysterious figures begin to appear in the shadows—perfect copies of those who came before. They mirror your actions, mimic your path, and adapt to your behavior.

What you’re running from may look familiar, but it’s anything but safe.

This DLC introduces a new kind of terror: intelligent, shape-shifting enemies that blur the line between self and threat. As the structure twists further into madness, nothing you see can be trusted—not even your own reflection.

Escape may still be possible... but at what cost to your identity?

70050000057308.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Military Gear
70050000057308.intro: Upgrade your gear, blend into the terrain, and protect the border!
70050000057308.description:
Enhance your Border Patrol experience with the Military Gear DLC, adding a new layer of realism to your gear! This DLC introduces a military camouflage skin for gloves and sleeves, designed to improve the visual authenticity of your character’s uniform and provide that tactical edge needed during intense border operations. Whether you’re conducting vehicle inspections or chasing down smugglers, blend into your environment with this stylish and practical addition to your arsenal.

Key Features:
	•	New Camouflage Skin: Apply a realistic military camouflage pattern to your gloves and sleeves for added immersion and style.

Equip yourself with the Military Camouflage Skin and take your Border Patrol duties to the next level!

70050000057310.name: ESCAPE BACKROOMS: DARKNESS HORROR NEW TRACKS
70050000057310.intro: New paths emerge, but the darkness is louder than ever. Can you find your way with the haunting new soundtrack?
70050000057310.description:
In New Tracks, the parking garage's eerie maze expands, revealing new hidden areas, chilling corridors, and forgotten levels. But this time, there’s a twist—a new, unsettling musical score accompanies every moment of dread. The haunting melodies change as you move through the garage, setting the stage for every encounter and heightening the sense of impending doom.

The deeper you venture, the more the garage shifts—your familiar surroundings become more distorted, and new threats lurk in every corner. The new tracks add an extra layer of tension, making each step feel heavier, each decision more crucial.

Explore new underground levels, solve cryptic puzzles, and survive dynamic AI threats, all while the music becomes a living, breathing part of your fear.

Will the new melodies guide you to safety, or lead you further into madness?

70050000057342.name: Darkest Dungeon® II: Infernal Supporter Pack
70050000057342.description:
“Take up these goods, and imbue them with purpose.”

Show your love for Darkest Dungeon II by adopting this Infernal Supporter Pack! The pack is a collection of cosmetic items for players who want to help bolster the work we've done to add many free updates to the game. (Such as Kingdoms!)

The Infernal Supporter Pack contains:
Infernal weapon kits with special inkfire visual effects. Arm your heroes with implements tainted by the spreading stain.
Infernal hero palettes with additional inkfire visual effects. Heed the call of the void and outfit your heroes in gear fit for overcoming the most severe of challenges.
4 exclusive stagecoach skins themed around Catacombs and Kingdoms enemy factions. Cover your coach in dripping slime or quivering sacks of eggs!

The above items are visible tokens of our heartfelt gratitude, but know that any support you choose to give means even more!

70050000057348.name: Magnificent Castles

70050000057395.description: Another DLC of the iconic Spy Guy Memory game - this time the Ancient Greece version!

70050000057398.intro: Welcome to your new life as the only pizza farmer-baker around!
70050000057398.description: Add a splash of style to your kitchen with five brand-new color themes for tiles, walls, and tables! Customize your pizzeria to match your mood — because every delicious pizza deserves a charming place to be served!

70050000057399.name: Cozy Comforts Style
70050000057399.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70050000057399.description: Give Draco and Luna cozy winter outfit you can toggle on the mannequin inside your home.

70050000057411.name: Survival Float Simulator: Fishing & Crafting Tools Update
70050000057411.intro: Craft like a survivor, fish like a legend.
70050000057411.description:
Upgrade your survival toolkit in “Survival Float Simulator: Fishing & Crafting Tools Update”!
Dive deeper into the swamp’s unforgiving wilderness with revamped tools designed to enhance your resourcefulness and survival tactics.

What’s new in this DLC:
	•	Upgraded Fishing Rod – Catch more, waste less. The improved rod helps you reel in better fish with greater ease.
	•	Standard Hook Redesign – A sleeker, sturdier look with better grip and throw mechanics. Your essential tool, now even more reliable.
	•	Advanced Hook Variant – Unlock the enhanced grappling hook with increased range, durability, and snagging precision.

From stronger casts to sharper snags, these upgraded tools are your ticket to more efficient survival, deeper exploration, and an edge against the swamp’s lurking threats.
Sharpen your strategy, enhance your gear – and keep that raft afloat.

70050000057426.name: Artisanal Kitchen
70050000057426.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70050000057426.description: Give your kitchen a refined new look with this handcrafted upgrade. The refreshed design adds warmth and charm to one of the most essential spaces in your home, making it feel both stylish and inviting.

70050000057427.name: Artisanal Bed
70050000057427.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70050000057427.description: Add a touch of elegance to your bedroom with a beautifully redesigned bed. This upgrade enhances the look of your sleeping area, making it cozier and more visually appealing.

70050000057428.name: House Facade
70050000057428.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70050000057428.description: Give your home a fresh new look with a charming exterior makeover. This upgrade transforms the house’s facade, adding character and style that stands out in the landscape. It's a perfect way to make your home feel truly unique.

70050000057429.name: Barn Facade
70050000057429.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70050000057429.description: Refresh your farm with a stylish new look for your barn. This upgrade revamps the barn’s exterior, giving it a distinctive and polished appearance. It’s a great way to bring a bit of flair to your daily routine.

70050000057430.name: Mysteria Island
70050000057430.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70050000057430.description: Set sail for Mysteria Island, a mysterious land rich with hidden gold and a majestic castle to explore. This enchanting new location offers adventure, treasure, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. A perfect destination for those seeking something extraordinary beyond the mainland.

70050000057434.name: Hammerhold Campaign
70050000057434.intro: Hammerhold's in for a surprise: Vez'nan sends you with the mighty Dark Army fleet for a lightning strike on the desert shores, catching the Legionnaires off guard!
70050000057434.description:
New thrilling stages and bosses
- 5 new stages: A whole new campaign packed with sand-tastic surprises. Each stage offers 3 different modes: Campaign, Heroic and Iron.
Disembark on the desert's shores, replenish at Sape Oasis, explore ancient pyramids. 
- New enemies: The Legionnaires have recruited an eclectic and rather quirky force. Prepare to face assassins, war elephants, djinnis. And even... magic carpets?
- Challenging Boss fights: Remember those heroes you thought were gone for good? They're back, and they're not here for a cozy family gathering.

The desert's fiercest join your ranks!
- New hero: Behold Isfet, a formidable mummy warlock, wielding an arsenal of spells and curses. Just don't make any ""wrapped up"" jokes – he’s not in the mood for puns.
- New tower: The Tremor Nest sandworms have an appetite as insatiable as a kid in a candy store. They'll gulp down anything in their path, be it friend or foe.

And of course…

- New achievements: For you to savor the sweet taste of bragging rights that come with them!
- Easter eggs galore: The desert may hold secrets, but it also has a sense of humor.

So, have you made up your mind, General?
Don’t keep the Dark Lord waiting too long, he’s known to get impatient! 
Time to rule the whole kingdom once and for all!

70050000057435.name: Pirate Kings Campaign
70050000057435.intro: It's time to hoist the sails and reclaim the seas in the name of the Dark Lord: pillage all 5 Pirate King’s islands for their hidden treasures!
70050000057435.description:
HOIST THE SAILS AND RECLAIM THE ISLANDS
New original stages and uncanny bosses!
- 5 new stages: explore all islands and lairs while encountering pesky new enemies.

Prepare cannonballs for the 5 “Pirate Kings”!
- Each stage offers 3 different modes: Campaign, Heroic, and Iron.

Pillage the Pirate King’s islands for their hidden treasures!
- New enemies: defeat corsairs, buccaneers, bomber parrots and even mischievous monkeys!
- And, of course, face electrifying boss fights against all 5 kings, including a familiar face… 


TURN THE TIDE OF BATTLE WITH THESE MIGHTY NEWCOMERS!
- New hero: Lucerna, an Evil Ghost Ship captain with ghostly fading abilities and bombastic firepower.
- New tower: the Ogre Shipwreck, a wrecked ship commanded by despicable Warmongers

AND, AS USUAL…

- New achievements: because what’s a pirate adventure without its tasty treasures? 
- Easter eggs galore: it’s never too deep to bring a joke or two to the surface!

General, bring the Dark Lord their flags!
Honor his dark rule by bringing his wrath to these insubordinate Pirates.
The Dark Army counts on you in this new mission!

70050000057442.name: NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Scenario,"Battle of Nagashino-Shitaragahara"
70050000057442.intro: The Final battle between Oda and Takeda
70050000057442.description:
An additional scenario for "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening."

After breaking the encirclement of the other Daimyo and ousting the Shogun Yoshiaki Ashikaga, Nobunaga had gained control of the Kinai area. 
While dealing with various internal problems, Nobunaga prepares for a final battle with Katsuyori Takeda, leader of the Takeda Clan following Shingen's death. 
Nobunaga's bid for unification was about to reach its climax.

▼Additional scenario
Battle of Nagashino-Shitaragahara

▼How to play
Select "NEW GAME" and at the scenario selection screen, select "Battle of Nagashino-Shitaragahara" to play.

70050000057445.name: Bridge Race: Busy DLC
70050000057445.intro: Build your bridges in a busy style!
70050000057445.description:

• Chef Skin – For masters of the kitchen with a taste for victory
• Astronaut Skin – Race beyond the stars
• Scuba Diver Skin – Perfect for deep dives into the competition
• Soldier Skin – March to victory with precision
• 10000 Coins – Extra coins to help you on your journey

Knock your foes off their feet with your new look!

70050000057447.intro: Build your bridges in a funny style!
70050000057447.description:

• Pigman Skin – Oink your way to the finish line
• Frenchman Skin – A charming look with Parisian flair
• Jester Skin – For mischief-makers who love to entertain
• 10000 Coins – Extra coins to help you on your journey

Knock your foes off their feet with your new look!

70050000057461.name: Hamster Playground - Tales & Tails Skin Bundle
70050000057461.description:
Step into a world of fashion and adventure and give your hamsters a style overhaul worthy of legends with the Tales & Tails Skin Bundle, five iconic skin packs spanning eras, intrigue and illusion:

- Ancient Skin Pack: Egyptian pharaoh headdresses, Greek togas and golden laurel wreaths
- Conquerors Skin Pack: rugged Viking tunics, horned helmets, pirate coats and tricorn hats
- Detectives Skin Pack: trench coats and classic detective caps
- Magicians Skin Pack: flowing capes, top hats and mysterious emblems
- Time Travellers Skin Pack: sleek futuristic suits and high-tech accessories

Mix and match these five packs for endless hamster style combinations!

70050000057462.name: Hamster Playground - The Whole Playground Pack
70050000057462.description:
Get ready to unlock every corner of Hamster Playground with The Whole Playground Pack, the ultimate mega-bundle that brings together all the thrills, chills, costumes and competitions in one irresistible package!
Race, pull, and go through every mode ever released:
- Vehicle Pull: test raw strength on winding tracks in our classic strongman challenge
- Eating Contest: mash that button to see which hamster devours the most snacks in record time
- Skateboard Race: carve through mazes and drag strips on four tiny wheels
- Beware The Cat: dodge prowling feline foes in this high-stakes survival sprint

Explore various styles with all DLCs:
- Spooky Hamster House: haunting décor, eerie outfits and ghostly quests
- Hamster City: urban furniture, on-the-job costumes and city-themed challenges
- Kawaii DLC: Asian-inspired décor, traditional garb and glamorous new missions
- Doll House DLC: dollhouse furnishings, rock-star outfits and music-themed quests
- Royal Hamsters DLC: medieval castles, knightly armor, royal gowns and fantasy adventures
- Cute Pets DLC: farmyard scenery, animal costumes and playful barnyard tasks

Deck out your hamsters with every skin pack ever released:
- Conquerors Skin Pack: armor, plumes and battle standards fit for a tiny general
- Ancient Skin Pack: regal robes, ornate headdresses and symbols of lost civilizations
- Detectives Skin Pack: trench coats and classic detective caps
- Magicians Skin Pack: flowing capes, top hats and mysterious emblems
- Time Travellers Skin Pack: sleek futuristic suits and high-tech accessories

Everything Hamster Playground has to offer -  every mode from Truck Pulling and Eating Contests to Skateboard Races and Beware The Cat, every world from Spooky Hamster House and Hamster City to Doll House, Royal Courts and Cute Pet farms, plus every skin from Conqueror armor to Ancient regalia - unlocked together in one epic bundle.

70050000057477.name: Clue: Noir Mansion Crime Scene
70050000057477.intro: Every shadow conceals a motive in Noir Mansion. Can you crack the case?
70050000057477.description:
The shadows over Hue County grow darker in the wake of a shocking murder.

Step into the elegant Noir Mansion and interrogate six suspects too sharp for their own good. They'll point fingers in every direction and offer up promises of honesty. 

But you know better. Trust nothing but your clue sheet...

Could it have been Crime Reporter Scarlett with the Mini Revolver? Maybe Private Detective Mustard used the ""Civil War"" Musket with Bayonet? Did Risk Analyst Plum turn himself into a liability with the Billiard Stick, or perhaps Lawyer Peacock cracked with the Meat Tenderiser. Did Signature Forger White sign off Boddy's death with the Silver Candelabra? Or maybe Con Artist Green phoned in a deadly performance with the Rotary Phone... 

With the Noir Mansion crime scene, you can toggle the special Noir filter at any time during your game! See the mansion in its full-colour glory, or drench it in deep, cinematic shadows. 

You'll also unlock Noir-themed cosmetics to dress up in true vintage style!

INCLUDES:

A BRAND-NEW CRIME SCENE – The highly requested film-noir theme arrives in Clue/Cluedo!

THEMED COSMETICS – This crime scene includes a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a sleek dice set and 12 new tokens.

MORE STORY TO EXPLORE – Delve into the murky backstories of each suspect and uncover their motives.

70050000057516.name: Truck Simulator 2025 - Driver Europe: Ultimate Garage
70050000057516.intro: A new truck, a new era of trucking domination.
70050000057516.description:
Upgrade your fleet in “Truck Simulator 2025 - Driver Europe: Ultimate Garage”!
Get behind the wheel of the MAH TGX800 – a powerful, stylish, and fully customizable truck built for serious hauls across Europe.

DLC Features:
- New Truck: MAH TGX800 – Experience the strength, style, and control of a next-generation machine.

Whether you’re hauling across scenic coasts or pushing through rugged terrain, the Ultimate Garage DLC puts true trucking excellence in your hands.

Add the MAH TGX800 to your collection and rule the roads like never before!

70050000057541.name: Dead by Daylight: Steady Pulse
70050000057541.description:
Time slows down. Calm settles in. Not even the looming shadow of a Killer can break her focus. If there are people in need, Orela Rose will save their lives – or die trying.   

Dead by Daylight: Steady Pulse brings new Survivor Orela Rose onto the scene. Haunted by the shocking death of her best friend, Orela dedicated her life to helping others as a paramedic.

Purchasing this Add-On also unlocks an exclusive Cosmetic: Black and White Blazer.

70050000057574.intro: Invite Princess Sakuna and Tama from Sakuna: Of Rice of Ruin to the lands of Azuma with this free DLC!
70050000057574.description: Princess Sakuna and Tama from Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin make their way to Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma. Sakuna can help you farm rice or join you in battle on your adventures.

70050000057575.name: KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It "Dire Situations" DLC
70050000057575.intro:
Consider or DIE
Extra content that awakens your hidden survival instincts.
70050000057575.description:
Survival Instinct.
It’s that gut feeling we’ve had since the caveman days—the power to sense danger and stay alive.
When things go seriously wrong, reading the room becomes a matter of life or death.

■ What’s This Game About?
This is extra content for KUUKIYOMI 4: Let’s Play Together, and it’s all about one thing: high-stakes situations.

From small everyday mess-ups to zombie outbreaks and even alien encounters—this world is full of chaos.
Take control of the red object on screen and face 30 brand-new, slightly more dangerous scenarios than usual.

■ Game Modes
・"Consider It" mode
Go through 30 non-stop do-or-die situations.
At the end, you’ll get a rating of how well you can read the room when it really counts.
Play again and again to train your survival instincts.

・“Consider It Together” mode.
Tackle 10 intense scenarios with a friend or family member.
Work together, stay in sync, and see how well you vibe as a team!

70050000057668.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Metalhead Character DLC
70050000057668.intro: Play as all-new, fully ranged character Metalhead!
70050000057668.description:
WEAPONS FULLY CALIBRATED
Play as the loveable, locked and loaded Metalhead! As Splintered Fate's first fully ranged character, he comes with a unique gameplay style to complement the Turtles. Fire his blasters, transform into a spinning missile frenzy, and lob landmines to stop enemies in their tracks. Metalhead has an affinity with our new (free!) Robotics Powers. Fully playable in both the Main Campaign and the all-new Arcade Mode, Metalhead is ready to join you wherever you play!

NEW WAYS TO PLAY
Play with 5 new Artifacts that can modify your run in interesting ways:
- Mysterious Gofu - Grants a random Tool at the start of each Chapter
- Gigantic Tusk - You can't heal, but gain a bunch of extra Dragon Coins
- Kitsune's Cup - You can't heal, but gain a bunch of extra Dreamer Coins
- Cracked Stasis Beacon - You are slowed, but defeating a boss grants a huge supply of Scrap
- Clan Hamato Seal - gain an additional Splinter's Revive, and revive with more health

70050000057775.name: Only Way Up! Parkour Jump Simulator: Into the Horizon
70050000057775.intro: Leap Into the Unknown – Conquer the Horizon!
70050000057775.description:
Defy gravity in a brand-new skyline!

Take your parkour adventure to new heights with the Into the Horizon DLC. Explore a stunning new cityscape packed with daring jumps, wall runs, and gravity-defying challenges. Master fresh obstacles, race through elevated routes, and prove your freerunning skills in the ultimate test of agility.

The horizon awaits—remember, the only way is UP!

70050000057792.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator - New Car in Garage
70050000057792.intro: Unleash the power: Rule the streets.
70050000057792.description:
Turbocharge your experience with the New Car in Garage DLC – the ultimate head start for any aspiring street legend!

This DLC grants you a Quantum Thunder Racer, a cutting-edge machine built for pure speed and style. If you already own the Quantum Thunder, you’ll receive its equivalent in in-game cash, so you can further enhance your dream garage your own way.

Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned racer, this bonus pack gives you the boost you need to burn rubber and rise through the ranks even faster.

Own the road, your way.

70050000057796.name: The Outer Reaches
70050000057796.description:
THE OUTER REACHES
The Master has laid waste to countless worlds in his quest for power: the Fragmented Plains, the Red Barrens, the Coral Archipelago, and the Crimson Highlands.

These four worlds form the most direct path to The Master, but alternative routes exist. These are known as The Outer Reaches.

ANDROMEDA
Even the mighty Zodiacs fear Andromeda. If she accepts a fight with you, she won't kill you, but she won't go easy on you either. If you beat her, she will become available as a summon and you might unlock her ending!

DLC FEATURES
- 4 new worlds, each with their own soundtrack.
- 16 new traps/elements.
- 32 additional enemy types.
- Andromeda boss fight, summon and ending.
- 2 new secret rooms.

HOW TO UNLOCK THE OUTER REACHES
Defeat the Master at least once and start a Destiny Level 1 run. You will have access to the Shattered Rises, and you will be able to battle Andromeda.

70050000057807.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku - "Too Real"
70050000057807.intro: Face your demons with the official Rhythm Rift for "Too Real" by Danny Baranowky feat. Hatsune Miku!
70050000057807.description:
This Rhythm Rift comes with:
- A fully-bopping Hatsune Miku virtual idol
- Background visualizer with leek and music note particle FX

(This track is part of the Hatsune Miku Music Pack.)

70050000057815.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Unleash the New Rifle
70050000057815.intro: Unlock the ultimate weapon – dominate every mission.
70050000057815.description:
Gain the upper hand in high-stakes operations with the Unleash the New Rifle Pack! This exclusive DLC grants immediate access to the powerful Automatic Rifle III – a high-performance weapon built for precision and rapid response in critical missions.

 - Unlock the Automatic Rifle III, featuring improved accuracy, recoil control, and stopping power.
Already own this weapon? No problem — you’ll receive its value in in-game currency automatically.

Dominate the battlefield with confidence — the mission starts now! Gear up, take control, and show the enemy who’s boss.

70050000057817.name: dotAGE: Folkways
70050000057817.intro: Village elder, help us! Meet new Pipfolks, lure them into your village, solve the problems they will cause, and play with new elders with unique mechanics!
70050000057817.description: Village elder, help us! Meet new Pipfolks, lure them into your village, solve the problems they will cause, and play with new elders with unique mechanics!

70050000057825.name: Heir of the Roads
70050000057825.description:
Welcome to Volume I of Outlanders Chronicles: "Heir of the Roads". 

Faraway in the arid outskirts of the Outlands, right on the edge of a neverending sea of dunes and treacherous desert roads, a small provincial town is planning something unprecedented in its history: a journey to the capital.

Travel aside Fairuza, a young town leader, through a journey full of perils, surprises, and heartfelt moments.

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode.

70050000057830.name: Flood and Fire
70050000057830.description:
Welcome to Volume II of Outlanders Chronicles: "Flood and Fire". 

In the northern region of the Outlands, across its icy valleys and jagged peaks, five clans of vicious mountain folk live in constant rivalry. When a sudden rise in water level forces them to start anew in the upper regions of the mountains, they will have to adopt more sustainable habits in order to survive.

This DLC invites you to follow the story of five clan leaders, as they put their differences aside to help each other while discovering the truth behind the flood.

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode.

70050000057835.name: Life of Yolotli
70050000057835.description:
Welcome to Volume III of Outlanders Chronicles: "Life of Yolitli". 

Deep within the dense jungle lands of the Outlands, a girl is born. As she grows up in a world of power-hungry leaders and reckless habits, she will learn valuable lessons about the intricate cycle of life and nature, the cost of unrestrained ambition, and, most importantly, herself.

In this DLC, we follow the life of one single leader in different stages of her life, from her curious childhood all the way to her enlightened elder years.

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode.

70050000057840.name: Home is where the heart is
70050000057840.description:
Welcome to Volume IV of Outlanders Chronicles: "Home is Where the Heart is". 

After receiving a letter from an estranged family member, a rookie Leader will journey through the tricky swamps of the Outlands while tracking the steps of his ancestors.

In this DLC, we follow the intertwined lives of four new characters exploring their own sense of belonging.

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode.

70050000057845.name: The Keeper's Shanty
70050000057845.description:
Welcome to volume V of Outlanders Chronicles: "The Keeper's Shanty".

The arrival of rowdy tourists disrupts the serenity of a group of tropical islands home to the meticulous ecologists Pirate Sisters. As the ambition of the castaways agitates the ecosystem, it’s up to its self-proclaimed protectors to take matters into their own hands and restore their home.

Follow the trials and tribulations of both locals and newcomers in a trail through the oasis-like landscapes the islands have to offer and unlock 3 new playable leaders!

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode.

70050000057850.name: Wandering Stars
70050000057850.description:
Welcome to Volume VI of Outlanders Chronicles: “Wandering Stars”.

In the midst of an expedition, a nomad community is led to a safe haven by a comet. The town considers its presence a good omen and celebrates every time it visits throughout the generations. However, one fateful day, the comet doesn’t appear, leaving them to helplessly try to stay together despite the absence of what once bound them.

Follow the rise and fall of a community and the adventures of 6 new playable leaders! Each with their own personalities and dreams, they will search for places that can accept them and their town. Trust your guiding star and navigate these levels on aegean-like landscapes and unforgettable characters.

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode and new buildings.

70050000057855.name: A Taste for Trouble
70050000057855.description:
Welcome to Volume VII of Outlanders Chronicles: “A Taste for Trouble”. 

Our journey brings us to a stark landscape, where a crime comes to the attention of one of the region’s brightest minds, the famous Detective Quan. During this journey, he will meet two idiosyncratic leaders with their own agendas, turning what initially seemed like an open-and-shut case into the highlight of his detective career.

Help Detective Quan and discover the truth behind this crime. Is everyone who they say they are? Will he find the truth or fail trying? There will be no question unanswered, no stone unturned, and no level uncompleted! 

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode, new buildings, and 3 new playable leaders.

70050000057860.name: The Culinary Diaries
70050000057860.description:
Welcome to Volume VIII of Outlanders Chronicles: “The Culinary Diaries”.

Unbeknownst to Antonia, a simple-minded anthropologist, a craving for elaborate meals had been simmering in her town. This realization sparks her quest to visit neighboring towns, learn their recipes, and bring them back to satisfy her community’s needs—and their appetites. 

Her involvement in the affairs of these towns teaches her the profound role food plays in a community, where she learns that, even without words, a well-prepared meal can serve as a helping hand, a pat on the back, or even a warm hug.

In addition to the 6-level campaign, this DLC contains new customization options for Sandbox mode, new buildings and recipes, and 5 new playable leaders.

70050000057868.name: New soundtrack
70050000057868.description: Immerse yourself in the emotional journey of lonely cats with a fresh soundtrack. Experience the world from a more intimate perspective, guided by new music and immersive elements.

70050000057878.name: Snug Finder: Hidden Joy
70050000057878.intro: Joy is hiding—can you find it?
70050000057878.description:
Step into a world of quiet wonder with Hidden Joy! 

Discover 15 brand-new cozy levels filled with charming details, heartwarming scenes, and unexpected delights. Whether you're a seasoned finder or just starting out, these hidden treasures will challenge your eyes and warm your heart. 

Relax, explore, and uncover the small joys tucked away in every corner.

70050000057883.name: Artifact Seeker - DLC 2: Shadow of the Deep Sea
70050000057883.intro: Tarasaya, pearl of the deep sea, disappeared overnight because of a sacred artifact called "Eternal Tide". Now, a fragment of a sea map will lead you to the ruins of Tarasaya in the deep sea.
70050000057883.description:
New character, Mermaid Princess Marisa.
The Kingdom of Dark Sea, Tarasaya, coveted the artifact "Eternal Tide" and was annihilated by the Ancient Gods. Only Princess Marisa was sealed by her mother's magic into a crystal coffin and sunk into the Abyssal Shadow. A thousand years later, Marisa awoke to find only the remnants of her homeland turned into phosphorescent dust and mist.
Characteristics: The princess is more adapted to fighting in the water.

New character Mysterious Captain Raven.
Many years ago, when she was serving on King Penguin's ship, Raven had seen the fragment of the Tarasaya chart in King Penguin's hand. This time, she gambled on the Serenity, not only for the treasure, but also to make her own reputation surpass that of King Penguin.
Characteristics: A patient gunner, she prefers to stand still and observe the enemy's weaknesses.

New character Gem Master Layla.
This gem master, whose pupils are filled with sparkling stars, claims to have been born in the rift of the sands of time. Travelers exchange their memories for the gems she carves, but they do not know that those gems are prophecies refined from the fragments of their own souls.
Characteristics: Layla always finds gems of higher quality.

10+ new events
20+ new artifacts
new synergy
new enemies
new map
new boss
More new affixes.

70050000057886.name: New Officer Data for "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Complete Edition" Collaborating NIJISANJI's VTuber "Ibrahim"
70050000057886.intro: Ibrahim enters the world of "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION"
70050000057886.description:
An officer data collaborating with NIJISANJI's VTuber "Ibrahim" for "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Complete Edition". Ibrahim will appear as "Ib Rahim", an officer living in the Sengoku Era Japan.
There will also be an event by Ibrahim, depicting new endings of the Honnōji Incident.

- How to Apply
Select "Edit Officer", choose "Active" under "Extra Officers"  > "Active/Standby" to make "Ib Rahim" appear in the game.
Events featuring "Ib Rahim", such as "Escape from Honnōji - Ib Rahim" will occur when starting the game with the officer "Ib Rahim" activated for a certain scenario, such as "Like A Dream" with the Oda (Nobunaga) Clan, and when certain conditions are met before "The Honnōji Incident" occurs.

Note: This content will be available for purchase by June 4th, 2026. If the content was downloaded within the defined deadline, you can continue playing this content afterwards.

70050000057888.name: Atelier Series Legacy BGM Pack
70050000057888.intro: Change the BGM to some of your favorite past songs!
70050000057888.description:
Adds a BGM pack of previous Atelier series songs that can be used to change the background music in the game.
Includes a special selection of over 1,000 songs from past Atelier series titles, ranging from "Atelier Marie: The Alchemist of Salburg" to "Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy."

Note: This content will be displayed in English for some languages. The BGM pack is accessible after unlocking base building and placing a Gramophone. Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000057890.name: Additional Map "Falbra Thicket"
70050000057890.intro: Adds the new map "Falbra Thicket"! Pioneer an unexplored map!
70050000057890.description:
Adds the new map Falbra Thicket, located deep within the Ligneus region.
A map filled with a new Pioneering Effort, new items, a spacious Building Area, and new quests focused around the Alber.
Pioneer a new map along with your companions and receive special rewards.

Note: In order to access the additional map, you must first clear the main quest "The Alber Settlement." Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000057892.name: Special costume for Yumia in collaboration with Asbel from "Tales of Graces f Remastered"
70050000057892.intro: A collaboration costume of Asbel's outfit from "Tales of Graces f Remastered"!
70050000057892.description:
Adds a collaboration costume for Yumia.

Note: This content will be displayed in English for some languages. 
Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room. Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70050000057896.name: Puff Up - Minigames Pack 1
70050000057896.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock 3 minigames:
• Throw Balls! - Stick the pins into the spinning circle without crashing
• Ball Jump! - Jump higher, avoid obstacles, and try to reach the top before you fall
• Balls in Cups! - Rotate the maze to make the balls land in the matching colored cups

Get ready to POP from fun!

70050000057898.name: Puff Up - Minigames Pack 2
70050000057898.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock 3 minigames:
• Pop Balls! - Drop the ball, smash obstacles, avoid the pit
• Floor Jump! - Jump and avoid obstacles, remember, your ball keeps rolling
• Zig Zag! - Zigzag upwards, change direction, avoid obstacles and walls

Get ready to POP from fun!

70050000057928.name: Experience x3 - Covenant of Solitude
70050000057928.description:
All characters' experience gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000057930.name: No Encounters - Covenant of Solitude
70050000057930.description:
Disables battle encounters.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000057932.name: Damage x2 - Covenant of Solitude
70050000057932.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000057934.name: No Skill Cost - Covenant of Solitude
70050000057934.description:
Skills no longer consume MP in battles.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000057973.name: Date Everything! - Early Bird DLC
70050000057973.description:
Can’t wait to get down and dirty with your fireplace? Long for the sweet embrace from your fridge? Our Early Bird Pre-Order Edition will have an incredibly profound effect on gameplay!

• Player Character wakes up one minute earlier each day – all clocks will be set to 8:59AM!
• Cute birdy comes by and whistles songs! This is a good thing maybe!

70050000057974.name: Date Everything! - Lavish DLC
70050000057974.description:
Is 100 just simply not enough dateable objects? Are you unsatisfied with lower-priced goods?  Do you literally want to fall in love with a micro-transaction?

With the Lavish DLC there is simply more of everything to extend your Date Everything adventure:

• Michael Transaction – the dateable micro-transaction! We gacha covered!
• Lucinda Lavish – the dateable deluxe edition herself.
• Fantastic Red Shirt – an unlockable option to be wearing a shirt that will sometimes be commented on by the dateables in a positive manner!
• Phone Backgrounds – Customizable phone menu with 26 new background covers to add a little… personality! 
• Artbook - Concept art for all 102 characters, plus never-before-seen costumes and collectables!
• OST - 4 hours of every genre under the sun!

70050000057983.name: No Man's Sky – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000057983.description:
Experience enhanced visuals and additional features with the No Man's Sky – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack!

Featuring:
Multiplayer - Meet other Travellers and discover, build, and fight together.
Enhanced visuals - Explore a more beautiful, higher-resolution universe.
Settlements - Become Overseer of growing planetary settlements.

70050000057990.name: Farming Tractor Simulator 2023 : Drive Combine & Trucks - Skybox Upgrade
70050000057990.intro: Breathe new life into your farm with stunning skies.
70050000057990.description:
Skybox Upgrade DLC introduces a significant visual enhancement by replacing the default SkyBox with a more refined and sophisticated version. This update transforms the sky above your farm, adding dynamic clouds, smoother lighting transitions, and more breathtaking sunsets and sunrises.

The new SkyBox greatly improves the atmosphere, providing a more detailed and realistic visual experience. You’ll notice subtle changes in the sky throughout the day, with richer colors and more natural lighting. This upgrade adds depth and immersion, making every moment on your farm feel more alive and captivating.

Bring new life and beauty to your farm with this visual upgrade!

70050000057991.name: Ravenswatch - Romeo & Juliet
70050000057991.description:
The greatest love story of all didn’t end the way we were told. Desperate after Romeo’s death, Juliet struck a deal with Baba Yaga. The witch agreed to bring her beloved back to life, but bound their fates together forever. United in life and in death, the two lovers now bear the burden of a curse whose effects far exceed their hopes… and their nightmares.
Fleeing Verona, the lovers joined the Ravenswatch in search of the treacherous witch, hoping to break their curse.

Romeo is a master swordsman, able to wield his rapier with melodic agility and grace.
Juliet wields her musket with deadly precision, able to pierce multiple enemies with a single shot.
Both heroes can be played solo, but only reveal their full potential as a duo. Their abilities complement each other, creating powerful synergies - if they stay together. In co-op mode, if one falls for good, the other goes down with them.

Unlock Romeo and Juliet, and experience a tragic tale where love and destiny intertwine. Face the Nightmare alone or join forces in co-op mode to uncover the secrets of Ravenswatch - at your own peril.

70050000057992.name: Ravenswatch - Romeo & Juliet Skin Pack
70050000057992.intro: Unlock 6 exclusive matching skins for Romeo and Juliet. Available from the hero selection menu.
70050000057992.description:
Unlock 6 exclusive matching skins for Romeo and Juliet. Available from the hero selection menu.

* Ravens Skins – Elegant garments in the colours of the Ravenswatch, worn proudly by the star-crossed lovers.
* Nightmare Skins – Dark and menacing attire inspired by the Nightmare.
* Eternal Love Skins – A unique spectral look with all-new visual effects, celebrating a love that defies death.

70050000058011.name: Special SFX Weapon Set
70050000058011.intro: Spice up your battles with these special weapons with original sound effects!
70050000058011.description:
This set contains the following downloadable content:
 
 ● Special Equipment - Noxus Albus (Laser Rifle)
 ● Special Equipment - Immutable Sin (Laser Rifle)
 ● Special Equipment - Gramr (Laser Blade)
 ● Special Equipment - King of Arms (Minigun)
 ● Special Equipment - Golden Dusk (Assault Rifle)
 ● Special Equipment - Crane (Machine Gun)

70050000058031.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Weapon Upgrade
70050000058031.intro: Reload your arsenal with a legendary shotgun.
70050000058031.description:
Gear up for your next hunt with the new gun - Regmintona 070, a powerful and reliable shotgun designed for close-range encounters with wild game. Whether you’re tracking fast-moving prey through dense underbrush or facing down a predator, this weapon offers unmatched stopping power and precision.

	•	This DLC grants you the Regmintona 070 for free — a versatile addition to your arsenal that blends classic design with lethal performance.
	•	Already own the Regmintona 070? No problem. Players who have previously unlocked this weapon will receive its full in-game value as compensation.

Add the Regmintona 070 to your loadout and dominate the wild with confidence!

70050000058033.name: Pinball FX - Williams Pinball Volume 9
70050000058033.description:
This classic Williams™ Pinball collection brings three iconic tables together - PIN BOT™, TAXI™, and WHO dunnit™ - each delivering a unique design, theme, and gameplay. Celebrate the golden age of pinball with vibrant style, addictive multiballs, and countless surprises for players of every skill level.

This pack features:

TAXI™: Jump into the driver’s seat of this high‑score cabbie extravaganza! Pick up famous passengers like Santa Claus, Dracula, Gorbie, or PIN BOT himself.

WHO dunnit™: Investigate crime scenes, gather clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the case - all within an amazing noir environment from the 1930s.

PIN BOT™: Embark on a journey through the Solar System! Fill the lamp matrix to unlock PIN BOT’s visor and shoot jackpots on this iconic 1980s sci-fi classic.

70050000058034.name: Pinball FX - Tomb Raider Pinball
70050000058034.description:
Relive Lara Croft’s greatest adventures with two action-packed tables! From the legendary halls of Croft Manor to mysterious tombs around the world, test your skills, uncover secrets, and play through iconic moments from the Tomb Raider franchise.

Adventures of Lara Croft: Embark on a globe-spanning pinball journey, reliving Lara Croft’s most legendary adventures. Face iconic enemies, explore ancient temples, and collect mythical artifacts in this action-packed pinball table!

Secrets of Croft Manor: Step inside Lara Croft’s ancestral home, where adventure awaits behind every corner. Train for Lara’s next expedition, explore hidden rooms, and uncover the manor’s deepest secrets! 

Whether you're training in Croft Manor or uncovering lost artifacts around the world, Tomb Raider Pinball is packed with adventure, nostalgia, and high-score thrills. Adventure awaits... are you ready?

70050000058037.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Touhou Project Arrangements Pack Vol. 2
70050000058037.description:

*The songs included in this product may be available in the Taiko Music Pass. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

70050000058053.name: Space Adventure Cobra - The Awakening - Preorder Bonus
70050000058053.description: Receive this exclusive bonus skin for Cobra, inspired by the iconic jacket he wore in the very first episode of the anime series.

70050000058054.name: Space Adventure Cobra - The Awakening - Gold Edition Upgrade
70050000058054.description:
Discover the Digital Gold Edition of “Space Adventure Cobra: The Awakening” and enjoy an exclusive bonus mission adapted from the 13th episode of the anime series: “The Roulette of Death”.

This special edition includes: 
- Smoking Skin
- Bonus Mission

70050000058072.name: Spy Guy Indonesia
70050000058072.intro: Spy Guy goes to conquer Indonesia!
70050000058072.description: Another addition to the Spy Guy game. This time we will take you on a journey to Indonesia, where in addition to hidden objects you will be able to learn interesting facts about the country through an interactive quiz.

70050000058076.name: Candivity: Under Water DLC
70050000058076.intro: Merge coins together and get the biggest treasure under the sea!
70050000058076.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- A new Under Water map
- 6 marine characters
- 9 diving accessories

Sweeten your day with a brand new look!

70050000058081.name: Ultimate Rock Climbing Challenge: Climber’s Pant
70050000058081.intro: Transform your climb with exclusive new gear!
70050000058081.description:
Ready to take your climbing experience to the next level? With the Climber’s Pant DLC, you’ll receive the exclusive Pant 4 gear as soon as you enter the game. If you’ve already purchased this item without the DLC, don’t worry – we’ll ensure you get the best value for your gear.

Features:
	•	Exclusive Gear: Get the Pant 4 gear, designed to improve your climbing experience with added style and functionality.
	•	Refund Guarantee: If you’ve already purchased Pant 4 before, you’ll automatically receive a refund, ensuring you get the best deal.

Upgrade your climbing gear and elevate your adventure today!

70050000058088.name: Hole io: Apocalypse DLC
70050000058088.intro: Wear doomsday skins and visit the new Apocalypse map with your friends!
70050000058088.description:
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- Apocalypse map
- Punk skin
- Nomad Skin
- Bandit Skin
- Scope Skin
- Ghoul Skin
- Survivor Skin
- Hazmat Skin
- Mutant Skin

Choose your cool skin, eat trash, cars, hideouts, motels, abandoned buildings, power plants and grow BIG!

70050000058136.name: Hot Wheels Let's Race™: Ultimate Speed - High Voltage Speed Pack
70050000058136.intro: Electrify the track with new cars, new track builder parts, and bold new decals!
70050000058136.description:
Turn up the power and leave your rivals in the dust! The High Voltage Speed  Pack amps up the action with futuristic rides, electrifying track parts, and bold new customization options.

Includes:

• 2 New High-Performance Cars
Unleash the futuristic Power Surge and the sleek Mach Speeder, both tuned for ultimate velocity and style.

• 2 New Themed Track Parts
Add high-voltage flair to your creations with electrified Track Builder pieces.

• 6 Exclusive Decals
Deck out your rides with cutting-edge, high-tech designs to stand out on the track.

Get ready to light up the race!

70050000058138.name: Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek - Fright Pack
70050000058138.intro: Get Slappy, the Haunted Mask, Jack O’Lanterns and more—each plus spooky-themed slingshots!
70050000058138.description:
Take your adventure to terrifying new levels with the Fright Pack—a monstrous bonus bundle that's as creepy as it is cool:

• 5 frightful, wearable monster masks from the R.L. series: Slappy, Attack of the Jack O'Lanterns, Werewolf of Fever Swamp, The Haunted Mask, and Lawn Gnome

• 5 slingshot skins based on the masks.  The VFX for the projectile trails are colored to match the slingshot and mask for one cohesive, awesome in-game presence

• 3D Model Viewer for you to check out all of the in-game characters in up-close detail in full 360-surround view

• Concept Art Viewer: Engage this image viewer to cycle through the amazing concept art images for the game.

70050000058140.name: Sunny Summer Style
70050000058140.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70050000058140.description: Swap Draco’s and Luna’s outfits to breezy summer attire with a quick click on the home-mannequin.

70050000058141.name: Draco's Nook
70050000058141.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70050000058141.description: Turn Draco’s room into an animal-lover’s sanctuary: hang a striking wildlife portrait, display a snug egg incubator with perfect hatching conditions, and relax in a bed framed by elegant bird carvings—toggle the makeover anytime via the mirror at home.

70050000058142.name: Luna's Nook
70050000058142.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70050000058142.description: Transform Luna’s room into a lush plant paradise filled with hanging leafy vines, terrarium, and colorful potted blooms —switch the style whenever you like with the home mirror.

70050000058143.name: Seaside Stories
70050000058143.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70050000058143.description: Embark on a summer-exclusive quest with a friendly mermaid who boosts your max energy. Dive in with new swimwear to gather shells—each with a chance of hiding a pearl—and showcase your collection on the seasonal shelves of the Fisherman’s House.

70050000058147.name: Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator: Starter Cash Boost
70050000058147.intro: Every empire needs a strong beginning. Boost your business.
70050000058147.description:
Kickstart your car wash empire with an instant boost!
With the Starter Cash Boost DLC, you’ll receive 2500 in-game cash added directly to your balance. Use this head start to speed up your progress—upgrade your first wash station, unlock new self-service bays, or invest in automation sooner than ever before.

Perfect for new entrepreneurs who want a faster route to success or experienced players looking to expand even further!

Grow your business smarter and faster—start with the advantage you deserve!

70050000058154.name: Dungeons 4 - Tales from the Campfire
70050000058154.intro: Stay a while and listen by the fireplace.
70050000058154.description:
This tiny vessel of the Always-Vigilant-Evil has discovered the terror-inducing quality of its howls, so the forces of Evil must team-up with all their power and skill to entertain it with some new adventures. Thus, the events unfold, and our protagonists (disgustingly good and enlighteningly evil alike) embark on four wildly diverse and challenging missions – which somehow still feel like a walk in the park compared with the horrifying nights alongside the Diaper-Wearing-Evil and its nerve-wrecking battle cries. 

• “Tales from the Campfire” enriches the world of Dungeons 4 with four bone-chilling, fully voiced campaign missions; each telling a story fit to calm the unruly (and incredibly loud) soul of the Regrowing Evil.

• Mission 1 “Gorgu’s Toys” starts out with the meanest theft in history – those pesky heroes have stolen Gorgu’s favourite toy mirror. Act fast to regain this treasured item before Gorgu’s tears flood your dungeon and drown your wildest dreams of evil supremacy. 

• Mission 2 is called “The Great Mail Robbery”. You might be sensing a recurring theme here, but this time, you are on the right side of the story: Catapulted back to the Wicked Wild West you’re aim is to rob a mail train! Sounds like a lot of fun, doesn’t it? 

• Mission 3 “Molten Core” is not for the weak willed, Thalya’s icy heart won’t be enough, you’ll need all the help you can get to cool down a steaming-hot, highly explosive volcano – even if it means working together with Tristan and his heroes.

• In Mission 4 we reach our fluffy finale with “Counting Sheep, Dungeon Style”: In the idyllic realm of the Knights of the Order of the Sheep, heroes wield a different kind of magic, turning your gruesome servants of Evil into fluffy, nerve-rackingly bleating sheep. But perhaps the Explosion-Loving Evil can use some sheep of its own...?

• Throughout all these stories, four new skills for Thalya will make sure your sweetest dreams come true – “Bad Air”, “Indomitable Horde”, “Hero Graves”, “Dark Side”.

70050000058171.name: HITMAN World of Assassination - The Banker Pack
70050000058171.description:
Unlock a series of cosmetics inspired by The Banker Elusive Target mission and gain permanent access to The Monarchique - A Two-level Arcade contract featuring The Banker Elusive Target.  

The pack includes: 
• The Banker King of Cards Suit 
• The Banker Silenced Pistol
• The Banker Rope
• The "Casino Monarchique" Chip (1.000.000)
• The Monarchique - A Two-level Arcade contract featuring The Banker Elusive Target

And a set of cosmetics for the Freelancer Safehouse inspired by the iconic Elusive Target mission.

70050000058197.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Werehog Pack
70050000058197.description: The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Werehog Pack includes the playable character Werehog, the Werehog vehicle "Beast Spike", and the Werehog Decal!

70050000058200.name: Flowers Pack 1

70050000058200.description: A set of flowers to embellish a sticker album.

70050000058201.name: Space Odyssey 1
70050000058201.intro: A purrfect puzzle among the stars!
70050000058201.description: Discover 24 fresh puzzles and help the space cats find their perfect spot among the stars!

70050000058205.name: Rocket Car : Ultimate Ball League Machines - Boost Your Balance
70050000058205.intro: Start strong, race fast, conquer the league.
70050000058205.description:
Fuel your journey in the Rocket Car league with a boost of 100,000 credits to your balance! Whether you’re upgrading your car or customizing your ride, this DLC gives you the resources you need to get ahead and dominate the competition.

Get ready to accelerate your experience with:
- 100,000 credits to enhance your cars and unlock powerful upgrades.

Join the action with a head start and race towards victory in the Rocket Car league!

70050000058207.name: Solaris Polaris skin
70050000058207.intro: Burn the Square to ashes with the new Polaris skin!
70050000058207.description: The Solaris start the game with the ability to turn water into solid lava and petrify enemies into ash. Master Heatwork, Osteophagy, Geothermics, Magmatism, Explosives, and much more.

70050000058245.name: Arsenal Skin Set
70050000058245.intro: Customize your Arsenal's look with these unique skins!
70050000058245.description:
This set contains the following downloadable content:
 
● Arsenal Skin - Crusader

70050000058246.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku Music Pack

70050000058246.description:

70050000058251.name: Special Equipment Set
70050000058251.intro: Spice up your battles with this special equipment set!
70050000058251.description:
This set contains the following downloadable content:
・Arsenal Skin - Bahamut
・Beguiling Suit (Outer Suit)
・Special Equipment - Victorious Gleam (Laser Blade)

70050000058276.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: Gold Rush
70050000058276.intro: Upgrade, drive, and claim your fortune.
70050000058276.description:
Enhance your offroad adventure with the Gold Rush DLC, giving you the ultimate advantage with 15,000 gold to boost your journey through challenging terrains. Whether you need to upgrade your legendary vehicles, enhance your winch, or improve your suspension and engine, this DLC will ensure you’re fully prepared for any off-road challenge.

What’s included:
- 15,000 Gold – Use it to upgrade your vehicles, unlock premium customizations, and improve performance.

Get ready to dominate the muddy forests, sandy careers, and snowy mountains with the Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: Gold Rush! Ready to take your off-road experience to new heights? The road less traveled awaits!

70050000058304.name: hololive Music Pack
70050000058304.intro: Transcend dimensions with the OFFICIAL hololive Music Pack!
70050000058304.description:
Featuring FOUR new Rhythm Rifts for:

70050000058415.name: Reus 2 - Ice Age
70050000058415.intro: Ice is life! Shape the world in a frozen new era.
70050000058415.description:
Fill the universe with even more life in Reus 2: Ice Age!
Re-create the prehistoric Ice Age with this brand new expansion, filled with biotica that have unique synergies with your worlds ecosystem.
- New Biome - Ice Age Tundra
- Variation of Aegir, the mighty Frost Giant
- 40+ new biotica, including apexes and cohorts
- New archetypes like Evolve and Extinct, building around early biotica to empower future ones

New Leaders
With 4 new leaders to explore, see how their personalities and desires shift the direction of humanity:
- The Painter - Wants to unlock as much as possible
- The General - Gains bonuses to military
- The Poet - Improves projects
- The Villain - Thrives in a hateful world

New Eras
There are also 4 new eras across the development of humanity to experience, giving even more opportunities to create thriving worlds or lead humanity to a spectacular end!
- Hunter Age - Crops don't grow easily in this weather so humans must hunt to survive.
- Enlightenment - Minds brimming with ideas, embrace an age of invention!
- Nuclear War - Create nuclear weapons and potentially blow up the entire planet.
- Age of Discovery - A planet full of biomes and adventures, humans love to collect oddities.
