70050000058434.name: Cotton DLC
70050000058434.intro: Cotton & Silk join the Cute 'Em Up adventure in the Trouble Witches universe, seeking her favorite WILLOW!
70050000058434.description:
It’s a magical crossover! Cotton & Silk bring their own “Trouble” to the Trouble Witches universe! 

The Trouble Witches world just got even more magical! Expand your spell-binding and witchy roster with the arrival of Cotton and her companion Silk in this extra character DLC: a special collaboration with the beloved "Cotton" series! 

This DLC includes: 

- New Playable Character: Cotton 
Take control of the young and powerful witch Cotton, joined by her cheeky fairy companion, Silk! With a completely unique playability, Cotton brings a fresh experience and chaos to this title. 

- Cotton Story Mode: 
Enjoy the original story featuring Cotton as she stumbles into the Trouble Witches world! Fully voiced in Japanese and filled with quirky dialogue, this exclusive scenario blends the humor and charm of the Cotton series with the bullet-hell thrills of Trouble Witches. 

- Exclusive Cotton BGM: 
Immerse yourself in the extra Cotton soundscape! Switch between the original Trouble Witches soundtrack and Cotton's own BGM whenever you like. 

Full Mode Compatibility: 
Whether you're battling through Arcade Mode, braving Walpurgis Night, or chasing high scores in Score Attack, Cotton is fully playable across all game modes 

*Please note that to download the Cotton DLC, the base game “Trouble Witches FINAL! Episode 01 Daughters of Amalgam” must be installed in your console.

70050000058594.name: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures - Determined to Love Christmas
70050000058594.intro: Explore five new locations in Who-ville with The Grinch and Max for a feast that’ll bring holiday cheer. Earn fun gadgets, accessories and more.
70050000058594.description:
It’s official. The Grinch has had a change of heart and now he wants to show every Who in Who-ville just how much. 

Get into the Christmassy spirit with him and Max swinging, sleighing, and even parachuting through the snowy land, gathering food to put on a festive feast. 

These missions will be full of puzzles to solve, fun accessories to unlock, and new obstacles to dodge. Watch out for those icicles!

DLC includes:

- Six new levels
- Fun gadgets to customize
- More accessories

From the Grinch Caves in Mount Crumpit down to the Village, work together to remind The Grinch he belonged all along.  

- Explore five new areas of Who-Ville
- Discover a secret snow-filled level 
- Play with new gadgets, such as Max’s parachute.
- Collect Grinchy rewards by gathering food and presents.

70050000058599.description:
Experience 5 stages of chaos and critical decisions you won't find in regular operations! Put your comprehensive air traffic control skills to the test in real-world scenarios!

[Details]
STAGE 1 "Centrair Shakes in Strong Winds!"
[Difficulty Level] NORMAL [Assigned Time] 8:00～8:25

STAGE 2 "Emergency Landing of an Aircraft!"
[Difficulty Level] HARD [Assigned Time] 10:10～10:45

STAGE 3 "Busy Flight Training!"
[Difficulty Level] EXTEND [Assigned Time] 14:30～15:15

STAGE 4 "Successive Emergency Evacuations!"
[Difficulty Level] HARD [Assigned Time] 11:20～11:50

Add this cult car to your top-tier collection and show who rules the city in career races. The Skyline R32 features classic design, advanced tuning options, and a driving experience that takes street racing to the next level.

70050000058791.description:
UNO™ Show ‘Em No Mercy™ is the most cutthroat version of the classic card game yet. It doesn’t play nice: embrace a new way to win, four rules designed to ruin friendships, and six Action Cards so brutal they should be illegal.
Ready to watch the world (and your game night) burn?

TWO WAYS TO WIN
• Play all your cards to win like a classic champ.
• Or be the last one standing as others fall to the Mercy Rule. If your hand has 25 or more cards, you're out, no second chances! Penalties stack fast, so stay sharp.
EXCLUSIVE RULES: DRAW, STACK, SWAP, AND PASS!
• Draw until you can play: If you don’t have a matching card, keep drawing until you do.
• Stacking: Stack Draw Cards to bury opponents in cards.
• 7 Swap: Drop a 7 to swap hands with the player of your choice.
• 0 Pass: Play a 0 to pass all hands in the direction of play.

SUPER-TOUGH ACTION CARDS
• Use Wild Draw 10, Wild Draw 6, and Wild Reverse Draw 4 to bring devastating penalties.
• Play Wild Color Roulette and force others to draw until they get a card of a certain color.
• Unleash Discard All to get rid of a whole color from your hand and Skip Everyone to take another turn. There is always a way to come back!

70050000058802.name: Tangram Collection Gem

70050000058802.description:
The original tangrams first appeared in China. These addictive puzzles had players combining triangular pieces (called tans) to form a simple image. All pieces had to be used and could not overlap. It is the elegance of this format that made tangrams a worldwide sensation!

Tangrams have come a long way since their global debut, with modern variations introduced beyond the original set of 7 puzzles. Tangram Collection furthers that reinvention, offering welcomed variety to players looking for the next step in tangram evolution.

Tangram Collection Gem features:
• Over 50 challenging puzzles to keep you solving!
• Simple and clean interface for that Zen-like puzzling experience.

Founded in 2020, Error300 Games is a game development studio based in Dublin, Ireland. Avid gamers themselves, they strive to make the games they want to play.

70050000059234.name: ASTRONEER: Megatech
70050000059234.description:
In the ASTRONEER: Megatech DLC, players unlock the ability to build massive Megastructure projects that will test their Basebuilding skills using new and existing technology. Each Megastructure will have its own unique identity and gameplay, unlocking new possibilities and rewards. Harness the power of Megatech to take Basebuilding and Automation to a whole new level! This DLC will be completely compatible with existing saves, and builds off of any progress you’ve already made in game, feel free to start fresh, or load up your existing saves and start building!

In addition, this DLC will be released alongside a free update for all players. The free update will include new items and the ability to create a Megastructure that will allow automated interplanetary transportation. That means you will be able to move resources and technology between planets!

Build Megastructure Projects
A new level of basebuilding has been unlocked in Astroneer. Pick the perfect spot, launch a Construction Anchor via a very safe space catapult, and then start amassing resources to feed to a mega drone! Gather resources the old fashioned way, with your terrain tool, or use more advanced strategies to automate production and watch your Megastructures build themselves. Every megastructure has unique benefits, boosts, and boons that will help you on your journey to master the solar system. This update contains 5 Megastructure projects, some free, and some part of the DLC: 

1. The Intermodal Terminal (free for all players) – Your personal shipping hub in the solar system. Send items and resources between planets via three shuttles, and even use automation tools like rails, sensors, and auto arms to automatically ship the things you need to the places you want them. 
 
2. Distribution Launcher System (free for all players) – A foundational Megastructure that helps you begin your mega projects. Load it up with the resources necessary to launch an anchor to your desired spot, then let this high speed launcher deliver it with precision.  
 
3. The Biodome (part of the Megatech DLC) - This megastructure is all about the green. Use this advanced technology to automate flora generation and gain unique benefits with Bio-huts, add-ons that can expand the functionality of the main dome.  
 
4. The Orbital Platform (part of the Megatech DLC) -  This is the big one! The Orbital Platform is all about terrain and building space bases. Expand the bounds of the platform with terrain blocks that are completely flat to get creative, or build the space base of your dreams. You can also modify the asteroid at the center of the platform! 
 
5. The Museum (part of the Megatech DLC) - The Museum is all about prestige. Have you been making thousands of Nanocarbon Alloy nuggets for show? Well now you can put them somewhere that will track that hard work. Build automation bases to contribute bytes, resources, and power that will be tracked for all to see in the museum. You can also display your rare collections of items here.

Quality of life and new items
In addition to the aforementioned free Megastructures, this update also has new items and fixes for all players! Players will now be able to organize their bases with icon signs, elevated walkways, and an automatic tether dropping item!

Cosmetic Rewards
This DLC also contains exclusive cosmetic items!

Whether you’re cutting through hidden compartments or confronting dangerous suspects, this new knife skin blends bold style with the rugged demands of border duty. Let it be a symbol of your experience and resolve on the frontline.

Included in this DLC:
New Knife Skin: A vibrant red camouflage pattern that stands out in any situation.

Equip your blade. Enforce with precision. Make your presence known.

70050000059936.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70050000059936.description: Celebrate the Christmas in style with this holiday-themed DLC! Create a warm and cozy atmosphere that will delight every guest.

70050000059939.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar

70050000059982.name: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Ford Dual Pack
70050000059982.description:
The Ford Dual Pack brings raw American power to your Expeditions garage with two legendary beasts: the Ford F-150 Raptor R and the Ford F-450 Super Duty.

As the most powerful F-150 Raptor ever, the Ford F-150 Raptor R is built to withstand harsh desert conditions without breaking a sweat. Thanks to its exceptional off-road durability and precise maneuverability, this truck is made to explore uncharted territory and come back unscathed.

If you favour endurance, the Ford F-450 Super Duty is your go-to for long-distance expeditions in remote areas. With crushing traction, massive fuel capacity, and an engine that refuses to quit, it will haul you through hell and back—no matter how deep into the wild you dare to venture.

This DLC is not included in the Year 1 Pass.

70050000059986.name: Railway Empire 2 - Industrial Wonders
70050000059986.intro: Plunge into the pounding heart of the Industrial Revolution in Railway Empire 2 – Industrial Wonders.
70050000059986.description:
Spearheaded by the steam locomotive, this era unleashed a wave of productivity and innovation, enabling complex supply chains and monumental construction projects that had previously been unimaginable. In Germany, the Ruhr Valley emerged as the powerhouse of industrialisation, where coal mines, steelworks, and railroads formed a vast, interconnected web of progress. Meanwhile, France prepared to crown the 1889 World’s Fair with the Eiffel Tower – a striking symbol of modern engineering. And in 1931, the United States began work on the Hoover Dam, a colossal concrete feat built with daring new techniques.

In Industrial Wonders, your railway company flourishes at the center of these transformative projects. Establish your own production facilities and build efficient railroad connections to fuel regional development and enable the construction of engineering marvels. A more intricate production system, featuring variable outputs and input goods per factory, adds new depth and complexity. If you manage to keep everything on track, you’ll witness some of history’s most iconic structures rise to industrial glory — one trainload at a time.

• Steaming Steel: Railway Empire 2 – Industrial Wonders takes players on an entrepreneurial journey to three pivotal hubs of the age of industrialisation.

• Heavy Duty: Utilize three authentic locomotives, including the iconic “Big Boy” and “Heavy Mikado”. 

• Full Steam Ahead: The DLC introduces three comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios, “Industrial Miracle” (starting 1869), “La Dame de Fer” (starting 1880) and “Concrete Giant” (starting 1910) 

• Shaping the Future: Prepare for the challenges of three new high-resolution maps of the Ruhr Area, Île-de-France, and the Lower Colorado Basin. 

• Ramp up Production: Become the master of industry with a more complex production system: Establish your own production sites and switch production goods for select rural businesses, while your factories have a greater variety in input and output goods.

• Heavy Tunes: More than 15 new themed music tracks and jingles to get you in the mood for the new environment and locomotives.

70050000059989.name: Opus Castle - Chapter 3
70050000059989.intro: The mystery thickens. Explore new areas of the castle and face even more intense paranormal activity in Chapter 3.
70050000059989.description:
Shadows grow thicker, and the line between reality and illusion begins to blur. As you venture through previously unseen areas of the castle, you'll uncover disturbing memories hidden in its walls. 

Paranormal phenomena become increasingly intense, and each decision you make pulls you closer to one of the many story paths, will you find the truth, or be swallowed by the castle’s darkness?

70050000059990.name: Opus Castle - Chapter 4
70050000059990.intro: The castle remembers. In Chapter 4, time and reality twist as spirits reveal personal truths about the tragedy.
70050000059990.description:
Chapter 4 invites you into the heart of the castle’s darkest secrets. Time begins to warp, showing the past as if it were the present. Visions of those who lived and died, there become unavoidable. T

he castle begins to reveal its own consciousness, reacting to your presence. Your investigation into the tragedy turns personal, and each ghost you meet has a story to tell or a warning to give.

70050000059991.name: Opus Castle - Chapter 5
70050000059991.intro: In Chapter 5, the past takes over. Choices become more dangerous as you uncover painful truths.
70050000059991.description:
In Chapter 5, the weight of the truth begins to surface. The boundary between the living and the dead collapses, and the castle becomes a maze of emotions, memories, and danger. You are no longer just a visitor, you are a part of the story. 

With each step, you're pushed to make choices that could unlock salvation or doom. Can you handle the consequences of your curiosity?

70050000059992.name: Opus Castle - Chapter 6
70050000059992.intro: The final reckoning. Chapter 6 delivers the ending your choices shaped. Will you find peace or be trapped forever?
70050000059992.description:
The final chapter of Opus Castle brings all storylines to their conclusion. In this haunting finale, all paths converge, and the castle forces you to face everything you've discovered and everything you've done. 

The spirits are restless, and the truth is no longer just a mystery to solve, but a reckoning. The castle’s fate and your own, rests in the decisions you’ve made. Will you escape, or become another whisper in its haunted halls?

70050000060452.name: Dead by Daylight: The Walking Dead
70050000060452.description:
A world ruled by walkers fades as a realm of death takes shape. Still, their goal remains unchanged: unite, endure, survive. Dead by Daylight: The Walking Dead draws iconic new Survivors Rick Grimes and Michonne into The Fog. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Sheriff's Hat badge and Tank in Ruins banner. 

Hardened by loss and driven by hope, Rick and Michonne bring leadership, loyalty, and an unbreakable bond to The Entity’s Trials. Now, their perseverance must be tested once more as they’re thrust from a world consumed by death into a realm that hungers for it.

70050000060587.name: Everdream Valley: Family Time DLC
70050000060587.intro: More stories, activities, and family to make your farm into a place called home for you and your loved ones.
70050000060587.description:
The Family Time DLC is all about celebrating what makes the Valley so special – family ties, creativity, and cozy moments. 

More stories, activities, and family to make your farm into a place called home for you and your loved ones.

What's New?
- Grandparents’ House is now open: it’s time for a bigger project after decorating your treehouse. Grandma and grandpa loved what you did to your hideout, and now it’s time to cozy up their place! 
- New Story Quests: new heartwarming adventures and challenges.
- New NPCs – Mom and Dad: Your parents have come to the Valley, bringing lots of new farm adventures! 
- New Animals: Rabbits, birds, insects and new species of ducks.
- New plants and furniture: 10 new plant types (trees, vegetables, flowers, shrubs), and over 20 pieces of new furniture pieces to decorate with! 
- New Mini-Games: five new activities to participate in! 
- Planting Update: You can now place plants outside garden beds for decorative touches.

Ready to spend quality time with family and make new memories? The Valley is waiting for you!

70050000060602.intro: The retro Magic of Cassette Tapes in Simon's Hands!
70050000060602.description: This special portable cassette player allows you to experience Simon's newest adventure while jamming to the tunes of the Original Soundtrack of the home computer classic Simon the Sorcerer (1993)!

70050000060617.name: Operation Night Strikers CS Pack
70050000060617.description:
Taste the arrangements for each era and platform!
Includes six home ports of the arcade games included in Operation Night Strikers.
From the 8-bit machines of the 1980s to the CD-ROM add-ons for 16-bit machines of the early 1990s; experience the games reimagined to suit a wide variety of platforms.

Lineup
•	Operation Wolf (FC/NES/SEGA Master System version)
•	Operation Thunderbolt (SNES version)
•	Night Striker (Mega CD version)
•	Space Gun (SEGA Master System version)

Operation Wolf
Includes the FC version released in Japan in 1989, the North American NES version, and the European SEGA Master System version.
The game is set in the South American jungle, where the former president and embassy staff have been taken hostage in a coup d'état.
The influence of features such as switching weapons dependent on the situation, firefights while protecting hostages, and enemies attacking from behind cover can be seen in games which followed Operation Wolf.

Operation Thunderbolt
Includes the North American SNES version released in 1994.
Six soldiers, including Dan Burnett and Shin Miyamoto, are tasked with rescuing the passengers and crew of a passenger jet hijacked by soldiers of the Republic of Bintazi.
The console version featured several original elements, including a selectable stage at the beginning of the game.

Night Striker
Includes the Mega CD version released in 1993.
The  United Nations Special Tactical Action Force main offensive unit, known as Night Striker, speeds through the neon-lit streets in the Inter-Gray Xsi armored car on a mission to crush the ambitions of the terrorists.
This versions features the original soundtrack and a unique arrangement, either of which can be selected.

Space Gun
Includes the SEGA Master System version released in 1992.
Set in 2039, an era of space exploration. You take the role of a space marine commando investigating a series of unexplained accidents ultimately leading him to a space freighter emitting a distress signal which holds a terrifying secret on board.

Perfect your play with quick save and load!
Save and load at any time: replay your favorite scenes over and over again, or practice difficult situations to hone your skills!

70050000060630.name: More Festivities Pack (Lantern Lineup, Paper Fan Battle)
70050000060630.intro:
The festival fun continues!
Let's enjoy the festival even more!
70050000060630.description:

The "More Festivities Pack" includes the following content:

・Collection Coins for the new games

70050000060647.name: Imagine Earth - Galaxies
70050000060647.intro: Colonize galaxies and earn victory points to become administrator. Manage your station, use orbital elevators, and explore a 4-planet campaign.
70050000060647.description:
Colonize Galaxies

This DLC offers whole galaxies with up to 20 planets to explore and populate. They can be played both in a free endless mode or in a competitive game mode against AI corporations.

The Space Station

It serves as our headquarters and central hub for planetary colonies. It also enables interplanetary research and allows us to unlock extensions for city centers.

Orbital Space Lift

With this new high-tech construct we can move our resources and items quickly and free of charge between the planetary colonies and the space station.

Extensions

Extensions provide special abilities for our city centers. A maximum of 3 of them can be installed per city center.

Introductory Story Campaign

The DLC features a Story Campaign centered around the Genesis Seed Initiative, starring our new USN Advisor Ixas. It spans accross four planets.

Galaxy-Wide Competition

Each planet will generate continuous income to be used for subsequent colonies. The party that has earned the most victory points at the end of the pioneer phase is announced main administrator of the galaxy.

Space Capsule Delivery

City Center capsules can now pack items from the space station. We can redefine the extensions to be installed before landing.

70050000060727.name: Picnic Delight 2
70050000060727.intro: Waffle Your Way to the Purrfect Picnic!
70050000060727.description: Unwrap 24 tasty new puzzles and stack every treat perfectly on a delicious waffle.

70050000060728.name: Picnic Delight 3
70050000060728.intro: Waffle Your Way to the Purrfect Picnic!

70050000060741.name: Chained Echoes: Ashes of Elrant
70050000060741.intro: Eldrea is calling once again. Eldrea needs you. One. More. Time.
70050000060741.description:
Eldrea is calling once again. Eldrea needs you. One. More. Time. Ashes of Elrant is the official DLC for the highly acclaimed Chained Echoes, offering you more of what you enjoyed so much. Meet all your beloved characters and answer the call as the Crimson Wings are needed once again. 

Ashes of Elrant takes place right before the end of Chained Echoes. While you and your clan are preparing for the final fight, a new call for help reaches the Crimson Wings. This mission will reveal more about the origin of the Order of Leonar and Lenne's past. What challenges await you in a new land where nothing is as it seems?

70050000060801.name: Until Then: Afterimages
70050000060801.intro: Follow Mark & Sofia through two riveting chapters in the aftermath of our story
70050000060801.description:
Award-winning narrative adventure Until Then brings two new riveting chapters following our beloved characters. Sofia returns home to memories she left behind. Mark meets a new lover and an old friend. On their own, they explore what it means to carry on living in the presence of absence. 

Play fresh minigames from tarot to baking, interact with engaging in-game phone apps for dating and video content, and run into beloved characters old and new across two chapters of gameplay. 

Chapter 1: Homecoming
Sofia returns home amidst a lockdown—a lot has changed. Familiar places have vanished, people have grown up, and at the same time, she has to confront the past she'd conveniently left behind.

Chapter 2: Sparks
Mark is the proud, responsible head of a college organization. There he finds love and an unexpected old friend. Has he truly changed as a person or will a spark burn down everything he's built?  

Requires the base game to play.

70050000060823.name: Little Nightmares III - Ferryman Costumes Set
70050000060823.description:
This costume set is exclusive to the Secrets of The Spiral - Expansion Pass. It is available in a set of two, suited for both characters Low and Alone.

70050000060824.name: Little Nightmares III - Dark Six Costumes Set
70050000060824.description:
Get the Dark Six Costumes Set suited for both characters Low and Alone - a twisted reflection of the girl who escaped The Maw.

Many questions remain about the identity of Dark Six. Is she an alternate reflection of Six, a haunted, corrupted reflection? Is she the same person, but darker, shaped by her fears and the horrors she’s witnessed? Or is she something completely different?

Her silhouette remains unchanged, but something is different… The yellow is gone.
What’s left is a cold echo - quiet, watching, waiting.

Wearing this costume is more than a disguise.
It’s a question: What happens when you stop running… and become what you feared?

70050000060825.name: Little Nightmares III - Second Additional Chapter
70050000060825.description:
Delve deeper into the eerie lands of The Spiral.

This additional tale enriches the experience and lets you uncover hidden secrets, new perspectives, and unexpected horrors.

70050000060826.name: Little Nightmares III - Residents Costumes Pack
70050000060826.description:
Prepare to enter a world where fear wears many faces.

Conceal your identity in The Nowhere and embrace your dark side by wearing the costumes of some of The Residents of the two previous games: The Janitor, The Twin-Chefs, The Lady, The Hunter. Each costume goes in a set of two, suited for both characters Low and Alone.

The Janitor Costume: Step into the shadows - perfect for those who prefer lurking in the quiet corners, ready to sweep away any trace of their presence.

The Twin Chefs Costume: Double the terror, double the chaos - the Twin Chefs costume brings a twisted culinary duo that’s as unsettling as it is unforgettable.

The Lady Costume: Elegance with a dark twist, the Lady costume channels a haunting grace, blending beauty and dread in a way only the truly unsettling can.

The Hunter Costume: Embrace the hunt - fierce, relentless, and ever-watchful, a true predator lurking in the dark.

70050000060827.name: Little Nightmares III - The Backstage
70050000060827.description:
STEP INTO THE BACKSTAGE

While exploring The Spiral, Low and Alone are torn apart. To find his friend, Low must venture into the darkest part of The Carnavale, behind the curtains, into The Backstage. Some secrets should stay buried... In The Backstage lies The Puppeteer hunting the living canvas for her next masterpiece. The show must go on in The mighty Carnavale.

HOLD ON TO THE LIGHT

To stay out of the shadow, Low will have to rely on Dime, a companion in despair. With her Torch Hat, Dime seems to be the only one who can guide him through The Backstage. She is the sole light he can trust, but will that be enough to snatch Alone from the clutches of The Puppeteer?

*This product is also included in the Secrets of The Spiral Season Pass. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

*Kindly note that the Klonoa Costumes Set is not available in Little Nightmares III - The Backstage.

70050000060968.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Wishblossom Ranch
70050000060968.intro: Rebuild the ranch of your dreams, forge bonds with your horses, and befriend new Villagers as you saddle up for a new Disney adventure!
70050000060968.description:
Includes 5,000 Moonstones
Nestled amongst the Wishblossom Mountains is a special place powered by the Heart’s deepest wishes, where horses once roamed free and stables were full of life. That was until the Ranch fell into the hands of someone who neglected it, causing a mysterious phenomenon—the Decay. Saddle up for an adventure with your magical new Disney friends to find the missing horses, reverse the effects of the Decay, and restore the Ranch to its former glory!

Befriend Four New Villagers and Three Horses
Snow White has been taking care of the Ranch since the Decay, but now she needs your help! Awaken Tinker Bell in order to understand the power behind Wishblossom Magic. You'll work with (and against) Cruella De Vil to untangle the mysteries of the Mountains, and adventure with Tigger through areas transformed by weird and whimsical wishes. 
That's not all! On your journey, you’ll befriend iconic steeds Maximus, Khan, and Pegasus as you ride towards the far reaches of the Mountains in search of adventure. Each horse brings their unique personality and special gameplay abilities to help you explore.

Mount Your Horses for New Adventures
Care for your horses daily by feeding, brushing, and petting your horses to deepen your Friendship Levels with them. You can also fully customize your horse’s appearance with customization features and accessories tailored to your style! 
Ride your horses and unlock special abilities. Your new mounts can also help you care for your Valley by helping with gardening, mining, and cleaning out your Village, opening tons of unique new experiences. 

Set Off on Horseback in a Vast World
The Wishblossom Mountains combine three new Biomes for you to explore, including the Wishblossom Ranch, a rustic farmland surrounded by snow-covered peaks and alpine meadows. Each Biome contains a fully customizable layout to make your own, exclusive craftable items and meals to unlock, and animal companions to befriend!

Help Snow White Restore the Ranch to Its Former Glory
With the help of your new friends, set out on a quest to reverse the effects of the Decay and bring life back to Wishblossom Ranch. Adventure deep into the Crystal Caverns, at the Heart of the Mountains, to find the key to get this world up and running again and complete puzzles to reach new areas.

70050000060994.name: Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift - Pack Lazy-nya
70050000060994.description:
Cook up explosive lasagnas and drift your way to the finishing line with the Pack Lazy-nya!
This DLC contains a kart and a hat.

70050000060995.name: Spy Guy Memory Fantasy
70050000060995.intro: Search for Fantasy items in new addition to Spy Guy Memory
70050000060995.description: Another DLC of the iconic Spy Guy Memory Game - this time the Fantasy version!

70050000060997.name: Neva: Prologue
70050000060997.intro: Set years before the events of the main game, Neva: Prologue tells the story of how Alba and Neva first met.
70050000060997.description:
Follow Alba as she chases a trail of white butterflies deep into the corrupted swamps, only to discover a frightened wolf cub, lost and alone. Determined to save her, Alba must earn the young wolf's trust and guide her through the blighted wilderness. Together, they will face new enemies, endure perilous trials, and confront a monstrous force that threatens to tear them apart.

Designed to be experienced after completing the main game, Neva: Prologue offers a deeper challenge and rich narrative for returning players. The expansion introduces three new locations, each featuring unique gameplay mechanics, alongside new challenges, enemies, and intense boss encounters.

70050000061002.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure - Wheatflour Wonderland
70050000061002.intro: Cogimyun, a beloved new Sanrio character, is coming to Hello Kitty Island Adventure in the whimsical world of Wheatflour Wonderland.
70050000061002.description:
Throughout your journey you’ll craft powerful wands, discover the secrets of beautiful gemstones, and transform into your most magical self–or perhaps a supercute critter!

- Befriend Cogimyun for the first time ever, with 35 friendship levels to unlock
- Craft magical wands that let you cast magic, transform into critters, or become items around the world!
- Find hidden collectible Wheathearts in puzzles throughout our largest world since launch
- Discover new cooking and crafting opportunities that let you customize outfits like never before
- Grow the wondrous Wheatflower and discover the glitter effect, bringing a new sparkle to the game
- Meet Cogimyun’s pet, Ebi Fry, and her adorable little brother, Cogimyon
- Unlock new character furniture and whimsical cabins, and decorate to your heart’s content
- Play 3 delightful new mini-games–one with friends!

70050000061007.name: KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000061007.intro:
One 4 All, All 4 One,
This is a game that checks your ability to be considerate to make the world a little more peaceful.
70050000061007.description:
This paid pass upgrades the Nintendo Switch™ edition of KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

Challenge yourself to new layers of consideration in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, which comes with a menu that evaluates your mouse control skills while using the Joy-Con™ 2. Consider considering this too!

This product is for those who already own the Nintendo Switch version of KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It. You cannot play the game by buying this product alone.
If you already own the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It, you do not need to purchase this product, as it will be a duplicate purchase.

70050000061051.name: [for Physical Package] Costume - Fluffy Peach Set
70050000061051.description:
This AOC is available only to players who purchased the game as a physical package. We kindly ask you to verify this information before making a purchase, as players with the digital download version will not be able to access this AOC.

---

A light outfit with a peach-colored wool sweater.

70050000061052.name: Costume - Fluffy Peach Set
70050000061052.description:
This AOC is available only to players who purchased the game as a digital download version. We kindly ask you to verify this information before making a purchase, as players with the physical package will not be able to access this AOC.

---

A light outfit with a peach-colored wool sweater.

70050000061075.name: Flight Simulator Delivery – Business Expansion
70050000061075.intro: Build your fleet faster with a head start.
70050000061075.description:
Get a valuable boost for your aviation empire right from the start!
You will receive the first hangar. This gives you a solid foundation to expand your fleet and operations.
If you already own all available hangars, you will instead be granted 80,000 in in-game currency to invest in aircraft upgrades, cargo expansion, or new airports.
 This DLC ensures you have the resources you need to accelerate your growth and take your airline to new heights from day one.

70050000061090.name: Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Building Materials Expansion
70050000061090.intro: New materials. New strength. New possibilities.
70050000061090.description:
Strengthen your survival odds with the Building Materials Expansion DLC. The ocean is unforgiving, but with access to new, reinforced building materials, you can push your raft’s durability and functionality to the next level.

Features included in this DLC:
Your raft will be upgraded with new materials—stronger, more durable, and better suited to withstand the harsh conditions of the open sea.

Turn your fragile raft into an ocean fortress. With stronger materials and smarter designs, the sea is yours to conquer.

70050000061097.name: Hit Song Pack Vol.1
70050000061097.intro: The first additional music pack is here!
70050000061097.description:
The very first additional music pack for QQQbeats!!! is "Hit Song Pack Vol.1"! A lineup of popular tracks, including anime songs and viral hits, is here!

Here are the included songs:
- Usseewa / Ado
- Pixel Galaxy / Snail's House
- Senkou / [Alexandros]
- Byoushinwo Kamu / ZUTOMAYO

70050000061100.name: Virtual Song Pack Vol.1
70050000061100.intro: The second additional music pack is already here!
70050000061100.description:
The "Virtual Song Pack Vol.1," featuring popular songs sung by virtual singers, is now available! A wide variety of hit songs are included!

Here are the included songs:
- Goodbye Declaration / Chinozo
- God-ish / PinocchioP
- Konton Boogie / jon-YAKITORY

70050000061102.name: Nimble Doeling (Pet Follower)
70050000061102.description:
Partner up with a friendly animal companion in Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree.

It is always great to have a partner in adventure, even if all they do is follow you. Make friends with the Nimble Doeling, who will graciously watch from a distance as you fight for your life.

70050000061109.name: Holo's Hanafuda DLC: Oozora Subaru & Nekomata Okayu Set
70050000061109.intro: This DLC contains add-on content for Holo's Hanafuda.
70050000061109.description:
This DLC adds the following content to Holo's Hanafuda:

■New Content
・Playable talent: Oozora Subaru
・Playable talent: Nekomata Okayu
・2 outfits for Oozora Subaru
・2 outfits for Nekomata Okayu
・A brand-new playable scenario (Oozora Subaru & Nekomata Okayu Arc)
・2 new BGMs
・12 new in-game titles
・New bento ingredients
...and more!

70050000061177.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Custom Cruisers #5
70050000061177.description: Elevate your off-road adventures with "Custom Cruisers #5"! This latest DLC pack for Buggy Off-Road Racing brings five all-new skins that combine innovation and artistry. From vibrant and daring patterns to refined designs, each skin transforms your buggy into a visual masterpiece. Make a statement on every terrain, whether you’re speeding through desert dunes or navigating rocky trails. Stand out from the competition and showcase your unique racing style with "Custom Cruisers #5"!

70050000061178.name: Cooking: Viva la Pizza!
70050000061178.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70050000061178.description:
Are you ready to open your own cozy pizzeria?
Great, because thanks to Cooking: Viva la Pizza! now you can!

New location, new mechanics, and brand new fun! is there anything else to wish for?
Open your doors for customers and prepare them a delicious portion of pizza!

What can you expect from the DLC?
- 10 fresh Italian ingredients to put on your pizza - choose them accordingly to the orders!
- Possibility to organize your workplace - you can't cook in a mess...
- A professional oven - bake the best pizza, in the best conditions.

70050000061180.name: TCG Card Market Simulator: Exterior Customization
70050000061180.intro: Turn your shop into a street art legend.
70050000061180.description:
Personalize your store’s exterior with new and original graffiti! With the Graffiti Style Pack, you can change the artwork on your store’s walls to give it a fresh and unique look. Whether you prefer an urban style, colorful designs, or TCG-inspired art, your store will now catch everyone’s eye.

Show off your style and stand out from the competition! Create a space that speaks directly to TCG fans, turning your store into a vibrant meeting place for the community of enthusiasts.

With this DLC, your store’s exterior becomes as memorable as your card collection.

70050000061192.name: Subway Simulator – Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Urban Speed
70050000061192.intro: Elevate your skills with the newest high-speed train.
70050000061192.description:
Expand your underground empire with the brand-new Metroliner Express! This high-performance train brings speed and modern design to your subway experience. 

Hop into the driver’s seat of the Metroliner Express and master the tracks with style. Whether you’re rushing through tunnels or stopping at bustling stations, this sleek addition will redefine your subway operations. 

Get ready to elevate your ride — the Metroliner Express is waiting for you in the depot!

70050000061194.name: Gildcrest Transmog Set
70050000061194.description: The Gildcrest Transmog Set gives your Inquisitor an exquisite-looking suit of armor that will turn the heads of even Faelduum's richest denizens and enemies. Don your golden armor and slay your enemies in style!

70050000061196.name: Dark Ale Quest
70050000061196.description:
Embark on an exciting new quest within the world of Faelduum: Dark Ale!

Solve the mystery of what exactly is in a strange ale keg in the basement of Rosalie’s inn. Put not only your combat abilities to the test... but also your taste in ale! 

Grab a flagon, Inquisitor, because it’s going to be a long night...

70050000061198.name: Curious Ottling (Pet Follower)
70050000061198.description:
Partner up with a friendly animal companion in Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree.

Make friends with the Curious Ottling... for the rats’ sake, we hope the Ottlings are not curious about them.

70050000061200.name: Shadowpyre Transmog Set
70050000061200.description: Menace enemies with the Shadowpyre Transmog Set, a demon visage wreathed in shadows.

70050000061202.name: Original Soundtrack
70050000061202.description:
Listen to the Original Soundtrack for Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree. 

Get whisked away by haunting melodies and dark fantasy soundscapes composed by Christos Antoniou and performed by the FILMharmonic Orchestra Prague.

70050000061203.name: Digital Artbook
70050000061203.description: Fall into a dark fantasy world! Delve into the rich, atmospheric, painterly art style of Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree with this Digital Artbook.

70050000061206.name: Crafty Kitling (Kickstarter Reward)
70050000061206.description: Thanks for supporting Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree on Kickstarter! Claim your exclusive Crafty Kitling (Pet Follower) and adventure together with your new companion.

70050000061208.name: Night Witch Set (Kickstarter Reward)
70050000061208.description: Thanks for supporting Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree on Kickstarter! Claim your exclusive Night Witch Transmog Set and slay in style.

70050000061209.name: Battle Train - Revenge of the Puffin
70050000061209.description:
Battle Train DLC: Revenge of the Puffin is pulling into the station—are you ready for the ride?

Step into a frosty new battlefield with Ludwig the Buffin, a brand-new Champion with a beak full of vengeance and feathers full of fury. This action-packed DLC delivers a fresh narrative experience, explosive new content, and icy-cool challenges that will test your tactical mettle.

What's Included:
・A new story arc revealing Aalvado’s shady origins, complete with fully voice acted and animated cutscenes!
・A new NON-Roguelite Campaign stuffed with over 27 handcrafted puzzles, fights, and challenges to test your track laying skills.
・A slew of new content, including cards, train parts, ornaments, hats, stickers, and some brand new opponents
・The ability to play as some of your favorite characters in special combat scenarios!

70050000061256.name: Additional Character Color
70050000061256.description:
It will add the following additional colors you can choose in the character select screen:

・Billy SPECIAL COLOR 
・Jimmy SPECIAL COLOR

70050000061257.name: Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks
70050000061257.description:
Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks includes the "ARTBOOK," which lets you view concept art and other illustrations from Double Dragon Revive, as well as the "SOUNDTRACK" featuring all 28 music tracks.

*Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks is a separate application from the main game.

70050000061303.name: Ray of Sunshine
70050000061303.description: See that feisty smile and those clenched fists? That’s the youngest sibling, armed with a unique weapon and ready to begin a journey of her own. She’s determined to prove she can take care of herself. Take control of her and experience a new way to play. Don’t let her size fool you! She’s fast and strikes fear into all who stand in her way.

70050000061310.name: Arena of Heroes
70050000061310.intro: Enter the ancient arena of your ancestors and prove your worth.
70050000061310.description:
Deep within the jungle, beneath the shadow of forgotten temples, lies a sacred ground where heroes are tested and legends are born.
Enter the ancient arena of your ancestors and prove your worth. 
Face unending waves of enemies in this relentless Endless Arena Mode, and see how long you can survive.

70050000061312.name: Fast Food 2025 Simulator: Vehicle Upgrade
70050000061312.description:
Fast Food 2025 Simulator puts you in charge of a fast-food empire, where you cook, serve, and grow your business in a bustling city. Customize your restaurant, upgrade your equipment, and delight your customers with delicious meals!

In the Vehicle Upgrade DLC, you can now change your vehicle model directly in the parking lot to attract even more customers without leaving the location!

Get ready to take your business to the next level and conquer the city in style!

70050000061321.name: Autumn Color School Uniform
70050000061321.description:
The following in-game item will be added:
[Content]

Autumn Color School Uniform

70050000061370.name: Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia
70050000061370.description:
Embrace the crown as King Romus Toras, and lead the Golden Kingdom to a new era. Reclaim lost territories through diplomacy or force. Engage with noble houses and oversee the resources of Rizia. How will you reign?

Features:

New Kingdom, New King: Assume the role of King Romus, the newly crowned leader of the Kingdom of Rizia. Explore South Merkopa, an expansion of the Suzerain Universe.

Geopolitical Challenges & New Resources: Start dialogues with new national leaders. Will you forge new alliances or make new enemies? Oversee the management of new invaluable resources such as energy and authority.

A Game of Houses: Engage in discussions on religion, family, and romance. Dive into the intricate dynamics of a royal family and houses where relationships intertwine, merging the realms of love, duty, and politics.

Build Your Nation: Sign dozens of Royal Decrees on topics such as order, economy, and welfare to develop and improve Rizia. Will you be the guardian of peace or the catalyst for conflict?

War Mechanic & Military Build-up: Experience the strategic and tactical military challenges in a turn-based experience. Build up the Rizian Armed Forces and train units to intimidate neighbors.

Rich Character Interactions: Encounter a diverse cast of 20+ characters each with unique backgrounds and motivations.

70050000061371.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Anime Tune Pack Vol. 1
70050000061371.intro: Dial up the intensity with three tunes from popular anime TV series with the Fitness Boxing 3: Anime Tune Pack Vol. 1 DLC*
70050000061371.description: Work up a sweat while you vibe to a DLC pack containing instrumental versions of three tunes from popular anime TV series: "IDOL" from [OSHI NO KO], "Bling-Bang-Bang-Born" from the Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc of MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES, and "Where Our Blue Is" from JUJUTSU KAISEN: Hidden Inventory/Premature Death.

70050000061372.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Purrfect Punch Pack
70050000061372.intro: Go from fists to toe-beans with kitty-themed target designs in the Purrfect Punch Pack DLC*
70050000061372.description: Customize your exercise targets with a series of cat-themed icons in this DLC pack. Upon purrchase, it will be pawsible to select your new target type from the Customize menu.

70050000061386.name: World’s Finest Art: The World of Mythological Paintings
70050000061386.intro: Embark on a majestic journey through the world of gods and heroes, experiencing legendary art as you play puzzles.
70050000061386.description:
This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The following 10 puzzle images are included.
-Neptune Resigning to Britannia the Empire of the Sea / William Dyce
-The Marriage of Cupid and Psyche / Pompeo Batoni

-The Judgment of Paris / Joachim Wtewael
-The Lament for Icarus / Herbert James Draper

70050000061388.name: Colorful Asia
70050000061388.intro: A journey to encounter colorful landscapes is just what you're looking for. Explore the charms of Asia with jigsaw puzzles.
70050000061388.description:
This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The following 10 puzzle images are included.
-Kuthodaw Pagoda, Myanmar
-Halong Bay, Vietnam

70050000061390.name: Colorful Sweets from Around the World
70050000061390.intro: Indulge in a colorful collection of unique sweets from around the world through puzzles.
70050000061390.description:
This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The following 10 puzzle images are included.
-Macaron / France

70050000061392.name: The Exit 8 Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000061392.intro: This is a pack that upgrades the Nintendo Switch™ version of The Exit 8 to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.
70050000061392.description:
Don't overlook any anomalies.

If you find anomalies, turn back immediately.

If you don't find anomalies, do not turn back.

To go out from Exit 8.

The Exit 8 is a short walking simulator inspired by Japanese underground passageways, liminal spaces and back rooms.

70050000061394.name: [Moving] Beach
70050000061394.intro: Feel the waves with vivid motion. Travel the world's most beautiful beaches by solving video puzzles.
70050000061394.description:
This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The following 10 moving puzzles are included.
-Krabi, Thailand

-Seychelles

70050000061417.name: ESCAPE – BACKROOMS HORROR: Unlimited Camera Vision
70050000061417.intro: The camera sees it all. Even what you shouldn’t.
70050000061417.description:
Descend deeper into the nightmare with an essential survival upgrade.

This DLC unlocks a night vision camera with unlimited battery life, giving you a new edge in the suffocating darkness of the Backrooms. See what hides beyond the flickering lights and decaying walls—but beware, some things are better left unseen.

Adapt, observe, and survive longer. In the Backrooms, light may be your only friend.

70050000061430.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business — City Style Upgrade
70050000061430.intro: Upgrade your streets, upgrade your success.
70050000061430.description:
Add a touch of style and modernity to your supermarket and its surroundings! With this DLC, you can customize your game’s urban environment by:
- Changing the truck color from blue to sleek black for a professional and polished look.
- Revitalizing the sidewalk by replacing plain gray with a vibrant orange that catches shoppers’ eyes.
- Darkening the main road to an intense black, giving a modern and refined urban feel.

Give your management experience a visual refresh, make your supermarket stand out in the city, and create a fresh atmosphere that inspires success

70050000061431.name: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution - Deluxe Edition Costumes
70050000061431.intro: Experience Shantae's long-lost adventure along with three stylish Deluxe Edition costumes!
70050000061431.description: The Deluxe Edition of Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution adds three special bonus outfits that change Shantae’s appearance and boost her magical abilities: Sizzle Armor Costume (enhanced Fireball Power), Relic Hunter Costume (enhanced Pike Ball Power), and High Voltage Costume (enhanced Storm Puff Power)! This is add-on content, exclusively available in the Deluxe Edition bundle of Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution, and is not available separately.

70050000061432.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000061432.description:
This Upgrade Pack grants access to Lynked: Banner of the Spark – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition. You must already own Lynked: Banner of the Spark on Nintendo Switch™* to purchase the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack.

*Lynked: Banner of the Spark on Nintendo Switch™ is compatible with, and can be played on, Nintendo Switch™ 2, but will not feature the added functionality listed above without owning the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack.

70050000061451.name: Spooky Season
70050000061451.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70050000061451.description: Add a spooky touch to your restaurant! Halloween decorations will bring festive chills and turn every meal into frightful fun.

70050000061452.name: Valentine's Day
70050000061452.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70050000061452.description: Fill your restaurant with love and charm! Valentine’s decorations will create a warm, romantic atmosphere perfect for sweet moments and cozy dinners.

70050000061453.name: Vintage Vibe
70050000061453.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70050000061453.description: Give your restaurant a timeless makeover! Vintage decorations add classic elegance and nostalgic charm to every corner.

70050000061485.name: Simon the Sorcerer: Origins - Deluxe DLC
70050000061485.intro: The history artbook and soundtrack – all in one epic package!
70050000061485.description:
The Deluxe DLC requires Simon The Sorcerer Origins Full Game!

Contains:

- Digital History Artbook
Celebrate the brand-new, magical comic art visuals of Simon the Sorcerer Origins with this digital artbook and discover all the secrets behind the return of the most famous wizard in video games!

- Official Digital Soundtrack
The complete official soundtrack of Simon the Sorcerer Origins more than 50 minutes of new and re-arranged music from the classic Simon the Sorcerer, featuring the renowned composer Mason Fisher.

70050000061494.name: Shujinkou Sabaku Arc
70050000061494.description:
Journey to the desert nation of Sabaku and uncover a new chapter in Shujinkou's story! Picking up right after the Genya Arc, this full-length sequel introduces fresh characters, even more dangerous foes, and a perilous mission to save a fellow friend from an ominous fate.

Key Features:
• Brave eight massive labyrinths filled with new, challenging puzzles.
• Collect dozens of Kanji orbs to unleash ontological attacks and exploit elemental weaknesses.
• Discover signboards that teach proverbs, JLPT N4 grammar, lore, and more.
• Master a new Cooking system using ingredients gathered across Genya and Sabaku.
• Embark on 100 side quests that explore the lives of Sabaku’s people and expand the story beyond the Genya Arc.
• Experience 40+ new 4K illustrations highlighting pivotal story and bonding moments with the cast.

NO GENERATIVE AI WAS USED IN THE PROCESS OF CREATING SHUJINKOU

70050000061496.name: Shujinkou: Akuma Quests
70050000061496.description:
Dive deep into the rich worlds of Genya and Sabaku with the Akuma Quests DLC! This episodic expansion offers an exciting blend of story-driven content, new costumes, and plenty of new enemies to fight.

• Six Akuma-Themed Costumes: Transform your Fuu Lobby partners with striking new looks, each tied to engaging narrative storylines (the “Akuma Quests“).
• Special Costume Dialogue: Unlock unique interactions between Shu and the rest of the cast, bringing the costumes to life.
• New Enemies and Kanji Lessons: Test your skills against new, formidable foes while learning new kanji along the way.
• 18 Story-Driven Quests: Experience 10-15 hours of new gameplay, with each partner’s new costume tied to their own three-part storyline.

70050000061500.name: Shujinkou: Swimsuit Quests
70050000061500.description:
Take a plunge into the sparkling seas of Shujinkou with the Swimsuit Quests DLC! This episodic expansion delivers a fresh and playful blend of story-driven content, dazzling swimsuits, challenging foes, and opportunities to dive into learning new Japanese kanji.

• Six Swimsuit Costumes: Dress your Fuu Lobby partners in vibrant beachwear, each unlocking a unique narrative adventure as part of the “Swimsuit Quests.”
• Special Costume Dialogue: Enjoy lively, summer-inspired exchanges between Shu and the cast, bringing these stylish swimsuits to life.
• New Enemies and Kanji Lessons: Battle against tough, oceanic-themed foes and learn new Japanese kanji! These special orbs can be found in the various Meiro of Genya.
• 18 Story-Driven Quests: Embark on 10-15 hours of engaging gameplay, with each partner’s swimsuit tied to a three-part storyline brimming with summer vibes.

70050000061508.name: Ravenswatch - Timeless Skin Pack
70050000061508.intro: Four of the Ravenswatch heroes can now don timeless outfits featuring refined details: reminders of the glory of the past. Includes skins for Scarlet, Melusine, Aladdin and Geppetto.
70050000061508.description:
Show off your style with the Timeless Skin Pack - an exclusive collection of 4 outfits inspired by time, legends and dreams. These cosmetic skins will transform your heroes, with unique new designs and refined details that will leave a lasting impression.

Immerse yourself in the world of re-imagined tales, with:
* Scarlet, in both human and werewolf form, dressed like a wild huntress with armour made of rope and bone, and adorned with scarlet ritual paint.
* Melusine, ruler of the abyss, wearing golden armour and a crown, like a serpent queen.
* Aladdin, guardian of the sands of time, clad in reinforced armour, with gold tattoos sparkling powerfully.
* Geppetto, master pyrotechnist, kitted out in a mechanical suit and equipped with gears and fireworks for lighting up the night.

Access these new outfits from the hero selection menu, and bring timeless style to any battlefield.

70050000061509.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Landscapes 2
70050000061509.description: 20 new landscape images to cross stitch or color by number

70050000061515.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Elite Weapon
70050000061515.intro: Tactical advantage begins with the right weapon.
70050000061515.description:
Upgrade your arsenal and take your hunts to the next level.
  This exclusive DLC grants you the powerful Savatimp 8 rifle — a precision-crafted weapon designed for accuracy, range, and stopping power. Whether you’re tracking elusive deer or taking down apex predators, the Savatimp 8 gives you the edge you need in the wild.
  Already own this weapon? You’ll receive 1400 in in-game currency instead — invest it in new gear, ammo, or upgrades to enhance your next expedition.
  Stay sharp. Hunt smart. The wilderness just got more rewarding.

70050000061517.name: High On Life: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000061517.description:
Fresh out of high school with no job and no ambition, you’ve really got nothing going for you until an alien cartel that wants to get high off humanity invades Earth. Now, you and a team of charismatic talking guns must answer the hero's call and become the deadliest intergalactic bounty hunter the cosmos has ever seen.

Travel to a variety of biomes and locations across the cosmos, go up against the nefarious Garmantuous and his gang of goons, collect loot, meet unique characters, and more, in the latest comedy adventure from Squanch Games!

High On Life: High On Knife DLC
It’s been 2 years since the Bounty Hunter defeated the G3 cartel. Now Knifey needs help tracking down a mysterious package from his homeworld. Will they get mixed up with a friendly giant, a pinball gun, poaching rings, and a terrifying intergalactic shipping company? Yeah. Sure.

70050000061525.name: Cipheur: Quotes Pack 2
70050000061525.description: Can you decipher 100 more quotes from famous people?

70050000061530.name: Furniture Flipper Simulator 2023: Revive, Restoration & Creative - Starter Kit
70050000061530.intro: Tools, talent, and a little treasure.
70050000061530.description:
Discover the artistry of furniture restoration like never before! With this DLC, your creative journey begins with 5000 units instantly credited to your balance, giving you the perfect head start to build your dream workshop and tackle premium restoration projects.

Step into the world of skilled furniture restoration and decorating, where every piece tells a story and your hands bring it back to life. From vintage gems to forgotten relics, transform the old into something extraordinary.

Whether you’re a seasoned artisan or a passionate newcomer, this DLC offers a rewarding blend of creativity, strategy, and craftsmanship.

70050000061531.name: Chained Climb Together: Skybound Environment
70050000061531.intro: Let the transformed sky inspire your courage and fuel your climb.
70050000061531.description:
Elevate your adventure with a stunning new skybox that transforms the world around you. This DLC introduces a completely redesigned environment backdrop, immersing you in breathtaking vistas as you and your companions scale the towering peaks.

Experience the climb like never before — the changing skies and atmospheric effects add a fresh layer of depth and challenge to your ascent. Whether you play solo or with friends, the new environment enhances every moment of your perilous journey.

Prepare to conquer the heights under a whole new sky.

70050000061541.name: Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack
70050000061541.description: Gloomy tunes for gloomy souls! Immerse yourself in 40 tracks of haunting Halloween-inspired melodies and classical horror animation charm. From eerie waltzes to tense, cinematic themes, Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack captures the dark, whimsical atmosphere of the game. Perfect for setting the mood, whether you’re wandering through moonlit graveyards or facing a slow and inevitable death.

70050000061543.name: Spy Guy Croatia
70050000061543.intro: Spy Guy sets off to the sunny coast of Croatia!
70050000061543.description: A new DLC to the Spy Guy game-this time Croatia. Detective Spy Guy visits the sunny coast of Croatia, where beautiful sights, funny scenes and more than 120 levels full of hidden objects await him.

70050000061549.name: LEGO® Voyagers
70050000061549.intro: Tumble, jump, snap together, and build your way through rich brick worlds
70050000061549.description:
From the makers of LEGO® Builder's Journey comes a new 2-player co-op adventure about friendship and play. When two friends make it their mission to rescue an abandoned spaceship, they embark on a journey beyond their wildest dreams, ultimately learning the value of being connected.

● Experience what it feels like to be a LEGO brick. Tumble, jump, snap together, and build your way through rich brick worlds.
● Unravel a poetic, non verbal narrative, set in beautiful brick built environments, supported by an atmospheric soundtrack.
● Cooperatively solve the game's many challenges and discover how two bricks are better than one. Play locally on the same screen, or online.
● Invite a friend to join your adventure for free with the Friend’s Pass. As long as one of you owns LEGO Voyagers, you can both play the full co-op experience together.

LEGO Voyagers asks open questions about building friendships, sharing dreams, and giving space.

It reminds us that while playing and being creative is for all shapes and sizes, it’s always better when you share it with a friend.

70050000061550.name: Free Emotes
70050000061550.intro: Express yourself with this set of free emotes!
70050000061550.description:
This DLC set includes:

■Additional Emote - Fist Pump
■Additional Emote - Roar

70050000061551.name: Meg's Monster: Lost Memories
70050000061551.intro: Delve deeper into the world of Meg's Monster through the eyes of five beloved characters and unearth harrowing secrets from the past in this short, episodic prequel DLC.
70050000061551.description:
Meg's Monster: Lost Memories is a collection of short prequel adventures that expand upon the world and lore of Meg's Monster by letting players experience the heartwrenching backstories of five wholly unique characters.

An MMA fighter who steps into the ring to earn money for his ailing brother's medical treatment.

A young girl whose bickering parents seem eerily on edge about her upcoming fifth birthday.

An unseen creature in a dark cell, created for the sole purpose of killing a specific human being.

A man reborn after death as a monster, who devotes his newfound life to bringing order to the Underworld.

A monster child, raised in a laboratory and subjected to extensive experimentation—but to what end?

Five lives. Five stories, heretofore untold.

Yet all beg the same underlying questions:

Can a monster be just as human as a human?

And can a human be more monstrous than a monster?

(Estimated Play Time: Around 2 hours)

70050000061561.name: Two Strikes - Baki Hanma
70050000061561.description:
Baki Hanma, the World’s Strongest Teen, joins the brutal world of Two Strikes. Born to fight and trained to surpass all limits, Baki brings his unmatched martial prowess and relentless spirit to the battlefield. With bone-crushing strikes, lightning reflexes, and a will forged through countless battles, Baki shakes up the fight like never before.

This DLC pack includes playable character Baki Hanma, from the hit anime Baki Hanma, featuring a completely new set of moves and animations. Also included: a brand-new stage, The Underground Arena, and an exclusive original music track.

Baki is fully playable across all online and offline game modes.

70050000061568.name: Pre-Order Bonus - Welcome Care Package
70050000061568.description:
Pre-order now to get the Welcome Care Package (digital content), the head start that any good farmer needs! The Welcome Care Package includes:
 
• An extra 3000G to start your farming adventure!
• 10 Turnip Seeds, 10 Onion Seeds, and 10 Cabbage Seeds!
• 10 Daisy Seeds and 10 Marguerite Seeds!

70050000061569.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark - Supporter Pack: Battle Ready
70050000061569.intro: Team up for an ARPG adventure!
70050000061569.description:
To our community– thank you for supporting Lynked: Banner of the Spark and our team! We’re humbled to have you along with us as we've developed this game for you. If you'd like to support us beyond the base game, we've released the Supporter Pack so you can take down the Combots in style! Gear up with new player outfits in the Spark-Tek theme, ten weapon class variants, backpacks, head wear, livery, and an Owl GoodBot to keep you company on missions. Taking a break from saving the world? Gild your space with a variety of decor items to make your town stand out!

Lynked: Banner of the Spark - Supporter Pack: Battle Ready will operate on both the Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

The Supporter Pack: Battle Ready Includes:

Player Outfits:
- Spark-Tek Commander outfit with 11 color variations
- Spark-Tek Scout outfit with 11 color variations 
- This pack also includes 6 total alternate styles for the commander and scout outfits

Weapon Variants:
- All 10 weapon classes in the Spark-Tek theme

Accessories:
- 2x Backpacks
- 2x Head wear options with 11 Colors each
- This pack also includes 6 alternate headwear styles

Liveries:
- Spark-Tek Livery

GoodBot Cosmetics:
- OwlBot with 11 additional color options

Town Decor Items:
- Spark-Tek Worktable
- Spark Tek Generator
- Spark-Tek Statue
- 2x Spark Tomes
- Gates & Fences
- 4x Floor options
- 3x Wallpaper options
- 3x Road options

70050000061587.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Travel Provisions
70050000061587.intro: Start from Zero in a Tale of Restoration and Retribution
70050000061587.description:
[Digital Version: Pre-order Bonus]
- Travel Provisions: A set of items and skills useful for the start of your journey.
Contents:
- Healing Grape (M) x5
- Inspiriting Plum (M) x5

((Only applicable for pre-orders made by 2025/12/03 23:59(EST).))

70050000061589.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Digital Deluxe Upgrade
70050000061589.intro: Start from Zero in a Tale of Restoration and Retribution
70050000061589.description:
*This product consists of additional content pertaining to OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0, released for Nintendo Switch™. It is not compatible with the separate version of OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 that can only be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please be careful to avoid purchasing the wrong product.

70050000061595.name: Forest Pack
70050000061595.description: A set of forest-themed stickers to embellish a sticker album.

70050000061602.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - 2020s Pops Pack
70050000061602.description:
