*The songs included in this product may be available in the Taiko Music Pass. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

70050000061615.name: More Watermelon Paradise
70050000061615.intro:
Welcome to a wonderful watermelon paradise!
This Watermelon Party is about to get even sweeter!
70050000061615.description:
6 new games appear in "More Watermelon Paradise," an additional content pack for Hit! Spin! Watermelon Party!

The "More Watermelon Paradise" DLC includes the following content:
6 Additional Games:
- Watermelon Pumping
- Watermelon Shooting
- Watermelon Farming
- Watermelon Weighing
- Watermelon Toss
- Watermelon Tower

70050000061617.name: Bowling Fever Expansion Pack #5
70050000061617.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70050000061617.description:
Elevate your bowling experience with the Expansion Pack#5 for Bowling Fever! 

This expansion introduces 10 new bowling ball styles, each crafted to add flair and precision to your game.

Whether you're competing or playing for fun, these new designs offer the perfect combination of style and performance.

Ready to up your game?

70050000061637.name: Find Sort Match - Summer Pack
70050000061637.intro: Have fun in the sun with the Summer Pack DLC!
70050000061637.description:
Prepare for a summertime escape. Your ideal seasonal diversion, featuring puzzles bathed in sunlight and calming challenges.

Improve your logic, focus, and creativity while enjoying new summery stories filled with holiday fun, travel ideas, tasty beach snacks, and bright cocktails. From packing your suitcase to setting up a tropical picnic or sorting sunglasses and flip-flops, every level is a playful reminder of the joys of summer.

Designed to please both casual players and puzzle pros alike, this DLC adds a refreshing touch of warmth and variety to your gameplay:

★ Organize travel bags, swimwear, and beach toys
★ Arrange tropical drinks, fruit platters, and party snacks
★ Sort sunscreen, seashells, towels, and souvenirs
★ Unpack vacation essentials and summer accessories
★ Enjoy bright, colorful levels inspired by the carefree spirit of summer

Let your mind wander to sunny shores while staying sharp. The Summer Pack offers a cheerful and cozy atmosphere, making it the ideal way to relax, reset, and refresh your skills.

70050000061647.name: Bad Guys Pack
70050000061647.intro:
Meet the Bad Guys!
Thief, Robber, Ruffian, and Spy now join the fray
Bail them out—use them to win!
70050000061647.description:
Includes the following content:

▼ Bad Guys Now Available Worldwide: Thief, Robber, Ruffian, and Spy

In the world of Richman, wealth and strategy go hand in hand—but now, chaos enters the game!
Command the Bad Guys and turn the tide with unpredictable new tactics.

Bail them out or release them from the hospital,and these troublemakers will fight by your side—helping you twist the rules and shake up the board!

*To use the Bad Guys Pack DLC, you must own the "Richman 4 Fun" (sold separately).

70050000061663.name: Funko Fusion - Birthday Celebration Pack
70050000061663.description:
Happy birthday to us! Celebrate Funko Fusion's 1st birthday with our gift to you - more characters to play as!

Download now and play as:

- Birthday Freddy
- Birthday Eddy
- Birthday Foxxo
- Birthday Proto

Thank you for your support from all of us at 10:10 Games!

70050000061668.name: Funko Fusion Deluxe Edition - Birthday Celebration Pack (RETAIL ONLY)
70050000061668.description:
Happy birthday to us! Celebrate Funko Fusion's 1st birthday with our gift to you - more characters to play as!

Download now and play as:

- Birthday Freddy
- Birthday Eddy
- Birthday Foxxo
- Birthday Proto

Thank you for your support from all of us at 10:10 Games!

70050000061685.name: Spy Guy Memory Indonesia
70050000061685.description: A new set of Indonesia-themed memory tiles. New pictures, challenges and memory training.

70050000061690.name: Spy Guy Circus Mission
70050000061690.intro: Discover the secrets of the circus at the fun park.
70050000061690.description: Spy Guy sets out to uncover the mystery at the circus. He has a circus mission ahead of him, in which he will search for hidden objects.

70050000061692.name: Sticky Business: Book of Shadows
70050000061692.intro: Craft enchanted stickers, explore witchy new stories, and charm your customers with mystical goodies in this cozy, spellbinding expansion. The coven is waiting!
70050000061692.description:
Something magical this way comes…

Open your Book of Shadows and dive into a charming new expansion for Sticky Business that’s steeped in witchy vibes and cozy spells. From enchanted stickers to spellbinding stories, the Book of Shadows DLC brings a bewitching blend of magic, mischief, and heartfelt moments to your sticker shop!

Craft the perfect love spell sticker and lovingly wrap them into a mystical bundle of charms and goodies for your favorite customer. The Book of Shadows is here to add a dash of the arcane to your daily sticker hustle.

What’s inside the Book of Shadows?

- 84 magical new stickers (+ 34 charming variations) themed around witchery, potions, familiars, and more
- 10 new customer stories exploring themes of love spells, coven friendships, family magic, and the little rituals that make life special
- 8 mystical new goodies to tuck into your sticker packages – from fancy crystals to bewitching keychains 
- 6 new glitter papers to add some serious sparkle to your spellwork

Time to light a candle, stir your cauldron, and bring a little magic to your sticker business. Let your creativity run wild—the coven is waiting!

70050000061698.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection - Independence Day

70050000061702.name: Asphalt Legends - Overdrive Duo Pack
70050000061702.intro: Push your limits with two iconic hypercars built for speed and style!
70050000061702.description:
Unlock these incredible hypercars and dominate the track!
With this offer, you unlock a Bugatti Divo and a 2-star Lamborghini Reventón Roadster.

This pack contains:
- 85 Bugatti Divo Blueprints
- 1 Key to unlock the Lamborghini Reventón Roadster
- 26 Lamborghini Reventón Roadster Blueprints
- 5,000 Tokens
- 5,000,000 Credits

70050000061705.name: Asphalt Legends - Praga R1 Max-Out Pack
70050000061705.intro: Take control and dominate the circuit with the maxed-out Praga R1.
70050000061705.description:
Get a 4-star Praga R1 (the pack contains enough Blueprints to max out the car).

This pack contains:
- 128 Praga R1 BP
- 1,000,000 Credits

70050000061706.name: SWORN - Cosmetic Pack (Spectre)
70050000061706.description:
Command the shadows with the Specter Pack’s four weapon skins — Infernal Sphere, Harvester Scythe, Sacrificial Blade, and Bone Claws — each dripping with dark menace. The Magus Outfit cloaks you in the mystery of a master sorcerer.
The pack contains:
o	Specter Cosmetic
o	Magus Outfit - The garb of a Magus, one of the powerful sorcerers that worked with Arthur to uncover the mysteries of The Grail.
o	Armillary Sphere cosmetic
o	Infernal Sphere - The sealed demonic power in this artifact is barely contained.
o	Scythe cosmetic
o	Harvester Scythe - This weapon pulses with power — the power of the dead.
o	Arcane Blade cosmetic
o	Sacrificial Blade - Formerly ornaments meant to ward off evil, they now seek to invite it in.
o	Claws cosmetic
o	Bone Claws - Claws fashioned from the bones of an ancient predator.

70050000061707.name: SWORN - Cosmetic Pack (Monk)
70050000061707.description:
Harness the divine with the Monk Pack’s four distinctive weapon skins — Morningstar Mace, Alchemist’s Staff, Sacred Tome, and the sinister Demon Chime. The Heretic Outfit marks you as a renegade monk who defies tradition.
o	Monk Cosmetic
o	Heretic Outfit - The garb of a heretic, a monk that abandoned the Fae Council to follow Morgan
o	Mace cosmetic
o	Morningstar Mace - A spiked mace, made for crushing armor.
o	Magic Staff cosmetic
o	Alchemist’s Staff - A staff of dark divination reforged for clerical use.
o	Tome cosmetic
o	Sacred Tome - A divine book with power flowing from every page.
o	Chime cosmetic
o	Demon Chime - A bell with a ring that sends dark sensations through its victims.

70050000061709.name: SWORN - Cosmetic Pack (Rook)
70050000061709.description:
The Rook Pack delivers brute force in style with four fearsome weapon skins — Steampunk Hammer, Shipbreaker Cannon, Treant Cleaver, and Pit Fighter Gauntlets. Rule the battlefield in the unyielding Runeforged Outfit.
The pack contains:
o	Rook Cosmetic
o	Runeforged Outfit - The garb of a Runeforged, a Soulforged imbued with magic by Nimue. She neglected to mention how the process affected the skin.
o	Hammer cosmetic
o	Steampunk Hammer – A strange hammer of unknown origin. While it feels heavy, it swings with uncanny ease.
•	 Cannon cosmetic
o	Shipbreaker Cannon – A cannon stripped from wreckage in Deep Harbor.
•	Halberd cosmetic
o	Cleaver Halberd – An axe built to rend the Treants that walk the forests.
•	 Gauntlets cosmetic
o	Pit Fighter Gauntlets – To make a living in the fighting pits, you have to be both brutal and clever.

70050000061711.name: SWORN - Cosmetic Pack (Vigilante)
70050000061711.description:
The Vigilante Pack arms you with four deadly weapon skins — Deadshot Bow, Helix Staff, Bonesaw Chakrams, and more — each honed for lethal takedowns. Top it off with the Viper Outfit and cement your place in the realm as a legendary fighter.
The pack contains:
•	Vigilante Cosmetic
o	Viper Outfit - The garb of a brawler, one of the few survivors of Arthur's sport-fighting pits.
•	Sword cosmetic
o	Barbaric Sword - Forged by the Giant Fae, this sword probably served them better as a toothpick.
•	Bow cosmetic
o	Deadshot Bow - A bow crafted for killing in silence.
•	Bo Staff cosmetic
o	Helix  Staff - A staff crafted in a far-away land, graceful and deadly.
•	Chakrams cosmetic
o	Bonesaw Chakrams - Blades crafted to ensure that they are the last thing their opponents ever see.

70050000061729.name: Free Hairstyles
70050000061729.intro: Try a new look with these free hairstyles for your avatar!
70050000061729.description:
This DLC set includes:

■Additional Hairstyle - Punk
■Additional Hairstyle - Giant Mohawk

70050000061747.name: Coffee
70050000061747.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000061747.description: Expand your café collection and decorate with eighteen new furnishings, a new floor, and a new wallpaper.

70050000061749.name: Cult of the Lamb - Woolhaven
70050000061749.intro: A lost God calls you from a mysterious mountain—rebuild the flock and reawaken winter to uncover the truth of the fallen lambs.
70050000061749.description:
NOTE: The content of this expansion is only accessible near completion of the base game.

Winter descends, and a long-silenced deity stirs beneath the snow.

Yngya, the forgotten God of the lambs, summons you to restore the flock and reclaim what time has erased. But as you breathe life into what long passed, a creeping Rot awakens, spreading corruption through the sacred mountain the lambs once called home…

Not all who tread this peak come seeking redemption. Upon the frozen summit, a wolf prowls — his pack hungers for war with the covetous Gods. Deep within the hidden caverns, a shadowy figure waits, blade honed and patience fraying. Restless spirits drift along the ridges, each bound by former sins. The past was buried for good reason — will you unearth it, or will it consume you?

That which was sacred now rots, and nothing is as it seems. Last of the lambs, Woolhaven’s fate rests in your hooves.

Discover Woolhaven
Return the lost souls of Woolhaven to their spiritual home and learn the long-forgotten history of lambkind. Rebuild the fallen town to its former glory and reclaim the mountain to restore Yngya’s depleted power, but beware; there is always a price to be paid.

Survive the Winter
Endure harsh blizzards and freezing temperatures that threaten your Cult’s survival. Build new structures to keep your Cult warm and protect your Followers from frostbite and famine.

Explore The Mountain
Venture into a new realm battered by bitter storms, crawling with creatures corrupted with the Rot lurking beneath the snow. Battle through two vast new dungeons, where the echoes of the past refuse to rest. Every soul redeemed on the mountain defiles it further, threatening all of The Lands of the Old Faith. Can you undo the sins of the past?

Take up Ranching
Unlock ranching and breed rare animals that provide wool, warmth and when desperate, precious meat. Tame, ride and let your Followers care for these majestic creatures.

70050000061764.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Turbo Boost
70050000061764.intro: Get the money. Get the power. Own the streets.
70050000061764.description:
Boost your racing career instantly with an extra $50,000 in cash!
Use this bonus to upgrade your ride, unlock premium cars, and customize your vehicles like never before. Get ahead of the competition by fueling your speed addiction with the ultimate financial boost.

Strap in, upgrade, and dominate the streets of Grand Rush like never before. Your next victory is just a turbo boost away!

70050000061774.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Edward Teach Pack
70050000061774.description:
Add the leader Edward Teach to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Edward Teach, better known as Blackbeard, was an English pirate whose name sparked dread in the captains of the Caribbean. In 1716, he joined the crew of Benjamin Hornigold, a leader of the Flying Gang, and quickly gained his own ships. With his impressive height, his long beard (decorated with, at times, lit fuses), and reputation for violence, he stalked the sea-lanes of the Caribbean and the nightmares of sailors. He outlived the Flying Gang and moved his operation to the Outer Banks of present-day North Carolina, where a pirate hunter, Robert Maynard, finally caught up with him.

Attributes, Unique Ability, and Agenda info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/leaders/edward-teach/

70050000061775.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Republic of Pirates Pack
70050000061775.description:
Add the Republic of Pirates civilization to your collection for the Exploration Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Where there is wealth, there is greed. The scramble for new world riches in the early 18th century brought English, Spanish, French, and Dutch fleets – but the prospect of quick riches also brought pirates. These were rarely organized, but in 1706, one band, the Flying Gang, took over the island of New Providence in the Bahamas and set up a short-lived republic for all who sought fortune…and came with few scruples.  

Attributes, Unique Ability, Unique Units, and Associated Wonder info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/civilizations/republic-of-pirates/

70050000061776.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Tonga Pack
70050000061776.description:
Add the Tonga civilization to your collection for the Antiquity Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

Into the endless blue, in search of new lands on scattered islands, the Polynesians sailed, settling the island of Tonga nearly three thousand years ago. Around 1000 CE, though, came another expansion, the Tu'i Tonga Empire – a struggle for dominance, tribute, and fealty over the Pacific. The Tongan kings maintained this system of hierarchical lordship over the islands until it, too, splintered.

Attributes, Unique Ability, Unique Units, and Associated Wonder info on the Game Guide:
https://civilization.2k.com/civ-vii/game-guide/civilizations/tonga/

70050000061777.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Sayyida al Hurra Pack
70050000061777.description:
Add the leader Sayyida al Hurra to your collection in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

In the wake of Granada's fall, Sayyida al Hurra rose as Morocco's champion to challenge Iberian power in North Africa. As the sole ruler of Tétouan, she was a fierce diplomat who strong-armed the Europeans in their native tongues and earned their admiration. When talks failed, she turned to the Barbary corsairs, forging alliances with famed pirates who kept her waters safe and her city wealthy.

70050000061778.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Ottomans Pack
70050000061778.description:
Add the Ottomans civilization to your collection for the Modern Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

From the shores of the Bosphorus, the Ottomans ruled an empire spanning six centuries and three continents. By the 19th century, the world's wealth flowed through the Grand Bazaar and the Ottoman navy ruled the seas. Tension between the religious and the secular prompted major reforms to reforge the Ottomans for a new era. But these changes came too late, and the empire gave way to the modern Republic of Türkiye.

70050000061779.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Iceland Pack
70050000061779.description:
Add the Iceland civilization to your collection for the Modern Age in Sid Meier's Civilization® VII!*

On a volcanic, windswept island, the Icelanders forged a commonwealth of chieftains and warriors, lawyers and scholars. Icelandic longships ranged far and wide – Vikings terrorized Europe's rivers and coasts as explorers roamed North America. Poets and saga-writers preserved their deeds alongside tales of gods, saints, and heroes. Centuries of independence held until Iceland, weakened by civil war, submitted to Norway.

70050000061780.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Tides of Power Collection - Wonder Pack
70050000061780.description: Explore new possibilities for your personalized empire with four new Wonders: Great Lighthouse, Nan Madol, Great Blue Hole, and Mapu'a Vaea Blowholes!

70050000061809.name: Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter - Haunted Interiors
70050000061809.intro: Face the undead in an atmosphere thick with tension.
70050000061809.description:
Breathe unsettling atmosphere into the ruins of the apocalypse. With this DLC, the abandoned building gains disturbing new layers—scattered remnants, damaged decor, and haunting details that suggest the chaos that came before.

Each room feels heavier, each hallway more claustrophobic. The enemies haven’t changed—but the place they hunt you in now feels darker, older, and all too real.

70050000061813.name: Cop Officers: Police Simulator of NYPD City - Department Choice
70050000061813.intro: Every corner of the city is yours to patrol—pick your starting point and lead the way.
70050000061813.description: Shape your destiny as an NYPD officer! This DLC gives you the freedom to choose the department where your career begins and customize your spawn point across different sectors of the city. Start your journey in a busy downtown precinct, patrol the bustling financial district, or take on the challenges of quieter suburban neighborhoods. Each choice offers a fresh perspective, unique patrol routes, and new opportunities to prove yourself in the line of duty. With greater freedom and replayability, this expansion lets you experience the life of a police officer in NYPD City like never before.

70050000061820.name: Mexican and Asian
70050000061820.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000061820.description: Bring a taste of Mexico and Asia with eighteen new furnishings, plus one floor and one wallpaper.

70050000061821.name: Supermarket
70050000061821.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000061821.description: Stock up your supermarket with eighteen new decor items, along with a fresh floor and wallpaper.

70050000061822.name: Zen
70050000061822.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000061822.description: Create harmony in your space with eighteen new zen-inspired furnishings, along with a calming floor and wallpaper.

70050000061841.name: Vampire Survivors: Ante Chamber
70050000061841.intro: Prepare for a different kind of Stake as the Jokers run wild in Vampire Survivors: Ante Chamber.
70050000061841.description:
They've demolished demons, battled bats, been to outer space, and failed to find any vampires, but now the Survivors face their greatest challenge yet: a bunch of Jokers. Will you fold under the pressure, or go all-in to be a Balatro-boosted bullet hell?
 
Join Jimbo and a cast of wild cards with combo potential that'll probably break the scoreboard. Get in on the action for a Full House of silly synergies, clownish combos, and bewildering Boss Blinds.

The house is full. The desk is rigged. And Luck is just another statistic. But fortune favours the bold, and if you can survive this clown car of poker puns, you can be the bullet hell even when the chips are down. 

4 New Characters (send in the clowns)
Jimbo: Your favourite forklift-certified clown finally has full-body representation in Vampire Survivors. Level-up bonuses from Survarot cards are boosted by x4.
Canio: The tragic clown in oversized finery. Has a special technique to trigger additional Survarot drafts, but won't stop frowning about it. 
Chicot - Wears the cap and bells, but makes bosses look like the real clowns by cutting their health in half and switching off their hazards.
Perkeo: Short in stature but never short on Passives, this fool has a practically unlimited pool to power him up.  

4 New Weapons & Evolutions
Infernolatro - Summon a burning score counter to burn your foolish foes to ashes.  Each enemy you roast fans the flames, expanding the inferno until the whole table's alight. 
Gros Michel: Release a barrage of banana projectiles, each with a 1-in-6 chance to explode for deliciously critical damage.
Fibonacci Seltzer - Fires mathematically beautiful spiralling streams of fizzy destruction that can trigger your other weapons.
Celestial Booster: Planets and a rocket orbit you constantly, dealing extra damage based on your current riches.

The Ante Chamber
Enter the Ante Chamber, an extradimensional analogue of Balatro's user interface. Battle buffoonish foes on a facsimile of Jimbo's home turf accompanied by a new ally, the Outer Saboteur, a silly little sidekick that steals your coins to throw them at enemies.    
  
1 New Hypnotically Looping Track

70050000061852.description: Ascend to the peak of a haunted land, enhanced for Nintendo Switch™ 2.

70050000061857.description:

70050000061908.name: Against the Storm - Nightwatchers
70050000061908.description:
The Blightstorm rages on as Nightwatchers introduces a new species into the fray alongside two new biomes, new buildings, and more for any Viceroy seeking additional options in the endless struggle. The Bats bring with them a talent for metallurgy and a disdain for weakness, growing more resolute when their compatriots falter. 

Meanwhile, as smugglers grow bolder, the harsh Rocky Ravines become an option for settlers – barren lands rich in ore and minerals. Viceroys building settlements among the scraggly rocks will find themselves reliant on black market traders while mining the basalt columns that grow here in place of trees. 

Those seeking more verdant fields will find suitable sites among the Bamboo Flats instead. Though lush with life, the heavy rainfall erodes the loose soil, and settlers must work carefully to appease a peculiar species local to the ecosystem if they want any chance at success: the Fluffbeak. If kept happy, this beast is able to produce fertilizer, giving the local Viceroy an opportunity to plan exactly where to enrich the soil and secure the future of their settlement.

Nightwatchers includes:
- Bats have little patience for weakness, having grown hardy and austere in their isolated underground halls. Fiercely devoted and stern, they bring their expertise with metals and a willingness to make sacrifices for the greater good. Once the Bats’ starting ability is unlocked, you will be granted access to the Manorial Court blueprint – use it to expel a member of a chosen species, leveraging this harsh punishment to motivate all who remain to work harder in the name of the Scorched Queen.
- The Rocky Ravine biome presents an unforgiving landscape where even the trees are made of stone, and the Black Market will be a key partner in your success – with fluctuating prices and a notable lack of wood, you’ll need to leverage your plentiful stone and amber to acquire the resources needed to keep your settlement growing. But be warned – these criminals will quickly turn from merchants to miscreants, and while they present an excellent opportunity, they also expect debts to be paid in a timely manner. 
- Settle the Bamboo Flats biome with the help of an unlikely ally – though the constant rain has left these regions devoid of fertile soil, the giant Fluffbeak, if kept happy,  is able to produce copious amounts of fertilizer to help create areas of fertile soil and establish a flourishing settlement.
- 3 new World Map Modifiers will bring harsher lands to conquer. From the Riverlands and their minimal space to places of great significance for the ancients, still watched by silent guardians that limit the number of Cornerstones that can be used.
- 3 new World Events introduce an increasingly powerful criminal organization, explosive alchemical experiments that threaten your carefully laid-out plans, and a tree-eating beast that inadvertently opens glades and unleashes the secrets hidden within them, whether you’re ready or not.
- 3 new Legendary Cornerstones, 16 new Deeds, and 6 new Decorations have been added alongside new rewards to the upgrade tree in the Smoldering City.
- The new biomes will appear on the world map after the current cycle ends. To unlock Bats as a playable species, you must reach level 11.

Punish the meek and push forth into harsher lands in service of the Scorched Queen – with the Bats by your side, there is little room for the weak-willed.

70050000061915.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Ruinous Supporter Pack
70050000061915.description:
This pack is primarily a way to support our small team, helping us to continue creating stories and games set in the Riven Realms. If you enjoy our content and want to see it expand, this is a great way to endorse the effort.

As a token of our gratitude for the support, this pack unlocks a single alternative appearance for all Companions* in the game (unique to each Companion). These cosmetics are purely visual, do not alter gameplay in any way, and do not represent “canon” looks for the characters. Instead, they are cool alternatives themed around the At the Heart of Ruin DLC’s content and factions.

The contents of the supporter pack are:
“Crimson Reaper” skin for Harvek
“Stalker Supreme” skin for Criftaa
“Sardakron Retainer” & “Sardakron Upstart” skins for Renkailon
“Expedition Sapper” skin for Garrik
“Venomous Fang Brave” & “Arachnid Warlord” skins for Gor’Goro
“Waterseeker” skin for Finndurarth
“Reeve of Varnurud” skin for Skornar
“Conflagrator” skin for Nedir
“Raptor Champion” skin for Eylani
“Hollow Exile” skin for Vorax*
“Faergal Psion” skin for Javek*
“Ironclad” skin for Sedarias*

As always, your support is much appreciated.
- The Lost Pilgrims Team

70050000061917.name: Simogo Legacy Collection - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000061917.description:
This upgrade pack upgrades Simogo Legacy Collection for Nintendo Switch™ to Simogo Legacy Collection – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

• Kosmo Spin
• Bumpy Road
• Beat Sneak Bandit
• Year Walk (+ Year Walk Companion)
• DEVICE 6
• The Sailor’s Dream
• SPL-T

Additionally, Simogo Legacy Collection features bonus content with thoughtfully curated curios from Simogo's wide-ranging history.

• Year Walk Bedtime Stories for Awful Children – E-book
• The Lighthouse Painting – Audio drama Podcast
• Music – Tracks from Simogo’s history, including previously unreleased tracks
• Images – Illustrations from Simogo’s archive
• Year Walk Prototype – Playable prototype
• Bumpy Road Prototype – Playable prototype
• Rollovski Prototype – Playable prototype
• The Sensational December Machine – Playable short story

Requires understanding of written and spoken English to be fully enjoyed.

70050000061921.name: Stardew Valley: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000061921.description: You’ve inherited your grandfather’s old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home? It won’t be easy. Ever since Joja Corporation came to town, the old ways of life have all but disappeared. The community center, once the town’s most vibrant hub of activity, now lies in shambles. But the valley seems full of opportunity. With a little dedication, you might just be the one to restore Stardew Valley to greatness!

70050000061922.name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate - KAHO DLC
70050000061922.description:
A daughter of a humble baker by day and a magical girl by destiny, Kaho’s bread-fueled justice comes to life with a freshly-baked moveset that’s as charming as it is chaotic. Whether flinging baguette blasts or unleashing croissant combos, she’s ready to roll… and rise.

Set against the vibrant backdrop of Los Angeles, California the downloadable content package includes:

-One new playable character Kaho Shibuya, a magical girl with the powers of cuteness and bread, available to use on Co-Op- and Battlegrounds Mode.
-Four new enemy mob characters to battle through on the new stage.
-A brand-new stage set in a fictional “LA,” dressed up for Anime Expo season available on Co-Op Mode.

70050000061948.name: Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key DX - DX Version Pre-order Bonus
70050000061948.description:
A set of 3 poses and 1 frame for each game which can be used in photo mode.

Note: This content may become available for purchase or for free separately at a later date.

70050000061959.name: Chef's Dream 1
70050000061959.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70050000061959.description: Unlock 24 brand-new puzzles, each packed with tasty treats — can you neatly fit them all into your bento box?

70050000061960.name: Little Nightmares III - Nomes Costumes Set
70050000061960.description:
The Nome Costumes Set lets you embody one of the most iconic figures from the world of Little Nightmares. Inspired by the small, secretive Nomes that hide in the darkest corners, this costume set gives your character a distinctive look, both unsettling and charming. 

The costume is suited for both characters Low and Alone.

70050000062001.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions - Advanced Scope
70050000062001.intro: Unlock the Sight 2 scope—precision wins battles.
70050000062001.description: Lead your SWAT team with confidence as you take on high-stakes hostage rescues and intense firefights. Upgrade your arsenal with the Sight 2 scope for Automatic Rifle III. This DLC enhances your weapon with cutting-edge optics, delivering sharper accuracy, faster target acquisition, and greater control in the heat of combat. Whether breaching enemy strongholds or holding the line under fire, the Sight 2 scope ensures you always have the advantage.

70050000062006.name: RetroMania Wrestling - Legends Pack: The Madness Returns
70050000062006.intro: The ring just got bigger, louder, and wilder!
70050000062006.description:
The squared circle just got bigger, louder, and wilder!

The latest RetroMania Wrestling DLC unleashes 6 legendary wrestlers — Macho Man Randy Savage, Ax & Smash of Demolition, Ricky Morton & Robert Gibson of The Rock ‘n’ Roll Express, and Magnum T.A.. Relive the glory days or rewrite history with these icons of wrestling, now fully playable in the RetroMania roster!

This DLC isn’t just about new talent — it’s packed with fresh ways to play. Enter House Show Mode for random match cards and high scores, or run Arcade and Promoter Tournaments across singles and tag team action. Claim gold with the brand-new Tag Team Championship and RetroMania World Championship, complete with title histories and stats. Customize wrestler gear, battle in 3 new stages, and explore 6 new Handicap match types.

This is the most stacked update in RetroMania history — are you ready to rumble?

70050000062008.name: Treflix: Comic Book Shame
70050000062008.intro: A comic book for children about emotions. Episode shame.
70050000062008.description: Treflix learns to fight emotions. A new challenge for them is shame.

70050000062010.name: Butterflies Pack
70050000062010.description: A set of butterflies-themed stickers to embellish a sticker album.

70050000062016.name: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000062016.description: By purchasing this content, "Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter" can be upgraded to "Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

70050000062018.name: Find Sort Match - Autumn Pack
70050000062018.intro: Cozy up with a new seasonal challenge.
70050000062018.description:
Welcome to the warm and friendly world of autumn with the Autumn Pack. This DLC brings all the colours, symbols and cozy feelings of the season to your favourite puzzle game. Put your attention to detail and sorting skills to the test as you solve puzzles featuring golden leaves, pumpkins, Halloween items, mushrooms and much more.

Each new level features beautifully themed autumn scenes that spark creativity and soothe your mind. Whether you're arranging jack-o’-lanterns, organizing fall treats, or matching woodland mushrooms, every puzzle delivers satisfying gameplay with a festive twist.

So, why not get into the autumn spirit by giving some new challenges a go?

★ Sort colorful autumn leaves by type and hue
★ Organize spooky Halloween decor like ghosts, bats, and potions
★ Match mushrooms, acorns, and cozy seasonal items
★ Stack pumpkins, candles, and other fall decorations
★ Complete puzzles inspired by crisp forest walks and harvest time

Strengthen your logic and focus while enjoying a stress-free, cozy experience full of autumn magic.

70050000062021.name: Find Sort Match - Hollywood Pack
70050000062021.intro: Enter the spotlight. Sort your way through cinema history!
70050000062021.description:
Lights, camera… organize! The Hollywood Pack brings the glitz and glam of iconic movies and TV shows into the relaxing world of Find Sort Match. Challenge your logic and creativity in puzzles inspired by blockbuster classics, cult favorites, and legendary scenes.

From arranging film reels and clapperboards to matching costumes, props, and set pieces. This pack offers a unique twist for every movie buff and puzzle lover alike.

Get ready to:
★ Sort famous movie memorabilia and scene props
★ Match iconic costumes, sunglasses, popcorn buckets, and more
★ Organize fictional scripts, VHS tapes, and red-carpet accessories
★ Recreate stylized scenes from cinema history
★ Spot clever references and Easter eggs hidden in the clutter

Perfect for fans of both film and precision, this DLC offers new levels that balance relaxing gameplay with film-inspired flair. Whether you're a casual viewer or a movie encyclopedia, the Hollywood Pack adds a whole new dimension of fun to your Find Sort Match experience.

70050000062025.name: Find Sort Match - Puzzle Pack
70050000062025.intro: Put the pieces together in the most satisfying way!
70050000062025.description:
Enjoy more brain-teasers with the Puzzle Pack! This time, the focus is on restoring order one piece at a time, whether that's repairing broken plates or assembling jigsaw-style images and intricate puzzles.

Test your logic, patience, and attention to detail as you organize scattered shards and match up picture pieces to reveal beautiful scenes. Whether you're restoring a shattered cup, piecing together a photograph, or completing a fragmented design, every task rewards focus and delivers that satisfying "click" of completion.

★ Rebuild broken plates, cups, and household items
★ Solve fragment puzzles to form complete images
★ Match visual pieces by pattern, color, and shape
★ Enjoy calm, satisfying gameplay with no timers or pressure
★ Discover new relaxing scenarios with every level

The Puzzle Pack expands the Find Sort Match universe with new mechanics and calming tasks that are as soothing as they are stimulating. Sharpen your mind and indulge your love of order in this cozy experience.

70050000062028.name: Find Sort Match - Christmas Pack
70050000062028.intro: Settle down by the fire and enjoy solving some puzzles!
70050000062028.description:
Celebrate the most wonderful time of the year with Find Sort Match: Christmas Pack, a special holiday-themed expansion packed with cozy, wintry puzzles. Bring your sorting skills into a magical world filled with snowflakes, festive treats, sparkling decorations, and heartwarming holiday vibes.

From arranging pine-scented candles and string lights to perfectly placing gingerbread cookies and colorful ornaments, each level is a charming nod to classic winter traditions. Whether you're stacking presents under the tree, sorting holiday tableware, or organizing snow globes and gift tags, there's joy in every task.

Get into the seasonal spirit with new activities:
 ★ Decorate trees with shiny baubles and twinkling lights
 ★ Sort snowflakes, candles, cookies, and gift items
 ★ Organize festive feasts, sweets, and hot cocoa stations
 ★ Pack presents with bows and ribbons
 ★ Arrange cozy winter scenes and cheerful holiday goods

The Christmas Pack is perfect for players who love puzzles and the magic of the holidays. It offers a relaxing yet mentally stimulating way to enjoy the season. Improve your focus and attention to detail while enjoying the cosy charm of winter.

Warm up your brain and your heart with Find Sort Match: Christmas Pack.

70050000062070.name: Hades II – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000062070.description: Hades II – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features higher-definition visuals, along with blazing-fast performance at 120 frames per second in docked mode.

70050000062246.name: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Goes Europa-Park
70050000062246.description:
Do you love fast-paced kart racing, preferably with family and friends? Have you already raced through the tracks of GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions with Ed & Edda, are you longing for more, and are a fan of Europa-Park? Then we have just the expansion you've been waiting for!

Because ‘Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Goes Europa-Park’ allows you to race through Europa-Park itself at high speed!

• Four brand new tracks at Europa-Park – drive them individually in different modes or one after the other in the Grand Prix!
• Race tracks inspired by the layout of Europa-Park for a real park feeling!
• Drive through many of the park's themed areas, racing past Voltron Nevera, Wodan Timburcoaster or the Eurosat sphere!
• Drive through the famous entrance gate of Europa-Park or venture into the Swiss bobsleigh track with your racer!
• Brand new racing mode: Prove that you are faster than the legendary ‘blue fire Megacoaster’ in the roller coaster challenge – alone or with up to four players in local multiplayer mode!
• 4 new characters with their own racers and designs – race through all the new and old tracks as Rulantica star Snorri, DINO MATES hero Mme Freudenreich, Sock the Allosaurus or the Yomi Rubi!

70050000062394.name: NBA BOUNCE: Retro Party Pack
70050000062394.intro: Pay tribute to Legacy Teams and party it up.
70050000062394.description:
Go back in time to pay tribute to legacy teams like the Charlotte Bobcats, New Jersey Nets, Seattle SuperSonics and Vancouver Grizzlies. Try out classic Hardwood Classic logos from teams like the Golden State Warriors and Miami Heat. 

Relive the glory days as you experience new ‘party mode’ effects. You perfected your 3-pointer, but do you have the skills to make the shot when it can change shape at any time? Outsmart the competition and make the basket before it shrinks.  

Show out with:  

- An old-school basketball  

- Classic sneakers and a newsboy cap 

- A blazing newspaper trail  

Features:

- HARDWOOD CLASSICS: Update your court logo and dress in vintage jerseys from 4 legacy teams.  

- LEAD HISTORIC TEAMS BACK TO VICTORY: Play with legendary teams on legacy courts.  

- THE PARTY DOESN’T STOP: Challenge yourself to score from shape-shifting 3-point lines and rims. 

- OLD SCHOOL IS THE NEW COOL: Score points with a vintage basketball, classic sneakers and a cap.  

- BLAZE A NEWSWORTHY TRAIL: Score points with a vintage basketball, sneakers and a newsboy cap.

70050000062442.name: Donkey Kong™ Bananza: DK Island & Emerald Rush
70050000062442.intro: Explore DK Island in the Donkey Kong™ Bananza: DK Island & Emerald Rush paid DLC!
70050000062442.description:
Sightsee across this modern take on Donkey Kong’s home, packed with nostalgic views like DK’s Treehouse, Gangplank Galleon, and other iconic locations. Take in-game photos with familiar friends Diddy Kong, Dixie Kong, Cranky Kong, and Rambi, and Squawks, and decorate DK Island with DLC-exclusive character statues that you can obtain with Banandium Chips. You might even find some hidden bonus stages among the mine cart tracks and jungle ruins!

You can get a first look at DK Island* by talking to Squawks after reaching the Racing Layer. After completing the game, you can visit DK Island as its own Layer and decorate it with character statues. 

Push your skills to the limit in the fast-paced challenge of Emerald Rush 

Take on timed, repeatable, increasingly difficult challenges in Emerald Rush—a mode that plays quite differently from the main game. Start from the ground up and rebuild DK’s power and skills as you progress through challenges in DK Island and various Layers of the Underground World. Collect emerald ore to earn exclusive in-game rewards and perks!

Access this DLC* and start Emerald Rush by talking to one of the Elders and then visiting the Warp Gong after clearing the main storyline.

70050000062489.name: Metroid Prime™ 4: Beyond – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000062489.intro: Upgrade your adventure on Viewros—only on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000062489.description:
Enhance your experience on Viewros with this upgrade pack. The Metroid Prime™ 4: Beyond – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game features enhanced resolution, framerate, and load times. You can also aim with a Joy-Con™ 2 controller as a mouse!

Two display modes let you choose how to experience the adventure. Enjoy more detail in Quality Mode, which runs at 60 frames per second in 4K while docked and in 1080p while in handheld, or prioritize super-smooth action with a higher frame rate in Performance Mode, which runs at 120 frames per second in 1080p while docked and 720p in while in handheld. Both choices are HDR compatible.

70050000062490.name: Holo-X and Holo-Y Apparel Items
70050000062490.intro: Customize your character’s in-game outfit with Holo-X and Holo-Y apparel items
70050000062490.description: Upon purchasing  this DLC, you can claim these Holo-X and Holo-Y in-game apparel items and wear them even during your journey through the main game. Once you unlock the ability to adjust your character’s looks and outfit—about an hour into the main story—you can claim these apparel items by pressing the X Button to open the main menu, and then pressing the − Button to access the Outfit & Looks menu.

70050000062491.name: Additional story content
70050000062491.intro: Venture into Hyperspace Lumiose for the next chapter of your adventure!
70050000062491.description:
Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a place known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the Mythical Pokémon Hoopa has the power to transform them into portals so you can travel there! Hoopa needs your help to do it, though: team up with the mysterious and talented baker, Ansha, to gather Berries and make donuts that will awaken Hoopa’s power and grant you and your Pokémon a variety of useful effects. 

Once you’re in Hyperspace Lumiose, join the Mega Evolution successor, Korrina, and Team MZ to investigate its mysteries. Just be sure you’re ready—this otherworldly version of Lumiose City can be a threatening place. The Pokémon here are different, and sometimes rare, with hyperspace levels that can make their total levels exceed the normal limit of 100.

It looks like your story with Team MZ isn’t over yet—continue your journey in Hyperspace Lumiose after completing the main game!

Encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions

As you progress through the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC*, you may encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions, such as two additional ones for Raichu—Mega Raichu X and Mega Raichu Y—as well as Mega Chimecho and Mega Baxcalibur!

70050000062492.intro: Discover the timeless charm of Sleeping Beauties from master paintings in the form of jigsaw puzzles.

70050000062601.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Scared Stiff
70050000062601.description:
Elvira is back to rattle your bones in the classic Scared Stiff pinball table! Join the Mistress of the Dark herself on a quest to “raise the dead” by completing six spooky tales.

Key Features:

- Fully authentic recreation of the 1996 arcade original
- Original Elvira voice lines and sound effects
- Six unique horror-themed modes
- Classic mechanical feel with modern enhancements

Do you have the guts to get Scared Stiff?

70050000062602.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Elvira and the Party Monsters
70050000062602.description:
It’s party time in the graveyard, and you’re invited! In Elvira and the Party Monsters, the Mistress of the Dark herself hosts a frightful evening packed with creepy creatures, sizzling shots, and multiball madness. Light up the dance floor as you bash the monsters, raise the dead, and keep the party alive with every flip.

Key Features:

- Faithful recreation of the 1989 arcade original
- Classic monster-party theme with unique modes and challenges
- Jackpots, skill shots, and graveyard challenges to master
- Elvira’s signature voice lines and cheeky commentary

The monsters are waiting… what are you bringing to the party?

70050000062631.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Shop Redesign
70050000062631.intro: Change your store’s feel and watch your business grow.
70050000062631.description:
Give your supermarket a fresh new look with this exclusive DLC that lets you change the colors of both the interior and exterior of your store. Customize the atmosphere, create a unique style, and make your store stand out from the competition. Whether you prefer a modern, classic, or bold design, this DLC gives you the freedom to completely transform your supermarket’s appearance to match your vision and attract more customers.

Use simple customization tools to try different color schemes and instantly change your store’s vibe. Make every visit memorable with a supermarket look that’s uniquely yours.

70050000062638.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Night Vision Mode
70050000062638.intro: Night vision activated — gain tactical advantage fast.
70050000062638.description:
Enhance your tactics with the new Night Vision feature. Dive deeper into the intense first-person shooter as you navigate darker environments where stealth and awareness are key. Use night vision to spot enemies hiding in shadows and plan your moves carefully.

Face hostile forces in the dark and push your skills to the limit. BODY CAM SHOOTER just got darker — and more intense!

70050000062639.name: Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace
70050000062639.description: A rush of blood flows beneath the skin. The skin splits, and the symphony begins. It twists and contorts into a maddening crescendo; more scream than song... An opera singer consumed by a gruesome curse. A young drummer seeking to make it big. Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace is an original Chapter featuring a new Killer, The Krasue, and a new Survivor, Vee Boonyasak.  Experience a terrifying take on Thai Folklore rooted in visceral body-horror.

70050000063973.name: GigaBash - GAMERA -Rebirth- DLC
70050000063973.description:
This DLC adds "Gamera" and "Guiron" from the iconic Gamera series in their modern, fully animated incarnations into GigaBash, featuring their own unique skillsets.

As seen in "GAMERA -Rebirth-", Gamera emerges to protect those it was made to destroy. Gamera shows that defense and offense go hand-in-hand, with plasma jets to close the distance and flaming projectiles to engage at range. Its thick armored shell ensures no attack gets through. The guardian kaiju is devastating and dangerous at any distance.

Slicing through at lightning speed, Guiron launches into the fray in its "GAMERA -Rebirth-" incarnation. With unmatched agility, Guiron wields its iconic bladed head to drive destruction into any who stand in the way. Its razor-sharp Scale Shots threaten those who try to escape. This kaiju is a living weapon in name and purpose.

Will you embody the cutting edge of Guiron and strike terror upon the world? Or will you don the shell of Gamera to purify and protect your allies?

70050000064024.name: Hirelings & Landmarks
70050000064024.intro: Need allies? Come row downstream! Discover unique strategies and make the Woodland wilder by adding hirelings. Best with fewer players, great with more!
70050000064024.description:
Hirelings
Hirelings can be added to games at any player count. With fewer players, the hirelings add new pieces to the map, ramping up the tension and giving you more tactical options. With more players, some hireling cards will flip over to reveal new special abilities to gain, letting you explore unique and powerful strategies.
Includes 13 promoted and 13 demoted hirelings
Landmarks
Bring the Woodland to life with landmarks!  Each landmark offers players new strategic challenges and tactical possibilities. Best of all, they work with each of Root's maps!
Barter for anything you need at the Black Market.
Find new friends and followers in the Lost City.
Craft a masterwork at the Legendary Forge.
Sit proud upon the grand throne in the Elder Treetop.
Achievements

70050000064091.name: Little Nightmares III - Klonoa Costumes Set

Wear these costumes to stand out as you explore unsettling environments and face the horrors of the Spiral. A nostalgic nod for long-time fans, and a fresh, haunting look for new adventurers.

The Jorsey – A sleek, early-90s contender known for its elegant lines and breakthrough design.
The Superbows – A daring late-70s experiment that pushed the limits of engineering with its radical, ground-hugging style.
The Betaborneo – A modern challenger from the 2020s, blending sharp aerodynamics with cutting-edge performance.

70050000064217.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000064217.intro: Embark on a cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends and restore an abandoned island to its former glory.
70050000064217.description:
• Discover eight unique regions, from the ocean’s depths to an island in the clouds
• Befriend iconic characters like cheerful Hello Kitty, mischievous Kuromi, and sweet Cinnamoroll
• Bake, cook, and craft the perfect gifts to become best friends
• Renovate cabins and decorate them to attract even more wonderful characters
• Create your perfect avatar, find and customize hundreds of outfits tailored to you, and create and collect furniture to achieve your dream home aesthetic
• Celebrate the joys of summertime, the winter holidays, and more with a year round calendar of events. And don’t forget to throw birthday parties for your friends

70050000064442.name: Chained Climb Together – Player Reskin
70050000064442.intro: New skin, new attitude, same epic adventure.
70050000064442.description:
Customize your climbing experience with a brand-new player skin! This DLC introduces a fresh and unique look for your character, helping you stand out as you ascend the challenging mountains alongside your team.

Whether you’re playing solo or cooperating with others, the new reskin adds style and personalization while keeping the game’s intense cooperative spirit alive. Get ready to conquer the heights with a completely new look!

70050000064450.name: Wall World Deep Threat
70050000064450.description:

But you will have to fight for answers, and not only with the new types of Zyrex: other inhabitants of the Wall are also not too keen on parting with their secrets.

Dig and enhance: Nine new mine biomes with relics and blueprints that you haven't seen before buried within.

Fight: New types of enemies and bosses, even angrier than before. A third party is now guarding the secrets of the Wall.

Explore: Study the finds to piece together the events of the distant past and uncover the secret that is buried deep in the bowels of the Wall.

70050000064476.description:

70050000064481.name: Ion Fury: Aftershock
70050000064481.description:
Ion Fury Continues: The Explosive Aftershock!
Just when you thought it was over, the battle rages on. Plunge back into the pixel-perfect world of Ion Fury: welcome to Aftershock, the electrifying continuation of the Fury odyssey. With Neo DC teetering on the brink of annihilation and a vengeful Dr. Heskel on the prowl, Shelly ""Bombshell"" Harrison's personal vendetta is about to boil over. Lace up your boots and once again become Neo DC's last hope against Dr. Heskel's nightmarish vision. The fate of the city rests in your hands. Are you ready to face the Fury?

Gear Up for Round Two
-	Uncharted Territories, Higher Stakes: Ignite the Fury with a gripping new campaign. Traverse 15 freshly-designed levels teeming with lurking adversaries.
-	Fresh Faces of Evil: Heskel’s been busy. Meet his new lineup of augmented monstrosities itching for a fight.
-	Packing More Heat: Enhance your firepower with new weapons and tools.
-	Push Your Limits: Challenge your skills with the grueling new Angel of Death difficulty level.
-	Ride On: Find out what a rotorcycle is and engage in white-knuckle vehicular combat.
-	Old, Yet New: Immerse yourself in Arrange mode for a fresh new take on all 28 levels from the original 2019 campaign, featuring new areas, new enemy encounters, and more.
-	Packed With Content: Engage in a total of 43 additional levels of sheer mayhem. See Ion Fury through a whole new lens.

Save the City... Again
-	Interactive Environments: Utilize destructible elements to set deadly traps and turn the tide against swarms of enemies.
-	New Puzzles to Decipher: Push your cognitive limits and crack intricate puzzles to unlock hidden paths and valuable resources.
-	Dynamic Narrative: Witness the story unfold through rich dialogues, ambient storytelling, and unexpected character interactions.
-	Soundtrack to Battle: Rock out to a powerful new score, fusing retro beats with modern intensity, underscoring every firefight and plot twist.
-	Achieve the Impossible: Take on unique achievement challenges that will test even the most battle-hardened players.
-	Modern Retro Fusion: A marriage of classic shooter elements with modern design sensibilities, delivering a nostalgic yet fresh experience.

Are You Up for the Challenge?
The city cries out for a hero, and it's calling your name. With greater evils, trickier levels, and an even more relentless Dr. Heskel, do you have what it takes to step up to the plate? Embrace the Fury. Ion Fury: Aftershock awaits.

70050000064484.name: Electronics Supermarket Simulator: Starter Cash
70050000064484.intro: Kickstart your electronics empire with cash bonus!
70050000064484.description:
Kickstart your electronics empire with this bonus DLC! Players receive €1000 in-game upon entering gameplay to jumpstart their business. Design your store, stock the latest tech, manage staff, and make smart decisions to grow your electronics supermarket.

Take advantage of your starting funds to expand, invest in new products, and get ahead in the competitive world of tech retail. Your journey to becoming the ultimate electronics tycoon begins here!

70050000064555.name: Summer Tiki Party
70050000064555.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70050000064555.description: Summer Tiki Party brings back the warmth of carefree summer days! Fill your Pocket Nook with tropical vibes, from bamboo furniture to colorful island decorations. Create your own pixel art oasis and keep the summer spirit alive, even during the cold days.

70050000064558.name: Chopstick Finesse 1
70050000064558.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!
70050000064558.description: Unlock 24 brand-new puzzles, each with delicious ramen bowls. Can you serve them all?

70050000064560.name: Chopstick Finesse 2
70050000064560.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!

70050000064575.name: MARS 2120 - The more, the merrier
70050000064575.intro: Sci-fi Metroidvania set on Mars, now with two new difficulty levels.
70050000064575.description:
In the metroidvania MARS 2120, you are sent on a rescue mission to Earth's first colony on Mars. Something terrible has happened, and it's up to you to uncover the truth. Combining intense melee combat, action-packed shootouts, and elemental special abilities, you'll need to explore hostile environments, face relentless enemies, and uncover the secrets of a threat that may extend far beyond the red planet.

With the “The More, The Merrier” DLC, the journey becomes even more challenging.

Play your way
Now with the long-awaited option to reconfigure controls.

Two new game modes
New Game+ - Relive the campaign while keeping your upgrades, but face stronger and more lethal enemies and bosses (health and damage increased by 1.5x).
New Game++ - For the most fearless, an even greater challenge: enemies and bosses with double health and damage.

New achievements
Each new game mode brings exclusive achievements to reward only the most skilled.

Get ready to return to Mars, test your limits, and prove that you can master every battle. After all, the harder... the better.

70050000064585.name: Top Racer Customs
70050000064585.intro: Arcade racing game now with new cars and an exclusive customization mode.
70050000064585.description:
"The nostalgia of the tracks is back with even more excitement! The classic Top Racer Collection, which brings together four legendary racing games from the 90s, now receives brand-new content: the Top Racer Customs DLC.

For the first time in the history of the franchise, players can customize their cars in Top Racer 1, not only visually, creating a unique style for each machine, but also in performance, adjusting speed, acceleration, nitro power, and fuel capacity.

And it doesn’t stop there: customized cars can be shared with other players. Who will be able to create the ultimate machine? This is your chance to build the perfect car for every track and challenge friends and rivals in adrenaline-fueled races.

On top of that, four brand-new cars are making their debut exclusively in Top Racer 1, all inspired by iconic models from the 80s and 90s that left their mark on the roads of that era. A heartfelt tribute to retro car culture and to the passionate fans who made Top Racer a timeless success.

Main features of the Top Racer Customs DLC (for Top Racer 1):
Performance tuning: speed, acceleration, nitro, and fuel capacity.
4 brand-new exclusive cars inspired by 80s and 90s icons.
Visual customization for Top Racer 1 cars and the 4 new vehicles.
Online sharing of your creations with other players.

Get ready to experience the ultimate version of Top Racer: nostalgia, speed, and now the freedom to design your dream machine. Relive the thrill, race like never before, and show your identity on the asphalt with Top Racer Customs!

Requires the base game Top Racer Collection to play."

70050000064608.name: Rento Shares & Bonds
70050000064608.intro:
Issue SHARES for your complete properties to raise money.
Hold a BONDS (Obligations) on other players
70050000064608.description:
SHARES

The new "Shares" feature enables players to issue shares for their complete properties (eg. Player has all 3 blue color lands and he can issue 2,3 or 4 shares for them to be bought by other players).

When other player buys a share, he then gets % of the rent that is paid when some players lands on that blue land.

If 4 shares are issued from player A and then player B buys one share, then when player C lands on that blue land, player A will not get the full rent from player C, but only 75% of it. The other 25% of the rent will go to player B.

BONDS

Bonds (also called obligations) are debt papers issued from one player to other player (1 to 1). Bond issuer takes X money as debt to bond holder. Bond issuer later has to payback that money + some predefined interest. The bond issuer has to return the loaned amount and interest in X turns (defined when the bond is issued).

Failed to do so will default the bond, forcing the debtor (bond issuer) to pay the owned money to the bond holder or to go bankrupt.

Both shares and bonds can be traded in the game.

Other players can buy shares and bonds throughout the game at their own terms/prices.

These custom dice are used when you turn on the setting "multiple dice".

In this game setting when each player has turn, he is allowed to choose which dice to roll. Apart from the default 1 2 3 4 5 6 dice, you can create custom dice with digits between 0 and 10 (including). 

For example you can make dice like: 0  5  7  7  10  10   or   0  0   10  10  1  1.

Apart from the default die 1 2 3 4 5 6, you can make 4 more dice to be used in the game (so total 5 dice maximum).

There are 2 limitations as well:
-The sum of all 6 dice sides must be maximum 40
-Each custom die must have 3 even sides and 3 odd sides

Another thing to note - in games with multiple dice - if you roll doubles - you will not roll again.

With a fruity cocktail still in hand and nothing but rage in his heart, the Dude must now punch, piss, and blast his way through a sunbaked swarm of brainwashed fanatics under the heat of a regular manhunt to get his guns back. He’s been stripped of his beloved boomsticks, sure - but don’t worry. The POSTAL Dude’s never unarmed. Just more improvisational. And this time he’s motivated as ever.

Make sure your body is ready to:

- Explore a brand new chapter that expands the story after Brain Damaged.

- Soak in the summer vibes and kick-back by kicking everyone’s collective ass. 

- Ruin holidays with 5 brand new offensive weapons - both literally and metaphorically. 

- Get sticky with the new sweaty sticky hand. Now you can get into places without the hook. Convenient and weird! 

- New enemies to rain on your parade - from the attention demanding xtitch streamers, to the dangerously chiseled chads. 

- Enjoy the cast of returning characters in a sun-stroked new adventure.

70050000065052.name: Storm Lancers – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000065052.description:
You and your friend just crash-landed on an alien planet harboring a secret source of powerful magic. All of reality is on the verge of collapse, and two magical creatures have chosen you as their heroes. To save the planet, you’ll fight, die, and bond with the Stormhearts to rise again — stronger, fiercer, and unstoppable. 

Storm Lancers is a fast-paced rogue-like, where every run means dodging death, overcoming enemies, and mastering powerful skills. The battle is on, so team up in chaotic co-op for survival.

GAME FEATURES 

ROGUE-LIKE ACTION
On Cryptica, no two runs are the same. Explore ever-shifting biomes in HDR at a smooth 60 FPS, where every leap, slash, and dash brings you one step closer to unraveling the mystery. Discover powerful gear, master randomized weapons, and earn permanent upgrades that transform your base move set into an acrobatic arsenal. 

CHAOTIC COUCH CO-OP
Help a friend then nab a rare drop right out from under them. This is all-out, rogue-like action that’s even better with two. Whether you’re having trouble with a later biome or just looking to add some chaos, a friend can dive in instantly in couch co-op or online with GameShare. If your partner drops, keep playing seamlessly in solo mode to stay in the action. 

BOSSES & ENEMIES
From a machine race that consumes planets to alien flora and fauna that want to kill everything, fight through bosses and enemies who will force you to think faster, fight harder, and adapt quickly. This is an ever-changing battlefield where killer instincts and survival skills are everything. 

WEAPONS & ABILITIES 
Grow your acrobatic moveset with permanent upgrades like slide, dash, and double jump. Plus, experiment with an evolving arsenal, flaming swords, razor-sharp katars, rifles, hammers, and grenade launchers. Each weapon is designed for destruction, so choose wisely — or die quickly.

KEY FEATURES 
• Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition—Enhanced with improved resolution, HDR, faster load times, and smoother performance
• Rogue-like Action—Playing at a smooth 60 FPS 
• Chaotic Co-op—Invite a friend for couch co-op or online co-op with GameShare
• Grow Your Acrobatics—Unlock permanent upgrades, like slide, dash, and double jump
• Test Your Power—Mix and match weapons, abilities, and powerups run after run
• An Alien Mystery—Face shifting biomes and alien bosses to unravel the mystery

70050000065074.name: The Last Faith: Awakened Ancients
70050000065074.intro: Awakened Ancients delivers long-awaited content, answers, deeper challenges and the most polished version of The Last Faith to date.
70050000065074.description:
Descend once more into Mythringal - if you dare - with additional gameplay, game modes, and a much-requested New Game Plus mode to uncover secrets only the most devoted players will recognize. 

Key Features:
The ultimate test awaits. Face 7 new merciless unique enemies and 5 unforgiving bosses in Awakened Ancients.

All new gameplay area and game modes.

Dungeon Mode. Once you have obtained the Nighthunter’s Grappling Claw, this area will become accessible within Oxnevylle Manor. In this new game mode, players can use 3 new characters to find new unique weapons, bosses, enemies, NPCs and items. Be rewarded with a new skin for completing.

New Game +. Take on an even more challenging journey with Eryk or as one of 3 new characters (after being unlocked in Dungeon Mode) in New Game Plus. Not challenging enough? Try NG+2, NG+3, and beyond. Note that previous save data will be replaced and all events will be reset.

Boss Rush Mode. Only available after completing the main game, start a New Game Plus and a new option will appear in the Extra section of the main menu. Take on all the bosses of The Last Faith as Eryk or 3 new characters, including optional bosses (excluding bosses from new Dungeon Mode). Be rewarded with a new skin for completing.

Tower of Despair. How long can you survive? The Tower of Despair is also accessible after completing the main game in the Extra section of the main menu, in this survival-style mode take down multiple waves of enemies from each act of the game as either Eryk or 3 new characters.

New executions and gameplay improvements. Wicked enemies deserve wicked takedowns. Defeat them with style with all new executions and gameplay improvements.

New selectable characters, items and weapons. Even more to explore and find in the new areas introduced in Awakened Ancients.

70050000065183.name: Two Strikes - Shinigami
70050000065183.description:
The Shinigami Descends DLC

Long watching from the veil of shadows, the Shinigami now steps into the arena. The collector of souls brings with him every technique stolen from the fallen — the architect of Two Strikes is yours to command. Cold, patient, and all-knowing, he fights not for glory or pride, but to decide how every story ends.

On the battlefield, the Shinigami is both inevitability and execution. He adapts to his opponent’s style, turning their own strength against them with devastating precision. Every strike is measured. Every movement is inevitable. To face him is to confront your final moment.

This DLC pack includes the playable character Shinigami, featuring a fully unique move set with stance-shifting combat, ritual executions, and soul-stealing finishers. Also included is a new stage, The Twilight Gate, where spirits wander between life and death — accompanied by an original music track composed exclusively for this release.

The Shinigami is fully playable across all online and offline game modes.

70050000065184.name: Clue: Legacy Suspect Pack
70050000065184.intro: More fan-favourite legacy suspects return to Clue!
70050000065184.description:
Prince Azure, Monsieur Brunette, Mrs White, Madame Rose, Miss Peach and Inspector Gray join the modern Clue digital game!

Redesigned and updated for the modern era, this pack contains twelve new suspect tokens that can be used on any crime scene you own.

Whether you’ve been waiting eagerly for their return or you’re meeting them for the first time,  when you add the Legacy Suspect Pack to your game, you can play the most iconic, nostalgic version of Clue!  

INCLUDES:
- 2 x PRINCE AZURE TOKENS – Give the prince a royal welcome to the modern Clue digital game!
- 2 x MONSIEUR BRUNETTE TOKENS – The roguish con artist swindles his way back onto the board.
- 2 x MRS WHITE TOKENS – The original Mrs White makes her grand return to the game.
- 2 x MADAME ROSE TOKENS – Madame Rose always knew she’d come back to Clue someday…
- 2 x MISS PEACH TOKENS – The Southern belle graces the board with her presence once more! 
- 2 x INSPECTOR GRAY TOKENS – This corrupt cop finds the Clue board again!

70050000065191.name: Flames of Damnation: Survival Boost
70050000065191.intro: More life, more power, more survival.
70050000065191.description:
Take your survival to the next level with this essential DLC! Your maximum health is increased from 100 to 200 units, giving you the resilience to face even the most relentless hordes of hellish enemies.

With your enhanced durability, you can take more risks and survive intense combat encounters, explore dangerous areas with greater confidence, engage in prolonged battles against stronger foes, and fully enjoy the fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping action without compromise.

Step into the depths of hell stronger and more prepared than ever. Your fight for survival just got a powerful upgrade!

70050000065193.name: Winter
70050000065193.intro: Unpack your memories, relax, and let the summer linger a little longer.
70050000065193.description: You've had enough of the hot, summer sun? With Winter Break DLC, you can travel to the snowy mountain resort and face 10 thrilling levels of the new challenges!

70050000065197.description:
Creep from the crypt in ghastly glamour with the Cursed Couture Wardrobe Expansion, conjured just in time for the witching hour by the Rug Reader. Shroud Aleksandra in the Vampyre Set's velvet shadows, where every glance hints at ancient hungers and forbidden power… or slip into the Phantom's Set, a spectral outfit so haunting that foes may flee before the first die has even been thrown.

This isn't just fashion—it's a fright. Because if one is going to stalk the floors of Mare's dark games, one might as well look drop-dead fabulous.

Includes two unique costume sets for Aleksandra and Fortune:

- The Vampyre Set
- The Phantom's Set

70050000065214.name: MFC - Midnight Fight Club: Cash Power
70050000065214.intro: Get rich fast and dominate every league.
70050000065214.description:
Give your fighter the ultimate advantage and accelerate your journey to the top of the leagues! Upgrade your stats, unlock new gear, and gain a strategic edge over your opponents.

What’s included:
- 500,000 in-game currency - a perfect advantage for players who want to rise though the ranks and dominate the competition.

Step into the arena stronger, faster, and richer!

70050000065226.name: Lake - Season's Greetings
70050000065226.intro: Jolly storylines, cozily-lit drives around the snowy town, and a heart-warming gaming experience await you!
70050000065226.description: It's Christmas time, 1985. You take on the role of Meredith's dad, Thomas Weiss, and will be treated to a warm reunion with Providence Oaks and its inhabitants. Get answers to questions that were teased in Lake, meet five completely new characters, and find out which role an almost retired postal worker can play in delivering the Christmas spirit to Providence Oaks.

70050000065231.name: Overcooked! 2 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000065231.intro: Kitchen chaos comes to Nintendo Switch™ 2
70050000065231.description: The cooking chaos of Overcooked! 2 hits Nintendo Switch™ 2 with a host of new features. Tear up the kitchen with 4K, 60 FPS gameplay, enjoy Nintendo Switch™ 2 features like CameraPlay and GameShare, plus meet an exclusive Chef: The Platinum Platypus. Hold onto your aprons and try not to set the kitchen, and your friendships, on fire.

70050000065299.name: Ozymandias - Indus Valley
70050000065299.intro: This DLC includes a new map: Indus Valley.
70050000065299.description: At the dawn of the Bronze Age, a new culture rises on the banks of the mighty Indus, harnessing the river with canals and reservoirs  to feed burgeoning cities of mud-brick.

70050000065304.name: The Art of Demonschool
70050000065304.intro: Experience Demonschool's visual development in this artbook containing over 100 pages of concept art and exclusive insight into the worldbuilding of the game.
70050000065304.description:
This DLC add-on offers two books that delve into the development process of Demonschool. Enjoy exclusive pieces of concept art in high resolution that were meticulously archived by Necrosoft Games, the developers of Demonschool.

The first book, "The Art of Demonschool", offers over 100 pages of insight into the process and history of how Demonschool's artistic direction was honed over its years of development. The second book, "The Design of Demonschool", guides viewers on how the experiences, cutscenes and minigames of Hemsk Island, where Demonschool takes place, are conceived and designed.

70050000065313.name: Tales of Berseria Remastered - Super Adventuring Assistance Set
70050000065313.description:

Content includes:

70050000065314.name: Tales of Berseria Remastered - Super Growth Support Herb Set

70050000065315.description: Let the wind in your sails with a set featuring tracks from previous games in the Tales of series to play while battling in Tales of Berseria Remastered.

70050000065383.name: Cards Pack 1
70050000065383.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70050000065383.description: Add even more charm to Cozy Memory with this adorable DLC! This expansion introduces new sets of cute animal cards to discover and match, bringing extra warmth and variety to your cozy puzzle sessions.

70050000065386.name: Cards Pack 4
70050000065386.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70050000065386.description: Add even more charm to Cozy Memory with this adorable DLC! This expansion introduces new sets of cute animal cards to discover and match, bringing extra warmth and variety to your cozy puzzle sessions.

70050000065397.name: Motel Owner Simulator – The Investor’s Gift
70050000065397.intro: Give your motel empire a head start.
70050000065397.description:
Give your motel empire a strong jumpstart! Whether growing your business or bouncing back from challenges, every savvy manager can use a helping hand. Add 50,000 cash to your in-game balance to accelerate your progress!

Use this extra cash to upgrade your rooms, decorate your interiors, expand your property, or invest in new facilities that will attract more guests and maximize your profits.

Enhance your management experience and grow your hospitality business faster with this exclusive DLC reward!

70050000065406.name: Digging A Hole 2025: Skybox Overhaul
70050000065406.intro: Thunder roars above, treasures await below.
70050000065406.description:
Take your underground adventure to the next level with dynamic weather and breathtaking skies! This DLC introduces rain that transforms the atmosphere of your backyard digs, adding a new layer of realism and challenge. Watch as puddles form, mud collects, and the environment reacts to changing weather conditions, making every excavation feel more immersive than ever.

Elevate your excavation journey with this atmospheric DLC and uncover the mysteries of the underground in a world that looks and feels more dynamic than ever!

70050000065411.name: Broken Sword - Shadow of the Templars: Reforged - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000065411.description: Upgrade your experience with crisp native resolution artwork and Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls on Nintendo Switch™ 2.

70050000065415.name: Synth Riders: Current Waves Music Pack
70050000065415.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future
70050000065415.description:
Those songs on your playlist you can’t get out of your head? They’re right here in the Current Waves Music Pack! It’s loaded with chart-topping hits from artists you love.

SONGS INCLUDE:
David Guetta & OneRepublic - "I Don't Wanna Wait"
Sia - "Gimme Love"

70050000065419.name: Synth Riders: 80s Mixtape Side B Music Pack
70050000065419.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future
70050000065419.description:
80s Mixtape - Side B wakes you up with unforgettable tracks and makes you never wanna give up playing this collection. These chart-toppers – all from the decade that inspired Synth Riders’ neon-soaked worlds – will take you back to the 80s as you dance to the sounds of Queen, The Cure, Wham!, and more!

SONGS INCLUDE:
