70050000065431.name: Ozymandias - Near East
70050000065431.intro: This DLC includes a new map: Near East.
70050000065431.description: As the Bronze Age reaches its zenith, its ancient empires achieve new heights of splendour and luxury. But new powers are stirring in the hills and beyond the sea.

70050000065440.name: Ozymandias - Aegean Sea
70050000065440.intro: This DLC includes a new map: Aegean Sea.
70050000065440.description: A thousand Greek warships sail the wine-dark Aegean. Troy gathers her allies and looks to her walls. The ancient sea-kingdoms of Crete sense opportunity.

70050000065441.name: Ozymandias - The Andes
70050000065441.intro: This DLC includes a new map: The Andes.
70050000065441.description: Rich cultures flourish among these peaks, nurtured by the gods of Sky and Earth. Now the proud mountain kings are challenged by a rising empire. Who will submit and who will die?

70050000065442.name: Ozymandias - Indonesia
70050000065442.intro: This DLC includes a new map: Indonesia.
70050000065442.description: From their fertile volcanic islands between the Indian Ocean and the Pacific, the lords of Indonesia control some of the richest seaways in the world. But is there land enough to share?

70050000065443.name: Ozymandias - The World
70050000065443.intro: This DLC includes a new map: the World.
70050000065443.description: After millennia of struggle, through ages of fire and flint, the inhabitants of this lonely blue marble begin to master the arts of civilization. Something, at last, to celebrate.

70050000065470.name: Ozymandias - Sahara Desert
70050000065470.intro: This DLC includes a new map: Sahara Desert.
70050000065470.description: The desert is expanding. But though it is harsh, it is full of life. Which of the surrounding empires can control the lucrative trade routes that snake across the sands?

70050000065471.name: Ozymandias - Mesoamerica
70050000065471.intro: This DLC includes a new map: Mesoamerica.
70050000065471.description: Great cities have stood in these jungles and highlands since time immemorial. Upstart tribes threaten the old balance. Will the peoples of the Jaguar enjoy one last pre-columbian golden age?

70050000065490.name: Formula Legends : Tech Power Pack
70050000065490.intro: Discover three groundbreaking cars in the Formula Legends: Tech Pack DLC! Inspired by bold eras of racing, each machine brings unique tech, daring design, and thrilling performance.
70050000065490.description:
Rediscover the boldest era of racing innovation with the Formula Legends: Tech Pack DLC. This pack introduces three legendary machines inspired by real-world technological breakthroughs — reimagined for the modern Formula Legends experience.

Each car in the Tech Pack captures a moment in motorsport history when creativity and engineering pushed beyond convention. Whether it’s radical aerodynamics, experimental traction systems, or perfect late-90s precision, these cars were built to challenge everything you know about racing.

Included Cars:

TramTram Cyclone – A fearless seventies design built around experimental aerodynamic technology. Master its unique handling and experience the raw power of its innovation.

HexaTyre 34 – An audacious multi-wheel marvel that redefines traction and control. Take on corners with impossible grip and feel every ounce of its mechanical ingenuity.

Jorsey BeeSting – Sleek, balanced, and lightning-quick. This nineties classic embodies engineering elegance and championship spirit.

Push the limits of innovation. Dominate the track with three of the most daring machines ever conceived in Formula Legends: Tech Pack DLC.

70050000065491.name: Airport Manager Simulator 2025: Beyond the Clouds
70050000065491.intro: The sky changes, your airport evolves.
70050000065491.description:
Take your airport to new heights with this DLC! Experience a transformed sky that evolves with each in-game day, reflecting unique atmospheres, weather variations, and lighting conditions.

From bright sunrises to stormy nights, the sky now changes with each day, adding realism, atmosphere, and a touch of magic to every airport operation. Every flight feels alive under ever-changing skies, making your airport truly dynamic.

Bring the skies to life and make your airport more beautiful than ever!

70050000065496.name: Formula Legends : Pioneer Pack
70050000065496.intro: From classic icons to modern marvels, the Pioneer Pack brings three cars that embody courage, creativity, and the spirit of racing evolution.
70050000065496.description:
Drive the Machines That Shaped History

Step into the world of racing innovation with the Pioneer Pack, a collection of three legendary machines that redefined speed, design, and engineering. From the golden age of racing to the modern era of precision performance, these cars don’t just compete—they tell the story of progress itself.

Included Cars:
Mclauden MID 70
It seemed built to chase the sun. Its golden body reflected every ray, and its heart pulsed with a steady, human-like rhythm. It didn’t race to win, but to exist in motion — a symbol of pure balance between light and speed.
Tram Tram Late 60
Raw and essential, made of strength and sound. Every curve told the story of a mechanical legend being born. It didn’t seek perfection, but the truth of speed — and its daring design introduced ideas that would change motorsport forever.
Gass Mid 20
A force of steel and carbon, driven by the spirit of challenge. Every piece seemed carved with pride and determination, echoing the roar of endless highways and racing hearts. Bold in line, fierce in heart, and free in soul.

Experience the Evolution of Motorsport
From the pioneers of innovation to the heroes of the modern track, the Pioneer Pack celebrates those who dared to redefine speed. Discover three cars that embody passion, progress, and pure performance.

70050000065500.name: Formula Legends : Early 2010’s Season Pack
70050000065500.intro: Dominate the Early 2010s turbo-hybrid era with a new season, two thrilling cars, and Story Mode!
70050000065500.description:
Step into the dawn of a transformative era in motorsport. The Early 2010’s Season Pack introduces two new cars and era-specific content that capture the innovation, unpredictability, and rapid evolution of the early 2010s — now fully integrated into Story Mode.

Lead your team with the new early-2010s generic chassis, representing the era’s core design philosophy across the grid. Then take on the challenge of the Early ’10 (Flower) — a bold car featuring a distinctive asymmetrical front-end concept and experimental aerodynamic ideas inspired by the period’s most daring engineering.

This era also marks the arrival of turbo-hybrid power units, a breakthrough that reshaped performance and dramatically reordered the competitive field. With its complete Story Mode integration, you’ll experience the narrative shifts, strategic upheavals, and rising rivalries that defined this pivotal decade.

This DLC includes:
2 new cars:
 - Generic early-2010s chassis
 - Early ’10 (Flower) with its radical asymmetric aero concept
A fully integrated Early 2010’s Season in Story Mode
Era-inspired liveries and visual elements
New challenges and scenarios reflecting key moments of the decade
Expanded season variety to enrich your Formula Legends journey

Relive the birth of the turbo-hybrid era — when innovation surged, power shifted, and racing changed forever.

70050000065507.name: Formula Legends : Turbo Power Pack
70050000065507.intro: Two Legendary Machines. Endless Classic Thrills.
70050000065507.description: Take a journey back to racing’s golden era with DLC 5 for Formula Legends! Step into the cockpit of the GoodJob Mi90, a sleek and daring classic built for precision and speed, and the Fyrex Early70, a vintage powerhouse made for pure track domination. Feel the roar of the engines, master every challenging curve, and experience the thrill that defined a generation of racing. With these legendary machines, the past comes alive—and the race is yours to win!

70050000065513.name: Holo's Hanafuda DLC: La+ Darknesss & Kazama Iroha Set
70050000065513.intro: A thrilling new story where two members of Secret Society holoX hatch a devious plan!
70050000065513.description:

70050000065514.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Shovel Knight Music Pack
70050000065514.intro: Dig into the OFFICIAL Shovel Knight Music Pack!
70050000065514.description:
Featuring FIVE new Rhythm Rifts by Jake Kaufman:
- "La Danse Macabre (Lich Yard)"
- "Strike the Earth! (Plains of Passage)"

Each Shovel Knight Rhythm Rift features:

- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

70050000065630.name: Railway Empire 2 - Steel Dragons
70050000065630.intro: Begin your journey on wings of steel, as heavy steam and the steady rhythm of the engine carry you into the mysterious Middle Kingdom.
70050000065630.description:
In Railway Empire 2 – Steel Dragons, lay your tracks to the farthest reaches of China – from the shores of the East China Sea, along the banks of the Yellow River and up the slopes of the majestic mountains of the west. Create the foundation of the world’s largest rail network by connecting cities and industries across the country. Work alongside Zhan Tianyou, the “Father of China's Railroad”, to transform the first railway connections into a proud national network, forming the backbone of expansion and progress.

Forge your expansive railway empire in the Middle Kingdom, powered by steam, steel, and ambition!

• The Middle Kingdom: Railway Empire 2 – Steel Dragons lets you explore and expand your railway network upon China while you enjoy the sights and sounds of the varied lands of the Middle Kingdom, including the Temple of Heaven.

• Smoke & Steel – Dragons unleashed:  Utilize 8 new authentic Chinese locomotives such as the “Rocket of China” and the Shèngli 8.

• Shanghai, Peking and Lanzhou: The DLC introduces 3 comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios, “Humble Beginnings” (1880), "Journey to the West” (1890) and "Of Bicycles and Fireworks” (1900).

• Forge ahead: The vast and varied landscapes of the Middle Kingdom await you on the regional "China" maps – playable on  5 individual map sections.

• Treasures of the Dragon: Transport more than 20 new regional products from traditional Medicine and mind-blowing Fireworks, to Bamboo, Gunpowder, and exquisite Silk Products.

• Pipa, Guzheng, and Suona: Over 15 themed music tracks and jingles inspired by traditional Chinese music to get you in the mood for the new setting.

70050000065632.name: Cyber Car Seller Simulator: Credits of Power
70050000065632.intro: The ultimate cash boost for cyber car moguls.
70050000065632.description:
Fuel your dealership ambitions with an instant boost! Add 500,000 in-game coins to your account and accelerate your rise in the neon-lit world of cyber car commerce.

Use your newfound funds to upgrade vehicles faster, expand your showroom, and invest in high-tech modifications that give you the edge over competitors.

Step into the future of automotive trade and dominate the cyber car market like a true mogul.

70050000065654.name: Cast n Chill - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000065654.description: Cast n Chill – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features Local & Online multiplayer via Gameshare, along with super smooth performance at 120 frames per second in Handheld & TV Mode.

70050000065658.name: VOCALOID™ Music+Character Pack
70050000065658.intro: A pack featuring 6 popular VOCALOID™ songs including "Monitoring" and "Tetris", along with a "Hatsune Miku" navigator and avatar is now available!
70050000065658.description:
As additional downloadable content for "GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS", a pack featuring 6 popular VOCALOID™ songs and characters such as Hatsune Miku is now available!

This pack includes the following content.

The navigator “Hatsune Miku (GCFP)” features an original design created for this game, and includes both animations and voice lines!
Navigator and avatars can be unlocked through the "Vocaloid Song + Character Pack Mission" added to Story Mode!

70050000065664.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000065664.intro: Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer NYC locales. Now on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70050000065664.description:
Unleash Turtle Power!
Grab your friends, pick your favorite Turtle and jump into an adventure to save Master Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious online and local co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

Bodacious Co-Op Gameplay
Brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

Build Your Power
Master the powers of water and fire, utrom and ooze, light and darkness, and -most importantly- Ninja to create unique and bodacious builds for your Turtles. Every run brings new challenges and opportunities - explore and perfect your favorite builds, and combine them with allies to conquer your enemies.

A Thrilling Story
When Splinter is kidnapped by Shredder, mysterious portals appear across NYC and the Turtles will battle to recover their father from the clutches of the Foot Clan. However, an even greater threat lingers in the shadows…

Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

Optimized for Nintendo Switch 2!

70050000065752.intro: Change up your style and enjoy the Casino Party even more! Customize your character with a variety of unique set skins!
70050000065752.description:

70050000065975.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered – Deluxe Edition Upgrade
70050000065975.description:
The Deluxe Edition delves even deeper into the lore of Legacy of Kain.
Includes:

-        Dark Prophecy Demo: A playable demo of the canceled sequel to Defiance: Dark Prophecy, offering insight into an unreleased chapter of the franchise.

-        Digital Comic Reader: Contains original Legacy of Kain tie-in comics, including one in English for the first time! Features a brand-new cover for the Defiance comic by original artist Tyler Kirkham.

70050000065996.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered – Shifter Skin Pack
70050000065996.description:
Echoes from a world that never was, these skins draw inspiration from Project Shifter, a Crystal Dynamics game concept that was developed into Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver.
Includes:
-        Shifter Reborn – Skin for Raziel
-        Forsaken Master – Skin for Kain

70050000066047.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Alopex Character DLC
70050000066047.intro: Alopex wields her kama with deadly accuracy and speed while grappling with her troubled past.
70050000066047.description:
NINJA FOR LIFE
She's ready for action...and to get back at Shredder.
Meet Alopex, a mutant arctic fox and ninja assassin who went from being unwaveringly loyal to Shredder to a true friend of the Turtles. Expertly swinging her sickle-like kama, she slices at her foes with ease. Hurling her kunai at close range, she deals a powerful blast of damage. And the best part-- she can briefly become invulnerable while targeting multiple enemies in rapid succession. Ninja powers that modify shuriken also affect her kunai, so try her out with the Ninja, Flame, and Water Powers for maximum impact.

NEW STORY
Indebted to the Turtles, Alopex joins their fight to rescue Splinter. But things get complicated for her along the way as she faces off against her former sister-in-arms, Karai. Shredder previously held sway over Alopex, but when she escaped his grasp Karai stayed behind, leaving them on opposite sides when they used to be partners. In this story, she wrestles with self-doubt as her past catches up with her, and she needs to find the strength to overcome it.

NEW WAYS TO PLAY

- Polar Bear Netsuke - Every 10 seconds, Final Strike will throw out a line of flames. Cooldown is halved under half health.
- Buddy the Wraith - Summon an allied Utrom Astral Wraith. On room completion, it levels up. On death, it levels down. Tier increases on chapter completion.

16 FUN PUZZLES

16 COLORING PAGES

A SAFE AND EDUCATIONAL GAME

70050000066272.name: Little Rocket Lab - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000066272.description:
You play as Morgan, an aspiring engineer headed home to complete your family's dream project - a rocket ship! Finding home not quite how she left it, Morgan will need to research and build clever contraptions and sprawling factories to help the locals. Hell rises once more in Reign of the Warlock, a transformative DLC for Diablo II: Resurrected. Rediscover the iconic story, gameplay, and challenge that defined the original, now enhanced with additional content and an expanded endgame.

【Enhanced Graphics & Frame Rate】

70050000066471.description:
Expand your underwater adventure with the Plane Wreck DLC, introducing a new map filled with thrilling discoveries.

Explore the remains of a crashed airplane lying on the ocean floor and search for valuable objects both inside and around the wreck. Examine lost supplies, gold bars, weapons, and military equipment resting quietly beneath the waves.

With this DLC, you’ll unlock:

Start your new expedition and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

70050000066473.name: Dive Expedition: Sunken Ship DLC
70050000066473.intro: Dive into the depths and explore the mysteries of a legendary sunken ship
70050000066473.description:

Explore the remains of a historic ship resting silently beneath the waves. Swim across its wooden decks, peek inside the captain’s cabin, and uncover what remains of its fateful voyage. Search for chests of gold, rare relics, and lost equipment hidden throughout the ship and surrounding seabed.

70050000066476.name: Factorio: Space Age
70050000066476.description:
Factorio: Space Age continues the player's journey after launching rockets into space.
Discover new worlds with unique challenges, exploit their novel resources for advanced technological gains, and manage your fleet of interplanetary space platforms.

Space platforms
The backbone of planetary logistics and the first foray into space.
Space platforms are flying factories that act as the means of transportation between planets.
 - Build defenses to shoot down incoming asteroids which threaten to smash your platform.
 - Catch asteroid chunks, crush them and process them into thruster fuel and turret ammunition.
 - Use the Platform hub and Cargo bays to shuttle cargo between planets.

Vulcanus
Blazing volcanic mountains, imposing geological landforms, plains blanketed in ash, and thick yellow sulfuric fog that burns your lungs and etches your eyes.
Extract and refine tough unbreakable Tungsten to craft big mining drills and foundries.
 - Pull lava from the pits to produce an abundance of molten iron and copper.
 - Research advanced metallurgic technologies to build an industrial forge-world.

Fulgora
A lifeless and desolate place.
The thin air is freezing cold but bone dry.
A distant sun twinkles in the dull purple of the sky.
Wispy clouds race by as a gale whips up sand that grates against your armour.
 - Protect yourself from the nightly lightning storms, harness their unrelenting power for your own electricity needs.
 - Reclaim the high-tech scraps and ruins of a long-forgotten civilization and recycle them into usable products.
 - Unlock the advanced electromagnetic and superconducting powers of Holmium.

Gleba
A vibrant multi-coloured swampy landscape shrouded in a light mist.
The air is thick and humid, carrying the muffled cries of unseen animals from far away.
 - Discover exotic plants, cultivate and harvest their fruits with Agriculture towers.
 - Cook, crush, and process your produce before they rot and turn to spoilage.
 - Venture into a new realm of biochemical engineering.

Aquilo
It's day, but stars still twinkle in the dark sky.
You count the planet's sun among the stars, larger and brighter than the others, but still so you can barely feel its warmth at all.
A howling wind chills you to the bone and gently rocks the iceberg you are sitting on.
 - Build heat pipes to keep your machines operational in the freezing cold.
 - Extend your factory by building ice platforms.
 - Unlock the power of cryogenic technologies and fusion power.

Elevated rails
Take your trains to the next level!
Elevated rails bring a whole new dimension of challenge and possibility to your rail networks.
 - Heavy-duty rail ramps and supports to elevate your rails.
 - Cross over any obstacles, build supports on the water to cross oceans.
 - Design advanced multi-level intersections to optimize your train system.

Quality
Make high tiers of quality of all your items, machines and equipment.
 - Every Item, Entity, and Equipment has 5 possible qualities, from Normal to Legendary!
 - Research the new Quality modules, use them to craft higher quality items and intermediates.
 - Each level of quality gives a greater bonus, machines craft faster, equipment is more powerful, turrets have increased range, etc.

New enemies and defenses
Some new planets are inhabited by unique and dangerous creatures you will need to defend against.

Space Age Music
Each new planet is accompanied by a unique soundtrack by Czech composer Petr Wajsar.
 - 1+ hour of music for each of the new Planets + Space.
 - Professionally recorded orchestral performance.

70050000067222.name: Dark Auction Original Soundtrack
70050000067222.intro:
The Auction of Dark Memories Begins Now.
What truths await beyond a bid made with your life?
70050000067222.description:
This is the original soundtrack for Dark Auction!

Featuring a total of 26 tracks.
The soundtrack is led by Yuko Komiyama
and Tsukasa Masuko,
with additional contributions from Yoshitaka Onishi, Takako Yumishima, and Ayumi Sumiki.

Select tracks also feature live performances by a jazz band.
Refined jazz sounds beautifully enhance the unique atmosphere of Dark Auction.

Jazz Band Performances
Piano: Hiroaki Idaka
Acoustic Bass: Shigeki Serizawa
Drums: Kenta Okamoto
Tenor Sax: Mitsuharu Ouchi
Trumpet: Atsushi Ozawa
Violin: Daisei Mii

70050000067223.name: Christmas
70050000067223.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70050000067223.description:
It’s tiiiiiiime! 
Deck the halls with festive cheer. This cozy pack features a customizable Christmas tree, twinkling lights, stockings to hang by the fireplace, festive wreaths, and elegant holiday dinner settings.

70050000067227.name: The Weaver
70050000067227.intro: One of many skittering siblings, she has woven her own path and returned with friends in tow.
70050000067227.description:
This sinister heroine weaves together the threads of battle with a style unlike any other. The Weaver commands a host of (mostly) adorable Pets, creatures bound in silk and shadow, who lend their aid to her cause.
As with other characters, the Weaver introduces her own pool of new cards (90+) and artifacts (50+), including a brand new card type!

70050000067228.name: Portraits Pack 1
70050000067228.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70050000067228.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will give you the thrill of meeting intriguing strangers on a tropical vacation.

70050000067241.name: BMX CITY RUN: Cash Surge
70050000067241.intro: Power up your cash flow - fuel your BMX fortune.
70050000067241.description:
Kickstart your extreme cycling adventure with a generous boost! This DLC grants you 10,000 cash to spend freely in the game. Unlock new bike models, upgrade your gear, or customize your character to your heart’s content.

Whether you’re aiming for daring stunts or exploring every hidden corner, this cash injection gives you the freedom to accelerate your journey and stand out on every ride.

70050000067242.name: VTuber Music Pack
70050000067242.intro: A pack featuring 6 popular VTuber songs is now available!
70050000067242.description:
A new pack that adds 6 popular VTuber songs is now available as additional downloadable content for "GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS"!

This pack includes the following content.

■ Songs (6 tracks)
- Carnivorous Plant / RIM
- Ahoy!! We are Houshou Pirates / Houshou Marine
- CapSule / Mori Calliope x Hoshimachi Suisei
- Born to be "BAU"DOL☆★ / FUWAMOCO
- SHUKUSEI!! RORI GAMI REKUIEMU☆ / Shigure Ui
- Kiss Kitsune / HIMEHINA

All songs can be enjoyed immediately in "Performance" mode once the DLC is installed, and some tracks will also be added as challenge songs to certain stages in "Story" mode.

70050000067248.name: Ogu and the Secret Forest - Winter Festival Blast
70050000067248.intro: Embark on an adventure to Winter Festival Island with Baby Ogu! Find the missing village chief and uncover the secrets hidden on the island. Includes a 1v1 local tennis battle game.
70050000067248.description:
Embark on an adventure to Winter Festival Island with Baby Ogu!
Find the missing village chief and uncover the secrets hidden on the island.

<New Areas>
Trouble has broken out on Winter Festival Island, where a festival is held every month to celebrate the winter season.
 What secrets lie hidden on Winter Festival Island, where the village chief has vanished and a yeti has been unleashed?
This DLC adds 45 new maps, including dungeons, for you to explore.
<To Winter Festival Island!>
Take a hot air balloon from Snowflake Village and head to Winter Festival Island!
Many residents on Winter Festival Island, where the village chief has disappeared, are in need of Baby Ogu’s help.
From familiar headbutt puzzles to mine carts, inverted towers, and the trials of the divine beasts — a wide variety of content awaits those who enjoyed the main story.

<Local Multiplayer: 1v1 Tennis>
Become one of the bug villagers and enjoy a tennis match with your friend!
 Choose your own underwear color and compete in a prideful one-on-one battle.

70050000067251.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Anime Pack Vol. 6
70050000067251.description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

- Song: KUSUSHIKI
Easy ★2, Normal ★2, Hard ★5, Extreme ★8
- Song: AI♡SCREAM!
Easy ★2, Normal ★3, Hard ★4, Extreme ★6
- Song: Same Blue
Easy ★2, Normal ★4, Hard ★5, Extreme ★7

*This product is not compatible with Taiko no Tatsujin: Drum'n'Fun!
*The songs included in this product may be available in the Taiko Music Pass. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.

70050000067253.name: Overrogue: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000067253.intro: A card deck-building roguelite! Explore labyrinths each time from level 1!
70050000067253.description:
In the underworld, where creatures of all shapes and sizes live, a Selection Battle is announced to decide the next Overlord. Complete labyrinths and collect crystals to achieve the title of Overlord!

Proceed through dungeon-like labyrinths building up your card deck in a roguelite style! There are up to 5 different labyrinth themes based on card genres like poison or graveyards. Enjoy a different deck experience each time you visit the labyrinth as the number of cards increases. Over 300 types of cards and 150 types of treasure await you, so combos and combinations are up to you.

Let's conquer the labyrinths and become the next Overlord!

Features:
- Card-deck turn-based battles
- Labyrinth exploration in a roguelite style
- Up to 5 unique labyrinth themes
- Over 300 types of cards
- Over 150 types of treasure
- And more elements you'd expect from a JRPG and roguelike game!

70050000067263.name: Farm Together 2 - Gothic Pack
70050000067263.intro: Become a creature of the night and sink your teeth into this customization pack for Farm Together 2!
70050000067263.description:
Gothic Pack offers the following content:
Avatar Customization:
* Gothic Clothing (4 colours)
* Gothic Face
* Winged Gothic hairdo (2 variants, 2 colours)
* Gothic hairdo (2 variants)
* Gothic earrings (4 colours)
* Gothic backpack (4 colours)
House:
* Gothic Manor
Tractor Customization:
* Gothic Antenna (4 colours)
Pet Customization:
* Gothic Nametag (4 colours)
Farm Items:
* Flower: Flytrap (4 variants)
* Crop: Chard (4 variants)
* Gothic Guestbook (4 colours)
* Gothic Travel Portal (3 colours)
Farm Decorations:
* Gothic Flasks Separator
* Catgoyle
* Gothic Fire pit
* Gothic Fence
House Decorations:
* Gothic Stool
* Gothic Chair
* Gothic Table
* Gothic Sofa
* Gothic Bed
* Gothic Wall Lamp
* Gothic Ceiling Lamp
* Gothic Floor Lamp
* Gothic Shelves
* Flasks
* Wall decoration

70050000067279.name: Isekai Rondo: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000067279.intro: Quest for a parallel universe after being reborn with the ultimate job!
70050000067279.description:
Sho, a young man who spends his days in an exploitative company in modern Japan, is reincarnated into a parallel universe as Shaw, due to an accident!

While the job given in his new life is 'Unemployed' and hardships continue with a bad luck party, one day he acquires the ultimate job as a Sage, suddenly becoming the strongest with ultra rare passive skills!

Aiming for the long-awaited mellow life he finds himself in a battle to defeat the Overlord after meeting the Hero Viola.

With exceptional passive skills that for example can change the future by returning before Game Over, get rid of enemies in turn-based battles by summoning spirits or managing mana plants, or even use the skills of monsters!

Complete quests and raise the guild rank so you can challenge deeper dungeon or other adventuring parties, too! With other elements such as a battle arena and the dungeon where treasure chests are automatically generated, your adventure against the Overlord's Army will surely be an unparalleled quest to finally gain a calm, modest life!

70050000067284.name: Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Survival Boost
70050000067284.intro: Survive longer and unleash unstoppable power.
70050000067284.description:
Give your dragon a powerful edge with this exclusive DLC! Once activated, your dragon gains +100 additional health, allowing you to survive tougher battles and dominate even the fiercest monsters.

Become stronger, last longer, and push deeper into every realm with enhanced durability.

70050000067288.name: PRITTO PRISONER - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000067288.description: This is a pass to upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ software “PRITTO PRISONER” to “PRITTO PRISONER – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.”

70050000067294.name: Formula Legends : Late 2020’s Season Pack
70050000067294.intro: Race with 8 new teams, 16 drivers, and next-generation season rules — the latest era of Formula Legends starts now.
70050000067294.description:
The Late 2020’s Season Pack brings present-day racing to Formula Legends. This new DLC brings 8 new teams, each with 2 drivers and custom helmets, along with 2 new liveries per team, a new championship, updated next-generation season rules, and a brand-new track — all fully integrated into Story Mode.

Compete in a new championship featuring modernized racing rules that reflect the latest innovations and standards in professional motorsport. Every decision matters, as strategy, skill, and precision define the outcome. Race on the Azerbaijan track, a contemporary circuit that challenges timing, overtaking, and tactical thinking.

With this DLC, the Late 2020’s Season Pack delivers a complete, authentic and engaging present-day racing experience — perfect for fans of modern motorsport and Story Mode enthusiasts alike.

This DLC includes:
8 new teams
16 new drivers with unique helmets
16 new liveries (2 per team)
1 new Story Mode championship
Updated next-generation season rules
1 new track: Azerbaijan

Experience the thrill of present-day Formula Legends — where every team, every driver and every race counts.

70050000067295.name: Formula Legends : Formula E - Electric Evolution
70050000067295.intro: Race the official Formula E championship across real-world city circuits, mastering energy, strategy, and cutting-edge electric performance.
70050000067295.description:
The future of racing is electric.
Expand your Formula Legends experience with Formula E: Electric Evolution, the official all-electric championship. Get behind the wheel of cutting-edge Formula E cars and compete on iconic city circuits around the world.
From Berlin to Tokyo, London to São Paulo, Miami to Shanghai, every race demands precision, strategy, and total control. Master the unique challenges of electric racing, where energy management, timing, and racecraft define victory.

Key Features
Official Formula E experience: Compete in the world’s premier all-electric racing series
6 real-world circuits: Berlin, Tokyo, London, São Paulo, Miami, Shanghai
3 generations of cars: Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 3 EVO
Authentic Attack Mode: Activate boosted performance through strategic off-line zones, just like real races
Double Header race weekends: Take on two consecutive races on the same circuit, each with its own qualifying session
Manual team selection: Choose which teams compete alongside you on the grid
Fully integrated: Career, Quick Race, and Time Trials

Precision. Strategy. Energy.
This is the evolution of racing.

70050000067309.name: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000067309.description: If you purchase SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION for Nintendo Switch™, you only need to purchase the upgrade pack to play the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

70050000067314.name: Sheol
70050000067314.description:
This is a large-scale DLC, with content far exceeding the base game and offering nearly 80 hours of gameplay. This DLC brings you the Dustlands like you've never experienced them before. With a new underground realm, exciting ruin exploration gameplay, and gripping storylines, you'll be immersed in the dangerous and opportunity-filled world of Dustland Delivery. Fix up your truck, call up your crew, and get ready for a brand new adventure!
 
※New Underground World: Sheol
 
Enter subway stations to travel between the darkness of the underground and the all-pervading danger of the surface. Explore and survive in two different worlds where your every decision could determine the future of the Dustlands.
 
• Volcanos and Glaciers: New terrain types bring whole new experiences. Change your strategy to fit the terrain, carefully shepherding resources to survive in the Dustlands.
 • Underground Cities and Factions: The cities of the underground are denser than the surface, each one with its own unique cultures and factions who could be potential allies—or potential enemies. Your choices will determine the balance of power in world of the underground.
 
※Ruins Exploration: No Risk, No Reward
 
Mysterious ruins lie scattered across the underground, symbols of the glories of the old world fraught with danger—and opportunity.
 
• Explore Ruins: Pull your crew out of your truck and send them to explore ruins filled with deadly traps, powerful enemies, and priceless loot. They'll need all their cunning to survive.
 • Incredible Rewards: Ruins are filled with rare equipment, road-building survey data, and other priceless resources. Every successful exploration will grant you huge rewards, helping you to stay alive in the underground.
 
※New Storyline: The Dustlands' Final Chapter
 
Deep in the underground lurks a secret that could shake the Dustlands to their foundations. The decision is yours: will you bring the truth to light?
 
• Experience a vast main storyline, with over 20 brand new side stories.
• Uncover mysteries, choose your own path, and witness the end of the Dustlands as we know it.

70050000067342.name: Beyond the Waste
70050000067342.intro: New worlds, new challenges, four times the content!
70050000067342.description:
Venture beyond the trash pile in the first major expansion for Royal Vermin!

This downloadable content adds over 50 new levels and 4 brand new game modes. Discover new playable characters and face off against your friends in even crazier and more varied arenas.

Unlock more hats and outfits to customize your vermin. Some say the rat goes faster with a banana on his head.

Beyond the Waste is for players who want even more chaos, variety and fun with friends. All content is permanent, accessible offline and unlocked immediately after purchase.

If you loved the fast and unpredictable battles of Royal Vermin, this expansion multiplies the fun by four. More levels, more game modes, more laughs, more everything. Just pure local multiplayer fun.

70050000067403.name: Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Chapter 2
70050000067403.description:
The battles fought. The pain endured. All of it leads back to him. The Upside Down has returned to The Fog, darkening the Realms with Vecna’s chilling presence. Only by banding together does hope stand the slightest chance.

Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Chapter 2 includes a new Killer, Vecna, The First, and new Survivors, Dustin Henderson and Eleven. Purchasing this Add-On unlocks the Mind Flayer Badge and the Bloody Rainbow Room Banner.

70050000067505.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #1
70050000067505.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067505.description: Rev up your racing experience with the Expansion Pack #1 DLC! This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70050000067506.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #2
70050000067506.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067506.description: Take your racing game to the next level with the Expansion Pack #2 DLC! This pack delivers three exclusive liveries, each designed to make your car a true showstopper on the circuit.

70050000067507.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #3
70050000067507.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067507.description: Unleash your inner champion with the Expansion Pack #3 DLC! This pack features three bold and eye-catching liveries, giving your race car a fresh, competitive edge.

70050000067508.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Expansion Pack #4
70050000067508.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70050000067508.description: Cross the finish line in style with the Expansion Pack #4 DLC! This pack includes three exclusive liveries, each crafted to bring a unique flair to your racing experience.

70050000067517.name: Little Cozy Home: Creative Desk
70050000067517.description: Expand your creative space with the new DLC. The set includes an elegant desk, a comfortable chair, and other accessories that let you create your dream office. Work in style!

70050000067518.name: Little Cozy Home: Cozy Living
70050000067518.description: Discover brand-new decorating possibilities with the new DLC. The pack includes stylish sofas, chairs, and accessories that will give your living room a unique atmosphere. Create a space you’ll always want to come back to.

70050000067522.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000067522.description: By purchasing this content, you can upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of "BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE" to "BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition."

70050000067547.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered - Ascendance Skin Pack
70050000067547.description:
Reflections from the past, these retro inspired skins present Kain and Raziel as they appear in Legacy of Kain: Ascendance. 
Includes:
-        Sarafan Ascendant – Skin for Raziel
-        Imperial Ascendant – Skin for Kain

70050000067605.name: World Tour Traffic Pack(2)
70050000067605.intro: Happily Dash with Character-Specific Cars and Bikes! Explore the World Map, Accelerate from 5 Turns to 10!
70050000067605.description:
Through the World Tour Traffic Pack(2), players in the 'Richman 4 Fun' game can upgrade their character's transportation style to an exclusive design and extend the usage time from the original 5 turns to 10 turns every time they use a car or bike card!

The bundle includes exclusive car and bike transportation designs (characters not included) for the following 10 game characters:

Exclusive car and bike for Zhao Ling Er
Exclusive car and bike for Lin Yue Ru
Exclusive car and bike for Lien Lien
Exclusive car and bike for A Nu
Exclusive car and bike for Odd Bioguy
Exclusive car and bike for Igloo
Exclusive car and bike for Wednesday
Exclusive car and bike for Gangnam Boy
Exclusive car and bike for Feng Tien-Ling
Exclusive car and bike for Xiao Man

Note: To use the World Tour Traffic Pack DLC, you must own the 'Richman 4 Fun' full game and the corresponding transportation character."

70050000067620.name: The Wandering Village: Onbu Skin Pack
70050000067620.intro: Embark on an adventure with five exciting new looks for your Onbu.
70050000067620.description:
Embark on an adventure with five exciting new looks for your Onbu.
The Onbu Skin Pack contains the following new skins:
- Azurda, the Cold Fire
- Aloba, Desert Sovereign
- Kizu, the Golden
- Makthaja of the Jungle
- Ourodon, the Amphibian
Skins only affect visual appearance and have no impact on gameplay.

70050000067625.name: Deserters & Disciples
70050000067625.intro: Explore new realms and dimensions, and five new races to add even more variety to your next dungeon dive!
70050000067625.description:
The Deserters & Disciples DLC is here to further add to the myriad ways you can approach Barony's deadly dungeons! This time we're bringing FIVE new races and classes, each introducing rich, fun, and unique mechanics to Barony for the first time.

Like before, monster races have a preferred class that can also be used by humans. Your new races can either use their signature class, or play as any of the stock classes from Barony! When you finish the game as a monster race, you'll unlock its signature class for any race to play. As always, you can wear monster skins as a costume without any gameplay changes if you prefer. Don't worry, you can still play with anyone who doesn't own the DLC.

Gremlins are short, wily, and mischievous. The only race in this DLC who Shopkeepers refuse to trade with! They get an extra boost from vandalizing the dungeon.

The Sapper starts with the Frypan, showing off the new Cooking feature. With a powerful flail, flammable greaseballs, and the Booby Trap spell, Sappers have a penchant for destruction.

The Dryad grows magical foliage to plant shrubs, healing friendlies and producing nutritious nuts to eat. Their natural magic provides defensive thorns and roots in battle!

The Scion shows off the three new schools of magic with equal skill. Summoning the durable Earth Sprite as a guardian, the Scion also wields the powerful Archon Scepter, rechargeable by sacrificing spells.

The Myconid grows a defensive cap that can be used to plant mushroom traps, doubling as a fungal food source! The mushrooms' toxic spores help weaken enemies for a decisive takedown (or escape)!

The Hermit uses debilitating spells on foes to empower their homemade shillelagh, taking down foes with a mystical bonk! Their beloved duck pet is always nearby, distracting enemies and even diving for fish!

The Gnome has a nose for gold, and improved magical potential, but won't get as far with brute-force melee attacks! Their ability to fashion jewels may help them make friends.

The Bard plays magical music to enhance their party with instruments that each provide a different inspirational buff. Their deadly rapier allows them to parry and riposte with expert finesse!

The Salamander's heart blazes with magical fire, getting hotter as they rampage! When cold, they are stony and tough. A hot salamander burns bright with glorious radiance. Watch out for flaming breath!

The Paladin can add holy light to their claymore's powerful strikes, perfect for banishing undead and demonic foes. Their Holy Symbol can be used to protect themselves and allies before a fight.

70050000067825.name: Two Strikes - Musashi Miyamoto
70050000067825.description:
Musashi Miyamoto, History's Strongest Swordsman, joins the brutal world of Two Strikes. Resurrected into the modern era to seek the ultimate challenge, Musashi brings his lethal mastery and an aura of death to the battlefield. With his legendary Niten Ichi-ryū two-sword style, the terrifying pressure of his "imaginary blades," and a ruthlessness that knows no bounds, Musashi cuts through the opposition with terrifying ease.

This DLC pack includes playable character Musashi Miyamoto, from the hit anime Baki-Dou, featuring a completely new set of moves and animations. Also included: a brand-new stage, The Tokugawa Scientific Research Facility, and an exclusive original music track.

Musashi is fully playable across all online and offline game modes.

70050000067833.name: Monster Roadtrip - Jacqueline and Doug (Playable Character Pack)
70050000067833.intro: HIT THE ROAD WITH TWO NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTERS!
70050000067833.description:
Doug is a former slime cube who's adopted a friendlier shape. He's got a soft side, a heart of gold, and is ready to have an unforgettable experience.

Jacqueline is an earthly pumpkin whose folksy farmer vibes will allow you to enjoy nature at its fullest.

You may have met them before, but now you can actually BE them as they hit the road with Polly and Scott!

Jacq and Doug are ready to become the unlikely heroes of the road. Join them as they take the wheel and lead you on a road trip like you've never experienced before!

70050000067834.name: Monster Train 2: Destiny of the Railforged
70050000067834.intro: Lead the new Railforged clan in your battle against the Titans!
70050000067834.description:
This exciting new expansion for Monster Train 2 adds a new clan, new artifacts and enemies, and a brand new game mode! 

The Railforged Clan
Once, they built the rail and the train itself, now they have taken up their hammers to join the fight! Lead the clan as Herzal, the blacksmith that built the Rail and the Boneshaker. Or lead as Heph, the blacksmith behind the Skullcrusher and the Covenant Outpost!

With their extensive engineering knowledge, utilize their unique Forge mechanic to build up units and equipment. Deploy an army of newly built train stewards, turrets, machines, and assemble equipment and units during combat to add to your army and fend off the enemy!

Soul Savior
Introducing a new type of run! Free powerful Souls from the clutches of the Lifemother and her twisted children who have been trapped within the Soulstream for untold ages. Souls are upgrades that can be equipped to cards and have a huge array of effects. The Lifemother is an unstoppable force of nature so you will need to level up your Souls to gain enough power to take on the challenges found in the Soulstream.

70050000067858.name: Holo's Hanafuda DLC: Usada Pekora & Houshou Marine Set
70050000067858.intro:
A thrilling new story where the PekoMari duo set sail on a wild adventure to acquire an unusual treasure!
New skills in the form of Peko RUSH and Holo Set Sail!!
70050000067858.description:
■New Content

70050000067863.name: Cat's Stories
70050000067863.intro: Discover the stories of the feline heroes of our game!
70050000067863.description: Each cat has its own story and personality. Our heroes would like to show you their strengths! Get to know them and enjoy the game even more.

70050000067866.name: Pinball FX - Bethesda® Pinball
70050000067866.description:
This purchase also entitles you to the Pinball M version of the DLC.

Stay alive in the stunning yet hostile environments in three fantastic pinball tables inspired by the most iconic Bethesda franchises.

- Explore the secrets of the Wasteland in a world decimated by nuclear war, join Factions, raid Vaults and collect Bobbleheads on the Fallout™ Pinball table.
- Fight your way through the UAC research facility, taking on hordes of demons to earn the DOOM Slayer name on the DOOM™ Pinball table
- Craft weapons, wield magic, equip armor, buy and sell goods, mine materials, find trainers and complete side quests before defeating Alduin and fulfilling your destiny as the Dragonborn on The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim™ Pinball table.
- Leaderboards, score tracking, exciting social features, and more

70050000067867.name: Pinball M - Bethesda® Pinball
70050000067867.description:
This purchase also entitles you to the Pinball FX version of the DLC.

Stay alive in the stunning yet hostile environments in three fantastic pinball tables inspired by the most iconic Bethesda franchises.

- Explore the secrets of the Wasteland in a world decimated by nuclear war, join Factions, raid Vaults and collect Bobbleheads on the Fallout™ Pinball table.
- Fight your way through the UAC research facility, taking on hordes of demons to earn the DOOM Slayer name on the DOOM™ Pinball table
- Craft weapons, wield magic, equip armor, buy and sell goods, mine materials, find trainers and complete side quests before defeating Alduin and fulfilling your destiny as the Dragonborn on The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim™ Pinball table.
- Leaderboards, score tracking, exciting social features, and more

70050000067871.name: Ruins Explorer Map Package
70050000067871.intro: Explore ancient Sky Ruins, challenge the scorching lava abyss, and become the rich man.
70050000067871.description:
Includes the following content:

・Sky Ruins Map
・Lava Abyss Map
・Flamy Card
・Li Xiao Yao's  pirates Clothes

*To use the Ruins Explorer Map Package DLC, you must own the "Richman 4 Fun" (sold separately).

70050000067947.name: Nitrous Fury: Sunrise Burnout
70050000067947.description:
Engines awaken with the rising sun.
Race on one new track bathed in morning light, with cool asphalt and perfect conditions for a flawless launch.
This is where reaction time and the first meters decide everything.

70050000067948.name: Nitrous Fury: Nightfall Boost
70050000067948.description:
Sunset brings no compromises.
One new track soaked in golden light, aggressive pacing, and maximum risk.
One last chance to prove who owns the strip.

70050000067949.name: Grumpy Driver Vintage Car DLC
70050000067949.description:
Hit the road in style with the Vintage Car DLC!
Unlock a classic ride packed with personality and take on brand-new missions crafted for true retro driving masters.

70050000067950.name: Grumpy Driver Sport Car DLC
70050000067950.description:
Ignite the streets with the Sports Car DLC!
Take control of a high-performance machine and tackle brand-new missions built for speed, precision, and pure adrenaline.

70050000067961.name: DEATH FOREST SEIKIN
70050000067961.intro: A Shocking Collaboration with Video Creator "SEIKIN"!
70050000067961.description:
In the mirror world, fantasies become reality.

Touka Hiiragi, the protagonist of "Death Forest: ANOTHER," is a huge fan of SEIKIN. While investigating the mysteries hidden in "the forest," she takes a break to watch his videos as usual—but an unexpected event transforms her world.

She wanders into a maddening mirror world where SEIKIN and Yoshie have fused together. Can she make it out of this nightmare alive?

[DLC Features]

Yoshie turns into SEIKIN! The giant looming faces all transform into video creator SEIKIN. A swarm of SEIKINs fills the screen, relentlessly hunting you down.

Exclusive Content Features exclusive voice lines recorded by SEIKIN himself and a unique story exclusive to this DLC. Includes multiple collaboration endings different from the main game—a must-see for fans!

■ About SEIKIN SEIKIN is a popular video creator who operates the channels SeikinTV and SeikinGames. He produces a wide variety of content that transcends genres, including singing, fun product reviews, challenge videos, and game commentary.

■ Recommended for:

Fans of first-person horror games.

Those who find horror scary but still want a thrill.

Streamers looking for an exciting game to play.

70050000067964.name: Collector's Cove Supporter Pack
70050000067964.description:
Celebrate your support of Collector's Cove with this exclusive Supporter Pack! 

It includes three unique cosmetic items:
- A crown for your animal companion
- A tiara for your animal companion
- A jester cap for your character

These cosmetics are designed to make your animal companion even more majestic, while you'll be able to bring a touch of humor to the court!

They are only available in this pack, as a special thank-you to players who are helping support Collector's Cove even further.

70050000068019.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Tool Textures
70050000068019.intro: Sharpen your skills and immerse yourself in a richer survival adventure.
70050000068019.description:
Enhance your swamp adventure with this update! In this DLC, the textures for essential tools such as the hammer and axe are updated, giving them a more detailed and realistic appearance when crafted or in your inventory. This visual enhancement adds a fresh layer of immersion to your survival experience, making every action—from chopping wood to building your raft—feel more satisfying.

Take your survival skills to the next level with these improved tools!

70050000068022.name: Platypus Reclayed Expansion Pack
70050000068022.description:
An expansion pack featuring two new missions! 

First up, Spooky Platypus! It’s spooky season in Colossatropolis... With the help of a friendly witch and her trusted broomstick you’ll need your wits about you as bats, ghosts, giant pumpkins and more try and give the local inhabitants nightmares.

Next, the Winter Mission! Winter has its grasp on Mungola and throughout the icy borderlands the battle rages on. 

In these all new levels from Anthony Flack and the Claymatic team you'll travel across shadowdraped hills and iceberg-laden seas, battling new foes and bosses.

70050000068036.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Infection Detection
70050000068036.intro: Scan faster, see clearer, stop infections in their tracks.
70050000068036.description:
Take your border defense to the next level! The temperature scanner now glows with a striking purple-pink hue, making it easier than ever to detect hidden fevers and subtle signs of infection.

Combine your upgraded tools with sharp intuition and strategic thinking to manage the increasing flow of desperate travelers, separating the healthy from the infected with precision.

Step into the checkpoint with enhanced surveillance and prove you can maintain control in a world on the brink of chaos.

70050000068049.name: Spy Guy Poznan
70050000068049.intro: New map, new challenges, new hidden objects!
70050000068049.description: Do you know a city whose symbol is two goats? Discover Poznań! A Polish city full of interesting places and beautiful corners. Search for hidden objects on another colorful map.

70050000068050.name: BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 – Elite Weapon Skin
70050000068050.intro: A new look, same deadly precision—your pistol upgraded.
70050000068050.description:
Take your arsenal to the next level with this DLC. Equip your pistol with a unique new skin that stands out in the heat of battle. Whether patrolling dangerous zones or engaging in high-stakes firefights, this visually striking upgrade gives your weapon a fresh, personalized look.

Combine style with precision — your enhanced pistol isn’t just for show. Make every shot count while showcasing your elite operative status in every mission. Upgrade your loadout, dominate the battlefield, and leave your mark in the world of BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025.

70050000068058.name: Chained Climb Together: New Rope
70050000068058.intro: New rope, new possibilities, new heights.
70050000068058.description:
Elevate your mountain-climbing journey with the new upgrade! This add-on transforms your current “Rope” into a fresh, enhanced version designed to improve both style and control during your ascent.

Whether you’re climbing solo or tackling the heights with a partner, the updated rope brings smoother handling, sharper responsiveness, and a new visual look that stands out as you scale the most dangerous cliffs.

Strengthen your connection, master the climb, and rise higher than ever!

70050000068200.name: Christmas
70050000068200.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000068200.description: Adorable animals need your help with decorating their home for Christmas! Add the magic and warmth of the winter holidays to your designs with 20 brand new items and festive music!

70050000068205.name: Flight Simulator 2025 – Bonus Cash
70050000068205.intro: Get your bonus and jumpstart your airline empire.
70050000068205.description:
Kickstart your aviation empire with an instant $350,000 bonus! This DLC gives you the financial boost needed to expand your fleet, upgrade hangars, or invest in new routes right from the start. Whether you want to buy faster planes, expand your airport facilities, or explore new destinations, this cash injection puts your ambitious plans within reach.

Take advantage of the early financial support and make every flight count as you build your global air transport empire. With extra funds in your account, the sky is truly your business!

70050000068214.name: Criminal Cleaner Simulator – Tactical Tools
70050000068214.intro: Crime scene cleaning just got a makeover.
70050000068214.description:
Give your cleaning gear a fresh new look! This DLC changes the appearance of your mop and trash bucket, letting you tackle crime scenes in style. While your mission remains the same—erase every trace and stay undetected—your tools now match your professional flair.

Upgrade your aesthetic while maintaining peak cleaning efficiency, and make every crime scene cleanup feel uniquely yours.

70050000068219.name: Celestial Haven
70050000068219.intro: New adorable companions join you on your runs
70050000068219.description:
Important: 100% of the revenue from this DLC goes to charity for animals!

We’ve partnered with One Voice, an organization dedicated to rescuing and protecting animals around the world to bring you this very special DLC. By purchasing it, you’ll directly support their mission and also unlock a shelter with many adorable pets in the Garden of Astral Ascent. Taking care of your virtual companions in the game will help take care of real animals.

DLC FEATURES 
- 5 valuable companions you can bring along on your explorations.
- 8 color variations for each pet and 12 particle effects to customize your companion
- They will sniff out and dig up special rewards throughout your run
- They’ll follow you everywhere and celebrate your victories — from defeating a tough Zodiac to perfecting a room

HOW TO UNLOCK
Complete the tutorial, then head to the bottom right area of the hub, below Sova's Platform to select a companion

70050000068337.intro: Explore a land shrouded in snow and secrets in this expansion for The Survivalists.
70050000068337.description:
Frostbite Fortress is a challenging expansion for experienced survivors. Journey to an unforgiving land, harness its unique resources, and prepare to face the evil buried beneath the ice.
 
Key Features:
 
- Survive the bitter cold and treacherous terrain of an expansive new biome.
 
- Explore the deadly labyrinth of Frostbite Fortress on your quest for answers (and loot, of course).
 
- Craft powerful new equipment to survive this new land, and bring it with you around the world.
 
- Brew primordial potions, mixing and matching ingredients for some unique boons.

70050000068346.intro: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor introduces North Western Railway’s Number 5 engine; James the Really Splendid Engine!

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor introduces North Western Railway’s Number 5 engine; James the Really Splendid Engine! Join everyone’s favorite red, mixed-traffic tender engine on four additional adventures around Sodor—more fun and magic await!

• Join James as you experience the Island of Sodor like never before.

• Enjoy 4 additional stories, all narrated by the legendary Mark Moraghan.

• Explore iconic landmarks across Sodor, such as the Tidmouth Sheds, Knapford station, and the famous Windmills.

70050000068427.name: World
70050000068427.intro: Find calm in relaxing world-themed coloring
70050000068427.description:
Expand your Coloree collection with a relaxing trip around the globe. World adds 15 new color-by-number illustrations inspired by iconic places – from sunlit European streets in Lisbon to penguins on the shores of South Africa.
Each picture is designed for a calm, focused moment: no timers, no scores, no pressure. Just choose a scene, follow the numbers, and watch detailed line art slowly fill with color as the stress of the day fades into the background. Difficulty varies from simple, soothing pieces to more intricate works for when you feel like sinking in a little deeper.
What’s inside:
- 15 new world-themed artworks to color at your own pace
- A mix of simpler and more complex scenes for different moods
- Relaxing, number-guided coloring made for adult players
- Gentle, pressure-free play – perfect for short breaks or quiet evenings
Take a small holiday in your mind, one tap of color at a time.

70050000068737.name: Braid, Anniversary Edition – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000068737.description:
Control the flow of time to solve subtle platform puzzles in this update of the indie classic "Braid," featuring refreshed artwork and seriously in-depth creator commentary.  Travel from a city house through a series of interconnected worlds where time behaves strangely, searching for an elusive Princess. Along the way you'll explore memories and regrets that still haunt you. This Anniversary Edition remaster of the award-winning platformer contains fully repainted high-resolution graphics, new sound effects and extensive audio commentary.

MANIPULATE TIME TO MOVE FORWARD
Rewind, pause and use the strange properties of time in each world to run and jump through beautifully painted environments. Avoid hazards, unlock doors and collect jigsaw puzzle pieces to assemble. If you get hung up on a particular puzzle, feel free to move on and return later.

A FRESH COAT OF PAINT
This is the game you remember, with all the original challenges and the same haunting, evocative score — but repainted pixel by pixel so that each carefully rendered world comes to life in high resolution. New visual details, animated brushstroke effects and revamped sounds add to the immersive experience.

GO (DEEP) BEHIND THE SCENES
Explore the most extensive developer commentary ever put into a game, with over 12 hours of recorded insight and conversation from developer Jonathan Blow, artist David Hellman and more members of the "Braid" creative team. Navigate it by visiting a new in-game world, which also contains new puzzles and redesigns of classic puzzles.  - Created by Thekla, Inc.

70050000068762.name: Sail Forth – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000068762.intro: Sail across the Deepblue in a quirky nautical adventure!
70050000068762.description:
Explore the Deepblue!
• Put the wind to your back and cast out into High Adventure over a vast ocean spanning dozens of eccentric regions. 
• Discover countless isles bursting with their own flora, fauna, friendly folk, and fearsome foes. 
• Playfully pursue a pod of curious dolphins, admire the beauty of the sun sinking into an icy horizon, or run down a clutch of cowardly criminals only to accept their apologies to the tune of wild cannonry.

Command a Sailing Fleet!
• Build and manage a custom cadre of specialized vessels to match any personality and play style.
• Buy, equip, upgrade, and modify your ships’ armaments to face off against the toughest privateers this side of the Eclipside.
• Crack open giant clams and loot lonely shipwrecks to fill your fleet’s treasure hoard and keep your crew in shipshape.

Fathom a Mystery!
• Join forces with the myriad inhabitants of this watery world to uncover a terrible secret buried in the depths of the Deepblue.
• Reel in a big one with the salty Anglerwranglers, learn the secret spyspeak of the Croaker Command Corps, save the sea life of the Moontiders, capture picturesque memories with a mysterious “camera” device, and much more.
• Inspire the finefolk from all over to work as one world-spanning crew to save the seas and the planet.

Sail Forth into Adventure!
• Tack and jibe and heave and cut with a sail and wind system designed with enough attention to realistic sailing physics to excite naval enthusiasts while also remaining deeply accessible to anyone and everyone.
• Sail through stormy swells and serene sunsets in a dynamic and breathtaking day-night weather system.
• Bask in the beauty of the benevolent ocean waters in Free Sail mode where the only goal is the ever-moving horizon.

The Deepblue calls with the bellow of High Adventure! Sail Forth!

70050000068885.intro: Turn the page and shape destiny in a card deck-building roguelite JRPG!

From reclaiming a fallen kingdom to unraveling the mysteries of the underworld, your choices shape the destinies of captivating characters and their intertwining tales.

70050000069034.name: Ravenswatch - Merlin
70050000069034.intro: The greatest wizard in Avalon awakens from his prison of slumber, stripped of his clairvoyance but not his power.
70050000069034.description:
Merlin, the famous wizard from Arthurian legend, joins the ranks of Ravenswatch. Trapped for centuries in a prison of slumber woven by the Lady of the Lake, his former love, the sorcerer finally awakens, stripped of his gift of clairvoyance, but not of his power. Lost and haunted by his past, Merlin joins forces with heroes of Ravenswatch to uncover the truth… and destroy the Nightmare.

This new playable hero is distinguished by his exceptional mastery of magic. Merlin is not limited to just three skills: he can choose from nine spells, divided into three categories that reflect the full extent of his abilities.
* Nature spells: summon colossal brambles, make it rain stars, or raise a stone shield that explodes on your enemies.
* Arcane magic: cast lightning bolts through monsters, throw a fireball or unleash a frost orb that pursues your targets.
* Sacred light: heal your wounds and those of your allies, blind your enemies and tear down their defences, or escape danger by teleporting away.

As he fights, Merlin generates Power Runes, a unique resource that amplifies his spells and enables him to create devastating combinations. Due to his variety of spells, his four ultimate abilities and his numerous talents, the gameplay has unprecedented depth.

The DLC also includes four skins which can be unlocked in-game, as well as three exclusive premium skins: a Ravenswatch outfit, a Nightmare outfit and a Royal Counselor outfit.

70050000069097.intro: Upgrade your underwater adventures for the Nintendo Switch™ 2!

You can experience improved performance with 1440p resolution with up to 60 fps when your Nintendo Switch™ 2 is connected to a compatible TV via your Nintendo Switch™ 2 Dock, or 1080p resolution with up to 60 fps when playing handheld. You can also play Subnautica with newly added Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls, making your ability to navigate the world of 4546B faster and easier!

You must already own Subnautica on Nintendo Switch™ to purchase the free Nintendo Switch™ 2 edition upgrade pack and enjoy the added enhancements.

70050000069219.description: Sit back, get cozy, and feel the magic of fixing beautiful, enchanted pots. DLC includes 14 new, winter-themed ceramics, each one with a cute feline you can admire by putting all the pieces together.

70050000069229.name: Super Mario Bros.™ Wonder – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park Upgrade Pack
70050000069229.intro: Upgrade the wonder of Mario fun with more content and improvements for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system
70050000069229.description:
Choose from an even larger cast of characters in this Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack*, which now adds Rosalina and Co-Star Luma to the existing cast. You can also enable Assist Mode to make any character immune to damage, not just Yoshis and Nabbit! Assist Mode also provides some protection from falls, giving you a Propeller Flower the first time you slip into a pit, lava, or poison swamp. 

Take on all seven of the Koopalings in newly added boss courses scattered throughout the Flower Kingdom. If you want an extra challenge, visit the Toad Brigade Training Camp and unlock Fierce Fights against buffed-up mighty versions of the Koopalings. Grab the Flower Pot power-up to throw flowers at your enemies and flower jump to flutter up and slowly glide down. You can also unlock Dual Badges that grant the effects of two Badges at once!

Meet up with friends for attractions and entertainment in Bellabel Park

Captain Toad has discovered some mysterious ruins in the Flower Kingdom! Explore this area with your friends in local**, online***, or local wireless** multiplayer in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Visit the attractions to cooperate or compete in over 100 courses that use a variety of game mechanics like Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls. As you play these attractions, you will unlock greetings to interact with your friends, flowers to decorate Bellabel Park, Dual Badges, and more. 

Share the wonder with more friends—even via GameShare

Team up, or race to the finish, with up to 11 friends online*** or up to seven via newly added local wireless**. You can also play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game with friends who don’t have it, in person or online, via GameShare****.

Tap amiibo accessories for in-game extras

In the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, you can now get power-ups in certain courses by tapping amiibo™ accessories*****, including three new ones: Elephant Mario, Poplin & Prince Florian, and Captain Toad & Talking Flower! The game is compatible with any amiibo accessories.

70050000069244.description: Create the perfect paradise for your furry companions. This collection offers a variety of cozy pet beds, stylish cat trees, scratching posts, decorative food bowls, and playful toys for both cats and dogs.

70050000069247.name: Cards Pack 1
70050000069247.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70050000069247.description:
Freshen up your gameplay with new buddies! Keep your focus up and enjoy pairing up even more cute creatures with 20 brand new card fronts. 
Card Fronds appear in game at random.

70050000069249.name: Glowing Decoration
70050000069249.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70050000069249.description: Let your aquatic paradise light up with glowing decorations! The DLC includes 3 shiny, vibrant elements that will add a captivating feeling of mystery to your aquarium.

70050000069250.name: Winter
70050000069250.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000069250.description: Your favorite animals want to play in the snow! Prepare yourself a cup of hot cocoa and start creating the coziest, warmest homes where the cute furry friends can have fun and relax. In the Winter DLC, you’ll find 23 brand new items (including 4 characters) to decorate both inside and outside, 1 new background, and 2 new music tracks to truly feel the magical atmosphere of the season!

70050000069252.name: Tokyo Racer X: Turbo Wheel
70050000069252.intro: Upgrade your wheels, drift with confidence, dominate the city.
70050000069252.description:
Give your ride a fresh new look! This DLC adds a brand-new rim to your car, letting you stand out on Tokyo’s streets as you drift, race, and dominate every corner. Elevate your car’s style and make every turn unforgettable.

Upgrade your vehicle’s appearance, express your unique street style, and take your customization to the next level in Tokyo Racer X.

70050000069257.intro: Get lost in the cyberpunk soundscape of the OFFICIAL VA-11 Hall-A Music Pack!
70050000069257.description:

Featuring FIVE new Rhythm Rifts by Garoad:

As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift: YLIAD. Available now for everyone!

Buying any song from this Music Pack also unlocks custom VA-11 Hall-A items to equip in your Rift Profile!

The updated soundscape deepens the atmosphere of the abandoned world, making every return feel a little different — more intimate, more alive. Sometimes, all it takes is a new sound to change how a place feels.

70050000069469.name: Subnautica: Below Zero - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000069469.intro: Upgrade your returning adventures on planet 4546B for the Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70050000069469.description: The Subnautica: Below Zero Nintendo Switch™ 2 upgrade pack adds enhanced functionality to your game for free! You can experience improved performance with 1440p resolution with up to 60 fps when your Nintendo Switch™ 2 is connected to a compatible TV via your Nintendo Switch™ 2 Dock, or 1080p resolution with up to 60 fps when playing handheld. You can also play Subnautica: Below Zero newly added Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls, making your ability to navigate the world of 4546B faster and easier!

70050000069472.name: Build A Queen: Pirate DLC
70050000069472.intro: Create the hottest power couple and style on your rivals!
70050000069472.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- Gagnam Style: A new victory dance!
- Robot Dance: Celebrate your win like a queen machine!
- Pirate Skin: Make your boyfriend look like a true king of the seas!

Look like a true king and queen!

70050000069473.name: Build A Queen: Prince DLC
70050000069473.intro: Create the hottest power couple and style on your rivals!
70050000069473.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- Snake Moves: A new victory dance!
- Prince Skin: Turn your boyfriend into a royal heir suited for a Queen!
- Charming Skin: Dress your boyfriend in kingly attire!

Look like a true king and queen!

70050000069475.name: Bratz® Rhythm & Style - Runway Ready
70050000069475.intro: Channel your bratitude with bold fashion, fresh hairstyles, and a fierce 2-player style showdown.
70050000069475.description:
Channel your bratitude in this DLC (Fashion Pack), bringing you the latest fashions, hottest hairstyles and a rockin’ new game mode.  

Life is too short to wear boring outfits, so elevate your wardrobe with cute sneakers and candy-colored shirts. Experiment with new, sleek and bold hairstyles, and make your look totally unique with hats or accessories. 

And now… the spotlight’s yours. Put your creative talents to the test in the 2-player competition mode. Go against the clock to serve the fiercest outfit and leave your fashion rivals guessing. 

Be THAT girl, showcasing your passion for fashion from London to Tokyo!

- STEAL THE SPOTLIGHT: Go against the clock and your friends in a new competition mode 

- STAY ON TREND: From cute sneakers to candy-colored shirts, pick from 36 fresh fits. 

- TURN HEADS BEING YOU: Sleek or bold? Pick from 11 hairstyles to elevate your look.

70050000069483.name: The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival - Language Pack
70050000069483.description: This is a language pack that allows you to play The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ on Nintendo Switch™ in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

70050000069511.name: Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Cash Boost
70050000069511.intro: Drive, deliver, and expand your empire with a powerful head start.
70050000069511.description:
Boost your trucking adventure with an instant $50,000 bonus! Jumpstart your career as a professional long-haul driver and upgrade your trucks, purchase new equipment, or expand your business across Europe. This DLC gives you a head start to explore the open road with even more freedom and possibilities.

Hit the road, embrace every challenge, and take your trucking adventure to the next level!

70050000069561.name: More to Gather Pack
70050000069561.intro:
All-new prizes added!
The crane game fun continues!
70050000069561.description:
Introducing new content for Scoop it! Crane Game in the "More to Gather Pack"!
Scoop more, gather more!

The "More to Gather Pack" includes the following content:
・108 additional prizes
