70050000069589.name: FISHING SIMULATOR 2025: Fishing Boost
70050000069589.intro: Your ultimate angling boost for bigger, legendary catches.
70050000069589.description:
Give your angling journey an extra edge with this exclusive upgrade designed to speed up your progress and improve your overall experience.

This upgrade grants you:
+100 kg carrying capacity — haul more fish before returning to shore
+80 bonus minutes — extend your fishing sessions and explore the waters longer
+800 XP — level up faster and unlock new gear with ease

Enhance your adventure, catch more, and progress at a smoother pace while staying fully immersed in the peaceful world of fishing.

70050000069612.name: Prison Skin
70050000069612.description:
This is an original Prison Skin created especially for players.
You can obtain the Prison Skin “Fun World.”

70050000069618.name: New Dawn Cymanti Skin
70050000069618.intro: Master botanics with the new Cymanti Skin! Meet Claude, Squishy, Eggy, Fairy, and other adorable insects.
70050000069618.description:
Cymanti Skin

Cymanti geneticists of the New Dawn Movement evolved these new, cuter appearances to ensure the lasting future of the swarm. Led by a Guru, this sect breeds hordes of adorable insects, colorful flowers, and funky toxins to dispatch their foes as they attempt to usher in a new age for the Cymanti!

This special New Dawn skin for Cymanti adds a cute, psychedelic spin on our favorite buggy tribe, which will help them work their way both into the enemy's backlines and your heart.

Features:

Unleash a horde of adorable, googly-eyed creatures upon your foes!

Bathe your enemies in trippy poisons with the flying Claude or long-ranged Lily!

Detonate the colorful Shoo and wreak havoc upon invading armies!

Froth up Foam that your creatures can use to cross the oceans!

Consume the docile Snulles and sweet Pupli Nectars to feed your expanding forces!

Use your Gurus to "convince" opposing troops to your side!

Eschew normal economics by spending Hearts to train troops and build structures!

Harness the combined might of Axolotls, Cacti,  Rubies, Fairies, and other bizarre creatures to overwhelm any who would underestimate your new form!



Note: This purely cosmetic New Dawn Cymanti Skin does not have any gameplay changes from the normal Cymanti Special Tribe, which must be purchased separately in order to be used.

70050000069649.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Frontline Upgrade
70050000069649.intro: A fresh coat hides nothing—only the threat remains unchanged.
70050000069649.description:
As the situation at the border evolves, this DLC changes the exterior appearance of the container by altering its color. The update brings a new visual identity to the checkpoint, reflecting the changes in the area and the level of alert. The border remains under control, but the visual signals clearly show that things are no longer the same.

And even if the world changes, you remain the only one who can decide who gets through. The mission continues — are you ready?

70050000069910.name: FATE: Reawakened - Prometheus
70050000069910.intro: Battle through a new dungeon, defeat the god of darkness and reclaim the light — because in FATE, your journey never ends.
70050000069910.description:
Enter the portal to a lost realm enshrouded in eternal nightfall.

This is Prometheus, a city once blessed by the gods but has now been all but abandoned by them.
Battle through a new dungeon and corrupted marble
Face creatures born of the shadow and the god Erebos
Reclaim the stolen Golden Flame 
— because in FATE, your journey never truly ends.

Features
A new town hub trapped by darkness
A new dungeon of corrupted marble
A new companion pet: Baby Pegasus


Prometheus is accessible in FATE: Undiscovered Realms via  the Temple of Fate.

70050000069911.name: Ants Empire Colony: Survival Boost
70050000069911.intro: Stronger ants, tougher battles, greater triumphs.
70050000069911.description:
Take your survival to the next level. This DLC grants your brave ant an expanded health pool, allowing you to withstand twice as much damage during exploration and battles. Survive longer and explore the surrounding world with greater confidence.

With increased resilience, every mission becomes smoother, every resource easier to collect, and every encounter more manageable. Rebuilding your colony feels more achievable than ever.

Step back into the natural battlefield—only this time, you’re stronger and better prepared.

70050000069936.description:
Step up your arsenal and dominate the battlefield like never before!

With this DLC, every weapon you collect comes with double the ammo, and all ammo pickups for each weapon type are doubled too. More firepower means more chances to defend your magical tree against waves of enemies, from pesky animal control squads to relentless urban machinery.

Arm yourself, stock up, and prepare for an even more intense battle to protect your enchanted home!

70050000069942.name: Portraits Pack 2
70050000069942.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will let you feel the warmth of the setting sun and hear the whispers of the charming stranger you just met.

70050000069943.name: Portraits Pack 3
70050000069943.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will let you feel the warmth of the setting sun and hear the whispers of the charming stranger you just met.

70050000069948.name: Cop Car Police Simulator Chase: Starter Cash
70050000069948.intro: Start your policing career with extra resources and take control of the city.
70050000069948.description:
Boost your policing career with an instant $5,000 added to your balance! Use the extra resources to upgrade your patrol vehicles, enhance your equipment, or tackle challenging missions more efficiently. With this head start, you can explore the city freely, respond faster to incidents, and enforce the law with greater authority.

Step into the shoes of a US police officer and experience the excitement of maintaining order, investigating crimes, and chasing suspects with added support right from the start.

70050000069950.name: Asphalt Legends – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000069950.description: Compete in intense arcade races, now upgraded with smoother frame rates, higher resolution and enhanced visuals for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.

70050000069966.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure - City Town
70050000069966.intro: Bright lights. Big dreams. Bigger adventures. Welcome to City Town!
70050000069966.description:
A rainbow metropolis awaits! Collect, create, and customize in this cozy adventure. Run your own personalized Cafe, set up all-new shops with Sanrio friends, and unlock the power of dreams to uncover the City’s hidden wonders.

- Welcome, Usahana! Become best friends and unlock 35 friendship levels
- Explore City Town with 90+ original quests and 30+ hours of adventure
- Unlock New Outfits and Decor, including over 150+ new clothing and furniture items
- Run Your Own Cafe – customize your space and craft your own orders for Sanrio friends
- Solve 60+ Puzzles and Challenges throughout (and beneath!) the City
- Plushies, Orchards, Arcades, and more! Help your Sanrio friends open seven new shops in City Town
- Create Custom Avatar Palettes and switch between your favorite outfits for that perfect look
- Unlock a Customizable Apartment Complex inside the Rainbow Tower
- Meet Usahana’s Visitor Friends: Panya, Buppi, Wanwa, Sora, and Nyako
- And… keep an eye out for a mysterious cameo guest

70050000069975.name: OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter: Visual Warfare
70050000069975.intro: New skins to make your mark on the battlefield.
70050000069975.description:
Take your tactical identity to the next level with this exclusive customization pack! This DLC expands your arsenal of visual options by adding 13 brand-new skins designed to enhance both your character and weapon aesthetics. Each skin is crafted to fit perfectly within the gritty, bodycam-style realism of the game, giving you more ways than ever to stand out on the battlefield.

Equip your new skins, personalize your loadout, and show your enemies that you’re not just a fighter — you’re a force with a signature presence.

70050000069980.name: Ice Age
70050000069980.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70050000069980.description: Create your winter paradise! Enhance your experience and make charming, snowy cities with Cozy Land Ice Age DLC! The expansion includes 20 new items, which will challenge your creativity and help bring tons of new ideas to life.

70050000070007.name: Portraits Pack 2
70050000070007.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will let you forget the world, and start an exciting journey into the unknown with a sweet companion by your side.

70050000070012.name: Supermarket CEO Simulator: Startup Cash
70050000070012.intro: Grow your business faster and smarter with a cash boost.
70050000070012.description:
Take your supermarket empire to the next level. With an extra 2,000 added to your balance, you can invest in new stock, upgrade equipment, and expand your stores faster than ever.

Use these resources to enhance your shelves, hire additional staff, and refine your business strategy. Every decision now carries more weight, helping you grow your retail empire with greater efficiency.

Step into the next phase of management and experience the excitement of accelerated growth, smarter investments, and a stronger path to becoming the ultimate CEO.

70050000070018.name: The Fox's Way Home – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000070018.description: By purchasing this content, the Nintendo Switch™ software "The Fox's Way Home" can be upgraded to "The Fox's Way Home – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition".

70050000070021.name: Cards Pack 1
70050000070021.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70050000070021.description: Make your memory training even more exciting with brand new cards! DLC includes 20 cute cards with cozy, everyday items, which will make your brain exercises even more fun!

70050000070022.name: Cozy Sunset Pack
70050000070022.intro: SnapCat is a cozy exploration game about finding cats and capturing quiet moments across peaceful islands.
70050000070022.description: You need EVEN MORE cats in your life? We gotchu! Don’t let your summer trip end yet, and find more furry friends ready to be photographed during the golden hour in Cozy Sunset Pack! The expansion includes 4 brand new levels in which you’re hunting for your feline models under the setting sun.

70050000070023.name: Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre – Bounty Boost
70050000070023.intro: Start rich, strike hard, and survive all duels.
70050000070023.description:
Start your journey in the Wild West with an instant advantage! This DLC grants you $3000 in-game, giving you the resources you need to upgrade your arsenal and build your reputation as a feared gunslinger.

Spend your extra bounty on better weapons and powerful ammunition, and be ready to face the most dangerous outlaws from the very beginning. With more money in your pocket, every duel becomes a chance to prove your skill and rise toward legend in Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre.

70050000070025.name: Cards Pack 2
70050000070025.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70050000070025.description: Refresh your game and keep your mind sharp! DLC introduces 20 new fun cards to mix and match during your relaxing me-time sessions with your console!

70050000070028.name: Professionals Abroad
70050000070028.intro: Includes a collection of explosive new missions taking the Nowhere City SWAT to far away places and pitting them against elite level Insurgent Threat.
70050000070028.description:
When Uncle Sam calls, Nowhere City SWAT answers! Deployed overseas to combat a new terrorist threat directly at the source, our heroes find themselves face to face with a deadly Insurgent network as well as the old familiar enemies.

Taking a page straight out of Door Kickers 2’s playbook, the Insurgents come equipped with dependable AKs and old but deadly Armor Piercing Snipers rifles, suicide vests and great numbers of misguided recruits.

The DLC includes 12 fresh and challenging missions that take Action Squad level design to the max and go further. Jump out of helicopters, blow up walls and find new ways to navigate the environment - but think fast, time is of the essence.

70050000070030.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Victory Pack
70050000070030.description:
The DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Victory Pack includes the following items:
- Accessory that changes the shape of aura when equipped.
 • V-Jump Design Aura
*Only some characters can equip this item.
- Ability Item that enhances the character when equipped
 • Victory Power

70050000070031.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Martial Arts Pack
70050000070031.description:
The DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Martial Arts Pack includes the following items:
- Early unlock of the following three characters:
 • Gohan (Future)
 • Gohan (Future), Super Saiyan
 • Bardock
＊Costume 2 included
- Ability Item that enhances the character when equipped
 • Super Sparking!

70050000070044.name: Formula Racing GP Cash Boost
70050000070044.intro: Boost and go to the victory!
70050000070044.description:
Push your racing career even further with an instant cash boost! 
This DLC grants a set amount of in-game currency to help you to spend less time earning and more time dominating the track.
More power. 
More victory.

70050000070048.name: Formula Racing GP Champion’s Ride
70050000070048.description:
Take your racing to the next level with a high-performance car! This DLC unlocks a car designed to push the limits of speed, handling, and precision.

Feel the difference on every corner, every straight, and every apex. Whether weaving through tight curves or sprinting down the track, your new car gives you fresh ways to master overtakes and dominate the competition.

New car. New possibilities.  
Refine your racing style and leave your rivals in the rearview.

70050000070058.name: The Castle of Lost Souls
70050000070058.intro: Beyond the haunted swamps of Golnir lies the Castle of Lost Souls. Challenge Slank, lord of stolen souls.
70050000070058.description:
Beyond the haunted swamps of western Golnir rises the grim fortress of Slank — the arch-fiend who has stolen the souls of mortals for centuries. Now the secret magic to destroy him is known, and your journey into the Castle of Lost Souls begins. Will you break his hold over the dead… or join them?

Based on the newly rewritten 700-section adventure by Dave Morris & Paul Gresty, this DLC brings one of the most iconic Fabled Lands quests into the CRPG with new locations, enemies, mechanics, and treasures.

A Dark Quest Awaits
Venture across cursed marshes, ruined villages, and the demon’s stronghold itself. Descend into the underworld, uncover forbidden rituals, battle corrupted spirits and undead guardians, and gather the tools needed to challenge Slank at the heart of his domain.

THE CASTLE OF LOST SOULS
3 Major Questlines: 50 000 words added to the base game in an interconnected arc culminating in a single high-stakes finale.

40 New Items: Cursed relics, underworld treasures, and powerful rewards tied to the wider campaign.

New Locations: Haunted roads, castle battlements, infernal chambers, and new underworld zones.

New Enemies & Mechanics: Face spectral knights, wraith executioners, chon-chon swarms, lammasu guardians, the Rauchwurm, the Undine - culminating in multiple confrontations with Slank himself.

New Achievements: 10 new achievements for explorers and completionists.

A legendary standalone gamebook - now a fully integrated Fabled Lands CRPG expansion.

The gates of the Castle have opened.

Do you dare enter?

70050000070061.name: Neon Additional Card
70050000070061.description:
Get the new card "Time for a prismatic show!" to use as a Wild Card.

*You will need to clear the Kizuna Connect dungeon to obtain this card.

70050000070062.name: Card-en-Ciel DLC - The World of "Gal Guardians Servants of the Dark"
70050000070062.description: This set includes new dungeons, cards, a Muse, and a Random Event related to Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark. Clear the first new dungeon and you'll be able to use the new cards and Muse, as well as trigger the Random Event, in other dungeons.

70050000070064.name: Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025: New Wheels
70050000070064.intro: Step into your latest car and take on every daring stunt.
70050000070064.description:
Take on the roads like never before with this DLC! Landorchini Super brings unmatched speed and precision to your stunt driving. Get behind the wheel, perform daring flips and jaw-dropping jumps, and master every stunt with style and control.

Push your limits and experience the ultimate thrill of high-octane driving—because every second counts when you’re chasing perfection.

70050000070068.name: Ghostly Defence
70050000070068.description: Welcome to Ocean Avenue, a new level for Ghost Master Resurrection. The mortals living in this modest suburban abode are an easy-going family with little to worry about, or so they think! A new mode comes to Ghost Master Resurrection - Defence. Those dastardly Ghostbreakers have mounted an all-out assault. Avoid their traps, adapt, and get rid of the Ghostbreakers!

70050000070070.name: THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION – Hunter Gloves
70050000070070.intro: Equip your hands, explore the wild, and outlast every threat.
70050000070070.description:
Upgrade your survival style! This DLC transforms your character’s hands, now sporting sleek, stylish gloves. Not only do they add a fresh visual flair, but they also make every interaction in the jungle feel sharper and more immersive.

Step into the deadly prehistoric world with a new edge – because even in the midst of chaos, style counts. Are you ready?

70050000070080.name: DO NOT USE
70050000070080.intro: Enjoy an ever-growing level pack with new songs!
70050000070080.description:
The Featured Levels Pack is additional content for A Dance of Fire and Ice. It adds new levels to the game covering a variety of styles and difficulty levels.

This pack will include free content updates over time, as new levels are added.

"Featured Levels" are levels that were originally created by members of the community. 7th Beat Games has worked together with them to bring the levels to the game officially. This pack includes some of the most creative and adrenaline-pumping levels in the game. Good luck!

70050000070095.name: Aquila
70050000070095.intro: Unlocks a new world for hexceed: Aquila brings 120 new puzzles. This DLC introduces the brand new "Dots" mechanic!
70050000070095.description:
This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Aquila! 
Puzzle your way through 120 brand-new levels!

70050000070096.name: Fantasy
70050000070096.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70050000070096.description: Build a realm of magic and adventure. This set includes castle-themed furniture, mystical decor like potion bottles, spellbook, and gold dragons, and items fit for a royal throne room or an enchanted forest.

70050000070097.name: Floor & Wallpaper
70050000070097.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000070097.description:
Animals got bored of the current interiors, they want cuter, fancier, newer! Refresh your designs, or get inspired and create tons of new ones with Floor & Wallpaper pack!

DLC includes 10 brand new walls and floors.

70050000070099.name: House Renovator Simulator: Budget Boost
70050000070099.intro: Renovate smarter and faster with additional budget backing.
70050000070099.description:
Step into the world of home renovation with extra support to make your projects smoother and more enjoyable.

This DLC provides 2000 in-game currency, allowing greater flexibility when planning renovations and experimenting with different styles. Use the additional budget to purchase tools, materials, and decorations, and approach every project with confidence.

Enhance your renovation journey and take full control over every detail of your projects.

70050000070102.name: Centaurus
70050000070102.intro: Unlocks a new world for hexceed: Centaurus brings 140 new puzzles and includes all mechanics from the previous DLC.
70050000070102.description:
This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Centaurus! 
Puzzle your way through 140 brand-new levels!

70050000070105.name: Capricornus
70050000070105.intro: Unlocks a new world for hexceed: Capricornus brings 123 new puzzles and includes all mechanics from the previous DLC.
70050000070105.description:
This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Capricornus! 
Puzzle your way through 123 brand-new levels!

70050000070106.name: Cetus
70050000070106.intro: Unlocks a new world for hexceed: Cetus brings 150 new puzzles and introduces the brand new "Chain" mechanic!
70050000070106.description:
This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Cetus! 
Puzzle your way through 150 new levels - this DLC introduces the brand new "Chain" mechanic! The hardest mechanic so far! The chain mechanic counts all the bombs attached to it in a continuous chain!

70050000070107.name: Sirius
70050000070107.intro: Unlocks a new world for hexceed: Sirius brings 120 new puzzles and includes all mechanics from the previous DLC.
70050000070107.description:
This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Sirius! 
Puzzle your way through 120 brand-new levels!

70050000070108.name: Alphard
70050000070108.intro: Unlocks a new world for hexceed: Alphard brings 231 new puzzles and includes all mechanics from the previous DLC.
70050000070108.description:
This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Alphard! 
Puzzle your way through 231 brand-new levels!

70050000070149.name: Flowers Pack 2
70050000070149.description: A set of new flower-themed stickers to embellish a sticker album.

70050000070156.description:
This set includes new dungeons, cards, a Muse, and a Random Event related to the Blaster Master Zero series.
Clear the first new dungeon and you'll be able to use the new cards and Muse, as well as trigger the Random Event, in other dungeons.

70050000070157.name: Ashes & Abyss
70050000070157.description:
Ashes & Abyss
A small gas station sits just on the edge of town. Mortals gather around a campfire in the campground just across the street. Make this trip to new level - Gas Station - be a night the mortals will never forget. Meanwhile, across town, there's horror brewing beneath the waves. The ocean takes far more than it yields in the new level - Marine.   Two new characters also join your roster. Release Pyro and Bathys from their chains!

70050000070161.name: BANG! BANG! BANDITS Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000070161.intro: "BANG! BANG! BANDITS" now with GameShare! Play with anyone, anywhere! Experience powerful visuals in stunning high-res and high FPS!
70050000070161.description:
By purchasing this content, you can upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of "BANG! BANG! BANDITS" to the "Bang! Bang! Bandits Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition."

The Nintendo Switch version of "BANG! BANG! BANDITS" is required to use this content. Additionally, if the latest update data is available, please update the software before use.

70050000070196.name: Anime Warriors Ultimate Fighters
70050000070196.description:
Expand your fighting roster with two powerful characters. Master their techniques and experience combat in fresh ways as you face your enemies.

Every battle becomes more intense, every encounter more strategic. With new fighters at your disposal, experiment with combos, adapt your tactics, and push your skills to the limit.

New characters. New strategies.  
Redefine your combat and dominate the battlefield like never before.

70050000070197.name: Spring
70050000070197.description:
Can you feel it? In the air? The first buds are starting to blossom on colorful ceramics, and magical cats are waking up from their winter slumber. 
Get ready for the most flourishing season by assembling 14 brand new, spring-themed kitty pots!

70050000070200.name: Basketball Legends 24: Bonus Boost
70050000070200.intro: Jump ahead with extra points and play like a true legend!
70050000070200.description:
Boost your journey in Basketball Legends 24 with an instant reward! Receive 5 bonus points added directly to your account to help you progress faster, unlock new features, and make your team even stronger. Step onto the court with extra advantage and dominate the game like a true legend!

Take your basketball adventure to the next level with this exclusive DLC!

70050000070205.name: Horticular: Frozen Frontier
70050000070205.intro: The long-lost research world Glacialis has appeared out of nowhere and your trusted council sends you there to establish contact.
70050000070205.description:
The long-lost research world Glacialis has appeared out of nowhere and your trusted council sends you there to establish contact and bring back any findings on the corrupted.

Frozen Frontier brings the following new things to the base game:

- Brand new story featuring frozen gnomes in hours of content.
- Arctic world, posing unique cold-based challenges.
- Completely new quests to progress through.
- New items and creatures befitting colder climates. How about a snowshoe hare?
- Snowfall covering your garden. Mostly as a cozy treat!
- Unique temperature-based expansion mechanic.
- Rely more on keepers who have distinct jobs.
- New upgrades specific to the world.
- Can be accessed from your existing save file.
- Most items and creatures will find their way back to your main world.

70050000070210.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ X: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000070210.intro: Enhance your experience on planet Mira with performance upgrades on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system
70050000070210.description: Put your journey on Mira into overdrive with this upgrade pack*. Xenoblade Chronicles™ X: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition brings a smoother framerate and 4K resolution** in TV mode, making this the most definitive Xenoblade Chronicles X experience to date.

70050000070223.name: Experience x3 - Fortuna Magus
70050000070223.description:
Experience gained in battles is tripled.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070224.name: No Encounters - Fortuna Magus
70050000070224.description:
Disables battle encounters.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070225.name: Damage x2 - Fortuna Magus
70050000070225.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070237.name: Hole io: Construction DLC
70050000070237.intro: Wear heavy-duty skins and visit the new Construction map with your friends!
70050000070237.description:
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- Construction map
- Operator Skin
- Power Generator Skin
- Engineer Skin
- Welder Skin
- Worker Skin
- Surveyor Skin
- Concrete Mixer Skin

Choose your cool skin, eat concrete, beams, cranes, excavators, buildings and grow BIG!

70050000070239.name: Portraits Pack 2
70050000070239.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations that will take you on dates of your dreams.

70050000070240.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - DeathShroud DLC
70050000070240.intro: Play as the legendary DeathShroud and relive his journey to the top!
70050000070240.description:
With DLC, You'll unlock:
- The Legendary boxer: DeathShroud!
- His iconic gloves, shorts and shoes!
- 21500 experience

See for yourself how it feels to be a boxing legend!

70050000070242.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Jonathan DLC
70050000070242.intro: Play as the legendary Jonathan and relive his journey to the top!
70050000070242.description:
With DLC, You'll unlock:
- The Legendary boxer: Jonathan!
- His iconic gloves, shorts and shoes!
- 20000 experience

See for yourself how it feels to be a boxing legend!

70050000070245.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Maverick DLC
70050000070245.intro: Play as the legendary Maverick and relive his journey to the top!
70050000070245.description:
With DLC, You'll unlock:
- The Legendary boxer: Maverick!
- His iconic gloves, shorts and shoes!
- 21500 experience

See for yourself how it feels to be a boxing legend!

70050000070250.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Frontier Skies
70050000070250.intro: Patrol the frontier under breathtaking new skies.
70050000070250.description:
Patrol the frontier under a completely redesigned Skybox, more refined and sophisticated than the standard skies. This upgrade enhances the visual atmosphere of every checkpoint, urban entry point, and remote terrain, making each day on duty feel more immersive and intense.

Feel the heightened tension as you manage inspections, chase smugglers, and make split-second decisions under skies that reflect the gravity of your mission.

Experience the frontier like never before with this enhanced visual upgrade!

70050000070256.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival: Wild Gear
70050000070256.intro: Equip yourself and take control of your survival adventure.
70050000070256.description:
Prepare for greater adventures and master the wild like never before. Step up your survival game with the addition of a powerful sword, placed directly in your inventory. Wield it to defend yourself against the dangers of the wild, hunt more efficiently, and carve your path through the forest with ease.

This DLC gives you a head start in your adventure, letting you focus on exploring, crafting, and mastering the untamed wilderness while already armed with a reliable weapon. Prepare, survive, and thrive in the heart of nature.

70050000070258.name: OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club: Power Boost
70050000070258.intro: Start strong, fight harder, and become the ultimate OFC champion.
70050000070258.description:
Step into the ring with a massive advantage! This exclusive DLC grants 500,000 coins and 200,000 fame, giving you the resources to train, upgrade, and dominate your opponents faster than ever.

Use the coins to enhance your fighter’s stats, unlock new gear, or expand your roster, while the fame boosts your reputation and opens doors to new tournaments and challenges. With this head start, you can focus on mastering devastating strikes, perfecting your combos, and climbing the ranks to championship glory.

Experience the ultimate fighter’s advantage and accelerate your journey to become the undisputed champion of OFC!

70050000070262.name: Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor: Predator Skin
70050000070262.description:
Give your dinosaur battles a fresh look! This DLC changes the textures of enemy dinosaurs, making every encounter more visually striking and immersive.

Face your foes in new, detailed appearances, adding variety and excitement to your survival journey. Every hunt, duel, and challenge feels different as you explore the lush biomes and engage with ancient predators in a whole new style.

Step into a world of enhanced visuals—your ultimate dinosaur survival adventure just got even more spectacular!

70050000070266.name: New Year Clothes Pack(3)
70050000070266.intro: Put on the festive New Year Clothes and welcome good luck and challenges!
70050000070266.description:
Exclusive New Year Clothes for the following TEN characters, available for unlimited use on all maps in the game:

-Jintaro
-Daniel
-Jiang Yun Fan
-Tang Yurou
-Long You
-Xiao Man
-Li Xiao Yao
-Zhao Ling Er
-A Nu
-Lin Yue Ru

*To use the New Year Clothes Pack, you must own the 'Richman 4 Fun' (sold separately).

70050000070278.name: Stunt Scooter Simulator: Boosted Ride
70050000070278.intro: Boost your tricks, flips, and style with a coin advantage from the start.
70050000070278.description:
Kickstart your stunt-riding adventure with an instant boost! This DLC grants 25,000 coins to help you unlock upgrades, enhance your scooter’s performance, and access customization options faster.

Take full advantage of this head start to push your limits, perform jaw-dropping tricks, and create your ultimate stunt scooter experience.

With extra coins in your pocket, you’ll be ready to dominate the streets and show off your skills in style!

70050000070282.name: Farm Together 2 - Frosty Pack
70050000070282.description:
Bundle up and stay warm with this customization pack for Farm Together 2!

70050000070286.name: Ship of Fools - Golden Bay Duo
70050000070286.intro: Set sail for gold and glory with The Golden Bay Duo!
70050000070286.description:
Set sail for gold and glory with The Golden Bay Duo! This pirate-themed Pack of Fools introduces two fortune-seeking new crewmates—legendary plunderers who dig deep and hunt smart to claim the riches of the high seas.

Both characters bring a new gameplay mechanic, allowing them to spend Sand Dollars to overcharge their reflect action, unleashing game-changing abilities.

Commodore Goldie – Flaunts its wealth with pride, yet hides a heart of gold

A goldfish with a taste for riches, Goldie digs with her trusty shovel to uncover Whirl Pearls. (or, with a bit of luck, maybe something else?)

On impact, these pearls create a Cash Vortex, scattering gold and wealth as they strike enemies!

Hanha – Relentlessly tracks the weak, leaving no bounty unclaimed

A fearsome bounty hunter, Hanha marks an enemy for the hunt.

When a marked foe is defeated, they drop a Hunting Trophy into the water—trinkets that boost player stats!

Each enemy has its own unique trophy, making every battle a high-stakes hunt.

Prepare to dig, plunder, and claim your fortune—solo or in co-op—with The Golden Bay Duo!

Note: Every Ship of Fools ""Pack of Fools"" DLC is automatically shared with your online co-op partner (host or client) for the duration of your play session.

70050000070295.name: Ship of Fools - Thunder Tide Duo
70050000070295.intro: Prepare to unleash shocking new strategies with The Thunder Tide Duo!
70050000070295.description:
Prepare to unleash shocking new strategies with The Thunder Tide Duo! This electrifying Pack of Fools introduces two eccentric new characters—mad scientists of high Aquademic renown who harness the power of static electricity to zap their foes into the bottomless abyss.

Both characters utilize a new gameplay mechanic that lets them roll to generate static charges. These charges build up and release into increasingly powerful electric effects.

Eelvis – Shock and Roll!

An amped-up electric eel with a jolted stage presence.

When he fires a cannon, he discharges all stored static energy, creating a devastating electric explosion on impact!

Gastropaul – Heavy shell, strong personality

This sea snail might be slow, but his resilience experiments make him a defensive powerhouse.

If Gastropaul gets knocked down or stunned, he shrugs it off and instead unleashes an electric explosion, fueled by his stored charges!

Get ready to uncover some of the greatest Sea-antific breakthroughs ever known to the archipelago—solo or in co-op—with The Thunder Tide Duo!

Note: Every Ship of Fools ""Pack of Fools"" DLC is automatically shared with your online co-op partner (host or client) for the duration of your play session.

70050000070399.name: Cozy Grove – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000070399.intro: Come for the view, stay for the friends.
70050000070399.description:
Welcome to Cozy Grove, a life-sim game about camping on a haunted, ever-changing island. As a Spirit Scout, you'll wander the island's forest each day, finding new hidden secrets and helping soothe the local ghosts. With a little time and a lot of crafting, you'll bring color and joy back to Cozy Grove!

Cozy Grove is synced to real world time, and provides 30-60 minutes of new quest content each day. After that, you can fish, craft and decorate to your heart's content!

Features:
• Beautiful, dynamic, hand-drawn landscapes that come alive when you help a spirit in need.
• Dozens of memorable characters and spirits for you to find and befriend. Each spirit has a unique, extensive story for you to unravel over time.
• Collect spirit animals, craft decorations, go fishing and more!
• 40+ hour campaign filled with side quests, designed to span months of playtime.

70050000070425.name: Cats Pack
70050000070425.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70050000070425.description: Looking for a purrfect way to spend your cozy evenings? Unleash the cat mania! Feed, sort, and prepare adorable toys to make your cutest furry friends happy! 10 new, pawtastic levels are waiting in Softly Placed Cats Pack.

70050000070427.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Quest Track
70050000070427.intro: Embark on a puzzle filled quest!
70050000070427.description:

70050000070505.name: Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator: Ammo Mayhem
70050000070505.intro: More feathers, more firepower, more fun!
70050000070505.description:
Take your pigeon pranks to the next level! With this feather-boosted upgrade, the ammo count for each weapon is increased by 3 times (×3), giving you more freedom to unleash chaos across the bustling park.

Whether you’re dive-bombing unsuspecting picnickers or showing off your avian super moves, more ammo means more mischief, more mayhem, and more wanted stars! Keep your stamina in check, plan your aerial antics, and enjoy the park like never before — now with triple the firepower at your wings.

Unleash your inner pigeon powerhouse and turn the park into your personal playground!

70050000070514.name: Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Sky of Chaos
70050000070514.intro: New skybox, more mayhem, more destruction.
70050000070514.description:
Get ready for a whole new level of chaos! This DLC adds a brand-new skybox that completely changes the city’s atmosphere. Experience destruction and mayhem under a more dramatic and intense sky. Perfect for epic battles, massive destruction, and endless adventure.

Are you ready to rule the city under a new sky?

70050000070520.name: Construction Machine Simulator 2023: New Machinery
70050000070520.intro: Boost your construction projects with extra power!
70050000070520.description:
Get ready to command the ultimate machine and take your construction adventure to the next level!

Operate your new VBear 34 to lift, dig, and deliver with precision. Whether you’re tackling challenging missions, expanding your construction empire, or perfecting your machinery skills, this gift lets you work faster, smarter, and more efficiently.

Step into the cab, power up the VBear 34, and reshape your construction world like never before!

70050000070523.name: Walls of Judgment
70050000070523.description:
Walls of Judgment
Some places are built to confine the body.
Other places are built to attract strange, otherworldly spirits.
The Walls of Judgment introduces two grim new locations:
A prison where no one can hear you scream.
The church where you may hide from your nightmares.

Behind the iron bars and the locked doors, mortals wait, pace, and pray.
Mortals are unaware they are prey. In the prison, isolation and routine can drive you mad.
If you doubt this truth, ask inmate Kyle, who has been in prison serving a sentence extending into the afterlife.
In the church, faith is tested. Most win, most of the time. Others are less fortunate.

Justice may be blind… and fear can stare straight through you...

70050000070526.name: Outbound - Schoolbus Adventures DLC
70050000070526.description:
Get ready to hit the road with the School Bus Adventures DLC, where the trusty Schoolie becomes your new playable vehicle! Explore the wilderness in style and transform this iconic school bus into a fully customized camper van. Outfit and personalize every corner as you venture off the beaten path, turning the Schoolie into your perfect home on wheels.

Designed for big adventures, the Schoolie offers generous interior space for building and creativity. It features a large sliding door, a smaller passenger-side entry, and a rear door that lets you move through the entire vehicle with ease. A ladder-accessible rooftop rack opens up new possibilities for expanding your base above the bus. Please note that you select your vehicle at the start of your adventure.

This DLC includes:
- A fully customizable school bus available as a playable vehicle.

70050000070530.name: Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing: Capital Boost
70050000070530.intro: Invest in your fleet and conquer the streets in pure cyberpunk style.
70050000070530.description:
Power up your journey with an instant credit injection! This DLC adds 1,000,000 credits, giving you the financial edge to build the ultimate cyberpunk garage.

Unlock futuristic cars faster, apply powerful upgrades, and customize your machines exactly the way you want. With a massive boost to your balance, you’re free to focus on what truly matters—speed, style, and domination on the neon-lit tracks.

Less grinding. More racing. Total control.

70050000070539.name: Tiny Auto Knights - Supporter Pack
70050000070539.intro: Improve your Tiny Auto Knights experience with this Supporter Pack! Get exclusive items for your player profile and a new dungeon arena for battles.
70050000070539.description:
Tiny Auto Knights Supporter Pack: Show off with style

A pack for those who want to support Mumpitz Games. You will significantly contribute to the further development of Tiny Auto Knights.

To express our sincere gratitude, you will receive the following set of prestigious items:

Player Profile Customizations
Show others that you support us by pimping your profile with these accessories:
- Picture frame
- Tiny Auto Knights Avatar
- Banner background effect
- Rainbow colored profile name

Arena Background
Fight your greatest battles in this special dungeon arena.

70050000070551.name: Between Worlds
70050000070551.description:
Between Worlds
Not all places are meant to be destinations. The Train Station is a place of arrivals, departures, and fleeting encounters. Mortals pass through, never feeling safe, as though they are being watched. Platforms fade into the darkness. The tunnels echo with distant sounds from the past and the present. Panic spreads faster than the Phantom Train Conductor can operate his locomotive.

Introducing a new Train Station level built upon crowds, open spaces, and relentless motion. No place ever feels secure.

Introducing a new game mode: Second Side of the Coin.

For the first time, step into the role of a Ghost-breaker who hunts ghosts, sets traps, and experiences fear from the other side—where control is fleeting and fragile, resources are limited, and every mistake means punishment.

70050000070554.name: Solid Ice and Terror
70050000070554.description:
Solid Ice and Terror

Escape the bitter cold outside. Screams echo across the ice, celebrating victories and championships of years past.

A massive industrial hockey arena has been abandoned for years. The lights flicker over empty stands and scarred ice. Mortals enter believing their greatest enemy is the polar vortex, however outside something far worse stalks the rink tonight. What looks cute can be just as terrifying. The officials are watching from beyond.

In Canada, hockey is life—even in the afterlife. Something far worse than the cold stalks the rink on this winter evening. The rules of the natural and the supernatural can change without warning. Some will cry for decades. Others are haunted forever.

Introducing a new level set in an industrial Canadian hockey arena somewhere in Canada. We’ll give you 514 guesses where. Every whistle cuts through the darkness, and every decision feels final.

Beware the supernatural official, Jacques Rougeau, who’s on the job.
“Justice isn’t fair. I don’t care if you get screwed over… bon!”

70050000070556.name: Frightful Night
70050000070556.description:
Frightful Night

The holidays arrive in Ghost Master Resurrection with a new Christmas Market level, draped in lights, decorations, and false cheer. Mortals gather to celebrate, laugh, and shop—blissfully unaware that terror awaits just beneath the tinsel.

Carols echo. Shadows linger.

Every smile hides a scream.

The most wonderful time of the year is here—for you to scare!

70050000070563.name: Cat Pack 1
70050000070563.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000070563.description: Is there anything better than cats? Yes - even MORE CATS! Make your house a home with 10 adorable brand new furry friends playing, relaxing, and practicing their cozy hobbies.

70050000070585.name: TOMOMI Another Story
70050000070585.intro: The protagonist of the previous title TOMOMI joins the fight in ROLLING STAR!
70050000070585.description:
A brand new story:
A new story unfolds with Tomomi as the protagonist.
Why did Riko undergo cryosleep?
How did Tomomi get here?
What's Laurie been up to? Secrets not found in her story will be revealed here.

Tomomi:
A ditzy, ninja lady who fights with a katana and shuriken. She has a crush on her partner, Riko.
Her controls and skills have been adjusted from the previous title to fit the world of ROLLING STAR. Enjoy a whole new gameplay experience with her.

New Vehicle:
A new combat vehicle exclusive to Tomomi's route has been added. It's a sleek, new unit completely different from Laurie's!

70050000070586.name: Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator: Balance Boost
70050000070586.intro: Your car wash empire begins here — faster, smarter, stronger.
70050000070586.description:
Take your car wash business to the next level instantly! This DLC adds 5,000 to your balance, giving you the boost you need to expand faster, upgrade equipment, and attract more customers right from the start.

Invest in self-service stations, enhance your tunnel car washes, or stock your on-site shop to increase revenue. With extra funds at your disposal, you can focus on growing your business and creating the ultimate car wash empire.

Start strong, expand quickly, and watch your car wash become the talk of the town!

70050000070595.name: Digging A Hole 2025: Power Start
70050000070595.intro: Dig deeper. Discover more. Dominate the depths.
70050000070595.description:
Boost your underground adventure with an instant reward of 500 bonus coins! This DLC gives you the extra resources you need to upgrade your tools, unlock new possibilities, and accelerate your progress through the mysterious depths.

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to push further underground, these bonus coins help you dig faster, discover rare artifacts sooner, and uncover ancient secrets with ease.

Jump into the adventure fully equipped and make every excavation count!
