70050000070629.name: Pocket Bravery - Season Pass 1
70050000070629.intro: Expand your roster with new fighters and stages in Pocket Bravery Season 1 DLC
70050000070629.description:
Meet the New Challengers

Rick Johnson – The fearless gunslinger from Guns N’ Runs joins the battle with a high-speed, close-range combat style. His Machines at Work stage brings the industrial chaos of his world to life.

Brandon Carter – A former CIA operative who now fights on his own terms. His sharp, tactical approach is perfectly matched by the urban intensity of the City Hall Station stage.

Dvesha – A mysterious shadow-wielder who bends darkness to his will. Face your fears in his unsettling Disturbed Place stage, where energy and chaos collide.

Camille Leclerc – A rebellious punk fighter from Marseille with a fiery attitude and a rhythm that hits as hard as her strikes. Her Marseille, France stage captures her raw, untamed spirit.

Season 1 Pass Contents
- Four playable characters: Rick Johnson, Brandon Carter, Dvesha and Camille Leclerc
- Four new stages inspired by each fighter’s story and style
        - Bonus content including colour palettes, gallery artwork and exclusive music tracks
- Full roster integration across Versus, Arcade and Online modes

Upgrade your line-up, master new styles and experience the evolution of Pocket Bravery with the complete Season 1 collection.

70050000070637.name: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Coin Rush
70050000070637.intro: Step into the driver’s seat with a head start!
70050000070637.description:
Hit the road with a clear advantage and accelerate your progress right from the very start of the game. This DLC gives you 50,000 coins, providing a fast start. Use these resources to upgrade your truck, customize the cabin and exterior, or invest in performance upgrades that will enhance your driving experience and delivery efficiency.

Be ready for any challenge on the roads of America and grow your trucking business faster than ever, while enjoying the freedom to create your own driving style.

70050000070642.name: The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000070642.description: If you purchase The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ for Nintendo Switch™, you only need to purchase the upgrade pack to play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70050000070707.name: Anime Warriors Money Bonus
70050000070707.description:
Fuel your fighting journey with an instant in-game currency boost! This DLC grants additional funds giving you the edge in every battle.
Spend less time grinding and more time mastering combos, honing your skills, and taking on elite opponents. 
Prepare your roster and fight without limits.

70050000070708.name: State of Panic
70050000070708.description:
Order was their shield. 
Fear will be their downfall.
Step inside the rigid world of bureaucracy with two new locations: a Government Bank and a Town Hall. Designed for security and control, these buildings quickly become pressure cookers when mortals realize the rules no longer protect them. 

Tight corridors, public spaces, and fragile authority create the perfect environment for paranoia to spread. Watch calm routines collapse as whispers turn into panic and trust evaporates. 

The system is failing. 
Make sure they feel every second of it.

70050000070712.name: Song Pack 8
70050000070712.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70050000070712.description:
Impress your friends and family by playing 5 brand new songs!
With this DLC you can improve your piano skills and learn:
Polly Wolly Doodle
Happy Folk Melody
The Itsy Bitsy Spider
Row, Row, Row Your Boat
Bingo

70050000070726.name: Cat Girl Survivor – Extra Episode DLC
70050000070726.intro:
Featuring Yui Ogura, Kana Ueda, and Marie Miyake in a fully voiced new story.
5 new stages, stronger bosses, and a new playable character, Mi
70050000070726.description:
Cat Girl Survivor – Extra Episode DLC

A major story expansion that deepens the world of Cat Girl Survivor.

Featuring full-voice performances by a renowned Japanese voice cast including Yui Ogura, Kana Ueda, and Marie Miyake, this DLC introduces brand-new story episodes that expand the narrative beyond the main game.
Discover hidden sides of the protagonists and uncover untold stories that add new depth to their relationships.

■ Voice Cast & Roles

Yui Ogura – Yuri

Kana Ueda – Akane

Marie Miyake – Koro

Nozomi Yamane – Chloe

Chirin Sakura – Shiro

Kenta Kiyozumi – Leo

All new story content is fully voiced to enhance immersion and character development.

■ DLC Features

New fully voiced story episodes

5 newly designed stages

More challenging new boss battles

New playable character: Mio

Mio is a bard-style character who uses sound waves to slow enemy movement.
Her unique crowd-control abilities introduce new strategic options and fresh build possibilities for advanced players.

This DLC delivers both narrative expansion and intensified combat content for players who want to experience the world of Cat Girl Survivor in greater depth.

Base game required to play.

70050000070737.name: Project Drift Japan Challenge: Tokyo Beats
70050000070737.intro: Take control of legendary cars and conquer the toughest roads.
70050000070737.description:
Enhance your drifting experience with newly added background music! This DLC add more energy and atmosphere to every race. The new background music blends seamlessly with the fast-paced gameplay and Japanese manga-style visuals, making every drift feel more intense and immersive.

Every drift, every corner, and every victory now feels more intense. Take control and enjoy a renewed drifting experience.

70050000070742.name: Supermarket Anime Cozy Music Track
70050000070742.intro: Fresh music for your cozy market.
70050000070742.description:
Add a fresh touch to your supermarket experience with a brand-new music track! 
This DLC introduces new song bringing a cozy and cheerful mood to your daily routine.
Enjoy managing shelves, serving customers, and growing your store with a new sound that perfectly matches the cute and wholesome atmosphere.
Same adorable world.  
A fresh vibe.

70050000070746.name: Supermarket Anime Cash Pack
70050000070746.description:
Boost your kawaii empire with extra in-game currency! This DLC provides an extra in-game currency to help you upgrade your shelves, unlock charming products, and make your supermarket even cuter and more efficient.

Spend less time earning and more time enjoying the adorable chaos of daily shop life. Upgrade faster, decorate your store, and delight your customers while growing your kawaii empire!

70050000070753.name: Arts Pack
70050000070753.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70050000070753.description:
Some of your toy friends are dignified and have a taste for finer things. Make them happy by hanging masterpiece paintings on their walls and placing their own little fine art exhibitions in their houses.  
Enhance your My Little Haven experience with 20 brand new items of Art DLC!

70050000070778.name: GigaBash - Final Ascension DLC
70050000070778.intro: The flames of justice burn bright blue!
70050000070778.description:
This DLC adds “Gaya Gigaman" and "Zargorah", 2 of GigaBash's characters given new forms, new abilities, and a whole new story mode chapter for Gigaman.

When the situation is most dire, humanity's hero Gigaman taps deep into his source of power and becomes Gaya Gigaman to deliver hope. Faster, stronger, and 100% more Giga! His moves are stellar, and his rise meteoric! Enhance his attacks with the power of the stars, and don't forget to pose for the camera.

Tremble before the ascension of Zargorah, the Devourer of Stars! This new threat combines the speed of the Demon Star and the might of the Extinction Dragon into one devastating Titan. When he roars, pandemonium ensues!

Gigaman, the Champion of Justice, takes new form as Gaya Gigaman! But his nemesis Zargorah threatens everything he holds dear. What happens when the two clash? Can Gigaman find the strength to stop the end of all things? Find out in the brand new Story Mode for Gigaman!

Will you deliver hope on wings of azure flame as Gaya Gigaman? Or will you take what is yours as Zargorah and shatter the world?

70050000070779.name: Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator – New Character
70050000070779.intro: Unlock new character and bring fresh chaos to your skateboarding adventures.
70050000070779.description:
Add a new legend to your skateboarding crew! Unlock a unique character and bring fresh style, tricks, and animations to your adventures.

Already have this character? No problem! Instead, you’ll receive the money equivalent to spend on upgrading your skateboard, gear, or other in-game items.

Whether you unlock the character or get the cash, this DLC enhances your skateboarding experience and adds even more meme-tastic fun!

70050000070813.name: Experience x3 - Tears Revolude
70050000070813.description:
All characters' experience gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070814.name: Skill Proficiency x3 - Tears Revolude
70050000070814.description:
All characters' skill proficiency gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070816.name: Experience & Skill Proficiency x2 - Tears Revolude
70050000070816.description:
All characters' experience and skill proficiency gained increases by 100%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070817.name: No Encounters - Tears Revolude
70050000070817.description:
Disables battle encounters.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070818.name: Damage x2 - Tears Revolude
70050000070818.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000070837.name: Prison Life Simulator Jail – Dark Horizons
70050000070837.intro: Navigate the shadows, outsmart the guards, and find your way to freedom.
70050000070837.description:
Take your prison experience to a whole new level. The prison world becomes even more immersive as ominous clouds fill the sky, changing the atmosphere and adding new challenges to your daily life. Move carefully across the yard, adapt your plans to the dimmed light, and use the shadows to avoid guards or uncover hidden opportunities.

Survive the gloom, outsmart the guards, and plan your escape while the skies grow darker. Can you maintain your freedom under the overcast skies?

70050000070889.name: Character Pack Flandre Scarlet
70050000070889.description:
Flandre Scarlet, the fan-favorite from the Touhou Project, has arrived in QQQbeats!!! 
Try out her new skill that transforms shot bubbles into Super Paint Bubbles!

- Abilities
Mixes Timer Bombs into released blank bubbles. The effect will automatically activate after 3 shots.

- Skill: Forbidden Fruit
Turns your shot bubble into a Red Super Paint Bubble for 3 shots. The effect ends when the field changes.

70050000070910.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Cultured Supporter Pack
70050000070910.description:
This pack is primarily a way to support our small team, helping us to continue creating stories and games set in the Riven Realms. If you enjoy our content and want to see it expand, this is a great way to endorse the effort.
As a token of our gratitude for the support, this pack unlocks a single alternative appearance for all Companions* in the game (unique to each Companion). These cosmetics are purely visual, do not alter gameplay in any way, and do not represent “canon” looks for the characters. Instead, they are cool alternatives themed around various cultures of the Riven Realms.

The contents of the supporter pack are:

“Dervish” skin for Harvek
“Argadorean Huntress” skin for Criftaa
“Ash Stalker” & “Ash Haunter” skins for Renkailon
“Mercator” skin for Garrik
“Marauding Warrior” & “Angred Protector” skins for Gor’Goro
“Kalani Crystalmancer” skin for Finndurarth
“Sharduk Nomad” skin for Skornar
“Shalimi Sorceress” skin for Nedir
“Ahari Sunstrider” skin for Eylani
“Demon Thrall” skin for Vorax*
“Sadirar Spirit Talker” skin for Javek*
“Dark Paladin” skin for Sedarias*

As always, your support is much appreciated.
- The Lost Pilgrims Team

70050000070924.name: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Foggy Streets
70050000070924.intro: Drive into a new atmosphere where fog transforms your parking empire.
70050000070924.description:
Elevate your parking empire to a whole new level with a stunning atmospheric transformation. This DLC adds volumetric fog to your lots, creating a sense of depth, mystery, and realism that changes the way you see and manage your properties.

Drive through misty lanes, observe how the fog alters customer behavior, and navigate a world where visibility affects every decision. Subtle shifts in light and shadows bring your parking lots to life, highlighting hidden details and enhancing the immersive experience.

Adapt your strategies, maintain efficiency, and continue building your empire while the fog adds a fresh challenge and a cinematic touch to your everyday management.

70050000070932.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: Fleet Expansion
70050000070932.intro: Your fleet just got stronger—take the wheel and dominate.
70050000070932.description:
Venture through rugged landscapes and take on challenging deliveries across muddy forests, sandy careers, and snowy mountains. This exclusive DLC adds the legendary “Pajero” to your fleet—a powerful, versatile vehicle designed to tackle the toughest terrain with ease.

Upgrade your fleet, master difficult routes, and experience offroad driving like never before. Gear up, hit the dirt, and complete your deliveries faster, safer, and in style, all while enjoying the offroad adventure!

70050000070940.name: Out of Sight: Stage Fright
70050000070940.intro: Delve deeper into Lady Janna's mansion with the Out of Sight: Stage Fright DLC.
70050000070940.description:
Another wing in the mansion opens up for Sophie and Teddy to explore, which extends the middle of the game with 3 new chapters that you can play as a part of the full experience or as a standalone adventure.

Uncover the story of a tormented Unseen, a spirit child who reaches out to Sophie for help with their final performance. Together with Teddy they reveal new perspectives, a chilling history, and a need to overcome their greatest fears.

The DLC also includes a set of cosmetic items Sophie can wear throughout the whole game.
New outfit - Soot & Tawny.
New hat - Cougher's Cap.
2 new masks (unlocked through play).

70050000070952.name: Parkour Simulator 2026 – Street Style
70050000070952.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70050000070952.intro: Start your journey equipped, stylish, and ready for action!
70050000070952.description:
Hit the city streets in style! Take your freerunning to the next level and make every jump, flip, and wall-run look epic. Gear up for the rooftops, alleys, and daring stunts with an exclusive hoodie, perfect for showing off your urban flair.

If you already own this hoodie, you’ll automatically receive 1,000 in-game credits instead, so you never miss out on a reward.

Elevate your freerunning adventure and dominate the city with confidence and style!

70050000070954.name: Bun Buns: Cozy DLC
70050000070954.intro: Create the coziest bakery in town!
70050000070954.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- A cute and cozy forest map
- 9 natural hairstyles
- 2 fantasy outfits
- 2 grassy hats
- 2 leafy accessories

Bake yourself a fresh new look!

70050000070956.name: Bun Buns: Cute DLC
70050000070956.intro: Become the cutest baker in town!
70050000070956.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- A cute and cozy dream map
- 9 pastel hairstyles
- 2 colorful outfits
- 2 cute hats
- 2 dreamy accessories

Bake yourself a fresh new look!

70050000070983.name: Easter Pack
70050000070983.description: A set of new easter-themed stickers to embellish a sticker album.

70050000071004.name: Cinema
70050000071004.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70050000071004.description: How about a movie night? Design cinema lobbies every movieholic would love with a pack of 20 brand new items!

70050000071005.name: Sports Pack
70050000071005.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70050000071005.description: Don’t let your Freaky Trip be over – expand your experience with 3 new, sports-themed illustrations for the sliding puzzle game.

70050000071006.name: Prehistoric Decoration
70050000071006.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70050000071006.description: Decorate your aquarium with items going back to the beginning of mankind. The DLC includes 3 elements that will make your aquatic paradise feel timeless.

70050000071007.name: Cards Pack 2
70050000071007.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70050000071007.description:
Freshen up your gameplay with new buddies! Keep your focus up and enjoy pairing up even more cute creatures with 20 brand new card fronts.
Card Fronds appear in game at random.

70050000071030.name: Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator: Abyss Outfit
70050000071030.intro: Dive into the depths with a fresh new look and stand out on every adventure.
70050000071030.description:
The ocean is dark, mysterious… and now, more stylish than ever. Equip a variety of unique suits and give your diver a fresh new look while exploring the mysterious depths of the ocean.

Whether you prefer sleek, professional gear or bold and eye-catching designs, these skins let you express your style on every dive. Face dangerous marine creatures, hunt rare species, and manage your oxygen — all while looking your best beneath the waves.

Stand out in the deep, impress in your sushi restaurant, and make every journey unforgettable.

70050000071035.name: Human Fall Flat - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000071035.description:
Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online. Free new levels are regularly added to the game which keeps players returning for more! 

INCLUDES NINTENDO SWITCH™ 2 EDITION FEATURES 
- GameShare: play Human Fall Flat with anyone – even if they don't own the game! 
- GameChat: share audio and video while playing with your friends. 
- Improved performance with higher frame rate and resolution. 
- Support for mouse controls. 

MORE THAN 30 UNIQUE WORLDS TO MASTER 
Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded.

MORE HUMANS, MORE MAYHEM 
Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 8 players transforms the way Human Fall Flat is played. 

A BLANK CANVAS
Your Human is yours to customise. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colours!

70050000071063.name: "Pretty Boy" song
70050000071063.intro: You can enjoy the "Pretty Boy" song in Musical Vibes RX!
70050000071063.description: This downloadable content gives you access to the following song in Musical Vibes RX: "Pretty Boy"

70050000071064.name: "Magnetic Pulse" song
70050000071064.intro: You can enjoy the "Magnetic Pulse" song in Musical Vibes RX!
70050000071064.description: This downloadable content gives you access to the following song in Musical Vibes RX: "Magnetic Pulse"

70050000071065.name: "Club Reverie" song
70050000071065.intro: You can enjoy the "Club Reverie" song in Musical Vibes RX!
70050000071065.description: This downloadable content gives you access to the following song in Musical Vibes RX: "Club Reverie"

70050000071077.name: Roll in Style: Pre-Order Bonus Dice Skins
70050000071077.description:
Prepare for a journey to a galaxy far, far away! Whether you’re bartering in the desert sands or marching in formation, these pre-order bonuses will make your next game night feel like you’ve scavenged treasure in the Outer Rim.

Pre-Order Bonus
Don’t miss out! Lock in your pre-order now to expand your collection with two legendary dice skins inspired by two of the galaxy’s iconic characters:

Jawa: Roll with the resourcefulness of a Tatooine scavenger. Perfect for finding luck in the most unlikely places!

Stormtrooper: Bring order to the board with the iconic Galactic Empire soldier. Don’t worry – these dice won’t miss their target!

70050000071085.name: The Gardener Simulator - Plant, Grow, Decorate, Build Sim: Harvest Bonus
70050000071085.intro: Turn your gardening passion into a thriving, prosperous oasis.
70050000071085.description:
Give your gardening journey a powerful head start with a generous boost of in-game currency. Whether you’re looking to expand your plot, invest in better tools, or unlock a wider variety of plants, this addition provides the resources you need to flourish.

With 5,000 coins in your balance, you can shape your garden exactly the way you envision it—without limits. Create stunning landscapes, experiment with rare plants, and build your own botanical empire with ease.

Shape your perfect garden and enjoy the rewards of your growing paradise.

70050000071098.name: Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG: River Mysteries
70050000071098.intro: Explore new areas and uncover underwater mysteries.
70050000071098.description:
Discover new secrets beneath the river’s surface! Explore the River location, now enriched with new environmental elements: a safe, a couch, and a destroyed house. Discover hidden secrets, interact with objects, and enjoy a more immersive and captivating underwater experience.

Dive into new challenges, uncover mysteries, and make your exploration of the river more exciting than ever.

70050000071099.name: Spring
70050000071099.intro: Welcome to the most charming, cozy ice cream parlor in town!
70050000071099.description: When it’s getting warm outside, birds are chirping, and the flowers are blooming, there’s nothing better than getting a delicious treat! Decorate your ice cream parlor to celebrate the start of the season with colorful new items of Spring DLC!

70050000071151.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000071151.intro: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney! Discover rich stories while building the perfect neighborhood alongside Disney and Pixar Heroes and Villains.
70050000071151.description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new.  

Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle.

Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley! 

Discover the Secrets of Dreamlight Valley
Free the Dream Castle from the insidious grip of the Forgetting, and unlock the unique Realms of well-loved Disney and Pixar characters, including great queens and kings such as Anna and Simba. Each Realm contains unique challenges with puzzles to solve in the quest to bring friendship back to the Valley.  
You’ll start your adventure in the Valley, but your journey will take you to infinity… and beyond! Explore what lurks in the Forest of Valor and brave the deepest caverns as you take on challenges from iconic Disney and Pixar heroes and villains. Who knows who—or what—you might discover.  

Forge Friendships with Disney & Pixar Characters 
Garden with WALL·E, cook with Remy, or kick back and fish with Goofy. What better way to collect, craft, and rebuild the Valley than with a friend! From beautiful princesses to nefarious villains, every Dreamlight Valley resident brings their own story arc, quests, and rewards. Meet up in daily hangouts and make friends with some of your favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

Restore the Valley to Its Former Glory 
Free the Valley from the grip of the Forgetting and return Dreamlight Valley to its former greatness by making it your own. In Dreamlight Valley, you can build the perfect neighborhood that is just for you with a fully customizable layout, creative landscaping, and thousands of decorative items. 
Will you settle on the Beach next to Moana, or call Buzz Lightyear your next-door neighbor in the Plaza?  

Express Your Disney Style 
Bring out your inner princess, villain, or Disney bounder! Assemble unique outfits and decorate your home with thousands of fantastic items. Using the Touch of Magic tool, you can even create your own designs with Disney- and Pixar-inspired decals! 
With the in-game Camera, get ready to snap a sunset selfie with Mirabel, capture a culinary creation with Remy, or simply cherish a moment.

A Game in Constant Evolution 
New content means that there's always something fresh to explore. Meet new characters in the Valley, check out the latest clothing and furniture collections in Scrooge’s Store, and complete challenging in-game events! Be sure to dream your way back to Dreamlight Valley regularly to discover new adventures!

70050000071155.name: Synth Riders: 80s Mixtape Side A Music Pack
70050000071155.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future
70050000071155.description:
80s Mixtape - Side A brings together some of our favorites from a time where the only things bigger than the hair were the hits!  We built this sensational compilation on five original chart-toppers from the New Wave decade which is such an inspiration for the neon immersive worlds of Synth Riders.

SONGS INCLUDE:
a-ha - "Take on Me" 
Starship - "We Built this City"
Devo - "Whip It” 
Phil Collins - "Sussudio" 
INXS - "New Sensation"

70050000071164.name: Synth Riders: Dua Lipa Music Pack
70050000071164.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future
70050000071164.description:
Turn up the volume and ride the beat with Dua Lipa Music Pack for Synth Riders.

This collection brings together some of Dua Lipa’s most iconic tracks. Each song is carefully mapped to match its unique rhythm and energy, offering a satisfying balance of precision, timing, and flow.

This music pack includes:
- "Don’t Start Now"
- "Levitating"
- "Physical"
- "Houdini"
- "Future Nostalgia"
- "Hallucinate"
- "These Walls"

What to expect:
- Choreographed maps designed for flow, style, and precision
- A vibrant, high-energy experience driven by music and timing
- Perfect for players of all skill levels, from casual riders to high-score chasers

Find your flow, stay on beat, and lose yourself in the music.

70050000071169.name: Synth Riders: Crypt of the NecroDancer Music Pack
70050000071169.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future
70050000071169.description:
Descend into the rhythm with a brand new music pack for Synth Riders, featuring official tracks from the acclaimed soundtrack of Crypt of the NecroDancer.

Every track is authentically brought into the experience, delivering fast-paced beats, challenging patterns, and an atmosphere that blends dark fantasy with neon energy.

This music pack includes:
- Official tracks from Crypt of the NecroDancer
- Maps built for flow, precision, and speed
- A unique crossover of underground dungeon vibes and immersive rhythm gameplay
- A fresh challenge for both new players and seasoned riders

Set List by Danny Baranowsky:
- "Disco Descent"
- "Konga Conga Kappa"
- "Rhythmortis"
- "Fungal Funk"
- "Styx and Stones"

Feel the beat. Stay in time. And remember… in the crypt, rhythm is everything.

70050000071171.name: UNO™ - Shovel Knight Theme
70050000071171.description:
Bring the heroic world of Shovel Knight to your UNO™ matches!

This cosmetic pack of 10 exclusive items transforms your game space with pixel-perfect art, a chiptune soundtrack, and iconic characters straight from the legendary 8-bit style action-adventure game.

Equip the full set or mix and match your favorite relics to create a play space worthy of a true hero!

The Shovel Knight Cosmetic Pack includes:
•	1 game board: A 3D pixel art scene where players gather around a warm campfire deep in the woods.
•	1 card deck: 16 unique designs, each showcasing fan-favorite faces from the Shovel Knight universe.
•	1 chiptune music track: A beloved theme from Shovel Knight’s soundtrack.
•	4 avatars: Portraits of 4 iconic characters.
•	1 avatar frame.
•	1 shiny Action/Wild Card visual effect.
•	1 stylized “UNO!” call to match the mood.

This pack is purely cosmetic and does not affect gameplay.

70050000071174.name: "Azure Striker Gunvolt" Crossover Character Skin
70050000071174.description: Adds a playable character skin from the "Azure Striker Gunvolt" series.

70050000071183.name: Cat Girl Survivor – Additional Character "Leah"
70050000071183.intro:
A new playable character joins the adventure.
Scatter spirit-hunting paint and detonate it to defeat enemies.
70050000071183.description:
A new playable character, “Leah”, joins Cat Girl Survivor.

Leah is the younger sister of Leo and the second cat of a mysterious family of genius exorcists. She joins the adventure as a powerful new ally.

Leah fights by scattering special spirit-hunting paint around her and detonating it to damage enemies across the battlefield.

Although she is even stronger than her brother Leo, Leah is still young and loves to sleep, so she doesn’t easily set out on adventures.

Give Leah a little allowance so she can buy her favorite dango and convince her to join your journey.

She will become a powerful ally well worth the dango.

*This content requires the base game “Cat Girl Survivor” to play.*

70050000071185.name: Extra Pack feat. Special DLC
70050000071185.description:
A special expansion pack!
Includes songs by the three members of V.I.P!
Hum along to some brand-new melodies!

 [Included Songs]
"Sekai-Chan and Kafu-Chan's Otsukai Gassoukyoku" (SEKAI & KAFU & COKO)
"Live" (KAFU)
"Be, Be, Be, Be!" (SEKAI)
"Kyu-Kurarin" (KAFU)
"It's Okay Now"(KAFU)

70050000071186.name: Extra Pack feat. Animation Vol.1
70050000071186.description:
A special expansion pack!
Includes songs by the five members of V.W.P!
Hum along to some brand-new melodies!

[Included Songs]
"DIVA" (V.W.P)
"Chase the Day" (V.W.P)
"BREATHE" (Isekaijoucho)
"INSIGHT" (RIM)
"distance"(Harusaruhi)

70050000071189.name: Extra Pack feat. Animation Vol.2
70050000071189.description:
A special expansion pack!
Includes songs by the five members of V.W.P!
Hum along to some brand-new melodies!

 [Included Songs]
"Shangri-la" (KOKO)
"Unraveling" (KAF)
"Desire" (V.W.P)
"Lights" (V.W.P)
"Witch(True) sinka ver"(V.W.P)

70050000071203.name: Personal Boards 7
70050000071203.intro: Create your own colorful stories with the latest DLC!
70050000071203.description: Unlock new boards where you can draw your own stories.

70050000071239.name: CONTRABAND BORDER POLICE SIMULATOR: New Skybox
70050000071239.intro: Every horizon tells a new story of duty and tension.
70050000071239.description:
Take your border duty to a new level! This DLC introduces a brand-new skybox, transforming the visual atmosphere of your checkpoint with dynamic skies, varied lighting conditions, and a more immersive environment.

The updated visuals enhance the tension of each decision, making your daily routine more engaging and realistic. Whether you’re stopping smugglers or facing difficult moral choices, the new skybox adds depth and mood to every moment on duty.

Step into your role beneath a constantly changing sky, and experience the border like never before.

70050000071245.name: Portraits Pack 3
70050000071245.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70050000071245.description: Expand your collection of puzzles with 6 new illustrations, that will make you feel excited about the unexpected meetings of unforgettable strangers.

70050000071249.name: Rooms Pack 1
70050000071249.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70050000071249.description:
Add more variety to your game with new rooms! What if all the cats wanted to fit in one box in your office? Or bathroom? Or an art room?
In the Rooms Pack 1 DLC, you’ll find 5 brand new rooms perfect for playing with cats!

70050000071254.name: Homes Pack
70050000071254.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70050000071254.description:
Have you ever thought about changing the main menu look in games so it fits your aesthetics? Now you can!
Homes Pack DLC allows you to change houses that contain all the levels. Pick the one you like the most or change them according to your mood!

70050000071291.name: Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000071291.description: The Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings™ Game includes enhanced resolution and improved frame rates.

70050000071294.name: Demon Castle Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade pack
70050000071294.description: A paid upgrade pack that allows you to upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of Demon Castle Story to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Demon Castle Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70050000071304.name: Premium DLC "Sakura Miku"
70050000071304.intro: New additional content based on Sakura Miku is now available!
70050000071304.description:
Special Sakura Miku costumes for Miku, cherry blossom-themed shared costumes, and room items based on Sakura Miku are now available!
Work together with Sakura Miku to complete the special puzzles!

70050000071308.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 10
70050000071308.description:
Relive the golden age of pinball with Williams™ Pinball Volume 10! This amazing collection brings together the iconic Diner™ pinball table with the first ever official recreation of Fire!™ and Comet™. 

This pack features:

Comet™: Ride the rails of a carnival classic! Race around the Comet Ramp, and chase high scores under the glow of flashing midway lights. 

Fire!™: Sound the alarm! Race against time to put out fires and rescue victims across a unique mirrored playfield, glowing with the heat of action.

Diner™: Step into the charm of a classic American diner. Collect the D-I-N-E-R lights by serving cranky customers to unlock Dine-Time for massive scores.

70050000071325.name: Flags Modes Pack
70050000071325.intro: Can you name each country just by looking at its national flag?
70050000071325.description:
This DLC package adds the following game modes in the Flags category:

• German States
• Swiss Cantons
• French Regions
• Italian Regions
• Historical
• Japanese Prefectures
• Russian Regions
• Spanish Regions

70050000071330.name: Symbols Modes Pack
70050000071330.intro: Play a collection of game modes exploring national animals, anthems, mottos and more! Also contains various regional/state symbols.
70050000071330.description:
This DLC package adds the following game modes in the Symbols category:

• Countries/National Animals
• Countries/National Trees
• Countries/National Anthems
• Countries/National Slogans
• US States/State Slogans
• US States/State Flowers
• US States/State Birds

70050000071334.name: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y - Expansion Pack
70050000071334.description:
The Expansion Pack includes the following content:
• 8 Playable Units*
- Ideon
- Hi-Nu Gundam
- Nightingale
- Imber
- Tauburn Compartment
- Villkiss
- Urs Ragnar
- Nirvash Z
*Rewarded upon completion of Area Missions
• Additional missions
- 26 Area Missions
- 15 On-board Missions
• Assist Crew Members
-Sugata & Wako
• 1 Special Mission
• [MASTER] Difficulty Mode
- Grants access to the MASTER difficulty. Designed to heighten the challenge of SUPER ROBOT WARS Y, this mode features strengthened enemies while allies will face increased upgrade costs and reduced experience gained. Additionally, repairing or resupplying units will no longer grant experience points.

70050000071424.name: Cool Shades

70050000071462.name: Fantasy Pack
70050000071462.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70050000071462.description: Don’t you love to escape into the world of dragons, elves, and magic? Cozy puzzles with castles, princesses, potions, and creatures are here to turn your ordinary evenings into fantastical adventures. Get enchanted by the 10 new levels of Softly Placed Fantasy Pack!

70050000071464.name: Pets Pack
70050000071464.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70050000071464.description:
Every home is a bit empty without at least one pet. Give cute inhabitants furry friends and equip them with food, toys, accessories, and more! 
Enhance your My Little Haven experience with 20 brand new items of Pets DLC!

70050000071467.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods
70050000071467.intro: Explore the Honeyglow Woods, and reconnect with Disney's Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore and Piglet in a brand-new Adventure Pack!
70050000071467.description:
Includes 2,000 Moonstones 

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods is a brand-new Adventure Pack for Disney Dreamlight Valley, perfect for newcomers to the Valley or seasoned Dreamlight players. Befriend 3 beloved Winnie the Pooh Characters, explore and decorate 4 brand-new areas, and solve puzzles in the mysterious Everoak Tree. Reconnect with childlike curiosity, rediscover the joys of friendship with a playful game of Pooh Sticks, and bring a touch of honey to your Valley as you perfect the art of beekeeping, which unlocks dozens of new crafting recipes!


Meet Friends Old and New
Deep within Dreamlight Valley lies the Honeyglow Woods, where you once spent lazy afternoons with long-lost friends.  Rediscover this idyllic place, and you’ll quickly find Winnie the Pooh, radiating with optimism even on the gloomiest days. Nearby, the courageous Piglet is ready to face his fears, and the thoughtful Eeyore quietly accepts the Woods' melancholy... though a little cheering up would be most welcome!
This whimsical world isn't just about reconnecting with old friends; you'll also be making new ones. Befriend a delightful family of colorful hedgehogs, ready to join you on your adventures.


A Touch of Sweetness
At the heart of the Honeyglow Woods lies its golden secret: honey! Learn the art of beekeeping, crafting Busy Bees’ Houses and placing them among vibrant flowers to gather Golden Honey. Use it to create whimsical Honeyglow Furniture, bake delicious treats, and unlock new recipes. You'll soon be spreading a little sweetness to every corner of the Valley.


The Mystery of the Everoak Tree
The Everoak Tree stands tall in the middle of the Woods, surrounded by four entirely unique, enchanting areas. Wander through Drowsybloom Acre, venture into the blooming Braveheart Grove, wade through the delightfully swampy Gloommeadow, and step into the Nectar Apiary and its giant honeycombs. As you restore each area and uncover the secrets within the Everoak Tree, you'll mend the land and unravel the mystery at the heart of the Honeyglow Woods.


A brand-new mini-game!

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods includes a brand-new mini-game you can play with all your Villagers: Pooh Sticks, inspired by the game as it appears in classic Winnie the Pooh stories! To play Pooh Sticks, find a bridge in the Gloommeadow and gather four Villagers. Each will choose an object and drop it over the bridge downstream. Whoever's object reaches the finish line on the river first wins! Pooh Sticks is a wholesome new way of creating lasting friendship bonds with your friends and neighbors in the Valley.

70050000071486.name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals - Portrait Pack "Maid Cafe on Electric Street"
70050000071486.description:

Enjoy a relaxing life on a tropical island.

70050000071512.name: Midnight Drifter-Drift Racing Car Racing Driving Simulator 2023 Speed Games: New Car

Designed for precision, style, and performance, it’s perfect for mastering tight corners and pulling off smooth, high-speed drifts. Customize its appearance, fine-tune its performance, and make it your ultimate drift machine.

Hit the streets, show off your skills, and dominate every drift with your new ride!

70050000071514.name: Car Racing Highway Driving Simulator, Real Parking Driver Sim Speed Traffic Deluxe 2022 – Vehicle Boost
70050000071514.intro: Feel the rush of high-speed driving and take control of the highway.
70050000071514.description:

Built for speed and precision, this high-performance vehicle is perfect for overtaking traffic and enjoying even more intense highway moments. Feel the thrill of fast acceleration, precise handling, and a sleek design built for drivers who love high-speed action.

Start the engine, hit the road, and prove your skills on the highway!

70050000071537.name: Cozy Collector

70050000071537.description: With these cute animals fun never ends! Train your perceptiveness with 10 brand new, cozy levels! Can you spot all the differences in the rooms filled with cute items and adorable residents?

70050000071546.name: Star Ores Inc. - Supporter Pack
70050000071546.intro: Unlock three exclusive decorative items and the digital Star Ores Inc. book!
70050000071546.description:
Looking to add more flair to your space station?
This exclusive pack unlocks three brand-new decorative items for your decoration blueprint terminal, perfect for giving your station a personal touch.

STAT-O-MAT
The Stat-O-Mat tracks without mercy: how many products you’ve sold, how many customers you’ve made happy, and how many you sent off into galactic disappointment empty-handed. A device for those who love numbers. Or guilt.

GREENFLAME BULB
Rare plant with central fruit. Responds to D64 laser with a brief green flame burst. Presumably ionic, not thermal.

COIN FOUNTAIN
This decorative device launches a shower of coins into the air whenever someone walks by, like a fountain, but with more return on investment. Officially, it serves to motivate the crew. Unofficially, it’s a popular hangout for Erfis with a hunger for pocket change.

Star Ores Inc. – The Official Book
Want to learn more about Star Ores Inc., its characters, and the long-forgotten station? Then you’re in the right place!
This official companion book includes:

The Station’s Backstory
Written by Ben Calvin Hary (currently lead writer at PERRY RHODAN, among others).
Discover who originally built the station, why it drifted abandoned through space for 350 years - and what all of that does to the sensitive emotion chips of a little robot named B.O.B.I.

Entrepreneur’s Station Handout
The unofficial but highly practical quick-start guide for all newly minted station operators!
Everything you need to know about the modern (well… 350-year-old) facilities, amenities, and automated support bots (like B.O.B.I.s and F3000-I ore units - aka Erfis).
A must-read for anyone curious about what actually works on their shiny-almost-new station — and what only runs on sheer optimism.
(Be honest: it was cheap, and you couldn’t afford anything better anyway.)

Morey Millers Mining & Processing Product Portfolio
(Formerly known as the Morey Millers Mining & Processing Product Catalog - but hey, marketing needs to justify its salary somehow.)
The must-have reference for anyone who wants to dig deeper - literally.
From the Deep Core Drill Mk IV to the latest Smelt-O-Tron models and automated forge cores, this guide has everything a prospector could dream of.
Perfect for turning your mine into a thriving business - or at least impressing the Trader’s Guild with your contributions.


Experience the world of Star Ores Inc. like never before - with backstories, in-universe manuals, and plenty of tongue-in-cheek commentary.
Perfect for fans, collectors, and anyone curious about what really lurks beneath the surface.

70050000071549.name: Sci-Fi Pack
70050000071549.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.

70050000071635.intro: Turn ordinary streets into your personal stunt arena.

Every ride becomes a fresh experience as your bike’s colors, parts, and accessories are automatically varied, giving you unique combinations every time. Elevate your extreme cycling experience — endless style, endless fun!

70050000071640.name: Formula Legends : Iconic Tracks
70050000071640.intro: Expand your Formula Legends experience with the Iconic Tracks Pack. Master Austria, Malaysia, and Bahrain across multiple eras, from Vintage classics to modern precision.
70050000071640.description:
Three countries. Decades of racing history. Countless legendary laps.
Expand your Formula Legends experience with the Iconic Tracks Pack. Master Austria across three eras — Vintage, Classic, and Modern. Take on Malaysia in its Classic form, and test your skills on Bahrain, featuring both Classic and Modern variations. 3 legendary circuits, spanning multiple eras:

Malaysia – Classic, Modern
Bahrain – Modern
Era-accurate presentation: Relive the evolution of racing, from historic machines to modern precision.
New career challenges: Push your mastery across decades of motorsport history.
Time Trials & Leaderboards: Compete with the global community for the fastest laps.
Fully integrated: Career and Quick Race modes — history rewards mastery.

Precision, courage, and speed will define your legacy.

70050000071641.name: Formula Legends : Historic Tracks Pack
70050000071641.intro: Expand your Formula Legends experience with historic and modern variations of legendary circuits, including San Marino Motorsports Park, Dutch Dunes Circuit, and Hatchwood Circuit.
70050000071641.description:
Relive the evolution of Formula racing with the Historic Tracks Pack for Formula Legends.

Take on three legendary circuits inspired by iconic motorsport destinations, each recreated across multiple eras of racing history. From unforgiving vintage layouts to refined modern configurations, every track offers a unique challenge and a distinct racing atmosphere.

Delve into the special dungeons of the Mega Mole Hole where you'll only encounter monsters you've befriended before. You select the ranks and families of the monsters that appear in the dungeon to increase your chances of meeting the exact ones you want.

If you need a monster that only shows itself at a certain location at a specific time, or is otherwise only obtainable through synthesis, you can use the Mega Mole Hole to make an easier time of befriending it.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check Additional Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the main characters have obtained the Zoom spell during the main story.

70050000071755.name: Monster Marathons
70050000071755.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

In Monster Marathons, you send out a party on an expedition mini game, instructing your monsters when to run and jump as you guide them to their destination. The farther your monsters travel, the more experience points and gold coins they'll earn, and the more crafting items they'll be able to pick up.

Along the way, your party will run into enemy monsters. The only way to avoid them, and go as far as you can, is with perfectly timed jumps and expertly controlled speed.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check Additional Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the main characters have obtained the Zoom spell during the main story.

70050000071756.name: Metallic Ring
70050000071756.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

The metallic ring is a special item you can use while out exploring to turn all the enemies in the area into metal monsters* or hunter mechs. You can use the metallic ring as many times as you like, but you'll have to wait 30 in-game minutes between uses.

The effects of the metallic ring wear off after some time has passed or if you leave your current area.

Depending on when you use the metallic ring, you may encounter monsters that provide far more experience points than otherwise available at that stage in the story. So whether you're just starting out or have already completed the main story, you can use the metallic ring to quickly and effectively boost your monsters' experience points.

*The metal monsters are metal slimes, liquid metal slimes and metal king slimes.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check Additional Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the second main area of story has been completed.

70050000071757.name: Scout Run VIP Card
70050000071757.description:
Downloadable content for DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.

The Scout Run VIP card is an exclusive item that makes using the Scout Run* even more rewarding. While the Scout Run is available in the base game, this item provides a range of extra benefits, including a bigger allowance of scouty snacks, more monsters appearing at one time, and a reduced wait time between uses.

*With the Scout Run feature, you use special items called "scouty snacks" to befriend monsters without having to enter battle. You can use this feature as many times as you like, but you have to wait a short while between uses.

- This content does not include the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World.
- This content and other bonuses are available as part of the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION and the DLC 4-ITEM SET. Please bear this in mind to avoid making duplicate purchases.
- You can claim this content by selecting "Check Additional Content" from the in-game menu screen.
- The content will be available to use only after the Scout Run has been unlocked during the main story.

70050000071888.intro: Invest, upgrade, and race without being held back.

Jumpstart your journey with a powerful financial boost! With this DLC, your in-game balance is increased by 200,000, giving you more freedom to upgrade your cars, unlock tuning parts, and dive deeper into the racing experience without delay.

Use your extra funds to experiment with builds, improve performance, and dominate both drift and drag challenges right from the start. Whether you’re perfecting your setup or expanding your garage, this boost helps you focus on what matters most—mastering the roads and becoming a drifting legend.

Gain a head start and accelerate your progress from the very beginning.

70050000071898.name: Ultimate Moto Bike Simulator: New Bike
70050000071898.intro: Control the bike, master the terrain, and dominate the ride.
70050000071898.description:
Expand your experience with additional content designed to enhance gameplay, progression, and overall player enjoyment. This DLC offers Bike Stratos Strike. If you have previously purchased Bike Stratos Strike separately, the equivalent value will be reimbursed.

Continue your journey across challenging terrains, unlock new possibilities, and enjoy an even more complete motocross experience with expanded content and improved progression.

70050000071903.name: ONLY UP! CARS: Bonus Coins
70050000071903.intro: Elevate your experience and keep climbing without limits.
70050000071903.description:
Gain an extra boost to accelerate your progress and expand your options throughout the experience. With this DLC, you will receive 30,000 coins, giving you more freedom to unlock new vehicles, apply upgrades, and customize your cars as you take on increasingly challenging vertical tracks.

Whether you’re looking to unlock more options, upgrade faster, or simply enjoy a smoother progression, this pack gives you the flexibility to make the most of every challenge.

Climb higher, upgrade faster, and take full control of your vertical driving experience!

70050000071904.name: Starter Pack
70050000071904.intro: Enjoy in-game extras with this Starter Pack bundle
70050000071904.description: The Pokémon Champions Starter Pack bundle* includes storage space for 50 additional Pokémon, 30 Teammate Tickets, and 50 Training Tickets. You’ll also get the “Battle! (Trainer Battle)” song featured in the Pokémon: Let’s Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let’s Go, Eevee games!

70050000071911.name: Turmoil - Deeper Underground
70050000071911.intro: Visit two new areas and discover new gameplay that you’ve never seen before in Turmoil!
70050000071911.description:
We’re excited to introduce you to Turmoil - Deeper Underground!

• An all-new town with new buildings, a new mayor, and balloon trips to special deep-drilling grounds!
• Besides oil, you can now also find water underground – which comes in handy when you want to drill faster and cheaper! But it’s also essential for the production of the highly valuable petrol!
• Petrol marks the start of a new era. You can’t just dig it up and sell it right away; you first have to produce it in refineries. It’s a challenging but rewarding undertaking, and we trust there will be no complaints about the revenues it generates!
• A brand new expedition: Every few in-game years, regular drilling levels are alternated with special research missions. Here, it’s all about trying to drill as deep as possible with limited resources. Can you drill deeper than your opponents?
• Two new playable characters to choose from: meet Thorpe and Mabel! Both willing and able!
• To get your drilling operation up and running as quickly as possible, meet Yvonne, Sanjay, and Dynamite Dale who will introduce you to their new wares! And of course your old friends Edward, Raynor, Fred, and William will stop by with their train to provide you with all the drilling equipment you need.
• Philip is also back, and he’s got a new game for you: Dice Dice Dice. If you can outsmart him, you’re sure to make a few extra bucks on the side.
• Just like previous campaigns, it’s all about who has the most town shares in the end. Deeper Underground uses the same bidding system as in the multiplayer campaign, but shares can also be earned in the deep-drilling missions.
• And last but not least: we’ve added an explosive item to the game, dynamite! While hard rock can be nice when it comes out of speakers, it’s a big problem when you stumble upon it underground. Normal drills are not strong enough, so make sure to visit Dynamite Dale in the Saloon!

70050000071912.name: New Character: Samael
70050000071912.description:
Please update the game to the latest version first.After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete her story missions to recruit her into your squad.

Samael, the “Angel of Death” in the heavens, has always been fiercely loyal. She faithfully follows divine will, guiding those on the brink of death to either Heaven or Hell. One day, she encountered a person protected by “Divine Light” and was unable to take their soul. She returned empty-handed and was reprimanded by God. Even after telling the truth, she received no understanding—only harsher punishment. Anger ignited within the once-loyal Samael, and when Lucifer rose in rebellion, she turned her resentment into fury and raised the banner of defiance.

Samael’s abilities are highly explosive. She burns her own life force to convert it into attack power, using her powerful execution skills to send the dying straight to Hell.

70050000071913.name: New Character: Lucifer
70050000071913.description:
Please update the game to the latest version first. After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete her story missions to recruit her into your squad.

As someone who holds immense power, she possesses profound wisdom and unique ideas. She begins to question God’s decisions and the way everything operates, standing on equal footing with the heavens and even the divine.

Lucifer’s skills and abilities are designed around the concept of “Omnipotence.” Her skills and talents are truly one of a kind, offering a highly flexible and diverse set of combinations that allow her to handle any situation.

70050000071929.name: My Summer Drive: Budget Boost
70050000071929.intro: Build your path with a more powerful, steady, and confident start.
70050000071929.description:
Kickstart your journey with an extra financial boost. You will receive $5,000, giving you more freedom to upgrade your car, purchase essential parts, and manage your survival more effectively from the very beginning.

Whether you want to speed up progress or simply enjoy a smoother start, this pack helps you stay one step ahead in a world where every decision counts.

Get a head start, make smarter choices, and build your perfect ride without limitations!

70050000071936.name: Rooms Pack 2
70050000071936.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70050000071936.description:
Enhance your cat fitting experience with brand new room backgrounds! Pick the one that fits your mood and enjoy the cozy gameplay tailored to your needs.
In the Rooms Pack 2 DLC, you’ll find 5 new, themed rooms perfect to play with cats!

70050000072032.intro: Expand your base with improved resources and better efficiency.

This DLC adds 5000 in-game currency to help you kickstart and expand your recycling operations. Gain extra funds to invest in equipment, hire workers, upgrade your base, and accelerate your progress as you grow your business.

70050000072450.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner: Financial Boost

70050000072483.name: Chippy&Noppo – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000072483.intro: Let's assemble a toy with two guys with different personalities!
70050000072483.description:
•Carry the parts and assemble a toy according to the plan!
"Chippy and Noppo" is an action puzzle that assembles parts into a toy!
Collect the parts in the factory, process the colors and shapes, and make the same toy as the blueprint.
"Even if it's a little different, you might be able to clear it...!?
Because the factory manager is a bit careless."

•Let's join the power of two guys with different personalities!
Cheerful "Chippy" is good in low places.
Tall and easy-going "Noppo" is good at jumping.
The key to clarifying the game is the cooperation of both, using their individuality to split roles, and more!

In solo play, operate two guys at the same time!
Operate well and aim for the fastest clear!
In multiplayer, operate "Chippy" and "Noppo" respectively.
This is a place where you can chat, so let's play while talking to friends and family!

•A lot of fun in the factory!
The factory is full of machines!
Let's make full use of the machine by processing the color and shape of the parts, using them for moving, and more!

・Just like athletic!?
There are also factories that need action, like climbing high scaffolds, getting around at the right time, and not just assembling!

・Work at various factories!
Progress in the game, factories in the woods and seas will appear!
Let's assemble a toy that matches the image of the factory!

What kind of toys are those two really good friends going to make,
and what kind of future are they going to make?

Buy this upgrade pack to add more features and enhancements for play on Nintendo Switch™ 2 to the Chippy&Noppo you already have.

A flashlight with unlimited battery life will be added to your inventory. If you already own a flashlight, it will be automatically upgraded to use an infinite power source, removing the need to manage or replace batteries during gameplay.

Personalize your character with a subtle but distinctive cosmetic detail. This DLC adds painted nails for the main character, allowing you to give your prison experience a more unique visual style.

Stand out with a customized appearance while navigating the harsh realities of prison life. Refine your look with a small detail that makes a noticeable difference, enhancing your character’s individuality.

Add a personal touch to your journey and express your style in a more distinctive way!

70050000072516.name: Kanjozoku 2 - Drift Car Games: Money Boost
70050000072516.intro: Accelerate your rise to ultimate street domination.
70050000072516.description:
Start your engines with a powerful advantage! This DLC adds 250,000 to your balance, giving you the freedom to upgrade, customize, and push your cars to the limit.

Step deeper into the underground world of Kanjo racing with more resources at your disposal. Fine-tune your engine, enhance performance, and build the ultimate JDM machine without restrictions.

Take control, invest wisely, and become the racer no one can catch.

70050000072521.name: Viking Colony Builder Valhalla: Golden Start
70050000072521.intro: Forge your empire with gold already fueling your ambitions.
70050000072521.description:
Every great Viking saga begins with the right resources. This DLC gives your colony an immediate advantage from the very first moment — at the start of each new game, 150 gold coins are automatically added to your treasury, ready to be put to work.

Use your golden head start to construct key buildings sooner, secure vital resources faster, or strengthen your defenses before the first threats arrive.

In the world of Valhalla, fortune favors the bold — and the prepared.

70050000072575.name: Citizen Sleeper – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000072575.intro: ROLEPLAYING IN THE RUINS OF INTERPLANETARY CAPITALISM
70050000072575.description:
Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of Tabletop RPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

ABOUT THIS GAME
One of 2022’s most acclaimed indies, the Game Awards-nominated Citizen Sleeper is a Tabletop-inspired narrative RPG set on Erlin’s Eye, a ruined space station that is home to thousands of people trying to survive on the edges of an interstellar capitalist society.

You are a sleeper, a digitised human consciousness in an artificial body, owned by a corporation that wants you back. Thrust amongst the unfamiliar and colourful inhabitants of the Eye, you need to build friendships, earn your keep, and navigate the factions of this strange metropolis, if you hope to survive to see the next cycle.

ROLL THE DICE. DO THE WORK. GET PAID. SURVIVE.
Inspired by Tabletop Roleplaying games, Citizen Sleeper uses Dice, Clocks and Drives. Each cycle you use the dice you are dealt to choose what to do with your time. Make or break alliances, uncover truths and escape your hunters. Survive and ultimately thrive, one cycle at a time.

TURN UP FOR YOUR FRIENDS
The station plays host to characters from all walks of life, trying to eke out an existence among the stars. Salvagers, engineers, hackers, bartenders, street-food vendors, each has a history which brought them here. You choose which of them you wish to help, and together you will shape your future.

ACCESS THEIR SECRETS
Eventually, you will learn to use your dice to hack into the station’s cloud to access decades of digital data, uncover new areas and unlock secrets. This is your unique power, and with it you can change your future. Corporate secrets, rogue AIs and troves of lost data await those willing to dive into the depths of the station’s networks.

YOU WERE MADE TO DIE
Essen-Arp: to them you are just property, one more asset in a portfolio that stretches across the stars. You are the product of an abusive system, in a universe where humanity’s expansion is marked by exploitation and extraction. Escape the makers of your decaying body, and chart your own path in a richly imagined, deeply relevant sci-fi world which explores ideas of precarity, personhood and freedom.

THE COMPLETE EXPERIENCE
Citizen Sleeper now includes all three post-launch DLC episodes FLUX, REFUGE and PURGE, which expand the game and introduce additional characters and locations to Erlin’s Eye in an exciting new late game storyline.

70050000072583.name: Cop Car Police Simulator Chase: Capital Boost
70050000072583.intro: The best officers are always prepared — financially and otherwise.
70050000072583.description:
Every good officer knows that being prepared makes all the difference. This DLC gives your career an immediate boost — 10,000 is added to your balance, giving you the financial head start you need to focus on what matters most: keeping the streets safe.

Use your extra funds to get ahead faster, unlock new opportunities, and build the foundation of a career worthy of the badge.

A stronger start. A better officer. A safer city.

70050000072587.name: Subway Simulator 2025 - City Train: New Style
70050000072587.intro: The underground just got a little more colorful.
70050000072587.description:
Every detail matters when you’re behind the controls. This DLC brings a fresh visual upgrade to your subway experience — transforming the appearance of the train benches into a bold, striking red that stands out against the familiar underground backdrop.

A simple change with a noticeable impact. The red seats add a new layer of personality to your cabin, making every journey feel slightly different — whether you’re navigating peak-hour chaos or cruising through the quiet of a late-night line.

A fresh look for every journey, every station, every shift.

70050000072595.name: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter Pack
70050000072595.description:
Pre-order Bonus: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter Pack

70050000072644.name: Primitive Life Simulator: Survival Boost
70050000072644.intro: Adapt, survive, and lead your tribe to greatness.
70050000072644.description:
Survival in the prehistoric world starts with one thing — food. This DLC gives your tribe an immediate advantage by adding 15 pieces of meat directly to your inventory the moment you start, ensuring your people are fed and ready to face whatever the wild throws at them.

With a full stock of meat already in hand, you can focus on what matters most — building shelters, crafting tools, exploring the environment, and developing your tribe — without worrying about hunger slowing you down in the critical early stages of survival.

In the prehistoric world, a well-fed tribe is a thriving tribe.

70050000072647.name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000072647.description:
This upgrade pack upgrades Lorelei and the Laser Eyes for Nintendo Switch™ to Lorelei and the Laser Eyes – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

A woman, summoned by an eccentric man to participate in a project in an old hotel somewhere in central Europe, becomes embroiled in a game of illusions, increasingly dangerous and surreal.

Now you are invited to fall into the same rabbit hole, in a non-linear mystery with an immense amount of handcrafted puzzles, constantly presenting you with new riddles to solve, each leading you closer to deciphering the enigma of Lorelei and the Laser Eyes.

70050000072648.name: Sayonara Wild Hearts - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000072648.description:
This upgrade pack upgrades Sayonara Wild Hearts for Nintendo Switch™ to Sayonara Wild Hearts – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.

Sayonara Wild Hearts is a dreamy arcade game about riding motorcycles, skateboarding, dance battling, shooting lasers, wielding swords, and breaking hearts at 200 mph.

As the heart of a young woman breaks, the balance of the universe is disturbed. A diamond butterfly appears in her dreams and leads her through a highway in the sky, where she finds her other self: the masked biker called The Fool.

Journey through a custom-written pop soundtrack, chase scores, and set out to find the harmony of the universe, hidden away in the hearts of Little Death and her star-crossed allies: Dancing Devils, Howling Moons, Stereo Lovers and Hermit 64.

Let’s Pop!

70050000072752.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!

70050000072754.name: Cozy Gardener Simulator: Bloom Hammer

70050000072773.name: Gladiators Simulator : The Champions of Liberty – Coins of Glory

70050000072773.description:
Step into the ruthless world of ancient Rome, where gladiators clash for glory and freedom. This DLC grants 2500 coins to strengthen your fighters, upgrade weapons and armor, and expand your arena. Train new gladiators, prepare for fierce battles, and rise to become the ultimate champion in the eyes of the crowd.

Every coin brings you closer to mastery—use them wisely and let your legend echo through the sands of the arena.

70050000072777.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Slash Character DLC
70050000072777.intro: Calm and collected until his Rage is unleashed! Play as fan-favorite Slash, the mutant snapping Turtle who stomps his way through all enemies in his path.
70050000072777.description:
MIGHTY MUTANT
Slash joins the fight at last! Towering over friends and foes alike, he makes a formidable opponent against Shredder's army. Claw, body slam, and roll through enemies with ease, using Slash's knockback abilities to level the playing field. What he lacks in speed he more than makes up for in fortitude. Wondering how to best play with Slash? He has affinity with Water and Ooze powers, but make the most of his skills by exploring others, too.


UNLEASH THE BEAST
Tap into Slash's Enraged mode - his special ability allows him to move faster and deal extra damage over a short period of time, making him a force of nature. Call down a meteoric explosion using his Tool to deal Dark damage to nearby enemies.

70050000072911.name: Pirate Simulator – Corsair Skull & Sails: Elite Crew

Stand out in every naval battle and on-deck duel while continuing your quest to lift the curse. Make every voyage unforgettable with a vessel that reflects your crew’s legacy. Dominate the seas with style and power.

70050000072915.name: Cleaning Pack

70050000072915.description: Don’t let your Freaky Trip be over – expand your experience with 3 new, cleaning-themed illustrations for the sliding puzzle game.

70050000072920.name: Mint And Chocolate Bars
70050000072920.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70050000072920.description: Chores never felt so sweet before! Refresh your laundry interiors with the Mint and Chocolate Bars DLC.

70050000072921.name: Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor: Survivor’s Treasure
70050000072921.intro: Transform your dinosaurs into unstoppable predators.
70050000072921.description:
Strengthen your dinosaur journey from the very beginning with an enormous resource boost! This DLC grants you everything you need to evolve faster, upgrade your abilities, and conquer the wild lands with ease.

This DLC includes:
 • 1,000,000 Bones – Use them to upgrade your dinosaur’s power, skills, speed, and survival abilities.
 • 10,000 Gold – Unlock premium upgrades, unique skins, and valuable progression bonuses.

Rise stronger, evolve faster, and become the ultimate ruler of the prehistoric era.

70050000072937.name: Skyship Quest Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade pack
70050000072937.description: A paid upgrade pack that allows you to upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of Skyship Quest Story to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Skyship Quest Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70050000072967.name: Firefighter:Car Fire Truck Sim Driving 2022 Simulator: Rescue Funds
70050000072967.intro: Power up your firefighting skills and gear for ultimate efficiency.
70050000072967.description:
Get an instant boost to your firefighting career! This DLC adds 50,000 to your balance, giving you the resources to upgrade your equipment, vehicles, and firefighting gear faster. Step into the boots of a real firefighter and experience the thrill of saving lives across more than 30 detailed locations.

Every second counts — put on your uniform, start your fire truck, and save lives with enhanced resources at your disposal!

70050000072983.name: Blood: Refreshed Supply™ - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000072983.description: Upgrade from the Nintendo Switch™ software Blood: Refreshed Supply™ to Blood: Refreshed Supply™ – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition!

70050000072984.name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000072984.description:
The highly anticipated sequel to one of 2022’s most acclaimed RPGs!

You are a sleeper, an emulation of a human mind housed in an artificial body. You are on the run from the corporation that made you and the gang that seeks to control you. Commandeer a ship, build a network of crew and allies, and take on challenging contracts as you seek to build a future for yourself.

Choose a class, configure your skills and assemble your crew in unique tabletop-inspired gameplay. Your future depends on the roll of a dice, as you make difficult choices in a complex world. Reinventing the award-winning systems of Citizen Sleeper, this RPG will satisfy both fans of the original game and new players alike.

STAY AHEAD OF YOUR PAST
After a desperate attempt to free yourself from servitude by rewriting the very code that governs your system, you are on the run again, this time with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past.

REBOOT / REBUILD / REPAIR
Citizen Sleeper’s revolutionary dice system returns, revised for the sequel. Manage your stress or take damage to your dice. Deal with glitches as they accrue in your system. Push yourself to get lucky and make this cycle count.

PUSH YOUR LUCK
Each character class now has a unique “Push” ability that can help you turn the tide of a difficult job or send you into a dangerous spiral depending on how and when you choose to use it. Reroll your dice to change your fate, or focus a single die to bet everything on a big success.

NAVIGATE THE BELT
Chart a course from hub to hub with complete freedom, taking on jobs and setting goals as you see fit. A living world, the Starward Belt rewards curiosity and care, but it's up to you to decide which locations and stories deserve your time and resources.

DO THE JOB, GET PAID
Contracts offer a new kind of focussed, tactical gameplay to the Citizen Sleeper experience. You’ll need to prepare carefully and choose the right approach for these multi-cycle, high-risk, high-reward jobs, but you’ll also have to react and adapt to both the roll of the dice and the twists and turns of each task.

CHOOSE YOUR FUTURE
Player choice is a massive part of the Citizen Sleeper experience, and the sequel deepens this with new skill checks that allow you to express your class and character in scenes, as well as branching storylines that will ask you to make hard choices. The future of your character is up to you.

70050000073031.name: Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator: Bonus Funds
70050000073031.intro: Adventure, crafting, and building—now with extra funds.

Take your skills to the next level and explore more of the countryside.

70050000073034.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Visual Horizon
70050000073034.intro: Bring a darker, more immersive sky to the infected frontier.
70050000073034.description:
Every shift at the checkpoint now feels more immersive, as the horizon, clouds, and lighting create a distinct mood over the infected border.

This exclusive DLC replaces the standard skybox with a unique visual atmosphere. From tense inspections to critical life-or-death decisions, the new sky transforms the entire environment and adds a fresh visual identity to your survival experience.

Hold the line beneath a sky that changes the fate of every decision.

70050000073039.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands
70050000073039.intro: Move unseen, strike fast, and survive longer with camo-ready hands.

Customize your combat experience with a fresh military-inspired visual upgrade. This DLC changes the appearance of the player’s hands and gloves, transforming them into a camouflage green style built for modern warfare.

Perfect for intense firefights and tactical missions, this cosmetic upgrade adds a more authentic soldier look to every battle and helps immerse you deeper into the frontline action.

Stay sharp, stay hidden, and step onto the battlefield looking like a true elite operative.

70050000073045.name: CARD SHOP GAME STORE - TCG SIMULATOR: Urban Style
70050000073045.intro: Transform your shop into a landmark of urban expression.
70050000073045.description:
Refresh your trading card store with a bold street-style makeover! This DLC adds eye-catching graffiti designs to the exterior of your building, giving your shop a unique and vibrant identity that stands out in the city.

Turn your card shop into a true collector hotspot with colorful wall art, modern urban aesthetics, and a stylish atmosphere that reflects the passion of the trading card community.

Bring personality to your business and show customers that your store is unlike any other!

Every step brings you closer to the top—but now, the world above you is never the same.

70050000073279.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Elite Skins
70050000073279.intro: The border is changing, make sure you are ready to lead.
70050000073279.description:

The appearance of soldiers and scientists has been updated, giving a fresh and more immersive visual identity while maintaining the tense atmosphere of the outbreak.Subtle environmental and character updates enhance the sense of realism, making every checkpoint and interaction feel more grounded and dynamic.

Equip your team with the look of a true elite force. The border is changing—make sure you are ready to lead it.

70050000073284.name: Wukong Black Legend: Hero’s Weapon

Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world. This time with our new Ocean Blue Chessboard DLC.
