70050000073349.description: By purchasing this content, the Nintendo Switch™ software "Touhou Yukkuri Mountain" can be upgraded to "Touhou Yukkuri Mountain – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition".

70050000073413.name: READY OR DIE: MP5 SPECIALIST
70050000073413.description:
In a world of complex and evolving weaponry, sometimes the best solution is a proven classic. The MP5 Tactical Entry DLC brings to your elite team's arsenal the submachine gun that has defined SWAT operations for decades.

When split-seconds mean the difference between life and death, you need a weapon that prioritizes close-quarters control and surgical precision. The H&K MP5 is more than just a tool; it is a standard of professionalism for operators who choose to neutralize threats without compromising civilian safety.

Key DLC Features:
- Precision Under Pressure: Experience the controllable recoil and balanced rate of fire that made the MP5 the gold standard for hostage rescue missions.

- CQB Dominance: Optimized for room-clearing, the MP5 provides the mobility needed to navigate tight corridors and difficult fatal funnels with ease.

- Tactical Versatility: Adapt to your playstyle—whether you prefer silent infiltration or a dynamic, high-speed breach.

- Authentic Realism: Modeled with obsessive attention to detail, from the iconic metallic sound of the "HK slap" reload to the specific ballistics of the 9mm round.

Equip the weapon that wrote the history of global tactical units. Reclaim control from the chaos with unmatched precision.

The new mission demands a classic approach. Are you ready to breach?

70050000073419.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - Cyclops & The Thing
70050000073419.intro: Cyclops and The Thing are joining the fight against Annihilus!
70050000073419.description:
THE ROCK'EM & BLAST'EM CONNECTION!
Two new Super Heroes join the fight against Annihilus!
Play as The Fantastic Four’s The Thing and X-Men’s Cyclops alongside the 15 playables Super Hero from the base game.

TO ME, MY X-MEN!
You asked for it, and here he is: the no-nonsense leader of the X-Men blasts into battle! 
Cyclops' signature kinetic energy beams will pierce through the Annihilation Wave. As they can also be shot diagonally, Cyclops will be a perfect pick to counter aerial enemies – and catch opponents off guard.

IT'S CLOBBERIN' TIME!
The Fantastic Four’s heaviest hitter brings his cosmic radiation-induced might to the fray, excelling as a grappling-focused powerhouse. 
With surprising mobility allowing him to bounce across environments to get the jump on enemies, this former ace pilot embraces his new role as a tanklike protector of family and allies alike, arriving as an incredible asset to any team.

Together, Cyclops and Thing are a perfect match to handle on the ground action and aerial foes.

And stay tuned for more info on the second major update planned later this year, including a new game mode and two new playable characters!

70050000073459.name: Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol: New Skybox
70050000073459.intro: More detail, more depth, more immersion than ever before.
70050000073459.description:
The airport skies have been updated to create a more immersive and realistic visual experience.

The new skybox brings improved lighting conditions, enhanced sky detail, and a refreshed atmosphere that better reflects the scale and tension of an international airport. The visual upgrade strengthens immersion during inspections, patrols, and security operations.

Experience a more vivid and dynamic airport environment where every shift in lighting and atmosphere adds depth to your duties on the front line against smuggling.

70050000073467.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Toyotomi Hideyoshi Pack
70050000073467.description:
The second of Japan’s "Great Unifiers," Toyotomi Hideyoshi brought Japan under one rule in the chaos of the Sengoku period. Beginning his career as a lowly footsoldier, Hideyoshi rose to become one of Oda Nobunaga’s most trusted retainers and a fearless warrior, as well as a patron of the arts. Upon Nobunaga’s betrayal and death, Hideyoshi avenged his former lord and continued the work of conquest, extending his sights out to the Korean peninsula and beyond.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.

70050000073468.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Heian Japan Pack
70050000073468.description:
By the light of the moon, in carefully cultivated gardens and elaborate villas, the poets of Heian Japan wrote their tales. The Heian period begins with the establishment of Heian-kyo (today Kyoto) in 794 CE, and marks the last era of classical Japanese history. It was a time of court refinement, when men and especially women of the court refined literature into a high art; it was also a time of rural neglect and decay, when the countryside grew increasingly restless, and tensions between powerful clans. This tension was to erupt in a revolt in the early 12th century, and the rise of the shogunates that were to dominate Japanese history for centuries afterward.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.

70050000073469.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Sengoku Japan Pack
70050000073469.description:
The Sengoku period was a war of all against all, when fortunes of samurai and daimyo were made and lost, and the source of many of the classic tales of feudal Japan. Beginning in the late 15th century and as feudal power grew, regional lords and clan leaders fought over control of the imperial throne, using European guns, ninja clans, temple armies. The period featured such figures as Hattori Hanzo, Oda Nobunaga, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Tokugawa Ieyasu. Tokugawa, securing the shogunate in 1603, ended the conflict, and established a centuries-long peace.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.

70050000073470.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Yi Sun-sin Pack
70050000073470.description:
The famed admiral, Yi Sun-sin, was a man of duty and resolve. Through a volatile career plagued by betrayal, Admiral Yi never strayed from his duty, answering the call of his king even from the depths of prison. From the splintered remains of the Korean navy, he forged a fleet of strength and led his men to victory against the overwhelming odds of the enemy, cementing his legacy as a hero to his men and to his people.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.

70050000073471.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Goryeo Pack
70050000073471.description:
Out of the fragmentation of Korea’s Three Kingdoms period came Goryeo, a center for scholarship and art, and a formidable force in East Asia. Established in 918 CE, Goryeo became a bastion of Buddhist scholarship, and was an early innovator in moveable type – in other words, a printing press. Additionally, Goryeo celadon pottery is famous for its sophistication and artistry. Goryeo faced challenges, though, keeping peace on the peninsula at first through strength, and then through strategic positioning as a vassal of the Yuan Dynasty of China. Yet in that empire’s fall, a new order arose – Joseon. 

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.

70050000073472.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Joseon Pack
70050000073472.description:
As stable as it was isolated, the Joseon Dynasty was a centuries-long period of peace in Korea, marked by the elaboration of Confucianism, a strong defense, and a rich local culture. Founded in 1392, the kingdom lasted until just before the dawn of the 20th century, repelling invasion after invasion from its neighbors. It was a highly structured society, with a rich scholarly tradition that carefully monitored outside influences, selecting only that which would make Joseon prosper. It would fall in 1897, after pressure from the ascendant Meiji Empire and the United States became overwhelming.

This content is also included with the Brush and Blade Collection DLC Bundle. If you own the Brush and Blade Collection, then you already own this content. DLC released in two installments through July 2026, each delivered automatically in-game on release. Exact release dates subject to change. Terms apply.

A cute decoration pack to bring a forest-like atmosphere to your otherwise nautical tavern!
You’re ready to dive into the world of Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker, but you wish it was just a little more green? That the view is nice, but one more potted plant wouldn’t hurt?

A whimsical decoration pack to spice up your tavern with more magic and alchemy!
Do you sometimes feel like your cozy, nautical tavern is lacking just a little bit of magic? And you just can’t help but crave that magical spark, infused with science and whimsy? Well, then we have good news for you!

70050000073741.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Autumn Girl Skin
70050000073741.description: The crisp Korean autumn. The melancholic atmosphere, intertwined with vibrant autumn foliage, feels like a fashion week for Korea's youth. To keep pace with the dazzling fashionistas roaming the streets, Mina adorns herself to the fullest today.

70050000073899.description:

Give your preserves a splash of varied new feathers.

70050000073921.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000073921.intro: Upgrade your workout for the Nintendo Switch 2 system
70050000073921.description:
Enhance your Fitness Boxing experience with this upgrade pack*. Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features a faster frame rate, increased resolution, and some additional content!

Push your training to the next level with an Advanced Scoring Mode that takes the timing of your hits into account, or a Boost Up feature that gradually increases the speed of your workout with each round. You can also see your movements on screen with the added CameraPlay** support.

Invite a friend to join your workout via GameShare

If you have upgraded to the Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game, you can share the game with anyone who has a Nintendo Switch or Nintendo Switch 2 system using GameShare*** via local wireless to work out side by side.

70050000073922.name: Cozy Grove: Camp Spirit – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000073922.intro: All those who are lost deserve kindness.
70050000073922.description:
Help cute, ghostly bears find peace in this relaxing sequel to the beloved life-sim game where kindness rules and new crafting, building, and camping island adventures await.

Attention, Spirit Scouts! Something spooky is afoot: A bus crash has left you stranded alone on a mysterious (yet delightfully cute) island. Explore the unique island, meet and befriend cute, ghostly spirit bears who need your help to remember their pasts and find peace. Customize a bustling, beautiful campsite by crafting, decorating, and building furniture to bring life and color back to this cute island, and hopefully reunite with your lost scout troop as you gradually repair your bus.

YOUR RELAXING ISLAND OASIS AT THE END OF A STRESSFUL DAY

Whether you're new to the "Cozy Grove" community or a devoted fan, this relaxing follow-up to the beloved life-sim adventure offers something for everyone. This edition of "Cozy Grove" is cuter and cozier than ever, introducing a fresh cast of quirky characters, new animal companions, a new setting and added gameplay features that offer endless ways to unwind at the end of a stressful day. So immerse yourself in a unique, relaxing watercolor art style filled with stunning details and activities to explore. Drop in daily for crafting, decorating, fishing and cooking fun, or embark on new quests to stay busy. Lead with kindness and achieve your camping dreams. Customize the cute, spooky island you've always wanted.

FIND NEW FOREVER FRIENDS AND CUTE ANIMAL COMPANIONS

Alongside familiar faces like Flamey and Mr. Kit, new spirit bears are waiting to bond with you and share their backstories. New animal companions are also on the island to offer support and relaxing comfort. Now you can pet a dog (!) or have a snail help lighten your load.

EXCHANGE GIFTS WITH ASYNCHRONOUS MULTIPLAYER MODE

A new asynchronous multiplayer mode lets you see spooky, cute astral projections of other players, connect with fellow Spirit Scouts and send and receive cute gifts through the mail. But introverts, no need to worry: There's no pressure to interact with your fellow players in real time. You're free to discover and gift in your own time, at your own relaxing pace.

NEW SPOOKY MYSTERIES TO INVESTIGATE

Uncover the secrets of the interconnected islands you've landed on as you complete daily quests. As you progress with patience and diligence, you may unlock new areas to explore. Visit dedicated stations for different activities and light up lamps to find bountiful new spots for foraging and mining.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ISLAND WHILE CRAFTING, DECORATING AND CAMPING

Just because you're living on a haunted island doesn't mean you can't get comfortable! Immerse yourself in crafting and decorating activities, or collect furniture to make the island your own. Plant flowers and fruit trees to harvest, raise ghostly animals and attract pets to your house. And if things start to feel ho-hum, give yourself a custom head-to-toe makeover.

A POSITIVE, HEARTENING DAILY RITUAL

This life-sim game unfolds in sync with real-world time, bringing cute surprises and spooky seasons on the island. If you finish the day's quests, you can cook, craft, collect shells, catch bugs, go fishing, skip rocks or even spruce things up with a new power-washing tool. Rake in rewards as you add to your collection of cute items and earn merit badges for all your accomplishments. A Spirit Scout's work is never done!

Created with love by Spry Fox

70050000073930.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Gangster Shaman Girl Skin
70050000073930.description: Upon discovering the shocking dimension known as the Otherworld, Mina became profoundly stressed by the shaman's fate and began to go off the rails. She started wearing black clothes adorned with coarse jewellery and grew increasingly gloomy. And now, rather than fleeing from the darkness out of fear, she has become a sorcerer who controls and utilises it.

70050000073936.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Overly Attractive Teacher Skin
70050000073936.description: Sehwa Private High School was thrown into utter chaos by her appearance. In fact, the entire school in Songreung District suffered the consequences. Not only was she a teacher with an impressive CV, having studied abroad, but her looks were celebrity-grade, and her attire was excessive... to the point of being bewildering. The principal, who valued decorum and refinement above all, was so shocked he nearly collapsed, foaming at the mouth. 'Buttons must be fastened right up to the neck! Underwear showing is unacceptable!' But Jihyun found Korea's summer unbearably hot.

70050000073942.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Daughter of a Millionaire Skin
70050000073942.description: The Sehwa Foundation proved far more formidable than anticipated, and its wealth was beyond imagination! Jihyun, already destined to inherit immense riches, resolved to abandon frugality and indulge herself to the fullest. No one would ever look down on or treat her with contempt.

70050000073948.name: Isekai Villain: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000073948.intro: Rise as a true villain and carve your own destiny in a dark fantasy RPG!
70050000073948.description:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.

Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.

70050000073959.name: Cards Pack 1
70050000073959.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70050000073959.description: With your furry friends, the fun never ends! Give your brain a boost and sharpen your memory by matching pairs across 22 vibrant, brand-new cards. Don't wait up, these colorful characters are ready to turn every session into a playful workout for your mind!

70050000073967.name: Additional Board 2
70050000073967.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70050000073967.description: Give your kid more space to play and learn! Unleash their artistic talents with a new canvas ready to be filled with colorful stories.

70050000073980.name: Boxes Pack
70050000073980.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70050000073980.description:
Your cats are picky! Not only have they picked a cardboard box as a perfect bed, but now they’re demanding that the box be pretty for them to consider napping inside.
Keep your cats happy with 5 new, themed boxes of Boxes Pack DLC!

70050000073981.name: Bakery
70050000073981.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000073981.description: Freshly baked pastries when they come from the beautifully arranged bakery! Make a perfect space for making and selling delicious croissants, donuts and buns with Bakery DLC!

70050000073984.name: Ravenswatch - Mercenaries Skin Pack
70050000073984.description:
Make a statement with the Mercenaries Skin Pack; an exclusive collection of 5 darker, bolder outfits for 5 of your favourite heroes.

* The Snow Queen – Her Majesty goes rogue in this new winter outfit, equipped with ice daggers which have been carefully forged for throwing at the worst Nightmares of Reverie.
* The Pied Piper – who called for the Plague Doctor? Become the Black Death with an outfit which is dripping with green slime. Even your rats will follow you in this new role!
* Aladdin – what if the best thieves were pirates? Wearing a bandana and armed with scimitars which have been transformed into sabers, Aladdin gives off a Caribbean vibe.
* Sun Wukong – the Monkey King transforms into a shadow ninja, donning a black hood and expertly wielding a magnificent new staff.
* Geppetto – would you trust this Geppetto as a travelling merchant? In this outfit, the woodcarver has swapped his chest for a rucksack filled with curiosities and a…Hammer-Lantern!?

Access these new outfits from the hero selection menu and bring the aura of a true mercenary to the battlefield, where only cunning and survival reign supreme.

70050000073988.name: Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter: Battlefield Sky
70050000073988.intro: New atmosphere, but the same intense warfare experience.
70050000073988.description:

This DLC enhances immersion by updating the skybox across all maps, creating a more dynamic and visually striking war zone that reacts to the intensity of modern combat. From clear tactical skies to dramatic, tension-filled horizons, every location now feels more alive and atmospheric.

Step back onto the battlefield with a refreshed, more immersive sky that makes every mission feel even more epic.

70050000074095.name: Water Blast Shooter - Wet Gun: Splash Cash
70050000074095.intro: Equip yourself for greatness and rule every map with confidence.

70050000074125.name: POLICE BORDER CONTRABAND PATROL SIMULATOR: Border Horizon
70050000074125.intro: Feel the atmosphere of every moment in a new way.
70050000074125.description:

This visual upgrade changes the appearance of the sky and overall environmental backdrop, creating a more immersive and distinctive atmosphere while maintaining the tense feeling of life at the border checkpoint.

Experience the border from a new perspective as changing lighting and updated skies bring additional depth to every moment on duty.

70050000074151.name: Basketball Legends 24: Pro Start
70050000074151.intro: Start better, progress faster, and enjoy more control.
70050000074151.description:

70050000074172.intro: Master the cityscape with specialized gear designed for high-pressure warfare.
70050000074172.description:

The city has fallen, and the shadows are hungry. Will you adapt to the new face of warfare, or become just another echo in the ruins?

Don’t let the shadows outrun you—take the wheel and claim your place as the ultimate racing legend.

70050000074305.name: GigaBash - Ultraman Zero DLC
70050000074305.intro: Ultraman Zero and Ultraman Belial joins the battle!
70050000074305.description:
This DLC adds ""Ultraman Zero"" and ""Ultraman Belial"", two iconic Ultras who are each other's antithesis, as seen in their 2009 classic ""Mega Monster Battle Ultra Galaxy: The Movie"" debut forms. Each legendary character comes with their unique skills and devastating moves in a loving homage to their enduring legacy.

A warrior who has made missteps and overcome them, Ultraman Zero is a proficient fighter from the Land of Light, an Ultra! Using the Zero Sluggers to keep enemies at bay, Emerium Slashes to pummel them at range, and a storied experience with space martial arts, Ultraman Zero is a master of combat. This is a hero who understands that power without justice is dangerous!

Once destined for greatness, Ultraman Belial gave it all up for power and pride. Wielding the powerful Giga Battlenizer, Ultraman Belial stands at the spearpoint of revenge against the Land of Light and all its people. The alien genes infused within this fallen Ultra give it fearsome abilities and strength to match the fury within. Claws, fireballs, lightning, and darkness: Ultraman Belial is ferocity itself!

One craved power and paid for it, the other overcame that craving to grow more powerful. Which one will you manifest in the arena? The hot-headed hero, Ultraman Zero? Or the vengeful Ultraman Belial, all rage and roiling fury?

70050000074320.name: Vice Thief Simulator: 80s Nostalgia – Glow Horizon
70050000074320.intro: New atmosphere for a legendary getaway.
70050000074320.description:
Step into a stylized 1980s underworld where the sky burns with neon hues and the streets are alive with opportunity.

Break into secure targets, steal luxury vehicles, and use clever distractions to stay one step ahead of law enforcement. The neon horizon is waiting for your next move. Step into the shadows, outrun the sirens, and claim the city as your own.

70050000074338.intro: A love story blossoms in the heart of Bangkok.
70050000074338.description:
In Brother's Wedding Story, the newest chapter of Urban Jungle, step into the shoes of Nurgun as he prepares for one of the most important moments of his life: proposing to his boyfriend Rachata, Pharita’s brother.

Surrounded by vibrant greenery and the warmth of the Thai sun, you’ll help Nurgun design and decorate their new home, making every detail perfect for the big day. But even the most beautiful homes can’t hide uncertainty — will Rachata say yes after all?

This romantic chapter blends heartfelt storytelling with Urban Jungle’s signature charm of design, creativity, and cozy expression.

70050000074344.name: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000074344.intro: How can you challenge a perfect, immortal machine?
70050000074344.description: Upgrade to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition of System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster

70050000074397.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70050000074397.description:

Help your thoughts flow easier with the new skin to your chessboard.

70050000074418.name: Go-Go Town! – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000074418.intro: Time to roll up your sleeves, Mayor!
70050000074418.description:
Step into the role of a truly hands-on mayor and shape your town from the ground up.

Plan neighbourhoods, optimise logistics networks, and help your community grow - all while juggling workers, infrastructure, suspiciously large tools, visiting robots, aliens & dinosaurs, and the general day-to-day chaos of building your dream town.

And when mayoral duties get a little much, take a break with a spot of fishing, have a spin on the Go-Kart track, or even high-five a cow. 

Play solo for perfect control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

Grow Your Town

Lay down your streets, then place businesses, homes, and services where they’ll thrive. Welcome tourists, keep them happy, and give them plenty of reasons to stick around and make your town their home. Hire workers, keep shops stocked, and make sure the money keeps flowing, then upgrade, expand, and unlock new ways to help your town flourish. 

Optimise, Automate, Prosper

Tailor each business, industry zone and building configuration to suit your wants and needs. Assign workers, optimise supply chains, set-up logistics networks and watch your systems flourish. Will you let automation do the heavy lifting, or will you be the Mayor of Micromanagement? 

Bring The Style

As mayor, style starts at home, but it doesn't stop there. Dive into immersive house customisation with full 360° placement and a handy colour picker, then take that creative control across your town with recoloured buildings, and plenty of ways to make every street, shop, and neighbourhood feel uniquely yours. Need a new look while you work? Step into the Change-O-Tron and emerge as the mayor you were always meant to be. Your town. Your mayor. Your style.

Chaotic Co-Op

Team-up with up with another mayor, in either local and online play for just the right amount of teamwork and chaos. Build together, manage together, panic together, and discover how quickly a carefully planned town can go sideways when everyone has a different idea of ‘helping’.

70050000074441.name: Wallpapers Pack 1
70050000074441.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70050000074441.description: Bored with your current Nintendo Switch™ theme? Give your console a fresh, fabulous look with nOS new Operating System and a pack of 4 cute, cozy wallpapers (coming both in light and dark mode!)

70050000074483.name: Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare – Power Surge
70050000074483.intro: Power up. Dive in. Unleash the wealth.
70050000074483.description:
Turbocharge your journey to becoming a legend! Secure your dominance with a massive hoard of 15,000 Crystals. Use this war chest to make the tactical decisions that matter—buy the best upgrades, adapt to every environment, and ensure that your legend is never forgotten.

Don’t just survive the loop—own it!

70050000074486.name: Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit – Custom Nitro
70050000074486.intro: Master the pursuit with a stylized booster overhaul.
70050000074486.description:
Blaze a trail through the city streets and make your presence known during every high-speed pursuit!

This DLC redefines your vehicle’s pursuit aesthetic, turning your tactical acceleration into an unforgettable display of power. Leave criminals staring in awe at your exhaust stream as you close the distance in a flash of shifting light.

Gear up, activate the turbo, and paint the highway with the colors of justice.

70050000074561.name: KAZUMA KANEKO: Refined Arts Pack vol.2
70050000074561.description:
This add-on content grants access to special "Creation Cards" for use in-game.

“Pack Contents”
- Arianrhod
- Raphael
- Banshee
- Apollo
- Satan

Note: Content available immediately in-game.

70050000074563.name: Premium DLC "Tropical Vacation"
70050000074563.intro: Ocean-inspired “Tropical Vacation” additional content is here!
70050000074563.description: Miku’s exclusive swimsuit avatar, along with ocean-inspired “Tropical Vacation”-themed costumes and room items, is here! Work together with the Piapro Characters to clear a newly added special puzzle!

70050000074654.name: Pistachio Room
70050000074654.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70050000074654.description: It’s time for a fresh start - make your creative space reflect your vibe to the fullest! Give your crafting space a flavorful makeover with this cosmetic DLC that repaints your atelier in a soothing, stylish pistachio green.

70050000074690.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Hunter Balance
70050000074690.intro: Boost your balance to reinforce your dinosaur’s strength.
70050000074690.description:
Accelerate your prehistoric journey and secure your place at the top of the food chain This DLC injects 500 coins into your active in-game balance, giving you immediate access to essential evolutionary upgrades.

In a brutal world where only the strongest giants and swiftest predators survive, having extra resources allows you to adapt instantly to unpredictable environmental dangers, unlock vital survival traits, and upgrade your creature’s primary abilities without delay.

Establish your territorial dominance across the volcanic zones and ancient forests with this crucial survival boost.

70050000074697.name: Happy Pack: Easy Coloring - 100+ Pages for Kids & Family
70050000074697.intro: Bold, easy coloring for kids and families.
70050000074697.description:
For those light, feel-good sessions where you just want to pick a page and enjoy the moment, Happy Pack is the cozy go-to. Expect simple doodle-style drawings, bigger shapes, and thicker lines, made to feel friendly for little hands and calming for everyone. 

You’ll color cheerful scenes filled with farm friends, friendly dinosaurs and adorable animals from around the world. Expect plenty of chibi-style cuties, happy foods and simple  mandalas, all made for quick, feel-good coloring without stress.

What’s included
- 11 collections (132 drawings total)
- 2 sticker packs (20 stickers total)
- 2 palettes (32 colors total)

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely. 


Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
- Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
- Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages. 

Cozy Pages is your pocket of calm: cute, cozy and always ready when you need a little break.

70050000074698.name: Relax Pack: Calm Coloring Pages - 100+ Soothing Drawings
70050000074698.intro: Calm, feel-good coloring break for grown-ups
70050000074698.description:
When you’re craving a little quiet time, Relax Pack is your place to unwind. It’s made for gentle, soothing sessions: pick a page, breathe out and let the day soften as you color.

Inside you’ll find a mix of mandalas, ornamental patterns and mosaic-inspired designs, plus relaxing pages with lettering you can color like tiny reminders to slow down. 

There are also travel-flavored scenes—little escapes that feel like postcards—alongside delicate nature moments and a touch of realistic illustration.

70050000074699.intro: Cozy kawaii vibes to color, anytime.
70050000074699.description:
If you’re here for the cute-but-calm aesthetic, Comfy Pack is your happy place. It’s the warm, cozy side of Cozy Pages: soft scenes, charming characters, and that comforting “curl up and unwind” feeling you get from coloring something adorable.

You’ll step into little worlds filled with cute animal scenes and sweet everyday cozy moments, meet fantasy characters with a playful twist, and explore the gentle magic of Japanese and Korean folklore.

You’ll also find anime-inspired pages, plus satisfying collections of trinket doodles, isometric houses, and little houses packed with adorable details.

70050000074701.name: 3D Pack: Blocky Voxel Coloring & Cube Art - 30+ Models
70050000074701.intro: A cozy mix of Voxel & 3D models to color.
70050000074701.description:
When you’re ready to take a little break from flat pages, the 3D Pack lets you color adorable 3D models — some with a smooth look, some in a charming voxel/blocky style. It’s the same calm Cozy Pages feeling, just with a more “hands-on” twist: pick a model, choose a palette and watch it come to life from every angle.

You’ll color cozy little houses, fun retro tech objects, cute foods and plenty of animals—all designed for satisfying, stress-free sessions. A small, playful corner to unwind in 3D, whenever you want something different.

What’s included

- 2 sticker packs (20 stickers total)
- 2 palettes (32 colors total)

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely.

70050000074702.intro: A quiet little place to create. Unlock 20 Whiteboards!
70050000074702.description:
Sometimes the best page is a blank one. With 20 whiteboards, you can scribble, sketch and invent your own cute scenes—no rules, no pressure. Pick a brush, choose a palette, add a sticker or two and enjoy a cozy creative moment for kids, teens and grown-ups alike.

What’s included

- 2 sticker packs (20 stickers total)
- 2 palettes (32 colors total)

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely.

70050000074777.name: Wingspan Bird Pack: Additional Asian Avians
70050000074777.intro: Enhance your wildlife preserve with the fan-designed 25 unique Asian bird cards with unique powers, and hear them sing in this digital Bird Pack.
70050000074777.description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Additional Asian Avians, featuring species from across Asia!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the fan-designed 25 unique Asian bird cards with unique powers, and hear them sing in this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from diverse Asian habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Give your preserves a vibrant splash of new feathers from across the Asian continent.

70050000074786.name: OFC - Ultimate Fighting Club: Born to Fight
70050000074786.intro: A new force enters the ring—unleash unmatched combat fury!
70050000074786.description:
The competition just got deadlier. Expand your roster with the exclusive arrival of Tyler Phoenix.

Step into the cage with a fighter engineered for high-intensity action, unique strategy options, and game-changing strikes. Train him, upgrade his vital stats, and execute lethal new combos to read and destroy your opponent’s strategy.

The ring is waiting—are you ready to ride the flames?

70050000074790.name: Mingo Pack
70050000074790.description: Unlock the Mingo Pack and get access to Mingo — a lightweight Class E speedster built for quick acceleration, sharp handling, and fast race starts. With its compact body and pop-up headlight style, Mingo is one of the quickest cars in its class and a perfect choice for players who love agile racing.

70050000074804.name: Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe
70050000074804.intro: Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.
70050000074804.description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe, featuring species from across mainland Europe!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from diverse European habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Enjoy the variety of familiar and lesser-known species, each with its own call and charm.

70050000074805.name: Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of the U.S.A.
70050000074805.intro: Enhance your wildlife preserve with the fan-designed 25 American bird cards with unique powers, and listen to them sing with this digital Bird Pack.
70050000074805.description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of the U.S.A., featuring species from across the United States!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the fan-designed 25 American bird cards with unique powers, and listen to them sing with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from a wide range of U.S. habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Give your preserves a bold and varied collection of new feathers from coast to coast.

70050000074806.name: Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Canada
70050000074806.intro: Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed Canadian bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.
70050000074806.description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Canada, featuring species from the Great North!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed Canadian bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from Canada’s forests, lakes, and tundra never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Give your preserves a crisp northern touch with these distinctive new feathers.

70050000074807.name: Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of New Zealand
70050000074807.intro: Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, unique New Zealand bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.
70050000074807.description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of New Zealand, featuring species from Aotearoa!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, unique New Zealand bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from New Zealand’s remarkable ecosystems never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Give your preserves a distinctive island flair with these rare new feathers.

70050000074835.name: DAVE THE DIVER - In the Jungle Content Pack
70050000074835.intro: Dave’s adventure continues, this time in the heart of the jungle.
70050000074835.description:
Leaving the Blue Hole behind, Dave and his crew travel to the jungle to investigate a mysterious phenomenon reported in the village of Utara. Beneath the jungle lake awaits a brand-new ecosystem to explore, along with new missions and discoveries. 

Featuring over 10 hours of new story and gameplay, DAVE THE DIVER - In the Jungle Content Pack introduces new systems, new locations, and thrilling new adventures beyond the ocean.

■ Freshwater Lake - Discover a whole new ecosystem
Prepare to encounter unfamiliar creatures, discover new ingredients, and face the hidden dangers lurking deep within an ancient underwater civilization.

■ Bancho Grill - New restaurant, new menu, same Bancho standards
Welcome to Bancho Grill, where bold jungle ingredients meet Bancho’s uncompromising culinary craft. Build relationships with the villagers and they might stop by as guests. See for yourself whether Bancho’s legendary cooking can win over the jungle too!

■ Utara Village - a warm welcome in the jungle
Lend a hand to the villagers and build meaningful relationships. Some may be wary of outsiders at first... but a thoughtful gift or a great meal can go a long way!

■ The jungle runs deeper
The jungle holds more than just villages and lakes. From mysterious ancient temples to eerie forests, Dave and his crew’s adventure continues deeper into the unknown!

70050000074839.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000074839.intro: Upgrade Shulk’s adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000074839.description:
Enhance an already critically acclaimed RPG adventure with this upgrade pack. Xenoblade Chronicles™: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features improved visuals, running at 60 frames per second with 4K* resolution in TV mode and full HD resolution in handheld mode, as well as smoother and sharper cutscenes. Not only does it contain all the additions and improvements of the Definitive Edition on the Nintendo Switch system, but it also includes some additional content for you to enjoy!

Race across the Bionis and Mechonis on a high-powered vehicle

Introducing the Ether Jet: a vehicle that will greatly enhance the speed at which you can traverse the Bionis and Mechonis, both in the main game and in the extended story of Xenoblade Chronicles: Future Connected (which has also been enhanced). But this is not just a convenience feature—you can also race competitively against the clock or your party members on racetracks throughout the world and earn in-game rewards in the process.

Unlock additional equipment, experience fully voiced Heart-to-Heart conversations, and more 

Get equipment made for riding the Ether Jet, and experience Heart-to-Heart scenes with fully voiced dialogue for the first time!

70050000074851.name: Clue: Sherlock Suspect Pack
70050000074851.intro: Become the legendary detective himself and play Clue!
70050000074851.description:
Two iconic mystery franchises combine with the Sherlock Suspect Pack for Clue.

Solve crimes as Sherlock Holmes, Professor Moriarty, Dr Watson and Irene Adler in this epic crossover. Each character sports an all-new design, creating an updated look that blends them seamlessly into the game you know and love.

As these characters aren’t tied to any expansion or case files, you can use them and their alternate-pose tokens right away. 

Add the legendary cast of Sherlock Holmes to your next game of Clue and figure out whodunit…
INCLUDES:

2 x SHERLOCK HOLMES TOKENS – Don the deerstalker and deduce who committed the crime as Sherlock himself!
2 x PROFESSOR MORIARTY TOKENS – Sherlock’s archenemy arrives, bringing his cunning wit to the Clue board. 
2 x DR WATSON TOKENS – The ever-faithful doctor turns his attention to the problem at hand!
2 x IRENE ADLER TOKENS – The only person to have truly outwitted Holmes, Irene Adler takes on the case!

70050000074863.name: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Cargo Legends
70050000074863.intro: Upgrade, customize, and conquer the streets in your dream vehicle.
70050000074863.description:
Accelerate your professional driving career and dominate the American highways! This DLC grants you a major advantage right from the start, fueling your journey with 75,000 coins.

Use these resources to unlock new opportunities: expand your fleet, access superior performance upgrades, or customize your truck in detail, from the cabin interior to the exterior elements.

Your road to success just got a whole lot faster!

70050000074875.name: Egypt City Builder: Ancient Find
70050000074875.intro: Instant wealth for your kingdom. Instant doom for your rivals.
70050000074875.description:
A prospering kingdom requires a solid foundation. With this DLC, your rising city is granted an blessing of 100 gold coins.

Use this royal wealth to command respect along the Nile and establish your dominance over neighboring settlements.

Claim your gold, fill your treasury, and build a civilization worthy of eternity!

70050000074899.name: Dungeon Village 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade pack
70050000074899.description: A paid upgrade pack that allows you to upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of Dungeon Village 2 to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Dungeon Village 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70050000074927.name: Only Up - Parkour Game: Coin Boost
70050000074927.intro: Supercharge your store balance and conquer the highest peaks!
70050000074927.description:
Take your ascent to the next level and conquer the highest peaks with confidence.

This DLC injects 20,000 coins into your in-game balance, giving you immediate access to essential equipment and special items in the shop. In a challenging world where a single misstep can send you back to the start, having extra resources allows you to unlock vital boosters without delay.

Secure your essential survival inventory and dominate all locations—from the bustling city to the depths of space.

70050000074938.name: Self Care Pack
70050000074938.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70050000074938.description: Don’t let your Freaky Trip be over – expand your experience with 3 new, self-care-themed illustrations for the sliding puzzle game.

70050000074949.name: Firefighters Simulator 2026: Emergency Budget
70050000074949.intro: Big budget. Better gear. Safer communities.
70050000074949.description:
In the high-stakes world of emergency response, having the right equipment at the right time saves lives. Give your station a operational boost and secure the frontline with absolute confidence.

This DLC grants you an instant boost of $5,000 credited directly to your station’s budget. Dangerous situations escalate in seconds, and this extra funding ensures your crew is always prepared for the worst.

Maximize your tactical planning, and upgrade your gear without limits.

70050000075088.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Frontline Gear
70050000075088.intro: Look the part of an elite checkpoint commander during intense zombie incursions.
70050000075088.description:
Refresh your perspective with this visual expansion that changes the skin of the player’s hands, transforming your view during every critical inspection and defense phase. Equip your guard with new gear and maintain absolute control over the quarantine zone with a premium look.

Stand out on the border and bring a fresh visual edge to your daily shifts as the ultimate line of defense.

70050000075091.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection: Spring 2

70050000075105.name: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon
70050000075105.intro: A cautionary tale, or a story better left untold? Legacy of the Bloodmoon is the darkest expansion to date for Vampire Survivors.
70050000075105.description:
In ancient times, Saint Baal'Thasar had a vision of paradise, lit by a bright, red moon. And so he founded the Order of the Red Moon, to lead people to a land of eternal life. The myth says that Baal'Thasar found his paradise during a pilgrimage, and so never returned.

Having lost its leader, the Order shattered and many fringe sects were born from its remnants. Today, members of one of the most unscrupulous cults, Clan Bloodmoon, embark on a journey to follow in Baal'Thasar's footsteps…

10+ New Characters
Unscrupulous beings consumed by ambition, a cautionary tale, or a story better left untold?
Legacy of the Bloodmoon adds 10+ new cursed characters, including:

Malice Bloodmoon: Malice is leading a pack of disciples in the search for the ancient lair of the Order of the Red Moon. Little do they know, they are there just to be used as cannon fodder and meat shields by the ruthless matron.
Calogero Bloodmoon: A heinous beast of a man with an unquenchable bloodlust. Any obstacle in his path ends up shattered by his massive axe.
Baal'Thasar: The founder of what was once known as the Order of the Red Moon, or what's left of him. What did he truly find on his pilgrimage?
Ashtart: One of the first followers of Baal, now turned into a malevolent presence that inhabits any old bones it touches.
Sargon: A king from ancient times who followed Baal, driven by ambition and fear of death, only to end up forever trapped in a hellish dimension.

16+ New Weapons
16+ new weapons across base forms and evolutions, including:

Scarlet Needle: Malice's favourite attack. Enemies are impaled by needles that inflict paralyzing pain.
Incineration: Why deal damage when you can erase a whole bunch of enemies from existence with a single flick of the hand?
Blacken Firmament: An ominous celestial body darkens the heavens and starts tearing reality apart.
FireBall: Yep, peak originality: a weapon called fire ball will now be in Vampire Survivors. To not be confused with FireFall, FireWall, or their union: FireStall.

8 New Music Tracks
♫ Legacy of the Bloodmoon
♫ It's Her Nature
♫ What He Wished For
♫ Borrowed Feathers
♫ Grasp All
♫ Lose All
♫ You Knew What He Was
♫ When You Took Him In


A new XL Stage

Red Moon Manor: The ancient lair of the Order of the Red Moon. The myth says that Baal'Thasar had built it as a fortress to conceal the secret of immortality. But Malice and Calogero discovered that the manor does indeed exist. What is it truly hiding?

70050000075154.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ 2 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000075154.intro: Upgrade Rex and Pyra’s search for paradise on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000075154.description:
Enhance a journey across Titans with this upgrade pack. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game features improved visuals, with 4K* resolution in TV mode and full HD in handheld mode at 60 frames per second, as well as smoother and sharper cutscenes. It also includes some additional gameplay content!

Discover a new rare Blade—and control your Blades to fight in mercenary squad battles

There’s an additional Blade out there for you to find! MOMO has two forms, light and dark, that you can swap between to change her appearance and elemental affinity. She also has a quest for you to complete.

Not only that, but you can directly command your Blades in the Merc Assault action battle mode! Choose up to six Blades to send out on Merc Missions where you move, fight, and swap freely between the Blades under your command. Combining Blade Specials will be key to victory!

Unlock new outfit designs for Pyra and Mythra

Customize the look of Pyra and Mythra with new outfit designs exclusive to this Nintendo Switch 2 Edition game. These appear not only while you’re adventuring, but also during cutscenes.

70050000075155.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure - Tea Garden
70050000075155.intro: An invitation with your name on it.
70050000075155.description:
Mysterious invitations for the Tea Garden Ball have gone out… and nobody knows who's hosting! Explore 15+ new quests, discover 38 new recipes, and dress to impress in 600+ new clothing variations.

Includes:
15 New clothing items with 300+ variants: Bonnets, bows, and full regency finery
2 New Food Stations: the Teapot and the Tiered Tray
38 New recipes: tea, scones and sandwiches galore
15+ New Narrative Quests in the Merry Meadows:Help Hello Kitty, My Melody, Pochacco, Kuromi, Chococat, and more prepare for the Tea Garden Ball
New Furniture & Decor Set: Transform your cabins into Tea Gardens of your very own!

70050000075165.name: [Moving] Journey Through France
70050000075165.intro: Discover France’s iconic landmarks through moving scenery. From historic streets to glowing night views, each scene comes alive in this moving puzzle pack.
70050000075165.description:
This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The following 10 moving puzzles are included.
-Mont Saint-Michel
-Mont Blanc
-Road to the Arc de Triomphe
-Colmar
-Nice Coastline
-Eiffel Tower and the Seine
-Lavender Fields of Provence
-Louvre Museum
-Saint-Jacques Tower and Fireworks
-Seine River Nightscape

70050000075175.name: FISHING SIMULATOR 2025: Big Catch
70050000075175.intro: Boost your career balance and enjoy the absolute freedom of high-tier angling.
70050000075175.description:
Kickstart your angling journey with a premium financial boost. Enhance your peaceful escape with an instant injection of $5,000 in-game cash.

Use your capital to build the ultimate tackle box, customize your rod setup, and adapt your strategy to the unique behavior of every fish species without any financial pressure.

Upgrade your career, find your quiet spot, and enjoy the reward of patience.

70050000075198.name: Stick Combat - Fighting Platformer: Power Up
70050000075198.intro: Fight harder and survive lethal strikes that would stop an ordinary warrior.
70050000075198.description:
Become the ultimate stickman champion and push your combat potential past its ordinary limits. This DLC is designed for warriors who refuse to fall.

Expand your maximum health pool with two extra hearts added directly to your vital gauge. Do not just survive the gauntlet—dominate every trap and conquer the world’s deepest secrets with absolute confidence.

Do not just survive the gauntlet—dominate every trap and conquer the world’s deepest secrets!

70050000075203.name: Arven - The Wolf Blade
70050000075203.description:
ARVEN, THE WOLF BLADE

Play as Arven, a Ranger of relentless determination who heard of a group of heroes trapped within an Astral Prison. Fighting alongside the wolf Kat, his hunting companion, this new hero had no other choice but to lend his blade to those fighting for their survival.

Arven is a character from Fallen Fates, the upcoming action RPG by Hibernian Workshop.

DLC CONTENT
- Brand new mechanic - Arven never travels without Kat. Traverse the astral prisons in good company with this wolf who will follow you throughout your escape attempts. Compatible with the Celestial Heaven DLC: your pet and Kat will follow you side by side.
- 25 new unique spells - Use the greatsword to create powerful slashes, move nimbly while setting up explosive traps, and more.
- Signature Spell - Throw a hook onto an enemy and dash towards them, while summoning Kat to assist you in battle and follow you around the battlefield.
- 30 Associated Perks - Adapt Arven's Signature Spell to your playstyle.
- 2 Weapon types for different playstyles:
    - Alpha Sword - Medium-range attacks, swinging and slashing enemies.
    - Ethereal Missiles - Use magic to shoot powerful blasts of energy from long range.
- 6 Weapon Passives - Each weapon comes with 3 unique passives, making Arven and Kat an even deadlier duo.
- Stellar Voice Acting - Arven is fully voiced in Japanese and English by the incredibly talented Tagui Omi and Ben Starr, respectively.
- New Papa Yalee Stories - 4 new stories to learn about Arven and Kat's mysterious origins.
- Cinematics and ending screens - Brand new cinematics and a new ending screen have been added for Arven.

HOW TO ACCESS ARVEN
If you own this DLC and have not yet met Arven in the Garden, he will appear after a couple of escape attempts.

ADDITIONS TO THE BASE GAME
Even if you do not own the DLC, you will still be able to:

- See Arven hanging out in the Garden.
- Collect and use 2 Arven Echoes during runs.
- Fight Arven's Shadow Clone.

70050000075206.name: Frost Survival – Winter: Energy Surge
70050000075206.intro: Explore the vast winter forest further before fatigue slows your progress.
70050000075206.description:
Conquer the unforgiving mountain wilderness with unmatched physical resilience. This DLC improves your character’s physical capacity, ensuring that stamina is consumed twice as slowly across all demanding physical activities.

Equipped with this vital boost to your overall endurance, your survival journey becomes a testament to human fortitude. Move faster, explore further into the dense winter forests, and maintain your momentum without being constantly halted by crippling fatigue.

Navigate the deepest snow and conquer frozen peaks with half the standard energy consumption.

70050000075214.name: Xenoblade Chronicles™ 3 – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000075214.intro: Upgrade Noah and Mio’s heartfelt journey on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70050000075214.description:
Enhance your adventure across Aionios with this upgrade pack. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game features improved visuals, running at 60 frames per second with 4K* resolution in TV mode and full HD resolution in handheld mode, as well as smoother and sharper cutscenes. It also includes some additional content, including newly voiced event scenes! 

Recruit an additional Hero, complete with their own quest 

The mythical new hero Shimmer joins you on your adventure! Shimmer is a speedy Attacker who can unleash devastating rapid-fire combos on her foes. She also wields the power of Foresight to see the future.

Test your strength against waves of enemies in Heroes’ Vault mode

Defeat as many enemies as you can in a defensive battle mode, exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. The more enemies you defeat, the more you’ll fill a gauge that you can use to strengthen your forces. Enhance your abilities, gain additional allies, but choose wisely—you’ll need to prepare well to defeat the almighty foe awaiting you at the end!

70050000075224.name: Street Basketball Street Style Kit #1
70050000075224.description: Hit the asphalt in style with the "Street Style Kit #1". This customization DLC brings a fresh, urban look to your wardrobe, featuring a stylish new jersey, matching shorts, and high-top boots designed for the concrete courts. Stand out during your next pickup game and express your personal style on the blacktop.

70050000075240.name: Street Basketball Street Style Kit #2
70050000075240.description: Bring some classic playground energy to your matches. The Street Style Kit #2 adds a throwback-inspired coordinate set to your collection. This DLC includes a retro-styled athletic jersey, matching shorts, and durable court boots. Gear up, step onto the court, and keep the classic streetball spirit alive.

70050000075241.name: Street Basketball Street Style Kit #3
70050000075241.description: Upgrade your character's look with the sleek, contemporary aesthetic of the Street Style Kit #3. This customization set offers a clean, modern design for players looking to refresh their appearance. The pack includes one premium jersey, a coordinating pair of shorts, and high-performance street boots.

70050000075242.name: Street Basketball Street Style Kit #4
70050000075242.description: Make a statement every time you check the ball. The Street Style Kit #4 delivers a bold, eye-catching look designed to make your character stand out from the crowd. Customize your player with a uniquely designed jersey, matching shorts, and rugged street boots built for competitive play.

70050000075263.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Cards Set #4
70050000075263.description: A simple visual update for your deck. This DLC adds one set of custom card averses and reverses. Select this theme from the customization menu to apply the new design to your cards.

70050000075264.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Cards Set #3
70050000075264.description: Personalize your poker hand with a new card style. This DLC contains one full set of custom card fronts (averses) and backs (reverses) to change up the look of your games.

70050000075265.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Cards Set #2
70050000075265.description: Enhance your time at the table with an alternative deck design. This DLC unlocks a single, cohesive aesthetic for your cards, featuring uniquely crafted card faces and card backs. Swap your standard deck for this new style to personalize your poker experience.

70050000075266.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Cards Set #1
70050000075266.description: Customize your poker table with a new visual theme. This cosmetic DLC adds one complete card design, featuring a matching set of custom card fronts (averses) and card backs (reverses). Easily apply this new style from the in-game settings to give your matches a fresh look.

70050000075271.name: Terraformers: Independence
70050000075271.intro: In this Terraformers DLC, Martian factions vie for power over the Red Planet.
70050000075271.description:
Align cities - When founding a city, assign which faction should lead its local government. There are 3 factions to choose from, with a total of 21 different policies to shape your city’s focus. The better your cities are developed according to a faction’s goals, the more influence the faction will acquire.

Form government - When a faction acquires enough influence, they will take a seat in the Martian Government. The distribution of seats between the various factions determines whether you’ll become a democracy, an oligarchy or a dictatorship.

Use faction perks — There are 50 Mandates in total, divided into five tiers. When a faction gains a seat in government it’ll grant one of these perks, providing a powerful one-time effect.

Gain independence - Earth starts with control of every Martian government seat. Each seat taken by a Martian faction moves Mars closer to independence

Leadership - Lead your Martian society in different ways with 4 new leaders. Invest in your leadership by increasing the amount of leaders that are proposed per term, or even increase the number of skills your leaders can use per turn.

Events - Shape Mars’ political fate through 11 new events.

Projects - Focus on leaders, government and factions with 12 new regional buildings, 4 new city buildings, and a new technology.

Landmark - Find a newly added powerful landmark of which there'll be only one on the planet.

Scenario - Try to achieve independence from Earth in a new, longer scenario.

Music - Accomplish all of this while listening to a new music track.

70050000075316.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS - Ultimate Pack
70050000075316.description:
The Ultimate Pack includes:
• 5 uniforms
• 3 alternate ball customizations
• 2 goal celebrations
• 2 main menu themes

70050000075334.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Digital Sound & Art Gallery
70050000075334.description: This digital gallery includes the original soundtrack used in the game, as well as high‑resolution artwork created during development—allowing you to explore the world of Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse in depth through both sound and visuals.

70050000075338.name: Lyon
70050000075338.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70050000075338.description: Change the look of your kitchen with the new DLC inspired by the beautiful, culturally rich city of Lyon! Cozy, warm furniture in this DLC will keep your passion for cooking aflame with every meal!

70050000075342.name: Colorful Golf Balls 7
70050000075342.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit new breathtaking locations.
70050000075342.description: Visit your favorite locations, this time with a set of 5 brand new skins for your golf ball, visual effects, and trails.

70050000075348.name: Collector's Cove Summer Pack
70050000075348.description:
Get ready for the beach with the Collector's Cove Summer Pack!
This outfit collection will let you enjoy the tropical sun in style.
This pack features five breezy cosmetics for your animal companion and five sun-kissed additions for your character.

70050000075357.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS - DLC Character Pack 1
70050000075357.description:

- 2 playable characters

- 14 customization items (including match BGM)
- And more!

*This content is also included in the Deluxe & Ultimate Editions, as well as the Season Pass. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70050000075359.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS - DLC Character Pack 3

- And more!

70050000075360.name: Rogue Legends
70050000075360.description:
Rogue Legends is a rogue-lite adventure across a huge variety of Bloon infested maps.

Build your Monkey Party and make strategic reward choices at key steps to advance. 

Win and Buy Artifacts to boost your Party's power and defeat the Boss!

70050000075361.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit - European Tour
70050000075361.intro: Explore brand new parking garages to race in - all around Europe!
70050000075361.description:
This DLC for Parking Garage Rally Circuit includes:
- 8 Brand new garages to race in, all from landmark locations across western Europe!
- A new original ska soundtrack

70050000075362.name: Frontier Legends
70050000075362.description:
Frontier Legends is a story based campaign adventure out in the wild frontiers of Monkey civilization. 

You are Sheriff, the new Sheriff of Sandytown. 

Help defend against the Wild Bloon invasion and track down the Diamondback Boss threatening the entire Frontier.

You and your posse need to work with a cast of Monkey characters to defeat the Bloons and protect your new home in Sandytown.

70050000075369.name: R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000075369.intro: The fate of two races depends on you.
70050000075369.description: Enjoy enhanced resolution and mouse controls when you upgrade to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition of R-Type Tactics I･II Cosmos! There's no better way to outsmart and outgun your opponents in this sci-fi strategy collection!

70050000075397.name: BUS SIM 25 - CITY SIMULATOR: Urban Sky
70050000075397.intro: Drive where the city streets meet a breathtaking new sky.
70050000075397.description:
Elevate your driving experience and transform the atmosphere of your city. This DLC introduces a stunning, high-definition alternative skybox to the gameplay scene.

Whether you are cruising through the bustling downtown or managing routes in the quiet suburbs, watch the world above change and immerse yourself in a completely reinvented urban landscape.

Change your view, redefine your drive, and master the streets under a new horizon.

70050000075417.name: Nature
70050000075417.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70050000075417.description: There’s no such thing as too much green! Let your citizens enjoy the beauty of nature with the variety of trees, stones, and more. Enhance your experience with 41 new items in the Cozy Land Nature DLC.

70050000075420.name: Ants Empire Colony: Power Surge
70050000075420.intro: Break your limits. Save the colony. Rebuild without limits.
70050000075420.description:
Fuel your journey with an unstoppable energy boost! Push your boundaries and take control of the wilderness like never hindrance.

With this DLC, your brave ant gains double the stamina, allowing you to sprint longer, carry resources faster, and outrun danger across the map. Rebuilding the colony demands relentless energy—now you have the power to match the challenge.

Explore further, gather quicker, and never slow down on your mission to restore the empire!

70050000075444.name: Battle Pixel: Arsenal Capital
70050000075444.intro: Spend smart, shoot fast, and outgun with elite funding.
70050000075444.description:
In a survival arena where there is no room for error, every resource matters. Dominate the battlefield with both power and flair!

This DLC credits your account with 3,000 in-game credits and build your dream loadout immediately. Secure your financial advantage before you even step into the shrinking active zone.

The boundary is shrinking—spend your cash, gear up, and claim the top spot!

70050000075449.name: Dead by Daylight: Jason
70050000075449.description:
Dead by Daylight: Jason brings the legendary horror icon into The Fog.  

Jason Voorhees, from Jason Universe, is beloved for his unparalleled brutality and iconic appearance. Summer camps, hockey masks, and machetes have never been the same... 

Purchasing this add-on unlocks the Hockey Mask badge and the Misty Cabin banner.

70050000075452.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - [Chiikawa Anime] Collab. Pack
70050000075452.description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

[Chiikawa Anime] Collab. Pack
- Song: Hitorigotsu -Band Ver.-
Easy ★1, Normal ★1, Hard ★3, Extreme ★3
- Mini Characters: Chiikawa, Hachiware, Usagi, Momonga, Rakko, Kurimanju, Shisa
- Nameplate (3 variations)
- Title (9 variations)

A special background featuring Chiikawa characters can be viewed when playing Hitorigotsu -Band Ver.- (single player) in Taiko Mode.
*The nameplates and the titles can be obtained by playing Hitorigotsu -Band Ver.-
*The mini characters, nameplates and titles can be changed in My Room.
*The song featured in this product cannot be played in Online Mode.

*This product is not compatible with Taiko no Tatsujin: Drum'n'Fun!

70050000075456.name: Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight - Color Burst
70050000075456.intro: Your flight, your palette—make every jump iconic.
70050000075456.description:
Ready to turn your high-speed descents into an absolute spectacle? Upgrade your flight profile and paint the atmosphere with your own signature trails.

Head over to the shop and explore the newly expanded SMOKE category, where three exclusive smoke effect colors await you. Cut through urban canyons and soar over snowy peaks leaving a stunning, colorful wake behind you.

Pick your trail, leap into the void, and paint the sky!

70050000075486.name: Aqua Nook
70050000075486.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70050000075486.description: Hear the sound of waves and gulls’ calls, feel the salty breeze and warm sun on your skin, dip your fingers into cool water… If you’re a beach, ocean, or mermaid lover, this room design is perfect for you!

70050000075487.name: Floor Pack
70050000075487.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70050000075487.description: Surprise your ghost friends with brand new designs of the flooring! Fluffy carpets or chic tiles? Give yourself a wider selection of floors with 20 new designs included in the Floors Pack DLC, and unleash your true creative potential!

70050000075500.name: Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter: Budget Boost
70050000075500.intro: Fund your fleet. Outrun the blast. Chase the chaos.
70050000075500.description:
Secure your next research grant and prepare your garage for the most extreme weather events on the planet.

An injection of 2,000 coins expands your available field allowance, ready to be deployed for critical equipment upgrades. Repair your storm-chasing rig, bypass the grind, and face the chaotic plains with the absolute confidence of a top-tier professional.

Maximize your potential, outrun the chaos, and claim your status among elite storm hunters.

70050000075510.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000075510.intro: Upgrade Your BlazBlue Entropy Effect X Experience on Nintendo Switch™ 2!
70050000075510.description:
The BlazBlue Entropy Effect X Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack delivers smoother performance, sharper visuals, and a faster, more responsive combat experience.

■ Enhanced Resolution & Frame Rate
Enjoy smoother, more detailed high-speed combat:
TV Mode: Supports up to 1440p resolution / 60 fps
Handheld Mode: Supports up to 1080p resolution / 60 fps

■ Significantly Reduced Loading Times
Loading times are significantly reduced, letting you get into battle faster and maintain a smooth, fast-paced gameplay flow.

■ Includes Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Exclusive Bonus Content
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack also includes exclusive Nintendo Switch 2 Edition bonus content:
Platinum Palette: Old World Fantasy
Chibi Avatar: Dango Balloon

70050000075538.name: DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter Multi Rocket Launcher Pack
70050000075538.intro: The city falls, the dead rise—your survival is all that matters.
70050000075538.description:
Take your firepower to the next level.

The Multi Rocket Launcher Pack adds a high-impact weapon designed to deal massive damage in critical situations. Perfect for handling dense waves of enemies, this launcher gives you the ability to clear space and regain control when the pressure builds.

Whether you’re surrounded or pushing through dangerous zones, this weapon offers a powerful solution for intense encounters.

Key Features:
- High-damage rocket launcher
- Effective against large enemy groups
- Strong addition to any loadout
- Built for high-pressure combat situations

Turn the tide when it matters most.

70050000075543.name: DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter: Sci-Fi Shotgun Pack
70050000075543.intro: The city falls, the dead rise—your survival is all that matters.
70050000075543.description:
Close-range power at its finest.

The Sci-Fi Shotgun Pack introduces a high-impact weapon built for intense close combat. Designed to deliver massive damage at short distance, this shotgun is perfect for tight spaces and fast enemy encounters.

When enemies get too close, this weapon gives you the edge you need to break through pressure and stay in control. A strong addition for players who prefer aggressive and direct combat.

Key Features:
- High-damage shotgun for close-range combat
- Ideal for tight spaces and fast encounters
- Enhances aggressive playstyle
- Adds new tactical option to your loadout
Take control when the fight gets close.

70050000075548.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: VA-11 Hall-A - "YLIAD" - Garoad
70050000075548.intro: Be the star that always shines in the dark night sky in the official Rhythm Rift for "YLIAD" by Garoad
70050000075548.description:
This Rhythm Rift features:
- Your favorite adorable android, Dorothy Haze
- Background visualizer with custom particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

(This track is part of the VA-11 Hall-A Music Pack.)

70050000075558.name: Gray War Conflict: Hostile Gear
70050000075558.intro: Leave your mark on the battlefield with elite hardware.
70050000075558.description:
In a conflict zone where every step could be your last, confidence in your weapon is everything. To help you dominate this hostile forest, it is time to expand your tactical arsenal.

Upgrade your presence on the battlefield with a rugged custom look for your Assault Rifle. Armed with this elite design, you can eliminate threats, clear zones, and make sure the enemy remembers the operative who took them down.

Prepare your weapon, trust your instincts, and claim your victory in the heart of the war-torn forest.

70050000075593.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: UNDERTALE - "Spider Dance" - Toby Fox
70050000075593.intro: Try your hand at the official Rhythm Rift for "Spider Dance" by Toby Fox (free song!)
70050000075593.description:
This Rhythm Rift features:

- A member of the Rift cast in their favorite UNDERTALE cosplay

(This track is part of the UNDERTALE Music Pack.)

70050000075594.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: UNDERTALE Music Pack
70050000075594.intro: Re-experience one of gaming's most iconic soundtracks with the OFFICIAL UNDERTALE Music Pack!
70050000075594.description:
This content pack is only available in the Music Pack DLC Bundle, along with a free song!

Featuring SIX new Rhythm Rifts by Toby Fox:
"Hopes and Dreams"
"Death by Glamour"

"Megalovania"

Each UNDERTALE Rhythm Rift features:

70050000075649.name: Tavern Owner Simulator: Elite Workers
70050000075649.intro: Dress your workers in professional uniforms matching your tavern’s success.
70050000075649.description:
Give your bustling establishment a complete visual upgrade with this exclusive staff makeover.

This DLC introduces a comprehensive set of alternative appearances and custom uniforms for your entire workforce, including your diligent bartenders, hardworking chefs, and swift servers.

Transform the atmosphere of your pub by matching your team’s look to your tavern’s unique architectural style.

70050000075652.name: Rooftops and Alleys: The Parkour Game - Ninja Pack DLC
70050000075652.description:
