(Final contents may vary)

70050000075653.name: Rooftops and Alleys: The Parkour Game - Trail Pack DLC
70050000075653.description:
Includes new trails for your character!
(Final contents may vary)

70050000075655.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Auto Fire DLC
70050000075655.intro: Let the fireballs fly on their own!
70050000075655.description:
With this DLC, you will unlock:
• Permanent Auto Fire

When enabled, your fireballs are launched automatically during regular stages, helping you destroy targets, earn coins, and build strength without aiming every shot manually.

You can turn Auto Fire off in the Boosters tab if you want to return to manual control. Auto Fire does not work during Challenges, so you will still need to prove your skill when it is time to unlock the next stage.

70050000075657.name: Battle Royal - Battlegrounds Call MP7 Arsenal Expansion
70050000075657.intro: Where Survival is Earned, Victory is Inherited.
70050000075657.description:
Speed defines survival.

The MP7 Arsenal Expansion introduces a lightweight and fast-firing weapon built for high-pressure combat. Designed for players who rely on quick reactions and constant movement, this weapon allows you to stay one step ahead in every encounter.

Ideal for close engagements, it delivers consistent performance when the fight becomes intense and unpredictable.

Key Features:
- Fast and responsive weapon handling
- Optimized for close-range encounters
- Supports high-mobility playstyle
- Expands combat flexibility
Stay fast. Strike first.

70050000075658.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Griffith DLC
70050000075658.intro: Unleash Light Family power with Griffith!
70050000075658.description:
With this DLC, you will unlock:
• Griffith - Alpha Pet from the Light Family

Add Griffith to your pet collection and strengthen your team with a powerful Light Family companion. This Alpha Pet boosts the passive skills of all pets in its family, giving your lineup even more power during regular stages.

Griffith also comes with an active skill that increases Stamina Recovery, helping you keep the fireballs flying longer as you train, destroy targets, and prepare for tougher challenges.

70050000075661.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Rath DLC
70050000075661.intro: Unleash Dark Family power with Rath!
70050000075661.description:
With this DLC, you will unlock:
• Rath - Alpha Pet from the Dark Family

Add Rath to your pet collection and strengthen your team with a fierce Dark Family companion. This Alpha Pet boosts the passive skills of all pets in its family, giving your lineup even more power during regular stages.

Rath also comes with an active skill that increases Fireball Power, helping you hit harder, destroy targets faster, and prepare for tougher challenges.

70050000075666.name: Battle Royal - Battlegrounds Call VAL Silent Strike
70050000075666.intro: Where Survival is Earned, Victory is Inherited.
70050000075666.description:
Stay unseen. Strike precisely.

The VAL Silent Strike DLC introduces a weapon designed for controlled and stealth-focused combat. Built for players who prefer precision over noise, this loadout allows you to eliminate targets efficiently while staying under the radar.

Ideal for tactical approaches, it gives you the advantage in situations where positioning and timing matter more than raw firepower.

Key Features:
- Precision-focused weapon for controlled engagements
- Designed for stealth-oriented gameplay
- Effective in mid-range combat situations
- Expands tactical playstyle options
Move quietly. Eliminate efficiently.

70050000075673.name: Everdell - Bellfaire
70050000075673.intro: The critters of Everdell celebrate in style in a new expansion!
70050000075673.description:
Celebration time! Bellfaire adds 6 exciting gameplay modules you can mix-and-match to expand your options and play with wild powers!
15 unique player powers which dramatically change your game
4 mysterious Forest locations
10 Events (9 special, 1 basic) to get you into the celebratory mood
Special Garland Awards for the most festive critters
The Market location for better bartering
Plus, Cardinals and Toads make their arrival as workers!

70050000075719.name: Squirrel Madness: Nut Boost
70050000075719.intro: Expand your arsenal and stand stronger against every enemy wave.
70050000075719.description:
Boost your magical tree defense adventure and gain extra resources to strengthen your fight. Get 500 nuts added directly to your in-game balance and use them to unlock upgrades, improve your weapons, and prepare for tougher waves of enemies threatening your enchanted home.

Expand your arsenal, enhance your abilities, and gain the advantage you need to protect the magical tree from relentless attacks. Every nut brings you closer to victory!

70050000075880.name: Werewolf Hunter - Survive The Howl: Damage Barrier
70050000075880.intro: Outlast the horror with improved damage protection.
70050000075880.description:
Enhance your survival capabilities with an extra shield bar added alongside your health. This shield starts at 100 units and absorbs incoming damage first, providing you with an additional buffer during intense encounters with deadly werewolves.

The shield regenerates using the same mechanics as your health, restoring over time when out of combat. Healing consumables prioritize restoring health first, and once your health is full, they will begin to repair your shield instead.

Adapt your strategy, manage your resources wisely, and increase your chances of surviving the night in the face of relentless supernatural threats.

70050000075919.name: Personal Boards 10
70050000075919.intro: Create your own colorful stories with the latest DLC!
70050000075919.description: Unlock new boards where you can draw your own stories.

70050000075923.name: Car Heist Simulator - Thief Mechanic: Cash Boost
70050000075923.intro: More funds, more freedom, more successful heists.
70050000075923.description:
Accelerate your rise through the criminal underworld and prepare for bigger, more rewarding heists.

Gain an instant financial boost for your criminal career with 1000 added directly to your in-game balance. Use your funds to improve your equipment, unlock useful upgrades, and prepare for increasingly challenging heists across the city.

Strengthen your preparation, improve your efficiency, and stay one step ahead of security systems as you work your way toward becoming the most skilled car thief in the city.

70050000075925.name: Wobbly Life - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000075925.description:
Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day! 

It's time to start earning and living your best Wobbly Life! 

Includes Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features:
- GameShare: Play Wobbly Life with anyone – even if they don't own the game! 
- GameChat: Share audio and video while playing with your friends. 
- Start where you left off on Nintendo Switch™ with forwards compatible save game to Nintendo Switch™ 2
- 1-4 players online and local split screen co-op

Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets and SO MUCH more 

+100 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends 

+90 vehicles to ride around (and crash)

+500 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look 

+infinite number of wobbly fun! 
 
FUN, FRIENDS & PHYSICS!

Let's start exploring! Almost everything is interactive – grab, play, and experiment in a world filled with props, mini-games, and surprises.  

Experience the joy of individual quests and shared adventures with up to 4 players in online or local co-op, all in one fantastical world. 

MYSTERIES AND MISSIONS

Embark on story missions, each offering unique rewards through satisfying puzzles and challenges. Unveil the mysteries of the tropical island, uncover the mountain’s secrets, delve into hidden caves...  

The Wobbly Museum has lost all its artifacts! Maybe you can help? Buy treasure maps and solve clues to find all the Museums' lost treasures and unlock fun rewards. 

GO GET A JOB!

Make grandma happy and go get that job! Earn money by choosing from +20 exciting jobs, each bringing their new unique challenges. From pizza delivery to firefighting, taxi driver to disco dancer… your wobbly dream job is waiting for you. 

LIVE THE HIGH WOBBLY LIFE! 

Once you’ve fattened up your bank account why not go on a shopping spree? Visit the Pet Shop to buy a faithful companion, buy and unlock +500 clothes items and choose from +90 different vehicles.  

When you’ve really made the big bucks, you can even buy a house: from a wooden shack to a huge fancy mansion, Wobbly Island has a home for everyone whatever your taste! 

PLAY YOUR OWN WAY WITH ARCADE MODE

Want to take a break from the Wobbly Island? Try out the Arcade mode! Discover four new game modes: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each have customizable settings for you to play with, multiple mini-games and new areas to have fun in!

GO TO SPACE! The Wobbly Space Programme is looking for new recruits. Space is a whole new open world, with new jobs, missions, and secrets to uncover. You'll even get to fly your own spaceships too, so what are you waiting for!

70050000075938.name: Wine Factory Simulator: Starter Capital
70050000075938.intro: Build, expand, and produce with greater confidence.
70050000075938.description:
Give your winery a stronger foundation and accelerate your path to success with additional resources at your disposal.

With $1500 added directly to your in-game balance, you can expand your vineyard, invest in better equipment, and improve your production capabilities from the very beginning.

Grow your business faster, refine your winemaking process, and take your first steps toward becoming a renowned wine producer.

70050000075963.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger - Digimon Anime Song Pack
70050000075963.description:
Replace various in-game background music with theme songs from Digimon animation works with this Digimon Anime Song Pack for Digimon Story Time Stranger!

Digimon Anime Song Pack includes:
- Butter-Fly (From Digimon Adventure)
- brave heart (From Digimon Adventure)
- Target～Akai Shougeki～ (From Digimon Adventure 02)
- Break Up! (From Digimon Adventure 02)
- The Biggest Dreamer (From Digimon Tamers)
- SLASH!! (From Digimon Tamers)
- FIRE!! (From Digimon Frontier)
- With The Will (From Digimon Frontier)
- Gouing! Going! My soul!! (From Digimon Savers - Digimon Data Squad)
- Believer (From Digimon Savers - Digimon Data Squad)
- Nebagiba! (From Digimon Xros Wars - Digimon Fusion Battles)
- WE ARE Xros Heart! (From Digimon Xros Wars - Digimon Fusion Battles)
- Mikakunin Hikousen (From Digimon Adventure:)
- Break the chain (From Digimon Adventure:)
- FACTION (From Digimon Ghost Game)
- First Riders (From Digimon Ghost Game)

*These tracks are as they appear in the show or are shortened for in-game use.

70050000075965.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger - Outer Dungeons The Halls of EXP, Gold, Materials
70050000075965.description:
Enhance Digimon Story Time Stranger with special outer dungeons.

Outer Dungeons include:
• The Hall of EXP: Obtain experience items by defeating Digimon in this Outer Dungeon
• The Hall of Gold: Obtain in-game currency by defeating Digimon in this Outer Dungeon
• The Hall of Materials: Obtain materials for Farm Items by defeating Digimon in this Outer Dungeon

*Outer Dungeons can be accessed through the The In-Between Theater.

70050000076079.name: Cards Pack 2
70050000076079.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70050000076079.description: With your furry friends, the fun never ends! Give your brain a boost and sharpen your memory by matching pairs across 22 vibrant, brand-new cards. Don't wait up, these colorful characters are ready to turn every session into a playful workout for your mind!

70050000076106.name: Farm Together 2 - Cyber Pack
70050000076106.intro: Experience the Future now with this customization pack for Farm Together 2!
70050000076106.description:
Experience the Future now with this customization pack for Farm Together 2!

Cyber Pack offers the following content:
* Avatar Customization Set: Clothing, Hairdo, Earring, Fairy
* Cyber House
* Farm Items: Cyber Tree (3 variants), Tetra Fish (5 variants)
* Farm Buildings: Cyber Teleporter, power station, sign
* Cyber Farm Decoration Set
* Cyber House Decoration Set

70050000076147.name: Cats Pack
70050000076147.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70050000076147.description:
This cat will be the last” is the biggest lie in human history. With Cats Pack, you can get new furry friends without feeling guilty! Can you resist their feline charms?
Cats Pack DLC contains new cats to fit in the box.

70050000076148.name: Shard Squad - Wind Character Pack
70050000076148.intro: Discover 4 new Wind Shards with unique abilities focused on speed, area control & enemy interaction. Unlock new builds and synergies!
70050000076148.description:
Wind Character Pack adds new winds to your adventure!

This pack introduces 4 new Wind Shards, each with unique abilities, playstyles, and synergies, allowing for new builds, strategies, and ways to face the game’s challenges.

Designed for players who enjoy experimenting with different mechanics and mastering agile movement, the Wind Shards focus on speed, area control, and dynamic interactions with enemies.

Included content:
• 4 new elemental Wind Shards
• Unique abilities for each character
• New build and synergy possibilities
• Fully integrated with the progression and systems of the base game

70050000076149.name: Boxes Pack
70050000076149.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70050000076149.description:
Making food is much more fun if it looks pretty! Pack your delicious food neatly in brand new boxes and never get bored!
Boxes Pack DLC allows you to change bento boxes – pick the one you like the most or change them every time you play to always keep things fresh!

70050000076150.name: Additional Board 3
70050000076150.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70050000076150.description: Give your kid more space to play and learn! Unleash their artistic talents with a new canvas ready to be filled with colorful stories.

70050000076152.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Security Gear
70050000076152.intro: Border duty never stops—make sure your equipment is up for the challenge.
70050000076152.description:
Enhance your experience with a visual upgrade for your scanning equipment. This DLC changes the appearance of both the clothing scanner and the temperature scanner, giving your inspection tools a refreshed and distinctive look while maintaining full functionality.

Continue your duty at the border with improved visual clarity and a more personalized inspection setup as you monitor incoming survivors and detect potential infections in a world overrun by the outbreak.

70050000076203.name: Succubus Sexy Devils: Abyss Outfit
70050000076203.intro: Give your lethal succubus a stunning new appearance.
70050000076203.description:
Elevate your infernal style while tearing through the nightmarish hordes of Hell.

This DLC grants your lethal demoness an exclusive new outfit, blending supreme temptation with absolute power. As you slice, shoot, and scorch your way through twisted arenas, this stunning attire will ensure you look flawlessly fierce in every brutal encounter.

Embrace the dark temptation, unleash your full power, and show every monster who is in charge.

70050000076205.name: Lou's Lagoon – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000076205.description:
Take flight in your seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After a devastating storm, gather materials with your Swirler, and help the locals rebuild. Can you uncover the truth behind Uncle Lou’s disappearance?

A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle 

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance.

Collect, Craft, Restore 

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. 

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.  

Meet the islanders of Limbo 

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins! 

Key Features: 
- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 
- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 
- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 
- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 
- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?

70050000076214.name: Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Fancy Predator
70050000076214.intro: New kicks, fresh threads, unstoppable shark powers.
70050000076214.description:
Who says the ultimate apex predator can’t have immaculate drip? Take your urban destruction to a whole new level of style!

With this DLC, your shark’s favorite footwear gets a premium upgrade. Experience a brand-new, high-end material texture on your sneakers that catches the light perfectly as you tail-slap your way through skyscrapers.

Run rampant, abduct characters, and crush bosses while sporting the freshest look in the entire metropolis. Destroy the city, but make it fashion!

70050000076216.name: Animal Buddies - Party Beasts: Vintage Overhaul
70050000076216.intro: The delivery industry called—they want their 90s technology back!
70050000076216.description:
Step into a refreshed version of your delivery experience with a playful visual twist.

Bring a fresh visual theme to one of your favorite challenges. This DLC replaces the standard boxes in the “Loader” level with a collection of retro televisions, giving one of the game’s delivery missions a completely different appearance.

Take on the Loader challenge with a different look and enjoy a new way to experience your favorite deliveries.

70050000076220.name: Skater Bunny Simulator: Skate Capital
70050000076220.intro: Build your dream setup and ride your own way.
70050000076220.description:
Take your first steps into the world of skateboarding with additional resources ready to support your adventure.

Expand your skateboarding journey with an additional $1000 added directly to your in-game balance. The extra funds provide greater flexibility for customizing your bunny, upgrading your skateboard, and exploring more of the game’s progression systems.

Enjoy a more versatile skating experience and create your own path to becoming a legendary skater bunny.

70050000076225.name: Daughter of Fate
70050000076225.intro: Please update the game to the latest version first. After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete her story missions to recruit her into your squad.
70050000076225.description:
There are many rumors about why the ethereal Xuan Nü appeared. Some say she came by Heaven’s mandate to save the Great Fire; others say she drifted here because of a conflict between divine beliefs; or perhaps she carries an even greater, unspeakable secret. Whatever the truth may be, she seems to share some common goals with the Heir of Formlessness. If you can earn Xuan Nü’s trust and aid, you will surely gain an unmatched and powerful ally on your path to immortality!

Skill Introduction:
Voidbreaker
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: Deals additional self-element damage based on the target’s lost HP.

Heaven-Earth Rectification
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to the single enemy character with the lowest HP.

Primordial Revelation
When dealing hit damage: Has a chance equal to a certain percentage of her Crit Rate to double the damage.

Mandate to Slay Evil
When landing a kill: Deals non-elemental damage to all enemy characters equal to a certain percentage of the overflow damage.

70050000076234.name: PRITTO PRISONER – DLC [Animal Skin KOGYARU & Himelove Pack]
70050000076234.description:
Super cute animal skins from the "KOGYARU & Himelove" collaboration are coming to PRITTO PRISONER!!
Make your gal & princess debut in PRITTO PRISONER!?

Limited-time sale: July 24, 2026 (Fri) 0:00 – October 23, 2026 (Fri) 23:59 *JST

70050000076241.intro: Decoration Set: KOGYARU & Himelove Pack A

70050000076242.intro: A set of casual T-shirts featuring designs like Blue Puni!
70050000076242.description:
Adds three T-shirt costumes for Yumia.

List of Contents:
- "Anytime Blue Puni!" Costume for Yumia

70050000076244.intro: A white costume for a brief moment of relaxation.

Adds the "Alchemist on Her Day Off" costume for Yumia.

Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room.

70050000076252.name: Jump Up 3D: Mini Basketball – New Style
70050000076252.intro: New gears, random spheres—dominate the court in style.
70050000076252.description:
Ready to turn heads on the trampoline? This DLC expands your customization menu with an exclusive line of high-flying outfits.

The moment you equip a piece, you step into the unknown—the game will automatically randomize your gear, giving you a completely unexpected outfit combination for your next big jump.

Don’t just aim for the hoop—aim for the ultimate surprise style. Get ready for showtime!

70050000076254.name: PRITTO PRISONER – DLC [Decoration Set: KOGYARU & Himelove Pack B]
70050000076254.intro: Decoration Set: KOGYARU & Himelove Pack B
70050000076254.description:
Super cute decorations from the "KOGYARU & Himelove" collaboration are coming to PRITTO PRISONER!!

70050000076260.name: Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000076260.description: By purchasing this content, the Nintendo Switch™ software "Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story" can be upgraded to "Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition".

70050000076269.name: Easy Red 2: Blood on the Danube
70050000076269.intro:
Fight the Eastern Front’s final battles.
From Budapest’s streets to Balaton’s frozen fields,
the Danube runs red.
70050000076269.description:
Blood on the Danube takes Easy Red 2 to Hungary in 1945, focusing on some of the final and most brutal battles of the Eastern Front of World War 2.

Fight across three historical campaigns: the Siege of Budapest, the Konrad Offensives, and Operation Spring Awakening. Experience more than 30 missions across two maps, from large-scale armoured warfare near Lake Balaton to brutal street-to-street fighting inside Budapest.

The expansion adds new Hungarian and Romanian factions with dedicated voice acting, along with a wide selection of new weapons, vehicles, tanks, aircraft, support equipment, and late-war experimental gear such as the Vampir ZG-1229 night vision scope.

Blood on the Danube expands the base Easy Red 2 experience with new environments, factions, equipment, and combined-arms battles designed to integrate with the mission and map editor.

70050000076273.name: Hotel Business Simulator: Cozy Basement
70050000076273.intro: Run your empire from a completely redesigned basement office.
70050000076273.description:
Every great hotel mogul needs a place to retreat, unwind, and plan their next big expansion. It’s time to trade the standard look for something with a lot more character!

This DLC transforms your player’s personal room into a stylish, atmospheric basement retreat. Blending a cozy underground aesthetic with an industrial edge, this complete visual overhaul gives your private space a unique, modern-rustic look without altering any core hotel gameplay.

Step downstairs, enjoy your newly redesigned sanctuary, and return to the lobby fully recharged to manage your empire!

70050000076334.name: New Planet Pack
70050000076334.description: 4 Planet themed balls - Earth, Mercury, Uranus and Pluto.

70050000076335.name: Artist Pack
70050000076335.description: 4 Artist themed balls - Green, Pink, Red and Violet.

70050000076338.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Fun Weapons Pack
70050000076338.description: Add some hilarity to your demonic destruction with seven goofy weapons, including the Leek, Push Broom, Rainbow, Megaphone, Paw Stick, Paintbrush, and Demon Gun Yoshitsuna!

70050000076353.name: Grass Green Chessboard
70050000076353.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70050000076353.description:
Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world. This time with our new Grass Green Chessboard.
Help your thoughts flow easier with the new skin to your chessboard.

70050000076357.name: Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto - DLC Chopper Bike Pack
70050000076357.intro:
Ride this beast through city streets.
Kick it into gear and reach top speeds.
70050000076357.description:
Add this powerful motorcycle to your garage with the Chopper Bike Pack DLC for Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto.
Upgrade and customize it to your liking to create your own unique chopper.

70050000076358.name: Seven-Star Strategist
70050000076358.intro: Please update the game to the latest version first. After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete her story missions to recruit her into your squad.
70050000076358.description:
Seven Stars Pavilion is an ancient sect deeply versed in the stars and the movements of heaven and earth. In an ancient age beyond record, Seven Stars Pavilion was founded in the northern part of the continent—a place better suited for observing the heavens. The Seven-Star Diviners are the core members of Seven Stars Pavilion. Their study of the starry heavens has reached perfection, allowing them to command the great power of the stars for their own use.

Skill Introduction:
Star Essence
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: additionally restores a certain amount of Mana.

Seven-Star Soul Suppression
Summons 7 Star Pieces. Each Star Piece deals self-element damage based on Attack to a random single enemy character.

Starry Array
When triggering Lucky Hit:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Starry Array】 to the target, lasting until the end of the wave.

Astral Divination 
After casting Ultimate:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Astral Divination】 to self, lasting until the end of the wave.

70050000076389.name: Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto - DLC Premium Car Pack
70050000076389.intro:
Ride this beast through city streets.
Kick it into gear and reach top speeds.
70050000076389.description:
Add this premium performance car to your garage with the Premium Car Pack DLC for Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto.

Upgrade and customize it to your liking to create your own unique ride.

70050000076395.name: Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto - DLC Ultimate Vehicle Pack
70050000076395.intro:
Choose your beast and dominate the city streets.
Kick it into gear and reach top speeds.
70050000076395.description:
Add two exclusive vehicles to your garage with the Ultimate Vehicle Pack DLC for Street Racing Simulator Evo : Car & Moto.
Upgrade and customize them to your liking to create your ultimate collection.

70050000076397.name: Virtual Singer Vol.2 Music+Character Pack
70050000076397.intro: A pack featuring 6 popular songs including "Liar Dancer" and "Brain Rot", along with a "Kasane Teto" navigator and avatar is now available!
70050000076397.description:
As additional downloadable content for "GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS", a pack featuring 6 popular songs and the character Kasane Teto is now available!

This pack includes the following content.

■ Songs (6 tracks)
- Liar Dancer / masarada
- Science / MIMI
- CANDY COOKIE CHOCOLATE / HALLO CEL
- Daidaidaidaidaikirai / Amala
- Signaling / AnythingBecomeMoe
- Brain Rot / Tokyo Manaka

■Navigator
- Kasane Teto(GCFP)

■Avaters
- Kasane Teto(GCFP)
- Kasane Teto(SV)
- Kasane Teto(White coat)

Once you add the DLC, all songs are immediately available to play in Performance Mode! Additionally, each song will be added to specific spaces as challenge tracks in Story Mode!

The navigator “Kasane Teto(GCFP)” features an original design created for this game, and includes both animations and voice lines!
Navigator and avatars can be unlocked through the "Virtual Singer Vol.2 Song + Character Pack Mission" added to Story Mode!

This mission also lets you enjoy a mini-story in four parts featuring Kasane Teto and this work’s original character, Sarashina Rikka(CV: Ohzora Naomi)!

70050000076417.name: Wallpapers Pack 2
70050000076417.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70050000076417.description: Bored with your current Nintendo Switch™ theme? Give your console a fresh, fabulous look with nOS new Operating System and a pack of 4 cute, cozy wallpapers (coming both in light and dark mode!)

70050000076420.name: Watering Can
70050000076420.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70050000076420.description: Expand your pottery collection with Watering Can DLC! Discover a variety of beautifully decorated watering cans inspired by nature, animals, and cozy gardens.

70050000076440.name: Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000076440.description: Upgrade from the Nintendo Switch™ software Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster to Outlaws + Handful of Missions: Remaster – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition!

70050000076451.name: STARBITES - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000076451.description: Experience higher resolutions, frame rates, and graphical quality when you upgrade to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition of STARBITES! You'll appreciate Bitter like never before!

70050000076456.name: Cats
70050000076456.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70050000076456.description: Bring even more cuteness to your creations with Cats DLC! Decorate your cozy spaces with 20 adorable cat characters in playful poses, making every design even warmer and more charming.

70050000076458.name: SOMA - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000076458.intro: A masterpiece of psychological horror. Fight to survive in a hostile world that will make you question your own existence.
70050000076458.description: Experience SOMA on Nintendo Switch™ 2 with enhanced image quality and a smoother frame rate.

70050000076469.name: Experience x3 - Asdivine Knot
70050000076469.description:
All characters' experience gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000076470.name: SP x3 - Asdivine Knot
70050000076470.description:
All characters' SP gained increases by 200%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000076471.name: Experience & SP x2 - Asdivine Knot
70050000076471.description:
All characters' experience and SP gained increases by 100%.
Effect stacks for similar items.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000076472.name: Damage x2 - Asdivine Knot
70050000076472.description:
Damage dealt to enemies is doubled.
Settings can be changed in the options section of the menu.

70050000076479.name: Blitz Pack
70050000076479.description: 4 Pro Balls - Purple, Aqua, Red and Black.

70050000076480.name: Fruit Pack
70050000076480.description: 4 Fruit themed balls - Orange, Apple, Lime and Watermelon.

70050000076481.name: Marmor Pack
70050000076481.description: 4 Pro balls - Green, Black, Yellow and Blue.

70050000076482.name: New Sports Pack
70050000076482.description: 4 Sport balls - Golf, 10 Ball, Beach and Football.

70050000076483.name: Wildlife
70050000076483.intro: Find calm in relaxing world-themed coloring
70050000076483.description:
Expand your Coloree collection with a journey into the animal kingdom. Wildlife adds 15 new color-by-number illustrations featuring fascinating animals from around the world – from powerful predators and gentle herbivores to colorful birds, delicate insects, and many other remarkable creatures.
Each artwork offers a peaceful, relaxing experience with no timers, no scores, and no pressure. Simply follow the numbers and watch every animal come to life with vibrant colors. Whether you're looking for a quick moment to unwind or a more detailed coloring session, Wildlife has something for every mood.
What's inside:
15 new wildlife-themed artworks to color at your own pace
A diverse collection of mammals, birds, reptiles, insects, and more
A mix of simpler and more detailed illustrations for every skill level
Relaxing, number-guided coloring designed for adult players
Calm, pressure-free gameplay that's perfect for unwinding
Discover the beauty of wildlife, one color at a time.

70050000076492.name: Wukong Black Legend: Nightfall Descends
70050000076492.intro: Embrace the eternal night and rewrite your own legend.
70050000076492.description:
Darkness falls upon the world, bringing deeper secrets and an entirely new visual thrill.

The sky has changed, and a new atmosphere awaits.This DLC replaces the standard gray sky with a deep, mysterious night sky, altering the visual aesthetic of your entire adventure.

Every sword clash, fire-ball capture, and hidden clue feels completely different under the cover of darkness.

70050000076494.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Warzone Falcons A10 & F2
70050000076494.description:
Expand your fleet. Expand your power.

The Falcons A10 & F2 Pack introduces two advanced aircraft built for different combat styles. Whether you prefer heavy firepower or speed and precision, these jets give you more flexibility in every mission.

Take control of powerful new machines designed to handle intense aerial combat. Adapt your tactics, improve your performance, and approach missions with new strategies depending on the aircraft you choose.

This expansion adds more variety to your gameplay, allowing you to face every challenge in the skies with greater confidence and control.

Key Features:
* Two additional aircraft with unique performance styles
* Expanded combat strategies and playstyles
* Enhanced aerial combat flexibility
* More options for different mission types
Take to the skies with more power than ever.

70050000076495.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Dual Strike Fighters SU15 & F16
70050000076495.description:
Double the jets. Double the impact.

The Dual Strike Fighters SU15 & F16 DLC expands your arsenal with two versatile aircraft designed for dynamic aerial combat. Each jet brings its own balance of speed, control, and firepower, allowing you to adapt your approach in every mission.

Switch between different combat styles and take advantage of new performance capabilities as you face increasingly intense battles. Whether you prefer precision or aggressive engagement, these aircraft give you the tools to stay ahead in the skies.

Key Features:
* Two new fighter jets with distinct handling styles
* Balanced performance for multiple combat approaches
* Increased flexibility during missions
* Expanded aircraft selection
Take control of the skies with new power and precision.

70050000076496.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Stealth Vanguard Pack SU57 & SAAB JAS 39
70050000076496.description:
Strike unseen. Control the skies.

The Stealth Vanguard Pack SU57 & SAAB JAS 39 introduces two advanced aircraft built for precision, control, and low-profile combat. Designed for pilots who rely on positioning and timing, these jets allow you to approach every mission with a more tactical mindset.

With enhanced maneuverability and stealth-oriented performance, you can engage enemies on your terms and maintain control even in high-risk situations.

Key Features:
* Two stealth-focused fighter jets
* Designed for precision and tactical gameplay
* High maneuverability and control
* Expands strategic combat options

Dominate the skies without being seen.

70050000076498.name: Another Crab's Treasure - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000076498.intro: A soulslike adventure set in a crumbling underwater world.
70050000076498.description:
As Kril the hermit crab, you’ll need to wear the trash around you as shells to withstand attacks from enemies many times your size. Embark on an epic treasure hunt to buy back your repossessed shell, and discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

TRASH OR TREASURE?
In this undersea society, trash is not only a way of life, but a valuable resource, used for everything from fashion to firearms. But with the presence of trash comes a mysterious infection known as the Gunk, which could spell doom for the entire ocean.

LEARN FROM NATURE
As Kril explores the ocean, he'll gain a variety of Umami Techniques—powerful attacks learned from the denizens of the seas. Punch your enemies with the overwhelming might of a Mantis Shrimp, ensnare them with the horrifying Bobbit Worm, and much more.

UNEXPLORED DEPTHS
The ocean goes deeper than one can imagine. Fight your way through kelp forests, coral reefs, sand castle cities, and even the unfathomable darkness of the deep-sea trenches, all in the name of getting back your prized shell.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Designed to be an approachable experience for newer soulslike players as well as provide a challenge for hardcore fans, Another Crab's Treasure offers something for any level of skill or time commitment. Assist options are provided for those seeking a less frustrating experience, but gluttons for punishment are sure to find the default game a challenge.

-Soulslike-inspired combat designed to be approachable for new players while still challenging experienced fans.

-A vast undersea world to explore with colorful creatures to fight and secrets to discover.

-Over 60 shells with a variety of special abilities to defend yourself against the ocean’s threats.

-Meet a host of undersea friends and foes as you slowly discover the dark secrets behind the polluted ocean.

-Learn magical Adaptations from creatures throughout the world, making their powers your own.

70050000076504.name: Japan
70050000076504.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000076504.description: Transform your virtual space into a peaceful Zen sanctuary with the Japan DLC! Design a traditional, tea-scented oasis for your cute animal residents - the ultimate cozy aesthetics of Japan are at your fingertips!

70050000076506.name: Fruits
70050000076506.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70050000076506.description: Tasty bananas, juicy raspberries, refreshing lemons… Make sure ALL the fruits fit in, and nothing goes to waste! Have fun stuffing 34 new, delicious items in a fancy, new box with a Fruits DLC!

70050000076514.name: Cotton Candy Room
70050000076514.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70050000076514.description: It’s time for a fresh start – make your creative space reflect your vibe to the fullest! Give your crafting space a sweet makeover with this cosmetic DLC that transforms your atelier into a dreamy cotton candy-inspired haven filled with soft pastel charm.

70050000076515.name: Cats Art
70050000076515.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000076515.description:
Decorate your space with adorable feline charm in the Cats Art DLC! Fill your room with cat-themed wallpapers, wall art, and cute décor that celebrate everyone’s favorite companions.

Purr-fect style for every cat lover!

70050000076537.name: Hoop Pack 3
70050000076537.intro: Stitch it up to puzzle out!
70050000076537.description:
This Hoop Pack contains 60 unique Hoops in various categories and sizes.
Featuring your favorite categories plus brand-new ones to discover:
- Animals
- Fairy Tales
- Games & Hobbies
- Mythical Creatures
- Transportation
- Outdoors
- Best Friends
- Pixel Art
- Retro
- Tiny Dinos
- Aquarium
- Food & Drinks
Expand your stitching adventure today!

70050000076539.name: Weekly Hoops Pack 1
70050000076539.intro: Stitch it up to puzzle out!
70050000076539.description:
This Weekly Hoops Pack contains 52 unique Hoops inspired by celebrations, cultural events, and special days from around the world.
There's always a new story to stitch!

70050000076548.name: Disney Speedstorm – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000076548.intro: Drift into the ultimate hero-based combat racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds.
70050000076548.description:
Disney Speedstorm is the ultimate hero-based combat-racing game, set on high-speed circuits inspired by Disney and Pixar worlds. It’s a thrilling arcade racing experience where players will need to master each Character’s unique Skills on the racetrack and claim victory. 

DISNEY & PIXAR GO FULL BATTLE RACING 
An incredible cast of characters, including Sulley, Beast, Mickey Mouse, Mulan, Baloo, Captain Jack Sparrow, and more, are suited and revving up for racing combat. Upgrade each Racer’s stats and make the most of their unique Skills that can impact the outcome of a single race and dramatically change the way you play the game! 

ARCADE RACING REDEFINED 
Anyone can pick up and play Disney Speedstorm, but mastering skills and techniques like timing your nitro boosts, precisely drifting around corners, and adapting to dynamic track environments are crucial to dominating each race. 

RACING TOGETHER HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER 
Pick your Racer and speed through action-packed tracks solo, or challenge friends in local and online multiplayer modes. You can even face off with players from around the globe to become an online legend.

DISNEY- & PIXAR-INSPIRED RACETRACKS 
Start your engine in environments inspired by some of your favorite Disney and Pixar films. From the docks of Pirates of the Caribbean’s Kraken Port to the wilds of The Jungle Book’s Jungle Ruins or the Scare Floor from Monsters, Inc., you can experience these worlds from a fresh, exciting perspective geared specifically for racing!

CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR OWN STYLE 
Choose your favorite Racer’s suit, a flashy kart livery, and show off stylish wheels and wings -- all of this and more is possible with the extensive customization features in the game! 

NEW CONTENT RACING YOUR WAY 
The action never slows down thanks to fresh seasonal content always around the corner. New Disney and Pixar Racers will be added regularly, bringing special skills for you to master (or overcome), and unique tracks will be created often, to pump fresh strategy into the mix. Support Crew characters, environments, customization options, and collectibles will also drop in regularly, so there’s always more to experience.

70050000076556.name: Hello Kitty Party Land - Bonus Avatar T-shirt
70050000076556.description:
Grants a T-shirt for your avatar that can be used in-game.
Select a character T-shirt for your avatar from 80 designs!

70050000076557.name: Rainbow Lady Birds
70050000076557.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70050000076557.description: This blaze of colors will never fade away! Make your days at the laundry bright and colorful with the Rainbow Lady Birds DLC.

70050000076589.name: Mounted Knights Battle : Medieval Warrior Honor Simulator - Elite Gear
70050000076589.intro: Forge a legendary path with upgraded battlefield readiness.
70050000076589.description:
Every legendary warrior requires gear that matches their valor. This DLC enhances a knight’s available arsenal, ensuring they are well-equipped for the challenges within the bustling cities.

Features:
- Adds Armor Number 7 to the inventory, sculpted to withstand heavy lance impacts in the heat of combat.
- In cases where Armor No. 7 is already available, a sum of 4,727 Coins will be rewarded instead to fund future tournament preparations.

Equip the armory, secure the treasury, and ride into the fray with confidence.

70050000076670.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Night Ops
70050000076670.intro: Every corridor. Every secret. Always visible.
70050000076670.description:
When every shadow could hide a deadly threat, reliable night vision becomes your greatest advantage.

This DLC adds a Night Vision Camera to your inventory with unlimited battery power, allowing you to explore the darkest corners of the Backrooms without worrying about losing visibility. If you already own a Night Vision Camera, it will be automatically upgraded with an infinite battery.

Keep your camera powered at all times, uncover hidden paths, spot dangers before they strike, and face the endless darkness with complete confidence.

70050000076692.name: Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Road to Success
70050000076692.intro: Build your trucking empire with a powerful financial advantage.
70050000076692.description:
Expand your business faster and hit the road without worrying about your starting budget.

This DLC grants $75,000 directly to your in-game account, giving you the freedom to invest in better trucks, essential upgrades, and new opportunities from the very beginning. Build your transport company, complete more profitable contracts, and accelerate your journey toward becoming a successful trucking entrepreneur.

Take control of your future, grow your fleet with confidence, and keep your business moving forward.

70050000076697.name: MYSIDE REALITY: Cozy Style
70050000076697.intro: Keep the story, change the style.
70050000076697.description:
A fresh outfit can completely change the feel of every encounter.

This DLC replaces Mira’s default clothing with an entirely new outfit, giving the mysterious companion a distinctive new appearance throughout the adventure. Every conversation, discovery, and unforgettable moment is accompanied by a refreshed visual style that blends naturally with the game’s immersive atmosphere.

Experience the story from a new perspective as Mira’s updated look brings an extra touch of personality to every encounter.

70050000076707.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Bonus Story: Catastrophe Flan Arc
70050000076707.description: Experience a bonus story and acquire five new enemy types (Sea Angel, Flora Beast, Evil Eye, Zombie Maiden, and Nine-Tails), each of which can become a battle buddy! You'll even be able to recruit Desco!

70050000076708.name: Disgaea Mayhem - N.A. Color Pack
70050000076708.description: Switch up N.A.'s look with these cool colors, unique to the Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2 versions of the game!

70050000076709.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Digital Soundtrack/Artbook App
70050000076709.description: With the Digital Soundtrack/Artbook App, you have the perfect digital accompaniment to Disgaea Mayhem. Enjoy the art and music even when you're not playing the game!

70050000076778.name: No More Slimes!! - "Catgirl Survivor" Characters Unlocked! [Akane] [Koro]
70050000076778.intro: Firepower support from cute catgirls from another dimension!!
70050000076778.description:
An unknown dimensional rift suddenly opened in the peaceful 'Slime Dimension'! Waking up in an unknown space filled with sticky and squishy monsters all around, two catgirls from the Catgirl Survivor dimension have crash-landed!

Akane, who deals continuous damage using her fiery fists, and Koro, who freezes enemies to deal massive damage using ice magic!

Strategically utilize the abilities of these two catgirls with completely different combat styles to defeat the Rainbow Slime and send them safely back home!

70050000076971.name: Car Detailing & Wash Simulator : Luxury Car Cleaner – Growth Fund
70050000076971.intro: A financial boost for your luxury detailing business.
70050000076971.description:
Expand your luxury car care business with additional funds available from the very beginning.

This DLC adds 2,500 to your in-game balance, providing extra resources to invest in better equipment, unlock valuable upgrades, and accelerate the growth of your detailing shop. Build a premium service faster and take on high-end vehicles with greater confidence.

A stronger starting budget means more opportunities to improve your workshop and establish a reputation as the city’s leading luxury car detailing expert.

70050000077048.name: dotAGE: Trade Secrets
70050000077048.intro: The world of dotAGE gets bigger! Trade Secrets adds 3 new elders, mechanics, resources, buildings, events, and much more!
70050000077048.description:
Trading Places!
Resources gain a new role in Trade Secrets. The Goldlings have discovered your village, and they are eager to trade their coins for your resources!  Stockpile goods in warehouses, move them via roads, and trade them through markets. Then use your hard earned coins to trade even more!

Born to ride!
Pips have finally discovered a better way to get their work done, by riding horses and using other means of transports! Craft boats, build carts, and tame horses to aid in the expansion of your village!

Brave new world!
After years of fear, Pips are ready to explore the world beyond! Dispatch them on expeditions and see what they bring back: rare resources, lost blueprints… and the occasional unfamiliar disease.

Three new elders!
New elders join the world of dotAGE! Meet Wanna the Merchant; Darwin the Explorer, and the elusive Granny!

..and secrets?
The outside world is mysterious, what might be waiting for you out there? Some Pips say that there is a lost treasure out there, as well as some kind of... special cult. There is only one way to find out... start exploring in Trade Secrets!

70050000077066.name: Raccoon Adventure: Animal City Simulator 3D Farm Super Deluxe – New Species
70050000077066.intro: Expand your adventures with brand-new wildlife encounters.
70050000077066.description:
Bring even more life to the world of Raccoon Adventure with three brand-new animal species waiting to be discovered.

This DLC introduces three new types of animals that naturally appear throughout the game world, making every exploration feel more varied and alive. Encounter fresh wildlife during your adventures, discover new interactions, and enjoy a richer environment as you roam forests, parks, and suburban neighborhoods.

Every journey becomes more exciting with additional creatures to find, observe, and share the world with as you continue your mischievous raccoon adventure.

70050000077076.name: SCREAM AND STEEL - Horror Story Shooter: Light the Way
70050000077076.intro: Every journey into darkness begins with a light.
70050000077076.description:
Face the nightmare with two essential sources of light that will help you survive the horrors hidden within the maze. This DLC adds a flashlight and a candle, giving you additional ways to navigate dark corridors and uncover what lurks in the shadows.

The flashlight illuminates your path until you pick up the pistol, at which point it is automatically replaced. If you die, the flashlight disappears, making every decision and every step through the darkness even more meaningful.

Venture deeper into the unknown, reveal hidden dangers, and rely on every source of light as you fight to escape the nightmare.

70050000077078.name: SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE: Ready to Fire
70050000077078.intro: Bring new firepower to the battlefield.
70050000077078.description:
Strengthen your arsenal with the DKS-501, a precision weapon built for long-range engagements and tactical missions. This DLC adds the rifle directly to your inventory, giving you another reliable option for taking on challenging assignments.

In addition to the weapon itself, you’ll also receive six locked weapon skins, allowing you to unlock and customize the rifle’s appearance as you progress.

Gear up, complete your missions, and master every shot with a weapon designed for elite marksmen.

70050000077156.name: City Bus Simulator: New Wheels
70050000077156.intro: Drive more routes with an expanded fleet.
70050000077156.description:
Growing your fleet is an important step toward building a successful transportation network.

Features:
- Adds the Martopolo double-decker bus to your vehicle collection.
- If the Martopolo bus has already been purchased, 290,000 in-game currency is awarded instead.

Expand your fleet, optimize your routes, and keep your passengers moving with confidence.

70050000077161.name: Green Zen Set
70050000077161.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70050000077161.description: Make the guests of your restaurant feel calm and eat your delicious meals with peace of mind with Green Zen Set! DLC adds a new customization option for tableware you serve your carefully prepared dishes on.

70050000077176.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026: Success Fund
70050000077176.intro: Give your business the boost it needs to expand.
70050000077176.description:
Every successful supermarket begins with smart investments. This DLC instantly adds 2,000 to your in-game balance, giving you additional funds to stock your shelves, expand your inventory, upgrade equipment, and improve your store from the very beginning. Make strategic decisions, invest where it matters most, and accelerate your journey toward becoming a successful supermarket owner.

Grow your supermarket with confidence, make every investment count, and turn your local shop into a thriving retail destination.

70050000077180.name: Tokyo Racer X: JDM Legend
70050000077180.intro: Dominate the streets with a premium performance car.
70050000077180.description:
Take your place in Tokyo’s underground racing scene with the Nissan Skyline R34 added directly to your garage. Known as one of the most iconic performance cars in street racing culture, it delivers the perfect balance of speed, control, and precision drifting for high-intensity races through neon-lit city streets and expressways.

From tight corner drifts to high-speed highway runs, this machine gives you the confidence to push your limits and stand out in every competition. Step into the driver’s seat, refine your skills, and make your mark in the underground racing world.

70050000077185.name: Mini Wheels Racers - Turbo Toy Playground: Green Fortune
70050000077185.intro: Build your collection faster and race with confidence.
70050000077185.description:
Give your racing adventure a head start with 1,000 Leaves added directly to your in-game balance. Use them to unlock new opportunities, expand your collection, and enjoy greater flexibility as you progress through colorful playgrounds and exciting races.

Whether you’re customizing your favorite toy cars, unlocking new content, or preparing for bigger challenges, this bonus helps you advance faster and make the most of every race.

Collect more, unlock more, and enjoy even more fun as you race toward becoming the ultimate playground champion.

70050000077191.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Golden Survival Pack
70050000077191.intro: Gold-polished gear for brutal fights and last stands.
70050000077191.description:
The world fell apart. Your weapons don’t have to look like it.

The Golden Survival Pack delivers a full set of premium gold-finished weapon skins for the survivors of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Outfit your arsenal with striking new looks of the iconic weaponry of The Walking Dead. Carve through walkers with Michonne’s katana, drop walkers with Daryl’s crossbow, or unload Rick’s magnum in the middle of a desperate last stand, every fight hits harder when your gear stands out against the ruins of the world.

Battle through the apocalypse with an arsenal forged to shine when everything else has gone dark. The Golden Survival Pack Includes 7 golden skins for iconic character weapons.

70050000077195.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Arcade Apocalypse Pack
70050000077195.intro: More walkers, more game modes, more skins, and more digital bonus content.
70050000077195.description:
The Arcade Apocalypse Pack expands the brutal world of AMC’s The Walking Dead with exclusive digital content built for survivors ready to push deeper into the apocalypse.

Push your skills to the limit in Walker Pit - an Endless Survival Mode, where every encounter becomes a desperate battle to stay alive against overwhelming odds. For survivors looking for the ultimate challenge, “Hell on Earth” difficulty strips away checkpoints and leaves no room for mistakes.

Also included are additional weapon & character skins, and the digital soundtrack.

The Arcade Apocalypse Pack includes:
•        2 Weapon Skins - Bloody Lucille, Tactical Magnum
•        1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick 
•        The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
•        HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
•        Digital Soundtrack

70050000077222.name: Mostroscopy: Expansion 1
70050000077222.intro:
Monsters. Masks. Mayhem.
A retro-style brawler inspired by 1950s Mexican Lucha & Monsters.
70050000077222.description:
CONTENT:
- Character "Vladislava", "Cabaret Stupa" Stage and Vladislava's Challenge Mode
- Character "Camazotz", "Tullum" Stage and Camazotz's Challenge Mode
- Character "Dollores", "Island of Dolls" Stage and Dollores' Challenge Mode
- Character "Medea", "Medea's Tomb" Stage and Medea's Challenge Mode
- Character "Saturnina", "Dead Gods" Stage and Saturnina's Challenge Mode
- Character "Tachiko Kikuchi", "Iwakura Niwa" Stage and Tachiko's Challenge Mode

70050000077230.name: Extra Song Pack 16
70050000077230.intro: This DLC grants access to 15 songs including Touhou original "Shanghai Scarlet Teahouse ~ Chinese Tea", "Flowering Night"
70050000077230.description:
This DLC grants access to 15 songs including Touhou original "Shanghai Scarlet Teahouse ~ Chinese Tea", "Flowering Night"

70050000077232.name: 1000xRESIST – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000077232.intro: A society of clones is ripped apart by a 1000-year-old secret.
70050000077232.description:
The Peabody Award-winning 1000xRESIST is a thrilling sci-fi adventure. 1000 years in the future, humanity is all but extinguished, and a disease spread by an alien occupation keeps the survivors underground. You are Watcher. You dutifully fulfil your purpose in service of the ALLMOTHER, until the day you learn a shocking secret that changes everything.

THE END OF HUMANITY
In the near future, we learn we are not alone in the universe. A mysterious alien race of giant entities arrives. We call them the Occupants.

They are not hostile, but it doesn’t matter. Their arrival is a death sentence. Humanity is wiped out in a matter of months, succumbing to a disease the Occupants have brought to our planet.

There is one survivor, a teenage girl called Iris. Somehow she is immune.

SOCIETY IS REBORN IN HER IMAGE
1000 years later. Iris is not only immune, but immortal. She has birthed a new society consisting exclusively of her own clones. She calls them Sisters. They call her the ALLMOTHER.

RELIVE HER MEMORIES
Within the Orchard, every sister has an assigned function, while six sisters have special roles to play.  As the new Watcher, Your role is unique. You have the great privilege of reliving and interpreting the memories of the ALLMOTHER through a process known as Communion, made possible by Secretary, your floating AI companion. You're excited to embark on your first Communion.

RESIST A THOUSAND-YEAR-OLD LIE
Your closest sister, Fixer, comes to you with a dangerous revelation. You have been lied to. The ALLMOTHER is not what she claims to be. Fixer’s claims rock the foundations of your world, throwing everything you know and believe into doubt as it falls to you to discover the truth.

DISCOVER THE TRUTH
Dive into the memories of the ALLMOTHER and explore pivotal moments in her life, jumping back and forth through moments in time to solve puzzles and access locked-off areas and secrets.

A STORY LIKE NO OTHER
Experience perspective shifts both literal and metaphorical as the game blends between 3rd person adventure, visual novel and first person walking simulator while throwing twists, turns and revelations at you until you question everything you think you know.

70050000077289.name: Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator – Workshop Boost
70050000077289.intro: Accelerate your journey to the championship.
70050000077289.description:
Take your drag racing career further with an instant boost to your progression. This DLC grants 70 upgrade points, giving you more freedom to develop your vehicles, unlock powerful improvements, and fine-tune different aspects of your racing experience.

Use these points to enhance your dragsters, improve performance systems, and customize your setup to match your driving style. Every upgrade brings you closer to dominating the quarter-mile tracks and outperforming your rivals.

Push your machines beyond their limits, refine your strategy, and become a stronger competitor on every race you enter.

70050000077314.name: Cat Girl Survivor – Additional Character "Emer"
70050000077314.intro:
A New Cat Has Arrived!
Blessed by the forest, she transforms into a powerful cat and attacks her enemies.
70050000077314.description:
A new playable character, “Emer”, joins Cat Girl Survivor.

Emer, a guardian cat who has protected the forest for ages, joins your adventure as a new ally.

Blessed by the forest, Emer can transform into a mighty guardian,
using powerful slashing attacks and deadly bites to overwhelm nearby enemies with incredible strength.

In her spare time, she carefully trims her claws to keep her favorite stockings from getting torn.

But the moment she encounters demons,
those carefully maintained claws become merciless weapons.

Experience thrilling battles with Emer, the Guardian of the Forest who transforms into a powerful cat (?) and unleashes overwhelming power!

*This content requires the base game “Cat Girl Survivor” to play.*

70050000077316.name: Love Spell: Aslan's Story (DLC)
70050000077316.intro: The magic of Love Spell continues with a brand-new romanceable bachelor: Aslan, The Wizard!
70050000077316.description:
Continue Luna's magical adventure in Love Spell with the first story expansion DLC, featuring an all-new romance route!

When Luna chases the mysterious pink-haired bartender, Aslan, through a magical portal, she finds herself stranded in a parallel world unlike anything she's ever known. Together with Aslan, Philia, and Aslan's adorable penguin familiar, Merlow, she'll embark on a brand-new adventure in search of a way back home.

Experience a full-length new romance route starring Aslan the Wizard, complete with new story content, beautiful CG artwork, and unlockable additions to the Gallery, Character Profiles, and Navigation Menu.

Whether you're returning to Love Spell or continuing your journey after the original prologue, Aslan's story offers a magical new chapter filled with romance, humor, and adventure.

70050000077317.name: Hex Park - Master DLC
70050000077317.intro: A relaxing puzzle adventure where simple rules lead to surprisingly deep challenges.
70050000077317.description:
Ready to level up your park-perfect planning? Hex Park: Master DLC adds 150 brand-new, handcrafted challenges that push your arrow-guiding skills to the limit. Every puzzle is built on Hex Park’s clean, intuitive logic—rotate and align arrow tiles, chain satisfying moves, and clear the board in as few steps as possible.
No timers, no pressure—just pure, strategic puzzle-solving with that “one more level” pull. Expect clever remixes of familiar mechanics (keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more) plus trickier layouts that reward planning, patience, and smart tool usage. When a board won’t budge, fair helpers like the hammer, dynamite, and drill keep your flow going—without breaking the puzzle.

70050000077326.name: Provence
70050000077326.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70050000077326.description: Feel the cool breeze of the sea and cook on marble countertops inspired by the historical architecture of Provence! Change the look of your kitchen and enjoy the picturesque beauty and unique tastes of France with the new Provence DLC.

70050000077327.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Dark Song Skin
70050000077327.description: Dark Song. The most threatening puppet monster the protagonists know.

70050000077335.name: Colorful Golf Balls 8
70050000077335.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit new breathtaking locations.
70050000077335.description: Visit your favorite locations, this time with a set of 5 brand new skins for your golf ball, visual effects, and trails.

70050000077337.name: Tray
70050000077337.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70050000077337.description: There’s no such thing as too much cute tableware! From sleepy kittens to mellow meadows - add more variety to your game with 14 brand new cozy tray patterns and relax assembling them piece by piece.

70050000077401.name: Food Truck Business Simulator: Revenue Boost
70050000077401.intro: Start your food truck journey with extra resources for success.
70050000077401.description:
A successful food truck starts with the right resources. This DLC instantly adds 5,000 to your in-game balance, giving you extra funds to upgrade your truck, unlock equipment, expand your menu, and grow your business faster. Invest in the improvements that matter most, reach new locations, and create an even better experience for every customer who visits your food truck.

Build your business with confidence, invest wisely, expand your culinary empire, and serve even more hungry customers across the city.

70050000077408.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator: Duty Outfit
70050000077408.intro: Stronger gear for the hardest emergency calls.
70050000077408.description:
Give your firefighter a refreshed and upgraded appearance while continuing to face life-threatening emergencies.

This DLC changes the character’s default appearance by replacing the standard outfit with a new, improved firefighter suit designed for a more modern and professional look. The updated uniform enhances the visual identity of your hero while maintaining full immersion in intense rescue missions across the city.

Step into burning buildings, respond to critical emergencies, and continue saving lives—now with a brand-new firefighting suit that reflects the courage and dedication of your role.

70050000077416.name: Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge: Skate Style
70050000077416.intro: Make your board part of your identity.
70050000077416.description:
Stand out in the busy city streets with a brand-new skateboard color that adds extra personality to your delivery runs. This DLC lets you customize your ride with a unique visual style, making every trick, grind, and delivery feel more personal and expressive.

Whether you’re speeding through traffic or performing stylish maneuvers across the urban playground, your skateboard now reflects your individuality as a true delivery pro.

Make every run more vibrant, more stylish, and uniquely yours as you dominate the city on wheels.

70050000077438.name: Sixtar Gate: STARTRAIL x Berry Melody Collaboration Pack
70050000077438.description:
A collaboration pack featuring Sixtar Gate: STARTRAIL and Berry Melody has arrived!

This downloadable content includes a total of 10 additional tracks.

70050000077444.name: Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre – Frontier Revolver
70050000077444.description:
Every gunslinger knows that the right sidearm can make all the difference when the bullets start flying. Head into every showdown with even greater confidence and firepower.

This DLC grants Pistol #6 for your arsenal. If you have already purchased this weapon, you will automatically receive a refund of $1,160 in in-game currency instead.

Expand your collection, take on every outlaw with confidence, and carve your name into the legends of the Wild West.

70050000077448.name: Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025: Racing Spirit
70050000077448.intro: Drive bigger. Jump higher. Stunt harder.
70050000077448.description:
Add a powerful new vehicle to your collection and enjoy even more ways to tackle spectacular stunt challenges.

This DLC grants the Brugacci Kipon, making it available for you to claim in the Car Shop. Put this high-performance machine to the test across massive stunt arenas, impossible ramps, daring jumps, and high-speed challenges.

Get behind the wheel, master every stunt, and show your driving skills with a powerful new addition to your garage.

70050000077459.name: Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Dragon’s Blessing
70050000077459.intro: Build a stronger dragon for every adventure.
70050000077459.description:
Strengthen your dragon’s magical abilities and prepare for even greater battles across dangerous realms filled with powerful monsters.

This DLC increases your dragon’s maximum mana by 100, allowing you to use magical abilities more often before needing to recover. Cast more devastating attacks, stay in the fight longer, and take on challenging encounters with greater confidence as you explore new worlds and defeat fearsome enemies.

Harness your enhanced magical power, overcome every challenge, and continue building your legendary dragon legacy.

70050000077461.name: Mystic Nook
70050000077461.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70050000077461.description: Gaze at the shining stars and try to see what the future brings… Make your game even more magical and feel like a real witch or wizard with Mystic Nook! This DLC will change the look of your bedroom into a stars- and moon-themed haven.

70050000077468.name: OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter: Urban Camo
70050000077468.intro: More tactical styles for every deployment.
70050000077468.description:
Bring more variety to your loadout and personalize your battlefield presence with a fresh set of cosmetic upgrades.

This DLC adds 11 new skins, giving you additional customization options to enhance your visual style during combat operations. Whether you’re preparing for intense firefights, coordinating with your team, or taking on challenging missions, these new appearances provide more ways to stand out on the battlefield.

Customize your experience, build your preferred look, and deploy into every operation with a style that matches your approach to combat.

70050000077478.name: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y - Anniversary Expansion Pack
70050000077478.description:
The Anniversary Expansion Pack includes the following content:

• 5 Playable Units*
- Gundam Calibarn
- Demi Barding
- Gundam Pharact
- Byakuya Gekkoei Sui
- Li-Brasta T
*Rewarded upon completion of Area Missions
• Additional missions

*Rewarded upon completion of Area Missions
• New Assist Crew Member
- Izana
• Bonus Mission [Anniversary Expansion Pack Exclusive]
- Experience an all-new scenario which takes place after the events of the main game. Players can carry over data from their main game save file to access the new scenario. If players have not cleared the main game, then they can access the Bonus Mission scenario option with pre-set game data.

70050000077489.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Digital Deluxe Upgrade
70050000077489.description:
A purchasable set containing all bonus content from the Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Digital Deluxe Upgrade, including outfits, music, formations, and gameplay items.

■Upgrades

Original Version Outfit Swap Pack for the Eight Protagonists
　
Button Badges
　・A set of eight button badges containing pixel art of the eight protagonists

SaGa Franchise Battle Music 10 Pack
　・Toggle between iconic battle themes from throughout the SaGa franchise.

Additional Formation Pack
　・Imperial Cross
　・Fanged Assault
　・Divine Wall

* After the content has been downloaded, players may check the content of the Original Version Outfit Swap Pack for the Eight Protagonists and SaGa Franchise Battle Music 10 Pack by opening the game and navigating to the Main Menu > Options > Bonuses section.
* The Button Badges of the Eight Protagonists, Additional Formation Pack, Trading Game Item Pack, and War Mode Item Pack can be obtained from a treasure chest in Loanne or the port of Myules after starting the game.
* There is also another set package that contains these items. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate purchases.

70050000077528.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival – Shelter Builder
70050000077528.intro: Improve your crafting and construction experience.
70050000077528.description:
Strengthen your survival journey with a useful new tool designed to support your exploration, crafting, and building efforts.

This DLC adds the Hammer directly to your inventory, giving you immediate access to this essential tool. Use it to assist with construction tasks, improve your shelter, and make your life in the wild more manageable as you gather resources and create your own haven.

Prepare for the challenges of the wilderness, expand your survival abilities, and continue building your path through nature.

70050000077550.name: Cash Guardian: Collector Operation “Capital Defense” – Extra Capital
70050000077550.intro: A stronger operation begins with better resources.
70050000077550.description:
Give your cash collection missions a stronger start with additional funds to support your progress.

This DLC adds 50,000 to your in-game balance, providing extra resources to help you upgrade your equipment, improve your operations, and prepare for more challenging armored transport missions across the city.

Manage your resources, protect valuable cargo, and continue your journey as a skilled cash transport specialist.

70050000077553.name: Summer Collection
70050000077553.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70050000077553.description: Turn your home into a summer paradise! Cool down in a pastel pool, build a sandcastle, read under a rainbow umbrella, and taste seasonal treats! Expand your design options with 20 brand new items of the Summer Collection DLC, including furniture, outdoor decor, animals, and more!

70050000077554.name: Jumbo Airport Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade pack
70050000077554.description: A paid upgrade pack that allows you to upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of Jumbo Airport Story to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Jumbo Airport Story – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70050000077564.name: Deadliest Catch - Ocean Boat Driving & Fishing 2022 Simulator: Sea Vessel
70050000077564.intro: Ready for storms, waves, and bigger catches.
70050000077564.description:
Take your crab fishing adventure further with a new ship designed to handle challenging waters and demanding expeditions.

This DLC grants the Meteor MKII ship, giving you a powerful new vessel to use during your dangerous crab-catching journeys. If the ship has already been purchased, you will receive 200,000 in-game currency as compensation.

Expand your fleet, improve your fishing operations, and continue your journey toward becoming the ultimate crab catcher.

70050000077573.name: LEGO® Party! Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000077573.description: The Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of LEGO® Party! includes enhanced resolution and improved frame rates.

70050000077592.name: Beautiful Old Towns
70050000077592.intro: Explore beautiful historic old towns where culture and history come alive. Cobblestone streets and charming architecture create an atmosphere of discovery.
70050000077592.description:

-Bruges, Belgium

70050000077593.name: Colorful Japanese Icons
70050000077593.intro: Discover the beauty of traditional Japanese motifs and craftsmanship. From seasonal symbols to beloved cultural treasures, each puzzle celebrates the charm of Japan.
70050000077593.description:
This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The following 10 puzzle images are included.
-Origami Crane

70050000077594.name: Radiant Floral Arrangements
70050000077594.intro: Step into a world of elegant floral arrangements and rich seasonal colors. Each puzzle captures the timeless charm and beauty of flowers.
70050000077594.description:
This is the additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The following 10 puzzle images are included.

70050000077595.name: [Moving] Nature's Palette
70050000077595.intro: Experience nature’s vibrant palette through beautifully moving landscapes. Seasonal colors and shifting light bring each scene to life in this moving puzzle pack.
