70050000077600.name: Capibara Pack
70050000077600.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70050000077600.description: The moment we all have been waiting for… CAPYBARAS ARE IN! Bring these absolutely adorable rodents into your homes and watch them chill, snack, and play around! In this pack, you will find 10 different capybaras that will make your experience even more fun!

70050000077603.name: Silent Mist: Survivor’s Armor
70050000077603.intro: Keep your defenses always in sight.
70050000077603.description:
The unknown becomes even more dangerous when every decision can mean the difference between survival and defeat. Stay alert as you venture deeper into the mist and face the horrors hidden within.

This DLC adds an armor indicator, allowing you to monitor your current protection at all times and better prepare for every encounter with the unseen threats lurking in the darkness.

Keep your defenses under control, survive longer, and uncover the secrets waiting beyond the fog.

70050000077666.name: Additional Character: Kiden
70050000077666.intro: Kiden, the lightning Ketsu Battler of a new era, joins the fight!
70050000077666.description:
Kiden, a Ketsu Battler for a new era, joins the fight!

Wielding the power of lightning and a massive greatsword with his butt, Kiden is a defensive Ketsu Battler who excels at taking enemy attacks head-on.

Block an opponent's attack with the new Ketsu Art "Counter" to unleash the blindingly fast Ketsu Art "Ketsu Divider"!!

If Counter blocks an opponent's Ketsu Art, Kiden enters Serious Zone instead of transitioning into Ketsu Divider, strengthening his base abilities.

What's more, activating Counter during Serious Zone pulls the opponent in with electromagnetic force and forcibly unleashes Ketsu Divider!!

Read your opponent's moves, master Kiden's Ketsu Arts, and charge into a battle where you can't afford to lose—especially not with your butt!!

70050000077670.name: Speedway Turbo: Car Racing Challenge – Racing Capital
70050000077670.intro: Build, upgrade, and race with confidence.
70050000077670.description:
Take your racing career to the next level with additional resources that help you progress faster and expand your opportunities on the track.

This DLC adds 135,000 to your in-game balance, giving you extra funds to purchase new vehicles, upgrade your garage, and prepare for even more demanding races as you climb through the competition.

Invest in your racing future, build your dream collection, and keep pushing toward victory on every track.

70050000077683.name: Hentai Sexy Girls : Splashes and Water – New Challenges
70050000077683.intro: Take on new challenges and reveal new images.
70050000077683.description:
Expand your puzzle collection with three brand-new images featuring captivating artwork and fresh challenges. Discover new scenes, solve additional puzzles, and enjoy more beautiful illustrations as you continue your journey through the game.

This DLC adds three new puzzles, giving you extra levels to complete and more artwork to reveal. Piece together every image, test your skills, and unlock new visual experiences.

Complete the new challenges, uncover every detail, and enjoy even more stunning puzzle moments.

70050000077688.name: Noir Mafia Simulator: 1960s American Crime – Endless Pursuit
70050000077688.intro: Run farther, escape faster, and outlast every pursuit.
70050000077688.description:
Keep moving when every second counts with a massive stamina boost designed for demanding heists.

This DLC increases your character’s stamina by five times, allowing you to sprint farther, react faster, and maintain peak performance during the most dangerous robberies. Whether you’re sneaking through heavily guarded buildings, escaping the police, or carrying out a perfectly timed operation, your enhanced endurance helps you stay one step ahead.

Push every heist further, escape with confidence, and keep the pressure on until the job is done.

70050000077724.name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Anime Pack Vol. 7
70050000077724.description:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode and Great Drum Toy War.

*Some songs may not be available in Online Mode.

70050000077734.name: Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter: Edge of Chaos
70050000077734.intro: Every battle deserves a better weapon.
70050000077734.description:
Sometimes the best way to deal with a wave of relentless mannequins is with a weapon that makes every hit feel even more satisfying.

This DLC replaces the standard baseball bat with a powerful axe, giving your melee combat a fresh new look while keeping the chaotic ragdoll action as fun as ever. Chop through stiff opponents, enjoy every physics-driven impact, and bring a new style to every encounter.

Swing harder, crush every mannequin in your path, and unleash even more mayhem with every strike.

70050000077738.name: FOUNTAINS - Shattered Shape
70050000077738.intro: This is a content expansion for the game FOUNTAINS
70050000077738.description:
Shattered Shape is an expansion to FOUNTAINS. You will continue your journey across the mysterious and dangerous One Kingdom and uncover the truth of the Usurper’s prophecy through a brand new twisted adventure. 

Delve into the depths of an uncharted land:
The southern Vainlands have long been forsaken and left to rot by the One Kingdom. Though too treacherous for most, the hooded stranger is called to this mystifying region. Explore new dungeons, discover secrets, and face new challenges that await in these accursed lands.

Face mystical and fearsome foes:
Harsh and dangerous new enemies are found in the southern Vainlands. From monsters to misshapen beings, the uncanny roam the open areas in their twisted forms while beasts prowl for their next victim. Many who venture there do not survive, and those who do are never quite the same.

Wield a new, powerful arsenal:
You will find many new powers to help you in your adventure through the south. Use new magical swords to hack your foes, utilise mystical tools to confuse your enemies, and collect unique armour sets to fight with style.

Uncover the truth of the Usurper’s Prophecy:
Throughout your journey across the One Kingdom, a voice calls out and brings you to the harsh lands of the south. While pursuing this call, new faces and personalities will guide you through the Vainlands with mysterious quests and novel insights into the Usurper’s prophecy. Expect the unexpected as you go deeper into the story of these lands.

70050000077747.name: Personal Boards 11
70050000077747.intro: Create your own colorful stories with the latest DLC!
70050000077747.description: Unlock new boards where you can draw your own stories.

70050000077748.name: Detective Pack
70050000077748.description: A set of new pictograms for creating stories!

70050000077751.name: Scott Pilgrim EX - Back in the Band
70050000077751.intro: The band is finally back together!
70050000077751.description:
Alternate versions of Stephen Stills, Kim Pine, and Knives Chau warp into the fight, completing the full band lineup in Scott Pilgrim EX! Stephen shreds aggressive guitar-fueled attacks, Kim drums out devastating percussive combos wrapped up in goth-cutie misanthropic energy, and Knives is ready to throw down with lightning-fast shadowy acrobatics and her emblematic battle scarf. Alongside new assist characters, combos, and powerful new moves, these fan-favorite additions expand the action with fresh ways to battle through Toronto.


• New Playable Characters
Stephen Stills
An aggressive rushdown frontman who keeps the pressure on with six strings-fueled attacks. Whether he's smashing enemies with his guitar or blasting them away with ear-popping feedback, Stephen is all about staying in your face and orchestrating devastating beatdowns.

Kim Pine
A hard-hitting mix-up fighter who combines brutal drumstick strikes, stomping breakdowns, and goth-cutie attitude. Kim lays down devastating rhythms with explosive drum solos, and trades BPM for PPM: Punches Per Minute!
                                                                                              
Knives Chau
A lightning-fast hit-and-run rogue specialist who overwhelms enemies with acrobatic attacks, and shadow clone techniques.Agile and elusive, Knives excels at weaving through the battlefield while delivering precise punishment.

• New Combos and Sick Moves
Discover new ways to string together over-the-top combos: Master new techniques, supers, and character-specific abilities. Launch enemies with sonic uppercuts, unleash drum-powered beatdowns, create shadow clone pressure, a whole setlist of moves worthy of a reunion!

• New Assist Characters
Expand your strategies with an all-new lineup of assist characters:

Joseph
The legendary producer behind the band cranks the volume to eleven, dropping a towering wall of sound that sends sonic projectiles crashing through the battlefield.

Hollie
No-Account Video's finest employee is done collecting late fees! Armed with her trusty remote, Hollie traps enemies in a relentless barrage of hits, giving you plenty of time to rewind the pain.

Mr. Chau
Knives' fiercely protective father joins the fight. Channel his unwavering determination to summon shadow clone support, turning every attack into a devastating multi-hit assault.

• New Character Palettes
New alternate looks inspired by Scott Pilgrim EX's multiversal adventures give your favorite fighters a fresh style for the battle ahead.

70050000077777.name: Wukong Black Legend: Warrior Skin
70050000077777.intro: Your legend deserves a legendary style.
70050000077777.description:
Venture into every battle with a fresh look that reflects the spirit of a fearless adventurer. Bring a striking new visual style to your journey while continuing to uncover hidden secrets and overcome dangerous challenges.

This DLC changes the appearance of your character, replacing the standard gray outfit with a red-themed costume and adding a distinctive back tattoo.
Whether you’re exploring ancient ruins, solving puzzles, or facing powerful enemies, your new appearance ensures you stand out throughout every adventure.

Forge your own identity, embrace a bold new style, and continue your adventure with confidence.

70050000077804.name: Character DLC Bundle 1
70050000077804.description:
Gasha, a monster born from countless grudges, and Ponkichi (Ninja), wearing a hood to seem like a ninja, have arrived!

This DLC contains the following:

・Gasha
・Ponkichi (Ninja)
・Substitute Lantern

70050000077808.name: Cards Pack 3
70050000077808.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70050000077808.description: With your furry friends, the fun never ends! Give your brain a boost and sharpen your memory by matching pairs across 22 vibrant, brand-new cards. Don't wait up, these colorful characters are ready to turn every session into a playful workout for your mind!

70050000077809.name: R-Type Tactics I • II Cosmos - Adjutant Emblem Pack
70050000077809.description: Use emblems that match your favorite Adjutants with the Adjutant Emblem Pack for R-Type Tactics I･II Cosmos!

70050000077811.name: Late Night Solo Shift Pack
70050000077811.intro:
It's time for a late-night solo shift at the convenience store!
New customers, a female clerk, and a robot join the fun!
70050000077811.description:
Introducing new content for Solo Shift! in the "Late Night Solo Shift Pack"!
With new tasks and new customers, your convenience store will be busier than ever!
A female clerk also joins the team, so enjoy playing as the clerk of your choice!
Take on the challenge of the night shift and aim to become a 3-star convenience store!

The "Late Night Solo Shift Pack" includes the following content:
・Adds a new area
・Adds new tasks
・Adds new customer types
・Adds a female clerk

*To access all content in this DLC,
 you must clear all stages up to Area 5.

70050000078139.name: BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 – Tactical Skin
70050000078139.intro: Bring a new tactical look to every operation.
70050000078139.description:
Give your primary weapon a fresh new appearance and head into every mission with a distinctive tactical style.

This DLC introduces a new skin for the AR15, replacing its standard appearance with a redesigned finish while preserving the weapon’s original performance. Personalize your loadout and bring a unique look to every firefight.

Upgrade your equipment, personalize your arsenal, and enter every mission with confidence and style.

70050000078143.name: WEB FISHING – Relax and Fish: Golden Catch
70050000078143.intro: Reach new fishing goals with extra spending power.
70050000078143.description:
Prepare for more rewarding fishing expeditions with a generous coin bonus.

This DLC adds 10,000 coins to your balance, giving you more freedom to upgrade your rods, reels, and equipment from the very beginning or expand your collection as you progress.

Prepare for bigger catches, improve your gear faster, and enjoy every relaxing moment on the water with extra resources ready to use.

70050000078147.name: Fear or Evil : Nightmare Horror Scary Game Phobia Simulator Hunter Games – Extra Life
70050000078147.intro: Stay alive longer with increased survival strength.
70050000078147.description:
Gain additional strength and survive longer in the darkness.

Increase your chances of survival with an additional 50 HP added to your character’s health. Explore the mysterious locations, uncover hidden clues, and face terrifying encounters with a stronger advantage.

Take on the investigation with improved endurance, withstand more dangerous situations, and continue searching for the truth behind the unknown horrors that await you.

70050000078153.name: Additional Board 4
70050000078153.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70050000078153.description: Give your kid more space to play and learn! Unleash their artistic talents with a new canvas ready to be filled with colorful stories.

70050000078257.name: Wrap Shop Simulator: Business Boost
70050000078257.intro: Become a culinary legend with a helpful boost.
70050000078257.description:
Take your culinary adventure further with extra resources to help your food truck reach new heights.

An additional 1,000 coins will be added to your in-game balance, giving you more freedom to purchase ingredients, upgrade equipment, unlock new opportunities, and grow your mobile kitchen.

Serve more customers, create delicious recipes, and build your reputation as you work toward becoming the ultimate culinary legend.

70050000078269.name: Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat – Hands Style
70050000078269.intro: Bring a new look to every mission in the exclusion zone.
70050000078269.description:
Enhance your adventure with a distinctive cosmetic upgrade.

Bring a fresh visual style to your journey through the abandoned ruins of Pripyat with a redesigned pair of gloves. This cosmetic DLC replaces the standard glove appearance with a brand-new design, adding a distinctive look to every exploration, firefight, and investigation.

Step into the exclusion zone with renewed style as you uncover Chernobyl’s darkest secrets and fight to survive every encounter.

70050000078306.name: Sky Blue Chessboard
70050000078306.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70050000078306.description:
Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world. This time with our new Sky Blue Chessboard.
Help your thoughts flow easier with the new skin to your chessboard.

70050000078307.name: Wallpapers Pack 3
70050000078307.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70050000078307.description: Bored with your current Nintendo Switch™ theme? Give your console a fresh, fabulous look with nOS new Operating System and a pack of 4 cute, cozy wallpapers (coming both in light and dark mode!)

70050000078309.name: Pre order bonus
70050000078309.description: Pre-order now to unlock a limited-edition exclusive Baton! Stand out on the podium with a unique cosmetic item available only to early conductors.

70050000078449.name: Gorilla Jungle King Simulator: New Skies
70050000078449.intro: Bring new life to your jungle survival adventure.
70050000078449.description:
Experience the wild jungle beneath a redesigned green morning skybox.

This DLC changes the morning environment, adding a vibrant and refreshing atmosphere as you explore, survive, and lead your gorilla pack.

Experience the jungle from a new perspective as you search for resources, protect your family, and continue your journey toward becoming the true king of the jungle.

70050000078453.name: The Ramen Sensei – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade pack
70050000078453.description: A paid upgrade pack that allows you to upgrade the Nintendo Switch™ version of The Ramen Sensei to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of The Ramen Sensei – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

70050000078455.name: Bakery
70050000078455.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70050000078455.description: Warm, crunchy, buttery… You can't miss even one piece of this mouth-watering pastry! Pack croissants, pretzels, donuts, and more like there's no tomorrow, and enjoy a fresh new box design with the brand-new Bakery DLC!

70050000078456.name: Lavender Room
70050000078456.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70050000078456.description: Give your atelier a touch of magic. This cosmetic DLC bathes your space in dusky, twilight-inspired purple - moody, romantic, and just a little mysterious. Ideal for late-night crafting sessions when you want your surroundings to feel as enchanting as your imagination.

70050000078457.name: Fast Food
70050000078457.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70050000078457.description: Juicy burgers and crispy fries taste even better from a beautifully arranged fast food stand! Make a perfect space for making and selling delicious burgers, fries and hot dogs with Fast Food DLC! Enjoy 20 new items to design your dream fast food corner!

70050000078465.name: Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery – Urban Makeover
70050000078465.intro: Drive in style from the first delivery onward.
70050000078465.description:
Add a vibrant new look to your trucking adventure with a custom pink appearance for your very first truck.

This cosmetic DLC replaces the standard paint with a striking pink finish, giving your vehicle a fresh style as you take on deliveries across the city and beyond. Whether you’re navigating busy streets or challenging off-road routes, your first truck will always stand out with its unique new appearance.

Deliver cargo in style and make every journey more memorable.

70050000078492.name: CloverPit: Unholy Fusion
70050000078492.description:
Unholy Fusion introduces the Surgery Machine, a grotesque new device that lets you fuse charms together into a single, even more powerful charm. Combine effects, discover new synergies, and break the machine all over again.

What’s been irresponsibly added:
Surgery Machine: fuse charms into one single, powerful trinket
30 Fusion Charms: discover overpowered charms that will entirely change your build
10 New Charms for further build variety
4 Symbol Modifiers to twist the rules further
7 Memory Cards to challenge your playstyle
1 Secret Finale: [spoiler]it’s a secret![/spoiler]

LET’S GO GAMBLING!

70050000078501.name: Extra Battle: Voidfall
70050000078501.description:
Contents
・Extra Battle ""Voidfall"" Added
・Voidfall Clear Rewards

Details
A selectable location for ""Voidfall"" will appear on the map.
Enjoy high-difficulty gameplay with 16 battles in total.
Multiple skills and skins can be obtained as completion rewards.

*This content is included as a pre-order bonus.
*This content is scheduled to be sold separately at a later date.

70050000078502.name: Bonus Skins for Rena and Soma
70050000078502.intro: Playable Characters: Rena & Soma Skins (3 types each)
70050000078502.description:
Bonus Skins for Rena and Soma
• Demon Blade Rena
• Scarlet Tiger Rena
• Azure Dragon Rena
• Demon Eye Soma
• Scarlet Tiger Soma
• Azure Dragon Soma

*This content is exclusively available as an early purchase bonus.

70050000078519.name: SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL: Ocean Vessel
70050000078519.intro: Face the deep sea with a powerful new vessel.
70050000078519.description:
Expand your ocean survival adventure with a new ship designed to face the dangers of the deep sea.

This DLC introduces a fresh vessel, giving you a new way to navigate dangerous waters and continue your fight against the relentless shark threat. Explore the unpredictable ocean, withstand powerful attacks, manage your resources, and keep your journey alive with a new ship ready for the challenges ahead.

Face storms, hazards, and the ultimate predator while experiencing your survival adventure from a fresh perspective.

70050000078531.name: The Long Desert Drive: Survival Knife
70050000078531.intro: Bring a fresh style to your most important survival tool.
70050000078531.description:
Give your survival adventure a fresh visual update and your equipment a new identity.

Explore the desert with an updated style that adds a unique touch to your journey through abandoned landscapes. This DLC changes the knife skin and updates its inventory icon, providing a redesigned appearance for one of your essential survival items.

Continue scavenging for resources, upgrading your vehicle, and facing unexpected dangers while carrying a knife with a distinctive new look.

70050000078645.name: Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun – Coin Boost
70050000078645.intro: Fight harder, explore further, and upgrade faster.
70050000078645.description:
Step into the zombie apocalypse with additional resources that help you get started faster. Every advantage can make a difference when danger is waiting around every corner and survival depends on smart decisions.

This DLC adds 500 coins to your in-game balance, giving you extra resources to support your progress throughout the game. Use your additional coins to prepare for the challenges ahead as you explore dangerous locations, battle relentless zombie hordes, complete missions, and continue building your arsenal for survival.

Gear up, face the zombie hordes, and keep your survival story going.

70050000078653.name: POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR: Patrol Style
70050000078653.intro: Step into duty with a redesigned officer appearance.
70050000078653.description:
Customize your officer experience with a new character appearance that adds a fresh visual style to your journey on the streets. This DLC changes the look of your character, giving your rookie cop a redesigned appearance while you continue to handle missions, protect citizens, and maintain order.

Step into the role of an officer with a refreshed style and face every challenge across the city with a new look.

70050000078742.name: EXSTETRA - Runes Set
70050000078742.intro: DLC featuring a set of abilities useful for battles in Exstetra
70050000078742.description:
This DLC includes a collection of special stones known as "Runes," which grant abilities when equipped, helping you gain an advantage in battles in Exstetra. ＜Contents＞ • Evade ×10 Ability: Dodges an enemy's attack on the spot. • Divine Protection ×10 Ability: Grants "Divine Protection" and revives the character when incapacitated. • Charity ×10 Ability: Grants "Charity" during a Burst, preventing all damage. • Counter ×10 Ability: Launches a counterattack when an enemy steps in to attack. • Critical ×10 Ability: Delivers a powerful strike that can stun the enemy. • Super Drain ×10 Ability: Restores HP and MP equal to the damage dealt by normal attacks. • Super Rate ×10 Ability: Doubles the activation rate of abilities. • Magic Counter ×10 Ability: Reflects one-quarter of magic damage received back to the caster. • Revenge ×10 Ability: Performs a retaliatory attack when hit by an enemy attack. • Evasion ×10 Ability: Steps back one space to evade attacks and certain spells, then returns to the original position. • Magic Resistance ×10 Ability: Guards against magic attacks and reduces damage taken. • Physical Resistance ×10 Ability: Guards against physical attacks and reduces damage taken. • Reset Rune ×3 Ability: A magic stone that removes all abilities enchanted onto equipment and restores it to its original rune state.
*This set can only be purchased once.* *The items included in this set can also be obtained in-game.*

70050000078743.name: EXSTETRA - Item Set
70050000078743.intro: DLC featuring a set of items useful for exploration and battles in Exstetra
70050000078743.description:
This DLC includes the following items useful for exploration and battles in EXSTETRA.

<Set Contents>
・Goddess's Tears x3
An item that increases affection for Ryouma.
・Goddess's Plume x3
An item that warps you to the village entrance.
・Goddess's Holy Water x3
An item that prevents enemy encounters for a while.
・Full Revive x4
An item that revives a defeated character with 100% HP and MP.
・Beast Essence x10
An item that triples the enemy encounter rate.
・Weapon Upgrade Gem x10
An upgrade gem that levels up weapons.
・Armor Upgrade Gem x20
An upgrade gem that levels up armor.
・Bloodstained Orb x3
A piece of equipment that increases the wearer’s stats and grants magic.
・Self-Improvement Kit x3
A piece of equipment that doubles the experience gained at the end of battle.

* This set can only be purchased once.
*The items included in this set can also be obtained in-game.*

70050000078762.name: Hex Park - Ultra DLC
70050000078762.intro: A relaxing puzzle adventure where simple rules lead to surprisingly deep challenges.
70050000078762.description:
Ready to level up your park-perfect planning? Hex Park: Ultra DLC adds 75 brand-new, handcrafted challenges that push your arrow-guiding skills to the limit. Every puzzle is built on Hex Park’s clean, intuitive logic—rotate and align arrow tiles, chain satisfying moves, and clear the board in as few steps as possible.
No timers, no pressure—just pure, strategic puzzle-solving with that “one more level” pull. Expect clever remixes of familiar mechanics (keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more) plus trickier layouts that reward planning, patience, and smart tool usage. When a board won’t budge, fair helpers like the hammer, dynamite, and drill keep your flow going—without breaking the puzzle.

70050000078764.name: Lamp Clicker - Spooky Lamps - DLC
70050000078764.description:
Lamp Clicker – Spooky Lamps

This DLC adds a few new, strange lamps — glowing worms, unsettling creatures and things that probably shouldn’t be glowing at all.

70050000078766.name: Lamp Clicker - Spooky Background - DLC
70050000078766.description:
Lamp Clicker – Spooky Background

This DLC adds a darker, slightly unsettling background to your room — creaking walls, strange shadows and the feeling that something isn’t quite right.

70050000078838.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Miniatures - Flowers 2
70050000078838.description: The DLC includes 20 new miniature flower images. Relax and color stunning tiny flowers anytime, anywhere!

70050000078874.name: AKIBA LOST - Original Soundtrack
70050000078874.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70050000078874.description:
The AKIBA LOST Original Soundtrack features 31 in-game background music tracks.
In addition to the 22 tracks featured in the television drama, this soundtrack also includes original compositions for the game by Tsukasa Masuko.
*Please note that the theme song and insert songs are not included.

Included Tracks
Drama: fox capture plan
- Theme from AKIBA LOST
- Game Show
- SHINJO
- SHINJO's Actions
- Edge of Action
- NEO AKIBA 01
- NEO AKIBA 02
- Kanda Myojin

- Vanished in AKIBA 02

- AKIBA Suspense 02

- AKIBA Suspense 05
- Assessment

- A Sorrowful Heart
- Close to You
- At a Crossroads
- Everyday Life in AKIBA 01
- Everyday Life in AKIBA 02
Game: Tsukasa Masuko
- KOEMANDA
- A Way Out
- REREPI
- Whispers of the Shrine
- The Theme of Magical Schoolgirl Lilica
- SAIGO
- SAIGO: Infiltration
- IWABE
- Doomed

70050000078875.name: AKIBA LOST - Drama Movie
70050000078875.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70050000078875.description:
Includes all six episodes of the TV drama broadcast on Nippon TV, one of Japan's leading nationwide television networks!
Experience the world of AKIBA LOST through a unique live-action experience that offers a different perspective from the game.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?

70050000078876.name: Pixel Character Costume Set A
70050000078876.description:
Pixel Character Costume Set A (Shinjo, Wakana, Aoi, Moe)
You can change costumes from the Options menu.

70050000078877.name: Pixel Character Costume Set B
70050000078877.description:
Pixel Character Costume Set B (Shinjo, Kokone, Chihiro, Yukimi)
You can change costumes from the Options menu.

70050000078906.name: Chained Up Together: Mystic Dragon
70050000078906.intro: Let a legendary guardian accompany every climb.
70050000078906.description:
Bring a new touch of fantasy to your cooperative adventure with the arrival of a majestic dragon.

This DLC adds a dragon to the center of the main location, where it rests atop a large rock before periodically taking flight and returning to its perch. As you and your partner overcome deadly traps, battle dangerous enemies, and solve challenging puzzles, the dragon adds a living centerpiece to the world, making every visit to the area feel even more immersive.

Explore, survive, and enjoy your adventure alongside this legendary guardian.

70050000078910.name: Survival Zombie: Safe Haven
70050000078910.intro: Build a better future with an expanded camp.
70050000078910.description:
Build a stronger foundation for your survival and make your camp feel more secure as you continue facing the dangers of the zombie apocalypse.

This DLC adds a house to the default “Camp” location, giving you a new structure that becomes part of your main base. Continue exploring abandoned locations, gathering resources, crafting equipment, and fighting the undead while returning to an expanded camp.

Establish a stronger home base, prepare for the challenges ahead, and continue your fight for survival with an upgraded camp.

70050000078915.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Fire's Edge
70050000078915.intro: The Fire’s Edge DLC brings two new recruitable heroes - The Runaway and the Duelist - to Darkest Dungeon.
70050000078915.description:
“...we have each of us in the dustiest cellars of our minds a counter at which we strive to repay the debts of the past with the debased currency of the present.” - Gene Wolfe

Two more wayward souls wander the Old Road. The Duelist and Runaway, debuted in Darkest Dungeon II, bring their unique abilities to bear against horrors that lurk beneath the manor.
Patterned in burns, draped in tatters and wielding a crude poker, the vagrant Runaway favours fire and stealth when pressed to fight.
By contrast, the Duelist stands severe, her ornate capelet conspicuously pierced above the breast. No challenger has yet to hold quarter against her bitter edge.


Features:
Two new hero classes: the Duelist and the Runaway
Set the dungeon alight with Runaway’s new combat mechanic: Burn!
New Trinket Mechanics such as Trigger Uses, Quest Charges and Progressive Trinkets
3 new Hamlet Districts: Academie Duello, Craftworks, and Archaeological Base Camp

The Runaway is a position-flexible damage dealer utilizing a unique Burn damage type with high synergy for teams that like to utilize Stuns and Pull/Knockback/Shuffle effects.

The Duelist is a complex damage dealer that dances between the party’s ranks, able to freely maintain Riposte while alternating between her two combat stances, Defensive and Aggressive. Proper planning of the Duelist’s future turns is key to mastering her playstyle and maximizing her potential!

Fans of both games will delight in this re-visioning of these two new iconic heroes for Darkest Dungeon.

70050000078922.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000078922.intro: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?!
70050000078922.description: This upgrade pack upgrades Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo for Nintendo Switch™ to Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition

70050000079040.name: Murders on the Yangtze River Deluxe Upgrade
70050000079040.description:
Deluxe Upgrade includes the following content:
- Ink & Gold Elegance Outfit Collection
- Mistveil Detective Outfit Collection

70050000079168.name: Toy Cowboy Royale : RPG Dragon’s Challenge – New Arsenal
70050000079168.intro: Equip a new weapon and prepare for legendary fights.
70050000079168.description:
Expand your arsenal and take on your enemies with a new weapon option. This DLC adds an axe as an additional weapon, giving your toy cowboy a stronger tool for close combat and new possibilities during battles.

Use the axe to face dangerous creatures, challenge powerful dragons, and continue your journey through a magical world filled with quests, treasures, and epic encounters.

Prepare your weapons, embrace new challenges, and become the ultimate hero of the realm.

70050000079183.name: Auto Sport Racing Simulator – R34 Legends Pack
70050000079183.intro: Speed, control, and pure racing focus.
70050000079183.description:
Step into a new level of performance with the R34 Legends Pack. Built for balance and control, these vehicles deliver a refined driving experience focused on precision and responsiveness.

Designed for demanding tracks and high-speed sections, they give you the confidence to handle corners, maintain stability, and stay in control during intense races. Adapt your driving style and approach each track with greater accuracy.

Expand your garage and elevate your performance on every lap.

70050000079191.name: Auto Sport Racing Simulator – Z Street Edition
70050000079191.intro: Speed, control, and pure racing focus.
70050000079191.description:
Bring a sharper, more agile edge to your races.

The Z Street Edition focuses on responsive handling and fast transitions, giving you vehicles built for precision in tighter layouts and urban-style tracks. Every turn demands control, and every acceleration rewards timing.

Feel the difference in how your car reacts, adapt to fast-changing situations, and keep your momentum through every corner.

Take a new approach to racing and refine your driving with a more dynamic style.

70050000079197.name: Asdivine Knot: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000079197.intro: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!
70050000079197.description:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises—until the truth shattered everything he believed. When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

70050000079202.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Armed Survivor
70050000079202.intro: Enter the Backrooms ready for every encounter.
70050000079202.description:
Improve your chances of survival with a reliable sidearm and additional ammunition, ready from the moment your journey begins.

This DLC adds a pistol loaded with 7 rounds and 200 reserve rounds to your inventory. If you already have a pistol, its ammunition is automatically updated to 7/200, ensuring you’re ready to face every threat lurking in the endless maze.

Fight with confidence, conserve your ammunition wisely, and survive the horrors hidden within the Backrooms.

70050000079206.name: Flying Fire Shark Console versions + Wardner DLC
70050000079206.intro: Console versions of Flying Shark and Fire Shark, and the action platformer Wardner.
70050000079206.description:
You must own the digital download version of Flying Fire Shark in order to play the content of this DLC.

This DLC adds the console versions of Flying Shark and Fire Shark. Experience the differences between the console versions and the original arcade versions. The NES™ version of Sky Shark (based on Flying Shark) recreates the effects of the arcade version with ingenuity, and the boldly rearranged music is a like a gust of fresh wind as you take to the skies. The Mega Drive version of Fire Shark provides a lower difficulty level, making it easier to play compared to the arcade original.

The DLC also includes Wardner, an action platformer first released in the arcades in 1987. Using fire magic to defeat enemies, the player receives money which can be used to buy items that helps them advance further into the insidious forest. Deep inside lurks the evil boss Wardner, who captured a young girl and turned her into a crystal ball. Can you save the fair maiden?

The following games will be added to the base game with this DLC:
• Sky Shark (NES™ version released in 1989) 
• Fire Shark (Japanese Mega Drive version released in 1990)
• Fire Shark (English Mega Drive/Genesis version released in 1990)
• Wardner (Japanese arcade version released in 1987)
• Wardner (International arcade version released in 1987)
• Pyros (North American version of Wardner released in 1987)
• Wardner (Japanese FDS version released in 1988)

70050000079212.name: Graveyard Keeper 2 - Pre-Order Bonus
70050000079212.description:
Take a break from fighting hordes of zombies with a rejuvenating session in your very own sauna. Then slip into an exclusive outfit and show the locals who the true village dandy is.

The pre-order bonus includes:

- A personal sauna outside the player’s house
- An exclusive outfit for the player character

70050000079216.name: Baseball Card Shop Simulator: Retail Boost
70050000079216.intro: Build bigger, trade smarter, and grow faster.
70050000079216.description:
Give your trading card business a stronger beginning with additional funds at the start of every new game.

This DLC grants a 3,000 bonus at the beginning of every new game, helping you expand your inventory, purchase more booster packs, improve your shop, and attract customers from the very first day.

Build your collection, grow your business faster, and create the ultimate destination for baseball card collectors.

70050000079230.name: Blood Dungeon - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000079230.intro: These dungeons are full of monsters. The blood is there. Take it!
70050000079230.description:
From the creators of Nidhogg comes a game about 2D platforming survival. You'll have to parkour your way around treacherous dungeons to kite monsters while gathering blood and powerups. 

Survive a run, take the bones you’ve earned to the Bone Shop, and get stronger. 

Complete quests to unlock upgrades, arenas, skins, and more.

Features:
- 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons
- 6 unlockable unique survival arenas
- Over 100 enemy types
- Over 100 quests to complete
- Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades
- Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hooey

70050000079323.name: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder - Business Boost
70050000079323.intro: Build your company with a stronger financial start.
70050000079323.description:
Give your construction company a stronger financial foundation with an additional 5,000 in-game currency.

This DLC instantly adds 5,000 in-game currency to your account, allowing you to purchase equipment sooner, expand your fleet, and take on larger construction contracts with greater confidence.

Invest in better machinery, grow your business faster, and build your path toward becoming the ultimate construction tycoon.

70050000079333.name: CONTRABAND BORDER POLICE SIMULATOR: Elite Knife
70050000079333.intro: Step into every mission with updated equipment.
70050000079333.description:
Take on every border inspection with renewed confidence as you continue protecting the checkpoint from smugglers and illegal activity. Every search, every document check, and every decision brings you one step closer to keeping the border secure.

This DLC adds a new knife with a unique appearance, giving one of your essential tools a refreshed style. Continue inspecting vehicles, searching suspicious belongings, uncovering hidden contraband, and protecting the border while carrying an updated blade.

Stay alert, enforce the law, and carry out your duties with a distinctive new look for one of your essential tools.

70050000079348.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Jurassic Style
70050000079348.intro: Refresh your journey through the ancient wilderness.
70050000079348.description:
Experience the prehistoric wilderness with a fresh visual update that brings even more variety to your adventures. Every journey across ancient landscapes feels more dynamic as familiar creatures appear with redesigned looks.

This DLC changes the appearance of three dinosaurs, giving them brand-new skins that add more visual diversity to the world around you while you explore, hunt, survive, and complete challenging missions.

Discover a refreshed prehistoric world and continue your survival adventure alongside dinosaurs with striking new appearances.

70050000079352.name: Dead by Daylight: Chorus of Sin
70050000079352.description:
Every sin has a voice. Every voice joins the chorus. And when the final verse is sung, judgement awaits us all. The proud shall burn in flames of retribution, and the meek shall toil in the ashes left behind.  

Step into the world of divine horror in Dead by Daylight's first community-created Chapter: Chorus of Sin. Play as The Judgment, a divine Killer sent to cleanse the world in flame, and Aurora Stardotter, a resolute Survivor leading her people out of the ashes.

70050000079643.name: Pharmacy Store Simulator: Shop Style
70050000079643.intro: Redesign your pharmacy and stand out in style.
70050000079643.description:
Give your pharmacy a fresh new identity and create a more distinctive shopping environment for every customer. A renewed appearance adds a different atmosphere to your daily business while you continue managing products, serving customers, and growing your store.

This DLC changes the design of your pharmacy, introducing a refreshed visual style that transforms the overall appearance of your business. Continue stocking shelves, expanding your inventory, setting prices, and building a successful pharmacy in a newly redesigned environment.

Manage your pharmacy in style and enjoy every business day with a fresh new look.

70050000079645.name: Miracle Circus
70050000079645.intro:
Welcome to “Miracle Circus”!
On a dazzling circus stage, the fruits will delight you with cute and surprising magical performances!
70050000079645.description:
Welcome to “Miracle Circus,” a wondrous dream stage where fruits and magic sparkle!
Your smiles and applause are precious energy that makes the circus shine.
Use the power you collect to unleash a variety of performances, merge fruits, and aim for an even higher score!

【Highlights of This Mode】
■ A spectacularly reimagined circus experience
Brand-new visuals and an exciting exclusive BGM transform the familiar stage into a special circus.
■ Boost your score with a variety of gimmicks!
From the “Spotlight” and “Fire Ring” to random magic bursting from the “Magic Hat,” a variety of performances bring the game to life.
Make clever use of each gimmick and aim for a high score!
■ Special merge effects
Merge fruits to create a watermelon in a brand-new form!
And when you complete the dream “Double Watermelon,” something unexpected might happen…?
Be sure to witness the surprising effects that can only be experienced in Miracle Circus!

Harness the power of magical energy and make Miracle Circus shine more spectacularly than ever!

70050000079839.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Extra Capital
70050000079839.intro: Equip yourself better and take on the wilderness.
70050000079839.description:
Start your hunting journey with an additional financial boost that helps you unlock new opportunities faster.

This DLC adds 1,000 in-game coins directly to your balance, giving you additional funds to support your progress. Spend them on essential gear, upgrades, and equipment as you explore vast landscapes, track wild animals, and master the art of hunting.

Upgrade your setup, venture into the wilderness, and take on every hunt with greater preparation.

70050000079912.name: CentrairEX Night Pack
70050000079912.intro: The first batch of additional content commemorating the release of Centrair EX!

70050000079935.name: Farm Together 2 - Zen Pack
70050000079935.intro: Clear your mind and relax with this customization pack for Farm Together 2!
70050000079935.description:
Zen Pack offers the following content:
* Avatar Customization Set: Clothing, Hairdo, Earring, Makeup, Fairy

* Zen House Decoration Set

70050000079940.name: CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival – Ammo Boost
70050000079940.intro: Extra bullets for a more prepared fight for survival.
70050000079940.description:
Face the horrors lurking inside the forsaken chocolate factory with a greater supply of ammunition at your disposal. This DLC adds 100 bullets, giving you extra firepower as you explore eerie rooms, solve sinister puzzles, and confront the malevolent entities hiding in the darkness.

Use your ammunition wisely as you uncover the factory’s disturbing secrets and fight to survive its twisted corridors. Every bullet can make a difference when danger is waiting around every corner.

70050000080129.name: Weekly Hoops Pack 2
70050000080129.intro: Stitch it up to puzzle out!
70050000080129.description:
This Weekly Hoops Pack contains 52 unique Hoops inspired by celebrations, cultural events, and special days from around the world.
There's always a new story to stitch!

70050000080133.name: Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms: Survival Boost
70050000080133.intro: Keep the way illuminated and focus on escaping the backrooms.
70050000080133.description:
Face the endless maze with one less limitation standing between you and survival. This DLC improves your exploration experience by removing the need to manage your flashlight battery while you search for clues, solve puzzles, and navigate through dangerous backrooms.

With this upgrade, your flashlight battery will no longer run out, allowing you to keep your path illuminated as you uncover secrets, avoid hidden threats, and progress through the terrifying environments.

Stay focused on the challenges ahead and explore the darkness with a constant source of light.

70050000080139.name: Trucking School: Truck Simulator Driving 2025 – Road Fund
70050000080139.intro: Prepare for the road ahead and grow your driving career.
70050000080139.description:
Give your trucking journey a valuable head start with an extra 40,000 in-game currency. Use your funds to support your progress, customize your trucks, and prepare for the challenging lessons and driving courses ahead.

Build your career, improve your driving skills, and make the most of your resources as you work toward becoming a professional truck driver.

70050000080143.name: Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector – Cleanup Style
70050000080143.intro: Make every cleanup mission look even better.
70050000080143.description:
Give your cleaning gear a fresh visual upgrade with a redesigned appearance for your trusty water gun.

The DLC changes the color of the water gun, giving one of your essential cleaning tools a bold new look throughout every space station restoration mission.

Keep every station spotless and complete your cosmic cleanup duties with equipment that looks as polished as your work.

70050000080156.name: Before Exit: Gas Station - Daylight DLC
70050000080156.intro: It's finally time for all the station's secrets to come to light!
70050000080156.description:
In the Daylight DLC, it's finally time for all the station's secrets to come to light in the rays of the sun. Take on the role of the employee's wife and conduct your own investigation every day in search of your missing husband, documenting all unusual events in photographs.

Photograph anomalies every day to advance your investigation in the new game mode
Survive 7 days of investigation, but miss even one detail and you'll lose the trail and have to start over
 Face supernatural events and try to make sense of what defies logic
See the story from the other side and discover what really happened to your husband

70050000080157.name: Before Exit: Gas Station - Midnight DLC
70050000080157.intro: Midnight DLC is the first major expansion for Before Exit: Gas Station, pushing the anomaly-detection experience into its darkest hours yet.
70050000080157.description:
Over 40 story-rich scenarios, packed with unique content, 4 different endings, and 6 mysterious bonus episodes.
Play through the game again and again to unlock everything and uncover the true ending. Are you ready to return home?
Play through 9 new scenarios beyond the classic workweek and descend into deeper darkness with each passing night
Face unique challenges and don't let the new weather conditions at the station get the better of you
 Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of horror and tremble with fear as your boss appears when you least expect it
Discover the true nature of the station and learn the secrets of its owner

70050000080199.name: Hole Digging Simulator 2025: Rainy Digging
70050000080199.intro: Discover hidden treasures under changing skies.
70050000080199.description:
Transform your digging adventure with a new weather effect and a refreshed sky.

This DLC adds a rain effect and changes the default skybox, creating a new environment while you continue exploring underground layers, uncovering hidden treasures, and searching for valuable discoveries.

Dig through the changing weather, enjoy a fresh atmosphere, and continue uncovering the secrets hidden beneath the surface.

70050000080203.name: Woodo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack
70050000080203.description:
This pack upgrades WOODO to WOODO Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition. 

Enjoy WOODO in higher resolution and with improved frame rates

70050000080204.name: VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival – Vivid Arsenal
70050000080204.intro: Embrace the full spectrum in every battle.
70050000080204.description:
Add a vibrant touch to your adventures. Equip a magical bow and arrows that feature a smooth RGB animation, seamlessly transitioning through the full spectrum of colors. 

Whether you’re exploring mysterious landscapes or battling dangerous foes, your weapon will shine with an eye-catching, ever-changing glow.

Bring color to the darkness and make every shot unforgettable.

70050000080213.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Prophecy Pack
70050000080213.intro: New character skin and additions to the cat creator.
70050000080213.description:
The Prophecy Pack gives you more options to enhance your Warrior Cats experience with additional content.

The Prophecy Pack includes:
•        8 Accessories to use in the cat creator 
•        12 Wearable accessories 
•        Cel-shaded characters skin

•        4 photo mode effects

70050000080219.name: Banana-Clicker: Click Power
70050000080219.intro: Double your clicks and collect bananas faster than ever.
70050000080219.description:
Boost your experience with a powerful clicking upgrade that makes every action count twice. This DLC adds the double-click feature, allowing each click to trigger two actions and helping you collect bananas more efficiently.

With every press working twice, you can increase your banana collection faster, discover more unique collectibles, and progress through the game with improved clicking power.

Click smarter, grow your collection, and enjoy a faster path to becoming the ultimate banana collector.

70050000080222.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - The Purrfect Look Pack
70050000080222.intro: Additional exclusive items for the cat creator.
70050000080222.description:
Your look can be as sharp as your claws!

Prepare for your adventure and gain additional items for the cat creator. The robust cat creator becomes even bigger as the Purrfect Look Pack includes five new elements for players to create their Warrior Cat.

Strut away from victory with a puffy tail. Strike fear into your enemies with intense eyes and lightning bolt-shaped whiskers. Be the envy of the Clan with a truly unique fur pattern. Completing the pack is a set of very distinctive ears.

The Purrfect Look Pack is exclusive to preorders and includes four elements to create an iconic look for your Warrior Cat.

70050000080310.name: Wizards Owl: Magic Delivery – Mystic Horizon
70050000080310.intro: Give every flight a magical new horizon.
70050000080310.description:
Refresh the atmosphere of the magical realm with a brand-new sky that gives every flight a unique and unforgettable look.

This DLC replaces the default sky with a unique custom skybox, giving the world a distinctive new appearance while preserving the original gameplay experience.

Take to the skies, admire a new magical horizon, and continue your quest beneath a completely transformed sky.

70050000080356.name: Sticky Business: Seaside Tales
70050000080356.intro: Escape to the seaside and fill your cozy sticker shop with ocean magic.
70050000080356.description:
Dive into a relaxing seaside getaway with Sticky Business: Seaside Tales! 

Bring the ocean breeze to your cozy sticker shop with over 113 new stickers and colorful variants inspired by sunny beaches, salty waves, sea creatures, pirate treasures, tropical vacations, and peaceful moments by the shore.

Pack heartfelt orders for brand-new customers and discover 10 charming new stories full of surf contests, beach adventures, drifting romances, pirate conventions, summer vacations, and quiet coastal towns.

This DLC includes:

- 113 new stickers with additional color variants
- 10 new customer stories about surfing, pirates, summer vacations, and more!
- 8 new goodies
- 6 glitter papers 

Whether you love turtles, whales, seashells, surfboards, palm trees, or treasure chests, Seaside Tales brings a splash of ocean magic to your sticker business.

70050000080387.name: Year of the Horse Set
70050000080387.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70050000080387.description: Welcome the Year of the Horse in style! This DLC brings a festive Japanese New Year makeover to your restaurant - think golden crane screens, lucky cats, sake bottles and warm red accents. Decorate your space and greet your guests with good fortune this season.

70050000080388.name: Nordex Pack
70050000080388.description: Unlock the Nordex Pack and add Nordex to your garage — one of the quickest Class D cars, built for fast starts, smooth handling, and confident high-speed racing. With its agile feel and strong performance, Nordex is a perfect choice for players who want to push every race to the limit.

70050000080389.name: Fortress Merge: Claire Pack DLC
70050000080389.intro: Double the game speed and unleash Claire’s power!
70050000080389.description:
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- Permanent x2 Game Speed!
- A new playable hero: Claire

Turn up the pace and fight through waves of monsters twice as fast! Switch x2 Game Speed On or Off at any time, giving you full control over the pace of every battle.

Claire brings powerful support to your army. Her permanent Mighty boost increases the damage of all units by 10%, while her Thunder Storm combat skill damages and slows every enemy caught within the storm.

Upgrade Claire, equip powerful gear, and use her abilities to bring new strength to your defense!

70050000080392.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition upgrade pack
70050000080392.description:
This pack upgrades Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter to Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition.
This version features higher framerates and enhanced graphics.

70050000080491.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Driver’s Fortune
70050000080491.intro: Boost your budget and race without limits.
70050000080491.description:
Accelerate your progress with a huge bonus that gives you more freedom to expand your garage and enjoy the road ahead. Invest in better vehicles, unlock new opportunities, and build your collection faster than ever.

This DLC credits $100,000 directly to your in-game balance, giving you extra funds to purchase cars and continue your journey through intense highway traffic and high-speed challenges.

Upgrade your garage, choose your next ride, and race toward victory with the advantage of a powerful financial boost.

This DLC replaces the default sky with a unique custom skybox, giving the port a completely refreshed appearance while preserving the original gameplay.

Operate under a new horizon, enjoy an enhanced atmosphere, and keep the harbor running smoothly beneath a brand-new sky.

70050000080524.name: Car Parking - Garage Simulator: Fresh Look
70050000080524.intro: Drive cars that truly match your personal style.
70050000080524.description:
Refresh your garage with a selection of stylish new paint options and make every vehicle stand out on the road. Whether you prefer bold, vibrant finishes or a fresh new appearance, these exclusive colors give you even more ways to personalize your favorite cars.

This DLC adds 4 brand-new vehicle colors, available immediately in the customization shop. The new colors are displayed at the top of the paint selection list, making them quick and easy to access whenever you’re ready for a new look.

Customize your collection, create your perfect style, and drive with a finish that matches your personality.

70050000080605.name: 4x4 TRUCK OFFROAD CAR DRIVER – Expedition Classic Pack
70050000080605.intro: Expand your garage with a powerful new offroad vehicle.
70050000080605.description:
Take your offroad adventures to the next level with a new vehicle built for challenging terrain. This DLC adds the Hummer H2, giving you a powerful new ride to use as you explore swamps, hills, muddy trails, and rugged landscapes.

Put its distinctive design to the test as you navigate difficult routes, search for lost car parts, and overcome demanding offroad obstacles. Expand your vehicle collection and experience the wilderness from behind the wheel of a new 4x4.

Get behind the wheel of the Hummer H2, conquer rough terrain, and prove your offroad driving skills.

70050000080607.name: Food Pack
70050000080607.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70050000080607.description:
What’s better than delicious food? EVEN MORE DELICIOUS FOOD!
Keep your restaurant guests excited by adding brand new snacks and products to your bentos!
Enhance your gameplay with mouthwatering ingredients of the Food Pack DLC!

70050000080619.name: Mine Clicker - Base Craft Building Game: New Horizons
70050000080619.description:
Transform the atmosphere of your adventure with a unique visual upgrade. This DLC replaces the default skybox with an exclusive new one, giving your world a fresh and distinctive look while preserving the core experience.

Give your island a brand-new horizon and enjoy your journey with an exclusive skybox that makes every moment feel fresh and unique.

70050000080647.name: Colorful Golf Balls 9

70050000080723.name: Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – Military Capital
70050000080723.intro: Build your forces and take control of the battlefield.
70050000080723.description:
Strengthen your strategy and take command with extra resources.

Give your campaign a valuable boost with 1,000 in-game currency added to your balance. Use your resources to support your army, prepare for challenging scenarios, and expand your strategic possibilities as you face intense battles governed by realistic physics.

Plan your moves carefully, customize your forces, and adapt to the chaos of the battlefield as you work toward becoming a legendary commander.

70050000080746.name: Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy – Cute Cat

This DLC introduces an exclusive skin featuring an adorable orange tabby kitten with bright blue eyes and a vivid expression of surprise and fright. The new character skin is displayed on the left side of the game’s main menu, giving the game’s opening screen a fresh and playful look.

Let this expressive little kitten accompany your fish-delivery adventures with a distinctive appearance that stands out from the start.

70050000080749.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Furr & Purr - 58 new puzzles
70050000080749.intro: Need more puzzles to solve? This DLC will provide you 58 more of them!

70050000080750.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Gallop & Glide - 58 new puzzles

Puzzle Galaxy: Gallop & Glide adds 58 NEW jigsaw puzzles inspired by grace and fantasy:

Let your imagination run wild and take flight!

70050000080751.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Mandala - 57 new puzzles
70050000080751.intro: Need more puzzles to solve? This DLC will provide you 57 more of them!
70050000080751.description:
Relax with intricate patterns inspired by the stars, traditional folk art and the beauty of nature.

Puzzle Galaxy: Mandala adds 57 NEW jigsaw puzzles filled with detailed and mesmerizing designs:

70050000080752.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Nature’s Silence - 57 new puzzles
70050000080752.intro: Need more puzzles to solve? This DLC will provide you 57 more of them!
70050000080752.description:
Escape into peaceful landscapes filled with quiet forests and the gentle colors of sunrise and sunset.

Puzzle Galaxy: Nature’s Silence adds 57 NEW jigsaw puzzles inspired by the calm beauty of nature:

Slow down and enjoy the silence of nature!

70050000080753.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Nostalgia Art - 57 new puzzles
70050000080753.intro: Need more puzzles to solve? This DLC will provide you 57 more of them!
70050000080753.description:
Explore dreamy city streets, familiar rooms and sunlit escapes filled with warmth and memories.

Puzzle Galaxy: Nostalgia Art adds 57 NEW jigsaw puzzles inspired by nostalgic places and peaceful moments:

70050000080885.intro: Explore colorful markets filled with vibrant fruits, flowers, fabrics, spices, and more. Discover the lively atmosphere and exotic charm of markets around the world.
