Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.

Wingspan: European Expansion takes you on a journey to another continent. Explore diverse European habitats and meet charming, beautiful birds with new interesting abilities.

In the adaptation of the award-winning Wingspan: Oceania Expansion embark on a journey through the breathtaking lands of Oceania. Learn about birds from around Australia and New Zealand and all-new resources and mechanics that will enrich your adventure of creating a wildlife preserve.

70070000019578.name: Midnight Drifter-Drift Racing Car Racing Driving Simulator - PREMIUM EDITION
70070000019578.intro: Dive into the ultimate drifting experience with Midnight Drifter -  Bundle!
70070000019578.description:
Experience an adrenaline-fueled race like never before! This exclusive bundle not only boosts the excitement with intense action but also maximizes your earnings. Explore a plethora of opportunities with a diverse car selection, extensive tuning choices, and lifelike physics. Level up your drifting prowess, accumulate substantial in-game currency, and establish your dominance as a street legend. Now, you can unleash the potential with DLC Pack, amassing resources and unlocking fresh avenues for an authentically immersive gaming journey. 
    Secure this game-changing bundle now for the ultimate Midnight Drifter experience – don't let this enhanced adventure pass you by!

70070000019593.name: AAA Clock Ultra Superb Edition
70070000019593.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000019593.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 4 DLCs: the Elegant, Digital, Pixel and Squid Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000019594.name: Pixel Paint 2 Complete Edition
70070000019594.intro: Experience the pixelated sensation, beloved by thousands of people. Discover a coloring book, unlike any other.
70070000019594.description:
Pixel Paint 2 is a sequel to an extremely popular game by the same name. The rules are quite simple. Put your mind at ease, follow the numbers, and fill out every last pixel with the right color. 

It's your first step in becoming an amazing pixel artist. Choose a theme you like and sink into the wonderful world of pixels. 

Choose from a wide range of drawings, and expand your pixel art gallery with the Passion and XD DLCs!

Key Features:

-Dozens of illustrations to choose from
-Relaxing gameplay
-Adorable characters
-Easy to play
-Simplistic Design
-Charming Pixel Drawings

70070000019595.name: Brain Memory Ultra Deluxe
70070000019595.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000019595.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 2 DLC: Cards Pack 1 and Cards Pack 4.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000019596.name: nPaint Happy Edition
70070000019596.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000019596.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the first and third gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000019598.name: Hentai Stars Ultimate Edition
70070000019598.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000019598.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Night Rider Ran DLC.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000019603.name: For a Vast Future Ultimate Edition
70070000019603.intro: Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
70070000019603.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

FAMILIAR GAMEPLAY
Whack every pixelated crook that stands in your way. For a Vast Future uses a classic turn-based formula with some extra twists. Every fight you win makes your allies stronger.

UPGRADE AND CRAFT
Collect powerful weapons and upgrade your characters. Turn them into demolition experts, master marksmen, or the most agile warrior in a room. Choose your way to become unstoppable.

Get access to Colour Palette 2 with this bundle and explore dangerous world in new tints. 

KEY FEATURES:
- Dystopian setting
- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70070000019608.name: Merge Games Cleaning Bundle
70070000019608.intro: Relax and chill with a perfect pair of cleaning games!
70070000019608.description:
Relax and chill with a perfect pair of cleaning games! Rebuild your family farm on an abandoned Earth in the cosy adventure No Place Like Home, and restore our polluted planet and help some cute animal friends along the way in Fresh Start. 

Fresh Start:

Fresh Start is a relaxing single player game, in which you embark on a mission to clean up the world and restore nature to its fresh and colorful shape. Watch as the world changes in front of your eyes as you help animals, solve puzzles and grow plants around you.

Travel all over the world and give it a Fresh Start it deserves!

A wonderful machine has been put into your hands - a combination of a vacuum cleaner and a watering hose! 

As you gather experience from restoring the world, you can choose to spend them on a variety of upgrades from the skill shop.
Use the power of water to bring dry and dead plants back to life.
As you travel around the world you’re going to meet some cute, unique friends in need! 

It’s not as simple as you think - apart from cleaning the world, there are quests waiting for you in each place your journey takes you to.

No Place Like Home:

No Place Like Home is a cute and relaxing sim where you play as Ellen Newland. A girl who decides to visit her grandfather, on Earth, for the very last time before she moves to Mars. However, she soon discovers that her grandpa is missing and that his farm was recently destroyed.

Clean the world, destroy mountains of trash, vacuum all the rubbish, and recycle resources to build your very own dream farm!

Find seeds, become a farmer, and use your produce to cook delicious dishes that can be traded for useful items!
Explore and go on adventures through many diversified zones.
Find, rescue and befriend farm animals that have gotten lost throughout the valley.

Rebuild, refurbish and decorate your house into a cosy place of perfection.

70070000019609.name: Foot Clinic: Complete Edition
70070000019609.intro:
Healing hands, happy feet!
Be the Foot Clinic hero!
70070000019609.description:
Step into the shoes of a doctor and podiatrist as you indulge in the foot clinic experience. Scrub, scrape, pluck, and pull all kinds of feet.

Features:
- 12 essential tools for treating and beautifying feet
- 2 premium tools for extra treatments: perfume and fish tank
- new skins: Tweezers Pro, Pedicure Pliers Pro, Toenail Pro, Foot Care Cream Pro, Thorn Tweezers Pro, Soap and Flusher Pro
- 4000 coins to upgrade your clinic faster
- mechanics of squeezing pimples, cutting nails, cleaning, shaving and much more
- lots of patients with various foot problems
- testing and vaccinating sick clients
- available tool skins to make the game even more funny
- equipment, furniture and decoration upgrades

Perform foot treatments for conditions like calluses, corns and ingrown toenails. Each patient presents a new problem, so you'll never get bored of your work!

When you're ready to take a break, head to the on-site nail salon for a pampering session. Give someone's feet the attention they deserve with various nail polishes, tattoos, and foot mask.

70070000019613.name: Golf With Your Friends - Starter Edition
70070000019613.intro: Tee yourself up for the perfect swing! Your first step into Golf With Your Friends has never looked so good!
70070000019613.description:
Make all your friends jealous on the green with:
Base Game
Caddy Pack
Bouncy Castle Course

70070000019614.name: Golf With Your Friends - Ultimate Edition
70070000019614.intro: An easy hole in one for any Golf With Your Friends fan!
70070000019614.description:
Grab everything from hats to courses, and swing in style with this seriously decked out version.
 
Including:
Base Game
Corrupted Forest Course
Bouncy Castle Course
Horrifying Headgear Pack
Pizza Party Pack
Sports Pack
Summer Party Pack
Racing Pack
Caddy Pack
Peaceful Pines Course
Fantasy Fables Pack
Teams Mode Pack

70070000019621.name: Have Fun Together
70070000019621.intro:
The more the merrier!
Gather friends and family for hilarious game nights with this bundle dedicated to party games.
70070000019621.description:
Megaparty: A Tootuff adventure 
Megaparty: A Tootuff adventure is a video game packed with fun mini games featuring Tootuff and his friends. Compete in go-kart races, paintball battles and dance competitions for hours of single-player and multiplayer fun. Immerse yourself in the colorful, comic world of Tootuff for an unforgettable party.

The Sisters - Party of the Year
Discover the video game adapted from the comic book and immerse yourself in the world of the Sisters, two sisters never short of ideas when it comes to getting into mischief. 
It all begins when Wendy decides to throw a New Year's Eve party at home with her friends. Before she can ask her parents, her insufferable little sister Marine has the same idea and beats her to it. But the parents only allow one party... To find out who will organize it, Marine and Wendy set themselves a series of challenges, each one crazier than the last... Sister against sister, it's going to get hot!

Garfield Lasagna Party 
Dozens of mini-games to discover in emblematic environments such as Garfield's house, the pizzeria, Liz's veterinary clinic... 
Our friends Garfield, Odie, Arlène and Nermal have set themselves a huge challenge: to take part in a gigantic Lasagna Party! On the program, a maximum of crazy mini-games: snowball throwing, obstacle courses, pizza slicing... Anything goes to get ahead of your opponents: win the mini-games, make the best dice throws... but also multiply low blows using objects!

70070000019624.name: Alien Hominid: The Extra Terrestrial Bundle
70070000019624.intro: Enjoy both of The Behemoth’s Alien Hominid games in a discounted bundle celebrating the past, present, and future of all things alien!
70070000019624.description:
For some classic couch co-op goodness, revisit Alien Hominid HD from 2004, where the excitement and chaos of run ‘n’ gun adventure awaits in nostalgic level design, bosses, and mini-games, including all PDA levels!
 
 Looking for more chaos? Need more silly alien moments in your life? Stuck on that one challenging boss from that one level with that one mechanic that makes you go AAAAAAAAAAA!?
 
 Whatever the case, we have more aliens up our sleeves!
 
 Switch over to Alien Hominid Invasion for 4-player capabilities and loads of new customization options, playstyles, and enemies. Continue the story of Alien Hominid HD through a non-linear leveling experience that allows you to strategically plan your attack against the enemy headquarters. Find out what happened to the original alien, get your revenge, and most importantly, make your Mothership proud!

70070000019625.name: Aquarium Land: Complete Edition
70070000019625.intro: Dive into an aquatic world where amazing animals await you!
70070000019625.description:
Go fish in the sea, swim, catch species like goldfish, starfish, koi fish and add them to your fish tank to expand your aquarium shop! 

Drive a motorboat, ride a jet ski or just jump in the water and dive with a friend in multiplayer mode! 

Features:
- 4 cute pets that will follow you everywhere and give you an active bonus (increased speed of catching fish or increased cash collected from fish)
- 400 extra gems to spend on upgrades, hiring employees and immediate filling of tanks with fish
- 4 secret fish you can feed to earn Beauty Cup points
- 4 new fishbowl decorations
- many different aquatic worlds
- 100+ species to catch
- multiplayer mode up to 2 players
- 20 funny skins to choose from
- character, customer and employee upgrades 
- motorboat and jet-ski riding
- different diving styles with cool animations
- aquarium decorations
- ship expeditions

Discover amazing places filled with a wide variety of beautiful animals. Discover huge and legendary creatures to attract more visitors. There is a customer for every sea animal, big or tiny, all you have to do is fish with attitude!

Invest in your aquarium shop and explore the sea world like a real fishy tycoon! The more money you earn, the more upgrades and aquariums you can get!

70070000019627.name: Triple Zombie Collection
70070000019627.intro: The ultimate apocaliptic bundle! Triple the zombies... triple the thrills!
70070000019627.description:
Get ready to face thousands of hungry zombies who are waiting for a chance to get you:

Zombie Defense - reinforce the barricades, choose a weapon, build turrets and destroy the approaching waves of zombies!

Zombie Raft - conquer the barren wastelands, gather resources, expand your vehicle and find the last survivors who desperately need your help!

Z Escape - get to the chopper, pick up the machine gun and destroy all the zombies to save your crew!

Endless hours of entertainment and killing hordes of zombies solo or with your friend in multiplayer mode for up to 2 players!

70070000019628.name: Truck Simulator Collection
70070000019628.intro: Here's the biggest truck collection you've been waiting for! Hop behind the wheel, choose a mission and deliver your client's cargo on time!
70070000019628.description:
Get ready for hours of driving around different places, lots of jobs, and more than 40 vehicles to buy in a bundle, including Truck Simulator, Truck Simulator 2 and Truck Simulator 3!

Drive carefully, connect to trailers and complete delivery jobs for clients at the Shipping Docks, Warehouse and Neighboring Area. Earn your seat in bigger and better trucks to access more advanced jobs with longer loads, bigger trailers and more valuable cargo!

Beat the target time and you will be rewarded handsomely. But don’t forget about caution and thoughtfulness – what good is your delivery if you smash the cargo along the way? 

Truck Simulator Collection features:
- drive over 40 vehicles from small forklifts to semi-trailer trucks!
- take over 150 challenging missions to complete your career 
- pull an extensive range of trailers and rigs.
- mind the realistic road traffic while delivering cargo from one place to another
- explore industrial areas and drive on the roads around them
- use different cameras to maneuver more precisely in challenging situations 
- experience realistic physics and graphics with well-detailed truck interiors

Drive, deliver like a pro and complete all the missions - grab the Truck Simulator Collection for the ultimate trucking experience!

70070000019631.name: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on this Wonderful World! Love For These Clothes Of Desire! - The Bikini Bundle
70070000019631.description:
This DLC bundle unlocks access to crafting unique costumes for each girl, featuring special scenarios. Included are ‘Super Megumin,’ ‘Extra Darkness,’ and ‘Deluxe Aqua.’ 

While the main game features heroines in swimsuits, these original designs exclusive to the DLC offer special swimsuits and additional scenarios for your enjoyment! 

The extent of exposure in the girls' special swimsuit event CGs varies based on the materials used. 

The storyline also adapts to these differences, enabling you to explore various aspects of the girls' personalities.

This bundle of DLC becomes accessible in Chapter 2 after receiving a new set of recipes from Vanir. The recipe list offers a wide array of outfits, but unlocking ‘Super Megumin,’ ‘Extra Darkness,’ and ‘Deluxe Aqua’ is exclusive to these DLC’s only.

70070000019633.name: Freaky Trip Deluxe Edition
70070000019633.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000019633.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Fall Pack DLC included in this bundle. 

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000019638.name: Acrylic Nails!: Spooky Edition
70070000019638.intro: Choose a color, paint the nail just the way you want and decorate it with special spooky accessories!
70070000019638.description:
Step into the world of beautification as you explore the magic of nail art! Choose the length of the client's nail, shape it using a file and then go wild with your choice of nail polishes, patterns and accessories!

In this bundle, you get content from the base game and Spooky Painting DLC which includes:
- painting selected parts of the nail with a brush 
- spider accessory
- skull accessory
- eyeballs accessory
- scary face accessory
- bats stencil
- spider's web stencil
- skull stencil
- bat stencil
- scary face stencil 
- scary face stencil second version 

You have plenty of possibilities to create stunning acrylic designs thanks to a large range of products. In your beauty salon you will find nail polishes with glitter, fashionable stencils to make gorgeous patterns as well as decorations in many shapes, made of different materials.

Many female clients want to use your amazing services. If they have any requests about the appearance of their nails, fulfill them and you will get the maximum rating of 3 stars!

Work in your own nail salon and express your creativity!

70070000019640.name: 5 in 1 Classics: Fashion Bubble Mania
70070000019640.description:
Step into the ultimate gaming experience that combines fashion and bubble-popping fun with our remarkable game bundle, "5 in 1 Classics: Fashion Bubble Mania." This extraordinary collection unites five captivating titles that will keep you entertained for hours on end.

Fashion Princess:
Enter the glamorous realm of high fashion and design your own runway masterpieces. Become the ultimate fashionista by mixing and matching outfits, accessorizing, and dominating the fashion scene.

Fashion Girls:
Join a vibrant community of fashion-forward friends and showcase your styling prowess. Dress up your virtual models with a variety of trendy clothing options, makeup, and accessories to become the top fashion guru.

Fashion Friends:
Socialize and connect with fellow fashion enthusiasts, engaging in style challenges that will prove your superiority as a fashion icon.

Princess Bubble Story:
Dive into a world of colorful bubbles and match them to create explosive combos. This bubble-popping adventure is visually stunning and incredibly addictive, challenging you to reach new high scores and conquer every level.

Bubble Puzzler:
Embark on a bubbly safari as you pop and match bubbles featuring adorable animals. This delightful twist on the classic bubble shooter game will warm your heart and test your bubble-blasting skills to the max.

Whether you're a fashion connoisseur or a casual gamer seeking captivating entertainment, "5 in 1 Classics: Fashion Bubble Mania" offers something for everyone. With stunning visuals, engaging gameplay, and endless opportunities for creativity, this bundle promises hours of non-stop fun.

Don't miss the opportunity to savour this ultimate gaming experience – acquire your bundle now and immerse yourself in the world of "5 in 1 Classics: Fashion Bubble Mania." Upgrade your gaming library and delve into a fantastic adventure filled with style, fashion, and bubbles!

70070000019641.name: Nickelodeon Kids Bundle
70070000019641.description:
An Outright Games bundle in support of UNICEF.

Featuring a collection of family fun games, available to purchase for a limited time.

Paw Patrol: On a Roll!

PAW Patrol is on a roll!

No job is too big, no pup is too small! The PAW Patrol is ready to save the day in Adventure Bay on 16 exciting rescue missions, but they can only do it with your help! Help each pup use their unique abilities to rescue friends and keep their community safe. 

Blaze and the Monster Machines: Axle City Racers

On your marks, get ready to race with Blaze and his monster machine friends! 

From Axle City’s colorful streets to the awesome Monster Dome stunt track, the world of Blaze is yours to explore! So buckle your seatbelts and take control of Blaze, Pickle, Darington, Zeg, Starla, Stripes… and even cheating Crusher! It’s time to race at blazing speed and go for the championship or compete with up to 4 players in couch split-screen mode! 

Ryan's Rescue Squad

Ryan’s friends have been kidnapped by the evil Dark Titan, Robo Combo, and Packrat – and you are the only hero who can rescue them! Set out on a quest packed with slime, spaceship-flying bosses, and Ryan’s Surprise Eggs. Collect Sun Coins and Surprise Eggs to unlock new shop items and customize your character with fun alien hats, gamer gear, and much more. Use your platforming skills and special moves to save the day.

70070000019649.name: Blasphemous + Blasphemous 2 Bundle
70070000019649.description:
The Miracle summons you Sinner! This bundle includes both of the indie smash hits Blasphemous 1 and 2. So enter the world of Blasphemous and get to smiting. 

In Blasphemous 1 you are introduced tto The Penitent One - a sole survivor of the massacre of the ‘Silent Sorrow’. Trapped in an endless cycle of death and rebirth, it’s down to you to free the world from this terrible fate and reach the origin of your anguish.

In Blasphemous 2 you awake from your tomb to a strange new world and once again enter an endless struggle against The Miracle. Dive into a perilous new world filled with mysteries and secrets to discover, and tear your way through monstrous foes that stand between you and your quest to end the cycle once and for all.

All alongside beautiful pixle graphics and an stunning orginal sound track that fully immerse you in the world.

70070000019651.name: Animal Farm Parking Extended Edition
70070000019651.intro: Master the chaos on the Animal Farm and become the ultimate parking pro!
70070000019651.description:
• Exciting Animal Adventure: Embark on a lively journey at the bustling Animal Farm!
• Heroic Farm Mission: Become the hero of the farm by guiding adorable animals out of the crowded pen.
• Strategic Problem-Solving: Exercise your problem-solving skills and strategic thinking.
• Charming Graphics: Enjoy delightful and charming graphics that bring the animal farm to life.
• Immersive Gameplay: Immerse yourself in a gameplay experience that combines fun, strategy, and adorable animal characters.
• Puzzle Lover's Delight: A must-play for puzzle enthusiasts who also have a soft spot for animals.

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Mission Pack I + II"!

70070000019656.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Happy Edition
70070000019656.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000019656.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable turtle and a super-sweet red panda.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000019657.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Legendary Edition
70070000019657.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000019657.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Summer and Winter Islands.

Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000019664.name: Theft Ride Legacy Gold Edition
70070000019664.intro: Gear up for the ultimate treasure hunt on wheels!
70070000019664.description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-packed adventure in "Theft Ride Legacy"! 
BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Color Pack, Extra Mission Pack" !

As a skilled motorcyclist, you'll navigate through abandoned warehouses to recover stolen loot from a bank heist. Using abandoned warehouses as your playground, dodge obstacles and race against the clock to collect as much loot as possible. 
Compete with friends in two-player mode to see who can become the ultimate loot hunter. 
With thrilling gameplay, challenging levels and the excitement of the chase, this game is perfect for anyone looking for a heart-pumping challenge.

Get ready to embark on an action-packed journey and become the ultimate loot hunter!

70070000019670.name: Piano: Learn and Play GOTY Edition
70070000019670.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000019670.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the first and seventh Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000019676.name: Razerwire Deluxe Edition
70070000019676.intro: Go back to the 80s with RazerWire: Nanowars - a true tribute to retro arcade-style gaming with modern rogue-like progression.
70070000019676.description:
FIGHT, DIE, UPGRADE AND FIGHT AGAIN

Survive the endless waves of invading aliens, and when you lose, use the resources you've gained to upgrade RazerWire and keep fighting!

RazerWire: Nanowars is a unique bullet-hell style game where you don't so much shoot enemies as use a wire connected to a generator as a weapon, cutting through enemies with a sharp monomolecular filament.

With each wave, the difficulty level increases! Opponents with new weapons and better armor appear, and this is where upgrades come to the rescue. With the points you earn, you can upgrade your weapon and also buy useful powerups.

IN THE FUTURE, FAR, FAR AWAY

Humanity has conquered most of the galaxy. Unfortunately, a new threat has emerged in our universe, but this time he is invisible to the human eye...

This threat turned out to be nano-sized aliens, reminiscent of viruses, destroying everything in their path while being almost impossible to detect.

Scientists led by Dr.Illerotsap have created a lethal weapon based on medical tools with a monomolecular filament used for microscale surgery - they call it... RazeWire

With this bundle you will have access to Soundtrack at any time.

KEY FEATURES:
- Arcade-style gameplay with rogue-like progression.
- A unique mechanic in which you use a super-sharp wire connected to a generator as a weapon.
- Endless waves of attackers with increasing difficulty.
- Many enemy types with several variants on each.
- Multiple unlockable upgrades and powerups.

70070000019685.name: Crowd City: Zombie Edition
70070000019685.intro: Lead the biggest zombie horde in town!
70070000019685.description:
Gather people accross the city and beat your opponents with your excellent leadership. The more people you run into, the bigger your crowd becomes!

In this bundle, you get content from the base game and Zombie Apocalypse DLC which includes:
- new Zombietown map
- 2 zombie American Football players skins
- regular, nasty zombie skin
- 1000 coins

Be aware of other players. If their group has more members, yours will be taken completely and you will have to start from scratch...

Try out a variety of funny skins and play on different maps. Prove that your crowd is the strongest in the city!

70070000019693.name: Zombie Defense: Definitive Edition
70070000019693.intro: Destroy the approaching waves of zombies using new weapons and skins with active bonuses!
70070000019693.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you...  Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun! 

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Zombie Defense: Complete Edition features:
- 6 new weapons!
- Red headband guy skin, which gives you +10% to damage
- Wonderful female skin, which gives you +10% to damage
- Monkey skin, which gives you +10% to fire rate
- Cyborg skin, which adds one extra part to your health bar 
- Blue warrior skin, which gives you +10% to movement speed
- Armored yellow worrior skin, which gives you +5% to damage and +5% to fire rate
- 1500 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons 
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players
- bosses among the horde 
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- Endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge, jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000019696.name: WRC Collection
70070000019696.description: Experience the best of the official rally games with the WRC Collection, which includes WRC 8, WRC 9 and WRC 10!

70070000019697.name: TT Collection
70070000019697.description: Experience the best of the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy, the ultimate and world's most dangerous motorbike road race, with the TT Collection. The TT Collection includes TT Isle of Man Ride on the Edge, TT Isle of Man Ride on the Edge 2 and TT Isle of Man Ride on the Edge 3.

70070000019699.name: nOS new Operating System Amazing Edition
70070000019699.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000019699.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here! 

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes Sudoku, Icon Themes and Long Cat DLCs.

Key features:

- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)

70070000019704.name: Cluedo - Epic Crime Collection
70070000019704.description:
Cluedo - The Epic Crime Collection Includes:

The Black Adder Resort
Mr. Coral, the manager of the Black Adder resort, has invited all six guests suspected of the murder of Boden “Boddy” Black Jr. to lay-low on his exclusive tropical island. Every guest accepts Coral’s invitation, only to find themselves in the middle of a new murder mystery!

The First Case File's's Revisited
You may have closed the Black Adder resort Case, but the Case File's's Revisited will blow it wide open! Two more guests were present when the crime was committed and new layers of evidence have come to light! Revisit the night of Callan Coral’s murder and discover the mysteries surrounding Gray and Hyacinth!

Nine More Crime Scenes - Coming Soon!
Investigate new murders in nine original Crime Scenes exclusive to the video game. Unravel fresh webs of intrigue and deception. Examine fresh character profiles, with new motives and evidence, and much more besides! With a regular release schedule, you will have more mysteries to solve for years to come!

70070000019723.name: Outer Wilds: Archaeologist Edition
70070000019723.description:
Outer Wilds is an open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.
 
Welcome to the Space Program!
You’re the newest recruit of Outer Wilds Ventures, a fledgling space program searching for answers in a strange, constantly evolving solar system.
 
Mysteries of the Solar System...
What lurks in the heart of the ominous Dark Bramble? Who built the alien ruins on the Moon? Can the endless time loop be stopped? Answers await you in the most dangerous reaches of space.
 
A World That Changes Over Time
The planets of Outer Wilds are packed with hidden locations that change with the passage of time. Visit an underground city before it’s swallowed by sand, or explore the surface of a planet as it crumbles beneath your feet. Every secret is guarded by hazardous environments and natural catastrophes.
 
Grab Your Intergalactic Hiking Gear!
Strap on your hiking boots, check your oxygen levels, and get ready to venture into space. Use a variety of unique gadgets to probe your surroundings, track down mysterious signals, decipher ancient alien writing, and roast the perfect marshmallow.                                                   

Echoes of the Eye
The Hearthian space program has detected an anomaly that can’t be attributed to any known location in the solar system. Grab your flashlight and prepare to illuminate the darkest secrets of the Outer Wilds...

70070000019742.name: Hole io: Freak Edition
70070000019742.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the universe!
70070000019742.description:
Choose your favourite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Features:
- 7 maps with different things to swallow 
- 22 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning  during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000019757.name: Acrylic Nails!: Complete Edition
70070000019757.intro: Get ready to nail it! Shape, polish and decorate some fabulous nails! Use a marble technique or paint with a brush just the way you want!
70070000019757.description:
Step into the world of beautification as you explore the magic of nail art! Choose the length of the client's nail, shape it using a file and then go wild with your choice of nail polishes, patterns and accessories!

You have plenty of possibilities to create stunning acrylic designs thanks to a large range of products. In your beauty salon you will find nail polishes with glitter, fashionable stencils to make gorgeous patterns as well as decorations in many shapes, made of different materials.

Acrylic Nails!: Complete Edition features: 
- use a new marble painting technique or paint selected parts of the nail with a brush 
- try out the new 8 accessories and 11 stencils in Christmas and Halloween themes!
- create beautiful nail designs in your nail salon
- experiment with different nail shapes and lengths
- try out multiple stencils and nail polishes
- serve your customers and fulfill their nail art requests
- change the look of your tools by putting on various skins
- invest in the appearance of your nail salon: paint the walls, change the floor and put in some decorations 
- create a mini portfolio by saving photos of your work directly to an album on your console!

Many female clients want to use your amazing services. If they have any requests about the appearance of their nails, fulfill them and you will get the maximum rating of 3 stars!

Work in your own nail salon and express your creativity!

70070000019769.name: Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash Deluxe Edition
70070000019769.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash
• Hidden Inventory/Premature Death
• Jujusta 2024

For the first time ever, the highly acclaimed series from Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump, JUJUTSU KAISEN, is expanding into the domain of console games!

• 2 VS. 2 CURSED TECHNIQUE BATTLES
Aim to become the strongest together by taking advantage of the characteristics of each technique, aiming for a Joint Attack that is triggered by combining attacks, and working together in harmony to assess the battle situation!

• CHARACTERS WITH THEIR OWN UNIQUE CURSED TECHNIQUE
Familiar members such as Yuji Itadori, Megumi Fushiguro, Nobara Kugisaki, and Satoru Gojo, as well as Cursed Spirits such as Jogo and Hanami, will also participate in the game.
Each character has his or her own unique Cursed Technique and actions.

• MASTER A NEW DOMAIN IN THE BATTLE!
As you grow in battle, more powerful techniques and latent abilities blossom.
Embrace the core of the Cursed Energy and win in the intensifying battle situation!

• UNLEASH THE SUPER DREADNOUGHT CURSED TECHNIQUE AND SEIZE THE VICTORY!
At the end of the game, when both players are fully developed, powerful techniques clash with each other.
The player must overwhelm his or her opponent dynamically, just as in the anime!

70070000019783.name: One Night: Burlesque Deluxe Edition
70070000019783.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000019783.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle you can learn about Holly's creation story by accessing her artbook from game menu. 

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000019791.name: Aquarium Land: Puppy Edition
70070000019791.intro: Dive into an aquatic world where amazing animals await you!
70070000019791.description:
Go fish in the sea, swim, catch species like goldfish, starfish, koi fish and add them to your fish tank to expand your aquarium shop! 

Drive a motorboat, ride a jet ski or just jump in the water and dive with a friend in multiplayer mode! 

Features:

- new fishbowl decoration

- motorboat and jet-ski riding

- aquarium decorations
- ship expeditions

Discover amazing places filled with a wide variety of beautiful animals. Discover huge and legendary creatures to attract more visitors. There is a customer for every sea animal, big or tiny, all you have to do is fish with attitude!

Invest in your aquarium shop and explore the sea world like a real fishy tycoon! The more money you earn, the more upgrades and aquariums you can get!

70070000019811.name: Z Escape: Complete Edition
70070000019811.intro: Get to the chopper! Pick up the machine gun and destroy all of the zombies to save your crew!
70070000019811.description:
Your quest is simple... rescue as many survivors as you can by killing all the walking dead!

Zombies run and climb on buildings very fast, so make sure to shoot quickly and precisely. If there are too many of them, use your surroundings - shoot at exploding barrels, destroy bridges and glass roofs, or just drop heavy building materials to stop the zombie horde! 

Features:
- balloon, laser and fire power up
- 6 new weapons
- 6 new weapon sights
- 6 new helicopter skins
- common, epic and legendary zombie & survivor skins
- additional 45000 coins
- hordes of zombies
- interactive surroundings
- many weapons and sights
- skins for zombies, survivors and helicopters
- levels with rewards and bigger zombies
- fun and addictive gameplay
- lots of shooting!

Rescue the survivors before they become infected! But beware, after each successful escape, the zombies will become even more challenging. You must apply your strategy in real-time and spot the right target to shoot in order to win!

If you believe that shooting zombies is not just a matter of luck, show your abilities and become the best helicopter sniper ever. Best of luck!

70070000019815.name: Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters Deluxe Bundle
70070000019815.description:
Grab the Digital Deluxe Edition today and get the DIGITAL EXCLUSIVE Swimsuit Costume Set!

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Neptunia: Sisters VS Sisters game
- Swimsuit Costume Set*
- Digital Artbook (47 pages)
- Soundtrack (9 tracks)

*The Swimsuit Costume Set is purely cosmetic. The set provides swimsuits for the Goddess Candidates and the Goddesses.

Swimsuit Costume Set includes swimsuits for:
- Nepgear
- Uni
- Rom
- Ram
- Neptune
- Noire
- Blanc
- Vert

70070000019820.name: Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU Standard Edition
70070000019820.intro: Wield the dance of the shaman. Reclaim your father’s spirit.
70070000019820.description:
Pre order* Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU Standard Edition and receive:
- a 10% discount
- Kalunga's Blessing visual effect variant
- 2 shaman points to unlock up to 2 skills in-game
- “Soulshifters” digital companion comic

A grieving boy begins to read a Bantu tale written by his late father. Adventure into the beautiful and treacherous lands of Kenzera as Zau, a young shaman who bargains with the God of death to bring his Baba back from darkness. With your cosmic powers and untried courage, you advance into unknown mythological lands. Once bursting with life, Kenzera is now rife with lost ancestral spirits. As Zau advances toward his goal, three mighty beings lie in wait, fearsome in their strength yet somehow strangely familiar. Will you embrace the dance of the shaman?

Embark on a poignant single-player story shaped by actor Abubakar Salim’s own experience with grief,  discovering how love gives us the courage to press on after devastating loss. Wield powers from the Sun and the Moon to defeat restless spirits in rhythmic combat and become a worthy Nganga: a spiritual healer. Discover a rich universe with untold lore of chaos & order and journey through mystical 2.5D realms awash with colour and depth, emboldened by multi-award-winning composer Nainita Desai's enchanting original score.

Crafted by Surgent Studios, the entertainment studio founded by actor Abubakar Salim (Assassin's Creed: Origins, Raised by Wolves) and published by EA Originals, Tales of Kenzera™: ZAU takes you on a thrilling emotional journey inspired by the rich myths of Bantu cultures.

70070000019824.name: Freaky Trip Ultimate Edition
70070000019824.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000019824.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Winter Pack DLC included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000019829.name: Cat's Cosmic Atlas Extended Edition
70070000019829.intro: Embrace the wonders of the night sky alongside an adorable kitten named Fellie.

70070000019832.name: Paper io 2: Animals Edition
70070000019832.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000019832.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- new 15 animal skins: cow, giraffe, hippo, duck, piggy, rhino, mouse, mammoth, rabbit, dog, snail, white whale, cobra, elephant, unicorn
- new 6 hats: fur with ears, guitar, crocodile, police cap, crown, diadem
- extra 9 custom game maps in the form of a: duck, fish, cat, rabbit, whale, bird, butterfly, octopus, seahorse
- 10000 coins to buy some upgrades or unlock skins right away!
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- 14 base skins which also change the look of your terrain
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- custom game with 45 various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000019837.name: Notes + Stickers Ultimate Edition
70070000019837.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000019837.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort. 

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 2 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality

70070000019843.name: Toasterball + Buissons Bundle
70070000019843.intro: Enjoy two couch games with this bundle!
70070000019843.description:
A multiplayer sports game… with toasters!

Toasterball is a multiplayer physics-based sports game, quick to learn and perfect for good old game nights on a couch with friends (1-4 players local multiplayer). Because you are playing as toasters, you can naturally expect some chaotic physics, random situations, electrical hazard, and more burnt toasts than you can ever imagine. There is also a real learning curve, with pro moves and enough gameplay variants to keep on surprising you for hours.

The game includes 24 gameplay variants, 5 unique arenas, 14 legendary athletes to play as, AI toasters and a ton of options to customize your matches.
--------
Take control of a bush in Buissons and challenge your friends in a hide and seek game up to 4 players.

Move when the night is dark and use the day as an opportunity to observe and flush out your opponents. Use the secrets of nature to your advantage and prepare for surprises: each game comes with a new forest of its own. Only one bush will survive... And do not forget to drop a fart from time to time, after all it's a lethal weapon.

You and your friends will laugh!
- A unique hide and seek game mixing action, observation and humor.
- Easy to play, there is only one button to fart. But only the most observants will win!
- Charming characters and settings, drawn and animated by hand
- Buissons is a 2 to 4 players competitive local game."

70070000019855.name: AAA Clock Endless Time Edition
70070000019855.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000019855.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 4 DLCs: the Elegant, Digital, Spin and Squid Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000019856.name: Brain Memory Ultra Ultimate
70070000019856.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000019856.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 2 DLC: Cards Pack 1 and Numbers Pack.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000019857.name: Pixel Paint 2 Legendary Edition
70070000019857.intro: Experience the pixelated sensation, beloved by thousands of people. Discover a coloring book, unlike any other.
70070000019857.description:
Pixel Paint 2 is a sequel to an extremely popular game by the same name. The rules are quite simple. Put your mind at ease, follow the numbers, and fill out every last pixel with the right color. 

It's your first step in becoming an amazing pixel artist. Choose a theme you like and sink into the wonderful world of pixels. 

Choose from a wide range of drawings, and expand your pixel art gallery with the Passion and Health DLCs!

Key Features:

-Dozens of illustrations to choose from
-Relaxing gameplay
-Adorable characters
-Easy to play
-Simplistic Design
-Charming Pixel Drawings

70070000019858.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Amazing Edition
70070000019858.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000019858.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming piglet and a super-sweet red panda.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000019859.name: Piano: Learn and Play Happy Edition
70070000019859.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000019859.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

70070000019864.name: nOS new Operating System Magnificent Edition
70070000019864.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000019864.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here! 

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes Sudoku, Screensaver and Long Cat DLCs.

Key features:

- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game

70070000019865.name: nPaint Amazing Edition
70070000019865.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000019865.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the first and fourth gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000019866.name: UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes Deluxe Edition
70070000019866.intro: The latest UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH, with new visuals, mechanics, moves, and characters!
70070000019866.description:
UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes Deluxe Edition contains:
・UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes full game
・25 Announcer Characters set
・Instant access to the playable character Kuon
・New playable character DLC (Character #1) to be released August 2024
・New playable character DLC (Character #2) to be released February 2025
・New playable character DLC (Character #3) to be released August 2025

Sys:Celes sinks towards ruination.
For the Immortalize, the collapse of all that is, looms on the horizon.
The curtain rises on the final chapter of the Hollow Night. Catastrophe beckons...

Experience the Dramatic Stylish 2D Fighting Action in the latest entry of the UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH series!

The first numbered sequel in the series!

▼ Choose from a roster of 24 total characters, with renewed visuals!
3 new characters join the battle: Moonlight Dancer "Twin Barrel Beauty" Kaguya, Indomitable Rampart "Steel Guardian" Tsurugi, and Endless Entity "Eternal Re-Birth" Kuon.
You won’t be able to take your eyes off the intense battles between these 24 fighters with the highly detailed HD pixel art graphics!

▼ Simple inputs make it easy to jump into the fray!
New to fighting games? Not a problem – simple inputs mean even beginners can pull off moves with a single button!

▼ Now supporting rollback netcode for an improved online experience!
With the addition of Casual Matches, it’s easier than ever before to dive in and enjoy online battles.

▼ Introducing new moves and game mechanics!
All characters now boast new moves, such as Hyde’s Blaring Outrage and Linne’s Soaring Dragon.
The new game mechanics Creeping Edge and Celestial Vorpal open up additional depth to gameplay.

▼ The final chapter! A new tale of the Hollow Night…
Sever the cycle. An end to the endless.
May the tale of these countless Nights be concluded, on this eve, the moment of destiny.
A long-awaited continuation to the tale of the Hollow Night unfolds!

70070000019882.name: Hentai World Happy Edition
70070000019882.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose, and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000019882.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet student Chiyo and Akane in her new foxy look.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 art pieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000019884.name: Cook, Serve, Delicious, Trilogy!
70070000019884.intro: A trilogy of the most delicious games ever made, with over 200+ hours of gameplay, massive campaigns and local co-op, and so much more.
70070000019884.description:
(Cook, Serve, Delicious!) is a deceptively easy game to learn but incredibly challenging to master as you progress from owning a rundown zero-star cafe into a five-star world famous restaurant.

(Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!!) is the massive sequel to the surprise best selling original, one of the few games that gives players complete control on how they want to build their restaurant.

(Cook, Serve, Delicious! 3?!) Cook, serve and manage your food truck as you dish out hundreds of different foods across war-torn America in this massive sequel to the million-selling series!

70070000019885.name: Hentai Stars Special Edition
70070000019885.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000019885.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Demoness Ayame and Night Rider Ran DLCs.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000019899.name: For a Vast Future Special Edition
70070000019899.intro: Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
70070000019899.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

FAMILIAR GAMEPLAY
Whack every pixelated crook that stands in your way. For a Vast Future uses a classic turn-based formula with some extra twists. Every fight you win makes your allies stronger.

UPGRADE AND CRAFT
Collect powerful weapons and upgrade your characters. Turn them into demolition experts, master marksmen, or the most agile warrior in a room. Choose your way to become unstoppable.

Get access to Colour Palette 4 with this bundle and explore dangerous world in new tints. 

KEY FEATURES:
- Dystopian setting
- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70070000019903.name: Additional minigame set pack
70070000019903.intro: "Chickempic" introduces a great value Mini-Game Set Pack adding 27 mini-games all at once!
