NEW WEAPON VARIATION: This Weapon Variation will give the Daggers a devastating overhaul, replacing some of the weapon upgrade cards with crazy new powers that open up completely new play styles and tactics.  
 
COSMETICS PACKS: First up is the CRED Cosmetics Pack. A kid today is defined by their hydration drink – and their swag. Impress your friends and show the world how much CRED you have. The CRED Cosmetics pack gives you plenty of CRED with a fresh hairstyle, a CRED hoodie, and a cape.  
An “Asspen” themed Cosmetic Pack featuring new jackets, hats, and more will be available later this season.

70070000020371.name: Hentai Girls Platinum Edition
70070000020371.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000020371.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Yui in her new puppy suit.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000020375.name: Quake + Quake II Enhanced Bundle
70070000020375.description:
Play the authentic, updated and visually enhanced versions of Quake and Quake II, and experience the ground-breaking first-person shooters that inspire today's retro-style FPS games. Also included are brand new expansions, online multiplayer PvP, online co-op, and more.

Quake Features:
•	Experience the Original Game, Enhanced
•	Play the Dark Fantasy Campaign
•	Get the Original Expansion Packs: “The Scourge of Armagon,” “Dissolution of Eternity” and “Dimension of the Past”
•	Discover the All-New “Dimension of the Machine” Expansion
•	Horde Mode
•	Enjoy Online & Local Multiplayer and CO-OP
•	Download Additional, Free Mods & Missions
•	Play Together with Crossplay

Quake II Features:
•	Experience the Original Game, Enhanced
•	Play the Intense Military Sci-fi Campaign
•	Get the Original Mission Packs: “The Reckoning” and “Ground Zero” 
•	Play the All-New Expansion “Call of the Machine” 
•	Get Quake II 64 for Free 
•	Enjoy Online & Local Multiplayer/CO-OP 
•	Motion Aiming Ready 
•	Play Together with Crossplay

70070000020377.name: Unicorn Overlord Monarch Edition
70070000020377.intro: Liberate Your Kingdom, Reclaim Your Destiny
70070000020377.description:
The Unicorn Overlord Monarch Edition contains
- 16-bit Arranged Music Album (20 tracks) 
- Digital Artbook (132 pages)

From the masterminds that brought 13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim, Odin Sphere, and Dragon's Crown, ATLUS x Vanillaware presents the rebirth of tactical fantasy RPG. Fight against fate and embark on a royal adventure to regain your reign alongside trustworthy allies.

Unicorn Overlord combines the timeless tactical RPG genre with overworld exploration and innovative battle system for a unique epic fantasy experience in the iconic Vanillaware style.

Key Features:
· Traverse a vibrant world, assemble units and direct them into exquisitely animated battles
· Perform heroic deeds and grow renown throughout the five nations
· Cultivate a grand army with over 60 unique characters, from humans and elves to massive beasts and heavenly angels

70070000020380.name: Stellar Interface + Sudoku Zenkai
70070000020380.intro: Explore the randomly generated galaxy and destroy all the galactic overlords. Solve Sudokus with your friends!
70070000020380.description:
In Stellar Interface be prepared to run through the universe, discover the numerous perks/consumables and their synergistic effects. Explore the randomly-generated galaxy to find merchants, unlock spacecrafts, collect StellarNetES Cartridges, checkmark your kills of the various galactic overlords.
And die. A lot!

Sudoku Zenkai is a game for beginners and advanced Sudoku players.
It lets you play cooperatively with your friends! You can start a new puzzle with a friend or simply ask one to help you on that tricky one, two heads are always better than one (usually).

70070000020381.name: Lacuna + Encodya Bundle
70070000020381.intro: The sci-fi detective adventure Lacuna meets the cyberpunk world of Encodya
70070000020381.description:
Lacuna
You are Neil Conrad, CDI agent. Awoken by the news of a murder, you rush into a case that will soon turn your life and the whole solar system upside down. Ask questions, collect evidence, and put the pieces together until the ugly truth reveals itself... or not.

Encodya
Neo Berlin 2062. Tina – a nine-year-old orphan – lives with SAM-53 – her big clumsy robot guardian –in a rooftop makeshift shelter in Neo-Berlin, a dark megalopolis controlled by corporations. Tina is an urban jungle kid, who has learned to live alone, scavenging from city dumpsters and eking out a living from scraps. Her funny robot is always with her, programmed to protect her no matter what.

70070000020382.name: Deadly Days + Orbital Bullet Bundle
70070000020382.intro: A fast paced 360° action-platformer with rogue-lite elements meets a unique strategic rogue-lite in the zombie apocalypse.
70070000020382.description:
Orbital Bullet is a fast paced 360° action-platformer with rogue-lite elements, where all actions take place in a circular pattern. Fight your way through a variety of procedural planets and use body modifications, crafting, upgrades and heavy weaponry.

In order to survive Deadly Days' zombie madness, you have to manage and protect a group of survivors and help them to stop the catastrophe. Discover and use a large number of wild and crazy objects, even wilder and crazier survivors, special abilities, and deadly weapons.

70070000020400.name: Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown Deluxe Pack
70070000020400.description:
Enhance your game experience with the Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown Deluxe Pack including in-game content such as the Immortal outfit for Sargon and the Prosperity Bird amulet. Get access to the digital adventure guide* to unravel the mysteries of Mount Qaf.

*Available for download and streaming from the official website, princeofpersia.com, in Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, or Spanish.

70070000020401.name: PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs - Deluxe Edition
70070000020401.description:
Pre-order now and get the following bonus content for PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs:
• Chomp Challengers PAC (in-game cosmetic items)
- 1 body: Unicorn - Rare
- 3 heads: Crown, Pompadour, Punk
- 2 faces: Googly Glasses, Retro Glasses
- 1 icon: Cherry Chomp
• 7-day Early Access

The Deluxe Edition includes:
• PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs
• Lunar Animals PAC
- 12 bodies: Mouse, Cow, Tiger, Bunny, Dragon, Snake, Horse, Sheep, Monkey, Rooster, Dog, Pig
- 1 maze: Lunar
• Namco Pals PAC
- 2 bodies: Fyger, The Prince
- 2 faces: Pooka’s Goggles, Pooka’s Goggles - Rare
- 2 heads: Klonoa, Dig Dug Helmet
- 3 mazes: Dig Dug, Mr. Driller, Galaga
- 6 icons: PAC-MAN 3D, Inky 3D, Blinky 3D, Pinky 3D, Clyde 3D, Frightened Ghost 3D

PAC-MAN Mega Tunnel Battle: Chomp Champs is an online-only PAC-MAN eating competition! Eat your way through multiple interconnected mazes using Power Pellets and a variety of Power Items to chomp the GHOSTS and opponent PAC-MAN players! Be the last PAC standing at the end of each match in this 64-player Battle Royale to be the Chomp Champ!

• EAT TO COMPETE
The only PAC-MAN Battle Royale with cross platform play!

• CONSUME ALL
Eat everything in your maze! Then tunnel to other PAC-MAN players’ mazes and munch even more for the high score!

• PAC-MAN À LA MODES
Elimination Mode features arcade style action against players of any rank where you earn Tokens to trade for cosmetics. Ranked Mode features serious competition against players of similar ranking where you earn Rank XP to place on the leaderboards!

• MISSIONS ADD META
Fulfill specific conditions during the match for a score boost!

• TRUE PAC VS. PAC ACTION
Munch Dots and Fruit, then eat a Power Pellet to chomp the GHOSTS... and even chomp other PAC-MAN!

• POWER TO THE PACS
Power Items add to the action with shields, speed, and more to give you the upper hand against the GHOSTS as well as other PAC-MAN players! Some Power Items help PAC-MAN, but others help the GHOSTS!

• ELIMINATING MAZES
Beware of flashing mazes as they drop out one by one during each match! Escape before they’re eliminated!

• PERSONALIZE YOUR PAC
With a fun variety of body, head, and face cosmetics you can stand out from the pack with your own style!

• GET YOUR PACS TOGETHER
Add players to your Friend list, track friends’ progress, spectate friends’ plays, and even invite them to play in the same match as you!

• PLAY OR SPECTATE
Spectate ongoing matches from the general player-base or observe your friends’ skills. Elimination Mode spectators can even vote on what Power Items will be released to the players!

• BE THE CHOMP CHAMP!
Out-maneuver, out-last, and out-PAC to be the last PAC standing against 63 other PAC-MAN opponents!

*In addition to this edition, a Standard Edition is also available. Please be careful not to purchase the same content twice.
*This product is a multiplayer game that is played mainly through online matches between players. The only mode that allows single play is the tutorial.

70070000020405.name: SnowRunner – 4-Year Anniversary Edition
70070000020405.description:
SnowRunner’s 4-Year Anniversary Edition includes the base game as well as the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4 Passes.

The ultimate off-road experience!

SnowRunner puts you in the driver’s seat of powerful vehicles as you conquer extreme open environments with the most advanced terrain simulation ever. Drive over 70 vehicles from brands such as Ford, Chevrolet, and Freightliner as you leave your mark on an untamed open world.

Overcome mud, torrential waters, snow, and frozen lakes while taking on perilous contracts and missions. Expand and customize your fleet with many upgrades and accessories including an exhaust snorkel for heavy waters or chain tires to battle the snow.

- Ride solo or with other players in 4-player co-operative!
- Face extreme environments in a highly advanced physics engine
- Over 70 unique vehicles to unlock, upgrade, and customize
- Complete dozens of challenging missions across an interconnected world

70070000020406.name: SnowRunner - Year 1 Pass + Year 2 Pass + Year 3 Pass + Year 4 Pass
70070000020406.description:
The 4-Year Anniversary Upgrade allows you to upgrade your game with the ultimate off-road experience!

SnowRunner’s 4-Year Anniversary Upgrade grants you access to 16 seasons of content - including 4 expansions - from the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4 Passes.

YEAR 1 PASS

The Year 1 Pass grants you access to the exclusive Sabertooth skin for the Heavy Duty Derry Longhorn 4520, as well as the 4 seasons of content, including new trucks, new maps, add-ons and more!
- Season 1 “Search & Recover”
- Season 2 “Explore & Expand”
- Season 3 “Locate & Deliver”
- Season 4 "New Frontiers"
- High Roller Pack
- Loaded Dice Vinyl Wrap
- Scorched Vinyl Wrap
- True Colors Vinyl Wrap
 
YEAR 2 PASS

The Year 2 Pass grants you access to four seasons of content, with new vehicles, new maps, add-ons and more! You will also get instant access to the exclusive Burning Bright Vinyl Wrap Pack, adding four exclusive skins for the Azov 5319, Azov 73210, YAR 87 and Voron AE-4380!
- Season 5: Build & Dispatch
- Season 6: Haul & Hustle
- Season 7: Compete & Conquer
- Season 8: Grand Harvest
- TATRA Dual Pack
- Burning Bright Vinyl Wrap Pack
 
YEAR 3 PASS

The Year 3 Pass grants you access to four seasons of new content, with new vehicles, new maps, add-ons and more! You will also get instant access to the exclusive Save the Day Vinyl Wrap Pack, adding four exclusive skins for the Freightliner M916, Freightliner 114SD, International HX520 and the Chevrolet Kodiak С70! 
Already available:
- Save the Day Vinyl Wrap Pack
- Season 9: Renew & Rebuild
- Season 10: Fix & Connect
- Season 11: Lights & Cameras
- Season 12: Public Energy

YEAR 4 PASS

The Year 4 Pass grants you access to four seasons of new content, with new vehicles, new maps, add-ons and more! You will also get instant access to the exclusive Salt of the Earth Vinyl Wrap Pack adding exclusive skins for the ANK MK28, the International PayStar 5070, the Caterpillar CT681 and the Western Star 6900 TwinSteer!
- Salt of the Earth Vinyl Wrap Pack
- Season 13: Dig & Drill
- Season 14: Reap & Sow
- Season 15: Oil & Dirt
- Season 16: Expansion 4 (working title)

70070000020413.name: Dead by Daylight - Gold Edition
70070000020413.description:
Embrace terror with Dead by Daylight’s Gold Edition, which includes the base game and 12 Chapters for a total of 16 Killers and 19 Survivors.

Whether you’re starting your journey in The Fog or looking to take things to the next level, there’s no better starting point than the Gold Edition. Experience a sprawling roster of horror characters in the quintessential Dead by Daylight experience.

 In addition to the base game characters, the Gold Edition includes: 

- The Legion and Jeff Johansen 
- The Plague and Jane Romero  
- The Oni and Yui Kimura  
- The Deathslinger and Zarina Kassir  
- The Blight & Felix Richter  
- The Twins and Élodie Rakoto  
- The Trickster and Yun-Jin Lee  
- Mikaela Reid  
- Additional Outfits & DLC Exclusive Items

70070000020415.name: Mojito the Cat Animal Edition
70070000020415.intro: Jump into action in this quirky puzzle game. Travel the world along with an adorable cat named Mojito (or one of his friends).
70070000020415.description:
Success is at every corner

Help your child (or yourself) grow logical skills alongside cute animals. Take your time and look around the map for best routes. Make sure to consider all possibilities. Remember! Gravity is not an issue if you have the right mindset.

Multiple characters

Check out over 10 unlockable characters to accompany you. You can become a fierce shark, an angry bull, a mighty rhino or a fluffy panda.

Travel through the world

Experience all of the unique worlds alongside Mojito. Travel through an elegant garden, a desert oasis, an active vulcano, an iceberg or even a magic forest. In case the last one was not to your liking, you can also have some fun in a regular forest.

Enjoy yourself even more with the Animals DLC included in the bundle. 

Key features:

- 60 puzzles to solve
- charming aesthetic
- 11 unique 3d cube Skins
- satisfying gameplay loop
- great challenges

70070000020440.name: Knights of Braveland - Ultimate Edition
70070000020440.intro: Epic adventures & co-op battles in a Braveland universe
70070000020440.description:
This edition includes the incredible action RPG "Knights of Braveland" and four exciting additions to it, offering a complete immersion in the Braveland universe.

Main Game: Knights of Braveland
Crush the most dangerous villains solo or in the company of up to 4 people! Each race is unique and is generated from a bunch of unique events and hurricane fights. Hack your way to victory solo or in a team of up to 4 knights. An endlessly replayed action RPG in the Braverlands universe.

The Heroes Guild has fallen into disrepair. The villains have won and are keeping the whole kingdom at bay. Team up with your friends to restore the guild castle and defeat all the leaders. Each journey is created from hundreds of special events that will form a unique story. The elves will reveal secret paths to you, and a simple innkeeper may well turn out to be a werewolf.

By winning battles, you will receive a variety of different equipment: swords, axes, spears, staffs, crossbows, bombs. So every time you create a knight with a special fighting style. Defeat the boss, get a reward, and spend it on improving your castle before a new hunt.

Add-ons are included:

"Fantastic Beasts DLC": This expansion complements the game with several new formidable bosses. In addition, now you can play as a powerful Wizard, a new hero who can defeat fantastic beasts with hunting equipment.

"Fun And Memes DLC": This add-on offers you even more fun and crazy ways to play the game. Most of the new equipment will be available in the first locations, so you will encounter more fun combinations at the beginning of the passage.

"Around The World DLC": This add-on offers you a whole bunch of game items from all over the world. Most of the new equipment will be available in the first locations, so you will encounter interesting combinations at the beginning of the passage.

"Hero Pack": This add-on allows you to defeat the villains with their weapons. Defeat bosses to unlock their unique equipment. In addition, 2 new heroes will join your cause.

Features:

Endless replayability: No two adventures are the same in this dynamic world.
Extensive customization: More than 100 pieces of equipment that can be found and used.
Upgradable Castle: Upgrade your fortress by getting bonuses and strategic advantages.
Multiplayer Co-op: Team up with friends for exciting cooperative battles.
Diverse Heroes: Start your journey as different characters, each with their unique path.

Embark on a journey filled with bravery, strategy, and camaraderie. "Knights of Braveland - Ultimate Edition" is the perfect combination of action, adventure and humor, providing hours of exciting gameplay.

70070000020447.name: Machinarium & Creaks
70070000020447.description:
This bundle includes two games: Machinarium and Creaks.

Machinarium

Machinarium is the award-winning independent adventure game developed by the makers of Samorost and Botanicula. Help Josef the robot to save his girlfriend Berta kidnapped by the Black Cap Brotherhood gang.


Creaks

The ground starts shaking, light bulbs are breaking - and something rather unusual is happening right behind the walls of your very room. Equipped with nothing but wit and courage, you slowly descend into a world inhabited by avian folk and seemingly deadly furniture monsters.

From the creators of indie classics Machinarium comes Creaks, a new puzzle adventure game that delights the senses with its hand-painted visuals, precise animation, eerie sounds, and an eclectic original score from Hidden Orchestra. Proceed at your own pace at figuring out the solutions to dozens of carefully designed puzzles, explore the mansion for hidden paintings and uncover the great secret.

70070000020450.name: Shalnor Legends Double Bundle
70070000020450.intro: Two Story-Rich RPG/Action-Adventure games, made by one person over the span of many years.
70070000020450.description:
Shalnor Legends: Sacred Lands
On a quest to prove herself to the goddess Illeria and becoming her champion, the young Elf Rynna has ventured into the Sacred Lands. This beautiful yet treacherous place can only be left by finishing the trial designed by the goddess herself.

Shalnor Legends 2: Trials of Thunder
The story begins with our young hero crash-landing on the shores of Thunder Island. In this treacherous yet tropically beautiful haven, he discovers an artifact of immense power. Upon realizing the true potential of the artifact, he embarks on a journey filled with challenges and hardships to unlock its full might.

70070000020456.name: Coloring Book: Complete Bundle - 410 drawings
70070000020456.intro: Dive into a world of drawing relaxation, creative mindfulness and pure fun! This Bundle is an inexhaustible source of drawings!
70070000020456.description:
Enjoy no limits to your creativity:
● A palette of 89 colors for fantastic nuances
● 9 tools for advanced effects and convenience – a brush that always paints inside contours for example
● Use the touch screen or the buttons on the Joy-Con™ controller

Share your creations:
● Up to 4 players can color in the same time!
● Save your images and view them easily in your album

Featuring Basic Chapter and all DLCs:
● Family & Home
● Vehicles
● Costume Party
● Adventure Chapter
● Classic Tales
● Whiteboards - empty canvases
● Om Nom Chapter
● Farm Life
● Ocean Animals
● Treasure Adventure
● Cosmos Fun
● Sweet Princesses
● Silly Animals

With its large range of options, Coloring Book is perfect for young and older children but can also be a great way to relax for adults.

70070000020458.name: Coloring Book: Bundle For Kids - 140 drawings
70070000020458.intro: This Bundle contains 122 drawings and 18 whiteboards!
70070000020458.description:
This Bundle is a “Coloring Book” version with DLCs:
● “Om Nom Chapter” with the ever-hungry hero of the famous Cut the Rope series is the newest addition. 
● “Whiteboards” with 17 empty canvases to express your talent
● “Basic Chapter” with 48 drawings divided in 8 themes: Jungle, Space, Cats, Ocean, Farm, Girls Room, Construction Site, Dinosaurs
● “Ocean Animals” with 30 pictures of aquatic life and their underwater habitats
● “Farm Life” with 30 pictures of countryside animals and their daily activities

70070000020461.name: Lonesome Village + A Tiny Sticker Tale Bundle
70070000020461.intro: Two great cozy adventures! Lonesome Village, the puzzle-solving adventure with social sim, and A Tiny Sticker Tale, the cozy adventure about stickers!
70070000020461.description:
Lonesome Village

Lonesome Village is a cozy, quiet town struggling to rebuild after a strange calamity wiped out their homes.

Take the role of Wes the coyote and help bring this village back from the brink of destruction in a puzzle-filled life sim!

A Tiny Sticker Tale

In A Tiny Sticker Tale, take anything from the world around you, turn it into a sticker, and use your creativity to stick it back in different places, solving puzzles, and helping your new friends!

In this wholesome bite-sized adventure, step into the tiny boots of Flynn, the donkey, and journey across Figori Island, discovering the vibrant quests that will require the power of a very special magical sticker book.

Ogre Pixel

70070000020467.name: Summer in Mara + Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara
70070000020467.intro: Experience the entire Chibig Universe with this bundle that includes Summer in Mara and Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara.
70070000020467.description:
Join Koa and her best friend Napopo in two adventures through the islands of Mara! 

‘Summer in Mara’ 
Take care of your own island, harvest your crops, create new tools and buildings, and sail with your boat to discover new islands and secrets.

‘Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara’ 
Outwit traps, manoeuvre dangerous environments, and explore a series of dazzlingly different landscapes on their quest to recover stolen pirate loot.

70070000020480.name: Thunder Ray: Origins
70070000020480.intro: Get ready for the ultimate Arcade Boxing, Retro-like experience in a game brimming with blood and violence.
70070000020480.description:
Step into the ring and experience the adrenaline-packed action of this retro-style arcade boxing game with a modern twist! 

This bundle includes the Forgotten Duels DLC, where you can play as Thunder in his original battles against humans.

70070000020482.name: GeoJelly Space Odyssey Bundle
70070000020482.intro: Leap into the cosmos with GeoJelly Space Odyssey
70070000020482.description: Embark on a platforming journey with GeoJelly, mastering precision jumps through challenging test chambers. Collect diamonds to unlock over 50 levels, solve logical puzzles, and embrace the thrill of becoming a speedrunner. Elevate your adventure with the Space Odyssey DLC, venturing into the cosmos with mind-bending portals, intricate space mazes, and a stellar experience that takes platforming to new heights. Unearth the universe's secrets as you navigate the void, combining the base game and DLC for an epic gaming odyssey.

70070000020499.name: Classic Games Collection Vol.2 Holiday Edition
70070000020499.intro: Welcome to the "Classic Games Collection Vol.2 Holiday Edition"!
70070000020499.description:
This is a second installment of the series in which we present you with popular classic games from across the world! 

Prove your mastery in those titles by playing against the AI or a friend in a local co-op mode.

This is a perfect game bundle to get your brain juices flowing!

Games included in the bundle:

Mahjong - Traditional Asian game in which you will have to match sets and pairs of tiles.

Word Search - find all the words hidden in the puzzle!

Battleships - Choose a right strategy to guess the placement of the enemy ships on the map!

Hangman - Can you guess the right word before the stick man hangs?

Try them all and find out why these games are still absorbing after all those years!

This bundle includes base game and DLC #1 Classic Holiday Spirit with:
- Christmas-themed delight. Bring the joy of the holiday season to your gaming with festive designs that echo the beloved cozy patterns of holiday sweaters and decorations.

70070000020514.name: My Bakery Empire: Complete Edition
70070000020514.intro: Enjoy this yummy cake-baking story and help Lizzie fulfill her dream of opening her own sweet bakery! Try new colorful decorations and compete in VIP competitions!
70070000020514.description:
Learn how to bake delicious, mouth-watering desserts like cupcakes, smoothies, donuts and cakes! With your assistance as a cake maker, Lizzie will become the most talented pastry chef ever! 

Take specific orders from customers and serve them with a smile. Make sure they get what they asked for, whether it’s cookies with pink frosting and sprinkles, donuts with colored glaze, or rainbow cakes! You’ll LOVE this tasty bakery story game, and here’s a little warning - it will make you hungry!

Features:
- use more than 100 new decorations to beautify your cakes!
- change Lizzie's look with more than 180 new items!
- participate in VIP competitions to win big prizes
- use 7500 additional coins to buy clothes, ingredients and bakeries
- learn how to bake tons of desserts from so many yummy recipes!
- take specific orders from your customers and make sure they get what they asked for
- bake the tastiest dessert ever, from apple yogurt smoothies and scrumptiously delicious cupcakes to princess birthday cakes!
- make your cakes extra fancy with colorful cake decorations
- dress up Lizzie like the true baker she is! Give her a pretty chef’s hat and a cute apron
- show off your sweet bakery skills and win first prize in baking contests and cake fairs!
- help Lizzie open up a cake bakery… and then another cake bakery… and another cake bakery!

Have fun opening up many delicious bakeries, baking with Lizzie, and becoming a true baking professional famous for beautiful, tasty delights! Build your bakery business and immerse yourself in the aromatic wonders of a bustling bake shop with a hint of cookie jam sweetness!

Cooking delicious dessert recipes in Lizzie’s kitchen has never been easier! Feel the cooking fever and help her bake the tastiest pastries ever!

70070000020516.name: Light-It Up: Complete Edition
70070000020516.intro: Swing, jump, flip and slide your stickman body from one neon color shape to another to make them glow and light-it up!
70070000020516.description:
In this big, dark world, you're a little stickman with a huge mission. Get ready to ignite the excitement and light your way through an epic adventure! Light up each figure, bringing it to life with vibrant colors. Get ready to test your reflexes and agility as you navigate through this colorful world of shapes and light!

Features:
- jump, flip, slide and swing as a little stickman 
- light up over 280 levels!  
- use 2000 additional gems to buy boosters and respawns
- think how to use obstacles to your advantage 
- avoid falling and touching the spikes 
- use 3 different boosters when you have trouble passing any of the levels
- collect stars to unlock next levels
- listen to satisfying sounds as shapes become lit up 
- unlock and wear all the skins that will make your stickman look awesome!

Just when you start to feel like a stickman boss and love that color glow, things get complicated as you jump, flip and pass levels. Color shapes start moving, rotating, and even exploding, and lethal spikes become a constant threat to your little stickman's life. If you miss a jump, if your swing’s a dud, if your flip isn’t on point, or if you hit a spike… you fall into oblivion!

So what do you say, stickman? Ready to swing, jump, flip, light-it up and glow, in the brightest of all jumping games?

70070000020518.name: Starward Rogue: Complete Edition
70070000020518.description: Get the base game of Starward Rogue, plus the AuGMENTED expansion in one package!

70070000020547.name: Snap Together: New Challenges
70070000020547.intro: Solve a dozen of puzzles with your friends in Snap Together and have more with New Challenges!
70070000020547.description:
Snap Together is a puzzle party game for up to 4 people on a single console! Assemble models with your friends or by yourself.

Play with your friends in Multiplayer mode and solve puzzles together or challenge them in Tournament mode.

In Tournament mode, there is only one winner! Use power-ups to mess up other players and win.

Features: 
144 puzzles
Single player and multiplayer
Up to 4 players on a single console
Tournament mode

Spin, Swap, Snap in Snap Together!

70070000020548.name: Helix Jump: Catch The Letters
70070000020548.intro: Blast your way through helix platforms, smash, bump and bounce to reach the end! Compete in the new multiplayer gameplay mode and collect all the letters!
70070000020548.description:
Your ball drops like a brick through colorful helix platforms that block its descent, but if you hit a red spot, it's over! Your ball shatters to pieces and you have to start your fall all over again. 

Even trap platforms are no match for a fireball falling at full speed! Choose your strategy: speed up like a madman or stop and wait for your next chance to roll and jump!

Features:
- drop your ball with crazy fast speed and make your way through helix platforms
- face your friends or family in multiplayer mode for up to 4 players with 4 different gameplay modes!
- practice your reflexes and break your best scores
- customize your ball with 36 unique skins!
- defeat bosses on levels with obstacles like switches and metal platforms that not even a fireball falling at full speed can destroy
- see how many levels you can complete in this never-ending game
- use extra 2000 coins to unlock skins even faster 
- invite anyone to play thanks to easy controls and simple rules
- never get bored thanks to this amazing time killer!
 
Even trap platforms are no match for a fireball falling at full speed! Choose your strategy: speed up like a madman or stop and wait for your next chance to roll and jump!

If you don't want to play solo, choose a multiplayer mode for up to 4 players and compete with your friends or family. Together, pick one of the four different gameplay modes with special challenges: get the highest score while avoiding getting minus points, be the first at the finish line, go as far as you can in a limited time or collect all the letters and form the word before other players do it! Reveal who is the fastest and most agile jumping ball among you!

The key is mastering your reflexes and looking ahead. To guide the bouncing ball, rotate the platforms to align the ball with the cracks. Do this in quick succession for a combo move and higher points. If you pass 3 levels consecutively, you'll be invincible for the first bounce after!

Jump into never-ending adventure with unlimited levels, test your skills, and invite others to have fun together!

70070000020553.name: Hentai Golf Deluxe Edition
70070000020553.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000020553.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' winter outfits with Prairie Greens DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000020564.name: Mob Control: Champions Edition
70070000020564.intro: Are you ready to become the ultimate champion in the world of tower defense battles? Create, grow, and lead your Knight mobs along with Explodon champions!
70070000020564.description:
Experience the strangely satisfying thrill of watching your mob multiply as you aim and shoot at the gates. Witness your army grow to massive proportions! Strategically deploy your mighty champions to break through enemy mobs and reach their bases. Choose the best combo to win!

Features: 
- fire new Knight mobs that fight with the strength of many Normie mobs thanks to a large amount of health and strength
- fire new Explodon champion with Jump & Crush primary skill and Final Boom area skill
- use new Rocket Barrage ultimate which nukes your enemies with bombs!
- open additional 12 booster packs with cards 
- spend 25000 extra coins to upgrade your cards in the armory
- fire mobs from your cannon and grow your army
- launch strong champions when your cannon is supercharged 
- play in local multiplayer mode with a friend and shoot two cannons at once!
- use multiplier gates or speed boosts strategically to gain a more significant advantage over your enemy
- destroy enemy bases and strengthen your own 
- play even against two enemies at the same time!
- unlock and level up different cannons, super champions, mobs and ultimates! 
- open booster pack to enhance your card collection

Use the special elements in the levels, such as speed boosts, multipliers, moving gates, and many more. Defend, conquer and rise to victory in this epic tower defense showdown!

If you need some help, you can invite a friend to play together in local multiplayer mode! Prepare for battle, devise a strategy together and fire your mobs from TWO cannons to triumph!

Win battles to unlock booster packs of varying rarities and enhance your card collection. Collectible cards hold the power to elevate your tower defense strategy to new heights. Unlock all the cannons, mobs and champions in the armory and discover their amazing evolutions as you level them up!

Rally your army, harness the power of collectible cards, and become the tower defense champion you were born to be!

70070000020566.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000020566.intro: The JRPG is back with a new host of heroes.
70070000020566.description:
Get the most out of your adventure with the Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes the following content: 
•	Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes full game
•	1x Easy Journey Pack: (6x Healing Herb, 4x Healing Incense, 2x Revive Medicine. 3x Runeshard of Return, 1x Gold Coin)
•	1x Headquarters Custom Object 
•	Season Pass: [3x Original Wallpapers by Junko Kawano, Story Expansion: The Chapter of Seign, Story Expansion: The Chapter of Marisa, Story Expansion: The Chapter of Markus and HQ Makeover Pack (Golden & Pink Headquarters Exterior Paint)]
•	Digital Mini Artbook 
•	Digital Soundtrack

Our story begins in one corner of Allraan, a tapestry of nations with diverse cultures and values. By dint of sword, and by way of magical objects known as “rune-lenses,” the land’s history has been shaped by the alliances and aggressions of the humans, beastmen, elves, and desert people who live there.

The Galdean Empire has edged out other nations and discovered a technology that amplifies the rune-lenses’ magic.

Now, the Empire is scouring the continent for an artifact that will expand their power even further. It is on one such expedition that Seign Kesling, a young and gifted imperial officer, and Nowa, a boy from a remote village, meet each other and become friends.

However, a twist of fate will soon drag them into the fires of war, and force them both to reexamine everything they believe to be right and true.

Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes became the #1 funded Kickstarter video game of 2020 thanks to phenomenal support from the community. 505 Games is truly honored to publish Eiyuden Chronicle and work with Rabbit & Bear to help deliver a memorable gaming experience to fans. The goal of Rabbit & Bear and 505 Games is to make sure Eiyuden Chronicle reaches its true potential and delivers a worthwhile JRPG the community will enjoy.

70070000020571.name: PAW Patrol: Grand Prix - Complete Edition
70070000020571.intro: Including all original race tracks, plus PUPtastic DLC features from RACE IN BARKINGBURG and PUP TREAT ARENA!
70070000020571.description:
Join your beloved PAW Patrol pups and race through 11 thrilling tracks in Adventure Bay, Jake's Snowboarding Resort, and the Jungle with up to 4 players. 

Overcome Mayor Humdinger's obstacles, easy controls for young players and a challenging mode for pros. Experience all the original game tracks and features, plus the DLC packs, RACE IN BARKINGBURG and PUP TREAT ARENA. 

In RACE IN BARKINGBURG, enjoy three new tracks, six vehicles, and medieval castle racing. Meanwhile, the PUP TREAT ARENA promises PUPtastic fun as you collect treats, use power-ups, and battle in three arenas. Don't miss the Golden Pup Treat! 

UP TO 4 PAW PATROL RACERS – You can play with friends in up to 4-player split screen as your favorite pups including Chase, Marshall and Rex from Dino Wilds! 

EXCITING ARENAS – Battle in Adventure Bay, the Jungle, and Jake’s Snowboarding Resort.

NEW RIDES – Drive six vehicles from “Ready, Race, Rescue”

CUSTOMISE YOUR KARTS – Make your kart more PAWsome with 20 topper items inspired by the show. The more you race, the more you’ll unlock!

70070000020573.name: Golf Guys: Fantasy Edition
70070000020573.intro: Face off against a dozen opponents in an ultimate golf battle royale, or invite friends to play in multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
70070000020573.description:
Grab your golf club, check the wind direction, aim well, choose the force of impact on the ball and hit it! Hurry up because no one is going to wait for you!

This game is all about speed, precision and decision-making. Compete in tournament mode on random maps with different rules. Score as many points as possible by hitting the ball in the center of the target, be first in a race to hit the ball into the hole before others do, or find the best way to beat everyone in a mini-golf with various obstacles!

Features:
- dress your golfer as a Knight or a Magician
- try a brand new Sword bat with maximum accuracy and power!
- use the new Eye ball with maximum wind resistance in matches!
- play golf battle royale tournaments and become a champion
- play against your friends or family in multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- practice your skills before tournaments in Zen mode 
- compete on over 15 maps with various obstacles and shortcuts 
- earn packs for winning tournaments to get skin cards, upgrade cards and money
- unlock silly character skins, golf clubs and balls in various funny shapes
- buy golf club and ball upgrades using earned coins
- perform quests to collect awesome rewards on your reward track

Consider the direction and speed of the wind when developing your strategy. After each match, the worst ones drop out so if you want to make it to the finals you have to stick to the podium! 

If you don't want to play solo, you can always invite your friends or family to play in the multiplayer mode! Choose your character skins, golf clubs and compete in a tournament for the title of the best golfer!

If you feel like practicing a little, turn on Zen Mode and become a better golfer! Choose a map, wind parameters and practice your strokes without worrying about time or other players!

Do you have what it takes to be the last one standing and become a golf champion?

70070000020576.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000020576.description:
Experience the complete Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley experience in Tove Jansson’s beautiful, lively and melancholic Moomin world in Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Digital Deluxe Edition.

Journey through the valley with the cherished keepsakes that Snufkin takes with him wherever he can: blooming flowers for his hat and a wooden mouthpiece for when he is lost in thought.
 
Join Snufkin and his best friend, Moomintroll, as they embark on a camping trip deep into the wilds before winter sets in. What should have been a relaxing excursion for two, turns into a chaotic and romantic journey, with many new and old friends.
 
The Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
- The cosmetic Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley Cherished Keepsakes DLC
- Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley: Fuddler's Courtship DLC

70070000020579.name: Freaky Trip Premium Edition
70070000020579.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000020579.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Winter and Spring Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000020581.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Ultimate Edition
70070000020581.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000020581.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes second Personal Boards DLC. 

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000020587.name: Hentai Girls Director's Cut
70070000020587.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000020587.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Etsuko in her new foxy suit.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000020592.name: Alwa's Legacy + Alwa's Awakening
70070000020592.description: The Alwa’s Collection Bundle is the perfect set of games for anyone who enjoys classic gaming in the form of metroidvania adventure platforming games.

70070000020603.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash Ultimate Edition
70070000020603.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000020603.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently. 


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Boo's Challenge DLC added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios

70070000020608.name: AAA Clock Extreme Extended
70070000020608.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000020608.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 4 DLCs: the Happy, Pixel, Squid and Cyber Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000020609.name: Brain Memory Ultra Premium
70070000020609.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000020609.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 2 DLC: Cards Pack 2 and Cards Pack 4.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000020610.name: Pixel Paint 2 GOTY Edition
70070000020610.intro: Experience the pixelated sensation, beloved by thousands of people. Discover a coloring book, unlike any other.
70070000020610.description:
Pixel Paint 2 is a sequel to an extremely popular game by the same name. The rules are quite simple. Put your mind at ease, follow the numbers, and fill out every last pixel with the right color. 

It's your first step in becoming an amazing pixel artist. Choose a theme you like and sink into the wonderful world of pixels. 

Choose from a wide range of drawings, and expand your pixel art gallery with the Passion, Party and Health DLCs!

Key Features:

-Dozens of illustrations to choose from
-Relaxing gameplay
-Adorable characters
-Easy to play
-Simplistic Design
-Charming Pixel Drawings

70070000020613.name: Cult of the Lamb - Cultist, Heretic, and Sinful Pack Bundle
70070000020613.description:
This bundle includes the Cultist Pack, Heretic Pack, and Sinful Pack for Cult of the Lamb.

Cultist Pack
Be the envy of every cult with this exclusive Cultist Pack that includes a seven-piece decoration pack for your charming commune, as well as five exclusive Follower forms.

Heretic Pack
Show your devotion to the Old Faith with Cult of the Lamb - Heretic Pack. This cosmetic set includes new Follower forms, a set of dastardly decorations for your Cult, and Fleece of the Old Faith for the Lamb to wear. If your Cult aesthetic is (even more) blood, death, and doom, this pack is for you!

Cult of the Lamb: Heretic Pack includes:
- 5 brand new follower forms: Moose, Gorilla, Goldfish, Mosquito, and Opossum.
- 8 new base decorations.
- A heretical new Fleece for the Lamb!

Sinful Pack
Sin to your heart’s content with Cult of the Lamb - Sinful Pack. This pack is the perfect way to indulge for those who enjoy a gluttonous aesthetic befitting kings and queens. Vanity might be a sin, but there’s nothing wrong with that!

Cult of the Lamb - Sinful Pack includes;
- 5 brand new Follower forms: Hammerhead, Ladybug, Tiger, Llama, Sphynx
- 6 new Follower outfits
- 6 new base decorations
- A sinful new Fleece for the Lamb!

70070000020617.name: Easy Dice for RPG/Tabletop - Premium Edition
70070000020617.intro: Every Dice Roll Sparks the Life of the Party!
70070000020617.description:
Introducing the Easy Dice for RPG/Tabletop - Premium Edition, the all-in-one solution for both casual and seasoned players of Board Games and RPGs. This exclusive bundle takes your gaming experience to new heights, providing a comprehensive set of features that will transform every tabletop adventure into an unforgettable event.

Immerse yourself in the diverse themes included in this premium bundle: the stoic Spartan Theme, the fierce Warrior Theme, and the mythical Dragon Theme. Each theme brings a unique aesthetic to your gaming setup, enhancing the atmosphere of your gatherings and making your tabletop sessions truly stand out.

Easy Dice for RPG/Tabletop - Premium Edition is not just a set of dice; it's a complete package designed to elevate your gaming sessions. Whether you're a casual player hosting game nights or a professional dungeon master orchestrating epic campaigns, this bundle has everything you need to enhance the enjoyment and immersion of your gaming experiences. Don't just play the game; make it legendary with Easy Dice.

70070000020624.name: One Night: Burlesque Special Edition
70070000020624.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000020624.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle you can learn about Club Crowd's creation story by accessing her artbook from game menu. 

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000020625.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Deluxe
70070000020625.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000020625.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming turtle and a super-sweet piglet.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000020626.name: Eastward - Between Two Worlds Bundle
70070000020626.intro: Welcome to the charming world of Eastward - the complete edition!
70070000020626.description:
Join Sam and John on a journey through a society on the brink of collapse in the Eastward base game, and discover a more peaceful parallel world for our duo in the Eastward: Octopia rural life DLC.

This bundle lets you purchase both Eastward and the Eastward: Octopia DLC at a discounted price.

70070000020631.name: Kebab Bar Tycoon Deluxe Edition
70070000020631.intro: Sizzle Your Way to Kebab Royalty!
70070000020631.description:
Embrace the sizzle of the grill as your new symphony in "Kebab Bar Tycoon". With 60 diverse levels serving as your playground, you'll orchestrate a ballet of skewers, veggies, and spices, crafting the perfect kebab. 

Enjoy the enhanced graphics and animations that bring your culinary conquests to life.

Treat your virtual customers with wide selection of exotic dishes that go far beyond the classic kebab. Ready to embark on a flavor-filled journey?

In Kebab Bar Tycoon you'll find:

- 60 levels filled with culinary challenges
- 150+ combination of delightful dishes 
- Countless upgrades to bar and decorations
- 25+ achievements to complete
- Easy to play, hard to master

Unlock the secrets of spices and secure your legacy as a kebab tycoon!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 (Grill Master) and expansion pack #2 (The Spice Route) with:

• 30 new levels

70070000020639.name: Piano: Learn and Play Superb Edition
70070000020639.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000020639.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes second and third Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000020640.name: Sweet Bakery Tycoon Complete Edition
70070000020640.description:
Embark on a delightful baking journey with 'Sweet Bakery Tycoon: Complete Edition.' This comprehensive package invites you to master the art of baking and manage your dream bakery. From crafting a wide variety of cakes using creams, fruits, and decorations, to personalizing your bakery space, the game combines the creativity of baking with strategic business management. Challenge yourself in diverse levels and enjoy a fulfilling baking experience.

DLCs Included in the bundle:

Multiplayer Mode DLC: Team up for shared baking adventures.
Expansion Pack 1: Introduce takeout sweets in 15 new levels.
Expansion Pack 2: Face challenging new levels to become the Dessert King.
Endless Mode DLC: Enjoy non-stop baking fun in an endless gameplay mode.

'Sweet Bakery Tycoon: Complete Edition' offers endless fun and challenges for all aspiring bakers!

70070000020643.name: Hentai Stars Definitive Edition
70070000020643.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000020643.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Night Rider Ran and Idol Tsubaki DLCs.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000020646.name: Zombie Defense: Perfect Cut Edition
70070000020646.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000020646.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you...  Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun! 

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Blue warrior skin, which gives you +10% to movement speed!
- Laser Katana weapon
- 250 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons 
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players!
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde 
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins 
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000020651.name: Trash Punk Deluxe Edition
70070000020651.intro: Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70070000020651.description:
“Trash Punk” is where anarchy reigns, and you’re the opossum punk rocking the apocalypse! This isn’t just a shooter; it's a top-down, adrenaline-pumping riot set in a world gone delightfully mad.

This bundle not only brings you the original chaos of mutated oddities and frantic gameplay but also adds two visually refreshing DLCs, "Winter Rampage" and "Toxic Twilight."

Armed with everything from gnarly firearms to wicked melee weapons, get ready to bash and blast through hordes of mutated oddities. Melee isn't just for show – smash your way to ammo as you carve a path through chaos. At every twisted turn, make tough calls: grab a new weapon, an upgrade, or some much-needed healing.

The game’s world is a wild mashup of punk rock rebellion and post-apocalyptic mayhem, where every rampage is a unique blend of chaos, with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two runs are alike. With a soundtrack dominated by heavy riffs, each level is a mosh pit of danger and excitement.

Grab your weapons and start the rebellion. How far can you go?

70070000020652.name: Cat's Cosmic Atlas Definitive Edition
70070000020652.intro: Embrace the wonders of the night sky alongside an adorable kitten named Fellie.
70070000020652.description:
Gaze upon the stars and other celestial bodies. Cat’s Cosmic Atlas takes you through the Southern and Northern skies. Experience the most beautiful sights and learn a thing or two about the vast Universe that surrounds us.

INTERACTIVE ADVENTURE

Immerse in the captivating picture book style, combining whimsical illustrations with the celestial magic of stars and planets. The game aesthetic draws inspiration from classic children's literature, creating an enchanting world you WANT to explore.

INTO THE NIGHT SKY

Educational values are seamlessly woven into the experience. Expand your knowledge about other worlds and stars. Learn fascinating facts about each celestial body you encounter. Earn badges to keep up with your discoveries.

EXPLORE

Choose what interests you the most and pursue the stars. Travel through our Solar System or stroll along the Southern and Northern sky. Your journey into space starts now!

Get even more information with Southern and Solar System Map DLCs in this bundle.

Key Features:

- A picture book aesthetic
- Interactive learning experience
- Nonlinear exploration
- An adorable kitten
- You can even pet her!
- Relaxing music

70070000020653.name: nPaint Ultra Deluxe
70070000020653.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000020653.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the first and seventh gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000020654.name: Athanasy + CEIBA Bundle
70070000020654.description: The visual novels from Wirion will delight with a deeply thought-out world, colorful characters, and a unique Biopunk-style aesthetic.

70070000020659.name: Escape Room Pentalogy Bundle
70070000020659.intro:
Five escape rooms developed by mc2games included! 
Mystic Academy, Palindrome Syndrome, Tested on Humans, Between Time and Regular Factory.
70070000020659.description:
This bundle includes five escape room games:

*Mystic Academy: Escape Room
*Palindrome Syndrome: Escape Room
*Tested on Humans: Escape Room
*Between Time: Escape Room
*Regular Factory: Escape Room

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?

PALINDROME SYNDROME: ESCAPE ROOM
You wake up in a spaceship with no memories. In this escape room with a sci-fi setting you will have to investigate your past solving different puzzles. Will you escape?

TESTED ON HUMANS: ESCAPE ROOM
You are the test subject. In this dark environment escape room, you have to solve various puzzles to escape from the research center where you are trapped. Will you escape?

BETWEEN TIME: ESCAPE ROOM
You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you must travel through time, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles to obtain untold treasures. Will you come back alive?

REGULAR FACTORY: ESCAPE ROOM
You don't work in a regular assembly line. In this escape room, you will investigate what is really being manufactured in a secret factory, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles. Will you discover the truth?

70070000020667.name: For a Vast Future Complete Edition
70070000020667.intro: Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
70070000020667.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

FAMILIAR GAMEPLAY
Whack every pixelated crook that stands in your way. For a Vast Future uses a classic turn-based formula with some extra twists. Every fight you win makes your allies stronger.

UPGRADE AND CRAFT
Collect powerful weapons and upgrade your characters. Turn them into demolition experts, master marksmen, or the most agile warrior in a room. Choose your way to become unstoppable.

Get access to Colour Palette 7 with this bundle and explore dangerous world in new tints. 

KEY FEATURES:
- Dystopian setting
- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70070000020668.name: Sail Forth + Maelstrom Bundle
70070000020668.intro: Sail across the Deepblue in a quirky nautical adventure!
70070000020668.description:
Explore the Deepblue!
• Put the wind to your back and cast out into High Adventure over a vast ocean spanning dozens of eccentric regions. 
• Discover countless isles bursting with their own flora, fauna, friendly folk, and fearsome foes. 
• Playfully pursue a pod of curious dolphins, admire the beauty of the sun sinking into an icy horizon, or run down a clutch of cowardly criminals only to accept their apologies to the tune of wild cannonry.

Command a Sailing Fleet!
• Build and manage a custom cadre of specialized vessels to match any personality and play style.
• Buy, equip, upgrade, and modify your ships’ armaments to face off against the toughest privateers this side of the Eclipside.
• Crack open giant clams and loot lonely shipwrecks to fill your fleet’s treasure hoard and keep your crew in shipshape.

Fathom a Mystery!
• Join forces with the myriad inhabitants of this watery world to uncover a terrible secret buried in the depths of the Deepblue.
• Reel in a big one with the salty Anglerwranglers, learn the secret spyspeak of the Croaker Command Corps, save the sea life of the Moontiders, capture picturesque memories with a mysterious “camera” device, and much more.
• Inspire the finefolk from all over to work as one world-spanning crew to save the seas and the planet.

Sail Forth into Adventure!
• Tack and jibe and heave and cut with a sail and wind system designed with enough attention to realistic sailing physics to excite naval enthusiasts while also remaining deeply accessible to anyone and everyone.
• Sail through stormy swells and serene sunsets in a dynamic and breathtaking day-night weather system.
• Bask in the beauty of the benevolent ocean waters in Free Sail mode where the only goal is the ever-moving horizon.

The Deepblue calls with the bellow of High Adventure! Sail Forth!

Dive headfirst into the heart of the storm with the Sail Forth Maelstrom expansion! A tempest has swept across the Deepblue, bringing forth colossal vortexes that promise unparalleled challenges and untold treasures. Are you ready to face the Maelstrom?

70070000020669.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 & 2 - Double Pack
70070000020669.intro: A dramatic action strategy RPG depicting hope and despair.
70070000020669.description:
*See the official store pages for details on the content.
*Please be careful not to buy duplicates of an item.

A special set of both Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 and 2 is now available!

Content:
・Fuga: Melodies of Steel - Full Game
・Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2 - Full Game

About Fuga: Melodies of Steel
Your adventure. Your choices.
Will you make sacrifices for victory? Or will you seek another path?
In this RPG, many choices have to be made in order to progress... but taking the safest road may not always be the best option.
Faced with a desperate situation, what course of action will you choose?

70070000020688.name: Notes + Stickers Premium Edition
70070000020688.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000020688.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort. 

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 5 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality

70070000020691.name: Hero of Fate（Deluxe Edition）
70070000020691.intro: Unstoppable Rogue-like excitement! Unlock new classes, gather allies, and dive into unique adventures. Conquer the monster hordes and embark on an epic journey.
70070000020691.description: Includes the main game and DLC, just install it directly. Get all the content at once and enjoy to your heart's content!

70070000020694.name: Ultimate Bundle
70070000020694.intro: Who says you can't have it all?
70070000020694.description: This bundle includes everything available for Evolution on Nintendo Switch™:   the Evolution Base Game, the Climate Expansion, all 3 Promo Packs:  Biodiversity, Arms Race, and Alone and Unafraid, and the Stained Glass Cards. Evolution is a lot more fun with this content so we're deeply discounting this bundle.

70070000020713.name: ASMR Slicing: Nice Cuts Edition
70070000020713.intro: Slice multiple objects made of kinetic sand in the most satisfying ASMR cutting game!
70070000020713.description:
Choose your favorite cutting tool no matter if it's a playing card, flosser or just a simple kitchen knife. Just cut, cut, cut and experience those satisfying ASMR
sounds! Slice a variety of colorful objects made of kinetic sand in the shapes of food, toys, buildings, everyday objects and ordinary cubes or blocks!

Features:
- cut through 64 colorful objects in many shapes!
- equip yourself with 23 epic blades!
- get an extra 5000 coins to spend
- listen to great ASMR sounds while cutting through every item
- play in challenge mode with different tasks 
- unlock mysterious objects and slice them all
- smash cookies with life quotes using a hammer

Need to raise the difficulty level a bit? Turn on the challenge mode! Cut off the right weight, divide an object into a given number of parts, cut an item perfectly in half, or find things hidden inside!

Progress to unlock new mysterious objects and collect coins for completed levels to buy epic blades ranging from lightsabers and credit cards to axes and chainsaws!

Get your new tools ready, face the challenges and become the ultimate slice master!

70070000020714.name: ASMR Slicing: Joyful Cutting Edition
70070000020714.intro: Slice multiple objects made of kinetic sand in the most satisfying ASMR cutting game!
70070000020714.description:
Choose your favorite cutting tool no matter if it's a playing card, flosser or just a simple kitchen knife. Just cut, cut, cut and experience those satisfying ASMR
sounds! Slice a variety of colorful objects made of kinetic sand in the shapes of food, toys, buildings, everyday objects and ordinary cubes or blocks!
