70070000020932.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? – New Edition
70070000020932.intro: Gather all your knowledge and get the jackpot while avoiding all the trick questions facing you!
70070000020932.description:
Put your general knowledge and your reflection skills to the test in « Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? – New Edition »!

Gather all your knowledge and get the jackpot while avoiding all the trick questions facing you!

With 15 questions to answer, it will become harder and harder to increase the prize fund: over 8,000 themed questions waiting to be answered (geographic, science, history, but also entertainment or arts), a growing difficulty and the pressure from the audience and the host…

All the ingredients are here to put the player under pressure!

70070000020941.name: World of Deadliest Catch 2024 Premium Edition
70070000020941.intro: World of Deadliest Catch: Earn More Money for an Exciting Adventure!
70070000020941.description:
Embark on a perilous journey into the icy depths of the Bering Sea in this thrilling fishing adventure. Test your mettle as you brave treacherous storms, choppy waters, and the relentless pursuit of the elusive king crab. In "World of Deadliest Catch" you'll commandeer your own vessel, navigating through the unforgiving Alaskan waters in search of fortune and glory. Customize your ship, upgrade your gear, and hone your skills as you compete against seasoned veterans and ambitious newcomers alike.
     Take advantage of the convenience of the Game + DLC Premium Edition bundle to unlock additional content and earn more money, allowing you to develop and purchase more powerful equipment for your crab-catching endeavors. From state-of-the-art ships to advanced nets, suits, and tools, every upgrade brings you closer to mastering the art of crab catching.
        But beware, the sea is as unpredictable as it is bountiful. You'll need to strategize and adapt to changing conditions, from shifting crab migration patterns to strict quotas and regulations.
       So, are you ready to test your luck and skill against the deadliest waters on Earth? It's time to cast off and claim your place among the bravest sailors and most skilled crab catchers in Alaska. The adventure awaits – will you rise to the challenge?

70070000020947.name: Foot Clinic: Fishy Edition
70070000020947.intro:
Healing hands, happy feet!
Be the Foot Clinic hero!
70070000020947.description:
Step into the shoes of a doctor and podiatrist as you indulge in the foot clinic experience. Scrub, scrape, pluck, and pull all kinds of feet.

Features:
- 12 essential tools for treating and beautifying feet
- new premium fish tank tool for extra treatments!
- mechanics of squeezing pimples, cutting nails, cleaning, shaving and much more
- lots of patients with various foot problems
- testing and vaccinating sick clients
- new skins for tools: Tweezers Pro, Foot Care Cream Pro, Soap and Flusher Pro!
- equipment, furniture and decoration upgrades
- additional 2000 coins

Perform foot treatments for conditions like calluses, corns and ingrown toenails. Each patient presents a new problem, so you'll never get bored of your work!

When you're ready to take a break, head to the on-site nail salon for a pampering session. Give someone's feet the attention they deserve with various nail polishes, tattoos, and foot mask.

70070000020949.name: Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Deluxe Edition
70070000020949.intro: Bang-On Balls: Chronicles – where history meets hilarity! Roll, smash, and bash your way through time in a 3D platforming extravaganza.
70070000020949.description:
Bang-On Balls: Chronicles - Deluxe Edition is the ultimate package for fans of this quirky, content-packed, destructible open-world sandbox adventure. Not only do you get the full game with all its features, maps, and collectibles, but you also get access to the official soundtrack and art book. Enjoy the catchy tunes and stunning visuals that bring this game to life. Whether you play solo, via local wireless multiplayer, or online co-op for up to 4 players, you will have a blast exploring, fighting, platforming, and customizing your character in this hilarious and chaotic game. No paid cosmetic DLC nonsense. Just pure fun and mayhem.

Bang on Balls Chronicles Deluxe Edition includes:

- The full game with multiple (slightly inaccurate) historically themed open worlds each with its own unique mechanics, items, and enemies.
- The official soundtrack with 40 tracks composed by Łukasz Salomon Bryła and Matthew Chilleli, featuring a variety of genres and styles to match each map’s theme.
- Survival Guide for Bang-On Balls Interns: The artbook filled with useful information about the world of Bang-On Balls, including commentary from the developers, sketches, and concept art, a must-have for every fan of the game!

Don’t miss this chance to get the most bang for your buck with Bang-On Balls: Chronicles Deluxe Edition. Buy it now and join the fun!

70070000020969.name: Suika Game Multi-Player Mode Expansion Pack
70070000020969.intro: A brand new two-player addition to the Suika Game is here; come and join the fun!
70070000020969.description:
"Enjoy three new game modes: ""Original,"" ""Time Limit,"" and ""Attack.""

""Original"" is the usual Suika Game, and the player with the highest score wins. Once the box is full, play ends at that point. If the other side's score is higher, you win at that point. If you are losing, continue playing. Can you catch up to your opponent?!

""Time Limit"" is a 5-minute intense competition, and the player with the highest score wins. When the rainbow gauge runs out, Poppy will drop fruits on her own, so you'll need to make decisions faster than usual!

In ""Attack,"" the winner is the one who ends the opponent's game. On every 5th attempt, you can send ""sinking"" fruit to your opponent's box. Sending a big fruit would surely turn things around!

We are currently developing an online play mode!
You will update to online play mode for free if you purchase the “Suika Game Multi-Player” DLC. So, stay tuned!"

70070000020972.name: nPaint Ultra Ultimate
70070000020972.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000020972.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the first and eighth gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000020978.name: Cat's Cosmic Atlas Complete Edition
70070000020978.intro: Embrace the wonders of the night sky alongside an adorable kitten named Fellie.
70070000020978.description:
Gaze upon the stars and other celestial bodies. Cat’s Cosmic Atlas takes you through the Southern and Northern skies. Experience the most beautiful sights and learn a thing or two about the vast Universe that surrounds us.

INTERACTIVE ADVENTURE

Immerse in the captivating picture book style, combining whimsical illustrations with the celestial magic of stars and planets. The game aesthetic draws inspiration from classic children's literature, creating an enchanting world you WANT to explore.

INTO THE NIGHT SKY

Educational values are seamlessly woven into the experience. Expand your knowledge about other worlds and stars. Learn fascinating facts about each celestial body you encounter. Earn badges to keep up with your discoveries.

EXPLORE

Choose what interests you the most and pursue the stars. Travel through our Solar System or stroll along the Southern and Northern sky. Your journey into space starts now!

Get even more information with Northern, Southern and Solar System Map DLCs in this bundle.

Key Features:

- A picture book aesthetic
- Interactive learning experience
- Nonlinear exploration
- An adorable kitten
- You can even pet her!
- Relaxing music

70070000021002.name: Astro Miner: Moon Landing
70070000021002.intro:
Embark on a Colorful Journey Through the Galaxy! 
Explore new planets and mine various minerals using your vacuum gun!
70070000021002.description:
Fly to extraordinary planets with different terrains and start mining valuable minerals to sell them in your base. Create corridors to reach stacks of crystals, or do it your own way and mine wherever you like with the help of dynamites. Hire workers and build an auto-miner machine to speed up your work!

Over time, mining gets more difficult because of more challenging terrains. Collect money to buy various upgrades for your mining machine, workers, vacuum gun, your character and the backpack you are carrying. This way you will be well prepared and get all the minerals out much faster! 

Features:
- fly to 12 bonus levels with moons on which you will find great cash rewards that will help you buy upgrades much earlier! 
- unlock 2 new vehicles you can ride on
- travel through multiple unknown and mysterious planets
- mine valuable crystals from various terrains using your vacuum gun
- sell the collected crystals in your base to earn a lot of money
- play in co-op mode for up to 2 players and share the duties!
- spend your money to buy different upgrades: capacity, force, speed, workers, mining speed and storage of your auto-miner machine
- if you have difficulty mining, use power-ups or blow up the area with dynamite!
- teleport to the underground to find gold coins or complete missions to get them
- visit the moon and see what rewards await you there 
- spend your coins to unlock awesome skins and hoverboard vehicle
- find fossils of various amazing creatures that once inhabited the planets 
- bring these creatures back to life, ask them to follow you and enjoy the extra bonuses they give you!

Use power-ups of increased backpack capacity, a magnet that attracts crystals, or a jetpack which, in addition to increasing the speed of movement, also melts the terrain. However, they are not free. To use them, you must go through the portal located on the planet and teleport yourself to the underground to find gold coins. You can also spend them to buy various character skins, vacuums and even vehicles! Yes, you read that right, because who wouldn't want to ride a hoverboard on an unknown planet? 

If you don't want to mine alone, invite a friend to play together in co-op mode and share the duties! Pick your favorite skins, hop on the hoverboards and get rich together by selling colorful minerals!

Beware, in the terrain you may find the fossils of creatures that once lived on the planet. Thanks to super technology you can bring them back to the world and assign them to follow you giving you various bonuses!

Now go! Put on your space suit, discover new planets with their terrains and mine for valuable crystals!

70070000021006.intro: Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
70070000021006.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

FAMILIAR GAMEPLAY
Whack every pixelated crook that stands in your way. For a Vast Future uses a classic turn-based formula with some extra twists. Every fight you win makes your allies stronger.

UPGRADE AND CRAFT
Collect powerful weapons and upgrade your characters. Turn them into demolition experts, master marksmen, or the most agile warrior in a room. Choose your way to become unstoppable.

Get access to Colour Palette 8 with this bundle and explore dangerous world in new tints. 

KEY FEATURES:
- Dystopian setting
- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70070000021007.name: Zombie Defense: Pew Pew Edition
70070000021007.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000021007.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you...  Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun! 

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Cyborg skin, which adds one extra part to your health bar 
- Lasergun weapon
- 250 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons 
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players!
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde 
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins 
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000021012.name: Zombie Defense: Flaming Edition
70070000021012.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000021012.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you...  Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun! 

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- Armored yellow worrior skin, which gives you +5% to damage and +5% to fire rate
- Flamethrower weapon
- 250 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons 
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players!
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde 
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins 
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000021018.name: Zombie Defense: Wonderful Edition
70070000021018.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000021018.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you...  Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun! 

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Wonderful female skin, which gives you +10% to damage
- Thunder Hammer weapon
- 250 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins

70070000021020.name: Notes + Stickers Definitive Edition
70070000021020.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000021020.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort. 

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 1 and 2 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality

70070000021022.name: Foot Clinic: Smelly Edition
70070000021022.intro:
Healing hands, happy feet!
Be the Foot Clinic hero!
70070000021022.description:
Step into the shoes of a doctor and podiatrist as you indulge in the foot clinic experience. Scrub, scrape, pluck, and pull all kinds of feet.

Features:
- 12 essential tools for treating and beautifying feet
- new premium perfume tool for extra treatments!
- mechanics of squeezing pimples, cutting nails, cleaning, shaving and much more
- lots of patients with various foot problems
- testing and vaccinating sick clients
- new skins for tools: Pedicure Pliers Pro, Tweezers Pro, Toenail Clippers Pro!
- equipment, furniture and decoration upgrades
- additional 2000 coins

Perform foot treatments for conditions like calluses, corns and ingrown toenails. Each patient presents a new problem, so you'll never get bored of your work!

When you're ready to take a break, head to the on-site nail salon for a pampering session. Give someone's feet the attention they deserve with various nail polishes, tattoos, and foot mask.

70070000021024.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Bundle
70070000021024.description:
SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated:

Are you ready, kids? The cult classic is back, faithfully remade in spongetastic splendor! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy and show the evil Plankton that crime pays even less than Mr. Krabs. Want to save Bikini Bottom from lots of rampant robots with your mighty bubbles? Of course you do! Want to underpants bungee jump? Why wouldn't you! Want to join forces in a brand new multiplayer mode? The battle is on!  

GAME FEATURES - Play as SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy and use their unique sets of skills - Thwart Plankton's evil plan to rule Bikini Bottom with his army of wacky robots - Meet countless characters from the beloved series 

REMAKE FEATURES - Faithful remake of one of the best SpongeBob games ever created - High-end visuals, modern resolutions and carefully polished gameplay - Brand new horde mode multiplayer for up to two players, online and offline - Restored content that was cut from the original game like the Robo Squidward boss fight and more


SpongeBob SquarePants: The Cosmic Shake:

Wish-granting Mermaid’s Tears in the hands of SpongeBob and Patrick… What could possibly go wrong? Sure, the very fabric holding the very universe very together could come very undone, opening up portals into Wishworlds full of knights, cowboys, pirates, and prehistoric snails. But that’s nothing everyone’s favorite sponge can’t handle - with the right cosmic costume!  Everybody do the Cosmic Shake!

- Unlock classic and new platforming skills like the Fishhook Swing and Karate Kick
- Don more than 30 F.U.N.tastic costumes like SnailBob and SpongeGar
- Travel to 7 distinct Wishworlds like Wild West Jellyfish Fields and Halloween Rock Bottom
- Experience all the buddy movie banter with SpongeBob’s permanent companion Balloon-Patrick
- Meet all your favorite Bikini Bottomites from the series, voiced by their original actors
- Brand-new soundtrack from the composers of Battle for Bikini Bottom + dozens of songs from the series!

70070000021027.name: Hentai Golf Extended Edition
70070000021027.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000021027.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' winter outfits with Lakeside Fairways DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000021034.name: Beauties Unveiled Premium Edition
70070000021034.intro: Beauties Unveiled takes you on a mesmerizing journey that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.
70070000021034.description:
Beauties Unveiled takes you on a mesmerizing journey that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.
As you navigate the game landscape, strategically deploy power-ups, and overcome ticking-clock challenges, you unlock the beautiful art that can be viewed in a special gallery. 
Expose the covered areas of the pictures and, eventually, reveal the whole picture. 
Be aware of many obstacles and opponents, choose carefully your path, and benefit from different power-ups available during each stage of the game. 
Pay attention to the obstacles that will get in your way – you may have a few chances but be wary as the number of attempts is limited! 
To snatch the highest score, you will need reflex, quick decisions and a bit of luck.

70070000021041.name: nGolf Ultimate Edition
70070000021041.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000021041.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Visit space with the Western Fairways DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000021050.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Special Edition
70070000021050.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000021050.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes fourth Personal Boards DLC. 

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000021054.name: Tchia: Oléti Edition
70070000021054.intro: A game inspired by New Caledonia.
70070000021054.description:
The Tchia: Oléti Edition comes with the Tchia base game and the Kepler Customization Pack, which includes four costume sets for Tchia and four boat customization packs, inspired by fellow titles from the Kepler game catalogue.

Join Tchia on her tropical open-world adventure as she sets off to rescue her father from the cruel tyrant, Meavora, ruler of the archipelago. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around beautiful islands as you explore a physics-driven sandbox. Face the fabric soldiers created by Meavora in open encounters where your creativity gives you the edge. Take control of any animal or object you can find, make new friends and jam on your fully playable Ukulele. A poetic coming-of-age story inspired by New Caledonia.

70070000021055.name: Paradiso Series Bundle
70070000021055.intro: Descend into the nightmare of Paradiso in melessthanthree's action-RPGs Lucah: Born of a Dream and Death of a Wish!
70070000021055.description:
Descend into the nightmare dreamworld of Paradiso in melessthanthree's action-RPG games Lucah: Born of a Dream and Death of a Wish! 

LUCAH: BORN OF A DREAM
HACK, SLASH, ASCEND. Lucah: Born of a Dream is a harrowing struggle through our worst nightmares.

You have been MARKED, cursed to have your inner demons come to life as vicious Nightmares. After awakening a false god, you must atone. Traverse the hellish realm of dreams, endure the nightmare onslaught, and uncover the strength to accept yourself.

DEATH OF A WISH
THE NEO-SANCTUM SHALL FALL. Claim retribution against the theocratic Faiths as you master vicious hack-and-slash combat in Death of a Wish, an action-RPG where style is salvation.

70070000021058.name: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS 2 Deluxe Edition
70070000021058.intro: The Earth is in pieces...again! We've gotta do more to save the planet!
70070000021058.description:
The "EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS 2" Deluxe Edition is a deluxe package that includes the main game bundled with additional DLC coming after the game is released. Check the official website for details on DLC.

-

  --Deluxe Edition Contents--
① "EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS 2" Main Game
② Season Pass
  --Additional Playable Characters--
  1) BRB, Freebike Ranger (EDF5) Joins the Fight
  2) Humanity's Security Officer, Ranger (EDF5) Civilian Outfit: Reskin
  3) Sky Dancer, Wing Diver (EDF5) Civilian Outfit: Reskin
  4) World's Greatest Engineer, Air Raider (EDF5) Civilian Outfit: Reskin
  5) Incredible Cargo Loader, Fencer (EDF5) Civilian Outfit: Reskin
  6) Colonist β, Heart of Brocade: Reskin
  7) Cosmonaut β, Wearing a Helmet: Reskin
  8) Additional Character ⑧
  9) Additional Character ⑨
  10) Additional Character ⑩
  11) Additional Character ⑪
  12) Additional Character ⑫
  13) Additional Character ⑬

  --Upcoming Major Content Update--
  14) Extra Mission Pack (Details to be announced on the official website and other media outlets.)

70070000021059.name: Freaky Trip Complete Edition
70070000021059.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000021059.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Winter and Fall Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000021064.name: Fun Chess Amazing Edition
70070000021064.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000021064.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Barbarian, Dwarf and Elf DLCs.

Key features:

- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000021065.name: nDay Ultimate Edition
70070000021065.intro: Keep all your important dates and events organized in one place with nDay!
70070000021065.description:
Start your day by planning in order to save time and avoid forgetting anything. Note all important events and appointments, and never miss a meeting again.


YOUR OWN PERSONAL CALENDAR
With nDay, you'll optimize your free time, schedule your day without worrying that something slipped your mind. Choose the year, month, day, exact hour and add a note. How simple is that? Add even more text in your description to remember more details about this date.


CUSTOMIZE AS YOU LIKE
It doesn't matter whether you use a 12 or 24-hour clock. In nDay you can customize it as you prefer. Additionally, you can change the available colors of the entire calendar according to your preferences.

Gain access to a greater variety of calendar colors with Themes Color 2 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Simple and clear interface
- Helps you organize your day
- Customizable

70070000021066.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Amazing Edition
70070000021066.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000021066.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Remix Vol. 2 and Summer Island DLCs.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000021069.name: Year 3 Season Pass!
70070000021069.intro: This is your pass to 6 exciting new worlds to complete in hexceed! With 800+ levels to complete, 150,000+ hexes to clear, and 2 more puzzle mechanics to discover!
70070000021069.description:
This pass unlocks all the DLC that we will release during hexceed's third year! We will be releasing a new DLC every other month, each containing a new world to complete. That's 6 new worlds to explore! Over 800 levels to complete! Over 150,000 individual hexes to uncover!

Although each DLC will be available for purchase individually, this Year 3 Pass lets you buy them all at once and for a discount!
Here is a breakdown of the DLCs included, as well as when we intend to introduce some new mechanics to the game:
1 - Aqua (Mar 2024)
2 - Ignis (May 2024) + new mechanic!
3 - Terra (Jul 2024)
4 - Ventus (Sep 2024) + new mechanic!
5 - Metallicum (Nov 2024)
6 - Glacias (Jan 2025)

70070000021071.name: Rain World - Deluxe Edition
70070000021071.intro: The story of the slugcats, packaged together in this Deluxe bundle of the base game of Rain World and its expansion, Rain World: Downpour.
70070000021071.description:
You are a slugcat. The world around you is full of danger, and you must face it – alone. Separated from your family in a devastating flood, you will need to find food and shelter between terrifying torrential downpours which threaten to drown all life. Climb through the ruins of an ancient civilization, evade the jaws of vicious predators, and discover new lands teeming with strange creatures and buried mysteries. Find your family before something makes a meal of you!

Rain World: Downpour is a DLC expansion of Rain World. Take control of five new characters with new abilities in this vast, redefined world. Slugcats have adapted to the harsh conditions alongside evolved predators! Survive new environmental conditions, dangers and explore uncharted territory.

70070000021072.name: Pony World - Color by Numbers & Animal Golf - Battle Race Bundle
70070000021072.intro:
Color your way through the enchanting Pony World!
+
Cute animal golf battle race game!
70070000021072.description:
Immerse yourself in a delightful world of creativity and competitive fun with this special bundle featuring two engaging Nintendo games.

Pony World - Color by Numbers:
Enter a charming realm filled with adorable ponies and vibrant colors. Pony World - Color by Numbers offers a relaxing and immersive experience where you can bring adorable pony scenes to life through the simple joy of coloring. With a wide array of colors and beautiful pony illustrations, this game provides hours of creative enjoyment for players of all ages.

Animal Golf - Battle Race:
Embark on an exciting journey across unique golf courses where the usual rules don't apply! Animal Golf - Battle Race combines the classic game of golf with thrilling racing elements and adorable animal characters. Compete against friends or AI opponents in fast-paced races, utilizing power-ups and strategy to outmaneuver your rivals. With colorful visuals, dynamic gameplay, and hilarious animal antics, Animal Golf - Battle Race promises endless hours of multiplayer excitement for players of all skill levels.

Experience the best of both worlds with this delightful bundle, perfect for gamers seeking creative expression and competitive thrills.

70070000021073.name: Rage Quit Bundle
70070000021073.description:
Hellstuck: Rage With Your Friends

Get ready to feel the pain!
Hellstuck: Rage With Your Friends is a punishing platforming game where you start in the deepest depths of Hell and must escape. But the way out is a long way up and the only thing in between you and escape is how much rage you can endure.

Can you beat your friends and make it out of Hell?
- Struggle upwards through each of the 9 Circles of Hell
- One missed jump can lead to a long fall back down


Diamond Hands: To The Moon

Diamond Hands: To The Moon is a simple to play, yet difficult to master jumping platform game where the ultimate goal is to get to the moon. You control your character by moving left, right and by jumping - and that's it. With practice, you'll be able to perfect your jump by controlling the jump's strength to land on any target platform. Apes that get to the moon will earn not only the title of diamond hands, but will also be showered in their heart's most luxurious desires!

Apes alone .. Weak!
Solo mode for those players seeking the most challenging adventure or versus on mode on split screen.

70070000021082.name: Hentai Girls Happy Edition
70070000021082.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000021082.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Kitty Shirayuki and Foxy Etsuko.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000021089.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash Special Edition
70070000021089.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000021089.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently. 


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Ta's Challenge DLC added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios

70070000021098.name: Frozen Honey ASMR: Complete Edition
70070000021098.intro: Enjoy making your frozen honey jelly desserts from scratch in the most satisfying ASMR game!
70070000021098.description:
Choose your favorite bottle, mix all ingredients, freeze it, and squeeze out the frozen honey jelly!

You are the owner of a frozen honey truck, and people can't get enough of your tasty honey desserts! Start the cooking adventure by choosing the bottle shape, adding candies, pouring colorful honey, and mixing it up. After that, put the stencil on the bottle, pop it into the fridge, and enjoy the sounds of the frozen honey. Sweet, soft, and incredibly tasty – frozen honey jelly has never been this much fun!

Features:
- add new 9 ingredients to your frozen honey jelly and freeze it using your new hand-held freezer!
- unlock a brand new truck, change its look with 3 unique skins and put a special sign on top!
- spend additional 4500 coins in the shop
- create fabulous and colorful frozen honey jelly desserts!
- let your imagination run wild using different sweets, honey colors, bottle shapes, and stencils! 
- meet the demands of your customers
- enjoy the ASMR sounds while preparing your delicious frozen honey!
- perform special tasks of collector, achiever, gamer and purchaser
- serve unique VIP characters
- customize your truck using various skins, signs, and truck shapes
- use skins to change the look of your equipment
- earn money to spend it in the store on skins, bottles, candies, and more!
- watch your customers eat the frozen honey jelly desserts you have prepared and wait for their reactions! 

Watch the ASMR rainbow jelly dance and swirl into the perfect frozen honey dessert In this game, you're the mastermind behind the sensational frozen honey jelly treats that everyone loves on social media!

Explore the joy of experimenting with various candies and colorful syrups to create your own satisfying frozen honey. It's not just a game – it's an interactive journey that combines jelly with the joy of crafting!

Dive into the pleasures of crafting, innovating, and experiencing the captivating charm of the Frozen Honey ASMR game!

70070000021103.name: AAA Clock Extreme Premium
70070000021103.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000021103.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 4 DLCs: the Pixel, Digital, Spin and Cyber Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000021104.name: Brain Memory Ultra Complete
70070000021104.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000021104.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 2 DLC: Cards Pack 2 and Figures Pack.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000021105.name: MeowMatch Ultimate Edition
70070000021105.intro: Merge cats, discover new adorable kittens and reach the highest score possible!
70070000021105.description:
Welcome to MeowMatch – a place full of adorable kitties where each move lets you reveal new lovely cats.


DISCOVER THEM ALL
Each matched pair of the same cat unlocks a new one. To make this task easier, try to remember the order of matching. Those cute fluffy creatures are waiting to be uncovered. Can you find them all?


EACH MOVE MATTERS
The game mechanics are based on the 2048 game, so every move you make might cause you to lose. Look at the board, analyze the current arrangement, try to predict how the elements will behave, and make your move.

Match new cats with the Cat's Theme 2 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Many cute kittens
- 14 colorful backgrounds to choose
- Meow-tastic soundtrack

70070000021112.name: Pixel Paint 2 Amazing Edition
70070000021112.intro: Experience the pixelated sensation, beloved by thousands of people. Discover a coloring book, unlike any other.
70070000021112.description:
Pixel Paint 2 is a sequel to an extremely popular game by the same name. The rules are quite simple. Put your mind at ease, follow the numbers, and fill out every last pixel with the right color. 

It's your first step in becoming an amazing pixel artist. Choose a theme you like and sink into the wonderful world of pixels. 

Choose from a wide range of drawings, and expand your pixel art gallery with the Passion, Party, XD, Health and Ocean DLCs!

Key Features:

-Dozens of illustrations to choose from
-Relaxing gameplay
-Adorable characters
-Easy to play
-Simplistic Design
-Charming Pixel Drawings

70070000021114.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Deluxe Edition
70070000021114.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000021117.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Extended
70070000021117.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000021117.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming turtle and a super-sweet hamster.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000021118.name: One Night: Burlesque Definitive Edition
70070000021118.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000021118.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle you can learn about Holly's and Suspects' creation story by accessing artbook from game menu. 

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000021139.name: Fit My Cat Deluxe Edition
70070000021139.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000021139.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Get access to new levels with Cat's Puzzle Pack 1 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000021148.name: Sprout Valley Deluxe Edition
70070000021148.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000021148.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Unlock new Valentine's Day items with Lovely DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000021153.name: Fashion World Extended Edition
70070000021153.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000021153.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!
- Create stunning looks with countless combinations of costumes, accessories, and scenic backdrops!
- Capture your creations in Photo Mode!
- Strive for perfection with the three-star rating system, boosting your game's replay value.
- Designed for fashion lovers of all ages!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #1 (Glamour Gala) with:

- 20 all-new levels of puzzles

70070000021154.name: Fashion World Deluxe Edition
70070000021154.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000021154.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!
- Create stunning looks with countless combinations of costumes, accessories, and scenic backdrops!
- Capture your creations in Photo Mode!
- Strive for perfection with the three-star rating system, boosting your game's replay value.
- Designed for fashion lovers of all ages!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 (Glamour Gala) and expansion pack #2 (Street Style) with:

- 40 all-new levels of puzzles

70070000021160.name: Hentai Stars Legendary Edition
70070000021160.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000021160.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Shy Fox Ayame DLCs.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000021164.name: Piano: Learn and Play Ultra Ultimate
70070000021164.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000021164.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes second and sixth Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000021176.name: nPaint Ultra Extended
70070000021176.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000021176.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the first and ninth gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000021191.name: For a Vast Future Platinum Edition
70070000021191.intro: Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
70070000021191.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

FAMILIAR GAMEPLAY
Whack every pixelated crook that stands in your way. For a Vast Future uses a classic turn-based formula with some extra twists. Every fight you win makes your allies stronger.

UPGRADE AND CRAFT
Collect powerful weapons and upgrade your characters. Turn them into demolition experts, master marksmen, or the most agile warrior in a room. Choose your way to become unstoppable.

Get access to Colour Palette 9 with this bundle and explore dangerous world in new tints. 

KEY FEATURES:
- Dystopian setting
- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70070000021192.name: Notes + Stickers Complete Edition
70070000021192.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000021192.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort. 

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 1 and 3 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality

70070000021199.name: Moto Rush GT GOTY Edition
70070000021199.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000021199.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Full Garage, Grip Collection #1 and Grip Collection #2 with:

- 17 new motorbikes (each with special colors)
- New colors for the rest of motorbikes
- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- eight pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

Check it out!

70070000021200.name: Bucket Crusher: Complete Edition
70070000021200.intro: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!
70070000021200.description:
Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw! Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you complete the first wall, there are various colorful and interesting mosaics with different shapes waiting for you to dig into and pull to pieces!

Features:
- tear down 35 amazing brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- change the look of your saw with 14 different skins!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Upgrade your machinery after each level and think carefully about the wisest way to invest your money. Increase the length, power, size, and fuel capacity to get more bricks with every run of the level!

If you want to knock down walls faster and earn more cash, consider buying special permanent upgrades that cost prestige points, but there's a catch here. To get them, you have to reset all your progress!

70070000021202.name: DIY Makeup: Complete Edition
70070000021202.intro:
Become the best DIY makeup stylist and unleash your creativity!
Unlock mean ingredients and help your clients with sweet revenge!
70070000021202.description:
Mix together various kitchen ingredients, and voila! You have created a fabulous new lipstick color and a fancy pampering face mask!

Immerse yourself in the world of DIY doll makeup and experiment with beautiful eye art, mascara, and various other makeup products. Indulge in the luxury of avocado face masks and raspberry blush to add a touch of glamour to your doll's beauty routine.

Features:
- Let your creativity run wild and create gorgeous makeup looks! 
- Choose the type of makeup you want to make: lipstick, face mask, powder or eye shadow
- Pick sweet ingredients that give color and texture, then add a little glitter if you like!
- Grab nasty ingredients, from spiders to moldy cheeses and make face masks with nasty suprise for the bad girls!
- Mix the formula and choose the container into which you want to pour everything. 
- Give complete makeovers to your clients. Choose their new hair, clothes, jewelry, and makeup!
- Take pictures of your artwork and choose a filter to give it a special look
- Go shopping and restock your ingredients
- Serve more clients, achieve new rankings, and unlock new ingredients! 
- Answer clients' questions and test your makeup knowledge

Take charge as the perfect makeup artist in your very own makeup salon and be part of an amazing big makeover experience. Transform your dolls into stunning beauties, and let your artistic talents shine through their makeovers!

Get ready for a princess makeup adventure like never before. It's time to embrace your passion for beauty and become the ultimate makeup artist in this captivating, sweet dollhouse makeover journey!

70070000021207.name: They Always Run Deluxe
70070000021207.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- They Always Run
- Audio Artbook (Arts from They Always Run)

70070000021208.name: Right and Down Double Bundle
70070000021208.intro: Two roguelike games developed by mc2games included! Right and Down + Right and Down and Dice.
70070000021208.description:
This bundle includes two roguelike games:

*Right and Down
*Right and Down and Dice

RIGHT AND DOWN
A deep roguelike and card game that is played using only two buttons: Right and Down! Choose your hero and explore randomly generated card dungeons, gather powerful artifacts to get new abilities, and fight against mighty enemies! Will you make it to level 50?

RIGHT AND DOWN AND DICE
Explore randomly generated card dungeons where you can only move Right and Down, use Dice to defeat mighty enemies, gather powerful artifacts, and learn new abilities! Will you be able to escape from the dungeon?

70070000021209.name: Class of Heroes 1&2: Complete Edition
70070000021209.intro: Swords, Magic, School! The beloved JRPG dungeon crawler returns!
70070000021209.description:
The Class of Heroes series returns for a new generation. Experience both the original Anniversary Edition and 2G, now remastered and ready for your enjoyment!

Live the life of a student twice as you crawl through endless dungeons, build your perfect cohort of students, take on hordes of enemies, in the Complete Edition which includes both games!

Build your perfect roster and handpick out your ideal party of 6 students to storm the labyrinths. Mix and match from 10 races and 18 classes, each with their own unique skill sets. Crawl through over 100 labyrinth maps facing over 250 potential enemies. Don’t forget to collect artefacts, explore inter-dimensional travel and conquer adversity. You determine the standard you thrive at, so be sure to take note of recipes for weapons, potions, and any upgrades necessary to level up your party.

Groups of excited students will walk through the doors of the academies to learn the tools of the trade and leave as the next Class of Heroes!

Do you have what It takes?

70070000021210.name: Not Tonight & Not Tonight 2
70070000021210.description:
Not Tonight is a post-Brexit management game, fusing a time-pressure RPG with a politically charged story where every decision matters. Will you join the resistance and fight the regime -- or keep your head down and hope that one day this will all be a distant memory? 

Not Tonight: One Love is a full, extra chapter that follows on from the main Not Tonight storyline. King's Head Dave has had just about enough of everything happening in Britain, and has decided to pack up and move to France, in the hope of finding true love.

In an alternative Britain where Brexit talks have collapsed, an extreme far-right government has taken power. Citizens of European heritage have been rounded up and exiled. Forced out of your previous life, you find yourself in the midst of a booming gig economy, fighting to scrape by and return to the city you call home.

-

Not Tonight 2 is an American document-checking road trip, fusing a time-pressure RPG with a politically charged, dark comedy where every decision matters. Will Eduardo's friends Malik, Kevin and Mari manage to locate and deliver his documents to Miami in time, or is this the end of the American dream?

In an alternative broken America, where capitalism and political greed have taken center stage, your friend has gone missing. Snatched during a protest, Eduardo Suarez has been seized by the authorities, and now sits ready for processing in the Miami gulag.

70070000021211.name: Darkness and Flame
70070000021211.intro: A story of a young girl involved in the battle between Darkness and Flame.
70070000021211.description: "Darkness and Flame" - enjoy this adventure game with lots of quests and hidden objects, puzzles and mini-games! Its innovative storyline will grab you right from the beginning and you'll be immersed in a world in which fantasy stands alongside the post apocalyptic reality and every living thing encounters the spreading Darkness.

70070000021224.name: My Little Universe: Complete Edition
70070000021224.intro: Go above and beyond the cosmos!
70070000021224.description:
The most complete edition of My Little Universe that includes:
- Base Game with 9 Planets
- Additional Demodium Planet
- 4 additional Character Skins

The universe is vast and filled with adventures, mysteries to solve, and enemies to fight… who knows, you might even meet a few friendly faces along the way. Better yet, invite up to three of your friends to join you in the split-screen local co-op mode because it’s always more exciting with friends!

EXPLORE!
9 mythical worlds and 65+ different dungeons, from mythology-inspired lands to hostile alien worlds await you and your friends. Filled with wonder and plunder, challenges and adversaries, your task is to restore these beautiful worlds to their former glory!

GATHER RESOURCES!
The worlds are filled with rich minerals ready to be harvested by your trusty tools, and mythical artifacts of untapped power guarded by powerful foes. Use more than 70 different gatherable resources to recreate lands long lost to a mysterious threat.

RISE UP TO THE CHALLENGE!
The universe won’t be restored that easily, and each challenge requires the proper tools for the job. Equipped with your trusty pickaxe, sharp sword, and sturdy axe, you’ll be thrown against 150+ different adversaries including mythical creatures, alien horrors, and even demigods!

UPGRADE YOUR GEAR!
With each planet comes new challenges and because of that, you have to stay prepared by upgrading to the newest and freshest tools, which will always keep you one step ahead of your opponents! Improve your weapon, tools, and armor up to 30+ levels!

Just Enjoy The Adventure.
Get entranced by the game’s cozy atmosphere, enjoy the relaxing soundtrack, and fall in love with the simplistic yet charismatic visuals. After all, it’s all about the journey and the friends we make along the way!

70070000021235.name: Hole io & Paper io 2
70070000021235.intro: Here's the ultimate action bundle you've been waiting for! Eat & conquer solo or with friends in multiplayer mode!
70070000021235.description:
Get ready for the thrilling gaming experience and endless hours of entertainment!

Hole io - Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

Paper io 2 - Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world. Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Simple entertainment can be the most addictive!

70070000021239.name: Hentai Golf Special Edition
70070000021239.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000021239.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' winter outfits with Sunset Pines DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000021241.name: Cooking Arena Pizza Yolo
70070000021241.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000021241.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Pizza Bar Tycoon".

70070000021243.name: Capybara, Ducks, Rats and Bananas Bundle
70070000021243.description:
This bundle contains lots of Capybara, Duck, Mouse and Banana!

Get Ducky Quacky + Capybara Madness + Ratyboy Adventures + Revenge of Banana in one bundle with good price!

70070000021245.name: Tangram Collection All In
70070000021245.intro: Tangram Collection offers a fresh spin on a classic tangram game. All In bundle contains base game and 4 DLC-s
70070000021245.description:
The original tangrams first appeared in China. These addictive puzzles had players combining triangular pieces (called tans) to form a simple image. All pieces had to be used and could not overlap. It is the elegance of this format that made tangrams a worldwide sensation!

Tangrams have come a long way since their global debut, with modern variations introduced beyond the original set of 7 puzzles. Tangram Collection furthers that reinvention, offering welcomed variety to players looking for the next step in tangram evolution.

Tangram Collection All In features:
• Tangram Collection Base Game
• Tangram Collection Heart
• Tangram Collection F
• Tangram Collection Other T
• Tangram Collection Egg

Founded in 2020, Error300 Games is a game development studio based in Dublin, Ireland. Avid gamers themselves, they strive to make the games they want to play.

70070000021248.name: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - Season Pass
70070000021248.intro: The JRPG is back with a new host of heroes.
70070000021248.description:
The Season Pass includes the following content: 
- 3x Original Wallpapers by Junko Kawano
- Story Expansion: The Chapter of Seign
- Story Expansion: The Chapter of Marisa
- Story Expansion: The Chapter of Markus
- 1 HQ Makeover Pack (Golden & Pink Headquarters Exterior Paint)

*The Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes base game is NOT included in this product.  
**Please be aware that this set is included in the Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - Digital Deluxe Edition.
***Please be careful not to purchase multiple times accidentally.
****In-game cosmetics and other downloadable content (DLC) will be available for Season Pass owners later in 2024.

About the Game: 

Our story begins in one corner of Allraan, a tapestry of nations with diverse cultures and values. By dint of sword, and by way of magical objects known as “rune-lenses,” the land’s history has been shaped by the alliances and aggressions of the humans, beastmen, elves, and desert people who live there.

The Galdean Empire has edged out other nations and discovered a technology that amplifies the rune-lenses’ magic.

Now, the Empire is scouring the continent for an artifact that will expand their power even further. It is on one such expedition that Seign Kesling, a young and gifted imperial officer, and Nowa, a boy from a remote village, meet each other and become friends.

However, a twist of fate will soon drag them into the fires of war, and force them both to reexamine everything they believe to be right and true.

Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes became the #1 funded Kickstarter video game of 2020 thanks to phenomenal support from the community. 505 Games is truly honored to publish Eiyuden Chronicle and work with Rabbit & Bear to help deliver a memorable gaming experience to fans. The goal of Rabbit & Bear and 505 Games is to make sure Eiyuden Chronicle reaches its true potential and delivers a worthwhile JRPG the community will enjoy.

70070000021254.name: Woodturning 3D: Complete Edition
70070000021254.intro: Carve your way to brilliance! Unleash your inner carpenter and shape incredible wooden sculptures!
70070000021254.description:
Grab a chisel, carve a shape, color it with sprays, and sell your masterpiece to customers! 

As an aspiring carpenter, you must exercise patience and precision, carving out some of the most complex pieces with attention to minute details - much like real-life woodworking.

Features:
- Grab chisels of 3 different shapes and start carving!
- Use tools precisely and carefully because any wrong movement can affect the final appearance 
- Accept customer offers for various sculptures and earn money  
- Decorate your wooden artwork with 15 colorful sprays and 24 stencils!
- Perform special tasks to get cash rewards 
- Put cool skins on your tools to look like a pro 
- Upgrade your studio and give it a new look
- Decide if you want to sell your sculptures or if you want to put them on your collection shelf 
- Conduct auctions of your works and see who bids the highest!

In this engaging universe, every stroke matters. You are not just randomly using your tools. Instead, you work like a sculptor who turns ordinary wood chunks into unique and colorful artwork.

It's less about speed and more about accuracy - a refreshing break from usual arcade fare - making it perfect for casual gamers and those seeking a challenging new venture!

Transform wood into amazing sculptures and master the art of precision!

70070000021260.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Season Pass
70070000021260.intro: Get the Turtles in style with Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed's Season Pass.
70070000021260.description:
The Season Pass includes: 

- 1987 Animated Series Pack
- 2 x Skin Packs
- New Mode

The content of the Season Pass can be bought separately, be aware and avoid redundant purchases.

70070000021264.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000021264.intro: Join the Turtle brothers straight from the sewers and slide into this new adventure of shell-shocking proportions!
70070000021264.description:
Dive into a new adventure of shell-shocking proportions! Fight crime and unravel an epic saga of justice and chaos.

The Deluxe Edition includes:

- 1987 Animated Series Pack
- 2 x Skin Packs
