70070000021267.name: Midnight Drifter-Drift Racing Car Driving Simulator- ULTIMATE EDITION
70070000021267.intro: Unleash the ultimate Midnight Drifter experience and leave your mark on the asphalt!
70070000021267.description: Prepare yourself for an adrenaline-charged racing experience like never before! Our exclusive bundle not only amplifies the thrill with intense action but also maximizes your earnings. Dive into a wealth of opportunities with a diverse selection of cars, extensive tuning options, and realistic physics. Sharpen your drifting skills, accumulate substantial in-game currency, and cement your legacy as a street legend. With the DLC Pack, unleash even more potential by acquiring resources and accessing new avenues for an authentically immersive gaming journey. Secure this game-changing bundle now for the ultimate Midnight Drifter experience – seize this enhanced adventure before it slips away!

70070000021269.name: Sprout Valley Ultimate Edition
70070000021269.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000021269.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Unlock new pack of items with Easter DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000021276.name: Party Party Time 2 + Party Hustle Pack
70070000021276.intro:
It's Party Party Time again!
Everyone join in and Let's Party!
70070000021276.description:
Introducing an all-new party game for everyone to pick up, play, and enjoy!
Share Joy-Con™ for up to 6 players to join the party!

Streamlined, enhanced, and intuitive controls make every play session unlimited and easy fun!
Compete with friends and family and let the fun times roll!

A new set with both Party Party Time 2 and the Party Hustle Pack is now available!
Get ready to party everyone!

70070000021282.name: MEGATON MUSASHI W: WIRED Deluxe Edition
70070000021282.intro:
Customize the parts and weapons of giant robot Rogues
to take back the Earth from alien invaders in this mecha
action RPG.
70070000021282.description:
This product adds the following bonus content to MEGATON MUSASHI: WIRED:
- Limited-edition Rogues: Kurandi Delta & Sir Wilde
- Limited-edition Weapons: Tempest Rider & Shell Holder
- Limited-edition Pilot Attire: Teru (Uniform), Ryugo (Uniform), & Reiji (Uniform)

■ Engage in exciting robot battles while being immersed in a thrilling story!
As Earth faces invasion by an alien force, a number of young people are chosen to pilot giant robots called Rogues to take back their home in this enthralling mecha action RPG.
Customize your Rogue to make it your own, master flashy attacks in the midst of battle, and enjoy an intricate tale full of rich characters.

■ Hack and slash through missions to obtain legendary items!
Eliminate your enemies with invigorating attacks to clear missions! Win battles and obtain parts to upgrade your Rogue! Collect rare items including custom parts, weapons, and power-up materials! Find legendary items to assemble the ultimate mecha!

■ Fight alongside your friends to defeat powerful enemies, or take them on in head-to-head battles!
Up to three players can play cooperatively online or via local wireless play, or can participate in fiery versus battles against other teams of up to three online!

■ Collab mechs join the action!
The classic super robots, Mazinger Z, Getter Robo, Combattler V, and Voltes V join Megaton Musashi in an epic collaboration! Both the mecha and their weapons are ready for battle! Collect all of the parts to assemble your own personalized battle machine!

*Check the official website (https://www.megaton-musashi.jp/wired/en/) for more details.

70070000021290.name: Family Game Mega Pack 14 in 1
70070000021290.description:
Welcome to the ultimate gaming experience for the whole family! Introducing the Family Game Mega Pack 14 in 1 – your one-stop solution for endless fun and excitement. Packed with a diverse assortment of 14 thrilling games, this bundle guarantees something for everyone, ensuring hours of entertainment for players of all ages.

Embark on a journey through various genres and gameplay styles, from pulse-pounding action to mind-bending puzzles and everything in between. Challenge your family and friends to epic battles, test your strategy in tactical showdowns, and unleash your creativity with imaginative adventures.

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the world of interactive entertainment, the Family Game Mega Pack 14 in 1 offers an accessible and engaging experience for all skill levels. With vibrant graphics, immersive soundtracks, and intuitive controls, each game is designed to captivate and delight players from start to finish.

From classic favorites to exciting new releases, this comprehensive collection includes titles that are sure to become instant classics in your gaming library. Gather your loved ones, fire up your gaming device, and get ready for endless hours of laughter, competition, and bonding with the Family Game Mega Pack 14 in 1. Let the fun begin!

70070000021292.name: Across the Obelisk - Starter Set
70070000021292.description:
Get the best possible start to your Across the Obelisk journey with the Starter Set!
This essential bundle brings together the Across the Obelisk base game and the acclaimed expansion Sands of Ulminin accompanied by the hero pack featuring Amelia, the Queen. The new zone introduced by Sands of Ulminin and the additional chilling abilities of Amelia, the Queen slot neatly into your adventure, giving you the most versatile and complete experience right from the start.

Across the Obelisk
Set forth in a co-op roguelite deckbuilder where every choice matters! Craft decks of breathtaking power. Journey alone or with up to three friends. Plot your party’s path to glory and face powerful enemies in deep tactical combat on your quest to save the kingdom of Senenthia in Across the Obelisk!

Sands of Ulminin
Embark on a journey through desert canyons, delve into ancient pyramids, and brave the depths beneath the Sands of Ulminin in an exhilarating new zone, playable as Act 2 or 3. Joining you are two new heroes, Laia and Navalea, offering dynamic dual-class options together with additional unlockable pets. Encounter new enemies and bosses, equip new items and battle your way through the multi-layered dungeon in the pyramids of Ulminin.
In multiplayer, only one player requires Sands of Ulminin to grant access to the new zone for the entire party.

Amelia, the Queen
This Hero Pack brings back the astray Queen of Senenthia to help search for her missing daughter, the princess. 
Amelia, the Queen introduces enchantment cards specializing in cold damage and a new set of vanishing cards. Alongside her faithful companion, Rifty, Amelia adds depth to your quest to unravel the mystery of the Obelisk with the Queen herself at the helm of your party.

70070000021294.name: Sculpt People: Complete Edition
70070000021294.intro: Bring your clay sculptures to life and start an incredible journey where imagination knows no limits!
70070000021294.description:
Mold the head, carve the details and decorate your work with different sprays and accessories!

Take on the exciting challenge of sculpting heads using clay. Follow reference photos to guide your hands and bring your creations to life. Whether it's a famous celebrity or a beloved pet, you'll enjoy the thrill of shaping each masterpiece!

Features:
- use clay to sculpt people's heads
- make sure the result is close enough to the photo!
- uncover 13 VIP figures to sculpt right away!
- customize your every work of art using over 300 accessories and color sprays!
- get top raitings for creativity, accessories and painting from your customers
- sell your works at auction and choose the highest bid!
- choose a box, insert the sculpture and fill it to secure it
- spend 2000 additional coins to upgrade your store or buy accessories even faster!
- express your creativity!

Make your sculptures unique by adding fun accessories and vibrant colors. From stylish hats to funky glasses, let your imagination run wild as you customize each piece to perfection. No two sculptures will ever be the same!

Show off your creations at prestigious auctions and watch as eager bidders compete to own your artwork. Choose the highest bid and see your sculptures find new homes in the hands of collectors who appreciate your talent.

Start your sculpting adventure and let your imagination run wild!

70070000021296.name: DIY Fashion Star: Complete Edition
70070000021296.intro: Refresh your wardrobe with stylish DIY projects and put your clothing design skills to the test!
70070000021296.description:
Got a boring old blouse? Reshape it, style it, decorate it, and make it a trendy new tank top with some clothing design hacks! 

You're about to blow the world away with all of your fabulously stylish DIY fashion design skills to give your followers the ultimate doll makeover. Get creative with super-fun, sweet doll dress-up projects. Use your outfit designer imagination and turn your ordinary clothes into OMG-to-die-for stylish DIY dress-up outfits!

Features:
- Complete awesome DIY fashion design dress-up clothing projects. Turn your boring old clothes into amazing new stylish outfits!
- Redesign new clothes and decorate them with new patches and accessories!
- Cut out patterns, sew on decorations, and add splashes of color onto your fashion designs! Unleash the inner fashionista you've always been destined to be!
- Give your doll a unique look with new stylish hairstyles and a new face-painting option! 
- Manage your very own DIY fashion dreamhouse studio from the comfort of your home and make videos of your dolly creations to gain followers. Become a famous fashion super stylist!
- Take pictures of your doll dressed in your DIY designer outfits and compete in selfie contests with other DIYers!
- Get a stunning, sweet doll makeover to look extra pretty in your DIY clothing!
- Transform your doll's style with 20 new and captivating clothes that will add a touch of sparkle to her look!

Take selfies with your new DIY clothes and compete in selfie contests! Run your own fashion designer channel and post videos of your DIY outfits to gain a huge fan base! 

To all DIY game lovers, unleash your creativity and dive into the world of doll dress-up inspired outfits!

70070000021298.name: Beauties Unveiled 2 Spicy Edition
70070000021298.intro: Beauties Unveiled 2 is a continuation of the mesmerizing journey from Part 1, that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.
70070000021298.description:
Beauties Unveiled 2 is a continuation of the mesmerizing journey from Part 1, that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.

This time, the art style is more manga-inspired, with the quick-paced gameplay you all liked. 

Overcome ticking-clock challenges, be aware of many obstacles and opponents, choose carefully your path, and benefit from different power-ups available during each stage of the game. 
Pay attention to the obstacles that will get in your way – you may have a few chances but be wary as the number of attempts is limited! To snatch the highest score, you will need reflexes, quick decisions, and a bit of luck.

70070000021301.name: nDay Extended Edition
70070000021301.intro: Keep all your important dates and events organized in one place with nDay!
70070000021301.description:
Start your day by planning in order to save time and avoid forgetting anything. Note all important events and appointments, and never miss a meeting again.


YOUR OWN PERSONAL CALENDAR
With nDay, you'll optimize your free time, schedule your day without worrying that something slipped your mind. Choose the year, month, day, exact hour and add a note. How simple is that? Add even more text in your description to remember more details about this date.


CUSTOMIZE AS YOU LIKE
It doesn't matter whether you use a 12 or 24-hour clock. In nDay you can customize it as you prefer. Additionally, you can change the available colors of the entire calendar according to your preferences.

Gain access to a greater variety of calendar colors with Themes Color 3 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Simple and clear interface
- Helps you organize your day
- Customizable

70070000021306.name: Cube Airport + Cube Farmer
70070000021306.intro: Embark on this memorable experience with a great and relaxing soundtrack and a beautiful view that will get you extremely satisfaction

70070000021307.name: Draknek and Friends Puzzle Bundle (2024)
70070000021307.intro: Seven puzzle masterpieces for one low price!
70070000021307.description:
From some of the best puzzle designers in the world comes the Draknek and Friends Puzzle Bundle, a collection of six of the best puzzle games in the last decade. With dozens of hours of fun, this bundle is a must-have for puzzle fans.

Set your belongings on fire on a beautiful voxel art puzzle island in Bonfire Peaks, the debut publishing project from Draknek and Friends.

Explore the museum of Human Englandland in A Monster’s Expedition, the critically beloved open world puzzle game. Players of all skill levels can enjoy hundreds of islands - some right in front of you, others well off the beaten track for true puzzle lovers

In Sokobond Express, combine atoms into molecules along creative and unexpected pathways in this mashup sequel to Sokobond and Cosmic Express. Explore new mechanics and new ways of thinking in this thoughtfully curated and surprisingly deep game created by up-and-coming puzzle designer José Hernández.

Patrick's Parabox is an award-winning puzzle game that explores a unique recursive system of boxes within boxes within boxes within boxes. Learn to manipulate the world's structure by pushing boxes into and out of each other. Wrap your head around what happens when a box contains itself, and learn to use infinity to your advantage. Explore many more mechanics and recursive twists as you delve deeper and deeper into the system. It's boxes all the way down.

In Cosmic Express, create pathways to navigate the galaxy’s most awkward space colony. It's cute, harder than it looks, and guaranteed to give you hours of challenging fun across hundreds of levels. 

In A Good Snowman is Hard to Build, players can continue exploring the world of A Monster’s Expedition while rolling up snowballs to become snowfriends. The easiest and most accessible of the four games, this game is a delight for all ages.

In Sokobond, move atoms to form increasingly complex molecules through over one hundred levels of challenging puzzles in Draknek’s first commercial release.

70070000021325.name: Freaky Trip Legendary Edition
70070000021325.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000021325.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Spring and Summer Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000021326.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Premium Edition
70070000021326.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000021326.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes fifth Personal Boards DLC. 

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000021331.name: Neptunia Game Maker R:Evolution Deluxe Bundle
70070000021331.intro: Build the top game dev studio as Older Nep in this off-beat, spunky action RPG!
70070000021331.description:
Older Neptune needs YOUR help to become the best game studio of Gamindustri! And with the Deluxe Edition, you can get ALL THE TOOLS to take Older Nep to the top!

70070000021332.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the second additional puzzle pack for Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000021338.name: Fun Chess Magnificent Edition
70070000021338.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000021338.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Barbarian, Dwarf and Ghost DLCs.

Key features:

- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000021340.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Magnificent Edition
70070000021340.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000021340.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Autumn and Summer Island DLCs.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000021341.name: Hentai Girls Amazing Edition
70070000021341.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000021341.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Puppy Yui and Foxy Etsuko.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000021342.name: Terra Memoria Deluxe Edition
70070000021342.intro: The Deluxe Edition includes Terra Memoria with its Artbook & OST
70070000021342.description:
A shortage of magic crystals and the sudden awakening of ancient robots leads six new friends on an incredible investigation across Terra – a cozy and fantastic world that combines 3D and pixel art.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Terra Memoria
- Terra Memoria Artbook & OST

Spoiler alert! The Artbook & OST contains some spoilers regarding Terra Memoria's story, browse at your own peril!

Note: The Artbook is only available in English.

70070000021344.name: SOL CRESTA Complete Set
70070000021344.intro: Enjoy EVERYTHING that SOL CRESTA has to offer!
70070000021344.description:
Dock, split, and form up! Pilot 3 fighters and take back the sun from the clutches of evil! Get the SOL CRESTA Complete Set at a great new price that offers the slick and speedy gameplay of the main game's Arcade Mode, the densely woven story of the Dramatic DLC, and the Legendary Fighters DLC that includes the legendary fighters from the CRESTA series.

What you get in the SOL CRESTA Complete Set:
- SOL CRESTA main game
- SOL CRESTA Dramatic DLC
- SOL CRESTA "Legendary Fighters" DLC Set (CR47, Wing Galiber, Wing Galiber II included)
Note: The SOL CRESTA Complete Set consists of the SOL CRESTA main game and all DLC packs that are currently available to purchase, with no exclusive content. Be careful of duplicate purchases. 

PlatinumGames’ NEO-CLASSIC ARCADE series carries on the spirit and fun of classic gaming using modern technology, and the first project in this endeavor is SOL CRESTA. SOL CRESTA takes the docking and formation strategies of classic shooting games Moon Cresta and Terra Cresta and elevates them with the “free-form docking” system. The flagship Yamato, composed of the fighters Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susano can utilize various attacks depending on how the three ships are aligned. Docking, splitting, and reforming the ships as needed is the key to defeating the invading armies of Mega Zofer.

Story
Humanity faced a crushing defeat at the hands of the Mandler Army during their last invasion of the solar system. Losing the moon and being driven from Earth, they were forced to retreat all the way to Laomedeia, the 12th moon of Neptune. With the last of their hope, they formed the solar recovery squad SOL CRESTA, and placed the fate of the solar system with the Yamato, a cutting-edge docking ship.

- Free-Form Docking
The Yamato, standing against the evil of Mega Zofer, is composed of 3 fighters. You’ll scramble with only one fighter at first, but pick up the right item and friendly fighters will appear for a power-up! Dock and split to change your attack properties and use different formations to access an amazing arsenal. 

- Classic 80s-Style Excitement
SOL CRESTA’s music is provided by legendary chiptune composer Yuzo Koshiro, and the game pays homage to the sound and visuals of the earlier Cresta series games, bringing back that arcade fever while taking it beyond mere nostalgia. There’s even a time limit, high score Caravan Mode, and online leaderboards. 

- PlatinumGames' New Challenge
What would happen if PlatinumGames, developers of satisfying and jam-packed action games like Bayonetta, NieR:Automata, and ASTRAL CHAIN tried their hand at shooting? This is the answer. The visuals are classic, but the originality and depth of the systems and gameplay provide a fresh and deep shooting experience that grows each time you play.

Note: The SOL CRESTA Complete Set consists of the main game and all DLC packs. 
The Dramatic DLC adds the Dramatic Mode to the game, which presents a dramatic storyline featuring an array of unique characters. The "Legendary Fighters" DLC adds three additional playable fighters in the form of CR47, Wing Galiber and Wing Galiber II. See the store pages for each DLC for more details, being careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000021356.name: Reigns: Complete Set
70070000021356.description:
This bundle includes the complete set of Reigns games: Reigns: Kings & Queens, Reigns: Game of Thrones, Reigns: Three Kingdoms, and Reigns: Beyond.

Reigns: Kings & Queens
Reigns: Kings & Queens includes both award-winning games Reigns and Reign: Her Majesty. Sit on the throne as a benevolent (or malevolent) monarch of the modern age and swipe your royal decrees to the left or right to impose your will upon the kingdom.

Reigns: Game of Thrones
Reigns: Game of Thrones is the heir to the award-winning HBO® TV series Game of Thrones® and the smash-hit swipe ‘em up series Reigns from Nerial and Devolver Digital. Through the fiery visions of Melisandre, claim the Iron Throne as Cersei Lannister, Jon Snow, Daenerys Targaryen, and more to carefully navigate the complex relationships and hostile factions of the Seven Kingdoms. Employ ruthless tactics to outwit political rivals and wield impervious charm on your fickle bannerman. Maintain the balance and favor of the people to extend your reign and maybe, one day, survive the horrors of the coming winter.

Reigns: Three Kingdoms
Inspired by the beloved Chinese epic "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," this game thrusts players into the turbulent final years of the Han dynasty. Players will encounter the many factions, wars and heroes of the saga as they swipe through to make high-stakes decisions, team up with the right army at the right time, gain power and more.

Discover new ways to enjoy this franchise's unique card-based swiping mechanic as you uncover the many secrets of a vast storyline, deploy strategy in turn-based battles and encounter a host of unexpected mini-games.

Reigns: Beyond
As an intergalactic indie rockband, plot your rise to *star*dom, traveling from planet to planet and gig to gig on your quest for fame and fortune. Play local (and not-so-local) clubs throughout the galaxy, recruiting alien band members along the way, and rock out across the cosmos!  But make sure you're managing your ship's resources and keeping your crew in check while on this stellar tour because one wrong decision may leave you dead in space!

70070000021362.name: Ecchi Paradise: Complete Edition
70070000021362.intro: Meet the most tempting and playful girls in ecchi paradise
70070000021362.description:
Immerse yourself in fantastic anime art and swap puzzles to see alluring girls posing exclusively for you!

Features:
- 80 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Easy and difficult levels
- Sensual music

The spicier the photo, the higher the difficulty level. Try to complete all the puzzles and don't be too hard on yourself if you can't finish fast. Take your time ;)

70070000021364.name: MeowMatch Extended Edition
70070000021364.intro: Merge cats, discover new adorable kittens and reach the highest score possible!
70070000021364.description:
Welcome to MeowMatch – a place full of adorable kitties where each move lets you reveal new lovely cats.


DISCOVER THEM ALL
Each matched pair of the same cat unlocks a new one. To make this task easier, try to remember the order of matching. Those cute fluffy creatures are waiting to be uncovered. Can you find them all?


EACH MOVE MATTERS
The game mechanics are based on the 2048 game, so every move you make might cause you to lose. Look at the board, analyze the current arrangement, try to predict how the elements will behave, and make your move.

Match new cats with the Cat's Theme 3 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Many cute kittens
- 14 colorful backgrounds to choose
- Meow-tastic soundtrack

70070000021371.name: Brain Memory Ultra Legendary
70070000021371.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000021371.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 2 DLC: Cards Pack 3 and Cards Pack 4.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000021372.name: Dentist Bling: Complete Edition
70070000021372.intro:
Ready for the ultimate dental experience?
Dive into the world of tooth care and become a master dentist!
70070000021372.description:
Treat your patients with different dental issues, from cavities to plaque buildup, and watch as their smiles transform under your expert care!

Perform treatments under time pressure, and don't forget about your customer's comfort. If you drill too long in the teeth, the customer will be dissatisfied with your service!

Features:
- perform a lot of different dental procedures 
- decorate customers' teeth with sparkling diamonds or apply a varnish that will change their color
- unlock and apply 15 tooth skins, 11 bling skins, and 11 chair skins
- work under time pressure and do your job the best you can! 
- upgrade the look of your clinic to make it cozier 
- buy an upgrades so your customers can last longer during dental treatment

Pull out decaying teeth and replace them with shiny new ones. Change their shape to fangs or apply braces. Yes doctor, at your salon, your patients LOVE braces!

Don't forget about your special BLING diamond treatment. This is a fancy teeth salon after all! 

Whatever you do, BLING, make them smile!

70070000021373.name: AAA Clock Extreme Definitive
70070000021373.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000021373.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 5 DLCs: the Elegant, Spin, Pixel, Happy and Squid Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000021384.name: One Night: Burlesque Complete Edition
70070000021384.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000021384.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle you can learn about Holly's and Club Crowd's creation story by accessing artbook from game menu. 

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000021385.name: Fit My Cat Ultimate Edition
70070000021385.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000021385.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Get access to new levels with Cat's Puzzle Pack 2 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000021390.name: nGolf Extended Edition
70070000021390.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000021390.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Visit wild west and space with the Moon Swing and Western Fairways DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000021406.name: The Rewinder: Definitive Edition
70070000021406.intro: Communicate with spirits and explore other people's memories to alter the past.
70070000021406.description:
This bundle contains The Rewinder and The Rewinder - Root of Evil.

The Rewinder is a 2D puzzle adventure game inspired by traditional Chinese folklore.

The game uses pixel art to mimic the aesthetics of Chinese ink paintings. Players will get to meet mythological figures such as the Spirit Wardens, the Ox-head and Horse-face Guardians of the Beyond, and the Tudi Gong (Keeper of the Land).

70070000021411.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Special
70070000021411.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000021411.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming piglet and a super-sweet clownfish.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000021415.name: Piano: Learn and Play Ultra Extended
70070000021415.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000021415.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes second and seventh Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000021416.name: Hentai Stars Platinum Edition
70070000021416.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000021416.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Singing Fox Ayame DLC.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000021417.name: Neon On!: Complete Edition
70070000021417.intro: Wanna see something amazing? Like, really electrifying? The ultimate neon puzzle game is here!
70070000021417.description:
Get your neon cables out of knots and connect them to the right light sources to create amazing neon masterpieces!

In Neon On, the colors are the key to each puzzle. Every box needs to be connected to the socket of the same color otherwise it won't work. Some boxes even require combining a couple of hues to create a different color!

Features:
- unlock 6 new boxes, 6 cables and 6 theme skins!
- solve puzzles by matching the colorful light sources to the correct boxes
- grab neon light cables by tips and connect the power 
- combine different hues to create entirely new colors
- connect the cables if the wire is too short, but be careful - the more you move them, the more they can get tangled!
- avoid pulling wires through laser walls - they will cut everything in half
- complete all stages of a level to light up a large animated neon sign!
- collect coins and buy skins for power boxes, cables, and themes

Challenge yourself to complete many levels where you will find various obstacles, from laser gates that can cut your cables to moving light sources or rotating boxes. Besides, be careful while moving the wires because they can easily get tangled, disconnected, and fall to the ground! 

Light up the cities with vibrant neon artworks!

70070000021422.name: nPaint Ultra Special
70070000021422.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000021422.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the first and tenth gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000021423.name: Monster Hunter Stories Collection
70070000021423.intro: Both Monster Hunter Stories games included in one collection!
70070000021423.description:
Both Monster Hunter Stories games included in one collection!

Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series that takes the world of Monster Hunter and expands upon it in new and exciting ways! No longer are you hunting monsters, but raising them! Featuring heroes known as Monster Riders, you will live alongside monsters and form lifelong bonds with them.

Contents:
- Monster Hunter Stories
- Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin (Standard Edition)

Game Introduction:
The first game tells the story of a Rider who confronts a calamity known as the Black Blight that has overtaken the world, all while learning to live together with Hunters. The second game is set four years later, when a new hero unravels the epic story surrounding a legendary Rathalos, one foretold to bring ruin to the world.

Game Features:
■ A turn-based RPG set in the world of Monster Hunter! Monster Hunter Stories features a strategic battle system which is easy to get the hang of, even for those who struggle with action games. Use Power, Speed, and Technical attacks to guess and overcome your opponent's attack patterns to inflict heavy damage and win head-to-head battles! Build up your Kinship Gauge to use skills or try your Monsties' unique Kinship Skills!
■ Turn popular monsters from the series into your Monsties! Explore the field using Monstie abilities, hatch eggs that you find along the way, and turn various monsters into Monsties! This game features many popular monsters from the Monster Hunter series, including Zinogre, Nargacuga, and Lagiacrus. Also featured is the Rite of Channeling, a ritual that awakens dormant abilities in your Monsties, allowing you to raise original Monsties and take on powerful enemies!
■ Online features that allow you to create a powerful party with the Monsties you have raised and enjoy battles with other players!

70070000021424.name: Monster Hunter Stories Deluxe Collection
70070000021424.intro: Both Monster Hunter Stories games included in one deluxe collection!
70070000021424.description:
Both Monster Hunter Stories games included in one deluxe collection!

Monster Hunter Stories is an RPG series that takes the world of Monster Hunter and expands upon it in new and exciting ways! No longer are you hunting monsters, but raising them! Featuring heroes known as Monster Riders, you will live alongside monsters and form lifelong bonds with them.

Contents:
- Monster Hunter Stories
- Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin (Deluxe Edition)

The Deluxe Edition includes the following downloadable content:
- Outfit for Ena: Kuan Coat
- Layered Armor for the Player: Razewing Armor Alpha and Razewing Armor Beta
- Hairstyle for the Player: Spiky Nergal
- Outfits for Navirou: Pukei-Pukei Costume and Nergigante Costume
- Sticker Sets: Adventure Buddies 2 and Adventure Buddies 3

*Some content will become available for use as the game progresses.
*The above downloadable content is the same as the content available in the standalone Deluxe Kit for Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin.

Game Introduction:
The first game tells the story of a Rider who confronts a calamity known as the Black Blight that has overtaken the world, all while learning to live together with Hunters. The second game is set four years later, when a new hero unravels the epic story surrounding a legendary Rathalos, one foretold to bring ruin to the world.

Game Features:
■ A turn-based RPG set in the world of Monster Hunter! Monster Hunter Stories features a strategic battle system which is easy to get the hang of, even for those who struggle with action games. Use Power, Speed, and Technical attacks to guess and overcome your opponent's attack patterns to inflict heavy damage and win head-to-head battles! Build up your Kinship Gauge to use skills or try your Monsties' unique Kinship Skills!
■ Turn popular monsters from the series into your Monsties! Explore the field using Monstie abilities, hatch eggs that you find along the way, and turn various monsters into Monsties! This game features many popular monsters from the Monster Hunter series, including Zinogre, Nargacuga, and Lagiacrus. Also featured is the Rite of Channeling, a ritual that awakens dormant abilities in your Monsties, allowing you to raise original Monsties and take on powerful enemies!
■ Online features that allow you to create a powerful party with the Monsties you have raised and enjoy battles with other players!

70070000021430.name: Slave Zero X Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000021430.intro: Hack and slash your way through a dystopian future to kill a man-made god.
70070000021430.description:
Included in the Digital Deluxe Edition:
• Console Costume Color for Shou
• Soundtrack & Art Gallery Application

From the top of Megacity S1-9, the Sovereign Khan rules with fists of iron and flesh. Beneath the city’s rotting foundations, a vengeful warrior embarks on a journey to murder him. 5 years prior to the events of Slave Zero, Slave Zero X brings new life to a world where horrific, living machines known as Slaves are primed to become the latest tools of war in humanity’s long and bloody history. A secret band of warriors known as The Guardians hope to stop these biomecha from being unleashed upon the world, but one swordsman among their ranks has a different idea: use the enemy’s own weapon against them. By merging with a stolen Slave Unit Prototype, Shou will become a furious Devil in pursuit of killing a false God.

• KILLER COMBOS: Use swift swordplay, explosive ordnance, and stylish combos against an army of meat and metal.

• DEATH FROM ABOVE: Air juggling, dashes, and frequent target switching allow for you to take down foes of any size while wall-jumping and platforming can help you outmaneuver your enemies.

• FIGHT FOR YOUR LIFE: Conquer mini-bosses, set pieces, and climactic 1-on-1 encounters that offer intense challenges against unforgettable villains.

• STRENGTH IS NOTHING WITHOUT CONTROL: Use the Training Room to hone precise and powerful moves to string together devastating attack sequences.

• BATTLE TO THE BEAT: A 90s-inspired soundtrack features heavy Drum’n’Bass and funky industrial music that adds to the thrill of combat.

• FEAST YOUR EYES: A unique visual aesthetic combines nostalgic 2D sprites with an advanced lighting system and stylized 3D environments.

• THE END IS NEVER THE END: After completing the campaign, further challenges await in an expansive and frenetic ‘Crimson Citadel’ procedural challenge tower with an online high score leaderboard.

70070000021445.name: For a Vast Future Director's Cut
70070000021445.intro: Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
70070000021445.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

FAMILIAR GAMEPLAY
Whack every pixelated crook that stands in your way. For a Vast Future uses a classic turn-based formula with some extra twists. Every fight you win makes your allies stronger.

UPGRADE AND CRAFT
Collect powerful weapons and upgrade your characters. Turn them into demolition experts, master marksmen, or the most agile warrior in a room. Choose your way to become unstoppable.

Get access to Colour Palette 10 with this bundle and explore dangerous world in new tints. 

KEY FEATURES:
- Dystopian setting
- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70070000021447.name: Notes + Stickers Legendary Edition
70070000021447.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000021447.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort. 

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 1 and 4 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality

70070000021451.name: Escape Room Super Bundle
70070000021451.intro:
Five escape room adventures for you to puzzle through!
Art Heist, Sotano, Vereda, Alumni and Subnet.
70070000021451.description:
This bundle includes five escape room adventure games:

+ ART HEIST - Escape Room Adventure
+ SOTANO - Escape Room Adventure
+ VEREDA - Escape Room Adventure
+ ALUMNI - Escape Room Adventure
+ SUBNET - Escape Room Adventure

ART HEIST - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
A stormy night, a secluded villa. An artwork has been stolen during a heist. Use your puzzle solving skills to track down the painting

SOTANO - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
You become trapped in a strange house and it's down to you to use your puzzle solving skills to escape before it's too late!

VEREDA - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Play as a secret agent assigned a mission to use your logic and problem solving skills to recover a secret dossier hidden in an unusual town.

ALUMNI - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Play as a scientist transported back in time to memories of college, now trapped in the past use your puzzle solving skills to escape back to the present time.

SUBNET - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Play as an IT expert sent on a mission to track down and stop the hacker group drkFORCE and their underground subway exploit before they escape!

70070000021458.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Extended Edition
70070000021458.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000021458.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #1 (Custom Cruisers #1) with:

This DLC pack introduces an exclusive collection of skins that transforms your buggy into a stunning display of speed and style. Unleash the power of personalized flair with designs that are as unique as your racing strategy. Each skin not only looks incredible, but also symbolizes your commitment to conquering every track.

70070000021459.name: Cooking Arena - 10 in 1 Edition
70070000021459.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000021459.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon", "Food Truck Tycoon - Asian Cuisine", "Burger Chef Tycoon", "Breakfast Bar Tycoon", "Pizza Bar Tycoon", "Pancake Bar Tycoon", "Sushi Time!", "Salad Bar Tycoon" and "Kebab Bar Tycoon".

70070000021469.name: Hentai Golf Premium Edition
70070000021469.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000021469.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with Prairie Greens and River's Edge DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000021471.name: Trash Punk Extended Edition
70070000021471.intro: Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70070000021471.description:
“Trash Punk” is where anarchy reigns, and you’re the opossum punk rocking the apocalypse! This isn’t just a shooter; it's a top-down, adrenaline-pumping riot set in a world gone delightfully mad.

This bundle not only brings you the original chaos of mutated oddities and frantic gameplay but also adds visually refreshing DLC "Winter Rampage".

Armed with everything from gnarly firearms to wicked melee weapons, get ready to bash and blast through hordes of mutated oddities. Melee isn't just for show – smash your way to ammo as you carve a path through chaos. At every twisted turn, make tough calls: grab a new weapon, an upgrade, or some much-needed healing.

The game’s world is a wild mashup of punk rock rebellion and post-apocalyptic mayhem, where every rampage is a unique blend of chaos, with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two runs are alike. With a soundtrack dominated by heavy riffs, each level is a mosh pit of danger and excitement.

Team up in the co-op mode as the iconic opossum punk or the fearless female skunk, each bringing their own punk flair to the fight. Together, you can tackle the chaos, doubling the firepower and strategy against the mutated menaces, making every playthrough like your favorite punk track – familiar yet fresh, and always exciting.

Grab your weapons and start the rebellion. How far can you go?

70070000021476.name: Kebab Bar Tycoon Extended Edition
70070000021476.intro: Sizzle Your Way to Kebab Royalty!
70070000021476.description:
Embrace the sizzle of the grill as your new symphony in "Kebab Bar Tycoon". With 60 diverse levels serving as your playground, you'll orchestrate a ballet of skewers, veggies, and spices, crafting the perfect kebab. 

Enjoy the enhanced graphics and animations that bring your culinary conquests to life.

Treat your virtual customers with wide selection of exotic dishes that go far beyond the classic kebab. Ready to embark on a flavor-filled journey?

In Kebab Bar Tycoon you'll find:

- 60 levels filled with culinary challenges
- 150+ combination of delightful dishes 
- Countless upgrades to bar and decorations
- 25+ achievements to complete
- Easy to play, hard to master

Unlock the secrets of spices and secure your legacy as a kebab tycoon!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #1 (Grill Master) with:

• 15 new levels

70070000021480.name: Infantry Attack: Complete Edition
70070000021480.intro:
Soldier! War is coming, and duty calls you! 
Enemies are invading our country, and we need YOU to defend it!
70070000021480.description:
Enemy troops, such as infantry, helicopters, tanks, warplanes, and drones, are coming for you! Jump on the machine gun and shoot them all!

Features:
- Unlock 2 new powerful weapons and 2 new drones! 
- Get 190 gold bars to spend on unique weapons or boosters
- Use additional 22500 cash on weapon and troops upgrades
- Defend the country against enemy soldiers
- Fight along your military crew and defeat the opponent's army on multiple warzones
- Upgrade your loadout to win the war
- Use modern war weapons: machine guns, rocket launchers and drones
- Fight and kill bosses!
- Easy controls and realistic graphics for intense action

You're not doing war alone. Your squad is here to help you: 
- Explosive Expert with an RPG rocket launcher to deal tremendous damage to military vehicles
- Rifleman who will shoot at a high range on the open battlefield
- Grenadier who specializes in fighting all ground units. 
You are in charge of the machine gun to clear the battlefield, which is highly addictive and enjoyable!

Missions will take place in different warzones, and you will need to adapt your shooting strategy depending on the battlefield: city, desert, jungle, forest, airport, and many more! Be on the frontline of the battleground or take to the air to shoot enemies from the helicopter!

Beware! Combat will be challenging, and enemies will become stronger over time, so upgrading your guns won't be enough. Level up teammates and prepare your military crew for shooting waves of soldiers!

Do you have what it takes to free your country from invaders and win the war?

70070000021493.name: Party Games
70070000021493.description:
Introducing the "Party Games" bundle - the ultimate collection for unforgettable moments with family and friends! Gather around for head-to-head trivia showdowns with Fastest on the Buzzer, test your luck with classic Bingo, or experience the adrenaline rush of Horse Racing. Get ready to laugh, compete, and make lasting memories together!

Fastest on the Buzzer

Fastest on the Buzzer is a fast-paced multiplayer trivia game where you challenge other players using your smartphone or tablet. Race to hit the buzzer before your opponents and answer questions to earn points. But beware - a wrong answer could cost you points and give your rivals a chance to steal the lead. Think fast and play smart to come out on top!

Bingo

Step into the immersive world of Bingo! Join friends or take on AI opponents in a modern take on this classic game, all from the convenience of your smartphone or tablet. Keep your eyes peeled and your fingers ready as the numbers are called out. Will you be the first to complete your card and shout "Bingo!"? Enjoy the thrill of the chase as you aim for victory in this timeless game of luck and strategy.

Horse Racing

Welcome to the electrifying world of Horse Racing, where two players compete to reach 1000 coins first. Place your bets on the horses you believe will win, then watch the race unfold in real-time excitement. With each win, your bet triples, but be cautious - running out of coins means game over. Are you prepared for the exhilarating race to the finish line? Saddle up, place your bets, and may the best jockey emerge victorious!

70070000021494.name: Fight Club
70070000021494.description:
Introducing the heart-pounding "Fight Club" bundle, featuring three exhilarating fighting games: Boxer, Fight, and Teddy Gangs. Prepare to dive into the world of intense combat like never before!

**Boxer**

Step into the ring in Boxer, an arcade-style, pick-up-and-play first-person boxing experience. Take on three gruelling rounds against one of seven formidable AI rival boxers, striving to avoid being knocked out. Hone your skills in the training gym, equipped with a punching bag and a dummy. Rise to the challenge, defeat your opponents, and cement your legacy as the ultimate boxing champion!

**Fight**

Get ready to enter the fray in Fight! After receiving an anonymous message revealing the location of hidden treasure within the ancient ruins of Saqqar, fighters embark on a quest driven by greed. Little do they know, sinister forces lurk within, led by the notorious Dragon, intent on siphoning the life force of unsuspecting combatants. Fight offers thrilling one-on-one battles with a diverse array of fighters and captivating scenes, ensuring each encounter is unique and adrenaline-fuelled.

**Teddy Gangs**

Prepare to unleash mayhem in Teddy Gangs! The once-beloved toy factory producing the world's finest teddy bears has descended into chaos. Evil teddies have escaped and are poised to conquer the world. As the last line of defence, you must confront hordes of malevolent teddy bears in fast-paced, action-packed combat. Brace yourself for a non-stop battle against these fluffy fiends, as Teddy Gangs proves that this showdown is anything but cuddly.

70070000021496.name: Geometric Sniper Bundle
70070000021496.intro: Put an end to evil... and evildoers!
70070000021496.description:
At trying times, the world needs heroes - and even though sometimes it's hard to tell what's black or white, what's important is that you're fighting for a good cause, like... getting rid of evil-shaped baddies and zombies.

Set your sights on evil and face all sorts of bad guys with the Geometric Sniper Bundle, consisting of...
- Geometric Sniper
- Geometric Sniper - Blood in Paris
- Geometric Sniper Z

70070000021500.name: Sherlock Purr 2 Extended Edition
70070000021500.intro: Get ready for a fur-tastic sequel with Sherlock Purr 2!
70070000021500.description:
Our clever cat detective is back, and this time, the mystery unfolds throughout the entire flat. Dive into an extended adventure filled with captivating challenges, vibrant colours, and puzzles that tickle the brain. 
Sherlock Purr 2 is an enchanting children's game, tailor-made for young explorers who adore cats and crave delightful mysteries. Join our whiskered hero, explore every nook and cranny, and embark on a meow-velous journey where every corner holds a delightful surprise. 

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Mystery Pack I" !

70070000021502.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Ultimate Edition
70070000021502.intro: Tasty burgers? We've got you covered!
70070000021502.description:
Like going in to town for a bite to eat? Everybody does! 

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side? 
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, french fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats! 

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up! 

Upgrade your restaurant and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger joint in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat
* 60 awesome levels to complete
* Countless dishes to master and serve
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Multiplayer Mode with:

• 40 new levels,
• 12 new achievements
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 
• endless gameplay mode

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000021506.name: Sticky Business Complete Bundle
70070000021506.intro: Create, pack and sell your own unique sticker creations!
70070000021506.description:
Sticky Business Features
- Get creative and build the cutest stickers out of thousands of possible combinations!
- Optimize your sticker production by building the perfect sticker sheets and make as much use of your resources as possible!
- Pack orders for your customers and hear about their lives!
- Buy upgrades to get more sticker graphics and effect foils to make your shop even more exciting!
- Add goodies and custom packaging to your orders to make your customers even more happy!

Sticky Business: Plan With Me Features
- More than 100 new sticker elements like habit trackers, days of the week, sticky notes, frames, washi tape, and more...
- Additional glitter effects for your stickers
- More candies and goodies to surprise your customers with
- Plus 10 additional customer stories all about planning, writing and new beginnings

70070000021517.name: Freaky Trip Platinum Edition
70070000021517.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000021517.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Spring and Fall Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000021518.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Definitive Edition
70070000021518.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000021518.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes sixth Personal Boards DLC. 

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000021527.name: Hentai Girls Magnificent Edition
70070000021527.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000021527.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Puppy Yui, Foxy Etsuko and Kitty Shirayuki.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000021552.name: Sprout Valley Extended Edition
70070000021552.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000021552.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Unlock new packs of items with Lovely and Easter DLCs.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000021560.name: Fun Chess Complete +
70070000021560.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000021560.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Barbarian, Fairy, Elf, Dwarf and Ghost DLCs.

Key features:

- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000021562.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Superb Edition
70070000021562.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000021562.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Autumn and Mixx Island Remix Vol. 2 DLCs.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000021564.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash Definitive Edition
70070000021564.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000021564.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently. 


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Kung's and Tary's Challenge DLCs added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios

70070000021569.name: One Night: Burlesque Legendary Edition
70070000021569.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000021569.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle you can learn about Liz's and Club Suspects' creation story by accessing artbook from game menu. 

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000021576.name: Hentai Stars Director's Cut
70070000021576.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000021576.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Lonely Kitty Ran DLC.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000021582.name: Beauties Unveiled Hot Edition
70070000021582.intro: Beauties Unveiled takes you on a mesmerizing journey that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.
70070000021582.description:
Beauties Unveiled takes you on a mesmerizing journey that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.
As you navigate the game landscape, strategically deploy power-ups, and overcome ticking-clock challenges, you unlock the beautiful art that can be viewed in a special gallery. 
Expose the covered areas of the pictures and, eventually, reveal the whole picture. 
Be aware of many obstacles and opponents, choose carefully your path, and benefit from different power-ups available during each stage of the game. 
Pay attention to the obstacles that will get in your way – you may have a few chances but be wary as the number of attempts is limited! 
To snatch the highest score, you will need reflex, quick decisions and a bit of luck.

70070000021587.name: Drift Legacy Deluxe Edition
70070000021587.intro: Epic Drifts, Legendary Roads: Your Journey Begins Now!
70070000021587.description:
Experience the ultimate drifting thrill with Drift Legacy! 
Choose and customize your dream car, from its performance to its appearance, making it truly yours. Tackle a variety of routes, from the industrial atmosphere of bustling docks to high-speed racetracks. With intuitive controls, stunning visuals, and the freedom to modify your ride, the game invites you to carve your path to victory.

Are you ready to leave your mark on the racing world?

★ THE LEGACY BEGINS ON THE TRACK ★

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Cars" !

70070000021588.name: Bowling Fever Extended Edition
70070000021588.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000021588.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!
