Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #2 with:
-10 new bowling ball styles

70070000021593.name: Breakfast Bar Tycoon Ultimate Edition
70070000021593.intro:
It's almost time for breakfast!
Go and prove that your breakfast bar deserves its fame!
70070000021593.description:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen? 

In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task! 

You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.

Take orders, prepare dishes and fight for tips! 

Invest your earnings into upgrading your restaurant and become a breakfast magnate!

Bon appetite!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2, Endless Mode and Multiplayer Mode with:

• 90 new levels to explore
• 16 new Achievements to complete
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 
• endless gameplay mode


NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000021607.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Ultimate Edition
70070000021607.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000021608.name: The Quintessential Quintuplets Double Pack
70070000021608.intro: Vacation with the Nakano quintuplets in this Double Pack!
70070000021608.description:
The Quintessential Quintuplets is now a game! 
Play as Futaro Uesugi and enjoy special moments with the Nakano quintuplets. 

The Double Pack includes 
・The Quintessential Quintuplets - Memories of a Quintessential Summer
・The Quintessential Quintuplets - Five Memories Spent With You

◇About The Quintessential Quintuplets - Memories of a Quintessential Summer◇
It's summer vacation! Futaro (VA: Yoshitsugu Matsuoka) and his younger sister Raiha (VA: Natsumi Takamori) have been invited to the quintuplets' private island.
But a sudden storm turns what was supposed to be a three-day, two-night vacation into two weeks of survival!
What fate awaits in this edge-of-your-seat island adventure with the quintuplets?

◇About The Quintessential Quintuplets - Five Memories Spent With You◇
Play as Futaro Uesugi and experience a graduation trip six months after his confession at the school festival.
The prologue of the game is set on the night after the school festival. The player is left to decide to whom they will confess their feelings. 
From that point onward, the game's original story will unfold!

70070000021616.name: Hentai World Amazing Edition
70070000021616.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose, and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000021616.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet students Sayuri, Chiyo and Rose in her new kitty look.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 art pieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000021625.name: WRC Generations – Upgrade to Fully Loaded Edition
70070000021625.intro: This upgrade bundle gives you access to all DLC available for the game.
70070000021625.description:
The Upgrade to Fully Loaded Edition bundle gives you access to all DLC available for WRC Generations.

- Peugeot 206 WRC 2002 DLC
- Citroen C4 WRC 2010 DLC
- Career Starter Pack DLC
- Porsche 911 GT3RS RGT Extra liveries DLC
- Livery Editor Extra Items DLC

70070000021630.name: The House of Da Vinci Complete Bundle
70070000021630.intro: Save money and purchase the whole The House of Da Vinci 3D adventure trilogy.
70070000021630.description:
Become Giacomo and join Leonardo da Vinci, the master of both art and science, as his friend and apprentice. Explore more of the Renaissance world full of puzzles, discover secret messages, and reveal mechanical wonders. Unravel conspiracies involving the most powerful people in Italy – and travel not only through space but time as well. Meet friends and rivals both old and new. Become the focus of a plan that might change history forever.

With sharp wits and an open mind, you will prevail.

70070000021640.name: Slayers X: Vengance of the Slayer & Hypnospace Outlaw
70070000021640.description:
Experience '90s internet simulator and puzzle phenomenon Hypnospace Outlaw, alongside Hypnospace favourite Zane Lofton's Psyko shooter Slayers X: Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer!

Hypnospace Outlaw is a '90s internet simulator in which you scour Hypnospace's wide variety of weird and wonderful websites to hunt down wrongdoers, while also keeping an eye on your inbox, avoiding viruses and adware, and downloading a plethora of apps that may or may not be useful.

.. welcome to.... THE STEEL SEWER. The biggest motherflippin secret base in the galaxy.
THE X SLAYER PACT:
We are X Slayers
It is we who fight The Psyko Sindikate.
We pledge to defend the people of earth even though they're beep-holes to us and don't even deserve it.

70070000021659.name: Piano: Learn and Play Ultra Special
70070000021659.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000021659.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes third and fourth Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000021660.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Premium
70070000021660.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000021660.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming piglet and a super-sweet hamster.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000021661.name: Fit My Cat Extended Edition
70070000021661.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000021661.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Get access to new levels with Cat's Puzzle Pack 3 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000021671.name: Train Traffic Manager Deluxe Edition
70070000021671.intro: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!
70070000021671.description:
Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.

Take on over 80 levels across diverse environments that range from sunny desertscapes to mysterious midnight scenes. It's more fun than a cactus in your caboose!

Each environment has its own unique challenges. Deserts have meteor showers (because of course they do), forests have fallen trees (what's a forest without a little lumber?), winters bring the freeze to your switches, and at midnight, well, you'll just have to see.

And if the chaos of normal mode gets too much, take a breather in endless mode. No objectives, just you, the tracks, and an infinite number of trains. It's the zen garden of train management!

Ready to dive into the madness? Take control of the tracks and show that chaos who's boss in Train Traffic Manager.

And remember: don't fall asleep at your post!

This bundle includes base game and DLC #2 (Classic Tracks Reimagined).
This remix DLC revitalizes 10 of the best campaign levels, transformed and remixed for an even more engaging challenge. Test your skills anew and see familiar routes in a whole new light!

70070000021674.name: Moonstone Island: Decorator's Pass
70070000021674.description:
A perfect pairing for your time on Moonstone Island, The Decorator's Pass! This bundle contains ALL past DLC and all future DLC for 2024, which means you'll get a horde of decorations and house skins for your Moonstone Island home!

Included is:
Decor Galore DLC
Eerie Items DLC
Cozy Comforts DLC
Designed for Lovers DLC
Arcane Artifacts DLC
Summer DLC Pack
Autumn DLC Pack

70070000021680.name: nPaint Ultra Premium
70070000021680.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000021680.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the second and third gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000021681.name: DLC set 3 Nadanan Sports Academy Pack
70070000021681.description:
【Contents】
- Playable Character in Free Mode “Mizuho Himekawa.”
- Playable Character in Free Mode “Kaede Oikawa.”

70070000021682.name: For a Vast Future GOTY Edition
70070000021682.intro: Experience a dystopian future and bring down the government, evil cults, and even more villains standing in your way.
70070000021682.description:
Sink into a classic RPG, and wait for your turn to STOP Doomsday from happening!

The people of Seralia experienced a devastating war. While most of them fight over scraps, the corrupted government schemes to take revenge using a secret weapon – secret and deadly. Join a group of heroic outlaws and stop this madness.

FAMILIAR GAMEPLAY
Whack every pixelated crook that stands in your way. For a Vast Future uses a classic turn-based formula with some extra twists. Every fight you win makes your allies stronger.

UPGRADE AND CRAFT
Collect powerful weapons and upgrade your characters. Turn them into demolition experts, master marksmen, or the most agile warrior in a room. Choose your way to become unstoppable.

Get access to all 10 Colour Palette DLCs with this bundle and explore dangerous world in new tints. 

KEY FEATURES:
- Dystopian setting
- Turn-Based Combat
- Multiple customization options
- A practical crafting system
- Single-player experience

70070000021684.name: Drawing Carnival: Horror Edition
70070000021684.intro: Unleash your inner artist and create gorgeous paintings made in different art styles!
70070000021684.description:
Grab your neon markers, spray paints, stick-on diamonds or glitter powder and use them to create amazing masterpieces! 

Divide your favorite portrait or any painting into four parts. Choose what you're going to paint with, decide which colors you're going to use, create a perfect image and put the painting in a frame to sell it!

Features:
- try new horror style to create spooky paintings of skeletons, monsters, and animals!
- use new bone marker!
- spend additional 1000 money for exhibition upgrades 
- paint in 5 various ways using different tools ranging from sprays to neon markers!
- complete many pictures with characters, food and animals
- choose the style in which you want to paint part of the picture
- choose colors from a large color palette
- when you are done painting, choose a frame to put your drawing in
- lead the sale of your works and earn money
- instead of using regular looking tools, put skins on them and make them look cooler!
- upgrade the look of your exhibition by buying new floors, walls and decorations
- paint your doodles, relax and have fun!

Paint the traditional way with markers or go crazy! Color by numbers by sticking glowing diamonds, apply glue to the picture and color it by sprinkling glitter, or apply stencils and use spray for unique effects!

Fill empty walls in the exhibition by hanging your art and see how people gather around your painting to buy it. Choose the best deal and make as much money as possible to decorate your exhibition. Change the look of the walls or floors and purchase new decorations to make this place as beautiful as your works!

Join the Drawing Carnival and let your doodle creativity run wild!

70070000021685.name: Multi Maze 3D: Complete Edition
70070000021685.intro: Get ready for the ultimate ball collecting experience that will keep you hooked for hours!
70070000021685.description:
Spin the wheel to the right or left and guide the balls through the maze straight into the cup!

Wait, there's more! This isn't just about collecting balls; it's about multiplying them and filling the cup to the brim. Prepare to be amazed, perform impressive manoeuvres, bouncing and collecting balls in a colourful frenzy!

Features: 
- Use 30 additional boosters! 
- Unlock 3 sweet skins instantly!
- Turn the wheel to move your colorful balls around 
- Guide your balls through the multiplier gates to increase their number!
- Lead them out of the maze straight into the cup! 
- Collect a minimum number of them to complete the level! 
- Change the skins of your colourful balls! 
- Spend blue gems to buy booster packs or to continue the level if you run out of balls!
- Listen to the cheerful and relaxing music that sets the mood of the game

Remember that you can always use boosters to duplicate your balls, remove unwanted gates or add new ones multiplying your balls times 2! 

Can you handle the challenge of collecting as many balls as possible? Get ready for a thrilling journey through the maze of fun!

Spin the wheel maze and let the adventure begin!

70070000021688.name: Brain Memory 2 Deluxe Edition
70070000021688.intro: Enhance your memory every day and become a master!
70070000021688.description:
Brain Memory 2 is based on simple memory game principles. It effectively helps improve focus and memory for everyone.


ADORABLE ILLUSTRATIONS
Thanks to colorful pictures, it’s easier to remember where each card is located. However, be cautious as some cards may differ in the held object or the pose the character assumes. Pay attention to the smallest details as it is key to success.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
To train effectively, the player can choose their preferred difficulty level and customize the appearance of the card covers. This allows the mind to focus on the appropriate number of cards and colors on the board.

Get new look of cards with Covers Pack DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 18 levels of difficulty
- Colorful illustrations on cards
- 10 colors of covers
- Relaxing music

70070000021693.name: Notes + Stickers Platinum Edition
70070000021693.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000021693.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort. 

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 1 and 5 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality

70070000021702.name: Hentai Golf Definitive Edition
70070000021702.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000021702.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with Prairie Greens and Lakeside Fairways DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000021704.name: CATAN® - Console Edition: The Complete Collection
70070000021704.description:
Gather your friends and family together for CATAN: Complete Collection! This definitive edition includes the core game of CATAN, the strategic depth of The Helpers expansion, and the captivating complexity of Cities & Knights. Whether you're a seasoned player or just landed on the shores of Catan, this comprehensive collection guarantees endless hours of thrilling competition, cunning negotiations, and strategic conquest. Elevate your tabletop adventures to new heights and forge your path to victory with the Complete Collection of CATAN.

CATAN - Console Edition
Acquire resources, master new strategies, and build your settlements across a board to make your game come to life. Challenge your family and friends in your living room, on the move, or play against smart and dynamic AI to become to hone your skills, then take them online with full cross-play compatibility! 

The Helpers
Call on the skills and services of CATAN’s most influential inhabitants. The first official expansion to CATAN - Console Edition, The Helpers adds an extra layer of strategy to the core game by introducing new rules with twelve new characters boasting unique abilities.

Cities & Knights
Your success on Catan has brought prosperity and wealth—along with unwanted attention. A merciless barbarian horde can smell your overflowing coffers and is descending on Catan’s shores. Can you still come out on top with this threat looming over the island? Will your knights be strong enough to stem the tide alone, or can you put aside your differences with other cities in the greater defense of Catan? Every decision counts, and the clock is ticking.

70070000021731.name: Beauties Unveiled 2 Fever Edition
70070000021731.intro: Beauties Unveiled 2 is a continuation of the mesmerizing journey from Part 1, that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.
70070000021731.description:
Beauties Unveiled 2 is a continuation of the mesmerizing journey from Part 1, that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.

This time, the art style is more manga-inspired, with the quick-paced gameplay you all liked. 

Overcome ticking-clock challenges, be aware of many obstacles and opponents, choose carefully your path, and benefit from different power-ups available during each stage of the game. 
Pay attention to the obstacles that will get in your way – you may have a few chances but be wary as the number of attempts is limited! To snatch the highest score, you will need reflexes, quick decisions, and a bit of luck.

70070000021734.name: Sherlock Purr Extended Edition
70070000021734.intro: Join Sherlock Purr on a purrfect adventure!
70070000021734.description:
Sherlock Purr is a fun and engaging children's game where players help the feline detective search for hidden objects in an apartment. With colorful graphics, entertaining animations, and brain-teasing puzzles, this game is perfect for young minds who love mysteries and cats. Follow Sherlock Purr's pawprints and solve the mystery today!

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Mystery Pack" !

70070000021738.name: Urban Flow Street Symphony
70070000021738.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000021738.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colourful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!
Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plough through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game and Streets Supplement #2 with:

- 5 new vehicles to the streets of Urban Flow, each one unique and with its own style.

70070000021740.name: Arcade Fusion Bundle
70070000021740.intro: A blast from the past with "XPOSED SWITCHED," where you'll draw rectangles to reveal hidden landscapes and beat tough levels.
70070000021740.description:
Then, dive into the adventure of "The Crystals of Atlantis. 

XPOSED SWITCHED

Draw rectangles to uncover the background area. Expose enough to complete the level. 
Uncover unique backgrounds and hit the highest score while mastering your skills.
Simple controls, demanding levels, but a rewarding experience.

Features: 
-3 types of terrain - be careful where you go! 
-4 different powerups are randomly available during the play.
-8 types of enemies will stand in your way to victory.
-48 levels waiting to be uncovered. 

This game is not easy. You've been warned!

THE CRYSTALS OF THE ATLANTIS

A story-based puzzle game, where players take on the role of an intrepid archaeologist working to solve the mystery of Atlantis.

Game modes:
• Adventure mode - travel around the world, and take part in the excavation of ancient treasures leading you ever closer to solving the mystery of Atlantis.
• Classic mode - enjoy a quick match-3 game in the location of your choice and at a difficulty level that suits you.

Features:
• 4 unique locations Egypt, Inca Temple in South America, and more!
• 70 different levels.
• 4 power-ups (e.g., Bomb, TNT, Thunder) and a special Super Power.
• Various unique level types e.g., collecting the pieces of an item, or revealing the hidden map.

70070000021741.name: Vera Blanc Supernatural Mysteries
70070000021741.intro: ~ Vera Blanc: Full Moon + Ghost In The Castle ~
70070000021741.description:
Vera Blanc: Full Moon:

Vera Blanc is a mystery / detective game. Take on the role of Vera Blanc, a young and beautiful woman with an extraordinary power: the ability to read other people's minds! The game plays like a visual novel / adventure game with two endings for the mystery and a collection of challenging minigames.
In this episode, our heroine travels to a mysterious town in Germany deep in the Black Forest.
A serial killer is on the loose, and all leads point to a werewolf as the culprit!
Features:
* Visual novel with multiple endings
* Solve a mystery
* Variety of minigames
* You can play with or without minigames
* Comic book inspired art style


Vera Blanc: Ghost In The Castle:

Vera Blanc is a mystery / detective game. Take on the role of Vera Blanc, a young woman with the ability to read other people's minds. The game is a mixture of visual novel and adventure game with a collection of challenging minigames, you can also play as a pure visual novel. In this episode, our heroine travels to a small village in central Italy. 
The town's legendary ghost seems like nothing more than a quaint story, but a string of murders and suicides all point to the castle's ghost, and locals are getting scared.
Will you be able to solve the mystery? 
Features
* Visual novel with multiple endings
* Solve a mystery
* Variety of minigames (you can also play without them)
* Comic book inspired art style

70070000021742.name: Adventure Horror Bundle
70070000021742.intro: ~ My Big Sister + Just Ignore Them + Red Bow ~
70070000021742.description:
My Big Sister:

Meet Luzia, a sarcastic twelve-year-old with a playful sense of humor. If you believe what she says, My Big Sister is an RPG-like adventure game that is not about her but about her sister Sombria.

My Big Sister is a game about Luzia and Sombria, two sisters who are trying to get back home after being kidnapped by strangers and Luzia takes it upon herself to ensure they both make it home.

Across the game’s multiple chapters and played from a top-down perspective, in My Big Sister, players can expect to clear puzzles and find specific items should they wish to advance through the game’s story, but be sure to take your time. With plenty of secrets and multiple endings, you’ll have your work cut out for you to make sure you get the ending Luzia and Sombria deserve.


Features: 
Unique chapter based story
Adventure style gameplay
Top-down pixel artwork
Original Soundtrack


Just Ignore Them:

Growing up we all knew that one kid who was absolutely terrified of the dark and convinced that there were monsters hiding beneath his bed, but what if it were true?

Just Ignore Them is a Point and Click game that revolves around boy named Mark, who is locked in a never ending chase to escape the monsters that pursue him.

After his father’s disappearance, the monsters started to appear, but one night can feel like a lifetime of pain, suffering and horror to a child... and fast forward to the present, Mark is now an adult, haunted by a troubling past. 

Written more like a movie, as opposed to a videogame, in this 8-bit psychological horror, Mark’s actions can wreak devastating consequences in the future and affect the ending to his story, so choose wisely, Mark’s fate depends on it.


Features: 
Unique chapter based story
Point and Click gameplay with an adventure element to it
Top-down pixel artwork
Original Soundtrack


Red Bow:

Red Bow is a top-down, creepy adventure game that sets players in the role of Roh, a young girl who gets trapped in a bizarre nightmare filled with creepy monsters! 

Roh finds herself trapped in a strange dark nightmare world. Help her realize what role she plays by exploring creepy environments. 

Solve puzzles and find hidden secrets on your adventure. The items you find along the way will decide on which ending you get! 


Features:

Decide people’s fates in the world of the void
Explore your environment to solve puzzles
Meet creepy eerie monsters
Multiple endings


This game depicts scenes of death and suicide and is not recommended for a younger audience or those who are sensitive of the topic.

70070000021743.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000021743.description:
Includes the full The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak game and the following DLC:
- Bonus Set
- Costume Set
- Voice Set

70070000021744.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Ultimate Edition
70070000021744.description:
Includes the full The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak game and the following DLC:
- Bonus Set
- Costume Set
- Voice Set
- Accessories Set
- Starter Set
- Advanced Set

70070000021765.name: Miriam’s Complete Cosmetic Bundle
70070000021765.description:
Miriam’s Complete Cosmetic Bundle contains all three premium DLC cosmetic packs designed to give Miriam unique looks in the game. Fight demons in style with these stylish new looks!  

The bundle includes the Succubus, Magical Girl and Japanesque cosmetic packs.  

Each cosmetic set includes multiple unique items that can be equipped as a set or individually. When all of the items for a set are equipped, the character’s HUD updates with a unique appearance.  

The individual pieces each have their own stats and can be upgraded by crafting. 

Succubus Cosmetic Set 
*  Scythe (WEAPON)
*  Vampiric Wig (HEAD)
*  Vampiric Skinsuit (BODY)
*  Vampiric Wings (ACCESSORY)
*  Vampiric Choker (SCARF)
* Dream Steal (SHARD) 

Magical Girl Cosmetic Set 
* Miri Scepter (WEAPON)
* Miri Wig (HEAD)
* Miri Dress (BODY)
* Communicator (ACCESSORY)
* Summon Bu-chan (SHARD)
* Familiar: Bu-chan (FAMILIAR)

Japanesque Cosmetic Set 
* Japanesque Umbrella (WEAPON)
* Japanesque Wig (HEAD)
* Japanesque Robe (BODY)
* Sarashi (ACCESSORY)
* Usagi Mask (ACCESSORY)
* Sakura Storm (SHARD)

70070000021769.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.3
70070000021769.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the third additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000021770.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? - Trivia Bundle
70070000021770.description:
The Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Trivia Bundle gives you access to brand new Content Packs, featuring over 2,000 new questions on a variety of interesting topics.!

So, is that your final answer?

70070000021772.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? - Movies Bundle
70070000021772.description:
This bundle contains:
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - Hitchcock DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 70s DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 80s DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 90s DLC Pack

70070000021823.name: Ace Attorney Anthology
70070000021823.intro: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy & Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy!
70070000021823.description:
Take that! All six mainline entries in the legendary Ace Attorney series are now available together in one special bundle. Go head to head with prolific prosecutors in the heated courtroom battles of Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy.

This set includes lawyer and protagonist Phoenix Wright’s adventures across all fourteen episodes in the series’ first three genre-defining games, a new narrative of legal trials and tribulations featuring rookie lawyer Apollo Justice across fourteen further episodes, plus an added bonus of two Special Episodes previously released as paid DLC.

Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy also comes with a comprehensive Art Library, an Orchestra Hall with more than 175 music tracks, and an Animation Studio feature, making it the most content-rich Ace Attorney collection to date.

Use your deductive reasoning and intuition to expose contradictions and reveal the truth.

Ace Attorney Anthology includes:

Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Justice for All
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Trials and Tribulations
Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies
Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Spirit of Justice

*Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy is identical to the trilogy of Ace Attorney games released in 2019.

-------------
Voice Languages: 
Japanese, English, French, German, Mandarin Chinese, Korean

Text Languages:
Japanese, English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

Some of the contents of the games in this collection are presented as initially released to preserve the games as originally created.

70070000021836.name: nZen Deluxe Edition
70070000021836.intro: Find your inner peace by relaxing with nZen.
70070000021836.description:
nZen will help you on your journey to finding yourself and understanding the world around you. Begin your contemplation, clear your mind, and let nZen guide you through the unexplored areas of your mind.


IDENTIFY YOUR GOAL
Select one of the available inspirational programs prepared for various occasions. During each of them, you will be able to focus on a voice that will help you achieve your goal. Focusing on the energy flowing through your body or stimulating your creativity are just two examples of how nZen can help you.


CALMING SOUNDS
During your sessions, you can switch between two available background noises that will help you relax. A harmonious melody or the sounds of waves breaking against the shore. Choose the one that soothes you more and drift away into the depths of your mind.

Find you inner peace with additional Life Purpose Reflection DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 5 different inspirational programs
- Calming background sounds
- Motivational quotes that will help you achieve your goal

70070000021838.name: The Magic and Murder Bundle
70070000021838.description: Investigate the case of the missing magician, or summon a demonic harem of murderous mistresses in Neon Doctrine’s Magic and Murder Bundle! Featuring our detective adventure game Death Trick: Double Blind and our succubi management simulator My Lovely Wife, experience gorgeous art and heinous murder alike.

70070000021845.name: Lost Castle Deluxe Edition
70070000021845.description: Grab some friends or go it alone and take on the fully-fortified castle and its winding dungeons of danger in Lost Castle: Deluxe Edition, containing both the Lost Castle and The Old Ones Awaken DLC with a discounted price!

70070000021877.name: Wildlife Adventures Collection – 3 in 1
70070000021877.description:
This bundle contains:
- Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch
- Dolphin Spirit - Ocean Mission
- Marsupilami Hoobadventure

70070000021878.name: My Universe Discovery Collection 2
70070000021878.description:
Discover the My Universe range of games with this 4 game bundle including : 
- My Universe - Puppies & Kittens
- My Universe - Pet Clinic Cats & Dogs
- My Universe - My Baby Dragon
- My Universe - Green Adventure : Farmers Friends

70070000021883.name: Bucket Crusher: Cool Kidz Edition
70070000021883.intro: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!
70070000021883.description:
Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw!

Features:
- tear down 11 regular and 8 playful brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- change the look of your saw with 10 different funny skins!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you complete the first wall, there are various colorful and interesting mosaics with different shapes waiting for you to dig into and pull to pieces!

Upgrade your machinery after each level and think carefully about the wisest way to invest your money. Increase the length, power, size, and fuel capacity to get more bricks with every run of the level!

If you want to knock down walls faster and earn more cash, consider buying special permanent upgrades that cost prestige points, but there's a catch here. To get them, you have to reset all your progress!

70070000021885.name: Frozen Honey ASMR: Nasty Edition
70070000021885.intro: Enjoy making your frozen honey jelly desserts from scratch in the most satisfying ASMR game!
70070000021885.description:
Choose your favorite bottle, mix all ingredients, freeze it, and squeeze out the frozen honey jelly!

Features:
- create fabulous and colorful frozen honey jelly desserts!
- let your imagination run wild using different sweets, honey colors, bottle shapes, and stencils! 
- add new 7 nasty ingredients to your frozen honey jelly to satisfy even the most picky customers ! 
- meet the demands of your customers
- enjoy the ASMR sounds while preparing your delicious frozen honey!
- perform special tasks of collector, achiever, gamer and purchaser
- serve unique VIP characters
- customize your truck using various skins, signs, and truck shapes
- use skins to change the look of your equipment
- earn money to spend it in the store on skins, bottles, candies, and more!
- spend additional 1000 coins in the shop
- watch your customers eat the frozen honey jelly desserts you have prepared and wait for their reactions! 

You are the owner of a frozen honey truck, and people can't get enough of your tasty honey desserts! Start the cooking adventure by choosing the bottle shape, adding candies, pouring colorful honey, and mixing it up. After that, put the stencil on the bottle, pop it into the fridge, and enjoy the sounds of the frozen honey. Sweet, soft, and incredibly tasty – frozen honey jelly has never been this much fun!

Watch the ASMR rainbow jelly dance and swirl into the perfect frozen honey dessert In this game, you're the mastermind behind the sensational frozen honey jelly treats that everyone loves on social media!

Explore the joy of experimenting with various candies and colorful syrups to create your own satisfying frozen honey. It's not just a game – it's an interactive journey that combines jelly with the joy of crafting!

Dive into the pleasures of crafting, innovating, and experiencing the captivating charm of the Frozen Honey ASMR game!

70070000021887.name: Time Travel Bundle
70070000021887.description: Go on a journey thousands of eons into the far future, or take a hop, skip, and a jump back to the early 1900’s with Neon Doctrine’s Time Travel Bundle!  Featuring Neon Doctrine’s sci-fi adventure game Library of Babel and beloved comic book beat-em-up The Legend of Tianding, let the past and the future alike dazzle you with two 2D side scrolling adventures!

70070000021889.name: Weed and Greet Bundle - Weedcraft Inc + Crossroads Inn
70070000021889.intro: Build your own weed empire or create a fantasy tavern - Weedcraft Inc + Crossroads Inn
70070000021889.description:
Weedcraft Inc:
Weedcraft Inc explores the business of producing, breeding, and selling weed in America, delving deep into the financial, political, and cultural aspects of the country's complex relationship with this troublesome and promising plant. An important, controversial topic presented in an insightful and detailed manner, Weedcraft Inc presents a challenge to those who would rule the reefer, offering a series of diverse scenarios and unique characters to work with (or around) as your budding empire grows. 

Crossroads Inn: 
Crossroads Inn, a real-time management sim, unfolds in Delcrys' unique fantasy realm. Construct and oversee your inn, delight traveling heroes, and achieve renowned status for your services across the kingdom.

70070000021890.name: Doctors and Bartenders Bundle - Bio Inc. Redemption + Crossroads Inn
70070000021890.intro: Bio Inc. Redemption + Crossroads Inn - Manage tavern or manage live and death!
70070000021890.description:
Crossroads Inn is a real-time management sim with role-playing games elements. The game consists of two unique modes offering totally different experiences.

In Sandbox mode gamers will focus solely on managing their business and economy – to build their very own tavern, hire and oversee staff, manage the supply chains and create new dish recipes.

In Campaign mode, micromanagement is just a prelude to a rich story as the kingdom is in turmoil and a shift of power is expected. Your Inn will soon attract the attention of important political and military figures, who are desperately trying to hold on to the reins of power. Gamers will become part of a large-scale drama full of political intrigues, vivid characters, treacherous NPC’s and dangerous quests inspired by RPG games – You will even have a damsel in distress to save!

Bio Inc.: Redemption is a complex biomedical simulator in which you make life or death decisions. Create the ultimate illness to infect and torment your victim or play as the head of a medical team and hopefully find a cure to save your patient. Will you be the plague or preserve humanity?

Including over 600 actual diseases, viruses, symptoms, diagnostic tests, treatments and other medical conditions, Bio Inc.: Redemption is frighteningly realistic. It will captivate you for hours, bringing you into a microscopic world of epic plague proportions!

70070000021902.name: Fit My Cat Special Edition
70070000021902.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000021902.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Get access to new levels with Cat's Puzzle Pack 1 and 2 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000021903.name: One Night: Burlesque Platinum Edition
70070000021903.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000021903.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle you can learn about Liz's and Club Crowd's creation story by accessing artbook from game menu.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000021904.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Definitive
70070000021904.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000021904.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF

70070000021913.description:
Two HD-2D RPGs from SQUARE ENIX’s Team Asano,
OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II are now available as a bundle!

Embark upon a story all your own.

one to the East and another to the West, divided by the Sundering Sea.
The opening of shipping routes has paved the way for huge vessels to take to the seas,
and newly invented technologies that use steam power are coming to the fore.
Many in this world are delighted at the prospect of establishing thriving industries and cultures,
but there are also those who suffer the oppression of war, disease and poverty.
That’s where you come in. Take control of one of eight travellers, born in different parts
of the world, travelling to different destinations, and each with their own special set
of skills, and journey across the world.

70070000021914.name: Call of Honor - Duty of Warfare & Battlefront Trench Warriors: Ops of Warfare
70070000021914.description:
CALL OF HONOR - DUTY OF WARFARE
Key Features:
1. Tactical Mastery: Assume the role of a skilled operative and lead your team through heart-pounding matches against a relentless enemy force. 
2. Points-Based Warfare: Engage in intense firefights where each kill results in a point deduction from your team's score. The stakes are high – the first team to lose all their points faces defeat.
3. Dynamic Locations: Explore five meticulously designed locations, each presenting its own set of challenges and opportunities. 
4. Arsenal of Destruction: Arm yourself with a vast array of more than 20 different weapons, ranging from powerful firearms to strategic grenades.

Prepare to answer the call, honor your duty, and engage in warfare like never before. "Call of Honor - Duty of Warfare" is a solo-player masterpiece that combines intense team-based action with a riveting narrative, delivering an unparalleled gaming experience on the Nintendo Switch™. Get ready to embark on a journey where every decision counts and only the strongest will prevail!

BATTLEFRONT TRENCH WARRIORS: OPS OF WARFARE
Key Features:
1. Authentic Environments: Immerse yourself in the gritty realism of trench warfare, exploring intricate underground labyrinths and navigating fortified war canals, all designed to make you feel like you're on the front lines of an actual war.
2. Diverse Weaponry: Arm yourself with an extensive selection of weapons, from classic firearms to cutting-edge military technology, providing a wide range of combat strategies and tactics.
3. Engaging Missions: Take on a variety of missions, each presenting its own set of objectives and challenges, testing your strategic thinking and combat skills.
4. Tactical Challenges: Overcome a plethora of challenges that demand quick thinking, precision, and adaptability, whether it's navigating treacherous terrain or outsmarting enemy forces.
5. High-Quality Realism: Experience the game with top-tier graphics and visual effects, capturing the intensity and authenticity of wartime for a truly immersive experience.

"Battlefront Trench Warriors: Ops of Warfare" offers you the opportunity to prove your valor, tactical expertise, and combat proficiency in a historically rich, genuine war environment. Are you prepared to face the challenges of the battlefield and emerge as a true hero in the Ops of Warfare?

Are you ready to unleash your inner feline musician? Let the whisker-tickling fun begin with Cat Piano!

70070000021932.description:
Make crazy hairstyles, mix colors and dye hair in different ways!

It's time for the finishing touches. Choose the hairstyle you want, such as braids or straighten hair with a straightener, and apply beautiful embellishments for your client to increase the WOW effect!

Become a part of the coolest hair challenge and beautify the look of your clients!

70070000021935.name: Color Road: Complete Edition
70070000021935.intro: Roll the ball as far as you can and face off your family or friends in multiplayer mode!
70070000021935.description:
Race around the track and collect the balls of your color to get as far as possible! Sounds easy? You wish!

Features:
- roll the ball on the road as far as possible
- only touch balls of the same color as yours

- change the look of your ball, tail and road with over 55 skins!
- complete all 45 challenges
- use 10 revive hearts thanks to which you can continue the game after losing
- spend 5000 additional coins on hearts or tail skins!
- train your reaction time to perfection!

Each time you jump over the ramp, the color of your ball changes! Pay close attention to the color of your ball and only touch the balls on the track that match yours. If you don't succeed, the ball bounces, and the game is over! As if that wasn't enough, the further you get, the faster your ball will start moving, and you'll have less time to react! 

Looking for a greater challenge? Look no further! Up to 45 different challenges await you! Get a certain number of points in time, change the ball's color 10 times, or smash 15 red balls! You'll be rewarded with ball skins and roads for completing these challenges! 

Play with a friend to compete in multiplayer mode and see who gets the farthest!

70070000021972.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Premium Edition
70070000021972.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000021975.name: Tell Me Your Story Deluxe Edition
70070000021975.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000021975.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD 

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

Discover the process of creating characters and locations with the Amelia Artbook DLC included in this bundle.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience

70070000021980.name: Brain Memory 2 Ultimate Edition

ADORABLE ILLUSTRATIONS

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
To train effectively, the player can choose their preferred difficulty level and customize the appearance of the card covers. This allows the mind to focus on the appropriate number of cards and colors on the board.

70070000021982.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000021982.description:
Choose your favourite skin, eat, grow and stay alive!
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Complete Edition features:
- 10 maps with different things to swallow 
- 48 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000021985.name: Only Way Up! Parkour Jump Simulator: Premium Edition
70070000021985.intro: Personalize Your Thrills, Customize Your Avatar and Dominate the Urban Jungle!
70070000021985.description:
Embark on a thrilling parkour journey through urban landscapes in "Only Way Up! Parkour Jump Simulator." Feel the adrenaline rush as you jump, hop, and roll through various cityscapes, each filled with exciting challenges. Now,in this bundle, you can not only experience the heart-pounding action of parkour game ,but also tailor your character with the Character Customization DLC. Customize your appearance with a range of options making each jump uniquely yours.
Key Features:
-Race through diverse urban environments filled with obstacles.
-Test your parkour skills with new challenges.
-Customize your character's appearance with outfits, accessories, and more.
-Engage in an immersive adventure that's easy to learn but hard to master.
Get ready for gravity-defying thrills and endless customization options!

70070000021991.name: Construction Machine Simulator: Premium Edition
70070000021991.intro: Embark on an Adventure in Construction Mastery with Our Exclusive Bundle, Featuring the Thunder MKT Truck!
70070000021991.description:
Attention, adventurers of the construction world! Get ready for an unmatched gaming experience with our latest bundle, featuring the exciting addition of the "New Truck - Thunder MKT"! Step into the virtual realm where you take charge of massive machines amidst the bustling construction site.
Game Features:
	•	Diverse Machinery: Control excavators, cranes, and the new "Thunder MKT" truck.
	•	Challenging Missions: Test your skills with precise tasks and payloads.
	•	Skill Growth: Unlock upgrades and broaden expertise in virtual construction.
	•	Career Mode: Manage crew and finances to build your legacy.
	•	Realistic Physics: Experience authentic machinery movement for engaging challenges.
The construction site calls out, urging your skilled team to embark on an adventure. Seize control and redefine the world, with each virtual brick laid, now with the "New Truck - Thunder MKT"!

70070000021995.name: Notes + Stickers Director's Cut
70070000021995.intro: Write down every amazing moment of your day using Notes + Stickers. Discover a new outlet for your fantastic memories.
70070000021995.description:
WRITE IT DOWN

Put your life in order. You'll never forget to buy milk, skip a dentist appointment or lose THE TASTIEST muffin recipe in your life. Customize your notes and create your own style.

STICK TO WHAT'S BEST

Enjoy a collection of adorable stickers and play around with their settings. Brighten up your memories without any effort. 

Get access to new colorful stickers with Sticker Pack 2 and 3 included in this bundle.

Key Features:

- Cutest stickers you've seen
- Classic notepad formula with extra steps
- Dozens of color combinations
- A safe place for your memories
- Simple design with high functionality

70070000021997.name: Hentai Golf Complete Edition
70070000021997.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000021997.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with Prairie Greens and Sunset Pines DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000022001.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Ultra Ultimate
70070000022001.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000022001.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Winter, Spring and Summer Mini Islands.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000022002.name: GUNDAM BREAKER 4 Deluxe Edition
70070000022002.description:
Pre-order now and get the following bonus content:
- Early Unlock GUNDAM RX-78 Recirculation Color
- 6 Builder's Parts

*Can be obtained through in-game progression.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
• GUNDAM BREAKER 4
• Deluxe Edition Bonus (Gunpla Parts Early Unlock - 15 Base Kits)
• Season Pass
- 5 Story Missions
- Season Pass Bonus (set of parts to recreate the Gunbarrel Strike Gundam - Gundam Breaker Ver.)

Create your own ultimate Gundam in the newest Gundam Breaker game!

In Gundam Breaker 4 you will create and customize your own powerful Gunpla, and put it to the test in thrilling combat missions.

• BREAK
Use two different weapons at once in Gundam Breaker 4 and break off parts of your enemies to add them to your collection. It's your loot - you get to keep it and use it!

• BUILD
Choose from over 250 base kits and combine their parts to build your perfect Gunpla. Customize it with paint, weathering, and decals to make it uniquely your own and display it in the new Diorama Mode. With multiple backgrounds and special effects to choose from, you can create epic, dynamic scenes to share online!

• BATTLE
Take your custom Gunpla in a variety of intense combat missions and put it to the test as you battle tough opponents in online or single player modes. Fight with your friends, equip new skills to gain an edge, and destroy your enemies!

Enter the new era of the Gundam Breaker series and prepare to BREAK, BUILD, & BATTLE!

*In addition to this edition, Standard Edition and Ultimate Edition are also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Story Mission DLCs will be available for purchase individually after launch.

70070000022003.description:
