70070000022007.name: Truck Drag Racing Legends Simulator: Premium Edition
70070000022007.intro: Unleash Your Inner Legend and Rule the Race Track in Style!
70070000022007.description:
Experience the ultimate drag racing adventure with the Truck Drag Racing Legends Simulator: Premium Edition! This all-in-one package combines the heart-pounding thrills of the base game with the exclusive customization options of DLC with including a treasure trove of new stickers to deck out your trucks!

The competition is fierce, but with the Truck Drag Racing Legends Simulator: Premium Bundle, you have the tools and the style to conquer all. Don't miss out on this incredible value!

70070000022011.name: STAR WARS: Hunters™ Bounty Pack
70070000022011.description:
The Star Wars: Hunters™ - Bounty Cosmetic Pack gives you access to the game download and Imara Vex's PLUM BOUNTY HUNTER Costume, her PLUM RIFLE Weapon Wrap, a BOUNTY PUCK Sticker, the YOUR CHAMPION Victory Pose and 500 CRYSTALS

NEW STAR WARS EXPERIENCE
Located deep in the Outer Rim on the planet of Vespaara and broadcast far and wide on the HoloNet, the stories and legends of battles that define galactic history are brought to life to entertain audiences and create champions seeking fame and fortune in this new gladiatorial spectacle.

MEET THE HUNTERS
Gear up for battle and pick a Hunter that suits your playstyle from a regularly updated roster of new characters including nefarious bounty hunters, heroes of the Rebellion, Imperial stormtroopers, and everything in between. Outclass opponents by mastering diverse abilities, skills and strategies while fighting it out in intense 4v4 third-person combat and dominating opponents on the road to fame in The Arena.

Star Wars: Hunters™ is a free to play game and includes optional in-game purchases.If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-game purchases in yourdevice's settings. For information about how Zynga uses personal data, please read our privacy policy at www.take2games.com/privacy.

You must be at least 13 years of age, or such higher age as required in your country, to play or download Star Wars: Hunters.

Terms of Service: https://www.zynga.com/legal/terms-of-service 
Privacy Policy: https://www.zynga.com/privacy/policy

70070000022013.name: nZen Ultimate Edition
70070000022013.intro: Find your inner peace by relaxing with nZen.
70070000022013.description:
nZen will help you on your journey to finding yourself and understanding the world around you. Begin your contemplation, clear your mind, and let nZen guide you through the unexplored areas of your mind.


IDENTIFY YOUR GOAL
Select one of the available inspirational programs prepared for various occasions. During each of them, you will be able to focus on a voice that will help you achieve your goal. Focusing on the energy flowing through your body or stimulating your creativity are just two examples of how nZen can help you.


CALMING SOUNDS
During your sessions, you can switch between two available background noises that will help you relax. A harmonious melody or the sounds of waves breaking against the shore. Choose the one that soothes you more and drift away into the depths of your mind.

Find you inner peace with additional Start Transcendental Journey DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 5 different inspirational programs
- Calming background sounds
- Motivational quotes that will help you achieve your goal

70070000022031.name: Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: Premium Edition
70070000022031.intro: Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat Legendary Game + Amazing Skins!Express Yourself!
70070000022031.description:
Experience the ultimate skateboarding adventure with the 'Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: Premium Edition' bundle! Dive into the meme-tastic world of laughter and epic skateboarding feats in the base game. Join iconic characters like Yellow Face, Swole Doge, and Maxwell Cat himself for thrilling rides and hilarious antics.

But that's not all! With the 'New Skins Pack' DLC, upgrade your skateboard with a range of vibrant colors and wacky designs, adding a new level of style to your shredding sessions. Customize your board, hit the ramps, and groove to the adrenaline-pumping soundtrack that accompanies every trick.

Skate, drift, and repeat with the ultimate meme-inspired bundle—Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator and the 'New Skins Pack' DLC. Get ready to shred in style like never before!

70070000022032.name: Freaky Trip GOTY Edition
70070000022032.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000022032.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Spring, Fall and Winter Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000022033.name: Hotel Hustle Deluxe Edition
70070000022033.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000022033.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE 
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from the Artbook Part 1 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts

70070000022037.name: Truck Simulator 2023 - Driver Europe: Premium Edition
70070000022037.intro: Double Down & Dominate: Trucks, Upgrades, Freedom. Unlock Your Full Trucking Potential.
70070000022037.description:
Unleash your inner trucking boss with the Truck Simulator 2023 - Driver Europe: Premium Edition! Conquer highways like never before with this all-in-one package that combines the complete TRUCK SIMULATOR 2023 - DRIVER EUROPE experience with a financial boost to transform your rig into a masterpiece.

Dominate the road with the Premium Edition, which includes:
- Exclusive Money Pack: Upgrade your trucks for heavy hauling and take on any challenge.
- The complete TRUCK SIMULATOR 2023 - DRIVER EUROPE experience: Explore stunning landscapes, customize your ride, and feel the thrill of the open road.

Don't just drive; own the road!

70070000022045.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Legendary Edition
70070000022045.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000022045.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes first and third Personal Boards DLC. 

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000022046.name: nBlocks - Unblock Your Creativity Ultimate Edition
70070000022046.intro: Design, build and create all of your fantastic ideas!
70070000022046.description:
With nBlocks you will be able to construct any project that resides in your mind using 2D blocks of various shapes. You can either use prepared templates and collect stars or start your own project from the beginning.


UNLIMITED POSSIBILITIES
To ensure each of your projects stands out, you can choose from 19 elements that you can fully rotate, duplicate, and customize their colors. Additionally, you can adjust the color of the board on which you arrange the blocks to suit your preferences.


CREATE YOUR OWN
Freestyle mode offers blank boards just waiting to be filled with blocks. This mode is perfect if you want to build a masterpiece from scratch all by yourself. No limitations, just you and your creativity.

Unblock new set of templates with Builder Pack 2 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 96 templates in challenge mode
- Freestyle mode to unleash your creativity.
- 19 unique elements and 20 colors
- Relaxing music that helps to focus

70070000022056.name: Sprout Valley Premium Edition
70070000022056.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000022056.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Make your island even more cozy with the Lovely and Cows DLCs.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000022062.name: Hentai Girls Ultra Deluxe
70070000022062.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000022062.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Puppy Yui, Foxy Etsuko, Kitty Shirayuki and Waiting Shirayuki.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000022063.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash Legendary Edition
70070000022063.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000022063.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently. 


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Boo's and Tary's Challenge DLCs added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios

70070000022064.name: AAA Clock Extreme Platinum
70070000022064.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000022064.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 5 DLCs: the Elegant, Pixel, Squid, Cyber and Digital Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000022066.name: Brain Memory Ultra Director's Cut
70070000022066.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000022066.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 2 DLC: Cards Pack 3 and Figures Pack.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000022067.name: Brain Memory Ultra GOTY Edition
70070000022067.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000022067.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 2 DLC: Cards Pack 4 and Numbers Pack.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000022072.name: Life Bubble: Complete Edition
70070000022072.intro: Hey there astronaut! Ready to go on your biggest space adventure?
70070000022072.description:
Embark on an exciting journey to explore new planets, collect valuable resources, and rescue lost astronauts!

Your mission is to expand your life bubble across the planet and repair your ship to continue your adventure into the unknown! 

Features:
- travel through beautiful and mysterious planets, each with unique resources and terrains
- collect valuable raw materials to rebuild machines and bridges
- use 3 new fantastic items: Golden Tool, Golden Suit, and Hoverboard!
- explore different areas and expand your life bubble over places where it is impossible to survive! 
- buy various character upgrades: bag, speed, life, tools, and power using your 30000 additional money immediately! 
- buy machine upgrades to increase its storage capacity 
- fight enemies with your power weapon!
- complete missions for extra money!

Chop wood, mine colorful crystals or diamonds, and use them to rebuild machines and bridges that will help you expand your life bubble area! Every construction needs specific raw materials, so search for their deposits and get to work!

Complete missions or sell resources you don't need in order to buy character and machine upgrades. Improve your abilities and tools to explore the planet fully prepared!

Be ready for obstacles along the way. Enemies are out to conquer your tiny universe. Protect your life bubble miniature world and fight back like a true space cowboy!

Prepare yourself for a unique and unforgettable space adventure!

70070000022075.name: Z Escape: Floaty Edition
70070000022075.intro: Get to the chopper! Pick up the machine gun and destroy all of the zombies to save your crew!
70070000022075.description:
Your quest is simple... rescue as many survivors as you can by killing all the walking dead!

Features:
- hordes of zombies
- interactive surroundings
- Balloon power up
- 3 new weapons
- 3 new weapon sights
- new zombie and survivor skin
- 15000 additional coins to spend
- levels with rewards and bigger zombies!
- skins for zombies, survivors and helicopters
- fun and addictive gameplay
- lots of shooting!

Zombies run and climb on buildings very fast, so make sure to shoot quickly and precisely. If there are too many of them, use your surroundings - shoot at exploding barrels, destroy bridges, and glass roofs or just drop heavy building materials to stop the zombie horde! 

Rescue the survivors before they become infected! But beware, after each successful escape, the zombies will become even more challenging. You must apply your strategy in real-time and spot the right target to shoot in order to win!

If you believe that shooting zombies is not just a matter of luck, show your abilities and become the best helicopter sniper ever. Best of luck!

70070000022086.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Complete
70070000022086.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000022086.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming turtle, a super-sweet red panda and dragon.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000022087.name: One Night: Burlesque Director's Cut
70070000022087.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000022087.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle you can learn about Suspects' and Club Crowd's creation story by accessing artbook from game menu.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000022088.name: Cat Piano Ultimate Edition
70070000022088.intro: Start the whisker-tickling Fun with Cat Piano.
70070000022088.description:
Cat Piano is the ultimate cat-tastic piano game designed especially for kids! Dive into a world of whimsical melodies and playful paw prints as you unleash your inner feline musician.


PURR-FECT PIANO PLAY
Cat Piano is a delightful piano version where kids can create music using charming cat sounds instead of traditional piano notes. Each paw print on the piano produces a different tone of cat sound, allowing children to compose their own tunes with a touch of feline flair.


PAWS FOR CREATIVITY
The only limit is your imagination! Challenge yourself to replicate your favorite songs using only cat sounds. Whether you're composing a gentle lullaby or a lively tune to get the whole family dancing, Cat Piano provides endless opportunities for creative expression.

Are you ready to unleash your inner feline musician? Let the whisker-tickling fun begin with Cat Piano!

Change adorable cats that accompany you while playing piano with Background Pack 2 DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Playful piano game featuring adorable cat sounds
- Different backgrounds with lovely cats
- Unlimited opportunities for creative expression and musical exploration
- Super option to show your kid different sounds

70070000022092.name: Train Traffic Manager Premium Edition
70070000022092.intro: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!
70070000022092.description:
Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.

Take on over 80 levels across diverse environments that range from sunny desertscapes to mysterious midnight scenes. It's more fun than a cactus in your caboose!

Each environment has its own unique challenges. Deserts have meteor showers (because of course they do), forests have fallen trees (what's a forest without a little lumber?), winters bring the freeze to your switches, and at midnight, well, you'll just have to see.

And if the chaos of normal mode gets too much, take a breather in endless mode. No objectives, just you, the tracks, and an infinite number of trains. It's the zen garden of train management!

Ready to dive into the madness? Take control of the tracks and show that chaos who's boss in Train Traffic Manager.

And remember: don't fall asleep at your post!

This bundle includes base game and DLC #3 (Fleet Upgrade - Jet & Circus)  with:

Bring a burst of fun and speed to your railways with the "Fleet Upgrade" DLC! Adorn your locomotives with the vibrant colors of the circus or the sleek design of a jet. With these two new skins, your trains won't just be on time; they'll arrive with flair!

70070000022102.name: Neon Doctrine's Greatest Hits Vol. 1
70070000022102.description: Lost Castle, The Legend of Tianding, and Yuppie Psycho. Three different games with almost nothing in common. Nothing that is, except they all captured your hearts. Embark on three grand adventures through magic castles, occupied cities, and the most terrifying of all: corporate offices, when you get Neon Doctrine’s Greatest Hits bundle, featuring our three most beloved games.

70070000022103.name: The Excrawlers + Shiro Bundle
70070000022103.description:
The Excrawlers is an action-RPG slasher game in which you and other heroes will have to plunge into the dark atmosphere of dungeons filled with monsters and madness. Find out how you got here, complete all the challenges and fight five deadly bosses to be able to get out!

Shiro is an adventure platformer in which you have to find your missing sister.

70070000022122.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Premium Edition
70070000022122.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000022122.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #1 (Custom Cruisers #1):

Elevate your presence on the dirt tracks with five new, meticulously crafted skins that blend high-speed performance with eye-catching beauty. From sleek, futuristic designs to rugged, battle-ready appearances, each skin ensures your buggy stands out as you drift, jump, and race towards victory.

70070000022127.name: Trash Punk Premium Edition
70070000022127.intro: Rock the apocalypse in punk style!
70070000022127.description:
“Trash Punk” is where anarchy reigns, and you’re the opossum punk rocking the apocalypse! This isn’t just a shooter; it's a top-down, adrenaline-pumping riot set in a world gone delightfully mad.

This bundle not only brings you the original chaos of mutated oddities and frantic gameplay but also adds visually refreshing DLC "Toxic Twilight".

Armed with everything from gnarly firearms to wicked melee weapons, get ready to bash and blast through hordes of mutated oddities. Melee isn't just for show – smash your way to ammo as you carve a path through chaos. At every twisted turn, make tough calls: grab a new weapon, an upgrade, or some much-needed healing.

The game’s world is a wild mashup of punk rock rebellion and post-apocalyptic mayhem, where every rampage is a unique blend of chaos, with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two runs are alike. With a soundtrack dominated by heavy riffs, each level is a mosh pit of danger and excitement.

Team up in the co-op mode as the iconic opossum punk or the fearless female skunk, each bringing their own punk flair to the fight. Together, you can tackle the chaos, doubling the firepower and strategy against the mutated menaces, making every playthrough like your favorite punk track – familiar yet fresh, and always exciting.

Grab your weapons and start the rebellion. How far can you go?

70070000022138.name: Anime Beauty Girl Puzzle Extended Edition
70070000022138.intro: Double the Fun with this Bundle, Main Game & DLC Exclusive - More Value, More Adventure!
70070000022138.description:
Expanded Content: Dive into a world of captivating puzzles with new images introduced in the DLC pack, enhancing your gameplay experience.
Features:
	•	Puzzle Challenge: Dive into a world of captivating puzzles with new images introduced in the DLC pack, enhancing your gameplay experience.
	•	Visual Delight: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals, featuring vibrant colors and intricate details that bring the anime world to life, captivating your senses at every turn.
If you're a puzzle and anime enthusiast, get ready to dive into the game like never before. With captivating visuals, immersive gameplay, and unbeatable value, this bundled offering promises to deliver an unforgettable anime puzzle experience.

70070000022141.name: Cooking Arena Lets Burger
70070000022141.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000022141.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Burger Chef Tycoon".

70070000022149.name: Urban Flow Traffic Tycoon
70070000022149.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000022149.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colourful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!
Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plough through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack and Streets Supplement #2 with:

- Challenge Mode!
- 20 new levels
- 5 new vehicles to the streets of Urban Flow, each one unique and with its own style.

70070000022150.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope - Special Ops
70070000022150.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game and Neon Strike with:

SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.

Receive yours now and be the ultimate marksman!

70070000022152.name: From Space Resistance Bundle
70070000022152.description:
That's no bubblegum army, that's an endless horde of menacingly pink aliens taking over our planet! Enough sweet talk, grab your gear, we need you and your squad to defeat the pink pests!
 
YOUR MISSION: Liberate Earth from the Alien horde!

70070000022153.name: 2D Indie Bundle
70070000022153.intro:
2D Indie Game Bundle!
Get 26 games with good price and big discount!
70070000022153.description:
2D Indie Game Bundle!
Get 26 games with good price and big discount!
26 games by Indie developers, including Action, Adventure, Platform, Sports and games from all genres.

70070000022157.name: Paint It: Yummy Edition
70070000022157.description:
Immerse yourself in the delicious world of Paint It: Yummy Edition! 

This special bundle will enrich your 3D coloring with a variety of food models, from crunchy vegetables to sweet treats. 

Each model is designed to inspire and add vibrant colors to your artwork. The set also includes exclusive stickers to decorate your creations. 

With Paint It: Yummy Edition your art will reach new heights. Create, decorate and showcase your culinary masterpieces!

70070000022165.name: Tangram Collection: The T Bundle
70070000022165.intro: Tangram Collection offers a fresh spin on a classic tangram game. The T Bundle contains base game and "Tangram Collection Other T" DLC
70070000022165.description:
The original tangrams first appeared in China. These addictive puzzles had players combining triangular pieces (called tans) to form a simple image. All pieces had to be used and could not overlap. It is the elegance of this format that made tangrams a worldwide sensation!

Tangrams have come a long way since their global debut, with modern variations introduced beyond the original set of 7 puzzles. Tangram Collection furthers that reinvention, offering welcomed variety to players looking for the next step in tangram evolution.

Tangram Collection: The T Bundle features:
• Tangram Collection Base Game
• Tangram Collection Other T

Founded in 2020, Error300 Games is a game development studio based in Dublin, Ireland. Avid gamers themselves, they strive to make the games they want to play.

70070000022172.name:
SPY×ANYA: Operation Memories
Deluxe Edition
70070000022172.intro: A slice of daily life drawn by a temporary family.
70070000022172.description:
Deluxe Edition includes:
• SPY×ANYA: Operation Memories 
• Deluxe Outing Pack
- Thrilling Costume Pack
- Exciting Costume Pack
- Anya's Bond Dress and Bond Hat
• Deluxe Edition Bonus: Anya's Director Chimera Hat

Based on the popular anime & manga series! Anya Forger has received a new assignment from school: create a photo diary of memories.

On weekdays, head to class in the morning, then enjoy family time in the evening.

On weekends, visit all sorts of exciting places, like the beach or art museums, in search of subjects worthy of photographing!

What kind of photo diary will you help Anya create?

• Take pictures when Anya finds something interesting!
• There are many peculiar things that can catch Anya's attention, like butterflies, swings, and fun sights during outings! Take great photos to complete her diary.
• There are a total of 10 outings to unique destinations for making memories!

SPY×ANYA also features over 15 minigames!
Enjoy over 15 minigames, including ones inspired by the anime series and those created originally for the game!
Fight to stay in sync with Yor's special training, ride Bond as you play spy, and use Anya's telepathic powers to read opponents' cards in Tycoon.

Bring out your inner fashionista with rich customization!
Have fun dressing up Anya, Loid, Yor, and Bond in a wardrobe of over 80 unique outfits, accessories, and hairstyles!
Purchase outfits from the in-game store with points earned from minigames. Play to your heart's content and unlock all kinds of clothes to wear on outings!

Spend time with your favorite characters based on the manga series!
In addition to Anya, Loid, Yor, and Bond; Damian and Becky from Eden College will also join the fun—not to mention Yor's brother, Yuri, and WISE agent Nightfall!
Play at school together, get help with homework, and create countless precious memories with Anya's friends and family.

*Custom outfits will not be displayed during certain minigames and cutscenes.
*Some content included in the Deluxe Edition will be available for individual purchase. Please take care to not make duplicate purchases.
*Bonus content may be distributed at a later date.

70070000022179.name: My Horse Stories: Complete Edition
70070000022179.intro: Get ready to make unforgettable memories and experience the beauty of the countryside like never before!
70070000022179.description:
Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ!  

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC, but your plans have changed. You're sent to middle-of-nowhere Kentucky to spend the summer with your grandma on a star-stable horse farm.  

Soon, you realize that this summer adventure holds untold potential! The horse farm becomes your heaven, and with each passing day, you grow closer to your loyal companion - a graceful horse with whom you'll weave your own unique horse-riding tale!  

Features: 
- Choose which horse out of 5 will become your best friend! 
- Make the most of the horse story summer - become a horse racing champ! 
- Train every day with your horse till you're ready to compete in international horse races 
- Compete in exciting horse story racing competitions around the world! - Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps! 
- Dress up like a champion in over 90 various clothes and change your hairstyles!  
- Take good care of your horse: feed, groom, and dress him with over 80 accessories! 
- Spend an additional 750 gems to buy clothes, energy, missing items for building improvements, and more!  
- Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won't let you off easy. Upgrade your horse-story farm and build new facilities. 
- Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!  

To rise above the competition and conquer the racetracks, you must train tirelessly, immersing yourself in the art of horsemanship. Your dedication will bring you face-to-face with rival stars and formidable opponents who will test your skills and determination. You and your horse will form an unbreakable bond through intense training sessions, setting the stage for legendary horse-riding tales that will be whispered for years to come!  

But it's not all about intense races and fierce rival stars. In the tranquil moments between training, you'll find solace in the stars' stable horses - majestic creatures that inspire awe and joyfully fill your heart. Take the time to nurture and care for them because their well-being is crucial to your success. Pamper them with love, groom their silky manes, and dress them in dazzling saddles that reflect their extraordinary beauty.  

You better make the most of it! Dress in cowgirl boots, dress up your new pet horse, start racing like a champion, and make it a horse story to remember!

70070000022185.name: Baking Time: Complete Edition
70070000022185.intro: Get ready for the ultimate bakery game that will satisfy your cooking fever and love for pastries!
70070000022185.description:
Stack all kinds of mouth-watering baked goods, from croissants to cookie hearts and everything in between! 

Grab your spatula, lift the baked goods out of the oven, and put them on display so that customers can buy them! With a steady stream of hungry customers waiting in line, it's up to you to deliver their orders quickly and efficiently!

Features:
- Bake over 30 different pastries that your customers won't resist!
- Collect baked goods with a spatula and put them on the display to sell them!
- Operate the cash register and satisfy your customers' appetites!
- Use your diamonds to unlock over 90 adorable animals that will increase your movement speed, capacity and the cash you collect!
- Earn tons of money to unlock new levels of your bakery!
- Hire staff to help you collect the baked goods much faster!
- Upgrade your character and workers to walk faster or carry more pastries!
- Perform baker's tasks and claim your rewards
- Prepare baked goods for special large orders!
- Feed your cookie monsters to get money each second
- Use the teleport to move faster between levels
- Get caught up in the cooking fever and try not to get hungry! 

Satisfy your customers and earn money that you can spend to hire additional staff and expand your bakery! Unlock new recipes and serve even more delicious pastries!

Need a helping hand? Invite your friend to play in local co-op mode and expand your bakery to the next level! Grab your aprons and get ready to bake up a storm in Baking Time together! 

So what are you waiting for? Keep those ovens hot and bake on!

70070000022186.name: SEGA Character Pass
70070000022186.description: Includes 6 SEGA all-stars each with their own unique stats! This pack also includes 15 customization items to deck your monkey out in the freshest SEGA themed fashion trends.

70070000022188.name: Mind's Decent Bundle (Darkwood + The Gap)
70070000022188.intro: The bundle that will challenge your grip on reality.
70070000022188.description:
Darkwood is a new perspective on survival horror. Scavenge and explore a rich, ever-changing free-roam world by day, then hunker down in your hideout and pray for the morning light.

The Gap tells a story of one man’s struggle to find a cure for his family’s illness through the exploration of parallel realities which include memories dear to his heart, forcing him to dive deeper into his psyche.

70070000022189.name: Xuan Yuan Sword Mystic RPG Bundle
70070000022189.intro: From classic to modern, enjoy two beautiful stories in one amazing RPG bundle!
70070000022189.description: Two award-winning role-playing games come together in one epic bundle. East and West join forces in the turn-based RPG classic Xuan Yuan Sword: Mists Beyond the Mountains. Fascinating real-time combat with a rich cinematic narrative awaits in the 3D action RPG Xuan Yuan Sword 7.

70070000022190.name: SteamWorld Heist Complete Bundle
70070000022190.description:
Embark on the full SteamWorld Heist adventure!

Play both SteamWorld Heist II, the next thrilling chapter in the story, and the original SteamWorld Heist in this complete bundle.

Including: 

SteamWorld Heist II 
Join Captain Leeway and his ragtag crew as they uncover the enigmatic menace threatening the Great Sea. Equip and upgrade your crew for turn-based gunfights packed with ricochet action and engage in real-time naval combat. Get ready to aim, plot, and plunder in this uproarious Steambot adventure!

SteamWorld Heist
In SteamWorld Heist you command robot pirates in epic tactical shootouts. It’s turn-based strategy with an action twist: By manually aiming your weapons you'll pull off insane bullet-bouncing trick shots!

SteamWorld Heist - The Outsider DLC
Captain Piper stumbles upon a new ally with a past shrouded in mystery. Dive into the action and take on new missions with brand-new weapons, gear and a shipload of hats!

SteamWorld Heist - Hatbox: Hatful Eight + 2 DLC
A lively bunch of hats that will surprise you with a life of their own. They’re cheaper than coffee, and certainly taste better!

70070000022191.name: Kingdom Imperial Collection
70070000022191.description:
This is the ultimate Kingdom collection, containing the following entries in the award-winning strategy series: Kingdom New Lands, Kingdom Two Crowns, Kingdom Two Crowns: Norse Lands, and Kingdom Eighties.

The Kingdom series is a 2D sidescrolling micro-strategy game with a minimalist feel wrapped in a beautiful, modern pixel-perfect aesthetic. Play the role of the Leader or the Monarch, enter a procedurally generated realm, and recruit loyal subjects to make your Kingdom flourish. Protect your domain from creatures looking to steal your coins and crown, explore islands, and discover curious and cryptic artifacts to aid your encounters with the monstrous Greed.

70070000022192.name: Kingdom Heritage Bundle
70070000022192.description:
Play through the ages with this great bundle of the award-winning strategy series Kingdom, combining medieval-inspired Kingdom Two Crowns with the 80’s-inspired Kingdom Eighties in a time-transcending bundle. 

The Kingdom series is a 2D sidescrolling micro-strategy game with a minimalist feel wrapped in a beautiful, modern pixel-perfect aesthetic. Play the role of the Leader or the Monarch, enter a procedurally generated realm, and recruit loyal subjects to make your Kingdom flourish. Protect your domain from creatures looking to steal your coins and crown, explore islands, and discover curious and cryptic artifacts to aid your encounters with the monstrous Greed.

70070000022196.name: Sculpt People: Famous Edition
70070000022196.intro: Bring your clay sculptures to life and start an incredible journey where imagination knows no limits!
70070000022196.description:
Mold the head, carve the details and decorate your work with different sprays and accessories!

Take on the exciting challenge of sculpting heads using clay. Follow reference photos to guide your hands and bring your creations to life. Whether it's a famous celebrity or a beloved pet, you'll enjoy the thrill of shaping each masterpiece!

Features:
- use clay to sculpt people's heads
- make sure the result is close enough to the photo!
- uncover 13 amazing VIP figures to sculpt right away!
- customize your every work of art using a variety of accessories and color sprays
- get top raitings for creativity, accessories and painting from your customers
- sell your works at auction and choose the highest bid!
- choose a box, insert the sculpture and fill it to secure it
- spend 2000 additional coins to upgrade your store or buy accessories even faster!
- express your creativity!

Make your sculptures unique by adding fun accessories and vibrant colors. From stylish hats to funky glasses, let your imagination run wild as you customize each piece to perfection. No two sculptures will ever be the same!

Show off your creations at prestigious auctions and watch as eager bidders compete to own your artwork. Choose the highest bid and see your sculptures find new homes in the hands of collectors who appreciate your talent.

Start your sculpting adventure and let your imagination run wild!

70070000022197.name: Sculpt People: Creative Edition
70070000022197.intro: Bring your clay sculptures to life and start an incredible journey where imagination knows no limits!
70070000022197.description:
Mold the head, carve the details and decorate your work with different sprays and accessories!

Take on the exciting challenge of sculpting heads using clay. Follow reference photos to guide your hands and bring your creations to life. Whether it's a famous celebrity or a beloved pet, you'll enjoy the thrill of shaping each masterpiece!

Features:

- make sure the result is close enough to the photo
- customize your every work of art using over 300 accessories and color sprays!
- get top raitings for creativity, accessories and painting from your customers

- earn money and spend it to upgrade your store

Make your sculptures unique by adding fun accessories and vibrant colors. From stylish hats to funky glasses, let your imagination run wild as you customize each piece to perfection. No two sculptures will ever be the same!

Start your sculpting adventure and let your imagination run wild!

70070000022200.name: Infantry Attack: Golden Edition
70070000022200.intro:
Soldier! War is coming, and duty calls you! 
Enemies are invading our country, and we need YOU to defend it!
70070000022200.description:
Enemy troops, such as infantry, helicopters, tanks, warplanes, and drones, are coming for you! Jump on the machine gun and shoot them all!

Features:
- Defend the country against enemy soldiers
- Fight along your military crew and defeat the opponent's army on multiple warzones
- Use new Golden Gatling primary weapon with high damage per second!
- Get 100 gold bars to spend on unique weapons or boosters
- Use additional 5000 cash on weapon and troops upgrades
- Upgrade your loadout to win the war!
- Use modern war weapons: machine guns, rocket launchers and drones
- Fight and kill bosses!
- Easy controls and realistic graphics for intense action

You're not doing war alone. Your squad is here to help you: 
- Explosive Expert with an RPG rocket launcher to deal tremendous damage to military vehicles
- Rifleman who will shoot at a high range on the open battlefield
- Grenadier who specializes in fighting all ground units. 
You are in charge of the machine gun to clear the battlefield, which is highly addictive and enjoyable!

Missions will take place in different warzones, and you will need to adapt your shooting strategy depending on the battlefield: city, desert, jungle, forest, airport, and many more! Be on the frontline of the battleground or take to the air to shoot enemies from the helicopter!

Beware! Combat will be challenging, and enemies will become stronger over time, so upgrading your guns won't be enough. Level up teammates and prepare your military crew for shooting waves of soldiers!

Do you have what it takes to free your country from invaders and win the war?
