70070000022463.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Ultra Extended
70070000022463.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000022463.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Winter, Autumn and Summer Mini Islands.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000022464.name: Hentai Girls Ultra Ultimate
70070000022464.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000022464.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Puppy Yui, Foxy Etsuko, Kitty Shirayuki and Playful Etsuko.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000022465.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash Platinum Edition
70070000022465.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000022465.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently. 


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Boo's and Ta's Challenge DLCs added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios

70070000022466.name: AAA Clock Extreme Director's Cut
70070000022466.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000022466.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 5 DLCs: the Elegant, Pixel, Squid, Happy and Digital Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000022482.name: nPaint Ultra Legendary
70070000022482.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000022482.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the second and sixth gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000022487.name: Piano: Learn and Play Ultra Complete
70070000022487.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000022487.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes third and seventh Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000022493.name: Sprout Valley Definitive Edition
70070000022493.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000022493.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Make your island even more cozy with the Easter and Cows DLCs.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000022497.name: nZen Extended Edition
70070000022497.intro: Find your inner peace by relaxing with nZen.
70070000022497.description:
nZen will help you on your journey to finding yourself and understanding the world around you. Begin your contemplation, clear your mind, and let nZen guide you through the unexplored areas of your mind.


IDENTIFY YOUR GOAL
Select one of the available inspirational programs prepared for various occasions. During each of them, you will be able to focus on a voice that will help you achieve your goal. Focusing on the energy flowing through your body or stimulating your creativity are just two examples of how nZen can help you.


CALMING SOUNDS
During your sessions, you can switch between two available background noises that will help you relax. A harmonious melody or the sounds of waves breaking against the shore. Choose the one that soothes you more and drift away into the depths of your mind.

Find you inner peace with additional Practice On Concentration DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 5 different inspirational programs
- Calming background sounds
- Motivational quotes that will help you achieve your goal

70070000022503.name: nBlocks - Unblock Your Creativity Extended Edition
70070000022503.intro: Design, build and create all of your fantastic ideas!
70070000022503.description:
With nBlocks you will be able to construct any project that resides in your mind using 2D blocks of various shapes. You can either use prepared templates and collect stars or start your own project from the beginning.


UNLIMITED POSSIBILITIES
To ensure each of your projects stands out, you can choose from 19 elements that you can fully rotate, duplicate, and customize their colors. Additionally, you can adjust the color of the board on which you arrange the blocks to suit your preferences.


CREATE YOUR OWN
Freestyle mode offers blank boards just waiting to be filled with blocks. This mode is perfect if you want to build a masterpiece from scratch all by yourself. No limitations, just you and your creativity.

Unblock new set of templates with Builder Pack 3 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 96 templates in challenge mode
- Freestyle mode to unleash your creativity.
- 19 unique elements and 20 colors
- Relaxing music that helps to focus

70070000022504.name: Cat Piano Extended Edition
70070000022504.intro: Start the whisker-tickling Fun with Cat Piano.
70070000022504.description:
Cat Piano is the ultimate cat-tastic piano game designed especially for kids! Dive into a world of whimsical melodies and playful paw prints as you unleash your inner feline musician.


PURR-FECT PIANO PLAY
Cat Piano is a delightful piano version where kids can create music using charming cat sounds instead of traditional piano notes. Each paw print on the piano produces a different tone of cat sound, allowing children to compose their own tunes with a touch of feline flair.


PAWS FOR CREATIVITY
The only limit is your imagination! Challenge yourself to replicate your favorite songs using only cat sounds. Whether you're composing a gentle lullaby or a lively tune to get the whole family dancing, Cat Piano provides endless opportunities for creative expression.

Are you ready to unleash your inner feline musician? Let the whisker-tickling fun begin with Cat Piano!

Change adorable cats that accompany you while playing piano with Background Pack 3 DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Playful piano game featuring adorable cat sounds
- Different backgrounds with lovely cats
- Unlimited opportunities for creative expression and musical exploration
- Super option to show your kid different sounds

70070000022505.name: Tell Me Your Story Extended Edition
70070000022505.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000022505.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD 

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

Discover the process of creating characters and locations with the Rose Artbook DLC included in this bundle.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience

70070000022506.name: Bomb Cat Ultimate Edition
70070000022506.intro: Match ultra-fluffy cats to achieve the highest score and unleash chaos with Bomb Cat.
70070000022506.description:
Bomb Cat takes inspiration from classic 2048 games but elevates the challenge with an insane bomb mechanic. In other words, it’s pretty simple – match the fluffy cats carefully, and watch out – the bombastic Bomb Cat can either assist you or completely disrupt your game.


2048 MATCH GAME WITH A BANG… OR A BOMB?
There are eleven fluffy cats, starting with sweet tiny blue kitten babies to match together. Each cat has a different weight depending on its size. Your goal is to achieve the highest score without running out of space.

To increase the challenge, a Bomb Cat will occasionally appear... to activate this kitty’s ability, it needs to touch the Flamey Cat. That’s when the explosion’s countdown starts! 

Depending on the circumstances, the blast can help you match smaller cats, as they will jump around the box, or end your game, as the cats can pop out of the open parcel and fly into space. Just like typical cats.


BE A COMBO HERO
Take the challenge of making your score furry freaking best. The more cats you match, the bigger your combo, which translates to more points.

Placing the cats strategically will help you maximize your score.

Unlock new board with Spring Background DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Eleven colorful cats to match like in classic 2048
– Possibility of sending cats to the Moon and back
– One special cat – Cat Bomb to make the game more challenging
– Combo mechanic to make your score even better
– Easy controlling, but challenging gameplay (sometimes)
– Endless and addictive fun
– Enjoyable music, which you can always turn off
– Once again... CATS (No regrets, cats are superior to other animals; deal with it already)

70070000022511.name: Hentai Stars Amazing Edition
70070000022511.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000022511.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Singing Puppy Tsubaki DLC.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000022512.name: Hentai World Ultra Deluxe
70070000022512.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose, and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000022512.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet students Sayuri, Rose in kitty costume and Nanami in puppy costume. 

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 art pieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000022516.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Legendary
70070000022516.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000022516.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes two new characters - an adorable swimming piglet, a super-sweet red panda and dragon.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000022518.name: One Night: Burlesque GOTY Edition
70070000022518.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000022518.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle, you can learn about the creation stories of Holly, Liz, and the Suspects by accessing the artbook from the game menu.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000022519.name: Hotel Hustle Ultimate Edition
70070000022519.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000022519.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE 
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from the Artbook Part 2 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts

70070000022524.name: Tokyo Cooking Ultimate Edition
70070000022524.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70070000022524.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.

Decorate your restaurant with the Oceanic Fish Set DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000022530.name: 10 in 1 Classic Games Pack
70070000022530.description:
Collection of awesome, family friendly games! Dive into it, play solo or together with other players!

Includes:

Fruity Puzzler
Bubble Fresh Fruits
Christmas Bubble Puzzle
Bubble Shoot Farm
Princess Puzzle Adventure
Bubble Puzzler
Fashion Friends
Fashion Girls
Fashion Princess
Space Lines

Embark on a journey through various genres and gameplay styles, from pulse-pounding action to mind-bending puzzles and everything in between. Challenge your family and friends to epic battles, test your strategy in tactical showdowns, and unleash your creativity with imaginative adventures!

70070000022534.name: Highway Moto Racing Rush 2023 Simulator - Premium Edition
70070000022534.intro: All-In-One Racing Bundle: Endless Speed, Ultimate Control.
70070000022534.description:
Get ready to embrace the thunderous roar of engines, ignite the spark of competition, and embark on an unforgettable journey that redefines the essence of being a speed enthusiast. This Ultimate Racing Bundle combines the thrilling main game with the groundbreaking DLC which including innovative motorcycle handles, offering you an unbeatable package that promises endless excitement and intense thrills.
Features:
	•	Innovative Motorcycle Handles: Experience new levels of speed and thrills.
	•	Wide Selection of Motorcycles: Choose from diverse, powerful bikes to match your racing style.
	•	Customization at Your Fingertips: Upgrade and modify your motorcycle to dominate the tracks.
This Bundle It’s the perfect choice for racing enthusiasts who want to get the most out of their gaming adventure.

70070000022539.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Special Edition
70070000022539.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000022543.name: Rocket Car: Ultimate Ball League Machines Premium Edition
70070000022543.intro: Gear Up for Maximum Excitement: Drive, Score, and Dominate with our Exclusive Bundle!
70070000022543.description:
Introducing the new Bundle, where high-speed cars meet intense soccer action in an electrifying fusion! Dive into the heart of the game and take advantage of the DLC pack + the main game, which provides double adrenaline and interest. Where you'll choose from a range of stylish vehicles, each with unique abilities, and engage in fast-paced gameplay across various modes and immersive stadium arenas. But the excitement doesn't stop there - with the DLC which including new Rim for Wheel with Spokes seamlessly integrated, customize your car with new accessories and elevate your gaming experience. 
Features:
	•	Customizable with new Accessories: Personalize your car with the latest accessories, including the New Rim for Wheel with Spokes DLC. 
	•	Immersive Environments: Unlock stadium arenas, each with its own unique theme and design, providing immersive environments for intense battles. 
Don't miss this unbeatable value that offers speed and adrenaline!

70070000022544.name: Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons Edition
70070000022544.description: New to The Fog? Check out Dead by Daylight: Dungeons & Dragons Edition, which includes the base game, the Dungeons and Dragons Chapter, and 2 Dungeons & Dragons Outfits: Baermar’s Roadside Ambush and Vecna’s Whispered One.

70070000022548.name: Bucket Crusher: Worldwide Edition
70070000022548.intro: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!
70070000022548.description:
Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw!

Features:
- tear down 11 regular and 8 new brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- change the look of your saw with 10 different funny skins!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you complete the first wall, there are various colorful and interesting mosaics with different shapes waiting for you to dig into and pull to pieces!

Upgrade your machinery after each level and think carefully about the wisest way to invest your money. Increase the length, power, size, and fuel capacity to get more bricks with every run of the level!

If you want to knock down walls faster and earn more cash, consider buying special permanent upgrades that cost prestige points, but there's a catch here. To get them, you have to reset all your progress!

70070000022550.name: Dentist Bling: Fantasy Edition
70070000022550.intro:
Ready for the ultimate dental experience?
Dive into the world of tooth care and become a master dentist!
70070000022550.description:
Treat your patients with different dental issues, from cavities to plaque buildup, and watch as their smiles transform under your expert care!

Perform treatments under time pressure, and don't forget about your customer's comfort. If you drill too long in the teeth, the customer will be dissatisfied with your service!

Features:
- perform a lot of different dental procedures on your new fairy tale forest chair
- decorate customers' teeth with new sparkling diamonds or apply a varnish that will change their color
- work under time pressure and do your job the best you can! 
- unlock and apply 12 tooth skins, 10 bling skins, and 10 chair skins
- upgrade the look of your clinic to make it cozier 
- buy an upgrades so your customers can last longer during dental treatment

Pull out decaying teeth and replace them with shiny new ones. Change their shape to fangs or apply braces. Yes doctor, at your salon, your patients LOVE braces!

Don't forget about your special BLING diamond treatment. This is a fancy teeth salon after all! 

Whatever you do, BLING, make them smile!

70070000022552.name: Neon On!: Bright Edition
70070000022552.intro: Wanna see something amazing? Like, really electrifying? The ultimate neon puzzle game is here!
70070000022552.description:
Get your neon cables out of knots and connect them to the right light sources to create amazing neon masterpieces!

In Neon On, the colors are the key to each puzzle. Every box needs to be connected to the socket of the same color otherwise it won't work. Some boxes even require combining a couple of hues to create a different color!

Features:
- unlock 3 new boxes, 3 cables and 3 theme skins!
- solve puzzles by matching the colorful light sources to the correct boxes
- grab neon light cables by tips and connect the power 
- combine different hues to create entirely new colors
- connect the cables if the wire is too short, but be careful - the more you move them, the more they can get tangled!
- avoid pulling wires through laser walls - they will cut everything in half
- complete all stages of a level to light up a large animated neon sign!
- collect coins and buy skins for power boxes, cables, and themes

Challenge yourself to complete many levels where you will find various obstacles, from laser gates that can cut your cables to moving light sources or rotating boxes. Besides, be careful while moving the wires because they can easily get tangled, disconnected, and fall to the ground! 

Light up the cities with vibrant neon artworks!

70070000022557.name: Sprout Valley Complete Edition
70070000022557.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000022557.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Unlock new pack of items and visit new biomes with Lovely and Summer DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000022558.name: nZen Special Edition
70070000022558.intro: Find your inner peace by relaxing with nZen.
70070000022558.description:
nZen will help you on your journey to finding yourself and understanding the world around you. Begin your contemplation, clear your mind, and let nZen guide you through the unexplored areas of your mind.


IDENTIFY YOUR GOAL
Select one of the available inspirational programs prepared for various occasions. During each of them, you will be able to focus on a voice that will help you achieve your goal. Focusing on the energy flowing through your body or stimulating your creativity are just two examples of how nZen can help you.


CALMING SOUNDS
During your sessions, you can switch between two available background noises that will help you relax. A harmonious melody or the sounds of waves breaking against the shore. Choose the one that soothes you more and drift away into the depths of your mind.

Find you inner peace with additional Box Breathing DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 5 different inspirational programs
- Calming background sounds
- Motivational quotes that will help you achieve your goal

70070000022559.name: nBlocks - Unblock Your Creativity Special Edition
70070000022559.intro: Design, build and create all of your fantastic ideas!
70070000022559.description:
With nBlocks you will be able to construct any project that resides in your mind using 2D blocks of various shapes. You can either use prepared templates and collect stars or start your own project from the beginning.


UNLIMITED POSSIBILITIES
To ensure each of your projects stands out, you can choose from 19 elements that you can fully rotate, duplicate, and customize their colors. Additionally, you can adjust the color of the board on which you arrange the blocks to suit your preferences.


CREATE YOUR OWN
Freestyle mode offers blank boards just waiting to be filled with blocks. This mode is perfect if you want to build a masterpiece from scratch all by yourself. No limitations, just you and your creativity.

Unblock new set of templates with Builder Pack 4 included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 96 templates in challenge mode
- Freestyle mode to unleash your creativity.
- 19 unique elements and 20 colors
- Relaxing music that helps to focus

70070000022563.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption Edition
70070000022563.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption Edition is the most complete way to experience the ultimate Warhammer 40,000 homage to retro shooters, including the base game and Forges of Corruption DLC.

Load up your Boltgun and plunge into battle headfirst! Experience a perfect blend of Warhammer 40,000, classic, frenetic FPS gameplay and the stylish visuals of your favourite 90’s retro shooters. 

Play as a battle-hardened Space Marine on a perilous mission across the galaxy, as they battle against the Chaos Space Marines and daemons of Chaos.

In glorious boomer shooter style, unleash your devastating Space Marine arsenal as you blast through an explosion of sprites, pixels and blood. Run, jump and charge across huge levels to shoot, shred and slice the worst heretics across the galaxy!

70070000022583.name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION
70070000022583.intro: Sonic and Shadow for a new generation
70070000022583.description:
Purchase the SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS Digital Deluxe Edition and receive additional iconic music tracks from previous Sonic and Shadow games, a Terios skin based on Shadow’s original concept, behind-the-scenes art, the Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack featuring the voice of Keanu Reeves, and more!  

It includes:  
•	Base Game
•	Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o	Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack (releasing December 12, 2024)
o	Terios Skin
o	Extra BGM Pack
o	Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
o	Skill Points (Sonic Generations)

Shadow the Hedgehog is back with Classic and Modern Sonic in SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS, an all-new collection featuring two unique experiences! 

Play as Shadow in a brand-new story campaign featuring never-before-seen abilities that prove why he’s known as the Ultimate Life Form! Speed through iconic stages from Shadow’s history, discover hidden secrets in an expansive hub world, and unlock new powers to take on Black Doom and save the world.

SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS also includes a complete remaster of the highly acclaimed SONIC GENERATIONS, a time-traveling adventure featuring a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D Sonic stages, now with upgraded visuals and new bonus content.

The Return of Shadow
In this new standalone campaign, Shadow’s nemesis, Black Doom, has reemerged and threatens to take over the world once again. Shadow must journey into his past, confront his painful memories, and unlock new dark powers to save the world.

Shadow Evolved
Harness Shadow’s new Doom Powers to battle hordes of enemies and tackle platforming challenges like never before. Surf on water, fly over obstacles, and stop time with the return of Chaos Control!

A Journey Through Time and Dimensions
Relive signature levels from Shadow’s previous adventures and accelerate through mind-bending stages in both 3D and 2D, warped by Black Doom’s influence as Shadow works to piece together the timeline and thwart his evil plans. 

Explore the New White Space
Stretch your legs in an all-new hub world inspired by the open-zone gameplay of Sonic Frontiers. As Shadow gains new powers, he can explore further and uncover the secrets hidden throughout!

SONIC GENERATIONS - An Epic Time-Traveling Sonic Adventure
Past meets present in SONIC GENERATIONS! When Dr. Eggman teams up with his past self and the mysterious Time Eater to erase their past defeats and rewrite history, they scatter Sonic and his friends across space and time. Now, Modern and Classic Sonic will have to team up to defeat this dastardly trio and restore their timeline to normal!

The Best of Both Worlds, Remastered
Spin dash through a greatest-hits collection of 3D and 2D versions of iconic stages from past Sonic games, now with updated visuals and reworked cinematics. 

More Collectibles, Bonus Content, and more!
Rescue Chao hiding in every level, rack up the highest pinball score in the Casino Nights Zone, and check out the museum for behind-the-scenes art, music, and more!

70070000022584.name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS Digital Deluxe Upgrade
70070000022584.intro: Sonic and Shadow for a new generation
70070000022584.description:
Upgrade to the SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS Digital Deluxe Edition and receive: 
•	Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o	Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Movie Pack (releasing December 12, 2024)
o	Terios Skin
o	Extra BGM Pack
o	Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
o	Skill Points (Sonic Generations)
