Rescue Chao hiding in every level, rack up the highest pinball score in the Casino Nights Zone, and check out the museum for behind-the-scenes art, music, and more!

70070000022587.name: Crypt Stalker Ultimate Edition
70070000022587.intro: Protect your world from demons as one of legendary Crypt Stalkers.
70070000022587.description:
Crypt Stalker is an 8-bit retro-styled arcade game. Take on the role of Gladys, one of the descendants of the world's defenders, and stop the demons before they unleash hell on the planet. Explore and defend diverse locations such as pyramids, a lake of fire, or overgrown ruins from unearthly creatures.


EXPLORE THE CRYPTS
As a highly trained Stalker, your task is to search and overcome every danger standing in your way. Watch out for your surroundings - unstable stones, and moving platforms are just a few dangers awaiting you during exploration.


FACE THE MONSTERS
Fight your way through enemies with a cyber whip or your reliable laser gun. At the end of each crypt, you will have to confront the powerful boss. Remember to replenish your gun ammunition or restore some health by destroying blocks, before going to battle.

Unlock new mode and save the world with Boss Rush+ DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Main story available in 2 difficulty levels: original and casual mode 
- The Lost Sequel featuring 6 extra chapters
- Real 8-bit graphics
- Console and handheld game versions
- Intense battles with bosses who await your arrival
- Nostalgic retro music with sounds of dying demons in the background
- Achievements and extra challenges

70070000022591.name: UNO™ Legacy Edition
70070000022591.description:
UNO™ Legacy Edition features the classic card game alongside three exciting DLCs:

UNO™: Play one of the most iconic games as you match cards by color, number, or symbol and play action cards to spice things up. Race against others to empty your hand before anyone else, and don’t forget to shout “UNO!” when you’re down to your last card!

UNO Flip!™ DLC: Elevate your UNO™ matches with a double-sided deck, introducing a competitive twist to the classic gameplay. Switch between the light and dark sides and get ready to spice things up with new action cards that are funnier than ever!

UNO™ 50th Anniversary DLC: Celebrate five decades of one of the most popular card games in style with this DLC and its gorgeous velvety cards. Plus, add a touch of flair with the special 50/50 card and its Gold Coin rule.

UNO Party! Mania™ DLC: For those craving chaos, UNO Party! Mania™ introduces 3 thrilling new action cards: the Point Taken, Wild Drawn Together, and Wild Pile Up cards. Brace yourself for bursts of laughter, nail-biting tension, and epic comebacks.

Whether it's a game night with friends or a solo adventure, UNO™ Legacy Edition promises endless hours of fun!

70070000022615.name: The GhostX : Sniper Simulator (Tactical Shooting & Eliminator) PREMIUM EDITION
70070000022615.intro: Get the Full Sniper Experience with the GhostX Bundle
70070000022615.description:
Discover the ultimate value with the GhostX Bundle, combining the intense main game with the thrilling DLC. Immerse yourself in the world of elite sniping, where each mission tests your precision and tactical skills in various dynamic environments.
This is a comprehensive Experience where get the full “GhostX” game and enhance it with the “GhostX wich New skins for military rifles” DLC. This bundle offers the complete package, providing hours of exhilarating gameplay and unique challenges.Take the shot. Conquer your missions. Elevate your gameplay. The GhostX Bundle is your gateway to the ultimate sniper adventure. 
Are you ready to prove your skills?

70070000022635.name: Hentai Golf Platinum Edition
70070000022635.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000022635.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with River's Edge and Sunset Pines DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000022637.name: WARZONE CHRONICLES - VIRTUAL WARFARE SHOOTER Premium Edition
70070000022637.intro: Night Vision and Endless Tension the Complete Survival Bundle Awaits.
70070000022637.description:
The Ultimate Survival Bundle offers a comprehensive and thrilling experience, combining the intense survival gameplay of the original Warzone Chronicles with the strategic depth and heightened tension of the Night Stalker DLC. Whether you're uncovering hidden weapons in the shadows or navigating the eerie darkness with night vision, every moment is a test of your survival instincts.
        Prepare for an unforgettable journey through the decaying corridors of the apocalypse, where every decision, every shot, and every narrow escape is etched into your own personal Warzone Chronicle. This bundle delivers a complete, adrenaline-fueled experience that will test your survival instincts and tactical prowess in a hauntingly immersive environment.

70070000022645.name: Crypt Stalker Extended Edition
70070000022645.intro: Protect your world from demons as one of legendary Crypt Stalkers.
70070000022645.description:
Crypt Stalker is an 8-bit retro-styled arcade game. Take on the role of Gladys, one of the descendants of the world's defenders, and stop the demons before they unleash hell on the planet. Explore and defend diverse locations such as pyramids, a lake of fire, or overgrown ruins from unearthly creatures.


EXPLORE THE CRYPTS
As a highly trained Stalker, your task is to search and overcome every danger standing in your way. Watch out for your surroundings - unstable stones, and moving platforms are just a few dangers awaiting you during exploration.


FACE THE MONSTERS
Fight your way through enemies with a cyber whip or your reliable laser gun. At the end of each crypt, you will have to confront the powerful boss. Remember to replenish your gun ammunition or restore some health by destroying blocks, before going to battle.

Unlock new missions and mode to save the world from the danger with Extra Quests and Boss Rush+ DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Main story available in 2 difficulty levels: original and casual mode 
- The Lost Sequel featuring 6 extra chapters
- Real 8-bit graphics
- Console and handheld game versions
- Intense battles with bosses who await your arrival
- Nostalgic retro music with sounds of dying demons in the background
- Achievements and extra challenges

70070000022655.name: Hole io: Warzone Edition
70070000022655.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the universe!
70070000022655.description:
Choose your favourite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Features:
- 7 maps with different things to swallow 
- 21 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning  during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000022661.name: Freaky Trip Amazing Edition
70070000022661.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000022661.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Summer, Fall and Spring Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000022662.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Director's Cut
70070000022662.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000022662.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes first and fifth Personal Boards DLC. 

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000022664.name: Bomb Cat Extended Edition
70070000022664.intro: Match ultra-fluffy cats to achieve the highest score and unleash chaos with Bomb Cat.
70070000022664.description:
Bomb Cat takes inspiration from classic 2048 games but elevates the challenge with an insane bomb mechanic. In other words, it’s pretty simple – match the fluffy cats carefully, and watch out – the bombastic Bomb Cat can either assist you or completely disrupt your game.


2048 MATCH GAME WITH A BANG… OR A BOMB?
There are eleven fluffy cats, starting with sweet tiny blue kitten babies to match together. Each cat has a different weight depending on its size. Your goal is to achieve the highest score without running out of space.

To increase the challenge, a Bomb Cat will occasionally appear... to activate this kitty’s ability, it needs to touch the Flamey Cat. That’s when the explosion’s countdown starts! 

Depending on the circumstances, the blast can help you match smaller cats, as they will jump around the box, or end your game, as the cats can pop out of the open parcel and fly into space. Just like typical cats.


BE A COMBO HERO
Take the challenge of making your score furry freaking best. The more cats you match, the bigger your combo, which translates to more points.

Placing the cats strategically will help you maximize your score.

Unlock new board with Summer Background DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Eleven colorful cats to match like in classic 2048
– Possibility of sending cats to the Moon and back
– One special cat – Cat Bomb to make the game more challenging
– Combo mechanic to make your score even better
– Easy controlling, but challenging gameplay (sometimes)
– Endless and addictive fun
– Enjoyable music, which you can always turn off
– Once again... CATS (No regrets, cats are superior to other animals; deal with it already)

70070000022680.name: Truck Simulator USA & ATV Monster Rally Bundle
70070000022680.intro: Double the Wheels, Double the Thrills. Two Epic Journeys but just One Bundle: Truck Simulator USA  & ATV Monster Rally Bundle!
70070000022680.description:
Experience the thrill of off-road racing and the adventure of long-haul trucking with our exclusive game bundle. Get behind the wheel of powerful ATVs or trucks and traverse diverse  landscapes with obstacles, in your favorite vehicles. This bundle brings together two dynamic simulators, offering endless hours of challenging and realistic gameplay.

ATV Monster Rally
	•	Navigate Obstacles: Tackle various terrains including dirt, sand, rocks, and mud.
	•	Real-life Physics: Enjoy challenging maneuvers with realistic physics under different weather conditions.
	•	Multiple Modes: Play single race, time trial, and career modes.
	•	Customization: Upgrade and personalize your ATVs for better performance and appearance.
	•	Competitive Features: Compete on leaderboards and earn achievements to track your progress.

Truck Simulator USA
	•	Diverse Truck Fleet: Choose from a variety of detailed trucks, each with unique handling.
	•	Open World: Explore a vast, realistic map inspired by American landscapes.
	•	Varied Missions: Complete diverse tasks to test and hone your driving skills.
	•	Truck Upgrades: Improve your truck with powerful engines, advanced transmissions, and more.
	•	Business Management: Expand your trucking empire by investing wisely.

This bundle offers the perfect combination for fans of off-road racing and long-haul trucking, providing a comprehensive and immersive simulation experience.

70070000022696.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Ultra Special
70070000022696.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000022696.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Winter, Summer and Volume 2 Mini Islands.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000022697.name: Hentai Girls Ultra Extended
70070000022697.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000022697.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Cleaning Yui, Waiting Shirayuki, Playful Etsuko and Kitty Shirayuki.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000022702.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash Director's Cut
70070000022702.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000022702.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently. 


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Tary's and Ta's Challenge DLCs added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios

70070000022703.name: AAA Clock Extreme GOTY Edition
70070000022703.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000022703.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 5 DLCs: the Elegant, Pixel, Squid, Spin and Digital Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000022704.name: Theft Ride Legacy Extended Edition
70070000022704.intro: Gear up for the ultimate treasure hunt on wheels!
70070000022704.description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-packed adventure in "Theft Ride Legacy"! 
BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Mission Pack" !

As a skilled motorcyclist, you'll navigate through abandoned warehouses to recover stolen loot from a bank heist. Using abandoned warehouses as your playground, dodge obstacles and race against the clock to collect as much loot as possible. 
Compete with friends in two-player mode to see who can become the ultimate loot hunter. 
With thrilling gameplay, challenging levels and the excitement of the chase, this game is perfect for anyone looking for a heart-pumping challenge.

Get ready to embark on an action-packed journey and become the ultimate loot hunter!

70070000022743.name: Adrenaline Collection Pack
70070000022743.intro: Discover 4 unique games to release adrenaline!
70070000022743.description:
Adrenaline Collection Pack is a pack of unique videogames with which you will be able to waste adrenaline. Speed, shooting, action, skidding and reflexes are the sauce of this pack that includes successful games such as:

- FAR S Ultra
- Micro Pico Racers
- Green Phoenix
- Skyland Rush

70070000022744.name: Think or Die Collection Pack
70070000022744.intro: Discover 4 games to rack your brain!
70070000022744.description:
Think or Die Collection Pack is a pack of unique video games with which you can push your brain to the limit and test your visual dexterity. Puzzles, spatial vision, jumps, strategy and visual speed are the sauce of this pack that includes successful games such as:

- Bleep Bloop
- Defentron
- The Flea
- Joe Jump

70070000022745.name: Zerouno Games Collection Pack 1
70070000022745.description:
Zerouno Games Collection Pack 1 is a pack of 9 unique video games published by the independent game publisher Zerouno Games. With this fantastic pack you can squeeze your brain to the limit, waste adrenaline and test your visual dexterity. Puzzles, spatial vision, speed, shooting, action, skidding, reflexes, jumps, music, strategy and visual speed are the sauce of this pack that includes successful games such as:

- Metal Tales Overkill
- Bleep Bloop
- Defentron
- The Flea
- Joe Jump
- FAR S Ultra
- Micro Pico Racers
- Green Phoenix
- Skyland Rush

Discover unique titles, from unique creators. A Must-Have!

70070000022746.name: Garten of Banban Bundle: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4
70070000022746.intro: Start your journey with Garten of Banban the proper way with this comprehensive bundle containing Garten of Banban 1, 2, 3 & 4! Dive right in and you're sure to make some friends!
70070000022746.description:
Explore the abandoned underground levels of Banban's Kindergarten in Garten of Banban 1, 2, 3, 4. Delve into the bizarre, suspiciously abandoned underground facility in search of your missing child. Can you find them before the facility's residents find you?

The Banban And Friends Gang:
Banban’s Kindergarten has earned a special place in every kid’s heart. The reason for this is the Banban And Friends Gang, which are the establishment’s mascots and icons. At Banban’s Kindergarten, nobody’s lonely thanks to them!

Banban’s Kindergarten, the dream place of every child:
Banban’s Kindergarten was once the go-to kindergarten for any parent who needed their children to attend a reputable learning facility. This was the case until everybody within the place suddenly vanished on a seemingly normal day, and now you must explore the establishment and find out what happened.

Explore with your flying companion:
Everything's better when you have a friend to share with. Use your handy drone to help you navigate and proceed through the facility, as well as have it keep you company when you are feeling lonely and scared, which you will be feeling a lot.

Survive the abandoned lower levels of Banban’s Kindergarten:
With no direction to go but down, you are forced to delve into even deeper levels of the mysterious establishment that is Banban’s kindergarten. Little do you know, you are heading down to where no human has been for quite some time…

FEATURES
• Sense of 4boding - There are no humans here but it doesn’t mean you’re alone
• Drone 4ce - Escape the facility with the help of your trusty drone
• 4get all you know - Use your head, solve the puzzles, and progress through the underworld
• Push through - You’re getting somewhere now, don’t get cold feet

70070000022747.name: Garten of Banban Bundle: 1 + 2
70070000022747.intro: Start your adventure with Garten of Banban the right way with this elegant bundle containing Garten of Banban & Garten of Banban 2! Dive right in and you're sure to make some friends!
70070000022747.description:
Explore the abandoned underground levels of Banban's Kindergarten in Garten of Banban 1 & 2. Delve into the bizarre, suspiciously abandoned underground facility in search of your missing child. Can you find them before the facility's residents find you?

The Banban And Friends Gang:
Banban’s Kindergarten has earned a special place in every kid’s heart. The reason for this is the Banban And Friends Gang, which are the establishment’s mascots and icons. At Banban’s Kindergarten, nobody’s lonely thanks to them!

Banban’s Kindergarten, the dream place of every child:
Banban’s Kindergarten was once the go-to kindergarten for any parent who needed their children to attend a reputable learning facility. This was the case until everybody within the place suddenly vanished on a seemingly normal day, and now you must explore the establishment and find out what happened.

Explore with your flying companion:
Everything's better when you have a friend to share with. Use your handy drone to help you navigate and proceed through the facility, as well as have it keep you company when you are feeling lonely and scared, which you will be feeling a lot.

FEATURES
• Double the Garten, double the Banban - Make even more friends… and enemies
• Flying support - Escape the facility with the help of your trusty drone
• Remember your lesson - Get past the mindbending puzzles with nothing but your wit and reflexes
• Don’t flinch - Are you brave enough to make it through the whole game?

70070000022748.name: Garten of Banban Bundle: 3 + 4
70070000022748.intro: Continue your Garten of Banban journey with this elegant bundle containing Garten of Banban 3 & Garten of Banban 4! Dive deeper into the facility! Will you find your missing child?
70070000022748.description:
Continue where Garten of Banban 2 left off and explore the mysterious establishment which turned out to be bigger than anyone could’ve thought! Avoid the unpleasant residents of the facility, make friends with ones who aren’t out to get you, and find your child.

Can you make it in time and escape with your life?

The Banban And Friends Gang:
Banban’s Kindergarten has earned a special place in every kid’s heart. The reason for this is the Banban And Friends Gang, which are the establishment’s mascots and icons. At Banban’s Kindergarten, nobody’s lonely thanks to them!

Explore further into the depths of Banban’s Kindergarten:
The depths of the mysterious establishment that is Banban’s Kindergarten turned out to be much bigger than anyone could have thought, with many floors having been built underneath the seemingly innocent Kindergarten explored in the first game. With friends being present at every turn, you have no choice but to continue delving deeper into the place in hopes of finding your child.

Turns out, making friends is not that easy!
Despite the number of opportunities you have had to make friends, you still fail every time. But with you delving even deeper into the establishment, perhaps you will find more success down in the lower levels. In Banban’s Kindergarten, there are friends to be made in every corner!

FEATURES
• Sense of 4boding - There are no humans here but it doesn’t mean you’re alone
• Drone 4ce - Escape the facility with the help of your trusty drone
• 4get all you know - Use your head, solve the puzzles, and progress through the underworld
• Push through - You’re getting somewhere now, don’t get cold feet

70070000022755.name: Frozen Honey ASMR: Sleek Edition
70070000022755.intro: Enjoy making your frozen honey jelly desserts from scratch in the most satisfying ASMR game!
70070000022755.description:
Choose your favorite bottle, mix all ingredients, freeze it, and squeeze out the frozen honey jelly!

You are the owner of a frozen honey truck, and people can't get enough of your tasty honey desserts! Start the cooking adventure by choosing the bottle shape, adding candies, pouring colorful honey, and mixing it up. After that, put the stencil on the bottle, pop it into the fridge, and enjoy the sounds of the frozen honey. Sweet, soft, and incredibly tasty – frozen honey jelly has never been this much fun!

Features:
- unlock a brand new truck, change its look with 3 unique skins and put a special sign on top!
- spend additional 2000 coins in the shop
- create fabulous and colorful frozen honey jelly desserts!
- let your imagination run wild using different sweets, honey colors, bottle shapes, and stencils! 
- meet the demands of your customers
- enjoy the ASMR sounds while preparing your delicious frozen honey!
- perform special tasks of collector, achiever, gamer and purchaser
- serve unique VIP characters
- customize your truck using various skins, signs, and truck shapes
- use skins to change the look of your equipment
- earn money to spend it in the store on skins, bottles, candies, and more!
- watch your customers eat the frozen honey jelly desserts you have prepared and wait for their reactions! 

Watch the ASMR rainbow jelly dance and swirl into the perfect frozen honey dessert In this game, you're the mastermind behind the sensational frozen honey jelly treats that everyone loves on social media!

Explore the joy of experimenting with various candies and colorful syrups to create your own satisfying frozen honey. It's not just a game – it's an interactive journey that combines jelly with the joy of crafting!

Dive into the pleasures of crafting, innovating, and experiencing the captivating charm of the Frozen Honey ASMR game!

70070000022767.name: Piano: Learn and Play Ultra Legendary
70070000022767.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000022767.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes fourth and fifth Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000022768.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Platinum
70070000022768.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000022768.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes three new characters - an adorable swimming dragon, a super-sweet red panda and clownfish.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000022769.name: One Night: Burlesque Happy Edition
70070000022769.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000022769.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle, you can learn about the creation stories of Holly, Liz, and the Club Crowd by accessing the artbook from the game menu.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000022771.name: nGolf Complete Edition
70070000022771.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000022771.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Change the appearance and visuals with Colorful Golf Balls 4 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000022772.name: Cat Piano Special Edition
70070000022772.intro: Start the whisker-tickling Fun with Cat Piano.
70070000022772.description:
Cat Piano is the ultimate cat-tastic piano game designed especially for kids! Dive into a world of whimsical melodies and playful paw prints as you unleash your inner feline musician.


PURR-FECT PIANO PLAY
Cat Piano is a delightful piano version where kids can create music using charming cat sounds instead of traditional piano notes. Each paw print on the piano produces a different tone of cat sound, allowing children to compose their own tunes with a touch of feline flair.


PAWS FOR CREATIVITY
The only limit is your imagination! Challenge yourself to replicate your favorite songs using only cat sounds. Whether you're composing a gentle lullaby or a lively tune to get the whole family dancing, Cat Piano provides endless opportunities for creative expression.

Are you ready to unleash your inner feline musician? Let the whisker-tickling fun begin with Cat Piano!

Change adorable cats that accompany you while playing piano with Background Pack 4 DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Playful piano game featuring adorable cat sounds
- Different backgrounds with lovely cats
- Unlimited opportunities for creative expression and musical exploration
- Super option to show your kid different sounds

70070000022773.name: Hotel Hustle Extended Edition
70070000022773.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000022773.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE 
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from the Artbook Part 3 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts

70070000022775.name: S.N.I.P.E.R - Hunter Scope - Tactical Arsenal
70070000022775.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

This bundle includes base game, Weaponry Upgrade and Neon Strike with:

-PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm 
-FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation 
-SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy 
-SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
-UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
-SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

70070000022806.name: Sprout Valley Summer Edition
70070000022806.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000022806.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Make your island even more cozy and visit new biomes with Summer DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000022808.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.5
70070000022808.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the fifth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000022812.name: Monster Jam™ Showdown - Big Air Edition
70070000022812.description:
Feel the adrenaline rush with Monster Jam™ Showdown - Big Air Edition! Get the full game and the Season Pass with its amazing content, as soon as it becomes available.

MASTER THE MOST ICONIC TRUCKS
The excitement of real-life Monster Jam™ events is ready to explode, thanks to the franchise's most recognizable icons: the trucks. Grave Digger™, El Toro Loco™, Megalodon™ and many others... Drive the hottest rides in Monster Jam™ racing the current fleet, the legendary history-making trucks, and the wildest fictional beasts from the toy universe. Unlock dozens of trucks and collect countless different liveries!

OFF-ROAD ARCADE RACING FUN
Dive into a unique arcade racing experience made of thrilling off-road races and cool tricks. Squeeze your boost to demolish your opponents, then crash, twist, and distress the environment to gain even more power. Whether you're a hardcore Monster Jam™ fan or an arcade game enthusiast, this title is primed to deliver immediate driving sensations and an accessible dual-steering racing experience.

FREESTYLE WITH STYLE
Balance your truck with the perfect wheelie, eat some dirt doing crisp donuts, or reach the sky performing the greatest big air ever. The bottom line is: get ready to defy gravity in freestyle mode! Launch yourself into insane jumps, flips & stunts, ruling the leaderboards and becoming a trick master! 

SHOW WHO'S THE BOSS IN THE SHOWDOWN TOUR
Start your career in the Showdown Tour! A non-linear adventure that will take you racing across various game modes, both in sport venues and wild nature. Beat your opponents and unlock new trucks, liveries, and perks. Who's the boss now?

RACE THE WILDERNESS
Racing and jumping in stadiums and arenas is cool, but sometimes you just want to go a bit off-track, right? So, get ready to drive through the most spectacular untamed environments. Racing through the Death Valley's dust, the forests of Colorado and the Alaskan ice. But watch out, Mother Nature is always lurking: sandstorms, thunderstorms and blizzards are going to make things even wilder!

TONS OF GAME MODES
Monster Jam™ Showdown lets you unleash your sickest tricks and your off-road racing skills among several game modes! Play the original events in the official Monster Jam™'s inspired stadiums, or go beyond reality with stunts and maneuvers that push the boundaries of what's possible, even for the most skilled driver. Racing on circuits, avoiding crashes on Figure 8 tracks, or surviving Horde races. But also performing in the Best Trick or the Extreme Freestyle mode! 
It's time to master them all: to kick off your career and challenge with your friends, even in split screen mode.

All content included in Season Pass will be released by February 2025.

70070000022823.name: CONSCRIPT - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000022823.description:
The Deluxe Edition of CONSCRIPT contains:
• CONSCRIPT base game
• Trench Raider Pack

Trench Raider Pack:
Battle through the trenches with 3 additional uniforms to choose from in the Trench Raider Pack, containing:
• Elite Trench Raider
• Pilot
• English Tommy

70070000022831.name: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed - Pre-Order
70070000022831.intro: Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed brings the magic of Disney to life in a vibrant 3D platformer.
70070000022831.description:
This beautiful remake sends Mickey Mouse on an epic journey through Wasteland, a realm of forgotten Disney characters. As Mickey, you will dive into a fantastical world and, armed with paint and thinner, shape your adventure and the fate of this alternate world.

Every stroke of your magic brush matters! Use paint to restore beauty and harmony or thinner to alter your environment and uncover hidden secrets. Your choices influence Mickey's destiny and change the outcome of this artistic odyssey. Will you become the epic hero Wasteland needs?

Encounter various iconic characters like Oswald the Lucky Rabbit, Walt Disney’s first creation, as you travel between lands in Wasteland. Collect virtual Disney pins, tackle creative challenges, and uncover secrets, all while exploring classic platforming levels inspired by animated films and shorts.

Originally envisioned by Warren Spector, reimagined by Purple Lamp, Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed employs state-of-the-art visuals and improved controls to breathe new life into a beloved classic. Experience new movement skills for Mickey, such as dash, ground pound and sprinting. The game’s compelling story makes it an unforgettable adventure for long-time fans and newcomers alike. Join Mickey Mouse and unravel the mysteries of Wasteland in this homage to Disney's legacy.

Pre-Order Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed now and receive the Costume Pack including Steam Boat Willie, Football, and Brave Little Tailor FOR FREE!

Preorder bonus: 
- early access 24 hours 
- Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed - Costume Pack

70070000022846.name: Hentai World Ultra Ultimate
70070000022846.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose, and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000022846.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet students Sayuri, Rose in kitty costume and Akane in fox costume. 

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 art pieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000022847.name: PAWfectly Designed Deluxe Edition
70070000022847.intro: Unleash your creativity and help design a dream space for each of your furry friends!
70070000022847.description:
Bundle includes "Extra Mission"!

Step into the charming paws of exceptionally talented interior designer doggie with a flair for creativity and an eye for detail. Your mission? To help your furry friends design their dream rooms, a cozy space where they can develop their passions.

Embark on a delightful journey across15 different project tasks with an interesting story, each presenting unique design challenges and opportunities to unleash your creativity. From the room of a great film director, bakery smelling of fresh baked goods, laboratory of a brilliant inventor to the gallery of a funny circus performer, every level offers a fresh canvas to showcase your interior design prowess.

"PAWfectly Designed" combines the joy of interior design with the charm of a delightful story, offering endless opportunities for creativity and imagination. Provides a fun and enriching experience for all aspiring interior designer.

• 15 Levels: Each level presents a new room and a unique story, from helping a cat friend create a dream recording studio to designing a inventor's laboratory for a chimp.
• Extensive Furniture Collection: Choose from a vast array of furniture and decor items, including chairs, tables, potted plants, various accessories and wall art.
• Intuitive Controls: Easily place and arrange furniture.
• Free Building Mode: Unleash your imagination and decorate rooms as you like.

70070000022851.name: nPaint Ultra Platinum
70070000022851.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000022851.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes the second and seventh gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000022861.name: Tell Me Your Story Special Edition
70070000022861.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000022861.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD 

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

Discover the process of creating characters and locations with the Amelia and Peanut Artbooks included in this bundle.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience

70070000022862.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Deluxe Edition
70070000022862.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000022862.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #1 and Custom Cruisers #2 with:

- new skins

70070000022863.name: Life Bubble: Gear Up Edition
70070000022863.intro: Hey there astronaut! Get ready for your biggest space adventure with the most powerful tools!
70070000022863.description:
Embark on an exciting journey to explore new planets, collect valuable resources, and rescue lost astronauts!

Your mission is to expand your life bubble across the planet and repair your ship to continue your adventure into the unknown! 

Features:
- travel through beautiful and mysterious planets, each with unique resources and terrains
- collect valuable raw materials to rebuild machines and bridges
- use your new Golden Tool, which has increased resource extraction power!
- explore different areas and expand your life bubble over places where it is impossible to survive! 
- buy various character upgrades: bag, speed, life, tools, and power using your 10000 additional money immediately! 
- buy machine upgrades to increase its storage capacity 
- fight enemies with your power weapon!
- complete missions for extra money!

Chop wood, mine colorful crystals or diamonds, and use them to rebuild machines and bridges that will help you expand your life bubble area! Every construction needs specific raw materials, so search for their deposits and get to work!

Complete missions or sell resources you don't need in order to buy character and machine upgrades. Improve your abilities and tools to explore the planet fully prepared!

Be ready for obstacles along the way. Enemies are out to conquer your tiny universe. Protect your life bubble miniature world and fight back like a true space cowboy!

Prepare yourself for a unique and unforgettable space adventure!

70070000022867.name: Color Water Sort: Complete Edition
70070000022867.intro: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!
70070000022867.description:
Use your head and arrange colored liquids to solve unique puzzles!  

Master the art of water sorting and rise to the top as a champion! Strategically move the water until every color is separated, proving your puzzle-solving prowess!  

Features: 
- face over 10000 levels!!!
- unlock 27 new tubes, 12 new wallpapers and 15 new caps!
- play in three game modes: classic, timed, and hard 
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!  
- give your brain an excellent workout  
- use additional powerups: 35 hints, 25 undo, and 10 extra tubes
- spend 25000 extra coins in the customization tab!
- collect keys and open prize chests 

Immerse yourself in the challenge of sorting water into tubes with the same colored liquid on top. Remember, the tubes can't be full for the water to go in. Plan your moves carefully to avoid losing!  

Complete thousands of levels in 3 different modes: 
• Classic - a standard mode where you can relax
• Timed - move fast and complete the level within the time limit 
• Hard - think about your every move, because you have a limited number of them

Enjoy this colorful brain challenge by yourself or against your friend!

70070000022882.name: [Summer Version] Special Skins Expansion Pack
70070000022882.description:
Up your enjoyment of Suika Game with this exclusive summer skin set!

"Sunset beach","Summer holiday","Sunflower farm","Fireworks display"

- 38 interchangeable fruit parts
- New designs for Poppy and boxes (4 types)
- Background skins (4 types)

70070000022901.name: Urban Flow Capital Commute
70070000022901.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000022901.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, London Rules and Streets Supplement #2 with:

•   Play 10 new stages!
•   Introducing 5 new vehicles to the streets of Urban Flow, each one unique and with its own style.

70070000022905.name: ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - Original Aircraft Series Set
70070000022905.description:
This is a special set that contains 3 original aircraft.
As a bonus, it also includes 20 emblems and 12 skins.

Original Aircraft Series Set includes:

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - ASF-X Shinden II Set
• Playable Aircraft: ASF-X Shinden II
A cutting-edge support fighter built to handle a variety of situations.
This aircraft can equip the 6AAM, RKT, or LASM as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Nagase skin.

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - XFA-27 Set
• Playable Aircraft: XFA-27
A carrier-based stealth fighter designed for ultimate performance.
This aircraft can equip the SOD, MSTM, or IEWS as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Scarface skin.

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - CFA-44 Nosferatu Set
• Playable Aircraft: CFA-44 Nosferatu
A next-generation carrier-based stealth fighter optimized for sol• raids.
This aircraft can equip the ADMM, EML, or IEWS as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Strigon skin.

Special Bonus Set:
20 Emblems
• 2 Nugget emblems commemorating the 25th anniversary of the ACE COMBAT series
• 5 in-game squadron emblems, including Ghost and Golem (Low-Vis)
• 13 emblems from other games in the series, including Nagase and Butterfly Master
12 Skins
12 skins from ACE COMBAT ZERO THE BELKAN WAR, including F-15C Eagle Cipher Skin and Rafale M Espada Skin

*Each of the aircraft sets is also sold separately.
*Skins and emblems can be viewed by choosing Select a Skin, or Select Emblem respectively.
*Skins and emblems can only be changed in campaign mode after completing campaign mode once.
*In multiplayer mode, skins and emblems can be changed from the beginning.

70070000022906.name: ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - Experimental Aircraft Series Set
70070000022906.description:
This is a special set that contains 3 original aircraft.
As a bonus, it also includes 10 emblems and 10 skins.

The Experimental Aircraft Series Set includes:

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F-15 S/MTD Set
• Playable Aircraft: F-15 S/MTD
This new-and-improved experimental F-15 is equipped with 2D thrust vectoring nozzles and large canards for increased air combat maneuverability.
This aircraft can equip the HPAA, FAEB, or HVAA as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Sorcerer Skin.

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F-16XL Set
• Playable Aircraft: F-16XL
A prototype bomber based on the F-16.
This aircraft can equip the UGB, 4AAM, or 4AGM as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Wizard Skin.

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - FB-22 Strike Raptor Set
• Playable Aircraft: FB-22 Strike Raptor
A stealth fighter based on the F-22 with improved explosive firepower.
This aircraft can equip the XSDB, LAAM, or SFFS as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Flash Skin.

Special Bonus Set:
10 Emblems
• 4 Nugget emblems commemorating the 25th anniversary of the ACE COMBAT series
• 6 emblems from other games in the series, including Albireo and Beast
10 Skins
10 skins from enemy squadrons in the series,
including CFA-44 Butterfly Master Skin and Su-37 Ofnir Skin.

*Each of the aircraft sets is also sold separately.
*Skins and emblems can be viewed by choosing Select a Skin, or Select Emblem respectively.
*Skins and emblems can only be changed in campaign mode after completing campaign mode once.
*In multiplayer mode, skins and emblems can be changed from the beginning.

70070000022907.name: ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - Cutting-Edge Aircraft Series Set
70070000022907.description:
This is a special set that contains 3 original aircraft.
As a bonus, it also includes 10 emblems and 13 skins.

Cutting-Edge Aircraft Series Set includes:

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F/A-18F Super Hornet Block III Set
• Playable Aircraft: F/A-18F Super Hornet Block III 
A modernized carrier-based fighter modeled after the F/A-18.
This aircraft can equip the LACM, 8AGM, or 4AAM as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Aggressor Splitter Skin.

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - F-2A -Super Kai- Set
• Playable Aircraft: F-2A -Super Kai-
A modernized multirole support fighter based on the F-2.
This aircraft can equip the LASM, 6AAM, or IEWS as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Tiger Skin.

ACE COMBAT™ 7: SKIES UNKNOWN - MiG-35D Super Fulcrum Set
• Playable Aircraft: MiG-35D Super Fulcrum
A multirole jet fighter developed as a variant of the MiG-29.
This aircraft can equip the SAAM, 6AAM, or 4AGM as its special weapon.
• Includes 7 skins, including the special Tiger Skin.

Special Bonus Set: 
10 Emblems
• 4 Nugget emblems commemorating the 25th anniversary of the ACE COMBAT series
• 4 emblems from Air Combat 22, an older game in the series
• 2 emblems from other games in the series, including Mobius 1
13 Skins
13 skins from main or enemy squadrons in the series,
including F/A-18F General Resource Skin and Su-57 Scarface Skin.
13 original colors, including ADFX-01 Glowing Red Skin.

*Each of the aircraft sets is also sold separately.
*Skins and emblems can be viewed by choosing Select a Skin, or Select Emblem respectively.
*Skins and emblems can only be changed in campaign mode after completing campaign mode once.
*In multiplayer mode, skins and emblems can be changed from the beginning.

70070000022909.name: Gas Station Simulator and Can Touch This DLC Bundle
70070000022909.intro: Buy an abandoned gas station and restore it to its full glory. Renovate, upgrade and expand upon the offered services to keep up with your clients demands.
70070000022909.description:
Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it to its former glory. Get rid of debris and broken furniture, fix up the walls, paint and decorate the place to your liking. Just don’t spend all your cash on the looks right away, you bought a gas station after all. Repair the equipment, buy what can’t be repaired and start serving your customers to earn money for further renovations and improvements.

Rebuild & Reconstruct!
Take matters into your own hand. Almost literally. With the help of your new, trusty hammer, 
it's time to redecorate like you've never done before. Refurbish walls to your heart's content, 
changing their features and decor as you see fit. Decide where to put trash cans or where to 
move the cash register to. Direct the crowd. Show your customers the right way to orderly 
queue without taking too much space. It's time to take interior customisation to a completely 
new level.
Paint & Spray!
No need to stare at an empty canvas any longer! Grab your spray can and add a little 
personal touch to any surface you can lay your hands on. With adjustable scale and rotation,
you can spray anything from large murals to tiny easter eggs hidden somewhere in the 
corners of your station. Combine existing decals with each other, creating even more 
elaborate and complex pieces of art. And whenever you start feeling like you're running out, 
more designs lie hidden all around for you to unlock!

70070000022917.name: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess Deluxe Edition
70070000022917.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess?! In this visual novel divinely beautiful girls will steal your heart!
70070000022917.description:
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!


WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?
While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?


LET THEM CHARM YOU
During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?


ONLY ONE WINNER
Despite the beauty and charm of all the girls, only one will be able to win the competition. Which one of them will impress you enough to award her the golden apple? Are you going to go with your heart or will you play fair?

And most importantly: will you find love in Love Elysium?

The Aimi's Secrets DLC included in this bundle, will allow you to spend even more time with her and get to know her better.

KEY FEATURES:
- An amazing story waiting for you
- 5 endings to discover = 5x more gameplay
- Unique personalities and temperaments of the girls
- Many dialogue options you can choose from
- Breathtaking island full of magical places
- Different reactions of girls depending on what you say

70070000022930.name: Tokyo Cooking Extended Edition
70070000022930.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70070000022930.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.

Decorate your restaurant with the Majestic Fuji Set DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000022936.name: Hentai Solitaire Deluxe Edition
70070000022936.intro: Pull an ace out of your pocket and check what challenges await you!
70070000022936.description:
Dive into a charming world full of cards and girls with Hentai Solitaire. Play the most iconic card game and practice your skills all along. Switch between cards, think about your next move and try to organize your deck from ace to king. 


ONE DECK TWO MODES
Test yourself in two available modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire. Try out both of them and check if you manage to complete them with no trouble. If you feel like you are stuck you can always go back or ask for a little help to receive a small hint.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
At any point of the game you can change the appearance of your deck. Simply choose one out of the ten amazing girls waiting for you and enjoy your new cover. 

Unlock new covers for your deck with Cards Pack 1 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Each playthrough is a new challenge
- 2 game modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire
- 10 stunning girls on covers
- Relaxing soundtrack

70070000022946.name: Hentai Golf Director's Cut
70070000022946.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000022946.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' stunning outfits with Lakeside Fairways and Sunset Pines DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000022947.name: Hentai Stars Magnificent Edition
70070000022947.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000022947.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Shy Fox Ayame and Singing Fox Ayame DLC.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000022950.name: nZen Premium Edition
70070000022950.intro: Find your inner peace by relaxing with nZen.
70070000022950.description:
nZen will help you on your journey to finding yourself and understanding the world around you. Begin your contemplation, clear your mind, and let nZen guide you through the unexplored areas of your mind.


IDENTIFY YOUR GOAL
Select one of the available inspirational programs prepared for various occasions. During each of them, you will be able to focus on a voice that will help you achieve your goal. Focusing on the energy flowing through your body or stimulating your creativity are just two examples of how nZen can help you.


CALMING SOUNDS
During your sessions, you can switch between two available background noises that will help you relax. A harmonious melody or the sounds of waves breaking against the shore. Choose the one that soothes you more and drift away into the depths of your mind.

Find you inner peace with additional Life Purpose Reflection and Transcendental Journey DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- 5 different inspirational programs
- Calming background sounds
- Motivational quotes that will help you achieve your goal

70070000022965.name: Touhou: New World + Story DLC Bundle
70070000022965.intro: A bundle that includes the base game for Touhou: New World and the Gensokyo Dreaming DLC!
70070000022965.description:
A bundle that includes the base game for Touhou: New World and the Gensokyo Dreaming DLC!

<Touhou: New World>
Explore the world of Gensokyo in this bullet hell action RPG adventure! Weave through barrages of bullets while taking down enemies using an expansive repertoire of explosive skills.

<Gensokyo Dreaming DLC>
◆New Scenario
Experience a brand-new story from the perspective of Sumireko Usami. After the appearance of the evil spirit Mima, Sumireko travels throughout Gensokyo gathering allies to face this new threat!

◆Additional Playable Characters
The following Touhou favorites will be added to the game as playable characters:
Sumireko Usami
Koishi Komeiji
Reisen Udongein Inaba
Youmu Konpaku
Remilia Scarlet
Sakuya Izayoi
Flandre Scarlet
Yukkuri Reimu

◆New Stages
Hop aboard abandoned trains, visit stations enshrouded by fog, venture through factories once used by the kappa, and even find yourself exploring the inside of a UFO! Get ready to experience newly added areas like Youkai Mountain, Genbu Ravine, Remains of Blazing Hell, and the Ice Cavern to expand your adventures in Gensokyo.

◆New Boss Characters
A slew of new enemies and bosses make an appearance too! Defeat the daunting foes that stand in your way and bring peace back to Gensokyo.

70070000022995.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Ultra Premium
70070000022995.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000022995.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Winter, Spring and Autumn Islands.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000022999.name: Hentai Girls Ultra Special
70070000022999.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000022999.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Cleaning Yui, Waiting Shirayuki, Playful Etsuko and Puppy Yui.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000023005.name: Uzzuzzu My Pet - Golf Dash GOTY Edition
70070000023005.intro: Swing into action and tee off on the craziest golf course ever with Uzzuzzu pack!
70070000023005.description:
Meet your new golf buddies, grab a club, and embark on a hilariously absurd golfing journey through the most ridiculous places.


SWAP BALLS FOR BANANAS, TEE OFF AND LET THE CRAZINESS BEGIN!
In Uzzuzzu’s universe, everything can be a golf ball. Sausage, egg, tuna – everything you can think of… Check with Boo what other surprises are waiting for you, and be aware of the item shape, because every “golf ball” bounces differently. 


MORE THAN AN ORDINARY GOLF ROUND
You won’t experience only casual levels in this game. Running away from enormous basketball or defending your friends from danger as a hot dog. Not to mention traps on your way like falling crates, moving knives or even bursts of pressure.


GO WITH THE FLOW
After you complete a certain amount of levels, you will earn a badge. It allows you to track your progress, and make a step forward into collecting all the trophies! Kung will be proud if you can make your collection extra shiny.

Test your skills in Kung's, Boo's and Tary's Challenge DLCs added to this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 well-known, adorable characters like Tary or Ta
- Over 70 challenging levels to beat
- 60 FPS on Nintendo Switch™ console
- Funky and twirky soundtrack
- Lots of humor and funny scenarios

70070000023009.name: AAA Clock Extreme Happy Edition
70070000023009.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000023009.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 5 DLCs: the Elegant, Pixel, Cyber, Happy and Spin Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000023016.name: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream Deluxe Edition
70070000023016.description:
Pre-order and get the following content:
- Demon King Costume Set
- 3 day Early Access

*Contents and specifications are subject to change without notice.
*The bonus costume set may be distributed at a later date.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
• SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream
• Character Pass Vol.1
- DLC 1 Worlds Beyond 1
- DLC 2 Worlds Beyond 2
- Character Pass Vol. 1 Bonus: Bonus Stamp Set
• Prism Heart Costume Set

SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream is an exciting new start as we depart from the 10th anniversary of the SWORD ART ONLINE game series!

Time and space, displaced
Galaxia, a new system allowing players to relive the past, has been added to ALfheim Online; however, Galaxia spins out of control causing players from all over time and space to be displaced! To set the timeline back on track, Kirito must work with fallen friends...and foes.

Choose your character and join the fight
Each with their own specific role on the battlefield, 21 SAO characters from various arcs are gathered to fight. Team up with a total of 20 players from around the world in 1 of 5 parties comprised of 4 players each for multiplayer co-op action!

Defeat high difficulty bosses in Raids
True to the SWORD ART ONLINE series, join a raid party and prepare for a fight with high difficulty bosses together! How you prepare for the fight is the key to victory!

*This product also includes content that may be sold individually. Please take care not to make duplicate purchases.
