*The bonus costumes can be equipped on the SKIN tab of the CUSTOMIZE screen, which will be opened after clearing Story > Chapter 1 > Quest 1.

*The bonus may be distributed at a later date.

70070000023031.name: S.N.I.P.E.R - Hunter Scope - Legacy Edition
70070000023031.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

This bundle includes base game, Elite Arsenal and Neon Strike with:

- RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition 
- SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements 
- SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
- SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology  
-SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
-UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
-SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

70070000023032.name: Knights & Guns: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle
70070000023032.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000023032.description:
Knights and Guns: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle
Arm yourself for epic battles with the Knights and Guns: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle. Unleash new weapons and don fortified armors as you embark on legendary quests through mystical lands filled with formidable foes.

This bundle includes:

- Expansion Pack
- Expansion Pack #2
- Armor Pack #1
- Armor Pack #2
- Armor Pack #3

70070000023033.name: Urban Flow: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle
70070000023033.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000023033.description:
Urban Flow: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle

Navigate the urban jungle with greater complexity with the Urban Flow: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle. Tackle new intersections and seasonal challenges across diverse cityscapes, testing your strategic planning and reflexes in ever-revolving traffic chaos.

This bundle includes:

- Expansion Pack
- Winter Expansion Pack
- London Rules
- Streets Supplement
- Streets Supplement #2

70070000023034.name: Moto Rush GT: 4 in 1 DLC Bundle
70070000023034.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000023034.description:
Moto Rush GT: 4 in 1 DLC Bundle
Accelerate your adrenaline rush with the Moto Rush GT: 4 in 1 DLC Bundle. Race through new thrilling tracks and mix it up with new vahicles, each designed to deliver high-octane experiences and unparalleled fun.

This bundle includes:

- Expansion Pack
- Grip Collection
- Grip Collection#2
- Full Garage

70070000023041.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle
70070000023041.description:
S.N.I.P.E.R. Hunter Scope: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle
Sharpen your precision and tactics with the S.N.I.P.E.R. Hunter Scope: 5 in 1 DLC Bundle. Gear up with an arsenal of new weapons, advanced gear, and strategic maps, designed to challenge your sharpshooting skill at every turn.

This bundle includes:

- Expansion Pack
- Weaponry Upgrade
- Elite Arsenal
- Target Acquired
- Neon Strike

70070000023044.name: Gravity Circuit Deluxe Edition
70070000023044.intro: Celebrate Gravity Circuit's first anniversary with this deluxe edition!
70070000023044.description:
This Bundle contains:
•Gravity Circuit Full Game:
The flashy action packed 2D platformer in the spirit of console classics.
Engage in intense combat, perform powerful combos, and battle the Virus Army.
•Gravity Circuit: Jukebox - Interactive OST:
-Relive the Adventure: Listen to the 43 tracks composed by Dominic Ninmark.
-Experience the soundtrack of Gravity Circuit in an interactive and well-designed format. 
Celebrate the anniversary of Gravity Circuit with this deluxe bundle. Whether you’re reliving the adventure or discovering it for the first time, this bundle provides the full Gravity Circuit experience.

70070000023053.name: Baking Time: Powerful Edition
70070000023053.intro: Satisfy your cooking fever and love for pastries with the help of new strong animals!
70070000023053.description:
Stack all kinds of mouth-watering baked goods, from croissants to cookie hearts and everything in between! 

Grab your spatula, lift the baked goods out of the oven, and put them on display so that customers can buy them! With a steady stream of hungry customers waiting in line, it's up to you to deliver their orders quickly and efficiently!

Features:
- Bake over 30 different pastries that your customers won't resist!
- Collect baked goods with a spatula and put them on the display to sell them!
- Operate the cash register and satisfy your customers' appetites!
- Use your diamonds to unlock 32 new cute and strong pets that will help carry the weight of your pastries!
- Earn tons of money to unlock new levels of your bakery!
- Hire staff to help you collect the baked goods much faster!
- Upgrade your character and workers to walk faster or carry more pastries!
- Perform baker's tasks and claim your rewards
- Prepare baked goods for special large orders!
- Feed your cookie monsters to get money each second
- Use the teleport to move faster between levels
- Get caught up in the cooking fever and try not to get hungry! 

Satisfy your customers and earn money that you can spend to hire additional staff and expand your bakery! Unlock new recipes and serve even more delicious pastries!

Need a helping hand? Invite your friend to play in local co-op mode and expand your bakery to the next level! Grab your aprons and get ready to bake up a storm in Baking Time together! 

So what are you waiting for? Keep those ovens hot and bake on!

70070000023055.name: My Horse Stories: Sunny Edition
70070000023055.intro: Make unforgettable memories with new horse Genie and experience the beauty of the countryside like never before!
70070000023055.description:
Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ!  

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC, but your plans have changed. You're sent to middle-of-nowhere Kentucky to spend the summer with your grandma on a star-stable horse farm.  

Soon, you realize that this summer adventure holds untold potential! The horse farm becomes your heaven, and with each passing day, you grow closer to your loyal companion - a graceful horse with whom you'll weave your own unique horse-riding tale!  

Features: 
- Meet the new horse - Genie. Choose which horse out of 3 will become your best friend! 
- Make the most of the horse story summer - become a horse racing champ! 
- Train every day with your horse till you're ready to compete in international horse races 
- Compete in exciting horse story racing competitions around the world! - Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps! 
- Dress up like a champion in over 70 various clothes and change your hairstyles!  
- Take good care of your horse: feed, groom, and dress him with over 70 accessories! 
- Spend an additional 250 gems to buy clothes, energy, missing items for building improvements, and more!  
- Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won't let you off easy. Upgrade your horse-story farm and build new facilities. 
- Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!  

To rise above the competition and conquer the racetracks, you must train tirelessly, immersing yourself in the art of horsemanship. Your dedication will bring you face-to-face with rival stars and formidable opponents who will test your skills and determination. You and your horse will form an unbreakable bond through intense training sessions, setting the stage for legendary horse-riding tales that will be whispered for years to come!  

But it's not all about intense races and fierce rival stars. In the tranquil moments between training, you'll find solace in the stars' stable horses - majestic creatures that inspire awe and joyfully fill your heart. Take the time to nurture and care for them because their well-being is crucial to your success. Pamper them with love, groom their silky manes, and dress them in dazzling saddles that reflect their extraordinary beauty.  

Boost your potential by partnering with Genie and win competitions with confidence, while looking like a true champion!

70070000023071.name: Cooking Arena Sushi Master
70070000023071.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000023071.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sushi Time!".

70070000023073.name: Burst Hero (Game Speed x2)
70070000023073.intro: Deck-building Rogue-like shooting game. Imaginative featured bullets, 19 heroes, 41 weapons, 31 types of bullets, 76 cards. Both automatic aiming and manual aiming are allowed.
70070000023073.description:
Rich Gameplay Combinations: 19 heroes, 41 weapons, 31 types of bullets, 76 cards, 17 talents, 5 challenging maps, and 20 difficulty mechanisms.

Fast-paced gameplay, easy to learn. Each battle lasts about 10 minutes, offering both casual and fun experiences.

Unique weapon system and imaginative bullet designs. Different weapons and bullets have completely different mechanisms, parameters and skills.

Strategic card system. Building your deck can create different gameplay styles.

Diverse level challenges. Each level has different enemies and different mechanisms. Each game has a different experience. You can unlock the final dynamic level, and all the gameplay in the level is random.

70070000023081.name: A Little to the Left Seeing Stars DLC Bundle
70070000023081.description:
Sort, stack, and organize household objects into just the right spot in A Little to the Left, a tidy puzzle game with a mischievous cat who likes to shake things up!
 
•	Puzzles hidden among household objects.
•	Multiple solutions make for intuitive and satisfying puzzle design.
•	A puzzle unique for you every day with The Daily Tidy Delivery.
•	Perfect for casual puzzle game fans and those who get a jolt of satisfaction from a well organized space.

Which way should the clock hands point? How to arrange the eggs? Who put so many stickers on this fruit?!? Come enjoy a calming world with an observational puzzle game with surprises around every corner. With charming illustrations and surprising scenarios, A Little to the Left is satisfying and curious with 75+ delightful puzzles to discover. Keep your eye out for a mischievous cat who has an inclination for chaos!
 
And now introducing to you... The Daily Tidy Delivery! With the Daily Tidy, you’ll get a puzzle delivered EVERY DAY with a variation on one of our favourite puzzles that’s unique to you. You’ll earn fun badges for playing too! If only tidying in real life was this rewarding.

A Little to the Left: Seeing Stars is all about multiple solutions. Collect up to 100 stars as you discover the logic behind a multitude of ways you could tidy up the house. Fold, flap, crush, join, stick, bounce, stack, strum and lovingly smash your way through a huge variety of new interactive items. Enjoy a total of 38 new levels that are layered with both easy-to-find solutions, as well as more challenging puzzles. There are also some extra cute visitors who will make an appearance as well. 
 
Key Features:
• 33 new levels: a mixture of “Multiple Solution” themed puzzles and traditional organizational levels.
• 5 additional bonus levels.
• 100 Solutions to discover.
• Levels with up to 5 different solutions!
• Interactive items that you can fold, flap, crush, join, stick, bounce, stack, strum and smash.
• Lots of variety.
• New OST.
• Hints for ALL solutions.
• Layered levels with both easy and challenging solutions.
• Multiple cats!

70070000023082.name: Destroy the world bundle
70070000023082.intro: Farm and survive in Farm for your Life a zombie filled post-apocalyptic farming game or destroy the world yourself as Rack an alien demon in Rack N Ruin.
70070000023082.description:
Farm for your Life:
Your community was taken down by a heavy storm which caused an apocalypse and unleashed the living dead. Together with the other survivors, it is your task to rebuild and to allow that sustainable life can still be assured. Cultivate your farm and manage your restaurant to provide food and deal with all the zombies.

Rack N Ruin:
Join Rack on an epic adventure across a world filled with magic and wonder. Then watch in astonishment as Rack befouls, corrupts, slaughters, and brings about a general air of misfortune to everything and everyone he confronts. Chaos reigns in this top-down action adventure rpg that's infused with the intensity of a classic shoot 'em up.

70070000023087.name: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers: Nintendo Switch™ Extended Edition
70070000023087.description:
The Nintendo Switch™ Extended Edition includes the Garage Bundle containing six additional patrol cars: Surveillance Police Vehicle, Warden Police Vehicle, Compact Police Vehicle, Guardian Police Vehicle, Multipurpose Police Vehicle, Urban Terrain Vehicle. 

Grab your Nintendo Switch™ and experience the everyday life of a police officer by joining the ranks of this fictitious American city's police force. Begin with parking violations and work your way up to shouldering greater responsibilities. Be part of Brighton's community, get to know your neighborhood, and fulfill the daily duties of a police officer as you fight crime during your shift. Always be tough, but fair: respect the law and gain more experience to unlock more neighborhoods, districts, and duties! Be ready to react at a moment’s notice! In the open world of Brighton you will be able to choose neighborhoods for your patrols and make sure to keep them safe. The game offers a simulation mode for experienced players looking for the most authentic experience, as well as a casual mode for those looking for a more relaxing patrol in the streets of Brighton. 

Go on patrol and begin your shift by issuing tickets, but be ready to handle all kinds of violations including accidents that can happen right in front of your eyes! Many different duties are waiting to be encountered in this living and breathing city. Stop drug deals from taking place in the local park, chase graffiti sprayers illegally tagging walls, stop speeding cars with your police siren, and even set up road barriers and cones around traffic accidents. Be prepared for anything – from minor incidents like a car blocking a bus stop to having to apprehend suspects and taking them to the holding cells. Your duties are your responsibility! 

ON PATROL: experience the everyday life of a police officer
BIG OPEN WORLD: 3 districts with several neighborhoods, each with their own unique flair
RESPONSIBILITIES: over XY violations and offenses 
PARTNERS: invite a friend and go on patrol together 
FOR ROOKIES: intuition system that helps you identify violations 
YOUR WAY: choose between casual and simulation mode

70070000023096.name: Brain Memory Ultra Magnificent Edition
70070000023096.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000023096.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with 3 DLC: Numbers Pack, Figures Pack and Covers Pack.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000023130.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Platinum Edition
70070000023130.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000023131.name: F1® Manager 2024 Deluxe Edition
70070000023131.intro: Lead your team to glory in F1® Manager 2024. A new Formula 1® season has arrived, and with it, the most comprehensive F1® management experience to date.
70070000023131.description:
The F1® Manager 2024 Deluxe Upgrade Pack contains 5 classically inspired livery patterns for use in Create A Team and 5 custom race replay scenarios that will push even the most strategic Team Principal to the limit. 

Lead your team to glory in F1® Manager 2024. A new Formula 1® season has arrived, and with it, the most comprehensive F1® management experience to date. Build a legacy with one of 10 official F1® constructors or create your own team for the very first time.  

Plan and direct your team’s strategy and watch as your driver’s execute your commands in thrilling F1 races, brought to life with a broadcast-quality presentation. Manage your drivers, staff, car development and facilities throughout multiple seasons to give your team the best chance to claim a spot on the Formula 1 podium.

NEW FOR 2024

CREATE A TEAM
For the first time in the series, create your own team to challenge the grid and forge a new legacy. Customise every element of your team from your origin and livery design to logo and racing suits. Recruit the right staff and drivers and negotiate with sponsors for placement on your car.

DEEPER MANAGEMENT
The dramatic world of F1 comes to life on and off the track with the brand-new Mentality System. Manage the personalities and needs of your staff and drivers in the pursuit of success. Keep your stars happy to avoid allowing rivals from poaching your talent, disrupting your team’s trajectory towards the top.   

Build a legacy by fostering talents from F2 & F3 to add to your own affiliate pool. Access the stars of the future and ensure their success is your success.

F1 RACES BROUGHT TO LIFE
Circuits visuals have been refreshed for the official 2024 season, including the returning Shanghai International Circuit. Improved track marbling and enhanced use of real-world data mean racing lines are clearer than ever, with enhanced trackside detailing providing the best-looking visual presentation to date.

Helicam provides a strategic bird’s eye view on the action, giving you a new perspective when executing and evolving your race day plans

MORE TO DISCOVER
·         2024 F1® Sprint race format
·         2024 driver and staff roster, including drivers from development and team academies
·         Improved approachability including refreshed data visualisations, the option to simulate the full race weekend, and enhanced tutorials
·         Race Replay returns for another thrilling season, allowing you to relive and redefine moments from the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship™

70070000023150.name: Piano: Learn and Play Ultra Platinum
70070000023150.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000023150.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes fourth and sixth Song Pack.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000023151.name: Sport & Fun: Swimming Ultra Director's Cut
70070000023151.intro: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con™ controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.
70070000023151.description:
EASY TO PLAY
Play with family and friends! Controls are intuitive, so simply move like you'd usually do while swimming and push forward. Swap your swimming style at any point for some extra fun.

REACH YOUR GOAL
Play with your friends or challenge yourself. Complete daily goals to improve your health and do your best to unlock every achievement.

ENJOY YOURSELF
Remember to swim at your own pace, and make time for some much needed breaks. Revel in the healthiest gameplay loop in your entire life.

This bundle includes three new characters - an adorable swimming dragon, a super-sweet red panda and hamster.

KEY FEATURES:

- cute characters
- different swimming styles
- change characters and style at any time
- variety of places to swim
- daily goals
- family fun great for all ages
- multi and singleplayer mode

70070000023152.name: One Night: Burlesque Amazing Edition
70070000023152.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000023152.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle, you can learn about the creation stories of Holly, Suspects, and the Club Crowd by accessing the artbook from the game menu.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000023157.name: Cat Piano Premium Edition
70070000023157.intro: Start the whisker-tickling Fun with Cat Piano.
70070000023157.description:
Cat Piano is the ultimate cat-tastic piano game designed especially for kids! Dive into a world of whimsical melodies and playful paw prints as you unleash your inner feline musician.


PURR-FECT PIANO PLAY
Cat Piano is a delightful piano version where kids can create music using charming cat sounds instead of traditional piano notes. Each paw print on the piano produces a different tone of cat sound, allowing children to compose their own tunes with a touch of feline flair.


PAWS FOR CREATIVITY
The only limit is your imagination! Challenge yourself to replicate your favorite songs using only cat sounds. Whether you're composing a gentle lullaby or a lively tune to get the whole family dancing, Cat Piano provides endless opportunities for creative expression.

Are you ready to unleash your inner feline musician? Let the whisker-tickling fun begin with Cat Piano!

Change adorable cats that accompany you while playing piano with Background Pack 1 and 2 DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Playful piano game featuring adorable cat sounds
- Different backgrounds with lovely cats
- Unlimited opportunities for creative expression and musical exploration
- Super option to show your kid different sounds

70070000023158.name: Hotel Hustle Special Edition
70070000023158.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000023158.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE 
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from the Artbook Part 4 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts

70070000023160.name: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess Ultimate Edition
70070000023160.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess?! In this visual novel divinely beautiful girls will steal your heart!
70070000023160.description:
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!


WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?
While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?


LET THEM CHARM YOU
During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?


ONLY ONE WINNER
Despite the beauty and charm of all the girls, only one will be able to win the competition. Which one of them will impress you enough to award her the golden apple? Are you going to go with your heart or will you play fair?

And most importantly: will you find love in Love Elysium?

The Emiko's Secrets DLC included in this bundle, will allow you to spend even more time with her and get to know her better.

KEY FEATURES:
- An amazing story waiting for you
- 5 endings to discover = 5x more gameplay
- Unique personalities and temperaments of the girls
- Many dialogue options you can choose from
- Breathtaking island full of magical places
- Different reactions of girls depending on what you say

70070000023174.name: Sherlock Purr 2 Deluxe Edition
70070000023174.intro: Join "Sherlock Purr 2" on a purrfect adventure!
70070000023174.description:
Bundle includes "Extra Mystery Pack II"!

Join the feline detective as he uncovers hidden objects, solves puzzles, and delves into the mysteries of extraordinary places across diverse locations. This game is perfect for young minds who love puzzles and cats, with vibrant graphics, engaging animations, and intellectual challenges. 
Follow Sherlock Purr's pawprints and solve new mysteries today!

70070000023192.name: Untitled Goose Game & Thank Goodness You're Here! Bundle
70070000023192.intro: Two passingly similar, yet very different games about causing hilarious chaos in small British towns.
70070000023192.description:
Untitled Goose Game
It's a lovely morning in the village and you are a horrible goose.

Thank Goodness You're Here!
Thank Goodness You're Here! is an absurd comedy slapformer set in the bizarre Northern English town of Barnsworth. As a traveling salesman, take the time to see the sights and meet the locals, who are very eager to give you a series of increasingly odd jobs…

70070000023213.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Ultimate Edition
70070000023213.description:
Pre-Orders* by 26 Sept of EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Ultimate Edition will include:

- Up to 7 Days Early Access, start playing on 20 Sept
- 3850 FC Points
- Football Ultimate Team™ Player Evolution Slot

Early Access Rush Rewards in Football Ultimate Team™ and Clubs:
- Doubled Bonus Points when playing Rush with Friends
- Head start on FC Hub Season 1
- Earn Special Rewards and Content

- Plus all Standard Edition pre-order content

EA SPORTS FC™ 25 gives you more ways to win for the club.

Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

Game requires a download of at least 31 GB via an Internet connection. You may also be required to create or link a Nintendo Account. MicroSD card (sold separately) may be required depending on your storage. Storage requirements may change, visit x.ea.com/ea/FC-Switch for details.

70070000023216.name: Fashion World Premium Edition
70070000023216.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000023216.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!
- Create stunning looks with countless combinations of costumes, accessories, and scenic backdrops!
- Capture your creations in Photo Mode!
- Strive for perfection with the three-star rating system, boosting your game's replay value.
- Designed for fashion lovers of all ages!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #2 (Street Style) with:

- 20 all-new levels of puzzles

70070000023234.name: S.N.I.P.E.R - Hunter Scope - Eagle Eye
70070000023234.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

This bundle includes base game, Elite Arsenal and Neon Strike with:

-RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design 
-BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west 
-SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle 
-SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
-UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
-SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

70070000023236.name: Train Traffic Manager Gold Edition
70070000023236.intro: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!
70070000023236.description:
Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.

Take on over 80 levels across diverse environments that range from sunny desertscapes to mysterious midnight scenes. It's more fun than a cactus in your caboose!

Each environment has its own unique challenges. Deserts have meteor showers (because of course they do), forests have fallen trees (what's a forest without a little lumber?), winters bring the freeze to your switches, and at midnight, well, you'll just have to see.

And if the chaos of normal mode gets too much, take a breather in endless mode. No objectives, just you, the tracks, and an infinite number of trains. It's the zen garden of train management!

Ready to dive into the madness? Take control of the tracks and show that chaos who's boss in Train Traffic Manager.

And remember: don't fall asleep at your post!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 (Subterranean Switch-Up) and expansion pack #2 (Classic Tracks Reimagined) with:

- 10 brand new underground maps that challenge you to navigate the dimly lit and intricate tunnels.

- 10 of the best campaign levels, transformed and remixed for an even more engaging challenge.

70070000023264.name: Farming Tractor Simulator 2024: Drive Combine & Trucks - Premium Edition
70070000023264.intro: Discover Our Premium Bundle!  Sow, Grow, and Farming - Unleash Your Farming Passion, Adventure Awaits!
70070000023264.description:
Embark on an extraordinary farming adventure with the Farming Tractor Simulator 2023 Bundle! This package includes the main game and the exciting new "Findt 2000MS" tractor DLC, enhancing your farming experience with superior performance and efficiency.

Key Features:
	•	Open-World Farm Simulation: Cultivate your dream farm, plant and harvest various crops, and take care of adorable animals in a picturesque environment.
	•	Advanced Farming Machinery: Operate heavy machinery, including the powerful new Findt 2000MS tractor, designed to boost your productivity and streamline farming tasks.
	•	Stunning Graphics and Gameplay: Enjoy stunning visuals and a lifelike farm setting, offering both fun and relaxation as you explore the vast open-world map.

Dive into the Farming Tractor Simulator 2023 Bundle and elevate your virtual farming experience with the Findt 2000MS tractor, making every farming task more efficient and enjoyable!

70070000023274.name: Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator: Premium Edition
70070000023274.intro: Choose Your Pigeon, Unleash Super Powers, and Embrace Mischief in  the ultimate avian adventure!
70070000023274.description:
Embark on a whimsical and entertaining adventure with Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator: Premium Edition Bundle! This unique package includes the beloved main game along with the exciting new DLC, introducing Lady Pigeon. Now, you can choose your personal pigeon, including the charismatic Lady Pigeon, to make the game more interactive and engaging.

Features:
	•	Be the Pigeon: Step into the feathery shoes of a daring pigeon and embrace your inner avian adventurer in a vibrant, bustling park.
	•	Meet Lady Pigeon: Discover the charm of Lady Pigeon, a pink female pigeon with unique flair, adding a fresh dynamic to your adventures.
	•	Mischief and Mayhem: Earn wanted stars as you stir up trouble, outsmarting 'police' characters hot on your tail.
	•	Super Pigeon Powers: Unleash powerful super attacks and enjoy the unique abilities of both the main character and Lady Pigeon.

With the addition of Lady Pigeon and the ability to choose your pigeon, this bundle enhances your feathered escapades, offering new adventures and endless fun in Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator: Premium Edition! Dive into the complete experience and let your chosen pigeon help you savor every moment to the fullest!

70070000023278.name: Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp: Premium Edition
70070000023278.intro: Master high-speed thrills and daring stunts, Unlock unique skins, conquer special missions, and earn more money in our new Bundle.
70070000023278.description:
Embark on a heart-pounding adventure with our newest release, Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp: Premium Edition! Dive into a realm of high-speed thrills and mind-boggling stunts as you take the reins of the mightiest monster trucks. Our last Bundle combines the adrenaline-pumping action of the main game with the incredible advantages of the Money Boost - 1 Million DLC. Get ready to dominate the monster truck world with this perfect combination

Key Features:
	•	Thrilling Action: Navigate challenging ramps and obstacles at high speed.
	•	Crystal Collection: Collect mystical crystals for awesome bonuses.
	•	Unique Skins: Use our sticker system to unlock extraordinary truck skins.
	•	Special Missions: Complete special missions for exciting rewards.
	•	Financial Boost: Instantly gain 1 million in-game currency for upgrades and exclusive items.
With Truckzilla, your goal is to unlock all the exclusive skins for your vehicle and create the coolest garage ever seen. Hone your skills, compete with the best, and become a legendary monster truck racer.

70070000023284.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Ultimate Edition
70070000023284.description:
LIMITED TIME ONLY - Pre-Orders* by 20 Aug of the EA SPORTS FC™ 25 Ultimate Edition will include:

- Untradeable Football Ultimate Team™ Hero Live Player Item starting 20 Sept

- Up to 7 Days Early Access, start playing on 20 Sept
- 3850 FC Points
- Football Ultimate Team™ Player Evolution Slot

Early Access Rush Rewards in Football Ultimate Team™ and Clubs:
- Doubled Bonus Points when playing Rush with Friends
- Head start on FC Hub Season 1
- Earn Special Rewards and Content

- Plus all Standard Edition pre-order content

EA SPORTS FC™ 25 gives you more ways to win for the club.

Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

Game requires a download of at least 31 GB via an Internet connection. You may also be required to create or link a Nintendo Account. MicroSD card (sold separately) may be required depending on your storage. Storage requirements may change, visit x.ea.com/ea/FC-Switch for details.

70070000023292.name: Mining Mechs + Magnetic Mystery Bundle
70070000023292.intro: Dig deep and make it big!
70070000023292.description:
This bundle includes the base game Mining Mechs and its Magnetic Mystery add-on!

Mining Mechs:

Strange noises and weird activities have been detected underground and you've been called in to help! Mining Mechs is a retro 2D action game presented in fluid pixel art style! Commandeer a high-tech mining mech to dig deep into the earth and collect valuable resources. Sell those resources on the surface to earn money, which you'll need to upgrade your mech or buy new ones.

Each mech has its own benefits and will help you explore the depths even further. Don't think your quest will be easy, though. The deeper you get, the tougher it gets! Will you unravel the dark secrets of the underground, or will you come up against challenges that push your digging skills to the limit?

Mining Mechs - Magnetic Mystery:

Explore a brand new map and storyline set in the arctic! Magnetic waves have been detected underground, and it's up to you to dig down and investigate!

Includes:

• A new map
• A new storyline
• 14 new resources
• 5 new mechs

70070000023296.name: Urban Flow Vehicle Vault
70070000023296.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000023296.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Streets Supplement and Streets Supplement #2 with:

•   Introducing 10 new vehicles

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

70070000023298.name: Bus Simulator 2024: City Driver - Premium Edition
70070000023298.intro: Maximize your profits, upgrade your fleet and enjoy Immersive gameplay with our with the complete bus driving premium bundle!
70070000023298.description:
Get ready for to embark on the thrilling adventure of a lifetime as you assume the role of a skilled bus driver, navigating through the bustling city and ensuring passengers reach their destinations on time! Now your journey is set to become even more exhilarating because just got a major upgrade, thanks to our new Bundle Bus Simulator 2024: City Driver - Premium Edition, Consists of the main game and the latest DLC

Here's why you won't want to miss out:
	•	$150,000 Cash Boost: Kickstart your journey with a hefty cash injection, instantly elevate your city driving experience.
	•	Explore a Vibrant Open-World: Navigate a meticulously crafted metropolis.
	•	17 Unique Buses: Use your cash boost to expand and upgrade your fleet, each bus with its own unique features.
	•	Boost Your Earnings: Pick up passengers and watch your profits soar.
	•	Immersive Gameplay: Enjoy dynamic AI, stunning graphics, and realistic bus physics
Jump on board and feel the thrill of the city streets with the our new bundle that makes you test the most exciting sensations

70070000023302.name: Super Woden GP Collection
70070000023302.intro: Buckle up, it's time to go racing!
70070000023302.description:
Enjoy two exciting isometric-style racing games in one bundle.

Download the Super Woden GP Collection for the ultimate experience in '90s style arcade racing games. Super Woden GP Collection includes the following two games:

• Super Woden GP
• Super Woden GP II

Collect over 200 vehicles and climb to the top of the motorsports world.

70070000023306.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Party Dash Special Edition
70070000023306.intro: A new party action game set in the Umamusume universe!
70070000023306.description:
Includes:
• Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Party Dash Game
• Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Party Dash Team Bundle

*Content details and specifications are subject to change without prior notice.
*Actual items may differ from the image shown.
*The Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Party Dash Special Edition (Nintendo Switch™) comes with Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Party Dash Team Bundle. Be careful not to buy the same DLC twice. The content of the DLC packs will become available in-game after their respective release dates.
*Online multiplayer for the Nintendo Switch™ version requires an internet connection and a Nintendo Switch Online subscription.
*Please confirm the details regarding the included content before making a purchase.
*Please confirm the differences between each edition before making a purchase.

A colorful cast of pixel-art Umamusume are all in line and ready to compete in the Slapdash Grand Prix, a school festival featuring four zany events! Which team will run, shoot, and eat their way to gold and glory?

1. Featuring 25 Playable Pixel-Art Umamusume!
Each team consists of 5 Umamusume, and a total of 4 teams have their eyes on the gold at the Slapdash Grand Prix! Play the game to unlock up to a total of 25 playable Umamusume, and not even counting the curious onlookers scattered across the stages!

2. Challenge a Frenzy of Racers in 4 Different Fan Fest Events!
The Grand Prix is made up of 4 events: Hurtling Hurdles, Blazing Baskets, Dodgeball Demolition, and Gourmet Gauntlet. Select an Umamusume from your team for each event and aim for the gold, but be prepared for some wacky rules and hijinks!

3. Content Galore for One Player or More!
In addition to the story mode that explores each team's unique cast, you can also decorate with your favorite furniture and invite your Umamusume roster to hang out in the clubroom. After that, they can play matches in both local play or online play! The Umamusume are sure to keep your heart racing whether in Single or Multiplayer!

4. Embark on a Grand Adventure with Gold Ship!
Run to the ends of the earth and beyond in this single-player roguelike mode where you play as Gold Ship, who sets out on a perilous journey to rescue her friend from hordes of evil robots. Wield water guns, dodgeballs, and other weapons in your unique arsenal to survive as long as possible. The farther you go, the stronger the enemies you'll face, but the higher your chances of finding rare loot!

70070000023317.name: Hole io: Complete Edition
70070000023317.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000023317.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Complete Edition features:
- 11 maps with different things to swallow 
- 55 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000023320.name: Hentai Anime Girls Succubus - Extended Edition
70070000023320.intro: Ultimate anime adventure, mystery, romance and new puzzles just in a one bundle
70070000023320.description:
Embark on the ultimate journey into the mesmerizing world of  Hentai Girls with this exclusive bundle, featuring both the captivating main game and the enticing Hentai Anime Girls Succubus: New Image Puzzle DLC. Dive into a universe where tantalizing artwork meets an engaging storyline, and solving intricate puzzles uncovers the secrets within.

Features
	•	Engaging Storyline: Delve into a narrative filled with mystery, romance, and seduction. Solve puzzles to reveal an alluring story with enigmatic anime girls.
	•	Stunning Visuals: Explore a gallery of captivating characters with unique backstories. Enjoy stunning visuals and animations.
	•	Challenging Puzzles: Test your wit, unlocking new storylines. The DLC adds an extra layer of challenge and excitement with a new image puzzle.
	•	New Content: Includes the exclusive Succubus Anime image puzzle, challenging your mind and captivating your senses.
Unleash your inner detective, indulge in the allure of anime, and prepare for an unforgettable experience that will leave you yearning for more. This ultimate bundle is your gateway to an enchanting world of mystery, romance, and enticing puzzles, all in one captivating bundle.

70070000023340.name: Tiffany Edition: Beauties Unveiled 2
70070000023340.description:
Beauties Unveiled 2 is a continuation of the mesmerizing journey from Part 1, that pairs the familiar excitement of classic arcade games with manga-inspired, and hentai-inspired art.

This time, the art style is more manga-inspired, with the quick-paced gameplay you all liked. 

Overcome ticking-clock challenges, be aware of many obstacles and opponents, choose carefully your path, and benefit from different power-ups available during each stage of the game. 
Pay attention to the obstacles that will get in your way – you may have a few chances but be wary as the number of attempts is limited! To snatch the highest score, you will need reflexes, quick decisions, and a bit of luck.

70070000023351.name: Truck Simulator 2024 - USA Driver Zone Premium Edition
70070000023351.intro: Embark on a millionaire's adventure with the ultimate trucking Simulator Bundle, transform your trucking career with last premium upgrades!
70070000023351.description:
Embark on the ultimate trucking adventure with "Truck Simulator 2024: USA Driver Zone - Millionaire's Edition." This special bundle combines the immersive base game with the thrilling "Millionaire's Dream DLC," offering a unique journey for truckers of all levels.

Key Features:
	•	Diverse Truck Selection: Choose from a fleet of meticulously detailed trucks, each with unique handling.
	•	Instant Wealth: Start your journey with a million dollars to invest in your trucking empire, thanks to the Millionaire's Dream DLC.
	•	Premium Upgrades: Access exclusive high-end trucks and top-of-the-line upgrades from the beginning.
	•	Mission Variety: Engage in a multitude of missions and jobs that challenge your driving skills.
	•	Open World Exploration: Roam freely through a beautifully crafted map inspired by the stunning American landscape.
In "Truck Simulator 2024: USA Driver Zone - Millionaire's Edition," you're not just driving; you're mastering the art of trucking while enjoying the luxuries of instant wealth and premium vehicles. Strap in, hit the road, and make your mark on the American highways with the ultimate trucker's dream bundle.

70070000023372.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Deluxe Content Pack
70070000023372.description:
Purchasing Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Deluxe Content Pack entitles digital in-game content!

Deluxe Content Pack includes:
• 2 leader personas
• Deluxe Cosmetics Pack

2 leader personas
Each persona offers a new variant of an existing leader, including a different outfit and background for that leader, new gameplay bonuses, and an alternative agenda that reflects a different side of their personality! The two personas included in this edition will be revealed at a later date.

DELUXE COSMETICS PACK

4 profile customizations
Embellish your player profile with these cosmetic customizations, including a striking new badge, a regal new title, an ornate new banner, and an eye-catching new portrait that will all make you stand out from other players! 

1 alternate scout skin
Give your scout recon unit a brand new look with this cosmetic outfit!

70070000023395.name: Mortal Kombat™ 1: Khaos Reigns Expansion
70070000023395.description:
A new reign of Khaos unfolds in Liu Kang's Era. This pack includes a new Story Expansion + 6 New Fighters

3 MK Fighters Available at Launch
3 Guest Fighters Available Post-Launch

70070000023396.name: Mortal Kombat™ 1: Khaos Reigns Bundle
70070000023396.description:
Level-up your Mortal Kombat 1 Base Game Experience and finish the fight through Havik's Reign of Khaos.

The Bundle includes access to the upcoming Story Expansion, 6 New Fighters (3 MK Fighters available at launch, 3 Guest Fighters available post-launch) and instant access to the Kombat Pack.

Kombat Pack Fighters (Available Now):
Omni-Man (Invincible)
Quan Chi
Peacemaker (DC’s Peacemaker)
Ermac
Homelander (The Boys)
Takahashi Takeda

Kameo Fighters:
Tremor
Khameleon
Janet Cage
Mavado
Ferra

Jean-Claude Van Damme Skin for Johnny Cage

70070000023421.name: YOGA MASTER Collection
70070000023421.intro: YOGA MASTER is the first wellness game of its kind, fully realized in 3D and designed by experts to help you achieve the perfect balance.
70070000023421.description:
Explore a world of harmony and relaxation with the "YOGA MASTER Collection" bundle. This exclusive package offers you a complete and convenient solution to enrich your yoga and meditation practice.

Bundle details:

1. YOGA MASTER Base Game: A complete 3D environment with over 150 yoga poses and 100 pre-made programs for all levels.
2. DLC Meditation Studio: Customizable environments and 3D Sound music for deep meditations.
3. DLC Magic Atmosphere: Scenarios and music that add a magical and atmospheric dimension.
4. DLC Dream Fantasy: Dream-like settings and melodies for a fantastic and immersive experience.
5. DLC Celestial Harmonies: Allows you to create personalized playlists with new music tracks and natural sound effects.
6. Free Bonus DLC - Meditation Music Pack 1: An exclusive addition of meditative music to further enrich your sessions.

Purchasing the "YOGA MASTER Collection" bundle represents an immersion into the ancient practice of yoga, enhanced by modern technology. This package combines a fully 3D realization, allowing for detailed and versatile visualization of each position, with the ability to customize your sessions through a wide selection of music tracks, supported by an advanced music player. This combination creates a unique and deeply immersive experience, ideal for those seeking a deeply personalized and technologically advanced yoga and meditation practice. Start your journey to wellness today with the "YOGA MASTER Collection"

70070000023429.name: LEGO® Horizon Adventures™ Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000023429.description:
Edition includes*:
•	LEGO® Horizon Adventures™
•	Roller Coaster Customization
•	Banuk Armor outfit
•	Shadow Stalwart outfit
•	“Alloy” Aloy outfit
•	Ratchet outfit
•	Rivet outfit
•	Sackboy outfit

Journey to a distant future, where the land is made of LEGO bricks and lush nature has reclaimed the Earth. Meet the Nora tribe who live in the settlement of Mother’s Heart, and catch your first glimpse of the incredible dinosaur-like machines that roam the forests, mountains, and deserts that stretch beyond the village walls...    

The LEGO adventure of a lifetime
Join hunter Aloy as she battles to save Earth from an ancient digital demon, and a gang of sunworshippers who want to live in a world without shade so they can soak up the rays while everything burns. 

Play alone or with friends
Hunt machines on your own as Aloy, or unlock colourful heroes Varl, Teersa, and Erend, and use their unique skills to defeat enemies and overcome challenges. Share the fun with another player online, or via innovative couch co-op on a single screen, so you’re always in the same world together.

Customize your home and your characters
Give the village of Mother’s Heart a unique makeover, decorating it in delightful ways to unlock unique LEGO buildings and ornaments. You can even dish out hilarious outfits for your friends to wear!

For LEGO and Horizon fans new and old
Uncover secrets from Aloy’s mysterious past as you explore stunning LEGO locations inspired by the world of Horizon, including thriving forests and soaring mountains. Delve deep into the underground Cauldrons or climb the iconic Tallnecks – all beautifully recreated in LEGO bricks.

Need an extra challenge? Replay levels that change to test your skills and unlock new surprises, or check the Mother's Heart Community Board for ways to help the village. See if you've got what it takes to ace every aspect of the game!

70070000023462.name: Color Water Sort: Relax Edition
70070000023462.intro: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!
70070000023462.description:
Use your head and arrange colored liquids to solve unique puzzles!  

Master the art of water sorting and rise to the top as a champion! Strategically move the water until every color is separated, proving your puzzle-solving prowess!  

Features: 
- face over 5000 levels! (you get 2500 new levels in Classic Mode)
- play in three game modes: classic, timed, and hard 
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!  
- give your brain an excellent workout  
- use 70 additional powerups right away: hints, undo, and extra tubes
- get 9 new tubes and 5 new caps
- get 4 new wallpapers
- collect keys and open prize chests 
- get 75000 coins and spend them on new tubes, wallpapers, caps, and powerups!  

Immerse yourself in the challenge of sorting water into tubes with the same colored liquid on top. Remember, the tubes can't be full for the water to go in. Plan your moves carefully to avoid losing!  

Complete thousands of levels in 3 different modes: 
• Classic - a standard mode where you can relax
• Timed - move fast and complete the level within the time limit 
• Hard - think about your every move, because you have a limited number of them

Enjoy this colorful brain challenge by yourself or against your friend!

70070000023469.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.6
70070000023469.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the sixth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000023471.name: Baking Time: Fast Edition
70070000023471.intro: Satisfy your cooking fever and love for pastries with the help of new fast animals!
70070000023471.description:
Stack all kinds of mouth-watering baked goods, from croissants to cookie hearts and everything in between! 

Grab your spatula, lift the baked goods out of the oven, and put them on display so that customers can buy them! With a steady stream of hungry customers waiting in line, it's up to you to deliver their orders quickly and efficiently!

Features:
- Bake over 30 different pastries that your customers won't resist!
- Collect baked goods with a spatula and put them on the display to sell them!
- Operate the cash register and satisfy your customers' appetites!
- Use your diamonds to unlock 32 new adorable and speedy pets that will help you travel faster than ever before! 
- Earn tons of money to unlock new levels of your bakery!
- Hire staff to help you collect the baked goods much faster!
- Upgrade your character and workers to walk faster or carry more pastries!
- Perform baker's tasks and claim your rewards
- Prepare baked goods for special large orders!
- Feed your cookie monsters to get money each second
- Use the teleport to move faster between levels
- Get caught up in the cooking fever and try not to get hungry! 

Satisfy your customers and earn money that you can spend to hire additional staff and expand your bakery! Unlock new recipes and serve even more delicious pastries!

Need a helping hand? Invite your friend to play in local co-op mode and expand your bakery to the next level! Grab your aprons and get ready to bake up a storm in Baking Time together! 

So what are you waiting for? Keep those ovens hot and bake on!

70070000023477.name: My Horse Stories: Classy Edition
70070000023477.intro: Make unforgettable memories with new horse Shadow and experience the beauty of the countryside like never before!
70070000023477.description:
Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ!  

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC, but your plans have changed. You're sent to middle-of-nowhere Kentucky to spend the summer with your grandma on a star-stable horse farm.  

Soon, you realize that this summer adventure holds untold potential! The horse farm becomes your heaven, and with each passing day, you grow closer to your loyal companion - a graceful horse with whom you'll weave your own unique horse-riding tale!  

Features: 
- Meet the new horse - Shadow. Choose which horse out of 3 will become your best friend! 
- Make the most of the horse story summer - become a horse racing champ! 
- Train every day with your horse till you're ready to compete in international horse races 
- Compete in exciting horse story racing competitions around the world! - Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps! 
- Dress up like a champion in 70 various clothes and change your hairstyles!  
- Take good care of your horse: feed, groom, and dress him with 70 accessories! 
- Spend an additional 250 gems to buy clothes, energy, missing items for building improvements, and more!  
- Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won't let you off easy. Upgrade your horse-story farm and build new facilities. 
- Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!  

To rise above the competition and conquer the racetracks, you must train tirelessly, immersing yourself in the art of horsemanship. Your dedication will bring you face-to-face with rival stars and formidable opponents who will test your skills and determination. You and your horse will form an unbreakable bond through intense training sessions, setting the stage for legendary horse-riding tales that will be whispered for years to come!  

But it's not all about intense races and fierce rival stars. In the tranquil moments between training, you'll find solace in the stars' stable horses - majestic creatures that inspire awe and joyfully fill your heart. Take the time to nurture and care for them because their well-being is crucial to your success. Pamper them with love, groom their silky manes, and dress them in dazzling saddles that reflect their extraordinary beauty.  

Boost your potential by partnering with Shadow and win competitions with confidence, while looking like a true champion!

70070000023483.name: Parking Masters Deluxe Edition
70070000023483.description:
Welcome to Parking Masters, where you'll face the ultimate test of your parking skills across a vast array of challenges! Maneuver cars, trucks, buses, and vehicles with trailers through numerous levels, all designed with realistic physics and a captivating visual style.

This package includes:
- Parking Masters
- Parking Masters - Big Rig DLC
- Parking Masters - Bus Driver DLC

With the addition of 2 DLCs, take on 100 additional levels that push your precision to the limit as you maneuver large vehicles with finesse and control.

Parking Masters Deluxe Edition offers a realistic and rewarding experience for all parking enthusiasts. Are you ready to prove your mastery and become parking champion?

70070000023521.name: Sam & Max: The Complete Trilogy
70070000023521.intro: What's better than one Sam & Max season? Three Sam & Max seasons!
70070000023521.description:
Sam is a six-foot canine detective with a nose for justice. Max is a hyperkinetic rabbity-thing with a taste for mayhem. Together, they’re the Freelance Police—an irreverent comedy duo whose esoteric crime-fighting style has been entertaining comic book and video game fans for more than thirty five years. 

In 2006–2010, Sam & Max starred in a series of episodic adventures created by Telltale Games. Now you can play their first three seasons (Sixteen episodes altogether!) in these remastered versions, which have been lovingly updated with gorgeous HD graphics, overhauled lighting and lip-sync, finessed cinematography, remastered audio, and several all-new musical tracks featuring live jazz musicians. 

SAM & MAX SAVE THE WORLD
It's just another day at the office when the Commissioner calls in with a disturbing report: former child stars are running amok in the street! 

What starts as an open-and-shut case of idiotic vandalism balloons into an all-out conspiracy as Sam & Max encounter one miscreant after another who have been mysteriously hypnotized. (You can tell from the "spinny thing" they do with their eyes.) 

Who's the source of this malfeasance, and what is their dastardly plan? Cracking this case will require Sam's nose for detective work, Max's lack of conscience, an assortment of inventory items, and a little help from neighbors Sybil Pandemik, Bosco, and Jimmy Two-Teeth. From Sam & Max's street to the White House lawn, inside the internet, and all the way to the moon, this baffling mystery gets weirder and funnier as it unfolds. 

SAM & MAX: BEYOND TIME AND SPACE
The Freelance Police are back on the crime beat in a showdown with Santa Claus, a race to subdue a giant volcano, and a face-off with a Eurotrash vampire… and then things get even weirder.

Is paranoid shopkeeper Bosco on to something with his talk of a grand conspiracy? Is diner proprietress Stinky hiding the truth about what happened to her grandfather (also named Stinky)? Will flaky neighbor Sybil Pandemik ever find true love? Did someone say… BIRTHDAY?!

Zombies will dance. Mariachis will sing. A giant battle robot will trash the streets. And when their friends’ lives are on the line, Sam & Max will risk their very souls to set things right. 

SAM & MAX: THE DEVIL’S PLAYHOUSE
Max has always been the more unhinged member of the Freelance Police—a lovable lunatic with a knack for spreading chaos wherever he goes. But recently his abilities have taken a supernatural turn.

It all started when he stumbled upon a mysterious toy that allows him to glimpse the future. Now Sam & Max have aroused the attention of a host of villains from across the galaxy who are hellbent on acquiring the magical Toys of Power to achieve their own ends.

As those who seek the Devil’s Toybox close in and Max’s psychic abilities grow beyond his control, the Freelance Police will come up against their most frightening adversary yet: the power of Max’s mind.

70070000023525.name: Cooking Arena Pastry Chef
70070000023525.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000023525.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Food Truck Tycoon" and "Sweet Bakery Tycoon".

70070000023528.name: AEW: Fight Forever - All Season Pass Bundle
70070000023528.description:
The AEW: Fight Forever All Season Pass Bundle includes all Season 1, 2, 3, and 4 DLC's, totaling 15 wrestlers, 4 minigames, two all-new modes including Beat the Elite and Tournament Mode, 4 new arenas including the 2023 Dynamite arena, the day and evening Beach arena, the Japan Shrine arena, and the haunted forest Fright Forever arena, plus 93 skin and attire options, AND 20 new premium tracks. More details below:  

- The AEW: Fight Forever FTR: Revival Pack which features AEW wrestlers Dax Harwood and Cash Wheeler PLUS minigames Join Us and Deth Race-X.
- The AEW: Fight Forever Limitless Bunny Bundle which features AEW wrestlers The Bunny and Keith Lee PLUS minigames MJF Car Thrash and Sloth Sling.
- The AEW: Fight Forever Hookhausen Very Handsome, Very Evil Pack which features AEW wrestlers HOOK and Danhausen. 
- The AEW: Fight Forever Dynamite Featuring The Acclaimed DLC which features the boldest Tag Team in AEW history, Anthony Bowens and Max Caster of The Acclaimed, PLUS the 2023 Dynamite arena. 
- The AEW: Fight Forever Beat the Elite DLC which features an all-new gameplay mode, Beat the Elite. Beat the Elite introduces single-player, offline competitions for the most competitive Fight Forever players. 
- The AEW: Fight Forever The Storm is Coming DLC which features the legendary women's wrestling champion from down under Toni Storm. Storm joins the Fight Forever playable roster along with 10 new premium tracks.
- The AEW: Fight Forever Swerve to the Beach DLC features Swerve Strickland, the day and evening Beach arenas, and two new attire customization options. 
- The AEW: Fight Forever Giant Swing in the Ring DLC features Claudio Castagnoli, 30 new re-skin options, and an alternate entrance song for Claudio.
- The AEW: Fight Forever Hayter's Gunna Game DLC features the legendary Jamie Hayter plus 5 new premium music tracks! 
- The AEW: Fight Forever World War Joe DLC features Samoa Joe, the new Japanese Shrine arena, two new attires, and 11 new moves.  
- The AEW: Fight Forever Rated Gold Superstar Pack features Adam Copeland, the new haunted forest Fright Forever arena, 30 new skins, and 7 new moves. 
- The AEW: Fight Forever Switchblade Tournament Pack features Jay White, 5 new premium music tracks, and the new Tournament Mode.

70070000023531.name: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid Sunset Bundle
70070000023531.intro: Explore the wonder of the Japanese countryside!
70070000023531.description:
Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid DLC Bundle includes the main game and DLC.

Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid
A circus troupe comes to Yomogi Town, a rural town in Japan situated between mountains and the ocean. As the son of the circus ringmaster, enjoy a special summer filled with adventures!

All of Yomogi Town and the nature surrounding it are an open world where you can enjoy summer to its fullest. Immerse yourself in nostalgic scenery filled with towering clouds, beautiful sunsets, and the sound of cicadas.

Summer days are always filled with activities like fishing at the river or catching rare bugs in a field. Help the circus succeed and interact with the townspeople if you'd like. Enjoy a night at the summer festival, dancing and watching fireworks. There's even a train so you can visit a neighboring town.

Your own special summer vacation filled with unique experiences awaits you on Nintendo Switch™!

DLC: Broadcast Over Sunset
■ New area "Sunset Island"
Set sail with the kids of the Trumpet Forest Detective Agency to uncover the secrets of Sunset Island, a mysterious island off the shore of Yomogi Town. 30 new fish and bug species have been added, as well as a dungeon with new mechanics.

■ New character "Tobiyama-san" and new events
Tobiyama-san, a member of the circus troupe, arrives in Yomogi Town. The new story revolves around a small radio station run by her and DJ Tei-kiatsu. New events and interactions have been added for the people of Yomogi Town as well.

*This is a bundle that includes the main game and DLC. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.

70070000023554.name: Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator - Premium Edition
70070000023554.intro: Your racing empire begins here, with our premium bundle, which comes with a bonus, our new DLC millionaire's boost!
70070000023554.description:
Experience high-octane racing with our Bundle Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 and the Millionaire's Boost DLC! Street Drag Racing Bundle offers an adrenaline-fueled 3D racing experience where you build, race, and tune your car to perfection. Compete in challenging races, upgrade your engine, and customize your ride with colorful paints and stickers. Enjoy realistic sounds, HD graphics, and online multiplayer mode.
          This bundle is composed of our main game + DLC which gives you 1,000,000 coins to unlock top-tier vehicles, exclusive parts, and dominate every race. Transform your racing experience and prove you’re the ultimate drag racer. Are you ready to become the king of the streets with Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator - Premium Edition? The challenge awaits!

70070000023562.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000023562.description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles main game
• Bonus Side Quest Collection: Shopping
• Season Pass
- DLC 1: A Strange Fate
- DLC 2
- DLC 3
- Season Pass Bonus Content: Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu

Spin a new tale of the Jura Tempest Federation together with all your favorite characters from the animated series!

• Action-Packed Battles with Exhilarating Combo Attacks
Players can enjoy thrilling action battles that combine flashy special moves and powerful combos. Through leveling up bonds with friends, Rimuru will learn Special Attacks, and even have allies join in to back up Rimuru’s attack. Finish off formidable enemies that are coming to destroy Tempest with Secret Skills animated in retro 8-bit style!

• Experience Stories from the Anime, as well as All-New Adventures
Relive the original story from the encounter with the Kijin to the battle against the Kingdom of Falmuth fully voiced! In addition, there are two brand new adventures from the original author for fans to enjoy! 

Goblin's Revenge Arc:
Kataki is a Bugbear who lost his friends in an attack by the Direwolves. The story of his revenge begins when he discovers that his former enemies and the Hobgoblins coexist in Tempest.

Religious Nation Arc:
The Theocracy of Angels is a mysterious religious nation that believes in angels. Aiming to take the power of the Storm Dragon, they face off with Tempest.

• Exciting City-Building
As players progress through the story and meet new allies, their community will grow from a small village to a great nation. Build a wide variety of buildings to take advantage of the Tempest Resonance which strengthens residents as you create more structures in your village! There are even modern Japanese-style buildings that make use of Rimuru's memory from the world before his reincarnation.

There are also more than 50 original subquests to enjoy! Enjoy the daily life in Tempest with laughter and tears as Rimuru and his friends work together to solve residents' problems and make the country a better place.

*This edition comes with content which is also sold separately. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.
*DLC 1, 2, and 3 will be released after the main game, by December 31st 2024. Content of each DLC will be announced at a later date. 
*Main game must be cleared before DLC or Bonus Content can be accessed.
*Contents and specifications are subject to change at any time.

70070000023563.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles - Season Pass
70070000023563.description:
Season Pass includes:
- DLC 1: A Strange Fate
- DLC 2
- DLC 3
- Season Pass Bonus Content: Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu

*The Season Pass may be included in other editions, and also includes content which is also sold separately. Please be mindful of duplicate purchases.
*DLC 1, 2, and 3 will be released after main game, by December 31st 2024. Content of each DLC will be announced at a later date.
*Main game must be cleared before DLC or Bonus Content can be accessed.
*Contents and specifications are subject to change at any time.

70070000023565.name: Fit My Cat Legendary Edition
70070000023565.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000023565.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Decorate your board with New Floor Pack included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000023574.name: Knights & Guns Summer Edition
70070000023574.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000023574.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game and Armor Pack #3 with:
- 2 new armors to help you on your quest

70070000023575.name: Train Traffic Manager Platinum Edition
70070000023575.intro: All Aboard the Chaos & Strategy Express!
70070000023575.description:
Train Traffic Manager isn't your grandpa's model railway set. Think fast, plan faster, and keep those trains from turning into flaming metal confetti. In this strategy-puzzle game, you're in charge of everything from switches and signals to drawbridges and, oh yeah, preventing cataclysmic train disasters.

Take on over 80 levels across diverse environments that range from sunny desertscapes to mysterious midnight scenes. It's more fun than a cactus in your caboose!
