70070000024528.intro: Team up for a pixel-packed adventure in Heavy Hand: Pixel Tree Forest Fury Deluxe Edition—where every swing and strategy counts for two!
70070000024528.description:
Unleash the ultimate pixelated adventure with the Deluxe Edition of Heavy Hand: Pixel Tree Forest Fury! This enhanced version takes your gameplay to new heights with two exciting DLC packs:

Heavy Hand: Coin Collector’s Bounty – Boost your treasure trove with an extra 1500 coins, giving you the edge to upgrade your gear and unlock special features faster than ever.

Heavy Hand: Dynamic Duo Unleashed – Double the fun with two brand-new characters, each with unique abilities and styles that bring fresh strategies and thrilling challenges to your cooperative play.

Dive into the lush, pixelated forest with a friend and experience the fury of the forest like never before. Team up, strategize, and conquer in the most exhilarating pixelated adventure around!

70070000024533.name: Heavy Hand: Complete DLC Bundle
70070000024533.intro: Elevate your game with the Heavy Hand: Complete DLC Bundle—score 1500 extra coins and unlock 2 new characters for double the adventure!
70070000024533.description:
Unlock the ultimate Heavy Hand experience with the Complete DLC Bundle! This exclusive collection is designed to supercharge your gameplay and expand your universe with essential additions. Here’s what you get:

Heavy Hand: Coin Collector’s Bounty - Dive into the action with a massive boost of 1500 coins! These additional coins are perfect for upgrading your gear, acquiring exclusive items, and advancing faster through the game’s challenging levels. Whether you’re a seasoned player or a newcomer, this bounty ensures you have the resources you need to maximize your potential.

Heavy Hand: Dynamic Duo Unleashed - Broaden your strategic options with 2 brand-new characters, each meticulously crafted to introduce fresh tactics and exciting gameplay dynamics. These characters come with unique abilities and styles, allowing you to explore new strategies and enhance your team's versatility in every battle.

The Heavy Hand: Complete DLC Bundle is your gateway to a richer, more immersive gaming experience. Equip yourself with extra coins to strengthen your arsenal, and harness the power of new characters to conquer your foes with even greater skill. Don't miss out on this essential bundle to elevate your Heavy Hand adventure to new heights!

70070000024568.name: Buffet Boss: Complete Edition
70070000024568.intro: Cook your way to the top and rule the restaurant scene!
70070000024568.description:
Step into the fast-paced world of Buffet Boss, where you’re not just cooking - you’re building a culinary empire! 

Start as a humble entrepreneur and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate chef, bartender, and manager.

Features:
● Expand brand new Rolling Sushi restaurant and become the biggest and best in town!
● Whip up a variety of mouth-watering dishes and refreshing drinks!
● Serve your guests quickly and keep your restaurant spotless!
● Train your staff to perfection and upgrade your kitchen equipment

As your restaurant grows, so do the challenges. Keep your customers happy, manage overcrowded dining rooms, and make sure your team is always at their best. The more successful you become, the more obstacles you’ll face, but with the right strategy, you’ll dominate the industry!

Prove your skills, overcome every challenge, and rise to the top as the Buffet Boss!

70070000024578.name: Amber Isle - Deluxe Edition
70070000024578.description:
Welome to Amber Isle. Our Deluxe Edition offers you the best pack of items to get your Paleo adventure on the right track! Included in this edition is:
·        Base Game
·        Starter Pack

70070000024581.name: Real Cake Maker: Complete Edition
70070000024581.intro: Grab your mixer and let the cake-making fun begin!
70070000024581.description:
Become the best cake baker in town and create the yummiest cakes in this delicious cooking adventure!

What kind of cake do you love? Whatever it is, you can bake it! From dreamy frosting to delightful decorations, design cakes that look as good as they taste. Show off your creations to friends, throw a fabulous cake party, or compete in exciting baking contests for the chance to be crowned the cake champ!

Features:
● learn how to bake the most delicious cakes and special cupcakes!
● automize your baking, designing, and decorating with the help of premium tools!
● decorate your cakes with lots of frostings, decorations, and toppers to make it look special!
● throw cake parties with your adorable animal friends and make each celebration memorable
● join baking contests, vote for your favorite cakes, and win the first prize!
● try on almost 150 clothes and hairstyles. dress up like the true baker you are!
● enjoy a collection of fun coloring pages to inspire your artistic side

Bake up some joy and sweeten your day with fun creations!

70070000024587.name: Anime Puzzle Quest: Complete DLC Bundle
70070000024587.intro: Unlock the Ultimate Experience with Anime Puzzle Quest: Complete DLC Bundle – All the Adventure, All the Fun!
70070000024587.description:
Unlock the full adventure with the Anime Puzzle Quest: Complete DLC Bundle! This all-in-one pack includes three fantastic expansions, each adding a unique twist to your puzzle experience:

Anime Puzzle Quest: 33 Animal Girls in Puzzle – Discover 33 charming animal-themed characters, each with their own special abilities and personalities, as you solve engaging puzzles and collect adorable new friends.

Anime Puzzle Quest: 36 Girls in Puzzle – Dive into a new realm of puzzle-solving with 36 diverse and captivating girls. Solve intricate puzzles to unlock these delightful characters, each bringing their own flair to the game.

Anime Puzzle Quest: 32 Animal Girls in Puzzle /2 – Enjoy double the fun with 32 more animal girls, adding new layers of strategy and excitement to your puzzle journey.

With stunning anime art, vibrant gameplay, and a plethora of unique characters, this bundle offers an immersive experience that will keep you entertained for hours. Get ready to solve, collect, and enjoy the ultimate puzzle adventure!

70070000024599.name: Anime Puzzle Quest: Deluxe Edition
70070000024599.intro: Unleash the Ultimate Puzzle Adventure with Anime Puzzle Quest: Deluxe Edition – All Characters, All Challenges, All in One!
70070000024599.description:
Experience the ultimate puzzle adventure with Anime Puzzle Quest: Deluxe Edition! This comprehensive package includes the complete collection of expansions for an enriched gameplay experience:

Anime Puzzle Quest: 33 Animal Girls in Puzzle – Immerse yourself in a world of adorable animal-themed characters. Solve captivating puzzles to unlock 33 unique animal girls, each with their own special traits and abilities.

Anime Puzzle Quest: 36 Girls in Puzzle – Expand your puzzle journey with 36 new and diverse characters. Tackle intriguing challenges to reveal these charming girls, each one bringing a fresh dynamic to the game.

Anime Puzzle Quest: 32 Animal Girls in Puzzle /2 – Enjoy even more puzzle fun with 32 additional animal girls. This pack doubles the excitement, offering new characters and strategies to enhance your gameplay.

With stunning anime visuals, engaging puzzle mechanics, and a wealth of characters to discover, the Deluxe Edition is your gateway to an unforgettable puzzle adventure. Solve, collect, and explore like never before!

70070000024633.name: PAWfect Cat Mansion Extended Edition
70070000024633.intro: Turn Grandma's old mansion into a cozy home for cute cats!
70070000024633.description:
Love cats? Then "PAWfect Cat Mansion" is the game for you!

Transform your grandma’s old mansion into a warm, welcoming home filled with playful kittens. Design fun rooms, choose cute furniture, and watch as the cats explore and relax in their new cozy spaces.

Features:
• Design fun rooms to unlock new decorations.
• Decorate your mansion with cool furniture.
•  Attract lots of different cats to your cozy home.
•  Keep your favorite cats with you forever!

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Levels"!

70070000024635.name: PAWfect Cat Mansion Legacy Edition
70070000024635.intro: Give Adorable Kittens a Dream Home – Restore the Mansion into a Kitty Paradise!
70070000024635.description:
Transform a run-down mansion into a cozy paradise for adorable kittens! Renovate, decorate, and fill the mansion with playful feline friends. Unlock new rooms, collect cute cats, and create the ultimate kitty haven!

Features:
• Design fun rooms to unlock new decorations.
• Decorate your mansion with cool furniture.
• Attract lots of different cats to your cozy home.
• Keep your favorite cats with you forever!

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Levels" and "Cuty Kitty Collection"!

70070000024646.name: Hotel Hustle Legendary Edition
70070000024646.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000024646.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE 
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from the Artbook Part 2 and 3 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts

70070000024676.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley – Enchanted Edition
70070000024676.intro: Explore a magical world in Disney Dreamlight Valley alongside Disney and Pixar friends, and expand your journey to Eternity Isle and the Storybook Vale where more adventures await!
70070000024676.description:
Live your Disney dream life with the Enchanted Edition, which includes the base game and two Expansion Passes. This edition also contains exclusive digital items.
· Access to Disney Dreamlight Valley, Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time and Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale
· 18,000 Moonstones* 
· Autumn Manor House style
· Baby Pegasus Animal Companion and Companion House
· Storybook Vale Dress and Ensemble

Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new. Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle. Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley!  

In Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale, the second Expansion Pass for the game, discover a land made up of fabled stories, where myths and fairy tales sprang to life… until Maleficent and Hades tore the Vale apart. With the guidance of the Lorekeeper, journey to the Vale and meet heroes and villains who will bring epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover.

Journey to Eternity Isle in Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time, the first Expansion Pass for the game. Adventure to this faraway land and utilize a mysterious new Royal Tool—the Hourglass—as you discover new secrets and uncover lost treasures. Foil Jafar’s plan to steal the Spark of Imagination, an ancient relic that holds the fabric of Dreamlight Valley together. With the help of the Hourglass, you are the key to fixing rifts in time and putting an end to Jafar’s evil plan! 

*Moonstones are an in-game currency that can be collected for free by performing tasks in the game or be purchased using real money. They are used to unlock the premium track of the Star Path (a battle-pass-inspired system that grants in-game cosmetic items as a player completes various tasks and missions). Moonstones can also be used to accelerate progress in the Star Path. Additionally, Moonstones can be used to purchase cosmetic items from the in-game store.

70070000024679.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley – The Storybook Vale Bundle
70070000024679.intro: Explore a magical world in Disney Dreamlight Valley alongside Disney and Pixar friends, and travel to the Storybook Vale, a land made up of fairy tales and myths!
70070000024679.description:
This bundle includes the Disney Dreamlight Valley base game; the new Expansion Pass, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale; and 13,000 Moonstones. 

Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new. Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle. Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley!  

In Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale, the second Expansion Pass for the game, discover a land made up of fabled stories, where myths and fairy tales sprang to life… until Maleficent and Hades tore the Vale apart. With the guidance of the Lorekeeper, journey to the Vale and meet heroes and villains who will bring epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover.

70070000024680.name: Alchemist Generations Bundle
70070000024680.intro: Play both of our alchemy games at a bargain price.
70070000024680.description:
Become the world's greatest Alchemist with this bundle containing:

ALCHEMIST: THE POTION MONGER
First-person Alchemist Simulator with RPG elements. Explore the world, gather ingredients, and sell or use potions you craft to help others and fend off enemies. Adopt pets to help you with your alchemy knowledge (and to pet them). Decorate your home however you like and brew your destiny!

ALCHEMIST SIMULATOR
Become the mystical alchemist, choose your contracts wisely as they will shape the world around you, discover the long-forgotten magical recipes, upgrade your lab, and become the most powerful alchemist of all time.

70070000024688.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Max Edition
70070000024688.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Weaponry Upgrade, Elite Arsenal, Target Acquired and Neon Strike with:

-PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm 
-FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation 
-SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy 
-RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design 
-BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west 
-SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle 
-RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition 
-SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements 
-SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
-SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology
-SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
-UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
-SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.

70070000024689.name: Pixel Cafe Complete Edition
70070000024689.description:
Welcome to Pixel Cafe
Dive into this captivating blend of an arcade time manager and visual novel. Help a small-town girl navigate life in a big city, and take part in her coming-of-age story as she forges connections, overcomes difficulties, and struggles to find her worth.

Uncover Hidden Tales
Explore Karstok, a city stuck between a socialist past and a capitalist future. Go on an emotional journey as you form connections with your bosses and clients in this beautifully crafted pixel art world.

Master the Art of Coffee and Cooking 
Perfect your coffee-making and cooking skills on your professional journey through 10 wildly different bars. Keep your customers satisfied as you learn new recipes and adapt to sub-optimal working conditions. Sounds too easy? Challenge one of the 50 optional Nightmare levels. Their hellish difficulty will surely hunt you in your dreams.

Decorate Your House
Breathe new life into your Grandma's old house. Buy furniture and unlock posters to decorate it and truly make it your own.

Experience the Emotional Journey
Witness an emotionally gripping narrative that spans three generations. Explore both the past and present through Pixel's eyes and see how memories of her Grandparents shaped her life.

A Unique Soundtrack
Immerse yourself in the game's atmosphere while listening to the captivating, original soundtrack by Arkadiusz Reikowski, featuring a diverse range of genres and emotions.

Embark on a heartfelt journey and discover the essence of Pixel Cafe, where the emotional story unfolds one cup at a time.

This bundle includes base game, Living Room Touches, Bedroom Touches and Kitchen Touches with:

A new variant for the Armchair
A different look for the Computer
An alternative design for the Wardrobe
A modest update for the Bookshelf
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
A new style for the Radio Nightstand
A different variant for the Refrigerator
An updated Oven and Stove design
A new look for the Sink
An alternative style for the Bar
Also, mix things up with two new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000024713.name: Miraculous: Paris Under Siege - Deluxe Edition
70070000024713.description:
Step into the suits of Ladybug and Cat Noir in their most daring adventure yet!  Embark on a thrilling adventure where heroism, acrobatic combat and parkour agility collide as Shadow Moth unleashes a wave of villains across the city.  It’s up to you and your friends to save Paris!

Miraculous: Paris Under Siege - Deluxe Edition contains the base game - with additional content and character options.

Included in the Deluxe Edition:

•  Exclusive Digital Artbook featuring character sketches, concept art, and modeling designs.

New Outfits based on Season 6 of the Miraculous show:

•  A new superhero outfit for Ladybug and 
•  A new sparkle effect for Ladybug's yo-yo

•  A new superhero outfit for Cat Noir
•  A new green glow effect for Cat Noir's staff

70070000024720.name: SWORN - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000024720.description:
Take the battle to Arthur in style with Deluxe Edition, giving you access to the ultimate collection of cosmetic upgrades for SWORN. The Cosmetic Bundle contains a unique weapon skin for each of the 4 character’s 4 weapons and a signature outfit tailored to each hero.

The Deluxe Edition of SWORN contains:
•	SWORN Main Game
•	SWORN – Deluxe Cosmetic Pack (Vigilante)
•	SWORN – Deluxe Cosmetic Pack (Rook)
•	SWORN – Deluxe Cosmetic Pack (Monk)
•	SWORN – Deluxe Cosmetic Pack (Spectre)

70070000024769.name: Fashion Princess: Gold Edition
70070000024769.intro: A game full of Fashion and Princess!
70070000024769.description:
In Fashion Princess you will become a fashionista trying to obtain new costumes and try to become the best photographer out there.

- 80 levels!
- Hundreds of mix betweens costumes, backgrounds and items!
- Photo mode!
- Three stars system, giving the game replayability!

This bundle includes base game, Extra Levels! and DLC#3 with 40 additional levels that challenge your puzzle-solving skills and creativity.
Play more, try more, and elevate your style to new heights with the latest levels in Fashion Princess!

70070000024776.name: Santa's Spot It + Exit Station 7 + Find Room 96 +HighScore Anomaly Shop +HighScore Anomaly Underground
70070000024776.intro: Dive into the thrilling world of anomalies.
70070000024776.description:
Find Room 96
You are trying to find room 96 but you are stuck in a loop. To find room 96, observe your surroundings and get familiar with it. 

Exit Station 7
You entered a train station and appear to be stuck in a loop. Multiple levels to test your observation skill. See if you have what it takes to escape the loop! 

Santa's Spot It
Get ready to dive into the magic of Christmas with Santa’s Spot It, the ultimate holiday themed puzzle game that’s perfect for all ages!

HighScore Anomaly Shop
When you start you will be on level 0.  You will be presented with an area to study the layout of objects observe your surroundings and get familiar with it.

HighScore Anomaly Underground
When you start you will be on level 0.  You will be presented with an area to study the layout of objects observe your surroundings and get familiar with it.

70070000024777.name: Daedalic Turn-Based Bundle
70070000024777.intro: This bundle contains three turn-based games for you to plan and execute your perfect strategies!
70070000024777.description:
This bundle contains three turn-based games for hours of deep, strategical fun: Capes, Inkulinati and Blackguards 2.

Capes
Twenty years ago, the supervillains won.

Since then, they’ve created a dystopian city where developing super powers is a crime. Nobody has managed to slow them down, until now. Capes is a turn based superhero strategy game where you build a team of heroes and fight to take back the city. Played across a series of campaign and patrol missions, choose to push forward with the story or take the time to explore the side missions and unlock more heroes, earn skill points and complete challenges, and learn more about your heroes lives.

Inkulinati
Inkulinati is an ink-based strategy game straight from medieval manuscripts, where a rabbit’s bum can be deadlier than a dog's sword.

Take your turn in Inkulinati duels filled with unexpected tactical depth (and humour!). Embark on an ever-changing journey, build your own bestiary, defeat medieval superstars and collect perks to unleash special powers.

Become a master of the Living Ink, grab your quill and build your unique strategy time after time so that you can be named the greatest Inkulinati of all time!

Blackguards 2
Blackguards 2 is a turn-based strategy-RPG and will deliver challenging hexfield battles and a gritty story filled with violence and crime.

Choose your playstyle: no matter if front line combat monster, mage or ranged fighter it's in your hands how you want to develop your character. Every action has consequences, so make your decisions wisely. Death may be just around the corner.

70070000024789.name: ASTRONEER: Glitchwalkers Edition
70070000024789.description:
This bundle includes the ASTRONEER base game and the Glitchwalkers DLC.

ASTRONEER is a beloved space sandbox sim, sending players out into a strange solar system to survive, explore, and experience an intriguing sci-fi tale.

Glitchwalkers is the first ever expansion to ASTRONEER, offering a new space to explore as well as new narrative, gameplay, and mysteries to uncover.

70070000024792.name: Color Water Sort: Time Attack Edition
70070000024792.intro: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!
70070000024792.description:
Use your head and arrange colored liquids to solve unique puzzles!  

Master the art of water sorting and rise to the top as a champion! Strategically move the water until every color is separated, proving your puzzle-solving prowess!  

Features: 
- overcome 5200 levels! (you get 2500 new levels in Classic Mode and 200 new levels in Timed Mode)
- play in three game modes: classic, timed, and hard 
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!  
- give your brain an excellent workout  
- use powerups: hints, undo, and extra tubes
- get 9 new tubes and 5 new caps
- get 4 new wallpapers
- get 25000 coins and spend them on new tubes, wallpapers, caps, and powerups!  
- collect keys and open prize chests 

Immerse yourself in the challenge of sorting water into tubes with the same colored liquid on top. Remember, the tubes can't be full for the water to go in. Plan your moves carefully to avoid losing!  

Complete thousands of levels in 3 different modes: 
• Classic - a standard mode where you can relax
• Timed - move fast and complete the level within the time limit 
• Hard - think about your every move, because you have a limited number of them

Enjoy this colorful brain challenge by yourself or against your friend!

70070000024794.name: Life Bubble: Speed Up Edition
70070000024794.intro: Hey there astronaut! Get ready for your biggest space adventure with the fastest gear!
70070000024794.description:
Embark on an exciting journey to explore new planets, collect valuable resources, and rescue lost astronauts!

Your mission is to expand your life bubble across the planet and repair your ship to continue your adventure into the unknown! 

Features:
● travel through beautiful and mysterious planets, each with unique resources and terrains
● collect valuable raw materials to rebuild machines and bridges
● use your new hoverboard, which will increase your character's movement speed!
● explore different areas and expand your life bubble over places where it is impossible to survive! 
● buy various character upgrades: bag, speed, life, tools, and power using your 10000 additional money immediately! 
● buy machine upgrades to increase its storage capacity 
● fight enemies with your power weapon!
● complete missions for extra money!

Chop wood, mine colorful crystals or diamonds, and use them to rebuild machines and bridges that will help you expand your life bubble area! Every construction needs specific raw materials, so search for their deposits and get to work!

Complete missions or sell resources you don't need in order to buy character and machine upgrades. Improve your abilities and tools to explore the planet fully prepared!

Be ready for obstacles along the way. Enemies are out to conquer your tiny universe. Protect your life bubble miniature world and fight back like a true space cowboy!

Prepare yourself for a unique and unforgettable space adventure!

70070000024799.name: Ecchi Memories: Sofia Edition
70070000024799.intro: Let the bras hit the floor
70070000024799.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 7 beautiful girls with alluring curves (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000024801.name: Warplanes: WW1 + Space Commander Bundle
70070000024801.intro: Become a legend of air combat! Two thrilling flight combat games together - Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces and Space Commander: War and Trade.
70070000024801.description:
Take a seat at the controls of an airplane or a space ship! Feel the power of their engines and experience the rush of adrenaline flowing through their veins while facing an enemy plane up in the air or space.

This bundle consist of two amazing flight combat action games Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces and Space Commander: War and Trade.

70070000024803.name: Warplanes: WW2 + Space Commander Bundle
70070000024803.intro: Become a legend of air combat! Two thrilling flight combat games together - Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight and Space Commander: War and Trade.
70070000024803.description:
Take a seat at the controls of an airplane or a space ship! Feel the power of their engines and experience the rush of adrenaline flowing through their veins while facing an enemy plane up in the air or space.

This bundle consist of two amazing flight combat action games Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight and Space Commander: War and Trade.

70070000024888.name: Farm It: Complete Edition
70070000024888.intro: Build your own dream farm! Take care of your animals, harvest crops, and sell homemade goodies at the local market!
70070000024888.description:
Plow the field, plant seeds, water the soil, and watch your crops grow! 

Enjoy the country life with other fun activities like fishing, feeding chickens, or cooking yummy food, ensuring there's never a dull moment on your farm!

Grow different crops, from carrots and radishes to oranges and big watermelons! Take orders and keep your customers happy with delicious meals and drinks made with your very own ingredients!

Features:
● live the country life as a real farmer!
● harvest carrots, eggplants, apples, and all your favorite fruits and vegetables
● feed chickens, geese, donkeys, and buffaloes to gather resources
● go fishing in a nearby pond and catch different kinds of fish
● cook food using your own ingredients and sell it in the local market 
● customize your character with over 220 clothes and hairstyles!
● make your farm feel like home with almost 400 decorations!
● buy anything you want with 11000 extra coins!

Express your unique style by changing the look of your character and spending your earnings on a wide range of clothes, shoes, hairstyles, and hats!

Relax with soothing sounds and enjoy satisfying visuals as you farm it all!

Start your farming adventure and create the farm of your dreams!

70070000024892.name: Doll Dress Up: Complete Edition
70070000024892.intro: Become the best doll stylist and make a fabulous princess with new items!
70070000024892.description:
Let your creativity shine as you style your doll with new clothes, accessories, hairstyles, and makeup! 

Create the perfect princess look and have fun with all the new items available! 

Features: 
- customize your sweet doll with a wide range of clothes, accessories and hairstyles! 
- unlock over 400 new items to make your doll look even more unique and stylish!
- personalize your doll's outfit, eye color, hairstyle and makeup
- compete for the title of the prettiest against other dolls!
- choose a background and take a beautiful picture
- watch as your doll collection grows larger and larger!

Take your doll on exciting adventures and explore different styles. Mix and match outfits to create the perfect look for every occasion. Whether it’s a day at the beach, a party, or a magical underwater adventure, your doll will always look her best!

Dress your doll in pretty skirts, cozy sweaters or shiny dresses for a fun fashion competition. Pose in different colorful scenes and get ready for a fantastic photo session!

Let the makeover fun begin!

70070000024894.name: Uboat Attack: Cloverfield Edition
70070000024894.intro: Rise through the ranks and become a legendary commander!
70070000024894.description:
Dive into tactical naval warfare against enemy fleets!

Get behind the guns of a submarine and lead it into thrilling battles against formidable enemy convoys! Use your torpedoes to sink enemy armadas and rise through the ranks to become an admiral of the U-boat fleet. 

Features:
• A new powerful ship: The mighty Cloverfield with a missile ability to break the enemy forces
• A big supply crate: 10000 hammers and extra torpedos
• Variety of authentic ships: Track and destroy real warships with precision
• Realistic damage effects: Experience intense combat scenarios with diverse damage types
• Three game modes: Engage in naval battles, liberate territories, or complete as many missions as possible
• Upgrades and ammunition: Enhance your submarine's stats and equip it with various types of missiles
• Boosters: Gain an edge over your enemies with boosters like armor, air support, instant reload, thermal vision, and more
• Bonus missions: Look up and destroy all enemy planes
• Stunning graphics and locations: Immerse yourself in the game with realistic visuals
• Intuitive controls: Navigate and aim with ease using simple, responsive controls

Explore underwater areas of arctic wastelands, canyons, abyss, and sunken temples to get a tactical advantage in war and prepare an ambush!

Engage in marine events, tactical missions, and naval challenges to earn valuable resources. Dominate the seas and showcase your naval prowess!

Are you ready for the ultimate naval warfare simulator?

70070000024906.name: nPaint Complete +
70070000024906.intro: Wow yourself. Become an outstanding artist with nPaint.
70070000024906.description:
With nPaint, the best illustration app for Nintendo Switch™ , you'll create both simple, ordinary and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite fairy tale characters to mind-blowing works of art.

Develop creativity

Put yourself in control and have freedom of choice. Use crayon, brush or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, holiday cards or the design of your dream living room. Become a modern Picasso and enjoy a remarkable personal gallery of your masterpieces. 

Magical experience

Choose from basic all the way to a mix of smoothly gradient alternating colors.

Innovative small, handy sketchpad or easel

Create anywhere - on the go, on a break at work, at the beach and on an airplane. Go to the next level of relaxation and indulgence. 

This bundle includes all ten gallery expansion.

Key features:
- Essential and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Create technical drawings, birthday cards or portraits
- Tuned to you
- Unprecedented ease of use
- For everyone, regardless of age

70070000024915.name: FAIRY TAIL 2 Digital Deluxe
70070000024915.intro:
The final battle of FAIRY TAIL is about to begin
Enjoy bonus outfits and features!
70070000024915.description:
“FAIRY TAIL 2” is a new RPG based on the popular magical combat fantasy manga and anime series “FAIRY TAIL,” whose story is beloved by fans around the world, with the original manga selling more than 72 million copies worldwide. This sequel to the game "FAIRY TAIL," released in July 2020, depicts the “Alvarez Empire Arc,” the climax of the original manga.

This set includes:
- The main game
- Outfit Set: "Alternate Costumes"
A set of 10 outfits in alternate colors, with 1 outfit for each party member character.
- Lucy Outfit (GUST Collaboration): "Ryza 1"
A Lucy-specific outfit based on the clothing of the "Atelier Ryza" protagonist Ryza.
- Erza Outfit (GUST Collaboration): "Ryza 2"
An Erza-specific outfit based on the clothing of the "Atelier Ryza 2" protagonist Ryza.
- Mirajane Outfit (GUST Collaboration): "Ryza 3"
A Mirajane-specific outfit based on the clothing of the "Atelier Ryza 3" protagonist Ryza.
- Bonus Feature: "Atelier Lucy"
"Atelier Lucy," a feature allowing players to synthesize and upgrade Lacrima, will be made available once the main game has been completed.
- Handy Items: "Crystals" (Set of 10)
A set of 10 Crystals that can be used for character progression. Crystals can be used after a reaching certain point in the game.
- Handy Items: "Lacrima Fragment" (Set of 10)
A set of 10 Lacrima Fragments, which can be used for Lacrima exchanges. This exchange feature will be unlocked after reaching a certain point in the game.

Note:
- Characters' outfits can be changed from the Characters screen. (The character must be a party member.)
- Please see the official site for more details.
- There are other editions that include this product. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000024920.name: Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil Complete +
70070000024920.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.
70070000024920.description:
Embark on a romantic adventure across the colorful landscapes of Rio de Janeiro in Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil. Play as Touji Ishikawa, a young heir to a prestigious family business in Japan, as he ventures into the vibrant streets of Rio de Janeiro in search of true love.

In this visual novel with puzzle mechanics, immerse yourself in Touji's quest to break free from the expectations of his family and discover his path in life.

Meet Tainara Alves, a spirited Brazilian beauty whose passion for dance and zest for life will ignite a spark within Touji's heart. Explore the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro, from the dazzling lights of Carnival to the tranquil shores of Copacabana Beach, as you uncover the secrets of Tainara's world.

But the path to true love is never easy, and Touji and Tainara will face their fair share of challenges along the way. Join them as they unravel mysteries and solve puzzles to see what’s waiting for you next.

Relive your favorite moments from Brazil with all three Best Stories DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Pocket love story
– Over 19 puzzles to solve along the way – the difficulty level rises going forward
– Beautiful anime-style characters
– Not the last Touji journey

70070000024922.name: FAIRY TAIL 2 Ultimate Edition
70070000024922.intro:
The final battle of FAIRY TAIL is about to begin
Digital Deluxe plus Season Pass!
70070000024922.description:
“FAIRY TAIL 2” is a new RPG based on the popular fantasy manga “FAIRY TAIL,” which sold more than 72 million copies worldwide. This sequel to the game "FAIRY TAIL" depicts the “Alvarez Empire Arc,” the climax of the original manga.

- "FAIRY TAIL 2 Digital Deluxe"
- "FAIRY TAIL 2 Season Pass"
Access to 5 types of purchasable DLC.
- Season Pass Bonus: Erza's outfit "Sky Dragon Slayer Wendy," Wendy's outfit "Fairy Queen Erza"
Outfits based on those worn in the "Alvarez Empire Arc."

Eligible content for season pass:
1) Bonus scenario original to game (TBD)
2) Bonus feature "Arena" (details TBD)
3) New party member set 1
Additional playable character (TBD), story, and 3 outfits.
4) New party member set 2
Additional PC (TBD), story, and 3 outfits.
5) New party member set 3
Additional PC (TBD), story, and 3 outfits.

Note:
- The season pass bonus will be available on the game's release date. Eligible content 1) is set to become available by the end of January 2025, 2) and 3) by the end of March 2025, and 4) and 5) by the end of April 2025.
- The details and release dates of content may change without notice. See the official site for details.
- Content can be accessed after reaching designated points in the game. 1) includes a new quest and story. 2) is a facility where players can retry battles against strong enemies. 3), 4), and 5) are sets including characters who have become playable, and their outfits and stories.
- Outfits can be changed via the Characters screen (only if they are party members).
- Other products contain the main game and this content. The season pass and eligible content will be available for purchase as standalone products at a later date. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000024955.name: Fit My Cat Complete +
70070000024955.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000024955.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

Decorate your board with New Floor Pack DLC and get access to new levels with all three Cat's Puzzle Packs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000024968.name: Hentai World Complete +
70070000024968.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose, and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000024968.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet a new character, student Sayuri, Chiyo, Kitty Rose, Puppy Nanami and Foxy Akane

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 art pieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000024994.name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Ultimate Upgrade
70070000024994.intro: Upgrade to Ultimate to add three exclusive Outfit Packs and cat content!
70070000024994.description:
Purchase the Ultimate Upgrade to get three additional Outfit Packs for Max, as well as the Exclusive Cat Content.

The Ultimate Upgrade contains:

• Final Fantasy VII Outfit Pack
• Fan Favorite Outfit Pack
• Paw Prints Cat Outfit Pack
• Exclusive Cat Content

Each Outfit Pack lets you change up Max’s look with 4 new indoor outfits and a coat, with one new indoor outfit available for Max to wear in each chapter of the story.

You can change Max’s Outfit Pack at the dresser in her apartment, and at the start of every new chapter. 

* Please note: the Spooky Outfit Pack and Decades Outfit Pack are only available to purchase in the Deluxe Upgrade, and are not contained in the Ultimate Upgrade.

FINAL FANTASY VII OUTFIT PACK
Max is living in a Materia world, with outfits incorporating unforgettable creatures and monsters from the Final Fantasy VII saga! This pack contains the Moogle coat and four indoor outfits: Chocobo, Cactuar, Bomb, and Tonberry.

FAN FAVORITE OUTFIT PACK
Dive deep into the franchise you love with fresh fits conjured from Arcadia Bay, Haven Springs, and the backwoods of Seattle. This pack contains the Hawt Dawg Man coat and four indoor outfits: Free Bird, Classic Doe, Wolf Squad, and Misfit Skull.

PAW PRINTS CAT OUTFIT PACK
Get your claws into this purrfectly indulgent selection of carnivorous couture! This pack contains the Leopard Print Camo coat and four indoor outfits: Awesome Pawsome, Peek Purple, Feline Fine, and Hang In There.

EXCLUSIVE CAT CONTENT
When Max discovers a lost cat on her back porch, she knows she must reunite it with its owner. But until then, she’ll need to take care of a skittish and unpredictable guest in her apartment…

This bonus content requires the base game Life is Strange: Double Exposure in order to play. 

All additional items, including all three Outfit Packs and the Exclusive Cat Content, will be available at launch of the base game.

70070000024996.name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Deluxe Upgrade
70070000024996.intro: Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to add two exclusive Outfit Packs for Max!
70070000024996.description:
Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition to get two additional Outfit Packs for Max.

The Deluxe Upgrade contains:

• Spooky Outfit Pack
• Decades Outfit Pack

Each Outfit Pack lets you change up Max’s look with 4 new indoor outfits and a coat, with one new indoor outfit available for Max to wear in each chapter of the story.

You can change Max’s Outfit Pack at the dresser in her apartment, and at the start of every new chapter. 

This bonus content requires the base game Life is Strange: Double Exposure in order to play. 

Both the Spooky Outfit Pack and Decades Outfit Pack will be available at launch of the base game.

SPOOKY OUTFIT PACK
Dial up the shivers and indulge your ghost-hunting, monster-wrangling passions with these outfits perfect for Halloween – or for witching hours all year round! This pack contains the Just Haunt It! coat and four indoor outfits: Maxidermy, Ragdoll Max, Max Ghoulfield, and Max O’Lantern.

DECADES OUTFIT PACK
Confront the inexorable passage of time and celebrate your colorful past, with iconic outfits that pay homage to 90s Grunge, 50s Rockabilly, 70s Flower Power, the 80s Mallrat, and 60s Psychedelia.

70070000024997.name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Deluxe Edition
70070000024997.intro: The Deluxe Edition includes two extra Outfit Packs for Max!
70070000024997.description:
Choose the Deluxe Edition to get two extra Outfit Packs for Max!

The Life is Strange: Double Exposure Deluxe Edition contains:

•	Life is Strange: Double Exposure - the complete game
•	Spooky Outfit Pack
•	Decades Outfit Pack

Both the Spooky Outfit Pack and Decades Outfit Pack will be available at launch of the base game.

Max Caulfield, photographer-in-residence at the prestigious Caledon University, discovers her closest new friend, Safi, dead in the snow. 

Murdered.

To save her, Max tries to Rewind time – a power she’s not used in years… instead, Max opens the way to a parallel timeline where Safi is still alive, and still in danger!

Max realizes the killer will soon strike again – in both versions of reality.

With her new power to Shift between two timelines – can Max solve and prevent the same murder?

ORDINARY GIRL, EXTRAORDINARY POWER
Max is thrust into a thrilling supernatural murder mystery – more dangerous than ever before!

TRAVERSE TWO TIMELINES
Forge allies and pursue suspects across two versions of reality, shaping both timelines through unforgettable choices.

RACE AGAINST TIME
A relentless detective has Max in his sights, and Safi’s killer grows closer with every clue uncovered. Can Max survive long enough – to do the impossible?

DECIDE THE FATE OF CALEDON
Explore two versions of a vivid winter campus, each packed with clues, secrets, and tough decisions. 

EXCLUSIVE SOUNDTRACK
A rich original score, new songs, and thrilling licensed tracks!

70070000025030.name: Thief Puzzle: Tricky Edition
70070000025030.intro: Steal your way to the top and become the king of thieves!
70070000025030.description:
Do you have what it takes to steal the treasure without leaving a trace? Put your skills to the test and claim your prize!

Achieve your goal by any means necessary, whether through stealth, speed, or diversion. Use whatever tactics you can to avoid detection and always stay out of sight, or you'll regret it. 

Features:
- Complete over 500 unique levels!
- Get a total of 19 extra skins and themes!
- Avoid tricky obstacles and don't get caught!
- Use your hand to steal the riches!
- Equip awesome themes and skins!
- Enjoy funny sounds and visuals!

What are you waiting for? Start your journey and become a master thief today!

70070000025033.name: nGolf Complete +
70070000025033.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000025033.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Unlock new levels with Moon Swing and Western Fairways. Also change the appearance with all Colorful Golf Balls DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000025054.name: Ys X: Nordics - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000025054.description:
Includes:
- Ys X: Nordics
- Costume Pack
- Sandras Pack

70070000025055.name: Ys X: Nordics - Digital Ultimate Edition
70070000025055.description:
Includes:

70070000025057.name: Ys X - Digital Ultimate Upgrade
70070000025057.description:

70070000025090.name: Touhou Spell Carnival Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000025090.description:
Show your true Touhou fandom and grab the Digital Deluxe Edition today! 

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
・Digital game
・Digital Art Book (57 pages)
・Digital Soundtrack (52 tracks)

70070000025114.name: Ecchi Secrets: Futuristic Edition
70070000025114.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls
70070000025114.description:
Secrets lie beneath the covers... avoid enemies and uncover pictures of beautiful girls posing exclusively for you.

Discovering the truth is never easy... the more tempting the secrets, the greater the challenges you'll face. Unravel all the mysteries to uncover what the girls are hiding, and prepare yourself for plenty of alluring photos along the way.

Features:
- Over 30 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- 16 new pictures of flirtatious girls ready for a date
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes

70070000025155.name: Dicefolk: Master Summoner Bundle
70070000025155.intro: Wield magical dice and build a team of powerful Chimeras to stop a mysterious evil in this tactical roguelite adventure.
70070000025155.description:
Dicefolk is a tactical roguelite game based on customizable dice and monster-catching mechanics. On your adventure as a Chimera Summoner, you'll meet dozens of unique and powerful creatures that you can recruit to create the perfect team

Play as Alea, a young Dicefolk hero who discovers her ability to befriend Chimera and fight back against evil forces threatening humanity’s extinction.

Roguelite Adventure
Embark on a thrilling quest to save humanity from the grasp of an evil sorcerer. Build a team from over 100 unique, hand-drawn Chimera to suit your playstyle. Unlock all the talismans to uncover the mystical secrets behind the Chimeras’ existence.

Master the Chimeras
With a large variety of Chimeras to befriend and command, you'll need to strategize and adapt your playstyle to suit each battle. From tough tanks to speedy attackers, each Chimera brings a unique set of abilities to the table. Your tactical choices will determine your success in battle!

Take Control of Combat
It’s all up to you! Customize your dice for maximum influence over your Chimeras’ attacks and abilities. Control the order in which battles play out and choose when parties take action. Dicefolk defies RNG and gives you unprecedented influence on the roll of the dice

Endless Replayability
Each playthrough offers its own rewards, and the Chimeras you encounter in one run can be entirely different than those you find in another. With different Chimeras comes different strategies to assemble your team for the perfect run!

70070000025156.name: Fly Corp – Complete Edition
70070000025156.intro: Expand your empire by connecting cities across the globe and play your way with Fly Corp – Complete Edition Bundle!
70070000025156.description:
The Complete Edition Includes:

Fly Corp. Build a thriving airline enterprise, connect the entire world with your network, keep an eye on your aircraft park and airports, and don’t get your passengers waiting. 

Fly Corp – Quick scenarios DLC Pack brings 6 new scenarios. Earn a specific amount of money before the time runs out, or try to keep up when the cities appear in the blink of an eye. And other speed challenges!

Fly Corp – Extreme scenarios DLC Pack. Here you’ll have to overcome the 6 hardest scenarios in the entire Fly Corp. Manage the airport with an enormous passenger flow or connect the biggest cities from the East Coast to Alaska. And other extremely hardcore challenges!

70070000025158.name: 10-in-1 Games Bundle for Kids & Toddlers
70070000025158.intro:
Endless fun for little hands.
From farm to safari,
let curiosity bloom!
70070000025158.description:
Discover our game bundle for the whole family! From exciting adventures to tricky puzzles – there’s something for everyone. Help Abbie on her farm, go on safari with Sophia, or solve fun hidden-object challenges – fun and entertainment are guaranteed! The games are kid-friendly, non-violent, and help boost creativity, concentration, and problem-solving skills in a playful way. Perfect for kids of all ages, including the little ones!

Grab this colorful game pack and jump right into the adventure!

The following games are included in this bundle:

- Aaron - The Little Detective
- Abbie's Farm for kids and toddlers
- Animal Puzzle for Kids and Toddlers
- Aqua Puzzle Adventures
- Around The World
- Dish Puzzle
- Farmquest
- Puzzle Playground
- Sophia's World
- Zoozzle

70070000025172.name: Hide 'N Seek!: Complete Edition
70070000025172.intro: ...8, 9, 10. Ready or not, here I come!
70070000025172.description:
Remember the good old game of hide and seek? Prepare for something a little more extreme!

Features:
- Wear 16 new premium skins!
- Make friends with 8 new pets!
- Get 10000 extra coins!
- Hide and run away from the seekers
- Find and capture all the hiders
- Enjoy multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Use powerups to gain an advantage
- Collect coins to buy skins and pets!

Dive into classic gameplay where you can hide or seek. Count down before setting off to find the Hiders, or blend into the environment, stay silent, and outsmart the Seeker to win!

Simple, fun, and dynamic—Hide 'N Seek brings the joy of this beloved childhood game to life!

70070000025174.name: Parking Jam: Tasty Edition
70070000025174.intro: Clear the jammed parking lot and get those cars moving!
70070000025174.description:
Navigate through an overfilled parking lot and move cars out of the way to help them all escape! 

The thought of a parking jam can be overwhelming at first, but don't worry—with a bit of strategy and quick thinking, you can clear the traffic jam and free the cars!  

This parking lot has many vehicles, including small cars, trucks, and SUVs. The jams get increasingly more complicated with each level. Show off how smart you are by clearing them all! 

Features: 
- face over 350 levels!  
- equip new fast food skin for your cars!
- enjoy new fiery trails!
- get extra 25000 coins!
- play in five game modes: Parking Jam, Challenges, Boss Levels, Lot Management, and Hexa Parking 
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!   
- complete levels to unlock new maps 
- use powerups to disable hurdles, freeze people, destroy vehicles, and crush entire lanes! 
- collect keys and open prize chests 
- earn coins and spend them on car skins, powerups and trails 

Try your luck in 5 different game modes:  
•  Parking Jam - Feel the satisfaction of clearing a traffic jam  
•  Challenges - Move cars to free the special vehicle  
•  Boss Levels - Show off your skills with limited moves  
•  Lot Management - Think quickly to take the cars to their lots  
•  Hexa Parking - Feel brilliant by solving unique puzzles 

See what it takes to clear the traffic jam and escape the parking lot!

70070000025176.name: Dreamland Farm Deluxe Edition
70070000025176.intro: After living in a big city your dreams come true – today you start your new life on a peaceful pixel farm!
70070000025176.description:
Your grandma has taught you everything about farming and foraging – from taking care of crops to knowing which berries and mushrooms are edible. Your time has come to become her successor!


A NEW START
You came from the big city to take over your grandma’s farm – a pretty brave move for a city dweller! It’s a good thing that this place has everything you need. With a few decent tools in your pocket, you can start making it your own. Plant crops, take care of cute animals, and don’t forget to explore this vast green expanse.

Make sure to take good care of yourself, during all this as your energy has its limits!


YOU ARE NOT ALONE
There is a small and peaceful town near the farm where you will find many hardworking people – like the local cook, smith, and the mayor. Getting to know them and helping them will expand your dreamland world bit by bit. Not to mention they will help you with upgrading your tools via blueprints… for a favor or two.

Are you ready to uncover the secrets of Dreamland Farm and fall in love with it, just like your grandma did?

Change the look of your farm with all 4 DLCs included in this bundle and make it more cozy.

KEY FEATURES:
- A pixel world with a cozy aesthetic
- Your own pixelated plot of land.
- To balance out the cute and round animals, we put them in a square barn!
- The world grows with you - as you upgrade your gear, the tiers of materials spawning in the world will go up!
- Learn new recipes the same way you get blueprints - but through more delicious means.
- No taxes!

70070000025196.name: Piano: Learn and Play Complete +
70070000025196.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000025196.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes all seven Song Packs.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000025201.name: MasterChef: Learn to Cook! - Complete Edition
70070000025201.intro: Do you have what it takes to be the number one chef? Show your cooking abilities in MasterChef: Learn to Cook!
70070000025201.description:
Choose your ingredients, slice, prepare, plate and serve delicious dishes with style in fun mini-games! 

The MasterChef judges will evaluate your dish based on your performance and speed. Complete and unlock new recipes, challenges, and mini-games along your cooking journey!

GET 3 PREMIUM BOXES FULL OF GOODIES
Boost your cooking career with boxes filled with a ton of ingredients, 3 unique tools, and 7500 prestige coins!

LEARN TO COOK WITH MORE THAN 120 RECIPES!
Make signature recipes from all over the world. Find your favorite dish and make it your specialty. From a Margherita Pizza to Sushi, what do you want to cook today?

CHALLENGE MINI-GAMES
Play dozens of mini-games with a twist! Challenges will take you to cook recipes with extra added difficulty. Will you be able to clear all of them?

MOTION CONTROLS
Become a true number one chef with immersive motion controls. Grab your Joy-Con™ and start cooking for real!

COOK WITH STYLE
Create an avatar and customize its features as you want! Become the coolest chef and stand out by changing your outfit from a wide range of clothes, accessories, and aprons!

UPGRADE YOUR COOKING GEAR
By completing mini-games, events and challenges, you will be able to collect different cooking gear such as pots, utensils, plates amongst others, and upgrade them! Cooking utensils are a chef’s best friend!

It is time to prove that you are a top chef!

70070000025222.name: Bubble Shoot Farm: Extended Edition
70070000025222.intro: Bubble puzzler full of farm animals!
70070000025222.description:
Welcome to Bubble Shoot Farm, the enchanting and addictive puzzle game that will whisk you away to a world of bubble-bursting fun! Prepare to embark on a captivating journey through a vibrant and charming countryside as you take on challenging puzzles that will test your wit and precision.

In Bubble Shoot Farm, you'll find yourself surrounded by lush landscapes, adorable farm animals, and fields bursting with colorful bubbles. Your mission is to match and pop bubbles to rescue cute critters and restore the beauty of this tranquil farm. With its intuitive gameplay and an array of exciting challenges, Bubble Shoot Farm is a perfect blend of strategy and relaxation.

Key Features:
Engaging Puzzle Action: Enjoy hours of engaging gameplay as you aim, shoot, and strategically match bubbles to clear levels and progress through the farm.

Adorable Characters: Meet a cast of charming farm animals, each with its own unique personality and story. Your goal is to save them by popping bubbles and setting them free!

Beautiful Environments: Immerse yourself in the picturesque farm landscapes, from rolling meadows to serene ponds, all brought to life with stunning graphics and attention to detail.

Power-Ups Galore: Utilize a variety of power-ups and boosters to help you conquer even the trickiest levels. Master the art of bubble-bursting to earn high scores!

Easy to Play, Challenging to Master: Bubble Shoot Farm offers simple and intuitive controls, making it accessible to players of all ages. However, mastering the game's intricacies will require skill and strategy.

This bundle includes the base game and DLC #1 with:
- 20 levels brand-new levels set in the charming countryside

Get ready for more levels, more strategy, and even more bubble-shooting excitement!

70070000025239.name: Tales of Graces f Remastered Deluxe Edition
70070000025239.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Tales of Graces f Remastered
• Battle BGM pack
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
• Super Growth Support Herb Set

Tales of Graces f is back with a beautiful and easier-to-play version!

The game also includes Lineage and Legacies, an after-story to the main scenario!

Tales of Graces f is an action RPG about adventure in fantasy worlds and overcoming obstacles through friendship and determination.

• A child’s promise is the world’s last hope
On a lush green planet called Ephinea, three young children make a promise to each other that could save the future.
Asbel, heir to a local lord, Richard, prince of the Windor kingdom, and Sophie, a strange girl with no known past, all swear a special friendship oath after helping each other survive a dangerous attempt on Richard’s life in the land of Lhant.
Years later, the world has changed. Asbel and his friends must face grave danger when Lhant becomes the battleground for a power grab among the three great nations of Ephinea. It is at this moment when an even greater threat is revealed and the bonds between the young heroes are put to the test with everything at stake.

• Exhilarating continuous action with two styles to choose from!
The Style Shift Linear Motion Battle System allows players to switch between two very different battle styles, Artes  and Burst.
You can choose the strength and range of the party’s attacks, the size of the attack, and how close or far away you need to be to the enemy for maximum effectiveness.

• Addition of convenient functions and improved graphics
Quality-of-life  functions have been added, such as auto-save, various skip functions, the ability to turn off enemy encounters in fields and dungeons, and more.

• Full character development and item elements
There are more than 100 different equipable titles that players can rank up through battles, allowing them to learn various skills and techniques that strengthen their stats.

• Lineage and Legacies depicts the world after the ending
Six months have passed since the journey around the world. Sophie is troubled by uncomfortable thoughts about her eventual future and she is determined to find a way out. 
At the same time, strange changes spread throughout Ephinea once again. While Asbel is concerned about Sophie, she and her friends set out to investigate the cause of the anomaly... cause of the anomaly...

70070000025245.name: Hotel Hustle Complete +
70070000025245.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000025245.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE 
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from all four Artbooks DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts

70070000025246.name: Moto Rush GT Epic Edition
70070000025246.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000025246.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Full Garage, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #3 with:

- 17 new vehicles—including an ATV and bicycle!
- 8 new gloves
- New colors for the rest of motorbikes
- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- 8 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000025248.name: Moto Rush GT Power Edition
70070000025248.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000025248.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

• Experience 4 different game modes

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #3 with:

- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- 8 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000025252.name: Gas Station Simulator, Airstrip DLC and Can Touch This DLC Bundle
70070000025252.intro: Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it.
70070000025252.description:
Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it to its former glory. Get rid of debris and broken furniture, fix up the walls, paint and decorate the place to your liking. Just don’t spend all your cash on the looks right away, you bought a gas station after all. Repair the equipment, buy what can’t be repaired and start serving your customers to earn money for further renovations and improvements.

Can Touch This DLC

Rebuild & Reconstruct!
Take matters into your own hand. Almost literally. With the help of your new, trusty hammer, 
it's time to redecorate like you've never done before. Refurbish walls to your heart's content, 
changing their features and decor as you see fit. Decide where to put trash cans or where to 
move the cash register to. Direct the crowd. Show your customers the right way to orderly 
queue without taking too much space. It's time to take interior customisation to a completely 
new level.
Paint & Spray!
No need to stare at an empty canvas any longer! Grab your spray can and add a little 
personal touch to any surface you can lay your hands on. With adjustable scale and rotation,
you can spray anything from large murals to tiny easter eggs hidden somewhere in the 
corners of your station. Combine existing decals with each other, creating even more 
elaborate and complex pieces of art. And whenever you start feeling like you're running out, 
more designs lie hidden all around for you to unlock!
Warehouse & Workshop
Did you ever feel like your station was missing something? That flair didn't quite measure up 
to par when looking beyond your main building? Have no fear for the future is here. From 
tables to desks to banners and lights, your Warehouse and Workshop now possess a full 
suite of purchasable customisations! Make the diamond in the sand shine even brighter than before.

Airstrip DLC

Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day 
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the 
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you 
in on his deals.
The Airstrip
You have plenty of space and as it turned out, there used to be an old military landing strip 
during WWII close to your gas station. Should be that hard to make it work again, right? You 
might even go a step further, order some aviation fuel and some parts for planes. A 
windsock wouldn’t probably hurt and some lights might turn out to be useful, since you will 
on occasion also need to help him land. Let’s see how things develop and what Joe is up 
to...
The Plane
Joe’s plane is like its pilot: old. It’s also simple. The most advanced technology on this thing 
is the LED reading light Joe uses to find his way on the chart. How hard can it be to fix some
simple things on a small plane? And it’s not like you are doing it for free.
The Gameplay
The Airstrip DLC brings new game mechanics and content to Gas Station Simulator based 
on events. Unlike the content we introduced in the past, it does not require your constant 
attention, it is more something that happens every now and then.

70070000025258.name: Moto Rush GT Ultra Edition
70070000025258.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
