70070000025265.name: One Night: Burlesque Complete +
70070000025265.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000025265.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle, you can learn about the creation stories of characters with all four Artbooks and three extra puzzle sets.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000025268.name: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - Complete Edition
70070000025268.description:
This bundle contains:
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?
- Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? – Deluxe Upgrade
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - Hitchcock DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 70s DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 80s DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Movies 90s DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - Geography II DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - US Presidents DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - Space Conquest DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - WWE DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - The Smurfs DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - Tintin DLC Pack
- Who Wants To Be A Millionaire? - NBA/NHL/MLB/NFL DLC Pack

70070000025281.name: FAIRY TAIL 2 Season Pass
70070000025281.intro: Enjoy "FAIRY TAIL 2" to the fullest with the season pass!
70070000025281.description:
Allows users to obtain 5 types of purchasable DLC at a lower cost than purchasing them separately.
- Season Pass Bonus: Erza's outfit "Sky Dragon Slayer Wendy," Wendy's outfit "Fairy Queen Erza"
An outfit for Erza based on Wendy's outfit in the "Alvarez Empire Arc" and an outfit for Wendy based on Erza's outfit in the same arc.

Eligible content for season pass:
1) Bonus Scenario: "FAIRY TAIL Hot Springs"
2) Bonus feature "Arena"
3) New party member set 1
Additional playable character (TBA), story, and 3 outfits.
4) New party member set 2
Additional PC (TBA), story, and 3 outfits.
5) New party member set 3
Additional PC (TBA), story, and 3 outfits.

Note:
- The season pass bonus will be available on the game's release date. 
Eligible content 1) is scheduled to become available by the end of January 2025, 2) and 3) by the end of March 2025, and 4) and 5) by the end of April 2025.
- The details and release dates of content may change without notice. See the official site for details.
- Eligible content can be accessed after reaching designated points in the game. 1) includes a new quest and story. 2) is a facility in which players can retry battles against strong enemies. 3), 4), and 5) are sets that include characters who have become playable, along with their outfits and stories.
- Characters' outfits can be changed from the Characters screen (only if they are party members).
- Other products contain the main game and the same content. The season pass and eligible content will be available for purchase as standalone products at a later date. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000025285.name: Clue - The Case File Collection 1
70070000025285.intro: An exclusive bundle arrives on Nintendo Switch™ consoles!
70070000025285.description:
Manifestation and murder await at Whispering Pines Retreat…

Black Adder Resort promises relaxation and revenge…

Meanwhile, someone’s on thin ice at the Polar Research Station…

Unlock Whispering Pines Retreat, Black Adder Resort, Polar Research Station and revisited case files in this amazing bundle – exclusively on Switch! 

INCLUDES:
NEW CRIMES – Head to different locations around the world to solve murder mysteries far and wide.
NEW CASE FILES – Find out more about your favourite cast of characters and their motives.
NEW COSMETICS – Each crime scene comes with its own array of immersive customisation options.

Contains:
Whispering Pines –  In another reality, six familiar figures receive invitations to an exclusive, luxury wellness resort. But one of them has manifested a murder! 
Black Adder Resort –  What happened after Tudor Mansion? Head to Black Adder Resort to discover the next chapter in the iconic tale…
Polar Research Station – Mr Boden “Boddy” Black has channelled his exceptional wealth into a remote Polar Research Station, presenting it as a noble act of philanthropy. But everything is not as it seems…
Case Files Revisited – New information comes to light at the Black Adder Resort, blowing the case wide open. Agent Gray and Analyst Hyacinth join the suspect roster, meaning you need to revisit the case file and solve the case once and for all!

70070000025295.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Season Pass
70070000025295.description:
Embark on countless new adventures and set yourself up for the long term with the Vagrus Season Pass. With it, you can partake in Vagrus’s massive expansion, as well as survive and thrive in numerous new, exciting locations across the Riven Realms and beyond. The Season Pass grants access to the Sunfire and Moonshadow expansion, along with two upcoming DLCs when they release, for a lower combined price than they would cost individually.

Sunfire and Moonshadow

Vagrus’s first expansion, Sunfire and Moonshadow, offers a new, vast region to explore complete with a swathe of new settlements, new enemies to conquer, new stories to be a part of, a large cast of characters, and new quests to complete through which the vagrus may make their mark on Xeryn. With all this, as well as the introduction of a central conflict involving three new factions – the Ahari, the Chimera Legion, and the Handjari – the expansion features content approaching half the size of the core game.

Old Acquaintances

This DLC reintroduces Sedarias and Javek, companions known to those familiar with the ‘Pilgrims of the Wasteland’ campaign, but now they are over a decade older. Each has changed drastically and each is equipped with new abilities, individual and specific loyalty quests that explore their own stories, with new enemies and rewards that accompany them. The DLC also introduces the Freelancers’ Guild, a new independent organization of mercenaries that can bolster or aid vagri looking for specialized skills.

At the Heart of Ruin (coming in 2025)

Vagrus’s second expansion, At the Heart of Ruin, offers a tight but multi-layered and dense region fraught with conflict and rich with opportunities. Vagri who decide to brave the forsaken paths of this broken realm will be challenged not only by new foes and villains, but also by the very nature one must traverse the mountainous terrain.

70070000025297.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Gold Edition
70070000025297.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000025322.name: Fly&Ride Collection
70070000025322.intro: Defy Gravity: Soar High with BoomBit's Fly&Ride Collection!
70070000025322.description:
Experience the thrill of extreme sports with BoomBit's exhilarating bundle, featuring Ramp Bike Jumping, Bike Jump, and Crazy Plane Landing. Perform daring stunts, conquer challenging courses, and pilot planes through treacherous skies.

In Bike Jump, enter the craziest, most challenging and spectacular sporting event ever conceived! Drive your bike as fast as you can down a breathtaking ramp and just… JUMP!

Perform the most unimaginable stunts on motorcycles, bicycles, even skis in the Ramp Bike Jumping!

Get into one of the amazing flying machines and launch as high as you can in Crazy Plane Landing!

With stunning visuals, realistic physics, and addictive gameplay, these games offer endless hours of fun.

Don't miss out on the ultimate extreme sports experience!

70070000025323.name: Crown Wars – Sacred Edition
70070000025323.intro: Fight darkness with sword and wit
70070000025323.description:
Fight the Order and its corruption by embodying light with the Sacred Edition. It includes:
- Brotherhood of Light Cosmetic Pack: Fight darkness and the Order by proudly wearing the Brotherhood of Light cosmetic pack. It contains a unique helm for each of your classes, a new skin for your weapons, and the Sacred Emblems pack to customize your squad and banner.
- Blood Pact Weapon Skins: Sometimes you need to fight fire with fire and blood with blood. Use the Order's own demonic weapons against them by equipping this weapon skin pack.

THE WAR OF CROWNS RAGES ON
Knights and brigands run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. But an even greater evil is lurking and plotting in the shadows. At the helm of your Domain, lead the fight against the forces of evil in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.
 
BECOME THE LORD OF YOUR DOMAIN
From your castle – your seat of operations – recruit, equip and train your soldiers to fight all those that threaten the kingdom. Build squads according to the requirements of each mission, then set out to find the source of the Evil and thwart the malevolent plans of the Order in brutal turn-based combat. Your management and strategic skills will be put to the test. Manage your resources wisely to help your Domain flourish, and plan your squad excursions by choosing which missions to tackle.
With the world on the brink of collapse, there can only be one solution: the Order must be defeated.
 
FIGHT DARKNESS WITH SWORD AND WIT
- The Hundred Years' War revisited
- Prevent the Order from expanding its influence and restore your reputation
- Rebuild your Domain
- Tactical battles in the purest tradition of the genre
 
ASSEMBLE YOUR PERFECT SQUAD
- 6 playable classes
- Improve your soldiers
- Fully customizable Companions
- Ransom your prisoners of war
- Each battle is different
- Brutal action

70070000025325.name: Lofi Chill Sessions: Halloween Edition
70070000025325.intro: Spooky beats, Cozy vibes – your perfect Halloween Chill!
70070000025325.description:
Get ready to elevate your spooky season with the Lofi Chill Sessions: Halloween Edition! This bundle features two hauntingly cool DLC packs:

*Lofi Chill Sessions: Spooky Pack – Transform your cozy chill space into a Halloween haven with eerie environments and themed objects that bring the spooky vibe to life. From flickering jack-o'-lanterns to misty graveyards, set the perfect mood for your lofi beats.

*Lofi Chill Sessions: Haunted Vibes – Meet two brand-new Halloween characters, each with their own unique style and spooky charm, adding a playful yet haunting touch to your chill sessions.

Whether you're studying, relaxing, or just soaking in the spooky vibes, this Halloween edition bundle is perfect for creating a laid-back, ghostly groove.

70070000025326.name: Little Strays: Deluxe Edition
70070000025326.intro: Prowl through abandoned places to rescue kittens and scavenge supplies, facing relentless challenges that test your courage and instincts.
70070000025326.description:
• Search abandoned warehouses for food and rescue lost kittens.
• Avoid obstacles and complete timed objectives.
• Play through 16 challenging levels.
• Compete in two-player split-screen mode.

Step into the heartwarming world of Little Strays, where you become the caretaker of a lovable group of stray kittens. In this charming adventure, your mission is to explore an large neighborhood, find food for hungry kittens, and reunite lost cats with their families.

While exploring abandoned areas, step with your paws carefully and uncover hidden spots filled with food.

Little Strays is a touching game for animal lovers of all ages. Can you find all the lost kittens and give them the care they need?

This bundle includes "New Feline Friends" which adds additional types of cats in different colors!

70070000025331.name: Brotato & Abyssal Terrors DLC - Bundle
70070000025331.intro: Enjoy Brotato and Brotato: Abyssal Terrors with this bundle!
70070000025331.description:
Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.
--------
After countless nights battling fiends on the scorching grounds of a treacherous planet, Brotato has decided to take refuge in the depths of the oceans. But he will soon discover that he is not alone.

Features
- 20 new waves with new enemies, elites and bosses
- 14 new characters
- 16 new weapons
- 30+ new items

70070000025334.name: Hidden Shy Cats & Dogs Bundle
70070000025334.intro: Find shy musician cats and dogs in this charming bundle! Enjoy cozy hidden-object gameplay as you discover adorable animals and create your own musical mix!
70070000025334.description:
The Hidden Shy Cats & Dogs Bundle brings together two delightful hidden-object games that are all about music, animals, and heartwarming discoveries!

In Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra, explore beautiful, hand-drawn scenes to uncover shy feline musicians. Each hidden cat adds a new instrument, letting you create unique melodies as you build your cat orchestra!

In Shy Dogs Hidden Orchestra, the fun continues with adorable puppies hiding in various vibrant settings. Find these bashful musician dogs to unlock more sounds and craft your own doggy symphony!

Enjoy relaxing gameplay as you search, find, and build your musical ensembles in these cozy, animal-themed adventures! Perfect for hidden-object fans and anyone who loves cute animals and soothing melodies.

70070000025335.name: Explore Another World Bundle
70070000025335.intro: Get ready to head to another world when you head to the adorable monster-filled land of New Wirral in Cassette Beasts, and over one hundred floating islands in Moonstone Island!
70070000025335.description:
Get ready to head to another world when you head to the adorable monster-filled land of New Wirral in Cassette Beasts, and over one hundred floating islands in Moonstone Island!

In Cassette Beasts you can collect awesome monsters to use during turn-based battles in this open-world RPG, now with online multiplayer mode. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts’ Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!

Moonstone Island is a creature-collecting life-sim set in an open world with 100 islands to explore. Make friends, brew potions, collect Spirits, and test your strength in card-based encounters to complete your Alchemy training!

70070000025341.name: Cooking Deluxe Edition
70070000025341.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000025341.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

Decorate your restaurant with an amazing Green Dragon Set included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!

70070000025377.name: Gas Station Simulator Airstrip DLC and Can Touch This DLC Bundle
70070000025377.description:
Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC
Cars are nice, but maybe airplanes are nicer? Build a small airstrip at your gas station and 
help Joe with his air routes in this DLC.
It is more story-driven than what we did in the past and it allows you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.
Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day 
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the 
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you 
in on his deals.
The Airstrip
You have plenty of space and as it turned out, there used to be an old military landing strip 
during WWII close to your gas station. Should be that hard to make it work again, right? You 
might even go a step further, order some aviation fuel and some parts for planes. A 
windsock wouldn’t probably hurt and some lights might turn out to be useful, since you will 
on occasion also need to help him land. Let’s see how things develop and what Joe is up 
to...
The Plane
Joe’s plane is like its pilot: old. It’s also simple. The most advanced technology on this thing 
is the LED reading light Joe uses to find his way on the chart. How hard can it be to fix some
simple things on a small plane? And it’s not like you are doing it for free.
The Gameplay
The Airstrip DLC brings new game mechanics and content to Gas Station Simulator based 
on events. Unlike the content we introduced in the past, it does not require your constant 
attention, it is more something that happens every now and then. 

Gas Station Simulator - Can Touch This DLC
Get some new tools and redecorate your gas station. Change walls, doors, windows and 
move things around. Make your own art and rival Dennis’ artworks. Want to change the 
warehouse or the workshop? Now you can. And much, much more.
Rebuild & Reconstruct!
Take matters into your own hand. Almost literally. With the help of your new, trusty hammer, 
it's time to redecorate like you've never done before. Refurbish walls to your heart's content, 
changing their features and decor as you see fit. Decide where to put trash cans or where to 
move the cash register to. Direct the crowd. Show your customers the right way to orderly 
queue without taking too much space. It's time to take interior customisation to a completely 
new level.
Paint & Spray!
No need to stare at an empty canvas any longer! Grab your spray can and add a little 
personal touch to any surface you can lay your hands on. With adjustable scale and rotation,
you can spray anything from large murals to tiny easter eggs hidden somewhere in the 
corners of your station. Combine existing decals with each other, creating even more 
elaborate and complex pieces of art. And whenever you start feeling like you're running out, 
more designs lie hidden all around for you to unlock!
Warehouse & Workshop
Did you ever feel like your station was missing something? That flair didn't quite measure up 
to par when looking beyond your main building? Have no fear for the future is here. From 
tables to desks to banners and lights, your Warehouse and Workshop now possess a full 
suite of purchasable customisations! Make the diamond in the sand shine even brighter than before.

70070000025379.name: "BEYBLADE X XONE & Season Pass"
70070000025379.intro: Enjoy thrilling and extreme video game battles!

70070000025381.name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 - Standard Edition
70070000025381.intro: Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4.
70070000025381.description:
Pre-purchase and receive:

- Wireframe Tony Shader

Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

- Reunite the crew with cross-platform online Multiplayer* for up to 8 skaters in new and returning game modes.
- Drop in to new parks or tear it up across the timeless parks from both Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 4, authentically remade in jaw dropping HD resolution with streamlined goals and the epic 2-minute format.
- Hit ‘em with some drip in the expanded Create-A-Skater and Create-A-Park modes, including the ability to create custom goals to share with friends for the first time ever.
- Shred harder than ever with more challenging goals and an enhanced New Game+ mode.
- Whether you’re a total casual or a grungy pro, the same smooth handling and simple-to-learn controls from Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2 will have you shredding like a Pro.

Alert the neighborhood watch and grab your skate buddies because the shred’s not dead. It’s back and better than ever.

- Additional songs included with the in-game soundtrack
- Exclusive Doom Slayer, Revenant, and Create-a-Skater skate decks
- Exclusive themed Create-a-Skater Items

Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

- Reunite the crew with cross-platform online Multiplayer** for up to 8 skaters in new and returning game modes.
- Drop in to new parks or tear it up across the timeless parks from both Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 4, authentically remade in jaw dropping HD resolution with streamlined goals and the epic 2-minute format.

70070000025404.name: Wingspan Oceania Deluxe Bundle
70070000025404.intro: Create the most amazing bird habitats in this complete Wingspan experience.
70070000025404.description:
This bundle includes:
WINGSPAN
WINGSPAN: European Expansion
WINGSPAN: Oceania Expansion
Seasonal Decorative Pack
Woodland Wonders Decorative Pack

Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.

Wingspan: European Expansion takes you on a journey to another continent. Explore diverse European habitats and meet charming, beautiful birds with new interesting abilities.

In the adaptation of the award-winning Wingspan: Oceania Expansion embark on a journey through the breathtaking lands of Oceania. Learn about birds from around Australia and New Zealand and all-new resources and mechanics that will enrich your adventure of creating a wildlife preserve.

In the Seasonal Decorative Pack for Wingspan, you'll get unlimited access to the 7 seasonal backgrounds that have appeared in 2021, along with brand new matching portraits, only available with this pack! With this DLC you will be able to play on your favourite background whenever you want to. Be it a winter background in the middle of summer, or an Easter background in winter - you don’t have to wait for a specific season to use it; you are free as a bird and can choose what and when you want!

Discover the diversity of forests with the Woodland Wonders Decorative Pack. With this pack, you'll get 6 enchanting, digitally hand-painted backgrounds of different forests and 6 player portraits of their inhabitants.

70070000025409.name: Across the Obelisk - The Sahti Collection
70070000025409.description:
The Sahti Collection combines the Shores of Sahti Story Pack with the Bernard, the Alchemist and Sigrun, the Valkyrie Hero Packs. Uncover the mysteries of the Sahti Islands and unlock powerful strategies thanks to the addition of two new hybrid heroes. Your adventure on the high seas starts here!

Set sail for the Sahti Islands in this all-new pirate-themed adventure. Powerful factions are vying for dominance in this once-peaceful archipelago. Will you defend the indigenous people, exploit their natural resources or battle to emerge as king of the pirates? The choice is yours!


The Shores of Sahti Story Pack introduces a classic pirate setting to Across the Obelisk alongside an array of new items, enemies and secrets to discover.

• Explore a tropical paradise thrown into chaos by the awakening of an ancient obelisk.

• Formidable foes have emerged from the depths of the ocean, threatening the existence of the spiritual Sahti people.

• Amid the turmoil, three powerful factions wrestle for control of the islands: the navy seeking to defend the locals, the greedy Company of Overseas Trade and feuding bands of pirates. Who will you side with?

• Face-off against 20 new enemies, three champion enemies and three new bosses, including the legendary Kraken.

• Bring two new pets to the party—Matey the parrot, and Mimy a mimic chest with a mouthful of teeth!

• Do battle in a gorgeous nautical combat theme.

• Thrilling new locations are yours to discover. Explore a mighty dreadnought, investigate a fearsome pirate fortress and solve the secrets of the briny deep.

• Navigate your way through a host of new events.

• Get to grips with 35 new items.

• Add a touch of seafaring flair to your deck with a new cardback design.

• Share the story with your co-op party. Only one person per party needs to own this Story Pack to play through the adventure.


Sigrun, the Valkyrie Hero Pack contains:

• Sigrun, a mage-scout hybrid capable of summoning lightning and thunder to torment her foes.

• An agile, rapid hero. Thanks to her Spellsinger talent, Sigrun receives Elemental spells from the mage class for free and at zero cost.

• A new pet. Jelly the jellyfish is a master of lightning, just like her Valkyrie friend.

• Three unique skins suitable for any goddess who may find herself far from Valhalla. 

• Three new Sahti Island-themed cardbacks.

• Custom replies for random events. Learn more about Sigrun’s mysterious past and noble quest to protect the Sahti people.

Discover an intriguing story and bring new strategies to bear with Sigrun, the Valkyrie.


Bernard, the Alchemist Hero Pack contains:

• Bernard, a scout-healer hybrid, best placed to take advantage of Flask and Rust, the tag and curse introduced in update 1.5.

• A deceptive hero. Bernard might have the speed of a turtle, but his powers are much mightier! Use his mastery of Rust to inflict powerful effects on unsuspecting enemies or reduce the impact of negative effects on Bernard.

• Inky, the octopus, a pet with the ability to shoot ink and apply the Wet, Poison and Dark status effects.

• Three unique skins, each fit for adventuring on the high seas and beyond.

• Three new cardbacks with a Sahti Islands flavor.

• Custom replies for random events. Discover more about Bernard’s personality, backstory and hopes for a longer life.

Thanks to Bernard, the Alchemist and Inky, his eight-legged friend, you can discover powerful new combinations previously unseen.

70070000025432.name: Mars Survivor: Complete Edition
70070000025432.intro: Conquer Mars, fend off alien threats, and secure your path to survival!
70070000025432.description:
After an asteroid catastrophe, your rocket ship crash-lands in the wilderness of Mars. Explore the planet's mysteries, strategize your escape, and build a shelter to protect yourself!

Features:
- Get a premium supply crates with lots of scraps, armor, weapons and materials!
- Use additional 1500 gems
- Navigate Mars's challenges
- Explore the planet's secrets and discover hidden materials 
- Build a shelter and protect yourself from the harsh Martian environment!
- Defend against alien invasions and uncover secrets of the creatures of Mars!
- Gather oxygen and essential materials from old rocket ships to survive
- Strategize your escape mission and secure your passage back to Earth!
- Open epic loot boxes to swap or upgrade your gear

Go on dangerous expeditions to gather intel and resources. Fight off hordes of alien creatures, and save other survivors. Use their skills and knowledge to defend your base from a huge enemy attack!

Become the last man standing on Mars, navigate through the wilderness, and prove your survival skills!

70070000025440.name: Carmen Sandiego Deluxe Edition
70070000025440.intro: Celebrate 40 years of Carmen Sandiego with the Deluxe Edition, crafted for devoted fans and new sleuths alike!
70070000025440.description:
Celebrate 40 years of Carmen Sandiego with the Deluxe Edition, featuring an exclusive caper that turns the tables—this time, you’re the detective chasing Carmen and her crew, just like in the original 1985 game.

Carmen Sandiego Deluxe Edition includes: 

•	Exclusive 40th Anniversary Caper – Where in the World? (The ACME Files)
•	Cosmetic Skin: Classic Carmen – Before the iconic red coat, there was brown.
•	Cosmetic Skin - Motorcycle Carmen outfit
•	Digital Official Soundtrack
•	Digital Official Artbook.


VILE is back on the scene, and for once, ACME and Carmen Sandiego have a common enemy. In a rare and temporary alliance, the world’s greatest thief must track down the syndicate before they can pull off their next big heist. Rookie gumshoes and seasoned detectives are invited to put their sleuthing skills to the test whether it’s in the narrative driven main campaign or the classic mode ‘The Acme Files’.

IT TAKES A THIEF TO CATCH A THIEF
Carmen Sandiego, the elusive master thief, has temporarily aligned herself with ACME. Her intimate knowledge of VILE’s operations and her unparalleled skills in espionage make her an invaluable, albeit risky, ally. 

GEAR UP GUMSHOE
A great thief is only as good as her tools. Glide across rooftops, grapple between buildings, and switch between night vision, UV, and thermal to track suspects and find hidden clues.

TRAVEL THE GLOBE
From the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro to the majestic landmarks of Tokyo, embark on a whirlwind tour of the world's most iconic destinations. With stunning visuals and immersive environments, every location comes to life, inviting you to explore, discover, and unravel the secrets that lie within.

SOLVE CAPERS
Use quick thinking and detective skills to decode messages, crack safes, and outwit VILE operatives before they disappear. Every choice impacts your mission, so act fast!

CAPTURE VILE
Use clues, interviews, and the ACME CrimeNet Database to profile and identify VILE operatives. But remember, a warrant is essential before making any arrests! Will you crack the case and bring VILE to justice, or will they evade capture?

70070000025441.name: Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000025441.description:

70070000025443.name: Distillery & Tavern Duo: Moonshine Inc. + Crossroads Inn: A Fantasy Tavern Sim
70070000025443.intro: Run the inn, brew the moonshine – business awaits!
70070000025443.description:
BEGIN WITH PASSION FOR MOONSHINE
We love moonshin’. There ain’t nothin’ better than good booze. In Appalachia, we know it well. We’ve got moonshine in our blood - in the case of some old-timers, maybe even literally. We love to talk about likker, make it, drink it all day long - and we love to share it too! How 'bout that, my gaming friend?

GET THE KNOW-HOW AND CRAFT FINE LIKKERS
What’s your alcohol of choice? Do you maybe know how to make it? The process is a complex one, but with our know-how, we can shed some light on it, if you’d like; a little bit of moonlight - moonshine! - to guide you through the processes of fermentation, distillation, and bottling. 

RUN YOUR BASE SMART... AND BE DISCREET
Makin’ booze is pure fun, but if you’re makin’ money too - now that’s the way to live. However, for that, you need to be smart, manage your base right, and not piss off the boys in blue...
We tried to capture the life of a moonshiner as realistically as possible. You’ll be managing workers who’ll be crafting and maintaining your equipment, you’ll be buying ingredients, unlocking technologies, planning deliveries and finances, making sure you remain as discreet as possible - and deciding whom to trust and with whom to work.

That’s how Moonshine Inc. came to be. Made for moonshiners, amateurs, dreamers, and newbies. Sit down, launch the game, enjoy crafting and running your business, and relax… after all, ain't nothin’ illegal ‘til you get caught!

---

In Crossroads Inn: A Fantasy Tavern Sim micromanagement goes head to head with a rich story. As the kingdom is in turmoil and a shift of power is expected, your Inn will soon attract the attention of important political and military figures, who are desperately trying to hold on to the reins of power. 

Will you stay neutral or become a part of a large-scale drama, full of political intrigues? Meet vivid characters, deal with treacherous NPCs, and fulfill dangerous quests inspired by RPG games – there’s even a damsel in distress to save!

In Sandbox mode, you will focus solely on managing your business and economy – build your own tavern, hire and oversee staff, manage the supply chains and create new dish recipes. If you get hungry for additional challenges, we've prepared 6 scenarios - every one of them is a separate, standalone story, bringing unique objectives and rules. 

Key Features: 

- Build your own tavern in the original fantasy world of Delcrys and enjoy a real-time management sim and RPG in one game!

- Choose between three distinct game modes: an epic Campaign mode with a non-linear story (12 different endings!), a nearly endless Sandbox mode dedicated to hardcore sim fans, and a scenario mode with 6 unique stories.

- Delve into the rich and detailed lore with feuding factions and influential organizations – choose to forge alliances or work against others in an original, low fantasy-set world.

- Enjoy the once-in-a-lifetime culinary adventure designed in cooperation with the experts from Nerds’ Kitchen - discover recipes, create new dishes, and serve assorted menus to attract various types of guests and fulfill their nutritional needs.

- Explore the complex tavern economy simulation including special guests, unique and regular employees, dozens of resources, and facilities to build and develop.

- Discover included in-game DLCs containing additional workers and items inspired by Klabater games!

70070000025449.name: Sprout Valley Autumn Collection
70070000025449.intro: Make your dream of settling on an island and growing a beautiful garden come true!
70070000025449.description:
Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

Autumn Collection includes 6 DLCs: Lovely, Easter, Cows, Nico's Skins, New Friend: Momo, Spray Paint.

KEY FEATURES
- Charming 2D pixel art graphics
- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!
- Simple and clear economy system
- Lovely music track

70070000025455.name: PAWfectly Designed: Ultimate Edition
70070000025455.intro: Unleash your creativity and help design a dream space for each of your furry friends!
70070000025455.description:
Bundle includes "Extra Mission" and "Room Expansion" add-on!

• 20 Unique Levels: Each level introduces a new room and storyline.
• Extensive Furniture Collection: Decorate with a wide variety of items like chairs, tables, plants, accessories, and wall art.
• Intuitive Controls: Easily place and arrange furniture with simple, user-friendly controls.
• Free Building Mode: Decorate rooms freely and bring your own creative visions to life.

Step into the charming paws of exceptionally talented interior designer doggie with a flair for creativity and an eye for detail. Help your furry friends design their dream rooms, a cozy space where they can develop their passions.

Embark on a delightful journey across 15 different project tasks with an interesting story, each presenting unique design challenges and opportunities to unleash your creativity. From the room of a great film director, bakery smelling of fresh baked goods, laboratory of a brilliant inventor to the gallery of a funny circus performer, every level offers a fresh canvas to showcase your interior design prowess.

70070000025460.name: Dreamland Farm Classic Edition
70070000025460.intro: After living in a big city your dreams come true – today you start your new life on a peaceful pixel farm!
70070000025460.description:
Your grandma has taught you everything about farming and foraging – from taking care of crops to knowing which berries and mushrooms are edible. Your time has come to become her successor!


A NEW START
You came from the big city to take over your grandma’s farm – a pretty brave move for a city dweller! It’s a good thing that this place has everything you need. With a few decent tools in your pocket, you can start making it your own. Plant crops, take care of cute animals, and don’t forget to explore this vast green expanse.

Make sure to take good care of yourself, during all this as your energy has its limits!


YOU ARE NOT ALONE
There is a small and peaceful town near the farm where you will find many hardworking people – like the local cook, smith, and the mayor. Getting to know them and helping them will expand your dreamland world bit by bit. Not to mention they will help you with upgrading your tools via blueprints… for a favor or two.

Are you ready to uncover the secrets of Dreamland Farm and fall in love with it, just like your grandma did?

Change the look of your farm with Banner DLC included in this bundle and make it more cozy.

KEY FEATURES:
- A pixel world with a cozy aesthetic
- Your own pixelated plot of land.
- To balance out the cute and round animals, we put them in a square barn!
- The world grows with you - as you upgrade your gear, the tiers of materials spawning in the world will go up!
- Learn new recipes the same way you get blueprints - but through more delicious means.
- No taxes!

70070000025465.name: Tell Me Your Story Grandma Collection
70070000025465.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000025465.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD 

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

This bundle includes all 3 extra puzzles DLCs and Rose Artbook showing the process of creating characters and locations.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience

70070000025470.name: Piano: Learn and Play Music Collection
70070000025470.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000025470.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes sixth and seventh Song Packs.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000025475.name: AAA Clock Classic Collection
70070000025475.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000025475.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 6 DLCs: the Squid, Cyber, Spin, Elegant Pixel and Digital Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000025480.name: Freaky Trip Freaky Collection
70070000025480.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000025480.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Summer, Winter, Fall Spring, and Space Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000025485.name: nGolf Balls Collection
70070000025485.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000025485.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Unlock new levels with Moon Swing DLC and also change the appearance with Colorful Golf Balls 3 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000025490.name: Tokyo Cooking Asian Collection
70070000025490.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70070000025490.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.

Decorate your restaurant with the Cherry Blossom and Sky Heron Sets DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000025495.name: Warplanes: WW1 + WW2 + Space Commander Bundle
70070000025495.intro: Become a legend of air combat! Three thrilling flight combat games together - Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces, Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight and Space Commander: War and Trade.
70070000025495.description:
Take a seat at the controls of an airplane or a space ship! Feel the power of their engines and experience the rush of adrenaline flowing through their veins while facing an enemy plane up in the air or space.

This bundle consist of three amazing flight combat action games Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces, Warplanes: WW2 Dogfight and Space Commander: War and Trade.

70070000025496.name: 10-in-1 Christmas Collection
70070000025496.intro: 10 games with guaranteed entertaining fun await you in this Christmas Collection!
70070000025496.description:
10 times the Christmas magic for the whole family!

Experience unforgettable moments with our fantastic Christmas Collection. Dive into 10 exciting games from different genres that have something for every age group and every taste! From exciting hidden object games to creative brain teasers like Mahjong and varied Match3 games. Whether young or old, everyone will get their money's worth!

Leave the stress of everyday life behind you and immerse yourself in the world of gaming. Make your Christmas more colorful and cheerful with our Christmas Collection!

Included games:
• Witch's Pranks - Frog's Fortune   
• Season Match HD                   
• Season Match 2                    
• Season Match 3: Curse of the Witch Crow
• Secrets of Magic - The Book of Spells  
• Secrets of Magic 2 - Witches & Wizards 
• Tales of the Orient - The Rising Sun   
• Forgotten Tales - Day of the Dead      
• Moai VI: Unexpected Guests        
• Mahjong Deluxe 3

70070000025497.name: Roses for My Love: Complete Set
70070000025497.description:
These are short stories that take place after the main story's ending, focused on the theme of "love gifted from her to the man she loves." See the fresh start of their relationship alongside newly drawn CGs.
This special set includes all four stories in one discounted bundle.

Roses for My Love: Lucien
"Feverish First Love" "On Paper Aeroplanes" "The Prince and the Knight"

Roses for My Love: Crius
 "Loving Back and Forth" "Tempting Game" "The Knight and the Foreigner"

Roses for My Love: Tyril
 "Painful Path to Love" "Like a Plea, Like a Prayer" "The Inquisitor and the Prince"

Roses for My Love: Zenn
"A Gentle and Teasing Embrace" "Innocent Joy" "The Foreigner and the Inquisitor"


・These stories include important information concerning the main story. It is highly recommended you save reading these for after clearing the main story.
・Please update to the newest version before playing.
・Please take care not to purchase duplicates.

70070000025522.name: Bubble Shoot Farm: Extra Version
70070000025522.intro: Bubble puzzler full of farm animals!
70070000025522.description:
Welcome to Bubble Shoot Farm, the enchanting and addictive puzzle game that will whisk you away to a world of bubble-bursting fun! Prepare to embark on a captivating journey through a vibrant and charming countryside as you take on challenging puzzles that will test your wit and precision.

In Bubble Shoot Farm, you'll find yourself surrounded by lush landscapes, adorable farm animals, and fields bursting with colorful bubbles. Your mission is to match and pop bubbles to rescue cute critters and restore the beauty of this tranquil farm. With its intuitive gameplay and an array of exciting challenges, Bubble Shoot Farm is a perfect blend of strategy and relaxation.

Key Features:
Engaging Puzzle Action: Enjoy hours of engaging gameplay as you aim, shoot, and strategically match bubbles to clear levels and progress through the farm.

Adorable Characters: Meet a cast of charming farm animals, each with its own unique personality and story. Your goal is to save them by popping bubbles and setting them free!

Beautiful Environments: Immerse yourself in the picturesque farm landscapes, from rolling meadows to serene ponds, all brought to life with stunning graphics and attention to detail.

Power-Ups Galore: Utilize a variety of power-ups and boosters to help you conquer even the trickiest levels. Master the art of bubble-bursting to earn high scores!

Easy to Play, Challenging to Master: Bubble Shoot Farm offers simple and intuitive controls, making it accessible to players of all ages. However, mastering the game's intricacies will require skill and strategy.

This bundle includes the base game and DLC #2 with:
- 20 levels brand-new levels set in the charming countryside

Get ready for more levels, more strategy, and even more bubble-shooting excitement!

70070000025530.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Super Edition
70070000025530.intro: Tasty burgers? We've got you covered!
70070000025530.description:
Like going in to town for a bite to eat? Everybody does! 

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side? 
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, french fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats! 

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up! 

Upgrade your restaurant and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger joint in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat
* 60 awesome levels to complete
* Countless dishes to master and serve
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and DLC#4 Endless Mode with:

• 20 new levels,
• 6 new achievements
• New Endless Mode

70070000025531.name: Bridge Race: Complete Edition
70070000025531.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70070000025531.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

Features:
- 7 additional skins to show off your style!
- 25000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition—who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000025533.name: Sweet Survivors: Complete Edition
70070000025533.intro: The purr-fect storm is coming! Can you protect your café from fluffy chaos?
70070000025533.description:
It looks like a normal day at the café… but suddenly, swarms of love-craving cats are storming in, and only you stand between them and total feline chaos! Armed with laser pointers, yarn balls, and even the dreaded pickle of doom, you’ll have to keep these fluffballs at bay while serving your customers their precious coffee. No big deal, right?

Features:
- Face down hordes of fluffy invaders
- Unlock 11 quirky toys and 9 heroic waiters
- Conquer shifts in 5 different café battlegrounds
- Upgrade your waiters and toys to become the strongest cat-wrangler
- Enjoy purr-fectly fun gameplay and cute visuals

Get ready for waves of fur and whiskers as you protect two cozy cafés. Upgrade your toys and special skills to become the best cat-fighting waiter around! With each shift, you’ll unlock new waiters, fun toys, and even more cat-tastrophes!

Can you save your café before the cats take over?

70070000025536.name: Neko Bento Deluxe Edition
70070000025536.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000025536.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

Unlock more puzzles to solve with New Levels 1 DLC included in this bundle.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000025537.name: Totally Reliable Delivery Service Deluxe Edition
70070000025537.intro: Everything you need to be a Totally Reliable Delivery Service person!
70070000025537.description: Includes, Totally Reliable Delivery Service, Cyberfunk, Stunt Sets, and Dress Code.

70070000025538.name: Totally Reliable Delivery Service Express Package
70070000025538.intro: Cyberfunk, Stunt Sets, and Dress Code DLCs all boxed up and ready to ship.
70070000025538.description:
Buckle up your back brace and fire up the delivery truck, it's time to deliver! Join up to three of your friends and haphazardly get the job done in an interactive sandbox world. Delivery attempted, that's a Totally Reliable Delivery Service guarantee!

FEATURES:

Local and Online Multiplayer: Go it alone to ensure the safety of your deliveries, or join your friends and put your teamwork to the test.

Controlled Noodly Chaos: Unpredictable ragdoll physics meets snappy platforming. Sprint, leap, dive, and grapple with ease, but collide with something and you'll be knocked out cold!

A World of Distractions: Take a break from deliveries and play around! The world is chock full of toys, vehicles, and machines that can be used for work or play.

Ragtag Crew: Customize your blue-collar workers and get your rear into gear, it's time to deliver!

70070000025542.name: Flame Keeper - Deluxe Edition
70070000025542.intro: A dynamic action rogue-lite with a unique twist. Balance your health and powers as you fight to return the light  to the world of Orbis
70070000025542.description:
Flame Keeper is a dynamic action rogue-lite with a unique little genre twist. Become Ignis on his quest to restore the Eternal Flame, stolen by creatures of shadow. Adapt and take on enemies as you decide how to balance your health vs progress in various biomes teaming with enemies. Use an array of moves and attacks, including punch combos, fiery dashes, wide area-of-effect stomps, and powerful finishers that deal decisive damage.

Dive deep into the world of Flame Keeper with the contents of the Deluxe Edition, which includes:
- Flame Keeper
the base game plus all existing updates
- Flame Keeper - Artbook
The Flame Keeper Artbook provides an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the creation of the game’s characters, environments, biomes, and overall development process.

70070000025548.name: Ecchi Oppai: Uniforms Edition
70070000025548.intro: Think you've got an eye for oppai?
70070000025548.description:
Even tough, strong girls need your help to find their hearts. Think fast and don't get distracted, or you'll lose them forever.

Choose from a selection of pictures and help these girls find what they're looking for. If you're good enough, you'll even get a reward.

Features:
- Over 160 pictures of girls including 30 new girls in uniforms
- Local multiplayer mode for you and your friends
- Simple and engaging gameplay

Can you find your way into their hearts?

70070000025552.name: Land of Mushrooms - Halloween Edition
70070000025552.description:
Dive into Land of Mushrooms - Halloween Edition, where spooky fungi come to life! Merge mushrooms and navigate a creepy, horror-themed world.

- Spooky Skins: Give your mushrooms a frightful makeover with creepy, Halloween-themed skins.
- Forest of Nightmares: Venture into a dark, eerie forest background for extra spooky fun.

Keep the pot from overflowing as you merge your way through this haunted edition!

70070000025556.name: SteamWorld Heist II & SteamWorld Build Bundle
70070000025556.intro: Heist, build, and conquer! The ultimate SteamWorld duo is here.
70070000025556.description:
Grab this bundle and experience the best of both worlds: strategic combat and creative construction!

SteamWorld Heist II:
- A Heist Fit for a Robot: Embark on a high-flying, tactical adventure as a reformed space pirate.
- Turn-Based Strategy with a Twist: Outsmart your foes with clever tactics and precise aim.
- A Colorful Cast of Characters: Meet a diverse crew of robots with unique abilities.
- A Steampunk Saga: Explore stunning, hand-drawn environments and unravel a captivating story.

SteamWorld Build:
- Build Your Own SteamWorld: Grow your steam-bot town and tend to their robot needs.
- Puzzle-Platforming Perfection: Solve puzzles and overcome obstacles above and below ground.
- A World of Wonder: Explore a vibrant, steampunk world and discover it’s hidden secrets.

Why Buy the Bundle?
- Save Big: Get both games at a discounted price!
- Endless Entertainment: Experience two critically acclaimed games from one of gaming's most beloved franchises.
- Perfect for Fans and Newcomers: Whether you're a seasoned SteamWorld fan or new to the series, this bundle has something for everyone.
- Don’t miss out on this amazing deal! Together, these two games offer hours of fun and excitement for players of all ages.

70070000025567.name: Magic Cats Pots Deluxe Edition
70070000025567.description:
Restore broken porcelain and reveal hidden magic in Magic Cats Pots puzzles!

Step into the magical world of Magic Cats Pots and breathe new life into old treasures!


AWAKEN YOUR COZY IMAGINATION
Imagine a cozy autumn morning, where the sun still warmly touches the faces of passersby. On the corner of a quiet street, behind a shop window, a cat named Seba lazily basks in the soft rays of sunlight. Inside the shop, shelves are filled with beautiful porcelain pieces – both new and those waiting for a second chance. 

Visitors can come to the shop with their broken treasures, and with a touch of magic, these items can be brought back to life. But this isn’t just any life – these objects are home to divine creatures: cats.


REPAIR AND BRING TO LIFE AGAIN
In Magic Cats Pots, your goal is to repair broken teapots, cups, plates, and other porcelain items. As you piece them back together, you may discover magical cats hidden within. Each restored item reveals its secrets, and with every successful repair, you unlock more challenges and new treasures.

With 126 different porcelain items to repair, each divided into specific categories, the magic never ends. As you progress, you unlock more complex challenges and discover new fluffy companions hidden within the ceramics.


ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES
The game offers a peaceful, relaxing journey through the world of porcelain and magical cats. With three different difficulty levels, you can enjoy simple, laid-back puzzles or tackle more intricate and demanding repairs. 

The levels are procedurally generated, meaning no two puzzles are ever the same. Even after completing a level and earning all the stars, you can replay it, with each attempt offering a fresh new experience. This ensures that the game remains engaging and never repetitive.

Unlock new set of decorations to fix with Frame Pack DLC included in this bundle.

70070000025571.name: Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter - Deluxe Edition
70070000025571.intro: Embark on a new 'tail' of revenge set across the frozen north of the Ratdom with this Deluxe Edition of the epic action-RPG sequel.
70070000025571.description:
Prepare for the chilling clash against the Dark Wings with the Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter Deluxe Edition, combining the brutal action-RPG base game with both the ‘Augur of the Draugr’ armour and weapon pack and ‘Hair to the Throne’ cosmetic DLC.

Step into the fray clad in the legendary Draugr armour of old, forged in the fires of the elder wars between Rat and Bat, before choosing between six different, warrior-worthy hair and beard styles. For those who seek to claim victory over winter’s shadow, only the fiercest attire will do.

Deluxe Edition
• Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter base game
• Augur of the Draugr pack: Features exclusive items, including three new helms, three armours, and three pauldrons, together with three new shields and three new axes.
• Hair to the Throne pack: An exclusive collection of six beards and hairstyles to further customise Arlo’s battle-readiness.

70070000025579.name: Giant Rush: Complete Edition
70070000025579.intro: Rush into a battle of giants!
70070000025579.description:
Run and collect stickmen of your color to grow bigger and more powerful! Outsmart traps, avoid danger, and smash everything in your path. The bigger you grow, the more unstoppable you become!

Features:
- 15 new hats that will make you look unique!
- 3 premium finishing animations!
- 1500 free stickmen for your city
- 7500 extra gems to grow your character
- Collect stickmen of your color to grow larger and more powerful!
- Grow stronger and defeat huge giants in intense fights!
- Upgrade your town to earn passive income
- Fight through a series of enemies in survival mode and show your skills!
- Choose battle upgrades like extra health, a chance to dodge, critical hits, and more!
- Unlock awesome outfits and accessories to customize your character
- Buy new and epic finishing animations!

Face giant bosses in epic battles. Dodge their powerful attacks, strike back, and defeat them! Show your strength as you take down the biggest giants and prove you’re the best!

Unlock amazing rewards as you play. Upgrade your town to earn more money, customize your character with cool accessories, and unlock epic finishing animations!

Your decisions will make the difference between victory and defeat!

70070000025587.name: STAR WARS: Hunters™ - Life Day Pack
70070000025587.description:
Star Wars: Hunters™ - Life Day Cosmetic Pack gives you access to the game download
and Grozz's LIFE DAY WOOKIEE Costume, LIFE DAY CLUBS Weapon Wrap, REVERENTIAL ORB Emote and LIFE DAY Avatar, and 500 CRYSTALS

NEW STAR WARS EXPERIENCE
Located deep in the Outer Rim on the planet of Vespaara and broadcast far and wide on the HoloNet, the stories and legends of battles that define galactic history are brought to life to entertain audiences and create champions seeking fame and fortune in this new gladiatorial spectacle.

MEET THE HUNTERS
Gear up for battle and pick a Hunter that suits your playstyle from a regularly updated roster of new characters including nefarious bounty hunters, heroes of the Rebellion, Imperial stormtroopers, and everything in between. Outclass opponents by mastering diverse abilities, skills and strategies while fighting it out in intense 4v4 third-person combat and dominating opponents on the road to fame in The Arena.

Star Wars: Hunters is free to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including random items). Information about drop rates for random item purchases can be found in-game.If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-game purchases in yourdevice's settings. 70070000025589.name: Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter - Deluxe Upgrade
70070000025589.intro: Utilise exclusive cosmetics & armour with this Deluxe Upgrade of the epic action-RPG.
70070000025589.description:
Prepare for the chilling clash against the Dark Wings with the Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter Deluxe Upgrade, featuring both the ‘Augur of the Draugr’ armour and weapon pack and ‘Hair to the Throne’ cosmetic DLC. Base game required.

Step into the fray clad in the legendary Draugr armour of old, forged in the fires of the elder wars between Rat and Bat, before choosing between six different, warrior-worthy hair and beard styles. For those who seek to claim victory over winter’s shadow, only the fiercest attire will do.

Deluxe Upgrade
• Augur of the Draugr pack: Features exclusive items, including three new helms, three armours, and three pauldrons, together with three new shields and three new axes.
• Hair to the Throne pack: An exclusive collection of six beards and hairstyles to further customise Arlo’s battle-readiness.

70070000025596.name: Candivity: Complete Edition
70070000025596.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
70070000025596.description:
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Features:
- 5 maps with crazy mechanics!
- 41 characters, 24 hairstyles and 48 accessories! 
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode for you and your friend!
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
- Fully customizable name and character
- An adorably sweet aesthetic

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000025603.name: STAR WARS: Hunters™ - Crimson Vanguard Pack
70070000025603.description:
Star Wars: Hunters™ - Crimson Vanguard Cosmetic Pack gives you access to the game
download and Sentinel's CRIMSON VANGUARD Costume, CRIMSON E-WEB Weapon
Wrap, and 500 CRYSTALS

NEW STAR WARS EXPERIENCE
Located deep in the Outer Rim on the planet of Vespaara and broadcast far and wide on the HoloNet, the stories and legends of battles that define galactic history are brought to life to entertain audiences and create champions seeking fame and fortune in this new gladiatorial spectacle.

MEET THE HUNTERS
Gear up for battle and pick a Hunter that suits your playstyle from a regularly updated roster of new characters including nefarious bounty hunters, heroes of the Rebellion, Imperial stormtroopers, and everything in between. Outclass opponents by mastering diverse abilities, skills and strategies while fighting it out in intense 4v4 third-person combat and dominating opponents on the road to fame in The Arena.

70070000025604.name: MLB® The Show™ 25 - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000025604.intro: Forge your baseball journey in The Show™

Ignite your passion and build your very own path to greatness—from high school all the way to the Hall of Fame! Along the way, connect with iconic baseball stars in fan-favorite modes – updated with new ways to play.

ROAD TO THE SHOW
 Road to the Show is a single-player, role playing mode where you create your own journey. Build the RTTS ballplayer you want, the way you want in Path to 99 Progression. Craft Perks to your liking and utilize a revamped attribute progression system for full control of your player's development. The college experience includes eight fully licensed teams such as Louisiana State University, University of South Carolina, University of Tennessee and UCLA.

 • New gameplay additions to Impact plays, including: hot shot catches for infielders, catchers blocking balls, rob foul ball opportunities, ball-in-dirt indicator when base running, new sliding swim move to avoid tag when stealing, and cut ball decision making for Catcher, 1B and 3B.

FRANCHISE & MARCH TO OCTOBER

DIAMOND DYNASTY
 Build your dream team from scratch. Collecting and earning player cards is the name of the game, as you craft your very own lineup. 
 • Set your sights on greatness with the overhauled, year-round Diamond Dynasty: 360 – with no more time-limited season restrictions.

 • Realize your in-game potential the smart way! The Community Stats feature stacks your performance against other players through in-game presentations.

STORYLINES
 Celebrate history in Storylines while you play as the barrier breakers and learn of baseball’s past. 
 • Continuing Storylines: The Negro Leagues with Season 3, this mode transports you into years gone by, introducing you to the unsung and unknown heroes of the national pastime. Experience career-defining moments through a combination of immersive gameplay and visual storytelling.

Two classic visual novels written by Kotaro Uchikoshi make their way to the West after over 2 decades of initial Japanese release! Enjoy the science fiction, mystery and love stories in Ever 17/Never 7 Double Pack!

Takeshi Kuranari, an ordinary college student, visits the underwater theme park LeMU. An accident occurs, trapping Takeshi and 6 other individuals inside LeMU, 51 meters below the surface. With no hope of rescue, Takeshi explores LeMU along with the mysterious girl Tsugumi and part-time employee You, searching for a way to escape to the surface.

70070000025688.name: SCP-087: PREMIUM EDITION
70070000025688.description:
Item: SCP-087
Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures:
Access to SCP-087 is restricted to authorized personnel with Level 3 security clearance. Exploration sessions within SCP-08 are limited to a maximum duration of 60 minutes and are to be conducted using D-Class personnel for exploration purposes.

Details:
SCP-087 refers to an anomalous structure that appears to resemble a stairwell. Attempts to reach the end of the stairwell have been unsuccessful, with subjects reporting an oppressive atmosphere upon entering the structure. Auditory hallucinations, specifically the sound of distant and distressed voices, are frequently reported by those who explore SCP-087. Light sources do not function effectively beyond a few meters within the structure, as the surrounding darkness appears to absorb any illumination.

Document 087-0:
This document details the initial efforts to investigate SCP-087 using D-Class personnel.

With included DLC, you can now absorb more damage before succumbing to the darkness. Each encounter with The Monster will test your limits, but with the ability to take up to four punches, you might just have a fighting chance to survive a little longer.

Surviving the Abyss DLC: Unlock the ability to endure up to four punches from terrifying monsters, giving you the resilience you need to survive longer against the odds.

Endless Horror: With all the content combined, you'll face new challenges, unravel deeper mysteries, and experience an ever-increasing sense of dread as you descend further into the Backrooms' wet and twisted underworld.

Are you ready for the complete nightmare? Backrooms Pools: Deluxe Edition is your ultimate survival test. How long will you last in the depths?

70070000025699.name: Sport Clubs Collection
70070000025699.description:
Introducing the Sport Clubs Collection: Immerse yourself in the thrill of precision and skill with our exclusive 3-in-1 Games Bundle, featuring Archery Club, Darts Club, and Baseball Club – the perfect fusion of classic sports in one exhilarating package!

Archery Club: Step into the shoes of an archer extraordinaire and experience the precision of archery like never before. Test your focus and accuracy as you aim for the bullseye, navigating challenging courses and unlocking new levels of mastery. 

Darts Club: Enter the vibrant world of Darts, where every throw counts! With various game modes and customizable dart sets, Dart Club caters to both casual players and seasoned pros. Show off your precision, aim for the elusive 180, and let the friendly competition begin!

Baseball Club: Pitcher-batter duels, cool items and upgrades to unlock, and most importantly - intuitive and engaging gameplay - this is the quick baseball game you’ve been waiting for!

Unleash your inner athlete and embark on a journey of precision, strategy, and excitement with the Sport Clubs Collection Bundle. Get ready to redefine your gaming experience – because when it comes to sports, we've got it all covered!

70070000025700.name: Battle Frenzy Collection
70070000025700.intro: Slash and mine for gold and glory!
70070000025700.description:
Enter the dungeon, defeat enemies and mine for gold in Mine & Slash! Embark on an epic RPG quest, as you dig and explore your way through a roguelite 3D world filled with magic and adventure. Take on mini-quests, fight off feverish enemies, and survive the rush of adrenaline as you smash through obstacles and obstacles. As a miner, you have the unique opportunity to collect gold and valuable resources as you dig deeper and deeper into the dungeon. But be warned, the deeper you go, the harder the challenges become, and the more powerful the enemies you will face.


Tiny Gladiators is a  terrifically fun fighting game with a white-hot RPG core! Crush your rivals in 1-on-1 combat, then set out on your road to revenge, building up your magical arsenal as you seek your father’s killer. Now charge back into the fighting arena, armed with fearsome powers, to strike your rivals down! The more fights you win, the more weapons you can afford, and the further you can venture into the fantastic world of Tiny Gladiators. Grow your powers and skills, and watch your Tiny Gladiators rise into legends!
