70070000025711.name: Cook For Love Deluxe Edition
70070000025711.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000025711.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

Change the look of your kitchen with Powder Red Blender DLC included in this bundle.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000025715.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure: Deluxe Edition
70070000025715.intro: Embark on a cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends and expand your journey with these Deluxe Bundles, including over 300+ unique items!
70070000025715.description:
Explore an open world, meet Hello Kitty and Friends, solve ancient puzzles, cook delicious dishes, customize your avatar and your cabins, and so much more.
Jump in with the Deluxe Edition, which includes the Hello Kitty Island Adventure base game and three Deluxe Bundles offering a super-charged start and spectacular Legacy Event items.

Deluxe Event Bundle
Over 300 Unique Items and Rewards upfront–no need to wait!
One Year of Legacy Clothing, Furniture, and other cosmetics early from events like:
•  2023 Spooky Celebration
•  2023 Give & Gather Celebration
•  2024 Luck & Lantern Celebration
•  2024 Hugs & Hearts Celebration
•  2024 Month of Meh, featuring gudetama
•  2024 Under the Sea Celebration
And so many more!

Deluxe Starter Bundle
10x Friendship Blossoms
3x Friendship Bouquets
10x Island Bouquets
50x Strawberry Crates

Deluxe Crafting Bundle
50x of each Dye color
100 Sticks
45 Iron Ore
50 Rubber

Collect your bundles once you start playing, through cute quests!

All this on top of the incredible world of Hello Kitty Island Adventure:

•  Discover eight unique regions, from the ocean’s depths to an island in the clouds 
•  Befriend iconic characters like cheerful Hello Kitty, mischievous Kuromi, and sweet Cinnamoroll
•  Bake, cook, and craft the perfect gifts to become best friends
•  Renovate cabins and decorate them to attract even more wonderful characters
•  Create your perfect avatar, find and customize hundreds of outfits tailored to you, and create and collect furniture to achieve your dream home aesthetic
•  Celebrate the joys of summertime, the winter holidays, and more with a year round calendar of events. And don’t forget to throw birthday parties for your friends
•  Solve hidden puzzles, catch cute critters, and garden to fill the world with flowers
•  Dive into a multiplayer game with real-world friends and family: team up to explore, get bonuses, and take sweet snapshots together

70070000025717.name: The Cheese Chase: Christmas Bundle
70070000025717.intro: Discover the coolest pizza delivery game enriched with new 25 map levels that will transport you into the holiday mood.
70070000025717.description: Dive into a city full of hungry citizens waiting for their order. Deliver pizzas, avoid kidnappers and be careful when crossing the street. Bundle will give you an additional 25 maps and 9 new characters!

70070000025725.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Xmas Edition
70070000025725.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000025728.name: Ecchi Oppai Fantasy Edition
70070000025728.intro: Think you've got an eye for oppai?
70070000025728.description:
Even girls from other worlds need your help to find their hearts. Think fast and don't get distracted or you will lose them forever.

Choose from the pictures and help these girls find what they are looking for. If you're good enough, you'll even get a reward.

Features:

- Local multiplayer mode for you and your friends
- Simple and addictive gameplay

Can you find the way to their hearts?

70070000025732.name: Gas Station Simulator and Party Time DLC Bundle
70070000025732.intro: Buy an abandoned gas station and restore it to its full glory. Renovate, upgrade and expand upon the offered services to keep up with your clients demands.
70070000025732.description:
Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it to its former glory. Get rid of debris and broken furniture, fix up the walls, paint and decorate the place to your liking. Just don’t spend all your cash on the looks right away, you bought a gas station after all. Repair the equipment, buy what can’t be repaired and start serving your customers to earn money for further renovations and improvements.

Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

More Popularity
Parties are also a great tool to boost your popularity, especially for those struggling with increasing popularity at higher levels. Each upgrade of your venue spot opens new opportunities for popularity boots as an added bonus to all the other rewards.

70070000025737.name: Vege Bubble Shoot Extended Edition
70070000025737.intro: Pop, Match, Harvest! Dive into a vibrant veggieventure!
70070000025737.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Vege Bubble Shot, a colourful and addictive puzzle game that will captivate your gaming senses. Dive into a fruity adventure where you'll use your strategic skills to save a delightful vegetable garden from pesky intruders and become a puzzle master!

Key Features:

    Vivid Vegetable Vistas: Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world brimming with hand-crafted, vibrant vegetables. Explore lush garden settings and interact with charming characters.

    Challenging Puzzles: Put your aim and matching skills to the test with a variety of engaging puzzles. Can you clear the garden of intruders with your accurate shots?

    Power-Ups and Boosters: Utilize an array of powerful boosters and unique power-ups to enhance your gameplay. Create spectacular chain reactions to tackle the intruders with flair.

    Endless Fun: Vege Bubble Shot offers hundreds of levels, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment for both short and extended gaming sessions.

    Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: The game is designed for players of all skill levels, with straightforward mechanics for beginners and depth for those seeking a greater challenge.

Multiplayer included! Vege Bubble Shot is the perfect game for both casual players and competitive gamers. Aim, shoot, and match your way through the captivating vegetable garden, and bring back harmony one bubble at a time. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this addictive and colourful adventure!

This bundle includes base game and Harvest Havoc #1 with:

- 20 all-new levels

70070000025739.name: Tomb Raider I-VI Remastered
70070000025739.intro: Play all of the classic Tomb Raider adventures in this remastered collection.
70070000025739.description:
Lara Croft is back!

Discover Lara Croft’s Original Adventures, Lovingly Restored

*Key Features*

See the Classic & Remastered Visuals: Play with the original polygonal models or swap to the remastered graphics at any time

Globe-trotting Adventure: Follow Lara Croft around the world and face off against deadly foes and dangerous myths.

Experience Lara’s Darkest Adventures: Uncover the secrets of Lara Croft’s past and shed light on the mystery of her disappearance

Included Game Titles

70070000025740.name: STAR WARS™: Prequel Pack
70070000025740.intro: The STAR WARS™: Prequel Pack offers four action-packed STAR WARS™ games for one low price!
70070000025740.description:
The STAR WARS™: Prequel Pack includes:

STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™

Take back the Theed Palace in this fast-and-furious lightsaber action game. You will have the power of the Force and your trusty lightsaber to help you ward off legions of battle droids, destroyer droids, assassins, and other creatures from  STAR WARS™: Episode I - The Phantom Menace™.

STAR WARS™: Bounty Hunter™

Bring in your bounty, dead or alive. In this classic third-person action-adventure, you'll become Jango Fett, Prime Clone of the Grand Army of the Republic, hired to capture a deranged Dark Jedi.

STAR WARS™ Republic Commando™

The squad is your weapon. Welcome to the Clone Wars: Chaos has erupted throughout the galaxy. As leader of an elite squad of Republic Commandos, your mission is to infiltrate, dominate, and ultimately annihilate the enemy.

STAR WARS™ Episode I Racer

Take control of a podracer speeding through flaming methane lakes, Tusken Raider assaults, anti-gravity tunnels, and much more in a pulse-pounding, do-or-die fight to the finish line.

70070000025759.name: Bouquet for My Girl：Complete Set
70070000025759.description:
A collection of stories from Lucien, Crius, Tyril, and Zenn's points of view, focused on the theme of "love gifted from him to her." See a new and charming side to each of your favorite characters alongside new CGs.
This special set includes all four stories in one discounted bundle.


Bouquet for My Girl: Lucien
"Sweet Secrets" "Prelude to the Future" "A Witch's Questionnaire"

Bouquet for My Girl: Crius
"My First At-Home Date" "Memories of Youth" "A Witch's Questionnaire"

Bouquet for My Girl: Tyril
"Impetus of Red and Black" "A Calm and Joyful Night" "A Witch's Questionnaire"

Bouquet for My Girl: Zenn
"Sleepless Night" "Penalizing Heat" "A Witch's Questionnaire"


・These stories include important information concerning the main story. It is highly recommended you save reading these for after clearing the main story.
・Please update to the newest version before playing.
・Please take care not to purchase duplicates.

70070000025784.name: Cowboys vs Zombies: Deluxe Edition

70070000025785.name: Hole io & Candivity
70070000025785.intro: Here's the ultimate arcade bundle you've been waiting for! Grow & merge solo or with friends in multiplayer mode!
70070000025785.description:
Prepare for a relaxing gaming experience and hours of fun with friends and family!

Hole io - Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

Candivity - Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy. Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Venture into worlds where size is key to being the best!

70070000025799.name: Star Trek: Legends - Complete Edition
70070000025799.intro: Captain - The fate of the universe is in your hands!
70070000025799.description:
Step into the role of your favorite heroes and villains from across the history of Star Trek and embark on an epic space adventure to control the mysterious Nexus. Battle to save all of existence in Star Trek’s official strategy-based RPG!

RECEIVE NEW CHARACTERS AND EXTRA RESOURCES
Start your journey with loads of resources and 18 new characters:
• 3 commanders: Picard (old), K'ehleyr and Thadiun Okona
• 3 scientists: Spock (young), Number One and Seska
• 3 engineers: Thy'lek Shran, Charles "Trip" Tucker III and Miles OBrien
• 3 security: Weyoun, Kor and Viceroy
• 3 medics: Guinan, Julian Bashir and Antaak
• 3 villains: Tolian Soran, Founder and Dolim
• Extra resources: x150 ProtoMatter, 1800 orbs, 30000 Latinum, and 18 Rare Bio-Gel

PREPARE FOR ADVENTURE 
Dive into the action with characters spanning the entire Star Trek universe! Take command of the U.S.S. Artemis and recruit a team of legendary Star Trek characters as you embark on daring missions, experience epic turn-based combat, and make choices that influence the game’s entire story.

ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM
Ever wanted to master Spock’s Vulcan nerve pinch or battle with Worf’s deadly bat’leth? Now is your chance! Recruit and command over 90 iconic characters from the Star Trek universe including Kirk, Spock, Picard, Janeway, Data, Burnham, Pike, and many more! Send your Star Trek team on critical missions that will test your crew’s skills and ingenuity. Earn special rewards by completing collections of characters based on the Star Trek shows they appeared in or the traits they possess. Plus, you can earn combat bonuses by using multiple Star Trek characters from the same collection in battle.

TAKE COMMAND OF THE U.S.S. ARTEMIS
Captain the U.S.S. Artemis and shape the fate of the cosmos! Choose your crew strategically. Each Star Trek character has their own specific skills and abilities to help you outwit, overpower and overcome your enemies. Every decision you make could be the difference between triumph and defeat. Take command, Captain – the galaxy awaits your leadership!

NAVIGATE AN IMMERSIVE UNIVERSE
Dive into the exquisitely crafted 3D world of Star Trek Legends! Explore beautifully rendered 3D worlds and interact with fully realized animated characters in this epic Star Trek RPG. 

Get ready to boldly go where no one has gone before in Star Trek: Legends. Your interstellar adventure awaits!

70070000025802.name: MasterChef: Learn to Cook! - Christmas Special
70070000025802.intro: Christmas is here! Roll up your sleeves and cook up a holiday feast worthy of a number one chef!
70070000025802.description:
Choose your ingredients, slice, prepare, plate and serve delicious dishes with style in fun mini-games! 

The MasterChef judges will evaluate your dish based on your performance and speed. Complete and unlock new recipes, challenges, and mini-games along your cooking journey!

GET A SWEET CHRISTMAS PRESENT
Start your cooking career with a box filled with fruits, nuts, sweets, 2500 prestige coins, and a unique whisk!

LEARN TO COOK WITH MORE THAN 120 RECIPES!
Make signature recipes from all over the world. Find your favorite dish and make it your specialty. From a Margherita Pizza to Sushi, what do you want to cook today?

CHALLENGE MINI-GAMES
Play dozens of mini-games with a twist! Challenges will take you to cook recipes with extra added difficulty. Will you be able to clear all of them?

MOTION CONTROLS
Become a true number one chef with immersive motion controls. Grab your Joy-Con™ and start cooking for real!

COOK WITH STYLE
Create an avatar and customize its features as you want! Become the coolest chef and stand out by changing your outfit from a wide range of clothes, accessories, and aprons!

UPGRADE YOUR COOKING GEAR
By completing mini-games, events and challenges, you will be able to collect different cooking gear such as pots, utensils, plates amongst others, and upgrade them! Cooking utensils are a chef’s best friend!

It is time to prove that you are a top chef!

70070000025804.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Complete Edition
70070000025804.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000025804.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 4 legendary boxers with their unique equipment and a bonus of 86000 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000025807.name: Minecraft Triple Bundle
70070000025807.description: Step into a blocky universe of creativity, thrills, and mystery with three Minecraft games in one bundle. Explore and shape infinite, unique worlds in Minecraft, the ultimate sandbox game where you can survive the night or create a work of art – or both! Team up with friends* or fight solo through action-packed and treasure-stuffed levels in Minecraft Dungeons. Forge alliances and fight in strategic battles to save the Overworld in Minecraft Legends. Want even more adventures? This bundle also includes 1020 Minecoins, which you can use to purchase exciting creator-made content for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition and Minecraft Legends.**

70070000025810.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Value Edition
70070000025810.intro: Tasty burgers? We've got you covered!
70070000025810.description:
Like going in to town for a bite to eat? Everybody does! 

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side? 
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, french fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats! 

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up! 

Upgrade your restaurant and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger joint in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat
* 60 awesome levels to complete
* Countless dishes to master and serve
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2 and DLC#4 Endless Mode with:

• 20 new levels,
• 6 new achievements
• New Endless Mode

70070000025811.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Super Edition
70070000025811.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000025811.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan. 

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 andEndless Mode with:

* endless gameplay mode

70070000025812.name: Breakfast Bar Tycoon Legendary Edition
70070000025812.intro:
It's almost time for breakfast!
Go and prove that your breakfast bar deserves its fame!
70070000025812.description:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen? 

In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task! 

You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.

Take orders, prepare dishes and fight for tips! 

Invest your earnings into upgrading your restaurant and become a breakfast magnate!

Bon appetite!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Endless Mode with:

70070000025813.name: Sweet Bakery Tycoon Definitive Edition
70070000025813.description:
Start your baking career and prepare some delicious cakes for your clients, using a whole set of creams, fruits and decorations.

Test your skills on 60 diverse and increasingly difficult levels.

Personalize your interior with countless upgrades.

All of us have a magic place, where everyday troubles seem to disappear. Sweet Bakery Tycoon fulfills your fantasy of creating and managing a bakery of your dreams

This bundle includes base game,  Expansion Pack 2, Multiplayer Mode and Endless Mode with:

• 7 new Achievements to complete
• endless gameplay mode
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

* 60 awesome levels to complete
