* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game, Multiplayer Mode and DLC#4 Endless Mode with:

• New Endless Mode
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000025815.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Legendary Edition
70070000025815.intro: Tasty burgers? We've got you covered!
70070000025815.description:
Like going in to town for a bite to eat? Everybody does! 

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side? 
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, french fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats! 

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up! 

Upgrade your restaurant and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger joint in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat
* 60 awesome levels to complete
* Countless dishes to master and serve
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and DLC#4 Endless Mode with:

• 40 new levels,
• 12 new achievements
• New Endless Mode

70070000025816.name: Breakfast Bar Tycoon Elite Edition
70070000025816.intro:
It's almost time for breakfast!
Go and prove that your breakfast bar deserves its fame!
70070000025816.description:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen? 

In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task! 

You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.

Take orders, prepare dishes and fight for tips! 

Invest your earnings into upgrading your restaurant and become a breakfast magnate!

Bon appetite!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Endless Mode and Multiplayer Mode with:

• 45 new levels to explore
• 8 new Achievements to complete
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 
• endless gameplay mode

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000025817.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Value Edition
70070000025817.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000025817.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan. 

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.
* Easy to play and hard to master.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2 and Endless Mode with:

* 20 new levels
* endless gameplay mode

70070000025818.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Discovery Edition
70070000025818.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000025818.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan. 

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.
* Easy to play and hard to master.

This bundle includes base game, Endless Mode and Multiplayer Mode with:

Join forces with your friend in the ultimate cooking adventure with this new Multiplayer Mode! 

• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 
• endless gameplay mode

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000025822.name: Spy Guy Memory Animals Challange
70070000025822.intro: Take up the challenge and exercise your memory in the extended memory game set!
70070000025822.description: Discover the base set and another series of memory cards, this time in the theme of animals! Can you remember them all?

70070000025826.name: Sweet Bakery Tycoon Upgrade Edition
70070000025826.description:
Start your baking career and prepare some delicious cakes for your clients, using a whole set of creams, fruits and decorations.

Test your skills on 60 diverse and increasingly difficult levels.

Personalize your interior with countless upgrades.

All of us have a magic place, where everyday troubles seem to disappear. Sweet Bakery Tycoon fulfills your fantasy of creating and managing a bakery of your dreams


Features: 
- 60+ cakes to serve
- Fruit cocktails
- 4 unique locations
- 60 levels to explore
- Unlockable items to upgrade your equipment, interior and ingredients
- 25+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes base game and Endless Mode with:

• endless gameplay mode

70070000025829.name: Party Party Time 3 + Party Miracle Pack
70070000025829.intro:
It's time for a new and improved party time!
Compete or cooperate—there's no limit on the fun when everyone's together!
70070000025829.description:
Get ready for an all-new sequel to the party game that anyone can enjoy!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 6 players can join in the fun!

Enjoy a large collection of intuitive and easy-to-play minigames!
Spend quality time with friends and family and have a blast!

Party Party Time 3 and the Party Miracle Pack are available together as part of a special set!
Let's party, everybody!

70070000025830.name: Pixel Cafe Gold Edition
70070000025830.description:
Welcome to Pixel Cafe
Dive into this captivating blend of an arcade time manager and visual novel. Help a small-town girl navigate life in a big city, and take part in her coming-of-age story as she forges connections, overcomes difficulties, and struggles to find her worth.

Uncover Hidden Tales
Explore Karstok, a city stuck between a socialist past and a capitalist future. Go on an emotional journey as you form connections with your bosses and clients in this beautifully crafted pixel art world.

Master the Art of Coffee and Cooking 
Perfect your coffee-making and cooking skills on your professional journey through 10 wildly different bars. Keep your customers satisfied as you learn new recipes and adapt to sub-optimal working conditions. Sounds too easy? Challenge one of the 50 optional Nightmare levels. Their hellish difficulty will surely hunt you in your dreams.

Decorate Your House
Breathe new life into your Grandma's old house. Buy furniture and unlock posters to decorate it and truly make it your own.

Experience the Emotional Journey
Witness an emotionally gripping narrative that spans three generations. Explore both the past and present through Pixel's eyes and see how memories of her Grandparents shaped her life.

A Unique Soundtrack
Immerse yourself in the game's atmosphere while listening to the captivating, original soundtrack by Arkadiusz Reikowski, featuring a diverse range of genres and emotions.

Embark on a heartfelt journey and discover the essence of Pixel Cafe, where the emotional story unfolds one cup at a time.

This bundle includes base game, Living Room Touches and Bedroom Touches with:

A new variant for the Armchair
A different look for the Computer
An alternative design for the Wardrobe
A modest update for the Bookshelf
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
A new style for the Radio Nightstand
Also, mix things up with 4 new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000025840.name: Parking Jam: Xmas Edition
70070000025840.intro: Clear the jammed parking lot and get those sleighs moving before Christmas!
70070000025840.description:
Navigate through an overfilled sleigh parking lot and help the elves escape in time for Christmas!

The thought of a holiday jam may feel daunting, but don't worry—with a sprinkle of strategy and quick thinking, you'll be freeing the sleighs and spreading holiday cheer in no time!

This parking lot is filled with sleighs of different size and color. The jams get increasingly more complicated with each level. Show off your Christmas spirit by clearing them all! 

Features: 
- face over 350 levels!  
- equip a new Christmas skin for your cars!
- enjoy new icy trails!
- get extra 25000 coins!
- play in five game modes: Parking Jam, Challenges, Boss Levels, Lot Management, and Hexa Parking 
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!   
- complete levels to unlock new maps 
- use powerups to disable hurdles, freeze people, destroy vehicles, and crush entire lanes! 
- collect keys and open prize chests 
- earn coins and spend them on car skins, powerups and trails 

Try your luck in 5 different game modes:  
•  Parking Jam - Feel the satisfaction of clearing a traffic jam  
•  Challenges - Move cars to free the special vehicle  
•  Boss Levels - Show off your skills with limited moves  
•  Lot Management - Think quickly to take the cars to their lots  
•  Hexa Parking - Feel brilliant by solving unique puzzles 

See if you’ve got what it takes to unwrap the jam and let the holiday traffic flow!

70070000025841.name: Bucket Crusher: Christmas Edition
70070000025841.intro: Power up your machine and dive into the holiday craze of joyful destruction!
70070000025841.description:
Can you bring down every last brick of these walls until there's nothing left but holiday cheer in the air?

Immerse yourself in the season's most satisfying casual game, where you slice through walls brick by brick with a powerful circular saw! 

Features:
- tear down 11 regular and 8 new Christmas themed brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- change the look of your saw with 10 different festive skins!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you've conquered the first wall, you'll find yourself facing a variety of vibrant, holiday-inspired mosaics. Each one holding a different festive scene, from hot cocoa to christmas presents, all waiting for you to tear down and reveal the magic within!

Upgrade your machinery after each round and strategize to make the most of your earnings. Boost your saw's length, power, size, and fuel capacity to plow through walls faster with each level!

And if you’re in the spirit of giving, consider giving away your progress for some prestige points. Spend them on powerful permanent upgrades and knock down walls even faster!

70070000025845.name: Diamond Painting ASMR: Xmas Edition
70070000025845.intro: Let your Christmas spirit shine as you create festive art with diamonds!
70070000025845.description:
Relax as you follow the numbers and paint at your own pace during this holiday!

Dive into unique canvases full of unicorns, hearts, cakes, and other stunning images. Enjoy the satisfying 'click' as each diamond snaps into place, bringing vibrant colors to life!

Bring a dinosaur back from the past or draw a diamond castle in 3D - whatever you imagine, you can paint it... with diamonds!

Features: 
- Color by numbers almost 700 pictures!
- More themes: Games, People, Places and Holiday!
- Create beautiful 3D paintings
- Choose from different canvas sizes
- Make awesome diamond art
- Listen to relaxing ASMR

Watch your masterpiece sparkle with each diamond you place!

70070000025846.name: My Horse Stories: Xmas Edition
70070000025846.intro: Make unforgettable holiday memories with your new horse Wilbur and experience the beauty of the Christmas like never before!
70070000025846.description:
Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ!  

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC, but your plans have changed. You're sent to middle-of-nowhere Kentucky to spend the summer with your grandma on a star-stable horse farm.  

Soon, you realize that this summer adventure holds untold potential! The horse farm becomes your heaven, and with each passing day, you grow closer to your loyal companion - a graceful horse with whom you'll weave your own unique horse-riding tale!  

Features: 
- Meet the new horse - Wilbur. Choose which horse out of 4 will become your best friend! 
- Make the most of the horse story summer - become a horse racing champ! 
- Train every day with your horse till you're ready to compete in international horse races 
- Compete in exciting horse story racing competitions around the world! - Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps! 
- Dress up like a champion in over 70 various clothes and change your hairstyles!  
- Take good care of your horse: feed, groom, and dress him with over 70 accessories! 
- Spend an additional 250 gems to buy clothes, energy, missing items for building improvements, and more!  
- Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won't let you off easy. Upgrade your horse-story farm and build new facilities. 
- Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!  

To rise above the competition and conquer the racetracks, you must train tirelessly, immersing yourself in the art of horsemanship. Your dedication will bring you face-to-face with rival stars and formidable opponents who will test your skills and determination. You and your horse will form an unbreakable bond through intense training sessions, setting the stage for legendary horse-riding tales that will be whispered for years to come!  

But it's not all about intense races and fierce rival stars. In the tranquil moments between training, you'll find solace in the stars' stable horses - majestic creatures that inspire awe and joyfully fill your heart. Take the time to nurture and care for them because their well-being is crucial to your success. Pamper them with love, groom their silky manes, and dress them in dazzling saddles that reflect their extraordinary beauty.  

Boost your potential by partnering with Genie and win competitions with confidence, while looking like a true champion!

70070000025847.name: Thief Puzzle: Xmas Edition
70070000025847.intro: Sabotage Christmas and become the king of thieves!
70070000025847.description:
Do you have what it takes to steal the gifts without waking anybody up? Put your skills to the test and claim your prize!

Achieve your goal by any means necessary, whether through stealth, speed, or diversion. Use whatever tactics you can to avoid detection and always stay out of sight, or you'll regret it. 

Features:
- Complete over 500 unique levels!
- Get a total of 19 extra skins and themes!
- Avoid tricky obstacles and don't get caught!
- Use your hand to steal the riches!
- Equip awesome themes and skins!
- Enjoy funny sounds and visuals!

Start your journey and become a master thief!

70070000025849.name: Him, the Smile & bloom Bundle
70070000025849.description:
Refreshing otome that explores the relationships of four different couples, all connected by a local flower shop.
 From unrequited love to unexpected new encounters, follow the stories of these adults all with different personalities, as they fall in love and blossom in their relationships.
 This bundle includes the main game and the additional side story - “Flower Halloween Night”.

70070000025860.name: Ravenswatch: Legendary Edition
70070000025860.description:
Choose a side and show your support for the game with the Legendary Edition.
Includes:
* Ravenswatch game
* Ravens Skin Pack: 9 exclusive Ravenswatch-themed outfits for Scarlet, Beowulf, Snow Queen, Pied Piper, Aladdin, Geppetto, Sun Wukong, Melusine and Carmilla. Available from the hero selection menu.
* Nightmares Skin Pack: 9 exclusive Nightmare-themed outfits for the same heroes and available from the same menu.

70070000025872.name: Tavern Talk - Tavern Tantrum Bundle
70070000025872.intro: Immerse yourself in the mysterious and wonderful worlds of Tavern Talk and Asteria with the Tavern Tantrum Bundle, including the game and the DLC "Tempest Tantrum".
70070000025872.description:
Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of Tavern Talk with the Tavern Tantrum Bundle.

Play as the Innkeeper in Tavern Talk, a cozy visual novel where you run a tavern in a D&D-inspired fantasy! Gather rumors, serve magical drinks, and meet adventurers on a life-changing quest.

This edition comes with the DLC "Tavern Talk: Tempest Tantrum", a wholesome tale set after the events of Tavern Talk. Meet Fable's long-suffering brother along with familiar characters from the main game. This new adventure adds roughly three hours of game time to your first run, featuring a branching narrative where your choice of brews matters more than ever!

70070000025889.name: Tails of Iron & Tails of Iron 2 - Standard Bundle
70070000025889.intro: The Rats exact revenge against the Frogs & Dark Wings with this ‘Tails’ bundle.
70070000025889.description:
Experience the Ratdom's devastating wars in the south and the north, with the Standard Bundle, bringing together the brand-new Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter with the original – and critically acclaimed – Tails of Iron. 

Standard Bundle
• Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter base game
• Tails of Iron base game

70070000025890.name: Tails of Iron & Tails of Iron 2 - Deluxe Bundle
70070000025890.intro: Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter and Tails of Iron are bundled together with their DLCs in this ultimate 'tail' and action-RPG experience.
70070000025890.description:
Experience every skirmish and slaughter of the Ratdom's devastating wars in both the south and the north, with the Deluxe Bundle bringing together the brand-new Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter with the original – and critically acclaimed – Tails of Iron. Includes the full collection of additional DLCs available for both games. 

Deluxe Bundle
• Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter base game
• Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter - Augur of the Draugr DLC: Features exclusive items, including three new helms, three armours, and three pauldrons, together with three new shields and three new axes.
• Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter - Hair to the Throne DLC: An exclusive collection of six beards and hairstyles to further customise Arlo’s battle-readiness.
• Tails of Iron base game
• Tails of Iron - Crimson Knight DLC: Features a blood-soaked collection of three armour skins, three helmet skins, three weapon skins, and three shield skins

70070000025891.name: The Ultimate Detective Bundle
70070000025891.intro: Includes Clue: Classic Edition and Clue!
70070000025891.description:
Different worlds, different motives, same question – whodunit? 

Enjoy the vintage aesthetic of Clue Classic Edition and experience a fresh, modern take on your favourite murder mystery in Clue. The Ultimate Detective Bundle offers the perfect combination of nostalgia and innovation within the beloved world of Clue! 

Clue: Classic Edition:
In Clue: Classic Edition, join the iconic classic cast of high society figures who find themselves in the spotlight for murder! Roll the dice, explore the board and uncover the truth behind the crime of the century. All the original beats of the beloved board game are here! 

Clue:
In Clue, revisit Tudor Mansion in the modern day. New mysteries await, and you'll need to up your detective skills to solve the case. Play with the original rules or take on the brand-new investigation format! Immerse yourself in an all-new way to experience the traditional board game. 

INCLUDES:
Clue: Classic Edition Base Game – Roll the dice and launch into a murder investigation. Whodunit? With what weapon? Where? 
Clue Base Game – Follow your suspects through the iconic Tudor Mansion, unlocking their motives and alibis, and exploring thrilling new case files!

70070000025894.name: Hunt or Hunted Bundle
70070000025894.intro: The perfect bundle for Metroidvania fans. Whether it's spearing lizards into walls or absorbing attacks from fleshhounds, you must fight for your life.
70070000025894.description:
I like GRIME. What's Rain World?

You're a simple creature-- the slugcat. You're small. Delicious. Nimble but fragile. Ingenious but distractable. You need to eat to survive but there's also something pulling you away from your home. Asking more of you and demanding you follow it across the industrial waste that was once a bustling world. Can you find it? Or will you be devoured as just another meal?

I like Rain World. What's GRIME?

Everything around you is flesh and stone but you are different-- you have nothingness, a void, a hunger that can never be sated. You can absorb all of the mass you've ever wanted and it will never be enough. The only thing that can satisfy you is knowledge. But to learn the secrets of this surreal world, you will need to push beyond what you ever thought possible.

70070000025895.name: Heart of the Dice Bundle
70070000025895.intro: This bundle is the perfect collection for roguelike deck builder fans, containing both Zoeti and Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles.
70070000025895.description:
Roll the dice, or play your hand with this bundle of two incredible Roguelike titles!

Astrea is a DICE-deck-building roguelike that flips the script on deckbuilders by using dice instead of cards and an unique dual “damage” system: Purification vs Corruption. Build a dice pool strong enough to purify Astrea's out-of-control corruption and save the Star System.

Zoeti is a turn-based roguelike that features a deck of playing cards used to create card combos and activate skills in the heat of battle. Bolster your arsenal of skills through battles, discoverable upgrades, or aid from the locals which enhance your plays to overcome the evil plaguing your land.

70070000025900.name: Ecchi: Time to Oppai
70070000025900.intro: Play and spend time with beautiful girls in the ecchi world.
70070000025900.description:
Stop time or meet cute girls who need your help finding their hearts.

Ecchi Oppai: Choose from a selection of pictures and help these girls find what they're looking for. If you're good enough, you'll even get a reward.
Features:
- Over 130 pictures of girls who need your help
- Local multiplayer mode for you and your friends
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Ecchi Time: Enjoy your day with the 5 most tempting girls, and check what they are doing as time passes. This extraordinary timepiece allows you to fully express yourself by customizing the clock's display and background to reflect your unique personality and preferences.

70070000025925.name: Pool Fever Extended Edition
70070000025925.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000025925.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #1 with:

5 new pool table designs

70070000025927.name: 18 in 1: Family Games Giga Pack
70070000025927.description:
Dive into endless family-friendly fun with 19 in 1: Family Games Giga Pack, a diverse collection of entertaining games for all ages! This incredible bundle features a wide range of puzzles, bubble-shooting challenges, and engaging adventures that guarantee hours of enjoyment.

Explore captivating worlds and themes, including:

    Animal Puzzle Cats and Animal Puzzle World: Piece together adorable animals in charming settings.
    Bubble Fresh Fruits and Bubble Shoot Farm: Burst into fun with vibrant bubble-shooting gameplay.
    Christmas Bubble Puzzle: Celebrate the holiday spirit with festive puzzles.
    Dino Puzzler World: Go back in time with dinosaur-themed puzzles.
    Fashion Girls, Fashion Friends, and Fashion Princess: Discover fabulous fashion adventures.
    Fantasy Saga Frenzy and Galaxy Mania: Journey through magical realms and the far reaches of space.
    Nature Puzzle and Space Lines: Relax with serene puzzles or test your skills in an arcade-style challenge.

With a wide variety of puzzles, themes, and styles, this ultimate collection has something for everyone. Whether you’re solving challenging puzzles or enjoying whimsical adventures, the Family Games Giga Pack is perfect for family gatherings, solo play, or fun with friends!

Get ready to embark on a gaming adventure packed with creativity, excitement, and charm.

70070000025929.name: Vege Bubble Shoot Premium Edition
70070000025929.intro: Pop, Match, Harvest! Dive into a vibrant veggieventure!
70070000025929.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Vege Bubble Shot, a colourful and addictive puzzle game that will captivate your gaming senses. Dive into a fruity adventure where you'll use your strategic skills to save a delightful vegetable garden from pesky intruders and become a puzzle master!

Key Features:

    Vivid Vegetable Vistas: Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world brimming with hand-crafted, vibrant vegetables. Explore lush garden settings and interact with charming characters.

    Challenging Puzzles: Put your aim and matching skills to the test with a variety of engaging puzzles. Can you clear the garden of intruders with your accurate shots?

    Power-Ups and Boosters: Utilize an array of powerful boosters and unique power-ups to enhance your gameplay. Create spectacular chain reactions to tackle the intruders with flair.

    Endless Fun: Vege Bubble Shot offers hundreds of levels, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment for both short and extended gaming sessions.

    Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: The game is designed for players of all skill levels, with straightforward mechanics for beginners and depth for those seeking a greater challenge.

Multiplayer included! Vege Bubble Shot is the perfect game for both casual players and competitive gamers. Aim, shoot, and match your way through the captivating vegetable garden, and bring back harmony one bubble at a time. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this addictive and colourful adventure!

This bundle includes base game and Harvest Havoc #2 with:

- 20 all-new levels

70070000025930.name: Mars Survivor: Red Rifle Edition
70070000025930.intro: Conquer Mars, fend off alien threats, and secure your path to survival!
70070000025930.description:
After an asteroid catastrophe, your rocket ship crash-lands in the wilderness of Mars. Explore the planet's mysteries, strategize your escape, and build a shelter to protect yourself!

Features:
- Get a premium supply crate with a set of amazonis armor, an ares rifle and lots of scraps, and materials!
- Use additional 500 gems
- Navigate Mars's challenges
- Explore the planet's secrets and discover hidden materials 
- Build a shelter and protect yourself from the harsh Martian environment!
- Defend against alien invasions and uncover secrets of the creatures of Mars!
- Gather oxygen and essential materials from old rocket ships to survive
- Strategize your escape mission and secure your passage back to Earth!
- Open epic loot boxes to swap or upgrade your gear

Go on dangerous expeditions to gather intel and resources. Fight off hordes of alien creatures, and save other survivors. Use their skills and knowledge to defend your base from a huge enemy attack!

Become the last man standing on Mars, navigate through the wilderness, and prove your survival skills!

70070000025932.name: Fashion World Upgrade Edition
70070000025932.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000025932.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!
- Create stunning looks with countless combinations of costumes, accessories, and scenic backdrops!
- Capture your creations in Photo Mode!
- Strive for perfection with the three-star rating system, boosting your game's replay value.
- Designed for fashion lovers of all ages!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #4 (Retro Fits) with:

- 20 all-new levels of puzzles

70070000025942.name: Giant Rush: Cute Edition
70070000025942.intro: Rush into a battle of giants!
70070000025942.description:
Run and collect stickmen of your color to grow bigger and more powerful! Outsmart traps, avoid danger, and smash everything in your path. The bigger you grow, the more unstoppable you become!

Features:
- 5 new hats that will make you look unique!
- a new premium Crescent Kick animation!
- 500 free stickmen for your city
- 2500 extra gems to grow your character
- Collect stickmen of your color to grow larger and more powerful!
- Grow stronger and defeat huge giants in intense fights!
- Upgrade your town to earn passive income
- Fight through a series of enemies in survival mode and show your skills!
- Choose battle upgrades like extra health, a chance to dodge, critical hits, and more!
- Unlock awesome outfits and accessories to customize your character
- Buy new and epic finishing animations!

Face giant bosses in epic battles. Dodge their powerful attacks, strike back, and defeat them! Show your strength as you take down the biggest giants and prove you’re the best!

Unlock amazing rewards as you play. Upgrade your town to earn more money, customize your character with cool accessories, and unlock epic finishing animations!

Your decisions will make the difference between victory and defeat!

70070000025945.name: Uboat Attack: Vortice Edition
70070000025945.intro: Rise through the ranks and become a legendary commander!
70070000025945.description:
Dive into tactical naval warfare against enemy fleets!

Get behind the guns of a submarine and lead it into thrilling battles against formidable enemy convoys! Use your torpedoes to sink enemy armadas and rise through the ranks to become an admiral of the U-boat fleet. 

Features:
• A new powerful ship: The cunning Vortice with a charm ability to confuse the enemy forces
• A big supply crate: 15000 medals and extra torpedos
• Variety of authentic ships: Track and destroy real warships with precision
• Realistic damage effects: Experience intense combat scenarios with diverse damage types
• Three game modes: Engage in naval battles, liberate territories, or complete as many missions as possible
• Upgrades and ammunition: Enhance your submarine's stats and equip it with various types of missiles
• Boosters: Gain an edge over your enemies with boosters like armor, air support, instant reload, thermal vision, and more
• Bonus missions: Look up and destroy all enemy planes
• Stunning graphics and locations: Immerse yourself in the game with realistic visuals
• Intuitive controls: Navigate and aim with ease using simple, responsive controls

Explore underwater areas of arctic wastelands, canyons, abyss, and sunken temples to get a tactical advantage in war and prepare an ambush!

Engage in marine events, tactical missions, and naval challenges to earn valuable resources. Dominate the seas and showcase your naval prowess!

Are you ready for the ultimate naval warfare simulator?

70070000025946.name: Life Bubble: Suit Up Edition
70070000025946.intro: Hey there astronaut! Get ready for your biggest space adventure with the most powerful suit!
70070000025946.description:
Embark on an exciting journey to explore new planets, collect valuable resources, and rescue lost astronauts!

Your mission is to expand your life bubble across the planet and repair your ship to continue your adventure into the unknown! 

Features:
- travel through beautiful and mysterious planets, each with unique resources and terrains
- collect valuable raw materials to rebuild machines and bridges
- use your new Golden Suit, which gives you the power of immortality!
- explore different areas and expand your life bubble over places where it is impossible to survive! 
- buy various character upgrades: bag, speed, life, tools, and power using your 10000 additional money immediately! 
- buy machine upgrades to increase its storage capacity 
- fight enemies with your power weapon!
- complete missions for extra money!

Chop wood, mine colorful crystals or diamonds, and use them to rebuild machines and bridges that will help you expand your life bubble area! Every construction needs specific raw materials, so search for their deposits and get to work!

Complete missions or sell resources you don't need in order to buy character and machine upgrades. Improve your abilities and tools to explore the planet fully prepared!

Be ready for obstacles along the way. Enemies are out to conquer your tiny universe. Protect your life bubble miniature world and fight back like a true space cowboy!

Prepare yourself for a unique and unforgettable space adventure!

70070000025947.name: Hide 'N Seek!: Friendly Edition
70070000025947.intro: ...8, 9, 10. Ready or not, here I come!
70070000025947.description:
Remember the good old game of hide and seek? Prepare for something a little more extreme!

Features:
- Wear 8 new cute skins!
- Make friends with 4 new pets!
- Get 5000 extra coins!
- Hide and run away from the seekers
- Find and capture all the hiders
- Enjoy multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Use powerups to gain an advantage
- Collect coins to buy skins and pets!

Dive into classic gameplay where you can hide or seek. Count down before setting off to find the Hiders, or blend into the environment, stay silent, and outsmart the Seeker to win!

Simple, fun, and dynamic—Hide 'N Seek brings the joy of this beloved childhood game to life!

70070000025948.name: Color Water Sort: Challenge Edition
70070000025948.intro: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!
70070000025948.description:
Use your head and arrange colored liquids to solve unique puzzles!  

Master the art of water sorting and rise to the top as a champion! Strategically move the water until every color is separated, proving your puzzle-solving prowess!  

Features: 
- overcome 5200 levels! (you get 2500 new levels in Classic Mode and 200 new levels in Hard Mode)
- play in three game modes: classic, timed, and hard 
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!  
- give your brain an excellent workout  
- use powerups: hints, undo, and extra tubes
- get 9 new tubes and 5 new caps
- get 4 new wallpapers
- get 25000 coins and spend them on new tubes, wallpapers, caps, and powerups!  
- collect keys and open prize chests 

Immerse yourself in the challenge of sorting water into tubes with the same colored liquid on top. Remember, the tubes can't be full for the water to go in. Plan your moves carefully to avoid losing!  

Complete thousands of levels in 3 different modes: 
• Classic - a standard mode where you can relax
• Timed - move fast and complete the level within the time limit 
• Hard - think about your every move, because you have a limited number of them

Enjoy this colorful brain challenge by yourself or against your friend!

70070000025949.name: Stylist Girl: Snowy Edition
70070000025949.intro: Dress up famous models and VIP celebrities to bring out their best looks with fabulous makeovers!
70070000025949.description:
Create tons of incredible fashion design looks for your clients and find them the perfect outfits for their big events! 

Welcome to Hollywood, the fabulous land of VIPs! Here, fashion rules, and all the amazing celebrities and fabulous models need to look their best to maintain their star status. That's where you come in - you're the stylist to the stars! Everyone's talking about the incredible looks you created at the latest red carpet event!

Features:
- Open up your very own stylist salon and become famous!
- Style and dress up your clients in glamorous outfits!
- Help your clients get the prettiest makeovers the world has ever seen!
- Make sure their nails are perfect and complement them with rings and bracelets!
- Get your celebrity models amazing new hairstyles!
- 240 new clothing items in a urban style to make your clients look even more trendy!
- 7 new stunning hair colors and 4 hairstyles!
- 47 new accessories such as glasses and jewelry!
- 31 new makeup items!
- 26 new nail salon items!

Your awesome reputation in fashion design is already bringing you fame and fortune! Lots of girls are heading to your stylist salon for fabulous fashion makeovers. Choose the perfect dress or outfit, add gorgeous accessories and fabulous shoes to complete the look! And don't forget to pick out a new hairstyle for your clients and make sure their nails are absolutely perfect!

Whether you're already a makeover fan or new to the genre, this game is bound to leave you amazed!

70070000025950.name: Doll Dress Up: Cute Edition
70070000025950.intro: Become the best doll stylist and make a fabulous princess with new items!
70070000025950.description:
Let your creativity shine as you style your doll with new clothes, accessories, hairstyles, and makeup! 

Create the perfect princess look and have fun with all the new items available! 

Features: 
- customize your sweet doll with a wide range of clothes, accessories and hairstyles! 
- unlock almost 300 new items to make your doll look even more unique and stylish!
- personalize your doll's outfit, eye color, hairstyle and makeup
- compete for the title of the prettiest against other dolls!
- choose a background and take a beautiful picture
- watch as your doll collection grows larger and larger!

Take your doll on exciting adventures and explore different styles. Mix and match outfits to create the perfect look for every occasion. Whether it’s a day at the beach, a party, or a magical underwater adventure, your doll will always look her best!

Dress your doll in pretty skirts, cozy sweaters or shiny dresses for a fun fashion competition. Pose in different colorful scenes and get ready for a fantastic photo session!

Let the makeover fun begin!

70070000025951.name: Farm It: Classy Edition
70070000025951.intro: Build your own dream farm! Take care of your animals, harvest crops, and sell homemade goodies at the local market!
70070000025951.description:
Plow the field, plant seeds, water the soil, and watch your crops grow! 

Enjoy the country life with other fun activities like fishing, feeding chickens, or cooking yummy food, ensuring there's never a dull moment on your farm!

Grow different crops, from carrots and radishes to oranges and big watermelons! Take orders and keep your customers happy with delicious meals and drinks made with your very own ingredients!

Features:
● live the country life as a real farmer!
● harvest carrots, eggplants, apples, and all your favorite fruits and vegetables
● feed chickens, geese, donkeys, and buffaloes to gather resources
● go fishing in a nearby pond and catch different kinds of fish
● cook food using your own ingredients and sell it in the local market 
● customize your character with over 200 clothes and hairstyles!
● make your farm feel like home with almost 300 decorations!
● buy anything you want with 6000 extra coins!

Express your unique style by changing the look of your character and spending your earnings on a wide range of clothes, shoes, hairstyles, and hats!

Relax with soothing sounds and enjoy satisfying visuals as you farm it all!

Start your farming adventure and create the farm of your dreams!

70070000025952.name: Sweet Survivors: Scary Edition
70070000025952.intro: The purr-fect storm is coming! Can you protect your café from fluffy chaos?
70070000025952.description:
It looks like a normal day at the café… but suddenly, swarms of love-craving cats are storming in, and only you stand between them and total feline chaos! Armed with laser pointers, yarn balls, and even the dreaded pickle of doom, you’ll have to keep these fluffballs at bay while serving your customers their precious coffee. No big deal, right?

Features:
- Face down hordes of fluffy invaders
- Unlock 9 quirky toys and 7 heroic waiters
- Conquer shifts in 3 different café battlegrounds
- Upgrade your waiters and toys to become the strongest cat-wrangler
- Enjoy purr-fectly fun gameplay and cute visuals

Get ready for waves of fur and whiskers as you protect two cozy cafés. Upgrade your toys and special skills to become the best cat-fighting waiter around! With each shift, you’ll unlock new waiters, fun toys, and even more cat-tastrophes!

Can you save your café before the cats take over?

70070000025953.name: Aquapark io: Animals Edition
70070000025953.intro: Race with your friends on waterslides and jump into the pool for victory!
70070000025953.description:
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or enjoy sliding solo. Prove that you are the fastest of them all!

Features:
- 13 large maps with slides
- 40 cute skins, 11 floaties, 13 gliders
- multiplayer mode up to 4 players on one screen!
- opening packs with random skins
- spawning mysterious powerups during the game
- catchy holiday music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Slide down the huge waterslide which spirals down from the sky, overtake your friends, push them off the track or use powerups to gain an advantage. The funniest part is that you can actually jump off the track at any moment and try to land on a lower level overtaking everyone in an instant!

70070000025956.name: Pick My Heart Chapter 2 Deluxe Edition
70070000025956.intro: Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends.
70070000025956.description:
Heartfelt Connections
Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends. This anime-inspired visual novel unfolds in a vibrant modern world where myth and reality blend, leading to humorous, heartfelt, and sometimes challenging moments.


Moments of Magic
In Chapter 2, Sota deepens his bonds with various characters, each carrying unique secrets and personalities. Whether it's Aphrodite, Hera, Athena, or Eris, Sota finds himself navigating through surprises, emotional revelations, and intense encounters that test his loyalty and affection.


Trials of Affection
Each goddess brings a new perspective to Sota’s life. Whether meeting at a cozy karaoke club or exploring a quiet, romantic setting, Sota’s choices shape his journey, and each encounter brings him closer to understanding the complexities of love.


Key Features:
- A modern love story with a touch of mythology
- Choices that matter and shape the story
- Four beautiful Greek goddesses, each with their own story and mystery
- A vibrant blend of modern life and ancient myth as gods and mortals co-exist
- Many unique locations and events, such as a date at a karaoke club
- The complex divine-earthly trials of love

70070000025961.name: Mystery Box 4-in-1 Bundle
70070000025961.description:
This amazing "Mystery Box 4-in-1 Bundle" brings you following 4 games:
Mystery Box: Escape The Room
Mystery Box: The Journey
Mystery Box: Evolution
Mystery Box: Hidden Secrets

Interact with bizarre mechanisms, think out of the box to gain your freedom, and discover historical unsolved mysteries.
You will experience a real-life adventure while playing this puzzle game! 

Take on the challenge of exploring mysterious locations and solving peculiar riddles, you won't forget the hours spent playing this puzzle adventure!
Interact with buttons, levers, and particular mechanisms to unlock several parts of the boxes.

70070000025962.name: Big Adventure 5-in-1 Bundle
70070000025962.intro: Wonderful trip around Europe through amazing touristic locations in more than 30 countries.
70070000025962.description:
This amazing "Big Adventure 5-in-1 Bundle" brings you following 5 games:
Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 1 
Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 2 Collector's Edition
Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 3 Collector's Edition
Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 4 Collector's Edition
Big Adventure: Trip To Europe 5 Collector's Edition

You’ll enjoy visiting several national parks, go around Budapest, experience the European music culture, 
have a look in the luxurious casino in Monaco, visit interesting museums, ancient castles and much more.

Welcome to inspiring Europe, where you'll travel to beautiful locations, swim in the Montenegrin resort of Rafailovici, 
visit the beautiful city of Luxembourg, explore fantastic museums, listen to music at a jazz festival, 
see England's famous Stonehenge, and much more! 

From theme parks to national parks, you won’t want to miss this unique chance to experience 
European history and culture through classic, relaxing Hidden Object gameplay!

70070000025963.name: I Love Finding 9-in-1 Bundle
70070000025963.description:
This amazing "I Love Finding 9-in-1 Bundle" brings you following 9 games:
I Love Finding Cats Collector's Edition
I Love Finding Pups Collector's Edition
I Love Finding MORE Cats Collector's Edition
I Love Finding MORE Pups Collector's Edition
I Love Finding Critters Collector's Edition
I Love Finding Birds Collector's Edition
I Love Finding Wild Friends Collector's Edition
I Love Finding Cats and Pups Collector's Edition
I Love Finding Furbabies Collector's Edition

Either if you love puzzles or pets or both, this is great bundle, fun for the whole family!

- dozens of mini games hidden object locations
- double zoom feature for Hidden Object scenes
- meet the developers’ adorable cats, pups and other pets
- casual puzzles for casual time
- great value for the money

70070000025964.name: Dreamland Farm Complete Edition
70070000025964.intro: After living in a big city your dreams come true – today you start your new life on a peaceful pixel farm!
70070000025964.description:
Your grandma has taught you everything about farming and foraging – from taking care of crops to knowing which berries and mushrooms are edible. Your time has come to become her successor!


A NEW START
You came from the big city to take over your grandma’s farm – a pretty brave move for a city dweller! It’s a good thing that this place has everything you need. With a few decent tools in your pocket, you can start making it your own. Plant crops, take care of cute animals, and don’t forget to explore this vast green expanse.

Make sure to take good care of yourself, during all this as your energy has its limits!


YOU ARE NOT ALONE
There is a small and peaceful town near the farm where you will find many hardworking people – like the local cook, smith, and the mayor. Getting to know them and helping them will expand your dreamland world bit by bit. Not to mention they will help you with upgrading your tools via blueprints… for a favor or two.

Are you ready to uncover the secrets of Dreamland Farm and fall in love with it, just like your grandma did?

Change the look of your farm with Banner and House Furnitures DLCs included in this bundle and make it more cozy.

KEY FEATURES:
- A pixel world with a cozy aesthetic
- Your own pixelated plot of land.
- To balance out the cute and round animals, we put them in a square barn!
- The world grows with you - as you upgrade your gear, the tiers of materials spawning in the world will go up!
- Learn new recipes the same way you get blueprints - but through more delicious means.
- No taxes!

70070000025965.name: Land of Mushrooms - Game Modes Edition
70070000025965.intro: Merge, grow, and play together in the magical world of mushrooms!
70070000025965.description:
Land of Mushrooms - Game Modes Edition:

Immerse yourself in the magical world of mushrooms with the complete Land of Mushrooms experience! Merge, grow, and master fungi in the main game, then enjoy exciting new challenges with two thrilling add-ons: 

- Small Mode, where tiny mushrooms create bigger challenges for a relaxing, extended gameplay experience.

- Coop Mode, where you and a friend work together to grow mushrooms and strategize for the highest scores. Discover the full adventure with new ways to play and endless fun!

70070000025970.name: Party Party Time 2 + Grand Pack Set
70070000025970.intro:
It's Party Party Time again!
Everyone join in and Let's Party!
70070000025970.description:
Introducing an all-new party game for everyone to pick up, play, and enjoy!
Share Joy-Con™ for up to 6 players to join the party!

Streamlined, enhanced, and intuitive controls make every play session unlimited and easy fun!
Compete with friends and family and let the fun times roll!

A full special set with Party Party Time 2 + the Party Hustle Pack, Party Spirit Pack, Lively Party Pack, and Character Style Pack is now available!
Enjoy the party together with everybody!

70070000025975.name: Magic Cats Pots New Delivery
70070000025975.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!


Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

Unlock new set of decorations to fix with Frame Pack and Pot Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

70070000025978.name: Tell Me Your Story Amelias Collection
70070000025978.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000025978.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD 

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

This bundle includes 3 DLCs with various artbooks and extra puzzle DLC.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience

70070000025979.name: Piano: Learn and Play Classic Edition
70070000025979.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000025979.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes three Song Packs DLCs.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000025980.name: AAA Clock Deluxe Collection
70070000025980.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000025980.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 7 DLCs: the Squid, Cyber, Spin, Elegant Pixel, Digital and Happy Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000025981.name: Freaky Trip Puzzle Collection
70070000025981.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000025981.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Summer, Winter, Fall Spring, and Garden Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000025982.name: nGolf Classic Edition
70070000025982.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000025982.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Unlock new levels with Moon Swing and Western Fairways DLCs and also change the appearance with Colorful Golf Balls 1 DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000025983.name: Tokyo Cooking Classic Edition
70070000025983.intro: Run the best sushi restaurant in the city, talk to customers and learn new recipes.
70070000025983.description:
Make your grandma proud in Tokyo Cooking! Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes. Take orders from customers, prepare their meals with passion and listen to their opinions to become better and better with each passing day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your Japanese restaurant in Tokyo Cooking. At the end of each day, you will have access to your laptop, where you can browse through equipment you can purchase for your place. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.

Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Complete mini-games to receive extra money as a bonus for your order.

Decorate your restaurant with the Cherry Blossom, Majestic Fuji and Oceanic Fish Sets DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out
- Step-by-step recipes
- Interesting customers
- Day/night system and access to laptop after work
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000025984.name: Fly Corp – DLC Bundle
70070000025984.intro: Elevate your Fly Corp experience with the DLC Bundle! The set of speed and extremely hardcore challenges makes this bundle a treasure trove at a bargain price!
70070000025984.description:
Fly Corp – DLC Bundle includes:

Fly Corp – Quick scenarios DLC Pack brings 6 new scenarios. Earn a specific amount of money before the time runs out, or try to keep up when the cities appear in the blink of an eye. And other speed challenges!

Fly Corp – Extreme scenarios DLC Pack. Here you’ll have to overcome the 6 hardest scenarios in the entire Fly Corp. Manage the airport with an enormous passenger flow or connect the biggest cities from the East Coast to Alaska. And other extremely hardcore challenges!

70070000026007.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.9
70070000026007.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the ninth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000026008.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.10
70070000026008.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the tenth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000026012.name: The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass
70070000026012.intro: The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass includes two story expansions bundled at a discount.
70070000026012.description:
The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass includes two story expansions bundled at a discount. Experience mysterious new conflicts, intriguing quests, strange new locations, outlandish weapons, devious characters, and additional ways to aid or defy the Board of Halcyon in two new narrative expansions for the darkly-humorous, critically-acclaimed, and award-winning sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division.

•	The Outer Worlds: Peril on Gorgon. Investigate the dark secrets of one of the most ambitious scientific undertakings in Halcyon: the development and synthesis of Adrena-Time, a drug intended to improve the productivity of workers across the colony.
•	The Outer Worlds: Murder on Eridanos. Venture to the skies of Eridanos and unravel the grandest murder mystery in the Halcyon colony! Everyone is a suspect in this peculiar whodunit after Rizzo’s hired spokesperson, the famous Halcyon Helen, winds up dead.

A copy of The Outer Worlds on the same platform is required to play expansion pass content. 

---
The Outer Worlds: Peril on Gorgon
ESRB RATING: Mature 17+
Blood and Gore
Intense Violence
Strong Language
Use of Drugs

70070000026016.name: The Outer Worlds: Board-Approved Bundle
70070000026016.intro: The Outer Worlds: Board-Approved Bundle, now with 100% less packaging!
70070000026016.description:
The Outer Worlds: Board-Approved Bundle, now with 100% less packaging! This bundle features The Outer Worlds and The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass, which includes both story-based expansions for the game.

THE OUTER WORLDS

The Outer Worlds is the award-winning single-player first-person sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division.

Lost in transit while on a colonist ship bound for the furthest edge of the galaxy, you awake decades later only to find yourself in the midst of a deep conspiracy threatening to destroy the Halcyon colony. As you explore the furthest reaches of space and encounter various factions, all vying for power, the character you decide to become will determine how this player-driven story unfolds. In the corporate equation for the colony, you are the unplanned variable.

THE OUTER WORLDS EXPANSION PASS

The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass includes two story expansions. Experience mysterious new conflicts, intriguing quests, strange new locations, outlandish weapons, devious characters, and additional ways to aid or defy the Board of Halcyon in two additional narrative expansions for the darkly-humorous, critically-acclaimed, and award-winning sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division.

•	The Outer Worlds: Peril on Gorgon. Investigate the dark secrets of one of the most ambitious scientific undertakings in Halcyon: the development and synthesis of Adrena-Time, a drug intended to improve the productivity of workers across the colony.
•	The Outer Worlds: Murder on Eridanos. Venture to the skies of Eridanos and unravel the grandest murder mystery in the Halcyon colony! Everyone is a suspect in this peculiar whodunit after Rizzo’s hired spokesperson, the famous Halcyon Helen, winds up dead.

A copy of The Outer Worlds on the same platform is required to play expansion pass content. 

---

70070000026025.name: Theft Ride Legacy: Gold Edition
70070000026025.intro: Gear up for the ultimate treasure hunt on wheels!
70070000026025.description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-packed adventure in "Theft Ride Legacy"! 
As a skilled motorcyclist, you'll navigate through abandoned warehouses to recover stolen loot from a bank heist. Using abandoned warehouses as your playground, dodge obstacles and race against the clock to collect as much loot as possible. 
Compete with friends in two-player mode to see who can become the ultimate loot hunter. 
With thrilling gameplay, challenging levels and the excitement of the chase, this game is perfect for anyone looking for a heart-pumping challenge.

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Extra Color Pack" and "Extra Mission Pack"!

Get ready to embark on an action-packed journey and become the ultimate loot hunter!

70070000026027.name: Boti: Byteland Overclocked Deluxe Edition
70070000026027.intro: The Boti: Byteland Overclocked experience + 4 add-on DLCs, soundtrack & artbook
70070000026027.description:
The full Boti: Byteland Overclocked experience + all 4 add-on DLCs, digital soundtrack and artbook all in one.

A Unique Blend of Nostalgic and Fresh 3D Platformer Experience
Boti: Byteland Overclocked combines classic 3D platforming with a splash of innovation. Double jump, dash, hover, and glide through vibrant levels, discovering fantastic combos inspired by the very essence of computers and technology.

Co-operative Fun with Friends
Enjoy the pure delight of gaming together in our drop-in, drop-out co-operative mode. Bond with a friend on your quest to save Byteland, with the gameplay seamlessly adapting between solo and two-player modes. Because everything is better… TOGETHER!

Meet The Cheerful Trio
Join Boti, the endearing data bot, and his charming companions, Zero and One, on an enchanting quest to rid Byteland of bugs, viruses, and glitches. Their cute, quirky dialogues will make you chuckle.

Uncover creative gameplay features
Experience a neat twist on classic platforming. Master creative arcade elements, such as rhythm-driven musical slides and magnetic gameplay, to explore and conquer challenges like never before.

Vibrant, colorful world inspired by computers and technology
Dive into Byteland, exploring the secrets of a cyber-world inspired by computers and technology both new and old. You’ll find a plethora of collectibles and data to assemble and relocate to their proper places inside the byte-tastic world of Boti!

All add-on DLCs and extras included

Grab the full digital artbook and soundtrack alongside all 4 add-on DLCs. Grab a special dino skin, enjoy winter-themed gifts, play 3 special Halloween maps, and choose the flashiest skins for your hovercraft.

70070000026028.name: Sherlock Purr 2 Ultimate Edition
70070000026028.intro: Embark on a purrfect adventure with Sherlock Purr to uncover hidden objects!
70070000026028.description:
• 20 Unique Levels: Explore beautifully designed homes and help residents find lost items.
• Sharpen your senses: Test your perceptiveness by finding each cleverly hidden object.
• Beat the Clock: Race to locate items as quickly as possible!

"Sherlock Purr 2" is a charming hidden-object adventure where you step into the paws of Sherlock Purr, a clever feline detective on a mission. Roam through cozy, unique houses as you search for hidden objects and uncover secrets. Each case is a fresh adventure, filled with intricate puzzles and clever clues that will challenge your detective skills. Join the investigation today! Get ready to explore, search, and help Sherlock Purr become the best detective in town! 

Bundle includes "Extra Mystery Pack I" and "Extra Mystery Pack II"!

70070000026038.name: Citizen Sleeper: Helion Collection
70070000026038.intro: Includes Citizen Sleeper and Citizen Sleeper 2
70070000026038.description:
The Helion Collection brings together the award-winning Citizen Sleeper, a gripping adventure inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, which has you living the life of an escaped worker as you attempt to survive on a lawless space station and its sequel, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, a dice-driven RPG where you get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

ABOUT CITIZEN SLEEPER
Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.

ABOUT CITIZEN SLEEPER 2: STARWARD VECTOR
A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

70070000026040.name: Maki: Paw of Fury Deluxe Edition
70070000026040.intro: Beat ‘em up and Retro Arcade game enjoyers – welcome to the world of Pangea!
70070000026040.description:
When a friend gets captured, Maki comes to her rescue! Fight your way through five diverse locations with funky fresh minigames, and conquer the dangerous opponents that stand in your way!


FEEL THE 90S IN AN ANIMAL STYLE — Maki: Paw of Fury’s combat elements are inspired by the hit beat ‘em up arcade games from the 90s, while the story of Maki takes place in the original world of Pangea. Animals rule here, and they’re passionate about sports, technology, and lifelong friendships. Speaking of, one is about to be on the brink of breaking!


A FRIEND IN NEED, A FIGHT INDEED — Maki gets a pleading call for help and realizes that his dear friend - Mapu - has betrayed him. Here starts the road of Maki: The Paw of Fury! He might look adorable, but don’t mistake his fox cuteness for weakness - he has studied the martial art of Tsume no Ken and can wield a tuna like a professional.


MAKI ISN’T ALONE — You can choose to play Maki the fox, but you can also choose Tincho, the muscular capybara, and Maka, the colorful otter who will show your enemies the power of music. Each of these characters is unique when it comes to looks, strength, and fighting style!

Unlock new Maki Aviator skin, included in this bundle.

VIBE WITH THE MUSIC AND THE WONDERFUL WORLD OF PANGEA — While all the fighting’s going on it’s hard to appreciate the visuals. But if you stand down just for a moment you’ll be able to appreciate the stunning views of Pangea’s world! You’’ travel through dark ninja forests, icy planes, and desert dunes in the tune of energetic and fighting-ready tracks.

70070000026044.name: Car Cops: Complete Edition
70070000026044.intro: From traffic stops to high-speed chases – think you’ve got what it takes to keep the streets safe?
70070000026044.description:
In Car Cops, you’re more than just a regular cop – you’re the sharp-eyed officer who never misses a clue! Patrol the streets, pull over suspicious drivers, and dive into the action-packed life of a police officer. Each stop could lead to a dangerous criminal, a desperate chase, or someone in need of urgent help.

Features:
- Extra Items: 7 new outfits for your police officer and additional 5000 cash to make your home the perfect place to relax after a hard day at work!
- Detailed Vehicle Inspections: Check IDs, match faces, and look for suspicious items in cars.
- Intense Car Chases: Follow criminals on the run in fast-paced pursuits across town.
- Showdowns with Criminals: Be ready for action when criminals fight back – take cover and return fire to stay safe.
- Professional Police Tools: Use x-rays, slice through seat fabric, and explore every corner of the car for hidden surprises.
- Deliver Justice: Bring suspects to court, where you decide if they’re guilty or innocent.
- Emergency Responder Role: Jump into action, offering CPR, putting out car fires, or helping with breakdowns on the road.

Check IDs, inspect faces, and scan every detail to decide if the driver is innocent or up to no good. From cutting open seat cushions, to defusing bombs in car trunks, you’ll need to stay alert and rely on your instincts and gear. And when a wanted criminal crosses your path, prepare for a heart-pounding chase – and don’t hesitate to take action when it’s time to draw your weapon!

But it’s not just about the bad guys – you’re there for the people, too. Some drivers might need CPR, others may have a car fire or a breakdown that only you can handle!

Think you can spot a criminal at first glance? Put your instincts to the test!

70070000026045.name: Devil Summoner Ultimate Bundle
70070000026045.description:
Purchase a bundle of paid additional content of "RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army" at a discount.

The Devil Summoner Ultimate Bundle includes the following: 

- DLC Content - Kuzunoha Village Trainings (Grant access to trials with experience, in-game currency, and stat increase rewards) 
- DLC Content - Demons of the Aril Rift (Grants access to battles with Special Book rewards) 
- DLC Content - Guest Demons Pack (Grants access to popular demons from the Shin Megami Tensei series) 
- DLC Content - Skill Book Pack (Forbidden books that grant special abilites)
- DLC Content - Survival Pack (Grants items that help for Battle)

*For more information on each DLC item, please refer to their individual listings.

*Please be careful not to repurchase the same items from the separately sold content.

*This bundle does not include any free additional content. You will need to download it separately.

70070000026049.name:
RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army 
- Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000026049.description:
Pre-orders include the cosmetic Raidou Glasses. Available before 21:00 PDT time Thursday, June 18, 2025. 

RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army - Digital Deluxe Edition includes: 

- Base game - "RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army"
DLC Content - Kuzunoha Village Trainings (Grant access to trials with experience, in-game currency, and stat increase rewards)
