70070000026050.name: Garten of Banban 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 6 + 7
70070000026050.intro: Experience the Garten of Banban series with this complete bundle, including Garten of Banban 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 & 7! Explore the facility and make new friends... If you dare.
70070000026050.description:
Travel through the abandoned underground levels of Banban's Kindergarten in Garten of Banban 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7. Discover the truth hidden behind the colorful rooms to find your missing child. Will you be able to survive in this unfamiliar place?

Life is easier with friends:
Banban and the Friends mascot Gang is waiting for you. Will you be able to get to know them better? Make new connections in the facility, but beware - the lower you go, the harder it may get to find a friendly face.

The history of Banban's Kindergarten:
Banban’s Kindergarten was once the go-to kindergarten for any parent who needed their children to attend a reputable learning facility. Everything changed when, one day, everyone vanished from the place. What happened? In search of your missing child, you will have to find the answer yourself.

Survive the levels of the establishment:
Delve deeper and explore the mysterious levels of the building. But be careful - some of those rooms haven't been visited by a human for quite some time, and they may hide things that should remain hidden...

Explore with your flying companion:
Everything's better when you have a friend to share with. Use your handy drone to help you navigate and proceed through the facility, as well as have it keep you company when you are feeling lonely and scared, which you will be feeling a lot.

FEATURES
• The whole gang's here - Meet new friends and don't get lonely!
• Me, myself, and my drone - Let your trusty electric friend help you!
• Solve the mysteries - Complete the mind-bending puzzles to progress through the underground!
• Don't turn back - There is only one way - down!

70070000026051.name: Little Mouse's Encyclopedia Puzzle Collection
70070000026051.intro: Explore the incredible world of nature with a charming little mouse. Beautiful, hand-painted graphics and an interesting collection of facts will awaken the naturalist's soul in everyone.
70070000026051.description:
INTERACTIVE ENCYCLOPEDIA
Little Mouse's Encyclopedia is ideal for born explorers. Wandering around the lively boards, you’ll find animals and plants by yourself. Using a magnifying glass, you can reveal cards that contain interesting information and drawings.

GORGEOUS ILLUSTRATIONS
The graphic style of Little Mouse's Encyclopedia was inspired by classic fairy tales and... children's encyclopedias. This enchanting and original style makes the exploration even more enjoyable, and various animations breathe life into the surroundings.

RELAXING MUSIC
While playing, listen to pleasant, relaxing music and the sounds of nature, such as birds chirping or frog toads.

EXPLORE THE WORLD
With a brave mouse, you’ll explore the area around its burrow, walk through the forest, sneak through the garden, and swim in the pond. In each of these places, unique species of animals and plants await you.

SO MUCH TO DISCOVER!
During your wandering, you’ll come across over 160 unique species, about which you can learn something interesting.

AVAILABLE IN MANY LANGUAGES
Little Mouse's Encyclopedia is available in 18 languages, including English, Japanese, German, Spanish, and French.
Immerse yourself in the extraordinary world of nature today with the brave little mouse!

This bundle includes 4 DLC: Garden, Forest, Pond and Puzzle Pack 1.

KEY FEATURES:
— over 160 species of animals and plants to discover
— 4 different habitats
— beautiful illustrations
— a fun way to learn
— relaxing music
— easy and intuitive controls
— available in many languages

70070000026056.name: Sky Diving: Deluxe Edition
70070000026056.intro: Experience the Ultimate Freefall with Exclusive Gear and Upgrades!
70070000026056.description:
Sky Diving: Deluxe Edition brings you the ultimate skydiving experience with everything you need to soar, dive, and conquer the skies! This exclusive bundle includes the main game along with two thrilling DLCs:

Backpack Customization DLC: Personalize your gear with stunning new backpacks like the sleek Falcon Glide and the bold Solar Flare, adding both style and performance to your dives.
Cash Flight DLC: Earn up to 50,000 coins by completing challenging dives and missions, unlocking new gear, customization options, and upgrades to enhance your skydiving experience.

With the Deluxe Edition, you get the full skydiving adventure with exclusive content, gear, and rewards, all in one amazing package. Ready to dive into the ultimate experience? The sky’s the limit!

70070000026062.name: Pool Fever Premium Edition
70070000026062.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000026062.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #2 with:

-5 new pool cues designs

70070000026065.name: Pool Fever Deluxe Edition
70070000026065.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000026065.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #2 with:

5 new pool table designs
5 new pool cues designs

70070000026067.name: Hotel Hustle Classic Collection
70070000026067.intro: Take a very hands-on approach to managing a bustling hotel and make sure your guests leave with a smile on their face.
70070000026067.description:
Welcome to the most bustling place in the world. Important notice: no, you can’t hide the bell from the guests. Yes, they will keep ringing it. Your role here will be to take care of the hotel and attend to guests and all their needs for the duration of their stay.


CLEAN, PREPARE, AND SERVE - SERVICE, I MEAN SERVICE 
Before the guests arrive you’ll need to tidy up and prepare their rooms. Look at your to-do list, take all the necessary equipment from the trolley and get rid of the mess. To answer incoming questions: yes, the guests will complain if they see but a crumb on their carpet.

Time is money. Delivering the guests’ special requests - like luxurious sheets or delicious sushi - need to be completed in a specific amount of time for you to receive your entire monetary bonus.


RUN THE HOTEL ALONE OR WITH A FRIEND
If you’d like to play with a friend, your stakes will be a bit higher, but two heads are better than one. The camera will pan out to include both characters on the screen at all times.

Happy hustling and do not forget: a “no running, wet floor” sign is not enough of an excuse not to deliver a guests their meal on time.

Browse amazing drawings from three new Artbooks DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Singleplayer and coop mode
- Stars that unlock new levels
- Many activities to complete
- 25 levels with various layouts

70070000026081.name: Bridge Race: Royal Edition
70070000026081.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70070000026081.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

Features:
- 3 additional skins to show off your style!
- 15000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition—who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000026084.name: Block Jam: Complete Edition
70070000026084.intro: Plan, match, and clear the board in Block Jam, where every move counts and every block needs the perfect match!
70070000026084.description:
Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and build amazing structures for your blocks. Sounds easy? Think again! – you only have so much room on your bench, and if you overfill it, it's game over!

Features:
- Extra items: 30x undo powerup, 30x more space powerup, 30x shuffle powerup, 30x magnet powerup and 12 new hats for the blocks that live on your dioramas!
- Match and Win: Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and avoid overfilling your bench.
- Limited Bench: Use your bench wisely – a full bench means game over!
- Bus Mode: Fill color-matched buses to clear levels and earn extra power-ups and coins!
- Fun Power-Ups: Use undo, magnet, reshuffle, or expand your bench to escape tricky situations.
- Build Your Diorama: Collect bricks to create unique structures in your very own block-populated diorama.
- Customize Your Blocks: Use coins earned in-game to give your diorama blocks unique and fun looks.

Every level gives you new challenges to solve, but don't worry – you have power-ups to help! Undo a move, reshuffle blocks, or add extra bench space when you're in a tough spot. Earn coins along the way to customize your blocks and make your diorama totally unique!

For an extra challenge, try "Bus Mode" – the classic Block Jam experience with a colorful twist! Match blocks to fill color-coded buses and watch them roll out. Complete all buses in a level, and you'll earn even more power-ups and coins to help you on your journey!

Jump into Block Jam – where every move is a step closer to clearing the board, personalizing your world, and mastering each challenge!

70070000026089.name: Spy Guy Memory: Brain Total Challenge
70070000026089.intro: The largest memory set in the Spy Guy Series
70070000026089.description: Test your memory with the entire Spy Guy Memory series. Discover fun pictures and train your memory.

70070000026090.name: KUUKIYOMI: Consider It! 123 Bundle
70070000026090.description:
With the bundle version, you can purchase the 3 titles in the "KUUKIYOMI: Consider It!" series at a great price.

■Set contents
・KUUKIYOMI: Consider It!
・KUUKIYOMI 2: Consider It More! - New Era
・KUUKIYOMI 3: Consider It More and More!! - Father to Son

*The contents included in this bundle are also sold separately. Please be careful about duplicate purchases.
*Please check the product page for details on each title.

70070000026092.name: Hand-Drawn Epic Adventures
70070000026092.intro: Two big adventures with memorable characters, for the price of one!
70070000026092.description:
- BROK the InvestiGator: An innovative "Punch & Click" adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

- Demetrios: A quirky adventure game inspired by classics, packed with humor!

Both games are very friendly to newcomers in the genre, with in-game hints, hotspots viewer and accessibility.

70070000026107.name: Animal Farm Parking: Premium Edition
70070000026107.intro: Help your farm animals escape their pens in this fun puzzle game filled with tricky obstacles and adorable challenges!
70070000026107.description:
Features:
• Cute and Diverse Animals: from playful pigs to gentle cows, clever chickens, and more!
• Challenging Puzzle Levels: Navigate animals through increasingly difficult levels.
• Obstacles and Barriers: Avoid hay bales, and other farm items that block your path. Watch out! Pens may have moving gates!

Dive into the delightful world of Animal Farm Parking, where strategy meets farmyard fun! As the caring owner of a lively farm, your mission is to help your adorable animals navigate out of their pens safely. But there’s a challenge – you must guide them in the correct order to avoid collisions and clear the path for everyone.

With a variety of animals to free, from playful pigs to curious ostriches, every level brings fresh puzzles and exciting twists, including moving obstacles that keep you on your toes. Complete each task quickly to let your animals roam free and enjoy the great outdoors!

This bundle contains "Extra Mission Pack II".

70070000026111.name: Drift Legacy Ultimate Edition
70070000026111.intro: Master thrilling tracks, drift to earn, upgrade your ride, and claim the title of Drift Champion!
70070000026111.description:
Experience the ultimate drifting thrill with Drift Legacy! 
Choose and customize your dream car, from its performance to its appearance, making it truly yours. Tackle a variety of routes, from the industrial atmosphere of bustling docks to high-speed racetracks. With intuitive controls, stunning visuals, and the freedom to modify your ride, the game invites you to carve your path to victory.

Are you ready to leave your mark on the racing world?
★ THE LEGACY BEGINS ON THE TRACK ★

BUNDLE INCLUDES "Racetrack of Champions" & "Extra Cars" !

70070000026125.name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals Triple Pack
70070000026125.intro: The Five Ordeals + Prisoners of the Battles + The Absence of Misericordia!
70070000026125.description:
The hidden gem of 3D dungeon RPGs is now available!

 Triple Pack Contains
- The Five Ordeals
- Scenario DLC Prisoners of the Battles
- Scenario DLC The Absence of Misericordia

Classic hardcore gameplay. Experience a deep dungeon crawling RPG. This game was created by the main staff that worked on the popular RPG series back in 2006. In this game, players can experience many different dungeon crawler RPGs using the same base system. Available with enhancements to the UI and much more. Official scenarios seen for the first time each with dozens of hours of gameplay.

70070000026138.name: Big Helmet Heroes - Exalted Edition
70070000026138.intro: The Exalted Edition includes Big Helmet Heores game + its Artbook & OST
70070000026138.description:
Discover the hilarious world of Big Helmet Heroes, a 3D beat 'em up combining combat and adventure. Find 29 adorable heroes hidden in fantastic kingdoms and choose your favorites to save the princess. Play alone or with a friend, and try to overcome the formidable challenges that await you!

- Epic and endearing heroes: there are 29 in total, each mastering one of 4 formidable combat styles and possessing their own unique superpower—find them all!

- Hilarious battles: face hordes of goblins and formidable bosses, use the environment to your advantage, and wield whimsical weapons to defeat them!

- Vast and imaginative worlds: explore stunning levels, from medieval fantasy to realms filled with mummies, pirates, and even charming yet fearsome unicorns!

- Local co-op mode: defeat enemies, strategize together, and enjoy chaotic situations as you fight side by side with a friend.

- A challenge for all: easy to start, but much more demanding for the skilled and daring.


The Exalted Edition includes:
- Big Helmet Heroes
- Artbook & OST

Note: The Artbook is only available in English.

70070000026139.name: Ala Mobile Variante

70070000026143.name: Atelier Yumia - Aladiss Investigation Preparation Set
70070000026143.intro: A set of costumes for Yumia and Flammi and the accessory.
70070000026143.description:
Includes a costume for both Yumia and Flammi, three "Training Wrist Weight" accessories, and the recipe for Training Wrist Weights. Training Wrist Weights increase the experience gained from defeating monsters by 3% while equipped.

List of Contents:
- "Athlete of Memories" Costume for Yumia
- "Floating Object of Memories" Costume for Flammi
- Exclusive Equipment "Training Wrist Weight" (Set of 3 plus recipe)

Note: The early purchase bonus can be claimed up through April 3rd, 2025. 
Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room. Accessories can be checked from the container, and recipes can be checked after unlocking synthesis. This content may become available for purchase or for free separately at a later date. Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70070000026144.name: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000026144.intro:
Walk the forbidden path, no matter where it leads.
A premium edition including costumes fit for a memory-filled adventure.
70070000026144.description:
People gather memories as they live their lives, thus developing their souls. This is the story of a young woman traveling across a ruined continent to find the path toward the future.

The theme of this game is "memory." There are moments when everyone must confront the past and their own memories. All memories, including both successes and failures, become nourishment for the future and help shape people. "Atelier Yumia" tells the story of Yumia and her companions as they follow the path they believe in while being confronted by the memories they discover along the way.

List of Contents:
• The main game
• Atelier Yumia - Colorful Collection
Costume palette changes for Yumia, Flammi, Viktor, Isla, Rutger, Nina, and Lenja (2 for each character, 14 total), three "Puni Badge" accessories, and the recipe for Puni Badges. While equipped, Puni Badges increase the experience gained from defeating Puni-type monsters by 50% and guarantee that they will drop items.

Note:
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room (the relevant characters must also have joined your party). Accessories can be checked from the container, and recipes can be checked after unlocking synthesis.
- Please be aware that other editions containing this product exist. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please be aware that the main game is also available for purchase as a standalone product. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000026148.name: DROS Deluxe Edition
70070000026148.intro: Explore the Tower, meet its strange inhabitants, collect alchemical treasures, and discover twists around every corner.
70070000026148.description:
DROS is a dark fantasy adventure where you'll swap between a small gooey creature and her human bounty hunter shell. Explore freely through 40 unique diorama-like levels filled with strange characters, intricate puzzles, hidden rooms, and ancient collectibles.


STORY WITH A TWIST
When the Captain is hanging by a thread, destiny tosses a curveball – enter Dros. Different motives, same mission: stop the Alchemist! Dive into the Tower's labyrinthine mysteries and mingle with its quirky denizens. Hunt for alchemical treasures and brace yourself for a world that keeps you on your toes.

Chat with an array of oddball and endearing characters as you journey. Humans and Dros cohabitate in the Tower, a place where the line between good and evil is as wavy as a squiggly straw.


SWAP THE BODY RIGHT
Prepare to body swap! Wiggle, jiggle, and sneak around as the gooey Little Dros. Bust open hefty doors, press down pressure plates and clear the way as the robust Captain. But beware... each of the Tower's 40 levels has its own unique surprises!
Obstacles galore await you. Flex both brainpower and muscle to solve puzzles, fend off creepy creatures, piece together alchemical treasures, and uncover a tapestry of stories.

This bundle includes additional Gallery DLC featuring ilustrations showing the magical world of DROS.

FEATURES:
- Exclusive version with subtitles and UI in English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese.
- Every nook and cranny of the Tower is meticulously designed.
- Unique soundtrack by electronic pioneer Arovane, seamlessly integrated into the world.
- Explore 40 levels each with unique puzzle mechanics, enemies, hidden rooms, and platforming.
- Play as two vastly different characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
- Amass Prima and gain new abilities.
- Narrative with humor and a bunch of heart.
- Collect diary entries to dive deeper into the story.
- Post-game challenges to keep the adventure going.
- Race through the game to uncover special secrets.

70070000026153.name: Neko Bento Tasty Seconds
70070000026153.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000026153.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

Unlock more puzzles to solve with New Levels 1 and 2 DLCs included in this bundle.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!

70070000026164.name: Cook For Love Ultimate Edition
70070000026164.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000026164.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

Change the look of your kitchen with Powder Red Blender and Colorful Stove DLCs included in this bundle.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000026174.name: Vege Bubble Shoot Deluxe Edition

Step into the enchanting world of Vege Bubble Shot, a colourful and addictive puzzle game that will captivate your gaming senses. Dive into a fruity adventure where you'll use your strategic skills to save a delightful vegetable garden from pesky intruders and become a puzzle master!

Key Features:

    Vivid Vegetable Vistas: Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world brimming with hand-crafted, vibrant vegetables. Explore lush garden settings and interact with charming characters.

    Challenging Puzzles: Put your aim and matching skills to the test with a variety of engaging puzzles. Can you clear the garden of intruders with your accurate shots?

    Power-Ups and Boosters: Utilize an array of powerful boosters and unique power-ups to enhance your gameplay. Create spectacular chain reactions to tackle the intruders with flair.

    Endless Fun: Vege Bubble Shot offers hundreds of levels, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment for both short and extended gaming sessions.

    Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: The game is designed for players of all skill levels, with straightforward mechanics for beginners and depth for those seeking a greater challenge.

Multiplayer included! Vege Bubble Shot is the perfect game for both casual players and competitive gamers. Aim, shoot, and match your way through the captivating vegetable garden, and bring back harmony one bubble at a time. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this addictive and colourful adventure!

70070000026175.name: Fashion World Value Edition
70070000026175.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000026175.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!

70070000026177.name: Dreamland Farm Easy Farming
70070000026177.intro: After living in a big city your dreams come true – today you start your new life on a peaceful pixel farm!
70070000026177.description:
Your grandma has taught you everything about farming and foraging – from taking care of crops to knowing which berries and mushrooms are edible. Your time has come to become her successor!


A NEW START
You came from the big city to take over your grandma’s farm – a pretty brave move for a city dweller! It’s a good thing that this place has everything you need. With a few decent tools in your pocket, you can start making it your own. Plant crops, take care of cute animals, and don’t forget to explore this vast green expanse.

Make sure to take good care of yourself, during all this as your energy has its limits!


YOU ARE NOT ALONE
There is a small and peaceful town near the farm where you will find many hardworking people – like the local cook, smith, and the mayor. Getting to know them and helping them will expand your dreamland world bit by bit. Not to mention they will help you with upgrading your tools via blueprints… for a favor or two.

Are you ready to uncover the secrets of Dreamland Farm and fall in love with it, just like your grandma did?

Change the look of your farm with Banner,House Furnitures and Kitchen Furnitures DLCs included in this bundle and make it more cozy.

KEY FEATURES:
- A pixel world with a cozy aesthetic
- Your own pixelated plot of land.
- To balance out the cute and round animals, we put them in a square barn!
- The world grows with you - as you upgrade your gear, the tiers of materials spawning in the world will go up!
- Learn new recipes the same way you get blueprints - but through more delicious means.
- No taxes!

70070000026178.name: Tell Me Your Story Melancholy Collection
70070000026178.intro: Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.
70070000026178.description:
Tell Me Your Story is a story-driven cozy puzzle game, which might remind you of the warm times spent with your grandparents or loved ones on getting to know the many, sometimes unexpected stories from their lives.

THE PERFECT TRIO

Meet Amelia, a schoolgirl with a vivid imagination, who’s going on her summer vacation to her grandma Rose’s cottage – her loyal best friend, Peanut, in tow.  This is where Rose had settled to find inner peace in her old age after the life she’s had…

What made her life so special, you ask?

Rose is not an ordinary grandmother – she has a home full of wondrous items and stories to tell. All her life she was a globetrotter, an adventurer – but without dangerous artifacts to deal with.

ADVENTERES AROUND THE WORLD 

Discover Asia, Europe, and the Amazon rainforest and feel like a child again, while listening to grandmother's colorful stories alongside Amelia and the adorable corgi doggie.

While helping unpack Rose’s things together with Amelia, you will find plenty of interesting artifacts that she took from her escapades around the world. They will help you get a better picture of the memories she wants to share with you and let you traverse through the images of her past.

Going through the adventure, you will have many puzzles to solve, which will help you discover the wonders Rose has hidden. Help out Amelia with writing everything down in the diary, and make all these stories even better with her imagination.

Following Rose’s footsteps will lead you to historical sites all over the world. First will be the journey through the Amazon rainforest in search of Aztec legends, then through the Yunnan region in China – where the masters of brewing tea lay. Last but not least, you will find yourself on board the Orient Express and its magical first route – from Paris to Istanbul.

Will this busy summer full of memories and adventure bring together two generations, that thought they had so little in common until now?

PICTURE ADVENTURE

Despite the remarkable stories we have to tell, Tell Me Your Story is also a beautiful eye-catching minimalist game with hand-drawn scenes, where there’s no need for any words – everything is brought together in your imagination, enhanced by the colorful images and puzzles.

This bundle includes 3 DLCs with various artbooks and two extra puzzle DLCs.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
- Multiple puzzles to solve
- A heartwarming story about the family bond
- A corgi dog – Peanut
- Minimalistic cozy graphic design
- Wonderful OST, to smooth your gameplay experience

70070000026179.name: Piano: Learn and Play First Time Edition

A marvel of modernity

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

70070000026180.name: Freaky Trip Salceson Edition
70070000026180.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000026180.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Summer, Winter, Fall Spring, Garden and Camp Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000026181.name: nGolf Master Collection
70070000026181.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000026181.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

70070000026207.name: Tank vs Tank Premium Edition

Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs. Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans.

Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

Unlock more puzzles to solve with New Levels 1, 2 and 3 DLCs included in this bundle.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000026262.name: Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Extended Edition
70070000026262.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000026262.description:
Love cooking games? Manage 9 distinct kitchens, craft over 500 dishes, and rise to culinary stardom across 1000+ fast-paced levels in Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire. Customize your home, unlock trophies, and bring the heat!

From street food to sushi, each kitchen will test your time-management skills as you work to satisfy impatient customers and hit your goals. But it’s not all about the kitchens—customize and upgrade your home to showcase your achievements, unlock trophies, and build a true empire!

Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Can you handle the heat and build your own cooking empire?

Key Features:

9 Unique Cuisines: Master a range of cooking styles and menus.
500+ Dishes: A global selection of recipes to perfect.
1000+ Levels: Challenge yourself with increasingly complex kitchens.
Home Customization: Upgrade your furniture and earn trophies to showcase your progress.
Fun & Fast-Paced: Simple to play, with endless hours of culinary excitement!

This bundle contains base game and Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Kebab Bar Tycoon.

70070000026264.name: Amelia's Garden Deluxe Edition
70070000026264.intro: Repair these pots and start a brand new rooftop garden!
70070000026264.description:
Turn this empty rooftop into your own green corner in the city. Glue together colorful pots, plant various seeds, and share your harvest with friends in Amelia’s Garden!


YOUR GARDEN IN A CITYSCAPE
There’s this old stairway in your building that leads to the rooftop. Not knowing what’s up there means that an adventure, however brief, awaits. You climb upstairs and push the handle of the heavy door that stands in your way. On the other side…
A big garden space, complete with a little fountain, a table, and benches. This fine view and plenty of broken flower pots are all yours now. With a clean, a bit of glue, and plenty of patience this place can be brought back to life – are you ready to start your own rooftop garden?


LITTLE STEPS TOWARD A COLORFUL FUTURE
Together with Amelia, you’ll be restoring this old garden to glory! There are 20 broken pots to put together, each with a unique plant. You can expect to see beets, tomatoes, strawberries, basil, and many more spices, veggies, and fruit alike.

Every pot has a unique puzzle required to put it together. After this task is finished, you can fill it with dirt, plant seeds, water it, and let it grow. Before you know it, you’ll see the fruit of your labor - though it can be a veggie of your labor, too. You can also move the pots however much you like and even organize them based on color!


A COZY SPACE FOR YOU AND YOURS
Various folks like various plants - Amelia’s friends are like this as well. As the plants grow you can give them out to people and earn hearts. Each person has a unique set of likes and dislikes, so even if you don’t like strawberries I’m sure someone else would gladly take them in!

Ease yourself into watching the cityscape while gardening. Relaxing music, hand-drawn artstyle, and non-timed puzzles are here to bring some peace to your life. Even in a bustling city, there has to be a place where you can take a deep breath. Don’t be afraid to make one for yourself!

This bundle includes Behind The Scenes 1 DLC.

70070000026270.name: Tales of Graces f Remastered - Deluxe Upgrade Pack
70070000026270.description:

70070000026272.name: Real Cake Maker: Tasty Edition
70070000026272.intro: Grab your mixer and let the cake-making fun begin!
70070000026272.description:
Become the best cake baker in town and create the yummiest cakes in this delicious cooking adventure!

What kind of cake do you love? Whatever it is, you can bake it! From dreamy frosting to delightful decorations, design cakes that look as good as they taste. Show off your creations to friends, throw a fabulous cake party, or compete in exciting baking contests for the chance to be crowned the cake champ!

Features:
● learn how to bake the most delicious cakes and special cupcakes!
● use professional baker tools for baking, designing and decorating!
● decorate your cakes with lots of frostings, decorations, and toppers to make it look special!
● throw cake parties with your adorable animal friends and make each celebration memorable
● join baking contests, vote for your favorite cakes, and win the first prize!
● dress up like the true baker you are! Put on a pretty chef’s hat and a cute apron
● enjoy a collection of fun coloring pages to inspire your artistic side

Bake up some joy and sweeten your day with fun creations!

70070000026275.name: Heisting: Wicked Edition
70070000026275.intro: What could be more exciting than the thrill of a perfectly performed heist?
70070000026275.description:
You are a masterful thief who embarks on a stealing spree across the world's most luxurious museums, galleries, and banks! 

Gather your crew of robbers and devise the perfect plan as you progress through increasingly difficult levels!

Features:
- rob the most luxurious banks, museums and galleries with the help of your gang!
- recruit new members to increase the size of the group and complete levels more efficiently
- use a new minigun weapon with 235 damage and 5 fire rate
- wear a new wicked skin with 2150 HP, +10% speed and +10% money
- buy upgrades for your weapons, skins, crew, and alarm delay
- carry out various missions: Gang War, Laser Madness, Jewellery Shop, Bank, The Tomb, Take Them Out and many more!
- use diverse weapons with their own damage and fire rate stats
- open safes to draw weapon or skin cards
- use additional 50 gems to buy upgrades even faster!
- become incredibly rich!

If things go wrong, and believe us, they will, it will be up to your skills to shoot your way out to safety. Choose your upgrades carefully, as they could be the difference between a big payday and a messy failure.

As you progress, you will need to convince more robbers to join your gang and help you with your heists. In order for the heist to be completed, you will need to steal everything in your sight.

You will encounter different enemies who will try to prevent you from taking your loot, and you'll need to adapt a unique strategy to get around each one of them.

Immerse yourself into a world where everything is yours for the taking. How much money can you get? The sky's the limit!

70070000026277.name: The Stone of Madness Special Edition
70070000026277.description:

70070000026288.name: Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter - Extended Edition
70070000026288.intro: Bid, win, and uncover treasures – the auction adventure starts here!
70070000026288.description:
Explore the thrilling world of storage auctions with the Bid Battle Bundle, featuring the base game Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter and the Treasure Fund DLC! Compete in intense auctions, uncover hidden treasures, and use exclusive bonuses to expand your collection and maximize your profits.

What’s included in the bundle?
	•	Base Game: Experience realistic auctions, explore themed storage units packed with treasures, and turn your discoveries into profit.
	•	Treasure Fund DLC: Start with a 100 in-game currency bonus, gain a strategic edge in auctions, and win valuable storage units faster.

Get ready to dominate the auction scene and turn every bid into a step toward succes!

70070000026299.name: Star Overdrive: Deluxe Edition
70070000026299.description:
Deluxe Edition includes:
Full Base Game
3 Hoverboard styles
1 Hoverboard design
50 dyes 
The Original Soundtrack
The Original Manga

Join Bios stranded on a distant alien planet with his hoverboard, solve creative puzzles, and fight formidable foes in his quest to reunite with his beloved. Wield the powers of his Keytar for combat, master the hypersonic Hoverboard for trick-filled traversal, uncover mysterious depths, gather resources, and craft parts to enhance your Hoverboard and explore across alien biomes in a massive Open World.  

Unleash the power of music! Wield your keytar to battle enemies, bend the laws of physics, and solve intricate puzzles. Explore abandoned places where your tapes are the key to survival and discovery.

Experience the thrill of speed with the advanced hoverboard. Explore vast landscapes, perform incredible tricks, and gain the edge in intense combat. Speed through missions with unmatched agility and style. Are you ready to hover to victory?

Crash land on an epic journey across a vast, abandoned alien planet! Uncover its secrets as you face relentless enemies, tackle formidable challenges, and navigate through constant danger. Explore the unknown and survive against all odds!

70070000026303.name: WARRIORS: Abyss - Hack'n'Dash Edition
70070000026303.intro: A set of costumes & items to help heroes hack'n'dash as they traverse Hell.
70070000026303.description:
Take command of historic and masterful warriors by challenging countless swarms of enemies. Through victory and defeat, traverse the merciless trials of hell.

70070000026306.name: Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp: Cash King Edition
70070000026306.intro: Unlock exclusive skins and show off your monster truck.
70070000026306.description:
Supercharge your monster truck experience with the Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp: Cash King Edition!
   Conquer daring ramps, collect magical crystals for epic bonuses, and customize your ride with unique skins. Complete special missions to earn exciting rewards and build the ultimate garage. Master your skills, dominate the arena, and rise as a legendary monster truck racer!

Get an instant bonus of 500,000 in-game currency, giving you the edge to unlock premium upgrades, unique skins, and exclusive items faster than ever. Don’t just play—own the road!

70070000026310.name: Pick My Heart Chapter 2 Unlikely Pair
70070000026310.intro: Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends.
70070000026310.description:
Heartfelt Connections
Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends. This anime-inspired visual novel unfolds in a vibrant modern world where myth and reality blend, leading to humorous, heartfelt, and sometimes challenging moments.


Moments of Magic
In Chapter 2, Sota deepens his bonds with various characters, each carrying unique secrets and personalities. Whether it's Aphrodite, Hera, Athena, or Eris, Sota finds himself navigating through surprises, emotional revelations, and intense encounters that test his loyalty and affection.


Trials of Affection
Each goddess brings a new perspective to Sota’s life. Whether meeting at a cozy karaoke club or exploring a quiet, romantic setting, Sota’s choices shape his journey, and each encounter brings him closer to understanding the complexities of love.

This bundle includes Ichika's and Kaito's Secrets DLCs.

Key Features:
- A modern love story with a touch of mythology
- Choices that matter and shape the story
- Four beautiful Greek goddesses, each with their own story and mystery
- A vibrant blend of modern life and ancient myth as gods and mortals co-exist
- Many unique locations and events, such as a date at a karaoke club
- The complex divine-earthly trials of love

70070000026314.name: Alchemy: Origins Season 2
70070000026314.intro: Alchemy: Origins + Alchemy: Origins Food I + Alchemy: Origins Food 2

70070000026341.name: TRUCK SIMULATOR 2025 & VEHICLE SIMULATOR BUNDLE
70070000026341.intro: Master the road, dominate the dirt – all in one epic bundle.
70070000026341.description:
Drive into the Ultimate Simulator Experience
Fuel your passion for the open road and high-octane challenges with Drive into the Ultimate Simulator Experience. This bundle features five exhilarating driving games, each designed to deliver unique adventures that test your skill, strategy, and style behind the wheel.

The Collection Includes:

	•	Hit the iconic highways of America.
	•	Build your trucking empire, complete diverse missions, and customize your fleet.

2. Truck Simulator 2023 - Driver Europe
	•	Explore Europe’s breathtaking landscapes and vibrant cities.
	•	Tackle winding roads, upgrade your truck, and experience the spirit of the open road.

3. Garbage Driver Truck Simulator 2025
	•	Become the city’s unsung hero by keeping the streets clean.
	•	Navigate busy urban environments, manage fuel, and handle challenging missions with precision.

4. Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim

5. Offroad Race Simulator

The road is yours to explore. Take the driver’s seat and set off on an unforgettable journey with Drive into the Ultimate Simulator Experience!

70070000026367.intro: Where tactics and terror collide - are you ready?

Survive relentless zombie waves in Warzone Chronicles and elevate your experience with the Interior Decor DLC! Battle in a gritty, VHS-inspired arena enhanced with atmospheric props, interactive decor, and apocalyptic themes that add depth to the chaos.

Uncover hidden weapons, manage resources, and use decor tactically to outlast the undead in this thrilling survival shooter. Get the bundle and turn every fight into a story worth surviving!

70070000026372.name: Drift Master Simulator 2024: NEW CARS EDITION
70070000026372.intro: New cars, new heights - unleash your inner drift master!
70070000026372.description:
Take Control of the Track with Drift Master Simulator 2024: NEW CARS EDITION
Unleash the ultimate racing experience with the NEW CARS EDITION bundle for “Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim.” This exclusive package gives you access to the game, 4 high-performance cars DLC and endless customization possibilities to elevate your driving adventures.

Equip your new vehicles with premium rims, bold spoilers, and unique upgrades to match your style and performance needs. Whether you’re crushing time trials, mastering precision drifts, or dominating intense races, this bundle has everything you need to stand out on the track.

Get ready to ignite your racing passion, redefine the competition, and become the ultimate drift master with this all-in-one edition!

70070000026373.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Boost to Success
70070000026373.intro: Take flight, build empires - your aviation journey starts here!
70070000026373.description:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of air transportation with the Flight Simulator Delivery: Boost to Success Bundle! You’ll begin your journey at a humble airport and rise to build a global aviation logistics empire. This powerful bundle gives you a main game and DLC what offer you a $350,000 in-game currency boost right from the start, putting you on the fast track to expanding your operations.

Unlock top-tier aircraft, upgrade your hangar facilities, and optimize your cargo transport capabilities to tackle even the most daring missions. With this strategic advantage, you’ll face incredible challenges and seize thrilling opportunities as you shape your aviation destiny.

Take control of your success, soar through the skies, and transform your small airline into a global empire!

70070000026378.name: Memories of Dusk: Complete Set
70070000026378.description:
A new tale of dusk told from the perspective of the four main love interests.
Experience the main story anew with additional scenes and get a glimpse into their thoughts in these two-part stories.
This special set includes all four stories in one discounted bundle.

■Memories of Dusk: Lucien
Lucien has lived alongside constant rejection due to being the son of a commoner mother. His only support through the isolation was memories of a red-headed childhood friend.
The story proceeds in the following order: "Flightless Wings""→ "Withering Flower" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."

■Memories of Dusk: Crius
Despite being lauded as the nation's preeminent knight, Crius harbors a void in his heart. He's put on a front of smiles so that no one could pick up on this, but the violent passions burning within Anastasia slowly but surely lead to change.
The story proceeds in the following order: "Flightless Wings" → "Withering Flower" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."

■Memories of Dusk: Tyril
Tyril is at times an inquisitor who hunts witches, and at others...
His life of discomfort and misfortune turns on its head when Anastasia appears as a heretofore unknown choice. What future awaits the inquisitor and the wilder of a witch's powers?
The story proceeds in the following order: "Withering Flower" → "Flightless Wings" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."

■Memories of Dusk: Zenn
Zenn suddenly realizes he's reliving the same few days over and over again and finds himself unsettled by the chain of tragedies playing out before him. He begins to suspect the witch and Anastasia are to blame...
The story proceeds in the following order: "Withering Flower" → "Flightless Wings" → "Blazing Regicide" → "Parting Memoirs."


・These stories include important information concerning the main story. It is highly recommended you save reading these for after clearing the main story.
・Please update to the newest version before playing.
・Please take care not to purchase duplicates.

70070000026383.name: Street Drag Racing : Garage Expansion Edition
70070000026383.intro: Rev your engines and dominate the streets!
70070000026383.description:
Experience the ultimate street racing adventure! This bundle combines the adrenaline-pumping Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games with the exciting Rise of GELENVAGEN DLC, unlocking the powerful GELENVAGEN for your collection.

Highlights:
	•	Core Game: Race, drift, and customize over 30 luxurious 3D cars in thrilling PvP multiplayer, dynamic tracks, and intense challenges.
	•	Rise of GELENVAGEN DLC: Unlock and race the GELENVAGEN, tackle new challenges, and enjoy enhanced tuning options. Already own the car? Get coins as compensation!

Features:
	•	Online PvP racing and multiplayer modes.
	•	Customizable cars with exclusive upgrades.
	•	Stunning HD graphics and realistic driving physics.

Build, race, and dominate the streets with this must-have bundle for car enthusiasts!

70070000026399.name: Cute Puppy Academy: Kart Pup Tales
70070000026399.intro: Take care of cute puppies, train and expand your academy!
70070000026399.description:
Care for lovable pups by teaching them tricks, enhancing their skills, and keeping them happy. Customize your academy, unlock new breeds, and build a joyful, tail-wagging environment.

• Care for puppies of all breeds and teach them fun tricks.
• Keep your pups happy, wash, feed, and entertain them with a variety of toys.
• Take your puppies on walks through a beautiful park full of surprises and activities.
• Expand your academy with new kennels, toys, and upgraded training spaces.

This bundle include "Beagle Training Pack".

70070000026455.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Anniversary Edition
70070000026455.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000026459.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Powerful Edition
70070000026459.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000026459.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Electro Nom: who eliminates one other runner!
- Goldie Nom: who gets more exp than any other Nom!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000026461.name: Rage Swarm: Explosive Edition
70070000026461.intro: Step into the swarm and rise as the ultimate survivor!
70070000026461.description:
Armed with powerful weapons, blast through waves of fierce enemies to reach the ultimate boss. Collect upgrades along the way to power up and make every shot count!

Features:
- Get lots of premium equipment and supplies including weapons, armor, and designs!
- 4000 extra coins to upgrade your gear and character
- Navigate through various landscapes
- Defend yourself from the fierce invaders
- Pick up upgrades to get stronger
- Level up and buy awesome talents
- Complete quests for useful loot
- Open epic loot boxes and enhance your gear

Unleash a diverse arsenal – from classic firearms to devastating rocket launchers – each with unique abilities for unstoppable action. Gear up with special outfits, each boosting your strength and making every battle more dynamic.

Dodge, shoot, and strategize your moves. Are you ready to conquer the swarm?

70070000026466.name: Ecchi Paradise: Kinky Edition
70070000026466.intro: Meet the most tempting girls in ecchi paradise

70070000026468.name: Doom & Destiny Worlds - Season Pass
70070000026468.intro: Every major DLC for Doom & Destiny Worlds in one lovely package!
70070000026468.description:
**This content is featured in the "Ultimate Supporter Edition" BUNDLE**

Adventure never ends with the Doom & Destiny Worlds Season Pass, featuring unique blueprints, bombastic game mods and exciting story add-ons with new missions, challenges and achievements!

The Season Pass includes:
- Survival of the Nerdiest DLC- The Survival Mod will make Do&De Worlds harder, better, NERDIER.
- Fantastic Quests and Where to Find Them DLC - Unlock rare and powerful items by helping who is in need. This is the way of the hero. Nothing is done for free!
- Damsels & Dragons - Summon 3 playable heroines, sail to 9 uncharted islands, fight powerful horrors and craft epic gear in your final adventure!

70070000026469.name: Doom & Destiny Worlds - Ultimate Supporter Edition
70070000026469.intro: Unlock everything ever made for Doom & Destiny Worlds!
70070000026469.description:
Are you nerd enough to fully support Doom & Destiny Worlds and the dweebs who made it?

Doom & Destiny Ultimate Supporter Edition Bundle features:

- the Season Pass, and never miss all the upcoming DLCs,
- the Deluxe Content.

70070000026473.name: Silver Axe - The Honest Elf (Deluxe Edition)
70070000026473.intro: A fairy-tale epic adventure! The Forest Goddess has fallen into a deep sleep. As a Forest Elf created by the goddess, you should take up the goddess's Silver Axe and seek out the lost power.
70070000026473.description:
Specially enhanced for Nintendo Switch™, this version brings a brand-new combat feel and superior ability system.

-Complete a fairy-tale epic adventure with the animals of the forest. 
After the goddess fell asleep, the forest gradually began to collapse. Generation after generation, the Elves chose brave warriors who took up the goddess's Silver Axe and returned to the forest, trying to save the goddess and the forest, but all failed. Now, you are the last chosen Elf Warrior, and it is your turn to complete this great adventure.

-Multiple story endings. Make your choice in the final chapter of the adventure. 
The power of the Silver Axe comes from the goddess. In this fairy-tale adventure, will you choose to be an honest elf? How will you decide to save the goddess and the forest?

-Unique elemental combination gameplay to create your desired ability. 
You can freely combine the four elements of wind, thunder, earth, and fire. Different combinations of elements will create entirely new abilities. Feel free to experiment with more elemental combinations to ultimately create the ability set you like.

-Exciting boss battles, rich in operational skills and strategies. Experience 17 completely different boss battles. Whether in the main story or side stories, you can enjoy rich and exciting boss challenges. Each boss battle has its own story and unique combat mechanisms.

70070000026481.name: Ecchi Memories: Louise Edition
70070000026481.intro: Let the bras hit the floor
70070000026481.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:

- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000026484.name: Bit Orchard: Animal Valley Classic Collection
70070000026484.intro: Pull out weeds, plant new apple trees and gather the literal fruits of your labor. With time, you'll discover ways to make your life easier and explore this charming 2D world.
70070000026484.description:
Upgrade your orchard

Sell your apples to earn money and improve your orchard. Expand your land and find new secrets. Who knows, maybe you'll make new friends along the way...

Retro graphics

Enjoy a trip down memory lane, with stylized 2D graphics, resembling old school titles. If you love pixel art games, you shouldn't hesitate to try out this charming game.

Chiptune music

You’ll hear a few catchy tunes to improve on your adventure. You can swap between tracks, whenever you go back into your room, for some much needed rest.

This bundle includes all six DLCs.

Key Features:
- Simple controls
- No invisible walls (only visible ones)
- Great replay value
- A pet rabbit
- various Christmas-themed items
- Stylized 2D graphics
- Incredible music track

70070000026488.name: Cook For Love Extended Edition
70070000026488.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000026488.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

Change the look of your kitchen with Powder Red Blender, Colorful Stove and Wooden Fridge DLCs included in this bundle.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000026489.name: Party Miracle Pack + Party Wonder Pack
70070000026489.intro: Power up Party Party Time 3 with 20 additional minigames!
70070000026489.description:
Get ready for a party filled with miracles and wonder!
The Party Miracle Pack and Party Wonder Pack pair are now available as a downloadable content bundle!

70070000026491.name: Party Party Time 3 + Wonderful Pack Set
70070000026491.intro:
It's time for a new and improved party time!
Compete or cooperate—there's no limit on the fun when everyone's together!
70070000026491.description:
Get ready for an all-new sequel to the party game that anyone can enjoy!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 6 players can join in the fun!

Enjoy a large collection of intuitive and easy-to-play minigames!
Spend quality time with friends and family and have a blast!

Party Party Time 3, the Party Miracle Pack, and the Party Wonder Pack are available together as part of a special set!
Let's party, everybody!

70070000026499.name: Hot&Hentai Extended Edition
70070000026499.intro: Step into the brand new version of the enchanting world of Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000026499.description:
Those captivating girls will invite you to take part in the most alluring puzzle experience available on Nintendo Switch™.


ANIME AS AN ART FORM
Immerse yourself in the beautiful anime-inspired art of Hentai Girls, where you'll get to know these stunning and intriguing women. Solve their puzzles to advance through their stories, all while enjoying their charming company.


CHALLENGING PROGRESSION
While the gameplay starts off simple, the challenges grow as you move forward. Stay focused – their enticing outfits might be distracting.

This bundle includes Gamer Etsuko and Garden Queen Shirayuki DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Stunning hand-drawn Hentai illustrations
- Soothing background music
- Easy-to-learn gameplay with increasing difficulty
- A unique and special concept

70070000026505.name: DROS Ultimate Edition
70070000026505.intro: Explore the Tower, meet its strange inhabitants, collect alchemical treasures, and discover twists around every corner.
70070000026505.description:
DROS is a dark fantasy adventure where you'll swap between a small gooey creature and her human bounty hunter shell. Explore freely through 40 unique diorama-like levels filled with strange characters, intricate puzzles, hidden rooms, and ancient collectibles.


STORY WITH A TWIST
When the Captain is hanging by a thread, destiny tosses a curveball – enter Dros. Different motives, same mission: stop the Alchemist! Dive into the Tower's labyrinthine mysteries and mingle with its quirky denizens. Hunt for alchemical treasures and brace yourself for a world that keeps you on your toes.

Chat with an array of oddball and endearing characters as you journey. Humans and Dros cohabitate in the Tower, a place where the line between good and evil is as wavy as a squiggly straw.


SWAP THE BODY RIGHT
Prepare to body swap! Wiggle, jiggle, and sneak around as the gooey Little Dros. Bust open hefty doors, press down pressure plates and clear the way as the robust Captain. But beware... each of the Tower's 40 levels has its own unique surprises!
Obstacles galore await you. Flex both brainpower and muscle to solve puzzles, fend off creepy creatures, piece together alchemical treasures, and uncover a tapestry of stories.

This bundle includes additional Gallery and Official Soundtrack DLCs, featuring illustrations of the magical world of DROS along with a music player in the game menu.

FEATURES:
- Exclusive version with subtitles and UI in English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese.
- Every nook and cranny of the Tower is meticulously designed.
- Unique soundtrack by electronic pioneer Arovane, seamlessly integrated into the world.
- Explore 40 levels each with unique puzzle mechanics, enemies, hidden rooms, and platforming.
- Play as two vastly different characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
- Amass Prima and gain new abilities.
- Narrative with humor and a bunch of heart.
- Collect diary entries to dive deeper into the story.
- Post-game challenges to keep the adventure going.
- Race through the game to uncover special secrets.

70070000026508.name: Eroblast: Playful Edition
70070000026508.intro: We found 21 Hot and Playful Anime Girls in your area
70070000026508.description:
You'll be able to chat with attractive girls, know their engaging storylines, receive spicy pictures, and solve Match-3 Puzzles to unlock new and cool pick-up lines for your waifu!

In this bundle you get content from the base game and Playful Pack which includes:
- 21 romanceable women to meet
- 120+ hot pics to unlock
- over 30 routes to go with each waifu, with between 5.000 to 10.000 words each
- 280 levels to beat
- 25+ hours of gameplay so get ready for flirting and pics!

Browse hot profiles and start a romance. Each girl you meet unveils a mix of storytelling, visuals and desires, from bishoujo women to anime klutz. Exchange intimate messages and flirty selfies, use cool pick-up lines and ask provocative questions - every choice you make will shape the outcome of your relationships.

Cannot take romance to another level? Solve puzzles and reach your true potential as a pick-up artist! With over 200 handcrafted levels and neat mechanics, expect addictive gameplay that goes far beyond basic blast puzzles. 

Uncover the interesting stories behind each waifu, unlock pictures, but be aware, some of these pictures are quite spicy so viewer discretion is advised ;)

70070000026510.name: Mixx Island: Remix Plus Retro Edition
70070000026510.intro: Mixx Island Remix Plus is a high-energy, action-packed shooter set in a fantastic 2D world. Gather your wits, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for the ultimate challenge.
70070000026510.description:
Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

With its vibrant graphics, pulse-pounding soundtrack, and intuitive controls, Mixx Island Remix is a game that's easy to pick up but hard to put down. 

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of side-scrolling games, you'll find plenty to love in this thrilling adventure.

In this bundle, in addition to the main game, you will get access to Mini Winter, Spring, Summer, Autumn Islands.
 
Key Features:

- 2D World
- High-action gameplay
- Rewarding gameplay loop
- Cute characters
- Astounding soundtrack
- Anime style aesthetic

70070000026515.name: Amelia's Garden Puzzle Collection
70070000026515.intro: Repair these pots and start a brand new rooftop garden!
70070000026515.description:
Turn this empty rooftop into your own green corner in the city. Glue together colorful pots, plant various seeds, and share your harvest with friends in Amelia’s Garden!


YOUR GARDEN IN A CITYSCAPE
There’s this old stairway in your building that leads to the rooftop. Not knowing what’s up there means that an adventure, however brief, awaits. You climb upstairs and push the handle of the heavy door that stands in your way. On the other side…
A big garden space, complete with a little fountain, a table, and benches. This fine view and plenty of broken flower pots are all yours now. With a clean, a bit of glue, and plenty of patience this place can be brought back to life – are you ready to start your own rooftop garden?


LITTLE STEPS TOWARD A COLORFUL FUTURE
Together with Amelia, you’ll be restoring this old garden to glory! There are 20 broken pots to put together, each with a unique plant. You can expect to see beets, tomatoes, strawberries, basil, and many more spices, veggies, and fruit alike.

Every pot has a unique puzzle required to put it together. After this task is finished, you can fill it with dirt, plant seeds, water it, and let it grow. Before you know it, you’ll see the fruit of your labor - though it can be a veggie of your labor, too. You can also move the pots however much you like and even organize them based on color!


A COZY SPACE FOR YOU AND YOURS
Various folks like various plants - Amelia’s friends are like this as well. As the plants grow you can give them out to people and earn hearts. Each person has a unique set of likes and dislikes, so even if you don’t like strawberries I’m sure someone else would gladly take them in!

Ease yourself into watching the cityscape while gardening. Relaxing music, hand-drawn artstyle, and non-timed puzzles are here to bring some peace to your life. Even in a bustling city, there has to be a place where you can take a deep breath. Don’t be afraid to make one for yourself!

This bundle includes Behind The Scenes 1 and 2 DLCs.

70070000026521.name: My Cozy Room Ultimate Edition
70070000026521.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000026521.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2 DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 1 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000026526.name: Ultimate Holidays Building Edition
70070000026526.intro: Let’s start the Ultimate Holidays wherever you are!
70070000026526.description:
Just lay down and chill with the cozy vibe of the Ultimate Holidays sandbox game, where you can begin whenever you are with your beloved console and start creating your own special place as your ultimate holiday goal.


ENDLESS HOLIDAYS
Focus on a place that you're dreaming and use all your imagination to create this perfect spot. You have 90 different objects that you can use to build a sunny californian town or cheerful amusement park. Or maybe an empty beach to wind down. Skies have a limit, but there's a lot of it.

The sea, canions, lovely hills or just a exotic beach. Find your landscape and start this cozy journey through a sandbox chillout.


TAKE YOUR MEMORIES WITH YOU
Ultimate Holidays without ultimate memories? Hell no. You can go to camera mode and take beautiful photos of your creations in a postcard style. Choose from 15 different hand drawing stamps with cute and funny things. 

Decorate your postcards with Postcard Stickers Pack 1 DLC included in this bundle.

MAIN FEATURES:
- Camera mode with a postcard vibe
- Space as big as your imagination
- Sandbox game with cozy and chillout vibe
- Four different landscapes
- 90 different objects to build from

70070000026535.name: Season Pass Vol. 2
70070000026535.description:
