70070000026541.name: Ecchi Secrets: Steampunk Edition
70070000026541.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls
70070000026541.description:
Secrets lie beneath the covers... avoid enemies and uncover pictures of beautiful girls posing exclusively for you.

Discovering the truth is never easy... the more tempting the secrets, the greater the challenges you'll face. Unravel all the mysteries to uncover what the girls are hiding, and prepare yourself for plenty of alluring photos along the way.

Features:
- Over 30 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- 16 new pictures of flirtatious girls ready for a date
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes

70070000026542.name: EvoMon Deluxe Edition
70070000026542.intro: Take care of the little pet creatures, train them to become the ultimate fighters and become an EvoMon Champion!
70070000026542.description:
Here they are – EvoMons – extraordinary creatures. Prepare them to become true EvoMon Champions! Take care of their needs, feed and train them while watching how a tiny, vulnerable baby evolves into a fearless warrior. 


BE THE BEST TRAINER FOR YOUR LITTLE ONE
Feed your friend with a variety of treats, keep it clean, and provide the necessary care tools from the store. Make sure all needs are taken care of because otherwise, your precious creature will stop growing and you will look after a baby forever. 

Train your EvoMon in a variety of 9 engaging minigames, earn experience points, and watch it evolve. After all, you have up to three different stages of all 49 to discover!


READY FOR A BATTLE?
Take your strong adult EvoMon into the Final Battles, where you will face the EvoMons of other trainers. Don't worry, if you fail to defeat them at once. Experience gained will come in handy the next time you test your strength. Who knows, maybe you'll leave the arena with the title of the new EvoMon Champion? 


OR MAYBE, IT'S TIME FOR AN ADVENTURE?
Embark on extraordinary adventures in the mysterious Expedition Zone! Discover unique EvoMons and acquire exclusive items only available there, that you can use in your EvoMon Lab.

And speaking of the lab. Each time you lose an EvoMon in battle, you can revive the old one or "freeze it". Combine two EvoMons to create an egg, with an unusual, brand-new EvoMon ready for training.


POSSIBILITIES AS NUMEROUS AS THE EVOMONS THEMSELVES
If you just need money, head to the fishing area to catch unique fishing items and fishes that you can use as food or sell.

You can even get new furniture from the gacha machine and decorate the EvoMon room according to your taste!

This bundle includes Themes DLC with amazing new colors. 

MAIN FEATURES:
- Taking care of small EvoMons in the style of classic pet digital toys from the 90s, followed by demanding training,
- 49 different EvoMons to collect with 3 evolutions each –  which brings the total to 149 evolutional stages!
- Training Area with 9 minigames to train your pets and earn Evocoins,
- Fierce battles with EvoMons of other trainers with the opportunity to win the title of EvoMon Champion! 
- A lab ready to store your frozen EvoMons, revive them, or combine a completely different and new types,
- Expedition Area with 3 different missions, each containing 1 exclusive minigame and a special item that releases a new - EvoMon in the laboratory,
- Fishing Area with various fish and special items to be explored,
- Decorating your EvoMon room with various furniture,
- Pixelated style,
- 8-bit soundtrack.

70070000026546.name: Purrfect Collection
70070000026546.intro: True Purrfection lays in roundness... of the cat! Purrfect collection is here with Fit My Cat, Neko Bento, Bomb Cat, and Magic Cats Pots
70070000026546.description:
Cat lovers, game lovers, and cat game lovers rejoice! Here is a bundle with four different casual games that will furry-up your evenings in four different ways.

Fit My Cat, where a few mischievous cats absolutely have to fit in one box. Pick them up, rotate them, move them around and lock them in to give them the most comfortable experience in their little cardboard apartment.

Bomb Cat - but these cats have claws! Stick all of them into one box to win this bombastic 2048 match game. During your comfy playthrough watch out for the titular bomb-cat - he might send your kitties into the orbit (and definitely out of the box).

Magic Cats Pots is about running an antique shop and gluing together broken plates, cups, and everything else that could fall off a table. This is a puzzle experience with various difficulty levels - from casual to hardcore!

Neko Bento is where all the tasty treats are! Help this kitty chef make all the bento boxes and fit the demanded ingredients inside. It's a tasty cooking adventure that might make your tummy rumble just a little...

And now that all four of these have joined together to form a bundle - we hope you'll enjoy this Purrfect Collection! 

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 300 different puzzle levels combined.
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- Relaxing or challenging - whatever floats your boat!
- Meowtastic soundtrack.

70070000026547.name: Tell Me Your Story Games Collection
70070000026547.intro: Cook For Love, Amelia’s Garden, and titular Tell Me Your Story are here to accompany you during rainy days.
70070000026547.description:
Tell Me Your Story Games Collection has all the games that take place in the universe of our beloved TMYS. Cook For Love, Amelia’s Garden, and titular Tell Me Your Story are here to accompany you during rainy days

With all three games finally released we can finally welcome you to Tell Me Your Story’s universe proper! With this collection you will be able to continue your adventure through time with no breaks needed!

Tell Me Your Story is a hand-drawn puzzle game where grandma-granddaughter duo Rose and Amelia find an old album. Through it they will relive Rose’s life and puzzle together her adventures in Yunnan, the Amazon Rainforest, and onboard the Orient Express.

Cook For Love is where Clement, an amateur cook, becomes the sole chef at a restaurant in Paris. Together with him, you’ll cook up homely dishes and revive the restaurant’s popularity based on the cookbook of a world-class chef!

Amelia’s Garden happens after Tell Me Your Story, when Amelia discovers an old garden on the rooftop of the building she lives in. Here, you’ll be helping her glue together pots, plant fruits and veggies, and give them away to her friends.

All three of those adventures are now available in one, cozy bundle. Are you ready to puzzle-up your life?

KEY FEATURES:
- Many puzzles to solve and dishes to cook.
- Heartwarming stories about family, friendships, and community.
- Corgi dog - Peanut - featured!
- Minimalistic, hand-drawn art style.
- Relaxing OST.

70070000026548.name: Learn & Play Collection
70070000026548.intro: The educational Learn & Play Collection combines good fun and creativity no matter the age! The Treflik Family, The Smurfs, and Uzzuzzu are ready for a new adventure.
70070000026548.description:
Who said that learning has to be boring? We’re combining a few of our most creative and educational titles for all ages to make Learn & Play Collection.

The Treflik Family is a coloring game combined with an episodic series focused on friendship, honesty, respect, and tolerance. The episodes have scenes which you can color in your own way!

The Smurfs: Colorful Stories feature the most well-known characters from the series and colorful ways to reimagine them. You can also make your own stories!

The Smurfs: Learn and Play is a collection of educational games. Learning how to write numbers, reading a clock, and finding specific objects in a busy environment is more fun with these blue friends.

Uzzuzzu My Pet is the tale of a group of crazy animal friends and their adventures. Here, you can watch their antics and color the funny situations they find themselves in.

This learning journey is guaranteed to be fun and colorful!

KEY FEATURES:
- Many drawing categories to choose from.
- Tool variations and textures aplenty.
- Creating personal stories and learn the basics!
- Cartooney soundtrack.

70070000026549.name: Battlefront Trench Warriors: Ops of Warfare & Trench Shooter : Warfare Tactics Bundle Collection
70070000026549.intro: From Trenches to Triumph—Your Battle, Your Legacy!
70070000026549.description:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate trench warfare experience, combining tactical challenges, intense combat, and immersive environments.

Step into the unforgiving trenches, navigate through intricate underground chambers, and engage in high-stakes battles that test your strategy and combat prowess. Whether you’re conquering historically authentic war zones or traversing dangerous battlefields filled with relentless enemies, every mission is a fight for survival and victory.

Key Features:

- Authentic Environments: Experience the gritty realism of trench warfare and dynamic battlegrounds, from fortified bunkers to war-torn streets.

- Diverse Weaponry & Upgrades: Arm yourself with a vast selection of firearms, grenades, and advanced military technology. Upgrade your arsenal to gain an edge in battle.


- Challenging Missions: Take on missions that demand strategic planning, quick reflexes, and adaptability. Navigate obstacles, eliminate enemies, and achieve unique objectives.

- Tactical Combat: Analyze enemy patterns, plan your weapon loadout, and use cover and movement to outsmart opponents. Precision and flexibility are key to survival.


- Progressive Difficulty: Face tougher enemies and increasingly complex objectives as you advance, ensuring each mission pushes your skills to the limit.

- Immersive Gameplay: Top-tier graphics, realistic sound effects, and detailed environments bring the chaos and intensity of war to life.

Prepare to overcome relentless challenges and prove your valor on the battlefield. Will you emerge victorious as a master of trench warfare? The fight awaits!

70070000026551.name: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000026551.intro: Unleash the power of the SHINOBI
70070000026551.description:
Purchase the SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition and receive the Starter Pack, Digital Art Book & Soundtrack, and SEGA Villains Stage, featuring Dr. Eggman and two additional bosses based on iconic SEGA villains.
 
It includes:
• Base Game
• Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o Starter Pack: the Ghost Outfit, the Medic Lite Amulet, and 2000 Gold
o SEGA Villains Stage (Coming Early 2026)
o Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
*Gold is collected during gameplay and cannot be purchased separately.

The iconic SHINOBI returns in an all-new 2D action platformer with a unique hand-drawn look created by the team behind the hit brawler Streets of Rage 4.   

Play as the legendary Shinobi Joe Musashi, master of the ninja arts. After finding your village burned to the ground and your clan turned into stone, you must set off on a quest for vengeance, ready to face an unparalleled evil and avenge your clan.  

• EXECUTE THE NINJA ARTS WITH PRECISION 
Wield your vast ninja arsenal including the great Katana Oborozuki, Kunai, Ninjutsu arts, and Ninpo to vanquish your foes.  

• MASTER THE WAY OF THE SHINOBI 
Unleash limitless combos with unique combat moves, acquire Amulets for enhanced abilities, and discover Ningi tools to overcome obstacles and uncover new paths. 

• JOURNEY THROUGH A STYLISTIC NEW WORLD 
Venture through more than a dozen unique and visually striking stages, from military bases to a scorching desert, challenging platforming puzzles, and hidden secrets.

70070000026556.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Stone Edition
70070000026556.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000026556.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS A LEGENDARY BOXER
Receive the legendary Jax Stone with his unique equipment and a bonus of 21500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000026558.name: Mars Survivor: Explosive Edition
70070000026558.intro: Conquer Mars, fend off alien threats, and secure your path to survival!
70070000026558.description:
After an asteroid catastrophe, your rocket ship crash-lands in the wilderness of Mars. Explore the planet's mysteries, strategize your escape, and build a shelter to protect yourself!

Features:
- Get a premium supply crate with a set of hellas armor, a gemini blaster and lots of scraps, and materials!
- Use additional 500 gems
- Navigate Mars's challenges
- Explore the planet's secrets and discover hidden materials 
- Build a shelter and protect yourself from the harsh Martian environment!
- Defend against alien invasions and uncover secrets of the creatures of Mars!
- Gather oxygen and essential materials from old rocket ships to survive
- Strategize your escape mission and secure your passage back to Earth!
- Open epic loot boxes to swap or upgrade your gear

Go on dangerous expeditions to gather intel and resources. Fight off hordes of alien creatures, and save other survivors. Use their skills and knowledge to defend your base from a huge enemy attack!

Become the last man standing on Mars, navigate through the wilderness, and prove your survival skills!

70070000026560.name: Bullet Hell Action Roguelites
70070000026560.description:
This bundle includes 2 Bullet Hell Action Roguelites: Genome Guardian and Keeper's Toll. There is over 100 hours of content between the two games!

**Genome Guardian**
COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic turret shooter roguelite with macroscopic depth. Survive 6 modes using an astounding array of turrets, perks, mutations and power-ups on this psychedelic journey to the heart of the abyss.

**Keeper's Toll**
Delve into an action-packed roguelite brimming with challenge and despair. Survive against an onslaught of relentless hordes and grueling bosses with skill-based ARPG gameplay. Embrace the darkness and cleanse these cursed lands.

70070000026561.name: Vertical Blast Vol. 1
70070000026561.intro: Dive into the thrilling universe of arcade shoot 'em ups with Vertical Blast Vol.1, an exclusive bundle by TOMAGameStudio!
70070000026561.description:
Experience fast-paced and intense action with:

Hexapoda: After a nuclear apocalypse, defend our planet from giant insects in this retro pixel-art shoot 'em up. Immerse yourself in unique visuals and an epic electro soundtrack!

I Got Isekai'd into a Shmup: Experience the unique adventure of an isekai inside a pixel-art shoot 'em up where you can choose one of 4 ships, each piloted by a character with their own personality and dialogues. Navigate through perilous levels, accompanied by the virtuoso melodies of a metal instrumental soundtrack!

70070000026566.name: Ultimate Holidays Cozy Edition
70070000026566.intro: Let’s start the Ultimate Holidays wherever you are!
70070000026566.description:
Just lay down and chill with the cozy vibe of the Ultimate Holidays sandbox game, where you can begin whenever you are with your beloved console and start creating your own special place as your ultimate holiday goal.


ENDLESS HOLIDAYS
Focus on a place that you're dreaming and use all your imagination to create this perfect spot. You have 90 different objects that you can use to build a sunny californian town or cheerful amusement park. Or maybe an empty beach to wind down. Skies have a limit, but there's a lot of it.

The sea, canions, lovely hills or just a exotic beach. Find your landscape and start this cozy journey through a sandbox chillout.


TAKE YOUR MEMORIES WITH YOU
Ultimate Holidays without ultimate memories? Hell no. You can go to camera mode and take beautiful photos of your creations in a postcard style. Choose from 15 different hand drawing stamps with cute and funny things. 

Decorate your postcards with Postcard Stickers Pack 1 and 2 DLCs included in this bundle.

MAIN FEATURES:
- Camera mode with a postcard vibe
- Space as big as your imagination
- Sandbox game with cozy and chillout vibe
- Four different landscapes
- 90 different objects to build from

70070000026571.name: One Night: Burlesque Classic Edition
70070000026571.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.
70070000026571.description:
One Night: Burlesque offers one of a kind visual novel story with puzzle elements. Become a detective and solve the case of an upcoming murder mystery. Your hidden talent gives you an advantage over the killer so use it wise.


SPECIAL GIFT
Get into the high heels of Holly, a talented dancer graced with a unique gift of telepathy.
Delve into the minds of those around her and try to solve this captivating noir mystery. Uncover their hidden motives and unveil the truth. Be cautious; every mind holds secrets, and not all are willing to share them right away.


WHO IS THE KILLER?
The wannabe murderer might not be a butler, but he's certainly in the audience. Navigate a labyrinth of tangled relationships and peel back the layers of deceit. The clock is ticking ominously, and every choice you make might decide the fate of your friends.

With this bundle, you can learn about the creation stories of characters with Holly, Liz, Suspects, Club Crowd and People Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- A noir aesthetic
- A detective-style murder mystery
- A unique setting (a Burlesque Club)
- Multiple endings depending on your choices
- An Incredible music track
- A charming telepathic dancer

70070000026572.name: One Night: Burlesque Deluxe Collection
70070000026572.intro: Step into the smoky, seductive world of the Angels Den, a luxurious burlesque club. Help her on a desperate mission to save a friend from certain doom.

70070000026583.name: Pick My Heart Chapter 2 School Days
70070000026583.intro: Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends.
70070000026583.description:
Heartfelt Connections
Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends. This anime-inspired visual novel unfolds in a vibrant modern world where myth and reality blend, leading to humorous, heartfelt, and sometimes challenging moments.


Moments of Magic
In Chapter 2, Sota deepens his bonds with various characters, each carrying unique secrets and personalities. Whether it's Aphrodite, Hera, Athena, or Eris, Sota finds himself navigating through surprises, emotional revelations, and intense encounters that test his loyalty and affection.


Trials of Affection
Each goddess brings a new perspective to Sota’s life. Whether meeting at a cozy karaoke club or exploring a quiet, romantic setting, Sota’s choices shape his journey, and each encounter brings him closer to understanding the complexities of love.

This bundle includes Ichika's, Kaito's and School's Secrets DLCs.

Key Features:
- A modern love story with a touch of mythology
- Choices that matter and shape the story
- Four beautiful Greek goddesses, each with their own story and mystery
- A vibrant blend of modern life and ancient myth as gods and mortals co-exist
- Many unique locations and events, such as a date at a karaoke club
- The complex divine-earthly trials of love

70070000026588.intro: Pick My Heart: Chapter 2 continues the romantic adventures of Sota and his encounters with goddesses and mortal friends.
70070000026588.description:

70070000026595.name: FRAG Pro Shooter: Ultimate Arena Edition
70070000026595.intro: EMBRACE THE ULTIMATE EXPERIENCE OF FRAG PRO SHOOTER
70070000026595.description:
Get access to the ultimate experience of FRAG Pro Shooter with the Ultimate Arena Edition!

Dominate the arenas, win epic battles, and climb to the top with this ultimate edition, featuring exclusive characters for every Arena rank. 70070000026603.name: The Jackbox Party Trilogy
70070000026603.intro: Game night is saved with The Jackbox Party Trilogy, including the first three Jackbox Party Packs. Get creative in Drawful, crack jokes in Quiplash, and survive deadly trivia in Trivia Murder Party
70070000026603.description:
Great news! The greatest collections of party games have been bundled into one gigantic deal! For one great price, The Jackbox Party Trilogy gets you each of The Jackbox Party Packs, which are sure to turn your next party or family gathering into a real giggle-fest.

You don’t need a bunch of controllers to join the fun. All of our games are played using any internet-connected devices, like phones, tablets or laptops, as controllers! The only things your guests need are a device and a sense of humor! Unfortunately, they can’t buy the latter.

From The Jackbox Party Pack:

With all these games, you’re going to need a lot more parties and a lot more friends!

70070000026604.name: The Jackbox Party Trilogy 2.0
70070000026604.intro: Keep the party going with hilarious games from Party Packs 4, 5, & 6! Craft lies in Fibbage 3, invent outrageous items in Patently Stupid, & escape deadly trivia in Trivia Murder Party 2.

70070000026605.name: The Jackbox Party Trilogy 3.0
70070000026605.intro: Write, draw, and laugh your way to victory with all 15 games from The Jackbox Party Packs 7, 8 & 9.
70070000026605.description:
What is The Jackbox Party Trilogy 3.0?

The Jackbox Party Trilogy 3.0 is a collection of the 15 hit games from The Jackbox Party Packs 7, 8 and 9. Draw your heart out with Drawful Animate, crack your friends up with a game of Quiplash 3, or bluff your way to victory with Fibbage 4. No matter which game you choose, family-friendly options and audience play-along for up to 10,000 people guarantee that just about anyone can play along.

Which games are included?

The Jackbox Party Trilogy 3.0 contains all of the hit games from The Jackbox Party Pack 7 (Quiplash 3, The Devils and the Details, Champ’d Up, Talking Points, Blather Round), The Jackbox Party Pack 8 (Job Job, Weapons Drawn, The Wheel of Enormous Proportions, Drawful Animate, The Poll Mine), and The Jackbox Party Pack 9 (Fibbage 4, Quixort, Junktopia, Nonsensory, Roomerang).


Settings + Features

It’s easy to play Jackbox games: your phone is your controller, so all you have to do is fire up a game and go! The Jackbox Party Trilogy 3.0 also boasts new moderation tools and audience play-along for up to 10,000 people, which means that you can enjoy safe, secure play with as many friends or family as you want. Games in The Jackbox Party Pack 9 are even localized in French, Italian, German, Castilian Spanish, and Latin American Spanish, which means that everyone can join the party - not just English speakers.

Review quotes 

“It doesn’t matter if you’ve never played the games before or if your artistic ability is basically zero, Jackbox Party Pack 7 is sure to bring a lot of joy into your home.”
90/100 – COGconnected

“[The Jackbox Party Pack 8]  is a solid entry in the Jackbox series, with multiple games that can keep everyone entertained for several hours, no matter their gaming preferences.”
WIRED

“Jackbox Party Pack 9 is a blast.”
9/10 – PC Invasion

70070000026619.name: Spy Guy Roma Edition
70070000026619.intro: Go on a journey to Ancient Rome with Spy Guy!
70070000026619.description: Meet Julius Caesar, find a calendar card on March 17, attend a Roman feast, or get a sneak peek at Leonardo da Vinci painting the Mona Lisa. Spy Guy Roma is another installment of the Spy Guy Hidden Objects game-this time the map of Ancient Rome will thrill you with 120 levels full of fascinating ancient hidden objects.

70070000026630.name: Neckbreak Deluxe Edition
70070000026630.intro: Fight your way out in this dirty retro-styled tactical FPS.
70070000026630.description:
Find yourself in a future city full of gangs, mafias, and other shady people. Become a vigilante who works during the day, and gets into a killing frenzy at night. Hop in the car, select a destination, and explore every corner of Crimson Tide.

If you want to feel an adrenaline rush, you can explore the city on foot but watch your back and don’t ask too many questions.


EVERYTHING CAN BE A WEAPON!
Search your surroundings for anything that looks deadly and use it to protect yourself. Throw bottles, knives, or even guns at the enemies. 

Nothing around you? 

Take some pills and breach doors to stun opponents, or just disarm them by kicking their faces. They will be pleased to drop a weapon for you then. You should definitely find and lick a frog – you will love it.


PLAN YOUR ATTACK
It’s your decision how to enter combat and how to end it. Find your first victim, and go with the flow. Try every possibility and find the best way to get the highest score. 

Kick an enemy while sliding to pick his weapon mid-air and land a headshot to defeat him. Creativity is the key to success. 


CREATE YOUR OWN STORY
There are 12 available endings waiting for you to be discovered. Each one takes around 4 hours for hardcore players to complete. The path you choose will never be completely the same next time. Also, check and search for collectibles that are hidden all over the city. 

This bundle includes Extra Stage DLC with new location and duels.

KEY FEATURES:
- 4 difficulty levels
- Multiple possibilities of approach
- Aim assist – if you need a little help
- Retro-styled graphics
- Entertaining soundtrack to keep combat exciting
- Your own apartment with a retro console full of mini-games

70070000026636.name: Darts Fever Premium Edition
70070000026636.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000026636.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game and Stylish Precision #2 with:

5 brand-new dart designs

70070000026656.intro: In addition to The Battle of Polytopia the game, the Deluxe bundle includes the Aquarion, Elyrion, Polaris and Cymanti Tribes
70070000026656.description: Includes 11 items: The Battle of Polytopia,  Aquarion Tribe, Elyrion Tribe, Polaris Tribe,  Cymanti Tribe, Aquarion Skin, Elyrion Skin, and Skin Packs 1-4

70070000026657.name: The Battle of Polytopia - All Special Tribes
70070000026657.intro: Upgrade your standard edition of The Battle of Polytopia to the Deluxe edition with this bundle.
70070000026657.description: The Battle of Polytopia - Deluxe Upgrade includes the Aquarion, Elyrion, Cymanti, and Polaris Tribe DLCs, Skin Pack 1-4 and the Aquarion Forgotten and Elyrion Midnight Skins.

70070000026658.name: Giant Rush: Brave Edition
70070000026658.intro: Rush into a battle of giants!
70070000026658.description:
Run and collect stickmen of your color to grow bigger and more powerful! Outsmart traps, avoid danger, and smash everything in your path. The bigger you grow, the more unstoppable you become!

Features:

- a new premium Jumping Uppercut animation!
- 500 free stickmen for your city
- 2500 extra gems to grow your character
- Collect stickmen of your color to grow larger and more powerful!
- Grow stronger and defeat huge giants in intense fights!
- Upgrade your town to earn passive income
- Fight through a series of enemies in survival mode and show your skills!
- Choose battle upgrades like extra health, a chance to dodge, critical hits, and more!
- Unlock awesome outfits and accessories to customize your character
- Buy new and epic finishing animations!

Face giant bosses in epic battles. Dodge their powerful attacks, strike back, and defeat them! Show your strength as you take down the biggest giants and prove you’re the best!

Unlock amazing rewards as you play. Upgrade your town to earn more money, customize your character with cool accessories, and unlock epic finishing animations!

Your decisions will make the difference between victory and defeat!

70070000026661.name: THE EXIT: LIMINAL ANOMALY HORROR DELUXE EDITION
70070000026661.description: Experience the ultimate horror with The Exit: Liminal Anomaly Horror Deluxe Edition. This deluxe edition includes the base game along with two spine-chilling DLCs: the Music Pack and the New Anomaly Pack. Immerse yourself in the haunting soundtracks that intensify the atmosphere and navigate through terrifying new anomalies that twist reality in unexpected ways. With these additions, the tension is even higher, the fear more palpable, and the mysteries deeper. Uncover every dark corner, face new horrors, and discover the truth in this expanded, immersive experience. Are you ready to survive the madness?

70070000026668.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Volume 7
70070000026668.description:
Dive into breathtaking adventures on three of the greatest Williams™ classics for a discounted price! Enjoy SWORDS OF FURY™, THE MACHINE™: BRIDE OF PIN·BOT™, and WHIRLWIND in their original form or as remastered tables with amazing visual upgrades.

SWORDS OF FURY: Unleash the fury of this 1988 solid state classic! Join the legendary Lion Man and prove your might! All in a world of sword and sorcery full of heroes, villains, and mythical monsters.

THE MACHINE: BRIDE OF PIN·BOT: Here comes the Bride! Awaken the Machine by activating her vocal circuits and eyes. Or go even further and bring her to life! A legendary table from the PIN-BOT trilogy.

WHIRLWIND: Storm Alert! Blow away the highest scores while battling the elements and capturing the wonders of our powerful nature.

70070000026669.name: Treflix: Mini Games Premium Bundle
70070000026669.intro: Great Bundle with games and comic book from Treflix World!
70070000026669.description:
Set of 5 Mini Games and Comic Book! 

Solve puzzles, find diffrences, check your brain with memory and connect dots!

Find out what happened to Treflixy and Spy Guy during a walk on the beach in a charming comic book that will get you better acquainted with your favorite characters.

70070000026679.intro: Step into the paws of a brave cat, navigating a perilous world to help kittens in need.
70070000026679.description:

• Search abandoned warehouses for food and rescue lost kittens.
• Avoid obstacles and complete timed objectives.
• Play through 20 challenging levels.
• Compete in two-player split-screen mode.

Embark on an adventure as a brave cat, exploring abandoned warehouses to find food and rescue lost kittens. Navigate tricky obstacles and beat the clock to complete challenging objectives. Compete with friends in a thrilling two-player split-screen mode for even more fun and excitement!

70070000026683.name: Coloring Book: Cute Edition - 150 drawings
70070000026683.intro:
Create the most impressive coloring book, alone or together (up to 4 artists) !

● “Ocean Animals” with 30 pictures of aquatic life and their underwater habitats
● “Farm Life” with 30 pictures of countryside animals and their daily activities
● "Silly Animals" with 30 pictures of clumsy and funny wildlife animals
● "Sweet Princesses" with 30 pictures of beautiful princesses ready to be colored
● "Cosmos Fun" with 30 pictures of space adventures

70070000026686.name: TMNT: Splintered Fate + DLC Bundle
70070000026686.intro: Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan!
70070000026686.description:
When Splinter is kidnapped by Shredder, mysterious portals simultaneously appear across NYC. With April and Metalhead analysing recovered artifacts for clues, the Turtles battle to recover their father from the clutches of the Foot Clan. However, as the gang gets ever closer to Splinter’s otherworldly location, an even greater threat lingers in the shadows…

In Splintered Fate, brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomised power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

With thrilling combat and endless challenges, Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

70070000026688.name: Discolored Bundle
70070000026688.intro: All the colors have gone missing and it's up to you to bring them back.
70070000026688.description:
The Discolored Bundle includes the first-person puzzle adventure games Discolored and Discolored 2. 

In Discolored all the colors have gone missing and it's up to you to bring them back. In the first Discolored you explore a lonely roadside diner where strange and surreal events occur. Solve inventive puzzles and try to unravel the mystery of how to bring all the colors back to the world.

Discolored 2 picks up right where the first one left off as you continue your mission to restore the missing colors, but now you discover you are being pursued by a shadowy organization that wants to stop you and steal the colors for their own sinister purposes. Your only hope is a woman in red who may be holding the key to preventing the world from becoming discolored.

70070000026693.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Elite Edition
70070000026693.intro: Tasty burgers? We've got you covered!
70070000026693.description:
Like going in to town for a bite to eat? Everybody does! 

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side? 
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, french fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats! 

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up! 

Upgrade your restaurant and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger joint in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat

70070000026694.name: Escape Room Ultimate Duo
70070000026694.intro:
Two escape rooms developed by mc2games are included! 
Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room and Mystic Academy: Escape Room.
70070000026694.description:
This bundle includes two escape room games:

*Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
*Mystic Academy: Escape Room

PYRAMIDS AND ALIENS: ESCAPE ROOM
Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid to find your missing mentor. As an intrepid explorer, solve puzzles, investigate clues, and unravel the pyramid's secrets. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?

70070000026695.name: Escape Room Ultimate Trilogy
70070000026695.intro:
Three escape rooms developed by mc2games are included!

70070000026695.description:

*Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room

PYRAMIDS AND ALIENS: ESCAPE ROOM

BETWEEN TIME: ESCAPE ROOM
You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you must travel through time, explore mysterious places, and solve puzzles to obtain untold treasures. Will you come back alive?

70070000026697.name: River City Girls 2 + Double Dragon DLC Bundle
70070000026697.intro: It's a one-two punch: River City Girls 2 plus add-on heroes Billy & Jimmy Lee!
70070000026697.description:
This bundle includes the following:
River City Girls 2 (full game)
River City Girls 2: Double Dragon DLC (add-on content)

About River City Girls 2:
The River City Girls are ready for round 2! When an old foe returns for revenge, Misako, Kyoko, Kunio, and Riki - joined by newcomers Marian and Provie - hit the streets for an all-new beat-'em-up adventure packed with new abilities, enemies, allies, locations, and more! Team up for local or online co-op, then pound punks into the dirt with brand-new guard-crush attacks, lift-off combos, elemental status effects, and other knuckle-busting techniques! Level-up to earn new moves, buy items and accessories in more than 40 shops, and recruit defeated foes and hired heavies to help you on your way! River City is bigger than ever, offering more areas to explore, more objects to destroy, and a day-night cycle! With nonlinear gameplay, character-specific VO, and another epic soundtrack by Megan McDuffee, River City Girls 2 will keep you brawling until all your enemies yell "BARF!"

Key Features:
• Six playable characters, each with their own fighting styles and upgradable move sets!
• Enhanced combat: guard crushes, lift-off combos, elemental attacks, and more!
• River City is bigger than ever! New locations with multiple routes and secret areas!
• Play solo or team up with a friend, locally or online
• New "hired heavies" aid you in battle! Have two recruits at once!
• Loads of NPCs to meet, interact with, and punch in the face - including surprise cameos!
• Awesome anime intro, comic book cutscenes, English and Japanese voiceovers, and a spectacular soundtrack featuring RCG1 composer Megan McDuffee!

About River City Girls 2: Double Dragon DLC:
LET'S GO, BROS! The legendary Double Dragons, Billy and Jimmy Lee, are busting out of their dojos and joining River City Girls 2 as playable characters! These twin brothers jump into battle as distinctive fighters, ready to throw down with bone-shattering punches, kicks, slams, and special attacks - including trademark moves such as the Hurricane Kick and Rising Knee! The bros are fully integrated into River City Girls 2's story mode, complete with full voice overs, plus this premium DLC also adds an epic new vocal song and a new dojo master!

Contents:
• Playable Billy Lee
• Playable Jimmy Lee
• Full story integration with new voiceovers by Dan Avidan (Billy) and Arin Hanson (Jimmy)
• New vocal song performed by Hanson and Avidan with music by RCG series composer Megan McDuffee
• New dojo master Boro

70070000026698.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.11
70070000026698.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the eleventh additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000026703.name: Tank vs Tank Deluxe Edition
70070000026703.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000026703.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?

This bundle includes base game, "War Paint #1" and "War Paint #2", with:

-8 unique tank skins and 8 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000026712.name: Snooker Fever Extended Edition
70070000026712.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000026712.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #1 with:

five stunning new table designs

70070000026713.name: Urban Flow Full Edition
70070000026713.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000026713.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Winter Expansion Pack, London Rules, Streets Supplement #1 and Streets Supplement #2 with:

•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    50 new stages!
•    Winter theme and new music!
•    12 new vehicles

70070000026714.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Legendary Edition
70070000026714.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000026714.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan. 

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.
* Easy to play and hard to master.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Endless Mode with:

* 40 new levels
* endless gameplay mode

70070000026721.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Full Edition
70070000026721.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Weaponry Upgrade, Elite Arsenal, Target Acquired and Neon Strike with:

- With the Expansion Pack you can fight and survive the zombie apocalypse in a brand new game mode!
- Play new maps or revisit old ones with new weapons.
-PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm 
-FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation

-SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
-SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology
-SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
-UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
-SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.

70070000026722.name: Breakfast Bar Tycoon Definitive Edition
70070000026722.intro:
It's almost time for breakfast!
Go and prove that your breakfast bar deserves its fame!
70070000026722.description:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen? 

In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task! 

You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.

Take orders, prepare dishes and fight for tips! 

Invest your earnings into upgrading your restaurant and become a breakfast magnate!

Bon appetite!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Endless Mode and Multiplayer Mode with:

70070000026723.name: Sprout Valley Friends Forever Expansion

Start a new journey and see how this is more than just a farming game.

ADORABLE CAT
Help cute cat Niko escape from the big city and settle with him on the Ostara archipelago. Just choose an island and start your new life! His knowledge and passion for nature will let you turn this island into the most stunning place on Earth. 

GAME ECONOMY
Your garden will produce many products you can sell and earn money. Remember to order unnecessary seeds, saplings and equipment to make your garden grow even bigger. Manage space on your island and pick the best place for your crops. Don’t forget to water them every day!

VARIOUS ACTIVITIES
It’s your choice what to do. Developing your skills by farming, mining, foraging, crafting, fishing will let you unlock new recipes and abilities. Make sure to unlock all of them and explore all possibilities in the game.

This bundle includes a total of 8 DLCs: Lovely, Easter, Cows, Summer, Nico's Skins, New Friend: Momo, Spray Paint, and the largest expansion ever created for Sprout Valley – Friends Forever.

- More than 20 hours of amazing gameplay
- Outfit customization
- Your own pets!

- Lovely music track

70070000026736.name: Love Colors & Calm Colors
70070000026736.intro: Two relaxing art experiences in one bundle! Color, create, and have fun—solo or with friends!
70070000026736.description:
Enjoy hours of colorful fun with Love Colors & Calm Colors! This special bundle brings two creative and relaxing games that let you express yourself through art. Whether you love painting by numbers or placing beautiful shapes to complete stunning pictures, there's something for everyone—kids and adults alike!

Love Colors – A pixel-perfect paint-by-numbers game where coloring is easy and fun! Choose from over 150 images across 10 exciting themes, including cute animals, yummy food, and even mythical creatures. Play alone to relax or invite up to 3 friends for a fun multiplayer coloring session on the big screen! The more you color, the more amazing your creations become!

Calm Colors – A peaceful and enjoyable experience where you place colorful shapes to reveal stunning low-poly illustrations. From adorable animals to breathtaking landscapes, there are 200 pictures to complete! Take your time, play at your own pace, and enjoy the soothing gameplay. Want to share the fun? Join up to 3 friends in local co-op mode and create together!

With two creative games in one bundle, you can relax, explore your imagination, and enjoy hours of artistic fun—alone or with friends!

70070000026737.name: Tiny Lands & Not Not - A Brain Buster
70070000026737.intro: Train your brain, spot the differences, and test your reflexes—solo or with friends!
70070000026737.description:
Get ready for a fun and brain-teasing adventure with Tiny Lands & Not Not - A Brain Buster! This bundle brings you two engaging puzzle games that challenge your observation, logic, and reaction speed in creative and exciting ways.

Tiny Lands – A relaxing twist on classic "Find the Differences" games! Explore beautifully crafted 3D environments where you can zoom, rotate, and interact with scenes to spot every hidden change. Enjoy peaceful landscapes, dynamic weather effects, and calming sounds—without time limits or penalties. It's the perfect game to sit back, relax, and play at your own pace.

Not Not - A Brain Buster – A fast-paced logic challenge that will put your brain to the test! Follow tricky instructions and swipe in the right direction—but be careful, things get harder with every level! Play solo in Classic or Challenge mode, or compete with a friend in Multiplayer Versus mode for the ultimate brain workout.

Think fast, focus hard, and enjoy two clever puzzle experiences in one bundle!

70070000026739.name: Johnny Ostad's Collection Bundle
70070000026739.intro: A collection of Action & Adventure RPG games made by Johnny Ostad. Released between 2019-2024.
70070000026739.description:
SHALNOR LEGENDS: SACRED LANDS
On a quest to prove herself to the goddess Illeria and becoming her champion, the young Elf Rynna has ventured into the Sacred Lands. This beautiful yet treacherous place can only be left by finishing the trial designed by the goddess herself.

VOSARIA: LAIR OF THE FORGOTTEN
A pump-action 2D side-scrolling game with different enemy types. along with a jump-to-the-roof mechanic that spices up the combat.
Avoid traps, survive enemy encounters and upgrade your weapons and gear to overcome the challenges.

DUNGEONS OF SHALNOR
A tactical Turn-based Roguelike game. Featuring a “Turn the Camera” mechanic that leads to expected and unexpected outcomes.

SHALNOR LEGENDS 2: TRIALS OF THUNDER
A Story-Rich RPG/Action-Adventure game. Step into the shoes of the young Orc Mogren and explore all of Thunder Island.

70070000026741.name: Bowling Fever Value Edition
70070000026741.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000026741.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

70070000026750.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

-2 new skins for each Buggy

Dive into the ultimate prison simulation with the Prison Life Simulator Jail and the immersive Prison Life Simulator Jail - Gangster Escape Games Scary Architect Battle: Renovation Pack. Experience life behind bars like never before with intense gameplay and enhanced visuals.

Prison Life Simulator Jail:
Survive the harsh realities of prison life — maintain order, complete daring tasks, and craft a cunning escape plan. Build alliances, navigate dangerous situations, and gather resources to outsmart the system and regain your freedom.

Prison Life Simulator Jail - Gangster Escape Games Scary Architect Battle: Renovation Pack:
Transform your experience with stunning new textures and detailed visuals. From authentic cell floors to revamped prison exteriors, immerse yourself in a more realistic and captivating prison environment.

Do you have what it takes to survive, strategize and escape? Find out in the Prison Life Simulator Jail - Gangster Escape Games Scary Architect Battle: Gangster Redesign Edition

70070000026756.name: 6 in 1 Racing Games Collection
70070000026756.intro: Six Ways to race, No Speed Limits, No Regrets
70070000026756.description:
Hit the streets, tracks, and dirt roads in this power-packed racing collection. From midnight drifts through Miami to state-of-the-art Formula races, each game brings its own flavor of speed and style. Jump between go-karts, supercars, dirt buggies, and sport bikes - there's always another racing twist waiting for you.

Jump into any race and test your skills for a quick thrill, or dive into career modes where you'll unlock new tracks, upgrade your rides, and prove yourself against AI racers. With tons of levels and achievements to unlock, each session brings new challenges and victories.

The bundle includes:
Adrenaline Rush: Miami Drive
Real Drift Racing
Motorbikes Pro 2025
Formula Racing Pro 2025
Go Kart Mania
Buggy Off-Road Racing

70070000026757.name: 9 in 1 Sports Games Mega Collection
70070000026757.description:
Get your game on with the 9 in 1 Sports Games Mega Collection. Our dynamic lineup of action-packed titles is for every type of player. From competitive darts to high-octane go-kart racing, this bundle mixes fast reflexes with fun strategy in bite-sized games that are perfect for quick sessions or longer marathons. Great for solo sessions or family matchups, it's your all-access pass to the court, track, green, and more.

With intuitive controls and pick-up-and-play gameplay, it’s the perfect bundle to keep everyone entertained, no matter their favorite sport. Whether you're chasing high scores or just blowing off steam, this pack delivers hours of sports fun with something new around every corner.

This bundle includes:

Street Basketball
Snooker Fever
Formula Racing PRO 2025
Pool Fever
Bowling Fever
Go Kart Mania

70070000026758.description:
The 15 in 1 Family Games Mega Collection brings you a huge variety of fun-packed games—from fast-paced racing and exciting action challenges to strategic puzzles and classic games. 

Non-stop entertainment with an exciting mix of games, simple controls, vibrant graphics, and endless replayability. Ideal for family game nights, casual play, or friendly competition, this bundle delivers incredible value for money. 

Whether you're looking for a quick challenge or a full-on gaming session, this bundle has you covered! Don't just play - create memories together! Bundle includes:

70070000026762.name: The Oregon Trail - Digital Deluxe Bundle
70070000026762.intro: Experience the classic adventure with The Oregon Trail and expand your frontier tales with the Cowboys and Critters DLC!
70070000026762.description:
A modern reimagining of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the iconic classic will fully immerse you in epic journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the totally extreme. Surviving blizzards, broken limbs, snakebites, exhaustion, starvation, and the dreaded dysentery is no small feat. Can you guide your party to a new life in Oregon before winter?

The Oregon Trail - Digital Deluxe Bundle includes:

- The Oregon Trail base game
- Cowboys and Critters DLC

ALWAYS A NEW ADVENTURE
• Build and name your party from different classes—each with their own starting items, skills, and personalities—to make every journey to Oregon unique.
• Overcome hundreds of random events where your choices affect the fate of your travelers, and are influenced by their unique skills and traits.
• Remember to take care of your party, wagon, and oxen, or they'll become casualties of the trail.

FRESH FEATURES
• Take on 15 playable Journeys.
• Experience 7 Quests inspired by historical events.
• Monitor your party members' health, morale, stamina and hygiene.
• Manage your inventory to squeeze everything you can into the wagon.
• Maintain your wagon to prevent breakdowns and inventory loss from spoiling or spillage.
• Learn about real people and places in your interactive Journal.
• Collect and learn about the many interesting animals you'll see on the trail.
• Catch 80+ species in the new Fishing mini-game.
• Obtain 140+ achievements.

COWBOYS AND CRITTERS DLC
• New Journey: The Chisholm Trail
• New character class: Cook
• New Quests: Forlorn Hope and Horse Creek Treaty
• New waypoint: Myths, Critters & Legends, Oh My!
• And lots more: New achievements, new pieces of Artwork, and new characters

TRUE TO THE ORIGINAL
• Hunting and Rafting make a long-awaited return, with faithful gameplay and all-new visuals.
• Dysentery, river fording, broken legs, and many more classic hazards await!

STRIKING ART DIRECTION AND SCORE
• A beautiful blend of charming pixel art characters, 3D environments and cutting-edge lighting and visual effects creates a unique visual style that's both nostalgic and contemporary.
• An all-original soundtrack of alt-country-inspired music combined with 8-bit-style sound effects.

RESPECTFUL REPRESENTATION
• For the first time, the game features Native American playable characters and stories, celebrating the history and cultures of the peoples who first lived on this land and still live here today.
• Native American scholars contributed to the game's storylines and dialogue to ensure accuracy and respectful representation.

OFFICIALLY LICENSED & SUPPORTED
• The Oregon Trail™ is an officially licensed game from HarperCollins Productions, who supported the evolution of The Oregon Trail™ so it would be true to the original, but with updated gameplay and visuals.
• 2016 Video Game Hall of Fame inductee
