70070000026766.name: SOS OPS! Family
70070000026766.intro: SOS OPS! is more than a game. You will find yourself in the epicenter of madness, where co-op missions with friends will raise the adrenaline to the limit!
70070000026766.description:
SOS OPS!
Your beloved town is in danger! Stay alert 24/7 to keep the situation in the town under control. No fires or lost cats allowed.

SOS OPS! – GUNS N’ OPS
The good old mess. Invite your friends online and compete in accuracy and chaos. Smash the location and release the entire clip into each other! Yeah, the one who sticks out a bucks for you will regret it.

SOS OPS! – TRIALS
Immerse yourself in a world where every obstacle is a mini-show. Here you will find the most unexpected challenges. Jump, dodge, slide and roll – you have to show all your dexterity and ingenuity to overcome them all.

70070000026768.name: WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT - Battle War Squad: P-40 Elite Fighter
70070000026768.intro: Master the skies – legendary jets and fierce aerial combat await!
70070000026768.description:
Take command of the skies with the WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT - Battle War Squad: P-40 Elite Fighter, featuring the WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT - Battle War Squad game and the action-packed P-40 DLC! Experience the thrill of aerial combat, engage in high-stakes dogfights, and rewrite history in one complete package.

Immerse yourself in heart-pounding combat as you pilot 12 legendary warplanes across intense battlefields. Conquer a diverse island map, perform daring stunts, and complete high-risk missions, from escorting bombers to devastating enemy bases. Rise through the ranks and prove yourself as an ace pilot in the most dynamic WWII flight experience.

DLC Bonus: Unlock the P-40 instantly or receive in-game currency if you already own it! P-40 Airplane – A Legendary Fighter Joins the Battle! Take flight with the iconic P-40 airplane, featuring enhanced visuals and a redesigned battlefield that intensifies every dogfight. Master the art of aerial supremacy and unleash precision strikes against your enemies.

Suit up, take off, and carve your name into history!

70070000026773.name: Tank vs Tank Prime Edition
70070000026773.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000026773.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs. Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?

This bundle includes base game and "War Paint #3" DLC, with:

-4 unique tank skins and 4 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

Grab it now and roll out in style!

70070000026774.name: Tank vs Tank Superior Edition
70070000026774.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000026774.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?

This bundle includes base game, "War Paint" and "War Paint #3", with:

-8 unique tank skins and 8 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000026775.name: Mini Market Design Deluxe Edition
70070000026775.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000026775.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the Furniture Material Collection 1 DLC, allowing you to add new colors to your furnitures.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000026781.name: Subway Simulator - Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Train Collection
70070000026781.intro: Take the fast lane – the city’s waiting!
70070000026781.description:
Subway Simulator - Underground Train Ride: Train Collection Bundle
Get the ultimate subway experience with this exclusive bundle, combining the full version of Subway Simulator - Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games with the Express Voyager Train DLC!

Main Game – Subway Simulator - Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games
Step into the driver’s seat and master the art of train operation! Navigate through realistic subway routes, transport passengers across 4 dynamic cities, and experience the thrill of running a metro system.
With 5 different trains to choose from and 100 progressively challenging levels, you’ll develop your skills, explore new stations, and build a career as a subway driver.

DLC – Express Voyager Train
Enhance your subway fleet with the Express Voyager, an elite high-speed train designed for smooth and efficient underground travel. Experience an improved train model, upgraded visuals, and the ultimate passenger transport experience.

Take control, expand your fleet, and experience the most immersive subway simulator ever!

70070000026787.name: Calico Complete
70070000026787.description:
Calico is a day-in-the-life community sim game where you are given an important and adorable task: rebuild the town’s cat café and fill it with cute and cuddly creatures! You will journey to a small village filled with magical girls and other fantastical friends, where you are placed in charge of a run down cat café. Build up your café by filling it with cute furniture, fun decorations, yummy pastries, and get it bustling with animals again!

Calico is meant to make you feel all warm and fuzzy inside. The gameplay reflects that with a laid back, low stress creative environment to explore and play in.

There's even more to explore in the world of Calico with the Neat Things DLC, including:

-New Quest — Neat Things Scavenger Hunt: Your beloved aunt has a mission for you that takes you across the whole island in search of some really neat things!
-New Area and NPC — Mermaid’s Cove: Visit Clover Cove to uncover a new area, and meet a mythical new friend — Nahla the Mermaid!  
-New Animal Companions: Become best buds with new cuddly friends, including a mischievous raccoon, a smiley axolotl, a playful elephant, a loveable golden retriever, and, of course, a very familiar cat!
-Two New Mini-Games: The Cutie City arcade has two new activities to enjoy, so be sure to pay it a visit!
-New Café Decorations: Create your dream aquatic-themed cafe with furniture!
-And More to Discover: Have a wander around the island and explore the world around you to uncover some fun new interactions such as playing in piles of fallen leaves, making a wish on dandelions that have gone to seed, and more!

70070000026792.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Extended Edition
70070000026792.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000026792.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon, Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes base game, Food Truck Tycoon Multiplayer Mode, and Food Truck Tycoon New Levels #1 with:

- Food Truck Tycoon local multiplayer gameplay mode
- 45 brand new levels for Food Truck Tycoon

70070000026793.name: Block Jam: Cute Edition
70070000026793.intro: Plan, match, and clear the board in Block Jam, where every move counts and every block needs the perfect match!
70070000026793.description:
Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and build amazing structures for your blocks. Sounds easy? Think again! – you only have so much room on your bench, and if you overfill it, it's game over!

Features:
- Extra items: 15x undo powerup, 15x more space powerup, 15x shuffle powerup, 15x magnet powerup and 6 new hats for the blocks that live on your dioramas!
- Match and Win: Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and avoid overfilling your bench.
- Limited Bench: Use your bench wisely – a full bench means game over!
- Bus Mode: Fill color-matched buses to clear levels and earn extra power-ups and coins!
- Fun Power-Ups: Use undo, magnet, reshuffle, or expand your bench to escape tricky situations.
- Build Your Diorama: Collect bricks to create unique structures in your very own block-populated diorama.
- Customize Your Blocks: Use coins earned in-game to give your diorama blocks unique and fun looks.

Every level gives you new challenges to solve, but don't worry – you have power-ups to help! Undo a move, reshuffle blocks, or add extra bench space when you're in a tough spot. Earn coins along the way to customize your blocks and make your diorama totally unique!

For an extra challenge, try "Bus Mode" – the classic Block Jam experience with a colorful twist! Match blocks to fill color-coded buses and watch them roll out. Complete all buses in a level, and you'll earn even more power-ups and coins to help you on your journey!

Jump into Block Jam – where every move is a step closer to clearing the board, personalizing your world, and mastering each challenge!

70070000026796.name: Backrooms: Exit from Supermarket Horror Deluxe Edition
70070000026796.intro: The Ultimate Survival Package: Main Game + All DLCs for the Full Nightmare Experience!
70070000026796.description:
Deluxe Edition delivers the ultimate horror experience, packed with all the spine-chilling DLCs to push your fear to the edge. Dive deeper into the heart of the supermarket’s endless, distorted aisles where every corner hides a new terror.

The Creepy Music DLC amplifies the nightmare with haunting melodies that wrap around you, turning each moment into an atmosphere of pure dread. Meanwhile, the Recordings Simulator DLC lets you uncover cryptic radio dialogues and hidden messages, shedding light on the twisted secrets that lie beneath the surface.

This is no ordinary survival horror—this is the full, unrelenting terror of a world gone mad. Escape if you can, but remember, every step forward is one closer to the abyss. Are you ready to face the nightmare in its most complete form?

70070000026797.name: Hide 'N Seek!: Scary Edition
70070000026797.intro: ...8, 9, 10. Ready or not, here I come!
70070000026797.description:
Remember the good old game of hide and seek? Prepare for something a little more extreme!

Features:
- Wear 8 new spooky skins!
- Make friends with 4 new pets!
- Get 5000 extra coins!
- Hide and run away from the seekers
- Find and capture all the hiders
- Enjoy multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Use powerups to gain an advantage
- Collect coins to buy skins and pets!

Dive into classic gameplay where you can hide or seek. Count down before setting off to find the Hiders, or blend into the environment, stay silent, and outsmart the Seeker to win!

Simple, fun, and dynamic—Hide 'N Seek brings the joy of this beloved childhood game to life!

70070000026801.name: Pool Fever Prime Edition
70070000026801.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000026801.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #3 with:

-5 new pool table designs

70070000026805.name: Doll Dress Up: Classy Edition
70070000026805.intro: Become the best doll stylist and make a fabulous princess with new items!
70070000026805.description:
Let your creativity shine as you style your doll with new clothes, accessories, hairstyles, and makeup! 

Create the perfect princess look and have fun with all the new items available! 

Features: 
- customize your sweet doll with a wide range of clothes, accessories and hairstyles! 
- unlock almost 300 new items to make your doll look even more unique and stylish!
- personalize your doll's outfit, eye color, hairstyle and makeup
- compete for the title of the prettiest against other dolls!
- choose a background and take a beautiful picture
- watch as your doll collection grows larger and larger!

Take your doll on exciting adventures and explore different styles. Mix and match outfits to create the perfect look for every occasion. Whether it’s a day at the beach, a party, or a magical underwater adventure, your doll will always look her best!

Dress your doll in pretty skirts, cozy sweaters or shiny dresses for a fun fashion competition. Pose in different colorful scenes and get ready for a fantastic photo session!

Let the makeover fun begin!

70070000026807.name: Christmas Store: Santa's Supermarket Simulator Deluxe Edition
70070000026807.intro: All the Holiday Fun, Plus 3 Festive DLCs!
70070000026807.description:
Get ready for the ultimate holiday shopping experience with Christmas Store: Santa's Supermarket Simulator Deluxe Edition! This edition includes the main game plus three exciting DLCs, packed with all the festive content you need.

Storage Upgrade DLC – Expand your shelves and optimize your store to handle even more holiday cheer.

New Holiday Products DLC – Add exciting new items to your store, from limited-edition gifts to seasonal treats that customers can’t resist.

Cash Boost DLC – Jumpstart your holiday sales with a special cash boost, giving you the resources to deck out your store and make this Christmas the most profitable yet.

Manage your supermarket, maximize your sales, and keep the holiday spirit alive all season long. The Deluxe Edition is your ticket to a jolly good time!

70070000026808.name: Golden Idol Investigations: Detective Pass
70070000026808.intro: The Rise of the Golden Idol - Detective Pass gives you access to all four upcoming Investigations DLC releasing in 2025 at a discounted price
70070000026808.description:
Investigations #1 - The Sins of New Wells
Follow Detective Roy Samson through four brand new cases of his dealings with an organized crime syndicate plaguing the city. Drugs, death, and ancient Lemurian magic will make headlines in The Sins of New Wells.

Investigations #2 - Codename [REDACTED]
Travel to Lemuria and investigate a deep reaching conspiracy that has infiltrated the upper echelons of Lemurian aristocracy and its King. Mingle with new age cults from India, gurus with potentially supernatural powers and charlatans that just want to scam westerners in Codename: [REDACTED].

Investigations #3 - Codename: Inquisition
When reports of the unlawful use of Lemurian technology begin to surface, an inquisition squad is sent to investigate - but are they truly immune to the Idol’s influence? Explore a world before modern technology and catch a glimpse at the world during the creation of the artifact itself in Codename: Inquisition.

Investigations #4 - Codename: Expedition
Set shortly after the events of The Case of the Golden Idol, follow a group of explorers as they set off on a seafaring adventure to discover a fabled and supposedly cursed treasure of a lost pirate captain. It’s all hands on deck in Codename: Expedition.

70070000026814.name: Valentine's Venture: True Love Odyssey Premium Edition
70070000026814.description:
Welcome to the ultimate way to experience this whimsical 3D platforming adventure! This special edition includes the main game plus the Race for Passion DLC, featuring a magical new soundtrack that brings even more heart to your journey.

Leap through enchanting worlds, solve adorable puzzles, and follow your heart in a quest for true love, all while being immersed in beautiful, love-filled melodies. With the Premium Edition, every moment feels even more magical. Are you ready to chase your happily ever after?

70070000026817.name: Cooking Ultimate Edition
70070000026817.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000026817.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

Decorate your restaurant with an amazing Green Dragon Set and Animal Set included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out 
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000026822.name: Crime Opera Collection
70070000026822.intro: Explore an anthology of tales about mafia life!
70070000026822.description:
Crime Opera: The Butterfly Effect

Following the sudden death of a mafia family’s matriarch, her sons Gerald and Xander are put on the defensive as former partners threaten to take over their collective business ventures for themselves. See through the eyes of the Gallo children as they witness murders, kidnappings and other crimes wrought upon their households by their own fathers.

Crime Opera II: The Floodgate Effect

Experience a new chapter in the mafia tale surrounding the Gallos family! This story begins 9 years after the original. Xander Gallo is now bitter, alone and out of control. He’s causing problems for not only other families within the syndicate but also for younger Gallo members as well. Those who remained behind to continue the family legacy are soon forced to take sides with or against Xander Gallo, while others who have seemingly moved on with their lives are pulled back in against their will.

Crime Opera Fandisk: The Caterpillar Candids

In this new anthology release of Crime Opera, explore a variety of short stories that take place before, during and after the events of the original visual novel, all presented in beautifully crafted hand-drawn style to convey the drama, emotion and gritty truth surrounding characters’ lives in the criminal underworld.

70070000026825.name: Darts Fever Deluxe Edition
70070000026825.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000026825.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game, Stylish Precision #1 and Stylish Precision #2 with:

10 brand-new dart designs

70070000026826.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000026826.description:

70070000026830.name: Formula Racing Pro 2025 Extended Edition
70070000026830.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000026830.description:
Get behind the wheel in Formula Racing Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Formula racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #1 with:

This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000026843.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Definitive Edition
70070000026843.intro: Tasty burgers? We've got you covered!
70070000026843.description:
Like going in to town for a bite to eat? Everybody does! 

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side? 
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, french fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats! 

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up! 

Upgrade your restaurant and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger joint in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat
* 60 awesome levels to complete
* Countless dishes to master and serve
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Multiplayer Mode and DLC#4 Endless Mode with:

• 20 new levels,
• 6 new achievements
• New Endless Mode
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000026845.name: Little Paws: Kitty Cat Simulator Deluxe Edition
70070000026845.intro: All the Purrfect Adventures in One!
70070000026845.description: Little Paws: Kitty Cat Simulator Deluxe Edition brings you the ultimate kitty adventure, combining the main game with all the adorable DLCs! Explore charming worlds, customize your kitty with cute skins, and enjoy a delightful soundtrack that sets the perfect mood for every whisker-twitching moment. With all the extras included, this edition lets you experience the full, purrfect journey in one package. Ready to embark on the ultimate feline adventure?

70070000026853.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Elite Edition
70070000026853.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000026853.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan. 

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.
* Easy to play and hard to master.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Endless Mode and Multiplayer Mode with:

Join forces with your friend in the ultimate cooking adventure with this new Multiplayer Mode! 

• 20 new levels

70070000026855.name: Moto Rush GT Master Edition
70070000026855.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000026855.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Grip Collection #1, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #3 with:

70070000026858.name: Knights & Guns Ultra Edition
70070000026858.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000026858.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Armor Pack #2  and Armor Pack #3 with:
- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 13 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000026859.name: Knights & Guns Master Edition
70070000026859.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000026859.description:

70070000026862.name: Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter -  Bidder Edition
70070000026862.intro: More auctions, more treasures, more excitement!
70070000026862.description:
Step into the fast-paced world of storage unit auctions and unlock the full potential of your treasure-hunting skills with this comprehensive bundle! Compete against determined bidders, explore abandoned storage units packed with hidden gems, and turn every find into a profitable success story.

This bundle offers the complete experience, blending the excitement of the base game with the extended features of the Treasure Hunter Expansion DLC. It’s your ultimate ticket to becoming a legendary storage auction master.

This bundle includes:
	•	Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter – Engage in intense bidding wars, explore diverse storage units, and discover valuable treasures hidden behind locked doors. Outbid your competitors, find rare collectibles, and build your 
reputation as a top storage hunter.
	•	Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter - Cash Hunter DLC –  Start your journey with 400 in-game currencies, giving you a head start in dominating auctions and securing the best deals. Take your skills to the next level with access to exclusive storage units and rare artifacts.

Don’t miss your chance to become the ultimate storage hunter!

70070000026865.name: Bratz® Rhythm & Style - Deluxe Edition
70070000026865.intro: Conquer the fashion world and groove with your new BFFs rockin’ fierce fashion pack looks.
70070000026865.description:
Dominate the runway in the Bratz ® Rhythm & Style: Deluxe Edition with the Bratz Pack and their friends (or frenemies). With these four fierce Fashion Packs, you can take your style game to new heights. Join them on a global adventure that combines style, rhythm, and your favorite songs from the Bratz universe, like ‘So Good’.

From Stilesville to Tokyo, you can achieve squad goals with Hayley, Hanae, and Bella – the ultimate IT girls. Explore and spill the tea with Felicia and snap everything you see with Kumi. Serve fashion, face and flawless vibes with BFFs. Hit those iconic notes, showcase your moves and own the stage with THE duo – Roxxi and Nevra #CoupleGoals. Or channel your inner mean girl and scheme with the Tweevil Twins, Kirstee and Kaycee.

Create customizable looks in the Bratz Fashion Studios, jet off to iconic cities with friends, but watch out for – self-proclaimed “Style Queen”, Burdine and the Tweevil Twins who are determined to steal the spotlight. Can you out-style and out-dance them in the ultimate fashion showdown? Take on the challenge with your besties in single or multiplayer with up to four players.

It's time to express yourself!

Fashion Packs included:
- The Fashion Celebrity Pack
- The Felicia & Kumi Pack
- The Roxxi & Nevra Pack
- The Tweevils Pack

Each Fashion pack includes outfit, make-up and hairstyle upgrades.

70070000026866.name: Sherlock Purr Adventures
70070000026866.intro: Be a cat detective and uncover hidden objects in this purrfect two-game bundle!
70070000026866.description:
Join the clever feline detective, Sherlock Purr, in this delightful bundle of hidden object adventures! Experience engaging puzzles as you help Sherlock explore the homes of his friends. Search for lost and hidden items and enjoy immersive gameplay experience.

This bundle contains the games “Sherlock Purr” and “Sherlock Purr 2”.

70070000026867.name: PAWfect Pet Paradise
70070000026867.intro: Design a cozy paradise for your furry friends!
70070000026867.description:
Unleash your creativity with two heartwarming design games where you craft the perfect spaces for adorable animals!

"Pawfectly Designed" – Assist your canine designer in arranging cozy spaces for their friends, ensuring they feel comfortable and inspired to follow their passions.

"Pawfect Cat Mansion" – Build and decorate a mansion for orphaned kittens, filling it with warmth and comfort so they can snuggle up by the fireplace.

Design, decorate, and create the ultimate paradise for your furry friends!

70070000026868.name: Extreme Ride Legacy
70070000026868.intro: Action-packed games bundle with drifting, chases, and intense challenges!
70070000026868.description:
Get behind the wheel with "Drift Legacy" and "Theft Ride Legacy", two adrenaline-fueled racing games in one epic bundle!

In "Drift Legacy", master the art of drifting, earn rewards, upgrade your ride, and unlock new cars to dominate the streets. Precision and style will make you a true drifting master!

Race against time in "Theft Ride Legacy" to recover stolen loot in high-speed chases. Navigate intense courses, outmaneuver obstacles, and prove your skills under pressure. Take on the challenge solo or compete with a friend in two-player split-screen mode!

Buckle up—this bundle delivers the ultimate thrill ride!

70070000026869.name: CAR RACING & DRIFT & DRIVING & DRAG BUNDLE
70070000026869.intro: Drift, Drag & Dominate – 10 Games, One Legendary Collection!
70070000026869.description:
Experience the Ultimate Driving Thrill
Get ready for the most exhilarating racing experience with the CAR RACING & DRIFT & DRIVING & DRAG BUNDLE. This high-octane collection brings together 10 adrenaline-fueled games packed with intense street racing, drifting challenges, drag battles, and open-world driving. Whether you’re a fan of JDM culture, illegal night races, high-speed police chases, or deep car customization, this bundle has everything you need to satisfy your need for speed.

FEATURES
	•	Street Racing & Drifting – Master the art of drifting and dominate the underground racing scene with legendary 90s JDM cars and modern performance machines.
	•	Ultimate Car Customization – Swap engines, fine-tune performance, upgrade suspensions, and apply stunning vinyls to create your dream car.
	•	Drag Racing & Speed Battles – Take your ride to the streets, fine-tune gear ratios, and push your car to its limits in head-to-head drag races.
	•	Open-World Driving – Explore neon-lit cities, Japanese highways, and thrilling circuits in an immersive open-world setting.
	•	Multiplayer & PVP Modes – Challenge players worldwide in intense online drift battles, time attack races, and police chases.
	•	Realistic Driving Physics – Feel the power of real engine sounds, dynamic weather, and detailed car handling mechanics.

With 10 games combined into one action-packed bundle, this is the ultimate experience for every racing and drifting enthusiast. Are you ready to push your skills to the limit and become the king of the streets?

70070000026870.name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 - Deluxe Edition Upgrade
70070000026870.intro: Purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition Upgrade to receive additional content.
70070000026870.description:
Purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition Upgrade to receive additional content:

- Digital Deluxe Edition Content

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

- The Doom Slayer and The Revenant playable skaters, each includes 2 secret moves. The Doom Slayer includes 2 unique outfits and the Unmaykr Hoverboard skate deck.
- Additional songs included with the in-game soundtrack
- Exclusive Doom Slayer, Revenant, and Create-a-Skater skate decks
- Exclusive themed Create-a-Skater Items

70070000026880.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Silver Edition
70070000026880.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000026898.name: Ecchi Uncover Complete Edition
70070000026898.intro: Time to sweep some girls off their feet.
70070000026898.description:
Traverse through a field of mines to uncover beautiful girls hiding within. Tread carefully, and you might just stumble on a different pair of bombs.
Features:
- Over 180 enticing pictures of girls with or without clothes
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes
Be careful, or you might get blown up.

70070000026899.name: SIMULATORS MEGA BUNDLE - Truck, Construction, Farming, Offroad, Bus
70070000026899.intro: Drive, build, and thrive in the ultimate simulator pack!
70070000026899.description:
SIMULATORS MEGA BUNDLE – Truck, Construction, Farming, Offroad, Bus
Experience the ultimate simulation adventure with SIMULATORS MEGA BUNDLE – a must-have collection for every simulation enthusiast! Dive into five thrilling worlds where you take control of powerful machines, manage businesses, and conquer challenging environments.

What’s inside the bundle?
	•	Tow Truck Driver Simulator 2023 – Rescue stranded vehicles, navigate through city streets, and build your own towing empire!
	•	Construction Simulator – Operate heavy machinery, complete challenging construction projects, and expand your business!
	•	Farming Tractor Simulator 2023 – Cultivate crops, raise animals, and run a successful farm in an open-world farming experience!
	•	Off-Road Racing Simulator – Conquer extreme terrains, customize your 4x4 vehicles, and prove your skills in adrenaline-fueled races!
	•	City Bus Driving Simulator – Navigate a bustling metropolis, pick up passengers, and become the ultimate bus driving legend!

Why choose SIMULATORS MEGA BUNDLE?
	•	Diverse Gameplay – Experience five unique and immersive simulation genres.
	•	Realistic Physics – Authentic vehicle handling and mechanics for maximum immersion.
	•	Business & Strategy – Manage resources, expand your empire, and thrive in each simulation.
	•	Endless Customization – Upgrade and personalize your vehicles and equipment.
	•	Massive Open Worlds – Explore cities, farms, rugged terrains, and bustling construction sites.

Whether you’re a fan of trucks, construction, farming, off-road racing, or city driving, this bundle has everything you need to test your skills and enjoy hours of engaging gameplay.
Get behind the wheel, take control, and master every challenge – all in one incredible bundle!

70070000026902.name: Skyline Bowling: Complete Edition
70070000026902.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000026902.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 6 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Balls - Equip 6 new bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 100K coins and 4K gems to buy and upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000026904.name: AAA Clock Anniversary Edition
70070000026904.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000026904.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 10 newest DLCs: Blowing Bubbles, Minimalistic Stars, Old Survivalist, Zebra Stripes, Cartoonish, Dots Everywhere, Koi Lake, Minimalistic Farm, Minute Focus and Fly High Clock.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000026906.name: Stacky Dash: Complete Edition
70070000026906.intro: Dash your hero across the mazes, stack the tiles higher and higher, and reach for the skies!
70070000026906.description:
Get ready for non-stop fun in Stacky Dash! Slide to collect tiles, build paths, and race through colorful levels full of exciting surprises. Dodge blasting cannons, and zip through portals as you conquer each tricky stage!

Features:
• Premium skins - Play with 10 epic skins!
• Unique tiles - Choose from 14 new tiles!
• Extra resources - Get 5K coins, 1K gems and 30 keys!
• Exciting Levels - Tons of fun puzzles that get trickier as you go!
• Crazy Challenges - Dodge cannon fire, zoom through portals, and avoid traps.
• Animal Rescue - Find cute animals and grow your zoo!
• Timed Mode - Race the clock for an extra challenge and rewards!
• Customization - Unlock awesome skins for your character and tiles.

Save adorable animals to grow your own zoo and take on timed challenges to test your speed. With tons of cool skins to unlock, every level is packed with energy and fun!

Solve your way through endless puzzles in Stacky Dash!

70070000026915.name: There's no Aliens - Season 1
70070000026915.description: There's no Aliens + There's no Aliens - Amusement Park

70070000026933.name: Treflix: Games and Comic Books for Kids
70070000026933.intro: A set of mini games and educational comics for children.
70070000026933.description: Make your child happy and show the world of cute Treflixes. The set includes 4 mini games and 2 comic books. Meet Treflik, Treflinka and Spy Guy, who will show you how to deal with anger, how to react calmly and play fun games with them: memory, puzzle, connect the dots and look for differences.

70070000026934.name: Spy Guy Cosmos Edition
70070000026934.intro: Spy Guy escapes into Space and searches for hidden objects between planets!
70070000026934.description: Far, far away in a galaxy far, far away, Spy Guy has gone on a journey to track down the missing parts of a spaceship. The cosmos is full of all sorts of items, but will he find what he needs. Discover a brand new 120 levels of the iconic Spy Guy game this time in space!

70070000026935.name: Spy Guy Memory Cosmos Challenge
70070000026935.intro: Try your hand at the iconic Memory game and its space version!
70070000026935.description: The Memory challenge is known to everyone, but have you tried your hand at the space version? Will you manage to discover all the tiles? Choose the super space challenge.

70070000026937.name: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT - DAIMA - Adventure Through The Demon Realm PACK
70070000026937.intro: BE THE HOPE OF THE UNIVERSE
70070000026937.description:
The DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm Pack includes the following content:
• DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 1 (July-Sep 2025)
• DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2 (Jan-Mar 2026)
• DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Pack Bonus
- Items: Ultimate Meat Feast, Mega Sacred Water, Purple Dino Horn, and Awakening Water

Explore the World of Dragon Ball DAIMA
DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Pack invites you to relive the thrilling adventures of Goku (Mini) and his friends Glorio, Shin and Panzy. Traverse fields and maps that faithfully recreate the stunning world of the anime series, Dragon Ball DAIMA.

Immerse Yourself in the Demon Realm
Experience the world of Dragon Ball DAIMA through the eyes of Goku (Mini). Walk through the intricate landscapes of the Demon World, meet new friends, fight new enemies, and discover new mysteries.

Engage in Battles with New Techniques
Experience battles as they are depicted in the anime, utilizing new techniques with the Power Pole. Leverage the Medi-Bug to get various effects and get support from Panzi and others to add a strategic layer to your combat.

These new elements bring a fresh and exciting dimension to DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT.

*Individual Additional Story DLCs can be purchased as standalone product. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Content will be available by 2/28/2026.

70070000026938.name: Zombie Quarantine: Blackout Survival DELUXE EDITION
70070000026938.intro: The Ultimate Survival Experience with All the Extras!
70070000026938.description:
The Zombie Quarantine: Blackout Survival – Deluxe Edition delivers the complete, heart-pounding survival experience. This ultimate package includes the main game along with the Action Beat DLC and Money Balance DLC, giving you everything you need to fight back against the relentless undead.

Survive the blackout with electrifying tracks that fuel the action and stock up on valuable resources to enhance your chances of survival. With all the DLC content, you’re fully equipped to face the darkness, build your defenses, and take down the horde. Will you survive the quarantine, or will the undead rise?

70070000026942.name: Unboxing: Cozy Home Simulator Ultimate Edition
70070000026942.description: The Ultimate Edition delivers the full cozy home experience, combining the main game with the Design Pack DLC and Music Collection DLC. Unbox, decorate, and design your dream home with new stylish decor items and personalized touches. Set the perfect atmosphere with a curated selection of relaxing and cheerful tunes. Whether you're unpacking boxes, arranging furniture, or enjoying the perfect playlist, this edition has everything you need to create your ultimate cozy sanctuary. Let your imagination run wild and transform your house into a warm, inviting home!

70070000026945.name: My Cozy Room Decor Deluxe
70070000026945.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000026945.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection and Cats DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 1 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000026952.name: Om Nom: Run & Om Nom: Run 2
70070000026952.intro: Double the run, be number one!
70070000026952.description:
Two Om Nom Run adventures for twice the speed and twice the fun! Sprint, dodge, and race to the finish across trap-filled tracks. Play solo in both titles, and enjoy couch-competitive local multiplayer in Om Nom: Run.

Om Nom: Run - Speed through 140 campaign levels across 9 locations, tackle 4 mission types, and power up with rockets, magnets, and more. Dress Om Nom in fun outfits, earn coins to upgrade, and jump into Free Run or local multiplayer on one screen (up to 8 players) or split-screen (up to 4).

Om Nom: Run 2 - The sequel pushes the pace with tighter turns and more demanding courses. Avoid obstacles, pick smarter lines, use shortcuts to stay ahead, and beat your rivals to the finish. Easy to learn, rewarding to master.

Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

70070000026953.name: Overboard! & Expelled!
70070000026953.intro: GET AWAY WITH MURDER in Overboard!, and then go back to school in the devilish follow-up Expelled!
70070000026953.description:
Two mystery adventures with wicked twists. Use any means necessary to uncover the secrets of those around you, and turn them to your advantage, in adventures where every choice counts, and every new discovery will open new strategies to try. 

In Overboard!, you play Veronica Villensey, whose husband has just been pushed overboard - one problem: you're the one who pushed him. Can you find someone to take the fall for the murder and save yourself?

In Expelled!, you're Verity Amersham, scholarship student at a top boarding school, who's being accused of a savage attack on another pupil. Can you find the real culprit - or something to take the blame?

In both you'll find detective work, secrets, wild characters, tall tales, blackmail, deception, love -- and murder.  

From the award-winning studio behind Heaven's Vault, A Highland Song and 80 Days, Overboard! and Expelled! are wild, funny and smart detective stories that will surprise you at every turn.

GAMEPLAY

* Explore, talk to other characters, sneak around - and try not to get caught!
* Your actions will affect other characters, who remember everything they see and hear.
* Everyone here has secrets - but remember, knowledge is power.

DYNAMIC NARRATIVE CLOCKWORK

* Next-gen visual novel: go where you want, when you want, and say what you want.
* Simulated story-world: other characters move and act independently, remembering everything they see and hear - and everything you do.
* Every minute counts: you have one day to escape punishment. The clock is always ticking!
* Who can you trust? Some characters are friendly and some are out to get you. Who will you befriend? Who will you betray?

HIGHLY REPLAYABLE

* Every run is different, with new leads and new opportunities for mayhem. 
* One play-through lasts about 30 - 45 minutes, but achieving that perfect run will take a lot longer...

SOMEONE HAS TO TAKE THE FALL

70070000026956.name: Atelier Yumia Season Pass
70070000026956.intro: Enjoy all of "Atelier Yumia" with the season pass!
70070000026956.description:
All of the paid DLC at a better price than when purchased individually.

Season pass contents: 19 items including the bonus
1) Season pass purchase bonus: Atelier Yumia - Additional Hair Color Set
Five hair color changes for Yumia, Flammi, Viktor, Isla, Rutger, Nina, and Lenja (Flammi's fire color changes). There are five different colors for each character.
2-8) Unique swimsuit costumes for each of the seven party characters
9-15) Unique academy-themed costumes for each of the seven party characters.
16) Recipe and Blueprint Expansion Pack "The Art of Aladiss"
17) Additional Map 1
18) Additional Map 2
19) Gust Extra BGM Pack

Note:
- The Season pass　purchase bonus and items 1-8 will be released at the same time as the main game. Items 9-19 are planned to be released by the end of October 2025.
- The name, details, and release date of each item are subject to change. Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.
- Costumes and hair color changes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room (the relevant characters must also have joined your party).
- Other requirements to use each item exist.
- Please be aware that there are other products which include this content. Excluding the set bonus, these items will also be able to be purchased individually at a later date. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases. Note that when making individual purchases, for the costumes included in items 2-8 and 9-15, Yumia and Flammi's costumes will be sold as a set but not separately.

70070000026957.name: Yumia and Flammi Swimsuit Set
70070000026957.intro: Swimsuit costumes for Yumia and Flammi.
70070000026957.description:
Adds a unique swimsuit costume for both Yumia and Flammi (two total).

List of Contents:
- "Waterside Alchemist" Costume for Yumia
- "Flying Water Jug" Costume for Flammi

Note:
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room.
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70070000026958.name: Atelier Yumia - Swimsuit Set
70070000026958.description:
A set of swimsuit costumes for Yumia, Flammi, Viktor, Isla, Rutger, Nina, and Lenja (one for each character, with seven total).

List of Contents:
- "Waterside Alchemist" Costume for Yumia
- "Flying Water Jug" Costume for Flammi
"Super Cute! Beach Memories" Costume for Isla
- "Knight's Long-Distance Swimwear" Costume for Viktor
- "Ebony Outlaw" Costume for Rutger
- "Blooming Heart" Costume for Nina
- "Cute Kitty Swimsuit" Costume for Lenja

Note:
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room (the relevant characters must also have joined your party).
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content and that these items can be purchased individually. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Note that when making individual purchases, Yumia and Flammi's costumes will be sold as a set but not separately.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70070000026968.name: Bridge Race & Stacky Dash
70070000026968.intro: Stack, build, and race your way to victory!
70070000026968.description:
Get ready for a thrilling duo of fast-paced, brick-stacking action with Bridge Race and Stacky Dash!

Bridge Race - Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

Stacky Dash - Slide to collect tiles, build paths, and race through colorful levels full of exciting surprises. Dodge blasting cannons, and zip through portals as you conquer each tricky stage!

Ready to build, stack, and dash your way to the top?

70070000026980.name: Idle Devils (Deluxe Edition)
70070000026980.intro: Summon your devils to form the ultimate devil squad! Watch your power grow every moment, even when you're away! Are you ready to become the new Devil King?
70070000026980.description:
Game Features:
+ 10 characters, 220 skills, 180 talents, over 400 equipments, and more than 200 equipment affixes. Plus, endless stage challenges that never stop!

+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a laid-back, stress-free experience where the game truly helps you unwind and relax. Even when you're taking a break, your devils will keep fighting, ensuring you continue to grow stronger.

+ Rich Loot and Equipment System:
During battles, every enemy you defeat has a chance to drop equipment. The equipment quality is determined by the stage level and treasure rank, with higher-quality equipment offering more diverse affixes. There’s even a chance to obtain exclusive, rare affixes to supercharge your power in combat!

70070000026986.name: West Escape: Complete Edition
70070000026986.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000026986.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

Features:
- Premium Equipment: Equip to gain extra tool and weapon damage, twice the loot from expeditions and reduced crafting time!
- Rare Gear and more: Obtain rare and uncommon equipment to boost your power level!
- Bonus currency: Get 2000 gems and spend them to progress even faster!
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes—dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load—freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70070000026989.name: Peachy Derby - Rush Edition
70070000026989.intro: 60FPS racing game where the girl Natsuki is forced to join the "Ninja Racing Tournament" to pay off her debt. 10 girls,100 dances anims, 600 voices, 16 chapters.
70070000026989.description:
Peachy Derby+Saori - Grey Investigator+Yuko - Black Investigator

Experience the story of girl Natsuki joining the ""Ninja Racing Tournament"" with her friends to pay off her debt. A total of 16 chapters.

[Let the Girls Dance]
In addition to racing, choose dances, outfits, and Japanese voice lines for the girls.

70070000026994.name: Bomb Cat Purrfect Edition
70070000026994.intro: Match ultra-fluffy cats to achieve the highest score and unleash chaos with Bomb Cat.
70070000026994.description:
Bomb Cat takes inspiration from classic 2048 games but elevates the challenge with an insane bomb mechanic. In other words, it’s pretty simple – match the fluffy cats carefully, and watch out – the bombastic Bomb Cat can either assist you or completely disrupt your game.


2048 MATCH GAME WITH A BANG… OR A BOMB?
There are eleven fluffy cats, starting with sweet tiny blue kitten babies to match together. Each cat has a different weight depending on its size. Your goal is to achieve the highest score without running out of space.

To increase the challenge, a Bomb Cat will occasionally appear... to activate this kitty’s ability, it needs to touch the Flamey Cat. That’s when the explosion’s countdown starts! 

Depending on the circumstances, the blast can help you match smaller cats, as they will jump around the box, or end your game, as the cats can pop out of the open parcel and fly into space. Just like typical cats.


BE A COMBO HERO
Take the challenge of making your score furry freaking best. The more cats you match, the bigger your combo, which translates to more points.

Placing the cats strategically will help you maximize your score.

Unlock new Wild Cat Mode along with Spring Background and Summer Background DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Eleven colorful cats to match like in classic 2048
– Possibility of sending cats to the Moon and back
– One special cat – Cat Bomb to make the game more challenging
– Combo mechanic to make your score even better
– Easy controlling, but challenging gameplay (sometimes)
– Endless and addictive fun
– Enjoyable music, which you can always turn off
– Once again... CATS (No regrets, cats are superior to other animals; deal with it already)

70070000026999.intro: Match ultra-fluffy cats to achieve the highest score and unleash chaos with Bomb Cat.

70070000027004.name: Maki: Paw of Fury Ultimate Edition
70070000027004.intro: Beat ‘em up and Retro Arcade game enjoyers – welcome to the world of Pangea!
70070000027004.description:
When a friend gets captured, Maki comes to her rescue! Fight your way through five diverse locations with funky fresh minigames, and conquer the dangerous opponents that stand in your way!


FEEL THE 90S IN AN ANIMAL STYLE — Maki: Paw of Fury’s combat elements are inspired by the hit beat ‘em up arcade games from the 90s, while the story of Maki takes place in the original world of Pangea. Animals rule here, and they’re passionate about sports, technology, and lifelong friendships. Speaking of, one is about to be on the brink of breaking!


A FRIEND IN NEED, A FIGHT INDEED — Maki gets a pleading call for help and realizes that his dear friend - Mapu - has betrayed him. Here starts the road of Maki: The Paw of Fury! He might look adorable, but don’t mistake his fox cuteness for weakness - he has studied the martial art of Tsume no Ken and can wield a tuna like a professional.


MAKI ISN’T ALONE — You can choose to play Maki the fox, but you can also choose Tincho, the muscular capybara, and Maka, the colorful otter who will show your enemies the power of music. Each of these characters is unique when it comes to looks, strength, and fighting style!

Unlock Maki Aviator and Tincho Nerd skins, included in this bundle.

VIBE WITH THE MUSIC AND THE WONDERFUL WORLD OF PANGEA — While all the fighting’s going on it’s hard to appreciate the visuals. But if you stand down just for a moment you’ll be able to appreciate the stunning views of Pangea’s world! You’’ travel through dark ninja forests, icy planes, and desert dunes in the tune of energetic and fighting-ready tracks.

70070000027013.name: Little Strays: Legendary Collection
70070000027013.intro: When humans fail you, survive the streets and rescue defenseless kittens as a streetwise survivor.
70070000027013.description:
When the world turns its back on you, embrace your duty and protect the vulnerable. Roam the streets as a fearless stray, scavenging for food and rescuing helpless kittens. Team up with a friend in split-screen mode, but stay sharp—only the bravest will save the most lives. Will you rise as the ultimate survivor?

• Search abandoned warehouses for food and rescue lost kittens.
• Avoid obstacles and complete timed objectives.
• Play through 20 challenging levels.
• Compete in two-player split-screen mode.

This bunlde include add-ons: "New Feline Friends" and "New hideouts".

70070000027017.name: Eroblast: Spicy Edition
70070000027017.intro: We found 21 Hot and Spicy Anime Girls in your area
70070000027017.description:
You'll be able to chat with attractive girls, know their engaging storylines, receive spicy pictures, and solve Match-3 Puzzles to unlock new and cool pick-up lines for your waifu!

In this bundle you get content from the base game and Spicy Pack which includes:
- 21 romanceable women to meet
- 120+ hot pics to unlock
- over 30 routes to go with each waifu, with between 5.000 to 10.000 words each
-  280 levels to beat
-  25+ hours of gameplay so get ready for flirting and pics!

Browse hot profiles and start a romance. Each girl you meet unveils a mix of storytelling, visuals and desires, from bishoujo women to anime klutz. Exchange intimate messages and flirty selfies, use cool pick-up lines and ask provocative questions - every choice you make will shape the outcome of your relationships.

Cannot take romance to another level? Solve puzzles and reach your true potential as a pick-up artist! With over 200 handcrafted levels and neat mechanics, expect addictive gameplay that goes far beyond basic blast puzzles. 

Uncover the interesting stories behind each waifu, unlock pictures, but be aware, some of these pictures are quite spicy so viewer discretion is advised ;)

70070000027018.name: Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator Premium Edition
70070000027018.intro: The ultimate retail experience with all DLCs included!
70070000027018.description: The Premium Edition offers the complete Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator experience, bundling the main game with all available DLCs. Unlock exclusive upgrades, extra funds, advanced storage, and more to take your gaming retail business to new heights. From stocking rare titles to expanding your store’s inventory, this edition gives you all the tools you need to dominate the gaming market. Build your empire, outsmart competitors, and become the go-to destination for gamers everywhere!

70070000027019.intro: Includes all 7 additional characters,Available for selection in the dance room.With stronger racing attributes and a brand-new appearance than the main characters.
