70070000027023.description: The Sakura Garden Deluxe Edition offers the ultimate experience, bundling the main game with all three DLCs! Dive into a serene world filled with captivating waifus, beautiful Japanese-style gardens, and relaxing moments. Unlock new waifus and outfits with the Girls Passion DLC, enjoy calming melodies with the Sakura Spirit Songs DLC, and enhance your garden with exclusive items using the Sakura Coin Pack DLC. With everything included, you’ll have all the tools to create the perfect, peaceful retreat while bonding with your charming companions. Embrace beauty, relaxation, and serenity in this complete, all-inclusive edition!

70070000027031.name: Anime Girls: JDM Car Passion Puzzle PREMIUM EDITION
70070000027031.intro: Ultimate Style, Speed, and Passion – All in One Edition!
70070000027031.description: Welcome to the ultimate package for car lovers and anime enthusiasts alike! This all-inclusive edition features the main game along with all DLCs, giving you access to exclusive cars, stylish customizations, and exciting puzzles. Unlock high-performance JDM cars, chic body kits, stunning decals, and immerse yourself in the world of street racing alongside gorgeous anime girls. Whether you're tuning your dream ride or dominating the streets, this edition has everything you need to fuel your passion for cars, style, and adventure. Get ready to race in the most stylish and adrenaline-filled experience!

70070000027034.name: Little Mouse's Encyclopedia Classic Edition
70070000027034.intro: Explore the incredible world of nature with a charming little mouse. Beautiful, hand-painted graphics and an interesting collection of facts will awaken the naturalist's soul in everyone.
70070000027034.description:
INTERACTIVE ENCYCLOPEDIA
Little Mouse's Encyclopedia is ideal for born explorers. Wandering around the lively boards, you’ll find animals and plants by yourself. Using a magnifying glass, you can reveal cards that contain interesting information and drawings.

GORGEOUS ILLUSTRATIONS
The graphic style of Little Mouse's Encyclopedia was inspired by classic fairy tales and... children's encyclopedias. This enchanting and original style makes the exploration even more enjoyable, and various animations breathe life into the surroundings.

RELAXING MUSIC
While playing, listen to pleasant, relaxing music and the sounds of nature, such as birds chirping or frog toads.

EXPLORE THE WORLD
With a brave mouse, you’ll explore the area around its burrow, walk through the forest, sneak through the garden, and swim in the pond. In each of these places, unique species of animals and plants await you.

SO MUCH TO DISCOVER!
During your wandering, you’ll come across over 160 unique species, about which you can learn something interesting.

AVAILABLE IN MANY LANGUAGES
Little Mouse's Encyclopedia is available in 18 languages, including English, Japanese, German, Spanish, and French.
Immerse yourself in the extraordinary world of nature today with the brave little mouse!

This bundle includes 5 DLC: Garden, Forest, Pond, Puzzle Pack 1 and 2.

KEY FEATURES:
— over 160 species of animals and plants to discover
— 4 different habitats
— beautiful illustrations
— a fun way to learn
— relaxing music
— easy and intuitive controls
— available in many languages

70070000027040.name: Fast & Furry Bundle
70070000027040.intro: High-speed thrills, wild tricks, and nonstop fun!
70070000027040.description: Get ready for high-speed thrills and wild adventures! Jump into action with Kao The Kangaroo, a vibrant 3D platformer full of magic and mystery. Then, take your stunt skills to the next level with Urban Trial Playground and Urban Trial Tricky, where crazy tricks, flips, and combos rule the road. Speed, style, and fun await in this adrenaline-packed bundle!

70070000027042.name: The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027042.intro: A deluxe set containing The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- base game, digital art book, and digital soundtrack.
70070000027042.description:
Enroll in the Special Defense Unit today! The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- Digital Deluxe Edition includes the following content.

Base Game
Digital Art Book 
Digital Soundtrack

Takumi Sumino is a totally average teenager living in the Tokyo Residential Complex, a place where every day is much like the last and nothing bad ever happens. All that changes when freakish monsters attack the town and start wreaking havoc. A strange creature calling itself Sirei appears and offers Takumi the power to protect those he holds dear... All he has to do is stab himself in the chest!

The next thing he knows, Takumi is in Last Defense Academy, a colossal school in the middle of nowhere surrounded by a wall of otherworldly flames. He and 14 other students have been drafted into the Special Defense Unit, a team tasked with keeping the school safe for the next 100 days. Initiated students transform their blood into the mysterious Hemoanima, a unique type of mutated blood which provides supernatural abilities. How much are they willing to sacrifice to take back their normal lives and save the world from the grotesque school invaders? The curtain rises on 100 days of war and despair...

Extreme Despair-Filled Endings
Takumi's choices will decide his future, but there's no telling what kinds of consequences these decisions might have...

Defensive Battles
When the invaders attack, it's up to Takumi to protect the school in tactical RPG battles. Use each student's unique Specialist Skills to turn the tide of battle in his favor!

Free Time & Exploration
Spend time with Takumi’s teammates to deepen his bonds with them, or explore the wilderness and ruins outside the school. Players can even use the items found to craft gifts and get even closer to Takumi’s allies!

70070000027048.name: On Your Tail Deluxe Bundle
70070000027048.description:
Welcome to the perfect vacation getaway: Borgo Marina. Be warned, there’s mysteries around every corner in this Italian paradise. Befriend the locals, find clues, and play your cards right to uncover the town’s secrets in this story-driven adventure.


On Your Tail Original Soundtrack

Dive into the most unique timeless vacation with the On Your Tail Original Soundtrack!

Featuring 23 tracks composed by Pietro Milanesi, this collection brings 41 minutes of immersive music straight from the charming town of Borgo Marina. Includes the standout single "Ricominciare", performed by the talented Kimono.

Don't just play the game—experience it!


On Your Tail Digital Artbook

Uncover the secrets of Borgo Marina with the Official On Your Tail Artbook!

Dive into 244 pages of behind-the-scenes content, never-before-seen artwork, and a heartfelt foreword from the developers.

This vibrant journey takes you through the creation of On Your Tail, from its earliest concepts to the final designs. A must-have for fans and art enthusiasts alike!

70070000027049.name: Artifact Seeker and DLC1 Bundle
70070000027049.intro: Artifact Seeker + Artifact Seeker - DLC 1: The Legacy of Mortia
70070000027049.description:
Artifact Seeker: Resurrection is a 3D Roguelike Survivor RPG game. A game of gods, with Aurorium as the board, And all the mortals as their pawns and swords. You can obtain artifacts by slaying corrupted enemies, collecting gold to exchange it for artifacts at mysterious merchants. How to use the power of artifacts, to play the game of gods? to end the game of gods or to become a god yourself. Artifact Seeker, Your choice.

Mortia, once the glory of the dwarven kingdom, birthed countless legendary master craftsmen. However, the dwarves never knew when to stop digging. Deep within the mines of Mortia, they unearthed something that should not have been awakened. Thus, Mortia sank into an endless darkness, never to see the light of day again.
The new DLC for Artifact Seeker, “The Legacy of Mortia” is coming soon! New characters, new maps, new boss, new Synergy, new artifacts, new events, and many more new contents await everyone’s exploration!

70070000027082.name: Ecchi Oppai Fusion Edition
70070000027082.intro: Think you've got an eye for oppai?
70070000027082.description:
Even girls from other worlds need your help to find their hearts. Think fast and don't get distracted or you will lose them forever.

Choose from the pictures and help these girls find what they are looking for. If you're good enough, you'll even get a reward.

Features:
- More than 172 pictures of girls, including 42 new girls 
- Local multiplayer mode for you and your friends
- Simple and addictive gameplay

Can you find the way to their hearts?

70070000027085.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027085.intro: Battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals along the way.
70070000027085.description:
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Deluxe includes the main game plus the "Seasons of Love" Romance Scenarios, and the "Marvelous Swimsuits" and "Festive Attire & Dark Woolby" bundles.

■"Seasons of Love" Romance Scenarios
Love is blooming in Azuma! With the Seasons of Love DLC Pack, you can unlock the romance scenarios for Cuilang and Pilika. Explore compelling romance scenarios and forge deeper connections as these enigmatic characters open their hearts to you.

■ Festive Attire & Dark Woolby Bundle
Celebrate in style with this elegant Festive Attire for Subaru and Kaguya. With a striking dark color palette, this refined yet timeless look is perfect for any special occasion.

■Marvelous Swimsuit Bundle 
Because love is about enjoying life's little moments, this DLC also unlocks a ‘Marvelous Swimsuit’ for each marriage candidate, offering an alternative seaside style with bespoke designs for each character.

Choose from one of two protagonists whose destinies are intertwined by mysterious forces. Use sacred treasures to fight against the Blight’s many forms to restore the people, and even gods, to their natural glory. Take farming further, as you’ll manage more than a plot, rebuilding entire villages and cultivating new allies and resources along the way. Explore seasonal-themed villages heavily inspired by traditional Japanese culture, each with brand-new festivals and revamped fan-favorites, as well as charming romance candidates.

Key Features

■Bold New Abilities and Weapons
As an Earth Dancer, use the power of dance, sacred treasures, and fresh weapons like the Bow and Talisman to purify the land, your farms, and undo the Blight’s damage.

■It Takes a Village
Don’t just mind the farm—rebuild entire villages! Construct and place buildings, enticing people to return to the villages and contribute. Revive the gods to bring vitality and valuable resources back to the plagued lands.

■Your Fantasy Japanese Life
Experience beautiful Japanese-inspired character designs and aesthetics—from festivals to events to monsters. Explore Azuma’s natural landscapes and its seasonal-themed locales steeped in tradition.

■Classic Romance and Relationships
Choose between male and female protagonists, then befriend or romance any of the eligible candidates in fully voiced scenarios. Recruit these new friends to aid you in battle, too!

70070000027086.name: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027086.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar
70070000027086.description:
STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Deluxe includes the main game plus the "Trunk of Transformation" set. 

■Trunk of Transformation
Mix up your style with a customization collection that's sure to get townsfolk talking! 

Keep things cute with additional hairstyles, or go full-on adorable with alpaca and chick costumes.
Seeking something stealthy? This set includes ninja outfits, a ninja glider, and even ninja-themed bazaar customizations!

Additional hairstyles:
Braid & Flowers
Cat Ear Buns with Highlights
Short Perm
Side Part with Highlights

Animal costumes:
Chick Costume Sets
Alpaca Costume Sets

Ninja Set: 
Ninja Outfit
Ninja Glider
Ninja Bazaar Set


Bring the winds of change to Zephyr Town
Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar. Set up your stall to sell produce and goods from the crops and animals you raise on your farm, and meet charming townsfolk to befriend and romance as you help the close-knit community thrive.

Key Features

■Breathe the refreshing alpine air!
Begin your idyllic new life on a farm and enjoy the daily rhythms of rural living. Nurture a variety of crops and care for adorable animals in the picturesque mountainside settlement of Zephyr Town.

■Soar to Success in the Weekly Bazaar
Sell your farm's produce and goods at the lively weekly bazaar. Customize your stall and take charge of your sales to build buzz, power up profits and put Zephyr Town’s Grand Bazaar back on the map. 

■An Easy-Breezy New Life 
Harness the power of the wind! Catch a breeze to effortlessly drift across the town on your glider, and use windmills to gather those gusts to create new goodies to sell at the bazaar.

■Love is in the Air
Meet the cherished community of Zephyr Town with a colorful cast of characters, from friendly townsfolk to magical nature sprites. Find friendship, fall in love, and maybe even start a family with one of twelve charming individuals ready to share this new chapter with you.

70070000027087.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Village Collection
70070000027087.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000027087.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes three Personal Boards DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000027093.name: PRINCESS GAMES PACK: 7 in 1!
70070000027093.intro: Ultimate Girls’ Gaming Bundle – 7 Fun & Fabulous Games!
70070000027093.description:
Get ready for endless fun with this amazing bundle of 7 exciting games designed just for girls! From stylish fashion adventures to magical fairy tales and creative challenges, this collection has something for every young gamer.

What’s Inside?
Dress-up and makeover games for fashion lovers
Enchanting fantasy worlds filled with magic
Cute pet care and adventure games
Fun simulation and creativity challenges

Perfect for kids and teens who love creativity, storytelling, and stylish fun! Whether you enjoy designing, exploring, or solving puzzles, this bundle guarantees hours of entertainment.

Grab your bundle now and let the fun begin! 

Explore captivating worlds and themes, including:
Princess Bubble Story
Princess Puzzle Adventure
Fashion Princess
Fashion Girls
Fashion Friends
Animal Puzzle Cats
Animal Puzzle World

70070000027098.name: Music Box Retro Collection
70070000027098.intro: Start your musical fun and create a catchy beat with the Music Box!
70070000027098.description:
Music Box is a drum machine app in the form of a handheld, easy-to-use mixing board, allowing you to create a variety of percussion beats. Compose everything that is playing in your soul and feel like a real DJ!


FEEL THE BEAT
At your disposal there will be a panel with a 16-step sequencer, where you will program your drum beat step by step. Whether you have heavier rock sounds or melancholic jazz in your heart, Music Box will have something to suit you.


ALL THE DRUMS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Snare drums, toms, cymbals – mix and match percussion elements to create the perfect beat. Switch between different genres, experiment and test your musical ear. There are countless settings at your disposal!

Unlock new sounds from Dance, Electro Pop genres and mix them for creating rhythmic beats.

KEY FEATURES:
- 3 different genre sets: Rock, Jazz, Acoustic,
- Every set includes 8 different sounds - a whole drum kit!
- Play your beats in real time or…
- …arrange them with 16-step sequencer
- Mix sounds together and control the tempo

70070000027103.name: TRUCK / REAL CAR DRIVING / Offroad / Motorcycle / DEMOLISH DERBY BUNDLE
70070000027103.intro: Trucking, racing, off-roading and destruction – all in one package!
70070000027103.description:
Experience the ultimate driving and vehicle simulation with the Truck / Real Car Driving / Offroad / Motorcycle / Demolish Derby Bundle! This collection includes five thrilling games, each offering unique driving challenges, stunning environments, and realistic mechanics. Whether you’re delivering cargo, racing through city streets, conquering offroad terrain, riding high-speed motorcycles, or wrecking cars in demolition derbies, this bundle has it all!

	•	Real Truck Simulator USA Car Games - Driving Games, Parking Sim, Car Speed Racing 2022
Become an American truck driver and take on the challenge of transporting cargo across vast landscapes. Upgrade your truck, manage fuel, and navigate highways while following traffic rules. Experience realistic trucking with dynamic weather, day-night cycles, and a deep economic system.

	•	Real Car Driving Simulator & Parking 2022 Games
If you’re passionate about high-end cars, this game is for you! Drive luxury vehicles through expansive cities, test your driving skills, and explore diverse maps with challenging missions. With realistic driving physics, customizable cars, and high-speed thrills, this game is the perfect driving simulator experience.

	•	Ultimate 4x4 Offroad Trucks :Car Racing Driving Simulator 2022
Take on extreme offroad driving challenges with a variety of rugged vehicles. Navigate through deserts, snowy mountains, muddy roads, and forests. Experience dynamic weather, realistic vehicle physics, and full customization as you conquer the wildest terrains.

	•	Motorcycle Driving Simulator-Dirt & Parking 2022 Racing Games Ultimate 4x4 City Offroad Kart
Expand your motorcycle collection, customize your ride, and dominate the streets in multiple racing modes! Perform stunts, drift through traffic, and complete exciting missions. With realistic bike physics, turbocharged engines, and immersive city environments, this game is perfect for motorcycle enthusiasts.

	•	Demolish Derby Nitro-Battle Driving Car Games 2022 Deluxe Driver
Unleash destruction in this high-speed car crashing simulator! Choose from a variety of vehicles, complete insane stunts, and wreck everything in sight. With realistic crash physics, detailed damage models, and massive arenas, the thrill of destruction has never been more fun!

Why Choose This Bundle?
	•	Five unique driving experiences in one package
	•	Realistic physics, vehicle handling, and environments
	•	Open-world exploration, missions, and challenges
	•	Customization options for trucks, cars, motorcycles, and offroad vehicles
	•	Thrilling demolition derby with detailed car damage mechanics

Get behind the wheel and experience the ultimate driving bundle today!

70070000027108.name: Rail Route - Deluxe Edition
70070000027108.intro: Rail Route - Deluxe Edition: Includes the base game and soundtrack!
70070000027108.description:
Rail Route - Deluxe Edition will take your love for railway management to the next level!
This edition includes the base game and the mesmerizing official soundtrack with music player in-game! 

Rail Route - Base Game 
Start with a simple network and transform it into a sprawling, fully automated railway empire! Whether you’re planning efficient routes, upgrading infrastructure, or optimizing train schedules, every decision impacts the flow of your network.

The Official Soundtrack & Music Player
Immerse yourself in the atmospheric compositions of Rupert Cole, a soothing mix of neoclassical piano and string melodies designed to keep you calm amidst the controlled chaos of railway management.

70070000027110.name: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator Complete Edition
70070000027110.intro: Everything you need to build your Bookstore Empire – all in one edition!
70070000027110.description: Book Supermarket: Library Manager Simulator Complete Edition is the ultimate all-in-one package for aspiring bookstore moguls! This edition combines the main game with all DLCs, offering a complete experience where you can manage, expand, and customize your bookstore to perfection. Stock up on bestsellers, manage inventory, optimize storage, and attract a loyal customer base. With new products, licensing options, and strategies for growth, you’ll be able to create the bookstore of your dreams. Everything you need to succeed in the world of literature and retail is right here!

70070000027111.name: Gas Station Simulator, Airstrip DLC and Party Time DLC Bundle
70070000027111.intro: Buy an abandoned gas station and restore it to its full glory. Renovate, upgrade and expand upon the offered services to keep up with your clients demands.
70070000027111.description:
Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it to its former glory. Get rid of debris and broken furniture, fix up the walls, paint and decorate the place to your liking. Just don’t spend all your cash on the looks right away, you bought a gas station after all. Repair the equipment, buy what can’t be repaired and start serving your customers to earn money for further renovations and improvements.

Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

It is more story-driven than what we did in the past and it allows you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.
Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day 
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the 
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you 
in on his deals.

70070000027116.name: Brain Memory Classic Edition
70070000027116.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
70070000027116.description:
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize  challenges to one's taste. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

Let them become masters of their minds with Covers Pack, Figures Pack, Numbers Pack and Cards Pack 1 DLCs.

Key Features:
– Improves memory
– Adorable Cards
– Adjustable difficulty level
– Relaxing music
– 8 card designs
– 20 difficulty levels

70070000027126.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Praetor Edition
70070000027126.description:
This edition includes:
- Vagrus - The Riven Realms
- Vagrus - The Riven Realms Season Pass
- Vagrus - The Riven Realms Patronage Pack
- Vagrus - The Riven Realms Soundtrack

70070000027135.name: SUSHI Shot + More Toppings & Skins Pack Set
70070000027135.intro:
Aim your sushi and shoot!
Hit sushi of the same type to make them grow bigger and bigger!
70070000027135.description:
Combining two sushi of the same type will merge them into a new type of sushi!
Keep on matching your sushi so that they don't pile up and overflow onto the counter!
A new high score is always just within reach!

Share Joy-Con™ for up to 4 players to join in the fun!

"SUSHI Shot" and the "More Toppings & Skins Pack" are available as part of a downloadable content bundle!
Switch up your Sushi Set, background, and more anytime you like!

70070000027136.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Super Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027136.intro: Battle corrupted monsters, rebuild seasonal farms and villages, and form bonds with the colorful locals along the way.
70070000027136.description:
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Super Digital Deluxe includes the main game plus the "Season of Love" Romance Scenarios, and the "Marvelous Swimsuits" and "Festive Attire & Dark Woolby" bundles. It also includes a Digital Artbook and Soundtrack app.

■"Seasons of Love" Romance Scenarios
Love is blooming in Azuma! With the Seasons of Love DLC Pack, you can unlock the romance scenarios for Cuilang and Pilika. Explore compelling romance scenarios and forge deeper connections as these enigmatic characters open their hearts to you.

■ Festive Attire & Dark Woolby Bundle
Celebrate in style with this elegant Festive Attire for Subaru and Kaguya. With a striking dark color palette, this refined yet timeless look is perfect for any special occasion.

■Marvelous Swimsuit Bundle 
Because love is about enjoying life's little moments, this DLC also unlocks a ‘Marvelous Swimsuit’ for each marriage candidate, offering an alternative seaside style with bespoke designs for each character.

■Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma Digital Artbook and Soundtrack
A Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App featuring 134 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, monsters, and development materials. Enjoy all 56 music tracks from Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma at your leisure.

Please note: The Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App is a separate application from the main game. 


Choose from one of two protagonists whose destinies are intertwined by mysterious forces. Use sacred treasures to fight against the Blight’s many forms to restore the people, and even gods, to their natural glory. Take farming further, as you’ll manage more than a plot, rebuilding entire villages and cultivating new allies and resources along the way. Explore seasonal-themed villages heavily inspired by traditional Japanese culture, each with brand-new festivals and revamped fan-favorites, as well as charming romance candidates.

Key Features

■Bold New Abilities and Weapons
As an Earth Dancer, use the power of dance, sacred treasures, and fresh weapons like the Bow and Talisman to purify the land, your farms, and undo the Blight’s damage.

■It Takes a Village
Don’t just mind the farm—rebuild entire villages! Construct and place buildings, enticing people to return to the villages and contribute. Revive the gods to bring vitality and valuable resources back to the plagued lands.

■Your Fantasy Japanese Life
Experience beautiful Japanese-inspired character designs and aesthetics—from festivals to events to monsters. Explore Azuma’s natural landscapes and its seasonal-themed locales steeped in tradition.

■Classic Romance and Relationships
Choose between male and female protagonists, then befriend or romance any of the eligible candidates in fully voiced scenarios. Recruit these new friends to aid you in battle, too!

70070000027137.name: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Super Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027137.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar
70070000027137.description:
STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Super Digital Deluxe includes the main game, the "Trunk of Transformation" set and a Digital Art Book & Soundtrack app.

■Trunk of Transformation
Mix up your style with a customization collection that's sure to get townsfolk talking! 

Keep things cute with additional hairstyles, or go full-on adorable with alpaca and chick costumes.
Seeking something stealthy? This set includes ninja outfits, a ninja glider, and even ninja-themed bazaar customizations!

Additional hairstyles:
Braid & Flowers
Cat Ear Buns with Highlights
Short Perm
Side Part with Highlights

Animal costumes:
Chick Costume Sets
Alpaca Costume Sets

Ninja Set: 
Ninja Outfit
Ninja Glider
Ninja Bazaar Set

■STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Art Book & Soundtrack
A Digital Art Book & Soundtrack App featuring 115 pages of exclusive artwork, including illustrations of characters, animals, and development materials. Enjoy all 66 music tracks from STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar at your leisure.

Please note: The Digital Art Book and Soundtrack App is a separate application from the main game. 


Bring the winds of change to Zephyr Town
Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar. Set up your stall to sell produce and goods from the crops and animals you raise on your farm, and meet charming townsfolk to befriend and romance as you help the close-knit community thrive.

Key Features

■Breathe the refreshing alpine air!
Begin your idyllic new life on a farm and enjoy the daily rhythms of rural living. Nurture a variety of crops and care for adorable animals in the picturesque mountainside settlement of Zephyr Town.

■Soar to Success in the Weekly Bazaar
Sell your farm's produce and goods at the lively weekly bazaar. Customize your stall and take charge of your sales to build buzz, power up profits and put Zephyr Town’s Grand Bazaar back on the map. 

■An Easy-Breezy New Life 
Harness the power of the wind! Catch a breeze to effortlessly drift across the town on your glider, and use windmills to gather those gusts to create new goodies to sell at the bazaar.

■Love is in the Air
Meet the cherished community of Zephyr Town with a colorful cast of characters, from friendly townsfolk to magical nature sprites. Find friendship, fall in love, and maybe even start a family with one of twelve charming individuals ready to share this new chapter with you.

70070000027138.name: Battlefield Waltz Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027138.description:
Explore the world of Ortesia with the Battlefield Waltz Digital Deluxe Edition.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

- Digital Game
- Digital Art Book (33 pages)

70070000027143.name: nPool Snooker Collection
70070000027143.intro: A classic game of pool on your Nintendo Switch™ – play with a friend or hone your skills vs an AI opponent.
70070000027143.description:
Whether a champion or an amateur, all pool fans will find what they’re looking for in nPool. Whether it's 8ball, 9ball, or customizable tables – a champion will have what a champion needs.


A CLASSY CHALLENGE
nPool features single-player mode and friends mode, so you can choose to play versus AI or challenge your friends. With accurate rules, classy graphics, and transparent controls; winning is all you need to care about!


A FEAST FOR YOUR EYES AND YOUR SPIRIT
Customize the game’s background, pool table, and even the stick to make it a pleasurable experience for more than your competitive spirit.

Have even more fun by unlocking two Skins Packs DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Play vs a friend or vs AI
- Two base game modes – 8ball and 9ball
- Multiple customizable options for the background, table, and stick

70070000027148.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Celeste Music Pack
70070000027148.intro: Keep the musical combat flowing with the Celeste Music Pack, featuring four iconic tracks from the award-winning Lena Raine!
70070000027148.description:
- Confronting Myself
- Reach for the Summit
- Resurrections
- Scattered and Lost

Each Celeste Rhythm Rift comes with:
- A fully-bopping Madeline or Badeline character
- Celeste Background Visualizer with Strawberry Particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design.

To celebrate, we've also added a FREE bonus track to Rift of the NecroDancer:
- Resurrections (dannyBstyle Remix)

The Celeste Music Pack is brought to you by Maddy Makes Games Inc, and Extremely OK Games, Ltd.

70070000027173.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Epic Edition
70070000027173.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000027186.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Value Edition
70070000027186.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000027186.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #2 and Custom Cruisers #4 with:

-2 new skins for each Buggy

70070000027187.name: Snooker Fever Deluxe Edition
70070000027187.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000027187.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Expansion Pack #2 with:

10 new table designs and 5 sleek cue styles

70070000027193.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Crafty Collection
70070000027193.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000027193.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes four Personal Boards DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000027200.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Extended Edition
70070000027200.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000027200.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

70070000027209.name: Supermarket Owner Business: Business Boost Edition

Take your supermarket management skills to the next level with the Supermarket Owner Simulator Business: Business Boost Edition, featuring Supermarket Simulator: Business and the Cash Bonus DLC! Supermarket Simulator: Business
Step into the role of a supermarket manager and experience the challenges and rewards of running your own store. From designing the perfect layout to managing inventory and customer satisfaction, every decision shapes your business. Expand, compete, and master the retail world!

70070000027223.name: 2-in-1 Kart Racing Bundle
70070000027223.intro: Double the fun with this 2-in-1 Kart Racing Bundle!
70070000027223.description:
Double the fun with this 2-in-1 Kart Racing Bundle!

Renzo Racer

Renzo Racer is a fun, cartoon-style racing game that will put your driving skills to the test as you try to cross the finish line first!

Choose one of 16 fun drivers and race over 20 exciting and twisty tracks full of obstacles and surprises. Plow through destructible objects, jump off jump ramps, but watch out for scattered boulders, fallen trees, black ice and oil slicks!

Play individual tracks or compete in tournaments against AI cars or against your friends in local 4-player mode.

emoji Kart™ Racer

Get behind the wheel in the first official emoji™ video game with up to four players and race over 16 exciting race tracks. The unique emoji™ generator also gives you the opportunity to create your very own emoji™ racer from thousands of combinations.

Be inspired by the colorful tracks with great music, funny sound effects and of course countless emojis™. Great emoji™ power-ups like poop or rocket are also available to you! emoji Kart™ Racer – for the whole family!

70070000027228.name: Car Dealership Business Simulator DELUXE EDITION
70070000027228.intro: Drive your dealership to the Next Level!
70070000027228.description: Experience the ultimate car dealership journey with the Car Dealership Business Simulator: Deluxe Edition, which includes the Road to Success DLC! This all-in-one package gives you the tools to build a thriving dealership from the ground up. With the Road to Success DLC, you'll receive a cash boost to supercharge your business, allowing you to expand your showroom, stock exclusive cars, and attract more customers. Unlock advanced upgrades, manage your inventory like a pro, and negotiate the best deals for maximum profits. Whether you're upgrading your dealership or exploring new vehicles, this deluxe edition is your key to dominating the car market and driving your success to new heights!

70070000027229.name: Burger Chef Tycoon Upgrade Edition
70070000027229.description:
Like going out to town for a snack? Everybody does! 

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side? 
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats! 

Try to deliver the orders on time, but be careful not to mix them up! 

Upgrade your bar and beautify it and find ingredients of the best quality, so that you'll be able to create the best burger bar in town!

To work!

In BURGER CHEF TYCOON you will find:

* 60 achievements to complete
* 40 statistics to track and beat
* 60 awesome levels to complete
* Countless dishes to master and serve
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* Countless upgrades, decorations to make your bar the best!

This bundle includes base game and DLC#4 - Endless Mode with:

• endless gameplay mode

70070000027233.name: Mini Market Design Ultimate Edition
70070000027233.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000027233.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the Furniture Material Collection 1 and 2 DLCs, allowing you to add new colors to your furnitures.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000027243.name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4 - Standard Edition
70070000027243.intro: Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4.
70070000027243.description:
Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

- Reunite the crew with cross-platform online Multiplayer* for up to 8 skaters in new and returning game modes.
- Drop in to new parks or tear it up across the timeless parks from both Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 4, authentically remade in jaw dropping HD resolution with streamlined goals and the epic 2-minute format.
- Hit ‘em with some drip in the expanded Create-A-Skater and Create-A-Park modes, including the ability to create custom goals to share with friends for the first time ever.
- Shred harder than ever with more challenging goals and an enhanced New Game+ mode.
- Whether you’re a total casual or a grungy pro, the same smooth handling and simple-to-learn controls from Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2 will have you shredding like a Pro.

Alert the neighborhood watch and grab your skate buddies because the shred’s not dead. It’s back and better than ever.

70070000027256.name: Pool Fever Definitive Edition
70070000027256.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000027256.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game,  expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

10 new pool table designs
10 new pool cues designs

70070000027262.name: Go Kart Mania Super Edition
70070000027262.intro: Your Ticket to World Kart Racing!
70070000027262.description:
"Go Kart Mania" the ultimate kart racing game brings the thrill ride right to your Nintendo Switch™.

Race through 36 uniquely challenging tracks in iconic locations from Europe, China, and Australia, each offering a distinct racing experience. 

Customize your kart to outsmart competitors. 

Engage in heart-pounding competition across the world, or treat yourself to a quick solo race to become a karting legend.

"Go Kart Mania" is your ticket to a world of high-speed excitement and adventure. 

Don't miss out - start your engines for an unforgettable racing journey!

This bundle includes base game, Livery Pack #1 and Livery Pack #4 with:

-2 new skins for each Kart

70070000027265.name: Survival Zone: Craft, Build & Grow DELUXE EDITION
70070000027265.intro: All-in-One Survival Adventure – Build, Craft, and Thrive!
70070000027265.description: The Survival Zone: Craft, Build & Grow Deluxe Edition includes everything you need for the ultimate survival experience! This edition comes with the Beauty Ambient DLC for stunning landscapes and immersive environments, and the Ultimate Treasure DLC with a generous 1500 coins to boost your progress. Build your village, craft essential tools, and defend against threats while enjoying breathtaking visuals and unlocking valuable treasures. With everything included, your adventure in the wild has never been more exciting or rewarding!

70070000027267.name: Piano: Learn and Play Road To Mastery Edition
70070000027267.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000027267.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes five Song Packs DLCs.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000027269.name: Candivity: Space Edition
70070000027269.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
70070000027269.description:
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

NEW VERSUS MODE!
Race to merge the biggest candy while using clever tactics to slow down your opponent. Unleash tricky power-ups, and prove who’s the ultimate candy master!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Features:
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode for you and your friend!
- Versus mode to sabotage your friends!
- 2 standard maps and a new Outer Space map!
- New alien characters and otherwordly accessories
- Fully customizable name and character
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
- An adorably sweet aesthetic

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000027275.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000027275.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats and Art DLCs included in this bundle.

- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000027276.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru Edition
70070000027276.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000027276.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS A LEGENDARY BOXER
Receive the legendary Masaru with his unique equipment and a bonus of 21500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000027282.name: AAA Clock Minimalistic Beginnings
70070000027282.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000027282.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with 8 classic and Minimalistic Stars DLCs.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000027284.name: Adventures In Time & Space
70070000027284.intro: ~ Escape from the Pharaoh's Tomb + Pirates on Target + Xatrom Command ~
70070000027284.description:
Escape from the Pharaoh's Tomb:

After an unlucky adventurer encounters a cursed skull while exploring the remote deserts of Egypt, he suddenly falls into the clutches of the mysterious Pharaoh’s tomb.

Escaping from each challenging room involves solving a puzzle where you’ll aim a magic beam of light to open a magical locked door. You’ll have to contend with dangerous enemies, avoid outlandish traps, and even out-maneuver the chamber walls closing in.

Help our hero make it through each perilous puzzle, or be lost until eternity.

Features
* Puzzle platforming gameplay
* Ancient Egypt adventure setting
* Numerous puzzles, traps, and enemies
* Comic book-inspired art


Pirates on Target:

Use your geometric and logic skills to fire cannons at pirate ships and sink them to the bottom of the sea.

In each level you’ll need to move the blocks strategically and change the trajectory of the cannonballs until they reach the target.

The concept is simple yet challenging, and the difficulty gradually increases over dozens of levels. 


Features:
* 60 levels with increasing difficulty
* Pirate ship combat theme
* Variety of obstacles and blocks
* Simple controls including a virtual cursor option


Xatrom Command:

A top-secret government laboratory experiment went wrong, and now invading aliens have infested the military base.

Time to clean things up! Grab your weapon, recruit a friend, and start blasting wave after wave of alien scum into oblivion. Obtain more powerful weapons, battle against enemies of all sizes, clear each room, and eliminate the thread to the facility.

Play a single player or co-op multiplayer campaign, and have a blast. 


Features:
* 50 levels that can be played solo or with local co-op
* Survival mode and boss rush mode
* Top-down shooter gameplay
* Multiple weapons and enemies
* Multiple difficulty settings

70070000027294.name: Freaky Trip Save the Cockapoo Edition
70070000027294.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000027294.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

Explore even more with Salcy due to the Summer, Winter, Fall, Spring, Garden, Camp and Hobby Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000027296.name: Fashion World Definitive Edition
70070000027296.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000027296.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!
- Create stunning looks with countless combinations of costumes, accessories, and scenic backdrops!
- Capture your creations in Photo Mode!
- Strive for perfection with the three-star rating system, boosting your game's replay value.
- Designed for fashion lovers of all ages!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2 (Street Style), expansion pack #3 (New Wave) and expansion pack #4 (Retro Fits)with:

- 60 all-new levels of puzzles

70070000027301.name: Cooking Extended Edition
70070000027301.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000027301.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

Decorate your restaurant with an amazing Green Dragon Set, Animal Set and Japanese Set included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out 
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000027308.name: Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp: The Skybox Edition
70070000027308.intro: Take the thrill to new heights with Truckzilla and the new skybox!
70070000027308.description:
Unleash the Ultimate Thrill with the  Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp: The Skybox Edition
Jump into the heart-pounding action of Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp and elevate your gameplay with the Skybox Upgrade DLC. Conquer massive ramps, collect magical crystals, and customize your truck, all while racing under stunning new skies.

Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp:
• Thrilling Action: Speed through ramps and obstacles.
• Magical Crystals: Collect crystals for powerful bonuses.
• Custom Skins: Unlock and upgrade unique truck skins.
• Special Missions: Complete challenges for exciting rewards.

New Skybox Upgrade DLC:
• Enhanced Visuals: Enjoy dynamic, high-quality new skyboxes that bring a fresh atmosphere to every ramp and stunt.

Upgrade your world and dominate the ramps like never before!

70070000027313.name: nGolf Hole in One! Edition
70070000027313.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000027313.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Unlock new levels with Moon Swing and Western Fairways DLCs and also change the appearance with Colorful Golf Balls 1, 2 and 3DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000027317.name: Vege Bubble Shoot Prime Edition
70070000027317.intro: Pop, Match, Harvest! Dive into a vibrant veggieventure!
70070000027317.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Vege Bubble Shot, a colourful and addictive puzzle game that will captivate your gaming senses. Dive into a fruity adventure where you'll use your strategic skills to save a delightful vegetable garden from pesky intruders and become a puzzle master!

Key Features:

    Vivid Vegetable Vistas: Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world brimming with hand-crafted, vibrant vegetables. Explore lush garden settings and interact with charming characters.

    Challenging Puzzles: Put your aim and matching skills to the test with a variety of engaging puzzles. Can you clear the garden of intruders with your accurate shots?

    Power-Ups and Boosters: Utilize an array of powerful boosters and unique power-ups to enhance your gameplay. Create spectacular chain reactions to tackle the intruders with flair.

    Endless Fun: Vege Bubble Shot offers hundreds of levels, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment for both short and extended gaming sessions.

    Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: The game is designed for players of all skill levels, with straightforward mechanics for beginners and depth for those seeking a greater challenge.

Multiplayer included! Vege Bubble Shot is the perfect game for both casual players and competitive gamers. Aim, shoot, and match your way through the captivating vegetable garden, and bring back harmony one bubble at a time. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this addictive and colourful adventure!

This bundle includes base game and Harvest Havoc #3 with:

- 20 all-new levels

70070000027319.name: Maki: Paw of Fury Extended Edition
70070000027319.intro: Beat ‘em up and Retro Arcade game enjoyers – welcome to the world of Pangea!
70070000027319.description:
When a friend gets captured, Maki comes to her rescue! Fight your way through five diverse locations with funky fresh minigames, and conquer the dangerous opponents that stand in your way!


FEEL THE 90S IN AN ANIMAL STYLE — Maki: Paw of Fury’s combat elements are inspired by the hit beat ‘em up arcade games from the 90s, while the story of Maki takes place in the original world of Pangea. Animals rule here, and they’re passionate about sports, technology, and lifelong friendships. Speaking of, one is about to be on the brink of breaking!


A FRIEND IN NEED, A FIGHT INDEED — Maki gets a pleading call for help and realizes that his dear friend - Mapu - has betrayed him. Here starts the road of Maki: The Paw of Fury! He might look adorable, but don’t mistake his fox cuteness for weakness - he has studied the martial art of Tsume no Ken and can wield a tuna like a professional.


MAKI ISN’T ALONE — You can choose to play Maki the fox, but you can also choose Tincho, the muscular capybara, and Maka, the colorful otter who will show your enemies the power of music. Each of these characters is unique when it comes to looks, strength, and fighting style!

Unlock Maki Aviator, Tincho Nerd and Tincho Karateka skins, included in this bundle.

VIBE WITH THE MUSIC AND THE WONDERFUL WORLD OF PANGEA — While all the fighting’s going on it’s hard to appreciate the visuals. But if you stand down just for a moment you’ll be able to appreciate the stunning views of Pangea’s world! You’’ travel through dark ninja forests, icy planes, and desert dunes in the tune of energetic and fighting-ready tracks.

70070000027326.name: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Deluxe Edition
70070000027326.intro:
Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds!
Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold...
70070000027326.description:
Please note this is the Deluxe Edition. Be aware there is also a Standard Edition available, so please ensure your selection before purchasing.
 
Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds!
Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold...

Single Player: Story Mode
Play as Tanjiro and relive the Entertainment District Arc, the Swordsmith Village Arc, and the Hashira Training Arc from the TV anime, Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba!
Battle Upper Rank demons with your allies!

VS Mode: The Hashira unite!
The game features over 40 characters, including the nine Hashira, the highest-ranking swordsmen of the Demon Slayer Corps!
New elements, such as Dual Ultimates and Gear, have been added!
Take on new challenges both online and offline!

Deluxe Edition Content:
- Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Main Game
- Character Unlock Keys: Tengen Uzui, Obanai Iguro, Sanemi Shinazugawa, and Gyomei Himejima
- Battle Attire: Tanjiro's Kimono (Entertainment District), Inosuke's Kimono (Entertainment District), and Uzui's Shinobi Attire
- VS Mode System Voice: Upper Rank Demons Set (Akaza, Daki, Gyutaro, Gyokko, Zohakuten)
- Character Unlock Key: Academy Rengoku and Academy Uzui

◎Bonus for linking save data
The following bonuses will be available for players with save data from Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles or Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- Sweep The Board!
- Bonus for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles save data:
Character Unlock Keys: Academy Tanjiro, Academy Nezuko, Academy Zenitsu, Academy Inosuke,  Academy Giyu, Academy Shinobu
- Bonus for Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- Sweep The Board! save data:
Character Unlock Key: Hinatsuru, Makio and Suma
Battle Attire: Hinatsuru, Makio and Suma Kimono (Meal Prep)

*Character Unlock Keys are bonuses that allow you to play the specified character in VS Mode at the very start.
*Battle Attire can be used in VS Mode.
*VS Mode System Voices can only be set in VS Mode settings. (Ex: "Fight!", "That's enough!")
*Bonuses for linking save data are only applicable for games on the same platform.
*Online play in VS Mode requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership (paid).
*The latest patch must be installed in order to use online features.
*Contents and specifications are subject to change without notice.
*The digital version bonuses are permanent.
*Bonuses may be distributed at a later date.

70070000027327.name: Artifact Escape Room Bundle
70070000027327.intro: Play an epic escape room trilogy where puzzles, mystery, and adventure collide in the search for an ancient artifact.
70070000027327.description:
This bundle includes three escape room adventure games:

+ ART HEIST - Escape Room Adventure
+ VENARI - Escape Room Adventure
+ DEDALO - Escape Room Adventure

ART HEIST - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
A stormy night, a secluded villa. An artwork has been stolen during a heist. Use your puzzle solving skills to track down the painting.

VENARI - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Embark on an escape room adventure to an ancient, mysterious island where your puzzle skills will be put to the test as you try to uncover a secret artifact.

DEDALO - ESCAPE ROOM ADVENTURE
Uncover the secrets of a frozen world. Explore ancient Arctic ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the power of a lost artifact. 

Will you unravel the mystery and conquer the ultimate escape room trilogy?

70070000027355.name: Party Miracle Pack + Party Wonder Pack + Party Smile Pack
70070000027355.intro: Power up Party Party Time 3 with 30 additional minigames!
70070000027355.description:
The miracles and wonders of the party are sure to make you smile!
The Party Miracle Pack, Party Wonder Pack, and Party Smile Pack are now available together as a downloadable content bundle!

70070000027358.name: Party Party Time 3 + Great Pack Set
70070000027358.intro:
It's time for a new and improved party time!
Compete or cooperate—there's no limit on the fun when everyone's together!
70070000027358.description:
Get ready for an all-new sequel to the party game that anyone can enjoy!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 6 players can join in the fun!

Enjoy a large collection of intuitive and easy-to-play minigames!
Spend quality time with friends and family and have a blast!

Party Party Time 3, the Party Miracle Pack, the Party Wonder Pack, and the Party Smile Pack are available together as part of a special set!
Let's party, everybody!

70070000027370.name: Peachy Derby - Deluxe Edition
70070000027370.intro: 60FPS racing game where the girl Natsuki is forced to join the "Ninja Racing Tournament" to pay off her debt. 10 girls,100 dances anims, 600 voices, 16 chapters.
70070000027370.description:
Peachy Derby+All 7 DLC

[Peachy Girl's Adventure]
Experience the story of girl Natsuki joining the ""Ninja Racing Tournament"" with her friends to pay off her debt. A total of 16 chapters. 

[Humanoid Kart Racing]
Choose a girl and reach the finish line before the others.Use ninja tools to attack enemies.

[Let the Girls Dance]
In addition to racing, choose dances, outfits, and Japanese voice lines for the girls.

70070000027371.name: Monument Valley 1&2 Bundle
70070000027371.intro: Experience the magic of Monument Valley and Monument Valley 2 in one complete bundle.
70070000027371.description:
Step into a world of stunning architecture, impossible geometry, and meditative puzzle-solving. Guide Ida and Ro through surreal landscapes, manipulating monuments to uncover hidden paths and solve intricate illusions.

With every chapter and DLC included, Monument Valley 1 & 2 Bundle is the definitive way to experience these award-winning games, now beautifully reimagined for new platforms.

70070000027372.name: Monument Valley: The Collection
70070000027372.intro: Experience the complete, award-winning Monument Valley series in one digital bundle.
70070000027372.description:
Begin with Ida’s search for forgiveness through impossible monuments in Monument Valley.
Continue with Ro and her child as they explore shifting architecture and the quiet bond of motherhood in Monument Valley 2.
Conclude with Monument Valley 3, where Noor sails through fading worlds in a journey to restore the light.

This is the first time all three games have been brought together – a chance to experience the full trilogy in one carefully crafted collection.

Monument Valley: The Collection offers hours of calming puzzles, evocative visuals, and immersive soundscapes that have resonated with millions. Whether you’re returning to these games or discovering them for the first time, Monument Valley: The Collection is the definitive way to step into a world of impossible beauty.

70070000027373.name: GUNDAM BREAKER 4 - Builder and Power-Up Set
70070000027373.description:
The Builder and Power-Up Set includes the following content:
• Builders' Vault Bundle
- Additional Builders Parts/Emblems
- Additional Diorama Items (Diorama Base, Diorama Objects, Diorama Gunpla)
- Enhance Items
Parts Enhance I x 200
Parts Enhance II x 200
Parts Enhance III x 200
- Evolve Items
Parts Evolve I x 200
Parts Evolve II x 200
• Power-up Booster Bundle
- Enhance Items
Parts Enhance IV x 200
Parts Enhance V x 200
Parts Enhance VI x 200
- Evolve Items
Parts Evolve III x 200
Parts Evolve IV x 200

*Individual DLCs can be purchased as standalone products. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Items in excess of the maximum number allowed will be discarded.

70070000027374.name: BEAST + FRAG | The Complete Shooter Collection
70070000027374.intro: UNLEASH THE ULTIMATE SHOOTER EXPERIENCE WITH BEAST & FRAG IN ONE EPIC BUNDLE!
70070000027374.description:
Get the complete Oh BiBi experience on Nintendo Switch with this exclusive bundle featuring FRAG Pro Shooter and BEAST: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team !

Two explosive shooters come together in one must-have bundle. Whether you are dueling in FRAG or teaming up in BEAST, this collection is the ultimate test of skill, strategy, and teamwork. Get ready to shoot, switch, and dominate.

- FRAG Pro Shooter is the hit hero shooter on Switch, delivering fast-paced 1v1 duels. Build your Battle Deck with over 100 heroes, switch between them instantly, and dominate the fight with first-person or third-person controls.

- BEAST: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team is Oh BiBi’s latest release, offering intense 3v3 battles with a unique dual gameplay system. Swap between your powerful MECHA and agile PET, master a diverse roster of heroes, and dive into an epic story mode.

70070000027389.name: Musical Vibes RX (2 included songs) + 6 additional songs
70070000027389.intro: You can enjoy Musical Vibes RX (2 included songs) + 6 additional songs for a low price!
70070000027389.description:
This bundle includes Musical Vibes RX (2 included songs) + 6 additional songs. When you buy this bundle you get 8 songs for the price of 6! The included songs are:
Narae Solis - Platinum Dreams
SIZZLA feat. TURBULENCE - Champion Sound (remix)
Cipher Blaze feat. Lila Brooks - Victory Lap
Lina Riko - Noche de Brillo
Nina Ray - Embrace Your Light
FIVEEBEATZ - Party
Elara Mae - Queen's Twilight
Lyra Rin - Lost and Found

70070000027390.name: Bundle of 6 songs
70070000027390.intro: You can enjoy 6 songs for a low price!
70070000027390.description:
This bundle includes 6 additional songs. When you buy this bundle you get 6 songs for the price of 5! The included tracks are:
Cipher Blaze feat Lila Brooks - Victory Lap
Lina Riko - Noche de Brillo
Nina Ray - Embrace your light
FIVEEBEATZ - Party
Elara Mae - Queen's Twilight
Lyra Rin  - Lost and Found

70070000027391.name: HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT Deluxe Edition
70070000027391.intro: The first full-scale HUNTER×HUNTER fighting game is here!!
70070000027391.description:
The first full-scale HUNTER×HUNTER fighting game is here!

■3v3 Nen ability team battle
Create teams of characters to face off in 3-on-3 battles.
Find a combination with synergy, and aim for the top with your own unique team!

■Rush combo
Just hold down the rush button and hit the button repeatedly to unleash powerful combos!
Feel the exhilarating rush of pulling off a combo with ease!

■Online battle
Face off against other players across the network to win rank points.
Your rank updates as you accumulate points. Aim to become a “three-star hunter”!
You can even compete with "G.I. Cards" at stake! Gather the cards for the specified slots!

■Story mode
Battle against CPU opponents as you enjoy a digest of beloved Hunter x Hunter moments!
This mode includes tutorial stages, so try it out first to understand the basics of how to play!


HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT Deluxe Edition Set Includes:
・HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT Full Game
・Season Pass 1
　┗2 additional characters (Neferpitou, Character 2, Character 3, Character 4)
　┗Character alternate costume (Chrollo)

Season Pass 1 Release Schedule:
・Additional DLC Character Neferpitou (Fall 2025)
・Additional DLC Character 2 (Winter 2025)
・Additional DLC Character 3 (Spring 2026)
・Additional DLC Character 4 (Summer 2026)
*Additional content will be released over time.
*Please refer to the official web site for details regarding the product and release schedule.

70070000027392.name: HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT Season Pass 1
70070000027392.description:
This Season Pass includes 4 playable characters and 1 alternate character costume for HUNTER×HUNTER NEN×IMPACT together in a discounted bundle.

*Some items included in Season Pass 1 are available for purchase individually. Be careful to avoid duplicate purchases.

Season Pass 1 includes:

　┗2 additional characters (Neferpitou, Character 2, Character 3, Character 4)

*Additional content will be released over time.

70070000027399.name: West Escape: Rancher Edition
70070000027399.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000027399.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

Features:
- Premium Equipment: Equip Silver Nail for extra tool damage!
- Rare Gear and more: Obtain rare and uncommon Rancher equipment to boost your power level!
- Bonus currency: Additional 500 gems for faster progress!
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes—dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load—freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70070000027402.name: Bus Simulator 2023: City Driver – Cruize Bus Edition
70070000027402.intro: Explore the city like never before – with the best buses in town!
70070000027402.description:
Take your city driving adventure to the next level with the Bus Simulator 2023: City Driver – Cruize Bus Edition! This collection combines the excitement of managing your own bus fleet  and performance of the exclusive Cruize Bus.

Explore a vibrant, open-world map as a skilled bus driver, picking up passengers, completing routes, and unlocking 17 unique buses. With realistic controls and high-quality graphics, every drive feels like an authentic experience.

Plus, with the Cruize Bus DLC, you’ll unlock the state-of-the-art Bus, designed for ultimate comfort and efficiency .
Whether you’re cruising the city streets in style or building the ultimate bus empire, this bundle offers everything you need to drive your success forward!

70070000027405.name: Skyline Bowling: Strike Edition
70070000027405.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000027405.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views.
