Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 3 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Balls - Equip 3 new bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 4K gems to buy and upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000027407.name: Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul Edition
70070000027407.description: New to The Fog? Check out Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul Edition, which includes the base game, the Tokyo Ghoul Chapter, and 2 Tokyo Ghoul Outfits: Awakened Ghoul for The Ghoul, and Rabbit Costume for Yui Kimura. Also included are the Curtain Call Chapter, Shattered Bloodline Chapter , and the Cursed Legacy Chapter.

70070000027410.name: Year 4 Season Pass!
70070000027410.intro: This is your pass to 6 exciting new worlds to complete in hexceed! With 700+ levels to complete!
70070000027410.description:
This pass unlocks all the DLC that we will release during hexceed's fourth year! We will be releasing a new DLC every 2 months, each containing a new world to complete. 6 new worlds to explore! Over 700 levels to complete!

Although each DLC will be available for purchase individually, this year 4 pass lets you buy them all at once and for a discount!
Here is a breakdown of the DLCs included:
1 - Rubrum (Apr 2025)
2 - Flavum (Jun 2025)
3 - Viridis (Aug 2025)
4 - Caeruleum (Oct 2025)
5 - Fuscus (Dec 2025)
6 - Violaceum (Feb 2026)

70070000027412.name: Border Police: Contraband & Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator
70070000027412.intro: Two worlds, two challenges - only the strongest prevail!
70070000027412.description:
Survival & Law Enforcement Bundle – Conquer the Past, Protect the Present!
Experience the ultimate test of survival and strategy with this thrilling bundle, combining prehistoric adventure with high-stakes law enforcement! Whether you’re battling for dominance in a world ruled by dinosaurs or standing against smugglers in a tense border patrol operation, every choice you make will determine your fate.

	•	Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor:
Step back in time and experience life as a dinosaur in a vast, untamed world. Explore breathtaking biomes, from lush jungles to volcanic wastelands, each filled with danger and discovery. Hunt, evolve, and fight for survival in a game that blends RPG mechanics with immersive prehistoric realism. Customize your dinosaur, complete thrilling missions, and prove your dominance in the land of giants.

	•	Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024:
Trade prehistoric survival for modern-day law enforcement as you step into the role of a border patrol officer. Inspect vehicles, interrogate suspicious travelers, and use high-tech tools to uncover hidden contraband. Engage in intense chases, make tough moral choices, and experience the unpredictable world of smuggling, corruption, and high-risk law enforcement. Every decision you make will shape the outcome of your career and the security of the border.

	•	Survive and evolve in the prehistoric world!
	•	Uphold the law and protect the border!
	•	Two intense, action-packed experiences in one bundle!

Are you ready to face the ultimate survival challenge and test your instincts in two completely different yet equally thrilling worlds?

70070000027413.name: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027413.description:
A bundle including the main game, as well as the "All in Abyss: Judge the Fake OFFICIAL DESIGN WORKS AND MUSIC PLAYER."

The "All in Abyss: Judge the Fake OFFICIAL DESIGN WORKS AND MUSIC PLAYER" is an application for the Nintendo Switch™. The content can be viewed by launching the application.

70070000027414.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.12
70070000027414.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the twelfth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000027420.name: Wash Simulator - Clean Garage, House, Cars Business Tycoons: Ultimate Cleaning Expansion
70070000027420.intro: Upgrade, clean, and dominate the washing business!
70070000027420.description:
Step into the world of professional cleaning and build your own business empire! Start from a small garage and grow into a top-tier cleaning tycoon by managing time, upgrading equipment, and satisfying customers with spotless results.
This bundle combines the full Wash Simulator experience with the exclusive New Tools & Comfort DLC, introducing essential tools, new features, and a cozy touch to enhance your cleaning empire.

What’s Included in This Pack?
Wash Simulator – Become the Ultimate Cleaning Tycoon!
	•	Build your washing empire from a small garage to a thriving business.
	•	Master time management to maximize earnings and satisfy customers.
	•	Invest in cutting-edge equipment and expand your workspace.
	•	New Tools & Comfort DLC - Fire Extinguisher, Sofa, Motor Table.

Upgrade your facility, optimize your operations, and take your cleaning business to the next level today!

70070000027425.name: Songs for a Hero + Shieldmaiden Bundle
70070000027425.intro: Get the full Dumativa Game Studio Switch Catalog!
70070000027425.description:
Two adventures in one single bundle!

Find a classic platformer with a twist in SONGS FOR A HERO: a dynamic soundtrack and funny lyrics that sings the player's actions and responds to what is happening during the adventure.

In SHIELDMAIDEN, the end of the world just started and everyone is gone. The machines took over and your only goal is to look for your missing sister in a retro wave atmosphere. Fight and find your way into the danger with your shield in this vibrant pixel art world.

70070000027448.name: Breakfast Bar Tycoon Upgrade Edition
70070000027448.intro:
It's almost time for breakfast!
Go and prove that your breakfast bar deserves its fame!
70070000027448.description:
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen? 

In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task! 

You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.

Take orders, prepare dishes and fight for tips! 

Invest your earnings into upgrading your restaurant and become a breakfast magnate!

Bon appetite!

This bundle includes base game, Endless Mode with:

• endless gameplay mode

70070000027449.name: Pixel Cafe Deluxe Edition
70070000027449.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000027449.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipement, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game and Bedroom Touches (DLC #2) with:

A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
A new style for the Radio Nightstand
Plus, enjoy two additional wallpapers for a little change in scenery.

70070000027453.name: Attack Hole: Complete Edition
70070000027453.intro: Swallow everything and become the biggest black hole!
70070000027453.description:
Eat whatever is in your path! Move fast, absorb everything in sight, and grow BIGGER! Grab as many weapons as you can before time runs out, then blast away your final target. The bigger your hole, the more powerful you become!

Features:
- 4 premium skins with powerful abilities!
- 30 extra power-ups to eat more and faster!
- 500 additional gems for buying skins and power-ups!
- Exciting levels packed with stuff to gobble up
- Animated skins to make your black hole look awesome
- Crazy power-ups to help you grow even faster
- Challenge mode where you consume a whole town
- Epic battles against huge bosses
- Easy controls so anyone can play
- Simple rules and tons of fun!

Pick a cool skin, zoom through fun levels, and see if you can swallow it all before the clock hits zero!

Ready, set, SWALLOW! How much can you eat before time runs out?

70070000027455.name: CAR GAMES BUNDLE & SIMULATOR - CAR PARKING, OFFROAD CAR, OFFROAD TRUCK, CAR RACING, TAXI
70070000027455.intro: Race, park, drift, and explore – the complete driving simulator experience!
70070000027455.description:
Get ready for the ultimate driving experience with CAR GAMES BUNDLE & SIMULATOR. This exclusive collection brings together six thrilling car games, each designed to test your skills in different driving scenarios. Whether you’re racing at high speeds, navigating rugged off-road terrain, mastering precision parking, or drifting through a lively city as a taxi driver, this bundle has something for every car enthusiast.

Games Included in the Bundle:
  1. Need for Drive - Car Racing - Experience high-speed racing in multiple game modes, including drag, sprint, time trial, and circuit racing.
  2. Car Parking Simulator 2024 - Test your precision parking skills in various environments, from tight urban lots to multi-story garages.
  3. 4x4 Offroad Car Exploration - Conquer rugged terrains, explore treacherous landscapes, and unlock powerful off-road vehicles.
  4. Drift Taxi Simulator - Take on the role of a drift taxi driver, completing extreme driving challenges and earning rewards.
  5. Offroad Truck 4X4 Dirt Simulator: Rally Racing Game - Drive powerful trucks through deserts and forests, overcoming harsh obstacles and difficult terrain.
  6. Car Parking Madness School Drive Mechanic Car Games Simulator 2023 - Improve your parking skill and ride on different cars from ordinary to supercars.

Key Features:
	•	Diverse Modes: Racing, parking, off-road, and drift taxi driving.
	•	Realistic Mechanics: Unique physics and controls for each game.
	•	Varied Environments: Urban streets, off-road trails, deserts, and parking lots.
	•	Vehicle Variety: Sports cars, trucks, SUVs, and taxis with customization.
	•	Engaging Challenges: Drag races, off-road missions, drifting, and parking tests.

Buckle up for six adrenaline-fueled driving experiences!

70070000027459.name: Stacky Dash: Action Edition
70070000027459.intro: Dash your hero across the mazes, stack the tiles higher and higher, and reach for the skies!
70070000027459.description:
Get ready for non-stop fun in Stacky Dash! Slide to collect tiles, build paths, and race through colorful levels full of exciting surprises. Dodge blasting cannons, and zip through portals as you conquer each tricky stage!

Features:
• Premium skins - Play with 5 new epic skins!
• Unique tiles - Choose from 7 new tiles!
• Extra resources - Get 2500 coins, 500 gems and 15 keys!
• Exciting Levels - Tons of fun puzzles that get trickier as you go!
• Crazy Challenges - Dodge cannon fire, zoom through portals, and avoid traps.
• Animal Rescue - Find cute animals and grow your zoo!
• Timed Mode - Race the clock for an extra challenge and rewards!
• Customization - Unlock awesome skins for your character and tiles.

Save adorable animals to grow your own zoo and take on timed challenges to test your speed. With tons of cool skins to unlock, every level is packed with energy and fun!

Solve your way through endless puzzles in Stacky Dash!

70070000027464.name: Music Box DJ Collection
70070000027464.intro: Start your musical fun and create a catchy beat with the Music Box!
70070000027464.description:
Music Box is a drum machine app in the form of a handheld, easy-to-use mixing board, allowing you to create a variety of percussion beats. Compose everything that is playing in your soul and feel like a real DJ!


FEEL THE BEAT
At your disposal there will be a panel with a 16-step sequencer, where you will program your drum beat step by step. Whether you have heavier rock sounds or melancholic jazz in your heart, Music Box will have something to suit you.


ALL THE DRUMS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Snare drums, toms, cymbals – mix and match percussion elements to create the perfect beat. Switch between different genres, experiment and test your musical ear. There are countless settings at your disposal!

Unlock new sounds from Dance, Electro Pop, Ethnic genres and mix them for creating rhythmic beats.

KEY FEATURES:
- 3 different genre sets: Rock, Jazz, Acoustic,
- Every set includes 8 different sounds - a whole drum kit!
- Play your beats in real time or…
- …arrange them with 16-step sequencer
- Mix sounds together and control the tempo

70070000027474.name: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance Digital Deluxe Upgrade
70070000027474.description:
Purchase the SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance Digital Deluxe Upgrade and receive the Starter Pack, Digital Art Book & Soundtrack, and SEGA Villains Stage, featuring Dr. Eggman and two additional bosses based on iconic SEGA villains.
 
It includes:
• Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
o Starter Pack: the Ghost Outfit, the Medic Lite Amulet, and 2000 Gold
o SEGA Villains Stage (Coming Early 2026)
o Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
*Gold is collected during gameplay and cannot be purchased separately.

The iconic SHINOBI returns in an all-new 2D action platformer with a unique hand-drawn look created by the team behind the hit brawler Streets of Rage 4.   

Play as the legendary Shinobi Joe Musashi, master of the ninja arts. After finding your village burned to the ground and your clan turned into stone, you must set off on a quest for vengeance, ready to face an unparalleled evil and avenge your clan.  

• EXECUTE THE NINJA ARTS WITH PRECISION 
Wield your vast ninja arsenal including the great Katana Oborozuki, Kunai, Ninjutsu arts, and Ninpo to vanquish your foes.  

• MASTER THE WAY OF THE SHINOBI 
Unleash limitless combos with unique combat moves, acquire Amulets for enhanced abilities, and discover Ningi tools to overcome obstacles and uncover new paths. 

• JOURNEY THROUGH A STYLISTIC NEW WORLD 
Venture through more than a dozen unique and visually striking stages, from military bases to a scorching desert, challenging platforming puzzles, and hidden secrets.

70070000027475.name: Shadow Labyrinth Deluxe Edition
70070000027475.description:
Pre-order now and get the following content:
- Original Arcade SFX DLC

Change the in-game sounds for MINI-PUCK mode to the original PAC-MAN sound effects.

*You can change this setting from the Options menu.
*The bonus may be given at a later date.

Deluxe Edition Includes:
• Shadow Labyrinth
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack

Shadow Labyrinth is a 2D action platformer and a genre-twisting alternate take on the iconic Pac-Man.

As Swordsman No. 8, awoken by a floating yellow orb, PUCK, on a mysterious planet where relics from past wars remain, you are chosen to become the instrument of its will. To survive you will discover many secrets, start preying on your enemies, and become the apex predator as you embrace your true purpose.

Discover a World of Secrets
Search the remnants of an age-old intergalactic conflict, started long before your arrival, and discover new powers and abilities. Use them to traverse an alien world as you battle dangerous creatures and evolved monstrosities.

Become the Apex Predator
Master the fluid combat and combine powerful skills to create a playstyle of your own. Use different playstyles to turn the tables on your enemies as you consume them and grow from prey to apex predator.

Embrace Your True Purpose
Team up with PUCK, and dive deeper into the maze of a mysterious alien world. Find out the truth behind your presence in this world, what does PUCK want and why it chose you.

*This product can be upgraded to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version after purchase at no additional cost.
To upgrade, download the upgrade pack available from the Nintendo eShop onto your Nintendo Switch 2.
*This product includes content that will also be sold separately. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000027477.name: Piano: Learn and Play Young Master Edition
70070000027477.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000027477.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes six Song Packs DLCs.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000027490.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Ultimate Edition
70070000027490.intro: The ultimate combat package – play, customize, dominate!
70070000027490.description:
Experience the full intensity of BODY CAM SHOOTER with this exclusive Tactical Bundle, combining the ultra-realistic shooter with a premium pistol skin for added style on the battlefield. Whether you’re executing precise tactical maneuvers or engaging in high-stakes combat, this bundle ensures you’re fully equipped for the challenge.

What’s Included:
	•	BODY CAM SHOOTER – An immersive, body cam-style FPS featuring realistic gunplay, smart AI enemies, and adrenaline-pumping tactical encounters.
	•	Exclusive Pistol Skin – A high-quality, intimidating weapon skin designed to make your sidearm stand out while maintaining the game’s gritty realism.

Adapt, strategize, and dominate your opponents with this complete package. Customize your loadout, step into intense firefights, and prove your skills in the most immersive tactical shooter yet. Lock, load, and take control!

70070000027497.name: Cooking Flair & Flavor
70070000027497.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000027497.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

Decorate your restaurant with an amazing Green Dragon Set, Animal Set, Japanese Set and Floral Set included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out 
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000027504.name: ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: The Ultimate Flashlight
70070000027504.intro: More light, more danger - dare to go deeper?
70070000027504.description:
Enter the ultimate nightmare with this bundle, combining ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR and the Eternal Light DLC for a terrifying yet illuminating experience.

Lost in the endless maze? The horror never stops.
Navigate an ever-shifting labyrinth where reality warps, fear tightens its grip, and unseen horrors lurk around every corner. The flickering lights and damp carpets hide more than just the unknown—they hide your fate.

A light in the darkness... but does it bring safety or reveal new terrors?
With the Eternal Light DLC, you are no longer defenseless against the void. Your flashlight never runs out, guiding you through the suffocating corridors. But be careful - some things were meant to stay in the shadows.

This bundle includes:
	•	ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR – A nightmarish survival experience in an endless maze of fear.
	•	Eternal Light DLC – A flashlight with infinite power, ensuring you’re never left in the dark.

Step into the light…if you dare.

70070000027508.name: Garfield Bundle – 2 in 1
70070000027508.description:
This bundle contains:
- Garfield Kart: Furious Racing
- Garfield Lasagna Party

70070000027509.name: Asterix Maxi Collection
70070000027509.description:
Find your favourite heroes in Asterix Maxi Collection with 6 games included!
- Asterix & Obelix XXL Romastered
- Asterix & Obelix XXL 2
- Asterix & Obelix XXL 3
- Asterix & Obelix XXXL
- Asterix & Obelix Slap Them All!
- Asterix & Obelix Slap Them All! 2

70070000027510.name: Detective Bundle – 4 in 1
70070000027510.description:
This bundle contains:
- Agatha Christie – Hercule Poirot: The First Cases 
- Blacksad: Under the Skin 
- Murder Mystery Machine 
- Arsene Lupin – Once a Thief

70070000027513.name: Highway Bikers: Moto Racing Simulator DELUXE EDITION
70070000027513.intro: The Ultimate Racing Experience – All Bikes, All Tracks, All Action!
70070000027513.description: The Highway Bikers: Moto Racing Simulator Deluxe Edition is the ultimate package for any racing enthusiast! This bundle includes the base game along with all DLCs: Rule The Roads DLC (featuring a high-performance new bike), Cash Pack DLC (boost your progress with extra money), and Desert Dream DLC (unlock the thrilling desert map). Get everything you need to customize, upgrade, and dominate the roads in one complete edition. Race through challenging terrains, unlock powerful bikes, and experience the full adrenaline-pumping action of the open highway!

70070000027518.name: nGolf Tournament-Ready Edition
70070000027518.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000027518.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

Unlock new levels with Moon Swing and Western Fairways DLCs and also change the appearance with Colorful Golf Balls 1, 2, 3 and 4 DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000027529.name: 3-in-1 Easter Collection
70070000027529.description:
Celebrate the Easter season with our exciting selection of games for the whole family! The 3-in-1 Easter Collection offers three exciting games that guarantee fun and enjoyment for young and old.

Be a champion in Summer Sport Games and prove your athletic skills and challenge your friends in twelve exciting disciplines! In Rubberduck Wave Racer, you can race across raging rivers and roaring white water courses at incredible speed. You can compete against each other with up to four friends - each as cute as they like. Enjoy in Island Flight Simulator fantastic open-ended gameplay, touch down in the tropics and transport freight between twelve exotic islands in more than a hundred exciting missions.

Leave the stress of everyday life behind you and immerse yourself in the world of play. Make your Easter more colorful and cheerful with our 3-in-1 Easter Collection!

Contents:
• Summer Sports Games
• Rubberduck Wave Racer
• Island Flight Simulator

70070000027533.name: Cooking Arena Fast Food Edition
70070000027533.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000027533.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Burger Chef Tycoon" and "Pizza Bar Tycoon".

70070000027541.name: Bowling Fever Super Edition
70070000027541.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000027541.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #4 with:

-20 new bowling ball styles

70070000027545.name: Tank vs Tank Platinium Edition
70070000027545.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000027545.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint #2 and War Paint #3 with:

-8 unique tank skins and 8 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000027579.name: Formula Racing Pro 2025 Premium Edition
70070000027579.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000027579.description:
Get behind the wheel in Formula Racing Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Formula racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #2 with:

This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000027587.name: Darts Fever Definitive Edition
70070000027587.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000027587.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game, Stylish Precision #2, Stylish Precision #3 and Stylish Precision #4 with:

15 brand-new dart designs

70070000027589.name: Snooker Fever Prime Edition
70070000027589.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000027589.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #3 with:

five new table designs and five sleek cue styles

70070000027591.name: Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator Premium Deluxe
70070000027591.intro: Unlock the Ultimate Aviation Experience – Elevate Your Journey with Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator Premium Deluxe!
70070000027591.description:
Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator Premium Deluxe is the ultimate aviation package, combining the base game with three incredible DLCs for an unmatched flying experience. Take to the skies with a vast range of aircraft, stunning realism, and dynamic missions. This deluxe edition unlocks everything you need to become a master pilot.

Base Game: Immerse yourself in a highly detailed flight simulator with realistic aircraft, complex flight dynamics, and expansive environments.

WINGS 2025 DLC: Soar with advanced aircraft, cutting-edge flight technology, and new, thrilling missions that challenge your skills.

CASH BUSINESS DLC: Build your aviation empire by managing an academy, growing your fleet, and navigating the business side of the skies.

NEW AIRPLANE DLC: Fly the latest aircraft with innovative designs and enhanced performance, pushing the boundaries of flight in every way.

With Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator Premium Deluxe, you get the complete aviation adventure. Master the skies, grow your aviation business, and explore the future of flight all in one premium package. The skies are yours—take control today!

70070000027595.name: Mini Market Design Extended Edition
70070000027595.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000027595.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the Furniture Material Collection 1, 2 and 3 DLCs, allowing you to add new colors to your furnitures.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000027596.name: STAR WARS™: Grand Collection
70070000027596.description:
Race to victory in the blistering podracing circuits of the Outer Rim, lead an elite squad of Clones, hunt the galaxy's most dangerous bounties as Jango Fett, master the ways of the Force as Kyle Katarn, and relive the epic battles of the Jedi Order.

Nine iconic Star Wars games, one unforgettable Grand Collection:

STAR WARS™: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast™
STAR WARS™: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy™
STAR WARS™: Republic Commando™
STAR WARS™: Episode I Racer™
STAR WARS™: The Force Unleashed™
STAR WARS™: Knights of the Old Republic™
STAR WARS™: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords™
STAR WARS™: Bounty Hunter™
STAR WARS™: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles™

70070000027603.name: Spy Guy Legends of Greece
70070000027603.intro: Discover the legends of ancient Greece with Spy Guy!
70070000027603.description:
Spy Guy sets off to Ancient Greece in search of hidden objects. Discover a beautiful, colorful map full of characters from Greek Mythology.
- 120 new levels
- unique map
- new story
- more than 500 hidden objects

70070000027605.name: Cassette Beasts - New Wirral Edition
70070000027605.intro: Grab Cassette Beasts and all its DLC in this edition!
70070000027605.description:
A perfect fit for savvy collectors is Cassette Beasts' New Wirral Edition! Includes the base game and all DLCs.

This download contains:

- Cassette Beasts
- Pier of the Unknown DLC
- Cosplay Pack
- Fashion Pack
- Wing Pack

70070000027608.name: Cute Puppy Academy: Legacy Edition
70070000027608.intro: A Playful New Companion Is Here!
70070000027608.description:
An exciting new canine has arrived at the academy! Stop by to greet this energetic pup, offer a treat, and begin the adventure. The "Basenji Training Pack" introduces a one-of-a-kind breed that thrives on attention and activity.

• Care for puppies of all breeds and teach them fun tricks.
• Keep your pups happy, wash, feed, and entertain them with a variety of toys.
• Take your puppies on walks through a beautiful park full of surprises and activities.
• Expand your academy with new kennels, toys, and upgraded training spaces.

70070000027615.name: Cute Puppy Academy: Legend Edition
70070000027615.description:
Say hello to your new best friend! An irresistibly cute Bull Terrier puppy!  

Take pups for walks, explore the neighborhood, and discover hidden toys together. Teach them fun new tricks, reward their progress with yummy treats, and watch their tail wag with delight!

After a day full of pranks and play, it’s time for cuddles, food, and a good scrub. Wash away the mud from their adventures, and make sure they’re happy and healthy.

Can you keep up with their mischievous antics and become the ultimate puppy trainer?

70070000027638.name: My Cozy Room Stylish Pack
70070000027638.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000027638.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art and Chic DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 1 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000027642.name: Construction Machine Simulator: Ultimate Builder
70070000027642.intro: Heavy machines, bigger challenges, ultimate control.
70070000027642.description:
Expand your construction empire with the Ultimate Builder, bringing together the base game and powerful additional content in one complete package. Take control of heavy-duty machinery, tackle challenging projects, and dominate the construction site like never before.

This bundle includes:
	•	Construction Machine Simulator – Experience the thrill of managing a bustling construction site with realistic physics, a variety of heavy machinery, and engaging missions.
	•	Machines Expansion DLC – Unlock the Grizzly MK II, a high-performance machine built for strength, durability, and precision, giving you an edge on the toughest tasks.

Build bigger, work smarter, and take on the most demanding construction challenges with the Ultimate Builder.

70070000027652.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Maywinner Edition
70070000027652.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000027652.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS A LEGENDARY BOXER
Receive the legendary Lord Maywinner with his unique equipment and a bonus of 21500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000027655.name: Bridge Race: Scary Edition
70070000027655.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70070000027655.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

Features:
- 4 additional skins to show off your style!
- 10000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition—who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000027659.name: Ecchi Memories: Maud Edition
70070000027659.intro: Let the bras hit the floor
70070000027659.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 7 beautiful girls with alluring curves (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000027660.name: Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator Deluxe Edition
70070000027660.intro: Everything You Need for the Ultimate Medieval Trading Adventure – Get the Deluxe Edition!
70070000027660.description: Step into the world of medieval commerce like never before with the Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator Deluxe Edition! This edition includes the full base game, plus exclusive DLC content to enhance your experience. You'll get the Coin Pack to boost your shop’s growth and the Songs Pack to immerse yourself in the enchanting melodies of the medieval world. Build your business, trade goods, and grow your empire while enjoying all the extra perks this Deluxe Edition has to offer. Perfect for players who want to dive deeper into the medieval marketplace!

70070000027667.name: Maki: Paw of Fury Clawmaster Edition
70070000027667.intro: Beat ‘em up and Retro Arcade game enjoyers – welcome to the world of Pangea!
70070000027667.description:
When a friend gets captured, Maki comes to her rescue! Fight your way through five diverse locations with funky fresh minigames, and conquer the dangerous opponents that stand in your way!


FEEL THE 90S IN AN ANIMAL STYLE — Maki: Paw of Fury’s combat elements are inspired by the hit beat ‘em up arcade games from the 90s, while the story of Maki takes place in the original world of Pangea. Animals rule here, and they’re passionate about sports, technology, and lifelong friendships. Speaking of, one is about to be on the brink of breaking!


A FRIEND IN NEED, A FIGHT INDEED — Maki gets a pleading call for help and realizes that his dear friend - Mapu - has betrayed him. Here starts the road of Maki: The Paw of Fury! He might look adorable, but don’t mistake his fox cuteness for weakness - he has studied the martial art of Tsume no Ken and can wield a tuna like a professional.


MAKI ISN’T ALONE — You can choose to play Maki the fox, but you can also choose Tincho, the muscular capybara, and Maka, the colorful otter who will show your enemies the power of music. Each of these characters is unique when it comes to looks, strength, and fighting style!

Unlock Maki Aviator, Tincho Nerd, Tincho Karateka and Maka Kiss skins, included in this bundle.

VIBE WITH THE MUSIC AND THE WONDERFUL WORLD OF PANGEA — While all the fighting’s going on it’s hard to appreciate the visuals. But if you stand down just for a moment you’ll be able to appreciate the stunning views of Pangea’s world! You’’ travel through dark ninja forests, icy planes, and desert dunes in the tune of energetic and fighting-ready tracks.

70070000027700.name: [Spring Version] Special Skins Expansion Pack
70070000027700.description:
- 38 interchangeable fruit parts
- New designs for Poppy and boxes (4 types)
- Background skins (4 types)

70070000027702.name: Pool Fever Diamond Edition
70070000027702.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000027702.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #3 with:

10 new pool table designs
5 new pool cues designs

70070000027707.name: Truck Simulator 2024 - USA Driver Zone: Heavy Cargo
70070000027707.intro: More trucks, more power, more adventure!
70070000027707.description:
Take your trucking journey to the next level with the Truck Simulator 2024 - USA Driver Zone: Heavy Cargo, the ultimate package for every trucking enthusiast. Explore vast highways, tackle challenging missions, and expand your fleet with new, high-performance additions. Whether you’re hauling heavy cargo across scenic landscapes or upgrading your truck for maximum efficiency, this bundle delivers the most immersive trucking experience yet.

Bundle Includes:
	•	Truck Simulator 2024 - USA Driver Zone – The ultimate open-world trucking experience with realistic physics, diverse missions, and an expansive fleet of trucks.
	•	New Truck DLC  – Access powerful new truck, enhanced features, and unique upgrades that elevate your gameplay.

Hit the road, push your limits, and build your trucking empire with the Truck Simulator 2024 - USA Driver Zone: Heavy Cargo!

70070000027713.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Premium Edition
70070000027713.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000027713.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #2 with:

Add style to your rides with this exclusive set of premium skins for your favorite bike.

70070000027717.name: Moto Rush GT Max Edition
70070000027717.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000027717.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Full Garage , Grip Collection #1, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #3 with:

- Complete your collection and discover new ways to conquer the streets with as many as 13 new vehicles—including an ATV and bicycle!
- 20 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000027718.name: West Escape: Adventurer Edition
70070000027718.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000027718.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

Features:
- Premium Equipment: Equip Silver bullet for 25% combat power
- Rare Gear and more: Obtain rare and uncommon Adventurer equipment to boost your power level!
- Bonus currency: Additional 500 gems for faster progress!
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes—dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load—freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70070000027726.name: Ecchi Uncover: Beauty Edition
70070000027726.intro: Will you let these beautiful girls blow you away?
70070000027726.description:
Traverse through a field of mines to uncover beautiful girls hiding within. Tread carefully, and you might just stumble on a different pair of bombs.
Features:
- Over 116 enticing pictures of girls with or without clothes
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes
Prepare for an explosion of emotions!

70070000027728.name: Skyline Bowling: Spare Edition
70070000027728.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000027728.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 3 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Balls - Equip 3 new bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 100K coins to upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000027732.name: Cozy Land Deluxe Edition
70070000027732.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000027732.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

Create your unique cozy land with additional Wild West Set 1 DLC included in this bundle.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000027739.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Upgrade Edition
70070000027739.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000027739.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan. 

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.
* Easy to play and hard to master.

This bundle includes base game and Endless Mode with:

* endless gameplay mode

70070000027743.name: CybeRage: Definitive Edition
70070000027743.intro: Survive endless waves of alien creatures and crush the heart of the infestation!
70070000027743.description:
"Phy embarks on a secret mission to an abandoned planet infested by a hostile hivemind. With the help of her partner Lizz and General Eral, she dives into the depths of the infestation and learns the dark truth behind its origins. Help her find the heart of the hive and put an end to this evergrowing threat.

Kill hordes of nasty bugs and use the experience gained to strengthen your arsenal and body with cybernetic enchantments. The hive will adapt and send more powerful enemies to stand in your way. Shoot them down with your army of drones, or slash them to pieces with your blade and stop the hivemind from growing even stronger!

Features:
- Engaging story: Accompany Phy in her quest against the hive
- Side stories: Explore 3 new metro lines and discover unique locations
- Immersive world: Experience 34 hand-crafted cyberpunk levels
- High-tech arsenal: 13 fighter drones to upgrade and evolve
- Melee weapons: 8 powerful swords with unique active abilities
- Rogue-lite progression: Unlockable permanent augments
- Contracts: Complete tasks to earn credits

Will you help Phy defeat the hive and save the cyber age from impending doom?"

70070000027744.name: Knights & Guns Hyper Edition
70070000027744.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000027744.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Armor Pack #1, Armor Pack #2  and Armor Pack #3 with:
- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 15 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000027758.name: The GhostX : Sniper Simulator (Tactical Shooting & Eliminator) Legendary Shooter
70070000027758.intro: Elite sniper. Legendary rifle. Unmatched power.
70070000027758.description:
GhostX Sniper Elite Bundle - Ultimate Sniper Experience - Legendary Shooter.Prepare to enhance your sniping skills with this exclusive bundle featuring the game “GhostX Sniper” and the new DLC “New Gun Pack”. Your hunting experience just got more intense than ever!

This bundle includes: 
	•	GhostX Sniper – Step into the shoes of an elite sniper in a world full of danger, where every mission is a challenge. Explore diverse environments, from busy streets to tranquil forests, each requiring tactical skills and unmatched precision.
	•	DLC – New Gun Pack – Take your game to the next level with the legendary M24 sniper rifle and 6 exclusive skins. Each customization reflects your unique style on the battlefield, and the new weapon will give you a significant advantage in any mission.

Become the elite sniper you’ve always wanted to be. With this bundle, GhostX becomes more intense, captivating, and personalized than ever before. Are you ready to put your skills to the test?

70070000027766.name:
FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000027766.intro: Another Life Awaits in this Fantasy World!
70070000027766.description:
This product includes the content of 'FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time' along with the following items.

- Exclusive Mount: Mini Napdragon
- Exclusive Napdragon Weapons: Napdragon Sword, Napdragon Claymore, Napdragon Bow, Napdragon Staff
- Iconic Outfit Pack: Ethereal Girl's Dress, Ethereal Girl's Sandals, Archaeologist's Hat, Archaeologist's Coat, Archaeologist's Boots, Trip's Helmet

*Visit the official website (https://www.fantasylife.jp/fli/en/) for more details about the bonuses included with each edition.

Step into this Slow-Life RPG where you can freely switch between 14 unique jobs, so called "Lives," and enjoy a carefree life in a fantasy world.
Fish, cook, shape the island to your liking, or team up with friends to battle monsters across the vast world.
It's up to you to choose what kind of Life you'll live!

■A Dragon Guides You to a Mysterious Island
You are an adventurer who sets sail with the archaeologist Edward and his team.
Following the light emanating from a dragon's fossil, you discover an uncharted, deserted island.
A vast abyss, a dragon made of bone, and a girl's message that begs you to save the world...
Travel between the island that thrived 1,000 years ago and the present-day island to unravel the mystery of its downfall!

■14 Unique Lives to Make Yours Brighter
In this world, a "Life" is the equivalent of a job.
Each has its own characteristics and provides various ways to enjoy yourself.
Collect ingredients or materials with Gathering Lives, create weapons or cook dishes with Crafting Lives, or fight monsters with Combat Lives. You can switch between any Life at any time, creating a life that's uniquely yours.

■Shape the Island! Create Your Town!
Use Lives to gather materials and restore the island to its former glory!
Not only can you place houses and objects, but you can also alter the landscape and draw rivers and roads to create a truly unique island.
Expand your house, place some furniture, and decorate the interior however you like!

■Embark on an Open-World Adventure!
Freely explore the largest continent in the series!
Climb ledges, swim across rivers and lakes, or ride on mounts - With these new actions you can explore the world without limits!

■Endless Fun with Multiplayer!
Enjoy multiplayer with up to 4 players!
Invite friends to your island, explore dungeons, or find your own ways to have fun together!
If you have two controllers, you can also use the 2 Player Family Co-op feature where one player can join the adventure as your travel companion without needing to connect online!

70070000027768.name: Cozy Hunt: Complete Edition
70070000027768.intro: Find, explore, and relax in a world full of cute details!
70070000027768.description:
Cozy Hunt is a cute and relaxing hidden object game. In this game, you look for different things hidden in big, beautiful pictures. Each picture is full of funny and sweet details, so it’s always interesting to play. Some things are easy to find, and some are more tricky — but every level is full of surprises!

In Cozy Hunt: More to Find expand your cozy adventure with 10 brand-new levels, filled with even more charming details and hidden objects to discover! Dive into beautifully illustrated scenes, challenge your observation skills, and enjoy the relaxing gameplay that makes Cozy Hunt so special. 

What’s great about this game:
 -50 cute and fun levels — every picture is different!
 -Play with touchscreen or with your controller
 -Beautiful pictures full of cute little things

Relax, look around, and have fun in the cozy world of Cozy Hunt!

70070000027781.name: Neko Bakery Deluxe Edition
70070000027781.intro: The ultimate cat-baker puzzle is served – fresh and purr-fectly sweet!
70070000027781.description:
Meet the fluffiest chef in town – a whiskered wonder who’s baking up a storm and needs YOU to pack up his pastry masterpieces! Sounds easy? Try cramming mountains of cupcakes, cakes, and fish-shaped treats into boxes that are waaay too small! Can your puzzle skills handle the sugar rush?

Why you’ll love it:

- 90+ brain-tickling bakery box levels!
- 29 drool-worthy treats to stack, squish, and squeeze in!
- Sweet tunes: chill lo-fi or jazzy café vibes!
- Art so cute it might make you meow.
- And of course – the pawsitively charming cat-baker!

Unlock more puzzles to solve with Baker's Puzzle Pack 1 DLCs included in this bundle.

Each box is a new paw-some puzzle that’ll twist your brain like a pretzel. Warning: side effects may include uncontrollable smiling and sudden pastry cravings!


Oh, and if you figure out how the cat didn’t eat everything before you showed up… tell us. We’re still investigating.

Get ready to puzzle, pack and purr. Just don’t eat all the pastries... yet.

70070000027803.name: Infinite Seek and Find - Season 1
70070000027803.description: Infinite Seek and Find + Infinite Seek and Find - Infinity Times Two DLC

70070000027813.name: Go Kart Mania Diamond Edition
70070000027813.intro: Your Ticket to World Kart Racing!
70070000027813.description:
"Go Kart Mania" the ultimate kart racing game brings the thrill ride right to your Nintendo Switch™.

Race through 36 uniquely challenging tracks in iconic locations from Europe, China, and Australia, each offering a distinct racing experience. 

Customize your kart to outsmart competitors. 

Engage in heart-pounding competition across the world, or treat yourself to a quick solo race to become a karting legend.

"Go Kart Mania" is your ticket to a world of high-speed excitement and adventure. 

Don't miss out - start your engines for an unforgettable racing journey!

This bundle includes base game, Livery Pack #1, Livery Pack #2 and Livery Pack #3 with:

-3 new skins for each Kart

70070000027819.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Ultra Edition
70070000027819.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000027819.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE A PREMIUM NOM AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Ultra Nom: who can protect you from any obstacle once!
- 2500 gold to buy new Noms!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000027821.name: Candivity: Mines Edition
70070000027821.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
70070000027821.description:
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Features:
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode for you and your friend!
- 2 standard maps and a new Deep Mines map!
- New miner characters and digging accessories
- Fully customizable name and character
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
- An adorably sweet aesthetic

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000027836.name: Fashion World Discovery Edition
70070000027836.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000027836.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!
- Create stunning looks with countless combinations of costumes, accessories, and scenic backdrops!
- Capture your creations in Photo Mode!
- Strive for perfection with the three-star rating system, boosting your game's replay value.
- Designed for fashion lovers of all ages!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #3 (New Wave) and expansion pack #4 (Retro Fits) with: 

- 40 all-new levels of puzzles

70070000027843.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Ultimate Patrol
70070000027843.intro: Step into the shadows and secure the frontier with military precision!
70070000027843.description:
Step up your game with the Ultimate Patrol! This bundle includes everything you need to enhance your border patrol experience. Not only will you get the core game with its immersive border control simulation, but also the Military Gear DLC, featuring realistic camouflage skins for your gloves and sleeves to give you that tactical advantage during every mission.

What’s Included:
	•	Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024: Take on the role of a border patrol officer in a high-stakes world where every decision counts. Conduct vehicle searches, verify documents, and tackle a variety of challenging missions while protecting the border from illegal activities.
	•	Military Gear DLC: Upgrade your gear with a military camouflage skin for gloves and sleeves, blending seamlessly into your surroundings for that extra level of stealth and immersion.

Prepare yourself for the most realistic and action-packed border patrol experience with the Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Ultimate Patrol. Keep the frontier secure in style with your new tactical camouflage skins!

70070000027848.name: Vege Bubble Shoot Upgrade Edition
70070000027848.intro: Pop, Match, Harvest! Dive into a vibrant veggieventure!
70070000027848.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Vege Bubble Shot, a colourful and addictive puzzle game that will captivate your gaming senses. Dive into a fruity adventure where you'll use your strategic skills to save a delightful vegetable garden from pesky intruders and become a puzzle master!

Key Features:

    Vivid Vegetable Vistas: Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world brimming with hand-crafted, vibrant vegetables. Explore lush garden settings and interact with charming characters.

    Challenging Puzzles: Put your aim and matching skills to the test with a variety of engaging puzzles. Can you clear the garden of intruders with your accurate shots?

    Power-Ups and Boosters: Utilize an array of powerful boosters and unique power-ups to enhance your gameplay. Create spectacular chain reactions to tackle the intruders with flair.

    Endless Fun: Vege Bubble Shot offers hundreds of levels, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment for both short and extended gaming sessions.

    Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: The game is designed for players of all skill levels, with straightforward mechanics for beginners and depth for those seeking a greater challenge.

Multiplayer included! Vege Bubble Shot is the perfect game for both casual players and competitive gamers. Aim, shoot, and match your way through the captivating vegetable garden, and bring back harmony one bubble at a time. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this addictive and colourful adventure!

This bundle includes base game and Harvest Havoc #4 with:

- 20 all-new levels

70070000027855.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.13
70070000027855.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the thirteenth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000027880.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Diamond Edition
70070000027880.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000027894.name: Survival Float Simulator: Raft Builder’s
70070000027894.intro: Build your raft, face the wild, and turn the swamp into your home.
70070000027894.description:
Step into the heart of a wild, waterlogged world with this immersive bundle that combines the core survival experience of “Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build” with the powerful gear upgrades from “Fishing & Crafting Tools Update.” Whether you’re just starting your journey or returning to the swamp stronger than ever, this is your complete survival toolkit.

What’s included in the bundle:
Survival Float Simulator – Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
	•	Craft your floating base using raw swamp materials.
	•	Fish, purify water, and defend your raft from deadly crocodiles.
	•	Personalize, expand, and fortify your sanctuary in the heart of nature’s chaos.

Fishing & Crafting Tools Update DLC
	•	Upgraded Fishing Rod for more efficient, rewarding catches.
	•	Enhanced Standard Hook with improved mechanics and design.
	•	Advanced Grappling Hook offering longer range and greater control.
	•	Shape your raft, sharpen your tools, and survive the wild like never before.

Raft Builder’s Bundle gives you the gear—and the grit—to master the swamp.

70070000027895.name: Gas Station Simulator, Can Touch This DLC and Party Time DLC Bundle
70070000027895.description:
Gas Station Simulator is all about renovating, expanding and running a gas station along a highway in the middle of a desert. Freedom of choice and multiple approaches to run your business and deal with pressure are key ingredients in this game.

Buy an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere and restore it to its former glory. Get rid of debris and broken furniture, fix up the walls, paint and decorate the place to your liking. Just don’t spend all your cash on the looks right away, you bought a gas station after all. Repair the equipment, buy what can’t be repaired and start serving your customers to earn money for further renovations and improvements.

Can Touch This DLC

Rebuild & Reconstruct!
Take matters into your own hand. Almost literally. With the help of your new, trusty hammer, 
it's time to redecorate like you've never done before. Refurbish walls to your heart's content, 
changing their features and decor as you see fit. Decide where to put trash cans or where to 
move the cash register to. Direct the crowd. Show your customers the right way to orderly 
queue without taking too much space. It's time to take interior customisation to a completely 
new level.
Paint & Spray!
No need to stare at an empty canvas any longer! Grab your spray can and add a little 
personal touch to any surface you can lay your hands on. With adjustable scale and rotation,
you can spray anything from large murals to tiny easter eggs hidden somewhere in the 
corners of your station. Combine existing decals with each other, creating even more 
elaborate and complex pieces of art. And whenever you start feeling like you're running out, 
more designs lie hidden all around for you to unlock!
Warehouse & Workshop
Did you ever feel like your station was missing something? That flair didn't quite measure up 
to par when looking beyond your main building? Have no fear for the future is here. From 
tables to desks to banners and lights, your Warehouse and Workshop now possess a full 
suite of purchasable customisations! Make the diamond in the sand shine even brighter than before.

Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

70070000027913.name: Spy Guy Memory Antiques
70070000027913.intro: Set of two Memory games in ancient style-Greece and Rome
70070000027913.description: Classic Memory game with ancient style cards. Rome and Greece set. 5 game modes, timer and record board. A game for everyone!

70070000027930.name: Real Cake Maker: Fancy Edition
70070000027930.intro: Grab your mixer and let the cake-making fun begin!
70070000027930.description:
Become the best cake baker in town and create the yummiest cakes in this delicious cooking adventure!

What kind of cake do you love? Whatever it is, you can bake it! From dreamy frosting to delightful decorations, design cakes that look as good as they taste. Show off your creations to friends, throw a fabulous cake party, or compete in exciting baking contests for the chance to be crowned the cake champ!

Features:
● learn how to bake the most delicious cakes!
● automize your baking, designing, and decorating with the help of premium tools!
● decorate your cakes with lots of frostings, decorations, and toppers to make it look special!
● throw cake parties with your adorable animal friends and make each celebration memorable
● join baking contests, vote for your favorite cakes, and win the first prize!
● try on almost 150 clothes and hairstyles. dress up like the true baker you are!
