● enjoy a collection of fun coloring pages to inspire your artistic side

Bake up some joy and sweeten your day with fun creations!

70070000027933.name: Cooking Arena Asian Style
70070000027933.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000027933.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Food Truck Tycoon - Asian Cuisine" and "Sushi Time!".

70070000027934.name: Mini Market Design Luxury Edition
70070000027934.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000027934.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the Furniture Material Collection 1, 2, 3 and 4, allowing you to add new colors to your furnitures.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000027945.name: Pixel Cafe Diamond Edition
70070000027945.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000027945.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipement, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game, Bedroom Touches and Kitchen Touches with:

A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
A new style for the Radio Nightstand
A different variant for the Refrigerator
An updated Oven and Stove design
A new look for the Sink
An alternative style for the Bar
Also, mix things up with two new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000027946.name: My Cozy Room Easter Edition
70070000027946.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000027946.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic and Easter DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 1 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000027953.name: Tank vs Tank Diamond Edition
70070000027953.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000027953.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint #1, War Paint #2 and War Paint #3 with:

-12 unique tank skins and 12 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000027955.name: Darts Fever Diamond Edition
70070000027955.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000027955.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game, Stylish Precision #1, Stylish Precision #2 and Stylish Precision #3 with:

15 brand-new dart designs

70070000027965.name: Snooker Fever Superion Edition
70070000027965.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000027965.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Expansion Pack #3 with:

10 stunning new table designs

70070000027967.name: Formula Racing Pro 2025 Deluxe Edition
70070000027967.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000027967.description:
Get behind the wheel in Formula Racing Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Formula racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #2 with:

-6 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000028004.name: Apex Heroines (Ultimate Edition)
70070000028004.intro: FHD+60FPS! 3D Hack&Slash & 3D Beat’em UP! Enjoy the fast-paced battles and can't stop the adrenaline rush.
70070000028004.description:
In the Ghost Zone Where Humans Dare Not Tread
Signals of metahuman activity have been detected. You'll step into the shoes of a rookie member of the Metahuman Watch, joining forces with five teammates to venture into this enigmatic realm. Your mission? To fight fire with fire and unravel the dark secrets lurking behind the scenes.

+ Can't Stop the Adrenaline Rush. Enjoy limitless dodging, infinite sprinting, zero cooldowns on abilities, and instant enemy eliminations. Controls are user-friendly, making it easy for beginners. Yet, higher levels demand skilled tactics and strategies.

+ Six Playable Characters.  Each character boasts distinctive traits and entirely different combat styles, offering a fresh gameplay experience.

+ Five Types of Weapons. Each offering a unique combat style and feel.   If you find yourself struggling, a simple weapon swap could turn the tide of battle.

+ Diverse and Challenging Levels. Some levels demand high levels of skill, while others require strategic thinking. But no matter the challenge, you'll always find a way to triumph—it's all up to you!

70070000028016.name: Not Not & Not Not 2
70070000028016.intro: NOT one game, but NOT NOT two games!
70070000028016.description:
Think your reflexes are sharp and your logic unshakable? Put them to the test—twice—inside this mind-mangling bundle that pairs the cult-classic NOT NOT with its sequel NOT NOT 2. 

Follow (or don’t follow) the cube’s ever-shifting commands, race the ticking timer, and see how long your brain can stay one step ahead of itself.

NOT NOT - A Brain Buster 
• Snap-decision gameplay: swipe Up, Down, Left, or Right exactly as (or exactly not as) instructed.
• Classic & Challenge modes that pile on new twists until your neurons knot.
• Local multiplayer for up to 4 players—perfect for “who’s really the smartest?” showdowns.
• Color-blind mode ensures everyone can join the confusion.

NOT NOT 2 - A Brain Challenge
• Fresh modes, dozens of new levels, and devilish rule combos that weaponize your instincts.
• Daily & Weekly Challenges plus global leaderboards for never-ending bragging rights.
• Revamped visuals, unlockable skins, and a stats dashboard to track your ever-improving (or deteriorating) mental agility.
• The same 4-player Versus chaos—now even faster and harder.

Whether you’re training your brain solo, battling friends on the couch, or chasing the top of the leaderboard every morning, NOT NOT & NOT NOT 2 deliver a deviously simple question: Left, right, up, down—easy, is it NOT?

70070000028019.name: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Fortune Edition
70070000028019.intro: Get ready to roll with the Lost in Random: The Eternal Die - Fortune Edition!
70070000028019.description:
Play early with our exclusive Fortune Edition!

Get up to 4 days of Early Access to Lost in Random: The Eternal Die before its official launch.

This limited-time offer is only available until launch day, 17 June 2025 (10:00 PDT)!

Step into the dice-rolled chaos of Lost in Random: The Eternal Die like never before with the Fortune Edition, featuring the beloved dark fantasy roguelite adventure alongside two exclusive new cosmetic sets in the Wardrobe Expansion.

Trapped within the Black Die by the sinister Mare the Knight, Queen Aleksandra must battle through an ever-shifting nightmare using her wits, combat skills, and a sprinkling of luck. With the fate of Random hanging in the balance, she and her living die-companion, Fortune, must turn the odds in their favour to escape the nightmare realm.

The Fortune Edition includes:

- Lost in Random: The Eternal Die – A dark fantasy roguelite set in the eerie, whimsical world of Lost in Random. Face unpredictable challenges, wield card-based abilities, and roll the dice to shift the tide of battle.

- Wardrobe Expansion – Two exclusive cosmetic outfits letting Queen Aleksandra slay her enemies in style with the inspiring Death Set or dazzling Crystal Set.

70070000028020.name: Explorers Collection: The Oregon Trail & Carmen Sandiego Bundle
70070000028020.intro: Two Timeless Adventures. One Epic Journey of Wits and Survival.
70070000028020.description:
Whether you're a seasoned sleuth, a trailblazing tactician, or a curious newcomer, the Explorers Collection is your passport to discovery.

Uncover mysteries across continents and brave the wild frontier in this premium bundle celebrating two of gaming's most iconic adventures. 

For a generation of gamers, Carmen Sandiego and The Oregon Trail™ weren't just lessons, they were legends. From school computer labs to living room PCs, these global phenomenas sparked curiosity, shaped childhoods, and defined what it meant to learn through play. Now reimagined, they return for those who grew up with them and for the next generation ready to explore, survive, and discover.

THE OREGON TRAIL - Every choice matters. Every journey is your own. 

A modern reimagining of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the iconic classic will fully immerse you in epic journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the totally extreme. Surviving blizzards, broken limbs, snakebites, exhaustion, starvation, and the dreaded dysentery is no small feat; all the while navigating an untamed frontier to get your party to their new life in Oregon before the winter. 

- Forge your path westward in a bold reimagining of the classroom classic -- complete with historical depth, strategic gameplay, and that famously fatal dysentery.

- Overcome hundreds of random events where your choices affect the fate of your travelers, and are influenced by their unique skills and traits.

- Remember to take care of your party, wagon, and oxen, or they'll become casualties of the trail.

CARMEN SANDIEGO - It takes a thief to catch a thief. 

VILE is back on the scene, and for once, ACME and Carmen Sandiego have a common enemy. In a rare and temporary alliance, the world's greatest thief must track down the syndicate before they can pull off their next big heist.  

Use spy tools such as gliders, grappling hooks, and thermal vision to solve crimes across global 
landmarks, outwit VILE operatives, and explore geography, culture, and critical thinking through stylish, story-driven gameplay. 

From the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro to the majestic landmarks of Tokyo, embark on a whirlwind tour of the world's most iconic destinations. With stunning visuals and immersive environments, every location comes to life, inviting you to explore, discover, and unravel the secrets that lie within.

Made for Curious Minds!

This isn't homework, it's hands-on history. These games are trusted by educators and built to sharpen thinking, empathy, and curiosity in players of all ages.
•Designed for clever kids, nostalgic grown-ups, and lifelong learners
•Features classroom-ready extras and family-friendly support
•A perfect blend of play, purpose, and pixel-powered discovery

70070000028090.name: Neko Bakery Chef Kit Edition
70070000028090.intro: The ultimate cat-baker puzzle is served – fresh and purr-fectly sweet!
70070000028090.description:
Meet the fluffiest chef in town – a whiskered wonder who’s baking up a storm and needs YOU to pack up his pastry masterpieces! Sounds easy? Try cramming mountains of cupcakes, cakes, and fish-shaped treats into boxes that are waaay too small! Can your puzzle skills handle the sugar rush?

Why you’ll love it:

- 90+ brain-tickling bakery box levels!
- 29 drool-worthy treats to stack, squish, and squeeze in!
- Sweet tunes: chill lo-fi or jazzy café vibes!
- Art so cute it might make you meow.
- And of course – the pawsitively charming cat-baker!

Unlock more puzzles to solve with Baker's Puzzle Pack 1, Baker's Puzzle Pack 2 and Baker's Puzzle Pack 3 DLCs included in this bundle.

Each box is a new paw-some puzzle that’ll twist your brain like a pretzel. Warning: side effects may include uncontrollable smiling and sudden pastry cravings!


Oh, and if you figure out how the cat didn’t eat everything before you showed up… tell us. We’re still investigating.

Get ready to puzzle, pack and purr. Just don’t eat all the pastries... yet.

70070000028099.name: How 2 Escape Collection
70070000028099.description:
How to Escape

Time is running out!

Each wagon is timed in different ways that you’ll discover. Running out of time means defeat. 
The longer you wait, the more difficult it is to see clearly...
Both players will need to interact with each other and focus on their sense. Puzzles will require logic, coordination, observation and listening but most of all: communication!
No time to chitchat. Get out of the trapped train. Every second is counted.


How to Escape: Lost Submarine

Put your communication and puzzle-solving skills to the test as you and a partner work together to prevent the start of war! Each of you has a crucial role to play that requires logic, coordination, observation and, above all, communication!

As player one, your job is to locate and investigate the inside of the submarine, where you’ll explore and interact with the environment.

Your friend is tasked with using the dedicated free companion app* to gather additional information so you both can solve the puzzles together. 

*Get the free How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine Companion App on your smartphone.

70070000028129.name: Mini Market Design Complete Collection
70070000028129.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000028129.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the Furniture Material Collection 1, 2, 3, 4, Wallpaper Collection and Floor Design Collection allowing you to add new colors to your furnitures and rearrange your market.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000028136.name: Wingspan: European Expansion + Wingspan: Oceania Expansion + Wingspan: Asia Expansion
70070000028136.intro: Meet the extraordinary birds from the Wingspan expansions.
70070000028136.description:
This bundle includes:
Wingspan: European Expansion
Wingspan: Oceania Expansion
Wingspan: Asia Expansion

Wingspan: European Expansion takes you on a journey to another continent. Explore diverse European habitats and meet charming, beautiful birds with new interesting abilities.

In the adaptation of the award-winning Wingspan: Oceania Expansion embark on a journey through the breathtaking lands of Oceania. Learn about birds from around Australia and New Zealand and all-new resources and mechanics that will enrich your adventure of creating a wildlife preserve.

Explore the wonders of Asia in Wingspan: Asia Expansion! Discover new birds and bonus cards, compete in Duet Mode, and immerse yourself in rich landscapes with stunning art and soothing music. Compete in fresh challenges, and experience a serene journey with Asia's avian marvels!

70070000028139.intro: Discover birds and features from Wingspan's expansions and decorative packs.

70070000028159.name: SHUTEN ORDER Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000028159.intro:
Happy New End...Have a good end
Digital Deluxe Edition includes the main game as well as the Visual Art Book and Mini Soundtrack!
70070000028159.description:
■ Digital Deluxe Edition includes 
・The full game 
・Digital Deluxe Edition exclusive Visual Art Book & Mini Soundtrack

■Story  
“168 remaining until the end of the world...”
Humanity is approaching its end.

In a world steeped in despair and chaos, a strange religious organization called Shuten Order emerges, yearning for the end of humanity. The group rapidly gains followers, eventually forming a small nation state called Shuten.  

Tragedy strikes during the grand festival celebrating their nation’s founding—the leader of the Shuten Order is murdered. Soon after, the protagonist awakens with no memory, greeted by two self-proclaimed "angels". They reveal a shocking truth: the protagonist is the murdered Founder, revived by divine power. However, the resurrection is incomplete—their memories are gone, and their life limited to a mere four days.  

To survive, the protagonist must overcome "God's trial": identify and kill their murderer.

With the clock ticking, the protagonist, given the alias Rei, dives into the tumultuous city as a detective. The suspects? Five ministers of the Shuten Order. There's no time to investigate them all. Choices must be made, and the pursuit of truth demands sacrifice.  

Who killed the Founder? For what reason? Can the mission be fulfilled before time runs out?  
Thus begins a high-stakes, four-day hunt for the truth.  

■Gameplay & Game System:  
●Ministry of Security: Stealth Action Horror
Flee from the legendary killer Nephilim while investigating suspect Manji Fushicho.  

●Ministry of Justice: Mystery Adventure  
Solve a murder tied to the wealthy Kukuri family and expose the true killer linked to suspect Kishiru Inugami. 

●Ministry of Science: Multi-Perspective Visual Novel
Navigate a deadly terrorist attack at a research lab while shifting between characters to avoid fatal outcomes, targeting suspect Teko Ion.  

●Ministry of Education: Romance Adventure (?!)  
After being poisoned, head to Shuten Academy and unmask three enigmatic girls, one of whom is suspect/poisoner Honoka Kokushikan.  

●Ministry of Health: Extreme Escape Adventure  
Survive a death game orchestrated by an unknown force while interrogating suspect Yugen Ushitora.  

*Visual Art Book & Mini Soundtrack is a separate application from the main game.

70070000028226.name: Train Plus Rolling Stock Add‑On Pack: Complete Bundle
70070000028226.description:

From the classic orange‑and‑navy livery to bold collaborations with hit games, enjoy them all while blasting past 1,000 km/h!

70070000028237.name: Capybara Zen Premium Edition
70070000028237.intro: Meditation and breathing game bundled with a music player and a dedicated new song.
70070000028237.description:
Capybara Zen will help you relax, clear your mind, breathe and forget about stress.

Together with the adorable capybara and her kitty friend, indulge in meditation. Listen to the music, breathe, turn off your head and focus on yourself - here and now!

In addition, the game includes an option to listen to the music itself along with a bonus song.

70070000028247.name: Harvest Moon® Cozy Bundle
70070000028247.description:
Step into the timeless world of Harvest Moon with a special bundle featuring two fan-favorite titles, now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch™! Whether you're returning or discovering them for the first time, Harvest Moon: The Lost Valley and Harvest Moon: Skytree Village are now together on one game card, complete with all downloadable content included! Revisit cherished characters, like Doc in his debut appearance, and enjoy the ultimate farming adventure. Customize your landscapes, cultivate mysterious crop mutations, and experience endless thrills, romance, and exploration in both vibrant worlds.

Harvest Moon: The Lost Valley
The Lost Valley takes you on a journey to restore the missing seasons of a magical valley. After seeking shelter from a snowstorm, you awaken to find a mysterious Harvest Sprite buried in the snow. Together, you'll embark on a mission to return all four seasons, gathering help from villagers, Harvest Sprites, the Harvest Goddess, and even the King of the Underworld!

•	Grow crops and raise animals like cows, chickens, and sheep! 
•	Unleash your creativity with 3D terrain customization—dig, build, and reshape the land! 
•	Unlock the power of seven Harvest Sprites, the Harvest Goddess, and the Harvest God! 
•	Build lasting relationships with the villagers, find love, marry, and start a family! 
•	Enjoy extra outfits, buildings, crops, and characters with all DLC included!  

Harvest Moon: Skytree Village
Skytree Village immerses you in a once-thriving oasis now on the brink of collapse. The Harvest Goddess has lost her power, and the land is dry and desolate. It's up to you to restore the seven Skytrees to revive the Goddess and bring life back to the land.

•	Meet an array of quirky characters in a bustling town!
•	Customize your terrain to your heart's content!
•	Woo your favorite bachelor or bachelorette and start a family!
•	Discover new crops, flowers, and expanded fishing mechanics!
•	Engage in deeper fishing activities by expanding waterways and catching rare fish!
•	Unlock new cosmetic items and two additional characters with all DLC included!

70070000028260.name: Against the Storm - Complete Edition
70070000028260.intro: Rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains.
70070000028260.description:
You are the Viceroy – a leader charged by the Scorched Queen to reclaim the wilderness and discover lost riches for the Smoldering City, civilization's last bastion against the Blightstorm that destroyed the old world. Unlike most survival city builders where your focus is on a single city, in Against the Storm you must build a vast, prosperous network of settlements populated by diverse fantasy races, each with their own specializations and needs.

The wilderness holds many hidden dangers, and never-ending storms will batter your population into submission. If your settlements should fall, then the expedition may end – but not the game. Against the Storm is a roguelite city builder, meaning you will carry forward the resources, upgrades, and experience of your past expeditions each time you set off for a new journey into the wild.

MANAGE A DIVERSE POPULATION OF VILLAGERS
Foxes, beavers, and lizards stand alongside humans and harpies in the struggle to survive. Utilize their strengths as you balance varying needs, from housing and culinary preferences to taste in luxuries and recreation. Will you manufacture raincoats, brew ale, and bake pies to boost morale in the face of the oppressive hostility of the forest, or will you prioritize the needs of one species over another to operate more swiftly for the Scorched Queen?

CITY BUILDER MEETS ROGUELITE
Experience city builder gameplay enhanced by roguelite replayability. Build and manage multiple settlements spread across a large world map, all while collecting valuable meta-progression resources to upgrade the Smoldering City. Manage your reputation to secure success at one settlement before moving on to establish another, constantly seeking new opportunities for growth, taking on unique challenges across multiple biomes, and bracing for the inevitable destruction of everything but the Smoldering City itself. How will you maximize each cycle to not just ensure the best fate for the Smoldering City, but for your career as Viceroy as well?

NEVER THE SAME GAME TWICE
Every city location presents unique challenges for even the most resourceful Viceroy with hundreds of modifiers and multiple distinct biomes. Adjust your strategy to changing conditions and experiment with rosters of building blueprints and perks that can help your society thrive or bring it to ruin. Will you take on and complete additional objectives and delve deeper into the dangerous forest for potential boons, or will you approach with caution to ensure you operate within your capabilities?

BUILD AN ENDLESS NUMBER OF CITIES
Laying the foundations for a new city is one of the most exciting moments in a city-building game. In Against the Storm, you'll have the opportunity to repeatedly experience this by creating new settlements, while still interacting with your network of previously established cities in a growing world.

The Complete Edition of Against the Storm comes with the Keepers of the Stone DLC which introduces a new species, two new biomes, and a selection of new buildings, orders, risks, and opportunities for any Viceroy up for the challenge.

The Frogs join the effort to push back the storm, bringing their skill with stone masonry and love for water with them. Meanwhile, changing tides have unlocked new potential in the distance – though Coastal Groves remain isolated and hard to reach, the ancient, submerged settlements of the area hold great treasures waiting to be uncovered. Meanwhile, unique opportunities present themselves in the once-thriving forests left barren by the march of industry – the Ashen Thicket is littered with broken trunks and remnants of a past age, awaiting a masterful Viceroy to restore its forgotten glory.

70070000028301.name: Ecchi Memories: Kayla Edition
70070000028301.intro: Let the bras hit the floor
70070000028301.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 7 beautiful girls with alluring curves (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000028312.name: The Plucky Squire x The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse Bundle
70070000028312.description:
This bundle includes The Plucky Squire and The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse.

The Plucky Squire
The Plucky Squire follows the magical adventures of Jot and his friends - storybook characters who discover a three-dimensional world outside the pages of their book.

When the malevolent Humgrump realises he's the villain of the book - destined to lose his battle against the forces of good for all eternity - he kicks the heroic Jot out of its pages and changes the story forever.

Jot must face challenges unlike anything he's ever seen if he is to save his friends from Humgrump's dark forces and restore the book's happy ending.

Jump between 2D and 3D worlds in this charming action adventure - solving puzzles, boxing badgers, flying with a jetpack, and enjoying many more delightful and surprising mini challenges as you become the hero of a living storybook.

The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse
The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse is a compact action RPG that creates a unique adventure for each new hero of legend in the relentless fight against the evil Mormo. Explore a delightful but dangerous overworld, brave menacing dungeons, and improve your hero in a charming village, during your quest to overcome the evil that plagues the island. Unleash the mystical Sword of Ditto and grab a co-op friend for an unforgettable adventure filled with delightful characters, extraordinary loot, and heroic battles!

70070000028344.name: Puff Up & 9 Minigames
70070000028344.intro: Grow the biggest balloon and don't POP!
70070000028344.description:
Inflate your balloon as much as you can while dodging spiky balls. Time your moves perfectly to grow bigger without popping — and watch out, the bigger you are, the harder it gets! 

Challenge your friends in the exciting Versus mode, where 2 players go head-to-head! Race to the finish line or compete to collect the most coins before time runs and win!

Features:
- 9 Iconic Minigames: Take on extra challenges with Minigames Pack 1 & 2
- Versus mode: Battle your friends in a 1v1 challenge!
- Upgrades and Power-Ups: Boost your abilities and beat the odds
- Balloons and Skins: Customize your shape and looks
- Satisfying Gameplay: Enjoy smooth, thrilling action every time you play

Unlock new balloons with unique styles and customize your experience as you play. Power up your abilities, take on exciting mini-games, and push your skills to the limit with every challenge!

See how big you can grow without bursting under pressure!

70070000028392.name: My Cozy Room Rock 'n' Roll Edition
70070000028392.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000028392.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic, Easter, Summer and Rock DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000028394.name: A Hat in Time - Ultimate Edition
70070000028394.intro: The Deluxe Edition contains the A Hat in Time main game and the Seal the Deal and Nyakuza Metro DLCs.
70070000028394.description:
In A Hat in Time you play as a tiny space-travelling girl with a big tophat. Her adventure is halted when all her fuel, the Time Pieces, is lost and scattered across a nearby planet. Hat Kid must now jump, fight and stitch new hats to make her way into every nook and cranny of this new world in order to restore her fuel and resume her journey. On her way, she'll bump into the menacing Mafia of Cooks, the goofy birds of Dead Bird Studio, the spooky shadows of Subcon Forest, and more!

SEAL THE DEAL introduces:

- An all-new chapter: The Arctic Cruise
- A new incredibly difficult mode: Death Wish!
- Six new Time Rifts!
- A ton of outfits, flairs, dyes and even camera filters!

Note: The Arctic Cruise requires 35 Time Pieces to access. Death Wish requires 27 Time Pieces to access.
Note: Death Wish is exceptionally, brutally difficult. Please take this into account when considering this DLC.

Nyakuza Metro introduces:

- 10 New Time Pieces!
- Stickers! Stickers can be attached to your weapon, used with the Camera Badge, or as emotes!
- A new weapon: The Baseball Bat!
- A new Purple Time Rift: Rumbi Factory!
- New flairs, including the Nyakuza Mask, Burger Cap, Artistic Vision, and more!
- 2 new camera filters!
- 3 new badges!
- Over 20 new dyes, including Wireframe, Pizza Time and more!

70070000028400.name: Date Everything! - Lavish Edition
70070000028400.intro: Find the object of your affection
70070000028400.description:
Is 100 just simply not enough dateable objects? Are you unsatisfied with lower-priced goods?  Do you literally want to fall in love with a micro-transaction?

With the Lavish Edition there is simply more of everything to extend your Date Everything adventure:

•	Michael Transaction – the dateable micro-transaction! We gacha covered!
•	Lucinda Lavish – the dateable deluxe edition herself.
•	Fantastic Red Shirt – an unlockable option to be wearing a shirt that will sometimes be commented on by the dateables in a positive manner!
•	Phone Backgrounds – Customizable phone menu with 26 new background covers to add a little… personality! 
•	Artbook - Concept art for all 102 characters, plus never-before-seen costumes and collectables!
•	OST - 4 hours of every genre under the sun!

Date Everything! brings an exciting new twist on the dating simulator genre. 

Your BFA in customer service unfortunately goes to waste as you lose your job to AI. But... a mysterious stranger sends a gift - magical glasses called 'Dateviators' - which make your house come alive and dateable! 

Each dateable object will open up, have their own stories and potentially become your lovers, friends, or enemies. With an exhaustive Who's Who of voice actors keeping you company on your journey! 

Features:
•	100 Datable Characters
•	Fully Voice Acted
•	Branching Narratives 
•	At Least 3 Endings Per Dateable Character
•	Puns Galore!

70070000028434.name: Sky and Ground Assault - Call of Warzone & Fighter Aces Bundle
70070000028434.description:
In a chaotic world, survival demands grit, strategy, and firepower. This intense experience puts you in two brutal warzones: on the ground where tactics rule, and in the skies where speed and precision decide the fight. Every moment counts—this is war commanded, not played.

Call of Glory – Critical Warfare

War doesn’t wait for courage—it demands it.

In Call of Glory – Critical Warfare, hesitation means defeat. Every battle tests your instincts, tactics, and precision. Lead your squad through intense firefights where every move and shot can change the outcome. Adapt quickly, outsmart your enemies, and make every second—and every bullet—count. Whether defending teammates or striking fast, your role is key in a game where strategy decides who survives.

Highlights of Combat:

•Squad-Based Warfare: Cooperate and adapt mid-battle to keep the edge.
•Tactical Point System: Each kill and assist affects the final outcome.
•Diverse Arenas: Five unpredictable maps demand flexible tactics.
•Over 20 Weapons: Choose, upgrade, and dominate with your favorite tools.
•Instant Decision Battles: The smarter soldier always survives.

The war is moving fast—can you keep up?

Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance

When the sky burns, only the bold remain airborne.
This isn’t just a dogfight—it’s a battle for aerial supremacy. In Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance, speed, precision, and skill are your weapons. Pilot powerful jets, outmaneuver enemies, and dominate ever-changing skies. Whether racing against time, surviving endless waves, or completing missions, you’ll need sharp instincts and steady focus to win.

Core Flight Missions:

•Intense Campaign: Face off against dangerous foes in story-driven missions.
•Time Assault Challenges: Destroy with speed and rack up your bonus.
•Endless Survival: Dodge, fire, and stay in the air as long as possible.
•Aircraft Customization: Upgrade 3 unique jets with specialized gear.
•Strategic Arsenal: Equip air-to-air, air-to-ground, and air-to-ship weapons.
•Immersive Maps: Fly through cities, oceans, and storm-ridden skies.

Above the clouds, there are no second chances. Just you, your machine, and the fight.

Only the sharpest minds and quickest reflexes will triumph in these intense battles for glory.

70070000028471.name: Games Advent Calendar 2025 Bundle
70070000028471.intro: Double the advent calendar fun with this awesome bundle!
70070000028471.description:
In this double advent calendar package, enjoy double the fun! Hop aboard the train on a ride through the Winter Valley in Winter Games Collection + Advent Calendar or surprise yourself every day leading up to Christmas with challenging jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Advent Calendar!

Winter Games Collection + Advent Calendar offers:

70070000028478.name: KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It + "Dire Situations" DLC Bundle
70070000028478.description:
You can purchase the main game KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It and the additional content KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It DLC "Dire Situations" as a value bundle.

■Included in the Set
・KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It
・KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It DLC "Dire Situations"

＜Main game＞
Why do humans “read the air“?
The answer lies in this “KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It”.

This game puts the spotlight on the childhood of the main character “You”,
Let's Consider It with innocence while looking back on various events that everyone must have experienced in their childhood.

The basic rule of deciding what to do in situations by moving the red object on the screen is the same.

Please consider the situation and read the atmosphere according to the various scenes that will be asked.

＜Additional content＞
This is extra content for KUUKIYOMI 4: Let’s Play Together, and it’s all about one thing: high-stakes situations.

From small everyday mess-ups to zombie outbreaks and even alien encounters—this world is full of chaos.
Take control of the red object on screen and face 30 brand-new, slightly more dangerous scenarios than usual.

70070000028489.name: Spy Guy Indonesia Deluxe
70070000028489.intro: Together with Spy Guy, go on a journey to Indonesia.
70070000028489.description:

70070000028506.name: ISLANDERS: New Shores - The Full Archipelago Bundle
70070000028506.intro: Explore everything the ISLANDERS series has to offer.
70070000028506.description:
Explore everything the ISLANDERS series has to offer, see infinite isles and capture the moment in style. 

Included:

ISLANDERS: New Shores - Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

ISLANDERS (Classic) - A minimalist strategy game about building cities on colorful islands. Explore an infinite number of ever-changing new lands, expand your settlements from sprawling villages to vast cities and enjoy the relaxing atmosphere.

ISLANDERS: New Shores Photo Filter Pack - Add new layers to photo mode with 10 fresh filters to capture the moment with.

70070000028507.name: ISLANDERS: New Shores - Island Hopping Bundle
70070000028507.intro: Explore an infinite number of ever-changing new lands across both ISLANDERS and ISLANDERS: New Shores with the Island Hopping Bundle.
70070000028507.description:
Experience both ISLANDERS: New Shores and ISLANDERS (classic) with the Island Hopping Bundle. From the first in the series that introduced a relaxed atmosphere to city building, to the follow up which builds on the foundations adding new depth and replyability.

Included:

ISLANDERS: New Shores - Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

ISLANDERS (Classic) - A minimalist strategy game about building cities on colorful islands. Explore an infinite number of ever-changing new lands, expand your settlements from sprawling villages to vast cities and enjoy the relaxing atmosphere.

70070000028512.name: Goosebumps Terror in Little Creek - Frightmare Edition
70070000028512.intro: The Spookiest Version of Goosebumps: Terror in Little Creek
70070000028512.description:
The Ultimate Goosebumps Experience, Fully Creeped-Out!

Get ready for the most thrilling, spine-tingling Goosebumps adventure yet with the Frightmare Edition—a deluxe bundle packed with the full base game, Goosebumps Terror in Little Creek, and bursting with all the eerie, exclusive content included in the fright-filled Fright Pack. This edition delivers the definitive Goosebumps mystery experience for players of all ages.

INCLUDES THE BASE GAME: Goosebumps Terror in Little Creek
• Explore the spooky town of Little Creek in a brand-new original Goosebumps story
• Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and battle horrifying new monsters
• Sneak, sling, and spellcast your way through eerie environments in suspenseful, family-friendly horror gameplay
• Shape your story with multiple endings based on your choices

PLUS ALL THE CONTENT FROM THE FRIGHT PACK:

MONSTER MASKS & SLINGSHOT SKINS
• Equip 5 iconic monster heads from the Goosebumps universe: Slappy, Haunted Mask, Lawn Gnome, Werewolf of Fever Swamp, and Attack of the Jack O’Lanterns
• Each mask comes with a matching slingshot skin and custom-colored VFX trail for maximum spooky style

3D MODEL VIEWER
• Rotate and zoom in on your favorite characters, monsters, and props in full 360° detail—perfect for fans and collectors

CONCEPT ART GALLERY
• Explore a curated collection of stunning behind-the-scenes artwork used to create the world of Little Creek

70070000028583.name: Pets and Friends Flowers Bundle
70070000028583.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of colorful flowers.
70070000028583.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new flowers to add variety to your album.

70070000028588.name: Rocket Car : Ultimate Ball League Machines - Speed Tycoon
70070000028588.intro: Drive faster. Upgrade smarter. Win easier.
70070000028588.description:
The Rocket Car : Ultimate Ball League Machines - Speed Tycoon gives you everything you need to jump into the action and dominate the league. It includes the main game plus the Boost Your Balance DLC, ensuring you’re fully equipped for an adrenaline-pumping racing experience!

With this bundle, you’ll get:
- Rocket Car: Ultimate Ball League Machines – Dive into the full game featuring fast cars, thrilling soccer action, and diverse game modes. Whether you’re a seasoned racer or a newcomer, the game offers something for everyone with its high-speed gameplay and immersive environments.
- Boost Your Balance DLC – Start with a bang by getting 100,000 credits, allowing you to instantly customize and upgrade your cars to suit your playstyle.

Don’t wait—get the power Bundle now and accelerate your journey to victory!

70070000028622.name: Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Complete Bundle
70070000028622.intro: Enjoy the full experience of the mountains with this Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Complete Bundle.
70070000028622.description:
Enjoy the full experience of the mountains with this Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Complete Bundle. Bike your way downhill whilst finding your own unique playstyle and make it up through the ranks to the top of the leaderboards!

The Lonely Mountains: Downhill Complete Bundle consists of:
- Lonely Mountains: Downhill (Base Game)
- DLC: Eldfjall Island
- DLC: Riley's Return
- DLC: Misty Peak
- DLC: Sierra's Revenge
- DLC: Redmoor Falls

70070000028637.name: Sunseed Island Cozy Kitchen Edition
70070000028637.intro: Set sail, collect, and restore – cozy vibes, charming creatures, and endless discoveries await!
70070000028637.description:
Welcome to Sunseed Island, the perfect escape for cozy gamers who love to farm, explore, and collect! Rebuild a lost village, befriend magical creatures, grow crops, fish in tranquil waters, and upgrade your tools. Discover the secrets of a mystical tree and reconnect the scattered islands!


Key Features:
- Rebuild & Restore – Help quirky NPCs bring their village back to life.
- Explore Diverse Islands – Travel across five unique biomes full of secrets.
- Complete Themed Exhibitions – Collect insects, fossils, fish, dishes, and plushies for the town hall.
- Upgrade & Expand – Improve your tools to farm, mine, and gather resources more efficiently.
- Relax & Fish – Cast your line and reel in a variety of unique fish.
- Meet Magical NPCs – Each has an animal-like form and a symbol reflecting their role.
- Uncover a Cozy Mystery – Restore the Great Sunseed Tree and reunite the islands.

This bundle includes Artisanal Walls & Floor, Artisanal Kitchen DLC, unlocking additional decorations for your house.

A long time ago, the islands were united by the Great Sunseed Tree, but when its power faded, the land shattered. Now, it’s up to you to restore the islands, rebuild the village, and uncover hidden magic.

Travel through five stunning biomes, each packed with wildlife, treasures, and secret challenges. Donate insects, fossils, fish, and dishes to themed exhibitions in the town hall and earn adorable plushies for completing NPC quests. Upgrade your tools to gather resources more efficiently and unlock new possibilities.

Meet quirky, magical NPCs, each inspired by real animals and marked with a symbol reflecting their role. Navigate freely, interact seamlessly, and enjoy a stress-free farming adventure!

Set sail for Sunseed Islands and let your cozy journey begin!

70070000028645.name: Cozy Land Enchanted Edition
70070000028645.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000028645.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

Create your unique cozy land with additional Wild West Set 1, Wild West Set 2, Science & Fantasy Set 1 and Science & Fantasy Set 2 DLCs included in this bundle.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.
