70070000028672.name: Bridge Race: Rush Edition
70070000028672.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70070000028672.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

NEW VERSUS MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Compete with your friends in an exciting head-to-head split-screen showdown. Choose your custom color and unique skin, set the number of rounds, and let your building skills shine. Earn points each round based on your finish, and see who rises to the top of the leaderboard. Ready to show off your skills and claim victory? 

Features:
- 4 additional skins to show off your style!
- 10000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition—who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000028675.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: 4X4 Extreme Adventure
70070000028675.intro: Unleash legendary rigs with golden precision.
70070000028675.description:
Gear up for the ultimate off-road adventure with the Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: 4X4 Extreme Adventure, combining the core game with the Gold Rush DLC. Dive into an intense, next-gen off-road experience, featuring legendary vehicles, challenging biomes, and the tools you need to conquer the toughest terrain.

Mudness Offroad Car Simulator
Explore three distinct biomes—muddy forests, sandy careers, and snowy mountains—across a massive, detailed map with 6 bases. Complete thrilling delivery tasks and side missions, or simply enjoy free-roaming in the harshest off-road environments. With multiplayer capabilities, you can team up with friends to tackle the toughest challenges.

Gold Rush DLC
Enhance your journey with 15,000 gold, giving you the ultimate advantage to upgrade your vehicles, enhance your winch, and fine-tune your car’s suspension, body, wheels, and engine for maximum performance. Whether you’re rescuing stuck vehicles, completing challenging deliveries, or just having fun in the mud, this DLC ensures you’re always prepared for whatever the road throws at you.

Get ready to conquer the toughest terrains, unlock golden rewards, and elevate your off-road game to new heights. The ultimate adventure begins now with the Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: 4X4 Extreme Adventure!

70070000028678.name: Monster Survivors: Echo Edition
70070000028678.intro: Survive, adapt, and conquer in a world overrun by monstrous creatures!
70070000028678.description:
The world is overrun by terrifying creatures, and only the toughest will make it out alive! Battle endless waves of monsters, face massive bosses, and upgrade your survivors to become unstoppable.

Features:
- new survivor: Echo!
- 150 crystals to promote your survivors
- 300 gems for chests and upgrades
- Non-Stop Action: Fight endless waves of monsters and test your survival skills
- Epic Boss Battles: Take on giant beasts and earn powerful rewards
- Survivor Upgrades: Unlock skills and level up your characters
- Ever-Changing Gameplay: No two runs are the same!
- Immersive Experience: Stunning visuals and intense sound effects

Every run is a new challenge! Improve your stats, unleash devastating abilities, and buy epic artifacts as you carve your path through the apocalypse. 

How long can you last before the monsters overwhelm you?

70070000028680.name: Hentai Girls Deluxe Edition
70070000028680.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000028680.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will help Yui, one of the girls from the main game, clean and throw away unnecessary things.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000028689.name: Hentai Games Collection Vol. 1
70070000028689.intro: Three stories. Three secrets. One unforgettable bundle.
70070000028689.description:
Hentai Games Collection Vol. 1 contains three titles:

Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil
Embark on a romantic adventure across the colorful landscapes of Rio de Janeiro in Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil. Play as Touji Ishikawa, a young heir to a prestigious family business in Japan, as he ventures into the vibrant streets of Rio de Janeiro in search of true love.

In this visual novel with puzzle mechanics, immerse yourself in Touji's quest to break free from the expectations of his family and discover his path in life.

Meet Tainara Alves, a spirited Brazilian beauty whose passion for dance and zest for life will ignite a spark within Touji's heart. Explore the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro, from the dazzling lights of Carnival to the tranquil shores of Copacabana Beach, as you uncover the secrets of Tainara's world.

But the path to true love is never easy, and Touji and Tainara will face their fair share of challenges along the way. Join them as they unravel mysteries and solve puzzles to see what’s waiting for you next.

KEY FEATURES:
– Pocket love story
– Over 19 puzzles to solve along the way – the difficulty level rises going forward
– Beautiful anime-style characters
– Not the last Touji journey



Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!


WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?
While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?


LET THEM CHARM YOU
During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?


ONLY ONE WINNER
Despite the beauty and charm of all the girls, only one will be able to win the competition. Which one of them will impress you enough to award her the golden apple? Are you going to go with your heart or will you play fair?

And most importantly: will you find love in Love Elysium?

KEY FEATURES:
- An amazing story waiting for you
- 5 endings to discover = 5x more gameplay
- Unique personalities and temperaments of the girls
- Many dialogue options you can choose from
- Breathtaking island full of magical places
- Different reactions of girls depending on what you say



Hentai Academy
Hentai Academy opens the door to a school full of delinquents – teens who need help with getting a headstart in life. Kenji, whose shoes you’ll step into, is passionate about giving them a second chance. Besides lectures and school trips, you will soon find yourself entangled in the matters of the heart of a fellow teacher.


IN SEARCH OF PASSION
You started a new life in a new place! The headmaster wants you to be comfortable so he introduces you to your guide - Camille - a beautiful young woman who teaches art. After a day well-spent together…


FIND LOVE WHERE IT IS LEAST EXPECTED
…you start getting closer. Where will this relationship go? What obstacles will stand in your way? Will you help the troubles of the heart just like you help the troubled teens?


KEY FEATURES:
- A story of true love full of passion and spark between the characters
- Puzzles to solve along the way with increasing difficulty
- Iconic and colorful locations

70070000028690.name: Hentai Games Collection Vol. 2
70070000028690.intro: Four sizzling adventures in one ultimate hentai bundle.
70070000028690.description:
Hentai Games Collection Vol. 2 includes four titles:

Hentai Stars
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.


Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations



Hentai World
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 artpieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise



Hentai Girls
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise



Hot&Hentai
Those captivating girls will invite you to take part in the most alluring puzzle experience available on Nintendo Switch™.


ANIME AS AN ART FORM
Immerse yourself in the beautiful anime-inspired art of Hentai Girls, where you'll get to know these stunning and intriguing women. Solve their puzzles to advance through their stories, all while enjoying their charming company.


CHALLENGING PROGRESSION
While the gameplay starts off simple, the challenges grow as you move forward. Stay focused – their enticing outfits might be distracting.


KEY FEATURES:
- Stunning hand-drawn Hentai illustrations
- Soothing background music
- Easy-to-learn gameplay with increasing difficulty
- A unique and special concept

70070000028691.name: Hentai Games Collection Vol. 3
70070000028691.intro: Golf, Solitaire, and a Cute Clock - All in One Bundle!
70070000028691.description:
Hentai Games Collection Vol. 3 includes three titles:

Hentai Golf
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.


KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack



Hentai Solitaire
Dive into a charming world full of cards and girls with Hentai Solitaire. Play the most iconic card game and practice your skills all along. Switch between cards, think about your next move and try to organize your deck from ace to king. 


ONE DECK TWO MODES
Test yourself in two available modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire. Try out both of them and check if you manage to complete them with no trouble. If you feel like you are stuck you can always go back or ask for a little help to receive a small hint.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
At any point of the game you can change the appearance of your deck. Simply choose one out of the ten amazing girls waiting for you and enjoy your new cover. 


KEY FEATURES:
- Each playthrough is a new challenge
- 2 game modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire
- 10 stunning girls on covers
- Relaxing soundtrack



Anime Clock
This summer, the way you use your clock will change forever. Say hi to Yusei and Kinneko! Enjoy the day together and check what girls are doing while time is passing by.

A simple, fail-proof design with a unique premise is the ultimate recipe for an awesome Clock. 

Go around your day alongside beautiful anime girls. Keep each other company. Take a look at their everyday lives with a bright smile.

Customize your new timepiece. Set up alarms, and enjoy every second with this daring reinvention of the classic clock experience.

Key features:

- Tell time!
- Set alarms
- Great for every minute of the day
- Brilliant design
- Customization options

70070000028695.name: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree Deluxe Edition
70070000028695.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
- Digital Artbook & Soundtrack

In this Roguelite adventure set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

- ENTER A VIBRANT WORLD FILLED WITH BEAUTY AND PERILOUS DANGER
On their quest to restore peace, play as Towa and the Guardians as they explore far-off lands threatened by Magatsu’s evil influence. In a world where even splendor hides a lurking threat, courage is the only way forward. As Hitoshi Sakimoto’s melodies guide the way, a breathtaking yet untamed landscape unfolds where the fight to save Shinju Village begins.

- FIGHT AS A DUO IN THRILLING ROGUELITE COMBAT
Towa, priestess of Shinju, stands united with 8 trustworthy companions to defeat Magatsu. Fight alongside a fellow guardian and wield the power of the sacred sword (Tsurugi) and staff (Kagura). Each guardian has its own abilities and set of swords, making each combat style and guardian pair unique. Together, pave your way through colorful lands, conquer dungeons, and defeat Magatsu’s minions!

- FORGE WEAPONS AND BONDS THAT STAND THE TEST OF TIME
As the guardians pursue their quests across different timelines, the village evolves over the years. Develop unique bonds with its residents and learn more about their customs and stories that are woven into the inner workings of the village. Each visit is a chance to train at the dojo, summon powerful Graces, and craft new swords at the smithing shop.

*A Standard Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000028697.name: Knights & Guns Full Edition
70070000028697.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000028697.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2, Armor Pack #1, Armor Pack #2  and Armor Pack #3 with:
- 20 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 16 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000028698.name: Go Kart Mania Upgrade Edition
70070000028698.intro: Your Ticket to World Kart Racing!
70070000028698.description:
"Go Kart Mania" the ultimate kart racing game brings the thrill ride right to your Nintendo Switch™.

Race through 36 uniquely challenging tracks in iconic locations from Europe, China, and Australia, each offering a distinct racing experience. 

Customize your kart to outsmart competitors. 

Engage in heart-pounding competition across the world, or treat yourself to a quick solo race to become a karting legend.

"Go Kart Mania" is your ticket to a world of high-speed excitement and adventure. 

Don't miss out - start your engines for an unforgettable racing journey!

This bundle includes the base game and Livery Pack #4 with:

-an exclusive collection of skins that transform your kart into a stunning display of speed and style.

70070000028699.name: Vege Bubble Shoot Superior Edition
70070000028699.intro: Pop, Match, Harvest! Dive into a vibrant veggieventure!
70070000028699.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Vege Bubble Shot, a colourful and addictive puzzle game that will captivate your gaming senses. Dive into a fruity adventure where you'll use your strategic skills to save a delightful vegetable garden from pesky intruders and become a puzzle master!

Key Features:

    Vivid Vegetable Vistas: Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world brimming with hand-crafted, vibrant vegetables. Explore lush garden settings and interact with charming characters.

    Challenging Puzzles: Put your aim and matching skills to the test with a variety of engaging puzzles. Can you clear the garden of intruders with your accurate shots?

    Power-Ups and Boosters: Utilize an array of powerful boosters and unique power-ups to enhance your gameplay. Create spectacular chain reactions to tackle the intruders with flair.

    Endless Fun: Vege Bubble Shot offers hundreds of levels, ensuring hours of engaging entertainment for both short and extended gaming sessions.

    Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: The game is designed for players of all skill levels, with straightforward mechanics for beginners and depth for those seeking a greater challenge.

Multiplayer included! Vege Bubble Shot is the perfect game for both casual players and competitive gamers. Aim, shoot, and match your way through the captivating vegetable garden, and bring back harmony one bubble at a time. Don't miss the opportunity to experience this addictive and colourful adventure!

This bundle includes base game, Harvest Havoc #1 and Harvest Havoc #3 with:

- 40 all-new levels

70070000028700.name: Fashion World Superior Edition
70070000028700.intro: Maker your mark in the Fashion World!
70070000028700.description:
Welcome to glamorous "Fashion World," where style meets puzzle in a dazzling arcade adventure!

If you've got a flair for fashion and a passion for puzzles, "Fashion World" is your runway to shine. Transform into a chic stylist aiming to capture the most fabulous outfits and become a celebrated fashion photographer.

- 80 levels of fashionable fun!
- Create stunning looks with countless combinations of costumes, accessories, and scenic backdrops!
- Capture your creations in Photo Mode!
- Strive for perfection with the three-star rating system, boosting your game's replay value.
- Designed for fashion lovers of all ages!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 (Glamour Gala) and expansion pack #3 (New Wave) with: 

- 40 all-new levels of puzzles

70070000028708.name: CybeRage: Shock Edition
70070000028708.intro: Survive endless waves of alien creatures and crush the heart of the infestation!
70070000028708.description:
Phy embarks on a secret mission to an abandoned planet infested by a hostile hivemind. With the help of her partner Lizz and General Eral, she dives into the depths of the infestation and learns the dark truth behind its origins. Help her find the heart of the hive and put an end to this evergrowing threat.

Kill hordes of nasty bugs and use the experience gained to strengthen your arsenal and body with cybernetic enchantments. The hive will adapt and send more powerful enemies to stand in your way. Shoot them down with your army of drones, or slash them to pieces with your blade and stop the hivemind from growing even stronger!

Features:
- Engaging story: Accompany Phy in her quest against the hive
- Side stories: Explore 1 new metro lines and discover unique locations
- Immersive world: Experience 24 hand-crafted cyberpunk levels
- High-tech arsenal: 11 fighter drones to upgrade and evolve
- Melee weapons: 6 powerful swords with unique active abilities
- Rogue-lite progression: Unlockable permanent augments
- Contracts: Complete tasks to earn credits

Will you help Phy defeat the hive and save the cyber age from impending doom?"

70070000028709.name: Ashwood Valley Deluxe Edition
70070000028709.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000028709.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

Get ready for winter with Cozy Comforts Style DLC included in this bundle.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70070000028721.name: ISLANDERS: New Shores - The Scenic Builders Pack
70070000028721.intro: Explore infinite new shores and capture the moments in style.
70070000028721.description:
Explore infinite new shores and capture the moments in style with ISLANDERS: New Shores and 10 Photo Mode Filters.

Included:

ISLANDERS: New Shores - Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

ISLANDERS: New Shores Photo Filter Pack - Add new layers to photo mode with 10 fresh filters to capture the moment with.

70070000028725.name: Hentai Golf Deluxe Edition
70070000028725.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000028725.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses and check girls' winter outfits with Prairie Greens DLC included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000028731.name: Attack Hole: Hero Edition
70070000028731.intro: Swallow everything and become the biggest black hole!
70070000028731.description:
Eat whatever is in your path! Move fast, absorb everything in sight, and grow BIGGER! Grab as many weapons as you can before time runs out, then blast away your final target. The bigger your hole, the more powerful you become!

Features:
- 2 premium skins with powerful abilities!
- 15 extra power-ups to eat more and faster!
- 250 additional gems for buying skins and power-ups!
- Exciting levels packed with stuff to gobble up
- Animated skins to make your black hole look awesome
- Crazy power-ups to help you grow even faster
- Challenge mode where you consume a whole town
- Epic battles against huge bosses
- Easy controls so anyone can play
- Simple rules and tons of fun!

Pick a cool skin, zoom through fun levels, and see if you can swallow it all before the clock hits zero!

Ready, set, SWALLOW! How much can you eat before time runs out?

70070000028735.name: Rage Swarm: Rapid Fire Edition
70070000028735.intro: Step into the swarm and rise as the ultimate survivor!
70070000028735.description:
Armed with powerful weapons, blast through waves of fierce enemies to reach the ultimate boss. Collect upgrades along the way to power up and make every shot count!

Features:
- Get lots of premium equipment and supplies including weapons, armor, and designs!
- 2500 extra gems to spend on loot boxes
- Navigate through various landscapes
- Defend yourself from the fierce invaders
- Pick up upgrades to get stronger
- Level up and buy awesome talents
- Complete quests for useful loot
- Open epic loot boxes and enhance your gear

Unleash a diverse arsenal – from classic firearms to devastating rocket launchers – each with unique abilities for unstoppable action. Gear up with special outfits, each boosting your strength and making every battle more dynamic.

Dodge, shoot, and strategize your moves. Are you ready to conquer the swarm?

70070000028740.name: Farm It: Cute Edition
70070000028740.intro: Build your own dream farm! Take care of your animals, harvest crops, and sell homemade goodies at the local market!
70070000028740.description:
Plow the field, plant seeds, water the soil, and watch your crops grow! 

Enjoy the country life with other fun activities like fishing, feeding chickens, or cooking yummy food, ensuring there's never a dull moment on your farm!

Grow different crops, from carrots and radishes to oranges and big watermelons! Take orders and keep your customers happy with delicious meals and drinks made with your very own ingredients!

Features:
● live the country life as a real farmer!
● harvest carrots, eggplants, apples, and all your favorite fruits and vegetables
● feed chickens, geese, donkeys, and buffaloes to gather resources
● go fishing in a nearby pond and catch different kinds of fish
● cook food using your own ingredients and sell it in the local market 
● customize your character with over 200 clothes and hairstyles!
● make your farm feel like home with almost 300 decorations!
● buy anything you want with 5000 extra coins!

Express your unique style by changing the look of your character and spending your earnings on a wide range of clothes, shoes, hairstyles, and hats!

Relax with soothing sounds and enjoy satisfying visuals as you farm it all!

Start your farming adventure and create the farm of your dreams!

70070000028751.name: Pixel Cafe Premium Edition
70070000028751.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000028751.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipement, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game and Kitchen Touches (DLC #3) with:

A different variant for the Refrigerator
An updated Oven and Stove design
A new look for the Sink
An alternative style for the Bar
And, freshen up with two more wallpapers perfect for any space.

70070000028752.name: Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge: Complete Edition
70070000028752.intro:
Just go Up, Down, Left or Right. Easy, is it NOT?
The ultimate brain-busting challenge is back with a fully revamped version!
70070000028752.description:
Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge that messes with your head and makes you doubt your intelligence.

Read the instructions written on the cube and run towards the correct direction. Be careful about the time limit and don't let your brain get tricked!

Features:
- 6 unique skins for your character
- 6 cool backgrounds for a change of scenery
- Discover new game MODES and many LEVELS to challenge your brain in various ways
- Improve your brain skills everyday with the DAILY and WEEKLY CHALLENGE and reach the TOP of the leaderboard!
- Exclusive Multiplayer Versus mode for up to 4 players! Share the brain busting in NORMAL, HARD or EXTREME difficulty levels
- Classic mode. Each level raises the difficulty up with new instructions
- Challenge mode. Reach the best score in a bottomless pit of despair!
- Unlock unique SKINS to customize your experience
- MEASURE your progress with the statistics dashboard and compare them with your friends!
- Color blind accessibility mode
- Brand new GRAPHICS

This misleading expert aims at crushing your brain's ability to think properly. Can yours handle it?

70070000028759.name: Flight Attendant & Ultimate Rock & Space Cleaner & Cash Guardian Simulator & Bundle
70070000028759.intro: From skies to space, cash to cliffs — master every role.
70070000028759.description:
Dive into the Flight Attendant & Ultimate Rock & Space Cleaner & Cash Guardian Simulator & Bundle and experience four wildly different professions—each packed with challenge, strategy, and immersive gameplay. From protecting millions to cleaning alien goo, climbing cliffs, and serving at 30,000 feet, this bundle has something for every simulation fan.

	•	Cash Guardian: Collector Operation “Capital Defense”
Take on the high-risk role of an armored transport specialist. Defend your cargo, outsmart criminals, and complete 100+ thrilling missions in a dynamic urban environment.
	•	Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector
Explore the aftermath of alien battles as a high-tech janitor. Clean up destroyed space stations, uncover hidden artifacts, and restore order across the galaxy.
	•	Ultimate Rock Climbing Challenge
Scale cliffs and push your limits in a breathtaking climbing adventure. Customize your climber, conquer difficult routes, and prove you’ve got what it takes to reach the top.
	•	Flight Attendant Simulator: Onboard Tasks
Join the skies as a rookie flight attendant. Handle emergencies, keep passengers happy, and climb the ranks in a realistic and rewarding aviation journey.

Four professions. Countless challenges. Total immersion.
Flight Attendant & Ultimate Rock & Space Cleaner & Cash Guardian Simulator & Bundle—where every job is anything but ordinary.

70070000028760.name: Alchemy: Origins Season 3
70070000028760.intro: Alchemy: Origins + Alchemy: Origins Food I + Alchemy: Origins Food 2 + Alchemy: Origins Hobby and Leisure
70070000028760.description:
Alchemy: Origins is a classic alchemy game that starts you with 4 basic elements and allows to connect them to create more and more elaborate items - all the way to reaching the stars.

Discover over 500 unique elements that can be combined in multiple ways. Can you find them all?

70070000028765.name: Tank vs Tank Legendary Edition
70070000028765.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000028765.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint #1, War Paint #2 and War Paint #4 with:

-12 unique tank skins and 12 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000028776.name: Snooker Fever Diamond Edition
70070000028776.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000028776.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Expansion Pack #3 with:

15 new table designs and 5 sleek cue styles

70070000028777.name: Formula Racing Pro 2025 Diamond Edition
70070000028777.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000028777.description:
Get behind the wheel in Formula Racing Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Formula racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #3 with:

-9 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000028782.name: Bodycam Stray Kitty DELUXE
70070000028782.intro: Unleash the full stray cat adventure — chaos, music, and a whole new sky!
70070000028782.description:
Step into the paws of a stray cat living a life full of fun, freedom, and unexpected adventures. Explore urban rooftops and backyards while completing quirky tasks and causing playful chaos in a vibrant world designed for curiosity and mischief.

This bundle includes the main title and two DLCs to expand your experience: fresh music that brings extra groove to every paw step, and a brand new skybox that transforms your world from above.

Live the life of a curious stray cat, complete quirky and playful tasks, and create chaos in cozy urban landscapes. Explore, jump, dig, and roam freely — now with enhanced audio vibes and a stunning new atmosphere to match your every adventure.

70070000028819.name: Our Exciting Summer Camp + More Activities Pack Set
70070000028819.intro:
It's time for an adventure in the great outdoors!
Enjoy the wonders of nature at this exciting summer camp!
70070000028819.description:
The usual crew heads off to summer camp!
Share Joy-Con™ and play with up to 4 players!

A new set with both Our Exciting Summer Camp and the More Activities Pack is now available!

70070000028820.name: Peachy Derby - Demon Edition
70070000028820.intro: 60FPS racing game where the girl Natsuki is forced to join the "Ninja Racing Tournament" to pay off her debt. 10 girls,100 dances anims, 600 voices, 16 chapters.
70070000028820.description:
Peachy Derby+Mephisto - Demon Maid

[Peachy Girl's Adventure]
Experience the story of girl Natsuki joining the ""Ninja Racing Tournament"" with her friends to pay off her debt. A total of 16 chapters. 

[Humanoid Kart Racing]
Choose a girl and reach the finish line before the others.Use ninja tools to attack enemies.

[Let the Girls Dance]
In addition to racing, choose dances, outfits, and Japanese voice lines for the girls.

70070000028825.name: Darts Fever Elite Edition
70070000028825.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000028825.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game, Stylish Precision #1, Stylish Precision #3 and Stylish Precision #4 with:

15 brand-new dart designs

70070000028826.name: My Cozy Room All in one
70070000028826.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000028826.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic, Easter, Summer, Rock, Halloween, Dogs, Cottagecore and Mediterranean DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000028832.name: My Cozy Room Season Collection
70070000028832.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000028832.description:
Description: My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock newest Cottagecore and Mediterranean DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000028837.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Hatsune Miku Music Pack
70070000028837.intro: Join the one and only Hatsune Miku in a musical adventure with her OFFICIAL Music Pack!
70070000028837.description:
Featuring SIX new Rhythm Rifts for:
- "Too Real" by Danny Baranowky feat. Hatsune Miku (free song!)
- "Intergalactic Bound" by Yunosuke & CircusP feat. Hatsune Miku
- "M@GICAL☆CURE! LOVE ♥ SHOT! by SAWTOWNE" feat. Hatsune Miku
- "Just 1dB Louder" by IOSYS TRAX feat. Hatsune Miku
- "MikuFiesta" by AlexTrip Sands feat. Hatsune Miku
- "Radiant Revival" by Jamie Paige feat. Hatsune Miku

Each Rhythm Rift comes with:
- A fully-bopping Hatsune Miku virtual idol
- Background visualizer with leek and music note particle FX

70070000028838.name: Dentist Bling: Science Edition
70070000028838.intro:
Ready for the ultimate dental experience?
Dive into the world of tooth care and become a master dentist!
70070000028838.description:
Treat your patients with different dental issues, from cavities to plaque buildup, and watch as their smiles transform under your expert care!

Perform treatments under time pressure, and don't forget about your customer's comfort. If you drill too long in the teeth, the customer will be dissatisfied with your service!

Features:
- perform a lot of different dental procedures on your new mad scientist's chair 
- decorate customers' teeth with new sparkling diamonds or apply a varnish that will change their color
- work under time pressure and do your job the best you can! 
- unlock and apply 12 tooth skins, 10 bling skins, and 10 chair skins
- upgrade the look of your clinic to make it cozier 
- buy an upgrades so your customers can last longer during dental treatment

Pull out decaying teeth and replace them with shiny new ones. Change their shape to fangs or apply braces. Yes doctor, at your salon, your patients LOVE braces!

Don't forget about your special BLING diamond treatment. This is a fancy teeth salon after all! 

Whatever you do, BLING, make them smile!

70070000028845.name: Atelier Ryza Secret Trilogy Deluxe Pack
70070000028845.description:
A definitive edition of the "Secret" series, "Atelier Ryza: Secret Trilogy DX," complete with new stories, playable characters, and features.  
This set features all three Secret series DX titles for a discounted price:

- "Atelier Ryza: Ever Darkness & the Secret Hideout DX"
- "Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX"
- "Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key DX"

Note:
- Each of the titles in this set can also be purchased separately. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- French is available only for "Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy DX"
- Please check the official "Atelier Ryza DX" site for details.

70070000028851.name: Snug Finder: Deluxe Edition
70070000028851.intro: Hey there, Finder! You’ve just uncovered something truly special — a charming hidden object adventure with delightful DLCs is waiting for you!
70070000028851.description:
A beautiful hidden object game awaits you with Snug Finder: More Fun and Snug Finder: Hidden Joy DLCs — guaranteed to bring you hours of fun!

Snug Finder is a charming hidden object game. Step into the role of a keen-eyed finder and search for all the hidden items — but be warned, it’s not always as easy as it seems!
Immerse yourself in a delightful experience filled with hand-drawn illustrations, soothing sounds, and a cozy atmosphere. Enjoy hours of gameplay across 75 beautifully crafted levels with over 500 hidden objects. Let the adventure begin!

Features:
-Over 500 hidden objects to discover
-75 beautifully illustrated levels
-Stunning hand-drawn visuals
-Relaxing, cozy atmosphere
-Full touchscreen support

70070000028856.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.14
70070000028856.description: This is a special set of all four titles in the fourteenth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2".

70070000028857.name: Jigsaw Masterpieces 2: Starter Pack - Famous Classic Paintings
70070000028857.intro: Begin your exploration of classic art with this special value bundle! It's the perfect introduction for puzzle lovers and art enthusiasts alike.
70070000028857.description:
This bundle includes the base game, Jigsaw Masterpieces 2, as well as a carefully curated set of additional content featuring timeless painting masterpieces.
Enjoy piecing together some of the most iconic and beloved artworks in history — all in the form of relaxing jigsaw puzzles.

There are a total of 70 puzzles, including 61 classic paintings and three animated jigsaw puzzles.
Expand your experience with more puzzle content available through additional content sold separately.

Included in this bundle:
-Jigsaw Masterpieces 2 (Base Game)
-World’s Finest Art: Renaissance Collection
-World’s Finest Art: Baroque Collection
-World’s Finest Art: Rococo Collection
-World’s Finest Art: Neoclassicism Collection
-World’s Finest Art: Romanticism Collection
-World’s Finest Art: Impressionism & Post-Impressionism Collection

70070000028868.name: Spy Guy Jigsaw Fun Premium Edition
70070000028868.intro: A set of premium puzzles and additional new images.
70070000028868.description: The basic version of Spy Guy Jigsaw Fun enhanced with new images!

70070000028870.name: Hole io: Doomsday Edition
70070000028870.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the universe!
70070000028870.description:
Choose your favourite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Features:
- 7 maps with different things to swallow 
- 21 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning  during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000028872.name: Candivity: Pirate Edition
70070000028872.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
70070000028872.description:
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

NEW VERSUS MODE!
Race to merge the biggest candy while using clever tactics to slow down your opponent. Unleash tricky power-ups, and prove who’s the ultimate candy master!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Features:
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode for you and your friend!
- Versus mode to sabotage your friends!
- 2 standard maps and a new Under Water map!
- New animal characters and swimming accessories
- Fully customizable name and character
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
- An adorably sweet aesthetic

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000028874.name: POLICE SIMULATOR & CRITICAL STRIKE & HUNTER SIMULATOR & WARFRONT TACTIS (SHOOTER & SIMULATOR BUNDLE)
70070000028874.intro: Are you ready to answer the call from every front?
70070000028874.description:
No backup. No second chances. Just you—and the mission.
Step into the line of fire across four explosive games where only skill, strategy, and sheer determination will see you through. The bundle delivers hard-hitting gameplay in four distinct worlds, each demanding a different kind of hero.

- Cop Officers: Police Simulator of NYPD City
Crime doesn’t sleep, and neither do you. Hit the streets of a crime-ridden city as a relentless NYPD officer. Pursue suspects, conduct raids, and enforce the law by any means necessary. Patrol with purpose, and show criminals that order still has a name.
- Critical Strike: SWAT Rescue Missions
Hostages are held. The clock is ticking. As the leader of an elite SWAT unit, you're the last line between chaos and control. Breach doors, clear rooms, and make every bullet count in tense, tactical operations where one wrong move spells disaster.
- Hunter Simulator Wild Hunting
No safety nets. No second shots. Stalk deadly predators through unforgiving wilderness where you’re not just the hunter—you’re also the hunted. Use stealth, precision, and instinct to survive in an open world ruled by nature’s fiercest beasts.
- Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator
Total war. Zero mercy. Command massive battles in a physics-driven strategy experience where every unit matters, and every mistake is punished. Outthink, outflank, and outfight your enemies as you carve your name into the history of war.

One bundle. Four battlegrounds. No compromises.
If you're looking for action, danger, and high-stakes decisions at every turn, this is the bundle you’ve been waiting for. Suit up, load out, and prove you have what it takes to dominate in every arena.

70070000028877.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: hololive Music Pack
70070000028877.intro: Transcend dimensions with the OFFICIAL hololive Music Pack!
70070000028877.description:
Featuring FOUR new Rhythm Rifts for:
- "BIBBIDIBA" by Hoshimachi Suisei
- "Play Dice!" by Hakos Baelz
- "Ahoy!! 我ら宝鐘海賊団☆" by Houshou Marine
- "Carbonated Love" by IRyS

Each Rhythm Rift comes with:
- A fully-bopping hololive talent
- Background visualizer with triangle particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design.

**A Massive Chumbud Send-Off for Gawr Gura!**

As a bonus, celebrate the graduated icon with the free Rhythm Rift, available now for everyone:
- "REFLECT" by Gawr Gura

Thank you, legendary shark!

70070000028884.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 Ultimate Edition
70070000028884.description:
EA SPORTS FC™ 26 Ultimate Edition includes‡:

- 4500 FC Points over 2 months††
- 1 additional Ultimate Team™ Player Evolution Slot

Clubs rewards:
- 1 Archetype Unlock Consumable
- 2 Double AXP for 10 Matches Consumables

Career rewards:
- 3 ICON Career Players
- 5-Star Coach available for hire in Manager Career
- 5-Star Youth Scout available for hire in Manager Career
- Manager Live Challenge Content

The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC™ 26.
Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience powered by community feedback, Manager Live Challenges that bring fresh storylines to the new season, and Archetypes inspired by greats of the game.

Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26, featuring the best players from the biggest clubs and competitions around the globe, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering more than 20,000 authentic players.

70070000028891.name: CrashMetal - Drift Racing Car Driving Simulator: Boosted Legends
70070000028891.intro: Dominate the streets with unmatched power.
70070000028891.description:
Get ready for the ultimate street racing adventure where speed, style, and skill rule the streets. This bundle includes the full game CrashMetal - Drift Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 plus the exclusive Skyline R32 DLC, giving you all you need to dominate every race.

CrashMetal - Drift Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games
Experience stunning next-gen graphics, realistic physics, deep car customization, and intense urban racing. Compete in high-stakes career challenges and feel the adrenaline rush.

DLC - Legendary Skyline R32Unlock the legendary Skyline R32 with advanced tuning and exceptional performance to stand out on the streets. Elevate your racing experience with this must-have DLC.

Race harder. Drive faster. Own the streets.

70070000028896.name: Street Drag Racing – King Racer
70070000028896.intro: Master the city streets and own every race.
70070000028896.description:
Elevate your racing experience with this complete bundle that brings together Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games and an exclusive Garage Expansion DLC.

- Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games - is a must have game for all cars lovers! You can Build, Race, and Tune your car until it’s at the absolute peak of it’s performance.

- Garage Expansion DLC - adds the iconic Lamborghini Huracan to your collection—or, if you already own it, grants you its full in-game value.

All you need to race, upgrade, and dominate the streets is right here — grab the complete bundle now!

70070000028898.name: Hentai Solitaire Secret Deck Edition
70070000028898.intro: Pull an ace out of your pocket and check what challenges await you!
70070000028898.description:
Dive into a charming world full of cards and girls with Hentai Solitaire. Play the most iconic card game and practice your skills all along. Switch between cards, think about your next move and try to organize your deck from ace to king. 


ONE DECK TWO MODES
Test yourself in two available modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire. Try out both of them and check if you manage to complete them with no trouble. If you feel like you are stuck you can always go back or ask for a little help to receive a small hint.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
At any point of the game you can change the appearance of your deck. Simply choose one out of the ten amazing girls waiting for you and enjoy your new cover. 

Unlock new covers for your deck with Cards Pack 1 and Cards Pack 2 DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Each playthrough is a new challenge
- 2 game modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire
- 10 stunning girls on covers
- Relaxing soundtrack

70070000028900.name: Shooter Bundle - Ghost Assassin, Hotline, Water Blast, Shadowblade, Yori's Journey
70070000028900.intro: Why choose one style when you can conquer all?
70070000028900.description:
Dive into an explosive collection of five action-packed indie games filled with strategy, adrenaline, and intensity. Shooter Bundle - Ghost Assassin, Hotline, Water Blast, Shadowblade, Yori’s Journey delivers a variety of gameplay experiences, from stealth assassinations and neon-drenched rampages to water gun battles, shadowy parkour, and post-apocalyptic survival.

Included Games:
Ghost Assassin – Stealth Strike
Master the art of silent assassination in a challenging stealth game where every step counts. Eliminate enemies with precision, use a variety of weapons, and avoid detection in increasingly complex levels.

Ruthless Carnage Hotline
Enter a neon-soaked world of chaos and crime. Pick your fighter and unleash brutal force through 13 intense levels of top-down mayhem. Stylish, fast, and unforgiving.

Water Blast Shooter – Wet Gun
Gear up for the most refreshing first-person shooter around. Soak your opponents with powerful water blasters across vibrant maps. Quick reflexes and smart tactics are your keys to victory.

Shadowblade Knight Symphony
Become a shadow warrior in a fluid, parkour-driven action game where combat and movement blend into one. Use your living weapon and chain agile moves into a deadly performance of skill and precision.

Yori’s Journey: Forgotten Origins
Fight for survival in a mysterious virtual experiment. Face deadly enemies, unlock combat techniques, and master powerful combos in this third-person combat adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world.

Whether you prefer stealth tactics or all-out chaos, this bundle offers hours of intense and unforgettable gameplay.
Step into the action. Now.

70070000028901.name: RISE & IRONFALL - VD-dev Legacy Pack
70070000028901.intro: Dive into the heart of the resistance  to repel the invasion… then hit the futuristic tracks in full arcade mode! The bundle delivers breathtaking solo, online, and local-split-screen action.
70070000028901.description:
RISE: Race The Future:
Experience the most addictive racing gameplay! Drift and slide like never before thanks to an exceptional fluid and precise physics-based slippery handling. Unique futuristic cars, smooth powerslides, jumps and water zones take old-school rally arcade games to the next level of fun!

IRONFALL Invasion:
In campaign mode, engage in intense battles against the Dyxide invaders across 11 thrilling levels, discovering new weapons and facing 9 types of enemies.
In multiplayer mode, challenge players worldwide and train against AI in Survivor mode.Earn “credits” by playing and you can bet on the outcome of games to increase your winnings, but beware of losing your stake if you don't succeed!

70070000028902.name: CAR SIMULATOR BUNDLE (CAR WASH, CAR HEIST, CAR DETAILING)
70070000028902.intro: Three games, one journey through the automotive universe.
70070000028902.description:
Dive into the exciting world of automobiles with three unique games, each offering its own style and challenges. This bundle delivers a complete experience—from luxury car care to building a car wash empire and pulling off high-stakes vehicle heists. 

	•	Car Detailing & Wash Simulator: Use professional tools to clean and restore rare, exotic cars to pristine condition. 
	•	Car Wash Tycoon: Start with a small manual car wash and grow your business into a fully automated, thriving enterprise. 
	•	Car Heist Simulator: Become a legendary thief by planning and executing stealthy heists on the most coveted vehicles. 

Each game offers a different perspective on the automotive industry, blending management, strategy, and intense action. Get ready to step into the shoes of an auto expert, entrepreneur, and master thief—all in one powerful bundle!

70070000028924.name: Hot&Hentai Secret Edition
70070000028924.intro: Step into the brand new version of the enchanting world of Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000028924.description:
Those captivating girls will invite you to take part in the most alluring puzzle experience available on Nintendo Switch™.


ANIME AS AN ART FORM
Immerse yourself in the beautiful anime-inspired art of Hentai Girls, where you'll get to know these stunning and intriguing women. Solve their puzzles to advance through their stories, all while enjoying their charming company.


CHALLENGING PROGRESSION
While the gameplay starts off simple, the challenges grow as you move forward. Stay focused – their enticing outfits might be distracting.

This bundle includes Gamer Etsuko and Garden Queen Shirayuki DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Stunning hand-drawn Hentai illustrations
- Soothing background music
- Easy-to-learn gameplay with increasing difficulty
- A unique and special concept

70070000028929.name: Just Dance 2026 Edition
70070000028929.intro: Gather your friends and family and turn your home into a dance floor with Just Dance 2026 Edition, featuring 40 exciting new tracks!
70070000028929.description:
From chart-topping hits to timeless classics, there's something for everyone.
The party never ends with Just Dance+!* Get 1 month of free access included with the game to enjoy hundreds of songs.

Create unforgettable memories with Just Dance 2026 Edition!

ENJOY 40 HOT NEW SONGS
From the hottest hits to timeless classics, there's a song for everyone and every moment in our all-new tracklist featuring:
- APT. By ROSÉ & Bruno Mars
- Houdini by Dua Lipa
- Counting Stars by OneRepublic
- Hung Up by Madonna

BRING YOUR FRIENDS AND FAMILY TO THE PARTY
Dance solo, in co-op, or get competitive:

70070000028930.intro: Gather your friends and family for an epic dance party with Just Dance 2026 Edition!
70070000028930.description:
With 40 new tracks, from hits to classics, there's something for everyone.
Try the new co-op Party mode or perform full-body dance sessions with your phone's camera!

70070000028936.name: Pool Fever GOTY Edition
70070000028936.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000028936.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

15 new pool table designs
10 new pool cues designs

70070000028939.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Diamond Edition
70070000028939.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000028939.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #3 with:

Add style to your rides with this exclusive set of premium skins for your favorite bike.

70070000028944.name: Midnight Drifter – Drift Racing Car Racing Driving Simulator: Racer’s Deluxe
70070000028944.intro: From tuning to triumph, become unstoppable.
70070000028944.description:
Unlock the full potential of your drifting passion with this exclusive bundle! Dive into the ultimate street racing experience and make your mark both on the track and in your personal garage.

Title Bundle includes:
	•	Midnight Drifter – Drift Racing Car Racing Driving Simulator 2023 Speed Games, featuring realistic driving physics, a wide range of cars, and intense drift racing challenges.
	•	Garage X DLC introduces a new garage design, giving your home base a fresh visual identity that’s as impressive as your skills on the road.

Race hard, drift faster, and create a garage that reflects your style. This bundle offers the complete Midnight Drifter experience — on the streets and behind the scenes.

70070000028952.name: Architect Life - Deluxe Home Edition
70070000028952.description:
Unlock a rich collection of cosmetic items to design even more original interiors and captivate your clients at first glance with the Deluxe Home Edition!

This edition includes:

· The full game Architect Life: A House Design Simulator 

· The HOBBIES PACK, featuring a wide variety of items to create the leisure spaces of your dreams: games, fitness, home cinema, music, painting, pottery, astronomy... everything you need to turn any room into a true expression of your passions!

· The SKETCH HOUSE PACK, including 30 unique furniture and décor elements designed to immerse your clients in stunning optical illusions, along with an exclusive customization for your architect’s office.

70070000028953.name: MADO MONOGATARI: Fia and the Wondrous Academy Deluxe Edition
70070000028953.intro: Enroll in the Ancient Magic Academy and become a Great Mage!
70070000028953.description:
Show you got what it takes to become a Great Mage and grab the Deluxe Edition today! 

The Deluxe Edition includes:
・Digital game
・Digital Art Book (64 pages)
・Digital Soundtrack (27 tracks)
・The Apprentice Mage Enrollment Set*

*The Apprentice Mage Enrollment Set will only be available as FREE DLC for the first two weeks after the game's launch to purchasers of the Digital Standard Edition or Digital Deluxe Edition and includes:

・Mage Hat x 5
・Special Spicy Curry x 3
・Quality Pickled Scallions x 10
・Special Apple Juice x 3
・Special Spice x 3
・Miracle Water x 3

70070000028954.name: Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil Playful Hearts Pack
70070000028954.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.
70070000028954.description:
Embark on a romantic adventure across the colorful landscapes of Rio de Janeiro in Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil. Play as Touji Ishikawa, a young heir to a prestigious family business in Japan, as he ventures into the vibrant streets of Rio de Janeiro in search of true love.

In this visual novel with puzzle mechanics, immerse yourself in Touji's quest to break free from the expectations of his family and discover his path in life.

Meet Tainara Alves, a spirited Brazilian beauty whose passion for dance and zest for life will ignite a spark within Touji's heart. Explore the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro, from the dazzling lights of Carnival to the tranquil shores of Copacabana Beach, as you uncover the secrets of Tainara's world.

But the path to true love is never easy, and Touji and Tainara will face their fair share of challenges along the way. Join them as they unravel mysteries and solve puzzles to see what’s waiting for you next.

Relive your favorite moments from Brazil with Best Stories 1 and Best Stories 2 DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Pocket love story
– Over 19 puzzles to solve along the way – the difficulty level rises going forward
– Beautiful anime-style characters
– Not the last Touji journey

70070000028967.name: Bus Simulator 2023: City Driver – Traffic Master
70070000028967.intro: The city is waiting — are you ready to drive?
70070000028967.description:
Step into the vibrant world of urban transportation with this complete bundle that includes the base game and exclusive DLC! In Bus Simulator 2023: City Driver – Traffic Master, take control of a diverse fleet of buses and navigate through a detailed, lively city. Transport passengers through heavy traffic while following routes and schedules, using an intuitive control system and realistic physics.

What you get in this bundle:
- Bus Simulator 2023: City Driver – step into the role of a skilled bus driver and navigate the busy city, making sure passengers reach their destinations on time!
- New Bus DLC – unlock the “Sobol Omsi” bus or receive a cash compensation (170,000).

Discover the city, manage your passengers, and enjoy a complete and realistic bus driving experience!

70070000028995.name: Sweet Survivors: Funky Edition
70070000028995.intro: The purr-fect storm is coming! Can you protect your café from fluffy chaos?
70070000028995.description:
It looks like a normal day at the café… but suddenly, swarms of love-craving cats are storming in, and only you stand between them and total feline chaos! Armed with laser pointers, yarn balls, and even the dreaded pickle of doom, you’ll have to keep these fluffballs at bay while serving your customers their precious coffee. No big deal, right?

Features:
- Face down hordes of fluffy invaders
- Unlock 9 quirky toys and 7 heroic waiters
- Conquer shifts in 3 different café battlegrounds
- Upgrade your waiters and toys to become the strongest cat-wrangler
- Enjoy purr-fectly fun gameplay and cute visuals

Get ready for waves of fur and whiskers as you protect two cozy cafés. Upgrade your toys and special skills to become the best cat-fighting waiter around! With each shift, you’ll unlock new waiters, fun toys, and even more cat-tastrophes!

Can you save your café before the cats take over?

70070000028997.name: Neo-Retro Summer Set
70070000028997.description:
Up your enjoyment of Suika Game with this exclusive summer skin set!

"Fruit Parlor","Summer Cream Soda","Aurora Pool","Neon City"

- 38 interchangeable fruit parts
- New designs for Poppy and boxes (4 types)
- Background skins (4 types)

70070000028998.name: Sausage Wars: Fire Edition
70070000028998.intro: An Epic Sausage Battle till the last drop of ketchup for up to 4 Players and 20 Bots!
70070000028998.description:
Careful - it’s a hot-dog-eat-hot-dog world out there. So fight to the death and push them all till your enemies are oozing Tomato Blood!!

With this edition you will unlock:
- new Burning stage in each local multiplayer mode! 

Wait for the right moment, push the sausage homies in the fire and watch them cook well. Just don't get roasted!

Release to head-bang and push enemy sausages into sausage wars battle obstacles like sharp tools, kitchen sinks, garden fire, or off the counter to their doom. The crowded city is overcrowded and we need to empty it! Try to push them all, fight and smash those sausages to smithereens!

Don’t forget your hot-diggity-dog victory dance at the end of each sausage wars battle level! Make sure you become the biggest wiener in town!

70070000029000.name: Parasol Superstars
70070000029000.intro: Rain or shine - it's time for two adventures!
70070000029000.description:
A STAR-STUDDED DOUBLEFEATURE!

PARASOL STAR:
The legendary bubble dragons Bub and Bob are back... in human form!?

In this critically acclaimed Taito classic, available on modern consoles for the first time, the now-transformed Bubby and Bobby embark on a mission to save their neighboring planets. But this time, instead of blowing bubbles, our favorite duo swings colorful parasols filled with magical powers.
Use parasols as a shield against enemy projectiles or stun, and pick up and throw foes as projectiles themselves!

Featuring:
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- Creative and clever game mechanics with magical Parasols
- More Parasols! Enjoy the tactical depth of the action-filled 2-Player Co-op
- A cosmic journey with 8 vibrant planets (and 2 secret bonus levels) 
- Catchy and memorable soundtrack

AND...

SPICA ADVENTURE:
Join Nico, a little girl clad in all pink and armed with an extraordinary parasol, on a dangerous yet colorful journey through space!
From the arcade legends, TAITO, experience this formerly Japan-exclusive 2D action jump & run filled with charm and cartoonish delight on modern consoles for the very first time! Reminiscent of the parasol from Parasol Stars: Bubble Bobble III, this yellow parasol will become your favorite accessory and best weapon. Use it to take down a wild mix of enemies that come straight out of a toybox!

Featuring:
- Straight from the Arcades: Experience an arcade classic transported to consoles for the very first time!
- A Kaleidoscope of Colors: Feast your eyes on the uniquely cute and colorful 2D graphics.
- Parasol Action: Show off your extensive combat skills with the parasol!
- Through the Universe: Choose your own journey across the 28 colorful stages of Spica.
- Legendary Arcade-inspired Soundtrack: Vibe to the rhythm of ZUNTATA’s funky tunes!

70070000029005.name: Ecchi Secrets: Complete Edition
70070000029005.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls
70070000029005.description:
Beneath every fog lies temptation... and danger. Outsmart your enemies and peel back the mystery to reveal anime girls waiting just for you.
The further you go, each secret you uncover brings you closer to their hidden desires. But be warned: the path to pleasure is full of challenges. Are you bold enough to unveil every surprise?
Features:
- Over 142 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes

70070000029009.name: Snake.io Ultimate Edition
70070000029009.description:
For those who love everything Snake.io!

Develop your skills, try to survive as much as you can and become the biggest snake. You start as a small snake, get bigger by eating other snakes who try to do the same. You have to attack wisely but defend skillfully. How long can you survive?

Attack fast with the mass-eject booster and get in front of other snakes to beat them when they hit you head on, no matter how small you are or how big they are. The best one wins.

Play against your friends as well! Snake.io introduces local multiplayer where you can compete with up to 3 other players on the same device for the highest score!

In the live event game mode, you'll need to complete a series of challenges in order to unlock each month's exclusive skins. Beware the boss snake as you try to complete these challenges, but with careful capture of the attack point you can take it down and claim its pellets for yourself! Make strategic use of super pellets to grant yourself a brief bout of invincibility and speed to assist you in taking down the formidable bosses!
Each monthly live event will contain the following features:
- 4 levels of increasingly difficult challenges
- 4 unlockable skins, themed around the monthly live event
- Roughly 25 days to complete all of the challenges each month!

Game Features:
- Grow fast to dominate the board with smooth gameplay
- No lag due to connectivity issues
- Supports handheld, docked, tabletop, and even touchscreen joystick controls
- Local Multiplayer with up to 4 players
- Access to unique live event game mode and real-time leaderboards
- 6 Elemental themed skins with the Elemental DLC
- 6 Pet themed skins with the Pets DLC
- 6 Mythology themed skins with the Mythology DLC

How to play:
- Cut in front of other snakes quickly to make them explode when they hit you head on
- Once you get them to hit you, eat them as fast as you can to gain more mass
- Eject mass to boost your speed with one button
- Try to beat the highest score based on your length during a session
- Internet connection is not needed, play wherever, you are offline or online

Are you a snake or a worm?

70070000029010.name: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess Tides of Warmth
70070000029010.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess?! In this visual novel divinely beautiful girls will steal your heart!
70070000029010.description:
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!


WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?
While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?


LET THEM CHARM YOU
During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?


ONLY ONE WINNER

70070000029019.intro: As a professor in a school for troubled teens you’ll have one goal - to teach, but what will you do when a troubled heart comes your way?

You started a new life in a new place! The headmaster wants you to be comfortable so he introduces you to your guide - Camille - a beautiful young woman who teaches art. After a day well-spent together…

Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny is a vibrant, universe-spanning mashup that brings iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy-style tropes and real-time RPG action.
