70070000029096.description:
Welcome to Sunseed Island, the perfect escape for cozy gamers who love to farm, explore, and collect! Rebuild a lost village, befriend magical creatures, grow crops, fish in tranquil waters, and upgrade your tools. Discover the secrets of a mystical tree and reconnect the scattered islands!


Key Features:
- Rebuild & Restore – Help quirky NPCs bring their village back to life.
- Explore Diverse Islands – Travel across five unique biomes full of secrets.
- Complete Themed Exhibitions – Collect insects, fossils, fish, dishes, and plushies for the town hall.
- Upgrade & Expand – Improve your tools to farm, mine, and gather resources more efficiently.
- Relax & Fish – Cast your line and reel in a variety of unique fish.
- Meet Magical NPCs – Each has an animal-like form and a symbol reflecting their role.
- Uncover a Cozy Mystery – Restore the Great Sunseed Tree and reunite the islands.

A long time ago, the islands were united by the Great Sunseed Tree, but when its power faded, the land shattered. Now, it’s up to you to restore the islands, rebuild the village, and uncover hidden magic.

Travel through five stunning biomes, each packed with wildlife, treasures, and secret challenges. Donate insects, fossils, fish, and dishes to themed exhibitions in the town hall and earn adorable plushies for completing NPC quests. Upgrade your tools to gather resources more efficiently and unlock new possibilities.

Meet quirky, magical NPCs, each inspired by real animals and marked with a symbol reflecting their role. Navigate freely, interact seamlessly, and enjoy a stress-free farming adventure!

Set sail for Sunseed Islands and let your cozy journey begin!

70070000029129.name: Stasis Bundle
70070000029129.intro: Explore the acclaimed sci-fi horror duo of the STASIS series.
70070000029129.description:
Experience the gritty atmosphere of an abandoned spacecraft and navigate a massive underwater base. 
Solve puzzles to progress and unravel the mysteries around you in this bundle containing STASIS and STASIS: BONE TOTEM.

***** STASIS
Experience a thrilling underwater adventure with classic point-and-click gameplay. Explore with 3 characters simultaneously. Ready for a journey to hidden places deep below the waves...?

STASIS is an isometric, point-and-click, sci-fi horror adventure game. It intertwines a gruesome narrative with retro adventure gameplay. Combine items, interact with computers and solve puzzles while experiencing the gritty atmosphere.

FEATURES:
▪ LOSE YOURSELF IN SOUND - experience cinematic AAA music composed by the legendary Mark Morgan,
▪ A BLAST FROM THE PAST - a retro adventure gameplay mixed with a gruesome narrative,
▪ WANDER AROUND THE GROOMLAKE - click, read and interact to explore the dark corners of your surroundings. Gather items and clues that will help you solve the puzzles,
▪ THE VOICES ARE GETTING LOUDER - unfold the story with professional voice acting that brings depth to every character.

***** STASIS: BONE TOTEM
Experience a thrilling underwater adventure with classic point-and-click gameplay. Explore with 3 characters simultaneously. Ready for a journey to hidden places deep below the waves...?

FEATURES:
▪ WATER UNDER, AND OVER THE BRIDGE - Delve deeper and deeper into a mysterious underwater facility
▪ MAC OR MACGYVER? - Combine items, swap between characters, and solve puzzles to progress
▪ SEASHELL RESONANCE - Listen to the beautiful, atmospheric score by Mark Morgan
▪ FAMILY FEUD - Explore the complicated family dynamic of Mac, Charlie, and their trusty Super-Toy, Moses
▪ IMMERSED -  Let the stunning visuals and deep narrative transport you to the bottom of the ocean where an ancient secret waits to be discovered

Follow Mac and Charlie, a husband and wife duo, who make their living scouring the ocean for salvage. But, when they stumble upon an abandoned oil rig in the Pacific Ocean, they uncover a horrific secret that Cayne Corporation will do anything to keep hidden.

As you embark on your adventure playing Mac, Charlie, and their trusty Super-Toy, Moses, you'll encounter an immersive narrative filled with spine-tingling horror and unexpected twists. Combining the thrilling storytelling of STASIS and a tense underwater setting, STASIS: BONE TOTEM offers a personal story that will test the limits of family resilience.

Navigate through a massive underwater base, complete intricate puzzles, and solve an ancient secret concealed at the bottom of the ocean. BONE TOTEM features the same isometric, point-and-click gameplay that made STASIS a classic fan favorite, but with a new cast and a unique setting that will leave you gasping for breath.

With stunning visuals, a music score by Mark Morgan, a screenplay written by a Hollywood ace, voice acting by veteran actors, and a gripping storyline that will keep you on the edge of your seat - STASIS: BONE TOTEM is a must-play game for horror and sci-fi adventure fans.

So what are you waiting for? 
Dive into the unknown and uncover the BONE TOTEM beneath the waves.

70070000029145.description:
This bundle contains the base game Yomi 2 and the Renegades Expansion.

The base game is packed full of characters and modes. The expansion includes two new characters (Troq and River), two new gems (Orange and Diamond), and the ability to play any of the unlockable "wacky rulesets" from the base game's Career Mode in online friend matches.

70070000029147.name: Atelier Yumia - "Fantasy Academy" Costume Set
70070000029147.intro: Go investigating in new academy-themed costumes.
70070000029147.description:
A set of academy-themed costumes for Yumia, Flammi, Viktor, Isla, Rutger, Nina, and Lenja (one for each character, with seven total).

List of Contents:
- "High-Class Dream Style" Costume for Yumia
- "Boba Tea" Costume for Flammi
- "Newbie Maid" Costume for Isla
- "Perfect Butler" Costume for Viktor
- "Wolf of the Streets" Costume for Rutger
- "Ultimate Teacher" Costume for Nina
- "Twilight Memories" Costume for Lenja

Note:
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room (the relevant characters must also have joined your party).
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content and that these items can be purchased individually. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Note that when making individual purchases, Yumia and Flammi's costumes will be sold as a set but not separately.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70070000029149.name: "Fantasy Academy" Costume Set for Yumia and Flammi
70070000029149.intro: Academy-themed costumes for Yumia and Flammi.
70070000029149.description:
Adds a unique academy-themed costume for both Yumia and Flammi (two total).

List of Contents:
- "High-Class Dream Style" Costume for Yumia
- "Boba Tea" Costume for Flammi

Note:
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room.
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.

70070000029154.name: Tank vs Tank Super Edition
70070000029154.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000029154.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint and War Paint #4 with:

-8 unique tank skins and 8 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000029159.name: Can Touch This DLC and Party Time DLC Bundle
70070000029159.description:
Can Touch This DLC

Rebuild & Reconstruct!
Take matters into your own hand. Almost literally. With the help of your new, trusty hammer, 
it's time to redecorate like you've never done before. Refurbish walls to your heart's content, 
changing their features and decor as you see fit. Decide where to put trash cans or where to 
move the cash register to. Direct the crowd. Show your customers the right way to orderly 
queue without taking too much space. It's time to take interior customisation to a completely 
new level.
Paint & Spray!
No need to stare at an empty canvas any longer! Grab your spray can and add a little 
personal touch to any surface you can lay your hands on. With adjustable scale and rotation,
you can spray anything from large murals to tiny easter eggs hidden somewhere in the 
corners of your station. Combine existing decals with each other, creating even more 
elaborate and complex pieces of art. And whenever you start feeling like you're running out, 
more designs lie hidden all around for you to unlock!
Warehouse & Workshop
Did you ever feel like your station was missing something? That flair didn't quite measure up 
to par when looking beyond your main building? Have no fear for the future is here. From 
tables to desks to banners and lights, your Warehouse and Workshop now possess a full 
suite of purchasable customisations! Make the diamond in the sand shine even brighter than before.

Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

70070000029189.name: Majorariatto Duo Bundle
70070000029189.intro: This bundle includes two games from the developer Majorariatto: Ambidextro, pureya.
70070000029189.description:
This bundle includes two games from the developer Majorariatto:

* Ambidextro
* pureya

AMBIDEXTRO
A witch has kidnapped the prince and the princess. As the royal wizard, you have been severed in half so you can go rescue both at the same time, but first you’ll need to learn to control the two halves of your body simultaneously.

With a series of quick single-screen platforming levels, Ambidextro will help you master the art of controlling two characters at once, one with each hand. Learn to split your focus and tackle increasingly challenging levels you would have thought impossible.

PUREYA
Simple arcade games are great, but they can get boring quickly. What if they changed every 10 seconds?

Pureya is a collection of arcade minigames that play with just 2 buttons. Every 10 seconds, the game will jump from one random minigame to another.

Avoid obstacles and collect as many marbles as you can, then use them in the pachinko machine to unlock new mini games, music and skins.

Enjoy a varied collection of 30+ minigames 10 seconds at a time or challenge them individually to aim for a high score.

70070000029197.name: Pizza Bar Tycoon Full Edition
70070000029197.intro: Become a pizza magnate! Create the best pizza in town!
70070000029197.description:
Look out! This pizzeria will soon become the talk of the town!

Well... at least that's the plan. 

Your customers are already queuing up, so you'll have to serve them as quickly as possible. However, that's easier said than done!

Everyone's in a hurry and you'll have to prepare each order correctly, or else your customers are going to get crossed!

Give it your all and you'll come out on top!

IN PIZZA BAR TYCOON YOU WILL FIND:

* 60 levels to explore, 70+ dishes to serve.
* Great cartoonish graphics, music and sound effects.
* Countless upgrades you can apply to ingredients and bar decorations.
* 47 Achievements to complete.
* Easy to play and hard to master.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2, Endless Mode and Multiplayer Mode with:

* 40 new levels
* local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 
* endless gameplay mode

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000029199.name: Darts Fever GOTY Edition
70070000029199.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000029199.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game, Stylish Precision #1, Stylish Precision #2, Stylish Precision #3 and Stylish Precision #4 with:

20 brand-new dart designs

70070000029200.name: Spy Guy Hidden Object Countries Extension
70070000029200.intro: Discover all the Spy Guy themed add-ons in the countries category!
70070000029200.description: Go with Spy Guy on a journey to the USA, Greece, Indonesia and Rome! Discover all the themed add-ons and find more than 2,500 hidden objects!

70070000029201.name: Hentai Golf Sunny Sands Edition
70070000029201.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000029201.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses with Prairie Greens and River's Edge DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000029207.name: STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar - Super Digital Deluxe DLC Set
70070000029207.intro: Gain access to all the DLC included the Super Digital Deluxe edition of STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar
70070000029207.description:
This premium set includes the following items:

- Trunk of Transformation
  - Additional hairstyles:
     - Braid & Flowers
     - Cat Ear Buns with Highlights
     - Short Perm
     - Side Part with Highlights
  - Animal costumes:
     - Chick Costume Sets
     - Alpaca Costume Sets
  - Ninja Set: 
     - Ninja Outfit
     - Ninja Glider
     - Ninja Bazaar Set
- STORY OF SEASONS: Grand Bazaar Digital Soundtrack and Digital Art Book

70070000029214.name: Puff Up: Classic Edition
70070000029214.intro: Grow the biggest balloon and don't POP!
70070000029214.description:
Inflate your balloon as much as you can while dodging spiky balls. Time your moves perfectly to grow bigger without popping — and watch out, the bigger you are, the harder it gets! 

Challenge your friends in the exciting Versus mode, where 2 players go head-to-head! Race to the finish line or compete to collect the most coins before time runs and win!

Features:
- 6 Iconic Minigames: Take on extra challenges with Minigames Pack 1
- Versus mode: Battle your friends in a 1v1 challenge!
- Upgrades and Power-Ups: Boost your abilities and beat the odds
- Balloons and Skins: Customize your shape and looks
- Satisfying Gameplay: Enjoy smooth, thrilling action every time you play

Unlock new balloons with unique styles and customize your experience as you play. Power up your abilities, take on exciting mini-games, and push your skills to the limit with every challenge!

See how big you can grow without bursting under pressure!

70070000029217.name: Flight Attendant Simulator: Onboard Tasks - Final Call
70070000029217.intro: Your journey to the skies starts here.
70070000029217.description:
Step into the exciting world of aviation with this complete package. Manage passenger safety and comfort while navigating realistic cabin scenarios and challenging in-flight situations.

Flight Attendant Simulator: Onboard Tasks
Experience the life of a rookie flight attendant as you ensure passenger comfort and safety on global flights. Handle demanding passengers, respond to emergencies, and master cabin crew duties in a detailed, realistic simulation.

Money Pack DLC:
Get an instant boost with 2,500 in-game currency. Use this bonus to unlock premium uniforms, special training modules, and other valuable upgrades that accelerate your career progression and help you stand out from day one.

Take off with confidence and style — your path to becoming a top flight attendant starts here!

70070000029221.name: Cat's Cosmic Puzzle Deluxe Edition
70070000029221.intro: A purrfect puzzle among the stars!
70070000029221.description:
Ready to test your brain in a galaxy full of fluffy tails and twinkling stars? In Cat Cosmic Puzzle, adorable cosmic kittens need your help organizing their dreamiest constellations!


Key Features:
- Over 90 spacey puzzles to solve!
- 29 glowing kitties to discover!
- Lo-fi space beats and dreamy cosmic tunes
- A crew of sweet stargazing kittens to guide you!
- Relaxing, visually enchanting experience for puzzle lovers of all ages

Expand your cosmic journey with the Space Odyssey 1 DLC, included in this bundle.

These celestial cats aren’t just sleeping on clouds – they’re puzzling over how to fit themselves as star-shaped pieces into the skies just right. With your help, they’ll complete dazzling constellations, solve galactic-shaped challenges, and nap peacefully under the stars.


Each puzzle is a cozy cosmic conundrum: squeeze glowing fluffies into limited spaces while navigating new shapes, magical clouds, and celestial obstacles. The deeper you go into space, the trickier the challenges become. But don’t worry – the cats believe in you!


With charming visuals, relaxing music, and over 90 unique levels to stargaze through, Cat Cosmic Puzzle is a chill experience that’s just as dreamy as it is puzzling.

70070000029224.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000029224.description:
Purchase the Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Digital Deluxe Edition and receive 3 Sonic Prime playable characters and the Season Pass.

This bundle includes:
• Base game 
• Season Pass:
- Sonic Prime Character Pack - Rusty Rose, Tails Nine, Knuckles the Dread (Available at launch)
- 6 Content Packs, which include guest characters, vehicles, tracks, emotes, and more from some of your favorite pop culture franchises.
* Additional content will be released sequentially after the game is released.
* Please check the official website for product details and release schedule.

Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.  

Speed to victory solo or as a team in a variety of offline and online modes and compete against players from around the world. Build the ultimate vehicle to match your racing style, unlock gadgets to gain the upper hand, and unleash power-up items to bring home the win!

Ready, Set, Warp!   
Race across 24 tracks and warp to 15 CrossWorlds with Travel Rings, a unique gameplay mechanic that transports the iconic characters from the Sonic and SEGA universes into new dimensions. Use unpredictability to your advantage as you change the landscape of each race!  

Race With the Best!
Choose from 23 iconic Sonic characters, the largest roster of any Sonic racing game! 

Make It Yours  
Mix and match between 45 unique original vehicles and 70 different gadgets to trick out your ride, level up your kart, and create the ultimate machine to match your racing style. 

Gain the Advantage with Powerful Items!  
Dominate your opponents with 23 different items including returning favorites and all-new items like the Monster Truck!  

Multiple Ways to Play  
Gather with friends and play local split-screen in Grand Prix and the new party mode Race Park, compete against a community of players from around the world with up to 12 players online in World Match, or test your driving skills in Time Trials.

70070000029249.name: Mortal Glory 2 + DLC
70070000029249.intro: Manage a team of traveling gladiators in this turn-based fantasy roguelike. DLC included!
70070000029249.description:
Find the best recruits, discover powerful item combinations and come up with clever tactics on the battlefield. The tournament awaits those who desire MORTAL GLORY!

QUICK TURN-BASED COMBAT
Roll an explosive barrel at your enemy, throw them into a pit or take out two enemies by knocking them into each other. With a wide variety of tools available to you, your creativity will determine how you deal with the competition. Unique arenas, randomized environments and occasional special rules ensure that each fight offers new tactical opportunities.

RECRUIT A TEAM
A wide variety of fantasy races are seeking glory, each with their own unique racial strengths. Whatever your tactics are, finding the best recruits is essential!

UNIQUE LOOT
There is a vast collection of unique relics, character perks and more to discover. Finding clever combos and deadly synergies will unlock new strategies and occasionally turn your gladiators into unfairly strong demons.

SKILLED AI
Various difficulty settings will accommodate your preferred playstyle and there are increasingly harder challenges to master. But beware... The AI is brutally talented at the highest levels.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH
With every step comes a new challenge or perhaps... an opportunity? It is up to you to guide where your team should travel next... and suffer the consequences.

REPLAYABILITY
Each playthrough is different! With various tactics to try and additional increasingly harder challenges to master, the arena will keep welcoming you back again and again. Thanks to conveniently paced combat, Mortal Glory 2 is also great to play if you only have a moment to spare.

Reign of Tyrants is an expansion pack to Mortal Glory 2. Dominate the tournament with new playable boss characters and discover powerful new items, skills and more!

70070000029259.name: Hole io: Complete Edition
70070000029259.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000029259.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Complete Edition features:
- 13 maps with different things to swallow 
- 70 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000029261.name: FRONT MISSION Remake Trilogy
70070000029261.intro: Experience the legendary tactical RPG series like never before with the FRONT MISSION Remake Trilogy.
70070000029261.description:
This exclusive collection includes fully remade versions of FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake, FRONT MISSION 2: Remake, and FRONT MISSION 3: Remake, bringing classic mech strategy battles to life with updated graphics and enhanced gameplay. 

FRONT MISSION 1st: Remake is set in the year 2090, where the world's conflicts are fought using giant war machines called Wanzers. Huffman Island, the only place where the Oceania Cooperative Union (O.C.U.) and the Unified Continental States (U.C.S.) share a land border is a hotbed of conflict.

In FRONT MISSION 2: Remake, 12 years have passed since the second Huffman conflict. The impoverished People's Republic of Alordesh has been suffering a severe economic decline ever since the war ended. The remake preserves the mature story, strategic turn-based combat, and Wanzer customization options of the original. Enjoy the revitalized classic with updated visuals and new features and enhancements.

FRONT MISSION 3: Remake is a tactical RPG set in a future where nations and corporations compete for dominance in a world shaped by powerful mechs called Wanzers. The game follows two diverging storylines based on an early choice made by the protagonist, Kazuki Takemura. Both narratives focus on a global conspiracy involving secret weapons, corporate greed, and nationalistic agendas.

70070000029262.name: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y Deluxe Edition
70070000029262.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• SUPER ROBOT WARS Y
• Bonus Mission Pack
- 15 Side Missions
- 1 bonus mission
• DLC 1 & 2 Set
- DLC 1
5 playable units
16 Area Missions

Super Robot Wars is a grid-based tactical combat RPG that brings units and pilots from a variety of anime together to battle their mutual foes.

Place your units strategically and command them to defeat your enemies!

Upgrade your units and train your pilots with credits and resources you earn after every mission. Super Robot Wars Y introduces the new Assist Link system, which brings your favorite sidekick characters into action, allowing them to participate in missions and enhance their abilities and effects. Strengthen your heroes to overcome the next challenge!

Enjoy the impossible epic battles where units and pilots from all the series clash together! Embark on a journey into lore-rich, new saga of Super Robot Wars!

70070000029264.name: Hidden Object Adventure Bundle
70070000029264.intro: Get a captivating collection of three exciting hidden object games with gripping plots and unexpected twists!
70070000029264.description:
Discover three exciting hidden object games full of mystery and adventure with the Hidden Object Adventure Bundle. Each game offers unique stories and stunning graphics that will leave you spellbound.

Take on the role of Princess Amelie in Namariel Legends and free your people and yourself from the iron clutches of the Lord. Immerse yourself in an exciting steampunk world in Kindom of Aurelia to discover the story of the royal family! Help the young thief Maria find her little brother in Fall of the New Age!

Don't miss the opportunity to put your skills to the test and uncover the secrets of these fantastic games!

This bundle is an absolute must for all lovers of hidden object games and offers hours of fun.

- 3 games with gripping plots and unexpected twists
- A modern mix of point & click adventure and hidden object
- Only now in one bundle

70070000029265.name: Hentai Solitaire Full House Edition
70070000029265.intro: Pull an ace out of your pocket and check what challenges await you!
70070000029265.description:
Dive into a charming world full of cards and girls with Hentai Solitaire. Play the most iconic card game and practice your skills all along. Switch between cards, think about your next move and try to organize your deck from ace to king. 


ONE DECK TWO MODES
Test yourself in two available modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire. Try out both of them and check if you manage to complete them with no trouble. If you feel like you are stuck you can always go back or ask for a little help to receive a small hint.


CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS
At any point of the game you can change the appearance of your deck. Simply choose one out of the ten amazing girls waiting for you and enjoy your new cover. 

Unlock new covers for your deck with Cards Pack 1, Cards Pack 2 and Themes Pack DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Each playthrough is a new challenge
- 2 game modes: Standard and Tripeaks Solitaire
- 10 stunning girls on covers
- Relaxing soundtrack

70070000029266.name: Giant Rush: Silly Edition
70070000029266.intro: Rush into a battle of giants!
70070000029266.description:
Run and collect stickmen of your color to grow bigger and more powerful! Outsmart traps, avoid danger, and smash everything in your path. The bigger you grow, the more unstoppable you become!

Features:
- 5 new hats that will make you look unique!
- a new premium Slap animation!
- 500 free stickmen for your city
- 2500 extra gems to grow your character
- Collect stickmen of your color to grow larger and more powerful!
- Grow stronger and defeat huge giants in intense fights!
- Upgrade your town to earn passive income
- Fight through a series of enemies in survival mode and show your skills!
- Choose battle upgrades like extra health, a chance to dodge, critical hits, and more!
- Unlock awesome outfits and accessories to customize your character
- Buy new and epic finishing animations!

Face giant bosses in epic battles. Dodge their powerful attacks, strike back, and defeat them! Show your strength as you take down the biggest giants and prove you’re the best!

Unlock amazing rewards as you play. Upgrade your town to earn more money, customize your character with cool accessories, and unlock epic finishing animations!

Your decisions will make the difference between victory and defeat!

70070000029281.name: AAA Clock Polka Dot Pack
70070000029281.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000029281.description:
Here is what all players have been waiting for - an amazing flip clock.

A simple, fail-proof design. It can be used as a decorative color accent on your desk, but also as a practical reminder using the alarm function.

This time, along with Cyber Clock, Squid Clock, Spin Clock, Digital Clock, Pixel Clock, National Clock, Elegant Clock, Happy Clock, Minimalistic Stars, Blowing Bubbles, Old Survivalist, Cartoonish Clock, Zebra Stripes and Dots Everywhere Clock DLCs.

Key features:

- Tells time!
- Setting alarms
- Great for any ages
- Brilliant design
- Cute platformer game included!
- Customization

70070000029282.name: My Cozy Room Halloween Edition
70070000029282.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000029282.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic, Easter, Summer, Rock and Halloween DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000029283.name: CSD 1/2 Forever Bundle
70070000029283.description:
"Cook Serve Forever" - Bathe in the sights, sounds, and story of Cook Serve Forever, a narrative cooking game where you serve delicious recipes to the hungry masses of Helianthus.

"Cook, Serve, Delicious!" is a deceptively easy game to learn but incredibly challenging to master as you progress from owning a rundown zero-star cafe into a five-star world famous restaurant.

"Cook, Serve, Delicious! 2!!" is the massive sequel to the surprise best selling original, one of the few games that gives players complete control on how they want to build their restaurant.

70070000029303.name: Stuff it! Deluxe Edition
70070000029303.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000029303.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!


What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

This bundle comes with the Kids' Playground DLC.

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?

70070000029304.name: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT + A NEW POWER AWAKENS SET - DAIMA EDITION
70070000029304.description:
The DAIMA EDITION includes:
• DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT
- A NEW POWER AWAKENS Part 1
- A NEW POWER AWAKENS Part 2
• DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Pack
- DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 1
- DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2
• Pack Bonus: Ultimate Meat Feast, Mega Sacred Water, Purple Dino Horn, and Awakening Water

A story for all Dragon Ball fans—adventure through the Demon Realm from the anime Dragon Ball DAIMA in DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT!

Relive the story of Goku and other Z Fighters in DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT! Beyond the epic battles, experience life in the DRAGON BALL Z world as you fight, fish, eat, and train with Goku, Gohan, Vegeta and others.

Explore the new areas and adventures as you advance through the story and form powerful bonds with other heroes from the DRAGON BALL Z universe.

• Experience the story of DRAGON BALL Z from epic events to light-hearted side quests, including never-before-seen story moments that answer some burning questions of DRAGON BALL lore for the first time!

• Play through iconic DRAGON BALL Z battles on a scale unlike any other. Fight across vast battlefields with destructible environments and experience epic boss battles against the most iconic foes (Raditz, Frieza, Cell, etc.). Increase your power level through RPG mechanics and rise to the challenge!

• Don’t just fight as Z Fighters. Live like them! Fish, fly, eat, train, and battle your way through the DRAGON BALL Z sagas, making friends and building relationships with a massive cast of DRAGON BALL characters.

*DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2 will be released by February 28, 2026. Details to be announced at a later date.

70070000029305.name: Launch Celebration Pack
70070000029305.description:
Celebrate the launch of Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter with this special DLC bundle! Contain a variety of costumes and items that can be used in game. The following DLC products are included in this budle: 

Mascot Costumes (Estelle and Joshua)
Bracer Starter Kit
Gift from Liberl
Summer Vacation Costume (Estelle)
Summer Vacation Costume (Joshua)
NEO Bracer Costume (Estelle)

※The above DLC contain in-game items. 
※After purchase, items can be obtained in-game by selecting ITEM from the main menu, and then selecting newly added content within the DLC tab. 
※In the event carrying capacity for an item has been reached, additional items will be discarded. 
※After costume items are obtained, they can equipped via the COSTUME section of the main menu.
※The main game Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter is necessary to use this content. In the event the latest patch is necessary, please update the game first and then make use of the content.

70070000029310.name: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles Deluxe Edition
70070000029310.intro: The groundbreaking tactical RPG makes its long-awaited return.
70070000029310.description:
*This product can be upgraded to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version after purchase at no additional cost.
To upgrade, download the upgrade pack available from the Nintendo eShop onto your Nintendo Switch 2.

Ivalice—a kingdom blessed by the light of the gods and ruled by the Two-headed Lion. A year after her defeat to Ordallia in the Fifty Years' War, the king succumbed to malady, leaving a mere boy of two to ascend the throne.

Whoever was named regent would rule in truth, and thus emerged two rival candidates: dukes Goltanna and Larg, whose deeds during the war had earned them great renown. Goltanna the Black Lion and Larg the White Lion were destined to clash, and the resulting conflict would come to be known as the War of the Lions.

- Product Description
The Deluxe Edition includes the following bonuses:

・ Weapon: Akademy Blade (Raises a unit's speed attribute slightly while equipped)
・ Headwear: Akademy Beret (Prevents the Charmed status while equipped)
・ Combat Garb: Akademy Tunic (Grants Shell while equipped)
・ Accessory: Ring of Aptitude (Boosts JP earned while equipped)
・ Consumable Items: Phoenix Down x10
・ Black Equipment for Ramza
・ Red Equipment for Ramza

*An internet connection is required to receive the bonuses.
*Bonuses can be obtained from the Options section of the main menu once it becomes available after starting a new game.
*Ramza's alternate equipment colors can be applied from his status screen under the Units section of the main menu.
*Certain bonuses can also be obtained by playing through the game.
*Bonuses may be distributed to players or made available for purchase at a later date.

70070000029316.intro: Always with you - AAA Clock. Great retro game included!
70070000029316.description:

This time, along with Cyber Clock, Squid Clock, Spin Clock, Digital Clock, Pixel Clock, National Clock, Elegant Clock, Happy Clock, Minimalistic Stars, Blowing Bubbles, Old Survivalist, Cartoonish Clock, Zebra Stripes, Dots Everywhere and Minimalistic Farm Clock DLCs.

70070000029336.name: Ashwood Valley Summertime Edition
70070000029336.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000029336.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

Be prepared for winter and summer with Cozy Comforts Style and Sunny Summer Style DLCs included in this bundle.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70070000029354.name: Moto Rush GT Total Edition
70070000029354.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000029354.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Full Garage, Grip Collection #1, Grip Collection #2, Grip Collection #3 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 17 new vehicles—including an ATV and bicycle!
- 8 new gloves
- New colors for the rest of motorbikes
- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- 16 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000029355.name: Urban Flow Total Edition
70070000029355.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000029355.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Winter Expansion Pack, London Rules, Streets Supplement #1 Streets Supplement #2 and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    50 new stages!
•    Winter theme and new music!
•    17 new vehicles

70070000029362.name: More Ducks Everywhere
70070000029362.intro: The ultimate high-tech rubber duck simulation, Placid Plastic Duck brings you dangerous levels of relaxation. With many different happy ducks, your only priority is to float around.
70070000029362.description:
Purchase the "More Ducks Everywhere" bundle and receive:
- Placid Plastic Duck Simulator and its 47 rubber ducks in the seaside pool
- The DLC Ducks, Please with 27 additional, unique ducks
- The DLC Quacking the Ice with a brand new location in the mountains
- The DLC Duck Addiction with even more ducks, 27 additional beauties
- The DLC Hippospace Download with a brand new location in space
- The DLC So Many Ducks with even more ducks, 27 additional beauties
- The DLC Rooftop One Percent with a rooftop new location on a skyscraper
- The DLC Ducks Galore with even more ducks, 27 additional beauties

70070000029363.name: Hot&Hentai Paradise Edition
70070000029363.intro: Step into the brand new version of the enchanting world of Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000029363.description:
Those captivating girls will invite you to take part in the most alluring puzzle experience available on Nintendo Switch™.


ANIME AS AN ART FORM
Immerse yourself in the beautiful anime-inspired art of Hentai Girls, where you'll get to know these stunning and intriguing women. Solve their puzzles to advance through their stories, all while enjoying their charming company.


CHALLENGING PROGRESSION
While the gameplay starts off simple, the challenges grow as you move forward. Stay focused – their enticing outfits might be distracting.

This bundle includes Gamer Etsuko, Garden Queen Shirayuki and Beach Yui DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Stunning hand-drawn Hentai illustrations
- Soothing background music
- Easy-to-learn gameplay with increasing difficulty
- A unique and special concept

70070000029369.name: Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil Midnight Secrets Collection
70070000029369.intro: Travel to Rio de Janeiro with Touji to meet his date – Tainara. Solve puzzles to unlock the story and discover what outcome awaits.
70070000029369.description:
Embark on a romantic adventure across the colorful landscapes of Rio de Janeiro in Hentai Dating Stories: Brazil. Play as Touji Ishikawa, a young heir to a prestigious family business in Japan, as he ventures into the vibrant streets of Rio de Janeiro in search of true love.

In this visual novel with puzzle mechanics, immerse yourself in Touji's quest to break free from the expectations of his family and discover his path in life.

Meet Tainara Alves, a spirited Brazilian beauty whose passion for dance and zest for life will ignite a spark within Touji's heart. Explore the bustling streets of Rio de Janeiro, from the dazzling lights of Carnival to the tranquil shores of Copacabana Beach, as you uncover the secrets of Tainara's world.

But the path to true love is never easy, and Touji and Tainara will face their fair share of challenges along the way. Join them as they unravel mysteries and solve puzzles to see what’s waiting for you next.

Relive your favorite moments from Brazil with Best Stories 1, Best Stories 2 and Best Stories 3 DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
– Pocket love story
– Over 19 puzzles to solve along the way – the difficulty level rises going forward
– Beautiful anime-style characters
– Not the last Touji journey

70070000029380.name: Haven Deluxe Edition
70070000029380.intro: Two lovers gave up everything and escaped to a lost planet to be together. A narrative RPG adventure about love and freedom. To play solo or in local co-op.
70070000029380.description:
Deluxe Edition! The Edition includes: 
- Haven with all the improvements to the game since launch: Couples update, Sweet little Things update...
- Haven Artbook

70070000029381.name: Tools Up! and Servonauts Bundle
70070000029381.intro: Fuel Up, Fix Up, and Team Up!
70070000029381.description:
Fuel Up, Fix Up, and Team Up!

In Servonauts, you and up to three friends tackle the galaxy’s quirkiest job: running a space gas station. Juggle pipe repairs, refine fuels, and try to keep up with the demands of impatient intergalactic travelers as you build the most efficient servo this side of the cosmos.

Meanwhile, Tools Up! challenges your renovation prowess as you race against the clock to remodel apartments, paint walls, and haul furniture with the utmost precision (and a lot of laughs).

70070000029382.name: Bearnard + What Lies in the Multiverse
70070000029382.description:
What Lies in the Multiverse is a story-driven 2D adventure that one could call a dramatic comedy. Filled to the brim with hilarious, cartoonish hijinks, the narrative also presents the player with mature and deep themes like death, envy, and obsession. 

Step into the furry paws of Bearnard, a master archer and reluctant hero. He embarks on an epic adventure to begrudgingly reclaim a legendary bow and defend his woodland home. In this single-player, story-driven journey, you'll explore diverse landscapes, battle countless enemies, solve physics-based puzzles, and meet a cast of quirky characters. Collect and unleash powerful cards in turn-based battles, carefully strategizing each move to outwit and overcome your foes.

70070000029383.name: Dark Deity + Suns Out, Swords Out (DLC)
70070000029383.intro: Step into the world of Terrazael... and get tanned!
70070000029383.description:
Fight back in turn-based battles, manage character relationships, collect dangerous artifacts, and hopefully restore the world torn apart by oathbreakers, warmongers, and wielders of forbidden arcane secrets.

A world on its last strand of hope brought to its knees by a Calamity centuries ago that tore down its mighty civilizations. Petty kings rule in place of grand emperors of old that wage fruitless, ill-advised wars picking over ancient ruins like glorified scavengers.

Lead a team of four students in the Brookstead Military Academy, who are shut down on the mysterious orders of King Varic. The ruler of the Kingdom of Delia is preparing to break a millennium-old treaty and Brookstead students make for fine cannon fodder... However, these four soldiers are destined for more than just acting as unwilling meat for another grinder.

They may not know it yet, but they will make their mark on history.

------

Sun's Out, Swords Out!

In this beach-based expansion to the original game, enjoy the sandy new character portraits, usable during a playthrough of the base game as well as the additional DLC content.

Enjoy 7 additional levels, each telling a story from the time both before and after the events of Dark Deity. Get a deeper look into characters from the main game that you always wanted to know more about, including playable chapters with Empyrean, Varic, Alastair, and Sterling.

70070000029384.name: Spy Guy Memory 250 pairs Challenge!
70070000029384.description: An extreme challenge of 250 pairs of Spy Guy Memory mind game. Try your hand at the huge board and find all the pairs in the shortest time possible.

70070000029390.name: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess Lovers' Island Edition
70070000029390.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess?! In this visual novel divinely beautiful girls will steal your heart!
70070000029390.description:
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!


WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?
While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?


LET THEM CHARM YOU
During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?


ONLY ONE WINNER
Despite the beauty and charm of all the girls, only one will be able to win the competition. Which one of them will impress you enough to award her the golden apple? Are you going to go with your heart or will you play fair?

And most importantly: will you find love in Love Elysium?

The Aimi's Secrets, Emiko's Secrets and Haru's Secrets DLCs included in this bundle allow you to spend even more time with girls and get to know them better.

KEY FEATURES:
- An amazing story waiting for you
- 5 endings to discover = 5x more gameplay
- Unique personalities and temperaments of the girls
- Many dialogue options you can choose from
- Breathtaking island full of magical places
- Different reactions of girls depending on what you say

70070000029395.name: Hentai Academy Classroom of Desire
70070000029395.intro: As a professor in a school for troubled teens you’ll have one goal - to teach, but what will you do when a troubled heart comes your way?
70070000029395.description:
Hentai Academy opens the door to a school full of delinquents – teens who need help with getting a headstart in life. Kenji, whose shoes you’ll step into, is passionate about giving them a second chance. Besides lectures and school trips, you will soon find yourself entangled in the matters of the heart of a fellow teacher.


IN SEARCH OF PASSION
You started a new life in a new place! The headmaster wants you to be comfortable so he introduces you to your guide - Camille - a beautiful young woman who teaches art. After a day well-spent together…


FIND LOVE WHERE IT IS LEAST EXPECTED
…you start getting closer. Where will this relationship go? What obstacles will stand in your way? Will you help the troubles of the heart just like you help the troubled teens?

Revisit your favorite moments with the Academic Stories 1,  Academic Stories 2 and Academic Stories 3 DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- A story of true love full of passion and spark between the characters
- Puzzles to solve along the way with increasing difficulty
- Iconic and colorful locations

70070000029404.name: Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club - Deluxe Edition
70070000029404.intro: Max out your adventure with the DELUXE EDITION—Snoopy at his coolest.
70070000029404.description:
The Ultimate Snoopy  & The Great Mystery Club Experience -- worthy of the world's most beloved beagle!

For the ultimate Snoopy super-fan — The DELUXE EDITION is the most complete Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club content collection and game experience, featuring:

•  The full standard-game of Snoopy & The Great Mystery Club, PLUS:

•  EXCLUSIVE "JOE COOL" OUTFIT – Suit up in Snoopy’s persona and most legendary look. Beagle swagger has never looked cooler!

•  2 RED BARON MINI GAMES – Take flight in the Sopwith Camel as Snoopy with high-flying challenges that will test your reflexes:
- Frozen Cave:   Carefully navigate ice trenches, avoid falling icicles and a multitude of icy obstacles!
- Scorching Desert:  Put your flying ace skills to the test as you fly through canyons, and even inside a pyramid, avoiding sand tornadoes and numerous obstacles!

•  2 PEANUTS SOAPBOX RACING MINI GAMES – Strap in, start your engines, and 3, 2, 1, GO!:
 - The Great Pumpkin Patch:   Race through The Great Pumpkin Patch, avoiding pumpkins & tangly vines, to claim victory!
- Off-Road Challenge: Race through a forest filled with jumps and obstacles as you try to avoid tree trunks, mud pits and even falling trees.

•  The 75th ANNIVERSARY COMIC COLLECTION:  75 full-color comics readable via an in-game viewer, celebrating our favorite gang!

Whether you're flying through frozen caves or channeling your inner Joe Cool, this bundle brings bonus fun worthy of the world’s most beloved beagle.

70070000029405.name: Hentai Stars Risky Influence Pack
70070000029405.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000029405.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

With the gameplay mechanics, after each puzzle is completed, the difficulty will increase. Try to solve all of them and don't get too distracted by girls’ outfits, which will change every time.

This bundle includes Demoness Ayame, Night Rider Ran and Idol Tsubaki DLCs.

Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000029409.name: Hentai Stars Blush & Broom Collection
70070000029409.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000029409.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY
