Key Features:
- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Sensual music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Different difficulty levels
- Unique outfits and locations

70070000029419.name: Hentai World Sly Tales Collection
70070000029419.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000029419.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet three new characters: Sayuri, Chiyo and Foxy Akane.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 artpieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000029427.name: Hentai Girls Lively Walk Edition
70070000029427.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000029427.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Cleaning Yui, Waiting Shirayuki and Playful Etsuko.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000029438.name: Vagrus - The Riven Realms Centurion Edition
70070000029438.description:
This edition includes:
- Vagrus - The Riven Realms
- Vagrus - The Riven Realms Patronage Pack
- Vagrus - The Riven Realms Soundtrack

70070000029456.name: Shopping Mall Girl: Sunny Edition
70070000029456.intro: Dress up in fabulous outfits and walk the runway like a pro!
70070000029456.description:
Showcase your style and become a supermodel in one of the best shopping games! 

No matter what your fashion style may be, this shopping mall has exactly what you're looking for! Get a fabulous new hairstyle at your favorite hair salon Chic Cuts, and dress up in the latest hot trends from our stylish shops!   

Features: 
- Dress up in beautiful outfits and become a star! 
- Show off your unique style on the cover of a magazine! 
- Battle against other clients for low-in-stock clothing! 
- Shop in a brand new premium store: Surf'N Style!
- Put on over 750 clothes, 125 accessories and more than 100 makeup items!
- Use 8000 additional coins to help you buy them all!
- Make sure your nails are perfect and complement them with rings and bracelets! 
- Enhance your hair with beautiful styles and vibrant colors! 

It's Black Friday! The excitement is real as you race to grab the clothes you need before they vanish from the shelves! Dress up in shirts, skirts, shoes, and accessories, or get expert advice from your personal shopper!  

Step into the spotlight and compete in a fashion battle, vote for your favorite fashion show looks, and strive to become the ultimate fashion show superstar! 

Get set for an unforgettable shopping adventure like no other!

70070000029458.name: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures - Merry & Mischievous Edition
70070000029458.intro: Steal presents, and throw a festive feast with The Grinch and Max. Help his heart grow three sizes with awfully fun challenges and surprises.
70070000029458.description:
Has The Grinch grown to love Christmas, or is he just putting on a show? Hmmm. 

Explore more of Who-ville in the Merry & Mischievous Edition of The Grinch: Christmas Adventures. Snowboard down from The Grinch’s Caves in Mount Crumpit, sleigh through the Forest, and even parachute through the Village, spreading Christmas cheer.
If you’re feeling Grinchy, join The Grinch and Max on a sneaky mission to steal presents. Do you think you can help his heart grow three sizes?

Maybe you can help him put on a festive feast for the Whos. Show them he’s had a change of heart by gathering food across the snowy land of Who-ville. Just be careful not to lose it. 

With cool gadgets to unlock like a Santa costume, jetpacks, and even a new parachute for Max, you’ll be prepared to overcome creepy spiders, tin soldiers and not-so-nice gingerbread men. Get rewarded with jigsaw puzzles and customizable accessories to keep The Grinch and Max completing missions in style. 

Will The Grinch save or steal Christmas? Rediscover the true meaning of the holidays, and work together to remind him and Max that they belonged all along. 

SEE THE OUTSKIRTS OF WHO-VILLE - Explore The Village, Town Hall, The Grinch Caves, Lakes and Sewers.

STUNT, FLIP, OR GLIDE - Showcase your skills using a jetpack, snowboard, sleigh and other customizable gadgets.

MISSIONS WITH A VIEW - Watch for collectables and enemies from the sky using Max’s Parachute.

NEW CHALLENGES, MORE REWARDS - Collect food and presents to earn jigsaws, art and accessories.

A CLASSIC FOR EVERYONE - From visuals inspired by original books to easy controls for players.

70070000029464.name: Hello Goodboy + To The Rescue!
70070000029464.intro:
Two tales. Countless tails.
Help pups find peace, purpose, and their forever homes in two emotional, dog-filled adventures.
70070000029464.description:
[Hello Goodboy] 
Hello Goodboy is a heartwarming, wholesome adventure featuring Iko, a boy new to the afterlife. With no memory of what brought him to the world beyond, he must rely on Coco, a strangely familiar dog who will help him solve the mysteries of this new existence. 

Journey through unknown, yet familiar places, meeting fellow souls on their own adventures through the afterlife. Pay it forward with generous favors for them and try to figure out just why Iko landed in the land beyond to begin with. However, mind the time: there's only so much of it!


[To The Rescue!]
To The Rescue! is a dog shelter simulator where you are responsible for taking care of dozens of cute dogs in need of homes. It's not all cuddles and snoot boops though: running a shelter can be a lot of work. You have to manage all of the dogs' needs in order to maximize their chances of finding the right forever homes.

Each day brings new challenges and rewards. Dogs have specific preferences, can get infectious diseases, and can have negative traits. But you can also hold fundraisers, get random donations, and, if you work hard, help someone find their new best friend. Unfortunately, there's never enough room, and always more dogs.

Some dogs are more desirable than others, but maybe if you can afford to wait long enough, just maybe, every dog will have their day.

70070000029465.name: Mail Time + Cat Cafe Manager
70070000029465.intro:
A bundle full of warmth and whiskers.
From mushroom hats to caffeinated cats, your cozy double shift starts now.
70070000029465.description:
[Mail Time]
Mail Time is a relaxing, cottagecore adventure set in a peaceful forest, far, far away. It's your first day on the job as a newly minted Mail Scout. Equipped with a mushroom hat, a pack full of letters, and unbridled enthusiasm, it's time to deliver letters and packages across the Grumblewood Grove.

Their recipients eagerly await the sight of your mushroom hat, so don't tarry! Run, jump, glide, and make your way across the forest to deliver parcels and joy to the cute critters that inhabit these woods.That's right. It's Mail Time!

If you ever wanted to enter a fairy tale, this is your chance. Explore the cozy, peaceful world crafted by Kela van der Deijl, and make friends with all manner of forest critters!


[Cat Cafe Manager]
Be warned...there's some real catty mysteries in our town - and a strange black cat roaming the streets…nothing you can’t handle right?

The life of a Cat Cafe Manager awaits! Your grandmother left you a small cafe in the somber village of Caterwaul Way...it's up to you to fix the place up, impress the locals, and befriend the local cat population. Time to roll up those sleeves, break out the tools, and get that creative coffee flowin’. Your cat cafe can be the talk of the town with the right attitude, menu, and (of course) the cats.

That's right, Caterwaul Way is home to a plethora of extraordinary felines. It’s in the name afterall! To the delight of the villagers, the local cafe can become their home. Who knows, maybe their presence will loosen tight tongues and help discover the succulent secrets of Caterwaul Way...

70070000029466.name: One Lonely Outpost + Echoes of the Plum Grove
70070000029466.intro:
Plant roots across any frontier. Colonize the cosmos or grow a legacy in Honeywood—
your story begins with a single seed.
70070000029466.description:
[One Lonely Outpost]

You're the first pioneer to hit the surface of a barren, alien world—a desolate expanse as far as the eye can see. Your job is simple: Take your Space-RV, power up your multipurpose tech gauntlet, and use whatever seeds found in the cargo to start a new life on this world. Over time, you'll make the planet life-sustaining for yourself and dozens of future colonists. But until then, it's going to be one lonely outpost...

[Echoes of the Plum Grove]

After washing onto the island's shores, you'll find yourself the newly minted owner of a humble plot of land. Pull up your sleeves, grab your tools, and get to work building a farm that will last not only a lifetime but span generations!

Echoes of Plum Grove is a casual, cozy farm simulator where your decisions have consequences. What to plant, what to stock for the winter, and who to befriend will shape not only the town of Honeywood but the island itself.

70070000029467.name: DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT + A NEW POWER AWAKENS SET - MASTER EDITION
70070000029467.intro: BE THE HOPE OF THE UNIVERSE
70070000029467.description:
The DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT - MASTER EDITION includes:
• DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT
• Season Pass (2 original episodes and a new story arc)
• Season Pass 2 (3 new story arcs)
• DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Pack
- DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 1
- DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2
• Pack Bonus: Ultimate Meat Feast, Mega Sacred Water, Purple Dino Horn, and Awakening Water
• 4 Cooking Items that give your character temporary and permanent Stat boosts
• Tao Pai Pai Pillar

Relive the story of Goku and other Z Fighters in DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT! Beyond the epic battles, experience life in the DRAGON BALL Z world as you fight, fish, eat, and train with Goku, Gohan, Vegeta and others.

Explore the new areas and adventures as you advance through the story and form powerful bonds with other heroes from the DRAGON BALL Z universe.

• Experience the story of DRAGON BALL Z from epic events to light-hearted side quests, including never-before-seen story moments that answer some burning questions of DRAGON BALL lore for the first time!

• Play through iconic DRAGON BALL Z battles on a scale unlike any other. Fight across vast battlefields with destructible environments and experience epic boss battles against the most iconic foes (Raditz, Frieza, Cell, etc.). Increase your power level through RPG mechanics and rise to the challenge!

• Don’t just fight as Z Fighters. Live like them! Fish, fly, eat, train, and battle your way through the DRAGON BALL Z sagas, making friends and building relationships with a massive cast of DRAGON BALL characters.

*DAIMA: Adventure Through the Demon Realm Part 2 will be released by February 28, 2026. Details to be announced at a later date.

70070000029468.name: Cozy Collection
70070000029468.intro: Decorators and puzzle masters come forward!
70070000029468.description:
A new cozy bundle has just dropped! It combines elements of architecture and puzzle solving - doesn’t it sound exciting?

And there is even more to come! The bundle includes all available DLCs for three of the games listed below: nGolf, My Cozy Room and Mini Market Design, so get ready for the ultimate cozy experience!

nGolf - mastermind your way into the hole, hopefully in one! Try to come up with a way to reach a hole while picking up stars midway… watch out for obstacles!

My Cozy Room - sports are not your thing? Don’t worry, here you can create the most beautiful room designs ever! The only limitation is your imagination so choose the furniture and unleash your inner artist!

Mini Market Design - would you like to take your architectural skills and mind outside the house? go ahead! Design an excitedly looking store which will be a reflection of your dream workplace!

Ultimate Holidays - room design is not enough? No problem. Here you are able to create a whole town!... or a beach where people could wind down. Don’t forget to photograph your work, the memories are worth it!

We hope you’ll enjoy this amazingly cozy collection - the selection wasn't random!

Key features:
- 90 different objects to build a town from.
- 1000+ furniture and decor items, try not to get dizzy!
- Over 60 golf fields to conquer.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay which lasts for hours.

70070000029469.name: Action Pack 2
70070000029469.description:
A brand-new action bundle, fresh out of the arsenal, is ready to punch boredom away!! Packed with four adrenaline-fueled titles, this explosive collection is all about fast reflexes, big explosions, and zero chill. Whether you’re sneaking through enemy lines or going in guns blazing, one thing’s for sure — peace  is not an option. Check out these action packed titles:


I See Red — a high-octane twin‑stick roguelite shooter where you step into the shoes of a vengeance‑driven fugitive as you blast your way through spaceships. Wield deadly weapons and demolish enemies’ cover.


DROS - Dive into a dark and mysterious Alchemist’s tower and try to escape, but be cautious as every floor holds new challenges; solving demanding puzzles, switching forms to adapt, and uncovering secrets.


Warhammer 40,000: Dakka Squadron — pilot the Ork aircraft in this explosive aerial shooter! Fly across war-torn planets, complete sabotage, defense missions, and customize your aircraft with powerful upgrades. Join an Ork Clan and dominate the skies!


Neckbreak — walk into a gritty future city ruled by gangs and chaos where during the day you’re just another face but at night you serve vengeance cold. Explore on foot or by car, turn anything into a weapon, and unleash an unpredictable combo.

Four games, endless action — what are you waiting for? Dive in and cause some chaos!


Key features:
- Fast-paced fights in a very destructive environment — you snooze,you  lose.
- Various game styles — everyone will find something for themselves.
- Multiple possible approaches — there isn’t only one good way to have fun.
- A wide range of weapons to choose from to defeat your foes.

70070000029470.name: Farming Collection
70070000029470.intro: Harvest time has come and an amazing collection right with it!
70070000029470.description:
Settle down in four cozy worlds where farming, friendship, and a touch of magic await. Whether you’re restoring a village, building a boutique, or uncovering enchanted secrets, a new peaceful life is waiting to be planted


Sunseed Island — Become a magical cat and rebuild a ruined island village. Farm, fish, explore, and bring nature back to its prime state, alongside adorable animal companions but beware the secrets of a mystical tree.


Sprout Valley — Escape the city with Nico the cat and build a peaceful life, far from the town noise, on a remote island. Grow crops, fish, craft, and customize your new home in the most charming way possible.


Ashwood Valley — A magical mishap turns your sibling into a cat and now it's up to you to lift the curse! Rebuild your home, raise magical crops, and befriend various animals. Every season holds secrets, and every harvest brings you closer to breaking the spell.


Cottonville — Bring back to life your family’s sewing business by growing crops, harvesting colorful dyes, and designing unique outfits. You are doing it not only for yourself but also for the whole town, who counts on you to reignite the fashion spirit that was once there.


Four games with unlimited ideas and possibilities — jump in and start plowing your way into the amazing Farming Collection.

Key features:
- Perfect opportunity to relax — the cozy vibe of the collection allows you to unwind.
- Farming with magical twists — not everything is what it seems to be.
- Restoring the natural balance — things got out of hand, time to fix them!
- Adorable and charming graphics — both your heart and eyes will be satisfied.

70070000029481.name: Pets and Friends Zen Bundle
70070000029481.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of zen themed stickers.
70070000029481.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new zen thmed stickers to add variety to your album.

70070000029498.name: S.N.I.P.E.R - Hunter Scope Total Edition
70070000029498.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Weaponry Upgrade, Elite Arsenal, Target Acquired, Neon Strike and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- With the Expansion Pack you can fight and survive the zombie apocalypse in a brand new game mode!
- Play new maps or revisit old ones with new weapons.
-PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm 
-FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation 
-SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy
-RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design 
-BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west 
-SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle 
-SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
-UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
-SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.
- RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition 
- SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements 
- SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
- SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology 
- FMS-1-G rifle

70070000029503.name: Knights & Guns Total Edition
70070000029503.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000029503.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2, Armor Pack #1, Armor Pack #2, Armor Pack #3  and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 20 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 18 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000029507.name: Super Sucker: Complete Edition
70070000029507.intro: Suck it all in… then launch it like a maniac with a cannon!
70070000029507.description:
Get ready for action with a vacuum so strong, even the laws of physics are nervous. Suck up everything in sight - boxes, animals, enemies… basically, if it’s not bolted down, it’s going in!

But that’s just the beginning. At the end of each level, it’s payback time! Fire everything you’ve collected straight at bosses, towers, and anything unlucky enough to stand in your way. It’s not personal. It’s vacuum justice.

Features:
• 6 New Skins - Vacuums shaped like a cash register, firehose, engine, flowerpot and other total mysteries. Is that one made of toxic waste? Maybe. Why not.
• Suck It All In - Enemies, crates... even elephants! This vacuum breaks records, physics, and probably warranty terms.
• Epic Boss Fights - Giant enemies. Flying objects. Extreme chaos. Maximum satisfaction.
• Smash Castles - No catapult? No problem. Your vacuum launches stuff like a pro.

Dodge obstacles, suck shiny gems, and unlock new vacuum styles that prove cleaning up can look cool too. The more you suck, the more fun it gets!

Nothing is safe from the Super Sucker! Seriously. Hide your stuff.

70070000029520.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000029520.intro: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
70070000029520.description:
Includes the full game, "Additional DLC Sets", and 48 hours of early access to the full game. Embark on an epic adventure ahead of everybody else!

[Contents]
・DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined base game
・DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined "Additional DLC Sets"
    Additional DLC - The Road of Regal Wretches
    Additional DLC - Luminary's Livery
    Additional DLC - Jam-Packed Swag Bag
・48 hours of early access
・White Wolf Costume (Appearance changing costume for Ruff)

*After the launch of DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined, the "Additional DLC Sets" and each additional DLC will also be available for individual purchase. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*Some items in the additional DLCs can also be obtained by progressing in the game.
*To play The Road of Regal Wretches, you will need to progress in the game and unlock the battle arena.
*The Road of Regal Wretches can be accessed by talking to the She-Slime at the battle arena reception desk.
*Contents such as the costumes and items can be received from the "Claim Special Rewards" menu in the game.

*This product is a bundle that includes DRAGON QUEST VII, released for Nintendo Switch™, and additional content pertaining to that title.
*This product can be played on both Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2, but there is also a separate version of DRAGON QUEST VII that can only be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2.
*This product is not compatible with the DRAGON QUEST VII Digital Deluxe Upgrade released for Nintendo Switch™ 2.
*The content included in this bundle is also sold separately. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases.

70070000029528.name: Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator – Mood on Wheels
70070000029528.intro: Epic tricks, iconic characters, endless fun.
70070000029528.description:
Jump into an epic skateboarding adventure filled with fast-paced drifting, iconic characters, and meme-inspired fun. Challenge yourself on dynamic courses and master tricks that push your skills to the limit.

Bundle includes:
Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator
Join iconic characters like Yellow Face, Swole Doge, and Maxwell Cat himself for thrilling rides and hilarious antics.

New Skater DLC
Unlock the exclusive “EmotionG” character, famed for explosive tricks and unique style.Already have EmotionG? Get the in-game currency equivalent instead.

Unlock endless fun and style with this bundle — perfect for mastering the streets and standing out from the crowd. Are you ready to own every trick and turn?

70070000029539.name: DLC Bundle 1
70070000029539.intro: A bundle that includes multiple sets and DLC content released for "DAEMON X MACHINA"
70070000029539.description:
This is bundle set includes the following DLC*:

"**Prototype Arsenal"
"**Prototype Suit"
Outer Suit "Camouflage Plugsuit"
Outer Suit "Formal Attire"
Arsenal "Crusader"
Arsenal "Muramasa"
Arsenal "Rabbit 11"
"Arsenal Decals" Set
Outer Emote Set
Arsenal Surface Bundle

**These items are the same as the early purchase bonus content, ""Prototype Arsenal"" and ""Prototype Suit"".If you have already downloaded this bonus, please be careful not to re-purchase it by mistake.

*Full version of game required to use DLC. Sold separately.

※This content is not in-game equipment, but in-game items for changing the exterior and appearance of the Arsenal and Outer Suit. There is no change in in-game status when used.

※The items included in this set can also be purchased individually. Please be careful not to purchase duplicates.

70070000029540.name: DLC Bundle 2
70070000029540.intro: A bundle that includes multiple sets and DLC content released for "DAEMON X MACHINA"
70070000029540.description:
This compilation set includes the following DLC*:

Outer Edit parts Set "Hair" vol.1
Outerwear Edit parts Set "Hair" vol.2
Outerwear Edit parts Set "Face" vol.1
Outerwear Edit parts Set "Face" vol.2
Outer Edit parts "Glasses"
Outer Edit parts "Eyepatch"
Outer Edit parts "Man Bun"

*Full version of game required to use DLC. Sold separately.

※This content is not in-game equipment, but in-game items for changing appearances. There is no change in in-game status when used.

※The items included in this set can also be purchased individually. Please be careful not to purchase duplicates.

70070000029555.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Battlefield Operator
70070000029555.intro: Ready for battle — complete and unstoppable.
70070000029555.description:
Gear up for the full experience with the BODY CAM SHOOTER: Battlefield Operator, a bundle that includes the base game and the exclusive AR-15 Tactical Skin DLC. Step into the role of a tactical operator and face intense encounters in a hyper-realistic first-person perspective — now with a bold new look for your primary weapon.

This bundle includes:
• BODY CAM SHOOTER – an ultra-realistic shooter with high-stakes action and smart enemy AI
• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Skin Upgrade – a new material inspired by real military gear, adding immersion and style to every mission

Turn every operation into a showcase of precision, strategy, and tactical skill. This isn’t just a shooter — it’s a test of your readiness. Step in prepared. Engage the threat. Emerge victorious.

70070000029561.name: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000029561.intro: Solve the mysteries of Hallfein in style with this premium edition.
70070000029561.description:
Two young adults return to their lost hometown in search of truth and to bring back what they hold dear.

Story:
The town of Hallfein was once situated at the border of three provinces, and thrived due to mining and trade. However, a mysterious disaster struck the town, causing most of its residents to disappear and leading to it becoming a restricted area.

As time passed, restrictions on the town were lifted, and a plan to restore it was initiated. Seizing this opportunity, a young woman and a young man, having come of age after being driven from Hallfein long ago, now return to the land they once called home.

After meeting in their hometown, the two embark on a journey together to seek the truth, unaware of the encounters and revelations that await them...

Content Details:
- The main game
- Digital Deluxe Pack
Costume palette changes for Rias, Slade, Raze, Wilbell, Totori, and Sophie (2 for each character, 12 total) and a Head Start Item Pack.
The Head Start Item Pack contains 10 types of ingredients and 2 types of Starpearls, setting you up for success during your early adventure.

Note:
- Please check the official site for details.
- Costumes can be equipped after the main menu is unlocked by selecting "Combat Equipment" followed by "Change Costume."
- Starpearls can be equipped after the main menu is unlocked by selecting "Combat Equipment."
- Please be aware that other editions containing this product exist. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please be aware that the main game is also available for purchase as a standalone product. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000029562.name: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian Ultimate Edition
70070000029562.intro: The Ultimate edition containing the Digital Deluxe edition and the season pass.
70070000029562.description:
Content Details:
- The main game
- Digital Deluxe Pack
- The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian - Atelier Season Pass
- Season pass purchase bonus: "Alchemist of Memories" Costumes for Rias and Slade

Season Pass Contents: 6 items including the bonus
1) Season pass purchase bonus: "Alchemist of Memories" Costumes for Rias and Slade
One costume each for both Rias and Slade.

2) Gust Extra BGM Pack
A pack of "Atelier" series background music that can be used when changing the in-game BGM.

3) Additional Characters - Resna and Valeria
After a certain point in the story, Resna and Valeria from "Atelier Resleriana" will be added as party members with additional characters stories.

4) "Beginning of Summer Days" Costume Set
A set of new swimsuit costumes for Rias, Slade, Raze, Wilbell, Totori, and Sophie. (1 each, 6 total)

5) Recipe Expansion Pack "The Essence of Alchemy"
A pack of useful recipes for your adventure.

6) High-Difficulty Dungeon "Backwards-Ticking Clock Workshop"
After a certain point in the story, the high-difficulty dungeon will be added.

Note:
- Items 1 and 2 will release with the main game. Items 3-6 will be released by the end of January 2026.
- The name, details, and release date of each item are subject to change. Please check the official site for details.
- Costumes can be equipped after the main menu is unlocked by selecting "Combat Equipment" followed by "Change Costume."
- Recipes are available after synthesis has been unlocked, and BGM tracks can be used by selecting "Change BGM" on the save menu.
- Other requirements to use each item exist.
- Please be aware that other products include this content exist and that besides the set bonus these items can be purchased individually. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000029563.name: Sugardew Island - Your cozy farm shop
70070000029563.intro: Run your own farm shop, without any pressure!
70070000029563.description: Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade your farm, and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the tiny island with life again. If you wish, you can go on dates with friendly locals, each with their own unique personality and backstory!

70070000029573.name: Monster Survivors: Rootsy Edition
70070000029573.intro: Survive, adapt, and conquer in a world overrun by monstrous creatures!
70070000029573.description:
The world is overrun by terrifying creatures, and only the toughest will make it out alive! Battle endless waves of monsters, face massive bosses, and upgrade your survivors to become unstoppable.

Features:
- new survivor: Rootsy!
- 150 crystals to promote your survivors
- 5000 coins for chests and upgrades
- Non-Stop Action: Fight endless waves of monsters and test your survival skills
- Epic Boss Battles: Take on giant beasts and earn powerful rewards
- Survivor Upgrades: Unlock skills and level up your characters
- Ever-Changing Gameplay: No two runs are the same!
- Immersive Experience: Stunning visuals and intense sound effects

Every run is a new challenge! Improve your stats, unleash devastating abilities, and buy epic artifacts as you carve your path through the apocalypse. 

How long can you last before the monsters overwhelm you?

70070000029579.name: West Escape: Gambler Edition
70070000029579.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000029579.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

Features:
- Premium Equipment: Equip Silver Coin for X2 expedition loot!
- Rare Gear and more: Obtain rare and uncommon Gambler equipment to boost your power level!
- Bonus currency: Additional 500 gems for faster progress!
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes—dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load—freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70070000029586.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2025 - Frontier Edge
70070000029586.intro: Where borders end, your duty begins.
70070000029586.description:
Step into the boots of an elite border enforcement officer with the Frontier Edge bundle – combining the tense, realistic experience of Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2025, where every decision matters, with the exclusive Red Camo Ops DLC.
Scan vehicles, inspect documents, chase down smugglers, and uncover hidden contraband. Now, patrol with extra authority using the bold red camouflage knife skin — a symbol of precision and power.

Bundle includes:
- Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2025 – A gritty, choice-driven border control simulator where you secure the frontier and outsmart criminal networks.
- Red Camo Ops DLC – A striking red camo skin for your knife, perfect for elite officers who mean business.

Take control. Enforce the law. Stand on the edge.

70070000029587.name: Pet Show: Complete Edition
70070000029587.intro: Draw a line to enclose the area and uncover the image underneath. Watch out for enemies who can catch you or cut your line!
70070000029587.description:
Take control of a brave little animal and uncover the adorable world hidden beneath the surface! 

Features:
• New Unique Levels - Complete 120 stages with 3 difficulty options each!
• Co-op Fun – Join forces with friends or family in local multiplayer!
• Tricky Enemies – Watch out for baddies that try to cut your line!
• More Custom Looks – Choose your favorite from 27 playful animal avatars!
• 2 additional mechanics: ice and water current
• New enemies and challenges to face!
• Cute Pictures – Reveal a new animal picture in every level—can you find them all?

As you move, you draw a line behind you—close the shape to reveal a piece of the cute picture underneath. From fluffy kittens to curious piglets, each level holds a surprise waiting to be uncovered.

Be careful! Flying foes and sneaky bugs are ready to interrupt your progress. If they hit your line before you close it, you’ll lose a life! Outsmart them with clever tricks like screen-edge teleporting and speed boosts to stay in the game!

Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op mode to uncover the hidden image together!

Draw, dodge, and discover!

70070000029589.name: Sports Camp: A 35-Game Adventure Deluxe
70070000029589.intro: Welcome to Sports Camp, the ultimate party game packed with over 35 unexpected activities.
70070000029589.description:
Welcome to Sports Camp Deluxe, the ultimate party game packed with over 35 unique and unexpected
activities. Forget traditional sports—jump into sheep roping, walking roll ball, hovercraft, and more in
a vibrant summer camp adventure.

Explore a lively open-world camp full of activities, treasures, and secrets in Story Mode, or
gather friends and family for instant multiplayer fun on one console. Compete, cooperate, or just
enjoy the adventure together, as every game is a new experience.

With easy-to-learn gameplay, nonstop variety, and activities you won’t find anywhere else,
there’s something for everyone.

Sports Camp is the perfect way to share unforgettable moments with your loved ones.

This bundle also contains Sports Camp's Artbook - 30 pages of concept art, artwork, avatars, animals, and environment.

70070000029610.name: Funko Fusion - Wicked Movie DLC Bundle
70070000029610.description:
Funko Fusion - Wicked Pack 1

Pink goes good with Green! Wave your wand as Elphaba and become good as Glinda, two new playable characters from Universal Pictures' Wicked.

Funko Fusion - Wicked Pack 2

Funko Fusion - Wicked Movie Pack 3

- Elphaba (Shiz)
- Glinda (Shiz)
- Prince Fiyero

Play as their Shiz-era variants and experience their early days like never before!

70070000029614.name: Hentai Puzzle Collection 14 in 1
70070000029614.intro: Welcome to “Hentai Puzzle Collection 14 in 1”. One goal — solve puzzles and have fun with new girls. Only for real senpais.
70070000029614.description:
Welcome to “Hentai Puzzle Collection 14 in 1” — the most perverted puzzle game set you can fit on your console!

This ultra-set of 14 hot hentai games is ready to tear your brain and pants at the same time. Collect puzzles, open images and… new puzzles with girls. Each puzzle girl is a new level with a sweet reward. Teachers, cat girls, nurses, demonesses — all are ready for your logical touches.

- Hentai Girls Puzzle

- Hentai Paradise Vol. 2
- Hentai Paradise Vol. 3
- Hentai Paradise Vol. 4

70070000029615.name: Buried Alive: Breathless Rescue & Whittingham Asylum: The Investigation
70070000029615.intro: One wrong move, and you’re buried deeper.
70070000029615.description:
Face your fears and descend into the unknown with two spine-tingling adventures.
In Buried Alive: Breathless Rescue, wake up trapped inside a coffin, surrounded by darkness and mystery. Your only hope? Solve deadly puzzles, uncover cryptic secrets, and fight your way out of the tomb before time runs out.

Then, step into the shoes of a journalist in Whittingham Asylum: The Investigation as you explore the haunted halls of an abandoned psychiatric hospital. Discover hidden truths, investigate eerie disappearances, and confront the horrors that still roam the asylum’s decaying corridors.

	•	Solve deadly mysteries
	•	Test your wit and courage
	•	Face psychological and supernatural terrors

Two games. One bundle. Endless nightmares.
Are you ready to escape the crypt... and survive the asylum?

70070000029616.name: Tristia: Chronicles
70070000029616.description:
Revitalize Tristia in this updated collection!

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Play as Nanoca Flanka, and revitalize the city—your way.

Build and manage a thriving city in Legacy, where you'll research and create new items for vendors, fulfill invention requests and build new facilities to help revitalize the city's economy. Enjoy a passionate story that unfolds based on your actions on your journey to bring back Tristia's luster.

Or dive into an action-packed adventure in Restore, which focuses on the day-to-day running of the shop. Complete major crafting projects as a constant barrage of requests pour in. Quickness counts as you gather materials, choose the right equipment, and deliver the necessary items for each level. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?

70070000029617.name: Hidden Object Bundle
70070000029617.intro: Find, explore, and relax in a world full of cute details!
70070000029617.description:
Snug Finder - is a beautiful hidden object game. Become a finder and try to find all objects, but be careful, sometimes it’s not that easy. 

Immerse yourself in a wonderful game with lovely illustrations, gorgeous sounds and cozy atmosphere. Spend hours on 36 amazing levels with over 300 hidden objects. Let’s start adventure!

Features:
360 hidden objects
36 gorgeous levels
Amazing illustrations
Cozy atmosphere
Touchscreen support

Cozy Hunt - is a cute and relaxing hidden object game. In this game, you look for different things hidden in big, beautiful pictures. Each picture is full of funny and sweet details, so it’s always interesting to play. Some things are easy to find, and some are more tricky — but every level is full of surprises!

What’s great about this game:
40 cute and fun levels — every picture is different!
Play with touchscreen or with your controller
Beautiful and happy pictures, full of funny little things
Relax, look around, and have fun in the cozy world of Cozy Hunt!

70070000029634.name: Pixel Cafe Full Edition
70070000029634.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000029634.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipment, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game, Living Room Touches, Bedroom Touches, Kitchen Touches and Bedroom Touches #2 with:

A new variant for the Armchair
A different look for the Computer
An alternative design for the Wardrobe
A modest update for the Bookshelf
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
A new style for the Radio Nightstand
An updated Oven and Stove design
A new look for the Sink
An alternative style for the Bar
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
Also, mix things up with two new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000029648.name: VARLET Digital DX Edition
70070000029648.intro:
This isn't a story about finding someone else—it's about finding yourself.
School life RPG VARLET
70070000029648.description:
This is a set that includes the main game VARLET along with the following content:

[VARLET Digital Deluxe Edition Contents]
VARLET Digital Deluxe Bonus: Art & Sound App
1. Digital Creative Artbook (80 pages)
2. Digital Special Album (53 tracks)

Monark & The Caligula Effect 2 School Uniform Set DLC
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
To be a "leader" that guides others forward, or to be an uncompromising "ruler"...

VARLET is a school life RPG where, through encounters with troubled boys and girls who are also searching for themselves, you begin to uncover a version of yourself you never knew existed.

[STORY]
Kousei Academy: where the protagonist has recently transferred.
Whispered rumors surround this place.
 
Another world where strange creatures dwell appears within the school...
...and once you've wandered in, there's no way back out.
 
After seeing this other world—a Glitch—with his own eyes,
the protagonist realizes several people have been replaced with monsters.
 
You must fight alongside your friends
to save the academy from imminent destruction.

[GAME SYSTEM]
Embracing Your Youth in School Life
Help other students deal with their problems as a member of the Student Support Services (SSS),and then go out with friends after school to make the most of your school days.

The bond between the two of you will grow stronger with each event you experience.
Be careful, though—becoming intimate with multiple people may cause problems…!?

Battles use a simple yet exhilarating Timeline Command system.
Take the lead as a “Leader” who supports allies in combat, or dominate the battlefield as a “Ruler” with powerful skills.
Use both fighting styles to seize victory!

Your choices will reveal your true self—.Triad Stats.
Light Triad: Morality, Sympathy, Altruism
Dark Triad: Machiavellianism, Psychopathy, Narcissism
These six stats will change according to the analyses you receive and choices you make during the game.

Triad stats can increase the number of dialogue options available to you
and enhance the power of passive battle skills.
What course of events will your true self bring about?

[CREATOR]
Character Theme Song Composer: wotaku, NILFRUITS, OSTER project, Yoshida Yasei, Tadano Kaede / A4., Hitoshizuku and Yamasankakkei, KANON69, Daibakuhasin
Music: Tsukasa Masuko
Scenario: Gakuto Mikumo, Ryutaro Ito
Scenario Editing: Kazunari Suzuki

70070000029652.name: Cat Cosmic Puzzle Supernova Pack
70070000029652.intro: A purrfect puzzle among the stars!
70070000029652.description:
Ready to test your brain in a galaxy full of fluffy tails and twinkling stars? In Cat Cosmic Puzzle, adorable cosmic kittens need your help organizing their dreamiest constellations!


Key Features:
- Over 90 spacey puzzles to solve!
- 29 glowing kitties to discover!
- Lo-fi space beats and dreamy cosmic tunes
- A crew of sweet stargazing kittens to guide you!
- Relaxing, visually enchanting experience for puzzle lovers of all ages

Expand your cosmic journey with the Space Odyssey 1 and Space Odyssey 2 DLCs, included in this bundle.

These celestial cats aren’t just sleeping on clouds – they’re puzzling over how to fit themselves as star-shaped pieces into the skies just right. With your help, they’ll complete dazzling constellations, solve galactic-shaped challenges, and nap peacefully under the stars.


Each puzzle is a cozy cosmic conundrum: squeeze glowing fluffies into limited spaces while navigating new shapes, magical clouds, and celestial obstacles. The deeper you go into space, the trickier the challenges become. But don’t worry – the cats believe in you!


With charming visuals, relaxing music, and over 90 unique levels to stargaze through, Cat Cosmic Puzzle is a chill experience that’s just as dreamy as it is puzzling.

70070000029662.name: Hentai Golf Lake of Relax Pack
70070000029662.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000029662.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses with Prairie Greens, River's Edge and Lakeside Fairways DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000029670.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Deluxe Edition
70070000029670.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO
• Season Pass - 4 Packs including Dragon Ball SUPER: SUPER HERO, Dragon Ball DAIMA, and more content that contains over 20 playable characters.
• Season Pass Bonus - Summon Shenron

DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Become a super warrior and experience the earth-shaking, limit-breaking power of Dragon Ball battles!

THE BIGGEST ROSTER IN HISTORY
Unleash the strength of over 180 fighters from Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball Super, Dragon Ball GT, and selected Dragon Ball movies, all in the base game! Each character comes with their own signature abilities, transformations, and techniques.

Make the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball yours!

BREATHTAKING 3D FIGHTS
Engage in heart-pounding, high-speed 3D battles that stay true to the anime and video game series, with breathtaking visuals and authentic combat moves like beam clashes, rush attacks, movements too quick for the eyes to see, and planet-razing ultimate attacks.

RIVALS MAKE YOU STRONGER
Challenge players online to test your skills, enjoy local multiplayer with up to six players on a single console, or connect multiple consoles for wireless play. Experience intense battles and become a Super Warrior with immersive motion controls using the Joy-Con™ controllers.

BLAZE A NEW PATH
Conquer the action-packed battles from the beloved original story, or discover and unlock new encounters for your favorite Z-Fighters and more. Relive your favorite moments from the series through cutscenes you can experience from the perspectives of eight characters!

CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE
Recreate your favorite battles from throughout the Dragon Ball story, or set up your dream story battle with your favorite characters! Share your creations with other fans and experience the battles brought to life by imaginations around the world.

*In addition to this edition, Standard Edition and Ultimate Edition are also available. Please be careful not to purchase the same content twice.

70070000029700.name: Airstrip DLC and Party Time DLC Bundle
70070000029700.description:
Cars are nice, but maybe airplanes are nicer? Build a small airstrip at your gas station and 
help Joe with his air routes in this DLC.
It is more story-driven than what we did in the past and it allows you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.

Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day 
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the 
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you 
in on his deals.

The Airstrip
You have plenty of space and as it turned out, there used to be an old military landing strip 
during WWII close to your gas station. Should be that hard to make it work again, right? You 
might even go a step further, order some aviation fuel and some parts for planes. A 
windsock wouldn’t probably hurt and some lights might turn out to be useful, since you will 
on occasion also need to help him land. Let’s see how things develop and what Joe is up 
to...

Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

More Popularity
Parties are also a great tool to boost your popularity, especially for those struggling with increasing popularity at higher levels. Each upgrade of your venue spot opens new opportunities for popularity boots as an added bonus to all the other rewards.

Ice Cream Time
Party Time introduces the ice cream stand with its own mini-game and interactions to not only complement the party time theme further, but also give you another thing to do at your gas station. The more variety the better.

And More
There is more. Little things and not so little ones, like a tablet type device allowing you access the PC from anywhere. No more running halfway across the gas station to check on something or set something up. And we are introducing collectables that can be found throughout the game.

70070000029708.name: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC Deluxe Edition
70070000029708.intro: Adventure is back on the menu in PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!
70070000029708.description:
The Deluxe Edition is a digital-exclusive version containing the main PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC game and DLC.

Deluxe Edition includes:
• PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC
• Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set
- 3 Collab Stages
- 1 Collab Costume
- 20 Collab Figures
• Collaboration Set Bonus: Legendary PAC-LAND Costume

PAC-MAN WORLD 2 has been modernized, enhanced, and upgraded! The fan favorite returns as PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!

The Ghosts snuck into PAC-Village and stole the Golden Fruit, unwittingly freeing the all-powerful ghost king, Spooky! PAC-MAN must venture across PAC-LAND to reclaim the Golden Fruit and put a stop to the dastardly Spooky!

A World of Fun
Run, chomp, butt-bounce, and more to meet PAC-LAND's challenge and charm! From B-Doing Tree Tops to ice skating in Snowy Mountain, and taking aim from the PAC-Marine deep in the Ocean. Rev roll in Paradise Meadows, Flutter jump over lava in the Volcano, and PAC-Dot attack through Ghost Island!  PAC-MAN is ready for action!

Remade for all PAC Players!
With modern graphics, expanded levels and PAC-Village, quality of life improvements, and voice acting - it's the fan favorite remade from scratch with the original recipe. But Re-PAC means more: new actions for PAC-MAN, updated boss battles, characters, collectables, customizations, even a 2-player mode!

In PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC, Adventure is back on the menu!

*This edition contains content which is also sold separately. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000029709.name: Capybara and Friends Cozy Bundle
70070000029709.intro: Meet the adorable capybara and all her friends!
70070000029709.description:
Is there a more perfect combination than cute animals, beautiful flowers, nice music and relaxation? Our set is the answer!
The set of two cozy games includes:
- Capybara Zen-your favorite breathing meditation app to the sounds of the original soundtrack.
- Pets and Friends- your favorite scrapbook for creating beautiful sticker compositions. In addition, you will arrange puzzles, play memory games and learn interesting facts from the world of animals.

70070000029712.name: 2 in 1 crazy sports
70070000029712.intro: Have a blast and compete with your friends and family in this fun sports pack full of unique, crazy, and very friendly athletes!
70070000029712.description:
• We will find various high-level sporting events held in an Olympic stadium: high jump, javelin throw, 400-meter hurdles, pole vault, hammer or discus throw and many more.

• Each event has its own mechanics when it comes to achieving its objective: balance, speed, timing and reflexes with the quicktime event system (QTE).

• Unlock no less than 60 bizarre and unusual athletes. With them you can have a laugh…imagine controlling Santa Claus or the vampire trying to do a pole vault, also a diver with fins, a superhero with a cape, a pink bunny costume and many more.

• Various game modes including One Vs One to challenge your best friend or family member. With a world ranking and friends ranking for each event (leaderboard), and with an Olympic podium to celebrate your great achievements and Olympic medals.

70070000029714.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Ultimate Edition
70070000029714.description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO
• Season Pass - 4 Packs including Dragon Ball: SUPER HERO, Dragon Ball DAIMA, and more content that contains over 20 playable characters.
• Season Pass Bonus - Summon Shenron
• Ultimate Upgrade Pack - including the following in-game items:
  - Goku (Super) Costume with Power Pole
  - Emote Voice Set
  - 2 player card backgrounds
  - 1 customization item that increases a character's fighting ability　
• Ultimate Edition Bonus - Summon Super Shenron

DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Become a super warrior and experience the earth-shaking, limit-breaking power of Dragon Ball battles!

THE BIGGEST ROSTER IN HISTORY
Unleash the strength of over 180 fighters from Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball Super, Dragon Ball GT, and selected Dragon Ball movies, all in the base game! Each character comes with their own signature abilities, transformations, and techniques.

Make the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball yours!

BREATHTAKING 3D FIGHTS
Engage in heart-pounding, high-speed 3D battles that stay true to the anime and video game series, with breathtaking visuals and authentic combat moves like beam clashes, rush attacks, movements too quick for the eyes to see, and planet-razing ultimate attacks.

RIVALS MAKE YOU STRONGER
Challenge players online to test your skills, enjoy local multiplayer with up to six players on a single console, or connect multiple consoles for wireless play. Experience intense battles and become a Super Warrior with immersive motion controls using the Joy-Con™ controllers.

BLAZE A NEW PATH
Conquer the action-packed battles from the beloved original story, or discover and unlock new encounters for your favorite Z-Fighters and more. Relive your favorite moments from the series through cutscenes you can experience from the perspectives of eight characters!

CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE
Recreate your favorite battles from throughout the Dragon Ball story, or set up your dream story battle with your favorite characters! Share your creations with other fans and experience the battles brought to life by imaginations around the world.

*The Goku (Super) Costume with Power Pole is a special costume that can be only attached to Goku (Super).
*One of the blasts will change to Power Pole Dance when the costume is attached.
*You can summon Super Shenron regardless of the number of Super Dragon Balls you own at the time of use.
*In addition to this edition, Standard Edition and Deluxe Edition are also available. Please be careful not to purchase the same content twice.

70070000029716.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Season Pass
70070000029716.description:
The DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO Season Pass includes 4 DLC Packs for a total of more than 20 playable characters from the Dragon Ball SUPER: SUPER HERO movie, Dragon Ball DAIMA, and more.

As a Season Pass Bonus, you can summon Shenron to obtain items such as costumes or zeni.

- DLC 1: HERO OF JUSTICE Pack 
Contains playable characters from the Dragon Ball SUPER: SUPER HERO movie.

- DLC 2: Dragon Ball DAIMA: Character Pack 1
Contains playable characters from Dragon Ball DAIMA. 

- DLC 3: To be released around Q2 2025
Contains playable characters from Dragon Ball DAIMA.

- Extra DLC: Shallot (DRAGON BALL LEGENDS)
Contains a playable character from DRAGON BALL LEGENDS.

*The contents included in this pass can also be purchased separately. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000029719.name: Once Upon A KATAMARI - King of All Sounds Edition
70070000029719.description:
The King of All Sounds Edition includes:
- Once Upon A KATAMARI
- Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side A
- Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side B

Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present.
 
In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll!

Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!
 
• A Shiny New Katamari Damacy Adventure Awaits
Experience new stages and a fabulous new soundtrack! Behold a fresh rolling experience, with never-before-seen support tools like the magnet to draw in nearby objects! How...attractive!
 
• Roll Through the Ages
The King was so well-behaved until he mistakenly crushed the Earth, the Moon, and numerous planets while fiddling with a peculiar scroll. Now roll your katamari through the Jurassic Era, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the sky's dazzling field of stars.
 
• Keep the Family Close With Cousin Customization
Play as The Prince, or choose among his 68 cousins and kin to play as. Customize their colors and faces to create as many original Cousin designs as there are stars in the sky.
 
• Compete in Celestial 4-Player KatamariBall
Conquer the game of KatamariBall, the galactic sport of choice across the Cosmos! Compete online against cousins around the world, or hone your skills with scintillating offline play against CPU opponents.
 
*A Standard Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000029730.name: Mom Simulator 2023: Cozy Home
70070000029730.intro: From managing chaos to designing comfort and style.
70070000029730.description:
Step into the rewarding world of modern motherhood with Mom Simulator 2023, a heartfelt life simulation game where you manage daily routines, care for your family, and create lasting memories. Now, elevate your home experience with the New Fence DLC, adding fresh textures and materials to personalize your yard’s borders and give your home a unique touch.

This bundle includes:
	•	The full Mom Simulator 2023 game — juggle chores, parenting, and self-care in a realistic and immersive family life simulation.
	•	The  New Fence DLC — customize your yard with new border design, material, and styles that make your home truly yours.

Create your perfect family life, inside and out, and enjoy a richer, more personalized gameplay experience with this exclusive bundle!

70070000029746.name: Let's Sing 2026 with International Hits
70070000029746.intro: Standard Edition: The Let’s Sing 2026 Standard edition includes 35 songs and a one month free trial of VIP Pass.
70070000029746.description:
The global karaoke party returns with Let’s Sing 2026, your ultimate ticket to fun-filled nights and unforgettable performances.

Whether you're warming up your vocal cords solo, teaming up in duets, or competing with friends, Let’s Sing 2026 delivers an unbeatable playlist, and endless entertainment!

Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.

- Billie Eilish – BIRDS OF A FEATHER
- Chappell Roan – HOT TO GO !
- Gracie Abrams – I Love You, I'm Sorry
- Selena Gomez – Single Soon
- Lizzo – 2 Be Loved (Am I ready)
- Shaboozey – Good News
- Ed Sheeran feat Lil Baby – 2step
...And many more!

Key Features:
* Sing along to official music videos for an authentic experience
* 4 exciting game modes for solo players and groups
* Up to 4-player support – perfect for parties and family gatherings
* Use your smartphone as a mic with the free companion app
* 1-month FREE VIP Pass included – unlock 180+ additional songs
* Whether you're a first-time performer or a karaoke king or queen, Let’s Sing 2026 invites you to step into the spotlight.

Get ready to take the stage!

70070000029747.intro: Gold Edition: The Let's Sing 2026 Gold edition includes 35 songs, as well as a one month free trial + 3 months of VIP Pass.
