70070000029753.name: Spy Guy Gdansk Edition
70070000029753.intro: Explore the beautiful Polish city of Gdansk with Spy Guy in great bundle!
70070000029753.description: Discover another map full of hidden objects in the Polish city of Gdansk together with basic version of Spy Guy Hidden Objects game. See the unique monuments, historical sites and fun characters among which hidden mysterious objects you must find with the detective.

70070000029758.name: Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist Deluxe Edition
70070000029758.intro: Immerse yourself in a fascinating world filled with magical gardens and witches.
70070000029758.description:
Join Nora, a spirited young witch who's made a few… reckless choices. Embark on a whimsical point-and-click adventure and help her right the wrongs she’s done. While you’re at it, help this wannabe alchemist become a licensed witch.

A MAGICAL GARDENER
Take on the role of a budding alchemist, tasked with nurturing magical gardens. Keep your plants from withering and gather all you can carry. Keep in mind that the clock is ticking, so don’t waste a single second.

EARN A LIVING
Take the literal fruits of your labor to create dozens of unique potions. You decide if you’d rather use them to remove some obstacles or sell them for a profit. Visit the nice elderly lady who runs the magic shop next door. Spend your money wisely and expand your range of possibilities.

DISCOVER SECRETS
Use your alchemy to revitalize the old gardens left by Nora’s grandmother. Uncover new locations and new materials to speed up your journey to the top. Help Nora realize her dream and become a master alchemist.

CUSTOMIZE
Chose from a wide plethora of options to make Nora’s home into the place you could call home. Use your hard-earned cash and customize it to your heart’s content.  It won’t influence your alchemy, but it will look glorious.

The Ghost Story DLC, included in this bundle, continues the main story and adds new quests, locations, ingredients, and decorations.

Key Features:
- A classic point&click game mixed with a farming simulator
- Unique Gardens
- A multitude of crafting options
- Vibrant illustrations
- Home customization
- Quirky characters

70070000029763.name: Birds and Cats
70070000029763.intro: Become a master quilter and a bird researcher!
70070000029763.description:
Become a master quilter and a bird researcher in this bundle featuring 2 digital adaptations of award-winning board games. Sew extraordinary quilts and attract cute kittens to them in Quilts and Cats of Calico, or create beautiful bird preserves full of unique birds in Wingspan.

This bundle includes:
- Wingspan
- Quilts and Cats of Calico

Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves. 

Quilts and Cats of Calico is a wholesome, award-winning complex puzzle game for 1 to 4 players. Meet adorable cats and sew the coziest quilts. Compete with other players in multiplayer mode, play solo, or delve into the story of a quilter sewing their way through the city of cats.

70070000029764.name: Birds and Cats Special Edition
70070000029764.description:
Become a master quilter and a bird researcher in this bundle featuring 2 digital adaptations of award-winning board games. Sew extraordinary quilts and attract cute kittens to them in Quilts and Cats of Calico, or create beautiful bird preserves full of unique birds in Wingspan.

This bundle also includes all available regional expansions and decorative packs for Wingspan, adding fresh strategies, unique birds and new mechanics to deepen your gameplay. You’ll also unlock customization options like seasonal backgrounds and player portraits that make every session feel even more vibrant and immersive.

This bundle includes:
Wingspan
Wingspan: European Expansion
Wingspan: Oceania Expansion
Wingspan: Asia Expansion
Seasonal Decorative Pack
Seasonal Decorative Pack 2
Woodland Wonders Decorative Pack
Quilts and Cats of Calico

Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.

Wingspan: European Expansion takes you on a journey to another continent. Explore diverse European habitats and meet charming, beautiful birds with new interesting abilities.

In the adaptation of the award-winning Wingspan: Oceania Expansion embark on a journey through the breathtaking lands of Oceania. Learn about birds from around Australia and New Zealand and all-new resources and mechanics that will enrich your adventure of creating a wildlife preserve.

Explore the wonders of Asia in Wingspan: Asia Expansion! Discover new birds and bonus cards, compete in Duet Mode, and immerse yourself in rich landscapes with stunning art and soothing music. Compete in fresh challenges, and experience a serene journey with Asia's avian marvels!

With the decorative packs, you will gain unlimited access to exclusive and seasonal backgrounds along with matching player portraits. Choose the ones you're in the mood for each game and enjoy digitally painted backgrounds no matter the season, time, and place.

Quilts and Cats of Calico is a wholesome, award-winning complex puzzle game for 1 to 4 players. Meet adorable cats and sew the coziest quilts. Compete with other players in multiplayer mode, play solo, or delve into the story of a quilter sewing their way through the city of cats.

70070000029765.name: Death Kid +  There's a Gun in the Office Bundle
70070000029765.intro: Escape the shadows or embrace the fight - two thrilling journeys, one unmissable bundle.
70070000029765.description: Two intense games, one great deal. In There's a Gun in the Office, you're a kidnapping victim trapped in a locked room, with just five days to plan a silent escape before your captors return - every move must be flawless or risk discovery. In Death Kid, you’re an immortal warrior battling through hordes of relentless enemies in a cursed well, mastering powerful abilities and protecting fragile souls as you fight to break the cycle of life and death. Whether you’re sneaking through shadows or tearing through foes, this bundle delivers high-stakes action, strategy, and adrenaline at a killer price.

70070000029769.name: Peachy Derby - Genius Edition
70070000029769.intro: 60FPS racing game where the girl Natsuki is forced to join the "Ninja Racing Tournament" to pay off her debt. 10 girls,100 dances anims, 600 voices, 16 chapters.
70070000029769.description:
Peachy Derby + Minami - Back to School

[Peachy Girl's Adventure]
Experience the story of girl Natsuki joining the ""Ninja Racing Tournament"" with her friends to pay off her debt. A total of 16 chapters. 

[Humanoid Kart Racing]
Choose a girl and reach the finish line before the others.Use ninja tools to attack enemies.

[Let the Girls Dance]
In addition to racing, choose dances, outfits, and Japanese voice lines for the girls.

70070000029773.name: Aquapark io: Hero Edition
70070000029773.intro: Race with your friends on waterslides and jump into the pool for victory!
70070000029773.description:
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or enjoy sliding solo. Prove that you are the fastest of them all!

Features:
- 13 large maps with slides
- 39 cute skins, 11 floaties, 13 gliders
- multiplayer mode up to 4 players on one screen!
- opening packs with random skins
- spawning mysterious powerups during the game
- catchy holiday music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Slide down the huge waterslide which spirals down from the sky, overtake your friends, push them off the track or use powerups to gain an adventage. The funniest part is that you can actually jump off the track at any moment and try to land on a lower level overtaking everyone in an instant!

70070000029775.name: Maze: Path of Light - Complete Edition
70070000029775.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70070000029775.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths—experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

Features:
- 5 new constellations with 143 additional mazes
- Creative Level Design: Conquer 4 maze types—square, circular, triangular, and hexagonal
- 5 Unique Challenges: Classic, Portal, Token, Limited Moves, Timed and Dark Mazes!
- Power-ups: 3 helpful powers to help you find your way
- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70070000029777.name: Neko Gelato Icy Paw Edition
70070000029777.description:
Ever wanted to start your own patisserie? Well, now it's your chance! Running your own pastry shop has never been easier in this puzzle cozy game. Move, place, and stuff all the meringues, waffles, ice creams, lollipops, and mochi to fit inside each available space.

Key Features: 
- Over 90 sweet levels to master!
- 29 sweets and chocolates to box.
- Soundtrack as sweet as the candy served! 
- Beautifully drawn confectionaries.
- Friendly host to accompany you in your journey!

Dive into a world of frosty fun and sweet surprises with Frosty Journey 1 DLC included in this bundle!

Many sweets in unique shapes and sizes that must fit somewhere. Pack the boxes almost like packing your customer orders, make sure they all fit! 

If something doesn't fit, you can start again and make sure all pieces fit in like a piece of an art. Each level delivers hours of entertainment as they test your skill and keep you focused.

70070000029779.name: Heisting: Fully Armed Edition
70070000029779.intro: What could be more exciting than the thrill of a perfectly performed heist?
70070000029779.description:
You are a masterful thief who embarks on a stealing spree across the world's most luxurious museums, galleries, and banks! 

Gather your crew of robbers and devise the perfect plan as you progress through increasingly difficult levels!

Features:
- rob the most luxurious banks, museums and galleries with the help of your gang!
- recruit new members to increase the size of the group and complete levels more efficiently
- use 3 new weapons with higher demage and faster fire rate!
- wear 3 new skins with high HP and super bonuses to speed, alarm delay and money!
- buy upgrades for your weapons, skins, crew, and alarm delay
- carry out various missions: Gang War, Laser Madness, Jewellery Shop, Bank, The Tomb, Take Them Out and many more!
- use diverse weapons with their own damage and fire rate stats
- open safes to draw weapon or skin cards
- use additional 50 gems to buy upgrades even faster!
- become incredibly rich!

If things go wrong, and believe us, they will, it will be up to your skills to shoot your way out to safety. Choose your upgrades carefully, as they could be the difference between a big payday and a messy failure.

As you progress, you will need to convince more robbers to join your gang and help you with your heists. In order for the heist to be completed, you will need to steal everything in your sight.

You will encounter different enemies who will try to prevent you from taking your loot, and you'll need to adapt a unique strategy to get around each one of them.

Immerse yourself into a world where everything is yours for the taking. How much money can you get? The sky's the limit!

70070000029782.name: Puzzle On! Bundle (Packs 1 and 2)
70070000029782.intro: You can purchase both Puzzle On! Packs in one bundle for a reduced price!
70070000029782.description: This is a bundle* that contains Puzzle On! Pack #1 and Puzzle On! Pack #2. To see the specific contents of each pack, please view the product information page for that pack.

70070000029786.name: Pokémon™ Friends Combo Bundle
70070000029786.intro: You can purchase the Basic Pack and both Puzzle On! Packs in one bundle for a reduced price!
70070000029786.description: This is a bundle* that contains the Basic Pack, Puzzle On! Pack #1 and Puzzle On! Pack #2. To see the specific contents of each pack, please view the product information page for that pack.

70070000029788.name: Block Jam: Fancy Edition
70070000029788.intro: Plan, match, and clear the board in Block Jam, where every move counts and every block needs the perfect match!
70070000029788.description:
Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and build amazing structures for your blocks. Sounds easy? Think again! – you only have so much room on your bench, and if you overfill it, it's game over!

Features:
- Extra items: 15x undo powerup, 15x more space powerup, 15x shuffle powerup, 15x magnet powerup and 6 new hats for the blocks that live on your dioramas!
- Match and Win: Match three blocks of the same color to clear levels and avoid overfilling your bench.
- Limited Bench: Use your bench wisely – a full bench means game over!
- Bus Mode: Fill color-matched buses to clear levels and earn extra power-ups and coins!
- Fun Power-Ups: Use undo, magnet, reshuffle, or expand your bench to escape tricky situations.
- Build Your Diorama: Collect bricks to create unique structures in your very own block-populated diorama.
- Customize Your Blocks: Use coins earned in-game to give your diorama blocks unique and fun looks.

Every level gives you new challenges to solve, but don't worry – you have power-ups to help! Undo a move, reshuffle blocks, or add extra bench space when you're in a tough spot. Earn coins along the way to customize your blocks and make your diorama totally unique!

For an extra challenge, try "Bus Mode" – the classic Block Jam experience with a colorful twist! Match blocks to fill color-coded buses and watch them roll out. Complete all buses in a level, and you'll earn even more power-ups and coins to help you on your journey!

Jump into Block Jam – where every move is a step closer to clearing the board, personalizing your world, and mastering each challenge!

70070000029792.name: My Cozy Room Puppy Paradise Pack
70070000029792.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000029792.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic, Easter, Summer, Rock, Halloween and Dogs DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000029812.name: Stuff it! Daily Chores Pack
70070000029812.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000029812.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!


What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

This bundle comes with the Kids' Playground and Livingroom Chaos DLCs.

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?

70070000029820.name: Cat Cosmic Puzzle Milky Way Collection
70070000029820.intro: A purrfect puzzle among the stars!
70070000029820.description:
Ready to test your brain in a galaxy full of fluffy tails and twinkling stars? In Cat Cosmic Puzzle, adorable cosmic kittens need your help organizing their dreamiest constellations!


Key Features:
- Over 90 spacey puzzles to solve!
- 29 glowing kitties to discover!
- Lo-fi space beats and dreamy cosmic tunes
- A crew of sweet stargazing kittens to guide you!
- Relaxing, visually enchanting experience for puzzle lovers of all ages

Expand your cosmic journey with the Space Odyssey 1, Space Odyssey 2 and Space Odyssey 3 DLCs, included in this bundle.

These celestial cats aren’t just sleeping on clouds – they’re puzzling over how to fit themselves as star-shaped pieces into the skies just right. With your help, they’ll complete dazzling constellations, solve galactic-shaped challenges, and nap peacefully under the stars.


Each puzzle is a cozy cosmic conundrum: squeeze glowing fluffies into limited spaces while navigating new shapes, magical clouds, and celestial obstacles. The deeper you go into space, the trickier the challenges become. But don’t worry – the cats believe in you!


With charming visuals, relaxing music, and over 90 unique levels to stargaze through, Cat Cosmic Puzzle is a chill experience that’s just as dreamy as it is puzzling.

70070000029821.name: Airstrip DLC, Can Touch This DLC and Party Time DLC Bundle
70070000029821.description:
Gas Station Simulator - Airstrip DLC
Cars are nice, but maybe airplanes are nicer? Build a small airstrip at your gas station and 
help Joe with his air routes in this DLC.
It is more story-driven than what we did in the past and it allows you to build a small airstrip close to your gas station.
Meet Joe
Joe is an old pilot flying an old single engine plane. He is a bit strange and one day 
approaches you to help him with his endeavours. For that he needs a place to land in the 
middle of nowhere to make a stop halfway to his destination. In return he is willing to cut you 
in on his deals.
The Airstrip
You have plenty of space and as it turned out, there used to be an old military landing strip 
during WWII close to your gas station. Should be that hard to make it work again, right? You 
might even go a step further, order some aviation fuel and some parts for planes. A 
windsock wouldn’t probably hurt and some lights might turn out to be useful, since you will 
on occasion also need to help him land. Let’s see how things develop and what Joe is up 
to...
The Plane
Joe’s plane is like its pilot: old. It’s also simple. The most advanced technology on this thing 
is the LED reading light Joe uses to find his way on the chart. How hard can it be to fix some
simple things on a small plane? And it’s not like you are doing it for free.
The Gameplay
The Airstrip DLC brings new game mechanics and content to Gas Station Simulator based 
on events. Unlike the content we introduced in the past, it does not require your constant 
attention, it is more something that happens every now and then. 

Gas Station Simulator - Can Touch This DLC
Get some new tools and redecorate your gas station. Change walls, doors, windows and 
move things around. Make your own art and rival Dennis’ artworks. Want to change the 
warehouse or the workshop? Now you can. And much, much more.
Rebuild & Reconstruct!
Take matters into your own hand. Almost literally. With the help of your new, trusty hammer, 
it's time to redecorate like you've never done before. Refurbish walls to your heart's content, 
changing their features and decor as you see fit. Decide where to put trash cans or where to 
move the cash register to. Direct the crowd. Show your customers the right way to orderly 
queue without taking too much space. It's time to take interior customisation to a completely 
new level.
Paint & Spray!
No need to stare at an empty canvas any longer! Grab your spray can and add a little 
personal touch to any surface you can lay your hands on. With adjustable scale and rotation,
you can spray anything from large murals to tiny easter eggs hidden somewhere in the 
corners of your station. Combine existing decals with each other, creating even more 
elaborate and complex pieces of art. And whenever you start feeling like you're running out, 
more designs lie hidden all around for you to unlock!

Gas Station Simulator - Party Time DLC Let the party begin
There is nothing like a cool night party in the middle of nowhere. When the normal customer traffic goes down, this might be another revenue stream to open up. Create a great party spot to attract people, offer them interesting products and cater to their needs. The more successful your parties and the more the partygoers are satisfied, the more money you earn and the bigger the party.

More Popularity
Parties are also a great tool to boost your popularity, especially for those struggling with increasing popularity at higher levels. Each upgrade of your venue spot opens new opportunities for popularity boots as an added bonus to all the other rewards.

70070000029828.name: Ashwood Valley Animals' Enthusiast Pack
70070000029828.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000029828.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

Unlock new outfits and change the look of your room with Cozy Comforts Style, Sunny Summer Style and Draco's Nook DLCs included in this bundle.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70070000029835.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII Settler's Edition
70070000029835.description:
Expand the strategic horizons of your empire and enjoy more options for your reign with Sid Meier's Civilization® VII Settler's Edition!

Sid Meier's Civilization VII Settler's Edition is the ideal way for new players to start their journey through history with a treasure trove of additional content. If you already own Sid Meier's Civilization VII Standard or Deluxe Edition, you can individually purchase the DLC included in the Settler's Edition.

Settler's Edition includes:
• Full base game
• Tecumseh and Shawnee Pack 
• Crossroads of the World Collection:
  - 2 leaders: Ada Lovelace, Simón Bolívar
  - 4 civilizations: Carthage, Great Britain, Nepal, Bulgaria
  - 4 Natural Wonders: Machapuchare, Mount Fuji, Vihren, Vinicunca
  - 1 badge cosmetic bonus
• Right to Rule Collection:
  - 2 leaders: Genghis Khan, Lakshmibai
  - 4 civilizations: Assyria, Dai Viet, Qajar, Silla
  - 4 Wonders: Grand Bazaar, Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, Ubudiah Mosque, Wat Xieng Thong
  - 1 badge cosmetic bonus
• 4 leader Personas: 
  - Ashoka (World Conqueror) Persona
  - Friedrich (Baroque) Persona
  - Himiko (High Shaman) Persona
  - Xerxes (The Achaemenid) Persona
• Deluxe Cosmetics Pack
  - 4 profile customizations
  - 1 alternate scout skin

70070000029840.name: Car Racing & Driving Bundle - Drag Racing, Highway Racer, Drift Japan, Toon Cars
70070000029840.intro: From city streets to mountain roads — race like a legend.
70070000029840.description:
Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush with the Car Racing & Driving Bundle - Drag Racing, Highway Racer, Drift Japan, Toon Cars! Whether you’re a fan of drag racing, mountain drifting, urban street racing, or stylized tracks, this bundle offers a wide variety of high-speed thrills to satisfy every racing enthusiast.

Included games:
	•	Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator
Master the quarter-mile drag races. Tune your dragster for maximum performance and race your way to the championship. 
	•	Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator
Race through hectic city traffic at breakneck speeds. Choose your ride and weave skillfully through the chaos to claim the top spot.
	•	Project Drift Japan Challenge
Drift on iconic Japanese mountain roads with legendary JDM cars. Perfect your skills, beat rivals, and enjoy a nostalgic Eurobeat soundtrack.
	•	Toon Toon Racing
Dive into a vibrant anime-inspired racing world with realistic car physics and smart AI opponents. A colorful and thrilling race experience awaits.
	•	Hot Rider Racing Simulator
Race across highways and deserts, upgrade your vehicles, adapt to weather conditions, and prove you’re the fastest on the road.

Why get this bundle?
	•	Diverse racing experiences: drag, drift, urban, and stylized.
	•	Unique cars with upgrade options and authentic handling.
	•	Immersive graphics and dynamic gameplay across all titles.
	•	Multiple game modes offering intense competition for every skill level.
	•	Non-stop high-speed excitement anytime, anywhere!

Get ready, rev your engines, and become the ultimate racing champion!

70070000029841.name: 12 Party Games Collection
70070000029841.intro: 12 games. Endless fun. One ultimate party pack!
70070000029841.description:
Dive into non-stop entertainment with 12 Party Games Collection - a bundle packed with exciting games that bring instant fun to any gathering.

Jump between fan-favorite hits: Hole io, Paper io 2, Skyline Bowling, Mob Control, Candivity, Golf Guys, Aquapark io, Ball Blast, Helix Jump, Puff Up, Pocket Mini Golf, and Pocket Mini Golf 2. Each game offers its own twist - from quick reflex challenges and arcade chaos to skill-based precision and pure, satisfying gameplay.

Play solo to master each game or share the joy with friends in friendly competitions up to 4 players! Discover your favorites, chase new high scores, and see who dominates the next round. Whether it’s a quick session or an all-night gaming marathon, every match brings something fresh to the table.

12 ways to play -12 times the fun!

70070000029844.name: Our Summer Festival 2 + More Festivities Pack Set
70070000029844.intro:
The time for Our Summer Festival has come around again!
Get ready for tons of festive fun with friends!
70070000029844.description:
The second installment in this series of exciting summer festival games is here!
Share Joy-Con™ and play with up to 4 players!

A new set with both Our Summer Festival 2 and the More Festivities Pack is now available!

70070000029847.name: Neko Gelato Feline Freeze Collection
70070000029847.description:
Ever wanted to start your own patisserie? Well, now it's your chance! Running your own pastry shop has never been easier in this puzzle cozy game. Move, place, and stuff all the meringues, waffles, ice creams, lollipops, and mochi to fit inside each available space.

Key Features: 
- Over 90 sweet levels to master!
- 29 sweets and chocolates to box.
- Soundtrack as sweet as the candy served! 
- Beautifully drawn confectionaries.
- Friendly host to accompany you in your journey!

Dive into a world of frosty fun and sweet surprises with Frosty Journey 1 and Frosty Journey 2 DLCs included in this bundle!

Many sweets in unique shapes and sizes that must fit somewhere. Pack the boxes almost like packing your customer orders, make sure they all fit! 

If something doesn't fit, you can start again and make sure all pieces fit in like a piece of an art. Each level delivers hours of entertainment as they test your skill and keep you focused.

70070000029848.description:

70070000029872.name: Broken Rules Collection
70070000029872.description:
Broken Rules Collection = Old Man's Journey + Gibbon: Beyond the Trees

Old Man's Journey
Old Man’s Journey, a soul-searching puzzle adventure, tells a story of life, loss, reconciliation, and hope. Entrenched in a beautifully sunkissed and handcrafted world, embark on a heartfelt journey interwoven with lighthearted and pressure-free puzzle solving. 

Gibbon: Beyond the Trees
Gibbon: Beyond the Trees is a hand-drawn adventure following a lost gibbon as they embark on a dangerous journey into unknown lands. Race to freedom in liberation mode, or play through an hour-long narrative that captures the real struggle of living creatures around the world.

70070000029892.name: Fantasy RPG Bundle
70070000029892.intro: Five indie RPG journeys in one neat bundle.
70070000029892.description:
From classic JRPG throwbacks to a life-sim comedy RPG and first-person mysticism, this collection brings five Elushis and Wathitdew Record releases together on Nintendo Switch™. Save Sarook, chase the Aeternum Gem, break a 29-day curse, and even work your way from open mic to the Comedy Arena. Five distinct adventures, turn-based battles, exploration, secrets, and plenty of charm, all in one place.

Included in the bundle:

Adventure Field IV
A semi open-world, turn-based JRPG set in the Sarook Kingdom. Gather soul gems, cook and farm between dungeons, and uncover quests and secrets that shift with the day–night cycle.

Frowntown
A light-hearted life-sim comedy RPG about climbing from open mic to the Comedy Arena. Read the crowd, shape your routine, upgrade your gear, and let choices steer your career.

Adventure Field Remake
A modernized return to the series’ origin with refined systems and visuals. Hunt 100 mandragoras, chase shiny monster drops, and choose between Remake and Classic difficulty for a tougher journey.

Aeternum Quest
A 90s-inspired 3D JRPG about a Gem Wielder in training. Recruit allies, capture and summon monsters, and pursue the universe-shaping Aeternum Gem across towns, towers, and dungeons.

The Atla Archives
An open-ended first-person quest to stop a catastrophe that repeats every 29 days. Explore the risen city of Atla, upgrade your stats, and conjure items and magic to fill the Fountain of Absence.

70070000029895.name: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess Burning Rivalry Edition
70070000029895.intro: Fall in love… with a goddess?! In this visual novel divinely beautiful girls will steal your heart!
70070000029895.description:
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!


WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?
While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?


LET THEM CHARM YOU
During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?


ONLY ONE WINNER
Despite the beauty and charm of all the girls, only one will be able to win the competition. Which one of them will impress you enough to award her the golden apple? Are you going to go with your heart or will you play fair?

And most importantly: will you find love in Love Elysium?

The Aimi's Secrets, Emiko's Secrets, Haru's Secrets and Tomoe's Secrets DLCs included in this bundle allow you to spend even more time with girls and get to know them better.

KEY FEATURES:
- An amazing story waiting for you
- 5 endings to discover = 5x more gameplay
- Unique personalities and temperaments of the girls
- Many dialogue options you can choose from
- Breathtaking island full of magical places
- Different reactions of girls depending on what you say

70070000029900.name: Love Elysium: Secret of the Goddess Ultimate Showdown

70070000029902.name: Skyline Bowling: Complete Edition
70070000029902.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000029902.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 12 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Balls - Equip 12 new bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 300K coins and 10K gems to buy and upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000029907.name: Ball Blast: Complete Edition
70070000029907.intro: Dodge falling rocks and blast them all!
70070000029907.description:
A wild rain of bouncing rocks crashes down - move fast, blast faster! 

Features:
- 9 New Maps: Blast your way through Space Station, Red Planet, Wasteland, Haunted Castle, Candy Land, Vaporwave, Desert, Runic, and Frozen maps!
- CO-OP: Team up with a friend and fend off the falling rocks together!
- Online Leaderboards: Survive as long as you can and get the best score in the world!
- Powerful Cannons: Choose between basic, shotgun, boomerang, and saw cannons!
- Devastating powers: Buy and upgrade powerful abilities to destroy everything!
- Special Levels: Defeat epic bosses and protect the bridge from destruction!
- 105 Item Shards: Gather more shards to upgrade your equipment!
- 24 Boosters: Includes Damage, Charge, Cannon, and Shield boosts to amplify your firepower!
- 7500 Gems: Spend extra gems on crates, fresh shards, and more power-ups!
- Replayability: Complete hundreds of unique levels and challenges!

Every rock has a number—hit it that many times and boom! it splits into two rocks with half the number and double the speed, turning the field into fast-moving chaos!

Play solo or with a friend for double firepower. Beat hundreds of levels, survive endless waves, and climb the world leaderboard!

Pick up coins and unlock new cannons: a wide-spread shotgun, a boomerang that swings back and spinning saw blades that slice through rocks as they fall. Upgrade power-ups like a piercing laser beam, explosive drones, and huge shockwaves to wipe out waves in a flash!

The rocks won’t stop bouncing—are you ready to keep blasting?

70070000029909.name: Frozen Honey ASMR: Frost Edition
70070000029909.intro: Enjoy making your frozen honey jelly desserts from scratch in the most satisfying ASMR game!
70070000029909.description:
Choose your favorite bottle, mix all ingredients, freeze it, and squeeze out the frozen honey jelly!

You are the owner of a frozen honey truck, and people can't get enough of your tasty honey desserts! Start the cooking adventure by choosing the bottle shape, adding candies, pouring colorful honey, and mixing it up. After that, put the stencil on the bottle, pop it into the fridge, and enjoy the sounds of the frozen honey. Sweet, soft, and incredibly tasty – frozen honey jelly has never been this much fun!

Features:
- unlock a brand new truck, change its look with 3 unique skins and put a special sign on top!
- spend additional 2000 coins in the shop
- create fabulous and colorful frozen honey jelly desserts!
- let your imagination run wild using different sweets, honey colors, bottle shapes, and stencils! 
- meet the demands of your customers
- enjoy the ASMR sounds while preparing your delicious frozen honey!
- perform special tasks of collector, achiever, gamer and purchaser
- serve unique VIP characters
- customize your truck using various skins, signs, and truck shapes
- use skins to change the look of your equipment
- earn money to spend it in the store on skins, bottles, candies, and more!
- watch your customers eat the frozen honey jelly desserts you have prepared and wait for their reactions! 

Watch the ASMR rainbow jelly dance and swirl into the perfect frozen honey dessert In this game, you're the mastermind behind the sensational frozen honey jelly treats that everyone loves on social media!

Explore the joy of experimenting with various candies and colorful syrups to create your own satisfying frozen honey. It's not just a game – it's an interactive journey that combines jelly with the joy of crafting!

Dive into the pleasures of crafting, innovating, and experiencing the captivating charm of the Frozen Honey ASMR game!

70070000029911.name: Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge: Golden Edition
70070000029911.intro:
Just go Up, Down, Left or Right. Easy, is it NOT?
The ultimate brain-busting challenge is back with a fully revamped version!
70070000029911.description:
Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge that messes with your head and makes you doubt your intelligence.

Read the instructions written on the cube and run towards the correct direction. Be careful about the time limit and don't let your brain get tricked!

Features:
- 3 unique skins for your character
- 3 cool backgrounds for a change of scenery
- Discover new game MODES and many LEVELS to challenge your brain in various ways
- Improve your brain skills everyday with the DAILY and WEEKLY CHALLENGE and reach the TOP of the leaderboard!
- Exclusive Multiplayer Versus mode for up to 4 players! Share the brain busting in NORMAL, HARD or EXTREME difficulty levels
- Classic mode. Each level raises the difficulty up with new instructions
- Challenge mode. Reach the best score in a bottomless pit of despair!
- Unlock unique SKINS to customize your experience
- MEASURE your progress with the statistics dashboard and compare them with your friends!
- Color blind accessibility mode
- Brand new GRAPHICS

This misleading expert aims at crushing your brain's ability to think properly. Can yours handle it?

70070000029917.name: Little Nightmares III Deluxe Edition
70070000029917.description:
Expand your eerie journey in The Spiral with the Deluxe Edition of Little Nightmares III!

With this Edition, you will get access to the Secrets of The Spiral (Expansion Pass) and The Residents Costume Set.

SECRETS OF THE SPIRAL - EXPANSION PASS:

- 2 additional chapters to play - delve deeper into the eerie lands of The Spiral. These additional tales enrich the experience and let you uncover hidden secrets, new perspectives, and unexpected horrors.

- Ferryman Costumes Set - exclusive to the Expansion Pass. A mysterious figure familiar to all children in The Nowhere. This costume set is suited for both characters Low and Alone.

THE RESIDENTS COSTUMES SET:

Conceal your identity in The Nowhere and embrace your dark side by wearing the costumes of some of The Residents of the two previous games: The Janitor, The Twin-Chefs, The Lady, The Hunter. Each costume goes in a set of two, suited for both characters Low and Alone. Prepare to enter a world where fear wears many faces.

Two young friends, lost in a frightening world not made for children. If they cannot find a way out of this Nowhere place, they’ll be condemned to a fate worse than death.

FACE YOUR CHILDHOOD FEARS TOGETHER

You play as Low and Alone, best friends ever since they found each other in this lonely nightmare. They each possess their own iconic item: a bow for Low and a wrench for Alone. Working together, they’ve become adept at sneaking through hidden passages, hoisting each other over massive obstacles, and watching each other’s backs.

Whether you’re playing with a friend or an A.I. companion, you’ll depend on each other's iconic items to create opportunities and to progress. The environment is full of clues and possibilities for imaginative children to exploit. Low’s arrows can reach high targets, cut through ropes, or down flying enemies, and Alone’s wrench is just the thing for crushing stunned enemies, smashing through barriers, or manipulating the workings of massive machines.

EMBARK ON AN IMMERSIVE AND DISTURBING ADVENTURE

No matter where you go, the Nowhere is home to horrific monsters. These Residents won't hesitate to go out of their way to capture any intrusive little Visitors that draw their attention. You might find yourself playing a terrifying game of hide and seek with Monster Baby in the sandy ruins of the Necropolis, struggling to avoid swarms of voracious Candy Weevils in an unsettling Candy Factory, or dodging heavy feet while running along the rain-soaked promenade of a filthy funfair.

You'll need to be ready to run, hide, or even defend yourself at a moment's notice to stay in one piece.

SINK INTO THE SPIRAL

Don’t be too distracted by the desolate beauty of the Nowhere. There are dark mysteries waiting for you as Low and Alone follow their mirror path across the Spiral. As each new location will become more dangerous and disturbing than the last, traumatic flashes from the past will begin to emerge. Will Low and Alone finally escape from this unending nightmare? Only you can help them, little ones...

70070000029918.name: Little Nightmares III - Secrets of The Spiral - Expansion Pass
70070000029918.description:
Delve deeper into the eerie lands of The Spiral with the Expansion Pass.

Secrets of The Spiral gives you access to 2 additional chapters and the Ferryman Costumes Set, exclusive to the Expansion Pass.

2 ADDITIONAL CHAPTERS:
While not essential to the main story, these additional tales enrich the experience and let you uncover hidden secrets, new perspectives, and unexpected horrors.

FERRYMAN COSTUMES SET (exclusive to the Expansion Pass):
A mysterious figure familiar to all children in The Nowhere. This costume is available in a set of two, suited for both characters Low and Alone.

70070000029924.name: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2: Core Add-on Bundle
70070000029924.description:
Core Add-on Bundle Content:
- Character Unlock Keys: Tengen Uzui, Obanai Iguro, Sanemi Shinazugawa, and Gyomei Himejima
- Battle Attire: Tanjiro's Kimono (Entertainment District), Inosuke's Kimono (Entertainment District), and Uzui's Shinobi Attire
- VS Mode System Voice: Upper Rank Demons Set (Akaza, Daki, Gyutaro, Gyokko, Zohakuten)

*Character Unlock Keys are bonuses that allow you to play the specified character in VS Mode at the very start.
*Battle Attire can be used in VS Mode.
*The latest patch must be installed in order to use online features.
*Contents and specifications are subject to change without notice.
*The items included in this set are also available in Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2 Deluxe Edition. Please be careful about duplicate purchases.
*To access this content, the base game (sold separately) is required.

70070000029945.name: Tales of Xillia Remastered - Deluxe Upgrade Pack
70070000029945.description:
The Deluxe Upgrade Pack includes:
- Battle BGM Pack
- Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
- Super Growth Support Herb Set

*A Deluxe Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000029946.name: Tales of Xillia Remastered Deluxe Edition
70070000029946.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Tales of Xillia Remastered
- Battle BGM pack
- Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
- Super Growth Support Herb Set

Experience Tales of Xillia, remastered for the first time ever.

Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.

Worlds Collide, Destiny Awaits

• Two Heroes, One Destiny
Follow the paths of Milla and Jude as they embark on their daring journey through Rieze Maxia, a wondrous land where mankind and spirits coexist in harmony.

• Partner Up with Dual Raid
Master the Dual Raid Linear Motion Battle System, mustering strategy and coordination to overcome action-packed battles in real-time combat. Team up with allies to unleash devastating combo attacks and unlock special support skills to overwhelm your foes.

• Witness the Dramatic Story with High-Quality Animation
Visit the gorgeous Rieze Maxia, revitalized by beautifully-rendered illustrations and animations.

• Quality of Life Upgrades
Explore with new quality-of-life updates including improved graphics, an auto-save feature, the ability to toggle encounters, early shop access, and more.

• An All-Around Experience
Xillia Remastered contains DLC launched alongside the original release, including costumes, useful items, and other fun extras.

*A Standard Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000029967.name: Cottonville Spooky Pack
70070000029967.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000029967.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

This bundle includes Halloween Outfits Pack DLC with new additional looks waiting for you.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000029977.name: Hentai World Loyal Companion Edition
70070000029977.intro: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.
70070000029977.description:
HENTAI IS ART

Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

You need to stay focused to truly enjoy the journey ahead. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" of the girl you're helping out. Every success on your part will make them happier!

In this bundle, you will meet three new characters: Sayuri, Chiyo, Foxy Akane and Puppy Nanami.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Almost 50 artpieces to unlock
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000029980.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley—Wishblossom Ranch Edition
70070000029980.intro: Explore a magical world in Disney Dreamlight Valley alongside Disney and Pixar friends and travel to Wishblossom Ranch to build the ranch of your dreams!
70070000029980.description:
This bundle includes Disney Dreamlight Valley the base game, the new expansion, Disney Dreamlight Valley: Wishblossom Ranch, and 13,000 Moonstones. 

Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new. Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle. Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley! 

In Disney Dreamlight Valley: Wishblossom Ranch, rebuild the ranch of your dreams, forge bonds with your horses, and befriend new Villagers as you saddle up for a new Disney adventure! Nestled amongst the Wishblossom Mountains is a special place powered by the heart’s deepest wishes, where horses once roamed free and stables were full of life. That was until the Ranch fell into the hands of someone who neglected it, causing a mysterious phenomenon – the Decay. Saddle up for an adventure with your new, magical Disney friends to find the missing horses, reverse the effects of the Decay, and restore the Ranch back to its former glory.

70070000029984.name: SUPER ROBOT WARS Y - DLC 1 & 2 Set
70070000029984.description:
The DLC 1 & 2 Set includes the following content:
- DLC 1
5 playable units
16 Area Missions
2 Assist Crew members
- DLC 2
5 playable units
16 Area Missions
1 Assist Crew member
- DLC 1 & 2 Set Bonus
2 Area Missions that reward Xelguard, Tyranado, and Tyranado Rex
1 bonus mission
- 2-day Early Access for DLC 1-2

*Individual DLCs can be purchased as standalone products. Be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Content will be available by August 2026.

70070000029986.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley—Ultimate Edition
70070000029986.intro: Explore a magical world in Disney Dreamlight Valley alongside Disney and Pixar friends, and expand your journey with the Wishblossom Ranch and the Storybook Vale Expansions!
70070000029986.description:
Live your Disney dream life with the Ultimate Edition, which includes the base game and two Expansions. This edition also contains exclusive digital items.
· Access to Disney Dreamlight Valley, Disney Dreamlight Valley: Wishblossom Ranch and Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale
· 18,000 Moonstones* 
· Exclusive Mount: Sven from Disney’s Frozen
· Exclusive Arendellian riding ensemble outfit
· Exclusive snowy alpine House Style

Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new. Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony—until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle. Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley! 
In Disney Dreamlight Valley: Wishblossom Ranch, rebuild the ranch of your dreams, forge bonds with your horses, and befriend new Villagers as you saddle up for a new Disney adventure! Nestled amongst the Wishblossom Mountains is a special place powered by the heart’s deepest wishes, where horses once roamed free and stables were full of life. That was until the Ranch fell into the hands of someone who neglected it, causing a mysterious phenomenon—the Decay. Saddle up for an adventure with your magical new Disney friends to find the missing horses, reverse the effects of the Decay, and restore the Ranch back to its former glory.
In Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale, discover a land made up of legendary stories, where myths and fairy tales sprang to life… until Maleficent and Hades tore the Vale apart. With the guidance of the Lorekeeper, journey to the Vale and meet heroes and villains who will bring epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover.

*Moonstones are an in-game currency that can be collected for free by performing tasks in the game or be purchased using real money. They are used to unlock the premium track of the Star Path (a battle-pass-inspired system that grants in-game cosmetic items as a player completes various tasks and missions). Moonstones can also be used to accelerate progress in the Star Path. Additionally, Moonstones can be used to purchase cosmetic items from the in-game store.

70070000029990.name: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Character Pass 3
70070000029990.description:
Upgrade your crew with Character Pass 3 for ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4! This powerful addition adds 6 new playable characters across 2 DLC packs, each bringing fresh abilities and iconic moves to the battlefield.

Includes:
• Character Pack 7: To be released around Q4 2025
- Lucci -CP0- + Costume
- New Playable Character + Costume
- New Playable Character + Costume
• Character Pack 8: Special Selection: To be released around Q1 2026
- Eneru
- King
- Z
• Shanks Additional Special Move "Divine Departure" (Character Pass 3 Bonus)

*The products in Character Pass 3 are also sold separately.
*Shanks Additional Special Move "Divine Departure" can be used by the playable characters Shanks or Shanks (Film: Red).

70070000029997.name: Waffle Kitty Picnic Pack
70070000029997.intro: Waffle Your Way to the Purrfect Picnic!
70070000029997.description:
Picnicking has never been more enjoyable! Just you and waffle decorating sounds like a perfect duo. This cozy puzzle challenges you to create the most delicious-looking waffles, but under one condition… everything has to fit!
Be careful though, with each level your skill progresses, but so does the challenge!


Key Features: 
- Over 90 yummy waffles to decorate!
- 29 ingredients to place.
- Lively soundtrack to boost your creativity as you prepare your waffles! 
- Master chef worthy quality ingredients.

This bundle includes Picnic Delight 1 DLC for extra tasty puzzles!

Some waffles may need more time to be assembled, but don’t worry if the first one isn’t perfect, just try again! Take as much time as you want.

Over 90 levels will keep you busy so get ready to spend some time on carefully selecting the best ingredients for the best waffle making. Grab the finest products and prepare to decorate in the tastiest atmosphere! 

Don’t wait and start garnishing the most awesome waffles the world has ever seen!

Just please try not to eat them midway through… Composure is the key!

70070000030012.name: Hentai Girls Bold Claw Pack
70070000030012.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000030012.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

HENTAI IS ART

A familiar anime art style of Hentai Girls brings you right into the lives of these young and beautiful women. Progress through the story by solving their respective puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

The gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging – increasing difficulty as you progress. Their lovely outfit might distract you... so maybe help them get rid of it? Every success on your part will make them happier.

In this bundle, you will have lots of fun with Cleaning Yui, Waiting Shirayuki, Playful Etsuko and Kitty Shirayuki.

Key Features:

- Hand-drawn Hentai art
- Relaxing music track
- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000030016.name: Hentai Girls Loyal Heart Edition
70070000030016.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000030016.description:

70070000030020.name: Hentai Girls Fiery Tail Collection
70070000030020.intro: Immerse yourself in the captivating world inhabited by Yui, Shirayuki, and Etsuko.
70070000030020.description:
These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch™ has to offer.

Key Features:
