- Simple gameplay mechanics
- Unique premise

70070000030031.name: Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Raft Power
70070000030031.intro: The ocean awaits — are you ready?
70070000030031.description:
Take control of your ocean survival experience by combining essential skills with upgraded raft construction.

Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor
 Stranded on a fragile raft with only a hook, gather resources, fend off predators, and transform your raft into a secure refuge. Survive alone or with friends against hunger, thirst, and sharks.

Building Materials Expansion DLC
 Upgrade your raft with stronger, more durable materials built to withstand rough seas and fierce predators.

Whether starting out or coming back, this bundle gives you everything to thrive—not just survive.

70070000030036.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Aviation Empire
70070000030036.intro: Boost your business, conquer the skies.
70070000030036.description:
Take command of the skies and build your cargo empire with this complete package! In Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Aviation Empire, inherit a small airline and transform it into a global logistics powerhouse. Fly a variety of aircraft, manage routes, upgrade hangars, and navigate dynamic weather across multiple airports worldwide.

This bundle includes:
	•	Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Rise to the heights of a professional pilot managing both your aircraft and business.
	•	Business  Expansion DLC – Start with the first hangar unlocked or receive $80,000 in in-game funds if you already own all hangars.

Get ready to take off faster and soar higher than ever before!

70070000030040.name: Spy Guy Memory Fantasy Edition
70070000030040.intro: Set of Memory game in with Fantasy DLC
70070000030040.description: Classic Memory game with fantasy style cards. 5 game modes, timer and record board. A game for everyone!

70070000030047.name: Run Sausage Run!: Crazy Edition
70070000030047.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000030047.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 3 new skins (Painter, Policeman and Prisoner)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000030052.name: Z Escape: Laser Edition
70070000030052.intro: Get to the chopper! Pick up the machine gun and destroy all of the zombies to save your crew!
70070000030052.description:
Your quest is simple... rescue as many survivors as you can by killing all the walking dead!

Features:
- Hordes of zombies
- Interactive surroundings
- Laser power up
- 3 new weapons
- New zombie and survivor epic skins
- 20000 additional coins to spend
- Levels with rewards and bigger zombies!
- Skins for zombies, survivors and helicopters
- Fun and addictive gameplay
- Lots of shooting!

Zombies run and climb on buildings very fast, so make sure to shoot quickly and precisely. If there are too many of them, use your surroundings - shoot at exploding barrels, destroy bridges, and glass roofs or just drop heavy building materials to stop the zombie horde! 

Rescue the survivors before they become infected! But beware, after each successful escape, the zombies will become even more challenging. You must apply your strategy in real-time and spot the right target to shoot in order to win!

If you believe that shooting zombies is not just a matter of luck, show your abilities and become the best helicopter sniper ever. Best of luck!

70070000030055.name: Subway Simulator – Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Pro Driver
70070000030055.intro: Become the ultimate master of the subway system.
70070000030055.description:
Master the tracks in four dynamic cities, operate a variety of trains, and unlock the power of the newest high-speed vehicle: the Metroliner Express. This bundle offers the ultimate subway driving experience, from the basics of train control to advanced routes and enhanced locomotive options.

Includes:
	•	Subway Simulator - Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games – Realistic subway driving in 4 cities, 5 trains, 100 levels
	•	Urban Speed DLC – A brand-new, high-speed train Metroliner Express with premium design and control

Take your subway journey to the next level — all aboard!

70070000030057.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree – Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000030057.description:
Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Digital Deluxe Edition contains: 

- Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Digital Version for Nintendo Switch™
- Curious Ottling & Nimble Doeling (Pet Followers)
- Shadowpyre & Gildcrest (Transmog Sets)
- Dark Ale Quest
- Original Soundtrack
- Digital Artbook

Slay your way in Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree, a dark fantasy action RPG. Battle monsters, craft powerful upgrades for your weapons and gear, and explore the secrets of this vast, ruined world.

DEFY YOUR FATE
You are an Inquisitor. As evil seeps into Faelduum through tears in reality, defy your purpose and embark on a path that leads to this world’s unraveling fate. From the towering majesty of Crimson City, through festering darkness, and into the horrors of Entropy... what will you become at journey’s end?

MASTER SOULSLIKE COMBAT
Choose from six unique Classes and wield blades and magic to master your craft in brutal battles. Dodge, parry, and strike with perfect timing to hunt vicious creatures and nightmarish bosses.

SUCCUMB TO A DARK FANTASY WORLD
Fall into a sinister tale with multiple endings written by Brian Mitsoda and hauntingly soundtracked by Christos Antoniou (Septicflesh) and the FILMharmonic Orchestra Prague. 60 quests and 75 unique locations await your discovery across this vast, interconnected world.

SLAY YOUR WAY
Create your Inquisitor and develop them through six Talent Trees. Hundreds of skill and combat upgrades are available, and you can also craft powerful weapons and gear to define your playstyle, die less, and deal death faster.

New to action RPG or Soulslike games? Tune the difficulty to your skill level in the settings.

70070000030058.name: Starter Pack Bundle: Seasons 5-9
70070000030058.description:
To celebrate Super Animal World’s upcoming launch later this year, we’re bringing back Starter Packs from previous seasons! This bundle includes 5 starter packs - totaling 5 Super Animal breeds, 10 cosmetics, and 3000 S.A.W. Tickets (premium currency used to purchase Super Animal Passes as well as premium cosmetic items from the SAW Shop).

This bundle includes:

Season 5 Starter Pack

- Super Marble Skullcat
- Zeus Outfit
- Lightning Bolt melee
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 6 Starter Pack

- Super Topiary Bear
- Cottagecore Dress
- Hedge Clippers melee
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 7 Starter Pack

- Super Alchemist Bengal Tiger
- Alchemist Outfit
- Potion melee
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 8 Starter Pack

- Super Cartoon Fennec Fox
- Cartoon Suspenders
- Ink Nib Pen melee
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 9 Starter Pack

- Super Kitsune Fox
- Miko Outfit
- Kitsune Scroll melee
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Neither animal breeds nor cosmetic items provide any gameplay advantage. Super Animal Royale Starter Packs are made available during their season, but could return in new ways in the future depending on community demand. If they do, they won’t ever be offered at a better value than their debut.

70070000030059.name: Ternox Games 4-in-1 Bundle
70070000030059.intro: Four indie games from Ternox: platformers, rhythm shoot'em'up, and dungeon roguelike.
70070000030059.description:
Taimumari: Complete Edition
A retro-style action platformer with magical girls, time travel, and fast-paced gameplay. Help Himari restore balance to the world with her trusty spells and acrobatics.

Bullet Beat
A rhythm-based shoot’em up where your every shot and explosion syncs with the music. Choose your soundtrack and blast your way through waves of enemies in this pulse-pounding arcade experience.

IN-VERT
A minimalistic yet mind-bending puzzle platformer. Swap between dimensions to guide a lonely robot through a glitchy world full of tricky logic and sharp platforming.

Nexoria: Dungeon Rogue Heroes
A brutal mix of dungeon crawling, turn-based combat, and card strategy. Lead your heroes through deadly procedurally-generated dungeons, where every move could be your last.

Whether you're seeking a nostalgic challenge or something fresh in a retro wrapper, the Ternox Classic Games Bundle is a great place to start.

70070000030073.name: TCG Card Market Simulator Ultimate
70070000030073.intro: Create a card shop as unique as your collection.
70070000030073.description:
Step into the shoes of a passionate card shop owner with TCG Card Market Simulator Ultimate, where your goal is to build the ultimate destination for trading card game fans. Manage your inventory by stocking the latest booster packs, set competitive prices, hire staff, and host exciting tournaments. Watch your business grow as you adapt to market trends and customer demands, turning your small shop into a thriving hub for collectors and players alike.

What you get in this bundle:
	•	TCG Card Market Simulator: Customize your shop layout, keep shelves neat, and highlight rare cards to create a seamless shopping experience.
	•	Exterior Customization DLC: Change the artwork on your store’s walls to give it a fresh and unique look.

Build a thriving card shop business, captivate your community, and showcase your unique style all in one complete package!

70070000030076.name: Deluxe Edition Upgrade Kit
70070000030076.intro: Upgrade to Double Dragon Revive Deluxe Editon!
70070000030076.description:
You will be able to access the following Double Dragon Revive Deluxe Edition contents:

①Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks (Digital Artbook and SOUNDTRACK)
②2 Additional Character Colors (Billy SPECIAL COLOR / Jimmy SPECIAL COLOR)

*Double Dragon Revive Digital Artworks is an individual application including both Digital Artbook and SOUNDTRACK.

70070000030077.name: Darts Fever Legendary Edition
70070000030077.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000030077.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game, Stylish Precision #1, Stylish Precision #2 and Stylish Precision #4 with:

15 brand-new dart designs

70070000030079.name: Neon On!: Lighting Edition
70070000030079.intro: Wanna see something amazing? Like, really electrifying? The ultimate neon puzzle game is here!
70070000030079.description:
Get your neon cables out of knots and connect them to the right light sources to create amazing neon masterpieces!

In Neon On, the colors are the key to each puzzle. Every box needs to be connected to the socket of the same color otherwise it won't work. Some boxes even require combining a couple of hues to create a different color!

Features:
- unlock 3 new boxes, 3 cables and 3 theme skins!
- solve puzzles by matching the colorful light sources to the correct boxes
- grab neon light cables by tips and connect the power 
- combine different hues to create entirely new colors
- connect the cables if the wire is too short, but be careful - the more you move them, the more they can get tangled!
- avoid pulling wires through laser walls - they will cut everything in half
- complete all stages of a level to light up a large animated neon sign!
- collect coins and buy skins for power boxes, cables, and themes

Challenge yourself to complete many levels where you will find various obstacles, from laser gates that can cut your cables to moving light sources or rotating boxes. Besides, be careful while moving the wires because they can easily get tangled, disconnected, and fall to the ground! 

Light up the cities with vibrant neon artworks!

70070000030082.name: Snooker Fever Legendary Edition
70070000030082.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000030082.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

15 new table designs and 10 sleek cue styles

70070000030095.name: Cooking Pizzeria Edition
70070000030095.intro: Run the tastiest pizzeria in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000030095.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant, and develop your cooking skills each day.

Become a master of crispiness and a virtuoso of stringy cheese – a true pizza maestro! Try your hand at making the perfect dough (we know it’s the key to success), learn the secrets of choosing the perfect ingredients, and achieve baking perfection with traditional and iconic pizza styles.

DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK… Your kitchen has all the equipment and ingredients needed to craft a pizza masterpiece. Follow each step from your to-do list, choose from many available ingredients, and add them based on the client’s wishes.

CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT Earn money from orders and customize your restaurant’s interior in Cooking. After each order, you’ll have enough to upgrade your equipment or buy new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants, and utensils.

Become a master of crafting the perfectly crispy pizza. Be precise, use the exact amount of ingredients, mix with passion, and follow each step with care to become a true Cooking master!

KEY FEATURES:

- Learn to make your own pizza – the perfect one!
- Upgrades to help you cook faster
- 32 unique ingredients that NEVER run out
- Tons of decorations to choose from
- Step-by-step recipes to reach crispy perfection

The bundle includes the base game, where you run your own sushi restaurant, and the pizzeria DLC.

70070000030097.name: Hentai Golf Picturesque Forest Edition
70070000030097.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70070000030097.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.

Get access to the new golf courses with Prairie Greens, River's Edge, Lakeside Fairways and Sunset Pines DLCs included in this bundle.

KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70070000030104.name: Pet Show: Wild Edition
70070000030104.intro: Draw a line to enclose the area and uncover the image underneath. Watch out for enemies who can catch you or cut your line!
70070000030104.description:
Take control of a brave little animal and uncover the adorable world hidden beneath the surface! 

Features:
• New Unique Levels - Complete 72 stages with 3 difficulty options each!
• New enemies and challenges to face!
• More Custom Looks – Choose your favorite from 12 playful animal avatars!
• Co-op Fun – Join forces with friends or family in local multiplayer!
• Tricky Enemies – Watch out for baddies that try to cut your line!
• Cute Pictures – Reveal a new animal picture in every level—can you find them all?

As you move, you draw a line behind you—close the shape to reveal a piece of the cute picture underneath. From fluffy kittens to curious piglets, each level holds a surprise waiting to be uncovered.

Be careful! Flying foes and sneaky bugs are ready to interrupt your progress. If they hit your line before you close it, you’ll lose a life! Outsmart them with clever tricks like screen-edge teleporting and speed boosts to stay in the game!

Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op mode to uncover the hidden image together!

Draw, dodge, and discover!

70070000030105.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Digital Deluxe Upgrade
70070000030105.intro: Upgrade to get bonus content for Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree!
70070000030105.description:
Upgrade Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree to get: 

- Curious Ottling & Nimble Doeling (Pet Followers)
- Shadowpyre & Gildcrest (Transmog Sets)
- Dark Ale Quest
- Original Soundtrack
- Digital Artbook

Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree for Nintendo Switch™ sold separately.

70070000030108.name: Fast Food 2025 Simulator: Business Tycoon
70070000030108.intro: Your fast-food empire just got a upgrade.
70070000030108.description:
Start your journey from a small food stand to a citywide fast-food empire in Fast Food 2025 Simulator. Manage your restaurant, cook delicious meals, serve customers, and grow your business with style and strategy.

This bundle includes:
	•	Fast Food 2025 Simulator - Cook, serve, and manage every aspect of your restaurant to satisfy customers and outshine the competition.
	•	Vehicle Upgrade DLC - Change your vehicle model directly in the parking lot to attract even more customers !

Whether you’re managing rush hour in the restaurant or switching up your vehicle to draw in crowds, this bundle gives you the full fast-food tycoon experience.

70070000030123.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Style Edition
70070000030123.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000030123.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #5 (Custom Cruisers #5):

Elevate your presence on the dirt tracks with five new, meticulously crafted skins that blend high-speed performance with eye-catching beauty. From sleek, futuristic designs to rugged, battle-ready appearances, each skin ensures your buggy stands out as you drift, jump, and race towards victory.

70070000030124.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.15
70070000030124.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the fifteenth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- World’s Finest Art: The World of Mythological Paintings
- Colorful Asia
- Colorful Sweets from Around the World
- [Moving] Beach

70070000030132.name: ESCAPE – BACKROOMS HORROR: Night Survival
70070000030132.intro: Master survival through shadows with a camera that never dies.
70070000030132.description:
Enter the endless maze — and now, see what was once hidden in the dark. Explore a twisted labyrinth of flickering lights, wet carpets, and unknown horrors — now with a night vision camera that never runs out of power. Even with light, the fear doesn’t fade.

Bundle includes:
	•	ESCAPE – BACKROOMS HORROR – A psychological survival horror game set in an ever-changing underground maze filled with disturbing creatures.
	•	Unlimited Camera Vision DLC – Adds a camcorder with unlimited night vision, giving you continuous visibility in the darkest corners of the Backrooms.

You’ve seen the shadows. Now face what hides inside them.

70070000030143.name: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution - Deluxe Edition
70070000030143.intro: Experience Shantae's long-lost adventure along with three stylish Deluxe Edition costumes!
70070000030143.description:
Shantae is back in an adventure 20 years in the making! The nefarious pirate Risky Boots has a “groundbreaking” new plan that will leave Sequin Land spinning — by rotating the continent, she can move any town right to the coast for easy plundering! As Shantae, turn the tectonic tables on Risky by taking control of the land itself: shift, twist, navigate, and explore by swapping between mix-and-match multilayered levels! Hair-whip and belly-dance your way through scrambled lands, misplaced towns, monster-filled crypts, and daunting labyrinths. Six creature transformations, fierce boss battles, and a 4-player versus mode await!

The Deluxe Edition of Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution adds three special bonus outfits that change Shantae’s appearance and boost her magical abilities: Sizzle Armor Costume (enhanced Fireball Power), Relic Hunter Costume  (enhanced Pike Ball Power), and High Voltage Costume (enhanced Storm Puff Power)!

Key Features:

• Discover the lost chapter of the Shantae saga, fully restored and released after 20 years!
• Fight and explore using your hair-whipping ability, magic items, and belly-dance transformations (including monkey, elephant, crab, and more)!
• Spin and shift Front Yard and Back Yard playfields to create new routes and solve puzzles!
• Visit towns, battle through labyrinths, purchase upgrades, find collectables, and meet with friends like Rottytops, Sky, and Bolo!
• For the first time ever in a Shantae game, four players can compete in Battle Mode!
• Deluxe Edition includes three bonus outfits: Sizzle Armor Costume, Relic Hunter Costume, and High Voltage Costume!

70070000030155.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Empire Builder
70070000030155.intro: Build your supermarket empire with style and smart management.
70070000030155.description:
Step into the world of supermarket management and experience the thrill of running your own grocery empire.
Design your store from the ground up, master inventory control, manage staff, and outsmart your competitors. Adapt to ever-changing market trends, launch marketing campaigns, and expand your business into a booming chain.

This bundle includes:
  Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Base Game
Build and manage your own supermarket from the ground up. Choose the layout, stock products, manage staff, and grow your retail empire.

  Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business — City Style Upgrade
Give your store a modern makeover with a black truck, vibrant orange sidewalks, and sleek dark roads—style your surroundings to stand out.

Whether you’re a budding entrepreneur or a seasoned tycoon, this bundle delivers hours of immersive gameplay and endless possibilities.
Ready to take charge and grow your business empire?

70070000030158.name: Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes Antique Edition
70070000030158.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70070000030158.description:
Handling a restaurant has never been easier. In Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes you can welcome customers and cook them the most delicious dishes they have ever tasted without breaking a sweat!


It’s high time you showed your culinary skills and prepared amazing meals for your guests who came to finally eat something tasty.

Mix the right ingredients, add a dash of creativity, and voilà, culinary magic right before your eyes! But remember to read the customers’ orders carefully, they can be picky.

Throughout your adventure you will be able to unluck more components and recipes, once you level up from receiving positive feedback from your customers.


What you can find inside your restaurant:
- 172 wonderful recipes.
- 24 unique ingredients.
- 4 different cooking options - blender, pan, pot, or oven

Unlock new decorations for your restaurant with Vintage Vibe DLC included in this bundle.

The hardest part of this job is not eating the dish before it comes out of the kitchen, they are that delightful!

Take your culinary tools and open the best restaurant in town right away!

70070000030159.name: Titi Drop: Complete Edition
70070000030159.intro: Merge the right way… and watch her smile.
70070000030159.description:
"Every move matters. Drop suggestive emojis and merge them to create bigger, juicier combos. It’s simple, keep it smooth, aim just right, and let things grow.

She’s watching — and the better you play, the more you’ll please her. Satisfy her with every perfect drop.

Features:
- 6 levels with unique shapes.
- A stunning woman to please.
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups.
- Beautiful backgrounds and relaxing music.

Can you handle the pressure?"

70070000030168.name: 4 in 1 Bundle
70070000030168.intro: Have fun with this 4-pack of incredible games.
70070000030168.description:
* Pure Chase 80's: is pure arcade, pure speed, pure adrenaline.

* Burn! SuperTrucks: It's a super truck simulator with the peculiarity that when you have an accident, it puts you back in time just before the crash.

* FootGoal! Tiki: Taka enjoys having table football in your living room.

* Sportitions'24: Fun sports for the whole family with a variety of the most extravagant athletes.

70070000030169.name: Prince of Persia™ - New Era Bundle
70070000030169.description:
Master platforming and combat in the Prince of Persia™ – New Era Bundle, featuring two must-play action platformers: the deep Metroidvania Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown and the thrilling roguelite The Rogue Prince of Persia™.

Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown
Dive into this critically acclaimed Metroidvania and play as Sargon, a warrior with the power to manipulate time and space. Explore a vibrant world inspired by Persian mythology, uncover the secrets of Mount Qaf, and embark on an epic quest filled with tight platforming, intense combat, and supernatural abilities.

The Rogue Prince of Persia™
In this challenging fast-paced roguelite, every death is a unique chance to rewrite fate, save Persia – or die trying. Master fluid, acrobatic combat and parkour as you explore your kingdom to right your wrongs!

70070000030178.name: Robinson Alchemy: Season 1
70070000030178.description: Enjoy several more locations to uncover and foods to cook!

70070000030179.name: Busy with holes
70070000030179.intro:
Two cozy digging adventures in one bundle!
Explore vibrant underground worlds solo or with friends.
Relax, dig deep, and collect rare dragons!
70070000030179.description:
This bundle includes two relaxing digging games where you explore colorful underground worlds and uncover hidden treasures.

In the single-player game, you'll dig deeper through vibrant layers of earth, find valuable ores, and upgrade your equipment. Discover rare dragons and mysterious secrets the deeper you go.

In the co-op version, team up with friends and enjoy a shared digging adventure. Work together to collect resources, enhance your tools, and find even more unique dragons.

Whether you play solo or with others, these cozy adventures are perfect for relaxing sessions full of discovery and charm.

70070000030181.name: Creepy person
70070000030181.intro:
Two very different horrors.
One is quiet, one is hunting.
Escape the street. Escape the house.
70070000030181.description:
This bundle includes two distinct psychological horror games where the world itself becomes your enemy.

In The Street 10, you're trapped in a never-ending Tokyo alley. There's no jump scares — only silence, dim lights, and a deep feeling that something is wrong. Watch the environment carefully. Small anomalies will guide you toward the hidden Exit 10. Numbers on the traffic light mark your progress. It's a walking simulator built on observation and paranoia — a liminal urban horror.

In Dissection, you wake up in a house with no memory of how you got there. Something terrible is stalking you. You’ll need to hide in closets, collect key items, and avoid the undead thing that wanders the halls. Escape is possible — if you’re smart and fast enough.

Together, these two games offer contrasting but deeply atmospheric horror experiences — one slow and creeping, the other fast and deadly.

70070000030188.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Season 1
70070000030188.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number + Landscapes 2

70070000030189.name: CybeRage: Thunder Edition
70070000030189.intro: Survive endless waves of alien creatures and crush the heart of the infestation!
70070000030189.description:
Phy embarks on a secret mission to an abandoned planet infested by a hostile hivemind. With the help of her partner Lizz and General Eral, she dives into the depths of the infestation and learns the dark truth behind its origins. Help her find the heart of the hive and put an end to this evergrowing threat.

Kill hordes of nasty bugs and use the experience gained to strengthen your arsenal and body with cybernetic enchantments. The hive will adapt and send more powerful enemies to stand in your way. Shoot them down with your army of drones, or slash them to pieces with your blade and stop the hivemind from growing even stronger!

Features:
- Engaging story: Accompany Phy in her quest against the hive
- Side stories: Explore a new metro line and discover unique locations
- Immersive world: Experience 24 hand-crafted cyberpunk levels
- High-tech arsenal: 11 fighter drones to upgrade and evolve
- Melee weapons: 6 powerful swords with unique active abilities
- Rogue-lite progression: Unlockable permanent augments
- Contracts: Complete tasks to earn credits

Will you help Phy defeat the hive and save the cyber age from impending doom?

70070000030191.name: Suzerain Expanded Edition
70070000030191.intro: The Expanded Edition includes the award-winning political drama Suzerain, and the Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia DLC.
70070000030191.description:
Suzerain
As President Rayne, lead the nation of Sordland in your first term of this text-based RPG. Navigate a political drama driven by conversations with your cabinet members. With looming war, rooted corruption, economic crisis and reform needed, the choices fall on your shoulders. How will you lead?

Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia
Embrace the crown as King Romus Toras, and lead the Golden Kingdom to a new era. Reclaim lost territories through diplomacy or force. Engage with noble houses and oversee the resources of Rizia. How will you reign?

70070000030192.name: Little Strays: Complete Edition
70070000030192.description:
Embark on a heartwarming adventure through quiet, less-traveled places and forgotten, abandoned corners of the city. Help a group of lovable stray cats in their search for food, safety, and a place to call home. Find lost kittens, uncover hidden routes, and enjoy a relaxing journey filled with charm and curiosity.

This version features extra content:
• Additional levels with new environments and fresh challenges.
• A variety of new cats to choose from, each with a unique coat color.
• New music tracks that add even more warmth and whimsy to your travels.

70070000030200.name: Marisa of Liartop Mountain Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000030200.description:
In addition to the main game, this bundle includes three bonus items:
- Marisa of Liartop Mountain: Digital Artwork & Sound Player, an application where you can enjoy the game’s art and music
- Marisa of Liartop Mountain: RD-Sounds Another BGM Pack Vol.1
- Marisa of Liartop Mountain: RD-Sounds Another BGM Pack Vol.2

The Digital Artwork & Sound Player is a Nintendo Switch™ application. Launch it to browse and enjoy the included content.

Note: A standard edition containing only the base game is also available. Please be careful not to purchase duplicates.

70070000030208.name: Coloring Book: Adventure Bundle - 90 drawings
70070000030208.description:
Coloring Book: Adventure Bundle is a version of Coloring Book with some additional content directly available:
● “Classic Tales” with 30 drawings divided in 6 themes: European Fairy tales, Stories of the American Indians, Pacific Myths, Winter Europe Tales, Oriental World.
● “Treasure Adventure” with 30 pictures of coloring adventures in mysterious places
● “Adventure Chapter” with 30 drawings divided into 5 unique boards: Creatures from outer space, Delicious looking desserts, Cute animals in the woods, Adorable dogs in the living room, Mighty cats in a fantasy world

70070000030216.name: Bridge Race: Silly Edition
70070000030216.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70070000030216.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

NEW VERSUS MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Compete with your friends in an exciting head-to-head split-screen showdown. Choose your custom color and unique skin, set the number of rounds, and let your building skills shine. Earn points each round based on your finish, and see who rises to the top of the leaderboard. Ready to show off your skills and claim victory? 

Features:
- 4 additional skins to show off your style!
- 10000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition—who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000030219.name: Maze: Path of Light - Forest Edition
70070000030219.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70070000030219.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths—experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

Features:
- 5 new constellations with 36 additional mazes
- Creative Level Design: Conquer 4 maze types - square, circular, triangular, and hexagonal
- 5 Unique Challenges: Classic, Portal, Token, Limited Moves, Timed and Dark Mazes!
- Power-ups: 3 helpful powers to help you find your way
- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70070000030221.name: Super Sucker: Clever Edition
70070000030221.intro: Suck it all in… then launch it like a maniac with a cannon!
70070000030221.description:
Get ready for action with a vacuum so strong, even the laws of physics are nervous. Suck up everything in sight - boxes, animals, enemies… basically, if it’s not bolted down, it’s going in!

But that’s just the beginning. At the end of each level, it’s payback time! Fire everything you’ve collected straight at bosses, towers, and anything unlucky enough to stand in your way. It’s not personal. It’s vacuum justice.

Features:
• 3 New Skins - Vacuums shaped like engine and other total mysteries. Is that one made of toxic waste? Maybe. Why not.
• Suck It All In - Enemies, crates... even elephants! This vacuum breaks records, physics, and probably warranty terms.
• Epic Boss Fights - Giant enemies. Flying objects. Extreme chaos. Maximum satisfaction.
• Smash Castles - No catapult? No problem. Your vacuum launches stuff like a pro.

Dodge obstacles, suck shiny gems, and unlock new vacuum styles that prove cleaning up can look cool too. The more you suck, the more fun it gets!

Nothing is safe from the Super Sucker! Seriously. Hide your stuff.

70070000030241.name: Musical Vibes RX: Total Vibes Vol. 1
70070000030241.intro: Get ready to move with Musical Vibes RX, a new dance game you can play using Joy-Con™ controllers or your smartphone camera connected to your Nintendo Switch™ console!
70070000030241.description:
Musical Vibes RX: Total Vibes Vol. 1 includes the base game Musical Vibes RX and three additional songs, all previously released and now offered together at a lower price than if purchased separately.

Musical Vibes RX is the new version of Musical Vibes—the first-ever dance game to let players use the camera of their smartphone connected to a console. Originally released in June 2023, the original broke new ground—and now RX takes the experience even further!

Dance Hands-Free with Incredible Moves!
Groove to fantastic music and master exciting new dance moves with full-body tracking powered by advanced AI technology. No controllers required when using your smartphone camera—just let your body move to the beat!

Track Your Progress 
Stay motivated with the built-in calorie counter that provides an estimated calorie burn during your game session.

Included Songs

"Platinum Dreams" by NARAE SOLIS — K-Pop

"Champion Sound (Remix)" by SIZZLA feat. TURBULENCE — Dancehall

"Noche de Brillo" by LINA RIKO — Reggaeton

"Embrace Your Light" by NINA RAY — Pop

"Party" by FIVEEBEATZ — Amapiano

"Victory Lap" by Cipher Blaze feat Lila Brooks — Hip Hop

"Queen Of The Night" by Elara Mae - K-Pop

"Lost and Found" by Lyra Rin - K-Pop

More tracks are planned for future updates! 

Multiplayer Fun
• Up to 4 players can join the fun with Joy-Con™ controllers.
• Up to 2 players can dance together using smartphone camera tracking.

Customize Your Experience
Personalize your avatar with fun outfits and choose from a variety of vibrant venues to match your style and mood!

Enhance Your Dance Floor
Own a Philips Hue smart lighting system? Connect it to transform your space into a dazzling concert venue with lights that react to the music!

More Than Dance
Feeling less energetic? Switch to Rhythm Game Mode, where you can press the correct direction on your controller in time with the beat—perfect for playing on the go!

Exciting Updates to Come!
Stay tuned for more tracks and features coming soon.

70070000030244.name: OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000030244.intro: Start from Zero in a Tale of Restoration and Retribution
70070000030244.description:
*This product is a bundle that includes OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0, released for Nintendo Switch™, and additional content pertaining to that title.
*This product can be played on both Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2, but there is also a separate version of OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 that can only be played on Nintendo Switch™ 2.
*This product is not compatible with the OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Digital Deluxe Upgrade released for Nintendo Switch™ 2.

This set is a bundle of the OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 base game, Deluxe Travel Provisions, and digital art book.

■ Contents of the Digital Deluxe Version
1. OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 Base Game

2. Deluxe Travel Provisions
▼ Action Skills
- Triple Strike Mastery
- SP Saver Mastery
- Extra JP Mastery
▼ Consumable Items: 8 Types of Nuts (M)
- Fortifying Nut (M)
- Magic Nut (M)
- Tough Nut (M)
- Resistant Nut (M)
- Light Nut (M)
- Critical Nut (M)
- Sharp Nut (M)
- Slippery Nut (M)
▼ Town Decorations: Festive Decoration Designs
- Table with Roasted Chicken
- Festive Arch
- Large Festive Arch
- Festive Flag
- Grand Vase

3. Digital Art Book

70070000030249.name: Stuff it! Candy Box Collection
70070000030249.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000030249.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!


What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

This bundle comes with the Kids' Playground, Livingroom Chaos and Sweet Tooth DLCs.

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?

70070000030255.name: Cottonville Runway Edition
70070000030255.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000030255.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

This bundle includes Halloween Outfits Pack and High Couture Outfits Pack DLCs with new additional looks waiting for you.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000030256.name: Spy Guy Croatia Edition
70070000030256.intro: Discover beautiful Croatia with Spy Guy!
70070000030256.description: Get caught up in the adventure and explore another map where we've hidden lots of objects in 120 levels.

70070000030267.name: Watermelon Party Paradise
70070000030267.intro:
Hit! Whack! Bam! It's watermelon-smashing time!
Play solo or with friends! Watermelon fun for everyone!
70070000030267.description:
Get ready for a watermelon-themed party game where the controls are simple and easy to learn!
Share Joy-Con™ and up to 6 players can join in the fun!
Have a party with friends and family, or play each game by yourself!

"Hit! Spin! Watermelon Party!" and "More Watermelon Paradise" are now available as a downloadable content bundle!

70070000030269.name: Demons Are Coming! - Hell Knight
70070000030269.description:
Expand your arsenal and gain a key advantage in the battle against the demonic invasion! This bundle introduces two valuable allies that add new layers of strategy and survivability. With more power and resilience at your side, you’ll be ready to send the demons back where they came from.

• The Blacksmith lets you upgrade your weapon mods before each fight, giving you a tactical edge from the start. Customize your loadout and unleash firepower tailored to your playstyle.
• The Armorer increases your durability by granting armor points, helping you endure the relentless waves of enemies.

70070000030273.name: Bowling Fever Summer Edition
70070000030273.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000030273.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #5 with:
-10 new bowling ball styles

70070000030278.name: Hentai Stars Rising Star Edition
70070000030278.intro: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.
70070000030278.description:
Get to know Ayame, Ran, and Tsubaki by completing puzzles and discovering their stories.

AMAZING ART

The art style of Hentai Stars brings you into the world of anime. Explore every story by solving puzzles and watch how the beautiful girls change. And don't worry, they will accompany you through the entire game. 

INCREASING DIFFICULTY

70070000030296.name: Simon the Sorcerer: Origins - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000030296.intro: A Deluxe Magical World experience like never before!
70070000030296.description:
In this deluxe version, Simon, the most sarcastic wizard in video game history, returns—and brings not only magic, but also style: Look forward to the official soundtrack and an enchanting art book full of imagery and curiosities!

A New Journey Begins! 

Thirty years after his first appearance on the screen, Simon is drawn into a foreign world by an ancient prophecy, that will tell his origins. This world is populated by powerful yet mostly useless wizards and strange creatures. On his journey, Simon must solve a series of tricky puzzles, operate alchemical devices, and learn powerful spells. And yes, he also has to taste a few disgusting stews! 

Puzzles, Magic, and Simon’s Humor 

Whether you're visiting the Magical World for the first time or returning once again – Simon is back, along with his unique sense of humor and a completely new graphic style. Simon the Sorcerer Origins brings the charm of the original saga back in a completely hand-drawn graphic style, blending classic gameplay mechanics with a fresh, new world of magic. 

Your Adventure, Your Puzzles 

Solve loads of tricky puzzles, test your wits, and face a variety of absurd situations and quirky characters. Combine items and clues to unravel the big mystery and become the legendary wizard you were always meant to be.   

Features:

- Official prequel to the cult series: Find out what Simon was up to just before his first magical misstep into the fantasy world, long before he started insulting talking doors. 

- A story with heart, humour, and a hat: Between motherly love, a forced move, and a healthy dose of chaos, Simon’s journey to becoming an (unwilling) hero begins. 

- Hand-drawn art style & iconic voice: Featuring lovingly hand-drawn graphics and Simon’s original voice, performed by British voice actor Chris Barrie, this feels like a trip back to the ’90s, just with far better resolution. 

- Between magic spells and cogs: Classic point-and-click gameplay meets modern mechanics. Solve quirky puzzles, crack ancient mechanisms, and collect (as always) way too many items. 

- Sarcasm, slapstick, and eccentric wizards: Encounter bizarre characters, delight in even odder conversations, and revel in Simon’s unmistakable wit: equal parts cheeky banter and “very British” humour. 

- Alchemy, magic & other mishaps: Tinker with spells, fiddle with alchemical contraptions, and dabble in questionable recipes. With a sprinkle of luck, the thing you were trying to do could very well happen.

History Artbook
Celebrate the brand new, magical comic art of Simon the Sorcerer Origins with this digital artbook and discover all the secrets behind the return of the most famous wizard in video game history!

Official Soundtrack
The complete soundtrack of Simon the Sorcerer Origins - more than 50 minutes of new and rearranged music from Simon the Sorcerer, by renowned composer Mason Fisher.

70070000030454.name: Shujinkou Deluxe Edition
70070000030454.intro: Become the main protagonist of this ambitious JRPG!
70070000030454.description:
The Shujinkou Deluxe Edition includes:
• Base Game - Shujinkou!
• Sabaku Arc - An enthralling story that takes place right after the end of the Genya Arc, featuring 100 new quests and a host of new friends and foes to encounter.
• Digital Artbook - Explore dozens of pages of concept art, sketches, and behind-the-scenes insights from six years of planning that brought Shujinkou to life!
• Select Soundtrack - Listen to 22 hand-selected songs from the Shujinkou Original Soundtrack on the go!

Learn one of the world's hardest languages as you help Shu, Jin, and Kou save Genya from language-devouring Akuma!

A retired samurai (主, Shu) is entrusted with saving his home from intelligent, language-devouring "Akuma" alongside an eccentric fox (人, Jin) freed from a cursed abode and an astute princess (公, Kou) with her own ambitions.
 
Shujinkou is a dungeon-crawler that offers a unique opportunity to learn Japanese as you play. In addition to being a full-fledged JRPG, it features thousands of Japanese words, phrases, kana, kanji, and grammar elements that players can master through focus, diligence, and consistency. The language content offers new knowledge for language learners of any level.
 
Learning Japanese is entirely optional. For those more interested in the adventure, Shujinkou delivers a rich role-playing experience:
• Explore challenging labyrinths and solve puzzles from a first-person perspective.
• Engage in strategic turn-based battles that evolve over time.
• Switch to “English-Only” mode at any time to focus solely on the gameplay experience.
• Master hundreds of Arawasu skills and uncover powerful items.
• Forge dozens of distinct weapons and armor, each with unique flavor text.
• Fish for a wide variety of marine creatures at various scenic spots.
• Complete 100 side quests that explore and expand upon the many inhabitants of Genya.
• Play six minigames hosted by members of the Fuu Lobby.
• Revisit your journey through the Art Gallery and Jukebox.

Having been in development for over six years, what truly sets Shujinkou apart is its additional, seamless integration of Japanese language learning. Whether you’re only here for the adventure or here to finally learn Japanese through a real video game, the ability to learn a challenging, real-world skill makes Shujinkou stand out in the already-crowded genre of amazing role-playing games.

NO GENERATIVE AI WAS USED IN THE PROCESS OF CREATING SHUJINKOU

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
All good things come to an end.

Relax in the world of Kemono Teatime, where animal ears are a normal part of everyday life. Here in Melodius, you can whip up whatever blends of tea you desire in your favorite cafe as you play through an adorable story. Come now and live out your bestest and cutest life—down to the last drop. Though, you do know that once it's run out, that's it, right? It'd do you best to learn that all good things come to an end.
Meet all the Kemomimis that come through the cafe and help them wind down, spend a cute and adorable time sipping on some tea, and come to terms with their ultimate fates.

[Here's one of our specialties!]
Create your own unique teas with our stock of 9 black teas, 15 herbs, and secret ingredients. Get to know the customers and make them something that they'll love while you immerse yourself in the wonderful sounds of the tea-making process.

[Let your ears enjoy the cute atmosphere too!]
De-stress with the cafe's ASMR, with all its sounds and effects recorded in binaural audio. The background music also changes with each customer, giving you unique experiences that come and go with each new soul you meet.

[All the staff and customers here are adorable Kemomimis!]
All the cafe staff and customers (except me) have animal ears! Please savor each encounter and goodbye while you can—I'm sure you'll have a very special and unforgettable time here with all the people you meet.

[The cafe will be open for three weeks only!]
You caught that, right? The shop's only running for a maximum of 21 days. What kind of people and stories will you get to know during this time? And is the cafe really shutting down after that? Why open up a limited-time cafe to begin with, anyway? The truth is up to you to uncover!

	•	GELENVAGEN Car DLC – Unlock the beast! Add the high-performance GELENVAGEN to your collection or get compensated in coins. Tackle new challenges, push your limits, and own the streets or off-road tracks.
	•	Millionaire’s Boost DLC – Receive a massive 1,000,000 coins! Unlock elite cars, rare upgrades, and get ahead of the competition faster than ever.
This bundle is your fast track to becoming a true street racing legend. Whether you’re drifting downtown, battling in online PvP, or customizing your dream car — it’s time to shift into top gear and leave everyone behind.

70070000030550.name: 6 in 1 Power Bundle Vol 2
70070000030550.intro: Enjoy 6 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!
70070000030550.description:
