-Pirates Pinball

70070000030551.name: Up Bundle
70070000030551.intro: Enjoy 3 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!
70070000030551.description:
This pack includes the games:

-Golf Up
-Ping Pong Up
-Darts Up

70070000030552.name: 4 in 1 Sports Bundle
70070000030552.intro: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!
70070000030552.description:
This pack includes the games:

- Speed Truck Racing
- 9-Ball Pocket
- Basketball Pinball
- Faster Than Bolt

70070000030558.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined Additional DLC Sets
70070000030558.intro: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
70070000030558.description:
A DLC set that will enhance your adventure, including additional contents, character costumes, and useful items for DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined.

[Contents]
・Additional DLC - The Road of Regal Wretches
・Additional DLC - Luminary's Livery
・Additional DLC - Jam-Packed Swag Bag
・White Wolf Costume  (Appearance changing costume for Ruff)

*This product does not include the base game of DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined.
*There is also a "Digital Deluxe Edition" that contains this product. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*Each additional DLC will also be available for individual purchase. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases.
*Some items in the additional DLCs can also be obtained by progressing in the game.
*To play The Road of Regal Wretches, you will need to progress in the game and unlock the battle arena.
*The Road of Regal Wretches can be accessed by talking to the She-Slime at the battle arena reception desk.
*Contents such as the costumes and items can be received from the "Claim Special Rewards" menu in the game.

70070000030571.name: Asphalt Legends - Praga R1 Max-Out Bundle
70070000030571.intro: Take control and dominate the circuit with the maxed-out Praga R1.
70070000030571.description:
Get a 4-star Praga R1 (the pack contains enough Blueprints to max out the car).

This pack contains:
- 128 Praga R1 BP
- 1,000,000 Credits

70070000030580.name: Chained Climb Together: Epic Climb
70070000030580.intro: Climb together and explore even further than before.
70070000030580.description:
Embark on an epic adventure where teamwork and precision are key. Scale towering mountains alongside your companions, navigating treacherous terrains and mastering realistic chain dynamics. With the new skybox, every ascent feels fresh and immersive, adding breathtaking vistas that heighten the thrill of your journey.
This bundle includes:
Chained Climb Together - An epic adventure where you and your companions, bound by mystical chains, must climb dangerous mountains.
Chained Climb Together: Skybound Environment - Transform your climbing experience with stunning new skies and atmospheric visuals.
Whether you climb solo or with friends, this collection offers the complete, ever-evolving challenge of conquering the heights together. Prepare yourself to climb higher, see farther, and conquer more than ever before.

70070000030585.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions - Arsenal of Honor
70070000030585.intro: Take command, upgrade your arsenal, win.
70070000030585.description:
Step into the shoes of an elite SWAT operative and face high-stakes hostage rescues and intense firefights where every decision counts.
Bundle Contents:
	•	Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions: Lead your team through tactical operations, breach enemy strongholds, and complete thrilling rescue missions.
	•	Advanced Scope DLC : Unlock the Sight 2 scope for Automatic Rifle III, providing enhanced accuracy, faster target acquisition, and superior control in all combat situations.
With this bundle, every mission becomes a chance to prove your courage and tactical skill. Take command, upgrade your arsenal, and lead your squad to victory.

70070000030592.name: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian - Atelier Season Pass
70070000030592.intro: Enjoy all of "The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian" with the season pass.
70070000030592.description:
All of the paid DLC at a better price than when purchased individually.

6 items including the season pass purchase bonus.

1) Season pass purchase bonus: "Alchemist of Memories" Costumes for Rias and Slade
One costume each for both Rias and Slade.

2) Gust Extra BGM Pack
A pack of "Atelier" series background music that can be used when changing the in-game BGM.

3) Additional Characters - Resna and Valeria
After a certain point in the story, Resna and Valeria from "Atelier Resleriana" will be added as party members with additional characters stories.

4) "Beginning of Summer Days" Costume Set
A set of new swimsuit costumes for Rias, Slade, Raze, Wilbell, Totori, and Sophie. (1 for each character, 6 total)

5) Recipe Expansion Pack "The Essence of Alchemy"
A pack of useful recipes for your adventure.

6) High-Difficulty Dungeon "Backwards-Ticking Clock Workshop"
After a certain point in the story, the high-difficulty dungeon will be added.

Note:
- Items 1 and 2 will release with the main game. Items 3-6 will be released by the end of January 2026.
- The name, details, and release date of each item are subject to change. Please check the official site for details.
- Costumes can be equipped after the main menu is unlocked by selecting "Combat Equipment" followed by "Change Costume."
- Recipes are available after synthesis has been unlocked, and BGM tracks can be used by selecting "Change BGM" on the save menu.
- Other requirements to use each item exist.
- Please be aware that other products include this content exist and that besides the set bonus these items can be purchased individually. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000030596.name: Treflix: All for Kids
70070000030596.intro: Set of educational games and comics for children
70070000030596.description: A set of safe and educational games and comics for children. Warm, pastel colors, calm music, and developmental games make this the perfect set for your child. In addition to four games, the set includes comics about emotions that teach children how to deal with them and what they mean!

70070000030598.name: Pets and Friends Butterflies Bundle
70070000030598.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of butterflies themed stickers.
70070000030598.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new butterflies themed stickers to add variety to your album.

70070000030607.name: Everdream Valley - Farm & Family Pack
70070000030607.intro: Grow, explore, and make memories in the full Everdream Valley experience.
70070000030607.description:
Grow, explore, and make lasting memories with the complete Everdream Valley experience. The Farm & Family Pack includes the full base game and the Family Time DLC, adding new story quests, characters, fun mini-games, and expanded customization options. Build your dream farm by day, experience magical adventures by night - and help your whole family feel at home in the valley.

Everdream Valley – The Game
A farming adventure with a dash of magic. Play solo or up to a 4-player coop. By day, restore your quaint farm into a summer paradise. Explore, raise crops, care for animals and rebuild your home. At night, inhabit various creatures through your dreams and bring enchantment to the valley.

Everdream Valley: Family Time DLC
Celebrate the warmth of family and community in the Family Time DLC. Dive into new stories, meet new characters, and help your parents and grandparents turn their valley homes into cozy dream spaces.

Here’s what's in it:
- Grandparents’ House: A new major project awaits!
- New Story Quests: Heartfelt stories and fresh challenges.
- New NPCs: Your Mom and Dad have joined the fun!
- New Animals: Including adorable rabbits, colorful birds, insects, and quirky ducks.
- New Plants & Furniture: Over 30 new decorative options.
- New Mini-Games: Five fresh activities to enjoy.
- Planting Upgrade: Place plants outside of garden beds for even more customization!

Don’t wait, get Everdream Valley - Farm & Family Pack NOW for the best Everdream Valley experience on console!

70070000030613.name: Sky Games Gold Edition
70070000030613.intro: Join the ultimate intergalactic party… are you ready to take off?
70070000030613.description:
Put on your gloves, stun your rivals, grab the balloons and soar to victory while leaving everyone else behind!

This bundle includes “14,000 in-game currency” to unlock all characters — and much more!

Features:
★ Party game for up to 4 players
★ Challenging single-player mode
★ 20 unique maps with varying difficulty levels
★ Randomly generated stages for endless variety
★ Extra modes such as “eliminate the weakest player”
★ Fun, customizable characters with nearly 100 unlockable visual add-ons
★ Global leaderboards to compete with players worldwide
★ Hidden power-ups to make matches even more competitive
… and more!

70070000030616.name: Truck Driver - Gold Edition
70070000030616.intro: Get the ultimate trucking experience with Truck Driver® Gold Edition!
70070000030616.description:
This definitive edition includes the Truck Driver base game, the Heading North DLC, additional paint jobs inspired by the USA, UK, Germany, and France, and the Hidden Places & Damage System DLC.

Hit the road with the best version of Truck Driver yet!
 
Truck Driver:
After inheriting a truck from your father, it’s time to hit the road and build your career in the trucking world. Take on jobs from a variety of clients, haul cargo across scenic routes, and customize your truck to match your style.
 
Heading North:
Expand your Truck Driver journey with the Heading North DLC! Uncle Karl challenges you to take your career to the rural region of Mangefjell. Explore fresh locations, work with new clients, and unlock exciting trucking opportunities across a beautiful Nordic-inspired landscape.

70070000030624.name: Class of Heroes: The Ultimate Trilogy
70070000030624.description:
Not one, not two, but three!

The Class of Heroes series returns for a new generation. Experience both the original Anniversary Edition, 2GR, and now even the third addition in the series, remastered and ready for your enjoyment!

Live the life of a student thrice as you crawl through endless dungeons, build your perfect cohort of students, take on hordes of enemies, in this dungeon crawler extraordinaire bundle which includes all the currently available Western releases in the series!

Build your perfect roster and handpick out your ideal party of 6 students to storm the labyrinths. Mix and match from 10 races and 18 classes, each with their own unique skill sets. Crawl through over 100 labyrinth maps facing over 250 potential enemies. Don’t forget to collect artefacts, explore inter-dimensional travel and conquer adversity. You determine the standard you thrive at, take note of recipes for weapons, potions, and any upgrades necessary.

Groups of excited students will walk through the doors of the Academies to learn the tools of the trade and leave as the next Class of Heroes!

Do you have what it takes?

70070000030625.name: Hole io: Egypt Edition
70070000030625.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the universe!
70070000030625.description:
Choose your favourite skin, eat, grow and stay alive!
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Features:
- 7 maps with different things to swallow 
- 20 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning  during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000030627.name: Mars Survivor: Action Edition
70070000030627.intro: Conquer Mars, fend off alien threats, and secure your path to survival!
70070000030627.description:
After an asteroid catastrophe, your rocket ship crash-lands in the wilderness of Mars. Explore the planet's mysteries, strategize your escape, and build a shelter to protect yourself!

Features:
- Get a premium supply crate with a set of tharsis armor, a deimos smg and lots of scraps, and materials!
- Use additional 500 gems
- Navigate Mars's challenges
- Explore the planet's secrets and discover hidden materials 
- Build a shelter and protect yourself from the harsh Martian environment!
- Defend against alien invasions and uncover secrets of the creatures of Mars!
- Gather oxygen and essential materials from old rocket ships to survive
- Strategize your escape mission and secure your passage back to Earth!
- Open epic loot boxes to swap or upgrade your gear

Go on dangerous expeditions to gather intel and resources. Fight off hordes of alien creatures, and save other survivors. Use their skills and knowledge to defend your base from a huge enemy attack!

Become the last man standing on Mars, navigate through the wilderness, and prove your survival skills!

70070000030630.name: Pet Show: Sea Edition
70070000030630.intro: Draw a line to enclose the area and uncover the image underneath. Watch out for enemies who can catch you or cut your line!
70070000030630.description:
Take control of a brave little animal and uncover the adorable world hidden beneath the surface! 

Features:
• New Unique Levels - Complete 72 stages with 3 difficulty options each!
• New water current mechanic!
• More Custom Looks – Choose your favorite from 12 playful animal avatars!
• Co-op Fun – Join forces with friends or family in local multiplayer!
• Tricky Enemies – Watch out for baddies that try to cut your line!
• Cute Pictures – Reveal a new animal picture in every level—can you find them all?

As you move, you draw a line behind you—close the shape to reveal a piece of the cute picture underneath. From fluffy kittens to curious piglets, each level holds a surprise waiting to be uncovered.

Be careful! Flying foes and sneaky bugs are ready to interrupt your progress. If they hit your line before you close it, you’ll lose a life! Outsmart them with clever tricks like screen-edge teleporting and speed boosts to stay in the game!

Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op mode to uncover the hidden image together!

Draw, dodge, and discover!

70070000030635.name: Bowling Fever Advanced Edition
70070000030635.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000030635.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #5 with:

-20 new bowling ball styles

70070000030636.name: Colorizing: Collection 1
70070000030636.intro: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation
70070000030636.description:
This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages. 
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

70070000030637.name: Family Bundle
70070000030637.intro: Roguelike, Match 3 and jigsaw puzzles! Fun for the whole family. No In-App-Purchases, all content included!
70070000030637.description:
Halftime Heroes
-Halftime Heroes is a Survival Rogue Action RPG where you fight monsters, defeat bosses, obtain loot and spend gold increasing your skills!

Ice Princess Crystals
-Solve 100 levels in this match 3 game with a beautiful princess in a magical ice world

Jigsaw Pets
-Solve 45 beautiful puzzles of pets including dogs, cats, horses and some magical friends

70070000030651.name: My Cozy Room Barista Edition
70070000030651.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000030651.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic, Easter, Summer, Rock, Halloween, Dogs, Cottagecore, Mediterranean and Coffee DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000030668.name: Cottonville Summer Collection
70070000030668.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000030668.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

This bundle includes Halloween Outfits Pack, High Couture Outfits Pack and Holidays Outfits Pack DLCs with new additional looks waiting for you.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000030672.name: TY the Tasmanian Tiger®: Bush Rescue™ Bundle
70070000030672.intro: Save on the TY the Tasmanian Tiger series when you purchase the bundle!
70070000030672.description:
Revisit the TY the Tasmanian Tiger® games on the Nintendo Switch™ systems!

Are you ready to explore the wilds of the Australian Outback in this remastered version of the classic character platformer, TY the Tasmanian Tiger?  TY the Tasmanian Tiger 2: Bush Rescue™  features more rangs, more vehicles, more mechs, and more EVERYTHING... in an open world Aussie Adventure. Explore a ripper new side of TY with the comic-style side scrolling adventure, TY the Tasmanian Tiger 4: Bush Rescue Returns™!

70070000030674.name: Puzzle Adventures Bundle - 4 in 1
70070000030674.intro: Easy to use puzzles for toddlers and kids. Featuring funny and cute motifs of animals and more. 100% frustration free and child-safe.
70070000030674.description:
This bundle contains the following four puzzle games with a t otal of 120 unique puzzles:

Puzzle Adventures - Forest Animals
Puzzle Adventures - Sea Animals
Puzzle Adventures - Farm Animals
Puzzle Adventures - Serve Dishes

70070000030675.name: Starter Pack Bundle: Seasons 0-4
70070000030675.description:
To celebrate Super Animal World’s upcoming launch later this year, we’re bringing back Starter Packs from previous seasons! This bundle includes 5 starter packs - totaling 5 Super Animal breeds, 10 cosmetics, and 3000 S.A.W. Tickets (premium currency used to purchase Super Animal Passes as well as premium cosmetic items from the SAW Shop).

This bundle includes:

Season 0 Starter Pack

- Super Twilight Fennec
- Twilight Newsboy Cap
- Twilight Overalls
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 1 Starter Pack

- Super Warrior Skullcat
- Warrior Outfit
- Macuahuitl Melee Weapon 
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 2 Starter Pack

- Super Moon Bear
- Warrior Monk Outfit 
- Warrior Monk Sword 
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 3 Starter Pack

- Super White Bengal Tiger
- Roman Armor
- Gladius 
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Season 4 Starter Pack

- Super Platinum Fox
- Ninja Outfit
- Sai
- 600 S.A.W. Tickets

Neither animal breeds nor cosmetic items provide any gameplay advantage. Super Animal Royale Starter Packs are made available during their season, but could return in new ways in the future depending on community demand. If they do, they won’t ever be offered at a better value than their debut.

70070000030695.name: Maze: Path of Light - Wild Edition
70070000030695.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70070000030695.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths—experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

Features:
- 5 new constellations with 36 additional mazes
- Creative Level Design: Conquer 4 maze types - square, circular, triangular, and hexagonal
- 5 Unique Challenges: Classic, Portal, Token, Limited Moves, Timed and Dark Mazes!
- Power-ups: 3 helpful powers to help you find your way
- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70070000030702.name: Run Sausage Run!: Bones Edition
70070000030702.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000030702.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 3 new skins (Brain Monster, Eye Monster, Xray Monster)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000030707.name: Super Sucker: Crazy Edition
70070000030707.intro: Suck it all in… then launch it like a maniac with a cannon!
70070000030707.description:
Get ready for action with a vacuum so strong, even the laws of physics are nervous. Suck up everything in sight - boxes, animals, enemies… basically, if it’s not bolted down, it’s going in!

But that’s just the beginning. At the end of each level, it’s payback time! Fire everything you’ve collected straight at bosses, towers, and anything unlucky enough to stand in your way. It’s not personal. It’s vacuum justice.

Features:
• 3 New Skins - Vacuums shaped like cash register, firehose, flowerpot and other total mysteries. Is that one made of toxic waste? Maybe. Why not.
• Suck It All In - Enemies, crates... even elephants! This vacuum breaks records, physics, and probably warranty terms.
• Epic Boss Fights - Giant enemies. Flying objects. Extreme chaos. Maximum satisfaction.
• Smash Castles - No catapult? No problem. Your vacuum launches stuff like a pro.

Dodge obstacles, suck shiny gems, and unlock new vacuum styles that prove cleaning up can look cool too. The more you suck, the more fun it gets!

Nothing is safe from the Super Sucker! Seriously. Hide your stuff.

70070000030711.name: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC - Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set
70070000030711.intro: Adventure is back on the menu in PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!
70070000030711.description:
Grants the Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set for PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!

Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set includes:
- 3 Collab Stages
- 1 Collab Costume
- 20 Collab Figures
• Collaboration Set Bonus: Legendary PAC-LAND Costume

*This content is also included in the Deluxe Edition. Please take care not to make duplicate purchases.

70070000030717.name: Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes Halloween Pack
70070000030717.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70070000030717.description:
Handling a restaurant has never been easier. In Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes you can welcome customers and cook them the most delicious dishes they have ever tasted without breaking a sweat!


It’s high time you showed your culinary skills and prepared amazing meals for your guests who came to finally eat something tasty.

Mix the right ingredients, add a dash of creativity, and voilà, culinary magic right before your eyes! But remember to read the customers’ orders carefully, they can be picky.

Throughout your adventure you will be able to unluck more components and recipes, once you level up from receiving positive feedback from your customers.


What you can find inside your restaurant:
- 172 wonderful recipes.
- 24 unique ingredients.
- 4 different cooking options - blender, pan, pot, or oven

Unlock new decorations for your restaurant with Vintage Vibe and Spooky Season DLCs included in this bundle.

The hardest part of this job is not eating the dish before it comes out of the kitchen, they are that delightful!

Take your culinary tools and open the best restaurant in town right away!

70070000030724.name: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter Season Pass
70070000030724.description:
Unlock a treasure trove of additional content for Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter with the Season Pass! Scheduled content is as follows:

【9/19/2025 Release】9 Items
Fine Red Diner Costume Set Vol. 1
Original Diner Costume Set Vol. 1
Glasses Set A
Pom Pom Pal Set A
Archangel Dress-up Set
Exciting Effect set
Banner Set A
Two Tone Hair Color Set
Orbment Cover Set

【9/25/2025 Release】10 Items
Jenis Royal Academy Uniform Set
Fine Red Diner Costume Set Vol. 2
Original Diner Costume Set Vol. 2
Glasses Set B
Pom Pom Pal Set B
Charming Backpack Set
Fallen Angel Dress-up Set
Banner Set B
Unique Hair Color Set
Chibi Orbment Cover Set

【10/2/2025 Release】7 Items
Resort Style Swimsuits (Estelle & Joshua)
Fine Red Diner Costume Set Vol. 3
Original Diner Costume Set Vol. 3
Trendy Headgear Set
Character Stand Set
Demon King Dress-up Set
Banner Set C

※All content included within the season pass, including items and descriptions included within, is subject to change without prior notice. 
※All content included in the Season Pass will also be sold separately as purchasable DLC upon each piece of content’s release. Content will be purchasable as DLC the same day it’s released in the season pass. In addition, any special edition bonuses or preorder bonuses are not included in the Season Pass.
※The main game Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter is necessary to use this content. In the event the latest patch is necessary, please update the game first and then make use of the content.

70070000030735.name: Demons Are Coming! - Final Strike
70070000030735.intro: Battle to reclaim your homeland from a relentless demonic invasion with additional 60 powerful weapon upgrades at your disposal!
70070000030735.description:
Battle to reclaim your homeland from a relentless demonic invasion in this fast-paced action roguelike. Wield two fully customizable weapons, master precise parries, and tear through destructible environments as you adapt to ever-changing, procedurally generated battlefields. With countless upgrade combinations and local co-op support, every run delivers fresh challenges and hours of replayable action.

Get ready for 60 weapon mod variations to supercharge your fight against the demonic horde! The arsenal expands with 20 unique weapon mods, each featuring 3 upgrade tiers, giving you more ways than ever to customize your loadout. Experiment with new builds, discover fresh strategies every time you play, and destroy every enemy that stands in your way.

70070000030739.name: TMNT: Splintered Fate Heroes Bundle
70070000030739.intro: Pick up the collection of base game and two epic character DLCs together to make a bodacious saving!
70070000030739.description:
Unleash the Turtles and their friends in a quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan!

In Splintered Fate, brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay on both Campaign and Arcade modes. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

This bundle includes two action-packed DLCs loaded with extra content, playable in both Campaign and Arcade modes:
CASEY JONES & THE JUNKYARD JAM
- New playable character: Casey Jones
- New level: The Junkyard

70070000030746.name: Double Dragon Revive Deluxe Edition
70070000030746.intro: The world-famous Double Dragon roars back to life!
70070000030746.description:

【Double Dragon Revive】
The Double Dragon series has defined the beat 'em up action genre ever since it hit the arcades in 1987.
Now it returns as Double Dragon Revive, thanks to the passionate support of retro game fans over the years!

1. Renewed, stylish character designs!
   See your favorites characters from the golden age of arcades recreated in modern 3D graphics.
   Powerful foes from their past return to face off against the Lee brothers.

2. The ultimate beat 'em up action experience!
   Defeat your foes in a genre staple side scrolling style. 
   Experience the same simple and intuitive gameplay as past entries, but with fresh controls, balance refined and balanced by Arc System Works fighting game expert developers. 
   
3. Thrilling, strategic action!
  More than a simple button-masher, the combat system offers many offensive and defensive options to adapt to your play style!   
  Learn enemy patterns and find the most effective strategies to deal with each of them!
  Use weapons and make the most of the gimmicks scattered through the stages  to seize the upperhand in battle!

70070000030770.name: Super Mario Galaxy™ + Super Mario Galaxy™ 2
70070000030770.intro: Journey through space in two Super Mario adventures, now improved for the Nintendo Switch™ system!
70070000030770.description:
Travel the cosmos with Mario in these two classic games—now with enhanced resolution, improved UI, and additional content on Nintendo Switch!  

Use button, stick, and motion controls—adapted to the Joy-Con™ controllers from the original Wii™ versions—to jump, glide, swing, and more as you collect Power Stars and power-ups. Learn more about the Lumas from additional Storybook chapters, and groove to all the game’s music, including a few additional tracks, in soundtrack mode. You can also give yourself additional Health and fall recovery with Assist Mode and use compatible amiibo™ figures* for a little extra help in your adventure. The galaxy awaits!  

Save** on the Super Mario Galaxy™ and Super Mario Galaxy™  2 games  when you purchase the bundle!

Save the galaxy from Bowser and his minions in the original planet-hopping adventure 

Bowser has attacked the Star Festival, abducted Princess Peach, and put the whole galaxy in danger! Join up with Rosalina and the Lumas, protectors of the cosmos, to restore the Comet Observatory and rescue the princess in the Super Mario Galaxy™ game. Use power-ups like the Bee Mushroom to fly, the Boo Mushroom to float and move through certain types of barriers, and more on your journey to reclaim the Power Stars!

Travel aboard Starship Mario to save the galaxy again…this time with Yoshi’s help! 

Bowser is at it again, but this time Mario has a little extra help in recovering the Power Stars. Join Lubba aboard Starship Mario for the duration of your journey, and team up with Yoshi to enhance your planet-hopping moves in the Super Mario Galaxy™ 2 game.  With Yoshi by your side, you can jump higher and further—and you can even attack foes using his tongue! Yoshi has his own power-ups too, like the Dash Pepper and the Blimp Fruit, which allow him to sprint super quickly, float Mario high into the air, and more.

Download the free update for improved visuals and mouse controls on the Nintendo Switch 2 system

Enhance your adventure even further with a free update to take advantage of the processing power of Nintendo Switch 2 features! This update brings visuals in 4K resolution*** and allows a second player to use mouse controls for collecting Star Bits and attacking enemies.

70070000030771.name: Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC
70070000030771.intro: Venture into Hyperspace Lumiose for the next chapter of your adventure!
70070000030771.description:
Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a place known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the Mythical Pokémon Hoopa has the power to transform them into portals so you can travel there! Hoopa needs your help to do it, though: team up with the mysterious and talented baker, Ansha, to gather Berries and make donuts that will awaken Hoopa’s power and grant you and your Pokémon a variety of useful effects. 

Once you’re in Hyperspace Lumiose, join the Mega Evolution successor, Korrina, and Team MZ to investigate its mysteries. Just be sure you’re ready—this otherworldly version of Lumiose City can be a threatening place. The Pokémon here are different, and sometimes rare, with hyperspace levels that can make their total levels exceed the normal limit of 100.

It looks like your story with Team MZ isn’t over yet—continue your journey in Hyperspace Lumiose after completing the main game!

Encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions

As you progress through the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC*, you may encounter more newly-discovered Mega Evolutions, such as two additional ones for Raichu—Mega Raichu X and Mega Raichu Y—as well as Mega Chimecho and Mega Baxcalibur!

Customize your character’s in-game outfit with Holo-X and Holo-Y apparel items

Upon purchasing this DLC, you can claim these Holo-X and Holo-Y in-game apparel items and wear them even during your journey through the main game. Once you unlock the ability to adjust your character’s looks and outfit—about an hour into the main story—you can claim these apparel items by pressing the X Button to open the main menu, and then pressing the − Button to access the Outfit & Looks menu.

The following DLC is included in this purchase:

• Holo-X and Holo-Y apparel items: Available October 16th, 2025
• Additional story content: Available December 10th, 2025

70070000030778.name: Fast Food 2025 Simulator & MYSIDE REALITY
70070000030778.intro: Step into two worlds of unforgettable adventure.
70070000030778.description:
Dive into two completely different yet equally captivating adventures with Fast Food 2025 Simulator and MYSIDE REALITY. Whether you crave a mysterious, mind-bending journey or the thrill of running a fast-paced business, this bundle has it all.

In Fast Food 2025 Simulator, the stakes are different but just as high. Start from a humble food stand and grow into a global fast-food empire. Cook mouthwatering meals, manage your staff, upgrade your kitchen, and dominate the industry with futuristic tools and smart strategies.

In MYSIDE REALITY, you find yourself trapped inside your favorite game, face-to-face with the enigmatic Mira. Every conversation, puzzle, and choice leads you closer to uncovering her true intentions — and the secret of this strange world. Will you find your way home, or lose yourself in the illusion?

From unraveling dark mysteries to sizzling burgers at lightning speed — this bundle offers the best of both worlds.

70070000030779.name: Squirrel Madness & Silent Mist
70070000030779.intro: Two different worlds, one ultimate fight for survival.
70070000030779.description:
Plunge into two unique survival experiences that test your courage in completely different worlds.

 Squirrel Madness – Defend a magical tree that grew from a legendary acorn in the middle of a bustling city. Armed with nut blasters, pinecone crossbows, and your unbreakable determination, face endless waves of animal control squads, machines, and city forces determined to bring down your home. Can you protect nature’s last beacon of hope?

 Silent Mist – Step into a forgotten, mist-covered world where fear and uncertainty lurk in every shadow. Your only weapons are your instincts, scarce resources, and the will to uncover the truth hidden deep within the fog. Not all dangers can be seen… and not all memories should be remembered.

From high-octane action to psychological horror, this bundle brings you:
- Two games with contrasting worlds and unique survival challenges.
- An unforgettable mix of intense combat and nerve-racking stealth.
- Stories that pit you against forces both seen and unseen.

Will you fight to protect the light of life, or survive the darkness of fear?
This bundle lets you do both.

70070000030788.name: Bowling Fever Road to 300
70070000030788.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000030788.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #5 with:

-40 new bowling ball styles

70070000030790.name: Railway Empire 2 - High Voltage Edition
70070000030790.description:
The Railway Empire 2 – High Voltage Edition includes:
•	Railway Empire 2 – Nintendo Switch™ Edition
•	Railway Empire 2 – High Voltage DLC

All aboard the express train to riches and fame in Railway Empire 2! Don the coat of a clever entrepreneur, take over a small railway company in the early 1800s and turn your steam engines into the workhorses of the economy. Grow your company into the largest railway company of the continent and outsmart your competitors as you connect cities and companies with an ever-expanding network of rail lines, bridges, and tunnels. 60 famous locomotives are at your disposal, all pulling freight and passenger cars as they usher in an era of historic importance during the Industrial Revolution.

Railway Empire 2 features bigger, more detailed and lively maps than ever before, focusing on iconic regions of the USA and Europe. Improved track construction helps you focus on the important decisions as you drive the economy and help the growth of the cities. Signals are placed automatically, bridges can hold more than 4 tracks and the expandable train stations can now have up to 8 tracks.

Choose from 6 different characters to lead your railway company, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Play the 5-chapter campaign or choose from any of the 14 different scenarios. Set your own difficulty in the fully customisable Free Play mode or build the perfect rail network in construction mode. You can also board one of your trains and gaze upon the scenery passing by as the iron horse speeds along the tracks as you enjoy the view from on top of your locomotive.

The Nintendo Switch™ Edition includes the full Railway Empire 2 game, the original soundtrack, exclusive skins for each of the three sizes of your railway stations, an exclusive skin for your company HQ, and an exclusive skin for two locomotives.


•	History in the making: In 1830 at the dawn of the age of railways, build a grand railway empire from scratch and choose from 60 detailed, historic locomotives that you can customize with your preferred colors and company initials.

•	A sprawling landscape: The huge and detailed game world covers iconic areas of the USA and Europe in more detailed regional maps, just waiting to be connected to your rail network.

•	Endless Possibilities: Choose how you want to play from the 5-chapter campaign set across iconic regions of Europe and the US, 14 scenarios, the customizable free play mode and the relaxing construction mode.

•	Improved track construction: Laying tracks is easier than ever with automatically placed signals, bridges that can hold more than 4 tracks, train stations with up to 8 tracks and new train station attachments to customize your stations. The land also adapts to your track layout as your tracks cross mountains, valleys and plains.

•	Enjoy the view: Ride along on top of your locomotive and see the landscape rush by.

70070000030792.name: Dungeons 4 - High Noon Edition
70070000030792.intro: Follow the Evil Way and foster the return of the Absolute Evil!
70070000030792.description:
The Dungeons 4 – High Noon Edition includes:
•	Dungeons 4 – Nintendo Switch™ Edition
•	Dungeons 4 – The Good, the Bad and the Evil DLC

Follow the Evil Way! The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more.

Build a cozy and comfortable Dungeon to suit your creatures’ needs and rule over them, then send them out into the Overworld to kindly remind the good people living there that the Absolute Evil rules. Gather your Evilness in new and dynamic ways and unleash it upon the lush green forests and plains of the Overworld to turn them over to the dark side. But make sure that your Dungeon is well-secured by traps and defended by your creatures, for those pesky heroes won’t just twiddle their thumbs while you turn their land into the Absolute Evil’s most pleasurable holiday paradise. 

But what is that noise? “Gold, gold, gold and gems, gold and gems and gold!” The ancient song echoes throughout the underworld, accompanied by the clanging steel of hammers and axes. The Dwarves have arrived to claim their share of the abundant resources and, together with the Elves and Humans of the Overworld, they send out raiding parties to find the Dungeon’s heart.

Dungeons 4 –  Nintendo Switch™  Edition delivers you from Good, featuring an exclusive “Princess” outfit for Thalya, a new outfit option for the Little Snots and a unique skin for your throne room, as well as the 'deluxe package' including the ‘Storming of Dollaran’ map, skins for Thalya and the Evil Hand, the official soundtrack and the digital artbook.

•	Follow the Evil Way: Dungeons 4 –  Nintendo Switch™ Edition features 20 fully-voiced (toss a coin to your Narrator) and deliciously evil missions, and several skirmish maps for those seeking a challenge. 

•	Change the world: Set up your evil home base on vast Underworld maps and prepare to spread your Evilness across the huge Overworld, turning the lush environments over to the dark side.

•	Everything is better with Dwarves™: The Dwarves have arrived to build their underground strongholds, these hardy little fellows compete with the Ever-Expanding Evil for space and resources.

•	The Multi-Faceted Evil: Thalya’s perk system places impressive new powers in her impatient hands. 

•	Work together, slay together: 2-player co-op multiplayer with both players managing one Dungeon together. All maps from the skirmish mode and the campaign are playable in co-op.

•	Extra Evil: The Dungeons 4 – Nintendo Switch Edition comes with an exclusive “Princess” outfit for Thalya, new skins for the Little Snots and your throne room, as well as the 'deluxe package' including the ‘Storming of Dollaran’ map, skins for Thalya and the Evil Hand, the official soundtrack and the digital artbook.

70070000030793.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Infinite Edition
70070000030793.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000030793.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #2 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-2 new skins for each Buggy

70070000030795.name: Railway Empire - Complete Edition
70070000030795.description:
The Railway Empire – Complete Edition includes:
•	Railway Empire – Nintendo Switch™ Edition
•	Railway Empire – Down Under DLC
•	Railway Empire – France DLC
•	Railway Empire – Germany DLC
•	Railway Empire – Great Britain & Ireland DLC
•	Railway Empire – Japan DLC
•	Railway Empire – Northern Europe DLC

United States, 1830: ‘The New World’ is in its ascendancy. Industry is booming, and the race is on to establish the most dominant and powerful rail empire in all of North America. It’s time to outthink and outmaneuver your competitors as you lead your company into the 20th century!

In Railway Empire, you will create an elaborate and wide-ranging rail network, purchase over 40 different trains modelled in extraordinary detail, and buy or build railway stations, maintenance buildings, factories and tourist attractions to keep your travel network ahead of the competition. You’ll also need to hire and manage your workforce if you want to ensure an efficient train service, whilst also develop over 300 technologies ranging from mechanical improvements to the trains themselves to workplace infrastructures and advanced amenities as you progress through five eras of technological innovations. 

However, you can’t just build and research your way to the top – the competition never sleeps, and to keep your business on track you’ll have to survive against up to three rival tycoons. To get to the top you may have to resort to more cutthroat tactics as you attack and sabotage your opponents through raids and industrial espionage.

The Railway Empire – Nintendo Switch™ Edition features the additional content Mexico, The Great Lakes and Crossing the Andes unlocking new scenarios on regional maps, additional soundtracks, locomotives as well as introducing the night & snow mode.

Features:		
- Exploit the economic opportunities of the United States in an extensive campaign, working your way step by step from coast to coast across this great continent.
- Lead your Railway Empire to success by establishing a comprehensive rail network and optimizing transportation of passengers and goods.
- Master challenges and objectives through a range of scenarios, or create your perfect railway network in construction mode without any financial pressure.
- Over 40 historically accurate locomotives and more than 30 different wagons can be acquired over the course of the game, and must be put to use in the best way in order to take advantage of their strengths and weaknesses.
- Invest in over 300 new technologies across five different eras to progress and maximize the potential of your rail network.
- Compete with up to three rival companies, and even sabotage their efforts with the use of bandits and spies.
- Includes the additional content: Mexico, The Great Lakes and Crossing the Andes

70070000030799.name: Port Royale 4 - Complete Collection
70070000030799.description:
The Port Royale 4 – Complete Collection includes:
•	Port Royale 4
•	Port Royale 4 – Buccaneers DLC

Set sail and join the colonial powers of Spain, England, France and the Netherlands in their fight for supremacy of the Caribbean in the 17th century. 

In ‘Port Royale 4’ you will take control of a colony as a young and ambitious governor who is eager to learn what it takes to manage and grow his small settlement into a bustling trader city.

Features:
• Choose from four colonial powerhouses: England, France, Spain and the Netherlands, each providing different benefits and unique gameplay style

• Appoint a leader for your adventure from four different character classes: the Explorer, the Merchant, the Buccaneer and the Pirate – each providing their own advantages and disadvantages

• Take on four extensive single player campaigns following each nation on their path to supremacy.

• Establish and manage trade with 60 Caribbean cities in a huge 3D game world. Steer clear of cliffs, shallow waters and stormy weather regions to optimize your trade routes.

• Select from 50 buildings, including 25 production sites, to produce goods like rum or luxuries.

• Construct town buildings with neighborhood effects to optimize productivity and manage the overall happiness of your citizens.

• 18 historically authentic ship types from the late 16th and 17th centuries

• Engage in tactical, turn-based naval battles with powerful captains.

• Licenses, building permits, new buildings and ships can be unlocked by growing your reputation within your nation.

70070000030817.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Ultimate Look
70070000030817.intro: Build your retail empire, style your unique store!
70070000030817.description:
Step into the ultimate supermarket management experience with this exclusive bundle. Build, manage, and customize your very own supermarket empire from the ground up — all while giving your store a fresh, unique look with the Shop Redesign DLC.

Bundle includes:
- Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Step into the shoes of a supermarket manager and build your retail empire from the ground up. Design your store layout, manage inventory and staff, and compete in a dynamic market to grow your business.
- Shop Redesign DLC – Give your supermarket a fresh new look by customizing the colors of both the interior and exterior. Personalize your store’s atmosphere, create a unique style, and make your supermarket stand out from the competition.

Together, this bundle offers the ultimate supermarket management experience — combine deep gameplay with creative freedom to build and style your very own retail empire.

70070000030824.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Tactical Edition
70070000030824.intro: Stay sharp, remain completely unseen, and outsmart your enemies.
70070000030824.description:
Step into the role of a tactical operator confronting hostile, armed enemies across highly detailed environments. This bundle combines the core BODY CAM SHOOTER game with the Night Vision Mode DLC — granting you the vital ability to see clearly in the darkest conditions.

Bundle includes:
	•	BODY CAM SHOOTER – Engage in ultra-realistic first-person combat against smart AI opponents on two challenging maps. Adapt your tactics with diverse weapons and dynamic settings.
	•	Night Vision Mode DLC – Use night vision to spot enemies hiding in shadows and plan your moves carefully.

Experience the full range of tactical gameplay, from daylight assaults to shadowy operations, and test your skills to the fullest.

70070000030830.name: MLB® The Show™ 26 - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000030830.intro: Make your mark. Become a Legend. Own The Show™.
70070000030830.description:
Pre-order to receive a Gold Choice Pack and Early Access on March 13, 2026.

This edition of MLB The Show 26 includes: 
• MLB® The Show™ 26
• 20 The Show Packs
• 2 World Baseball Classic Choice Packs
• 1 Legend Choice Pack
• 1 World Baseball Classic Uniform Pack
• 1 Equipment Pack
• Double Daily Rewards
• 1 Cover Athlete Bat Skin Pack
• 20K Stubs™

Step up and take control of how you leave your mark in the most immersive MLB® The Show™ yet. 

Discover new Road To The Show mechanics, deeper Franchise experiences, enhanced customization options, and true-to-life on-field action.

Road To The Show
NEW – Road to Cooperstown & Expanded Amateur Years Career
Your journey to greatness starts here, which path will you choose?
Earn a coveted spot at the MLB Draft Combine® or catch the eye of one of 11 additional new colleges as you advance through chapters of your career.
Compete in the officially licensed Men’s NCAA® College World Series® as you rise from a promising high school talent to one of the all-time MLB® greats – immortalized in the National Baseball Hall of Fame and maybe even a place on the first ballot.

Diamond Dynasty¹
Unmissable Updates
Build your ultimate fantasy team with a new Red Diamond rarity tier and World Baseball Classic player cards featuring elite game-changing players.
Play revamped Mini-Seasons campaigns as you level up your stars with an upgraded PXP system, customize their skills with Parallel Mods, and hit Parallel V faster through special challenges.

Franchise 
NEW – Revamped Front Office Experience
Play the nail-biting key matches and moments of your Franchise GM career with streamlined seasons and Custom Game Entry. Track rumours and strike big deals in the ultimate all-in-one Trade HUB, where a new Trade Logic System delivers real depth, immersion, and high-stakes decision-making. Smarter lineups and improved player regression now mirror the real decisions and realities that shape your organization’s future.

Storyline¹
The Negro Leagues Season 4
The award-winning game mode returns with all-new legends, uniforms, and stadiums – celebrating the stories of some of the most important yet often forgotten ballplayers in history.

Gameplay Updates – More Control Than Ever
Bear Down Pitching: exert total control over your pitches by earning a limited supply of elite focus to deploy in the most critical moments.

Big Zone Hitting: rack up the home runs with more control over your swing placement, giving you a better chance to nail that sweet spot.

¹Internet connection required.

70070000030831.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood Music Pack
70070000030831.intro: Bend reality with the OFFICIAL Everhood Music Pack!
70070000030831.description:
Featuring FOUR new Rhythm Rifts:
- "The Final Battle" by Cazok
- "Feisty Flowers" by Cazok

- "Why Oh You Are LOVE" by Dancefloor is Lava

As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift: "Powers of Destruction" by Cazok. Available now for everyone!

Each Everhood Rhythm Rift features:

- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

70070000030844.name: Sausage Wars: Toxic Edition
70070000030844.intro: An Epic Sausage Battle till the last drop of ketchup for up to 4 Players and 20 Bots!
70070000030844.description:
Careful - it’s a hot-dog-eat-hot-dog world out there. So fight to the death and push them all till your enemies are oozing Tomato Blood!!

With this edition you will unlock:
- new Trapdoor stage in each local multiplayer mode! 

Battle other sausages on a new, unstable ground. Trigger the trapdoors and watch them fall into the toxic soup!

Release to head-bang and push enemy sausages into sausage wars battle obstacles like sharp tools, kitchen sinks, garden fire, or off the counter to their doom. The crowded city is overcrowded and we need to empty it! Try to push them all, fight and smash those sausages to smithereens!

Don’t forget your hot-diggity-dog victory dance at the end of each sausage wars battle level! Make sure you become the biggest wiener in town!

70070000030846.name: Candivity: Stars & Stones Edition
70070000030846.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!

You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

- Candivity: Deep Mines DLC

NEW VERSUS MODE!
Race to merge the biggest candy while using clever tactics to slow down your opponent. Unleash tricky power-ups, and prove who’s the ultimate candy master!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Features:
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode for you and your friend!
- Versus mode to sabotage your friends!
- 4 maps: Outer Space, Deep Mines and 2 standard maps
- New animal characters and swimming accessories
- Fully customizable name and character
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
- An adorably sweet aesthetic

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000030852.name: ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Nightmare
70070000030852.intro: Explore, fight, and survive the labyrinth of horrors.
70070000030852.description:
Step into a labyrinthine nightmare where reality bends and sanity crumbles. This bundle includes the base game ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR and an exclusive DLC that adds a powerful survival tool to your inventory: a pistol loaded with 7 bullets in the chamber and 200 spare rounds.

In the base game, navigate an endless maze of damp carpets, flickering lights, and twisted corridors. Face unknown horrors, hide or confront terrifying creatures, and survive through diverse rooms, each presenting new challenges and fears. Use your camcorder to capture the horrors and add a strategic layer to your survival.

With the Arm Yourself DLC, you are armed to face the maze’s darkest threats. The pistol gives you a fighting chance against the relentless dangers lurking in every shadow, making every decision and every shot crucial.

This bundle offers the ultimate survival horror experience: explore the twisted Backrooms, confront terrifying creatures, and arm yourself to survive the unimaginable. Can you escape this endless nightmare?

70070000030853.name: Z Escape: Flaming Edition
70070000030853.intro: Get to the chopper! Pick up the machine gun and destroy all of the zombies to save your crew!
70070000030853.description:
Your quest is simple... rescue as many survivors as you can by killing all the walking dead!

Features:
- Hordes of zombies
- Interactive surroundings
- Fire power up
- 3 new helicopter skins
- 3 new weapon sights
- Legendary zombie and survivor skin
- 10000 additional coins to spend
- Levels with rewards and bigger zombies!
- Skins for zombies, survivors and helicopters
- Fun and addictive gameplay
- Lots of shooting!

Zombies run and climb on buildings very fast, so make sure to shoot quickly and precisely. If there are too many of them, use your surroundings - shoot at exploding barrels, destroy bridges, and glass roofs or just drop heavy building materials to stop the zombie horde! 

Rescue the survivors before they become infected! But beware, after each successful escape, the zombies will become even more challenging. You must apply your strategy in real-time and spot the right target to shoot in order to win!

If you believe that shooting zombies is not just a matter of luck, show your abilities and become the best helicopter sniper ever. Best of luck!

70070000030859.name: Subway Simulator: Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games – World of Rails
70070000030859.intro: Navigate, customize, and conquer the subway tracks.
70070000030859.description:
Subway Simulator – World of Rails Bundle brings you the full underground experience in one complete package, combining the base game with two exciting DLCs. It’s the perfect choice for train enthusiasts and players who want to explore everything the world of Subway Simulator has to offer.

This bundle includes:
- Base Game – Subway Simulator: Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games – drive passenger trains across four cities, choose from five different models, explore realistic subway routes, and progress through 100 levels to build your career as a subway driver.
- DLC 1 – New Color Train Pack – customize your trains with a wide palette of colors, making every journey unique and adding a personal touch to your underground rides.
- DLC 2 – Express Voyager Train – add a modern, high-speed train designed for crowded routes, offering new challenges and a faster, more intense driving experience.

You’ll not only enjoy the thrill of driving trains, but also the freedom to personalize your experience and push the limits with high-speed travel. It’s the complete package for every subway simulation fan!

70070000030863.name: Complete Edition
70070000030863.description: Dive into the Outlands with the main game + Heir of the Roads + Flood and Fire + Life of Yolotli + Home is where the heart is!

70070000030864.name: DLC Pack
70070000030864.description: Get the DLCs: Heir of the Roads + Flood and Fire + Life of Yolotli+ Home is where the heart is

70070000030875.name: Spy Guy Memory Circus Mission Edition

70070000030875.description: Classic Memory game with fantasy style cards. 5 game modes, timer and record board. A game for everyone! Additional a new set of circus-themed memory tiles. New pictures, challenges and memory training.

70070000030878.name: Spy Guy Hidden Objects Special Missions
70070000030878.intro: Test your observation skills in Spy Guy's special missions!
70070000030878.description:
Join Spy Guy on special missions! Escape to fantastic underground worlds where dark surprises await you. Solve puzzles in the circus and discover the secrets of space!

The set includes 3 games with 120 levels each, each with over 200 hidden objects and 3 game modes!

70070000030881.name: Risk of Rain 2 + Survivors of the Void + Seekers of the Storm + Alloyed Collective Bundle
70070000030881.intro: Unleash the critically acclaimed Risk of Rain 2 and its first three expansions!
70070000030881.description:
Unleash Risk of Rain 2 and its three expansions! This bundle includes Risk of Rain 2, the Survivors of the Void DLC, Seekers of the Storm DLC, and the Alloyed Collective DLC.
Bring your friends on the adventure! Only one player must own the DLC to enable the monsters, levels and items for the whole lobby. Players without the DLC will be unable to select the seven DLC Survivors or permanently unlock new items, logbooks, or other content.

Risk of Rain 2:
Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

Survivors of the Void:
The Gateway to the Void has opened! The corrupting power it contained has engulfed Petrichor V and plunged the planet into darkness. For millennia, The Void Creatures have grown dominant by taking artifacts from our realm to theirs. Now they look to add you to their collection.
2 New Survivors
Over 40 New Items
4 New Stages
12 New Enemies
2 New Elite Types
New Game Mode
New Alternate Ending

Seekers of the Storm:
An ancient threat awakens on Petrichor V. Master new Survivors, wield new items, and battle across uncharted regions. Ascend the levels of the Colossus in a race to confront The False Son. Defeat him and unlock the true power of his Soul!
3 New Survivors
8 Items + 1 Special Boss Item
5 Stages + 3 Additional Stage Variants
3 Bulwark’s Ambry Variants
3 Monsters
2 Elite Types
15 Survivor Alt Skins
2 Interactables

Alloyed Collective:
Lured, enslaved, and left to rust. The Alloyed Collective now stirs from the scrap of their fallen allies, driven by a singular purpose: returning home. Master two new Survivors and descend deep into Petrichor V to take on the Alloyed Collective’s ultimate creation.
2 New Survivors
18 Items
7 Stages + 1 Additional Stage Variant
7 Drones
6 Enemies
2 Teleporter Bosses
New Alternate Ending

70070000030898.name: Darts Fever Bullseye Legends
70070000030898.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000030898.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs

Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

70070000030915.name: Pool Fever Precision Shoot
70070000030915.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000030915.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Classic puzzle game where you unlock vivid and sensual illustrations step by step! The game focuses on attractive girls in glamorous and daring outfits. They are all ready to charm you with their looks.

All images are created with love for the smallest details, and their expressive poses, stylish outfits and bright emotions give each illustration a special atmosphere. The realistic assembly mechanics will make you feel like you are assembling a real paper puzzle. Relaxing music will help you to fully immerse yourself in the game.

This bundle contains:
