70070000030932.name: NBA 2K26 SLAM Edition
70070000030932.description:
The SLAM Edition* includes additional MyCAREER and MyTEAM bonus content, plus Virtual Currency:

- 35,000 VC
- Full Series 1 Team Selection
- Triple Threat Park Free Agent Pack
- 5x Series 1 Packs
- 2-Hour 2XP Coin
- 10x 6 Types of Skill Boosts (10 Games)
- 10x 3 Gatorade Boosts (10 Games)
- SLAM Cover Athletes Shirt

CONTROL THE COURT

Experience enhanced gameplay and authentic controls that allow you to orchestrate the offense and dictate the pace of play. Facilitate with free-flowing, dynamic movement, stay in rhythm with improved shooting mechanics, and separate from defenders with graceful Eurosteps. Flash your skills and play fast in single-player and multiplayer game modes.

SQUAD UP AND WIN

Create your legend in MyCAREER and build a MyPLAYER capable of leading an NBA franchise to the NBA Finals. Achieve individual and team success, raise banners, and play your way into the Hall of Fame. Squad up with friends and challenge rival squads to see who runs the court.

UNITE STARS IN MyTEAM

Collect and compete with NBA and WNBA superstars in MyTEAM. Assemble a star-studded roster, put your dream team to the test in single-player and multiplayer modes, and acquire new cards to make your MyTEAM fantasy a reality.

YOUR TEAM, YOUR STORY

Write the next chapter of an NBA franchise as a General Manager in MyLEAGUE, and add to its storied history by raising banners. Influence the future of the sport and leave an indelible mark on the league.

*Internet connection and NBA 2K Account required to redeem and use bonus content. Terms apply.

Play Now, MyNBA, The W, and MyLEAGUE are available offline. All other game modes and features require Internet connection and may require online account registration (varies 13+).

70070000030961.name: Bowling Fever Infinite Edition
70070000030961.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000030961.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #5 with:

-20 new bowling ball styles

70070000030963.name: Sugardew Island - Halloween Bundle
70070000030963.intro: Run your own farm shop, without any pressure!
70070000030963.description:
Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade your farm, and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the tiny island with life again. 

If you wish, you can go on dates with friendly locals, each with their own unique personality and backstory!

70070000030966.name: Snooker Fever Rack 'n' Roll
70070000030966.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000030966.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2, Expansion Pack #3 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

20 stunning new table designs
10 sleek cue styles

70070000031005.name: Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000031005.description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition Includes:

Dispatch Full Game
The Art of Dispatch: Digital Artbook* - 100+ pages
4 Digital Comics* - 45+ pages
   • Issue #1 - Splash & The Last Bender
   • Issue #2 - Pas De Deux & Shellshock
   • Issue #3 - Get Up
   • Issue #4 - The Death of Mecha Man

Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles from the writers and directors of Tales from the Borderlands and The Wolf Among Us, and features an all-star cast including Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, and Jeffrey Wright.

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified. 

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

As their dispatcher, you take charge of a team of ex-supervillains given a shot at redemption. Manage and level up your roster, all while navigating office relationships and romances, and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge!

> Shape the Story

In Dispatch, every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

>  Deploy Your Heroes 

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

> Manage Your Roster

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment

Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror)
Laura Bailey (The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us II, Marvel's Spider-Man)
Erin Yvette (Hades II, The Wolf Among Us, Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon)
MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White) 
Jacksepticeye (Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)
Travis Willingham (The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role, Lego Avengers)
Alanah Pearce (V/H/S Beyond, Cyberpunk 2077, Gears 5)
Lance Cantstopolis (Karate, Dancing, Actor)
Joel Haver (Filmmaker, Actor, YouTuber)
THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake, Hoes Depressed)
Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money), oops!)
Matthew Mercer (Critical Role, Overwatch, Resident Evil 6)
and Jeffrey Wright (American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale)

* Only available with English text

70070000031059.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Racing Titans
70070000031059.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000031059.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

-4 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000031072.name: Zombie Defense: Jungle Edition
70070000031072.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000031072.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you... Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun!

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Red Headband guy skin, which gives you +10% to damage!
- Monkey skin, which gives you +10% to fire rate
- Quad Rocket Launcher weapon
- Banana weapon
- 500 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000031075.name: Infantry Attack: Golden Backup Edition
70070000031075.intro: Soldier! War is coming and duty calls! Enemies are invading our country and we need YOU to defend it!
70070000031075.description:
Enemy troops, such as infantry, helicopters, tanks, warplanes, and drones, are coming for you! Jump on the machine gun and shoot them all!

Features:
- Defend the country against enemy soldiers
- Fight along your military crew and defeat the opponent's army on multiple warzones
- Golden Gatling primary weapon with high damage per second!
- UD-1 Whirligig Drone and Shark Drone with high damage per second!
- 130 gold bars to spend on unique weapons or boosters
- 12500 cash to spend on weapon and troops upgrades
- Upgrade your loadout to win the war
- Use modern war weapons: machine guns, rocket launchers and drones
- Fight and kill bosses!
- Easy controls and realistic graphics for intense action

You're not doing war alone; your squad is here to help you: An explosive Expert with an RPG rocket launcher to deal tremendous damage to military vehicles, a Rifleman who will shoot at a high range on the open battlefield, and finally, a Grenadier who specializes in fighting all ground units. You are in charge of the machine gun to clear the battlefield, which is highly addictive and enjoyable!

Missions will take place in different warzones, and you will need to adapt your shooting strategy depending on the battlefield: city, desert, jungle, forest, airport, and many more! Be on the frontline of the battleground or take to the air to shoot enemies from the helicopter!

Beware! Combat will be challenging, and enemies will become stronger over time, so upgrading your guns won't be enough. Level up teammates and prepare your military crew for shooting waves of soldiers.

Deadly and heavily armed bosses will challenge you through the war, and only sharpened skilled players will survive. To win the battle, you must aim right and use the weapons and kill-strikes at your disposal smartly.

Do you have what it takes to free your country from invaders and win the war?

70070000031084.name: My Cozy Room Multiculture Collection
70070000031084.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000031084.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic, Easter, Summer, Rock, Halloween, Dogs, Cottagecore, Mediterranean, Coffee, Mexican and Asian DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000031094.name: Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 1 - 4 - Standard Edition Bundle
70070000031094.intro: Two critically acclaimed remakes in one Bundle!
70070000031094.description:
The Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 1 - 4 Bundle brings together two critically acclaimed remakes that capture the spirit of the four original titles, updated for next-gen visuals and performance.

This Bundle includes:

- Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2
- Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4

TONY HAWK'S™ PRO SKATER™ 1 + 2

Drop back in with the most iconic skateboarding games ever made. Play the fully-remastered Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 2 games in one epic collection, rebuilt from the ground up in incredible HD.

- Skate as the legendary Tony Hawk and the original pro roster, plus new pros
- Skate to songs from the era-defining soundtrack along with new music
- Hit insane trick combos with the iconic handling of the Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ series
- Play all the original game modes and go head-to-head with local 2-Player modes
- Show off your style and creativity with upgraded Create-A-Park and Create-A-Skater features
- Take your sessions online and compete against players from around the world in Multiplayer* modes and leaderboards

TONY HAWK'S™ PRO SKATER™ 3 + 4

Get hyped for the legendary franchise to return with Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4. Everything you loved is back, but revamped with more skaters, new parks, gnarlier tricks, eardrum shattering music, plus a whole lot more.

70070000031111.intro: Rail Route - Express Edition: Includes the base game and Happy Passenger DLC!
70070000031111.description:
Rail Route - Express Edition will take your love for railway management to the next level!
This edition includes the base game and the Happy Passengers DLC, which expands the game with a new mechanic: passenger satisfaction. 

Rail Route - Base Game

70070000031246.name: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions Deluxe Edition
70070000031246.description:
The ultimate racing experience with Ed & Edda has arrived! This special Deluxe Edition includes both the base game Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions and the brand-new expansion Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Goes Europa-Park.

Join Ed & Edda, the beloved mascots from Europa-Park and stars of the feature film GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE, in a fast-paced kart racer designed for the whole family. Race with twelve colorful characters through iconic tracks across Europe - and now, for the very first time, speed through Europa-Park itself!

Experience thrilling races through the park’s famous themed areas and attractions: dash past Voltron Nevera, WODAN - Timburcoaster, and the glowing Eurosat sphere, drift through the legendary entrance gate, or take on the twists of the Swiss Bob Run. And in the brand-new Rollercoaster Challenge, prove you’re faster than the legendary blue fire Megacoaster!

With 12+ exciting tracks, clever power-ups, unique racers, and split-screen multiplayer for up to four players, the Deluxe Edition delivers fun and unforgettable moments for fans of the film, families, and Europa-Park enthusiasts alike.

Highlights of the Deluxe Edition:

- Europa-Park adventure: Four new tracks set inside Europa-Park with authentic park atmosphere.

- Rollercoaster Challenge: Beat the speed of the blue fire Megacoaster - solo or in multiplayer.

- New racers: Play as Snorri, the Rulantica star, Mme Freudenreich, the hero of DINO MATES, Socke the Allosaurus, or Rubi, the Yomi.

- All base game content included: Eight playable characters, European-inspired tracks, multiple race modes, and customizable vehicles.

- Family fun: Local multiplayer for up to four players.

Get behind the wheel and experience the thrill of Europa-Park like never before!

70070000031248.name: The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle
70070000031248.intro: The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle includes 6 party games designed to send your night to a new dimension of infinite fun! Perfect for get-togethers with family or friends!
70070000031248.description:
Which games are included in The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle? 

The Jackbox Party Pack 11 catapults you and your crew into the best timeline of party game pandemonium. Whether you’re a trivia titan, a joke mastermind, or the resident undercover detective of your friend group, there’s something for everyone in your group. This pack includes five brand-new party games and countless laughs: 
Doominate (Writing): Take a perfectly lovely situation and destroy it in this head-to-head joke game where it feels so good to be so bad. Doominate supports 3-8 players.
Hear Say (Sound Effects): Record sound effects and dialogue directly from your phone in a foley-inspired game where laughter is the soundtrack. Then, watch your voices come to life in a series of short movie clips! Hear Say supports 2-8 players. 
Cookie Haus (Drawing): Play our coziest and kookiest drawing game yet by fulfilling cookie design orders for unusual clientele. Don’t play on an empty stomach! Cookie Haus supports 3-8 players.
Suspectives (Social Deduction): There’s been a crime, one player secretly did it, and the evidence comes from your own survey answers! Study the clues, defend your innocence (even if you’re lying), and put your friends on trial. Suspectives supports 4-8 players.
Legends of Trivia (Trivia): Assemble your team and put your trivia knowledge to the test in a fantastical world full of danger! Trivia! Teamwork! Monsters! Do you dare? Legends of Trivia supports 1-6 players.

The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a standalone game that takes real surveys from real people around the globe. This game is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Discover how your fellow players think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?” Enjoy endless replayability with six different game modes:
Hilo: Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! 
Speed: In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher!
Squares: Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares.
Bounce: In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! 
Dash: You’re competing against your fellow players: find the most popular answer in a group of options taken from one of our enormous lists to move ahead. Double down on your choice for more progress (or more punishment), send extra choices to your opponent’s list to slow them down, and tune into public opinion to outpace everyone on your way to the finish line.
Dares: You control whether a fellow player must guess something higher or lower on the list than what’s just been revealed. Throw them a nearly impossible challenge… but don’t be shocked when they nail it and rake in the points. After you’ve completed a dare, turn around, share the love and dare another player.
All game modes in The Jackbox Survey Scramble support 2 to 10 players.

70070000031255.name: Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes Lovers' Collection
70070000031255.intro: Run your own restaurant for many hungry customers!
70070000031255.description:
Handling a restaurant has never been easier. In Cozy Cooking: Tiny Tastes you can welcome customers and cook them the most delicious dishes they have ever tasted without breaking a sweat!


It’s high time you showed your culinary skills and prepared amazing meals for your guests who came to finally eat something tasty.

Mix the right ingredients, add a dash of creativity, and voilà, culinary magic right before your eyes! But remember to read the customers’ orders carefully, they can be picky.

Throughout your adventure you will be able to unluck more components and recipes, once you level up from receiving positive feedback from your customers.

Saddle up, lock and load - freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70070000031303.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000031303.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

This bundle includes Halloween Outfits Pack, High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack and Japan 90s DLCs with new additional looks waiting for you.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

- Aquarium Land: Baby Seal

Discover amazing places filled with a wide variety of beautiful animals. Discover huge and legendary creatures to attract more visitors. There is a customer for every sea animal, big or tiny, all you have to do is fish with attitude!

Invest in your aquarium shop and explore the sea world like a real fishy tycoon! The more money you earn, the more upgrades and aquariums you can get!

70070000031306.name: Neko Bento 2 Deluxe Edition
70070000031306.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70070000031306.description:
Say hello to Neko Bento 2 — a flavor-packed puzzle experience where lunch is still cute, but now even trickier to pack!

This time your favorite feline chef is back with even more riddles to solve! You thought you knew it all? Think again because these levels with brand new ingredients and shapes will put your spatial brain to the test.

Although the challenge has risen, you don’t have to worry too much about that. You may have as much time as you like to complete a puzzle.

What will Neko Bento 2 serve you?
- Over 90 levels to eat up.
- 29 various ingredients to organize - pay attention to their shapes, it’s crucial…
- Music track that will help your mind focus and lock in!
- Artwork that will win your taste over… and not only the music one.

Chefs tend to be impatient, so don’t wait for too long and become the ultimate bento master!

70070000031353.intro: Dominate skies, master logistics, earn glory.
70070000031353.description:
Take command of your very own airline and experience the thrill of global air cargo. From small regional flights to managing a growing fleet, hangars, and airports worldwide, embark on a journey to become a top aviation tycoon.

This bundle includes:

Take on bigger missions, expand your fleet, and dominate the skies in this ultimate air cargo experience.

70070000031357.name: Urban Flow Green Wave
70070000031357.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000031357.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Winter Expansion Pack and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    40 new stages!
•    Winter theme and new music!
•    7 new vehicles, including the fire truck and snow plow!

70070000031361.name: Gloomy Eyes - Deluxe Edition
70070000031361.intro: Explore Gloomy Eyes in complete experience of this cozy horror fairytale.
70070000031361.description:
Step into the world of Gloomy Eyes with complete experience of this cozy horror fairytale - featuring the full game and its haunting 40-track soundtrack. 

Gloomy Eyes: A cozy horror, “self-coop”, adventure about two unlikely souls who forge a forbidden bond and journey together to find the sun. Explore eerie yet charming spooky levels, switch between two unique characters, and solve brain-teasing puzzles.

Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack: Gloomy tunes for gloomy souls! Immerse yourself in 40 tracks of haunting Halloween-inspired melodies and classical horror animation charm. From eerie waltzes to tense, cinematic themes, Gloomy Eyes - Soundtrack captures the dark, whimsical atmosphere of the game. Perfect for setting the mood, whether you’re wandering through moonlit graveyards or facing a slow and inevitable death.

70070000031366.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Culinary Road Trip
70070000031366.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000031366.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon, Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Food Truck Tycoon Multiplayer Mode, Food Truck Tycoon New Levels #1, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #2 and Pizza Bar Tycoon Multiplayer Mode with:

- Food Truck Tycoon local multiplayer gameplay mode
- 45 brand new levels for Food Truck Tycoon
- Pizza Bar Tycoon local multiplayer gameplay mode
- 40 brand new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000031371.name: Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Predator Rising
70070000031371.intro: Survive the relentless hunt of ocean predators.
70070000031371.description:
Face the ocean’s dangers and discover its mysteries as you survive on a fragile raft, gathering resources, expanding your floating base, and confronting the fiercest predator in the sea with a brand-new, redesigned look that makes every encounter more thrilling.

Bundle Includes:
- Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor – Gather resources, build and expand your raft, explore mysterious islands, and fight to survive against the unforgiving ocean.
- Shark Upgrade DLC – Face a fearsome shark with a unique new design, adding fresh intensity and immersion to your survival battles.

Take your ocean journey to the next level with the Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Predator Rising!

70070000031375.name: Bakery Bundle - Lemon Cake + Magical Bakery
70070000031375.intro: Serve up sweet delights and enchanting treats in the whimsical worlds of Magical Bakery and Lemon Cake.
70070000031375.description:
Magical Bakery:
Magical Bakery is a single-player cooking and management game set in an enchanted bakery that sells all sorts of sweets and pastries, with a twist, they may contain traces of magic!

Lemon Cake:
While the bakery might initially be broken down, overgrown and even haunted, don’t worry! You’ll be able to repair, furnish and decorate every room in the bakery. Gather honey from your beehive, raise a cow to collect fresh milk and adopt a few chickens to add eggs to your recipes. You’ll also be able to grow trees and plants to harvest a variety of fruits.

70070000031376.name: Farming Adventure Double Pack - Orange Season + Garden Witch Life
70070000031376.intro: Cultivate your dream farm, befriend the townsfolk, and embrace a cozy life in Orange Season and Garden Witch Life.
70070000031376.description:
Orange Season:
Orange Season is a delightful farm-life RPG inspired by the classics of the genre! Make your farmer dreams come true in the charming Orange Town.

Grow crops, raise animals, fish, and mine to build a successful and profitable farm. Socialize with the residents by helping them out with quests and forge meaningful relationships that will last a lifetime. Take a break from time to time by participating in town festivals and minigames. Explore and farm as you deal with the challenges of your new life in Orange Season! 

Garden Witch Life: 
You're a little witch from the big city who has just lost her job. Life didn't go as you'd expected, but now you can start anew on a tiny island full of possibilities!

Grow your own magical garden, decorate your ancient treehouse, care for cute creatures, and make friends along the way.

70070000031377.name: Mystery Horror Bundle - Saint Kotar & Charon's Staircase
70070000031377.intro: Face your fears, solve puzzles, and unravel secrets in Saint Kotar and Charon's Staircase.
70070000031377.description:
Saint Kotar:
In this story-and-choice driven psychological horror detective game, you play as Benedek and Nikolay – two troubled godly men in search for their missing relative in an ancient God-devoted town called Sveti Kotar. Here, an unknown presence preys upon the weak and sways on devil worship and witchcraft. Evidence points to your missing relative being involved in the grisly murders and the occult, but what is the truth? Are you also to blame for what happened?
 
Charon's Staircase:
In the 1970s, a totalitarian regime known as The Ministry ruled with an iron fist. They committed numerous inhumane and sinister acts during their reign, but those days are over, as they now aspire to join the European Union.

You play as an agent codenamed: ‘Desmond’, sent by The Ministry who is tasked with retrieving and destroying classified documents from the Oack Grove estate, that reveal the horrifying activities that happened in the past. Your journey, however, leads you to an unpleasant and gruesome discovery – Project Alpha.

70070000031392.name: Gloomy Eyes + Arise: A Simple Story
70070000031392.intro: From shadows to memories, two journeys of the soul.
70070000031392.description:
From shadows to memories, two journeys of the soul. 

Step into two emotional and unforgettable adventures with this unique bundle. In Gloomy Eyes, enter a cozy horror world that feels both eerie and enchanting. Switch between two unlikely souls as they form a forbidden bond and journey together through unknown landscapes. Use teamwork to solve clever puzzles and search for the sun in a land ruled by darkness. 

Then, in Arise: A Simple Story, embark on a heartfelt journey through love, loss, and memory. Manipulate time to reshape your surroundings and relive the bittersweet moments of a past life. Each puzzle uncovers a new piece of an emotional tale that balances joy with sorrow, hardship with hope. 

Together, these games weave stories of connection, resilience, and discovery. Whether facing shadows or cherishing memories, this bundle invites you to feel, reflect, and be moved.

70070000031405.name: Truck Driver - DLC Bundle
70070000031405.intro: Expand your trucking adventure with a complete DLC collection in one bundle!
70070000031405.description:
Heading North:
When your uncle challenges you to continue your trucking career overseas in the cold, but captivating, green country Mangefjell, you decide to take on the adventure. Drive around beautiful Nordic inspired landscapes as you continue your trucking career and complete numerous jobs for new characters. 

UK Paint Jobs:
“Fancy a British lorry?” With six different paint jobs, you can customize your truck with classic British designs. Create a truck that perfectly reflects your love for the United Kingdom with paint jobs of typical British symbols.

German Paint Jobs:
Customize your truck in typical German style. Switch it up between six unique paint jobs that give a glimpse into the German culture.

French Paint Jobs:
“Vive la France!” Personalize your truck in classic French style. You can now show your love for beautiful France with six different paint jobs.

USA Paint Jobs:
Customize your truck in all-American style. With six unique USA themed paint jobs, you can create a truck that perfectly suits your love for the United States of America.  

Hidden Places & Damage System:
Get ready to hit the road and discover hidden places and new vehicles. Drive safe though, since a new damage system shows visual damage on your truck and other vehicles at the point of impact.

70070000031413.name: TCG Card Market Simulator: Trading Empire
70070000031413.intro: Build your trading card empire from the ground up.
70070000031413.description:
Experience the full thrill of running your own trading card empire with the TCG Card Market Simulator: Trading Empire! This complete package gives you everything you need to manage, expand, and dominate your card shop from the very beginning.

The bundle includes:
	•	TCG Card Market Simulator – Start your own card shop, stock booster packs, manage rare collectibles, and organize exciting tournaments to attract trading card fans.
	•	Balance Boost DLC – Your balance grows by 2500 cash, providing the resources to expand faster and smarter.

Whether you’re a new player or looking to enhance your shop, this bundle provides all the tools and rewards you need to build, strategize, and succeed in the competitive world of trading cards.

70070000031418.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Elite Sniper
70070000031418.intro: Prepare for unpredictable hunts with tactical enhancements.
70070000031418.description:
Explore stunning wild landscapes and experience the authentic challenges of hunting in an open, dynamic world. With a wide range of customizable weapons and ever-changing environments, every hunt becomes a unique and thrilling adventure.

- Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Use a diverse arsenal of weapons and adapt your strategy based on dynamic weather conditions and complex animal behaviors for a truly immersive hunting experience.
-  Tactical Gloves DLC – Adds an exclusive gloves skin to complete your hunter’s gear. If you already own this item, you will receive its coin value instead, giving you the freedom to use your resources as you wish.

Get ready to embark on a wilderness adventure full of challenges and customization, equipped with everything you need right at your fingertips!

70070000031419.name: Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim: Cars Collection
70070000031419.intro: Speed, style, and legendary machines in one pack.
70070000031419.description:
Experience the thrill of racing and drifting in one powerful package! This edition includes Drift Master Simulator 2024 – Driving Sim along with two exciting DLCs that expand your garage with exclusive cars and customization options.

- Drift Master Simulator 2024: Driving Sim
Immerse yourself in high-speed action with races, time trials, and drift challenges across five dynamic modes. Choose your vehicle, tune it with rims, spoilers, and upgrades, and show your skills on every track.
 - Unlock4 Cars Pack DLC
Add 4 high-performance cars to your garage, designed to deliver speed, precision, and unique style.
- 4 Ultimate Cars Pack DLC
Expand your collection with another 4 legendary drift machines. Unlock them through the special Cars Pack or choose their value in in-game currency to boost your progress.

Take control, customize your ride, and dominate the road—your ultimate drifting journey starts here!

70070000031423.name: TCG Card Market Simulator & Airport Manager Simulator 2025 & Heist Simulator 2025
70070000031423.intro: Business, aviation, and crime – all under your control.
70070000031423.description:
Step into three unique worlds of strategy, management, and high-stakes action with this simulation bundle! Whether you dream of running a successful business, managing a global airport, or pulling off daring heists, this bundle has something for every type of player.

1. TCG Card Market Simulator – Build and expand your very own trading card shop! Stock the hottest booster packs, manage your inventory, and turn your store into a bustling hub for TCG fans while navigating an ever-changing market.
2. Airport Manager Simulator 2025 – Take control of a major international airport, ensuring smooth passenger flow, flawless logistics, and on-time flights. From ground equipment to flight schedules, every detail is in your hands.
3, Heist Simulator 2025 – Master the art of the perfect heist. Plan your strategies, equip yourself with high-tech gear, and outsmart the law in adrenaline-fueled missions that test your stealth and cunning.

With this bundle, you’ll explore the thrill of entrepreneurship, the pressure of global operations, and the excitement of high-risk adventures—all in one package. Are you ready to prove your skills across three worlds where every decision counts?

70070000031424.name: "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle" Character Pass
70070000031424.description:
The "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle" Character Pass bundle includes all 7 playable characters.

※The additional content included in the Character Pass will be released incrementally, with multiple releases scheduled through September 2026.

What's included:
Tanjiro Kamado (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Zenitsu Agatsuma (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Giyu Tomioka (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Shinobu Kocho (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Doma Character Pack
Akaza (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Kaigaku Character Pack

70070000031436.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Ultra Edition
70070000031436.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000031451.name: Project Drift Japan Challenge – Drift Legacy
70070000031451.intro: Master the mountain curves and drift in ultimate style!
70070000031451.description:
Experience the full thrill of drifting on Japan’s legendary mountain roads with this complete bundle! Take control of your favorite JDM cars, master every turn, and show off your style with new DLC.

This bundle includes:
- Project Drift Japan Challenge – Drift on iconic Japanese mountain roads, challenge local fleets, and experience addictive Eurobeat music and Japanese manga-style graphics.
- Drifting in Color DLC – Customize your garage and stand out with vibrant new colors for your rides: pink, green, purple, and dark blue.

Bundle Features:
- Master 6 famous Japanese cars
- Drift across 5 unique mountain tracks
- Use realistic physics and full controller support
- Access 4 brand-new car colors for ultimate customization
- Unlock new cars, break records, and dominate the slopes

Step into the driver’s seat, upgrade your garage, and take your drifting adventure to the next level!

70070000031458.name: Chained Climb Together Editions
70070000031458.intro: Scale dangerous heights where only heroes prevail.
70070000031458.description:
Experience the full online climbing adventure with Chained Climb Together Editions. Work closely with your friends, bound by mysterious chains, as you overcome the challenging and treacherous mountain terrains. Coordination and strategy are key to conquering dangerous paths and unique obstacles.

This bundle includes:
- The base game: Chained Climb Together – an intense cooperative online adventure featuring difficult terrains and unique challenges.
- Player Reskin DLC – a completely fresh look for your character that allows you to stand out visually during your ascent.

Get ready for a memorable adventure that combines intense teamwork with personalized style. Join your team and climb to the summit with a fresh look and unwavering determination!

70070000031461.name: Agent A & Down in Bermuda Bundle
70070000031461.description:
Outsmart a villain in Agent A: A puzzle in disguise and unravel the islands secrets deep Down in Bermuda. 

Two unforgettable puzzle adventures packed with mystery, exploration, and clever twists - all together in one must-have collection.

70070000031485.name: Bucket Crusher: Cool World Edition
70070000031485.intro: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!
70070000031485.description:
Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

This bundle includes:
- Bucket Crusher
- Bucket Crusher: Cool Kidz
- Bucket Crusher: Around The World

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw!

Features:
- tear down 11 regular and 16 playful brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- change the look of your saw with 12 different funny skins!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you complete the first wall, there are various colorful and interesting mosaics with different shapes waiting for you to dig into and pull to pieces!

Upgrade your machinery after each level and think carefully about the wisest way to invest your money. Increase the length, power, size, and fuel capacity to get more bricks with every run of the level!

If you want to knock down walls faster and earn more cash, consider buying special permanent upgrades that cost prestige points, but there's a catch here. To get them, you have to reset all your progress!

70070000031492.name: DIY Fashion Star: Stylish Beauty Edition
70070000031492.intro: Refresh your wardrobe with stylish DIY projects and put your clothing design skills to the test!
70070000031492.description:
Got a boring old blouse? Reshape it, style it, decorate it, and make it a trendy new tank top with some clothing design hacks!

This bundle includes:
- DIY Fashion Star
- DIY Fashion Star: Glow Up!
- DIY Fashion Star: Stylish Outfits

Features:
- Complete awesome DIY fashion design dress-up clothing projects. Turn your boring old clothes into amazing new stylish outfits!
- Cut out patterns, sew on decorations, and add splashes of color onto your fashion designs! Unleash the inner fashionista you've always been destined to be!
- Try out face-painting option with 10 different colorful designs ranging from butterflies and stars to lovely flowers!
- Make 2 new hairstyles with beautiful braids!
- Transform your doll's style with 20 new and captivating clothes that will add a touch of sparkle to her look!
- Manage your very own DIY fashion dreamhouse studio from the comfort of your home and make videos of your dolly creations to gain followers. Become a famous fashion super stylist!
- Take pictures of your doll dressed in your DIY designer outfits and compete in selfie contests with other DIYers!
- Get a stunning, sweet doll makeover to look extra pretty in your DIY clothing. Dye your doll's hair, get her a new hairstyle, and do her makeup!

You're about to blow the world away with all of your fabulously stylish DIY fashion design skills to give your followers the ultimate doll makeover. Get creative with super-fun, sweet doll dress-up projects. Use your outfit designer imagination and turn your ordinary clothes into OMG-to-die-for stylish DIY dress-up outfits!

Take selfies with your new DIY clothes and compete in selfie contests! Run your own fashion designer channel and post videos of your DIY outfits to gain a huge fan base!

To all DIY game lovers, unleash your creativity and dive into the world of doll dress-up inspired outfits!

70070000031494.name: Electronics Supermarket Simulator: Gadget Kingdom
70070000031494.intro: Build your tech empire and dominate the electronics market.
70070000031494.description:
Dream big and step into the exciting world of electronics retail! Turn your passion for technology into a thriving business, create your own high-tech empire, and experience the thrill of managing a bustling electronics store.

This bundle includes:
- Electronics Supermarket Simulator – Step into the dynamic world of high-tech retail, design and manage your own electronics store, stock the hottest products, and create an engaging shopping experience for your customers. Build your brand, grow your business, and dominate the competitive electronics market.
- Electronics Supermarket Simulator: Starter Cash – Receive a financial support to start your business, allowing you to expand faster, make strategic decisions, and take your electronics empire to the next level.

Take control, grow your business, and become the ultimate electronics tycoon with this complete package!

70070000031497.name: Ion Fury: Double Shot Edition
70070000031497.intro: The base game of Ion Fury and the "Aftershock" DLC in one convenient bundle!
70070000031497.description:
Shelly “Bombshell” Harrison earned her nickname by defusing bombs, but when the evil Dr. Jadus Heskel unleashes his cybernetic cult onto the streets of Neo DC, she knows it’s time to start causing explosions instead!

Her quest to slay Heskel leaves a trail of carnage throughout huge, multi-path levels filled with gigantic explosions, more secret areas than we can count, and inhuman foes behind every corner. There’s no regenerating health; stop taking cover and start running and gunning. 

Shelly’s crusade to take down Heskel’s army will see her cause destruction with a wide arsenal of weapons, including alternate fire modes and different ammo types. Her revolver, the tri-barreled Loverboy, brings pain to enemies and pleasure to players with both single shots and Old West-style gunslinging action. Who needs a regular shotgun when you can load buckshot into your grenade launcher? And violent, over-the-top Bowling Bombs rip enemies apart with ease.

Ion Fury takes the best from old-school first-person shooters and combines it with modern mechanics. Headshots? Oh yeah. More physics and interactivity? You bet. Modern resolution and framerate? Of course!

Key Features of Ion Fury
- Duck, jump, climb, swim, and blast your way through 7 exciting zones packed with multiple levels of mayhem!
- A beautiful game world assembled from thousands of hand-crafted textures and sprites
- An arsenal of devastating weapons, including multiple ammo types and alternate fire modes. Revolvers, grenade launchers, heat-seeking bombs and more!
- The classic '90s action you love, meshed with modern inventions like headshots and seamless level transitions
- All levels are hand-made and full of different paths you can take, cool effects, and complex set pieces!
- Original soundtrack to underscore the relentless action!

Ion Fury Continues: The Explosive “Aftershock” DLC!
Are You Up for the Challenge?
- Traverse 15 freshly-designed levels teeming with lurking adversaries.
- Heskel’s been busy. Meet his new lineup of augmented monstrosities itching for a fight.
- Enhance your firepower with new weapons and tools.
- The grueling new Angel of Death difficulty level.
- Find out what a rotorcycle is and engage in white-knuckle vehicular combat.
- Arrange mode for a fresh new take on all 28 levels from the original 2019 campaign, featuring new areas, new enemy encounters, and more.
- Engage in a total of 43 additional levels. Utilize destructible elements to set deadly traps and turn the tide against swarms of enemies.
- Push your cognitive limits and crack intricate puzzles to unlock hidden paths and valuable resources.
- Witness the story unfold through rich dialogues, ambient storytelling, and unexpected character interactions.
- Rock out to a powerful new soundtrack, fusing retro beats with modern intensity.

70070000031505.name: BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons
70070000031505.intro:
More Quests, More Power!
An All New Bubble Bobble Experience!
70070000031505.description:
*"BUBBLE Symphony" is also included with "BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons."

Bub the bubble-blowing dragon goes on an adventure through sweet dungeons that change every time!
Blow bubbles to catch bullies, use your horns and spikes to burst the bubbles and beat them!
Bubbles can be carried by the wind, and you can get to high places by riding bubbles!
Collect treasures in dungeons that change every time you step inside and conquer huge castles!
Collecting treasure will strengthen Bub's abilities and skills.
Get stronger along with Bub and explore the depths of treat-filled dungeons!

■Game features
-The first in the series to feature "dungeons" that change every time you step into them!
Each time you enter a dungeon, the shape of the stage, the platforms, the enemies that appear, and their placement change, so you can always enjoy a fresh level!
You don't necessarily have to beat all of the enemies in this game!
Simply trap them or defeat them your way, and move on to the next stage by passing through the donut-shaped gate!
In the dungeons, it is easy to get "treasures" that can be used to make Bub stronger, so dive back into dungeons repeatedly to collect treasures and build Bub's skills up!

Once you get used to the controls and familiar with leveling Bub up, we recommend challenging your limits and dive even deeper into the dungeon!

- A huge "castle" that develops the map appears for the first time in the series!
The castle is one huge stage, and you will progress through each room that is connected like a maze, sometimes getting lost, sometimes finding your way using the knowledge you have build playing.
Unique bosses are waiting, so level Bub up, equip yourself, and aim for the deepest treasures.

- Master new and returning skills!
The Water Bubble is back in a new form!
You'll also find new skills that will help you along your journey, like Rolling Attack, which wipes enemies out, as well as many other abilities.

Use your skills to break through paths that were previously inaccessible, and defeat strong enemies in one go...!

- Find the skills and strategies that suit you!
The skills you have learned become items you can use.
The number of items you can take to a dungeon or castle at once is fixed, so it's up to you to decide what kind of skill items and useful items you take and how many of them you take.

You can also decide in what order you use the treasures you collect to make Bub stronger.

■The setting

The setting of the new Bubble Bobble game is a world full of "strange" sweet treats!
Cute Candy-shaped enemies start appearing in vibrant dungeons and castles.

■The Story

When Bub wakes up... finding himself in a strange laboratory.
A mysterious person named "Dolchen" suddenly appears and asks him to take on a mission to retrieve the "treasure" that lies dormant in the dungeon and castle.
Bub loves adventure, so when he hears "treasure," you bet he's up for it!
And so begins Bub's strange and sweet adventure.

70070000031506.name: BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Edition
70070000031506.intro:
More Quests, More Power!
An All New Bubble Bobble Experience!
70070000031506.description:
"BUBBLE BOBBLE SUGAR DUNGEONS Deluxe Edition" Contents
・"BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons" main game
・BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Contents

*"BUBBLE Symphony" is also included with "BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons."
*Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeons and Bubble Symphony included in this content are also sold separately as a bundle containing both titles. Please be careful not to purchase the same content twice.

The "BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Deluxe Contents" includes a digital concept artbook and soundtrack from the main game.

Bub loves adventure, so when he hears "treasure," you bet he's up for it!
And so begins Bub's strange and sweet adventure.

70070000031524.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Special Edition
70070000031524.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000031524.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #3 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-2 new skins for each Buggy

70070000031543.name: UNO™ ULTIMATE EDITION
70070000031543.description:
Get the full UNO™ experience with the Ultimate Edition, which combines the base game with all 9 exciting DLCs.
From DLCs inspired by Mattel's iconic games to Ubisoft's best-loved worlds, each adds a unique twist to the classic gameplay.
Whether you're in the mood for party fun, strategic chaos, or themed adventures, UNO Ultimate Edition is packed with variety, surprises, and hours of fun.

UNO Ultimate Edition features the classic card game alongside nine exciting DLCs:
• UNO is the iconic card game you love, now with new ways to play and connect. Match cards by color, number, or symbol, play action cards to spice things up, and race against others to empty your hand first. Customize your experience with house rules and cosmetic options for a fresh twist on a timeless favorite.
• UNO Flip!™ elevates your UNO matches with a double-sided deck and new action cards, introducing a competitive twist to the classic gameplay!
• Celebrate in style with UNO 50th Anniversary and its gorgeous velvety cards.
• Unleash chaos with UNO Party! Mania™, which introduces 3 new action cards that promise wild thrills and epic comebacks.
• UNO Show ‘Em No Mercy™ turns up the heat with the most unforgiving version yet. Brutal action cards, extreme draw penalties, and knockout mechanics turn every match into a ruthless fight for survival.
• Play like a Viking in UNO Valhalla where the board is part of the gameplay!
• Join the revolution in UNO The Call of Yara, the DLC that brings resource management into the game.
• Play an action-packed game mode featuring characters from Immortals Fenyx Rising in UNO Fenyx's Quest.
• Get ready to move with the UNO Just Dance theme, offering upbeat rhythms, funky effects, and new Theme Cards.
• UNO Rayman adds a playful twist with lush visuals and four unique Theme Cards.

70070000031544.name: UNO™ LEGACY EDITION
70070000031544.description:
Dive into the world of UNO™ with the Legacy Edition bundle!

This collection features the classic card game alongside 4 exciting DLCs: UNO Flip!™, UNO 50th Anniversary, UNO Party! Mania™, and UNO Show ’Em No Mercy!™.
With four unique ways to play, UNO Legacy Edition brings extra fun and variety to your game nights!

UNO Legacy Edition features the classic card game alongside four chaotic DLCs:
• UNO is the iconic card game you love, now with new ways to play and connect. Match cards by color, number, or symbol, play action cards to spice things up, and race against others to empty your hand first. Customize your experience with house rules and cosmetic options for a fresh twist on a timeless favorite.
• UNO Flip! elevates your UNO matches with a double-sided deck, introducing a competitive twist to the classic gameplay. Switch between the light and dark sides and get ready to spice things up with new action cards that are wilder than ever!
• Celebrate five decades of one of the most popular card games in style with UNO 50th Anniversary and its gorgeous velvety cards. Plus, add a touch of flair with the special 50/50 card and its Gold Coin rule.
• For those craving chaos, UNO Party! Mania introduces 3 thrilling new action cards: the Point Taken, Wild Drawn Together, and Wild Pile Up cards. Brace yourself for bursts of laughter, nail-biting tension, and epic comebacks.
• UNO Show ‘Em No Mercy cranks up the intensity with brutal action cards, extreme draw penalties, and knockout mechanics. Outsmart your opponents, survive the chaos, and win by emptying your hand or being the last one standing.

70070000031545.name: Once Upon A KATAMARI - Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side A + B Bundle
70070000031545.description:
*This bundle contains products contained within the Deluxe Edition. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

Bundle includes:
• Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side A
• Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side B

- Katamari Damacy Series Songs: 60 tracks
60 additional BGM tracks. Jam along to all your favorite music from Katamari Forever, Beautiful Katamari, Touch My Katamari, and more!

- 26 Costume pieces from previous Katamari series titles.

*Additional BGM available after completing certain missions.

70070000031554.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Urban Warfare
70070000031554.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- With the Expansion Pack you can fight and survive the zombie apocalypse in a brand new game mode!
- Unlock 3 powerful weapons to use them in the DLC and base game to improve your scores
- FMS-1-G rifle

70070000031555.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Hostile Territory
70070000031555.description:

-SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy 
- FMS-1-G rifle

- FMS-1-G rifle

70070000031573.name: WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT – Battle War Squad: Thunder Wings
70070000031573.intro: Epic air battles await – are you ready to lead?
70070000031573.description:
Take flight into the ultimate WWII air combat experience! This pack combines the thrilling base game WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT with the powerful B25 Bomber DLC – giving you access to intense dogfights, challenging missions, and the legendary B25 bomber.

- WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT – Battle War Squad
Pilot 12 historically accurate aircraft, complete daring missions, and rise through the ranks to become an ace. Dogfights, bombing runs, and tactical maneuvers await as you fight to dominate the skies.

- WWII AIRPLANE FIGHT – Battle War Squad: B25 Bomber 
Unlock the legendary B25 bomber, bringing unmatched firepower and resilience to your hangar. If already purchased, you’ll receive 31,000 coins to further expand your fleet.

Experience the roar of engines, the chaos of combat, and the glory of victory – all in one complete air warfare package.

70070000031581.name: Pixel Cafe Dreamy Interiors
70070000031581.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000031581.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipment, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game, Living Room Touches and Bedroom Touches #2 with:

A new variant for the Armchair
A different look for the Computer
An alternative design for the Wardrobe
A modest update for the Bookshelf
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
Also, mix things up with two new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000031582.name: Pixel Cafe Home Sweet Home
70070000031582.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000031582.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipment, and keep your customers happy.
