70070000031596.name: Neko Ramen Deluxe Edition
70070000031596.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!
70070000031596.description:
It's time to try ramen like you've never had before! Filled with delicious aromas, Neko Ramen will stimulate your logical thinking and ignite your senses!


Fulfill ramen orders under the guidance of a true master – the one and only feline chef! Each ramen is a perfectly calculated arrangement of flavors and shapes, so strain your brain to accommodate all the ingredients! But be careful, because intense thinking can be as spicy for the mind as ramen itself!


The orders will become increasingly sophisticated and difficult (but also more delicious). However, you don't have to worry about that, as you have as much time as you want to prepare the dish!


Here's what you'll find on the Neko Ramen menu:
- Over 90 scrumptious levels!
- 29 ingredients to compose perfect dishes.
- Music that will make you want ramen yourself.
- And charming graphics that stimulate both the eyes and the taste buds!

This bundle includes Chopstick Finesse 1 DLC with even more delicious levels to complete.

Do not wait, because even though the ramen will not get cold, the cat chief may not be so forgiving!

70070000031598.name: Spy Guy Memory Chicago Edition
70070000031598.intro: Défi mémoire sur le thème de Chicago dans un superbe coffret !
70070000031598.description: A new set of Chicago- themed memory tiles. New pictures, challenges and memory training with main game Spy Guy Memory!

70070000031602.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 - FUTURE SAGA Pack Set
70070000031602.description:
The FUTURE SAGA Pack Set bundles together FUTURE SAGA Chapter 1-4! This pack set is jammed full of content to enjoy DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 even more, including Extra Missions with characters active in new forms, new Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, Costumes, and more!

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 1
• 5 New Playable Characters: Vegeta (Super Saiyan God, Ultra Supervillain), Goku Black (Super Saiyan Rosé, Ultra Supervillain), Broly (Restrained), Android 18 (DB Super), Videl (DB Super)
• 3 Extra Missions
• 12 Parallel Quests
• 15 Additional Moves
• 3 Costumes/Accessories
• 5 Super Souls
• 63 Illustrations

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 2
• 3 New Playable Characters: Jiren (Full Power, Ultra Supervillain), Belmod, Goku (Mini)
• 1 Extra Missions Arc
• 4 Parallel Quests
• 7 Additional Moves
• 2 Costumes/Accessories
• 3 Super Souls
• 14 Illustrations

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 3
• 2 New Playable Characters: Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain), Broly (DB Super)
• 1 Extra Missions Arc
• 3 Parallel Quests
• 6 Additional Moves
• 5 Costumes/Accessories
• 3 Super Souls
• 23 Illustrations
• 1 Extra Scenario: Cheelai & Broly All Out! Conton City Patrol

FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4
• A new Playable Character and more!

*Future Saga Chapter DLCs can be purchased separately. Please take care to avoid duplicate purchases.
*Some of the above contents can be obtained by clearing certain conditions in the game.
*Content will be available by 9/30/2026.

70070000031603.name: Capybara Zen Purification Edition
70070000031603.intro: A meditation game with a capybara, cleansing music, and breathing!
70070000031603.description: Meditate, breathe, and relax with an adorable capybara, a kitten, and a new, additional soundtrack.

70070000031605.name: Spy Guy Chicago Edition
70070000031605.intro: Venture to Chicago with Spy Guy.
70070000031605.description: Discover Spy Guy Hidden Objects Deluxe Edition with a new, additional map that will take you to Chicago.

70070000031608.name: Sailing the winds & New Tanks
70070000031608.description:
This bundle brings together two contrasting worlds, offering the perfect experience whether you're in the mood for a peaceful getaway or an adrenaline rush.

Sailing The Winds is an adventure simulator that blends exploration with fishing. Step into the shoes of an adventurer on a quest to help a friend find his missing father, navigating an archipelago with a pirate past.

New Tanks is a fast-paced action game that delivers non-stop excitement.

70070000031630.name: Vampires and Knights : Eclipse Survival & Magic Craft – Armor of Legends
70070000031630.intro: Armor up and face relentless shadowed enemies.
70070000031630.description:
The kingdom is shrouded in darkness, cursed by a powerful sorcerer and haunted by deadly vampires. Solar eclipses cast shadows over the land, and brave knights must rise to survive the night.

This bundle combines the full Vampires and Knights : Eclipse Survival & Magic Craft experience with the Tools of Survival DLC, giving you everything you need to face the growing threat.

Included in this bundle:
- The Full Game – Explore cursed lands, craft weapons, build fortifications, and engage in epic battles against vampires and other dark creatures.
- Tools of Survival DLC – Start your journey with essential gear appearing near the player: Level 1 Helmet and Level 1 Armor, giving you an early advantage in survival and combat.

Step into the cursed fog, gather your courage, and fight for the kingdom’s survival. Every night is a test, every battle shapes your legend, and every dawn brings new hope.

70070000031639.name: Capybara Zen Good Vibrations
70070000031639.intro: Meditation and breathing game bundled with a music player and a dedicated new songs
70070000031639.description:
Capybara Zen will help you relax, clear your mind, breathe and forget about stress.

Together with the adorable capybara and her kitty friend, indulge in meditation. Listen to the music, breathe, turn off your head and focus on yourself - here and now!

In addition, the game includes an option to listen to the music itself along with a bonus songs.

70070000031641.name: Spy Guy American Dream
70070000031641.intro: Grab your dreams and set off on the journey of life!
70070000031641.description:
Set off with Spy Guy to America! Discover American maps full of hidden objects. Search for them on the American prairie, bridges, cities, and especially in Chicago!

Spy Guy American Dream features over 500 hidden objects, 3 game modes, and lots of fun!

70070000031652.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Road Legends
70070000031652.intro: Turn every highway into your runway of speed and style.
70070000031652.description:
Feel the ultimate rush of high-speed street racing! Dive into Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator, where precision and speed are your best allies navigating busy city streets — and unlock the exclusive Drive in Color DLC to customize your ride like never before.

This bundle includes:
- Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator - the full base game with realistic driving physics, intense traffic challenges, and multiple game modes to test your skills.
- Drive in Color DLC - featuring three fresh new paint jobs — bold blue, striking pink, and sleek turquoise — to customize your rides and stand out on the streets.

Dominate the highways in style and speed. Choose your car, choose your color, and race like never before. One bundle. Infinite rush.

70070000031657.name: Pocket Nook Breath of Summer Edition
70070000031657.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000031657.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

Relive sunny days with Summer Tiki Party DLC included in this bundle.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000031658.name: BROK the InvestiGator + The Brawl Bar
70070000031658.intro: Investigate by day, brawl by night!
70070000031658.description:
Get two complementary games set in the BROK universe at a reduced price !

This bundle includes:

BROK THE INVESTIGATOR – The world’s first Punch & Click! A unique adventure mixing classic storytelling and investigation with beat’em up action. Play as Brok, a private detective and former boxer, in a cyberpunk world where animals have replaced humans. Solve puzzles, uncover conspiracies, and fight your way through danger in a branching story with multiple endings.

BROK: THE BRAWL BAR – A standalone party beat’em up built on BROK’s combat system. Take on a variety of challenges, face waves of enemies, and enjoy local multiplayer with friends. Along the way, discover complementary story elements that expand the BROK universe.

- Two full games at a reduced price
- Experience a story-driven adventure and an action-focused beat’em up featuring the same characters
- Local co-op supported in both the main adventure and The Brawl Bar
- A great entry point into the BROK universe.

70070000031659.name: BROK Complete Bundle
70070000031659.description:
Get all three games set in the BROK universe at a reduced price. Together, they represent the full BROK journey: story, action, and heart.

This bundle includes:

BROK THE INVESTIGATOR – The world’s first Punch & Click! A unique adventure mixing classic storytelling and investigation with beat’em up action. Play as Brok, a private detective and former boxer, in a cyberpunk world where animals have replaced humans. Solve puzzles, uncover conspiracies, and fight your way through danger in a branching story with multiple endings.

BROK: THE BRAWL BAR – A standalone party beat’em up built on BROK’s combat system. Take on a variety of challenges, face waves of enemies, and enjoy local multiplayer with friends. Along the way, discover complementary story elements that expand the BROK universe.

BROK: NATAL TAIL SPECIAL – A festive visual novel prequel. Follow Graff and Ott as they take part in “Natal Untail,” a twisted version of Atlasia’s ancient tradition. Discover a heartfelt tale of sharing and friendship, with interactive choices made specifically for consoles.

- Three full games at a reduced price
- Enjoy adventure, narration and beat’em up action
- Text fully localized in 9 languages
- The complete BROK experience!

70070000031661.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Tides of Power Collection
70070000031661.description:
Tides of Power Collection* includes:
• 2 new leaders: Edward Teach, Sayyida al Hurra
• 4 new civilizations: Tonga, Republic of Pirates, Ottomans, Iceland
• 4 new Wonders: Great Lighthouse, Nan Madol, Great Blue Hole, Mapu'a Vaea Blowholes

Explore new possibilities for your personalized empire with post-launch paid add-on content of the Tides of Power Collection! Embody two new leaders: Edward Teach and Sayyida al Hurra. Lead four new civilizations: Republic of Pirates, Tonga, Ottomans, and Iceland. Discover the majesty of four new Wonders: Great Lighthouse, Nan Madol, Great Blue Hole, and Mapu'a Vaea Blowholes.

70070000031671.name: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Deluxe Edition
70070000031671.intro: A new era of hyperdimensional football will see online battles ignite the world!
70070000031671.description:
The "INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Deluxe Edition" is a value package which adds the following bonus content to the base game.

■ Package Contents:
- Base Game
- Choose-a-Character Crate
- Bond Object: Football Club Room (Raimon)
- Bond Object: Rai Rai Noodles (Inazuma Town)
- Promise Pendant (equipment that boosts EXP gained)
- Victory Jump! (Goal Celebration)

*For more details on the bonuses included with each edition, visit the official website.

O smoldering clouds, let INAZUMA's lightning split the sky!

The newest title in the hyperdimensional football RPG series "Inazuma Eleven" is finally here!
A new story featuring a new protagonist, over 5,400 characters to collect and train, as well as an intense competitive mode; there is no shortage of activities to enjoy!

■ Story Mode
This new story takes place 25 years after the first Inazuma Eleven.
In search of a world without football, protagonist Destin Billows enrolls at South Cirrus Junior High. Meanwhile, within the prestigious Raimon Junior High - renowned as the top team in the nationals - rises a Football Monster named Harper Evans.
When these two cross paths, a tale begins to unfold...

■ Chronicle Mode
A roster spanning over 5,400 characters from previous entries in the series!
Relive past Inazuma Eleven matches with Victorio, the boy who came from the future.
Take on various teams, collect and train characters, and build your ultimate dream team!

■ Bond Station (Kizuna Station)
Freely arrange nostalgic objects from the Inazuma Eleven series to create your own "Bond Town"!
Customize your avatar, invite friends over and enjoy socializing and playing matches together!
Your custom made avatar can also be used in matches!

■ The Ultimate Anime Experience Brought to Life by MAPPA
In-game anime cutscenes were made in cooperation with animation studio MAPPA!
With the longest anime runtime in the series' history, the story's intensity will reach new heights.

70070000031681.name: Knights & Guns Arcane Arsenal
70070000031681.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000031681.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 6 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000031683.name: Knights & Guns Mystic Armor
70070000031683.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000031683.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 20 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 11 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000031695.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru & Maywinner Edition
70070000031695.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000031695.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Lord Maywinner DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 2 legendary boxers - Lord Maywinner and Masaru with their unique equipment and a bonus of 43000 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2: Remastered allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000031702.name: Cooking Arena World Tour Edition
70070000031702.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000031702.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Pancake Bar Tycoon", "Sushi Time!", "Salad Bar Tycoon" and "Kebab Bar Tycoon".

70070000031717.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: The Ultimate Survivor’s
70070000031717.intro: Prepare your raft, prepare your arsenal.
70070000031717.description:
Embark on the ultimate swamp survival adventure with this bundle! Navigate murky waters, craft your raft, and transform a simple floating platform into a thriving sanctuary.

This bundle includes:
- Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build – Explore the swamp, gather resources, craft tools, fish for food, purify water, and expand your floating haven. Face tangled vegetation, treacherous waters, and relentless crocodiles as you test your survival skills.
- Legendary Arms DLC – Equip your raft with revamped weapons: a gleaming sword, a robust spear, and a carved club. Take on the swamp’s dangers with style, power, and unmatched immersion.

Features:
- Craft, upgrade, and expand your raft to survive the wild.
- Master fishing, purifying water, and hunting in the swamp.
- Defend your sanctuary against crocodiles and other threats.
- Unlock new weapon designs and enhance your combat capabilities.
- Immerse yourself in a fully upgraded survival experience.

Face the swamp’s mysteries fully prepared and discover the true depths of your resilience — all in one complete survival package!

70070000031723.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? - Final Answer Edition
70070000031723.intro: THE MOST COMPLETE EDITION OF THE GAME, EVER!
70070000031723.description:
The Final Answer Edition includes all question packs released since 2020, plus the Deluxe Upgrade, which unlocks the QUICK and NO TIMER modes for an optimal playing experience.
Also included are 13 brand-new, exclusive question packs, bringing the total to over 12,000 questions!

New packs include: 
- Mythology
- 80s Music
- 90s Music
- 2000s Music
- Ancient Egypt
- Ancient Greek and Roman Civilizations
- Racing
- Inventors and Inventions
- Monuments and Wonders
- Stars and Celebrities
- TV Series
- World War II
- US Movies from the 2000s

70070000031724.name: Johnny Trigger: Triple Rebel Edition
70070000031724.intro: Looking for definitive action? Here’s Johnny!
70070000031724.description:
Johnny Trigger - International Man of Mayhem!

This bundle includes:
- Johnny Trigger
- Johnny Trigger: Lunatic DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Hunter DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Butcher DLC

Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends.

Do you have what it takes to bring down the underground world of the mafia?
“Less talk, more bullets” - that’s Johnny’s motto as he runs, jumps, spins, slides and keeps on shooting till every bad guy’s bitten the dust.

Dive straight in and get shooting! Johnny Trigger’s short but immensely satisfying levels make it the perfect action game to fill a short break.
And if you’ve got a little more time, there’s so much to collect and a new challenge round every corner.

Features:
- 3 new skins: Lunatic, Butcher and Hunter
- 3 new weapons: Showtime, Vengeance and Triforce
- 3000 additional gemms to buy other currencies
- 150 additional puzzles to unlock more comic graphics
- 40 additional keys to open locked doors in base
- 50 additional hammers to unlock another upgrades in base

So what are you waiting for? Those bad guys aren’t going to beat themselves, you know.

70070000031729.name: Cozy Gardener Simulator & House Renovator Simulator
70070000031729.intro: Grow colorful gardens and craft welcoming living spaces.
70070000031729.description:
Discover the joy of relaxation and creativity with this bundle! Whether you prefer bringing beauty and harmony to a lively small town or transforming abandoned houses into dream homes, this bundle offers two unique and heartwarming experiences.

1. Cozy Gardener Simulator
Step into the role of the town’s gardener and caretaker. Plant, water, and nurture vibrant gardens, mow overgrown lawns, and bring charm to every street corner. Meet townsfolk, complete wholesome quests, and enjoy calm, pressure-free gameplay.

2. House Renovator Simulator
Grab your tools and give forgotten homes a second life. Demolish walls, renovate interiors, paint, decorate, and design each space in your own style. With realistic mechanics and a wide selection of materials, every renovation becomes a success story.

Why choose this bundle?
- Two complementary games combining relaxation and creativity.
- Rewarding experiences: from cultivating nature’s beauty to renovating homes.
- Freedom to design, create, and transform at your own pace.

With the Cozy Gardener Simulator & House Renovator Simulator Bundle, every day brings new opportunities to craft warmth and beauty around you.

70070000031739.name: Storm Tale 2 & Ancient Relics: Adventure Bundle
70070000031739.intro: Test your Match-3 skills in an epic adventure in Storm Tale 2, alongside Griffri the wizard, as Ancient Relics: Egypt takes the genre to extraordinary new heights.
70070000031739.description:
*** Storm Tale 2 ***
Sharpen your sword and take up your bow - it’s time to fight back a powerful sorcerer and his mighty dragon. Join Griffri, the wizard, on a quest to not only rebuild his village, but to put an end to the perilous reign of evil that threatens the realm. Play bonus mini-games with cool 3D hidden object scenes and jigsaw puzzles. Beat the obstacles and win many trophies on your journey through this addictive match 3 game. Bring the peace back to this fabulous land. Are you ready for an adventure?

*** Ancient Relics: Egypt ***
Embark on an extraordinary journey through time in "Ancient Relics - Egypt", an immersive match-3 adventure set in the captivating world of Ancient Egypt. Solve challenging Match-3 puzzles to gather precious gold and rebuild a once-thriving village to its former glory. Unearth priceless power-ups hidden within the Pharaoh's tomb, as you delve deeper into the ancient secrets. Be strategic and make every move count to overcome the pharaoh's dark and ancient magic. Can you conquer the puzzles, save the village, and put an end to the Pharaoh's fury? The fate of Egypt rests in your hands.

70070000031743.name: Serial Killers & Zombies: Horror Bundle
70070000031743.intro:
Two nightmares.
One bundle.
Can you survive them both?
70070000031743.description:
Two complete horror games. One deadly challenge.

This bundle brings together Zombie Survival and The Ripper: Serial Killers, offering two different takes on survival horror for players who enjoy tension, danger, and dark atmospheres.

In Zombie Survival, the threat is everywhere. You must endure relentless undead attacks, manage scarce resources, and fight to stay alive as the world collapses around you.

In The Ripper: Serial Killers, the danger is more personal. Face a chilling psychological hunt where every step forward could bring you closer to the killer or to becoming the next victim.

Whether you prefer chaotic survival against the undead or a tense battle of nerves against a human predator, this bundle delivers hours of horror driven gameplay at a reduced price.

Survive both nightmares.
Or let them consume you.
Ready to play?

70070000031744.name: Anime Romance Collection: 3 Game Bundle
70070000031744.intro:
Three anime romances.
One irresistible bundle.
Which girl will catch your heart?
70070000031744.description:
Three complete anime romance games. One charming collection.

This bundle brings together Yandere Anime Girlfriend: The Mean Waifu Sim, Cozy Earth: Hawaii Island Love Anime GIRLS, and K-pop Idols Dating: Anime Love, offering three different anime inspired romance experiences focused on charm, personality, and connection.

Meet expressive anime girls with very different attitudes. Some are sweet and relaxed, others confident and intense, and others shine with idol-like charisma. 

Each game invites you into a distinct setting, from tropical islands to stylish pop culture scenes, where conversations and choices shape every interaction.

Progress through light visual novel gameplay, unlock new moments, and discover how each girl reacts as you get closer. 

Attraction builds over time, personalities unfold naturally, and every experience offers its own tone and rhythm.

Whether you enjoy cozy romance, playful tension, or glamorous anime dating, this bundle delivers hours of engaging anime love stories at a reduced price.

Three games.
Three styles of romance.
One bundle to enjoy.

Play now!

70070000031745.name: Anime Romance Boys Collection: 3 Game Bundle
70070000031745.intro:
Three anime romances.
One irresistible bundle.
Which boy will steal your heart?
70070000031745.description:
Three complete anime romance games. One charming collection.

This bundle brings together Yandere Anime Boyfriend: A Day with Your Husbando Sim, Cozy Earth: Hawaii Island Love Anime BOYS, and K-pop Idols Dating: Anime Love for B.SeveT, offering three different anime-inspired romance experiences centered on charm, personality, and emotional connection.

Meet expressive anime boys with very different attitudes. Some are calm and affectionate, others confident and intense, and others shine with idol like charisma that draws you in from the first encounter.

Each game takes you to a distinct setting, from relaxing tropical islands to stylish pop culture scenes, where conversations and choices shape every interaction.

Progress through light visual novel gameplay, unlock new moments, and discover how each boy reacts as your bond grows stronger.

Attraction develops over time, personalities unfold naturally, and every experience offers its own tone and rhythm.

Whether you enjoy cozy romance, playful tension, or glamorous anime dating, this bundle delivers hours of engaging anime love stories at a reduced price.

Three games.

70070000031752.name: Spy Guy Halloween
70070000031752.description:

Over 700 hidden objects, 360 levels, and 3 game modes!

70070000031757.name: My Cozy Room Relaxation Zone Edition
70070000031757.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000031757.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Create your own relaxation zone with Zen DLC included in this bundle. 

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000031758.name: 20 in 1 Family Games Mega Collection
70070000031758.intro: 20 games, one epic collection — fun for everyone!
70070000031758.description:
The 20 in 1 Family Games Mega Collection brings you a huge variety of fun-packed games—from fast-paced racing and exciting action challenges to strategic puzzles and classic games. 

Non-stop entertainment with an exciting mix of games, simple controls, vibrant graphics, and endless replayability. Ideal for family game nights, casual play, or friendly competition, this bundle delivers incredible value for money. 

Whether you're looking for a quick challenge or a full-on gaming session, this bundle has you covered! Don't just play - create memories together! Bundle includes:

70070000031760.name: DRAGON QUEST - HD-2D Erdrick Trilogy Collection
70070000031760.description:
- The Nintendo Switch™ version of the Erdrick Trilogy Collection includes the Nintendo Switch™ version of DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake and the Nintendo Switch™ version of DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake.
There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of the collection available, which contains DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake for Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please ensure you check the contents of the collection before purchasing.

Three legendary adventures. One definitive bundle.
Get the complete Erdrick Trilogy that includes DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake and DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake at a discounted price.
Immerse yourself in the adventure of a lifetime with these three masterpieces.

DRAGON QUEST III
Years ago, the great hero Ortega bid farewell to his wife and child as he set off on a quest to defeat the villainous Archfiend, Baramos. Ortega failed his quest, and Baramos still threatens the world.
Now, on their 16th birthday, Ortega’s only child is summoned by the king of Aliahan and entrusted with a mission of the highest import: to take on Ortega’s quest, vanquish Baramos and save the world.

DRAGON QUEST I
Thanks to the heroic efforts of the legendary Erdrick, the Lord of the Underworld was defeated and peace returned to the land of Alefgard. Yet this peace was not to last, as the diabolical Dragonlord has risen and unleashed hordes of monsters on the realm once more. Now, descendant of Erdrick, it is your destiny to defeat this new evil and rescue the world from its plight!

DRAGON QUEST II
Many years have passed since Alefgard was saved at the hero's hand, earning him the same title as his storied forebear. The descendants of this Erdrick and his scions founded three kingdoms that thrived in peacetime. Yet, darkness stirs once more and a sudden invasion of malicious monsters plunges the world into shadow again. All that stands between the forces of evil and their wicked ambitions is a band of young princes and princesses of Erdrick's lineage. The time has come for them to venture forth and honor their ancestor's legacy!

70070000031772.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Elite Combat
70070000031772.intro: Gear up, move fast, and dominate the battlefield.
70070000031772.description:
Experience the full intensity of tactical combat with this ultimate bundle, designed for elite operatives ready to take on any challenge.

Bundle includes:
- Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions — Lead your squad through heart-pounding hostage rescues and fast-paced firefights in this thrilling first-person tactical shooter.
- Combat Gloves DLC — Unlock exclusive tactical gloves that enhance your grip and style on the battlefield, or receive the equivalent in-game currency to upgrade your gear.

Gear up, strategize, and dominate every mission with precision and professionalism. Are you ready to become the ultimate SWAT hero?

70070000031779.name: Crazy Goose Simulator: Chaos Edition
70070000031779.intro: Honk loud, flap harder, cause havoc!
70070000031779.description:
Double the chaos, double the fun! Get ready for the ultimate goose-filled adventure with this bundle.

What’s included in this bundle:
- Crazy Goose Simulator – Take control of a mischievous goose and roam freely through quirky environments. Honk, flap, and prank your way through hilarious scenarios while completing entertaining objectives.
- New Skybound DLC – Transform the skies above every level with vibrant, dynamic landscapes. Soar through whimsical clouds, enjoy stunning sunsets, and make your goose antics even more epic!

Whether you’re a seasoned honker or a feathered newcomer, this bundle delivers hours of outrageous fun, spectacular sights, and sky-high mischief!

70070000031784.name: Suicide Guy Bundle
70070000031784.description:
All the Suicide Guy games are now available on Nintendo Switch™ in one mega bundle!
Experience the full trilogy of the indie hit Suicide Guy in a single, dream-filled collection:

- Suicide Guy
- Suicide Guy: Sleepin' Deeply
- Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams

Dive into the bizarre and extraordinary dreams of our clumsy hero — this time, you'll have to save not one, not two, but three beers!.

Features:

• Physics-based puzzles and levels
• Hilarious creatures to mess with
• Powerful “ultimate moves”: grab, throw, activate, and even burp your way through dreams
• Drive all sorts of crazy vehicles

Use all your skills to wake him up!
Despite the title, this game series is NOT about suicide or depression — it’s a light-hearted, funny, and surreal adventure that will keep you smiling till the end.

70070000031785.name: Woodle Tree Bundle
70070000031785.description:
This bundle contains the first two set of Woodle Tree videogames!

Woodle Tree Adventures
is an old school platform game with a catchy and unique art style! Explore a total of 6 worlds and save the lands with the magical water drops you'll find through your journey, bringing back peace and balance and finally becoming the new hero!


Woodle Tree 2: Worlds
is an open world platformer/adventure game. This time the forces of evil are taking over the Wood Lands with a black substance that is absorbing energy and life from the living creatures! Will you be able to take over this enormous new evil force?

70070000031786.name: MEGA SIMULATOR BUNDLE - Forest Ranger Life Simulator / Primitive Life Simulator / Gladiators Simulator: The Champions of Liberty / Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight
70070000031786.intro: Explore, survive, fight, and soar through four epic worlds.
70070000031786.description:
Four different worlds, one ultimate bundle of thrilling experiences. From the serenity of hidden forests and the struggle for survival in the Stone Age, to the blood-soaked arenas of Ancient Rome and the heart-pounding rush of wingsuit flight—this bundle takes you on a journey through time, nature, and pure adrenaline.

Included Games:
	•	Forest Ranger Life Simulator – Reclaim the Wild
Step into the role of a forest ranger, restore forgotten landscapes, care for wildlife, and protect nature’s treasures.
	•	Primitive Life Simulator
Travel back to prehistoric times—hunt, gather, craft, and build your tribe to survive the unforgiving wilds.
	•	Gladiators Simulator: The Champions of Liberty
Enter the deadly arenas of Rome, manage fighters, and battle for honor, power, and freedom.
	•	Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight
Leap into the skies and master extreme wingsuit flights across breathtaking landscapes.

Why this bundle?
- Unique adventures – nature, survival, history, and extreme sports.
- Diverse gameplay – from crafting and exploration to combat and high-speed flight.
- A complete journey – from the ground of ancient forests to the endless skies.

Step into the adventure bundle and live four unforgettable worlds in one epic collection!

70070000031791.name: Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator – The Racer’s Journey
70070000031791.intro: Drive, drift, and dominate – your garage, your legacy!
70070000031791.description:
Get the ultimate street racing experience with this bundle! Featuring the full game Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games and two exciting DLCs, this collection delivers speed, power, and limitless customization.

Bundle Includes:
- Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games – The adrenaline-fueled 3D car racing simulator where you can build, tune, and race your dream cars. Compete in online multiplayer, master drag and drift challenges, and prove yourself as a street racing legend!

- Street Drag Racing: Rise of GELENVAGEN (DLC) – Unlock the beastly GELENVAGEN and dominate the streets or off-road tracks. Upgrade, customize, and push this powerful machine to its limits for the ultimate performance. Already own it? You’ll receive full coin compensation!

- Street Drag Racing – Garage Expansion (DLC) – Add the legendary Lamborghini Huracan to your garage and take street racing to the next level. Tune, paint, and master this supercar, or receive its in-game cash value if it’s already in your collection.

Take control, challenge rivals worldwide and rise as the king of drag racing. With realistic sounds, over 30 cars, and endless tuning options, this bundle is the perfect package for every racing fan!

70070000031797.name: Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle – Dominant Predator
70070000031797.intro: Hunt longer, roam farther, survive stronger.
70070000031797.description:
Experience the full power of the African savannah with survival bundle! Step into the paws of the king of the jungle and explore vast landscapes, hunt diverse prey, and lead your pride with strategy and skill.

Bundle Highlights:
- Lion Simulator Survival: RPG Animal Battle: Roam expansive ecosystems, experience realistic lion behavior, sharpen your hunting skills, and manage your pride while surviving the challenges of the wild.
- Strength of the King DLC: Enjoy double health and stamina, making your lion stronger and more enduring in every hunt, chase, and territorial battle.

Dominate the savannah like never before, where every hunt and every challenge tests your strength, strategy, and survival instincts.

70070000031802.name: Ball Blast: Halloween Edition
70070000031802.intro: Dodge falling rocks and blast them all!
70070000031802.description:
A wild rain of bouncing rocks crashes down - move fast, blast faster!

Every rock has a number - hit it that many times and boom! it splits into two rocks with half the number and double the speed, turning the field into fast-moving chaos!

Play solo or with a friend for double firepower. Beat hundreds of levels, survive endless waves, and climb the world leaderboard!

Pick up coins and unlock new cannons: a wide-spread shotgun, a boomerang that swings back and spinning saw blades that slice through rocks as they fall. Upgrade power-ups like a piercing laser beam, explosive drones, and huge shockwaves to wipe out waves in a flash!

Features:
- 3 New Halloween Maps: Blast your way through Haunted Castle, Candy Land and Vaporwave map!
- CO-OP: Team up with a friend and fend off the falling rocks together!
- Online Leaderboards: Survive as long as you can and get the best score in the world!
- Powerful Cannons: Choose between basic, shotgun, boomerang, and saw cannons!
- Devastating powers: Buy and upgrade powerful abilities to destroy everything!
- Special Levels: Defeat epic bosses and protect the bridge from destruction!
- 6 Extra Cannon Boosters: Amplify your firepower!
- 15 Boomerang Shards
- 10 Shock Wave Shards
- 10 Laser Shards
- 2500 gems: Spend extra gems on crates, fresh shards, and more power-ups!
- Replayability: Complete hundreds of unique levels and challenges!

The rocks won’t stop bouncing - are you ready to keep blasting?

70070000031805.name: Pets and Friends Christmas Bundle
70070000031805.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of christmas themed stickers.
70070000031805.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new christmas themed stickers to add variety to your album.

70070000031807.name: Run Sausage Run!: Hella Weenies Edition
70070000031807.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000031807.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 9 new skins (Brain Monster, Eye Monster, Xray Monster, Angel, Astronaut, Devil, Caveman, Witch, Teacher)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000031813.name: Little Strays: Havana
70070000031813.intro: Pounce into Havana’s alleys and give every stray kitten a happy ending.
70070000031813.description: Step into the paws of a fearless feline in an action-packed arcade adventure built for one or two players. Explore streets, sun-drenched rooftops, and hidden corners across 6 brand-new levels in Havana City. Scavenge for food, rescue frightened kittens, and outsmart every obstacle in a race against time. With 22 total levels and a thrilling split-screen mode, team up with a friend or face off head-to-head to save the most strays. The city needs a hero! Will it be you?

70070000031815.name: Twins of the Sun: Legacy Edition
70070000031815.intro: Join the twins and their youngest sibling on a fast, fierce, action-packed adventure.
70070000031815.description:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through wild lands, lush jungles, haunted mines, and ancient temples. Join the twin heroes as they set out to rescue their kidnapped sister, and take control of the youngest sibling, whose innocent gaze and small stature hide a fierce, unstoppable spirit. Fast, fearless, and armed with a unique weapon, she’s ready to prove she can stand on her own.

Play solo or team up in 2-player local co-op, face powerful enemies, and shape a brand-new story.

70070000031819.name: Bridge Race: Horror Edition
70070000031819.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70070000031819.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

This bundle includes:
- Bridge Race
- Bridge Race: Spooky DLC
- Bridge Race: Funny DLC

NEW VERSUS MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Compete with your friends in an exciting head-to-head split-screen showdown. Choose your custom color and unique skin, set the number of rounds, and let your building skills shine. Earn points each round based on your finish, and see who rises to the top of the leaderboard. Ready to show off your skills and claim victory? 

Features:
- 8 additional skins to show off your style!
- 20000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition—who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000031821.name: Atari 50: Game + DLC Bundle
70070000031821.description:
The Atari 50: Game + DLC Bundle gives you access to the full Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration game plus the following DLC packs:

- DLC 1: The Wider World of Atari
- DLC 2: The First Console War
- DLC 3: THE NAMCO LEGENDARY PACK

70070000031822.name: Atari 50: DLC Bundle
70070000031822.description:
The Atari 50: DLC Bundle gives you access to the the following DLC packs:

- DLC 1: The Wider World of Atari
- DLC 2: The First Console War
- DLC 3: THE NAMCO LEGENDARY PACK

70070000031824.name: Hunt or Hunted Bundle
70070000031824.intro: The perfect bundle for Metroidvania fans. Whether it's spearing lizards into walls or absorbing attacks from fleshhounds, you must fight for your life.
70070000031824.description:
I like GRIME. What's Rain World?

You're a simple creature-- the slugcat. You're small. Delicious. Nimble but fragile. Ingenious but distractable. You need to eat to survive but there's also something pulling you away from your home. Asking more of you and demanding you follow it across the industrial waste that was once a bustling world. Can you find it? Or will you be devoured as just another meal?

I like Rain World. What's GRIME?

Everything around you is flesh and stone but you are different-- you have nothingness, a void, a hunger that can never be sated. You can absorb all of the mass you've ever wanted and it will never be enough. The only thing that can satisfy you is knowledge. But to learn the secrets of this surreal world, you will need to push beyond what you ever thought possible.

70070000031825.name: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 Legendary Edition
70070000031825.description:
The Legendary Edition includes:
• ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4
• Character Pass
- Character Pack 1: Whole Cake Island Pack
- Character Pack 2: Worst Generation Pack
- Character Pack 3: Land of Wano Pack
- Charlotte Katakuri Early Unlock
• Character Pass 2
- Character Pack 4: The Battle of Onigashima Pack
- Character Pack 5: One Piece Film: Red Pack
- Character Pack 6: Legend Dawn Pack
- Onigashima Battle Law Costume (Character Pass 2 Bonus)
• Character Pass 3
- Character Pack 7: Future Island Egghead Pack
- Character Pack 8: Special Selection Pack
- Shanks Additional Special Move "Divine Departure" (Character Pass 3 Bonus)
• Additional Episodes Pack
- Additional Episode 1: Yamato's Grand Tour Logbook & Soul Map 1
- Additional Episode 2: Koby's Combat Chronicle & Soul Map 2
- Additional Episode 3: Path to the King of the Pirates & Soul Map 3

The PIRATE WARRIORS series has successfully combined the popular anime ONE PIECE with the thrilling action of the WARRIORS series to create a worldwide phenomenon selling more than four million copies! Based on the concept of fighting hordes of enemies while adventuring with trusted allies, experience awesome ONE PIECE action lifted straight from the anime!

ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 is the latest evolution of PIRATE WARRIORS action! Based on the concept of experiencing a real ONE PIECE battlefield, buildings will come crashing down during the action and attacks will throw up smoke and dust, placing you in the thick of the ONE PIECE world! Injecting fresh elements that couldn't be achieved in previous entries has now realized an even more thrilling brand of PIRATE WARRIORS action!

*The items included in this set can also be purchased individually. Please take care to avoid overlapping purchases.

70070000031827.name: Skyline Bowling: Spooky Edition
70070000031827.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000031827.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 3 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Halloween Balls - Equip 3 new spooky bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 150K coins and 1K gems to buy and upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000031829.name: Oblivion Dreams: Spooky Edition
70070000031829.intro: Peek into haunting visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble the spirit of Halloween.
70070000031829.description:
Piece together creepy fragments of imaginary worlds, where pumpkins glow and monsters hide around every corner. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the darkness - will you uncover what remains, or fade into the night?

Features:
- 64 atmospheric images inspired by spooky dreams and dystopian landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the spooky mood.

Every solved puzzle is like a treat... no tricks included.

70070000031832.name: Tropico 6 - Dictators Delight Edition
70070000031832.description:
The Tropico 6 – Dictator’s Delight Edition includes:
•	Tropico 6 – Nintendo Switch™ Edition
•	Tropico 6 – Caribbean Skies DLC
•	Tropico 6 – Festival DLC
•	Tropico 6 – Lobbyistico DLC
•	Tropico 6 – Spitter DLC
•	Tropico 6 – The Llama of Wall Street DLC

The Tropico 6 - Nintendo Switch™ Edition includes an exclusive palace design, the captivating flamingo pond, something every dictator craves to impress his neighbouring states and a tourist costume for El Prez to enjoy those warm caribbean nights adequately.

Features:
• Play on large archipelagos for the first time in the series. Manage multiple islands at the same time and adapt to various new challenges.
• Send your agents on raids to foreign lands to steal world wonders and monuments, to add them to your collection. 
• Build bridges, construct tunnels and transport your citizens and tourists in taxis, buses and aerial cable cars. Tropico 6 offers completely new transportation and infrastructure possibilities.
• Customize the looks of your palace at will and choose from various extras.
• Tropico 6 features a revised research system focusing on the political aspects of being the world’s greatest dictator. 
• Election speeches are back! Address the people and make promises that you can’t possibly keep.


In times of political turmoil and social unrest, the people are calling for visionary leaders, who will steer the fate of their country with foresight and ingenuity. Prove yourself once again as a feared dictator or peace-loving statesman on the island state of Tropico and shape the fate of your nation through four distinctive eras. Face new challenges on the international stage and always keep the needs of your people in mind. 

For the first time in the series, manage extensive archipelagos, build bridges to connect your islands and use new means of transportation and infrastructure. Send your Tropicans on raids to steal the wonders of the world, including the Statue of Liberty and the Eiffel Tower. Customize your palace at will and give election speeches from your balcony, to win the favor of your subjects.

70070000031852.name: Cottonville Winter Whispers Edition
70070000031852.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000031852.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

Prepare for cold days with Winter Outfits Pack included in this bundle.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000031861.name: Neko Bento 2 Cozy Feast Edition
70070000031861.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70070000031861.description:
Say hello to Neko Bento 2 — a flavor-packed puzzle experience where lunch is still cute, but now even trickier to pack!

This time your favorite feline chef is back with even more riddles to solve! You thought you knew it all? Think again because these levels with brand new ingredients and shapes will put your spatial brain to the test.

Although the challenge has risen, you don’t have to worry too much about that. You may have as much time as you like to complete a puzzle.

What will Neko Bento 2 serve you?
- Over 90 levels to eat up.
- 29 various ingredients to organize - pay attention to their shapes, it’s crucial…
- Music track that will help your mind focus and lock in!
- Artwork that will win your taste over… and not only the music one.

This bundle includes the Chef's Dream 2 DLC, featuring even more levels to complete.

Chefs tend to be impatient, so don’t wait for too long and become the ultimate bento master!

70070000031866.name: Too Many Clothes Edition
70070000031866.description:
Fashion Without Limits!

POPUCOM: Too Many Clothes Edition includes the following contents: 

POPUCOM base game
The [Too Many Clothes Pack] DLC
[Hairstyle]: Back-Slicked Hair, Morning Dew, Frenzied Rhythm, Machinist Goggles
[Attire]: Birdiepuff Down Jacket, Russet Autumn Breeze, Metal Storm, Brass Age
[Footwear]: Shadow Force, Rocky Trail, Shattered Soundwave, Difference Engine

*Note: Corresponding DLC is required to use these paid cosmetic items.

70070000031870.name: Urban Car Driver Simulator: City Explorer Challenge – Racer
70070000031870.intro: Experience ultimate speed and precision in every ride.
70070000031870.description:
Explore the vibrant streets of Sunny Island City and take your garage to the next level with an exclusive high-performance vehicle.

Bundle Includes:
- Urban Car Driver Simulator: City Explorer Challenge – Navigate bustling avenues, iconic landmarks, and dynamic neighborhoods while mastering traffic, challenges, and missions. Customize your driving experience and sharpen your skills in a realistic urban playground.
- Thunderbolt Flux DLC – Add the Thunderbolt Flux to your garage and experience unmatched speed, precision, and style. If you already own the car, you will receive the cash recompense – 145,000 coins.

Take your Urban Driver Simulator journey to the ultimate level with this all-in-one bundle!

70070000031874.name: Pocket Nook Spooky Edition
70070000031874.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000031874.description:
Boo! The spooky season is here, bringing the all-new Halloween DLC included in this bundle!

Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.


Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000031877.name: Asphalt Legends -- Porsche Bundle
70070000031877.intro: Two Porsches. Legendary performance. Unmistakable style.
70070000031877.description:
Available now! You can get the Porsche Panamera Turbo S and Porsche 911 turbo 50 years.

This pack includes:
- 1 Key to unlock Porsche Panamera Turbo S
- 55 Porsche 911 turbo 50 years Blueprints
- 1,000 Tokens
- 1,000,000 Credits

70070000031899.name: Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Luxe & Lounge
70070000031899.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000031899.description:
Love cooking games? Manage 9 distinct kitchens, craft over 500 dishes, and rise to culinary stardom across 1000+ fast-paced levels in Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire. Customize your home, unlock trophies, and bring the heat!

From street food to sushi, each kitchen will test your time-management skills as you work to satisfy impatient customers and hit your goals. But it’s not all about the kitchens—customize and upgrade your home to showcase your achievements, unlock trophies, and build a true empire!

Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Can you handle the heat and build your own cooking empire?

Key Features:

9 Unique Cuisines: Master a range of cooking styles and menus.
500+ Dishes: A global selection of recipes to perfect.
1000+ Levels: Challenge yourself with increasingly complex kitchens.
Home Customization: Upgrade your furniture and earn trophies to showcase your progress.
Fun & Fast-Paced: Simple to play, with endless hours of culinary excitement!

This bundle contains the base game and DLC#2- Cozy Living, with:
- new set of furniture for your Living Room!

70070000031900.name: Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Cozy Corners
70070000031900.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000031900.description:
Love cooking games? Manage 9 distinct kitchens, craft over 500 dishes, and rise to culinary stardom across 1000+ fast-paced levels in Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire. Customize your home, unlock trophies, and bring the heat!

From street food to sushi, each kitchen will test your time-management skills as you work to satisfy impatient customers and hit your goals. But it’s not all about the kitchens—customize and upgrade your home to showcase your achievements, unlock trophies, and build a true empire!

Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Can you handle the heat and build your own cooking empire?

Key Features:

9 Unique Cuisines: Master a range of cooking styles and menus.
500+ Dishes: A global selection of recipes to perfect.
1000+ Levels: Challenge yourself with increasingly complex kitchens.
Home Customization: Upgrade your furniture and earn trophies to showcase your progress.
Fun & Fast-Paced: Simple to play, with endless hours of culinary excitement!

This bundle contains the base game and DLC#3- Creative Desk, with:
- new set of furniture for your Office!

70070000031911.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X Deluxe Edition
70070000031911.description:
[Game Overview]  
A *roguelite action game* set in the BLAZBLUE universe, featuring striking 2D visuals, stylish, fast-paced combat, and precise, responsive controls.
Command a line-up of unique characters from the renowned BLAZBLUE franchise and dive into an unparalleled action experience.
[Story]
At a mysterious domain, known as “the Lab”,a group of elite researchers race to save a collapsing word; however, despite their efforts to date, Dr. Mercurius, head of the laboratory, still warns the world’s downfall is near.
In a last-ditch effort, the urgent *Research of Possibility* initiative seeks to collect *Shards of Possibility*—a special fragment of the world that could forestall the seemingly inevitable destruction.
These shards lie within the *Sea of Possibility*, a realm between worlds, beyond the bounds of reality.
Our protagonist, *Ace*, is the only being capable of diving into this sea.  
Guided by the elite researchers at *the Lab*, Ace descends again and again in pursuit of salvation—until strange visions take hold and his body begins to change.
As Ace continues to dive, countless memories flood his mind, and the truth behind the collapsing world—and the research itself—begins to surface....
“……The Power of Azure.” 

[Deluxe Edition Contents]

*Blazblue Entropy Effect X – Standard Edition*
