70070000031924.name: Shadowforge Chronicles: War of Legends
70070000031924.intro: Rise through darkness and claim your glory.
70070000031924.description:
Step into a dark fantasy world where magic and weaponry are your only allies against ancient forces of evil. With this bundle, you not only get the full Shadowforge Chronicles experience, but also an exciting DLC that enhances your journey and gives you a powerful head start.

What’s included:
- Shadowforge Chronicles: Immerse yourself in a mysterious kingdom consumed by dark magic. Explore forgotten lands, battle relentless enemies, and harness a unique blend of magical abilities and deadly weapons. Every decision, every battle, and every spell shapes your adventure.
- Gold Bonus DLC: Instantly receive 2,000 coins to boost your resources and gain the freedom to upgrade weapons, enhance magical abilities, and prepare for the relentless battles ahead. Use your coins to unlock rare gear, purchase essential items, and experiment with different combat strategies to dominate your foes.

Step into the darkness stronger, richer, and more prepared than ever. Your adventure just got a powerful head start—explore, fight, and conquer!

70070000031926.name: Pets and Friends Forest Bundle 2
70070000031926.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of forest themed stickers.
70070000031926.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new forest themed stickers to add variety to your album.

70070000031928.name: Spy Guy Christmas
70070000031928.intro: Make yourself a gift and buy a detective game for Christmas!
70070000031928.description:
Spy Guy is the perfect game for any occasion! Take on the role of a detective and search for hidden objects on various maps in three modes. 
For Christmas, we have created a set that will not only reveal the Christmas map included in the main game, but also take you on a journey to different cities! It's a unique gift you can give yourself for Christmas and beyond!

70070000031930.name: Clue: Crime Scene Collection 2
70070000031930.intro: Includes Noir Mansion, two future crime scenes, and Legacy Suspect Pack!
70070000031930.description:
Take on a case fit for the silver screen in Noir Mansion, then get ready for two more crime scenes yet to come! Plus, enjoy the Legacy Suspect Pack on launch for more characters to play with. 

INCLUDES:
NOIR MANSION – Includes the Noir Mansion board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a sleek dice set and 12 new tokens
FUTURE CRIME SCENE #1 – Coming soon…
FUTURE CRIME SCENE #2 – Coming soon…
LEGACY SUSPECT PACK – Includes 12 new tokens featuring additional suspects. Coming soon…

70070000031931.name: Clue: Crime Scene Collection 1
70070000031931.intro: Includes Whispering Pines Retreat, the Black Adder Resort, Polar Research Station, the 2016 Suspect Pack and revisited case files
70070000031931.description:
Manifestation and murder await at Whispering Pines Retreat. The Black Adder Resort promises relaxation and revenge. Meanwhile, someone’s on thin ice at the Polar Research Station…

The Clue mystery continues in this epic bundle of crime scenes and cosmetics! 

Unlock Whispering Pines Retreat, the Black Adder Resort, Polar Research Station, 2016 Suspect Pack and revisited case files in this amazing bundle – exclusively on Nintendo Switch™! 

The Black Adder Resort 
Mr Callan Coral, a former business partner of Mr Boden “Boddy” Black, has invited everyone suspected of his business associate’s murder to lie low on his tropical island. However, things take a turn for the worse when they once again find themselves at the heart of another murder mystery!

The Black Adder Resort: Case File Revisited #1
A bonus addition to the Black Adder Resort crime scene! A hyacinth blooms in death once more, bringing shades of gray to the Black Adder Resort crime scene! Agent Gray and Analyst Hyacinth join the suspect roster, but are either of them the real culprit? Or has the true murderer dragged them in to muddy the waters? 

Whispering Pines Retreat
The calm, quiet solitude of Whispering Pines Retreat makes it the ideal location for relaxation…and revenge. A new story unfolds as a group of six supposed strangers seek refuge in the brand-new forest wellness centre, but things take a dreadful turn when they become entangled in a shocking crime…

Polar Research Station
At the frozen ends of the Earth, a cold-blooded murder unfolds! Venture to the frozen outpost of the Polar Research Station and figure out which of the six snowed-in suspects murdered Mr Boden ""Boddy"" Black, with what and in which room.

2016 Suspect Pack
You asked, we delivered – the iconic 2016 Clue characters make their grand return to the digital board game. With twelve tokens to choose from, you can add a touch of timelessness to your next game of Clue! 

INCLUDES:
- THE BLACK ADDER RESORT – Includes the Black Adder Resort board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a snake dice set and 12 new tokens
- THE BLACK ADDER RESORT: CASE FILE REVISITED #1 – Includes two new suspects and four more tokens
- WHISPERING PINES RETREAT – Includes the Whispering Pines Retreat board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a leafy dice set and 12 new tokens
- POLAR RESEARCH STATION – Includes the Polar Research Station board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, an icy dice set and 12 new tokens
- 2016 SUSPECT PACK – Includes 12 new tokens featuring the 2016 Clue cast

70070000031950.name: Flames of Damnation: Survival Instinct
70070000031950.intro: Step into hell stronger, faster, and unstoppable.
70070000031950.description:
Step into the relentless, adrenaline-pumping world of Flames of Damnation, where classic 90s shooter action collides with modern mechanics. Face hordes of demonic enemies, master lightning-fast strafe-jumping, and wield a unique arsenal of infernal weapons as you fight for survival in richly detailed, hellish environments.

This bundle includes:
- Flames of Damnation – Experience fast-paced combat, epic boss battles, and exploration in a dark, infernal world.
- Survival Boost DLC – Increase your maximum health from 100 to 200 units, giving you the resilience to endure intense battles and survive longer in hellish encounters.

Step into hell stronger, more prepared, and ready to dominate every encounter. Your fight for survival has never been more epic.

70070000031953.name: Chubby Pixel Mega Bundle
70070000031953.intro: All Chubby Pixel games in one bundle!
70070000031953.description:
All the Chubby Pixel games are now available on Nintendo Switch™ in one mega bundle!
Experience the full trilogy of the indie hit Suicide Guy and Woodle Tree Adventures in a single, dream-filled collection:

- Suicide Guy
- Suicide Guy: Sleepin' Deeply
- Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams
- Mai: Child of Ages
- Woodle Tree Adventures
- Woodle Tree 2: Dexlue+

Dive into the bizarre and extraordinary dreams of our clumsy hero — this time, you'll have to save not one, not two, but three beers!

Features:

• Physics-based puzzles and levels
• Hilarious creatures to mess with
• Powerful “ultimate moves”: grab, throw, activate, and even burp your way through dreams
• Drive all sorts of crazy vehicles

Use all your skills to wake him up!
Despite the title, this game series is NOT about suicide or depression — it’s a light-hearted, funny, and surreal adventure that will keep you smiling till the end.

70070000031954.name: Retro Horror Bundle
70070000031954.intro: The ultimate horror duo - jump or blast to survive!
70070000031954.description:
Double the fun with the Retro Horror Bundle, featuring Lorn’s Lure and Nightmare Reaper! 
Switch between an intense boomer shooter and challenging parkour gameplay, all wrapped in timeless pixel aesthetics.

LORN'S LURE:
Leaving his home colony while tracking a mysterious glitch, an android finds himself in the midst of a vast and dangerous structure, completely hidden from his people’s knowledge. Unable to go back, you must keep going to find out where he is being led… And why he left in the first place.

FEATURES:
▪ BACK TO THE PAST - retro ‘90s PC graphics with a modern flair,
▪ DIVE INTO THE STORY - uncover the mysterious lore as you traverse the world,
▪ CHALLENGE YOURSELF - jump, climb, slide, and scan your way around obstacles, using simple mechanics,
▪ SOAK IN THE ATMOSPHERE - discover the dark, horror, foreboding world,
▪ SKY’S THE LIMIT - with no “parkour ledges”, climb almost any vertical wall face using your pickaxes,
▪ TOUGH, BUT FAIR - mistakes can be frustrating, but you won't be punished by having to redo lengthy sections. Just keep climbing!
▪ CHANGE THE PACE - alternate between peaceful moments that let you take in the sights and thrilling fast sections.

NIGHTMARE REAPER:
A dark and violent meld of retro and modern action games, inspired by the classic 2.5D first-person shooters of the 90s, with elements of modern looter shooters and roguelites.
Intense and addictive gameplay
Tons of enemies are crammed in open-ended levels full of surprises, geysers of blood, and treasure.

You rise to prevent her doom
and duke it out with nightmares
to reap salvation in blood.

FEATURES:
▪ That’s progress! - Use the gold you find to purchase tons of character upgrades and new abilities via minigames.
▪ Choice Paralysis - Gather 80 unique weapons containing a funky mix of attributes randomized from over 30 enchantment types.
▪ Necrotic Optimism - Unleash carnage to the tune of music and audio by the great Andrew Hulshult.
▪ Memory Hole - Uncover a non-intrusive but mysterious story.
▪ More Than a Nightmare - Explore many game modes, and pick the one you like.
▪ Dream Logic - Progress through the nightmarescapes that mix manual and random level generation.
▪ Digging Up Memories - Enjoy tons of random events and find all the secrets.
▪ Soundtrack by the great Andrew Hulshult.

70070000031955.name: Racing Simulator Bundle: Driving School Simulator & Real Driving Simulator
70070000031955.description:
This bundle includes two games: Driving School Simulator and Real Driving Simulator.

Driving School Simulator
Learn to drive with over 150 vehicles, including sports cars, SUVs, sedans, supercars, hypercars and hatchbacks. Explore diverse maps, complete career lessons and master the road rules. Play solo or join friends online in Free Ride and Multiplayer races!

Real Driving Simulator
Drive more than 80 vehicles across a massive open world set in Europe, featuring 20+ cities to explore. Experience realistic interiors, authentic engine sounds and dynamic weather. Complete races, off-road missions and driving challenges with detailed damage and full tuning options.

70070000031959.name: Tavern Talk Complete Edition
70070000031959.intro: Immerse yourself in the mysterious and wonderful world of Asteria with this Complete Edition including Tavern Talk, the AOC "Tempest Tantrum" and the costume pack "Pirate Palooza".
70070000031959.description:
Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of Tavern Talk with the Complete Edition.

Play as the Innkeeper in Tavern Talk, a cozy visual novel where you run a tavern in a D&D-inspired fantasy! Gather rumors, serve magical drinks, and meet adventurers on a life-changing quest.

This edition comes with the AOC "Tavern Talk: Tempest Tantrum", a wholesome tale set after the events of Tavern Talk with roughly three hours additional game time. Meet Fable's long-suffering brother along with familiar characters from the main game. 

Also included is the costume pack "Pirate Palooza" that offers pirate-themed outfits for your favorite detective-outlaw-duo: Melli and Zephir! Ready for their adventures out on the roaring sea—or wherever the quest board in the Wayfarer’s Inn leads them.

70070000031960.name: Ecchi Secrets: Chilling Edition
70070000031960.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls
70070000031960.description:
Beneath every fog lies temptation... and danger. Outsmart your enemies and peel back the mystery to reveal anime girls waiting just for you.
The further you go, each secret you uncover brings you closer to their hidden desires. But be warned: the path to pleasure is full of challenges. Are you bold enough to unveil every surprise?
Features:
- Over 30 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- 16 new pictures of flirtatious girls ready for a date
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes

70070000031962.name: MFC – Midnight Fight Club: Path to Glory
70070000031962.intro: Equip, upgrade, and dominate like a champion.
70070000031962.description:
Step into the intense world of professional mixed martial arts with MFC - Midnight Fight Club, and take your fighting career to the next level with the Cash Power DLC. Experience thrilling battles, dynamic combat, and realistic physics, while instantly boosting your resources to dominate the leagues faster than ever.

What’s included:
- MFC - Midnight Fight Club – The full game with dynamic combat, epic boss fights, and customizable fighters.
- MFC - Midnight Fight Club: Cash Power – 500,000 in-game cash  added to your account to upgrade stats, unlock gear, and gain a competitive edge.

Unleash your full potential, upgrade instantly, and claim victory!

70070000031968.name: Real Truck Simulator USA & Ultimate 4x4 Offroad & Real Car Driving Simulator Bundle
70070000031968.intro: Trucks, offroad vehicles, and luxury cars – hours of fun await!
70070000031968.description:
Take your driving skills to the next level with this driving simulator bundle, featuring three incredible experiences. Whether you crave the thrill of long-haul trucking, extreme off-road challenges, or high-speed luxury cars, this collection has it all!

1. Real Truck Simulator USA Car Games - Driving Games, Parking Sim, Car Speed Racing 2022
Become an authentic American truck driver and transport cargo across the USA. Navigate highways, farmland, and desert roads with precision while upgrading your truck and completing challenging transport missions. Manage fuel, maintenance, and cargo carefully to succeed in a realistic economy and dynamic day-night world. Explore new states and cities as you grow your trucking career.

2. Ultimate 4x4 Offroad Trucks :Car Racing Driving Simulator 2022
Get ready for the ultimate off-road adventure! Drive powerful 4x4 trucks through hills, mountains, and extreme terrains. Test your skills on 30 challenging tracks across 3 open-world environments. Customize your vehicles, experience dynamic weather effects, and tackle thrilling trials or freeride challenges. Perfect for adrenaline junkies and off-road enthusiasts!

3. Real Car Driving Simulator & Parking 2022 Games
Experience the joy of driving luxury cars in vast open-world maps. Improve your skills through challenges, explore new environments, and enjoy realistic driving mechanics with authentic engine sounds and interiors. High-speed driving and parking challenges make every ride exciting and immersive.

Why Choose This Bundle:
- All-in-one driving adventure: trucks, offroad, and luxury cars
- Explore diverse terrains and cities with unique vehicles
- Upgrade, customize, and master every ride
- Hours of immersive driving fun for all types of car enthusiasts

Take control of your wheels, conquer the roads and trails, and experience the ultimate driving adventure with this bundle!

70070000031971.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.17
70070000031971.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the seventeenth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Kittens’ Day
- Views of Mt. Fuji
- Blooming Tables
- [Moving] The Four Seasons of Japan

70070000031973.name: Twins of the Sun: Master Collection
70070000031973.intro: Join the twins’ adventure and test your skills in the battle Arena.
70070000031973.description:
Two siblings. One mission. A kidnapped sister to rescue. This colorful action-adventure blends fast-paced hack-and-slash combat with a story about courage, teamwork, and family. Explore 25 handcrafted stages, swap between the twins or play in local co-op, and face memorable enemies and epic bosses in a vibrant, family-friendly world.

The DLC expands the adventure with Challenge Mode and the Arena, introducing tougher trials and endless enemy waves. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op as you push your skills to the limit and fight for survival.

70070000031981.name: Maze: Path of Light - Dusk Edition
70070000031981.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70070000031981.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths-experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

Features:
- 5 new constellations with 36 additional mazes
- Creative Level Design: Conquer 4 maze types - square, circular, triangular, and hexagonal
- 5 Unique Challenges: Classic, Portal, Token, Limited Moves, Timed and Dark Mazes!
- Power-ups: 3 helpful powers to help you find your way
- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70070000031982.name: Treasure Drop: Gold Edition
70070000031982.intro: Don’t let your treasure leave the dome. Merge it together, and create the biggest fortune!
70070000031982.description:
Get ready for a treasure-filled adventure beneath the waves! Merge coins and gems to uncover riches beyond imagination!

This bundle includes:
- Treasure Drop
- Treasure Drop: Open Sea DLC
- Treasure Drop: Algae Valley DLC

Features:
• Online leaderboards to show off your score!
• Co-op mode to play and merge together!
• Versus mode to challenge your friends!
• 4 maps with unique shapes!
• 10 new character skins - otters and sea monkeys!
• 12 new accessories!
• 5 exciting power-ups that can change everything!
• Fully customizable name and character
• A bright and dazzling underwater look!

Discover maps that change how you play, each with its own unique shape and background. Can you master them all and merge the biggest treasure?

CO-OP mode
Play together locally inside one dome and collect points as a team! Merge treasures, grab power-ups, and try to reach the highest score side by side.

VERSUS mode
Challenge a friend locally! The dome is split in half - one side for you, one side for your opponent. If one player overfills their dome and items spill out, the other has only a few seconds left to score as many points as possible before the game ends!

Catch amazing power-ups as they float to the surface and use them whenever you want:
- Bomb: Explodes and pushes everything away
- Pearl: Merges with any treasure
- Ruby Curse: Makes treasure even more valuable
- Eruption: Destroys all stones
- Specter: Lets your treasure pass through obstacles

Swim to the top and rule the leaderboard!

70070000031986.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE ULTIMATE EDITION
70070000031986.intro: Experience the EVOLUTION of Xtreme Battle!
70070000031986.description:
This product bundle includes:
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SPECIAL BLADER PACK
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SEASON PASS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
The BEYBLADE ACTION game that faithfully recreates the world of BEYBLADE X arrives with three powerful evolutions! Witness EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

■ Evolution 1: EVOBATTLE
Your strategy changes dramatically depending on your Bey type. Attack Type specializes in offense, Stamina Type absorbs the opponent’s stamina, Defense Type activates shields for solid protection, and Balance Type boosts attack power through combos! Experience thrilling high-speed Battles that demand skill and precision! Challenge Bladers around the world in online matches!

■ Evolution 2: EVOSTORY
New allies await—compete, grow, and chase your dreams together in the ultimate BEY BATTLE ROYALE (BBR)!

■ Evolution 3: EVOCUSTOMIZE
Customization reaches new heights! Collect materials to coat your Beys in your favorite colors, enhance your favorite parts, and choose X Skills to create the perfect Beys for your Battle style!


A special set to dive deeper into the world of BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE!
Carefully selected items for the Blader who seeks their own unique Beys and ultimate strength!

Contents:
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE XP & PRIZE MONEY BOOST KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE PART DROP +1 EXPANSION KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING ITEM SET
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING SHOP EXPANSION KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING PATTERN & COLOR EXPANSION KIT


Additional Beys Explode Onto the Scene! Get 14 Beys!

*DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER is scheduled to be distributed sequentially.
*Unreleased Beys cannot be used until they are distributed.
 
Contents:
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SEASON PASS BONUS
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER VOL.1

BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER VOL.3
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER METAL COAT

70070000031987.description:

Contents:

BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER VOL.3
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DIGITAL BEYBOOSTER METAL COAT

70070000031991.name: Little Strays: Beyond Havana
70070000031991.intro: The journey continues in the shadows of Havana.
70070000031991.description:
Step into the paws of a brave stray cat on a heartfelt mission to rescue lost kittens and survive in a world that’s been left behind. Explore 16 warehouse levels where you’ll scavenge for food, overcome obstacles, and protect the smallest and most vulnerable. Every step and every meow matters.

This bundle includes the Havana Expansion, featuring two bright new city maps full of colorful rooftops, narrow alleys, and hidden courtyards to explore. Discover new secrets and kittens in need throughout these lively streets.

Customize your hero with new coat colors and patterns, and experience the adventure with a brand-new soundtrack.
Play solo or challenge a friend in two-player split-screen every rescue counts.

70070000031998.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE DELUXE EDITION
70070000031998.intro: Experience the EVOLUTION of Xtreme Battle!
70070000031998.description:
This product bundle includes:
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SPECIAL BLADER PACK
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
The BEYBLADE ACTION game that faithfully recreates the world of BEYBLADE X arrives with three powerful evolutions! Witness EVOBATTLE, EVOSTORY, and EVOCUSTOMIZE!

■ Evolution 1: EVOBATTLE
Your strategy changes dramatically depending on your Bey type. Attack Type specializes in offense, Stamina Type absorbs the opponent’s stamina, Defense Type activates shields for solid protection, and Balance Type boosts attack power through combos! Experience thrilling high-speed Battles that demand skill and precision! Challenge Bladers around the world in online matches!

■ Evolution 2: EVOSTORY
New allies await—compete, grow, and chase your dreams together in the ultimate BEY BATTLE ROYALE (BBR)!

■ Evolution 3: EVOCUSTOMIZE
Customization reaches new heights! Collect materials to coat your Beys in your favorite colors, enhance your favorite parts, and choose X Skills to create the perfect Beys for your Battle style!


A special set to dive deeper into the world of BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE!

Contents:
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE XP & PRIZE MONEY BOOST KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE PART DROP +1 EXPANSION KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING ITEM SET
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING SHOP EXPANSION KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING PATTERN & COLOR EXPANSION KIT

70070000031999.name: Cozy Memory Deluxe Edition
70070000031999.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000031999.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes Covers Pack with extra colorful cards.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000032000.name: Rail Route - Complete Edition
70070000032000.intro: Rail Route - Complete Edition: Includes the base game, soundtrack, and two DLCs!
70070000032000.description:
Rail Route - Complete Edition will take your love for railway management to the next level!
This premium collection includes the base game, the mesmerizing official soundtrack, and two game-changing expansions: Happy Passengers DLC and the Map Pack DLC, offering even more ways to master the art of automation and strategic rail design.

Rail Route - Base Game 
Start with a simple network and transform it into a sprawling, fully automated railway empire! Whether you’re planning efficient routes, upgrading infrastructure, or optimizing train schedules, every decision impacts the flow of your network.

The Official Soundtrack & Music Player
Immerse yourself in the atmospheric compositions of Rupert Cole, a soothing mix of neoclassical piano and string melodies designed to keep you calm amidst the controlled chaos of railway management.

Happy Passengers DLC – Your Riders, Your Responsibility
Now, it’s not just about moving trains, it’s about moving people. Introducing passenger satisfaction as a core mechanic in Endless Mode, adding a whole new layer of challenge and strategy.
- The Survey Office – Monitor passenger demands and fine-tune your network accordingly.
- Passenger Expectations – Stations now have unique demand patterns, making every decision matter.
- New Rewards – Deliver stellar service and earn additional stars for your efficiency!

Map Pack DLC – Expand Your Rail Empire
Take on 15 additional maps, ranging from real-world-inspired locations to mind-bending, fictional challenges. Whether you're looking for relaxed experimentation or the ultimate test of your dispatching skills, this map collection has it all.

All aboard for the ultimate railway experience!

70070000032002.name: BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE SPECIAL BLADER PACK
70070000032002.description:
A special set to dive deeper into the world of BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE!
Carefully selected items for the Blader who seeks their own unique Beys and ultimate strength!

Contents:
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE XP & PRIZE MONEY BOOST KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE PART DROP +1 EXPANSION KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING ITEM SET
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING SHOP EXPANSION KIT
BEYBLADE X EVOBATTLE BEY COATING PATTERN & COLOR EXPANSION KIT

70070000032012.name: Tales of Berseria Remastered Deluxe Edition
70070000032012.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Tales of Berseria Remastered
• Battle BGM Pack
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
• Super Growth Support Herb Set

Tales of Berseria returns with enhanced playability and quality-of-life enhancements!

Engage in the ultimate quest for self-discovery, remastered for the first time. The sacred kingdom awaits the arrival of its savior, and a lone woman named Velvet is marked by traumatic deceit. Join Velvet on her journey for vengeance, along with her cast of eccentric companions, as they sail through the archipelago which comprises the kingdom of Midgand.

• A Tale of Emotion Versus Reason
Let emotions guide your destiny, or maintain order with the power of reason. Witness the eternal struggle between the head and the heart as Velvet is challenged to stand by her convictions while the world around her compresses into a system of order.

• An Exhilarating Combat System
Freely choose Artes to suit your playstyle and perform a variety of combos. Collect enemy Souls to unleash a barrage of attacks for a thrilling battle experience.

• A Modern, High-Quality Retelling
Useful features like destination markers and the ability to disable enemy encounters make traversing the islands of Midgand all the more enticing. Visit the famous Grade Shop from the game's opening. Get a smooth play experience only found in this remaster!

• Access DLC from the First Iteration
This version features several DLC from the original 2016 version. A treasure trove of content awaits you, such as outfits for your characters from the previous Tales Of games along with useful equipment for your travels.

*A Standard Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000032014.name: Tales of Berseria Remastered - Deluxe Upgrade Pack
70070000032014.description:
The Deluxe Upgrade Pack includes:
• Battle BGM Pack
• Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
• Super Growth Support Herb Set

*A Deluxe Edition is also available. Be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000032036.name: Motel Owner Simulator – Empire Builder
70070000032036.intro: Build bigger facilities and grow your motel empire.
70070000032036.description:
Step into the world of hospitality management with Motel Owner Simulator and give your business a head start with the included The Investor’s Gift DLC. Build, decorate, and expand your motel while managing every detail to satisfy your guests and maximize profits.

This bundle includes:
- The full Motel Owner Simulator game – design interiors, run your business, expand your property, and become the top choice in the region.
- The Investor’s Gift DLC – receive 50,000 cash to accelerate your progress, invest in upgrades, and grow your empire faster.

Whether you’re a new manager or a seasoned strategist, this bundle gives you everything you need to succeed and dominate the motel industry.

70070000032037.name: Astro Duel Deluxe + Astro Duel 2
70070000032037.description:
Astro Duel 2 blurs the line between space shooter and platform fighter. Whether versus or co-op, prepare to fight in space and on foot at the same time! Strike within the fully-destructible arenas or just nuke ‘em from orbit.

BATTLE THROUGH GRAVITY AND SPACE
Pilot an elite Nano Fighter that lets you smoothly transition between space flight and ground combat. Enter gravity zones to instantly absorb your ship and switch controls to platforming action.

GAME FEATURES
• Battle in Versus Mode with up to 6 players and full bot support
• Work together in Bounty Mode, a 1 to 3 player co-op adventure
• Defend or steal the safe as a team in Cash Grab, then buy equipment between rounds
• Use heavy cannons or lasers to annihilate threats in space, and slash or shoot as a Pilot to stop rogues on land
• Uncover a solar system stretched thin and ready to be exploited

Astro Duel Deluxe is a fun, frenetic local multiplayer party game for 1 to 6 players! Prepare for a fierce battle: rounds are quick and death is sudden. Blast your friends into space. Run over their helpless bodies for good measure.

FEATURES:

• Battle up to 6 players or add any combination of AI Ships.
• Run over pilots in Pilot Hunters mode, battle for the most kills in Ship Hunters, or join forces in Team Annihilation!
• Arm your ship with offensive and defensive powerups including missiles, lasers, jousters and shields.
• Dynamic arenas provide a host of hiding places and hazards. Avoid turrets, death beams, and black holes or you're dead!
• Party mode – Ships can only turn in one direction! A true "Astro Party" experience.
• Mix up play with Game Modifiers. Enable asteroids, starting powerups, unlimited dash, and so much more!

70070000032038.name: Electronics Puzzle Lab 1 & 2 Collection
70070000032038.intro: Awaken your inner engineer with 3D puzzles inspired by electronic circuitry!
70070000032038.description:
Awaken your inner engineer with the brainteasing circuitry of Electronics Puzzle Lab! In this fun and educational 3D puzzle game, your task is to inspect circuit boards and make adjustments to power LED lights. Take a seat at your workbench, cut wires, flip switches and more as you trace the path of the current.

This collection contains 2 games:

Electronics Puzzle Lab
Electronics Puzzle Lab 2

70070000032039.name: Need for Race Street King & Formula Auto Sport Racing Pack
70070000032039.intro: From the streets to the circuit - master them both.
70070000032039.description:
Two Worlds. One Obsession - Pure Speed.

From the neon-lit chaos of underground street racing to the high-precision circuits of elite Formula competitions, this bundle unites two adrenaline-charged racing experiences for true speed enthusiasts.

In Need for Race - Street King, you rise from the backstreets to the big leagues. Tune, upgrade, and dominate every city race as you climb toward legend status.

In Formula Auto Sport Racing, precision is everything. Manage every turn, every pitstop, and every second as you battle to master the fastest machines on Earth.

Key Features
 • Two unique racing experiences - street & Formula
 • Deep car customization and performance tuning
 • Realistic driving physics and responsive controls
 • AI opponents that adapt to your skills
 • Dozens of tracks across vibrant cities and iconic circuits

Feel the engines roar, chase the perfect line, and claim your place among racing’s elite.
Two paths. One passion. The race never ends.

70070000032040.name: Boxville Collection
70070000032040.description:
Step into the hand-drawn universe of Boxville — a charming series of puzzle adventures about friendship, courage, and creativity. Explore beautifully animated cardboard cities, meet quirky can residents, and solve clever environmental puzzles to uncover the stories hidden inside every box.


What’s Inside:

Boxville
Discover the original award-winning adventure that started it all. Follow a tin can named Blue Can as he searches for his lost friend across a city built entirely from cardboard and everyday objects.

Boxville 2
Continue the story in a brand-new journey filled with deeper puzzles, expanded environments, and even more breathtaking handmade visuals. Team up with new characters, uncover mysteries, and restore harmony to the city once again.

Key Features
-Hand-painted visuals
-Dozens of original puzzles and mini-games
-Peaceful, dialogue-free storytelling
-Immersive music and ambient sound design
-Family-friendly gameplay with artistic charm


Experience the Whole Story
The Boxville & Boxville 2 Bundle brings both games together — perfect for players who want to enjoy the complete Boxville universe from start to finish.

Explore. Think. Feel.
Every box hides a story — and now you can open them all.

70070000032056.name: Digging A Hole 2025: Premium Edition
70070000032056.intro: Dig deeper. Discover more. Adventure awaits.
70070000032056.description:
Embark on an exciting journey into the hidden depths of your backyard and experience the underground world like never before! This bundle combines the full Digging A Hole 2025 experience with the Skybox Overhaul DLC, enhancing your adventure with a richer, more atmospheric world that feels alive with every dig.

Included in this Bundle:
- Digging A Hole 2025 – Dig, discover, and trade your way through layers of earth in search of hidden treasures and ancient secrets.
- Skybox Overhaul DLC – Experience stunning weather effects and a transformed skybox that make your world come alive with rain, storms, and atmospheric beauty.

Discover a world where every dig tells a story — and every storm reveals something new.

70070000032059.name: Tavern Talk + Pirate Palooza (Costume AOC)
70070000032059.intro: Immerse yourself in the mysterious and wonderful world of Asteria with this bundle including Tavern Talk and the costume pack AOC "Pirate Palooza".
70070000032059.description:
Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of Asteria with this bundle.

Play as the Innkeeper in Tavern Talk, a cozy visual novel where you run a tavern in a D&D-inspired fantasy! Gather rumors, serve magical drinks, and meet adventurers on a life-changing quest.

Also included is the costume pack "Pirate Palooza" that offers pirate-themed outfits for your favorite detective-outlaw-duo: Melli and Zephir! Ready for their adventures out on the roaring sea—or wherever the quest board in the Wayfarer’s Inn leads them.

70070000032078.name: Neko Ramen Solo Edition
70070000032078.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!
70070000032078.description:
It's time to try ramen like you've never had before! Filled with delicious aromas, Neko Ramen will stimulate your logical thinking and ignite your senses!


Fulfill ramen orders under the guidance of a true master – the one and only feline chef! Each ramen is a perfectly calculated arrangement of flavors and shapes, so strain your brain to accommodate all the ingredients! But be careful, because intense thinking can be as spicy for the mind as ramen itself!


The orders will become increasingly sophisticated and difficult (but also more delicious). However, you don't have to worry about that, as you have as much time as you want to prepare the dish!


Here's what you'll find on the Neko Ramen menu:
- Over 90 scrumptious levels!
- 29 ingredients to compose perfect dishes.
- Music that will make you want ramen yourself.
- And charming graphics that stimulate both the eyes and the taste buds!

This bundle includes Chopstick Finesse 2 DLC with even more delicious levels to complete.

Do not wait, because even though the ramen will not get cold, the cat chief may not be so forgiving!

70070000032080.name: Ozymandias - Complete Edition
70070000032080.intro: This bundle includes Ozymandias and all its DLCs.
70070000032080.description:
List of included DLCs:
- Indus Valley
- Near East
- Mesoamerica
- Indonesia
- Aegean Sea 
- The Andes
- Sahara Desert
- The World

70070000032088.name: Ecchi Numbers: Complete Edition
70070000032088.intro: Fill her grid and reveal the picture.
70070000032088.description:
Think you’ve got the skills to go all the way? Fill in the right positions and slowly clear away the puzzle—revealing more than just your brainpower.

Every number brings you closer to the full picture. Get it right, and you’ll uncover a beautiful picture waiting just beneath the surface... but one wrong move and you might just ruin the mood.

Features:
- 116 beautiful girls looking for company
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Take your time, plan your moves, and finish strong.

70070000032094.name: CybeRage: Storm Edition
70070000032094.intro: Survive endless waves of alien creatures and crush the heart of the infestation!
70070000032094.description:
Phy embarks on a secret mission to an abandoned planet infested by a hostile hivemind. With the help of her partner Lizz and General Eral, she dives into the depths of the infestation and learns the dark truth behind its origins. Help her find the heart of the hive and put an end to this evergrowing threat.

Kill hordes of nasty bugs and use the experience gained to strengthen your arsenal and body with cybernetic enchantments. The hive will adapt and send more powerful enemies to stand in your way. Shoot them down with your army of drones, or slash them to pieces with your blade and stop the hivemind from growing even stronger!

Features:
- Engaging story: Accompany Phy in her quest against the hive
- Side stories: Explore a new metro line and discover unique locations
- Immersive world: Experience 24 hand-crafted cyberpunk levels
- High-tech arsenal: 11 fighter drones to upgrade and evolve
- Melee weapons: 6 powerful swords with unique active abilities
- Rogue-lite progression: Unlockable permanent augments
- Contracts: Complete tasks to earn credits

Will you help Phy defeat the hive and save the cyber age from impending doom?

70070000032099.name: ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Survival Journey
70070000032099.intro: Uncover hidden horrors beyond the light.
70070000032099.description:
Step into a world where darkness never ends and reality itself twists against you. In the this bundle, every hallway hides new terrors, and every shadow could be your last. Navigate endless corridors filled with flickering lights, damp carpets, and creatures that lurk just out of sight.

Bundle Includes:
	•	ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR (Base Game)
Enter the labyrinthine nightmare of the Backrooms, where no two rooms are the same. Experience suffocating dread, haunting encounters, and a first-person survival horror adventure that will test your courage at every turn.

	•	ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Eternal Light DLC
Illuminate the darkness with a flashlight that never runs out of power, revealing hidden horrors and allowing you to explore deeper into the maze. Will the light guide your survival—or simply expose more nightmares?

	•	ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Unlimited Camera Vision DLC
Descend further into the Backrooms with a night vision camera that never dies. See what hides in the shadows, observe the unseen, and gain a strategic advantage—but beware, some secrets are better left alone.

Combine all three to experience the ultimate Backrooms nightmare, where fear, light, and vision collide—can you survive long enough to escape?

70070000032100.name: Mystery and Magic - Escape Room Bundle
70070000032100.intro:
Two escape room games are included! 
Secrets of Blackrock Manor - Escape Room and Mystic Academy: Escape Room.
70070000032100.description:
This bundle includes two escape room games:

*Secrets of Blackrock Manor - Escape Room
*Mystic Academy: Escape Room

SECRETS OF BLACKROCK MANOR - ESCAPE ROOM
Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?

70070000032101.name: Exploration Escape Room Bundle
70070000032101.intro: Four escape room games included! Mystic Academy: Escape Room, Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room, Secrets of Blackrock Manor: Escape Room, Between Time: Escape Room.
70070000032101.description:
This bundle includes four escape room games:

*Mystic Academy: Escape Room
*Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
*Secrets of Blackrock Manor: Escape Room
*Between Time: Escape Room

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?

PYRAMIDS AND ALIENS: ESCAPE ROOM
Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid to find your missing mentor. As an intrepid explorer, solve puzzles, investigate clues, and unravel the pyramid's secrets. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

SECRETS OF BLACKROCK MANOR - ESCAPE ROOM
Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...

BETWEEN TIME: ESCAPE ROOM
You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you must travel through time, explore mysterious places, and solve puzzles to obtain untold treasures. Will you come back alive?

70070000032102.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Shovel Knight Music Pack
70070000032102.intro: Dig into the OFFICIAL Shovel Knight Music Pack!
70070000032102.description:
Featuring FIVE new Rhythm Rifts by Jake Kaufman:
- "La Danse Macabre (Lich Yard)"
- "Strike the Earth! (Plains of Passage)"
- "In the Halls of the Usurper (Pridemoor Keep)"
- "High Above the Land (The Flying Machine)"
- "An Underlying Problem (The Lost City)"

As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift: 
"Main Theme" by Jake Kaufman. Available now for everyone!

Each Shovel Knight Rhythm Rift features:
- The chivalrous Shovel Knight
- Background visualizer with custom particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

70070000032116.name: Airport Manager Simulator 2025: Ultimate Takeoff
70070000032116.intro: Experience the rhythm of a living airport.
70070000032116.description:
Take your airport management experience to the next level! Step into the world, where you oversee every aspect of a bustling international airport, from passenger logistics and baggage handling to coordinating aircraft services and ground operations.

Bundle Includes:
- Airport Manager Simulator 2025 – Full airport management simulation with dynamic challenges and immersive gameplay.
- Beyond the Clouds DLC – Transform your airport under ever-changing skies, from bright sunrises to stormy evenings, adding realism, atmosphere, and a touch of magic to every flight.

Upgrade your airport operations and enjoy the full experience, where every day feels fresh, immersive, and alive under a living sky.

70070000032123.name: Cyber Car Seller Simulator: Elite Dealership
70070000032123.intro: Build your ultimate cyber car empire.
70070000032123.description:
Experience the ultimate cyber car adventure! Step into the neon-lit world of cyber car commerce and take your dealership to new heights!

With this bundle, you’ll get:
- The full Cyber Car Seller Simulator - Scout futuristic vehicles, negotiate the best deals, enhance them with cutting-edge modifications, and sell them for a massive profit.
- Credits of Power DLC - Add 500,000 in-game coins to your account and accelerate your rise in the neon-lit world of cyber car commerce.

Buy, modify, and sell futuristic vehicles, upgrade your showroom, and dominate the cyber car market faster than ever.

70070000032126.name: Evo Pop: Hot Edition
70070000032126.intro: Fill the world with Evos! Use the Flame Evo to burn the battlefield!
70070000032126.description:
Take control of Evos - colorful creatures that live in colonies and grow at lightning speed! Bigger Evos devour smaller ones of different breeds. Dominate the battlefield by filling the screen with Evos or eating all your rivals!

Features:
- the Flame Evo!
- 400 Coins to upgrade your Evos
- 400 Gems to buy chests
- MULTIPLE ENEMIES: A three-way brawl for you to come on top of!
- PHYSICS-BASED GAMEPLAY: Control the creatures by using different spells on them.
- UPGRADE & EVOLVE: Each Evo breed has unique skills, such as jumping or sliding downhill. These properties can be upgraded to make your Evos even stronger.
- PLAN A STRATEGY: Evos interact with the environment and eat grass, flowers and bugs to multiply faster. Fight for strategic resources on the map to win!
- DOZENS OF WORLDS: Evo Pop features multiple worlds with unique design elements and physics, making the gameplay fresh every time.

Get ready to POP OFF and have FUN!

70070000032127.name: Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge: Platinum Edition
70070000032127.intro:
Just go Up, Down, Left or Right. Easy, is it NOT?
The ultimate brain-busting challenge is back with a fully revamped version!
70070000032127.description:
Not Not 2 - A Brain Challenge that messes with your head and makes you doubt your intelligence.

Read the instructions written on the cube and run towards the correct direction. Be careful about the time limit and don't let your brain get tricked!

Features:
- 3 unique skins for your character
- 3 cool backgrounds for a change of scenery
- Discover new game MODES and many LEVELS to challenge your brain in various ways
- Improve your brain skills everyday with the DAILY and WEEKLY CHALLENGE and reach the TOP of the leaderboard!
- Exclusive Multiplayer Versus mode for up to 4 players! Share the brain busting in NORMAL, HARD or EXTREME difficulty levels
- Classic mode. Each level raises the difficulty up with new instructions
- Challenge mode. Reach the best score in a bottomless pit of despair!
- Unlock unique SKINS to customize your experience
- MEASURE your progress with the statistics dashboard and compare them with your friends!
- Color blind accessibility mode
- Brand new GRAPHICS

This misleading expert aims at crushing your brain's ability to think properly. Can yours handle it?

70070000032129.name: Bucket Crusher: Gold Edition
70070000032129.intro: Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction!
70070000032129.description:
Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

This bundle includes:
- Bucket Crusher
- Bucket Crusher: Cool Kidz
- Bucket Crusher: Holiday Spirit

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw!

Features:
- tear down 11 regular and 16 playful brickwork mosaics using your saw!
- earn coins for each brick you claim and reset your progress to get Prestige Points!
- upgrade your machinery for more power, size, length, and fuel capacity
- buy a variety of improvements: treadmill, tank, multiplier, discount, and servo!
- change the look of your saw with 12 different funny skins!
- relax and de-stress after a long day
- beware, because the game is very addictive!

Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

Once you complete the first wall, there are various colorful and interesting mosaics with different shapes waiting for you to dig into and pull to pieces!

Upgrade your machinery after each level and think carefully about the wisest way to invest your money. Increase the length, power, size, and fuel capacity to get more bricks with every run of the level!

If you want to knock down walls faster and earn more cash, consider buying special permanent upgrades that cost prestige points, but there's a catch here. To get them, you have to reset all your progress!

70070000032132.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Urban Warfare
70070000032132.intro: Dominate the battlefield — visually and tactically.
70070000032132.description:
Step into the most intense and realistic tactical experience ever created. The bundle combines the base game with two exclusive weapon skin upgrades, giving you both the firepower and the style to dominate every mission. Enter lifelike environments, face aggressive NPCs, and master the chaos with precision, discipline, and tactical awareness.

Bundle Includes:
• BODY CAM SHOOTER (Base Game): Immerse yourself in a next-generation first-person shooter where every second counts. Face smart, reactive enemies across two detailed maps, using your training, strategy, and instinct to survive. The photorealistic visuals and body cam perspective put you right in the middle of the action — every movement, recoil, and decision feels real.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Tactical Pistol Skin (DLC): Command attention with an exclusive pistol skin designed for elite operators. Combine precision and intimidation as you clear rooms and engage in high-stakes encounters. Stand out on the battlefield — not just for your skill, but for your presence.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Skin Upgrade (DLC): Equip your AR-15 with a new tactical finish inspired by real special forces gear. Sleek, durable, and deadly — this upgrade reflects your professionalism and readiness for any operation. When perfection is your standard, every detail matters.

This is more than a shooter — it’s tactical realism redefined.

70070000032135.name: Zombie Defense: Gold Edition
70070000032135.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000032135.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you... Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun!

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Blue warrior skin, which gives you +10% to movement speed
- Wonderful female skin, which gives you +10% to damage
- new weapons: Laser Katana and Thunder Hammer
- 500 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000032139.name: WIZNWAR PINBALL BUNDLE
70070000032139.intro: DEMON'S TILT: OCCULT PINBALL ACTION x XENOTILT: HOSTILE PINBALL ACTION together at one low price!
70070000032139.description:
TURBO CHARGED PINBALL RETURNS! Now with bigger sprites, more baddies, more secrets & MORE BULLETS! Demon's Tilt pushes the limits of the Video Pinball genre!

X

LIGHTNING STRIKES AGAIN!! XENOTILT, the sequel to the cult hit, DEMON'S TILT. Get ready for another PINBALL FANTASY.

70070000032171.name: Garten of Banban Bundle: 0 + 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 6 + 7 + 8
70070000032171.intro: Experience the Garten of Banban series with this complete bundle, including Garten of Banban 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 & 8! Explore the facility and make new friends... If you dare.
70070000032171.description:
Travel through the abandoned levels of Banban's Kindergarten in Garten of Banban 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8. Discover the truth behind the colorful rooms to find your missing child. Will you be able to survive in this unfamiliar place?

Life is easier with friends:
Banban and Friends are waiting for you! Make new connections in the facility, but beware - the lower you go, the harder it may get to find a friendly face.

The history of Banban's Kindergarten:
It was once the go-to kindergarten for any parent who needed their children to attend a reputable learning facility. Everything changed when, one day, everyone vanished from the place. What happened? In search of your missing child, you will have to find the answer yourself.

Survive the deepest levels:
Travel through the mysterious levels of the building. But be careful - some rooms haven't been visited by a human for quite some time, and they may hide things that should remain hidden...

Explore with your flying companion:
Use your trusty drone to help you navigate and move through the facility - and to keep you company when things get scary...

FEATURES
• The whole gang is here - Meet new friends and spend some time with them (while you still can...)!
• Me, myself and my drone - Let your electric companion help you!
• Solve the mysteries - Complete the mind-bending puzzles to progress through the underground!
• Get closer to the truth - Delve deeper into the mysterious establishment and uncover the truth!
• Don't turn back - There is only one way - down!
• The entire story - play through every console chapters of Garten of Banban and piece together the truth behind it all...

70070000032172.name: Darkest Dungeon® II: Resolute Edition
70070000032172.description:
Get Darkest Dungeon II, and all DLC together for a tidy discount.

Darkest Dungeon II is a roguelike road trip of the damned. Form a party, equip your stagecoach, and set off across the decaying landscape on a last gasp quest to avert the apocalypse. The greatest dangers you face, however, may come from within...

Gather your courage and ride out into the chaos of a world undone. Four heroes and a stagecoach are all that stand between darkness and salvation.

NEW KINGDOMS GAME MODE!
Kingdoms is an entirely new stand-alone strategic campaign game mode available to play now in Darkest Dungeon II.

Protect your Kingdom
Manage a persistent roster of heroes, gather resources, and pursue an epic questline in order to track down and defeat the source of evil before all is lost.

CONFESSIONS GAME MODE
Roguelike Runs, Each With Its Own Emerging Story
Each expedition lasts from 30 minutes to several hours. Even an untimely end will arm you with resources that can be spent to improve your next journey.

The Affinity System
As travels progress, heroes bond with each other or grate on each others’ nerves, leading to desperately needed combat synergies or journey-ending dysfunction. Manage their stress and interaction to keep the team together until the bitter end.

Face Your Failures
Uncover and experience the tragic origin stories of each hero and unlock their full potential.

Nightmarish Environs
From the burning Sprawl to the diseased Foetor, the road will challenge your strategies and your endurance.

And more...
Rest your weary, shell-shocked heroes at the Inn, where you can manage their stress and relationships with a variety of diversions and delights.
Uncover and experience the tragic origin stories of the heroes.
A stylish and dynamic evolution of Darkest Dungeon’s signature art style.
A return of the narration system and voice actor Wayne June!
Exciting improvements to the turn-based combat from Darkest Dungeon.

The Binding Blade DLC
One waits at the crossroads for redemption, the other, adrift in the sprawling wilds of the Kingdom.  Master the ruthless Duelist, battle through barricades, and seek clues that will lead you to...the last of the Crusaders.

Features:
Two New Playable heroes: The Duelist & The Crusader
Both new heroes are complete with unique trinkets, signature items, and fully voiced backstories including playable flashback encounters
New Roaming mini-boss: The Warlord

Darkest Dungeon® II: Inhuman Bondage
Plunge your stagecoach into the long-forgotten Catacombs beneath the Kingdom and face a corrosive, oozing threat!

Features:
New mini region - The Catacombs, a high risk, high reward region playable on both Confessions and Kingdoms game modes
New slime-sodden enemy faction unique to the Catacombs
New playable hero: The Abomination
The Abomination comes complete with unique trinkets, signature items, and a fully voiced backstory including playable flashback encounters

Darkest Dungeon® II: Infernal Supporter Pack
The Infernal Supporter Pack contains:
Infernal weapon kits with special inkfire visual effects. Arm your heroes with implements tainted by the spreading stain.
Infernal hero palettes with additional inkfire visual effects. Heed the call of the void and outfit your heroes in gear fit for overcoming the most severe of challenges.
4 exclusive stagecoach skins themed around Catacombs and Kingdoms enemy factions. Cover your coach in dripping slime or quivering sacks of eggs!

Darkest Dungeon® II: Hero Origin Pack
Transform your heroes into their past forms as you race towards the looming mountain to face your failures!

The Hero Origin Pack includes a fully functional skin of each hero's former self, first glimpsed in their Shrine of Reflection sequences.

70070000032175.name: SUGOROKU CASINO PARTY + More Skins Collection Set
70070000032175.intro:
Get ready for a thrilling adventure of strategy and luck!
Let's play Sugoroku Casino Party!
70070000032175.description:
Play casino games, earn chips, and aim to become No. 1!

Share Joy-Con™, and up to 6 players can join in the fun!

"SUGOROKU CASINO PARTY" and the "More Skins Collection" are now available as a value set!

70070000032204.name: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered Deluxe Edition
70070000032204.description:
Return to the dark world of Nosgoth as you take control of both the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant Raziel, two powerful entities bound by the conflict between free will and fate.

Armed with legendary blades and supernatural abilities, battle through towering gothic spaces filled with enemies, puzzles, and long-buried secrets – where no victory comes without a cost.

Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered has been updated with new HD graphics, refined controls, and a modernized game camera with the ability to toggle between the HD and original presentation any time. This new edition also boasts a photo mode, alternate character skins, a comprehensive lore reader, and unreleased content and 'lost levels' from the original game.

Dual Protagonist
Play as both Kain and Raziel, each with distinct abilities, combat styles, and perspectives that shape how the story unfolds.

Dark Fantasy and Rewarding Puzzles
Explore ruined cities, ancient temples, and towering strongholds filled with environmental puzzles, challenging enemies, and horrible secrets.

Faithfully Remastered for Modern Play
Updated HD visuals, refined controls, and a modernized camera, with the option to switch between modern and classic presentation at any time.

Character Skins
Earn alternate skins for both Kain and Raziel inspired by the Legacy of Kain canon.

The Deluxe Edition delves even deeper into the lore of Legacy of Kain.
Includes:

-        Dark Prophecy Demo: A playable demo of the canceled sequel to Defiance: Dark Prophecy, offering insight into an unreleased chapter of the franchise.

-        Digital Comic Reader: Contains original Legacy of Kain tie-in comics, including one in English for the first time! Features a brand-new cover for the Defiance comic by original artist Tyler Kirkham.

70070000032211.name: My Cozy Room Yoga Class Edition
70070000032211.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000032211.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

Unlock additional Wallpaper Collection 1 and 2, Floor Design Collection, Cats, Art, Chic, Easter, Summer, Rock, Halloween, Dogs, Cottagecore, Mediterranean, Coffee, Mexican and Asian and Zen DLCs included in this bundle.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000032212.name: Neko Ramen Duo Pack
70070000032212.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!
70070000032212.description:
It's time to try ramen like you've never had before! Filled with delicious aromas, Neko Ramen will stimulate your logical thinking and ignite your senses!


Fulfill ramen orders under the guidance of a true master – the one and only feline chef! Each ramen is a perfectly calculated arrangement of flavors and shapes, so strain your brain to accommodate all the ingredients! But be careful, because intense thinking can be as spicy for the mind as ramen itself!


The orders will become increasingly sophisticated and difficult (but also more delicious). However, you don't have to worry about that, as you have as much time as you want to prepare the dish!


Here's what you'll find on the Neko Ramen menu:
- Over 90 scrumptious levels!
- 29 ingredients to compose perfect dishes.
- Music that will make you want ramen yourself.
- And charming graphics that stimulate both the eyes and the taste buds!

This bundle includes Chopstick Finesse 1 and Chopstick Finesse 2 DLCs with even more delicious levels to complete.

Do not wait, because even though the ramen will not get cold, the cat chief may not be so forgiving!

70070000032214.name: WINGSPAN: Decorative Packs Bundle
70070000032214.intro: A gallery of nature’s finest wonders!
70070000032214.description:
This bundle includes:
- Seasonal Decorative Pack
- Seasonal Decorative Pack 2
- Woodland Wonders Decorative Pack

In the Seasonal Decorative Pack for Wingspan, you'll get unlimited access to the 7 seasonal backgrounds that have appeared in 2021, along with brand new matching portraits, only available with this pack! With this DLC you will be able to play on your favourite background whenever you want to. Be it a winter background in the middle of summer, or an Easter background in winter - you don’t have to wait for a specific season to use it; you are free as a bird and can choose what and when you want!

With the Seasonal Decorative Pack 2, you'll complete your collection with 6 backgrounds: 5 of them known from special events at Wingspan and one entirely new! Plus, each with a new matching player portrait available exclusively with this DLC.

Discover the diversity of forests with the Woodland Wonders Decorative Pack. With this pack, you'll get 6 enchanting, digitally hand-painted backgrounds of different forests and 6 player portraits of their inhabitants.

70070000032220.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Star Edition
70070000032220.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000032225.name: SCHEDULE I – MAFIA EMPIRE EDITION
70070000032225.intro: Power grows as you expand your underground empire.
70070000032225.description:
Step into a world of shadows, ambition, and strategy, where every choice shapes your underground empire. Navigate hidden markets, outsmart rivals, and rise to power in a city that never sleeps.

This bundle includes:
- Full game: Grow your empire, manage resources, and make strategic choices to rise to power.
- Above the Crime DLC: Enjoy a dynamic sky that evolves above your world, adding depth, atmosphere, and a stunning visual experience.

With this bundle, you get the complete experience—master the streets, expand your operations, and enjoy a visually upgraded world that reacts to your rise. Experience your empire like never before—strategic, immersive, and unforgettable.

70070000032230.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Complete Bundle
70070000032230.intro: The ultimate bundle for those who never get tired of jigsaw puzzles!
70070000032230.description:
Play with beautiful varied illustrations, breathtaking photos and special video puzzles playing after completing a particular assembly.

This bundle includes 335 puzzles from the Puzzle Galaxy series, divided into the following themes:
• Space & Steam
• Cuteness Overload
• Animal Album
• Beautiful Views
• Moody Pics
• Pet Show
• Beautiful Paintings

Features:
- 335 puzzles to assemble
- Various themes: space, steampunk, ocean animals, dogs and cats, princesses, horses, and landscapes and more
- Single and multiplayer mode (up to 2 players)
- Range of pieces number: 6, 15, 28, 40, 56, 60, 96, 150
- Available in 10 languages

A relaxing collection designed for everyone who enjoys the calm and focus of puzzle solving.

70070000032232.name: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Empire Builder
70070000032232.intro: Build your empire from the ground up and master the art of parking management.
70070000032232.description:
Step into the thrilling world of parking management! Build and manage your parking empire from the ground up, upgrading facilities, optimizing spaces, and mastering the art of revenue maximization.

- Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator
Experience the full gameplay, managing your lots, expanding your empire, and uncovering the strategic challenges of the parking industry.

- Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Power of Profit 
Enjoy a $5,000 financial boost to accelerate expansions, implement advanced technology, and give your empire a strong financial start.

A perfect combination of gameplay and resources, giving your parking empire a head start. Are you ready to build the ultimate parking empire?

70070000032237.name: Turok Trilogy Bundle
70070000032237.description: Turok is back and no dinosaur is safe! When it was first released in 1997, Turok introduced gamers to a world teeming with cunning enemies, traps, puzzles and deadly weapons all within a vast 3D environment ready to explore. Now the classic game has been restored and enhanced with a new visual engine and exciting new features to sink your teeth into!

70070000032238.name: Upscale Studio - Ultimate Bundle: 20 in 1
70070000032238.intro: All Our Games in One Bundle

Experience the entire Upscale Studio universe with this ultimate collection! Discover every world we’ve created, packed with fun, challenge, and creativity.

All games are included. Explore every genre and find your new favorite game!

70070000032239.name: Best of Upscale Studio Bundle: 5 in 1

70070000032239.description:
Discover a collection of fan-favorite titles that showcase the very best of Upscale Studio, from hilarious adventures to intense survival challenges and clever puzzles.

Included in the bundle:

Bad Cat
Play as a mischievous kitten and cause chaos in Granny's house! Prank Granny and her dog every chance you get in this hilarious troublemaking adventure.

Arm yourself and face the zombies. Solve puzzles, find resources, and battle to save humanity from a deadly epidemic because you are the chosen one!

Choice of Life: Wild Islands
A card-based visual novel where every choice matters. After surviving a shipwreck, you must explore a mysterious island and decide your fate. Will you survive, thrive, or meet an untimely end?

Conquistadorio
Begin your journey through ancient mysteries and lost treasures. Play as a weary conqueror seeking redemption and unlock secrets, solve puzzles, and discover the legendary missing tomb.

Find Sort Match
Relax and challenge your mind with this satisfying sorting puzzle game. Test your focus and logic as you organize everyday objects in colorful, creative ways.

70070000032240.name: Upscale Studio - Logic Bundle: 5 in 1
70070000032240.intro: Challenge your brain and take it easy at the same time.
70070000032240.description:
A cozy collection of creative puzzle and logic-based games designed to boost your brainpower while helping you relax. From ancient mysteries to calm, colorful challenges. It’s the perfect mix of focus and fun!

Begin your journey through ancient mysteries and lost treasures. Play as a weary conqueror seeking redemption and unlock secrets, solve puzzles, and discover the legendary missing tomb.

Find Sort Match
Relax and test your logic in this satisfying sorting puzzle experience. Organize everyday items, find perfect matches, and enjoy the simple pleasure of order and creativity.

Pixel House
A calm, artistic escape where every color and pattern tells a story. Mix shades, paint walls, and design your dream space at your own pace. The slow moment of peace and creativity.

Trainlax
Reimagine the art of railway building in this puzzle game. Design smooth train routes, solve clever transport challenges, and enjoy a soothing rhythm that sharpens your thinking while keeping you relaxed.

Ringlorn Saga
Join Gerhard's search for his missing father in the retro action RPG. Traverse a pixelated world full of hidden dungeons and secrets. Find items that unlock new paths, but know this: enemies lurk everywhere, forcing you to think before you act.

70070000032243.name: Sweet Survivors: Classy Edition
70070000032243.intro: The purr-fect storm is coming! Can you protect your café from fluffy chaos?
70070000032243.description:
It looks like a normal day at the café… but suddenly, swarms of love-craving cats are storming in, and only you stand between them and total feline chaos! Armed with laser pointers, yarn balls, and even the dreaded pickle of doom, you’ll have to keep these fluffballs at bay while serving your customers their precious coffee. No big deal, right?

Features:
- Face down hordes of fluffy invaders
- Unlock 9 quirky toys and 7 heroic waiters
- Conquer shifts in 3 different café battlegrounds
- Upgrade your waiters and toys to become the strongest cat-wrangler
- Enjoy purr-fectly fun gameplay and cute visuals

Get ready for waves of fur and whiskers as you protect two cozy cafés. Upgrade your toys and special skills to become the best cat-fighting waiter around! With each shift, you’ll unlock new waiters, fun toys, and even more cat-tastrophes!

Can you save your café before the cats take over?

70070000032245.name: Bee Simulator: The Hive - Deluxe Edition
70070000032245.intro: The complete buzzing adventure with Bee Simulator: The Hive - Deluxe Edition!
70070000032245.description:

Included in the Deluxe Edition:

Full Game: Bee Simulator: The Hive – See the world through the eyes of a bee! Fly across a world inspired by Central Park, collect pollen, protect your swarm in an exciting story mode, and use the new expansion to build your own hive! Explore, race, dance, and engage in thrilling mini-games, solo or in the split-screen co-op!

Artbook: Bee Simulator: The Hive – Dive into 70 pages of stunning concept art, detailed storyboards, user interface designs, and behind-the-scenes insights. Witness the intricate process of bringing this vibrant world to life and rediscover your favorite moments through breathtaking wallpapers and more!

Why stop at just the game when you can immerse yourself in the full Bee Simulator: The Hive experience? Grab the Deluxe Edition and enjoy the sweetest bundle of all!

70070000032252.name: Puzzle Book: Animals Edition
70070000032252.intro: If you’re missing the magic of doing jigsaw puzzles, then you’ve come to the right place!

Puzzle Book: Animals Edition offers 60 different puzzles to solve, divided into themes - from fantasy to dinosaurs. Arts for this game were made by artist specialized in various styles. They are beautiful paintings of creatures and landscapes or simpler drawings for kids. There is something for everyone!

This bundle includes:
- Puzzle Book
- Puzzle Book: Cats Pack
- Puzzle Book: Ocean Views
- Puzzle Book: Foxes Pack
- Puzzle Book: Adventure Pack

Speaking of everyone, you can adjust the difficulty by selecting the number of fragments per puzzle - from 6 to as much as 150! It’s a great title for both children and adults. Add peaceful music that plays in the background and you’ve got a great, relaxing afternoon.

Hungry for some competition? Or you just want to assemble pieces with friends or family? Try co-op mode! Just share a Joy-Con™ with another person and start doing puzzles together.

Features:
- 60 different puzzles to solve, divided into themes
- Each stage has 6 difficulties - from 6 pieces to 150
- Beautiful arts created by various artists
- Play solo or with a friend in co-op mode

70070000032258.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Master Your Market
70070000032258.intro: Build. Manage. Expand. Your supermarket empire awaits.
70070000032258.description:
Start your journey as an ambitious supermarket owner, customize every detail of your store, manage your staff, optimize your inventory, and expand your retail empire.

This bundle includes:
• Full Game – Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
 Build, design, and manage your own supermarket empire from the ground up. Make strategic decisions, adapt to market trends, and expand your business into a thriving retail chain.

• Cash Bonus DLC
 Get an instant €1000 in-game currency to supercharge your start! Use it to stock premium products, improve your layout, and grow your store faster than ever.

• City Style Upgrade DLC
Bring a modern touch to your surroundings! Upgrade your delivery truck to sleek black, refresh your sidewalks with vivid orange, and give the main road a deep, stylish black finish.

Key Features:
- Oversee every aspect of your business — from shelves to staff.
- Start strong with extra funds to accelerate your growth.
- Enhance your supermarket’s visual appeal with bold new urban designs.
- Expand your store, attract customers, and dominate the market.

Take your supermarket from a humble corner shop to a city landmark.

Discover Lara Croft’s Original Adventures, Lovingly Restored

Globe-trotting Adventure: Follow Lara Croft around the world and face off against deadly foes and dangerous myths.

Experience the Legendary Narrative: Centuries after your former master, Kain, betrays and executes you, you rise again and embark on a relentless quest for revenge. 
Wield the Powers of a Wraith: Slay your former vampire brethren with your claws, bolts of telekinetic energy, and the elemental Wraith Blade. Grow stronger by devouring the souls of your enemies.
Shift Between Realms: The Elder God has granted you the ability to shift between the Spectral and Material Realms. Traverse the realms to solve puzzles, reveal new paths, and defeat your foes.

70070000032276.name: Neko Bento 2 Seasonal Delights Pack
70070000032276.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70070000032276.description:
Say hello to Neko Bento 2 — a flavor-packed puzzle experience where lunch is still cute, but now even trickier to pack!

This time your favorite feline chef is back with even more riddles to solve! You thought you knew it all? Think again because these levels with brand new ingredients and shapes will put your spatial brain to the test.
