This bundle includes the Chef's Dream 1 and Chef's Dream 2 DLCs, featuring tons of new levels to complete.

Chefs tend to be impatient, so don’t wait for too long and become the ultimate bento master!

70070000032278.name: Oblivion Dreams: Complete Edition
70070000032278.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000032278.description:

BECOME A SYNTH RIDER IN A FUTURISTIC MUSICAL WORLD: 
Experience a high-octane cyberpunk musical adventure where you catch notes, weave through obstacles, and ride neon rails in perfect sync with the beat.  Grab your hoverboard and perform epic air stunts in retro futuristic cityscapes!

With 42 electrifying songs, from synthwave—the genre that inspired the game’s VR origins—to ’80s anthems and today’s hits, including song packs by Lady Gaga and Gorillaz. Starting with its synthwave roots, the soundtrack has expanded to feature songs from amazing artists including Sunset Neon, Dance with the Dead, Jamie Berry…and many more!

Abracadabra

GORILLAZ PACK FEATURES 7 BEST HITS:

70070000032326.name: Hole io: Blossom Edition
70070000032326.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000032326.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

Funko Fusion

Play through iconic worlds and mashup characters inspired by some of your favorite franchises in an action-adventure game with uniquely authentic, irreverent humor from the creative minds of 10:10 Games.

Experience Beloved Worlds
Battle foes and solve puzzles in diverse and expansive worlds that are rich with personality. Relive memorable moments from some of your favorite movies, TV shows, comics, and more in an authentic new experience made by fans, for fans.

Compete with your friends in an exciting head-to-head split-screen showdown. Choose your custom color and unique skin, set the number of rounds, and let your building skills shine. Features:
- 11 additional skins to show off your style!
- 35000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition -who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000032348.intro: Step into an extraordinary rhythm-based fitness adventure across four islands to explore.

The Fitness Adventure PRO + Trip Hop Walking bundle blends training, music, and exploration into a vibrant, energizing experience where movement becomes pure enjoyment.

Fitness Adventure PRO guides you across four themed islands featuring walking, running, Beat Walking™, workouts, fit dance, boating, and meditation. Missions, challenges, and unlockable rewards help maintain long-term motivation throughout the journey.

The Trip Hop Walking DLC enhances the experience with five exclusive tracks full of atmospheric, rhythmic energy. These pulsing beats elevate walking and boating sessions, creating an immersive and almost hypnotic flow that increases rhythm and intensity during those activities.

This bundle delivers a dynamic wellness experience driven by music, exploration, and a wide range of fitness activities—an ideal balance of strength, rhythm, and atmospheric sound.

70070000032355.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - El Loco Edition
70070000032355.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000032355.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - El Loco DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS A LEGENDARY BOXER
Receive the legendary El Loco with his unique equipment and a bonus of 21500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000032358.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Complete Edition
70070000032358.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000032358.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - El Loco DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Mark Rouser DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Landon Phil DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Lord Maywinner DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Jax Stone DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 6 legendary boxers with their unique equipment and a bonus of 126500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000032360.name: Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Sea Adventure
70070000032360.intro: Survive the ocean under breathtaking new skies.
70070000032360.description:
Navigate the open seas on your fragile raft, gather resources, explore mysterious islands, and face the ocean’s challenges—all while enjoying a completely redesigned Skybox material that transforms the atmosphere of every journey.

Bundle Includes:
- Float Survival Simulator – Ocean Survivor: Gather resources, expand your raft, fish, cook, and survive the unforgiving ocean environment.
- Skybox Overhaul DLC: Experience dynamic, breathtaking skies that enhance the visual atmosphere.
Elevate your survival journey with enhanced visuals and a deeper sense of immersion!

70070000032364.name: Against the Storm - Complete Edition
70070000032364.intro: Rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains.
70070000032364.description:
You are the Viceroy – a leader charged by the Scorched Queen to reclaim the wilderness and discover lost riches for the Smoldering City, civilization's last bastion against the Blightstorm that destroyed the old world. Unlike most survival city builders where your focus is on a single city, in Against the Storm you must build a vast, prosperous network of settlements populated by diverse fantasy races, each with their own specializations and needs.

The wilderness holds many hidden dangers, and never-ending storms will batter your population into submission. If your settlements should fall, then the expedition may end – but not the game. Against the Storm is a roguelite city builder, meaning you will carry forward the resources, upgrades, and experience of your past expeditions each time you set off for a new journey into the wild.

MANAGE A DIVERSE POPULATION OF VILLAGERS
Foxes, beavers, and lizards stand alongside humans and harpies in the struggle to survive. Utilize their strengths as you balance varying needs, from housing and culinary preferences to taste in luxuries and recreation. Will you manufacture raincoats, brew ale, and bake pies to boost morale in the face of the oppressive hostility of the forest, or will you prioritize the needs of one species over another to operate more swiftly for the Scorched Queen?

CITY BUILDER MEETS ROGUELITE
Experience city builder gameplay enhanced by roguelite replayability. Build and manage multiple settlements spread across a large world map, all while collecting valuable meta-progression resources to upgrade the Smoldering City. Manage your reputation to secure success at one settlement before moving on to establish another, constantly seeking new opportunities for growth, taking on unique challenges across multiple biomes, and bracing for the inevitable destruction of everything but the Smoldering City itself. How will you maximize each cycle to not just ensure the best fate for the Smoldering City, but for your career as Viceroy as well?

NEVER THE SAME GAME TWICE
Every city location presents unique challenges for even the most resourceful Viceroy with hundreds of modifiers and multiple distinct biomes. Adjust your strategy to changing conditions and experiment with rosters of building blueprints and perks that can help your society thrive or bring it to ruin. Will you take on and complete additional objectives and delve deeper into the dangerous forest for potential boons, or will you approach with caution to ensure you operate within your capabilities?

BUILD AN ENDLESS NUMBER OF CITIES
Laying the foundations for a new city is one of the most exciting moments in a city-building game. In Against the Storm, you'll have the opportunity to repeatedly experience this by creating new settlements, while still interacting with your network of previously established cities in a growing world.

The Complete Edition of Against the Storm comes with the Keepers of the Stone and Nightwatchers DLC which introduce two new species, four new biomes, and new buildings, orders, risks, and opportunities for any Viceroy up for the challenge.

70070000032373.name: Them's Fightin' Herds - Season 1 Pass
70070000032373.description:
The Season 1 Pass includes:
•	4 Additional playable characters (each with a unique stage and Pixel Lobby avatar)
•	Exclusive character palette pack (1 for each character in the base roster and Season 1 Pass)
•	4 Exclusive Pixel Lobby accessories

Details:
• This item requires the base game (sold separately) to be used.
• Additional characters and colors will be available as they are released.
• This bundle includes items that are sold separately in individual character packs.
• The palette pack and Pixel Lobby accessories are exclusive to the Season 1 Pass and are not sold separately.

70070000032377.name: Them's Fightin' Herds: Deluxe Edition
70070000032377.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes Them’s Fightin’ Herds (base game) and the Season 1 Pass.
The Season 1 Pass includes:
•	4 Additional playable characters (each with a unique stage and Pixel Lobby avatar)
•	Exclusive character palette pack (1 for each character in the base roster and Season 1 Pass)
•	4 Exclusive Pixel Lobby accessories

70070000032379.name: Pet Show: Gold Edition
70070000032379.intro: Draw a line to enclose the area and uncover the image underneath. Watch out for enemies who can catch you or cut your line!
70070000032379.description:
Take control of a brave little animal and uncover the adorable world hidden beneath the surface! 

This bundle includes:
- Pet Show
- Pet Show: Sea Animals
- Pet Show: Winter Animals

Features:
• New Unique Levels - Complete 96 stages with 3 difficulty options each!
• New water current and ice mechanics!
• More Custom Looks - Choose your favorite from 22 playful animal avatars!
• Co-op Fun - Join forces with friends or family in local multiplayer!
• Tricky Enemies - Watch out for baddies that try to cut your line!
• Cute Pictures - Reveal a new animal picture in every level - can you find them all?

As you move, you draw a line behind you - close the shape to reveal a piece of the cute picture underneath. From fluffy kittens to curious piglets, each level holds a surprise waiting to be uncovered.

Be careful! Flying foes and sneaky bugs are ready to interrupt your progress. If they hit your line before you close it, you’ll lose a life! Outsmart them with clever tricks like screen-edge teleporting and speed boosts to stay in the game!

Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op mode to uncover the hidden image together!

Draw, dodge, and discover!

70070000032381.name: Ecchi Memories: Double Date Edition
70070000032381.intro: Let the bras hit the floor!
70070000032381.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 9 beautiful girls with impressive proportions (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000032382.name: Infantry Attack: Platinum Edition
70070000032382.intro: Soldier! War is coming and duty calls! Enemies are invading our country and we need YOU to defend it!
70070000032382.description:
Enemy troops, such as infantry, helicopters, tanks, warplanes, and drones, are coming for you! Jump on the machine gun and shoot them all!

This bundle includes:
- Infantry Attack
- Infantry Attack: Gold'n'Gun
- Infantry Attack: Strike From Above

Features:
- Defend the country against enemy soldiers
- Fight along your military crew and defeat the opponent's army on multiple warzones
- Golden Gatling primary weapon with high damage per second!
- Air Marker secondary weapon with high damage per second!
- 160 gold bars to spend on unique weapons or boosters
- 15000 cash to spend on weapon and troops upgrades
- Upgrade your loadout to win the war
- Use modern war weapons: machine guns, rocket launchers and drones
- Fight and kill bosses!
- Easy controls and realistic graphics for intense action

You're not doing war alone; your squad is here to help you: An explosive Expert with an RPG rocket launcher to deal tremendous damage to military vehicles, a Rifleman who will shoot at a high range on the open battlefield, and finally, a Grenadier who specializes in fighting all ground units. You are in charge of the machine gun to clear the battlefield, which is highly addictive and enjoyable!

Missions will take place in different warzones, and you will need to adapt your shooting strategy depending on the battlefield: city, desert, jungle, forest, airport, and many more! Be on the frontline of the battleground or take to the air to shoot enemies from the helicopter!

Beware! Combat will be challenging, and enemies will become stronger over time, so upgrading your guns won't be enough. Level up teammates and prepare your military crew for shooting waves of soldiers.

Deadly and heavily armed bosses will challenge you through the war, and only sharpened skilled players will survive. To win the battle, you must aim right and use the weapons and kill-strikes at your disposal smartly.

Do you have what it takes to free your country from invaders and win the war?

70070000032385.name: Run Sausage Run!: Diamond Edition
70070000032385.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000032385.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 15 new skins (Brain Monster, Eye Monster, Xray Monster, Caveman, Witch, Teacher, Angler, Country Girl, Hunter, Beekeeper, Firefly, Toxic, Painter, Policeman, Prisoner)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000032388.name: Call of Glory - Critical Warfare & AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault Bundle Collection
70070000032388.intro: One Warrior. Two Battlefronts. Victory on Every Horizon.
70070000032388.description:
Two Battlefields. One Warrior — Total Warfare.

From brutal ground operations to high-speed aerial combat, this bundle delivers two explosive war experiences designed for those who never retreat and never surrender.

In Call of Glory – Critical Warfare, you enter the frontline as an elite soldier. Move through hostile zones, switch between dozens of weapons, and outsmart enemies in fast, tactical firefights where precision and reflexes decide everything.


In AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault, you take the fight to the clouds. Pilot advanced jets, lock onto enemy aircraft, dodge missile storms, and dominate the skies across high-risk, dynamic combat environments.

Key Features

-Two distinct war experiences — ground & air
-20+ weapons with realistic mechanics and recoil
-High-speed jet dogfights with smooth flight controls
-Campaign, Survival & Time Attack missions
-Varied battle zones across land, sea, and sky
-Upgrades, progression, and escalating challenges

Gear up. Take off. Fight across every front.

Two missions. One hero. Victory is the only outcome.

70070000032397.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Snowy Edition
70070000032397.description:
A third-person, stealth, adventure game focused on the story of the Moonshadow Huntress: Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in the home village and follow your desired path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a secretly hidden missing piece of artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one that can reach that destination. At least you need to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
-Stylized and colorful world
-Fully voice acted emotional story
-Stealth mechanics, arrows crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving
-A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening)
-Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
-A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify: pose, camera effects, stickers, face mimics etc.

70070000032398.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 TOTY Edition
70070000032398.description:
EA SPORTS FC™ 26 TOTY Edition includes:

- 5,000 Season Points

- Gold Team of the Year Nominees Starting XI Pack with 11 TOTY Nominee Gold Player Items (Men’s & Women’s) rated 82 or higher

Three (3) 2025 Highlights 1 of 5 Player Item Picks (all untradeable, rated up to 88 OVR, from last year’s EA SPORTS FC 26 Football Ultimate Team campaigns§):
- Star Defender Player Item Pick: Choose 1 of 5 Defenders
- Star Midfielder Player Item Pick: Choose 1 of 5 Midfielders
- Star Attacker Player Item Pick: Choose 1 of 5 Attackers

The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC™ 26.

Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience powered by community feedback. The new Authentic Gameplay option delivers the most true-to-football experience ever in Career, while the Competitive Gameplay option—driven by refined fundamentals, added consistency, and enhanced responsiveness—is tailor-made for play in Football Ultimate Team™ and Clubs.

Put your dream squad to the test in Football Ultimate Team™ with new Live Events and Tournament modes, as well as a refreshed Rivals and Champs experience.

Experience Manager Career like never before with all-new Manager Live Challenges. Earn rewards throughout the new season by taking on a variety of real-world scenarios and alternative storylines – ranging from a few minutes of play to multiple seasons.

Archetypes inspired by the greats of the game introduce new classes to Clubs and Player Career, bringing more individuality to your player. Develop your abilities by upgrading attributes and unlocking Archetype Perks to give your player a distinct feel on the pitch.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

70070000032408.name: SCP Foundation: Universe Horror – Light of the Abyss
70070000032408.intro: Face the unknown and uncover hidden secrets.
70070000032408.description:
Explore dark, eerie facilities filled with hostile SCP entities and unravel chilling mysteries hidden behind locked doors.

This bundle includes:
- SCP Foundation: Universe Horror: Experience the authentic SCP Universe, navigate dimly lit corridors, manage resources, and survive against unpredictable SCP entities.
- Infinite Light DLC: Receive a special flashlight with infinite battery and modified materials, perfect for exploring the darkest corners of the facilities.

Step inside, but beware — not everything contained wants to stay locked away. With the bundle, you’ll have the tools to survive, explore, and uncover every dark secret the Foundation hides.

70070000032425.name: Demonschool - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000032425.intro: Enjoy the tactics RPG spookiness of Demonschool together with a detailed in-game art book!
70070000032425.description: Enrich your Demonschool experience with this bundle, which includes Demonschool (the full tactics RPG) and The Art of Demonschool digital artbook.

70070000032431.name: Cottonville Snowy Collection
70070000032431.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000032431.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

This bundle includes Halloween Outfits Pack, High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack, Japan 90s Outfits Pack and Winter Outfits Pack DLCs with new additional looks waiting for you.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000032436.name: Neko Bento 2 Culinary Fiesta Edition
70070000032436.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70070000032436.description:
Say hello to Neko Bento 2 — a flavor-packed puzzle experience where lunch is still cute, but now even trickier to pack!

This time your favorite feline chef is back with even more riddles to solve! You thought you knew it all? Think again because these levels with brand new ingredients and shapes will put your spatial brain to the test.

Although the challenge has risen, you don’t have to worry too much about that. You may have as much time as you like to complete a puzzle.

What will Neko Bento 2 serve you?
- Over 90 levels to eat up.
- 29 various ingredients to organize - pay attention to their shapes, it’s crucial…
- Music track that will help your mind focus and lock in!
- Artwork that will win your taste over… and not only the music one.

This bundle includes the Chef's Dream 3 DLC, featuring even more levels to complete.

Chefs tend to be impatient, so don’t wait for too long and become the ultimate bento master!

70070000032442.name: My Cozy Room Winter Shopping Edition
70070000032442.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000032442.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes the Supermarket DLC.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000032444.name: Dive Expedition: Complete Edition
70070000032444.intro: Your next great discovery lies just below the surface
70070000032444.description:
Dive into the ultimate underwater exploration experience with Dive Expedition: Complete Edition, which includes the base game and all released DLC in one collection!

Explore sunken ships, submarines, plane wreckage, and mysterious underwater ruins filled with hidden treasures and fascinating artifacts. Take your time as you navigate detailed environments, complete exploration objectives, and collect items scattered across the sea floor. Examine each discovery up close, uncovering the secrets of lost vessels and forgotten places.

This edition adds two new locations to your adventure: the wreck of a crashed airplane and a legendary sunken ship. Search through cabins, cargo holds, and surrounding seabeds for lost supplies, gold, weapons, and rare relics resting quietly beneath the waves.

Features:
• Discover 4 unique underwater maps: two shipwrecks, a plane wreck, and a submarine
• Find and examine a wide range of items, relics, and equipment
• Complete various exploration objectives across all included locations
• Enjoy a calm, atmospheric experience with no danger or combat
• Relax with immersive underwater sounds and a selection of 9 atmospheric music tracks

Dive deeper, explore every wreck, and uncover everything the ocean hides.

70070000032446.name: Raptor Evolution: Complete Edition
70070000032446.description:
Take control of a mighty dinosaur in a post-apocalyptic world on a quest to recover its stolen eggs.

Smash through environments, gather resources, and hunt grotesque human-mutants to evolve and grow stronger. Use what you collect to rebuild bridges, restore paths and push deeper into a world filled with danger and mystery. 

Unleash three powerful evolution forms with the Vectoraptor, Infermadon and Celestosaurus skins. Radiate neon energy, command the fury of fire, or glow with cosmic power as you power up your journey with bonus Meat, Mutagen and Gems that fuel your evolution and give you the edge in every battle.

Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying bosses standing between you and your lost brood. Crush anything that stands in your way and prove you are the true apex predator of the wasteland.

Features:
- Unlock 3 new evolution skins: Vectoraptor, Infermadon and Celestosaurus
- Get a total of 900 Meat, 65 Mutagen and 1350 Gems to power up your evolution and make your raptor stronger in every battle
- Break everything: destroy environments and leave nothing standing
- Use advanced technology: encounter futuristic machines that will aid your survival
- Engage in fierce battles: hunt down mutants and monstrous creatures
- Meet various enemies: take on diverse foes with unique behaviors
- Lead your warriors: command other beasts and dominate the wasteland 
- Evolve to become a super beast: grow stronger with every challenge you overcome!

Will you survive and recover your eggs?

70070000032449.name: Fight For America: Complete Edition
70070000032449.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000032449.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- Iron Patriot mech: crush enemies with enhanced speed, health and damage
- Premium weapons: Zap Gun, Golden Amcar, Flamethrower, Grenade Launcher, Snowball Launcher and Blizzard to shock, burn, freeze and blast enemy waves
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000032451.name: Treasure Drop: Complete Edition
70070000032451.intro: Don’t let your treasure leave the dome. Merge it together, and create the biggest fortune!
70070000032451.description:
Get ready for a treasure-filled adventure beneath the waves! Merge coins and gems to uncover riches beyond imagination!

Features:
• Online leaderboards to show off your score!
• Co-op mode to play and merge together!
• Versus mode to challenge your friends!
• 6 maps with unique shapes!
• 21 new character skins - otters and sea monkeys!
• 24 new accessories!
• 5 exciting power-ups that can change everything!
• Fully customizable name and character
• A bright and dazzling underwater look!

Discover maps that change how you play, each with its own unique shape and background. Can you master them all and merge the biggest treasure?

CO-OP mode
Play together locally inside one dome and collect points as a team! Merge treasures, grab power-ups, and try to reach the highest score side by side.

VERSUS mode
Challenge a friend locally! The dome is split in half - one side for you, one side for your opponent. If one player overfills their dome and items spill out, the other has only a few seconds left to score as many points as possible before the game ends!

Catch amazing power-ups as they float to the surface and use them whenever you want:
- Bomb: Explodes and pushes everything away
- Pearl: Merges with any treasure
- Ruby Curse: Makes treasure even more valuable
- Eruption: Destroys all stones
- Specter: Lets your treasure pass through obstacles

Swim to the top and rule the leaderboard!

70070000032452.name: Evo Pop: Complete Edition
70070000032452.description:
Take control of Evos - colorful creatures that live in colonies and grow at lightning speed! Bigger Evos devour smaller ones of different breeds. Dominate the battlefield by filling the screen with Evos or eating all your rivals!

Features:
- NEW EVOS: unlock Flame, Bee, Virus and Hover Evos, each with special abilities!
- ADDITIONAL RESOURCES: 3900 coins and 1400 gems to upgrade your Evos and buy chests.
- MULTIPLE ENEMIES: A three-way brawl for you to come on top of!
- PHYSICS-BASED GAMEPLAY: Control the creatures by using different spells on them.
- UPGRADE & EVOLVE: Each Evo breed has unique skills, such as jumping or sliding downhill. These properties can be upgraded to make your Evos even stronger.
- PLAN A STRATEGY: Evos interact with the environment and eat grass, flowers and bugs to multiply faster. Fight for strategic resources on the map to win!
- DOZENS OF WORLDS: Evo Pop features multiple worlds with unique design elements and physics, making the gameplay fresh every time.

Get ready to POP OFF and have FUN!

70070000032455.name: Zombie Defense: Diamond Edition
70070000032455.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000032455.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you... Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun!

This bundle includes:
- Zombie Defense
- Zombie Defense: Flamethrower
- Zombie Defense: Laser Katana
- Zombie Defense: Lasergun
- Zombie Defense: Banana
- Zombie Defense: Thunder Hammer

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Armored yellow worrior skin, which gives you +5% to damage and +5% to fire rate
- Blue warrior skin, which gives you +10% to movement speed
- Cyborg skin, which adds one extra part to your health bar
- Monkey skin, which gives you +10% to fire rate
- Wonderful female skin, which gives you +10% to damage
- new powerful weapons: Flamethrower, Laser Katana, Lasergun, Banana and Thunder Hammer
- 1250 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000032457.name: Run Chicken Run Christmas Bundle
70070000032457.intro: Run away like a chicken as fast as you can!
70070000032457.description:
Take on the role of Manny, a cunning chicken who spends his days thinking about how to escape from Treflik's Chicken Coop on Uncle's Farm. Avoid obstacles, collect fruit, and score points to run as far as possible. Additionaly try our Christmas map!

Don't let anything stop you!

- You are a chicken
- Explore a farm, check machines, eat fruits
- Try yourself, beat the score!
- Relaxing game with no combat

70070000032459.name: Spy Guy Memory Christmas
70070000032459.intro: Make yourself a gift and get a large memory game set!
70070000032459.description: The classic memory game is a great option for players of all ages. Check out our Christmas set and explore different themes that you can discover and practice your memory with!

70070000032461.name: There's No Santa: Season 1
70070000032461.description: There's No Santa: Season 1 + There's No Santa: Inside the Pyramid

70070000032464.name: There's no Cake: Season 1
70070000032464.description: There's no Cake + There's no Cake: Santa's Village

70070000032470.name: Kao the Kangaroo - Roo'les Breaker Bundle
70070000032470.intro: Kao the Kangaroo is back and he’s bending the Roo’les!
70070000032470.description:
Roo'les Breaker Bundle includes the Kao the Kangaroo (2022) full game and the Bend the Roo’les DLC for one knockout price!

Kao’s world has just been turned upside down with tricky new challenge stages and a big crab-tastic battle with the click-clacking Crab King! Will Kao be able to defeat him?

Experience the neck-stretching, snoot-booping furry icon in a whole new way!

70070000032473.name: REAL ESTATE Simulator – FROM BUM TO MILLIONAIRE: Street Survival
70070000032473.intro: Rise from the streets and build a real estate empire like no other.
70070000032473.description:
Embark on the journey from nothing to everything with this exclusive bundle! Start as a small-time property investor and strategize your way to real estate domination. Navigate market trends, negotiate deals, and outsmart competitors as you climb from humble beginnings to billionaire status.

This bundle includes:
1. REAL ESTATE Simulator – From Bum to Millionaire
- Build, buy, and manage properties across the city.
- Interact with NPC clients, from cautious first-time buyers to wealthy investors.
- Renovate, sell, and expand your real estate empire, from modest homes to luxury skyscrapers.

2. Beggar Outfit DLC
- Transform your beggar character with a new visual style: torn, dirty clothes and a garbage bag instead of a radio.
- Cosmetic-only upgrade – makes your rise to success feel even more authentic.
- Add realism and immersion to your early-game experience.

Start your journey from the streets and watch your empire grow – from rags to riches, every step counts.

70070000032475.name: Paper io 2: Complete Edition
70070000032475.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000032475.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- 90+ skins which also change the look of your terrain
- 33 funny hats to wear
- custom game with 90+ various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000032482.name: Skyline Bowling: Platinum Edition
70070000032482.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000032482.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

This bundle includes:
- Skyline Bowling: Light Style
- Skyline Bowling: Spooky Style
- Skyline Bowling: Sweet Style

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 9 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Balls - Equip 9 new bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 300K coins and 6K gems to buy and upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000032486.name: Internet Club & Cafe Simulator: Rise & Expand
70070000032486.intro: Create, upgrade, and watch your café thrive with endless possibilities.
70070000032486.description:
Step into the world of Internet Club & Café Simulator and take your café to the next level! Build and manage the ultimate internet café, upgrade your computers and furniture, and attract more customers than ever before. Protect your café from theft and hackers while staying ahead of trends in the digital world.

Bundle Includes:
- Internet Club & Café Simulator game — create, manage, and expand your café empire.
- Internet Club & Café Simulator – Financial Boost — receive $5,000 in-game cash to invest in upgrades, furniture, and tech from day one.

Start stronger, upgrade quicker, and make your café the ultimate tech hub in town!

70070000032491.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Complete Edition
70070000032491.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000032491.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Ultra Nom: who can protect you from any obstacle once!
- Electro Nom: who eliminates one other runner!
- Goldie Nom: who gets more exp than any other Nom!
- Om Nelle: who earns extra exp and helps you level up faster!
- Fiesta Nom who starts each race with a long turbo boost!
- Viking Nom who triggers a powerful long turbo boost shortly after the race begins!
- Wind Nom who gives a big running speed boost to keep you ahead!
- Droid Nom who triggers a medium turbo boost a few seconds after the race starts!
- Iron Nom who gives you a 30-second shield right at the start!
- X Nom who gives you a big boost when climbing and running on walls!
- Visor Nom who eliminates two other racers right at the start of the race!
- 12500 gold to buy new Noms!

NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Grab friends or family and jump into the same race on one screen. Chase the lead, pull off last-second comebacks, and see who really is the fastest runner among you!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000032504.name: Ball Blast: Gold Edition
70070000032504.intro: Dodge falling rocks and blast them all!
70070000032504.description:
A wild rain of bouncing rocks crashes down - move fast, blast faster!

This bundle includes:
- Ball Blast
- Ball Blast: Wilds DLC

Features:
• 3 New Maps: Blast your way through Desert, Runic and Frozen map!
• CO-OP: Team up with a friend and fend off the falling rocks together!
• Online Leaderboards: Survive as long as you can and get the best score in the world!
• Powerful Cannons: Choose between basic, shotgun, boomerang, and saw cannons!
• Devastating powers: Buy and upgrade powerful abilities to destroy everything!
• Special Levels: Defeat epic bosses and protect the bridge from destruction!
• 10 Shield Boosters
• 15 Shotgun Shards
• 10 Turret Shards
• 10 Plasma Cannon Shards
• 2500 gems: Spend extra gems on crates, fresh shards, and more power-ups!
• Replayability: Complete hundreds of unique levels and challenges!

Every rock has a number - hit it that many times and boom! it splits into two rocks with half the number and double the speed, turning the field into fast-moving chaos!

Play solo or with a friend for double firepower. Beat hundreds of levels, survive endless waves, and climb the world leaderboard!

Pick up coins and unlock new cannons: a wide-spread shotgun, a boomerang that swings back and spinning saw blades that slice through rocks as they fall. Upgrade power-ups like a piercing laser beam, explosive drones, and huge shockwaves to wipe out waves in a flash!

The rocks won’t stop bouncing - are you ready to keep blasting?

70070000032508.name: Draknek and Friends Puzzle Bundle
70070000032508.intro: For puzzle fans, by puzzle fans
70070000032508.description:
From some of the best puzzle designers in the world comes the Draknek and Friends Puzzle Bundle, a collection of some of the best puzzle games in the last decade. With dozens of hours of fun, this bundle is a must-have for puzzle fans.

In LOK Digital, discover a cryptic language of world-changing words
Learn the rules as you go and uncover how each new word has its own special ability to change the world around you in deep and surprising ways. Expand your vocabulary through 15 distinct worlds, each one exploring a new mechanic and completely shaking up the way you solve puzzles.

Set your belongings on fire on a beautiful voxel art puzzle island in Bonfire Peaks, the debut publishing project from Draknek and Friends.

Explore the museum of Human Englandland in A Monster’s Expedition, the critically beloved open world puzzle game. Players of all skill levels can enjoy hundreds of islands - some right in front of you, others well off the beaten track for true puzzle lovers

Patrick's Parabox is an award-winning puzzle game that explores a unique recursive system of boxes within boxes within boxes within boxes. Learn to manipulate the world's structure by pushing boxes into and out of each other. Wrap your head around what happens when a box contains itself, and learn to use infinity to your advantage. Explore many more mechanics and recursive twists as you delve deeper and deeper into the system. It's boxes all the way down.

In Cosmic Express, create pathways to navigate the galaxy’s most awkward space colony. It's cute, harder than it looks, and guaranteed to give you hours of challenging fun across hundreds of levels. 

In A Good Snowman is Hard to Build, players can continue exploring the world of A Monster’s Expedition while rolling up snowballs to become snowfriends. The easiest and most accessible of the four games, this game is a delight for all ages.

In Sokobond, move atoms to form increasingly complex molecules through over one hundred levels of challenging puzzles in Draknek’s first commercial release.

70070000032511.name: BRAINROT & TUNG COLLECTION 5 in 1
70070000032511.description:
Welcome to the Peak of Playable Chaos.
A collection forged from memes, madness, and pure unfiltered energy.

Step into a universe where nothing behaves as it should — physics, logic, and sanity have all been permanently fired.
Here, every game is its own flavor of absurdity: from stocking supermarket shelves to battling nightmare creatures, fleeing through flooded liminal mazes, throwing hands with Italian-meme fighters, and piloting airplanes that would make real pilots cry.

In this world:
- Supermarkets roar.
- Monsters swarm.
- Pools whisper.
- Fighters scream in twelve languages.
And planes… flight gloriously.

Every title brings its own brand of deranged brilliance:
speedrun retail chaos, relentless survival arenas, poolcore horror, meme-fueled combat, and air missions that defy all forms of aerodynamics.
No rules.
No logic.
No brakes.
Just pure chaos entertainment, handcrafted for those who want their games loud, bizarre, and unapologetically unhinged.
If you crave adrenaline, insanity, and laughs you can’t explain —
this is the right place.

70070000032513.name: Formula Legendary Bundle 3 in 1
70070000032513.intro: Every turn is a battle. Every win is a story.
70070000032513.description:
Immerse yourself in a world where speed and the roar of engines become constant companion. Here, racing is more than just a competition. It's a way of life, a challenge to physics, and a test of your nerve.

Tracks await you, each offering its own unique challenge: from tight, technical corners where every millimeter counts, to wide, high-speed straights where only reaction and courage matter. Slide in perfect drifts, attack apexes, control the pressure of your opponents—and don't give time the slightest chance.

Test yourself in a variety of racing formats:
— compete for the perfect line on circuits,
— fight for milliseconds in intense time trials,
— unleash the full force of acceleration to pull ahead at the most critical moments,
— tune your cars to perfection.

Every start is a new story. Every finish is a step toward mastery.
In this universe, speed is everything, and victory comes only to those who push through.
Feel the thrill of the race. Feel the grip of your tires on the asphalt.
Prove that you were born for the track—and your name will be remembered as a true racing legend.

70070000032515.name: Steamworld Essentials Collection
70070000032515.intro: No matter your favorite genre, there’s a SteamWorld game to dig into!
70070000032515.description:
Step into the ultimate  SteamWorld experience in SteamWorld Essentials Bundle Collection 

Across the series, every game explores a new genre while expanding the charm, humor, and rich lore that define this award-winning franchise. Whether you’re mining, strategizing, deck-building, or constructing whole towns, SteamWorld delivers polished gameplay and unforgettable characters in every entry. No matter your favorite genre, there’s a SteamWorld game to dig into! 

The SteamWorld Essentials Collection includes:

SteamWorld Dig 
Go back to where everything started! A breakout metroidvania mining-platformer where you descend into a shifting underground world filled with treasure, secrets, and lurking dangers, all while helping rebuild a dusty frontier town.

SteamWorld Dig 2 
The perfect sequel? Refined, larger, and story-rich follow-up featuring Dorothy on a quest through vast biomes, hidden caverns, ancient tech, and fast, fluid platforming.

SteamWorld Heist: Ultimate Edition
A turn-based tactical shooter with skill-based aiming, ricochet trick shots, stellar loot, and a charismatic crew of steambot space outlaws led by Captain Piper Faraday.

SteamWorld Heist II 
Tactical adventures return in this long-anticipated sequel - this time taking you across the Great Sea. Command customizable crews as Captain Leeway, explore ocean regions in your trusty submarine, upgrade your ship, and engage in refined turn-based shootouts with new systems and expanded lore.

SteamWorld Quest: Hand of Gilgamech 
A deck-building RPG set in a charming, steampunk-meets-fantasy universe. Build your card decks, craft combos, and guide heroic bots through turn-based battles as your explore this classic SteamWorld fantasy tale!

SteamWorld Build 
City-building meets meets dungeon crawling mining adventure. Construct a thriving frontier town while excavating the planet below, managing resources, and racing to escape a collapsing world.

70070000032518.name: Life Bubble: Gold Edition
70070000032518.intro: Hey there astronaut! Ready to go on your biggest space adventure?
70070000032518.description:
Embark on an exciting journey to explore new planets, collect valuable resources, and rescue lost astronauts!

This bundle includes:
- Life Bubble
- Life Bubble: Golden Tool
- Life Bubble: Golden Suit

Features:
- travel through beautiful and mysterious planets, each with unique resources and terrains
- collect valuable raw materials to rebuild machines and bridges
- explore different areas and expand your life bubble over places where it is impossible to survive!
- unlock Golden Tool, which has increased resource extraction power
- unlock Golden Suit, which gives you immortality outside the life bubble and during fights with enemies
- buy various character upgrades: bag, speed, life, tools, and power
- buy machine upgrades to increase its storage capacity
- use an additional 20000 money to buy upgrades much faster
- fight enemies with your power weapon
- complete missions for extra money!

Your mission is to expand your life bubble across the planet and repair your ship to continue your adventure into the unknown!

Chop wood, mine colorful crystals or diamonds, and use them to rebuild machines and bridges that will help you expand your life bubble area! Every construction needs specific raw materials, so search for their deposits and get to work!

Complete missions or sell resources you don't need in order to buy character and machine upgrades. Improve your abilities and tools to explore the planet fully prepared!

Be ready for obstacles along the way. Enemies are out to conquer your tiny universe. Protect your life, bubble miniature world, and fight back like a true space cowboy!

Prepare yourself for a unique and unforgettable space adventure!

70070000032522.name: Maze: Path of Light - Platinum Edition
70070000032522.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70070000032522.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths - experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

This bundle includes:
- Maze: Path of Light 
- Maze: Path of Light - Oasis Constellations
- Maze: Path of Light - Forest Constellations
- Maze: Path of Light - Dusk Constellations

Features:
- 15 new constellations with 107 additional mazes
- Creative Level Design: Conquer 4 maze types - square, circular, triangular, and hexagonal
- 5 Unique Challenges: Classic, Portal, Token, Limited Moves, Timed and Dark Mazes!
- Power-ups: 3 helpful powers to help you find your way
- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70070000032524.name: Johnny Trigger: Emerald Edition
70070000032524.intro: Looking for definitive action? Here’s Johnny!
70070000032524.description:
Johnny Trigger - International Man of Mayhem!

This bundle includes:
- Johnny Trigger
- Johnny Trigger: Avenger DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Hunter DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Butcher DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Hotshot DLC

Features:
• 4 new skins: Avenger, Hunter, Butcher and Hotshot
• 4 new weapons: Hurricane, Tri-Shot Bow, Vengeance and Sawed-off
• 5000 additional gemms to buy other currencies
• 35000 additional money to buy or draw weapons and skins in shops
• 75 additional puzzles to unlock more comic graphics
• 65 additional keys to open locked doors in base
• 50 additional hammers to unlock another upgrades in base

Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends.

Do you have what it takes to bring down the underground world of the mafia?
“Less talk, more bullets” - that’s Johnny’s motto as he runs, jumps, spins, slides and keeps on shooting till every bad guy’s bitten the dust.

Dive straight in and get shooting! Johnny Trigger’s short but immensely satisfying levels make it the perfect action game to fill a short break.
And if you’ve got a little more time, there’s so much to collect and a new challenge round every corner.

So what are you waiting for? Those bad guys aren’t going to beat themselves, you know.

70070000032527.name: Farm Land: Gold Edition
70070000032527.intro: Start your farming adventure! Take care of the plants, watch them grow and harvest the crops!
70070000032527.description:
Your quest is simple... sow the seeds, harvest the crops, sell your products to the merchants and expand your farm to become the best farmer you can be!

This bundle includes:
- Farm Land
- Farm Land: Kitten
- Farm Land: Parrot

Features:
- unlock kitten and parrot that will follow you wherever you go!
- unlock active bonuses that increase: coins collected from merchants by 25% or capacity of barns by 50%
- get 500 extra gems to spend on: unlocking random characters, an instant rain event or a harvest upgrade
- build well-functioning farms on 4 maps
- unlock over 50 cool skins!
- play with a friend on a split screen in local multiplayer mode
- harvest apples, wheat, tomatoes, eggplants and all your favorite fruits and vegetables
- play many mini-games involving animals
- hire workers to help you plant and harvest your crops
- expand your farm by buying more land
- ride a bike to speed up movement around your giant farm
- fast travel with your boat and double your income

Take part in other very satisfying activities. Go fishing, milk all the cows, shear the sheep and much more!

If you need a little help on the farm, invite a friend to play together on the split screen! Put on your funny skins, hop on your bikes and share the responsibilities.

Are you ready for country life?

70070000032531.name: Demons Are Coming! - Ultimate Battle
70070000032531.intro: More power. More strategy. More ways to crush the horde.
70070000032531.description:
Strengthen your crusade against the demonic forces with a bundle packed full of power, flexibility, and fresh tactical options! This expansion introduces new tools and enhancements that elevate every run, helping you tailor your playstyle and dominate even the toughest arenas.

• Empower your combat style with a set of advanced combat perks that boost both your melee and ranged efficiency. Strike faster, hit harder, and control the battlefield with greater precision than ever.
• Unlock a series of run-start bonuses that give you an early advantage - from improved mobility to increased damage potential - letting you dive straight into the chaos with confidence.
• Discover new synergy opportunities that interact with your existing weapon mods, creating stronger builds, wilder combos, and even more satisfying demon-slaying setups.

70070000032532.name: Cup Heroes: Diamond Hoard Bundle
70070000032532.intro: Join the adventure fully loaded with 16,000 diamonds!
70070000032532.description:
Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen! 

How to Play: 
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles. 
- Save the Queen: Your ultimate goal is to rescue the Queen who has been captured by evil forces. 
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and gems to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges. 

Features: 
- Premium Currency: Use 16,000 Diamonds to unlock new heroes, purchase keys to open exclusive chests, obtain high-rarity gear, and gain a powerful edge in battle.
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team. 
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes. 
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game. 
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen. 
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience. 
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests to earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!

70070000032538.name: Star Trek: Legends - Picard Edition
70070000032538.intro: Captain - The fate of the universe is in your hands!
70070000032538.description:
Step into the role of your favorite heroes and villains from across the history of Star Trek and embark on an epic space adventure to control the mysterious Nexus. Battle to save all of existence in Star Trek’s official strategy-based RPG!

RECEIVE NEW CHARACTERS AND EXTRA RESOURCES
Start your journey with loads of resources and 9 new characters:
• 3 commanders: Picard (old), K'ehleyr and Thadiun Okona
• 3 engineers: Thy'lek Shran, Charles "Trip" Tucker III and Miles O'Brien
• 3 security: Weyoun, Kor and Viceroy
• Extra resources: x90 ProtoMatter, 900 orbs, and 9 Rare Bio-Gel

PREPARE FOR ADVENTURE 
Dive into the action with characters spanning the entire Star Trek universe! Take command of the U.S.S. Artemis and recruit a team of legendary Star Trek characters as you embark on daring missions, experience epic turn-based combat, and make choices that influence the game’s entire story.

ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM
Ever wanted to master Spock’s Vulcan nerve pinch or battle with Worf’s deadly bat’leth? Now is your chance! Recruit and command over 80 iconic characters from the Star Trek universe including Kirk, Spock, Picard, Janeway, Data, Burnham, Pike, and many more! Send your Star Trek team on critical missions that will test your crew’s skills and ingenuity. Earn special rewards by completing collections of characters based on the Star Trek shows they appeared in or the traits they possess. Plus, you can earn combat bonuses by using multiple Star Trek characters from the same collection in battle.

TAKE COMMAND OF THE U.S.S. ARTEMIS
Captain the U.S.S. Artemis and shape the fate of the cosmos! Choose your crew strategically. Each Star Trek character has their own specific skills and abilities to help you outwit, overpower and overcome your enemies. Every decision you make could be the difference between triumph and defeat. Take command, Captain – the galaxy awaits your leadership!

NAVIGATE AN IMMERSIVE UNIVERSE
Dive into the exquisitely crafted 3D world of Star Trek Legends! Explore beautifully rendered 3D worlds and interact with fully realized animated characters in this epic Star Trek RPG. 

Get ready to boldly go where no one has gone before in Star Trek: Legends. Your interstellar adventure awaits!

70070000032541.name: MasterChef: Learn to Cook! - Meatlover Special
70070000032541.intro: Roll up your sleeves and cook up a meaty feast worthy of a number one chef!
70070000032541.description:
Choose your ingredients, slice, prepare, plate and serve delicious dishes with style in fun mini-games! 

The MasterChef judges will evaluate your dish based on your performance and speed. Complete and unlock new recipes, challenges, and mini-games along your cooking journey!

RECEIVE A PREMIUM BOX FULL OF MEATS 
Boost your cooking career with a box filled with meat, dairy, seafood, 2500 prestige coins, and a unique knife!

LEARN TO COOK WITH MORE THAN 120 RECIPES!
Make signature recipes from all over the world. Find your favorite dish and make it your specialty. From a Margherita Pizza to Sushi, what do you want to cook today?

CHALLENGE MINI-GAMES
Play dozens of mini-games with a twist! Challenges will take you to cook recipes with extra added difficulty. Will you be able to clear all of them?

MOTION CONTROLS
Become a true number one chef with immersive motion controls. Grab your Joy-Con™ and start cooking for real!

COOK WITH STYLE
Create an avatar and customize its features as you want! Become the coolest chef and stand out by changing your outfit from a wide range of clothes, accessories, and aprons!

UPGRADE YOUR COOKING GEAR
By completing mini-games, events and challenges, you will be able to collect different cooking gear such as pots, utensils, plates amongst others, and upgrade them! Cooking utensils are a chef’s best friend!

It is time to prove that you are a top chef!

70070000032542.name: Cute Puppy Academy: Friends Pack
70070000032542.description:
Welcome the newest trio of energetic companions to your Cute Puppy Academy! With three unique breeds joining your training grounds, this bundle is packed with charm, playfulness, and plenty of tail-wagging fun.

Teach your pups adorable tricks, develop their skills, and keep them happy with lots of grooming, feeding, and cuddles. Take them on joyful walks through a lively park full of surprises, mini-games, and activities that challenge their agility and strengthen your bond.

As your academy grows, expand it with new kennels, toys, and upgraded training spaces to create the perfect home for every puppy in your care. Build your reputation as the ultimate trainer and enjoy watching each pup thrive under your guidance.

This bundle includes three delightful DLCs:
Beagle Training Pack, Basenji Training Pack, and Bull Terrier Training Pack.

70070000032547.name: Kitty Cat Adventures Bundle
70070000032547.description:
Step into a world made for cat lovers, where every whisker twitch and playful pounce comes to life! Whether you're roaming the streets as a curious stray, exploring the globe as an adventurous kitty, or running your very own veterinary clinic, this collection offers endless feline fun.

Create chaos, uncover secrets, and explore charming locations with your furry companions. Jump, dig, chase, and discover hidden treasures as you embrace the playful spirit of every cat.

Care, nurture, and grow your own clinic into a bustling hub where happy paws and purring hearts abound. Every kitty you treat leaves a mark on your growing empire of animal care.

From mischievous adventures to soothing journeys across the world, and from fun-loving antics to the satisfaction of helping every furry friend — this bundle brings together all the joy, curiosity, and charm of a cat's life in one place.

Be free, be playful, and let your inner feline shine — because here, every tail has a story.

70070000032548.name: SCP / Backrooms / Exit Bundle 6 in 1
70070000032548.intro: Darkness doesn't hide you — it hunts you.
70070000032548.description:
Step into a world where the familiar becomes terrifying, and every corner hides a truth you were never meant to see.  
This bundle unites several unsettling experiences — each one exploring a different fracture in reality, each one pushing you deeper into places that shouldn’t exist.

From empty supermarkets that reshape themselves… to office corridors that loop endlessly… to stairwells swallowing all light… and garages where something waits in the dark — every game invites you to confront the uncanny.

Here, the world behaves wrong.  
Here, your senses cannot be trusted.  
Here, escape is never guaranteed.

Every game offers a different nightmare:

- looping spaces that shouldn’t exist
    
- entities that move when you don’t look
    
- anomalies that break logic
    
- environments that turn against you
    
- a constant feeling of being watched

70070000032549.name: Supermarket Simulator Bundle 3 in 1
70070000032549.intro: Your store, your rules, your empire.
70070000032549.description:
Welcome to a world where commerce becomes an art form, and every store is a reflection of your imagination.
This collection brings together three vibrant simulation games in which you create, develop, and manage your own businesses—from a bookstore to a gaming empire to Santa's festive supermarket.

Different worlds await you here, but one goal: to turn a small business into a thriving place you'll want to return to.

You'll be able to:

- Build a literary paradise.
Create a cozy library and bookstore, stock the shelves with bestsellers, rarities, and new releases, organize themed zones, and inspire visitors to new discoveries.

- Manage the gaming store of your dreams.
Sell consoles, bestsellers, and collector's editions, keep customers interested, and grow your gaming empire. Set prices, monitor demand, and stay ahead of the competition.

- Experience the magic of holiday management.
In Santa's festive supermarket, you'll be in charge of everything: from gifts and sweets to happy shoppers searching for the perfect surprise. Upgrade the store, expand departments, and create a true winter fairytale.

Each game offers its own style, pace, and atmosphere—from the quiet comfort of literature to the exciting world of console business and holiday magic.

70070000032550.name: Hidden Object Adventure Bundle 2
70070000032550.intro: Experience three thrilling stories, challenging puzzles, and fantastic worlds – the Hidden Object Adventure Bundle 2 is perfect for adventure and suspense lovers.
70070000032550.description:
Discover three worlds filled with puzzles, secrets, and exciting stories. The Hidden Object Adventure Bundle 2 combines three captivating hidden object adventures that will keep you entertained for hours. Explore unusual locations, meet intriguing characters, and solve tricky puzzles to uncover the truth behind mysterious events.

Games Included:
Witch’s Pranks: Frog’s Fortune
Help cursed princes and outsmart a cunning witch in a fairytale adventure brimming with charm and magic.

Ominous Tales: The Forsaken Isle
Explore a mysterious, deserted island and uncover the dark truth behind an ancient curse.

Greed: The Mad Scientist
Stop a mad scientist and uncover a dangerous conspiracy filled with sinister experiments.

This bundle offers a thrilling adventure package for anyone who loves entering mysterious worlds and savoring every minute.

• Three games with captivating stories full of puzzles and discoveries
• A modern blend of point-and-click and hidden object gameplay
• Ideal for fans of mystery, fantasy, and adventure
• Only now in one bundle

70070000032551.name: Heartfelt Homes Bundle
70070000032551.intro: Whether on a fantastical island of mutants or a space station among interplanetary clouds, real feelings are shared in true conversations. The heart of a good story.
70070000032551.description:
Tell me more about Mutazione!
Just because it's an island full of colorful mutants doesn't mean they haven't made a home there. Mutazione has so much love for the small-scale, interpersonal drama that tight-knit communities get wrapped up in-- and it delivers on a bigger, grander mystery to boot.

Tell me more about Universe for Sale!
Whoever said a rickety, old space station, lodged in the clouds of Jupiter, couldn't be a home? A home filled with scientific marvels-- apes who can talk, people separated entirely from their flesh, a tentacle-haired woman who can make universes in the palm of her hand. But all that science doesn't stop the real emotions they have from spilling over when the stakes get high, and the world seems like it's ending.

70070000032552.name: Spirit & Soil Bundle
70070000032552.intro: Grow your spirit buried within the soil of your past...
70070000032552.description:
What's Whispering Willows?
Young Elena Elkhorn embarks on a harrowing journey to find her missing father and discover the secrets of the Willows Mansion. Aiding her journey is a unique amulet she received from her father, which allows her to astral project her spirit into a ghostly-realm and communicate with the dead. Play as Elena to find her missing father, use your astral projection to solve the mansion’s tricks and puzzles, help the lingering souls, and discover so much more in Whispering Willows.

What's Mutazione?
Just because it's an island full of colorful mutants doesn't mean they haven't made a home there. Mutazione has so much love for the small-scale, interpersonal drama that tight-knit communities get wrapped up in-- and it delivers on a bigger, grander mystery to boot.

70070000032563.name: Star Trek: Legends - Spock Edition
70070000032563.intro: Captain - The fate of the universe is in your hands!
70070000032563.description:
Step into the role of your favorite heroes and villains from across the history of Star Trek and embark on an epic space adventure to control the mysterious Nexus. Battle to save all of existence in Star Trek’s official strategy-based RPG!

RECEIVE NEW CHARACTERS AND EXTRA RESOURCES
Start your journey with loads of resources and 9 new characters:
• 3 scientists: Spock (young), Number One and Seska
• 3 medics: Guinan, Julian Bashir and Antaak
• 3 villains: Tolian Soran, Founder and Dolim
• Extra resources: x60 ProtoMatter, 900 orbs, 30000 Latinum, and 9 Rare Bio-Gel

PREPARE FOR ADVENTURE 
Dive into the action with characters spanning the entire Star Trek universe! Take command of the U.S.S. Artemis and recruit a team of legendary Star Trek characters as you embark on daring missions, experience epic turn-based combat, and make choices that influence the game’s entire story.

ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM
Ever wanted to master Spock’s Vulcan nerve pinch or battle with Worf’s deadly bat’leth? Now is your chance! Recruit and command over 80 iconic characters from the Star Trek universe including Kirk, Spock, Picard, Janeway, Data, Burnham, Pike, and many more! Send your Star Trek team on critical missions that will test your crew’s skills and ingenuity. Earn special rewards by completing collections of characters based on the Star Trek shows they appeared in or the traits they possess. Plus, you can earn combat bonuses by using multiple Star Trek characters from the same collection in battle.

TAKE COMMAND OF THE U.S.S. ARTEMIS
Captain the U.S.S. Artemis and shape the fate of the cosmos! Choose your crew strategically. Each Star Trek character has their own specific skills and abilities to help you outwit, overpower and overcome your enemies. Every decision you make could be the difference between triumph and defeat. Take command, Captain – the galaxy awaits your leadership!

NAVIGATE AN IMMERSIVE UNIVERSE
Dive into the exquisitely crafted 3D world of Star Trek Legends! Explore beautifully rendered 3D worlds and interact with fully realized animated characters in this epic Star Trek RPG. 

Get ready to boldly go where no one has gone before in Star Trek: Legends. Your interstellar adventure awaits!

70070000032568.name: MasterChef: Learn to Cook! - Veggie Special
70070000032568.intro: Roll up your sleeves and cook up a veggie feast worthy of a number one chef!
70070000032568.description:
Choose your ingredients, slice, prepare, plate and serve delicious dishes with style in fun mini-games! 

The MasterChef judges will evaluate your dish based on your performance and speed. Complete and unlock new recipes, challenges, and mini-games along your cooking journey!

RECEIVE A PREMIUM BOX FULL OF VEGGIES
Boost your cooking career with a box filled with vegetables, grains, 2500 prestige coins, and a unique peeler!

LEARN TO COOK WITH MORE THAN 120 RECIPES!
