Make signature recipes from all over the world. Find your favorite dish and make it your specialty. From a Margherita Pizza to Sushi, what do you want to cook today?

CHALLENGE MINI-GAMES
Play dozens of mini-games with a twist! Challenges will take you to cook recipes with extra added difficulty. Will you be able to clear all of them?

MOTION CONTROLS
Become a true number one chef with immersive motion controls. Grab your Joy-Con™ and start cooking for real!

COOK WITH STYLE
Create an avatar and customize its features as you want! Become the coolest chef and stand out by changing your outfit from a wide range of clothes, accessories, and aprons!

UPGRADE YOUR COOKING GEAR
By completing mini-games, events and challenges, you will be able to collect different cooking gear such as pots, utensils, plates amongst others, and upgrade them! Cooking utensils are a chef’s best friend!

It is time to prove that you are a top chef!

70070000032571.name: Candivity: Platinum Edition
70070000032571.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
70070000032571.description:
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

This bundle includes:
- Candivity
- Candivity: Under Water DLC
- Candivity: Deep Mines DLC
- Candivity: North Pole DLC

Features:
• Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
• Co-op mode for you and your friend!
• Versus mode to sabotage your friends!
• 5 maps: Under Water, Deep Mines, North Pole and 2 standard maps
• New animal characters and swimming accessories
• Fully customizable name and character
• Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
• An adorably sweet aesthetic

NEW VERSUS MODE!
Race to merge the biggest candy while using clever tactics to slow down your opponent. Unleash tricky power-ups, and prove who’s the ultimate candy master!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000032574.name: Giant Rush: Gold Edition
70070000032574.intro: Rush into a battle of giants!
70070000032574.description:
Run and collect stickmen of your color to grow bigger and more powerful! Outsmart traps, avoid danger, and smash everything in your path. The bigger you grow, the more unstoppable you become!

This bundle includes:
- Giant Rush
- Giant Rush: Silly DLC
- Giant Rush: Cute DLC

Features:
• 10 new hats that will make you look unique!
• 2 premium finishing animations!
• 1000 free stickmen for your city
• 5000 extra gems to grow your character
• Collect stickmen of your color to grow larger and more powerful!
• Grow stronger and defeat huge giants in intense fights!
• Upgrade your town to earn passive income
• Fight through a series of enemies in survival mode and show your skills!
• Choose battle upgrades like extra health, a chance to dodge, critical hits, and more!
• Unlock awesome outfits and accessories to customize your character
• Buy new and epic finishing animations!

Face giant bosses in epic battles. Dodge their powerful attacks, strike back, and defeat them! Show your strength as you take down the biggest giants and prove you’re the best!

Unlock amazing rewards as you play. Upgrade your town to earn more money, customize your character with cool accessories, and unlock epic finishing animations!

Your decisions will make the difference between victory and defeat!

70070000032576.name: Sausage Wars: Gold Edition
70070000032576.intro: An Epic Sausage Battle till the last drop of ketchup for up to 4 Players and 20 Bots!
70070000032576.description:
Careful - it’s a hot-dog-eat-hot-dog world out there. So fight to the death and push them all till your enemies are oozing Tomato Blood!!

With this edition you will unlock:
- new Burning stage in each local multiplayer mode! 
- new Trapdoor stage in each local multiplayer mode! 

Wait for the right moment, push the sausage homies in the fire and watch them cook well. Just don't get roasted!

Release to head-bang and push enemy sausages into sausage wars battle obstacles like sharp tools, kitchen sinks, garden fire, or off the counter to their doom. The crowded city is overcrowded and we need to empty it! Try to push them all, fight and smash those sausages to smithereens!

Don’t forget your hot-diggity-dog victory dance at the end of each sausage wars battle level! Make sure you become the biggest wiener in town!

70070000032578.name: Color Water Sort: Gold Edition
70070000032578.intro: It's time to show how smart you are! Test your puzzle-solving skills in this water sorting game!
70070000032578.description:
Use your head and arrange colored liquids to solve unique puzzles!

Master the art of water sorting and rise to the top as a champion! Strategically move the water until every color is separated, proving your puzzle-solving prowess!

Features:
- face over 7500 levels!!!
- unlock 18 new tubes, 8 new wallpapers and 10 new caps!
- play in three game modes: classic, timed, and hard
- face off against a friend in local multiplayer mode!
- give your brain an excellent workout
- use powerups: hints, undo, and extra tubes
- spend 50000 extra coins in the customization tab!
- collect keys and open prize chests

Immerse yourself in the challenge of sorting water into tubes with the same colored liquid on top. Remember, the tubes can't be full for the water to go in. Plan your moves carefully to avoid losing!

Complete thousands of levels in 3 different modes:
• Classic - a standard mode where you can relax
• Timed - move fast and complete the level within the time limit
• Hard - think about your every move, because you have a limited number of them

Enjoy this colorful brain challenge by yourself or against your friend!

70070000032580.name: Aquarium Land: Platinum Edition
70070000032580.intro: Dive into an aquatic world where amazing animals await you!
70070000032580.description:
Go fish in the sea, swim, catch species like goldfish, starfish, koi fish and add them to your fish tank to expand your aquarium shop!

This bundle includes:
- Aquarium Land
- Aquarium Land: Baby Seal
- Aquarium Land: Parrot
- Aquarium Land: Armadillo

Drive a motorboat, ride a jet ski or just jump in the water and dive with a friend in multiplayer mode! 

Discover amazing places filled with a wide variety of beautiful animals. Discover huge and legendary creatures to attract more visitors. There is a customer for every sea animal, big or tiny, all you have to do is fish with attitude!

Invest in your aquarium shop and explore the sea world like a real fishy tycoon! The more money you earn, the more upgrades and aquariums you can get!

Features:
- many different aquatic worlds
- 3 pets: baby seal, parrot and armadillo each with active bonuses that increase fishing speed at sea
- 100+ species to catch
- multiplayer mode up to 2 players
- 20 funny skins to choose from
- character, customer and employee upgrades 
- motorboat and jet-ski riding
- different diving styles with cool animations
- aquarium decorations
- ship expeditions
- 3 secret fish you can feed to earn beauty cup points
- 3 fishbowl decorations
- 300 gems

Can you be the best fish tycoon, let the tides lead you and rule your tile aquarium?

70070000032583.name: Ecchi Secrets: Vivid Edition
70070000032583.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls
70070000032583.description:
Secrets lie beneath the covers... avoid enemies and uncover pictures of beautiful girls posing exclusively for you.

Discovering the truth is never easy... the more tempting the secrets, the greater the challenges you'll face. Unravel all the mysteries to uncover what the girls are hiding, and prepare yourself for plenty of alluring photos along the way.

Features:
- Over 30 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- 16 new pictures of charming girls awaiting your arrival
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes

70070000032584.name: My Horse Stories: Gold Edition
70070000032584.intro: Get ready to make unforgettable memories and experience the beauty of the countryside like never before!
70070000032584.description:
Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ!

This bundle includes:
- My Horse Stories
- My Horse Stories: Winter DLC
- My Horse Stories: Summer DLC

Features:
• Choose which horse out of 4 will become your best friend!
• Make the most of the horse story summer - become a horse racing champ!
• Train every day with your horse till you're ready to compete in international horse races
• Compete in exciting horse story racing competitions around the world! - Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps!
• Dress up like a champion in over 80 various clothes and change your hairstyles!
• Take good care of your horse: feed, groom, and dress him with over 70 accessories!
• Spend an additional 500 gems to buy clothes, energy, missing items for building improvements, and more!
• Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won't let you off easy. Upgrade your horse-story farm and build new facilities.
• Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC, but your plans have changed. You're sent to middle-of-nowhere Kentucky to spend the summer with your grandma on a star-stable horse farm.

Soon, you realize that this summer adventure holds untold potential! The horse farm becomes your heaven, and with each passing day, you grow closer to your loyal companion - a graceful horse with whom you'll weave your own unique horse-riding tale!

To rise above the competition and conquer the racetracks, you must train tirelessly, immersing yourself in the art of horsemanship. Your dedication will bring you face-to-face with rival stars and formidable opponents who will test your skills and determination. You and your horse will form an unbreakable bond through intense training sessions, setting the stage for legendary horse-riding tales that will be whispered for years to come!

But it's not all about intense races and fierce rival stars. In the tranquil moments between training, you'll find solace in the stars' stable horses - majestic creatures that inspire awe and joyfully fill your heart. Take the time to nurture and care for them because their well-being is crucial to your success. Pamper them with love, groom their silky manes, and dress them in dazzling saddles that reflect their extraordinary beauty.

You better make the most of it! Dress in cowgirl boots, dress up your new pet horse, start racing like a champion, and make it a horse story to remember!

70070000032586.name: Coloring Book: Story Time Bundle - 120 drawings
70070000032586.intro: Create the most impressive coloring book, alone or together (up to 4 artists) ! This Bundle contains over 120 drawings!
70070000032586.description:
This Bundle contains:
● “Coloring Book” base game
● “Adventure Chapter” with 30 pictures of cute animals, delicious desserts and outer space fun
● “Costume Party” with 30 pictures of pirates, cowboys, princesses, knights and other fun costumes
● "Cosmos Fun" with 30 pictures of space adventures with planets, spaceships and funny aliens
● "Treasure Adventure" with 30 pictures of mermaids, pyramids and tropical islands

70070000032588.name: Ink & Paper: DoodleCut - Complete Edition
70070000032588.intro: Draw a line to enclose the area and doodle it. Watch out for baddies who can catch you or cut your line!
70070000032588.description:
You take control of a doodle bug crawling across the notebook. As you move, you draw a line behind you. When you surround an area, you can capture and doodle it. You must sketch more than three-quarters of a page to win.

Each level offers plenty of challenges - from special areas to multiple types of enemies. Don't let them catch you or cut your line!

Play alone or with your friend in co-op mode to get the most space in the shortest time! You can also unlock expert speed and endless mode.

Ink & Paper: DoodleCut - Complete Edition includes:
• Full game
• 50 additional doodle levels
• 4 extra skins: Rocket, Planet, Duck and Frog

Doodle, divide and conquer!

70070000032591.name: Bendy: Revive and Survive Bundle
70070000032591.description:
Dive into two thrilling Bendy adventures filled with ink-soaked horror and survival challenges in Joey Drew Studios.

Bendy and the Dark Revival

Play as Audrey, trapped in a deranged animation studio. Sneak, fight, and solve puzzles to survive twisted creatures and the relentless Ink Demon. Uncover dark secrets to escape the studio’s inky nightmare.

Bendy: Lone Wolf

Become Boris in a brutal survival gauntlet through endless, eerie corridors. Battle cartoonish monsters, dodge deadly traps, and evade the Ink Demon’s pursuit in a pulse-pounding quest for truth.

70070000032593.name: Bendy: Ink Demon's Collection
70070000032593.description:
Experience the complete Bendy saga with three chilling games, blending mystery, horror, and survival in the haunted depths of Joey Drew Studios.

Bendy and the Ink Machine
As Henry, explore an abandoned animation studio hiding dark secrets. Navigate a maze of horrors, solve puzzles, and face nightmarish creatures from the shadowy Dark Puddles.

Bendy and the Dark Revival
Play as Audrey, trapped in a deranged animation studio. Sneak, fight, and solve puzzles to survive twisted creatures and the relentless Ink Demon. Uncover dark secrets to escape the studio’s inky nightmare.

Bendy: Lone Wolf
Become Boris in a brutal survival gauntlet through endless, eerie corridors. Battle cartoonish monsters, dodge deadly traps, and evade the Ink Demon’s pursuit in a pulse-pounding quest for truth.

70070000032597.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.18
70070000032597.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the eighteenth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- World’s Finest Art: Katsushika Hokusai
- Animals with Flowers
- The Fantasia from Beyond: The Digital Canvas 5
- [Moving] Journey Through Italy

70070000032603.name: Robot Skin: Bloody Pack
70070000032603.intro: Transform your robots into terrifying monsters with this skin pack!
70070000032603.description:
This bundle includes all Bloody robot skins at a discounted price.

Included items:

70070000032612.intro: A luxurious bundle to enjoy PRITTO PRISONER to the fullest!
70070000032612.description:
"This value bundle includes the main game PRITTO PRISONER and a selection of DLC items at a discounted price.
