70070000032622.name: Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter – Survival Master
70070000032622.intro: Survive the undead night with tactical precision.
70070000032622.description:
Step into the relentless fight for survival with Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter and experience the full, heart-pounding package that tests your skills against waves of the undead in a claustrophobic, abandoned building.

This bundle includes:
1. Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter — intense survival gameplay, hidden weapons, and resource management within a gritty VHS-style apocalypse.
2. WARZONE CHRONICLES - Night Vision DLC  — adding night vision capabilities, plunging you into eerie, pitch-black corridors where every shadow conceals danger.
3. Warzone Chronicles: Interior Essentials Pack — enhancing the environment with new interior decorations that transform the abandoned complex into a more immersive and challenging battleground..

Prepare for a survival experience like no other, where strategic movement and quick reflexes are your only tools against the ceaseless undead threat. Navigate the transformed environment, adapt to new challenges, and rely on your night vision goggles to outsmart enemies lurking in the dark. Are you ready to survive the nightmare?

70070000032628.name: Big Game Bundle 10-in-1
70070000032628.description:
10 in 1 Games Bundle – Complete Your Library with a Diverse Set of Exciting Titles!

Looking for a pack full of fun, variety, and hours of entertainment? This special 10 in 1 games bundle is the perfect opportunity to expand your library with a selection of titles that will satisfy every type of player — from fans of dynamic action to those who enjoy relaxing and creative experiences.

Inside, you’ll find carefully selected games that differ in style, genre, and pace. This means you’ll always have something for long gaming sessions as well as quick, casual play. Each game offers a unique experience and has been chosen to ensure the bundle is not only a great deal but also highly diverse and enjoyable.

Why is it worth it?

- 10 games in one package – great value at a low price

- Various genres and styles – there’s something for everyone

- Thoughtfully curated selection – only games that deliver real fun

- Perfect for expanding your collection or giving as a gift

Don’t wait — jump into a world of entertainment and discover all the titles in this unique bundle. It’s the perfect moment to enrich your library with games that will keep you entertained for weeks to come!

70070000032636.name: Clue: Deluxe Edition
70070000032636.intro: Take your Clue/Cluedo game to the next level!
70070000032636.description:
The classic murder mystery returns with a modern twist.

The Clue/Cluedo: Deluxe Edition contains everything you need to become the ultimate detective – at an incredible price too! Travel around the world to investigate chilling cases, striving to solve the murder before anyone else. 

In the iconic base game, you’ll explore Tudor Mansion, gathering clues and unlocking motives. Deduce who killed Mr Boden “Boddy” Black, with what and where. Read all-new case file pages, finding out more about Clue/Cluedo’s cast of colourful characters. 

Then, take on all-new original crime scenes; the Deluxe Edition opens up ten crime scenes – the Black Adder Resort, Whispering Pines Retreat, Polar Research Station and Noir Mansion will be playable immediately, then the remaining crime scenes as they release for a total of ten. As an added bonus, you’ll also get the Tropical Pack, which lets you spruce up your game with the Tropical dice, clue sheet, card back and avatar, plus the upcoming Legacy Suspect Pack.

INCLUDES:
CLUE/CLUEDO BASE GAME – Includes the Tudor Mansion board, Tudor Mansion-themed player avatar, card back, clue sheet and dice set, plus 12 tokens 
CRIME SCENE COLLECTION 1 & 2 – Grants access to a total of 6 crime scenes, current and future!
THE BLACK ADDER RESORT – Includes the Black Adder Resort board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a snake dice set and 16 new tokens and two additional suspects
WHISPERING PINES RETREAT – Includes the Whispering Pines Retreat board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a leafy dice set and 12 new tokens
POLAR RESEARCH STATION – Includes the Polar Research Station board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, an icy dice set and 12 new tokens
NOIR MANSION – Includes the Noir Mansion board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a sleek dice set and 12 new tokens
FUTURE CRIME SCENES – Two future crime scenes as soon as they release. Coming soon…
2016 SUSPECT PACK – Includes 12 new tokens featuring the 2016 Clue/Cluedo cast
LEGACY SUSPECT PACK – Includes 12 new tokens featuring additional suspects. Coming soon…
BONUS CONTENT – Tropical Pack, including a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet and a tropical dice set

70070000032637.name: Clue: Crime Scene Collections 1 & 2
70070000032637.intro: Includes six crime scenes and bonus cosmetic content!
70070000032637.description:
Experience true luxury next time you play Clue/Cluedo on Nintendo Switch™! 

With the Clue/Cluedo: Crime Scene Collections 1 & 2, take on six brain-teasing cases across new boards and enjoy a plethora of bonus cosmetic content. 
 
INCLUDES:
THE BLACK ADDER RESORT – Includes the Black Adder Resort board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a snake dice set and 12 new tokens
THE BLACK ADDER RESORT: CASE FILE REVISITED #1 – Includes two new suspects and four more tokens
WHISPERING PINES RETREAT – Includes the Whispering Pines Retreat board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a leafy dice set and 12 new tokens
POLAR RESEARCH STATION – Includes the Polar Research Station board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, an icy dice set and 12 new tokens
NOIR MANSION – Includes the Noir Mansion board, a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet, a stylish dice set and 12 new tokens
FUTURE CRIME SCENE #1 – Coming soon…
FUTURE CRIME SCENE #2 – Coming soon…
2016 SUSPECT PACK – Includes 12 tokens featuring the classic Clue/Cluedo cast – Miss Scarlett (2016), Colonel Mustard (2016), Dr Orchid (2016), Reverend Green (2016), Mrs Peacock (2016) and Professor Plum (2016)
LEGACY SUSPECT PACK – Coming soon…
BONUS CONTENT – Tropical Pack, including a new player avatar, a different card back, a themed clue sheet and a tropical dice set

70070000032645.name: TCG Card Market Simulator: Trade Master
70070000032645.intro: Build your shop, trade your cards, grow your empire.
70070000032645.description:
Dive into the trading card shop experience with bundle, which includes the base game and two exclusive DLCs. Start from scratch and build your own card shop empire — manage your stock, set prices, and host tournaments to attract fans from all over. With this complete edition, your store not only runs smoothly but looks better than ever!

- Base Game – TCG Card Market Simulator
Become the ultimate card shop owner! Buy booster packs, trade, organize tournaments, and master the art of card market strategy to grow your business into a true TCG hub.
- DLC 1 – Skybox Upgrade
Give your shop a stunning visual refresh with a brand-new skybox! Transform your environment and make every trade feel special under a new, scenic backdrop.
- DLC 2 – Exterior Customization
Redesign your shop’s exterior with stylish graffiti and creative designs. Express your personality, attract attention, and make your store the talk of the TCG community!

Build your dream shop, attract passionate collectors, and rise to the top of the card market — your trading card empire starts here!

70070000032650.name: BMX CITY RUN: Pro Rider
70070000032650.intro: Boost your stunts, explore every location, and ride like a legend!
70070000032650.description:
Get the BMX experience with this bundle! Take on thrilling locations, perform daring stunts, and explore the city like never before.

This bundle includes:
- Full Game: BMX CITY RUN - Embark on your extreme cycling journey, customize your character and bikes, and master each mission across unique and exciting locations.
- DLC: Cash Surge - Kickstart your adventure with exclusive in-game bonuses to upgrade your bikes, unlock powerful perks, and enhance your BMX stunts from the very start.

Push your limits, show off your skills, and ride to glory. Everything you need for the ultimate BMX adventure is here!

70070000032656.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Fleet Manager
70070000032656.intro: Take control of the skies and build your cargo empire.
70070000032656.description:
Take off into the ultimate aviation experience, including the base game and both DLCs. Step into the shoes of an aspiring airline owner and pilot, and transform a humble cargo airline into a global aviation empire. From small regional airports to bustling international hubs, your journey is filled with thrilling challenges, strategic decisions, and limitless opportunities.

What’s Included:
1. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business:
- Manage your aircraft and airline business simultaneously, from a single-engine plane to a full-fledged cargo empire.
- Explore over 10 unique airports worldwide, each offering distinct challenges and business opportunities.
- Navigate variable weather conditions and day/night cycles for realistic and demanding flight scenarios.
- Transport a variety of cargo, from routine mail to rare and precious items, testing both your piloting and strategic skills.

2. Cash Cargo (DLC):
- Start your journey with an instant $350,000 in-game currency bonus.
- Invest in top-tier aircraft, expand your hangars, and enhance your cargo operations right from the beginning.

3. Business Expansion (DLC):
- Receive your first hangar for a strong foundation in fleet management and operations.
- Already own all hangars? Get 80,000 in-game currency to invest in aircraft, cargo, or new airports.

Take control of the skies and build your cargo business like never before. From thrilling flights and strategic management to elite cargo operations, this complete bundle gives you everything you need to become a legend in aviation.

70070000032658.name: Casual Sport Series: Racket Sports Bundle
70070000032658.intro: Grab your racket, hit the court, and become the ultimate racket sports champion!
70070000032658.description:
Step onto the court and experience the thrill of fast-paced racket sports with the Casual Sport Series: Racket Sports Bundle, featuring Casual Sport Series: Badminton and Casual Sport Series: Tennis. 

Master precision, timing, and strategy as you compete in two of the world’s most exciting court sports. In Casual Sport Series: Badminton, unleash lightning-fast smashes, delicate drop shots, powerful clears, and tricky net plays. Quick rallies and responsive controls make every match a dynamic test of reflexes and skill.

Switch to Casual Sport Series: Tennis and compete across realistic surfaces including grass, clay, and hard courts. Use a full arsenal of shots-from topspin and slices to drop shots and powerful serves-to outplay your opponents and dominate the match.

With vibrant arenas, roster of characters, and easy-to-learn controls, this bundle delivers hours of exciting sports action for players of all skill levels.

Bundle Includes:
Casual Sport Series: Badminton
Casual Sport Series: Tennis

70070000032661.name: Oblivion Dreams: Transport Edition
70070000032661.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000032661.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 64 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.

70070000032664.name: Wall World Complete Edition
70070000032664.intro: Get the complete Wall World experience with this bundle!
70070000032664.description:
Get the complete Wall World experience with this bundle! Wall World Complete includes:

Wall World: A chill, physics-based platformer where you climb a mysterious wall, explore its secrets, and build your home. Use your grappling hook to overcome obstacles, collect resources, craft powerful upgrades, and uncover the secrets of the wall.

Wall World: Deep Threat: The exciting DLC expansion that adds new threats, new biomes, new weapons, and new mysteries to the world of Wall World. Explore the depths of the wall and face off against a dangerous new enemy.

70070000032665.name: Super Princess & Puzzle Collection: 18 Games in 1
70070000032665.intro: 18 charming games in one magical bundle!
70070000032665.description:
Super Princess & Puzzle Collection brings together a delightful selection of colorful, relaxing and easy-to-play puzzle adventures for all ages. Match shapes, solve clever puzzles, pop bubbles and explore a variety of vibrant worlds — from fantasy kingdoms and cute animal realms to festive holiday settings.

Perfect for quick sessions or long playtimes, this collection offers endless fun and amazing value: 18 games in 1!

Features

A huge variety of puzzle gameplay

Colorful graphics and friendly themes

Princess, animals, fruits, fashion and holiday-themed puzzles

Hundreds of levels across all games

Simple controls suitable for kids and adults

Relaxing, family-friendly fun

Included Games

Zoo Merge
Fashion Passion Puzzle
Christmas Puzzle Story
Fantasy Saga Frenzy
Galaxy Mania
Bubble Shoot Farm
Bubble Fresh Fruits
Christmas Bubble Puzzle
Fashion Princess
Fashion Girls
Fashion Friends
Animal Puzzle Cats
Fruity Puzzler
Dino Puzzler World
Nature Puzzle
Princess Puzzle Adventure
Animal Puzzle World
Princess Bubble Story

70070000032667.name: Hentai Session: Tropical Thrill
70070000032667.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70070000032667.description:
Welcome to Hentai Session, a relaxing puzzle experience full of color, style, and charm. Take your time to assemble vivid illustrations featuring elegant and expressive characters. Each completed puzzle unlocks a detailed image designed with care and creativity in your collection.


Enjoy the satisfying flow of gameplay, soft background music, and cozy atmosphere that make each session a moment of calm and focus. Whether you’re here to unwind or to challenge your observation skills, it’s the perfect way to relax and have fun.

This bundle include Portraits Pack 1 DLC

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 puzzles to complete
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle assembly
- High-quality illustrations full of detail
- Gentle music and relaxing atmosphere
- Gallery mode to view completed works
- Perfect for a calm and focused gameplay session

70070000032678.name: DIY Fashion Star: Gold Edition
70070000032678.intro: Refresh your wardrobe with stylish DIY projects and put your clothing design skills to the test!
70070000032678.description:
Got a boring old blouse? Reshape it, style it, decorate it, and make it a trendy new tank top with some clothing design hacks!

This bundle includes:
- DIY Fashion Star
- DIY Fashion Star: Arts & Crafts
- DIY Fashion Star: Stylish Outfits

Features:
- Complete awesome DIY fashion design dress-up clothing projects. Turn your boring old clothes into amazing new stylish outfits!
- Redesign new clothes and decorate them with new patches and accessories!
- Cut out patterns, sew on decorations, and add splashes of color onto your fashion designs! Unleash the inner fashionista you've always been destined to be!
- Transform your doll's style with 20 new and captivating clothes that will add a touch of sparkle to her look!
- Manage your very own DIY fashion dreamhouse studio from the comfort of your home and make videos of your dolly creations to gain followers. Become a famous fashion super stylist!
- Take pictures of your doll dressed in your DIY designer outfits and compete in selfie contests with other DIYers!
- Get a stunning, sweet doll makeover to look extra pretty in your DIY clothing. Dye your doll's hair, get her a new hairstyle, and do her makeup!

You're about to blow the world away with all of your fabulously stylish DIY fashion design skills to give your followers the ultimate doll makeover. Get creative with super-fun, sweet doll dress-up projects. Use your outfit designer imagination and turn your ordinary clothes into OMG-to-die-for stylish DIY dress-up outfits!

Take selfies with your new DIY clothes and compete in selfie contests! Run your own fashion designer channel and post videos of your DIY outfits to gain a huge fan base!

To all DIY game lovers, unleash your creativity and dive into the world of doll dress-up inspired outfits!

70070000032680.name: Golf Guys: Gold Edition
70070000032680.intro: Face off against a dozen opponents in an ultimate golf battle royale, or invite friends to play in multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
70070000032680.description:
Grab your golf club, check the wind direction, aim well, choose the force of impact on the ball and hit it! Hurry up because no one is going to wait for you!

This bundle includes:
• Golf Guys
• Golf Guys: Space DLC
• Golf Guys: Fantasy DLC

Features:
- try out 2 new amazing bats and 2 new balls with maximum stats!
- put on 4 new themed funny skins
- play golf battle royale tournaments and become a champion!
- play against your friends or family in multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- practice your skills before tournaments in Zen mode
- compete on over 15 maps with various obstacles and shortcuts
- earn packs for winning tournaments to get skin cards, upgrade cards and money
- unlock silly character skins, golf clubs and balls in various funny shapes
- buy golf club and ball upgrades using earned coins
- perform quests to collect awesome rewards on your reward track

This game is all about speed, precision and decision-making. Compete in tournament mode on random maps with different rules. Score as many points as possible by hitting the ball in the center of the target, be first in a race to hit the ball into the hole before others do, or find the best way to beat everyone in a mini-golf with various obstacles!

Consider the direction and speed of the wind when developing your strategy. After each match, the worst ones drop out so if you want to make it to the finals you have to stick to the podium!

If you don't want to play solo, you can always invite your friends or family to play in the multiplayer mode! Choose your character skins, golf clubs and compete in a tournament for the title of the best golfer!

If you feel like practicing a little, turn on Zen Mode and become a better golfer! Choose a map, wind parameters and practice your strokes without worrying about time or other players!

Do you have what it takes to be the last one standing and become a golf champion?

70070000032682.name: Aquapark io: Gold Edition
70070000032682.intro: Race with your friends on waterslides and jump into the pool for victory!
70070000032682.description:
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or enjoy sliding solo. Prove that you are the fastest of them all!

This bundle includes:
- Aquapark io
- Aquapark io: Animals DLC
- Aquapark io: Sweet and Spooky DLC

Features:
- 14 large maps with slides
- 40+ funny skins, 11 floaties, 13 gliders
- multiplayer mode up to 4 players on one screen!
- opening packs with random skins
- spawning mysterious powerups during the game
- catchy holiday music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Slide down the huge waterslide which spirals down from the sky, overtake your friends, push them off the track or use powerups to gain an adventage. The funniest part is that you can actually jump off the track at any moment and try to land on a lower level overtaking everyone in an instant!

70070000032684.name: West Escape: Platinum Edition
70070000032684.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000032684.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

This bundle includes:
• West Escape
• West Escape: Rancher DLC
• West Escape: Adventurer DLC
• West Escape: Hustler DLC

Features:
- Premium Equipment: Silver watch for -25% crafting time, Silver nail for X2 tool dmg and Silver bullet for 25% combat power!
- Rare Gear and more: Obtain rare and uncommon equipment to boost your power level!
- Bonus currency: Get 1500 gems and spend them to progress even faster!
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes - dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load - freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70070000032686.name: Sweet Survivors: Gold Edition
70070000032686.intro: The purr-fect storm is coming! Can you protect your café from fluffy chaos?
70070000032686.description:
It looks like a normal day at the café… but suddenly, swarms of love-craving cats are storming in, and only you stand between them and total feline chaos! Armed with laser pointers, yarn balls, and even the dreaded pickle of doom, you’ll have to keep these fluffballs at bay while serving your customers their precious coffee. No big deal, right?

This bundle includes:
• Sweet Survivors
• Sweet Survivors: Spooky DLC
• Sweet Survivors: Flashy DLC

Features:
- Face down hordes of fluffy invaders
- Unlock 10 quirky toys and 8 heroic waiters
- Conquer shifts in 4 different café battlegrounds
- Upgrade your waiters and toys to become the strongest cat-wrangler
- Enjoy purr-fectly fun gameplay and cute visuals

Get ready for waves of fur and whiskers as you protect cozy cafés. Upgrade your toys and special skills to become the best cat-fighting waiter around! With each shift, you’ll unlock new waiters, fun toys, and even more cat-tastrophes!

Can you save your café before the cats take over?

70070000032688.name: Uboat Attack: Gold Edition
70070000032688.intro: Rise through the ranks and become a legendary commander!
70070000032688.description:
Dive into tactical naval warfare against enemy fleets!

Get behind the guns of a submarine and lead it into thrilling battles against formidable enemy convoys! Use your torpedoes to sink enemy armadas and rise through the ranks to become an admiral of the U-boat fleet.

This bundle includes:
- Uboat Attack
- Uboat Attack: Vortice DLC
- Uboat Attack: Cloverfield DLC

Features:
• Three new powerful ships: Vortice and Cloverfield!
• A big supply crate: 15000 medals, 10000 hammers, and extra torpedos to strengthen your forces!
• Variety of authentic ships: Track and destroy real warships with precision
• Realistic damage effects: Experience intense combat scenarios with diverse damage types
• Three game modes: Engage in naval battles, liberate territories, or complete as many missions as possible
• Upgrades and ammunition: Enhance your submarine's stats and equip it with various types of missiles
• Boosters: Gain an edge over your enemies with boosters like armor, air support, instant reload, thermal vision, and more
• Bonus missions: Look up and destroy all enemy planes
• Stunning graphics and locations: Immerse yourself in the game with realistic visuals
• Intuitive controls: Navigate and aim with ease using simple, responsive controls

Explore underwater areas of arctic wastelands, canyons, abyss, and sunken temples to get a tactical advantage in war and prepare an ambush!

Engage in marine events, tactical missions, and naval challenges to earn valuable resources. Dominate the seas and showcase your naval prowess!

Are you ready for the ultimate naval warfare simulator?

70070000032690.name: Mars Survivor: Gold Edition
70070000032690.intro: Conquer Mars, fend off alien threats, and secure your path to survival!
70070000032690.description:
After an asteroid catastrophe, your rocket ship crash-lands in the wilderness of Mars. Explore the planet's mysteries, strategize your escape, and build a shelter to protect yourself!

This bundle includes:
• Mars Survivor
• Mars Survivor: Red Rifle
• Mars Survivor: Blue Blaster

Features:
- Get a premium supply crates with lots of scraps, armor, weapons and materials!
- Use additional 1000 gems
- Navigate Mars's challenges
- Explore the planet's secrets and discover hidden materials
- Build a shelter and protect yourself from the harsh Martian environment!
- Defend against alien invasions and uncover secrets of the creatures of Mars!
- Gather oxygen and essential materials from old rocket ships to survive
- Strategize your escape mission and secure your passage back to Earth!
- Open epic loot boxes to swap or upgrade your gear

Go on dangerous expeditions to gather intel and resources. Fight off hordes of alien creatures, and save other survivors. Use their skills and knowledge to defend your base from a huge enemy attack!

Become the last man standing on Mars, navigate through the wilderness, and prove your survival skills!

70070000032693.name: My Cozy Room Shopping Spree Pack
70070000032693.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000032693.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes 17 great DLCs for the game.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000032695.name: Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Survival Master
70070000032695.intro: Rule the skies and dominate the battlefield.
70070000032695.description:
Take control of mighty dragons and face epic battles with this powerful bundle. Explore dangerous realms, uncover hidden secrets, and defeat monstrous foes as you unlock legendary dragon abilities. Venture through mystical portals, hatch new dragons, and wield ancient powers that shape your destiny. Every realm is filled with fierce enemies, lost treasures, and breathtaking landscapes waiting to be conquered.

This bundle includes:
	•	Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Soar through treacherous skies, unleash fiery attacks, battle colossal monsters, and master multiple dragons, each with unique strengths and abilities.
	•	Survival Boost DLC – Grant your dragon +100 additional health, allowing you to endure harsher battles, survive deadly encounters, and push deeper into the most dangerous realms.

Take flight, strike hard, and become the ultimate dragon in every battle as you carve your legacy across realms filled with danger, mystery, and unending adventure.

70070000032704.name: Dustland Delivery(Wildmax Edition)
70070000032704.intro: This edition includes the Dustland Delivery base game and Dustland Delivery: Sheol DLC, featuring over 120 hours of gameplay content.
70070000032704.description:
Base Game:
Dustland Delivery is a post-apocalyptic survival business simulator, featuring over 40 hours of gameplay content. Scour the wastes for profit, complete missions to grow your trading empire, and assemble a rag-tag band of adventurers to turn your city into the capital of the Dustlands. Danger lurks around every corner—but no risk, no reward!

Marshal Resources to Build Your Dustland Empire
 •  A vast game world with a rich narrative to explore
 • Establish trade routes across unique settlements to become a kingpin of the wastes
 • Control resource flows to build magnificent cities
 
Transform Your Truck for Apocalyptic Adventures
 • Create your own mobile base to cruise through the Dustlands
 • Install mods to turn your truck into a deadly weapon against infected swarms
 
A Cast of Unique Companions
 • Recruit a rag-tag group of adventurers with distinctive traits
 • Assign different roles to help build your city
 • Tool up and train animal companions to boost your team's stats
 • Undead? No excuse not to show up for work...
 
Random Events, Freedom to Choose
 • Countless random events: armored motorcades, undead raids, unknown signals from mysterious locations...
 • Your Dustland, your way: become a warrior for justice, a money-grubbing merchant, or an infamous bandit
 
Struggle for Power, Rebuild the Wastes
 • 6 major factions with a web of complex relations
 • Exploit power struggles and trading rivalries to come out on top
 • Form alliances, stir up trouble, and build your own power base
 
Complex Weather System
 • Forge a path through the Dustlands while fighting storms and hidden dangers
 • Set up camp to shelter from the elements, then ride out at daybreak

Sheol DLC：
This is a large-scale DLC, with content far exceeding the base game and offering nearly 80 hours of gameplay. This DLC brings you the Dustlands like you've never experienced them before. With a new underground realm, exciting ruin exploration gameplay, and gripping storylines, you'll be immersed in the dangerous and opportunity-filled world of Dustland Delivery. Fix up your truck, call up your crew, and get ready for a brand new adventure!
 
※New Underground World: Sheol
 
Enter subway stations to travel between the darkness of the underground and the all-pervading danger of the surface. Explore and survive in two different worlds where your every decision could determine the future of the Dustlands.
 
• Volcanos and Glaciers: New terrain types bring whole new experiences. Change your strategy to fit the terrain, carefully shepherding resources to survive in the Dustlands.
 • Underground Cities and Factions: The cities of the underground are denser than the surface, each one with its own unique cultures and factions who could be potential allies—or potential enemies. Your choices will determine the balance of power in world of the underground.
 
※Ruins Exploration: No Risk, No Reward
 
Mysterious ruins lie scattered across the underground, symbols of the glories of the old world fraught with danger—and opportunity.
 
• Explore Ruins: Pull your crew out of your truck and send them to explore ruins filled with deadly traps, powerful enemies, and priceless loot. They'll need all their cunning to survive.
 • Incredible Rewards: Ruins are filled with rare equipment, road-building survey data, and other priceless resources. Every successful exploration will grant you huge rewards, helping you to stay alive in the underground.
 
※New Storyline: The Dustlands' Final Chapter
 
Deep in the underground lurks a secret that could shake the Dustlands to their foundations. The decision is yours: will you bring the truth to light?
 
• Experience a vast main storyline, with over 20 brand new side stories.
• Uncover mysteries, choose your own path, and witness the end of the Dustlands as we know it.

70070000032710.name: Twins of the Sun: Complete Edition
70070000032710.description:
Set out on a thrilling adventure across untamed regions, dense jungles, cursed mines, and long-forgotten temples! Follow the twin heroes on their quest to save their abducted younger sister. 

The add-on unlocks the youngest sister as a playable character. Beneath her petite build lies a relentless fighting spirit. Quick on her feet, brave, and equipped with a one-of-a-kind weapon, she’s fully prepared to carve out her own destiny and leave a lasting mark on the story.

Broaden the experience with the extra Challenge Mode and enter the Arena, a relentless battleground where never-ending enemy waves will push your abilities to the limit. Confront formidable opponents, refine your combat skills, and fight for glory as you aim to rise as arena legends.

Take on the journey alone or join forces in 2-player local co-op and overcome every trial together.

70070000032714.name: Cottonville Valentine Edition
70070000032714.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000032714.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.


Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

Get ready for Valentine’s Day with the Love Outfits Pack included in this bundle.

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000032716.name: Pocket Nook Winter Wonderland Edition
70070000032716.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000032716.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

Relive winter days with Christmas DLC included in this bundle.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000032723.name: Subway Simulator – Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Metro Master
70070000032723.intro: Drive multiple trains, explore new stations, and create your style.
70070000032723.description:
Discover the complete underground experience! This bundle brings together everything you need to dive into the thrilling world of subway operations. Enjoy a mix of realism, creativity, and high-speed action as you build your career, customize your trains, and master every route on the map.

The bundle includes:
• Subway Simulator – Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games - Step into the role of a professional subway driver and explore detailed routes, diverse cities, and bustling stations. Progress through 100 challenging levels, operate multiple train models, and grow your skills as you advance through the ever-evolving subway network.
• DLC: New Color Train Pack - Express your creativity with a wide palette of vibrant colors. Customize your train to match your unique style and transform every journey into a visually striking ride through the underground world.
• DLC: Urban Speed - Expand your fleet with the sleek and powerful Metroliner Express. Designed for speed and performance, this modern train elevates your operations and adds a dynamic new edge to your subway experience.

With this bundle, you get the combination of exploration, customization, and high-speed mastery. Drive, discover, personalize — the entire subway system is yours to command!

70070000032731.name: Airplane Flight Simulator Bundle: Combat Zone & Dangerous Landings
70070000032731.intro: Handle Extreme Landing Situations and Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Pilot in our Best Flight Simulation Bundle!
70070000032731.description:
This bundle includes 2 games: Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone and Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings

Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone
Do you like piloting legendary fighter jets? In Airplane Flight Simulator : Combat Zone, you have open-world maps to explore, with an amazing selection of realistic airplanes. Enjoy the fully immersive experience provided by awesome flight controls, realistic interiors, sound effects and challenging weather scenarios.

In this flight simulator, you can engage in realistic combat and destroy all kinds of enemies, such as boats, ships, trucks, tanks and fighter jets. Prove yourself as the best pilot when faced with combat scenarios!

Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings
In this Flight Simulator, you take control of 33 unique airplanes across 15 action-packed levels and 3 free ride modes. Navigate through some of the most extreme flight emergencies, including engine fires, landing gear failures, dual engine flameouts, brake failures, flap issues and lightning strikes. Each level is set in a diverse environment, from snowy mountains to sunny beaches, vibrant towns and peaceful countryside, with both day and night scenarios to challenge your piloting skills. With realistic flight controls, immersive cockpit interiors, dynamic weather and day-night cycles, this simulator offers one of the most thrilling and authentic aviation experiences.

In Airplane Flight Simulator : Dangerous Landings, you must prove your skills as the ultimate pilot, managing to land safely under the most extreme conditions. With a global map showcasing realistic cities and airports, every landing challenges your skills to the fullest.

70070000032732.name: Bus Driving Simulator 24 City Roads & Farmer Simulator Bundle
70070000032732.intro:
Many vehicles carefully selected for you, built for all types of roads, ready to bring you on an unforgettable journey.
Explore different areas while driving on a Big Adventure!
70070000032732.description:
This bundle includes 2 games: Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads and Farmer Simulator.

Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads puts you in the driver’s seat and lets you become a real Bus Driver! Featuring detailed maps all over the world, a wide variety of modern city buses and school buses with realistic interiors and a groundbreaking 1:1 physics engine.

Features:
• A total of 21 buses to choose from, including 4 diesel, 5 hybrid, 5 electric, 4 articulated, 2 school buses and 1 double-decker (more available as DLC)
• Realistic city maps: United States of America (San Francisco), South America (Buenos Aires), Europe (Germany - Berlin, United Kingdom - London, Czech Republic - Prague), UAE (Dubai), China (Shanghai)
• Career and Free-ride modes
• Lots of bus customization options including paint, accessories, body parts, air conditioning, flags, decals and many more
• Detailed and customizable interiors
• Open/Close Doors button, animated people entering/exiting the bus
• Choose from 6 combinations of time-of-day and weather conditions, featuring midday, sunset, night, and either rainy or clear skies
• Drive kids to school using school bus models
• Bus company management system with hired drivers for your buses and custom route scheduling
• Intelligent Traffic System

Become the best bus driver in the world with Bus Driving Simulator 24 - City Roads!

Farmer Simulator
Farmer Sim will let you become a real farmer! Take yourself in an awesome open world and start enjoying this great farming simulator. Harvest different types of crops, manage your livestock - cows, sheep, turkeys, pigs. Experience the farming life, transport woods, hays, etc.
This Farmer Simulator will allow you to play with many machines, tractors, combines, trucks, trailers, plows, seeders, etc.

70070000032743.name: Slingshot Fun Collection
70070000032743.intro: Ready to launch some chaos? Load up your vehicle, pull back the slingshot, and fire away!
70070000032743.description:
Make it Fly is the ultimate dream of a flight enthusiast. Not only complete exciting flying tasks, but do it in the planes of your own design and creation!

Create the most effective flying contraptions you can think of or go crazy and see if the wildest machines you can imagine can still fly. Complete all of the challenges the game has in store for you or invite your own.

FEATURES:
- Intuitive building interface - use available elements in your own, creative way
- Various tasks to complete - think about them when you build!
- Unlock new types of elements & bases - never run out of ideas!
- Become a pilot and a constructor - hold your fate in your hand!

---

Are you a brave enough stunt driver? A crazy enough stunt driver? A fearless enough stunt driver to SEND A CAR FLYING OFF A SLINGSHOT?

In this awesome, one-of-a-kind driver arcade experience you will be able to:

- Adjust the strength of the sling shot
- Choose a jumping direction
- Watch your car jumping, flying, bouncing around until it smashes into the target...

… but only if you’re a skilled enough driver!

Aim carefully & try to land in the marked spot! For the coins you collect in each stunt you can buy awesome upgrades:

- Sling shot power: faster driving = further flying!
- Engine: for driving faster
- Bonus: earn more money for future stuntman jumping

The further you get, the more challenging the terrain becomes and the more carefully you have to aim your jumping.

70070000032744.name: Build & Feast Collection
70070000032744.description:
Cooking Festival is a delicious management sim that will let you bake, fry and grill around the world! Become the master chef the cooking world has been waiting for and whip up some homemade pancakes, grill juicy ribs, bake aromatic original Italian pizzas, and serve delicious ice cream that everyone loves! Cooking is incredibly easy - just tap & serve! Start exploring the world and prepare whatever cuisine you like!

Put your engineering skills, intuition and smarts to test in this brand new Bridge Construction Simulator puzzle game. You will become a constructor who is required to improvise and – most of all – adapt to the task at hand. Use your resources to construct structures able to hold the weight of a car. Try to become a good builder as fast as you can - things will get hard. You won't be racing against the time, so be a careful and thoughtful constructor.

Churn out massive machines in your finely-tuned factory of Idle Inventor - day and night, even while you’re not playing! As a factory-owning tycoon, you’ll be deciding how to max out your production. Manufacture cars, trucks, planes, military vehicles, and high-tech instruments for space exploration! Watch your factory grow from a single production line to a world-famous industrial powerhouse. And because you’re automating, your factory keeps working while you’re away - check in the morning, it’s amazing to see how much money you made while sleeping!

70070000032745.name: Truck & Camping Collection
70070000032745.description:
Offroad driving game for the adventurous! Navigate a dark forest with a map & compass, complete exciting missions. Detailed graphics, awesome cars, lighting and effects!

Start your adventure in the wilds today! This new and exciting offroad driving game lets you prove yourself in the rough terrain, driving and completing multiple different tasks!

Check your surroundings, use the tools available to you and start exploring! Find the next navigation point you have to reach or a specific place you have to investigate and try to reach it as fast as possible.

--- 

It’s vacation time! Get out of your house and begin the adventure today. Feel the summer breeze and prepare for a fun ride!

Camper Van Simulator features multiple different cars, each of them suited for a weekend getaway as well as long-term camping. Can you drive them around with style and precision required? If you want to earn your time in the sun you will have to give it your best!

You will drive campers, caravans, rv’s and even a boat trailer. The game features a wide selection of different cars. Each one of them has to be handled with care and precision.

Most of the time the narrow passages and roadside obstacles will be all of your problems. But the game also features realistic traffic that has to be taken into account. Remember – you’re driving a massive vehicle. You don’t want to crash it!

70070000032756.name: Neko Ramen Chef’s Special Edition
70070000032756.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!
70070000032756.description:
It's time to try ramen like you've never had before! Filled with delicious aromas, Neko Ramen will stimulate your logical thinking and ignite your senses!


Fulfill ramen orders under the guidance of a true master – the one and only feline chef! Each ramen is a perfectly calculated arrangement of flavors and shapes, so strain your brain to accommodate all the ingredients! But be careful, because intense thinking can be as spicy for the mind as ramen itself!


The orders will become increasingly sophisticated and difficult (but also more delicious). However, you don't have to worry about that, as you have as much time as you want to prepare the dish!


Here's what you'll find on the Neko Ramen menu:
- Over 90 scrumptious levels!
- 29 ingredients to compose perfect dishes.
- Music that will make you want ramen yourself.
- And charming graphics that stimulate both the eyes and the taste buds!

This bundle includes Chopstick Finesse 3 DLC with even more delicious levels to complete.

Do not wait, because even though the ramen will not get cold, the cat chief may not be so forgiving!

70070000032762.name: Cozy Memory Sweet Dreams Edition
70070000032762.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000032762.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes Cards Pack 1 with extra colorful cards.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000032776.name: Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim: Drift & Dominate
70070000032776.intro: Legendary rides, extra coins, and unlimited drifting fun.
70070000032776.description:
Take control of high-speed vehicles, master precision drifts, and push your racing skills to the limit across five thrilling game modes. Customize your rides with spoilers, rims, and unique upgrades to reflect your personal style while conquering dynamic environments.

This bundle includes:
- Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim – The adrenaline-pumping base game featuring immersive driving experiences and multiple challenging modes.
- Rich Racer DLC – Take your game to the next level with an additional 500,000 coins! Upgrade your vehicles with premium parts, customize your rides, and dominate the competition. Unlock new possibilities and become the ultimate driving maestro.
- 4 Ultimate Cars Pack DLC – Expand your garage with 4 legendary cars, each offering unique drifting abilities and iconic designs. Choose between opening the Cars Pack or receiving in-game currency to upgrade and personalize your collection.

Get ready to ignite your racing passion and become the ultimate drift master—your high-speed adventure starts here!

70070000032781.name: Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games – Ultimate Racing
70070000032781.intro: Millionaire’s coins, legendary rides, and unstoppable fun.
70070000032781.description:
Experience the ultimate street racing adventure with Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 and its exclusive DLCs! This adrenaline-fueled 3D car racing game lets you build, tune, and race your dream cars on streets packed with challenges, competing against the world’s best racers. Become a street legend, drift through turns, dominate drag races, and upgrade your cars to reach peak performance.

Bundle Includes:
1. Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games (Base Game)
- Race and drift on realistic city streets in high-speed drag competitions
- Build, customize, and tune over 30+ luxurious 3D cars
- Express yourself with colorful paints, cool stickers, and unique styling
- Enjoy online multiplayer PvP and test your skills against racers worldwide
- Take on car challenges, complete missions, and earn coins to unlock top-tier vehicles

2. Street Drag Racing: Millionaire’s Boost (DLC)
- Receive 1,000,000 in-game coins to unlock and upgrade your cars instantly

3. Street Drag Racing – Garage Expansion (DLC)
- Add the iconic Lamborghini Huracan to your garage (or claim its full in-game value if already owned)

With this bundle, you get everything you need to build, race, and dominate. Are you ready to leave your rivals in the dust?

70070000032790.name: Happy Landing Bundle
70070000032790.intro: Jump, leap and let fly to a happy landing with these three family-fun games!
70070000032790.description:
Bring action, adventure, and friendly competition to your family game night with this three-pack game bundle of Evel Knievel, Finnigan Fox and Cornhole. Each game features a multiplayer mode for family fun.

EVEL KNIEVEL
Relive Evel Knievel's legendary jumps like never before! From daring motorcycle stunts to riding a rocket over Snake River Canyon, this is the ultimate tribute to America's greatest daredevil. 

Simple controls with motion control option: tilt the controller to rotate in midair and stick your landings!

Play solo or turn-based multiplayer with up to four players!

FINNIGAN FOX
Join Finnigan on an epic journey through mystical lands. Wield your bladed crossbow to defeat enemies! Master the seasons with your magic to solve puzzles. Find the special tree seeds to help your friends rescue the forest!

Adventure solo as Finnigan, or compete with up to four players in the flying bird levels. 

CORNHOLE
Enjoy the popular outdoor lawn game in the comfort of your living room! Use motion controls or timing controls to toss bags onto the board or into the hole for points! 

Career mode: Compete in venues around the world and climb to Cornhole stardom! 

Arcade mode: Fast and frenzied simultaneous throwing competition!

Free play: Perfect for casual multiplayer games and solo practice. 

Supports 1 to 4 players with optional AI players—fun for all ages!

70070000032791.name: Achilles Bundle: Legends Untold & Survivor
70070000032791.intro: Two epic games. One bundle. Experience the untold story of a Greek hero in Achilles: Legend Untold and battle wave after wave of relentless foes in Achilles: Survivor.
70070000032791.description:
Answer the call of legend with the Achilles: Legends Untold & Achilles: Survivor Bundle. 

ACHILLES: LEGENDS UNTOLD
Discover an extraordinary adventure in a dynamic Action RPG with souls-like combat. Explore the mythical world of ancient Greece, where you’ll assume the role of the fearless warrior, Achilles.
Dive into a world where mastering combat is key to survival. Block and evade attacks, then sever limbs and heads of your foes. Develop your own tactics and achieve success over your enemies. If you fall in battle, rise again, enhance your hero's skills, try a different tactic, and venture forth once more.

KEY FEATURES:
SOULS-LIKE COMBAT – combat based on stamina management, dodging and blocking.
VARIOUS WEAPON COMBINATIONS – many weapon types with unique movesets for each combination. Wield two axes, a spear and a shield, a two-handed sword - create your own playstyle.
CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT – extensive skill tree, passive and active skills, upgradable stats and attributes.
A WIDE RANGE OF ENEMIES – fight regular bandits & warriors, mythological monsters and  powerful bosses with unique behaviours and tactics.
CRAFTING SYSTEM – collect loot and create usable items like potions, petards, stat enhancements + many more.
OPEN WORLD – an expansive world to explore, including many smaller levels like dungeons and basements.
STORY AND QUEST ELEMENTS - discover an intriguing story with two different endings and complete various side quests in the meantime.

Revel in the spectacular sights. Explore open worlds and take on countless challenges. Become an unbeatable hero!

ACHILLES: SURVIVOR
Every run writes your legend.

Achilles: Survivor is a fast-paced, single-player bullet hell set in Ancient Greece. Play as Achilles - or one of the legendary souls freed from Tartarus - and face relentless waves of enemies. Build deadly structures, evolve your powers, and grow stronger with every run. Defeat your enemies... or die trying.

Are you ready for battle?

KEY FEATURES:
- Fast-paced bullet hell in a world of Greek myths. Survive endless waves of enemies in a top-down action roguelike. 
- Build to survive, not just shoot. Drop traps, healing shrines, and summon allies with a unique structure-building system that turns the tide when things get desperate.
- Unlock legendary survivors. Play as Achilles or one of a growing cast of mythological heroes, each with unique powers and playstyles.
- Progression that respects your time. Complete challenges, earn Favors, and unlock permanent upgrades - get stronger with every attempt, even in defeat.
- Return to mythic Greece. Explore beautifully crafted arenas inspired by Achilles: Legends Untold - from the walls of Troy to windswept Greek coastlines.

70070000032792.name: Spot the Cat: Stories Edition
70070000032792.intro: Discover the stories of the feline heroes of our game!
70070000032792.description:
Can you find two identical cats? Use your pattern recognition skills and match the cats in pairs! Plus, learn about their history and personalities!
Each cat has its own story and personality. Our heroes would like to show you their strengths! Get to know them and enjoy the game even more.

70070000032799.name: 15-in-1 Mega Bundle
70070000032799.intro: 15 games, endless fun – action, puzzles, and adventure in one ultimate bundle!
70070000032799.description: Dive into a diverse 15-in-1 game collection packed with action, puzzles, and adventure! Battle through space in Galaxy Battle, explore dangerous lands in Shadow Quest and Dungeons and Goblins, and test your skills in challenges like Ramp Bike Racing, Parking Pro: Top-Down Challenge, and Nightshade Ninja Warrior. Relax with clever puzzles in Pool Puzzles, Pipes Master, and Word Quest, or chase high scores in fun arcade titles like Bounce Journey, Foxy's Coin Hunt, and Cloud Roll. With racing, strategy, puzzles, and arcade fun, this bundle offers something for every type of player.

70070000032809.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Extended Edition
70070000032809.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000032809.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #1 with:

This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000032813.name: Collector's Cove Supporter Edition
70070000032813.description:
The Supporter Edition is for those who want to support the developers of Collector's Cove even further!
Please know that we are incredibly grateful for your support. Thank you very much!

This edition includes the full game, two royal cosmetics for your animal companion – to give them an extra majestic look – and a matching jester cap to customize your character – perfect to keep their majesty entertained.

70070000032818.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Elite Ops
70070000032818.intro: Plan, execute, and conquer the most dangerous operations.
70070000032818.description:
Step into the boots of an elite SWAT operative and experience the ultimate first-person tactical action. Lead your squad through high-stakes hostage rescues, navigate intense firefights, and test your courage in fast-paced, high-risk operations. Strategically plan every move, master a wide range of weapons, and overcome deadly challenges to emerge victorious.

This edition includes:
- Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Command your team of assault troops, medics, snipers, and demolition experts. Analyze enemy positions, adapt to dynamic scenarios, and tackle gripping missions in a narrative full of intrigue and danger.
- Unleash the New Rifle DLC – Gain immediate access to the powerful Automatic Rifle III, built for precision, rapid response, and superior stopping power. Already own it? Receive its value in in-game currency automatically
- Advanced Scope DLC – Upgrade your arsenal with the Sight 2 scope for Automatic Rifle III, enhancing accuracy, target acquisition, and control under fire. Always stay one step ahead of your enemies.

Gear up, take control, and dominate the battlefield. Your tactical skill and bravery will determine the outcome of every mission—are you ready to answer the call and become the ultimate hero?

70070000032841.name: Moto Rush GT Essentials Edition
70070000032841.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000032841.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with any control method including... Toy-Con™ Motorbike! (Nintendo Labo™ Toy-Con 01: Variety Kit)

Forget about speed limits and the rules of the road! Here, you are in charge!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

MOTO RUSH GT FEATURES:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support – dust off your LABO if you have it!
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Tilt support – play by rotating your console!
• Play with Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller, or any other control method!
• Support all play styles - TV, Tabletop, Handheld, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads from around the world

This bundle includes base game and Grip Collection #4 with:

• four pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control. Outshine and outpace your rivals!

Check it out!

70070000032846.name: Survival Float Simulator – Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Survival Adventure
70070000032846.intro: Step into the heart of the swamp and master survival.
70070000032846.description:
Step into the mysterious swamp and begin your journey of survival! Build your raft from raw materials, craft essential tools, and navigate murky waters full of hidden dangers and tangled vegetation. Test your skills and ingenuity to thrive in this untamed environment.

This bundle includes:
1. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build (Base Game):
Craft your haven from its bounty, transforming a makeshift raft into a thriving sanctuary. Embrace the challenge – murky waters, tangled vegetation, and an untamed beauty await your resourceful spirit.
2. Tool Textures (DLC):
The textures for hammer and axe are updated, giving them a more detailed and realistic appearance when crafted or in your inventory.

Explore, craft, and survive like never before—your swamp adventure just got richer, more detailed, and more satisfying!

70070000032859.name: Outlanders Ultimate Collection
70070000032859.description: Dive into the Outlands with the main game + Heir of the Roads + Flood and Fire + Life of Yolotli + Home is where the heart is +The Keeper's Shanty + Wandering Stars + A Taste for Trouble + The Culinary Diaries

70070000032860.name: DLC Pack 2
70070000032860.description: Get the DLCs: The Keeper's Shanty + Wandering Stars + A Taste for Trouble + The Culinary Diaries

70070000032861.name: DLC Pack 1 & 2
70070000032861.description: Get the DLCs: Heir of the Roads + Flood and Fire + Life of Yolotli+ Home is where the heart is + The Keeper's Shanty + Wandering Stars + A Taste for Trouble + The Culinary Diaries

70070000032866.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Wild Arsenal
70070000032866.intro: The wild calls - answer with power and strategy.
70070000032866.description:
Venture deep into the untamed wilderness and face the thrill of the hunt. Whether you’re tracking elusive prey or preparing for high-stakes encounters, this bundle gives you everything you need to elevate your hunting experience from start to finish.

This bundle includes:
1. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting (Base Game)
 Explore vast open environments, track intelligent wildlife, customize your gear, and master realistic hunting mechanics shaped by dynamic weather and advanced animal AI.

2. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Weapon Upgrade (DLC)
 Gain access to the Regmintona 070, a powerful close-range shotgun. If already unlocked, you’ll receive its full in-game value instead.

3. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Elite Weapon (DLC)
 Equip the Savatimp 8, a precision long-range rifle built for accuracy and impact. Players who already own it will receive 1400 in-game currency.

Prepare your gear, steady your aim, and step into the wild with confidence—this bundle delivers everything you need for the ultimate hunting adventure.

70070000032869.name: Stunt Driver Collection
70070000032869.description:
Have you ever wanted to feel like a super agent performing spectacular stunts? Have you ever been late on a plane and had no time left to park your car and run for the check in? And you were wandering: Why can’t I just park my car inside a plane? Are you a little bit insane? Now you have that possibility in "Jump into the Plane"!
This is not an impossible mission. Drive your rocket boosted car directly into a cargo hold of a flying plane! And remember, timing is crucial here!  One second less and you're gone! So hurry! You’ve got a plane to catch!

---

It’s a bird! No, it’s a plane! Or maybe a car? What the hell is that thing? I want to drive this right now! If you ever feel this way when seeing some of your favourite superhero vehicles, you’re in the right place! So buckle up and prepare for super fun times in Super Hero Driving School. Because even heroes need a driving licence, you know!

70070000032880.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Critical Scan
70070000032880.intro: Take control, detect hidden danger, and stop the outbreak completely.
70070000032880.description:
Take control of the ultimate quarantine checkpoint and protect humanity from a zombie outbreak with this bundle. Manage desperate travelers, detect hidden infections, and make critical decisions that could mean the difference between life and death. 

Bundle Includes: 
1. Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint 
Take charge of a high-stakes border checkpoint, use military-grade tools, inspect travelers, and make life-or-death decisions in a world teetering on the edge of a zombie outbreak. 

2. Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Infection Detection 
Enhance your checkpoint with the new purple-pink temperature scanner, detect hidden fevers faster, and gain a strategic advantage to identify infected individuals before it’s too late. 

Experience the ultimate border defense challenge—where every scan, decision, and action counts. Spot the infected, protect the healthy, and survive in a world on the brink of chaos.

70070000032883.name: Moto Rush GT Hero's Edition
70070000032883.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000032883.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 8 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000032884.name: My Cozy Aquarium: Antique Pack
70070000032884.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000032884.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle include Antique Decoration DLC.


KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000032894.name: Urban Flow Content Bundle
70070000032894.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000032894.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, London Rules and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•   Play 10 new stages!
•   Introducing 5 new vehicles to the streets of Urban Flow, each one unique and with its own style.

70070000032897.name: BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 – Modern Arsenal
70070000032897.intro: Equip, engage, and dominate with a deadly weapon.
70070000032897.description:
Step into the intense world of modern combat, featuring the full BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 experience and an exciting weapon upgrade. Patrol dangerous zones, engage in high-stakes firefights, and complete critical objectives, all while giving your pistol a striking new material for a personalized touch on the battlefield.

Bundle Includes:
- BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 – Experience first-person missions through a realistic bodycam perspective. Complete tactical operations, secure zones, and eliminate threats with precision and strategy.
- Elite Weapon Skin DLC – Equip your pistol with a unique new skin, enhancing its appearance and giving your firearm a standout look in combat.

Combine elite combat skills with a custom arsenal, dominate every mission, and make your mark as a top operative. Every shot counts, and now your style does too.

70070000032904.name: Spy Guy Poznan Edition
70070000032904.intro: A new map, new challenges, new hidden objects, but the same familiar game!
70070000032904.description:
Do you know a city whose symbol is two goats? Discover Poznań! A Polish city full of interesting places and beautiful corners. Search for hidden objects on a new, colorful map.

The basic version of the game will introduce you not only to the Polish city, but also to wonderful colorful maps, where over 200 hidden objects await you in each part.

70070000032906.name: Urban Flow Hero's Edition
70070000032906.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000032906.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Streets Supplement and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•   Introducing 10 new vehicles

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

70070000032915.name: Chained Climb Together: Climb Higher
70070000032915.intro: Rise together - master every rope, conquer every peak.
70070000032915.description:
Embark on an epic ascent in Chained Climb Together and enhance your climbing experience with a completely upgraded rope! Bound by mystical chains with your companions, navigate towering mountains, treacherous terrains, and unique challenges while coordinating every move with precision.

This bundle includes:
- Chained Climb Together – Experience vertical climbing like never before. Master chain mechanics, explore diverse mountain landscapes, and overcome obstacles to claim new heights. Play solo or team up with friends in a thrilling online adventure.
- Chained Climb Together: New Rope – Transform your climbing gear with a stronger, more responsive rope that improves control, stability, and precision. Conquer every peak with confidence and style.

Coordinate with your team, master the ropes, and rise to the summit together! This bundle delivers the full climbing adventure with all the tools you need to dominate the vertical challenge.

70070000032922.name: Knights & Guns Essentials Edition
70070000032922.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000032922.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game and Armor Pack #4 with:
- 2 new armors to help you on your quest

Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", " Sweet Bakery Tycoon (DLC#1)" and "Burger Chef Tycoon (DLC#3)".

70070000032929.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of birds themed stickers.
70070000032929.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album.
