- DLC: Suit Customization - Unlock an exclusive costume to customize your character and stand out in your adventures.

Enhance your survival journey, explore new possibilities, and experience Palland like never before with this ultimate bundle!

70070000032950.name: Summer Unpacked Winter Break
70070000032950.intro: Unpack your memories, relax, and let the summer linger a little longer.
70070000032950.description:
Summer may be ending, but your adventure is just beginning! In Summer Unpacked, you’ll revisit the cozy moments of your summer days through many charming puzzle levels. Sort your souvenirs, organize your travel bags, and rediscover the little joys that made the season special. Each puzzle is a gentle reminder of sunny afternoons, seaside picnics, and long, golden sunsets.


Relax, take your time, and enjoy the soothing gameplay designed to bring back those warm summer vibes. Whether you’re folding clothes, arranging postcards, or fitting keepsakes perfectly into place - every level tells a quiet story of nostalgia and peace. It’s the perfect way to say goodbye to summer… without really letting it go.

This bundle contains the Winter DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Over 30 cozy puzzle levels inspired by the end of summer
- Relaxing gameplay full of gentle logic and organization challenges
- Beautiful, sun-washed visuals and calm ambient soundtrack
- Feel-good atmosphere perfect for winding down
- Satisfying mix of sorting, arranging, and fitting puzzles

70070000032955.name: S.N.I.P.E.R - Hunter Scope Hero's Edition
70070000032955.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Target Acquired and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition 
- SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements 
- SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
- SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology 
- FMS-1-G rifle

70070000032960.name: Cozy Tiny Home Christmas Miracles
70070000032960.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000032960.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle contains the Christmas DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

Start stronger, expand faster, and turn your aviation dreams into reality. With this boost, the sky truly is your business!

70070000033037.description:
Get ready to explore a colourful open world packed with secrets, challenges, and endless driving fun!

From sunny beaches and peaceful farms to bustling downtown streets and misty mountain peaks — every corner hides surprises waiting to be discovered. 

Find hidden collectibles, unlock unique car skins, and reveal secret paths and jump ramps scattered across the map!

Complete exciting missions to earn stars and expand your collection of cars — from everyday rides like taxis, vans, and pickups to emergency vehicles, off-roaders, and legendary supercars. Each car brings its own personality, and your hero even changes outfits and facial expressions to match the action!

Enjoy a living city with working traffic lights, honking drivers, and expressive reactions in fun comic-style bubbles. Whether you’re parking with precision, racing against the clock, or delivering goods safely across town — every task is a new adventure.

Drive, explore, discover — and make every ride your own!

Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Vision offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

70070000033049.name: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor - Deluxe Edition
70070000033049.intro: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor!
70070000033049.description:
Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Ride with the classic steam team and enjoy nostalgic stories and new narratives from the engineer’s seat. This Deluxe Bundle includes everyone’s favorite Number 5 engine, James! Explore the Wonders of Sodor—fun and magic await!

• Join Thomas, Diesel, Gordon, Percy, and Emily for railway adventures in their home, the Island of Sodor.

• Explore iconic landmarks across Sodor, such as the Tidmouth Sheds, Knapford station, and the famous Windmills.

• Play a total of 8 stories, all narrated by the legendary Mark Moraghan.

• The Deluxe Bundle includes James and 4 extra stories to enjoy!

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor is powered by Train Sim World, combining the unparalleled detail and realism of Unreal Engine and Simugraph with accessible controls to create a nostalgic experience that all Thomas & Friends™ fans can enjoy.

Welcome to a vibrant metropolis bursting with neon lights, roaring engines, and pure adrenaline.

Test your reflexes and precision in intense straight-line races across ¼ mile, ½ mile, or full-mile tracks — both by day and under the dazzling glow of city nights.

Upgrade, tune, and customise more than 60 unique cars to dominate your rivals. Boost your engine, fine-tune your gearbox, unleash the nitro, and leave your opponents in a trail of smoke and shattered pride.

Shift. Launch. Win.

Every second counts. Every victory matters.
Feel the rush of nitro, the thrill of precision, and the glory of crossing the finish line first.

70070000033061.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Street Racing

70070000033061.description:
Get ready for the ultimate street racing experience with Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator! Navigate through bustling city traffic, master high-speed maneuvers, and push your driving skills to the limit as you aim to become the king of the roads. Every turn, drift, and overtake tests your precision, reflexes, and racing instincts.

This bundle includes:
1. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Dive into immersive city traffic racing with realistic car physics, stunning graphics, and a wide variety of vehicles. Race through multiple modes, dominate the leaderboards, and prove your skills on every street.

2. New Car in Garage DLC – Turbocharge your garage with the Quantum Thunder Racer, a high-speed, stylish machine built for ultimate street domination. Already own the car? You’ll receive its in-game cash equivalent to customize your garage further.

3. Turbo Boost DLC – Jump ahead in your racing career with $50,000 in extra cash. Upgrade your cars, unlock premium vehicles, and customize your fleet for maximum speed and style. Take control of the streets and leave your rivals behind.

Hit the gas, upgrade your rides, and dominate the city streets. With everything included in this bundle, your road to racing glory has never been faster or more thrilling!

70070000033066.name: Criminal Cleaner Simulator – Crime Cleanup
70070000033066.intro: Take control of every scene and clean like a true professional.
70070000033066.description:
Step into a world where precision and style matter. Every crime scene is a challenge, and every tool counts. Upgrade your crime scene cleaning experience with this bundle, combining the full game with stylish new equipment skins. Tackle every scene with efficiency, skill, and a professional look.

Bundle Includes:

70070000033072.name: The Survivalists - Complete Edition
70070000033072.intro: Preparation is the key to survival. Gear up in advance with The Survivalists: Complete Edition.

Preparation is the key to survival. Gear up in advance with The Survivalists: Complete Edition and get access to:

The Survivalists:

A living world full of surprises, secrets and danger awaits in The Survivalists, an adventure-filled survival sandbox set in The Escapists universe. Explore, build, craft and even train monkeys with up to three friends in a desperate bid to survive. Have you got what it takes to be a Survivalist?

Step into the ultimate survival experience with this bundle. Face the untamed wilderness armed with your instincts, trusty weapons, and now enhanced protection. Track, hunt, and outsmart the legendary Bigfoot while your new armor shields you from deadly attacks, giving you the edge in every encounter.

This bundle includes:
1. Bigfoot Hunting – Explore a living, breathing forest filled with unpredictable danger. Hunt, survive, and master the wilderness in a first-person, high-stakes adventure.
2. Bigfoot Hunting: Hunter’s Shield – Equip protective armor, track your defense with a dedicated armor bar, and survive longer against the forest’s deadliest threats.

Prepare yourself for the ultimate hunt. Will you outwit the legend—or become another forgotten story in the shadows of the forest?

70070000033092.name: Football Legends 2025 Extended Edition
70070000033092.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70070000033092.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

This bundle includes the base game and Team Pack #1 with:
- three new teams

70070000033100.name: Cottonville Complete Collection
70070000033100.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000033100.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes the following DLCs: Halloween Outfits Pack, High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack, Japan 90s Outfits Pack, Love Outfits Pack, and Winter Outfits Pack.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000033101.name: Neko Bento 2 World Flavors Collection
70070000033101.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest lunchbox puzzle is back with even more satisfying challenges!
70070000033101.description:
Say hello to Neko Bento 2 — a flavor-packed puzzle experience where lunch is still cute, but now even trickier to pack!

This time your favorite feline chef is back with even more riddles to solve! You thought you knew it all? Think again because these levels with brand new ingredients and shapes will put your spatial brain to the test.

Although the challenge has risen, you don’t have to worry too much about that. You may have as much time as you like to complete a puzzle.

What will Neko Bento 2 serve you?
- Over 90 levels to eat up.
- 29 various ingredients to organize - pay attention to their shapes, it’s crucial…
- Music track that will help your mind focus and lock in!
- Artwork that will win your taste over… and not only the music one.

This bundle includes the Chef’s Dream 1, 2, and 3 DLCs, featuring even more levels to complete.

Chefs tend to be impatient, so don’t wait for too long and become the ultimate bento master!

70070000033103.name: Cozy Memory Tiny Adventurers Pack
70070000033103.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000033103.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes Cards Pack 1 and the Covers Pack, featuring extra colorful cards.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000033108.name: Little Cozy Home Extended Edition
70070000033108.intro: Create, decorate, and make your dream home come true!
70070000033108.description:
Design Your Dream Home!

Step into your cosy virtual house and unleash your creativity!

Decorate seven beautifully crafted rooms — living room, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, office, hallway, and veranda — each ready to reflect your unique style.

Pick your favourite wall colours, wallpapers, floors, rugs, and furniture to make each room truly your own. Experiment, mix styles, and see your dream home come to life!

Keep your favourite designs and return to them anytime.
Take a picture of your creation without menus or buttons in the way!

Outside your window, the world changes with four beautiful seasons – from sunny spring and summer, through colourful autumn, to snowy winter.

Easy to play, relaxing, and full of creativity – perfect for young decorators with big imaginations!

Decorate, play, and make your home the cosiest place ever!

This bundle includes the base game and Creative Desk with:

The set includes an elegant desk, a comfortable chair, and other accessories that let you create your dream office. Work in style!

70070000033110.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection Core Edition
70070000033110.description:
Terrorise the unsuspecting citizens of Gravenville across 11 fully reimagined locations, from eerie asylums and military compounds to chaotic frat houses and heavily guarded police stations. All included Core Edition. The Core Edition also features two brand-new DLCs included with the base game!

Command An Army Of Ghosts  
Summon and control a legion of ghosts, banshees, gremlins, and more, each with unique abilities. Your ghoulish goons are more terrifying (and entertaining) than ever.  
 
Strategy Meets Supernatural  
Blend tactics, adventure, and resource management in a seamless gameplay loop set within a richly built paranormal world. 
 
Solve Mysteries, Unleash Horror 
Every haunting is a puzzle. Use spectral strategy and powers to uncover secrets, manipulate mortals, and complete objectives.  
 
Rediscover the Fear  
Ghost Master: Resurrection invites you to master the art of fear in a beautifully reimagined supernatural playground. The dead have risen... and they're under your control.

70070000033114.name: Coloree: Colors Near & Far Bundle
70070000033114.description:
Slow down and enjoy a calming color-by-number experience designed to help you relax, unwind, and take a mindful break—whenever you need it.
Coloree: Colors Near & Far Bundle combines the full base game with the World content, offering a rich and varied collection of coloring pages that range from cozy, everyday moments to beautiful places from around the globe.
The base game invites you into a warm and comforting world of illustrations inspired by daily life, people, seasonal moods, and gentle scenes. You’ll find a wide variety of themes—from cozy interiors and peaceful moments to scenes inspired by different times of the year. Each illustration comes with its own level of complexity, letting you choose between simpler pages with around 50 colors or more detailed artworks featuring over 150 colors for longer, more immersive sessions.
The included World content expands your journey with 15 unique illustrations inspired by real places across different continents. From iconic landmarks to atmospheric locations, these pages let you explore the world at your own pace, one color at a time. Just like the base game, each world illustration offers varying difficulty levels, making the experience welcoming for beginners and satisfying for more advanced colorists alike.
There are no time limits, no scores, and no penalties—only gentle progression and the freedom to color however you like. Whether you want a short, relaxing break or a longer creative session, Coloree adapts to your mood. Start, pause, and return anytime without pressure.
Designed as a cozy, inclusive experience, Coloree is made for anyone who enjoys calming creativity—regardless of age, background, or experience with games. The intuitive controls and clear color-by-number system make it easy to relax from the very first page, while the variety of themes ensures there’s always something new to discover.
If you’re looking for a peaceful way to unwind, express creativity, and enjoy beautifully crafted illustrations, Coloree: Colors Near & Far Bundle offers a soothing coloring experience that feels just as good as it looks.

70070000033122.name: Cup Heroes: Handful Bundle
70070000033122.intro: Join the adventure fully loaded with 481 diamonds!
70070000033122.description:
Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen! 

How to Play: 
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles. 
- Save the Queen: Your ultimate goal is to rescue the Queen who has been captured by evil forces. 
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and gems to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges. 

Features: 
- Premium Currency: Use 481 Diamonds to unlock new heroes, purchase keys to open exclusive chests, obtain high-rarity gear, and gain a powerful edge in battle.
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team. 
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes. 
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game. 
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen. 
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience. 
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests to earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!

70070000033124.name: Neko Ramen Trio Collection
70070000033124.intro: Get ready to stretch your brain and your belly — the cutest ramen puzzler is piping hot!
70070000033124.description:
It's time to try ramen like you've never had before! Filled with delicious aromas, Neko Ramen will stimulate your logical thinking and ignite your senses!

Fulfill ramen orders under the guidance of a true master – the one and only feline chef! Each ramen is a perfectly calculated arrangement of flavors and shapes, so strain your brain to accommodate all the ingredients! But be careful, because intense thinking can be as spicy for the mind as ramen itself!

The orders will become increasingly sophisticated and difficult (but also more delicious). However, you don't have to worry about that, as you have as much time as you want to prepare the dish!

Here's what you'll find on the Neko Ramen menu:
- Over 90 scrumptious levels!
- 29 ingredients to compose perfect dishes.
- Music that will make you want ramen yourself.
- And charming graphics that stimulate both the eyes and the taste buds!

This bundle includes Chopstick Finesse 1, Chopstick Finesse 2 and Chopstick Finesse 3 DLCs with even more delicious levels to complete.

Do not wait, because even though the ramen will not get cold, the cat chief may not be so forgiving!

70070000033136.name: Cozy Gardener Simulator: Style Your Garden
70070000033136.intro: Bring a little magic to your cozy garden adventures!
70070000033136.description:
Step into the heart of a charming small town and become the gardener everyone loves. With this bundle, you’ll get the full Cozy Gardener Simulator game along with a delightful DLC to personalize your tools and make your garden even more special.

Bundle Includes:
1. Cozy Gardener Simulator – Grow vegetables and flowers, care for flower beds, and keep lawns neat with your trusty lawnmower. Meet friendly townsfolk, complete wholesome quests, and experience relaxing, slow-paced gameplay filled with simple joys.

2. Cozy Gardener Simulator: New Skin – Give your trusty watering can a charming new look! Personalize your tool and add style to every gardening session, making your garden and town even more delightful.

Bring warmth, style, and charm to your garden and make every day in town a little brighter!

70070000033189.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Combat Zone
70070000033189.intro: Become an elite operator and master every dangerous mission.
70070000033189.description:
Step into high-stakes operations where split-second decisions and tactical awareness determine survival. This bundle brings together the full game and two DLCs designed to expand your tactical options and deepen immersion on the battlefield. Experience modern tactical combat at its most intense.

Bundle Includes:
• BODY CAM SHOOTER (Base Game) - Engage in a realistic first-person shooter experience from a bodycam perspective. Face reactive, armed NPCs across two unique tactical maps, adapt your strategy with different weapon types, and survive intense firefights where every decision matters.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Tactical Pistol Skin - Customize your sidearm with a premium pistol skin that adds a bold, professional look while preserving tactical realism. Stand out in combat with a weapon that reflects precision, confidence, and style.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Night Vision Mode - Operate in darkness with the Night Vision feature. Navigate shadow-filled environments, detect hidden enemies, and rely on stealth and awareness to gain the upper hand during night operations.

Prepare for immersive combat, enhanced tactics, and a sharper visual edge.

70070000033191.name: Pursuit Deluxe Edition
70070000033191.intro: Stay ahead, stay untouchable. Escape is the ultimate victory.
70070000033191.description:
Experience the full adrenaline-fueled journey with the Pursuit Deluxe Edition.
Take the wheel in a relentless city where every mission is a race against time, the police, and the unforgiving streets. Your reflexes, instincts will be tested as you  accelerate through tight corners, and make split-second decisions that determine your escape. 
Every chase tells a story — and every escape is earned.

This bundle includes the main title and two DLCs , giving you everything you need to master the escape:
- Extra funds gives you power through the city than ever. Upgrade, focus on speed, stay ready, and dominate every intense run.
- Unlock a car made for the unstoppable. Master sharper maneuvers, take turns with precision, and elevate every escape with a new driving edge.
Outrun them all. Keep moving forward.

70070000033208.name: ESCAPE – BACKROOMS HORROR: Depths of Fear
70070000033208.intro: Darkness hides more than shadows - it hides your worst fears.
70070000033208.description:
Descend into an endless nightmare where every corner hides new horrors. This ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR bundle includes the full game along with two DLCs that enhance your survival experience with light and firepower. Navigate the twisted maze, face terrifying creatures, and test your courage in an environment where sanity is always at risk.

Bundle Includes:
• ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR (Base Game) - Explore a labyrinth of damp carpets and flickering lights, where no two rooms are alike. Survive as you confront unknown horrors, using your camcorder to uncover hidden threats. Experience relentless dread amplified by chilling sounds, eerie lighting, and immersive first-person perspective.

• ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Eternal Light - Illuminate the darkness with a powerful flashlight that never runs out of power. Venture deeper into the maze with confidence, reveal hidden details, and uncover lurking horrors as you navigate the suffocating darkness. Light may be your only hope—or reveal even more nightmares.

• ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Arm Yourself - Face the maze’s deeper terrors armed with a pistol and limited ammunition. Every shot counts as you confront terrifying creatures and survive the twisted corridors. 

Strategy, courage, and precision are essential to make it out alive. Prepare for an experience of escalating fear, intense survival challenges, and a nightmare that never ends.

70070000033214.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Season 3
70070000033214.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number + Landscapes 2 + Under The Sea 2 + Flowers and Butterflies 2

70070000033215.name: Cipheur - Season 4
70070000033215.description: Cipheur + Quotes Pack 2 + Quotes Pack 3 + Uncommon Words 2 + Proverbs 2

70070000033222.name: SHIKA-Q Nexus Edition
70070000033222.description:
This bundle includes the full version of “SHIKA-Q” along with the “Nexus Battle Pass,” which grants access to exclusive rewards.

Engage in ultra-fast competitive puzzle battles on a 10×10 board, where creating Links and making split-second decisions determine victory. The “Nexus Battle Pass” adds season-exclusive customization items, bringing additional style and personality to your matches.

Collect limited-time rewards this season and experience the world of “SHIKA-Q” on a deeper level.

Content
■ Full Game
■ Nexus Battle Pass

Game Features
■ Strategy ×Super Speed × Showdown (1–2 Players)

Connect Links on a 10×10 board as offense and defense unfold in real time. Instant decisions determine victory.

Custom settings allow players to adjust the balance between speed and strategy—from slower, thought-focused matches to ultra-high-speed battles.

In addition to Offline Versus, the game also supports Online Battles and Ranked Matches, where split-second judgment determines the winner against players worldwide.

■ Challenge Mode (Single-Player)

A world-ranking-supported solo mode fully synchronized with music.

As stages progress, both the music and gameplay evolve. Manage your health, balance offense and defense, clear all 99 stages, and aim for a high score.

Unlike Versus Mode, this mode emphasizes discovering the optimal solution for each situation.

■ Characters, Worldbuilding & Customization

A diverse cast of characters enhances the competitive experience through unique themes and presentation.

Customize UI design, music, emotes, loading screens, wallpapers, icons, and more to personalize your matches.

Each theme includes dedicated character songs, deepening both musical and narrative immersion.

Tailor the atmosphere to your playstyle and express yourself through battle presentation.

■ DLC Battle Pass – Expanding the Online Experience

The DLC Battle Pass unlocks rewards progressively through mission completion.

It includes premium customization content such as UI designs, music, emotes, loading screens, wallpapers, and icons—enhancing the competitive experience.

The more you play, the more your presentation evolves. Your progress remains visible, supporting a long-term online experience built on growth and achievement.

※ The “SHIKA-Q” full game and the “Nexus Battle Pass” are also sold separately.
※ The full game is included in the “Premium Edition” and “Deluxe Edition,” and the “Nexus Battle Pass” is included in the “Deluxe Edition” and the “Battle Pass Set.” Please be careful not to purchase duplicates.

70070000033224.description:
This bundle includes the full version of “SHIKA-Q” along with both the “Nexus Battle Pass” and the “Premium Battle Pass,” each offering access to special rewards.

Engage in ultra-fast competitive puzzle battles on a 10×10 board, where creating Links and making split-second decisions determine victory. Each Battle Pass includes its own set of exclusive customization items, adding even more style and personality to your matches.

Collect season-limited rewards and experience every aspect of “SHIKA-Q” battles to the fullest.

Premium Battle Pass: Included in Premium Edition and Battle Pass Set.

70070000033261.name: Mini Market Design Classroom Craft
70070000033261.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000033261.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the School DLC, which allows you to build your dream classroom.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000033263.name: Hentai Session Exciting Encounters
70070000033263.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70070000033263.description:
Welcome to Hentai Session, a relaxing puzzle experience full of color, style, and charm. Take your time to assemble vivid illustrations featuring elegant and expressive characters. Each completed puzzle unlocks a detailed image designed with care and creativity in your collection.


Enjoy the satisfying flow of gameplay, soft background music, and cozy atmosphere that make each session a moment of calm and focus. Whether you’re here to unwind or to challenge your observation skills, it’s the perfect way to relax and have fun.

This bundle include Portraits Pack 2 DLC

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 puzzles to complete
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle assembly
- High-quality illustrations full of detail
- Gentle music and relaxing atmosphere
- Gallery mode to view completed works
- Perfect for a calm and focused gameplay session

70070000033264.name: Baki Dou: Blood Arena
70070000033264.description:
Step into the shoes of Baki Hanma in this action-packed 2D anime fighting game.

This bundle includes the Musashi DLC, a brand-new battle inspired by the latest season, Baki Dou.

Enter the arena for an intense showdown as Baki takes on the legendary swordsman in a brutal, high-stakes fight. New visuals, new animations, and an unforgettable duel await.

70070000033286.name: Ecchi Breaker: Active Edition
70070000033286.intro: Break the blocks and meet sporty girls.
70070000033286.description:
Focus and get ready to play.  Each hit brings you closer to what lies behind the blocks, and the prize for winning has never looked so good.

Focus, control your shots, and watch the tension rise with each block you destroy. But be careful... too many misses and the moment may slip away.

Features:
- 48 sports-loving girls waiting to be discovered
- Sensual music and satisfying effects
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- A feast for the eyes

Keep the balls in play and break through to your reward.

70070000033292.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.19
70070000033292.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the nineteenth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Charming Townscapes
- Wildlife in the Snow
- A Visual Guide to Japanese Landscapes
- [Moving] Japanese Landscapes with Railways

70070000033305.name: SELLING & PARKING & CRASH - Simulator Bundle
70070000033305.intro: Dig deep. Park smart. Crash hard. Three simulators. One ultimate bundle.
70070000033305.description:
Experience three unique simulator worlds in one powerful bundle, combining underground exploration, precision driving, and extreme crash action.

SELLING & PARKING & CRASH - Simulator Bundle brings together three full-featured simulation games, each offering a different style of gameplay and challenge.

Dig deep underground in a relaxing excavation simulator where exploration, upgrades, and smart selling lead to greater discoveries. Uncover valuable minerals, rare treasures, and hidden relics as you upgrade your tools and push deeper into the earth at your own pace.

Test your driving precision in a realistic American parking simulator. Navigate tight spaces, multi-level garages, skill-test ramps, and complex obstacles using a wide range of vehicles - from city cars to powerful muscle cars - all with lifelike driving physics.

Push your limits in an intense crash-driving simulator focused on speed, ramps, and destruction. Launch cars through extreme courses, survive brutal impacts, and beat time challenges with realistic crash physics and adrenaline-fueled gameplay.

Whether you enjoy calm progression, technical driving, or high-speed chaos, this bundle delivers variety, value, and endless replayability - all offline and ready to play anytime.

70070000033320.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Style Edition
70070000033320.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000033321.name: Cult of the Lamb: The One Who Waits
70070000033321.description:
The Cult of the Lamb: The One Who Waits bundle includes the base game, Cultist Pack, Heretic Pack, Sinful Pack, Pilgrim Pack, and Woolhaven DLC.

Cult of the Lamb casts players in the role of a possessed lamb saved from annihilation by an ominous stranger and must repay their debt by building a loyal following in his name. Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland worshippers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

BUILD YOUR FLOCK
Collect and use resources to build new structures, perform dark rituals to appease the gods, and give sermons to reinforce the faith of your flock.

DESTROY THE NON-BELIEVERS
Explore a sprawling, randomly generated world, fight off hordes of enemies and defeat rival cult leaders in order to absorb their power and assert your cult's dominance.

SPREAD YOUR WORD
Train your flock and embark on a quest to explore and discover the secrets of four mysterious regions. Cleanse the non-believers, spread enlightenment, and perform mystical rituals on the journey to become the mighty lamb god.

Cultist Pack
Be the envy of every cult with this exclusive Cultist Pack that includes a seven-piece decoration pack for your charming commune, as well as five exclusive Follower forms.

Heretic Pack
Show your devotion to the Old Faith with Cult of the Lamb - Heretic Pack. This cosmetic set includes new Follower forms, a set of dastardly decorations for your Cult, and Fleece of the Old Faith for the Lamb to wear. If your Cult aesthetic is (even more) blood, death, and doom, this pack is for you!

Cult of the Lamb: Heretic Pack includes:
- 5 brand new follower forms: Moose, Gorilla, Goldfish, Mosquito, and Opossum.
- 8 new base decorations.
- A heretical new Fleece for the Lamb!

Sinful Pack
Sin to your heart’s content with Cult of the Lamb - Sinful Pack. This pack is the perfect way to indulge for those who enjoy a gluttonous aesthetic befitting kings and queens. Vanity might be a sin, but there’s nothing wrong with that!

Cult of the Lamb - Sinful Pack includes;
- 5 brand new Follower forms: Hammerhead, Ladybug, Tiger, Llama, Sphynx
- 6 new Follower outfits
- 6 new base decorations
- A sinful new Fleece for the Lamb!

Pilgrim Pack
Deep in the Lands of the Old Faith lies paradise, for any pilgrims brave enough to seek it…

Join Jalala and Rinor as they journey across the Lands of the Old Faith, searching for a place to call home - as long as they can survive the dangerous Cultists looking for new sacrifices, the terrifying creatures hunting for a meal, and the strange mushroom-peddlars… not to mention rumors of a wicked beast who stalks the land, searching for their next victim…

This interactive adventure will show the world of Cult of the Lamb as you’ve never seen it before, with characters new and old to meet and mysteries to uncover.

The Pilgrim pack includes:
- The full Pilgrim story and bonus pages!
- A unique quest
- 3 new Follower forms
- 2 new outfits for your Followers to wear
- 5 new decorations

Woolhaven
A lost God calls you from a mysterious mountain—rebuild the flock and reawaken winter to uncover the truth of the fallen lambs. Face the past before it consumes you in this full-length expansion for Cult of the Lamb.

70070000033357.name: Oblivion Dreams: Luxury Edition
70070000033357.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000033357.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 64 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.

70070000033359.name: Cult of the Lamb: Woolhaven Edition
70070000033359.description:
The Cult of the Lamb: Woolhaven Edition includes the base game and Woolhaven DLC.

Cult of the Lamb casts players in the role of a possessed lamb saved from annihilation by an ominous stranger and must repay their debt by building a loyal following in his name. Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland worshippers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

BUILD YOUR FLOCK
Collect and use resources to build new structures, perform dark rituals to appease the gods, and give sermons to reinforce the faith of your flock.

DESTROY THE NON-BELIEVERS
Explore a sprawling, randomly generated world, fight off hordes of enemies and defeat rival cult leaders in order to absorb their power and assert your cult's dominance.

SPREAD YOUR WORD
Train your flock and embark on a quest to explore and discover the secrets of four mysterious regions. Cleanse the non-believers, spread enlightenment, and perform mystical rituals on the journey to become the mighty lamb god.

Woolhaven
A lost God calls you from a mysterious mountain—rebuild the flock and reawaken winter to uncover the truth of the fallen lambs. Face the past before it consumes you in this full-length expansion for Cult of the Lamb.

70070000033368.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Rouser Edition
70070000033368.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000033368.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Mark Rouser DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS A LEGENDARY BOXER
Receive the legendary Mark Rouser with his unique equipment and a bonus of 21500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000033373.name: Pets and Friends Valentines Bundle
70070000033373.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of valentines themed stickers.
70070000033373.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new valentines themed stickers to add variety to your album.

70070000033374.name: Spy Guy Junior Untypical Animals
70070000033374.intro: Find all the untypical animals with Spy Guy!
70070000033374.description: Before Spy Guy became a famous detective, he was dedicated to helping others from a young age. Alfred Moritz is trying to capture all the animals in the world to lock them in his private zoo. Can you and Spy Guy catch him before he achieves his goal? Discover the new Hidden Objects game, where in addition to searching for hidden objects, you will learn many fascinating facts about animals from around the world. With a beautiful, colorful, animated map, over 100 animals, an encyclopedia with interesting facts, and 3 game modes - see how quickly you can find them all!

70070000033387.name: Bridge Race: Gold Edition
70070000033387.intro: Build your way to victory, one brick at a time!
70070000033387.description:
Grab your bricks, get building, and race to the finish line before your rivals even lay their first stone! Collect bricks of your color and build your bridge to the next level. Got some extra bricks? Use them to expand your castle and unlock quirky new brick designs!

This bundle includes:
- Bridge Race
- Bridge Race: Medieval DLC
- Bridge Race: Funny DLC

NEW VERSUS MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Compete with your friends in an exciting head-to-head split-screen showdown. Choose your custom color and unique skin, set the number of rounds, and let your building skills shine. Earn points each round based on your finish, and see who rises to the top of the leaderboard. Ready to show off your skills and claim victory? 

Features:
- 7 additional skins to show off your style!
- 10000 coins to help you on your journey!
- Build across endless levels of fun!
- Local multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!
- Customize your bricks and character for a unique look!
- Expand your castle with extra bricks!
- Challenge yourself in epic bonus and boss stages!

Want to slow the competition down? No problem! Trip them up and zoom ahead to claim first place. Crush those bonus levels to stack up coins, and then use them to unlock new skins and colors to show off your style!

Outbuild, outsmart, and outlast the competition -who knew building bridges could be this much fun?

70070000033390.name: Run Sausage Run!: Chicken Edition
70070000033390.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000033390.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 3 new skins (Chicken, Cockroach and Fly)
- extra 15,000 coins to spend on outfits, powerups, or whatever

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000033392.name: NBA BOUNCE - GOAT: The Movie: Deluxe Edition
70070000033392.intro: Step onto the court with your favorite NBA team and mascots. Dribble, dunk, unlock gear, and play solo or with friends in fun game modes.
70070000033392.description:
Includes:

•	NBA BOUNCE 
Step onto the court with your favorite team! Choose from 30 NBA teams, dribble, dunk, and unlock cool gear as you rise from rookie to pro. Play solo or with friends in exciting game modes like Quick Match and Playoffs, while partying with mascots. Experience basketball like never before! 

•	NBA BOUNCE - Retro Party Pack
Pay tribute to Legacy Teams and party. 

Dominate the court with:  
-	An old-school basketball  
-	Classic sneakers and a newsboy cap 
-	A blazing newspaper trail  

•	NBA BOUNCE - GOAT: The Movie
Inspired by the film, GOAT, take your game to championship levels. Play as 8 new characters, rise in the Climb, and enter a showdown with friends in The Cage. Knockdown the competition and master every court.

Rise to legend status with: 
-	3 Roarball colors
-	Fresh new sneakers
-	New achievements

70070000033396.name: Skyline Bowling: Gold Edition
70070000033396.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000033396.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

This bundle includes:
- Skyline Bowling: Spooky Style
- Skyline Bowling: Sweet Style

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 6 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Balls - Equip 6 new bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 200K coins and 6K gems to buy and upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000033398.name: Maze: Path of Light - Gold Edition
70070000033398.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70070000033398.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths - experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

This bundle includes:
- Maze: Path of Light 
- Maze: Path of Light - Oasis Constellations
- Maze: Path of Light - Dusk Constellations

Features:
- 10 new constellations with 71 additional mazes
- Creative Level Design: Conquer 4 maze types - square, circular, triangular, and hexagonal
- 5 Unique Challenges: Classic, Portal, Token, Limited Moves, Timed and Dark Mazes!
- Power-ups: 3 helpful powers to help you find your way
- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70070000033399.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger - Season Pass
70070000033399.description:
Season Pass includes Additional Digimon & Episode Packs 1, 2, and 3, and Season Pass bonus Farm Item Golden Moai. This additional content adds new trainable Digimon and new episodes to craft a special experience that weaves together encounters across time and space not told in the main story.

Season Pass includes:
Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 1: Alternate Dimension
• Unlocked digivolution paths for the following five Mega Digimon
- BlitzGreymon
- CresGarurumon
- Omnimon Zwart
- Omnimon Alter-S
- Omnimon Alter-B
• A new episode featuring the Digimon listed above and the central characters, Kyoko Kuremi and Kodai Kuremi.

Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 2: GAKU−RAN
• Unlocked digivolution paths for the following five Mega Digimon
- BanchoLillymon
- BanchoStingmon
- BanchoGolemon
- BanchoMamemon
- Omnimon: Merciful Mode
• A new episode featuring the Digimon listed above and the central character, Hiroko Sagisaka.

Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 3: Anti-ParadoX
• Unlocked digivolution paths for the following five Mega Digimon 
- Omnimon (X Antibody)
- Jesmon (X Antibody)
- Magnamon (X Antibody)
- Gallantmon (X Antibody)
- UlforceVeedramon (X Antibody)
• A new episode featuring the Digimon listed above and the central characters, Asuna Shiroki and Monica Simmons.

Season Pass Bonus: Farm Item Golden Moai

*This product includes content that is also sold separately. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000033401.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger - Costume Pack
70070000033401.description:
A Costume Pack that includes multiple costumes and unlocks side missions related to each costume.

Costume Pack includes:
• Costume Swimwear Set
- Protagonist (Dan Yuki) Costume Swimwear
- Protagonist (Kanan Yuki) Costume Swimwear
- Inori Misono Costume Swimwear
- Aegiomon Costume Swimwear
- Side Mission: Proper Beach Attire

• Costume Chosen Children Set
- Protagonist (Dan Yuki) Costume Chosen Children Outfit
- Protagonist (Kanan Yuki) Costume Chosen Children Outfit
- Inori Misono Costume Chosen Children Outfit
- Aegiomon Costume Chosen Children Outfit
- Side Mission: The Targeted Cosplayer

• Costume Digimon Costume Set
- Protagonist (Dan Yuki) Costume Digimon Costume
- Protagonist (Kanan Yuki) Costume Digimon Costume
- Inori Misono Costume Digimon Costume
- Aegiomon Costume Digimon Costume
- Side Mission: Knowledge Is the Death of Fear

*Costumes may not be reflected in some cutscenes.
*This product includes content that is also sold separately. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.

70070000033403.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger Deluxe Edition
70070000033403.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Digimon Story Time Stranger
• Season Pass
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 1
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 2
- Additional Digimon & Episode Pack 3
- Season Pass Bonus: Farm Item Golden Moai
• Deluxe Edition Bonus: Costume Cyber Sleuth Set

Digimon Story Time Stranger is an RPG with monster-taming elements that explores the deep bond between humans and Digimon in an epic story that unravels the mystery of the world’s collapse.

Embark on an adventure that spans across the human world and Digital World, collecting and raising a diverse array of Digimon to fight in turn-based battles.

An Epic Story of Connection
Tokyo, Japan – An agent of a secret organization encounters an unknown creature shortly before a city-leveling explosion. They then reawaken eight years in the past...
Take on a mission to uncover the mystery of the world’s collapse, where chance encounters with unique characters will shape your journey across time and parallel worlds - and change fate itself.

Adventure Between Worlds and Time
Journey between the parallel human world and the Digital World: Iliad where Digimon reside. Explore the Digital World and its intricately detailed realms and discover all of its secrets.

Strategic Turn-Based Battles
Enjoy dynamic turn-based combat that combines strategic elements with evolved battle components. More than 450 Digimon and deep customization options provide limitless ways to approach the challenges of battle and reveal the strength of the bonds formed with your Digimon.

*This product is the Deluxe Edition. A Standard Edition and Ultimate Edition are also available. Please be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Costumes may not be reflected in some cutscenes.
*The DLC included in the Season Pass will be distributed by September 30, 2026.

70070000033405.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger Ultimate Edition
70070000033405.description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:

70070000033408.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Retail Kingdom
70070000033408.intro: Build your supermarket from a small shop into a thriving retail empire.
70070000033408.description:
Kickstart your journey to retail success! Take control of every aspect of your supermarket, from layout design and product stocking to expansion and brand identity. With extra starting cash and powerful customization options, you’ll be able to grow faster and create a store that truly stands out.

This bundle includes:
- Full Game - Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
Build, manage, and expand your own supermarket. Optimize profits, manage inventory, and turn a small shop into a thriving retail empire.
- Cash Bonus DLC
Instantly receive €1000 in-game currency to accelerate your startup, invest in premium products, upgrades, and early expansions.
- Shop Redesign DLC
Customize both the interior and exterior colors of your store. Create a unique atmosphere, refine your style, and make your supermarket visually stand out to attract more customers.

Start faster, look better, and build smarter. This bundle delivers everything you need to begin your supermarket success story.

70070000033420.name: Cozy Pets and Friends
70070000033420.description: Our bundle is a treat for gamers! Race a chicken, create an album with stickers of cute animals, or deliver pizzas while being chased by a cunning cat! It's all in this adorable set!

70070000033425.name: Ariana and the Elder Codex Deluxe Bundle
70070000033425.description:
Unravel the mysteries hidden within the Library with the Ariana and the Elder Codex Deluxe Bundle!

The Deluxe Bundle includes:
• Digital game
• Digital Art Book (62 pages)
• Digital Soundtrack (18 tracks)
• Ocean Bookmark*
• Rainfall Ring**
• Mothers' Blessing**

*The Ocean Bookmark will only be available as FREE DLC for the first two weeks after the game's launch to purchasers of the Digital Standard Edition or Deluxe Edition.

**The Rainfall Ring and Mothers' Blessing are exclusive DLC for the Deluxe Edition.

70070000033436.name: DAMON and BABY Deluxe Edition
70070000033436.intro: An unlikely pair, an unforgettable journey
70070000033436.description:
■Deluxe Edition Contents
- Main game
- Digital Artworks & Digital Soundtrack

"DAMON and BABY" is also available in the standard edition. Please be careful not to purchase more than one copy.
"Digital Artworks & Digital Soundtrack" is separate applications from the main game.


An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

■A new take on shooting action and in-depth exploration
Experience a new type of action adventure, featuring a fusion between exploration within an expansive world and highly technical twin-stick shooting. At your home base, power up the demon king Damon and make purchases. During the exploration phase, defeat enemies to complete each area. The story progresses as you alternate between the two phases.

■Strategic battles with a vast arsenal of weapons and gimmicks
The battle mechanics include both close-ranged attacks with handguns as well as long-ranged attacks with machine guns and more.
You can find more powerful weapons as you explore. 
During the boss battles awaiting within each stage, a strategic approach making use of the area gimmicks will prove crucial.

■Customization and Outfit Changes
Damon grows throughout the adventure, learning to master various weapons and skills. You can customize your set of skills to match your play style. You can even choose from a variety of outfit options to change Damon's appearance.

■Journey together with two player co-op
Take control of Damon's canine companion to help him in combat in various ways, such as collecting items.
*Only available via local (offline) play

70070000033445.name: Bowling Fever Special Edition
70070000033445.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000033445.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #5 with:

-20 new bowling ball styles

70070000033447.name: Ravenswatch - Year One DLC Pack
70070000033447.description:
The Year One DLC Pack brings together all the additional content published during the first year of Ravenswatch.  It gives you access to 8 DLCs: 3 playable heroes and 6 skin packs, as well as the digital artbook and the official soundtrack. This is the simplest, most affordable way to unlock all the game content released so far.

This pack does not contain the base game.

Content included:

* Fairytales Skin Pack
* Ravens Skin Pack
* Nightmares Skin Pack
* Unleashed Skin Pack
* Romeo & Juliet
* Romeo & Juliet Skin Pack
* Timeless Skin Pack
* Merlin

70070000033451.name: SnapCat Cozy Deluxe Edition
70070000033451.intro: SnapCat is a cozy exploration game about finding cats and capturing quiet moments across peaceful islands.
70070000033451.description:
Pack your things, we're going on a trip! We're going to visit breathtaking islands and make the most of the summer sun. But remember - the core item in your luggage is your camera!
Aside from admiring the architecture and colorful flora, we have one crucial mission - documenting the furry inhabitants of the islands. Can you find and photograph all of them? 
Grab your camera and get ready for the cat-tastrophe of cuteness! 
No timers, no battles, no pressure—just pure, pawsitive vibes. 

Wander across bright, bubbly islands that feel like an endless summer vacation—but keep your eyes peeled! These fuzzy superstars love to hide, lounge, stretch, and strike suspiciously perfect poses. Aside from taking pictures, you can fill their cute little water bowls to keep them happy, and, most importantly, don't forget to pet them! 

Every photo you take lands in your super-colorful Cat-alog Album, where you can admire your masterpieces, name your new feline friends, and relive every whisker-wiggling moment.

Snap Cat:
Bright colors. Big personalities.
Cats who act like they’re the stars of their own cartoon show.
(And honestly… they kinda are.)

Deluxe Edition includes SnapCat: Mia's Cozy Adventure base game and Cozy Night Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 21 colorful islands full of kitties 
- cozy, stress-free gameplay and feel-good atmosphere
- relaxing music, perfect for unwinding after a long day
- photo album with all your pictures and the option to name the cats

70070000033453.name: Ravenswatch - Year One Edition
70070000033453.description:
Discover Ravenswatch in its most complete version yet, bringing together the base title and all the content published during the first year.
Battle the Nightmare with 3 new playable heroes — Merlin, Romeo and Juliet — customize your runs with 6 skin packs, and dive behind the scenes, with the digital artbook and official soundtrack.

Edition contents:
* Ravenswatch
* Fairytales Skin Pack
* Ravens Skin Pack
* Nightmares Skin Pack
* Unleashed Skin Pack
* Romeo & Juliet
* Romeo & Juliet Skin Pack
* Timeless Skin Pack
* Merlin

70070000033459.name: ONLY UP! ULTRA EDITION
70070000033459.intro: Climb higher, move smarter, and conquer every obstacle.
70070000033459.description:
Reach new heights and unlock your full climbing potential with this bundle! Combining the full game with an exclusive DLC, you’ll gain extra support to make every jump and challenge more manageable and exciting. Every platform, obstacle, and leap remains a test of skill and timing—but now you can tackle the climb with added advantages and confidence.

Bundle Includes:
1. ONLY UP! – Embark on a vertical adventure filled with towering obstacles, floating islands, and twisting paths. Test your precision, timing, and platforming skills as you strive to reach the top.
2. ONLY UP! Turbo Jump – Receive 15000 bonus support to enhance your climb. Approach each challenge with greater strategy, confidence, and style.

Climb higher, move faster, and make every leap count!

70070000033462.name: KAZUMA KANEKO'S TSUKUYOMI Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000033462.intro: Ancient myths awaken in a modern-day Babel. A sleek, tactical deck-building tower dungeon from the legendary Demon Artist, Kazuma Kaneko.
70070000033462.description:
"The Digital Deluxe Edition is a bundle that includes the base game and additional content. A Standard Edition containing only the base game is also available. Please take care not to make duplicate purchases.

""Bundle Contents""
- KAZUMA KANEKO'S TSUKUYOMI(Base Game)
- DLC KAZUMA KANEKO: Refined Arts Pack vol.1"

70070000033468.name: Freaky Trip Tricky Treats
70070000033468.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000033468.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

This bundle includes the Cooking Pack DLC.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000033469.name: Cat & Friends Memory Fuzzy Friends
70070000033469.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70070000033469.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.

This bundle includes the Back Cards DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70070000033480.name: AirStrike Command: Tactical Assault Operation & Helicopter Battle Arena Simulator
70070000033480.intro: Take control. Take flight. Take victory.
70070000033480.description:
The battlefield is no longer on the ground — it’s in the air.

This action-packed bundle puts you behind the controls of powerful aircraft and combat helicopters, offering two unique aerial combat experiences that test both strategy and skill. From calculated tactical operations to fast, competitive aerial battles, every mission challenges your ability to dominate the skies.

	•	In AirStrike Command: Tactical Assault Operation, you act as an elite air commander, delivering precision strikes, defending key locations, and supporting allied forces in dangerous combat zones. Each mission demands smart positioning, quick decisions, and careful use of firepower as enemies attack from all directions.
	•	In Helicopter Battle Arena Simulator, the fight becomes more direct and intense. Pilot combat helicopters in high-energy aerial confrontations where agility, teamwork, and accurate fire decide the outcome. Face off in controlled arenas, adapt to different environments, and prove your mastery in explosive air-to-air combat.

Together, these games create a complete air warfare experience — one focused on tactical command, the other on pure aerial combat skill. Rule the skies, master every maneuver, and turn air superiority into victory.

70070000033481.name: 3in1 Racing Collection
70070000033481.description:
With the 3in1 Racing Collection, you get three fast-paced fun racers in one package – perfect for quick sessions or long duels in local multiplayer. Whether you're drifting precisely through corners, competing in chaotic item battles, or battling for the best times on waves and water tracks, only one thing matters – speed, timing, and the next victory.

Look forward to three different racing styles:

emoji Kart™ Racer: 
In the first official emoji™ video game, you'll race across 16 colorful tracks and create your own racer from thousands of combinations using the emoji™ generator – including fun power-ups like poop or rockets.

Rubberduck Wave Racer: 
Experience incredibly fast speeds as you race across raging rivers and roaring whitewater rapids. Your little duck also swims on lava, fruit juice, and the Milky Way!

Renzo Racer:
Brings classic cartoon racing fun: Choose from 16 drivers and race across 20 exciting tracks full of obstacles and surprises.

Whether you're chasing records alone or competing head-to-head, the 3in1 Racing Collection delivers a diverse racing experience for every occasion – making it the ideal package for arcade racing fans.

• 3 Games in 1 Bundle: Renzo Racer, emoji Kart™ Racer, Rubberduck Wave Racer
• Diverse racing experiences: Kart, fun, and wave racing in one package
• Quick to start, high fun factor – ideal for couch gaming and short sessions
• Local multiplayer: with up to 4 players

70070000033500.name: QQQbeats!!! + Virtual Song Pack Vol.1 Value bundle
70070000033500.intro: A great-value bundle that includes the base game and Virtual Song Pack Vol. 1!
70070000033500.description:
"QQQbeats!!!" is a brand-new puzzle game that combines simple bubble shooting with easy-to-play rhythm game mechanics. Enjoy the excitement to the fullest by making the most of each character's unique personality!

You can play online in "Ranked Match," "Casual Match," or "Private Match."
There are also "Local Battles" and "Shared Battles" for offline play, as well as "COM Battles" where you can practice against the computer at your own pace.

■ DUOps
DUOps is a cooperative play mode where you team up with friends to battle against enemies.
You can enjoy it casually both online and offline.

70070000033512.name: Dark Auction: Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000033512.intro:
The Auction of Dark Memories Begins Now.
What truths await beyond a bid made with your life?
70070000033512.description:
This is the Deluxe Edition of Dark Auction,
which includes the full game and the original soundtrack.

◆ Original Soundtrack
Featuring a total of 26 tracks.
The soundtrack is led by Yuko Komiyama
and Tsukasa Masuko,
with additional contributions from Yoshitaka Onishi, Takako Yumishima, and Ayumi Sumiki.

Select tracks also feature live performances by a jazz band.
Refined jazz sounds beautifully enhance the unique atmosphere of Dark Auction.

Jazz Band Performances
Piano: Hiroaki Idaka
Acoustic Bass: Shigeki Serizawa
Drums: Kenta Okamoto
Tenor Sax: Mitsuharu Ouchi
Trumpet: Atsushi Ozawa
Violin: Daisei Mii

◆ Story:
1981, Somewhere in Europe.

Eighteen-year-old Noah is haunted by the memory of his mother abandoning him as a child.
He lives with his father Leonard, a failed writer obsessed with collecting items related to “Dictator X.” 
Noah wishes he would stop, but Leonard refuses to give up his strange obsession, even as they struggle financially.

One day, an auction invitation arrives, addressed to Leonard. Ignoring Noah’s protests, Leonard sets off for the old castle where the auction is to be held, promising to tell Noah everything once he returns.
But Leonard never comes home. With no way to contact him, Noah heads to the castle himself, determined to bring him home—only to witness something shocking.
Trapped inside the castle with the other guests, Noah decided to accept the Auctioneer's invitation, and take part in the auction himself.


Characters:
Noah Crawford (VA. Kengo Kawanishi)
Leonard Crawford (VA. Rikiya Koyama)
Edgar Schultz (VA. Daisuke Namikawa)
