70070000033530.name: Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition
70070000033530.intro: Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition includes the remaster of Diablo II and its Lord of Destruction® expansion, plus the new Reign of the Warlock DLC.
70070000033530.description:
The Genre-Defining Action RPG, Better than Ever
Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition includes the critically acclaimed remaster of Diablo II and its Lord of Destruction® expansion, together with the brand-new Reign of the Warlock DLC. 
Journey through the Hell-scarred land of Sanctuary; faithfully preserved and enhanced with modern 3D graphics, remastered audio, and updated cinematics. 
The included Reign of the Warlock DLC expands upon the Diablo II: Resurrected experience with the brand-new Warlock class, an overhauled endgame, fresh mechanics, and modern quality-of-life updates. 
 
Eight Classes, Eight Players, Endless Replayability
Experience the story of a world ravaged by eternal conflict between the forces of Heaven and Hell. Obtain powerful items, master over 200 awe-inspiring skills across eight classes, and vanquish the minions of the Burning Hells in 8 player co-op. Dominate the leaderboards, then get a fresh start with seasonal ladder resets that introduce new challenges. 
 
New Class - Warlock 
The Warlock arrives in Diablo II: Resurrected, a master of shadow who turns the power of the Burning Hells against itself. 
Command forbidden power through three unique paths:  
• Demon focuses on enslaving hellspawn and binding them into loyal, fearsome allies that fight at your command.  
 
• Eldritch channels searing mental magics into ordinary weapons, transforming them into conduits of devastating force.  
 
• Chaos unleashes the raw elements of Hell, fire and shadow allowing you to rain elemental destruction upon your enemies from afar. 
 
New Challenges, New Builds
Collect new Unique items, sets, and runewords to create powerful new builds for classic classes. 
Take on expanded endgame challenges with Terror Zone updates, the Colossal Ancients fight, reworked enemy difficulty scaling, and new mechanics that reward strategy and class mastery. 
Track your progress with the new Chronicle system, which shows all the items you’ve collected account-wide and rewards completionists with exclusive bonuses. 
 
Refined, Not Reimagined
Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition includes powerful quality-of-life updates without compromising Diablo II’s iconic feel. The new customizable Loot Filter reduces screen clutter, helping you identify the gear that matters most to you. Managing resources across characters is also easier than ever with updated Stash Tabs, including dedicated tabs for gems, materials, and runes for quick sorting. 
 
Feeling nostalgic? Switch freely between eras and experience Diablo II the way you remember.
 
Cross-Game Rewards
Celebrate your journey through Sanctuary and beyond. Instantly unlock Kervek the Putrid Pet and the Forbidden Tethers Back Trophy in Diablo IV, giving your wanderer a touch of forbidden flair. You’ll also receive the Horadric Cube Housing Item in World of Warcraft, a timeless artifact to display proudly at your home in Azeroth.

70070000033531.name: Q Collection
70070000033531.description: Are you up to the challenge of Q? The concept is simple: draw objects on the screen and use gravity to help solve the puzzles. The solution is up to you, but can you make it work? With multiple ways to solve each problem, Q Collection consisting of: Q Remastered, Q2 HUMANITY and Q with VTUBERS will test the limits of your creativity and stretch your imagination.

70070000033533.name: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2
70070000033533.intro: The second installment of the collection featuring “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)”
70070000033533.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.
This collection is the second installment of the definitive Metal Gear Master Collection.

Vol. 2 includes Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version).

Each game includes a Screenplay Book containing the text from the respective title, plus a Master Book offering detailed insights into the story and characters.

Also, as purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes METAL GEAR Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

[Game List]
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)
Metal Gear: Ghost Babel
*Versions for other regions of Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots can be downloaded separately from the store.

[Digital contents]

Metal Gear Solid 4: Master Book
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker Screenplay Book
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker Master Book

If you have save data for any title included in METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.1, you can receive in-game items usable in Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version) respectively.

70070000033546.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Mega Edition
70070000033546.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000033546.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #1, Custom Cruisers #3 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-3 new skins for each Buggy

70070000033549.name: Club Sports Collection Extended Edition
70070000033549.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000033549.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on Nintendo Switch™!
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con™, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns Nintendo Switch™ into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #1 with:

5 brand-new dart designs

70070000033556.name: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Complete Edition
70070000033556.description:
Get ready to experience POSTAL from a brand-new perspective!

This boomer-shooter spin-off of the fan-favorite Running With Scissors franchise will take you further down the rabbit hole than any previous entry in the series. You’re not in Paradise anymore, and things are about to get weird, as POSTAL: Brain Damaged unfolds inside the twisted psyche of the POSTAL DUDE himself!
Yes — a completely new, retro-modern, action-driven, skill-based take on POSTAL.
“Did HYPERSTRANGE pull it off?” you might ask. Oh yes. Looks like we did.

POSTAL: Brain Damaged – These Sunny Daze is here, bringing a tropical serotonin collapse and some seriously juicy carnage.

Just when you thought the POSTAL Dude had finally caught a break, he’s ripped out of vacation mode by a full-scale nationwide ginger purge. The new President is a flag-humping lunatic from yesterday’s headlines, redheads are officially public enemy number one, and a tech-nerd Vice President has run off with The Dude’s personal arsenal.

70070000033557.name: Magic Cats Pots Winter Ceramics
70070000033557.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This bundle includes the Winter DLC.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!

Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000033562.name: Johnny Trigger: Diamond Edition
70070000033562.intro: Looking for definitive action? Here’s Johnny!
70070000033562.description:
Johnny Trigger - International Man of Mayhem!

This bundle includes:
- Johnny Trigger
- Johnny Trigger: Avenger DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Hunter DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Butcher DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Hotshot DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Lunatic DLC

Features:
• 5 new skins: Avenger, Hunter, Butcher, Hotshot and Lunatic
• 5 new weapons: Hurricane, Tri-Shot Bow, Vengeance, Sawed-off and Showtime
• 8000 additional gemms to buy other currencies
• 35000 additional money to buy or draw weapons and skins in shops
• 150 additional puzzles to unlock more comic graphics
• 65 additional keys to open locked doors in base
• 50 additional hammers to unlock another upgrades in base

Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends.

Do you have what it takes to bring down the underground world of the mafia?
“Less talk, more bullets” - that’s Johnny’s motto as he runs, jumps, spins, slides and keeps on shooting till every bad guy’s bitten the dust.

Dive straight in and get shooting! Johnny Trigger’s short but immensely satisfying levels make it the perfect action game to fill a short break.
And if you’ve got a little more time, there’s so much to collect and a new challenge round every corner.

So what are you waiting for? Those bad guys aren’t going to beat themselves, you know.

70070000033572.name: Bendy: Studio Collection
70070000033572.description: Survive and discover the mysteries of Joey Drew Studios in this dual collection of the popular Bendy franchise. Bendy: Studio Collection tells the story of Henry in Bendy and the Ink Machine and Audrey in Bendy and the Dark Revival. Find out what nightmares lie within the inky abyss of this classic animation studio.

70070000033577.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Extended Edition
70070000033577.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000033577.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch™!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch™.

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #1 with:
5 new pool table designs
5 new snooker table designs

70070000033578.name: Dive Expedition: Sunken Edition
70070000033578.intro: Your next great discovery lies just below the surface
70070000033578.description:
Explore sunken ships, submarines, and mysterious underwater ruins filled with hidden treasures and fascinating artifacts.

Take your time as you navigate detailed environments, complete exploration objectives, and collect items scattered across the sea floor. Examine each discovery up close, uncovering the secrets of lost vessels and forgotten places.

This edition adds one new location to your adventure - a legendary sunken ship. Swim across its wooden decks, peek inside the captain’s cabin, and uncover what remains of its fateful voyage. Search for chests of gold, rare relics, and lost equipment hidden throughout the ship and surrounding seabed.

Features:
• Discover 3 unique underwater maps: two shipwrecks and a submarine
• Find and examine a wide range of items, relics, and equipment
• Complete various exploration objectives across all included locations
• Enjoy a calm, atmospheric experience with no danger or combat
• Relax with immersive underwater sounds and a selection of 9 atmospheric music tracks

Dive deeper, explore every wreck, and uncover everything the ocean hides.

70070000033580.name: Fight For America: Patriot Edition
70070000033580.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000033580.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- Iron Patriot mech: crush enemies with enhanced speed, health and damage
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!
- 1000 additional coins to purchase upgrades or build new turrets

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000033582.name: Pocket Nook Pet Mania Edition
70070000033582.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000033582.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!

Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!

There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

This bundle includes the Cat & Dog DLC.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000033583.name: Brain Boost Buddies Neuron Navigator
70070000033583.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70070000033583.description:
In Brain Boost Buddies, kids can flip and match cute animal cards - from smiling puppies to fluffy bunnies - while training their memory and concentration skills.

Parents will love it too! The game helps develop focus, logic, and patience in a calm, positive way. Plus, players can easily choose the right difficulty level to make the challenge just right for every age.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 1 DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Adorable animal cards that make learning fun
- Different difficulty levels for all ages
- Improves memory, focus, and attention skills
- Bright, colorful visuals designed for kids
- Relaxing and cheerful background music
- Perfect for family playtime and early learning

70070000033584.name: My Cozy Aquarium: Glow Pack
70070000033584.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000033584.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle includes the Glowing Decoration DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000033585.name: Cozy Tiny Home Snow Festival
70070000033585.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000033585.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes the Winter DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000033586.name: Raptor Evolution: Future Edition
70070000033586.description:
Take control of a mighty dinosaur in a post-apocalyptic world on a quest to recover its stolen eggs.

Smash through environments, gather resources, and hunt grotesque human-mutants to evolve and grow stronger. Use what you collect to rebuild bridges, restore paths and push deeper into a world filled with danger and mystery. 

Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying bosses standing between you and your lost brood.

Features:
- Unleash powerful evolution form with Vectoraptor skin
- Break everything: destroy environments and leave nothing standing
- Use advanced technology: encounter futuristic machines that will aid your survival
- Engage in fierce battles: hunt down mutants and monstrous creatures
- Meet various enemies: take on diverse foes with unique behaviors
- Lead your warriors: command other beasts and dominate the wasteland
- Evolve to become a super beast: grow stronger with every challenge you overcome!
- Use 300 Meat, 20 Mutagen and 450 Gems to power up your evolution and make your raptor stronger in every battle

Will you survive and recover your eggs?

70070000033594.name: Formula Legends: 2025 DLC Collection
70070000033594.intro: Get all five DLCs released in 2025! Includes 13 cars across Raw Power, Tech Power, Pioneer Pack, Early 2010’s Season, and Turbo Power.
70070000033594.description:
Fuel your Formula Legends experience with all the DLCs released in 2025! This bundle includes five thrilling packs, featuring 13 incredible cars and a wealth of era-inspired content. (Please note: Base game not included.)

Raw Power – 3 high-performance cars, plus engine upgrades and enhanced handling options. Feel the adrenaline as you dominate every track with sheer raw speed!

Tech Power – 3 cutting-edge vehicles with advanced aerodynamics, precision tuning, and futuristic gadgets. Optimize your car for ultimate performance and strategy.

Pioneer Pack – 3 exclusive pioneer vehicles, unique liveries, and special challenges designed to test your skills and creativity. Perfect for those who want to push boundaries.

Early 2010’s Season Pack – 2 cars from the early 2010s, era-inspired liveries, and integrated Story Mode content. Relive the nostalgia with modern gameplay mechanics.

Turbo Power Pack – 2 turbocharged vehicles with nitro boosts and performance-enhancing modifications. Perfect for fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled racing action.

70070000033641.name: Ogu and the Secret Forest + Winter Festival Blast DLC Set
70070000033641.intro: The main game and additional content set for Ogu and the Secret Forest is here!
70070000033641.description:
A journey to a new world with Baby Ogu—an adventure that leads all the way to the Winter Festival Island.

This set includes the full 2D adventure game Ogu and the Secret Forest along with the additional DLC Ogu and the Secret Forest - Winter Festival Blast, allowing you to enjoy the complete adventure in one package.

[Set Contents]
・Ogu and the Secret Forest (Main Game)
・Ogu and the Secret Forest - Winter Festival Blast (Additional DLC)

Travel to a new world with Baby Ogu, wearing an explorer’s hat. Explore over 250 regions as you meet new friends, defeat enemies, and solve a variety of puzzles throughout your journey. Within this calm yet richly detailed world, long-hidden stories gradually come to light.

● Ogu and the Secret Forest (Main Game)
A 2D adventure game centered around puzzles and exploration. Solve diverse puzzles, collect hats and masks to customize Baby Ogu, and make use of special abilities. Record beautiful scenery in your sketchbook to gain hints, help friends in need, and form new bonds along the way.

● Ogu and the Secret Forest - Winter Festival Blast (Additional Content)
An expansion that broadens the story even further. Uncover the truth behind the chaos that erupted on an island once known for its winter festival. This DLC adds 45 new maps, including dungeons, along with new content such as headbutt puzzles, mine carts, the upside-down tower, and trials of the divine beast. You can also connect Joy-Con™ controllers to enjoy local multiplayer (1-on-1 tennis).

70070000033652.name: Little Cozy Home Deluxe Edition
70070000033652.intro: Create, decorate, and make your dream home come true!
70070000033652.description:
Design Your Dream Home!

Step into your cosy virtual house and unleash your creativity!

Decorate seven beautifully crafted rooms — living room, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, office, hallway, and veranda — each ready to reflect your unique style.

Pick your favourite wall colours, wallpapers, floors, rugs, and furniture to make each room truly your own. Experiment, mix styles, and see your dream home come to life!

Keep your favourite designs and return to them anytime.
Take a picture of your creation without menus or buttons in the way!

Outside your window, the world changes with four beautiful seasons – from sunny spring and summer, through colourful autumn, to snowy winter.

Easy to play, relaxing, and full of creativity – perfect for young decorators with big imaginations!

Decorate, play, and make your home the cosiest place ever!

This bundle includes the base game and Cozy Living with:

The set includes stylish sofas, chairs, and accessories that will give your living room a unique atmosphere. Create a space you’ll always want to come back to.

70070000033669.name: BUNDLE with 19 GAMES
70070000033669.intro: One bundle. 19 games. One crazy low price.
70070000033669.description:
Discover 19 complete games in one incredible value bundle:

Isolated	
Dice People	
Tiny Little Farm	
Toroom	
FPS Bullet Storm	
The Cat	
Cat Survivors	
.cat Milk	
Mechatris	
Milk Seller	
Ayala: Forgotten Realms	
Cyber AI Defense	
Rafa's World	
The Meownth	
CubbettyCube	
Farm	
Fire Race	
Submarine Bubble	
Dunkirk - The Forgotten Soldier	
Scrap Bolts

70070000033670.name: Sniper - Elite Shooter Squad & The World of War II: Frontlines of History
70070000033670.intro: Aim true. Fight smart. Rewrite history.
70070000033670.description:
Precision. Strategy. History in the crosshairs.

Step into the front lines of modern marksmanship and historic warfare with Sniper - Elite Shooter Squad & The World of War II: Frontlines of History. This bundle brings together two action-packed shooter experiences where every shot, every move, and every decision can change the outcome of the mission.

	•	In Sniper - Elite Shooter Squad, precision is your greatest weapon. Take on high-risk missions across diverse environments, choose from a wide range of sniper rifles and firearms, and eliminate targets using stealth, positioning, and tactical planning. From long-range eliminations to careful infiltration, success depends on patience, accuracy, and smart execution.
	•	The World of War II: Frontlines of History transports you back to one of the most defining conflicts in human history. Fight across iconic World War II locations inspired by real battlefields, experience large-scale combat scenarios, and witness the challenges faced by soldiers on multiple fronts. Authentic weapons, detailed environments, and intense combat place you directly in the heart of history’s most pivotal moments.

Together, these two games offer a complete shooter experience — from focused, methodical sniping to full-scale wartime action.

Key Features:
	•	Two distinct shooter experiences: modern sniping and World War II combat
	•	Tactical gameplay focused on precision, positioning, and strategy
	•	Diverse missions and environments across multiple locations
	•	Authentic weapons and immersive battlefields
	•	Action-driven gameplay with strategic depth

Sharpen your aim, test your tactics, and relive battles where skill defines survival. This is your chance to control the battlefield — one shot at a time.

70070000033676.name: The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ (Multi-language version)
70070000033676.intro: Off the court, he's even more of a Prince!
70070000033676.description:
The Prince of Tennis Sweet School Festival ~♡-40 and more...~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
During a joint school festival hosted by the tennis clubs of seven academies, you are chosen to serve as a member of the festival’s management committee.
Guide and support the players of your assigned school, strengthen your bonds, and strive for first place in the stall competition!

<Features>
- Experience a school life filled with romance, surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.

70070000033679.name: Paper io 2: Fast Edition
70070000033679.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000033679.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- 29 skins which also change the look of your terrain
- 6 new funny hats to wear
- custom game with 54 various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000033683.name: Tokyo Racer X: Street Racing
70070000033683.intro: Race through neon streets with unmatched confidence.
70070000033683.description:
Step into the underground street racing scene of Tokyo and dominate the neon-lit streets! In this bundle, experience heart-pounding races, precision drifting, and intense rivalries while customizing your dream machine with body kits, performance parts, paint jobs, and decals.

Bundle includes:
- Tokyo Racer X – Master high-speed races, perfect your drifts, and take on rival crews in a story-driven street racing campaign filled with challenges and excitement.
- Turbo Wheel DLC – A brand-new rim has been added to your garage, upgrading your ride with a stylish new look and enhancing your street-style customization.

Race faster, drift harder, and show off your unique style—Tokyo’s streets are yours to conquer!

70070000033694.name: Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Road King
70070000033694.intro: Take the wheel, expand your fleet, and master every delivery across iconic routes.
70070000033694.description:
Get the trucking experience with this bundle! Step into the shoes of a professional long-haul trucker and explore Europe like never before. This bundle gives you everything you need to start your career, upgrade your trucks, and take on exciting missions across iconic highways.

Bundle Includes:
1. Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Experience realistic long-haul trucking across Europe with a variety of trucks, scenic routes, and challenging missions.
2. Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Cash Boost – Receive $50,000 in-game cash to upgrade your fleet, unlock new trucks, and expand your routes for an enhanced trucking experience.

Take the wheel, master the highways, and experience long-haul trucking at its finest!

70070000033701.name: Aquarium Land: Gold Edition
70070000033701.intro: Dive into an aquatic world where amazing animals await you!
70070000033701.description:
Go fish in the sea, swim, catch species like goldfish, starfish, koi fish and add them to your fish tank to expand your aquarium shop!

This bundle includes:
- Aquarium Land
- Aquarium Land: Parrot
- Aquarium Land: Armadillo

Drive a motorboat, ride a jet ski or just jump in the water and dive with a friend in multiplayer mode! 

Discover amazing places filled with a wide variety of beautiful animals. Discover huge and legendary creatures to attract more visitors. There is a customer for every sea animal, big or tiny, all you have to do is fish with attitude!

Invest in your aquarium shop and explore the sea world like a real fishy tycoon! The more money you earn, the more upgrades and aquariums you can get!

Features:
- many different aquatic worlds
- 2 pets: parrot and armadillo each with active bonuses that increase fishing speed at sea
- 100+ species to catch
- multiplayer mode up to 2 players
- 20 funny skins to choose from
- character, customer and employee upgrades 
- motorboat and jet-ski riding
- different diving styles with cool animations
- aquarium decorations
- ship expeditions
- 2 secret fish you can feed to earn beauty cup points
- 2 fishbowl decorations
- 200 gems

Can you be the best fish tycoon, let the tides lead you and rule your tile aquarium?

70070000033704.name: AirJet Fighter Sky Dominators: Aerial Assault & World War II - Airplanes Battle
70070000033704.intro: Take control. Master the air. Dominate the skies.
70070000033704.description:
Rule the skies across two eras of aerial warfare. Take flight in a world where air combat defines victory, skill, and survival. AirJet Fighter Sky Dominators: Aerial Assault & World War II – Airplanes Battle brings together two intense flying experiences that challenge you across futuristic battlefields and historic warzones, each demanding precision, reflexes, and tactical mastery.

In AirJet Fighter Sky Dominators: Aerial Assault, you control advanced combat jets in explosive, fast-paced missions set in dynamic environments. Face waves of enemy airjets, drones, warships, and fortified targets as you push through neon cities, open oceans, and dangerous airspace. Unlock new aircraft, master powerful weapons, and dominate the sky through pure aerial action and nonstop combat pressure.

Shift to a different era in World War II – Airplanes Battle, where classic military aircraft and large-scale aerial battles define the fight. Choose your side, take control of iconic warplanes, and engage in strategic air combat inspired by historical conflicts. Complete missions, earn rewards, upgrade your fleet, and prove your skill across multiple battle modes that test both strategy and piloting ability.

Together, these two games deliver a complete aerial combat experience — from modern jet warfare to legendary WWII dogfights. Whether you prefer futuristic firepower or classic air battles, the sky becomes your battlefield.

70070000033729.name: Scoop it! Crane Game + More to Gather Pack Set
70070000033729.intro: The fan-favourite arcade classic—The Crane Game—returns, powered up! Packed with more content and fresh new controls! Become a Crane Master!
70070000033729.description:
Play the evolved Crane Game experience on the Nintendo Switch™!
Grab a Joy-Con™ controller each and face off against a friend in an intense 1-on-1 battle!
Scoop, drop, push!

A new set with both Scoop it! Crane Game and the More to Gather Pack is now available!
There are over 390 different prizes to collect!

70070000033767.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Party Edition
70070000033767.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000033767.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Om Nelle: who earns extra exp and helps you level up faster!
- Fiesta Nom: who starts each race with a long turbo boost!
- 2000 gold to buy new Noms!

NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Grab friends or family and jump into the same race on one screen. Chase the lead, pull off last-second comebacks, and see who really is the fastest runner among you!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000033775.name: FISHING SIMULATOR 2025: Ultimate Fishing
70070000033775.intro: Your biggest haul is waiting – are you ready?
70070000033775.description:
Immerse yourself in the serene world of FISHING SIMULATOR 2025: Ultimate Fishing and enhance your experience with the exclusive upgrade included in this bundle. Whether you are a casual angler or a seasoned pro, this bundle gives you everything you need to make your fishing adventure bigger, longer, and more rewarding.

Included in this bundle:
1. Fishing Simulator 2025 (Game) – Explore beautifully detailed waters, master dozens of fish species, and customize your gear for the ultimate angling experience.

2. Fishing Simulator 2025: Fishing Boost – Boost your gameplay with:
+100 kg carrying capacity – Haul more fish before heading back to shore
+80 bonus minutes – Extend your fishing sessions and explore longer
+800 XP – Level up faster and unlock new gear with ease

Step into the peaceful, authentic fishing world, enjoy longer sessions, catch bigger hauls, and progress faster with this complete bundle. Your ultimate angling adventure starts here!

70070000033782.name: Pinball Spire x 9 Years of Shadows
70070000033782.description:
PINBALL SPIRE
Action adventure meets pinball in this one-of-a-kind pinballvania adventure. When a mysterious spire appears from thin air, it's up to an intrepid pinball to bump, spin, shoot, and flip its way to the top and solve the tower’s mysteries!

9 YEARS OF SHADOWS
Fight to bring beautiful colors back to a hand-crafted world of darkness and discover the story of Europa, a young warrior, and her ghostly childhood companion, Apino.

70070000033783.name: Traveler's Refrain x Dreamscaper
70070000033783.intro: A Song-Casting Story Driven Action-RPG and an endlessly replayable Action Roguelike await you...
70070000033783.description:
DREAMSCAPER
By night, delve deep into your subconscious and discover powerful artifacts to conquer your nightmares. By day, explore the city of Redhaven and build relationships to unlock the power of your dreams. DREAM. DIE. WAKE. REPEAT.

TRAVELER'S REFRAIN
Wield your magical instrument and defy the mecha-goddesses of fate in this Song-Casting Story Driven Action-RPG. Explore a forbidden forest as Traveler. Help him reunite with his long lost love as you fight through abominations and solve mysterious puzzles, all while an ancient conflict unfolds.

70070000033784.name: Heroes of Mount Dragon x G.I. Joe: Wrath of Cobra
70070000033784.intro: An action-packed side-scrolling brawler and a retro side-scrolling beat 'em up await...
70070000033784.description:
HEROES OF MOUNT DRAGON
Unleash dragon-morphing powers in this action-packed side-scrolling brawler! Choose from unique heroes, each with their own fighting style. Play couch co-op or online with up to 3 friends. Team up to defeat evil or compete for supremacy. Fun and accessible for all skill levels!

G.I. JOE: WRATH OF COBRA
Yo Joe! Cobra returns once again with its most fiendish plot yet and it's up to G.I. Joe to defeat them once more! Pick one of the real American heroes, gear up, and get straight into the fight in this retro side-scrolling beat 'em up - and make Cobra RETREAT yet again!

70070000033785.name: Totally Reliable Delivery Service - Deluxe Edition
70070000033785.description:
Everything you need to be a Totally Reliable Delivery Service person! Includes, Totally Reliable Delivery Service, Cyberfunk, Stunt Sets, Dress Code, Atari Attire, and Mascot Mayhem.

Buckle up your back brace and fire up the delivery truck, it's time to deliver! Join up to three of your friends and haphazardly get the job done in an interactive sandbox world. Delivery attempted, that's a Totally Reliable Delivery Service guarantee!

FEATURES:

Local and Online Multiplayer: Go it alone to ensure the safety of your deliveries, or join your friends and put your teamwork to the test.

Controlled Noodly Chaos: Unpredictable ragdoll physics meets snappy platforming. Sprint, leap, dive, and grapple with ease, but collide with something and you'll be knocked out cold!

A World of Distractions: Take a break from deliveries and play around! The world is chock full of toys, vehicles, and machines that can be used for work or play.

Ragtag Crew: Customize your blue-collar workers and get your rear into gear, it's time to deliver!

70070000033786.name: Totally Reliable Delivery Service - Express Package
70070000033786.description: Cyberfunk, Stunt Sets, Dress Code, Atari Attire, and Mascot Mayhem DLCs all boxed up and ready to ship!

70070000033799.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Survival Checkpoint
70070000033799.intro: The border’s pressure grows with every wave—can you hold the line?
70070000033799.description:
Step into the most intense border checkpoint experience in a world on the brink of a zombie outbreak. You are in charge of life-and-death decisions as you screen refugees, inspect documents, and detect infections. Every choice matters, and every mistake can cost lives.

This bundle includes:
1. Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint 
Take control of the border, inspect incoming refugees, and prevent the outbreak from spreading.

2. Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Frontline Upgrade 
A visual update that changes the container’s color and gives the checkpoint a new look as the situation evolves.

The border is still dangerous—now it looks different too. Are you ready to take control?

70070000033812.name: The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ (Multi-language version)
70070000033812.intro: Stranded with a Prince—get ready to Survi-love!
70070000033812.description:
The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~ is a globally remastered edition of a legendary otome game that has been beloved in Japan for more than 20 years.

<Story>
While on vacation, a sudden storm leaves you and your friend stranded on a deserted island.
Join forces with the tennis club members who shared your ship and set out together to escape the island.

<Features>
- Experience a survival life surrounded by many charming Princes.
- Enjoy sweet and bittersweet date events unique to each Prince!
- Experience elegant, beautifully illustrated event CGs, with some artwork enhanced by animation.

70070000033820.name: Ants Empire Colony – Ant of Steel
70070000033820.intro: The colony needs you - stronger than ever before.
70070000033820.description:
Step into the shoes of a brave ant and rebuild your colony from the ground up. Explore a rich natural environment, gather resources, and complete carefully designed missions while facing foes at every turn. Every action shapes the world around you, and every item you collect brings your colony closer to restoration.

This bundle includes:
1. Ants Empire Colony – Rebuild your anthill from the ground up, gather resources, complete 11 exciting missions, and survive against natural and enemy threats in a dynamic sandbox environment.

2. Ants Empire Colony: Survival Boost – Boost your ant hero with twice the health, survive longer, endure tougher battles, and explore the wild world with confidence.

Rebuild your ant empire—stronger and better equipped than ever before. Are you ready to save the colony?

70070000033833.name: Grumpy Driver Deluxe Edition
70070000033833.intro: Too many cars? Never. Too much fun? Impossible!
70070000033833.description:
Get ready to explore a colourful open world packed with secrets, challenges, and endless driving fun!

From sunny beaches and peaceful farms to bustling downtown streets and misty mountain peaks — every corner hides surprises waiting to be discovered. 

Find hidden collectibles, unlock unique car skins, and reveal secret paths and jump ramps scattered across the map!

Complete exciting missions to earn stars and expand your collection of cars — from everyday rides like taxis, vans, and pickups to emergency vehicles, off-roaders, and legendary supercars. Each car brings its own personality, and your hero even changes outfits and facial expressions to match the action!

Enjoy a living city with working traffic lights, honking drivers, and expressive reactions in fun comic-style bubbles. Whether you’re parking with precision, racing against the clock, or delivering goods safely across town — every task is a new adventure.

• A vast open world to explore
• Many vehicles with unlockable skins
• Varied missions: parking, delivery, time trials
• Dynamic traffic and interactive AI
• Playful hero with animated emotions

Drive, explore, discover — and make every ride your own!

This bundle includes the base game and Sport Car DLC with:
- brand new Sport Car and missions connected to it

70070000033835.name: DW 25th Anniversary Top Characters Costume Set Pack
70070000033835.intro: A set of 11 costumes for the top characters of the "DYNASTY WARRIORS" series.
70070000033835.description:
A set of 11 costumes for the top characters of the "DYNASTY WARRIORS" series, chosen in the DW series 25th anniversary poll. The set will be made available once the player has completed the tutorial.

• 4 extra costumes for Lianshi
• 1 extra costume for Yu Jin
• 4 extra costumes for Dong Bai

Notes:
- Please see the official site for more details on costumes included in this set.

70070000033839.name: Squirrel Madness: Nut Storm
70070000033839.intro: More nuts, more firepower, more explosive action!
70070000033839.description:
Defend your magical acorn tree from relentless city threats in Squirrel Madness! Arm yourself with nut blasters, pinecone crossbows, and other powerful weapons as you face waves of enemies, from animal control squads to urban machinery.

Bundle Features:
1. Squirrel Madness - 50 levels of action, 6 unique weapons, diverse enemies, and atmospheric city locations. Heal and upgrade your tree between waves and survive increasingly challenging enemy attacks.

2. Squirrel Madness: Ammo Frenzy - All weapons now come with double ammo, and all ammo pickups are doubled. Stockpile firepower, unleash unstoppable attacks, and survive longer against waves of enemies.

Prepare for epic battles, maximize your arsenal, and experience nonstop action and chaos!

70070000033842.name: Bowling Fever Star Edition
70070000033842.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000033842.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-20 new bowling ball styles

70070000033847.name: Hentai Vision Golden Beach Adventures

70070000033854.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Deluxe Edition
70070000033854.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000033854.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #2 with:

This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000033858.name: Cop Car Police Simulator Chase - Car games simulator & driving: Patrol Master
70070000033858.intro: Patrol the streets, investigate crimes, and tackle incidents with confidence.
70070000033858.description:
Step into a lively, freely-accessible city and take control of your district while tackling traffic incidents, investigating crimes, and pursuing criminals.

Bundle Includes:
1. Cop Car Police Simulator Chase - Car games simulator & driving: Patrol the city, investigate crimes, chase suspects, and maintain law and order using realistic police vehicles and mechanics.

2. Cop Car Police Simulator Chase: Starter Cash: Receive $5,000 in-game cash to upgrade your patrol vehicles, improve equipment, and accelerate your career progression.

Why this bundle:
- Complete Policing Experience – Drive multiple police vehicles, respond to incidents, and patrol streets across a detailed US city.
- Enhanced Resources – Start with extra funds to improve your vehicles and gear for faster progression.
- Challenging Missions & Exploration – Investigate crime scenes, chase suspects, and freely explore the city at your own pace.

Take control of the city, enhance your career, and experience the thrill of law enforcement!

70070000033861.name: 30 in 1 Family Games Mega Collection
70070000033861.intro: 30 games. Endless smiles. Pure family fun!
70070000033861.description:
The 30 in 1 Family Games Mega Collection brings you a huge variety of fun-packed games—from fast-paced racing and exciting action challenges to strategic puzzles and classic games. 

Non-stop entertainment with an exciting mix of games, simple controls, vibrant graphics, and endless replayability. Ideal for family game nights, casual play, or friendly competition, this bundle delivers incredible value for money. 

Whether you're looking for a quick challenge or a full-on gaming session, this bundle has you covered! Don't just play - create memories together! Bundle includes:

70070000033864.name: Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor – Build & Survive
70070000033864.intro: Survive the sea. Build your fortress. Face the predator.
70070000033864.description:
Face the unforgiving open sea in the Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor experience, combining the base game with two essential DLCs for the ultimate ocean survival adventure. Explore a vast and dangerous ocean, gather resources from drifting wreckage, craft tools, cook food, and expand your raft into a true floating sanctuary.

Bundle Includes:
1. Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor (Base Game) - Survive on the open ocean using crafting, exploration, and ingenuity. Build and upgrade your raft, filter seawater, cook meals, fish for food, and face constant marine threats in a fight for survival.

2. Building Materials Expansion DLC - Increase your chances of survival with new, reinforced building materials. Strengthen and upgrade your raft to withstand harsh ocean conditions and relentless attacks, transforming it into a durable floating fortress.

3. Shark Upgrade DLC - Shark encounters are more intense than ever. Featuring a completely redesigned shark with a unique new material, this upgrade makes every attack more thrilling, immersive, and visually striking.

Turn a fragile raft into an ocean stronghold, conquer the relentless sea, and prove you have what it takes to survive where others fail. The ocean survival adventure awaits!

70070000033866.name: Zombie Defense: Platinum Edition
70070000033866.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000033866.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you... Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun!

This bundle includes:
- Zombie Defense
- Zombie Defense: Laser Katana
- Zombie Defense: Banana
- Zombie Defense: Thunder Hammer

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Blue warrior skin, which gives you +10% to movement speed
- Monkey skin, which gives you +10% to fire rate
- Wonderful female skin, which gives you +10% to damage
- new powerful weapons: Laser Katana, Banana and Thunder Hammer
- 750 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000033868.name: Run Sausage Run!: Good & Evil Edition
70070000033868.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000033868.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 3 new skins (Angel, Devil and Astronaut)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000033880.name: Candivity: Gold Edition
70070000033880.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
70070000033880.description:
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

This bundle includes:
- Candivity
- Candivity: Under Water DLC
- Candivity: Deep Mines DLC

Features:
• Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
• Co-op mode for you and your friend!
• Versus mode to sabotage your friends!
• 4 maps: Under Water, Deep Mines and 2 standard maps
• New animal characters and swimming accessories
• Fully customizable name and character
• Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
• An adorably sweet aesthetic

NEW VERSUS MODE!
Race to merge the biggest candy while using clever tactics to slow down your opponent. Unleash tricky power-ups, and prove who’s the ultimate candy master!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000033889.name: Ecchi Numbers: First Edition
70070000033889.intro: Fill her grid and reveal the picture.
70070000033889.description:
Think you’ve got the skills to go all the way? Fill in the right positions and slowly clear away the puzzle—revealing more than just your brainpower.

Every number brings you closer to the full picture. Get it right, and you’ll uncover a beautiful picture waiting just beneath the surface... but one wrong move and you might just ruin the mood.

Features:
- 52 beautiful girls looking for company
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Take your time, plan your moves, and finish strong.

70070000033893.name: OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter: Tactical Ops
70070000033893.intro: Every mistake is punished instantly on the battlefield.
70070000033893.description:
Step into the most realistic combat simulation with OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter, now enhanced with the ultimate customization pack. Experience full tactical action while showing off your personal style.

Bundle Features:
1. OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter
Plan your strategy, equip the latest tactical gear, and face intense multiplayer battles or solo missions. Experience realistic weapon handling, dynamic bodycam effects, and challenging enemy encounters across diverse environments.

2. OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter: Visual Warfare
Stand out on the battlefield with 13 brand-new skins. Customize your operator and weapons, showcase your unique style, and bring personality to every mission. These skins provide visual variety and let you make your loadout unmistakably yours.

Enhance your combat experience, dominate the battlefield, and express your style like never before!

70070000033904.name: Cozy Land Winter Wishes
70070000033904.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000033904.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

Create your unique cozy land with additional Ice Age DLC included in this bundle.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000033907.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 ICONS Edition
70070000033907.description:
EA SPORTS FC™ 26 ICONS Edition includes:

- One Gold Starting XI pack, with 11 untradeable Gold Player Items (1 Goalkeeper, 4 Defenders, 3 Midfielders, 3 Attackers) rated 84 or higher

Three Iconic Players Picks (all untradeable, rated up to 91 OVR), from a selection of base & campaign ICONs & Heroes from select EA SPORTS FC 26 Ultimate Team campaigns from game launch until Mar 31§:

- 1 of 5 ICON or Hero Defender Player Pick
- 1 of 5 ICON or Hero Midfielder Player Pick
- 1 of 5 ICON or Hero Attacker Player Pick

The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC™ 26.

Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience powered by community feedback. The new Authentic Gameplay option delivers the most true-to-football experience ever in Career, while the Competitive Gameplay option—driven by refined fundamentals, added consistency, and enhanced responsiveness—is tailor-made for play in Football Ultimate Team™ and Clubs.

Put your dream squad to the test in Football Ultimate Team™ with new Live Events and Tournament modes, as well as a refreshed Rivals and Champs experience.

Experience Manager Career like never before with all-new Manager Live Challenges. Earn rewards throughout the new season by taking on a variety of real-world scenarios and alternative storylines – ranging from a few minutes of play to multiple seasons.

Archetypes inspired by the greats of the game introduce new classes to Clubs and Player Career, bringing more individuality to your player. Develop your abilities by upgrading attributes and unlocking Archetype Perks to give your player a distinct feel on the pitch.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

70070000033925.name: Heart of Darkness Collection
70070000033925.intro: Journey through Nosgoth’s dark legacy in a remastered classic and a new chapter
70070000033925.description:
The Heart of Darkness Collection is the ultimate Legacy of Kain experience, bringing together Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered Deluxe Edition and Legacy of Kain: Ascendance in one definitive bundle.
Return to the dark world of Nosgoth and relive the climactic struggle between Kain and Raziel in Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered Deluxe Edition, updated with modern enhancements and exclusive bonus content.  Then step into Legacy of Kain: Ascendance, a fast-paced 2D action platformer that brings you Nosgoth in a brand new way.

70070000033934.name: TCG Card Market Simulator – Shop Tycoon
70070000033934.intro: Build your ultimate card shop and dominate the trading scene.
70070000033934.description:
Start your journey as a top TCG entrepreneur with TCG Card Market Simulator and take your card shop to new heights. Manage your inventory, set prices, customize your store, and attract trading card enthusiasts as you grow your business into a bustling hub for collectors and fans alike.

Bundle Includes:
1. TCG Card Market Simulator – Build and manage your card shop from the ground up. Customize layouts, stock up on boosters, organize tournaments, and track market trends to grow your TCG empire.

2. TCG Card Market Simulator: Skybox Upgrade – Refresh your store’s look with a brand-new scenic backdrop, enhancing the atmosphere and making every card trade feel special.

3. TCG Card Market Simulator: Balance Boost – Gain 2,500 in-game cash to expand your shop, invest in boosters, highlight rare cards, and grow your business faster.

Transform your card shop into the ultimate TCG destination. Upgrade your store, attract more customers, and master the trading card market as you become a true collector’s hub.

70070000033936.name: Hentai Portrait Luxiourious Lagoon
70070000033936.description:
Enter Hentai Portrait- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.

Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Portrait offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000033937.name: Hentai Session Golden Hour Collection
70070000033937.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70070000033937.description:
Welcome to Hentai Session, a relaxing puzzle experience full of color, style, and charm. Take your time to assemble vivid illustrations featuring elegant and expressive characters. Each completed puzzle unlocks a detailed image designed with care and creativity in your collection.


Enjoy the satisfying flow of gameplay, soft background music, and cozy atmosphere that make each session a moment of calm and focus. Whether you’re here to unwind or to challenge your observation skills, it’s the perfect way to relax and have fun.

This bundle include Portraits Pack 1 and Portraits Pack 2 DLCs

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 puzzles to complete
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle assembly
- High-quality illustrations full of detail
- Gentle music and relaxing atmosphere
- Gallery mode to view completed works
- Perfect for a calm and focused gameplay session

70070000033938.name: Supermarket CEO Simulator: Empire Builder
70070000033938.intro: Step into the shoes of a true supermarket owner and grow your empire.
70070000033938.description:
Step into the world of retail management with Supermarket CEO Simulator and take your supermarket empire to new heights! Build, manage, and expand your stores while making strategic decisions that shape your path to becoming the ultimate retail mogul.

Bundle Includes:
1. Supermarket CEO Simulator – Take charge of your own supermarket, manage inventory, hire and train staff, launch promotions, and expand your business across multiple locations. Every decision counts as you compete to become the market leader.
2. Supermarket CEO Simulator: Startup Cash – Start with an extra 2,000 in your balance to invest in stock, upgrade your stores, and accelerate your growth. Use these resources to make smarter business moves and expand faster.

Grow your stores, attract loyal customers, and turn your small supermarket into a thriving retail empire. Experience strategic management, smart investments, and accelerated growth all in one bundle!

70070000033942.name: DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter & WW2 Soldiers of Honor - Warzone Assault
70070000033942.intro: Survival Has Many Faces. Face Them All.
70070000033942.description:
Two wars. Two battlefields. One test of survival and skill.

This two intense shooter experiences that throw you into unforgiving combat scenarios where every decision matters. Face relentless zombie hordes in a collapsing city and step onto the front lines of World War II, where courage, precision, and tactics decide victory. Whether you’re fighting for survival or honor, this bundle delivers nonstop action across two distinct combat worlds.

DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter

The city has fallen. The undead rule. Survival is your only mission.
In DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter, you fight through a post-apocalyptic city overrun by zombies. Fast-paced firefights, constant pressure, and limited resources force you to stay alert at all times. Defeat enemies to earn Survival Points, unlock powerful upgrades, and customize your weapons to match your playstyle.

Move between dangerous zones using helicopters, explore abandoned areas filled with hidden threats, and rely on tactical tools like grenades and traps to survive increasingly difficult encounters. Every wave pushes your reflexes and decision-making to the limit.

Key Highlights:

- Intense arcade-style FPS zombie combat
- Weapon and ability upgrades through progression
- Tactical gadgets and customizable equipment
- Survival-focused gameplay in hostile environments

WW2 Soldiers of Honor – Warzone Assault

Honor is forged in the heat of battle.
Step into the chaos of World War II and take on high-risk missions behind enemy lines. As a skilled soldier, you’ll sabotage enemy positions, clear fortified locations, and fight across war-torn environments inspired by historic conflicts.

Each mission challenges your tactical approach, requiring careful weapon choice, positioning, and awareness. Hidden objectives and relics reward exploration, while escalating battles keep the pressure high from start to finish.

Key Highlights:

- Story-driven WWII combat missions
- Historically inspired weapons and gear
- Tactical objectives and strategic gameplay
- Varied war zones with dynamic encounters


From surviving an undead apocalypse to fighting for victory on the battlefield, this bundle offers action, intensity, and replayability across two unique shooters. Master both worlds, adapt to different combat styles, and prove you have what it takes to survive any war.

70070000033943.name: Homura: The Crimson Warriors Deluxe Edition
70070000033943.intro: Ignite the fire within the Crimson Warriors' hearts in their final showdown!
70070000033943.description:
Brave the Ura Yagyu and win the hearts of the Crimson Warriors with the Deluxe Edition! This bundle includes the digital game, five short stories featuring fiery romance for each of the five love interests, and a 26-track digital soundtrack!

The Deluxe Edition includes:
・Digital Standard Edition
・Digital Short Stories (20 Pages)
・Digital Soundtrack (26 Tracks)

70070000033944.name: Astro Party EX - Stellar Edition
70070000033944.description:
Astro Party EX is a chaotic local multiplayer space brawler. Blast enemy ships, run over pilots, and laugh while you do it. The twist? Ships can only turn right. (whaaaaa?)

• Up to 4 players
• Two-button controls
• Fully destructible arenas
• Stylish pixel art & music

Astro Party EX - Stellar Edition includes the base game and expands the party with a new world, two new pilots and a new game mode.

INCLUDES:
• Flare Watch - a dangerous outpost
• Box Cat - the Street Brawler
• Dina - the Lost Huntress
• Deathmatch  - a non-stop onslaught in a single arena

70070000033956.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Airline Empire
70070000033956.intro: Expand your fleet, conquer airports, and master the skies.
70070000033956.description:
Take to the skies and build your aviation empire with this exclusive bundle of Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business. Experience the thrill of managing your own airline, from modest beginnings to becoming a global cargo powerhouse. Navigate diverse airports, handle a variety of cargo types, and master challenging weather conditions as you rise to the top of the air transport industry.

Bundle Includes:
1. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Start your journey as the inheritor of a small airline and grow it into a worldwide cargo empire. Manage aircraft, hangars, airports, and missions across a vast open world.

2. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cash Cargo – Gain a strategic boost with $350,000 in in-game currency to enhance your fleet, upgrade facilities, and expand your airline’s reach.

3. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Powerlift Cargo – Add the Heavy Lift Carrier aircraft with a dedicated slot, or receive $525,000 compensation if already owned, enabling you to transport larger cargo and elevate your airline to elite status.

Embark on an unparalleled aviation adventure. Upgrade your fleet, expand your network, and experience the ultimate cargo transport challenge as you transform your airline into a dominant force in the skies.

70070000033961.name: SnapCat Cozy Extended Edition
70070000033961.intro: SnapCat is a cozy exploration game about finding cats and capturing quiet moments across peaceful islands.
70070000033961.description:
Pack your things, we're going on a trip! We're going to visit breathtaking islands and make the most of the summer sun. But remember - the core item in your luggage is your camera!
Aside from admiring the architecture and colorful flora, we have one crucial mission - documenting the furry inhabitants of the islands. Can you find and photograph all of them? 
Grab your camera and get ready for the cat-tastrophe of cuteness! 
No timers, no battles, no pressure—just pure, pawsitive vibes. 

Wander across bright, bubbly islands that feel like an endless summer vacation—but keep your eyes peeled! These fuzzy superstars love to hide, lounge, stretch, and strike suspiciously perfect poses. Aside from taking pictures, you can fill their cute little water bowls to keep them happy, and, most importantly, don't forget to pet them! 

Every photo you take lands in your super-colorful Cat-alog Album, where you can admire your masterpieces, name your new feline friends, and relive every whisker-wiggling moment.

Snap Cat:
Bright colors. Big personalities.
Cats who act like they’re the stars of their own cartoon show.
(And honestly… they kinda are.)

Extended Edition includes SnapCat: Mia's Cozy Adventure base game and Cozy Sunset Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 21 colorful islands full of kitties 
- cozy, stress-free gameplay and feel-good atmosphere
- relaxing music, perfect for unwinding after a long day
- photo album with all your pictures and the option to name the cats

70070000033962.name: Little Strays 2: Valley of Colors
70070000033962.intro: The city fell silent but the cats are still here, and they need your help!
70070000033962.description:
Play as a stray cat exploring an abandoned city in search of food, shelter, and hope.
Rescue lost kittens, help other strays survive, and guide them to hidden safehouses across the ruins.
Explore deserted streets, flooded sewers, and forgotten underground labs - solo or in two-player co-op.
Sneak, sprint, and slip past threats like aggressive dogs and swarms of bugs.

• Explore abandoned streets, flooded sewers, and forgotten underground laboratories
• Rescue kittens, bring food, and escort animals to safety
• Avoid danger with stealth, timing, and fast escapes
• Two-player co-op: explore together and watch each other’s backs
• Find safehouses and protect the cats you save

70070000033968.name: Mini Market Design Aesthetic Academy
70070000033968.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000033968.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.

Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the School, Furniture Material Collection 1 and Furniture Material Collection 2 DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000033971.name: Freaky Trip Ultra Special
70070000033971.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000033971.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

This bundle includes the Cooking Pack and Camp DLCs

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000033973.name: Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre – Outlaw Saga
70070000033973.intro: Step into the frontier and prove your skill in deadly duels.
70070000033973.description:
Step into a lawless land and prove your skill in deadly duels where only the fastest gunslinger survives. Travel through scenic towns, face ruthless outlaws, and earn your reputation as a legendary gunslinger. Every duel tests your speed, strategy, and precision, pushing you to master the art of the quick draw.

This bundle includes:
• Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre – Explore the Wild West, engage in epic battles, upgrade your arsenal, and complete challenging missions.

• Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre – Bounty Boost – Receive $3000 in-game to get a head start on weapons, ammunition, and reputation.

Are you ready to claim your bounty and become a true legend of the Wild West?

70070000033975.name: Cat&Friends Memory Critter Cuddles
70070000033975.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70070000033975.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 1 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70070000033979.name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery Digital Deluxe Edition
