70070000033979.intro: Lead the Calamity Angels team with pride and grab the Digital Deluxe Edition!
70070000033979.description:
Lead the Calamity Angels team with pride and grab the Digital Deluxe Edition!

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Digital Standard Edition game
• Digital Art Book (52 pages) / Short Stories
• Digital Soundtrack (25 tracks)

70070000033980.name: Unusual Friends Bundle
70070000033980.description:
Cat Souls:

In Cat Souls, you will be playing as Ruby, an energetic cat with a strange ability. Like all cats, Ruby has more than one life, but not all of them can use their past souls as a platform.

Ruby and her friend went on an adventure and successfully found the mythical Hourglass of time! Sadly the end of that adventure is the beginning of a new one.

Enemies appeared out of nowhere, and our protagonists tried to run but… only Ruby managed to escape. But she still has 7 lives! Now is the time to rescue your friend and get the Hourglass of Time back!

Jump, avoid obstacles, use levers, and collect keys to reach the end of each level in time. The spikes will only take one of your lives, but be careful not to waste them all!


Features:
* 45 levels
* Fun soul game mechanic
* Different obstacles and enemies
* 6 different worlds
* 2D Platformer
* Cute pixel art


Bumballon:

Join Bumballon on this cute but frantic adventure spanning across an incredible world full of dangers!

Explore 7 unique worlds overflowing with beautifully animated graphics and retro game nostalgia. Overcome various perils to save Bumballon's magical kingdom and rescue the beautiful Princess Moon.

Each mistake becomes a lesson to overcome future obstacles in Bumballon’s tough but fun and rewarding journey.


Features:
* Beautiful animated graphics.
* Explore 7 worlds.
* 35 different levels.
* 5 unlockable skins.
* Variety of action mechanics.


Prisonela DX:

Get ready for platforming incarceration insanity in Prisonela DX. These levels may be short, but fun!

Use your special parkour abilities to overcome all the obstacles, and avoid all the traps. Don’t expect to atone for your mistakes in this prison madhouse though. Each time you die, you’ll be warped to a completely different level where you’ll have to adapt and survive.

Do you have what it takes to escape this platforming prison hell? Find out in Prisonela DX!


Features
* Platform action gameplay
* Short levels
* Different skins
* Random level order
* Cute pixel art style

70070000033981.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Alopex Bundle
70070000033981.intro: Pick up both the base game and the Alopex Character DLC for a bodacious savings!
70070000033981.description:
Unleash the Turtles and their friends in a quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan!

In Splintered Fate, brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay on both Campaign and Arcade modes. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

ALOPEX CHARACTER DLC
 - 5 new artifacts
 - New playable character: Alopex

Alopex wields her kama with deadly accuracy and speed while facing her troubled past as Karai's sister-in-arms. Explore 5 new Artifacts while playing through a brand new story line as the mysterious mutant arctic fox.

With thrilling combat and endless challenges, Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

70070000033990.name: Ecchi Breaker: Brave Edition
70070000033990.intro: Break the blocks and meet brave women.
70070000033990.description:
Focus and get ready to play. Each hit brings you closer to what lies behind the blocks, and the prize for winning has never looked so good.

Focus, control your shots, and watch the tension rise with each block you destroy. But be careful... too many misses and the moment may slip away.

Features:
- 50 brave girls waiting to be discovered
- Sensual music and satisfying effects
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- A feast for the eyes

Take up the challenge.

70070000034009.name: Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025: Hit the Road
70070000034009.intro: Reach new heights with flips, jumps, and high-speed action.
70070000034009.description:
Step into the world of high-speed thrills and extreme stunts with this bundle! Take control of the most exciting vehicles, perform gravity-defying flips and jumps, and master every track as you rise to become the ultimate stunt hero.

This bundle includes:
1. Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025 - Drive a huge variety of cars, from sleek sports cars to legendary classics. Take on challenging stunt tracks, execute daring flips, and prove your precision driving skills across multiple dynamic environments. 
2. Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025: New Wheels - Get behind the wheel of the Landorchini Super, a high-speed stunt car. Perform flips, daring jumps, and precision maneuvers across every track, and experience the ultimate thrill of stunt driving.

Take control, push your skills to the max, and become a true Car Stunt Hero!

70070000034017.name: Neva - Complete Edition
70070000034017.intro: Experience the moving tale of a young woman and her lifelong bond with a magnificent wolf as they embark on a thrilling adventure through a rapidly dying world.
70070000034017.description:
The Neva - Complete Edition includes the base game and Prologue DLC.

Neva is an emotionally-charged action adventure from the visionary team behind the critically acclaimed GRIS.

Neva chronicles the story of Alba, a young woman bound to a curious wolf cub following a traumatic encounter with dark forces. Together they embark on a perilous journey through a once-beautiful world as it slowly decays around them.

Over time, their relationship will evolve as they learn to work together, helping one another to brave increasingly dangerous situations. The wolf will grow from a rebellious cub to an imposing adult seeking to forge her own identity, testing Alba’s love and their commitment to one another.

As the cursed world threatens to overwhelm them, Alba and her courageous companion will do whatever it takes to survive and make a new home, together.

Neva: Prologue
Follow Alba as she chases a trail of white butterflies deep into the corrupted swamps, only to discover a frightened wolf cub, lost and alone. Determined to save her, Alba must earn the young wolf's trust and guide her through the blighted wilderness. Together, they will face new enemies, endure perilous trials, and confront a monstrous force that threatens to tear them apart.

Designed to be experienced after completing the main game, Neva: Prologue offers a deeper challenge and rich narrative for returning players. The expansion introduces three new locations, each featuring unique gameplay mechanics, alongside new challenges, enemies, and intense boss encounters.

70070000034028.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Legendary Edition
70070000034028.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000034028.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #4 with:

-3 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000034038.name: Build A Queen: Complete Edition
70070000034038.intro: Showcase your looks on the catwalk and compete in thrilling fashion battles!
70070000034038.description:
Step into the world of glamour and style with Build A Queen! The ultimate fashion game where you can become a doll maker and create your dream queen!

Become a virtual fashion designer and let your creativity shine! Choose your model and dive into a project makeover. Design everything: from stunning hairstyles and flawless makeup to the hottest outfits and fabulous accessories! This is your chance to build a sweet doll with your unique style.

Features:
- Build YOUR Queen: shape your characters body with stunning or monstrous makeover choices!
- Dress to impress: customize hairstyles, makeup, outfits, and accessories.
- Get a boyfriend: outstyle your rival and win his heart!
- Walk the runway: showcase your look in fashion battles and catwalk challenges.
- 3 victory dances: Celebrate your win with Gagnam Style, Robot Dance and Snake Moves!
- 3 boyfriend skins: Turn your boyfriend into a Pirate, Prince or Charming King!

Will you make the right choices to win and become the ultimate Fashion Queen?

70070000034039.name: THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION – Hunt for Survival
70070000034039.intro: Outlast the predators and become the ultimate survivor.
70070000034039.description:
Venture deeper into a deadly prehistoric jungle where every decision can mean the difference between life and death. This bundle combines the survival experience with enhanced tools to tackle the island’s challenges in style and with precision.

Bundle includes:
• THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION (Full Game): Explore abandoned research sites, gather essential supplies, and outsmart relentless dinosaurs using stealth, strategy, and the environment.
• THE LOST DINO: SURVIVAL EXPEDITION – Hunter Gloves: Upgrade your character’s appearance with sleek, tactical gloves, adding a fresh visual flair and enhancing your immersive survival experience.

Experience the complete adventure. Outlast predators, uncover the island’s dark secrets, and survive in ultimate style.

70070000034044.name: Fight For America: Golden Edition
70070000034044.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000034044.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- New weapon: unleash the Golden Amcar, a perfectly balanced assault rifle built for any fight
- Extra coins: Boost your campaign with 4000 coins to upgrade your weapons, turrets, and base
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000034046.name: Raptor Evolution: Hot Edition
70070000034046.description:
Take control of a mighty dinosaur in a post-apocalyptic world on a quest to recover its stolen eggs.

Smash through environments, gather resources, and hunt grotesque human-mutants to evolve and grow stronger. Use what you collect to rebuild bridges, restore paths and push deeper into a world filled with danger and mystery. 

Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying bosses standing between you and your lost brood.

Features:
- Unleash powerful evolution form with Infermadon skin
- Break everything: destroy environments and leave nothing standing
- Use advanced technology: encounter futuristic machines that will aid your survival
- Engage in fierce battles: hunt down mutants and monstrous creatures
- Meet various enemies: take on diverse foes with unique behaviors
- Lead your warriors: command other beasts and dominate the wasteland
- Evolve to become a super beast: grow stronger with every challenge you overcome!
- Use 200 Meat, 30 Mutagen and 400 Gems to power up your evolution and make your raptor stronger in every battle

Will you survive and recover your eggs?

70070000034049.name: Subway Simulator - Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Urban Conductor
70070000034049.intro: Explore new tracks, face exciting challenges, and drive in style.
70070000034049.description:
Step into the subway adventure, combining Subway Simulator game and two exciting DLC expansions. Take control of underground trains, master intricate routes, and experience the thrill of urban transit like never before.

Bundle includes:
• Subway Simulator – Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Become a real subway driver and explore multiple cities, stations, and routes. Choose from five trains, develop your skills across 100 challenging levels, and make your mark in the ever-evolving subway world.
• Express Voyager Train DLC: Drive the elite Express Voyager, a high-speed train designed for modern routes. Experience faster travel, advanced technology, and enhanced passenger comfort while exploring new challenges and city routes.
• Urban Speed DLC: Take the wheel of the Metroliner Express and elevate your subway operations. Navigate tunnels, stop at bustling stations, and master high-speed routes with precision and style.

Experience the ultimate combination of subway simulation, high-speed travel, and urban exploration. Upgrade your subway driving career and enjoy every route, train, and challenge this bundle has to offer.

70070000034054.name: House Renovator Simulator: Designer Home
70070000034054.intro: Plan, decorate, and personalize every unique house.
70070000034054.description:
Experience the world of home renovation with this  bundle! Transform old, forgotten houses into modern, welcoming homes while managing your budget, tools, and materials with precision. Every detail counts, from tearing down walls to choosing the perfect finishes and furniture.

Bundle Includes:
1. House Renovator Simulator (Base Game) – Embark on a realistic renovation journey, customize interiors in modern, rustic, or classic styles, and bring forgotten homes back to life.
2. House Renovator Simulator: Budget Boost – Receive 2000 in-game currency to support your projects, giving you extra flexibility to plan, upgrade, and decorate with confidence.

Take full control of your renovation projects, enhance your creativity, and transform every house into a dream home with this bundle!

70070000034056.name: Year 5 Season Pass!
70070000034056.intro: This is your pass to 6 exciting new worlds to complete in hexceed! With 700+ levels to complete!
70070000034056.description:
This pass unlocks all the DLC that we will release during hexceed's fifth year! We will be releasing a new DLC every 2 months, each containing a new world to complete. 6 new worlds to explore! Over 700 levels to complete!

Although each DLC will be available for purchase individually, this year 5 pass lets you buy them all at once and for a discount!
Here is a breakdown of the DLCs included:
1 - Aquilla (April 2026)
2 - Centaurus (June 2026)
3 - Capricornus (August 2026)
4 - Cetus (October 2026)
5 - Sirius (December 2026)
6 - Alphard (February 2027)

70070000034073.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - All Character DLC Bundle
70070000034073.intro: Pick up all three epic character DLCs together to make a bodacious savings!
70070000034073.description:
Unleash the Turtles and their friends in a quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan!

In Splintered Fate, brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay on both Campaign and Arcade modes. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

This bundle includes three action-packed DLCs loaded with extra content, playable in both Campaign and Arcade modes:
CASEY JONES & THE JUNKYARD JAM
- New playable character: Casey Jones
- New level: The Junkyard
- New enemies and challenging bosses
- 5 new artifacts
- New narrative: Help Casey get his car back together!

METALHEAD CHARACTER DLC
- New playable character: Metalhead, first fully-ranged hero
- 5 new artifacts

ALOPEX CHARACTER DLC
- 5 new artifacts
- New playable character: Alopex

With thrilling combat and endless challenges, Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

70070000034079.name: Pixel Cafe Upgrade Edition
70070000034079.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000034079.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipment, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game and Bedroom Touches #2 with:

A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
Also, mix things up with two new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000034081.name: Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Gold Edition
70070000034081.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000034081.description:
Love cooking games? Manage 9 distinct kitchens, craft over 500 dishes, and rise to culinary stardom across 1000+ fast-paced levels in Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire. Customize your home, unlock trophies, and bring the heat!

From street food to sushi, each kitchen will test your time-management skills as you work to satisfy impatient customers and hit your goals. But it’s not all about the kitchens—customize and upgrade your home to showcase your achievements, unlock trophies, and build a true empire!

Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Can you handle the heat and build your own cooking empire?

Key Features:

9 Unique Cuisines: Master a range of cooking styles and menus.
500+ Dishes: A global selection of recipes to perfect.
1000+ Levels: Challenge yourself with increasingly complex kitchens.
Home Customization: Upgrade your furniture and earn trophies to showcase your progress.
Fun & Fast-Paced: Simple to play, with endless hours of culinary excitement!

This bundle contains base game, DLC#2- Cozy Living and Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Kebab Bar Tycoon, with:
- new set of furniture for your Living Room!
- whole additional restaurant - Kebab Bar

70070000034083.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle ANIVERSARY Edition
70070000034083.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000034083.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle and Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1 with:

- 20 brand new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon

70070000034088.name: Football Legends 2025 Deluxe Edition
70070000034088.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70070000034088.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

This bundle includes the base game and Team Pack #2 with:
- three new teams

70070000034089.name: Pool Fever Legendary Edition
70070000034089.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000034089.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #4 with:

15 new pool table designs
5 new pool cues designs

70070000034091.name: Snooker Fever Definitive Edition
70070000034091.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000034091.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Expansion Pack #3 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

15 stunning new table designs
10 sleek cue styles

70070000034093.name: Nitrous Fury Deluxe Edition
70070000034093.intro: Feel the speed, master the nitro, and rule the streets!
70070000034093.description:
Feel the Speed. Rule the Streets.

Step into the world of high-octane drag racing, where every millisecond counts and every gear shift can decide your fate.

Welcome to a vibrant metropolis bursting with neon lights, roaring engines, and pure adrenaline.

Test your reflexes and precision in intense straight-line races across ¼ mile, ½ mile, or full-mile tracks — both by day and under the dazzling glow of city nights.

Upgrade, tune, and customise more than 60 unique cars to dominate your rivals. Boost your engine, fine-tune your gearbox, unleash the nitro, and leave your opponents in a trail of smoke and shattered pride.

Shift. Launch. Win.

Every second counts. Every victory matters.
Feel the rush of nitro, the thrill of precision, and the glory of crossing the finish line first.

It’s not just a race — it’s a lifestyle.

This bundle includes the base game and Sunrise Burnout with:
- new track bathed in morning light

70070000034097.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Power Edition
70070000034097.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000034098.name: Pocket Nook Fantastic Realms Edition
70070000034098.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000034098.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!

Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!

There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

This bundle includes the Fantasy DLC.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000034101.name: Darts Fever Superior Edition
70070000034101.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000034101.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 4 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game, Stylish Precision #1 and Stylish Precision #3 with:

- 10 brand-new dart designs

70070000034108.name: Cozy Memory Bright Sky Edition
70070000034108.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000034108.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes Cards Pack 2 with extra colorful cards.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000034110.name: Pets and Friends Flowers Bundle 2
70070000034110.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of colorful flowers.
70070000034110.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new flowers to add variety to your album.

70070000034111.name: Card-en-Ciel Expansion Pass
70070000034111.description:
This expansion pass grants access to the following items:

◆Expansion Pass purchase bonus
　・Neon card for use as Wild Card exclusive to Expansion Pass

◆DLC Pack 1
　・New story dungeon, "Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark"
　・"Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark" additional cards
　・"Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark" additional Muse
　・"Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark" additional random events

◆DLC Pack 2
　・New story dungeon, "Blaster Master Zero Series"
　・"Blaster Master Zero Series" additional cards
　・"Blaster Master Zero Series" additional Muse
　・"Blaster Master Zero Series" additional random events

70070000034112.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection Season Pass
70070000034112.intro: 10 monthly DLC packs for Ghost Master Resurrection. Base game required. Core Edition includes DLC 1 and 2. Season Pass includes DLC 3 through DLC 12.
70070000034112.description:
Expand the terror across an entire season of haunting with the Ghost Master Resurrection Season Pass.
This Season Pass includes 10 downloadable content packs, released monthly, adding new locations, new modes, new characters, and fresh supernatural challenges across Gravenville.
Included DLC packs
DLC Pack 3 Ghostly Defence
Take the haunting to Ocean Avenue and survive a Ghostbreaker assault in the new Defence mode.
DLC Pack 4 Ashes and Abyss
Terror strikes at the Gas Station and deep beneath the waves in Marine, with new characters joining your roster.
DLC Pack 5 Walls of Judgment
Haunt two grim locations, a prison built to confine and a church built to test faith.
DLC Pack 6 Between Worlds
Unleash fear in the Train Station and try a new mode where you face the hunt from the other side.
DLC Pack 7 Frightful Night
A Christmas Market draped in lights, carols, and false cheer, perfect for seasonal scares.
DLC Pack 8 Solid Ice and Terror
Explore an abandoned hockey arena where the rules can change without warning.
DLC Packs 9 to DLC 12
Additional DLC packs will be revealed closer to release.

70070000034113.name: Guns and Bullets Bundle
70070000034113.intro: ~ Evil Diary + Material Evidence + Zombies, Aliens and Guns ~
70070000034113.description:
Evil Diary:

Enter a post-apocalyptic urban wasteland where your goal is to reach a secure zone, but you have to cut across areas overrun with monsters.

Take on the role of of Eve, a fierce heroine who is determined to survive the horror by any means necessary. Shoot down enemies from afar or slash them up close and clear the way towards freedom. 

Featuring 32 intense levels where you can follow the fate of a survivor following his diary writings. Evil Diary will satisfy your urge to slay hordes of grotesque monsters.


Features:
* 32 combat levels
	* Various enemies types
* Compelling story through on survivor notes
* 2 additional character skins to be unlocked


Material Evidence:

You’ll need strategy and precision to clear each level full of malicious hoodlums toting bats, knives, guns, and other arms.

Pick up the weapons of fallen enemies and use them to your advantage. Investigate a dangerous gang hideout, shut down an insidious drug-selling operation, and get your revenge against the notorious criminals responsible.

Can you take on this challenge and defeat all your enemies?


Features:
* Gritty storyline
* 3 playable characters
* Multiple enemies and weapons
* Skip level option to avoid blocking player progress
* Two difficulty modes
* 2D action combat


Zombies, Aliens and Guns:

Aliens have attacked the planet, and they’re turning innocent people into mindless zombies. 
		
It won’t be long before the invaders have destroyed the planet unless somebody with guns stands in their way. That’s where you come in! Lead a cadre of soldiers who are ready to take down every last enemy in their path. 

You can fight alone or with a friend thanks to the local co-op mode! Try to beat the 33 levels and unlock all the 7 survival levels and the boss rush mode!


Features:
* 33 levels of carnage
* 7 survival levels and boss rush mode
* 2.5D shooting action gameplay
* Variety of terrain and scenarios
* Multiple weapons
* Boss battles

70070000034114.name: Planet of Lana Collection
70070000034114.intro: Experience Lana and Mui’s journey across two adventures
70070000034114.description:
Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey with Lana and her loyal companion Mui.

Planet of Lana Collection includes:

Planet of Lana
In a world torn between nature’s grace and cold machine invasion, one girl and her companion must rely on their bond to survive and protect what they hold dear. Their story of hope, loss, and love will stay with you long after the journey ends.

Planet of Lana II
As greed and power divide the tribes of their home planet, Lana and her little companion, Mui, must stand together against the forces reshaping their world – struggling not just for survival, but for the soul of their home.

70070000034116.name: Formula Racing GP Deluxe Edition
70070000034116.description:
Step into the adrenaline-fueled world of Formula Racing GP: Apex Overtaking and experience the ultimate motorsport challenge. Every corner tests your courage, every straight pushes your speed, and every overtake defines your skill. 

This bundle includes the main title and two DLCs, giving you everything you need to dominate the track:
- Cash Boost: Spend less time earning and more time mastering the apex.
- Unlock Car: Take your racing to the next level with a high-performance vehicle. Feel the difference in every corner and straight as you refine your racing style and leave your rivals in the rearview.

With this complete bundle, every race becomes a proving ground for champions — fearless, intense, and unforgettable.

70070000034141.name: Magic Cats Pots Blooming Vases
70070000034141.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This bundle includes the Spring DLC.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!

Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000034142.name: Cozy Tiny Home Designer Pack
70070000034142.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000034142.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes the Floor & Wallpaper DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000034143.name: My Cozy Aquarium: Mini Decorator Pack
70070000034143.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000034143.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle includes the Glowing Decoration and Antique Decoration DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000034144.name: Brain Boost Buddies Synapse Starter
70070000034144.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70070000034144.description:
In Brain Boost Buddies, kids can flip and match cute animal cards - from smiling puppies to fluffy bunnies - while training their memory and concentration skills.

Parents will love it too! The game helps develop focus, logic, and patience in a calm, positive way. Plus, players can easily choose the right difficulty level to make the challenge just right for every age.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 1 and Covers Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Adorable animal cards that make learning fun
- Different difficulty levels for all ages
- Improves memory, focus, and attention skills
- Bright, colorful visuals designed for kids
- Relaxing and cheerful background music
- Perfect for family playtime and early learning

70070000034146.name: Basketball Legends 24: Rise of Champions
70070000034146.intro: Master every move, outplay rivals, and dominate every play.
70070000034146.description:
Step into the world of Basketball Legends 24, where past, present, and future converge in an epic celebration of hoops culture. Gather your team of legends, experience basketball across different eras, and dominate the courts with next-level gameplay and stunning visuals.

Bundle Includes:
1. Basketball Legends 24 – The full game with legendary squads, timeless gameplay, and immersive basketball action. Customize your player, climb the rankings, and compete in intense head-to-head matches against friends and rivals.

2. Basketball Legends 24: Bonus Boost – Receive 5 bonus points to boost your progression, unlock features, and strengthen your team instantly.

Take your basketball adventure to the next level and become a true legend.

70070000034151.name: ASTRONEER - Glitchwalkers & Megatech Bundle
70070000034151.description:
This bundle includes the Glitchwalkers DLC and Megatech DLC.

Travel to the Aeoluz system in pursuit of a grand threat in Astroneer: Glitchwalkers. The Glitchwalkers DLC is our first ever expansion to Astroneer, offering a new space to explore as well as new narrative, gameplay, and mysteries to uncover.

In the ASTRONEER: Megatech DLC, players unlock the ability to build massive Megastructure projects that will test their Basebuilding skills using new and existing technology. Each Megastructure will have its own unique identity and gameplay, unlocking new possibilities and rewards. Harness the power of Megatech to take Basebuilding and Automation to a whole new level! This DLC will be completely compatible with existing saves, and builds off of any progress you’ve already made in game, feel free to start fresh, or load up your existing saves and start building!

70070000034164.name: Club Sports Collection Deluxe Edition
70070000034164.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000034164.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #2 with:

5 brand-new dart designs

70070000034166.name: Hole io: Complete Edition
70070000034166.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000034166.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Complete Edition features:
- 15 maps with different things to swallow 
- 85 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000034172.name: Hentai Frames Sweet Memories
70070000034172.description:
Enter Hentai Frames- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Frames offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This game includes the DLC Portraits Pack 2, which expands your puzzle collection with 6 new illustrations.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000034173.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024: Frontier Command
70070000034173.intro: Every mission feels more intense and immersive than ever.
70070000034173.description:
Tackle high-stakes inspections, chase smugglers, and manage checkpoints under a completely redesigned Skybox that is more refined and sophisticated than standard skies. Every mission feels more immersive, with dynamic horizons enhancing the tension and realism of your daily patrols.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024
Patrol borders, inspect vehicles, verify documents, and enforce law across diverse terrains.

2. Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Frontier Skies
Enjoy cinematic skies that transform the visual atmosphere of every checkpoint, urban entry point, and remote terrain.

Elevate your border enforcement experience and patrol the frontier like never before with Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024: Frontier Command!

70070000034177.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Complete Edition
70070000034177.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000034177.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - El Loco DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Mark Rouser DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Landon Phil DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Lord Maywinner DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Jax Stone DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - DeathShroud DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Jonathan DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Maverick DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 9 legendary boxers with their unique equipment and a bonus of 189500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000034182.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival – Survival Journey
70070000034182.intro: Step into the wilderness and master the art of survival.
70070000034182.description:
Step into the untamed wilderness and enhance your survival adventure with a head start. Explore vast forests, gather resources, craft tools, and build your own haven while equipped for the challenges ahead.

Bundle Includes:
- Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival (Full Game)
Explore diverse landscapes, master survival skills, craft essential items, and build a thriving settlement in the heart of the wild.

- Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival: Wild Gear 
Receive a powerful sword directly in your inventory, giving you an immediate advantage as you face the dangers of the wilderness and carve your path to survival.

Embrace the challenge, expand your skills, and thrive in a world where every decision shapes your journey.

70070000034184.name: OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club: Rise of Champions
70070000034184.intro: Step into the ultimate fighting club and fight for glory!
70070000034184.description:
Step into the ruthless world of no-holds-barred combat with OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club and gain a powerful head start with extra coins and fame. Train your fighter, master devastating moves, and climb the ranks faster than ever with this bundle.

Bundle Includes:
1. OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club (Full Game): Step into intense tournaments, choose your fighter, expand your roster, and master every punch, kick, and combo. Develop your strategy, improve vital stats, and dominate the ring to claim championship glory.
2. OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club: Power Boost: Receive 500,000 coins and 200,000 fame to enhance your fighter, unlock new upgrades, and gain a significant head start in your path to becoming the ultimate champion.

Experience the thrill of the fight, accelerate your progression, and rise above all challengers to become a legend in the world of OFC!

70070000034188.name: ASTRONEER: Premium Edition
70070000034188.description:
This bundle includes the ASTRONEER base game, Glitchwalkers DLC, and Megatech DLC.

ASTRONEER is a beloved space sandbox sim, sending players out into a strange solar system to survive, explore, and experience an intriguing sci-fi tale.

Glitchwalkers is the first ever expansion to ASTRONEER, offering a new space to explore as well as new narrative, gameplay, and mysteries to uncover.

In the ASTRONEER: Megatech DLC, players unlock the ability to build massive Megastructure projects that will test their Basebuilding skills using new and existing technology. Each Megastructure will have its own unique identity and gameplay, unlocking new possibilities and rewards. Harness the power of Megatech to take Basebuilding and Automation to a whole new level! This DLC will be completely compatible with existing saves, and builds off of any progress you’ve already made in game, feel free to start fresh, or load up your existing saves and start building!

70070000034199.name: Paper io 2: Tasty Edition
70070000034199.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000034199.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- 29 skins which also change the look of your terrain
- 6 new funny hats to wear
- custom game with 54 various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000034210.name: Tank vs Tank Definitive Edition
70070000034210.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000034210.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint #2, War Paint #3 and War Paint #4 with:

-12 unique tank skins and 12 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000034212.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Deluxe Edition
70070000034212.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000034212.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch™!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch™.

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #2 with:
- 5 new queues
- 5 new snooker table designs

70070000034213.name: Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor: Enhanced Survival
70070000034213.intro: Step into the wild and dominate your dinosaur journey.
70070000034213.description:
Step into the prehistoric world and embark on a thrilling survival adventure! In this bundle, experience life as iconic dinosaurs, explore lush dynamic biomes, complete challenging missions, and engage in epic duels with ancient predators. Gather resources, grow stronger, and shape your own evolutionary journey in a living, breathing prehistoric world.

This bundle includes:
1. Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor – Live the ultimate dinosaur adventure through 10 immersive chapters, with 50+ missions, customizable dinosaurs, and dynamic biomes full of challenges.
2. Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor: Predator Skin – Upgrade the visual experience with new textures for enemy dinosaurs, making every predator encounter unique, visually striking, and more immersive.

Survive, explore, and dominate the prehistoric era—your dinosaur adventure just got even more epic!

70070000034219.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Full Edition
70070000034219.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000034219.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #1, Custom Cruisers #2, Custom Cruisers #3, Custom Cruisers #4 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-5 new skins for each Buggy

70070000034233.name: Horticular: Complete Edition
70070000034233.description:
Buy both Horticular and Horticular: Frozen Frontier and save based on buying them separately!

About Horticular:

Horticular is a relaxing garden-builder that begins with mysterious gnomes summoning you. Their wish? For you to breathe new life into a long-lost garden, abandoned by its previous caretaker.

Enter a magical world where you build up and expand a lush garden at your own pace. In your journey, you attract adorable animals to inhabit every corner; uncover helpful upgrades; and assist quirky characters for rewards and story development—all while juggling decay and fending off corruption sent by your nemesis!

Creative Freedom:
Build and expand the garden of your dreams with hundreds of unlockable surface types and items. You set the pace and what to do next, whether it be developing a new vegetable area, progressing a lucrative story arch, or just sitting back and admiring your creation.

Animal Ecosystem:
Create and preserve animal habitats to attract adorable creatures. Each species has its own requirements to fulfill before they pay you a visit, so you have to plan ahead if you want them all. Should you not take proper care of your inhabitants, they may leave you in pursuit of better luck elsewhere!

Immersive World:
Immerse yourself in your personal garden diorama, complete with a day-night cycle and weather effects. But while a rainy and lantern-lit evening may be cozy, it is not just for show! You will find that darkness attracts unsavory characters, some animals prefer specific weather conditions, and lightning strikes loom under stormy skies.

Maintaining Magic:
Nurture your garden with magic. Over time, you will have to deal with unhappy animals, garden decay, and corrupted agents sent by your nemesis. But with a combination of helpful gnomes and your own magical gloves, you are sure to keep an everblooming environment.

Garden Upgrades:
Choose how your gardening journey develops by upgrading abilities and investing in new items. Since you make the decision, every playthrough is personal. But worry not; no choice locks you out of content, and you are able to collect everything!

Pen Pals:
Encounter multiple quirky characters writing you letters throughout the story. Each individual has their own specialty, and they frequently give you tasks to carry out in exchange for a reward. What you decide to pursue is completely up to you, and there is always something waiting to be done.

70070000034236.name: Stunt Scooter Simulator: Ultimate Stunts
70070000034236.intro: Perform extreme tricks and become the ultimate stunt rider.
70070000034236.description:
Experience the thrill of stunt riding and scooter customization, where performing jaw-dropping tricks and mastering flips across diverse locations is just the beginning. Choose from a variety of scooters, personalize them with colors, decals, and performance upgrades, and push your skills to the limit in this dynamic simulation.

Bundle Includes:
1. Stunt Scooter Simulator (Full Game) - Build, upgrade, and customize your scooters while performing incredible stunts in multiple environments. Take on challenges, unlock new tricks, and prove your skills as the ultimate stunt rider.
2. Stunt Scooter Simulator: Boosted Ride - Jumpstart your adventure with 25,000 coins to unlock upgrades faster, enhance your scooters, and gain a head start on your journey to scooter mastery.

Start your stunt scooter adventure with everything you need to perform epic tricks, upgrade your ride, and dominate the streets from the very beginning.

70070000034242.name: Farm Together 2 - Season 1 Bundle
70070000034242.description:
This Bundle features the first 4 content packs for Farm Together 2, the fun & relaxing farming game!

Explorer Pack - New clothing & tractor!
Meadow Pack - Prairie-themed content!
Gothic Pack - Vampire-themed content!
Frosty Pack - Arctic themed content!

70070000034247.name: Hotel Business Simulator: Master the Hotel
70070000034247.intro: Build, upgrade, and manage your way to hotel mastery and success.
70070000034247.description:
Step into the hotel management experience! This bundle includes everything you need to build and grow your hotel empire, along with an exclusive bonus to give you a head start.

What’s Inside the Bundle:
• Hotel Business Simulator - Build, manage, and grow your hotel empire from humble beginnings to a five-star luxury destination.

• Hotel Business Simulator: Golden Boost - Jumpstart your journey with 25,000 coins to unlock upgrades, enhance rooms, and impress guests faster.

Experience the journey from aspiring innkeeper to hospitality mogul in one convenient package. Your dream hotel awaits - build, decorate, and thrive!

70070000034257.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Strike Force
70070000034257.intro: Your armour, your shield, your advantage—master every encounter.
70070000034257.description:
Step into the ultimate battlefield experience and enhance your combat awareness. This bundle gives you everything you need for fast-paced, tactical warfare: lead your elite squad, outsmart opponents, and dominate every 5v5 battle with precision and strategy.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Experience intense 5v5 battles, dynamic maps, and realistic weapon handling in this fast-paced modern military shooter.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Green Armour – Enhance your tactical edge with a clear, green-coloured armour interface that shows your protection status at a glance, helping you react faster and dominate the battlefield.

Prepare for warfare like never before—experience both the core game and the ultimate tactical upgrade in one bundle.

70070000034266.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.20
70070000034266.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the twentieth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Landscapes with Castles
- Landmarks of the World
- Animals Looking at the Camera
- [Moving] Journey Through Switzerland

70070000034286.name: Softly Placed Cats Collection
70070000034286.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70070000034286.description:
Step into the world, where mundane tasks turn into little adventures and ordinary items provide so much joy. See everything around you in bright, new, vibrant colors and make things even more beautiful by adding fun patterns. Wake up your inner child and find the happiness in little things.
 
Each level of the game consists of a unique challenge, providing fresh, yet relaxing gameplay, that will make you curious for what’s coming next.  

This bundle includes the Cats Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
-40 unique cozy puzzle levels
-Gameplay consisting of different types of challenges
-Beautiful, vibrant visuals, where everyday items turn into something magical
-Relaxing, cheerful soundtrack 
-Inspiring, nostalgic atmosphere
-Variety of puzzles exercising different parts of the brain

70070000034291.name: Auto Sport Racing & DRONE DELIVERY - FPV SIMULATOR
70070000034291.intro: Speed on the ground. Precision in the air.
70070000034291.description:
Speed takes many forms — sometimes on asphalt, sometimes above the city skyline.

In this experience, control and precision define every challenge. Push powerful racing machines to their limits on demanding circuits, then switch perspective and take flight through a living city as you pilot advanced delivery drones under constant pressure. 

Behind the wheel, Auto Sport Racing Simulator delivers fast-paced circuit racing built around clean lines, responsive handling, and progression-driven competition.
Above the streets, Drone Delivery – FPV Simulator challenges you in a completely different way. Pilot high-tech drones through urban environments filled with obstacles, traffic, and dynamic conditions.

From ground-level racing to high-speed aerial navigation, this experience blends intensity, progression, and mastery into one continuous journey. 

Auto Sport Racing Simulator

Auto Sport Racing Simulator delivers a pure, skill-driven racing experience where every corner and straight matters. Race across a variety of carefully designed tracks, each offering its own rhythm and challenge—from tight technical sections to long, high-speed runs.
Upgrade and tune your vehicles to match your racing style, unlocking new performance parts and expanding your garage as you progress through events. 

Main Features:
- Competitive circuit racing with diverse track layouts
- Vehicle upgrades and performance tuning
- Multiple race types and progression-based events
- Unlockable cars and new environments
- Smooth handling and immersive visuals

Drone Delivery – FPV Simulator

Drone Delivery – FPV Simulator puts you in control of a professional delivery drone in a living city full of movement and challenges. Fly through streets, buildings, and tight spaces while completing time-critical deliveries ranging from food to urgent supplies.
Realistic FPV controls, battery management, and environmental challenges demand precise navigation and smart planning. 

Main Features:
- Realistic FPV drone flight physics
- Delivery missions with time and accuracy goals
- Dynamic city environments and weather conditions
- Upgradeable drone systems and equipment
- Expanding city districts with increasing difficulty

Stay focused, adapt to every challenge, and prove your control—no matter where the action takes you.

70070000034310.name: Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator Rampage
70070000034310.intro: More ammo, more mayhem — let the feathers fly!
70070000034310.description:
Step into the feathers of your daring pigeon and explore the park like never before. Dive-bomb picnickers, prank fellow pigeons, and show off your superpowered moves while enjoying triple the firepower to maximize your mischief.

Bundle Includes:
1. Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator (Full Game): Experience life as a mischievous pigeon in a lively park. Explore, prank, collect wanted stars, dodge the park ‘police’, and enjoy a whimsical, feathered adventure like no other.

2. Pigeon Sim - Bird Simulator: Ammo Mayhem: The ammo count for each weapon is increased by 3 times (×3), giving you more freedom to unleash chaos across the bustling park.

Take flight, cause chaos, and triple your fun with this ultimate pigeon experience!

70070000034315.name: Cooking Arena Upgrade Edition
70070000034315.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000034315.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon" and "Breakfast Bar Tycoon".

70070000034319.name: Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Wild City
70070000034319.intro: Unleash your shark instincts and rewrite the entire city.
70070000034319.description:
Become the ultimate predator with this bundle. Release your inner shark and jump into a city packed with destruction, adventure, and total insanity. Unleash your super abilities and dominate the urban jungle with unstoppable power.

What the bundle includes:
1. Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Your shark form knows no boundaries—run through the streets, abduct characters, and create chaos everywhere you go. Face tough NPCs and epic bosses in a world where nothing is safe.
2. Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Sky of Chaos: Adds a dramatic new skybox that changes the city’s atmosphere, making the chaos feel even more intense and visually epic.

Are you ready to rule the city and become the ultimate predator?

70070000034323.name: Construction Machine Simulator 2023: Heavy Machine
70070000034323.intro: Build bigger, work smarter, dominate every project.
70070000034323.description:
Step into the world of heavy construction and take full control of powerful machines across a dynamic and challenging worksite. From precision digging to large-scale lifting and delivery tasks, every mission tests your skills and strategy.

Bundle Includes:
1. Construction Machine Simulator 2023
Experience life on a busy construction site. Operate excavators, cranes, bulldozers, and more while completing challenging missions that require precision and skill. Progress through Career Mode, unlock upgrades, manage budgets, and grow your reputation as a master builder.

2. Construction Machine Simulator 2023: New Machinery
Receive the powerful VBear 34 machine as a gift and expand your fleet instantly. This additional heavy-duty equipment gives you more versatility on-site, allowing you to complete tasks more efficiently and take on new challenges with greater control and power.

Take control, power up your machines, and reshape the construction world. The site is waiting — it’s time to get to work!

70070000034324.name: Knights & Guns Hero's Edition
70070000034324.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000034324.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Armor Pack #2 and Armor Pack #4 with:
- 4 new armors to help you on your quest

70070000034330.name: Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing: Cyber Reign
70070000034330.intro: Dominate every track, master every drift, and build your neon empire.
70070000034330.description:
Experience the thrill of neon-lit streets and high-speed cyberpunk racing! Step into the neon-drenched future with this bundle, combining the full game with a massive financial boost to accelerate your domination.

Bundle Includes:
1. Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing
 Dive into a neon-soaked futuristic city where speed and style define your legacy. Choose from 10 unique cyberpunk cars, drift through three visually stunning tracks, unlock upgrades. Master precision driving and build your reputation as the ultimate Neon Drifter.

2. Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing: Capital Boost
 Receive 1,000,000 credits instantly added to your account. Unlock vehicles faster, maximize upgrades, and customize your garage without limits. Gain the financial edge you need to dominate the competition and focus purely on performance and style.

Command the streets from your very first race and embrace the full cyberpunk racing experience!

70070000034331.name: Cup Heroes: Champion's Starter Pack
70070000034331.intro: Join the adventure fully loaded with Coins, Diamonds, Epic Keys, and Hero Tokens!
70070000034331.description:
Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen! 

How to Play: 
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles. 
- Save the Queen: Your ultimate goal is to rescue the Queen who has been captured by evil forces. 
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and gems to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges. 

Features: 
- Premium Currency: Use 1000 Diamonds to unlock new heroes, purchase keys to open exclusive chests, obtain high-rarity gear, and gain a powerful edge in battle.
- Base Currency: Use 1600 Coins to upgrade your gear and permanent stats.
- Epic Keys: Open 30 epic crates! (Epic crate contains Uncommon, Rare or Epic gear. Guaranteed Epic gear after 6 opens)
- Hero Tokens: Use 1600 tokens to upgrade your hero and unlock new perks  
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team. 
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes. 
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game. 
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen. 
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience. 
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests to earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!

70070000034334.name: 10 Casual Games Collection
70070000034334.intro: 10 wildly addictive casual hits in 1 crazy bundle!
70070000034334.description:
Welcome to a collection where relaxation, creativity, chaos, and pure silliness come together.

10 Casual Games Collection brings together ten fan-favorite experiences in one unpredictable bundle. Mine crystals on alien planets, run a restaurant empire, paint with diamonds, slice kinetic sand, bake pastries, dig for treasure, mix ingredients to create magical creatures, race as a sausage, light up neon shapes, and run your very own foot clinic.

Whether you’re in the mood for satisfying ASMR, creative chill gameplay, or lighthearted co-op fun on one screen, this bundle has a game for every mood.

Included in this bundle:
• Astro Miner
• Buffet Boss
• Diamond Painting ASMR
• ASMR Slicing
• Baking Time
• Dig Deep
• Mystical Mixing
• Run Sausage Run!
• Light-It Up
• Foot Clinic

Pick a game, press play, and enjoy a moment of pure, simple fun whenever you need it.

70070000034350.name: Urban Flow Core Edition
70070000034350.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000034350.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
