 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Streets Supplement #2 and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•   Introducing 10 new vehicles

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

70070000034352.name: Grumpy Driver Gold Edition
70070000034352.intro: Too many cars? Never. Too much fun? Impossible!
70070000034352.description:
Get ready to explore a colourful open world packed with secrets, challenges, and endless driving fun!

From sunny beaches and peaceful farms to bustling downtown streets and misty mountain peaks — every corner hides surprises waiting to be discovered. 

Find hidden collectibles, unlock unique car skins, and reveal secret paths and jump ramps scattered across the map!

Complete exciting missions to earn stars and expand your collection of cars — from everyday rides like taxis, vans, and pickups to emergency vehicles, off-roaders, and legendary supercars. Each car brings its own personality, and your hero even changes outfits and facial expressions to match the action!

Enjoy a living city with working traffic lights, honking drivers, and expressive reactions in fun comic-style bubbles. Whether you’re parking with precision, racing against the clock, or delivering goods safely across town — every task is a new adventure.

• A vast open world to explore
• Many vehicles with unlockable skins
• Varied missions: parking, delivery, time trials
• Dynamic traffic and interactive AI
• Playful hero with animated emotions

Drive, explore, discover — and make every ride your own!

This bundle includes the base game and Sport Car DLC and DLC Vintage Car with:
- brand new Sport Car and missions connected to it
- brand new Vintage Car and missions connected to it

70070000034355.name: Little Cozy Home Complete Edition
70070000034355.intro: Create, decorate, and make your dream home come true!
70070000034355.description:
Design Your Dream Home!

Step into your cosy virtual house and unleash your creativity!

Decorate seven beautifully crafted rooms — living room, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, office, hallway, and veranda — each ready to reflect your unique style.

Pick your favourite wall colours, wallpapers, floors, rugs, and furniture to make each room truly your own. Experiment, mix styles, and see your dream home come to life!

Keep your favourite designs and return to them anytime.
Take a picture of your creation without menus or buttons in the way!

Outside your window, the world changes with four beautiful seasons – from sunny spring and summer, through colourful autumn, to snowy winter.

Easy to play, relaxing, and full of creativity – perfect for young decorators with big imaginations!

Decorate, play, and make your home the cosiest place ever!

This bundle includes base game, Cozy Living and Creative Desk with:

-Cozy Living includes stylish sofas, chairs, and accessories that will give your living room a unique atmosphere. Create a space you’ll always want to come back to.
-Creative Desk includes an elegant desk, a comfortable chair, and other accessories that let you create your dream office. Work in style!

70070000034366.name: Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator: Deluxe Tycoon
70070000034366.intro: Build your empire, attract more customers, and lead the town.
70070000034366.description:
Step into the car wash simulation and grow your business from the ground up. Expand your stations, upgrade equipment, and attract more customers as you turn your small wash into a thriving empire.

Bundle Includes:
1. Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator (Full Game) - Step into the world of car wash entrepreneurship! Start with a simple wash station, clean cars by hand, and gradually expand your business. Upgrade equipment, automate operations, and build the car wash everyone in town will be talking about!

2. Car Wash Tycoon Business Simulator: Balance Boost - Boost your growth and accelerate your progress with extra resources to help expand faster, unlock new stations, and attract more customers. Focus on building the ultimate car wash empire and enjoy a smoother start to your business journey.

Build your dream car wash, grow your business, and become the town’s number one destination!

70070000034370.name: Digging A Hole 2025: Deep Gold
70070000034370.intro: Keep digging, keep discovering, and enjoy the thrill of exploration.
70070000034370.description:
Embark on the underground adventure with this bundle! Explore the hidden depths of your backyard like never before — dig deeper, discover rare artifacts, trade them for better tools, and unlock the secrets buried beneath the earth.

Bundle Includes:
1. Digging A Hole 2025 - Experience endless digging, uncover hidden treasures, upgrade your tools, and explore secret layers beneath your backyard. Every discovery brings you closer to ancient mysteries waiting underground.

2. Digging A Hole 2025: Power Start - Receive 500 extra coins instantly to jump-start your adventure, upgrade your equipment faster, and explore deeper areas more quickly.

Start your digging journey now and uncover the mysteries hidden beneath the surface!

70070000034395.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Super Edition
70070000034395.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000034395.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- X Nom who gives you a big boost when climbing and running on walls!
- Visor Nom who eliminates two other racers right at the start of the race!
- 2000 gold to buy new Noms!

NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Grab friends or family and jump into the same race on one screen. Chase the lead, pull off last-second comebacks, and see who really is the fastest runner among you!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000034397.name: Shop Simulator Collection Bundle: Trading Card & Collectible Cars & Retro Geek
70070000034397.intro: Can you turn your small shop into the ultimate shopping haven? Prepare to manage, sell and grow in these amazing shopping simulators!
70070000034397.description:
This bundle of games will give you a taste of the excitement of opening a shop in your town and expanding your business worldwide. Attract like-minded individuals and help them discover something unique! Create an iconic meeting place for your friends! 

Check 3 amazing games in one pack
- Trading Card Shop Simulator
- Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
- Retro Geek Shop Simulator

Expand and upgrade your stores. Transform all spaces into a stylish haven for clients and embrace your inner perfectionist. 

Arrange the shops and add new features so that everyone can find what they are looking for. Create designated areas for buying, trading and playing.   

Add smart features to make shopping easier and help you stay organised. 

Search for hidden gems and sell them to eager customers. Find rare items to complete your collection! 

Act like a real entrepreneur!
- Keep your inventory fresh and exciting by stocking up on goods.
- Set your prices to strike the right balance between profit and demand. Will you aim for high profit margins, or attract more customers with discounts?
- You decide when to open your shop and when to restock.
- Build your reputation — remember that customer reviews shape your success! Keep your customers happy and watch your shop grow.
- Customise your store with posters, shelves, and eye-catching displays to make it your own.
- Some products are particularly special — if you can get hold of them, you can sell them at a huge profit!

Can you turn your small shop into the ultimate shopping haven? Prepare to manage, sell and grow in these amazing shopping simulators!

70070000034402.name: Bowling Fever Full Edition
70070000034402.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000034402.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-50 new bowling ball styles

70070000034405.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Premium Edition
70070000034405.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000034405.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #3 with:

This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000034407.name: Dive Expedition: Fallen Edition
70070000034407.intro: Your next great discovery lies just below the surface
70070000034407.description:
Explore sunken ships, remains of a crashed airplane, submarine, and mysterious underwater ruins filled with hidden treasures and fascinating artifacts.

Take your time as you navigate detailed environments, complete exploration objectives, and collect items scattered across the sea floor. Examine each discovery up close, uncovering the secrets of lost vessels and forgotten places.

This edition adds one new location to your adventure - the wreck of an airplane. Search for valuable objects both inside and around the wreck. Examine lost supplies, gold bars, weapons, and military equipment resting quietly beneath the waves.

Features:
• Discover 3 unique underwater maps: shipwreck, airplane and a submarine
• Find and examine a wide range of items, relics, and equipment
• Complete various exploration objectives across all included locations
• Enjoy a calm, atmospheric experience with no danger or combat
• Relax with immersive underwater sounds and a selection of 9 atmospheric music tracks

Dive deeper, explore every wreck, and uncover everything the ocean hides.

70070000034408.name: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Highway Adventure
70070000034408.intro: Your trucking empire starts with every mile you drive!
70070000034408.description:
Hit the road and experience everything it means to be a professional truck driver on the highways of America! This bundle gives you the opportunity to explore cities, suburbs, and industrial zones, delivering cargo and managing your own trucking business.

What’s included in the bundle:
1. Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver
The full game that puts you in the shoes of a professional truck driver, featuring diverse missions, unique locations, and the chance to grow your transportation business.

2. Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Coin Rush
Get 50,000 coins and use these resources to upgrade your truck, customize the cabin and exterior, or invest in performance upgrades that make your deliveries faster and more efficient.

This bundle provides both the complete game experience and a fast start with the bonus DLC, preparing you for any challenge on America’s roads. Hit the road, manage your business, and become a true highway professional!

70070000034409.name: Ecchi Secrets: Fantasy Edition
70070000034409.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting girls
70070000034409.description:
Beneath every fog lies temptation... and danger. Outsmart your enemies and peel back the mystery to reveal girls waiting just for you.

The further you go, each secret you uncover brings you closer to their hidden desires. But be warned: the path to pleasure is full of challenges. Are you bold enough to unveil every surprise?

Features:
- Over 30 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- 16 new pictures of charming girls awaiting your arrival
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes

70070000034411.name: Moto Rush GT Exclusive Edition
70070000034411.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000034411.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 4 new motorbikes (each with special colors)
- New colors for the rest of motorbikes
- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- 4 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000034422.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Core Edition
70070000034422.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Neon Strike and Expansion Pack #2 with:

SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.
- FMS-1-G rifle

70070000034437.name: Hentai Vision Summer Serenity Collection
70070000034437.description:
Enter Hentai Vision - a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Vision offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This game includes the DLC Portraits Pack 1 and Portraits Pack 2, which expands your puzzle collection with 12 new illustrations.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000034439.name: Hentai Portrait Coast Explorer Collection
70070000034439.description:
Enter Hentai Portrait- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.

Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Portrait offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This game includes the DLC Portraits Pack 1 and Portraits Pack 2, which expands your puzzle collection with 12 new illustrations.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000034440.name: Cozy Land Special Edition
70070000034440.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000034440.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

This bundle includes three DLCs: Ice Age, Wild West Set 1, and Wild West Set 2.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000034441.name: Piano: Learn and Play Silly Songs Pack
70070000034441.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000034441.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the Song Pack 8 DLC.

Key Features:
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000034446.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Deluxe Edition
70070000034446.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000034446.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle and Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #2 with:

- 20 brand new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon

70070000034448.name: Darts Fever Upgrade Edition
70070000034448.intro: Step Up to the toe line!
70070000034448.description:
Get ready to test your aim and precision in Darts Fever, the ultimate darts game experience!

Take on classic and exciting game modes like 201, 301, 501, Cricket, and Around the Clock. Whether you're sharpening your solo skills or challenging up to 3 friends in local multiplayer, Darts Fever delivers non-stop dart-throwing fun. 

An innovative aim mechanic and stunning 3D graphics make every game an authentic dart-throwing experience. And with motion-controlled Joy-Con™ support, you can truly feel the action as you throw your darts with realistic movement, just like you’re playing in a real-life pub match!

Grab your darts, take aim, and hit the bullseye!

6 unique board designs
10 custom dart styles
5 game modes
Single-player or up to 4 players multi-player
Motion control Joy-Con support
Realistic 3d Graphics and throwing mechanic

This bundle includes base game and Stylish Precision #4 with:

5 brand-new dart designs

70070000034450.name: Snooker Fever Value Edition
70070000034450.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000034450.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

- 10 stunning new table designs
- 10 sleek cue styles

70070000034453.name: Football Legends 2025 Premium Edition
70070000034453.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70070000034453.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

This bundle includes the base game and Team Pack #3 with:
- three new teams

70070000034454.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Platinium Edition
70070000034454.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000034454.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action.  Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision.  Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #3 with:

-2 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000034457.name: Pool Fever Platinium Edition
70070000034457.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000034457.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #3 with:

- 5 new pool table designs
- 5 new pool cues designs

70070000034460.name: Nitrous Fury Complete Edition
70070000034460.intro: Feel the speed, master the nitro, and rule the streets!
70070000034460.description:
Feel the Speed. Rule the Streets.

Step into the world of high-octane drag racing, where every millisecond counts and every gear shift can decide your fate.

Welcome to a vibrant metropolis bursting with neon lights, roaring engines, and pure adrenaline.

Test your reflexes and precision in intense straight-line races across ¼ mile, ½ mile, or full-mile tracks — both by day and under the dazzling glow of city nights.

Upgrade, tune, and customise more than 60 unique cars to dominate your rivals. Boost your engine, fine-tune your gearbox, unleash the nitro, and leave your opponents in a trail of smoke and shattered pride.

Shift. Launch. Win.

Every second counts. Every victory matters.
Feel the rush of nitro, the thrill of precision, and the glory of crossing the finish line first.

It’s not just a race — it’s a lifestyle.

This bundle includes the base game, Nightfall Boost and Sunrise Burnout with:
- new track bathed in morning light
- new track soaked in sunset

70070000034461.name: Pixel Cafe Discovery Edition
70070000034461.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000034461.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipment, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game, Kitchen Touches and Bedroom Touches #2 with:

A different variant for the Refrigerator
An updated Oven and Stove design
A new look for the Sink
An alternative style for the Bar
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
Also, mix things up with 4 new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000034464.name: Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Platinium Edition
70070000034464.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000034464.description:
Love cooking games? Manage 9 distinct kitchens, craft over 500 dishes, and rise to culinary stardom across 1000+ fast-paced levels in Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire. Customize your home, unlock trophies, and bring the heat!

From street food to sushi, each kitchen will test your time-management skills as you work to satisfy impatient customers and hit your goals. But it’s not all about the kitchens—customize and upgrade your home to showcase your achievements, unlock trophies, and build a true empire!

Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Can you handle the heat and build your own cooking empire?

Key Features:

9 Unique Cuisines: Master a range of cooking styles and menus.
500+ Dishes: A global selection of recipes to perfect.
1000+ Levels: Challenge yourself with increasingly complex kitchens.
Home Customization: Upgrade your furniture and earn trophies to showcase your progress.
Fun & Fast-Paced: Simple to play, with endless hours of culinary excitement!

This bundle contains base game, DLC#3- Creative Desk and Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Kebab Bar Tycoon, with:

- an elegant desk, a comfortable chair, and other accessories that let you create your dream office!
- whole additional restaurant - Kebab Bar

70070000034466.name: Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter – Outbreak
70070000034466.intro: The abandoned building holds secrets you may never escape.
70070000034466.description:
Step into a relentless fight for survival where darkness, decay, and fear collide. In this intense bundle, every corridor becomes a trap, every shadow a threat, and every decision a matter of life or death. Explore a compact yet deadly environment where danger lurks behind every corner.

Bundle Includes:
1. Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter
Enter a brutal survival arena set inside an abandoned building where danger lurks around every corner. Face relentless waves of zombies, search for hidden weapons, and manage your resources carefully to stay alive.

2. WARZONE CHRONICLES - Night Vision DLC
This DLC introduces a night vision mode that allows players to navigate through darkness using specialized goggles. The green-tinted view reveals enemies and obstacles hidden in the shadows, changing how you approach every encounter.

3. Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter - Haunted Interiors
This DLC enhances the environment by reworking the building’s interiors with darker visuals and unsettling details. Rooms are filled with damaged objects, scattered debris, and signs of past chaos, creating a heavier and more oppressive atmosphere.

Every second counts, every bullet matters. Survive the night… or become part of it.

70070000034473.name: Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim: The Drift Formula
70070000034473.intro: Become faster, stronger, and more skilled with every race.
70070000034473.description:
Step into the ultimate high-speed experience and take full control of your drifting journey. This complete bundle is designed for drivers who want more speed, more style, and more power right from the start. Explore dynamic environments, master precision drifting, and compete across multiple game modes that test your skills in every possible way.

Bundle Includes:
1. Drift Master Simulator 2024 - Driving Sim (Full Game)
Dive into an adrenaline-fueled driving experience with a wide selection of vehicles and deep customization options. Master multiple game modes, conquer diverse environments, and perfect your drifting skills to dominate every track.

2. Drift Master Simulator 2024: Rich Racer DLC
Start your journey with a major advantage. Receive 500,000 coins to upgrade your vehicles, unlock premium parts, and accelerate your progress. Build the ultimate setup and stay ahead of the competition.

3. Drift Master Simulator 2024: Unlock4 Cars Pack
Expand your garage with 4 exclusive high-performance cars designed for speed and precision. Customize them with unique upgrades and stand out on every track as you push your drifting skills to the limit.

4. Drift Master Simulator 2024 – 4 Ultimate Cars Pack
Add 4 legendary cars to your collection, each featuring unique drifting capabilities and iconic designs. Choose to unlock the full pack or receive equivalent in-game currency to upgrade your current vehicles and personalize your progression.

More cars. More power. More drift. This is your complete racing experience!

70070000034474.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Premium Edition
70070000034474.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000034474.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #3 with:
- 5 new pool table designs
- 5 new snooker table designs

70070000034479.name: Project Drift Japan Challenge: Drift Master
70070000034479.intro: Drive iconic JDM cars and experience the thrill of total mastery.
70070000034479.description:
Take on the mountain drifting adventure in Japan! Slide through legendary roads, master the art of precision drifting, and prove your skills against local rivals. 

This bundle includes: 
• Project Drift Japan Challenge  – Drift on 5 challenging mountain roads, drive 6 iconic Japanese cars, enjoy addictive drift physics, full controller support, and customizable car colors. 
• Project Drift Japan Challenge: Tokyo Beats – Adds fresh background music to enhance the racing experience and make every drift even more immersive. 

Step into the driver’s seat, dominate every turn, and become a true drift legend!

70070000034481.name: Club Sports Collection Premium Edition
70070000034481.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000034481.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch™
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #3 with:

- 5 brand-new dart designs

70070000034495.name: My little haven Art Lover Collection
70070000034495.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70070000034495.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

This bundle includes the Arts Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70070000034509.name: Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games – Ultimate Racer
70070000034509.intro: Supercars, turbo boosts, and endless street racing thrills.
70070000034509.description:
Step into the world of high-octane street racing, where every drag, drift, and turbo boost tests your skill and courage. Unlock luxurious vehicles, add exclusive parts, and express yourself with vibrant paints and stickers as you rise through the ranks to become a street legend.

This bundle includes:
1. Street Drag Racing Car Driving Simulator 2022 Games
The full base game offers adrenaline-fueled 3D drag and drift racing. Build, upgrade, and tune over 30 luxurious cars, compete in online PvP mode, and master challenging street tracks. Enjoy realistic car sounds, HD visuals, and intense racing missions while earning coins to expand your garage and improve performance.

2. Street Drag Racing: Millionaire’s Boost DLC
Boost your gameplay with 1,000,000 coins to instantly unlock top-tier cars and exclusive upgrades. Upgrade engines, enhance performance, and dominate every race with a wealth advantage. Feel the rush as you push your cars to the limit and prove you are the ultimate street racer.

3. Street Drag Racing: Rise of GELENVAGEN
Unlock the powerful GELENVAGEN supercar, perfect for both street and off-road racing. If you already own it, receive coins equal to its in-game value. Tackle new challenges, upgrade your rides, and take your online multiplayer skills to the next level.

4. Street Drag Racing – Garage Expansion DLC
Add the Lamborghini Huracan to your garage, or claim its full in-game cash value if already owned. Customize and upgrade this iconic supercar, then race it to dominance on the streets. Expand your collection and become the ultimate street racing legend.

The streets are waiting—are you ready to become the ultimate drag racing champion?

70070000034516.name: Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator – Street Legends
70070000034516.intro: Epic skateboarding action, crazy tricks, and endless crew chaos.
70070000034516.description:
Feel the rush, pull off epic tricks, and explore the streets like never before! Customize your boards, perform insane tricks, and shred with a crew full of meme-filled characters. Hit the streets and join the skateboarding adventure!

This bundle includes:
1. Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator – Join Maxwell Cat, Yellow Face, Swole Doge, Capybara, and other meme-filled characters on epic skateboarding adventures. Customize your boards with wild designs and vibrant colors, perform insane tricks, and enjoy the hilarious, meme-tastic fun.
2. Skateboard Drifting with Maxwell Cat: The Game Simulator – New Character – Receive a new character to add to your crew. If you already have this character, you’ll receive the money equivalent to spend on upgrading your skateboards, gear, or other in-game items. This DLC adds fresh content, new challenges, and even more ways to shred the streets in style.

Whether you’re drifting, racing, or performing crazy tricks, this bundle delivers all the action, chaos, and meme-filled excitement.

70070000034521.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Tactical Command
70070000034521.intro: Take control of every operation and prove your tactical mastery.
70070000034521.description:
Enter a world where every second counts and every decision can determine the fate of innocent lives. This bundle brings together the full tactical experience of elite SWAT operations, combining intense first-person combat, strategic planning, and powerful upgrades designed to give you the advantage in the most dangerous situations.

Bundle Includes:
1. Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions (Full Game)
Step into the role of an elite operative and lead your team through intense hostage rescue missions. Use strategy, coordination, and skill to overcome enemies, manage your squad, and complete objectives in dynamic, high-pressure scenarios.

2. Unleash the New Rifle (DLC)
Upgrade your arsenal with a powerful automatic rifle built for precision, stability, and rapid engagement. Gain the upper hand in combat and respond faster to emerging threats. If already owned, its value is converted into in-game currency.

3. Combat Gloves (DLC)
Enhance your presence on the battlefield with exclusive tactical gloves that reflect your professionalism and elite status. If already owned, receive in-game currency to boost your progress and unlock new upgrades.

Prepare for high-stakes missions, equip yourself with the right tools, and prove your tactical mastery in every operation. When the pressure rises, true leaders step forward — and victory follows.

70070000034527.name: Double Mystery - Escape Room Bundle
70070000034527.intro:
This bundle includes the following escape rooms:
- The Lab - Escape Room
- The Island - Escape Room
70070000034527.description:
THE LAB - ESCAPE ROOM
Walk through a futuristic complex while solving puzzles and discover how you got there. What are these mysterious creatures? Why everything looks abandoned?

THE ISLAND - ESCAPE ROOM
You wake up on an unknown island, alone and without help. Will you be able to solve the mysteries it contains? Will you find out how you got there?

Could you escape from this escape rooms?

70070000034528.name: Gothic Classic Khorinis Saga
70070000034528.description:
Deadly foes yet to be conquered. Untold riches yet to be unearthed. Unbreakable bonds yet to be formed. 100+ hours of fantasy RPG greatness await you on the journey of the Nameless Hero. Discover Khorinis and its mine colony in this masterpiece bundle of Gothic Classic and Gothic II Complete Classic.

Gothic Classic:
War has been waged across the kingdom of Myrtana. Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed ore.

The whole area, dubbed "the Colony", is surrounded by a magical barrier, a sphere two kilometers diameter, sealing off the penal colony from the outside world. The barrier can be passed from the outside in – but once inside, nobody can escape. The barrier was a double-edged sword - soon the prisoners took the opportunity and started a revolt. The Colony became divided into three rivaling factions and the king was forced to negotiate for his ore, not just demand it.

Gothic II Complete Classic:
Continue the story of the Nameless Hero in Gothic II Complete Classic, the award-winning sequel that improved on its predecessor in every way. Experience it now for the first time on Nintendo Switch.
Gothic II Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the add-on Night of the Raven to your fingertips for the first time on a console.

You have torn down the magical barrier and released the prisoners of the Mine Valley. Now the former criminals of the forests and mountains are causing trouble around the capital of Khorinis. The town militia is powerless due to their low amount of force–outside of the town, everyone is helpless against the attacks of the bandits.

70070000034530.name: Legendary Spell(Deluxe Edition)
70070000034530.intro: This edition includes the base game Legendary Spell and a DLC featuring a brand-new game mode: Spell Panic.
70070000034530.description:
Base Game:
This is a deck-building roguelike game. Combine and upgrade over 100 carefully designed spells to forge the ultimate magical power.

More than 50 unique enemies appear across a wide variety of stages. Choose your own battle strategy and cast powerful spells at just the right moment to fend off endless waves of foes!

Encounter unexpected events, decide between risky or safer paths, face different enemies, pick different cards, and discover powerful relics!


DLC：
Enemies will swarm in massive numbers, and you’ll need to keep choosing new spells to build the ultimate magical setup. In fast-paced battles, find the spell strategy that keeps you alive!

70070000034537.name: Buggy Off-Road Power Edition
70070000034537.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000034537.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #1, Custom Cruisers #4 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-3 new skins for each Buggy

70070000034543.name: West Escape: Gold Edition
70070000034543.intro: Outrun the law, blast aliens, and fight for love in the wildest ride through the Wild West!
70070000034543.description:
West Escape throws you into a chaotic frontier where the law is on your tail and alien invaders are wreaking havoc. As a fugitive desperate to reunite with your lost love, you'll need to collect scrap, upgrade your gear, and face off against relentless extraterrestrial threats.

This bundle includes:
• West Escape
• West Escape: Rancher DLC
• West Escape: Hustler DLC

Features:
- Premium Equipment: Silver watch for -25% crafting time and Silver nail for X2 tool dmg!
- Rare Gear and more: Obtain rare and uncommon equipment to boost your power level!
- Bonus currency: Get 1000 gems and spend them to progress even faster!
- High-Energy Combat: Dodge enemy attacks and blast aliens with powerful weapons like revolvers and shotguns.
- Gear Upgrades: Collect scrap and loot to upgrade weapons and gear, boosting stats like speed and damage.
- Explosive Expeditions: Venture into dangerous areas to uncover new gear, resources, and challenges.
- Wild West Meets Sci-Fi: Experience a unique fusion of classic Western adventure and alien invasion chaos.
- Fast-Paced Progression: Keep moving forward with nonstop action, upgrades, and intense encounters.

Fast-paced combat keeps you on your toes - dodge deadly attacks and strike back with revolvers, shotguns, and more. Every battle and upgrade brings you one step closer to freedom and the ultimate showdown in this explosive mix of Wild West grit and sci-fi action.

Saddle up, lock and load - freedom and love are waiting on the other side of this alien-infested frontier!

70070000034589.name: Prison Life Simulator Jail – Gangster Escape
70070000034589.intro: Survive the darkness, outwit the guards, and claim your freedom.
70070000034589.description:
Step into the harsh realities of prison life with the ultimate bundle that combines the full game with the atmospheric DLC. Experience life behind bars like never before, where every decision, every shadow, and every move can determine your fate.

Bundle Includes:
1. Prison Life Simulator Jail - Gangster Escape Games Scary Architect Battle
Immerse yourself in a realistic first-person simulation of prison life. Maintain order, complete tasks, interact with other inmates, and accumulate resources to plan your daring escape. Navigate the strict routines of the prison while testing your cunning, strategy, and social skills.

2. Prison Life Simulator Jail – Dark Horizons
Take your experience further as ominous clouds fill the sky, changing the atmosphere and adding new challenges. Move carefully across the yard, use shadows to avoid guards, and discover hidden opportunities.

Can you survive the gloom, outsmart the guards, and finally secure your freedom?

70070000034592.name: Birushana: Winds of Fate Deluxe Edition
70070000034592.intro: A new wind, carrying a future yet unknown...
70070000034592.description:
For those wanting even more Birushana, grab the Birushana: Winds of Fate Deluxe Edition! This bundle includes the digital game, plus a twenty-nine page digital art book featuring nine short stories!
 
The Deluxe Edition includes:
・Digital Standard Edition
・Digital Art Book & Short Stories (29 Pages)

70070000034593.name: Sports Challenge: 50+ Games Edition
70070000034593.intro: Access 50 party games and compete with your friends and family in local co-op.
70070000034593.description:
Enjoy this party game bundle packed with dozens of sports game and unexpected activities to play solo or with friends and family.

This bundle includes:
- Sports Camp: A 35-Game Adventure
- Instant Sports
- Instant Sports Winter Games
- Instant Sports Summer Games

70070000034603.name: Anime Warriors Premium Edition
70070000034603.description:
Welcome to the intense world to experience the ultimate combat adventure. Facing elite foes and confronting, every battle tests your skill and agility.

This bundle includes the main title and two DLCs, giving you everything you need to dominate the arena:

- Combat Funds: Gain an instant in-game currency boost to unlock new characters. Spend less time grinding and more time mastering combos.
- Unlock Fighters: Expand your roster with two powerful characters. Master their techniques, adapt your tactics, and push your combat skills to the limit as every battle becomes more intense and strategic.

Prepare your fighters, refine your combat, and dominate the battlefield like never before.

70070000034613.name: Supermarket Anime Deluxe Edition
70070000034613.description:
Step into the full adorable world and become the ultimate kawaii supermarket manager! 
Manage shelves, serve delightful customers, and keep your store stocked with cute products. Unlock upgrades and expand your kawaii empire while enjoying fun and wholesome management gameplay.

This bundle includes the main title and two DLCs, giving you everything you need to grow your charming store:

- A brand-new song to your supermarket, bringing a cozy and cheerful mood to every workday and making your store even more delightful.
- Extra in-game currency to upgrade faster, unlock new products, and enhance your kawaii empire with less waiting and more fun.

Enjoy the complete kawaii experience, from adorable daily routines to fresh sounds and extra cash — everything you need to make your supermarket the cutest spot in town!

70070000034620.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build – Predator Waters
70070000034620.intro: Build, expand, and survive against relentless predators.
70070000034620.description:
Step into a relentless swamp survival experience where every resource matters and every decision can mean life or death. This ultimate edition expands your journey with enhanced tools and powerful weapon designs, giving you everything you need to endure the wild waters and thrive against nature’s fiercest threats.

This bundle includes:
1. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
Build, expand, and survive on a floating raft in a dangerous swamp filled with hidden resources and deadly crocodiles. Craft tools, purify water, cook food, and turn your fragile platform into a secure sanctuary.

2. Survival Float Simulator: Fishing & Crafting Tools Update
 Improve your efficiency with upgraded fishing and crafting tools, including enhanced hooks and a better fishing rod, allowing for faster resource gathering and deeper exploration.

3. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Legendary Arms
Equip redesigned weapons with unique visuals and stronger presence, giving you an edge in combat and a more immersive survival experience.

Adapt to the environment, outsmart predators, and prove that you have what it takes to survive in one of the most unforgiving landscapes.

70070000034625.name: Orwell Bundle
70070000034625.description:
Get the complete Orwell experience with Season One, the award-winning surveillance thriller Orwell: Keeping an Eye on You, and the darker Season Two, Orwell: Ignorance Is Strength.

In Season One, Big Brother has arrived--and it’s you. Investigate the lives of citizens to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks. Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences.

In Season Two, take on the role of a government official in a top-secret department of the Orwell surveillance program during a time of political tension and violent civil unrest. Given the power to both uncover and fabricate "the truth", how far will you go in the service of your country?

70070000034636.name: Splash of Color: Complete Edition
70070000034636.intro: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!
70070000034636.description:
Piece together bright, colorful images by swapping tiles and solving lively puzzles. Watch patterns shift, colors click into place, and pictures slowly reveal themselves as you play. Jump in, make a few swaps, and watch the colors come together.

Features:
- 192 puzzles big and small for you to solve
- Simple and satisfying swap puzzle mechanics.
- A lively and colorful aesthetic!

Watch the colors fall into place!

70070000034637.name: Urban Flow Comprehensive Edition
70070000034637.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000034637.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, London Rules and Streets Supplement#3 with:

•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    30 new stages!
•    5 new vehicles

70070000034641.name: Musical Vibes RX: Total Vibes Vol. 4
70070000034641.intro: Get ready to move with Musical Vibes RX, a new dance game you can play using Joy-Con™ controllers or your smartphone camera connected to your Nintendo Switch™ console!
70070000034641.description:
Musical Vibes RX: Total Vibes Vol. 4 includes the base game Musical Vibes RX and 6 additional songs, all previously released and now offered together at a lower price than if purchased separately.

Musical Vibes RX is the new version of Musical Vibes, the first-ever dance game to let players use the camera of their smartphone connected to a console. Originally released in June 2023, the original broke new ground, and now RX takes the experience even further!

Dance Hands-Free with Incredible Moves!
Groove to fantastic music and master exciting new dance moves with full-body tracking powered by advanced AI technology. Put the controller down, your smartphone camera does the tracking. Just follow the beat!

Track Your Progress
Stay motivated with the built-in calorie counter that provides an estimated calorie burn during your game session.

Included Songs (11)

"Club Reverie" by Naya Luz Feat. J-Rhyme – R&B  

"Magnetic Pulse" by Vénna feat. Jinseo — K-Pop

"Pretty Boy" by Clara Solane — R&B

"Platinum Dreams" by NARAE SOLIS — K-Pop

"Champion Sound (Remix)" by SIZZLA feat. TURBULENCE — Dancehall

"Noche de Brillo" by LINA RIKO — Reggaeton

"Embrace Your Light" by NINA RAY — Pop

"Party" by FIVEEBEATZ — Amapiano

"Victory Lap" by Cipher Blaze feat Lila Brooks — Hip Hop

"Queen Of The Night" by Elara Mae - K-Pop

"Lost and Found" by Lyra Rin - K-Pop

More tracks are planned for future updates! 

Multiplayer Fun
• Up to 4 players can join the fun with Joy-Con™ controllers.
• Up to 2 players can dance together using smartphone camera tracking.

Customize Your Experience
Personalize your avatar with fun outfits and choose from a variety of vibrant venues to match your style and mood!

Enhance Your Dance Floor
Own a Philips Hue smart lighting system? Connect it to transform your space into a dazzling concert venue with lights that react to the music!

More Than Dance
Feeling less energetic? Switch to Rhythm Game Mode, where you can press the correct direction on your controller in time with the beat—perfect for playing on the go!

Exciting Updates to Come!
Stay tuned for more tracks and features coming soon.

70070000034646.name: Cooking Arena Super Edition
70070000034646.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000034646.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Food Truck Tycoon Asian Cuisine" and "Pancake Bar Tycoon".

70070000034648.name: Knights & Guns Core Edition
70070000034648.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000034648.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Armor Pack #3 and Armor Pack #4 with:
- 4 new armors to help you on your quest

70070000034668.name: Hunter Simulator : Wild Hunting – Premium Hunting
70070000034668.intro: Survive the wild, upgrade your gear, and hunt like a pro.
70070000034668.description:
Step into the wilderness fully prepared with this complete hunting experience bundle. Explore vast open landscapes, track elusive animals, and master the art of the hunt while equipped with exclusive content designed to enhance both your performance and style.

This bundle includes:
1. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting (Base Game)
Dive into a realistic hunting simulation set in breathtaking environments. Explore forests, mountains, and open plains filled with dynamic wildlife. Use a wide range of customizable weapons and gear while adapting to changing weather and intelligent animal behavior.

2. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Weapon Upgrade (DLC)
Enhance your firepower with the Regmintona 070, a powerful shotgun built for close-range hunting. Designed for precision and stopping power, it’s perfect for tracking fast prey or facing dangerous predators. Already own it? Receive its full in-game value instead.

3. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Tactical Gloves (DLC)
Upgrade your look and performance with an exclusive gloves skin. Add a unique touch to your hunter’s gear while improving your overall experience. Already unlocked? Get the equivalent coin value to spend as you wish.

Prepare your gear, sharpen your instincts, and dominate the wilderness. With enhanced equipment and endless landscapes to explore, the hunt has never been more intense.

70070000034677.name: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Expanded Parking
70070000034677.intro: Build your empire, grow your influence, and master every decision.
70070000034677.description:
Take your parking empire to the next level with the bundle that combines the full game with a visually stunning expansion. Experience the thrill of managing your lots while enjoying an enhanced atmosphere that brings depth, strategy, and cinematic detail to every corner.

Bundle Includes:
1. Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator
Step into the driver’s seat and become the ultimate Parking Lot Tycoon. Build and manage parking lots to maximize revenue, upgrade facilities, and expand your empire. Make strategic decisions, balance customer satisfaction with pricing, and uncover the intriguing story behind the land you own.

2. Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator – Foggy Streets
Enhance your experience with volumetric and realistic fog that transforms your parking lots. The fog adds depth, atmosphere, and cinematic flair, affecting visibility, customer behavior, and traffic flow.

Build smarter, manage better, and see your parking empire come to life under the veil of fog.

70070000034680.name: Chained Climb Together: Climb to Survive
70070000034680.intro: Rise through perilous terrain and prove your skill on every peak.
70070000034680.description:
Step into a thrilling vertical journey where precision, strategy, and skill are the keys to survival. Climb towering mountains, overcome dangerous obstacles, and master every move as you push toward the summit. Every step matters when the path is unforgiving.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Chained Climb Together
 Embark on an epic climbing adventure where mystical chains guide your ascent. Scale massive vertical landscapes filled with hazards, tight paths, and intense challenges.

2. Chained Climb Together: Skybound Environment (DLC)
 Transform your journey with a breathtaking new skybox that redefines the atmosphere of the game. This DLC introduces stunning visuals and dynamic skies, immersing you in a more vibrant and challenging climbing experience.

3. Chained Climb Together – Player Reskin (DLC)
 Stand out on your climb with a fresh new look. This DLC adds a unique player reskin, allowing you to customize your appearance as you tackle the mountains.

The higher you go, the harder it gets. Will you reach the top… or fall trying?

70070000034682.name: Tank vs Tank GOTY Edition
70070000034682.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000034682.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint, War Paint #2, War Paint #3 and War Paint #4 with:

-16 unique tank skins and 16 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000034696.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Premium Edition
70070000034696.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000034696.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle and Pizza Bar Tycoon Multiplayer Mode with:

- This DLC for Pizza Bar Tycoon  features an exciting local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family. 

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000034701.name: Build A Queen: Prince Edition
70070000034701.intro: Showcase your looks on the catwalk and compete in thrilling fashion battles!
70070000034701.description:
Step into the world of glamour and style with Build A Queen! The ultimate fashion game where you can become a doll maker and create your dream queen!

Become a virtual fashion designer and let your creativity shine! Choose your model and dive into a project makeover. Design everything: from stunning hairstyles and flawless makeup to the hottest outfits and fabulous accessories! This is your chance to build a sweet doll with your unique style.

Features:
- Build YOUR Queen: shape your characters body with stunning or monstrous makeover choices!
- Dress to impress: customize hairstyles, makeup, outfits, and accessories.
- Get a boyfriend: outstyle your rival and win his heart!
- Walk the runway: showcase your look in fashion battles and catwalk challenges.
- New victory dance: Celebrate your win with Snake Moves!
- 2 boyfriend skins: Turn your boyfriend into a Prince or a Charming King!

Will you make the right choices to win and become the ultimate Fashion Queen?

70070000034704.name: Run Sausage Run!: Country Edition
70070000034704.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000034704.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 3 new skins (Angler, Country Girl and Hunter)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000034709.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator - 4x4 Racing Games Driving, Parking, Battle, Tuning 2022 SIM Kart: Offroad Missions
70070000034709.intro: Take control of your fleet and dominate every offroad challenge.
70070000034709.description:
Experience the full thrill with this bundle, combining the game with an exclusive DLC that adds a powerful new vehicle to your fleet. Traverse muddy forests, sandy careers, and snowy mountains while completing challenging deliveries, transporting workers, and exploring every corner of the map.

Bundle Includes:
1. Mudness Offroad Car Simulator (Full Game) – Experience a next-gen AAA offroad multiplayer simulator featuring three diverse biomes, six bases for deliveries, a winch system to rescue stuck vehicles, multiplayer fun, and detailed vehicle tuning including suspension, body, wheels, and engine. Complete demanding delivery missions, take on rewarding side quests, and explore the wilderness in your customized vehicles.

2. Mudness Offroad Car Simulator: Fleet Expansion (DLC) – Receive the “Pajero”, designed to handle all terrains with ease. Make deliveries faster, safer, and more exciting while tackling muddy forests, sandy careers, and snowy mountains. Already own the vehicle? Its full in-game value will be credited to your account, letting you spend it however you like.

Get behind the wheel, tackle every terrain, and turn every delivery into an offroad adventure.

70070000034717.name: Two Strikes - Ultimate Edition
70070000034717.description:
Experience the electrifying rush of life-or-death duels in a heartbeat!

Dive into Two Strikes, a casual 2D fighting saga adorned with mesmerizing hand-drawn animations, whisking you away to a fierce epoch in Japan, where every stroke of the blade could spell doom or glory.

Position yourself wisely; every move could be your last.

Dart around to close in or evade assaults, seizing the opportunity when foes are within your weapon's grasp!

Striking decisively is your path to triumph, yet tread carefully as predictable moves are easily thwarted.

Outwit adversaries by masking your intentions, feigning attacks with nimble dashes.

And when victory is within sight, unleash devastating strikes to claim your honor!

This Bundle includes playable characters Baki Hanma, from the hit anime Baki Hanma, Mushashi Miyamoto from the hit anime Baki-Dou and Shinigami.

All characters are fully playable across all online and offline game modes.

70070000034728.name: Parkour Simulator 2026 – Rooftop Hero
70070000034728.publisher: Lu Ming trading as Shane Game
70070000034728.intro: Dominate rooftops, alleyways, and every obstacle in your path!
70070000034728.description:
Hit the streets fully equipped! Take on rooftops, alleys, and urban obstacles with style and confidence. Get the ultimate freerunning experience with the full game plus exclusive gear to kick off your journey in the city.

This bundle includes:
1. Parkour Simulator 2026 (Full Game) – Master jumps, flips, wall-runs, and vaults across rooftops, alleys, and urban obstacles. Explore the city freely or tackle challenging timed courses while upgrading your skills and unlocking new abilities.
2. Parkour Simulator 2026 – Street Style (DLC) – Receive an exclusive hoodie to show off your urban style while freerunning. If you already own the hoodie, you’ll automatically get 1,000 in-game credits instead, so you never miss a reward.

Jump, flip, and run with style—this bundle equips you with everything you need to dominate the city and become the ultimate freerunning legend.

70070000034733.name: Cooking Arena Value Edition
70070000034733.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000034733.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Food Truck Tycoon Asian Cuisine" and "Breakfast Bar Tycoon".

70070000034738.name: Magic Cats Pots Special Edition
70070000034738.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This game includes the DLC Spring and Frame Pack.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!

Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000034739.name: Moto Rush GT Core Edition
70070000034739.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000034739.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Grip Collection #3 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 8 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000034741.name: Pocket Nook Enchanted Paws Edition
70070000034741.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000034741.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

This game includes the DLC Cat&Dog and Fantasy.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
