- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000034742.name: Evo Pop: Sweet Edition
70070000034742.intro: Fill the world with Evos! Use the Bee Evo to swarm your enemies!
70070000034742.description:
Take control of Evos - colorful creatures that live in colonies and grow at lightning speed! Bigger Evos devour smaller ones of different breeds. Dominate the battlefield by filling the screen with Evos or eating all your rivals!

Features:
- the Bee Evo!
- 1000 Coins to upgrade your Evos
- 400 Gems to buy chests
- MULTIPLE ENEMIES: A three-way brawl for you to come on top of!
- PHYSICS-BASED GAMEPLAY: Control the creatures by using different spells on them.
- UPGRADE & EVOLVE: Each Evo breed has unique skills, such as jumping or sliding downhill. These properties can be upgraded to make your Evos even stronger.
- PLAN A STRATEGY: Evos interact with the environment and eat grass, flowers and bugs to multiply faster. Fight for strategic resources on the map to win!
- DOZENS OF WORLDS: Evo Pop features multiple worlds with unique design elements and physics, making the gameplay fresh every time.

Get ready to POP OFF and have FUN!

70070000034748.name: Bowling Fever Grand Edition
70070000034748.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000034748.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #5 with:

-30 new bowling ball styles

70070000034754.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Upgrade Edition
70070000034754.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000034754.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #4 with:

This pack introduces three stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000034756.name: Cozy Tiny Home Cat Collection 1
70070000034756.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000034756.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes Cat Pack 1 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000034759.name: Pets and Friends Easter Bundle
70070000034759.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of easter stickers.
70070000034759.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of easter-themed stickers to add variety to your album.

70070000034761.name: Paper io 2: Gold Edition
70070000034761.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000034761.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- 44 skins which also change the look of your terrain
- 12 new funny hats to wear
- custom game with 63 various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000034765.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator: Speed Challenge
70070000034765.intro: Feel the rush, master the streets, and leave your rivals in the dust.
70070000034765.description:
Strap yourself in for the racing experience! This bundle combines the full Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator game with exciting DLCs that enhance your garage, style, and speed. Navigate bustling city traffic, master high-speed racing, and prove yourself as the ultimate street legend.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator
Experience the thrill of racing through dynamic city streets with a variety of cars, from sleek cruisers to high-octane supercars. Test your precision, reflexes, and control as you weave through traffic and push every car to its limit.

2. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator - New Car in Garage
Boost your garage instantly with the Quantum Thunder Racer, a cutting-edge car built for speed and style. If you already own this vehicle, you’ll receive its in-game cash equivalent to customize your garage further.

3. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Drive in Color
Add flair to your rides with three new vibrant paint jobs: bold blue, striking pink, and sleek turquoise. Stand out on the streets and show off your style while maneuvering through traffic or racing for leaderboard glory.

Prepare to push your limits, race with precision, and leave your competition in the dust!

70070000034766.name: Spy Guy Memory Countries Edition
70070000034766.description: A classic memory game with a fun twist! Try your hand at it and keep your eyes peeled! How good is your memory? Test yourself in our game!

70070000034767.name: Ball Blast: Platinum Edition
70070000034767.intro: Dodge falling rocks and blast them all!
70070000034767.description:
A wild rain of bouncing rocks crashes down - move fast, blast faster!

This bundle includes:
- Ball Blast
- Ball Blast: Wilds DLC
- Ball Blast: Dreamland DLC

Features:
• 6 New Maps: Blast your way through Desert, Runic, Frozen, Haunted Castle, Candy Land and Vaporwave map!
• CO-OP: Team up with a friend and fend off the falling rocks together!
• Online Leaderboards: Survive as long as you can and get the best score in the world!
• Powerful Cannons: Choose between basic, shotgun, boomerang, and saw cannons!
• Devastating powers: Buy and upgrade powerful abilities to destroy everything!
• Special Levels: Defeat epic bosses and protect the bridge from destruction!
• 15 Boomerang Shards
• 10 Shock Wave Shards
• 10 Laser Shards
• 6 Extra Cannon Boosters
• 15 Shotgun Shards
• 10 Turret Shards
• 10 Plasma Cannon Shards
• 10 Shield Boosters
• 5000 gems: Spend extra gems on crates, fresh shards, and more power-ups!
• Replayability: Complete hundreds of unique levels and challenges!

Every rock has a number - hit it that many times and boom! it splits into two rocks with half the number and double the speed, turning the field into fast-moving chaos!

Play solo or with a friend for double firepower. Beat hundreds of levels, survive endless waves, and climb the world leaderboard!

Pick up coins and unlock new cannons: a wide-spread shotgun, a boomerang that swings back and spinning saw blades that slice through rocks as they fall. Upgrade power-ups like a piercing laser beam, explosive drones, and huge shockwaves to wipe out waves in a flash!

The rocks won’t stop bouncing - are you ready to keep blasting?

70070000034770.name: Fight For America: Hot Edition
70070000034770.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000034770.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- New weapons: unleash fiery destruction with the Flamethrower and Grenade Launcher!
- Extra coins: Boost your campaign with 2500 coins to upgrade your weapons, turrets, and base
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000034791.name: Let's Sing 2026 with International Hits
70070000034791.intro: Standard Edition: The Let’s Sing 2026 Standard edition includes 35 songs and a one month free trial of VIP Pass.
70070000034791.description:
The global karaoke party returns with Let’s Sing 2026, your ultimate ticket to fun-filled nights and unforgettable performances.

Whether you're warming up your vocal cords solo, teaming up in duets, or competing with friends, Let’s Sing 2026 delivers an unbeatable playlist, and endless entertainment!

Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.

- Billie Eilish – BIRDS OF A FEATHER
- Chappell Roan – HOT TO GO !
- Gracie Abrams – I Love You, I'm Sorry
- Selena Gomez – Single Soon
- Lizzo – 2 Be Loved (Am I ready)
- Shaboozey – Good News
- Ed Sheeran feat Lil Baby – 2step
...And many more!

Key Features:
* Sing along to official music videos for an authentic experience
* 4 exciting game modes for solo players and groups
* Up to 4-player support – perfect for parties and family gatherings
* Use your smartphone as a mic with the free companion app
* 1-month FREE VIP Pass included – unlock 180+ additional songs
* Whether you're a first-time performer or a karaoke king or queen, Let’s Sing 2026 invites you to step into the spotlight.

Get ready to take the stage!

70070000034792.intro: Gold Edition: The Let's Sing 2026 Gold edition includes 35 songs, as well as a one month free trial + 3 months of VIP Pass.

70070000034803.name: Football Legends 2025 Gold Edition
70070000034803.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70070000034803.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

This bundle includes base game, Team Pack #1 and Team Pack #2 with:
- 6 new teams

70070000034805.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Moon Edition
70070000034805.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000034807.name: Ecchi Memories: Double Trouble Edition
70070000034807.intro: Let the bras hit the floor!
70070000034807.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 9 beautiful girls with impressive proportions (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000034811.name: Pixel Cafe Elite Edition
70070000034811.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000034811.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipment, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game, Living Room Touches, Kitchen Touches and Bedroom Touches #2 with:

A new variant for the Armchair
A different look for the Computer
An alternative design for the Wardrobe
A modest update for the Bookshelf
A different variant for the Refrigerator
An updated Oven and Stove design
A new look for the Sink
An alternative style for the Bar
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
Also, mix things up with 6 new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000034813.name: Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Diamond Edition
70070000034813.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000034813.description:
Love cooking games? Manage 9 distinct kitchens, craft over 500 dishes, and rise to culinary stardom across 1000+ fast-paced levels in Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire. Customize your home, unlock trophies, and bring the heat!

From street food to sushi, each kitchen will test your time-management skills as you work to satisfy impatient customers and hit your goals. But it’s not all about the kitchens—customize and upgrade your home to showcase your achievements, unlock trophies, and build a true empire!

Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Can you handle the heat and build your own cooking empire?

Key Features:

9 Unique Cuisines: Master a range of cooking styles and menus.
500+ Dishes: A global selection of recipes to perfect.
1000+ Levels: Challenge yourself with increasingly complex kitchens.
Home Customization: Upgrade your furniture and earn trophies to showcase your progress.
Fun & Fast-Paced: Simple to play, with endless hours of culinary excitement!

This bundle contains base game, DLC#2- Cozy Living and DLC#3- Creative Desk with:

- stylish sofas, chairs, and accessories that will give your living room a unique atmosphere.
- an elegant desk, a comfortable chair, and other accessories that let you create your dream office!

70070000034820.name: Mini Market Design Blockbuster Blueprint
70070000034820.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000034820.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes Cinema DLC.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000034827.name: Freaky Trip Athletic Adventures
70070000034827.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000034827.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

This bundle includes Sports Pack DLC.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000034843.name: Little Strays 2: Souls of First Light
70070000034843.intro: When all seems lost, a lone cat appears on the horizon, bringing hope.
70070000034843.description:
Step into the paws of a brave stray cat and fight to bring hope back. Rescue lost kittens, search for food, and help other strays survive. Explore ruined neighborhoods, deserted warehouses, shopping malls, and canals.

In this adventure, cooperation is key. Team up with a friend in full two-player co-op, explore together, and help each other survive. Every kitten you rescue brings the city one step closer to life.

This bundle includes the base game and the Music DLC, adding new atmospheric tracks that refresh familiar locations and deepen the emotional tone of every rooftop run, quiet alleyway, and hidden passage.

Features:
• Play solo or team up in a full two-player co-op experience.
• Seven story-driven levels with unique quests.
• Explore a ruined city filled with dangers, from swarming insects to patrolling dogs.
• Rescue lost kittens, gather food, and help fellow strays survive.
• Music DLC with new atmospheric tracks that enrich every location.

70070000034847.name: My Cozy Aquarium: Prehistoric Pack
70070000034847.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000034847.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle include Prehistoric Decoration DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000034848.name: Let's Sing 2025 with International Hits
70070000034848.intro: Standard Edition: The Let’s Sing 2025 Standard edition includes 35 songs and a one month free trial of VIP Pass.
70070000034848.description:
Let's Sing 2025 brings the ultimate karaoke experience straight to your living room! Sing along with your family and friends to the latest hits, as well as a generous selection of all-time classics.
Complete your journey to stardom with a brand-new career mode, or join the VIP ranks to gain access to even more tracks. Perform at home or online with a global cast of singers!

Classic mode
The Classic karaoke experience where you sing solo or with friends up to 4 singers. Compete for the highest score based on your pitch and rhythm.

Feat mode
Team up with another player to sing a duet. You'll need to work together to harmonize and hit the right notes to score big. It's a great way to test your vocal chemistry with a friend!

Complete the new Career mode
The Let's Sing career mode returns with a brand-new single player adventure! Join forces with a cast of unforgettable characters and tackle exhilarating challenges on your journey to stardom.

Customise your character
Create your own unique avatar, with options to customise your appearance as well as your in-game voice and dance moves!

Perform in the Let's Sing Music Awards
Show off your star potential, rise up the leaderboards, and earn exclusive rewards by performing in the seasonal Let's Sing Music Awards!

Mic up with the Companion App
Short of a microphone or two? Your friends and family can simply download the companion app and use their smartphone as a mic. Everyone’s invited to this party!

Get in the VIP Lane
Subscribe to the Let's Sing VIP Pass for 1, 3 or 12 months and enjoy instant access to more than 150 songs with the launch of Let's Sing 2025. The VIP Pass also grants access to exclusive year-round seasonal events!

Join in the Let's Sing Fest
Step up to the Local Stage to enjoy a one player game mode where you'll compete with dozens of singers online in a dynamic leaderboard free-for-all!
Players who own the VIP Pass can take to the Main Stage instead, and enjoy the limelight with other VIPs from all over the world!

Get ready for Showtime
The exciting Let's Sing Showtime event lasts for one hour each week, opening up the Main Stage to every player! Enjoy access to all the songs in the VIP Pass while the event is active, even if you don't have an active subscription.

Standard Edition: The Let’s Sing 2025 Standard edition includes 35 songs and a one month free trial of VIP Pass.

Complete your journey to stardom with a brand-new career mode, or join the VIP ranks to gain access to even more tracks. Perform at home or online with a global cast of singers!

70070000034859.name: Cozy Memory Fuzzy Explorers Pack
70070000034859.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000034859.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes the Covers Pack, Cards Pack 1 and Cards Pack 2
 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000034868.name: Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator – The Deep Deluxe
70070000034868.intro: Dive deeper, explore further, and make your mark beneath the waves.
70070000034868.description:
Dive into the ocean adventure and experience the complete journey from deep-sea hunter to sushi master. Explore mysterious depths by day, hunt fish and strange marine creatures using harpoons and underwater tools, then transform your catch into delicious dishes by night.

This bundle includes:
1. Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator (Base Game)
Explore dangerous biomes, manage your oxygen, and discover rare species hidden deep beneath the surface. Every dive brings new challenges, new rewards, and new mysteries waiting to be uncovered.

2. Diver, Catch & Cook Simulator: Abyss Outfit (DLC)
Personalize your diver with a collection of unique outfits. Stand out beneath the waves and make every dive truly your own with fresh visual styles that bring more identity to your journey.

Balance survival, exploration, and culinary success while looking your best in the deep. The ocean awaits — are you ready to dive in?

70070000034877.name: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Gold Edition
70070000034877.intro: TMNT: Splintered Fate with three DLCs. Brawl through NYC in TMNT: Splintered Fate with all 7 playable heroes and the Junkyard level.
70070000034877.description:
TMNT: Splintered Fate with three DLCs.
Brawl through NYC in TMNT: Splintered Fate with all 7 playable heroes and the Junkyard level.

This bundle includes:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam DLC
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Metalhead Character DLC
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Alopex Character DLC

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

Casey Jones & The Junkyard Jam DLC
The Turtles friend and fellow vigilante Casey Jones is always ready to pick up his hockey stick and do some damage. What’s more, he happens to know a shortcut to the rooftops of NYC! Strangely, their path takes them straight through the Junkyards and Punk Frog turf.

Metalhead Character DLC
Play as the loveable, locked and loaded Metalhead, with a unique gameplay style to complement the Turtles. Fire his blasters, transform into a spinning missile frenzy, and lob landmines to stop enemies in their tracks. Metalhead has an affinity with our new (free!) Robotics Powers.

Alopex Character DLC
Meet Alopex, the mutant arctic fox and ninja assassin. Expertly swinging her sickle-like kama, she slices at her foes with ease. Hurling her kunai at close range, she deals a powerful blast of damage.

70070000034895.name: Cute & Cozy 5-in-1
70070000034895.intro: Introducing: Cute & Cozy for creative cozy games lovers!
70070000034895.description:
Just sit back, relax, grab a cup of your favorite hot beverage, and let yourself get lost in titles that will ease your mind and fill your heart with wholesomeness.

Design your dream houses like there’s no tomorrow with endless possibilities with Cozy Tiny Home, Pocket Nook, and My Cozy Room. Let yourself rediscover wonder and find beauty and magic in the simplest details in Softly Placed. Collect all beautiful stickers and save the galaxy in Pilo and the Holobook. 

Save and don’t worry about looking for a new game to play with the Cute & Cozy bundle!

70070000034896.name: Cozy Life Collection
70070000034896.intro: Do you love travelling, trying new things, and exciting adventures? We've got you!
70070000034896.description:
Explore the sun-drenched, Mediterranean islands and take pictures of all the adorable cats you can find in SnapCat: Mia’s Cozy Adventure. Help your toy friends furnish and decorate the tiny homes of their dreams. Become a Parisian chef and charm everyone with your masterfully crafted meals. Challenge yourself as a restaurant owner, cook the most delicious meals, and try new recipes as you improve your skills. Spend quality time with your children or siblings learning while playing fun mini-games with The Smurfs: Learn and Play.
 
Save and don’t worry about looking for a new game to play with the Cozy Life Collection!

70070000034897.name: Cute & Cozy Farm 5-in-1
70070000034897.intro: The ultimate bundle for cozy farming games fans is here!
70070000034897.description:
Escape the hustle and bustle with this curated collection of heartwarming adventures. Whether you're tossing dough, befriending spirits, or stitching the latest Cottonville fashions, this bundle is your one-way ticket to peak relaxation.
 
What’s inside:
-Cat&Rabbit Pizza Farming – farm fresh ingredients and prepare delicious pizzas for your restaurant guests. Just be careful not to mess the orders!
-Sprout Valley – trade the city lights for the gentle breeze of the Ostara archipelago. Step into the paws of a charming cat and build your dream life from the ground up in this peaceful paradise.
-Ashwood Valley – magic meets restoration. Fix up a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.
-Cottonville – channel your inner designer! Balance the life of a tailor and a farmer as you grow raw materials to craft stunning outfits for a cast of colorful neighbors.
-Little Bug  – step into an adventurous story about a young city girl trapped in a dangerous fantasy world, where evil pink spirits lurk in canyons, ice caves, and moonlit deserts.
 
Save big time and prepare for the endless hours of cozy gaming!

70070000034903.name: The Gardener Simulator - Plant, Grow, Decorate, Build Sim: Garden Paradise
70070000034903.intro: Cultivate, decorate, and transform your garden into a paradise!
70070000034903.description:
Step into a vibrant world where your gardening dreams come to life. Explore diverse plants, design your perfect garden layout, and enjoy realistic growth cycles that bring every seed and bloom to life. Whether you’re a newcomer eager to start your first plot or an experienced gardener looking to enhance your oasis, this bundle provides all the essentials to cultivate, grow, and prosper.

Bundle includes:
• The Gardener Simulator - Plant, Grow, Decorate, Build Sim lets you manage your garden plot, plant a wide variety of flora, balance resources, and design beautiful layouts that make your garden flourish in vivid detail.

• The Gardener Simulator - Plant, Grow, Decorate, Build Sim: Harvest Bonus includes 5,000 coins to unlock new plants, tools, and decorative items, boosting your progress and helping you expand your garden faster.

Start your gardening adventure fully equipped with everything you need to grow, decorate, and transform your garden into a thriving, beautiful paradise.

70070000034910.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Comprehensive Edition
70070000034910.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Elite Arsenal and Expansion Pack #2 with:

• With the Expansion Pack you can fight and survive the zombie apocalypse in a brand new game mode!

Unlock 3 powerful weapons to use them in the DLC and base game to improve your scores.
Play new maps or revisit old ones with new weapons.
Fill your gallery and cabinet with new models and medals.

• Want some more reliable and tested guns for your collection? With this expansion, you'll get: 
-RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design 
-BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west 
-SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle 
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000034911.name: Let's Sing 2024 with International Hits – Platinum Edition
70070000034911.intro: Step into the spotlight. | It's your time to shine!
70070000034911.description:
Let’s Sing 2024 brings a thrilling new karaoke experience to your living room. Enjoy chartbreaking hits and all-time classics that are guaranteed to make you sing at the top of your lungs. Step into the spotlight with the brand new career mode and rise to stardom. Become a VIP and test your vocal range with many more songs online. Experience seasonal events online with Let's Sing Fest and join the never-ending karaoke party alone or with friends while you play with people across the globe. 

Perform some of your favorite current hits as well as all-time classics from the new song selection featuring 35 exciting and popular tracks.

Sing your heart out to hits like "When You're Gone" by Shawn Mendes, “Dynamite” by BTS, „Million Dollar Baby“ by Ava Max or „abc (nicer)” by GAYLE. 

Or how about some record breaking tracks like "About Damn Time" by Lizzo, "Made You Look (Again)" by Meghan Trainor or "Wrecking Ball" by Miley Cyrus? The choice is yours!

Game modes: Career, Classic, Feat., Let's Sing Fest

Career Mode: Live the dream of becoming a superstar in this brand new singleplayer narrative adventure. Join forces with unforgettable characters and tackle exhilarating challenges on your way to stardom.

Avatar customization: Create your own unique online personality with this extensive toolbox. From the way you look all the way through to how your avatar moves, we’ve got you covered. 

Let's Sing Fest: The ultimate challenge for all solo artists. This single player game mode lets players compete with dozens of singers online in a free-for-all. It includes a dynamic leaderboard and provides additional feedback on other performers. Join the room and try to rank first in a never-ending flow of songs. 

VIP Pass: The Let's Sing VIP Pass is an online subscription service that gives you access to an extensive online library of songs and year-round seasonal events for the duration of your subscription. The Let's Sing 2024 Platinum edition includes one month free trial + 12 months of VIP Pass Subscription.

No mic at hand? No problem! The official Let's Sing companion app turns your smartphone into a microphone, lets you change your looks, set up a party and much more!

70070000034921.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Value Edition
70070000034921.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000034921.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #4 with:

-2 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000034923.name: Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG: Secrets & Survival
70070000034923.intro: Dive deeper, explore further, and uncover mysteries that shape your journey.
70070000034923.description:
Discover a richer aquatic journey with the full game and its exciting expansion. Explore vibrant oceans, stunning coral reefs, and winding rivers as you evolve from a small fish into a powerful and majestic creature.

This bundle includes:
	•	Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG 
Embark on an epic journey, build your community, race for glory, and master survival in a captivating underwater world.

	•	Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG: River Mysteries
Discover new areas, interact with unique objects, and uncover hidden secrets for a richer and more immersive experience.

Experience new challenges, explore stunning environments, and enjoy the full depth of life beneath the waves. Are you ready to dive in? Your underwater adventure awaits!

70070000034926.name: Brain Boost Buddies Rapid Reaction Rumble
70070000034926.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70070000034926.description:
In Brain Boost Buddies, kids can flip and match cute animal cards - from smiling puppies to fluffy bunnies - while training their memory and concentration skills.


Parents will love it too! The game helps develop focus, logic, and patience in a calm, positive way. Plus, players can easily choose the right difficulty level to make the challenge just right for every age.

This bundle includes Card Pack 2 DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Adorable animal cards that make learning fun
- Different difficulty levels for all ages
- Improves memory, focus, and attention skills
- Bright, colorful visuals designed for kids
- Relaxing and cheerful background music
- Perfect for family playtime and early learning

70070000034927.name: Cat & Friends Memory Paw Prints
70070000034927.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70070000034927.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.

This bundle includes Back Cards and Cards Pack 1 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70070000034928.name: SnapCat Cozy Ultimate Edition
70070000034928.intro: SnapCat is a cozy exploration game about finding cats and capturing quiet moments across peaceful islands.
70070000034928.description:
Pack your things, we're going on a trip! We're going to visit breathtaking islands and make the most of the summer sun. But remember - the core item in your luggage is your camera!
Aside from admiring the architecture and colorful flora, we have one crucial mission - documenting the furry inhabitants of the islands. Can you find and photograph all of them? 
Grab your camera and get ready for the cat-tastrophe of cuteness! 
No timers, no battles, no pressure—just pure, pawsitive vibes. 

Wander across bright, bubbly islands that feel like an endless summer vacation—but keep your eyes peeled! These fuzzy superstars love to hide, lounge, stretch, and strike suspiciously perfect poses. Aside from taking pictures, you can fill their cute little water bowls to keep them happy, and, most importantly, don't forget to pet them! 

Every photo you take lands in your super-colorful Cat-alog Album, where you can admire your masterpieces, name your new feline friends, and relive every whisker-wiggling moment.

Snap Cat:
Bright colors. Big personalities.
Cats who act like they’re the stars of their own cartoon show.
(And honestly… they kinda are.)

This bundle includes Cozy Night Pack and Cozy Sunset Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- cozy, stress-free gameplay and feel-good atmosphere
- relaxing music, perfect for unwinding after a long day
- photo album with all your pictures and the option to name the cats

70070000034931.name: Pool Fever Superior Edition
70070000034931.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000034931.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #3 with:

- 10 new pool table designs

70070000034935.name: Snooker Fever Discovery Edition
70070000034935.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000034935.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #3 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

- 10 stunning new table designs
- 5 sleek cue styles

70070000034939.name: Wander Scoop Strawberry Spring
70070000034939.intro: Welcome to the most charming, cozy ice cream parlor in town!
70070000034939.description:
The Secret Ingredient: Empathy
The true delight of Wander Scoop lies in the heartwarming cutscenes and dialogues. Every quirky character who slides onto a stool carries a personal puzzle and different ice cream flavors, and the process of making them serves as a metaphor for life’s challenges and joys. 

Level Up Your Cozy Kingdom
Fortunately, guiding souls and making people happy can also be profitable! As you ace those metaphorical mix-ups and sell your legendary treats, you'll earn money and gain the experience needed to upgrade your arsenal of ingredients and equipment, as well as decorate your parlor.

A Feast for the Eyes and Soul
Sink into a world rendered in a beautiful, colorful, and inviting pastel art style. Everything is soft, rounded, and comforting. Every detail, from the gentle texture of the whipped cream to the subtle shimmer of the ice crystals, is designed to give you a warm hug in game form.

Come on in. The scoop is waiting to be wielded.

This bundle includes the Spring DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 10 unique, flavorful customers to meet and learn their stories
- Tons of delicious new ingredients, equipment, and decor items to be unlocked
- Delightful pastel art style 
- Sweet, cozy atmosphere, encouraging to cherish the simple joys of life
- Smooth, relaxing music

70070000034940.name: Raptor Evolution: Godly Edition
70070000034940.description:
Take control of a mighty dinosaur in a post-apocalyptic world on a quest to recover its stolen eggs.

Smash through environments, gather resources, and hunt grotesque human-mutants to evolve and grow stronger. Use what you collect to rebuild bridges, restore paths and push deeper into a world filled with danger and mystery. 

Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying bosses standing between you and your lost brood.

Features:
- Unleash powerful evolution form with Celestosaurus skin
- Break everything: destroy environments and leave nothing standing
- Use advanced technology: encounter futuristic machines that will aid your survival
- Engage in fierce battles: hunt down mutants and monstrous creatures
- Meet various enemies: take on diverse foes with unique behaviors
- Lead your warriors: command other beasts and dominate the wasteland
- Evolve to become a super beast: grow stronger with every challenge you overcome!
- Use 400 Meat, 15 Mutagen and 500 Gems to power up your evolution and make your raptor stronger in every battle

Will you survive and recover your eggs?

70070000034956.name: Zombie Army 4: Dead War Complete Edition
70070000034956.description:
BUY ZOMBIE ARMY 4: DEAD WAR COMPLETE EDITION

Zombie Army 4: Dead War Complete Edition includes the thrilling base game and all the paid DLC* from Season Passes Two and Three and even the Ragnarök Campaign and Character Pack’.

Hitler’s hordes are back for more in this spine-chilling shooter from the makers of Sniper Elite! Abominable occult enemies, epic weapons, and a harrowing new campaign for 1-4 players await in 1940s Europe, as you fight to save humankind from undead Armageddon!

•	The Complete Edition includes:
o	Zombie Army 4: Dead War – base game
o	Season Pass Two
o	Season Pass Three
o	The Ragnarök Campaign and Character Pack
o	And much much GORE!

70070000034958.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Complete Edition
70070000034958.intro: Your train crashed! Find your friends and rebuild your home!
70070000034958.description:
Your friends are scattered across the city, and the rail network is in pieces! Draw colored tracks, reconnect the railroads, and guide trains back to their stations to find your lost buddies and bring everyone home.

With each rescue, your hometown slowly recovers, but the puzzles get trickier. Tunnels, crossroads, and clever obstacles will test your logic and creativity as you invent new routes, solve mind-bending challenges, and restore order to the railways.

Features:
- 1000+ handcrafted logic puzzles!
- 120 extra-large levels full of challenges!
- Tricky mechanics like gates, crossroads, and obstacles.
- Multiple solutions that reward creative thinking!

70070000035020.name: Tank vs Tank Value Edition

Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?

70070000035025.name: Knights & Guns Comprehensive Edition
70070000035025.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000035025.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:

70070000035031.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

70070000035057.intro: Survive the labyrinth, confront the horrors within, and see if you can escape the endless nightmare.

Descend into a twisted, endless nightmare with ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR and its essential DLC expansions. Navigate a labyrinth of damp carpets, flickering lights, and ever-changing corridors where every corner hides terror and unknown horrors.

70070000035084.name: Söldner-X Complete Collection
70070000035084.intro: The ultimate side-scrolling shoot'em up collection!
70070000035084.description:
The Söldner-X Complete Collection is a compilation of two critically acclaimed shoot'em up games in one collection.

Söldner-X: Himmelsstürmer

As Earth's resistance forces struggle to defend against a deadly infection consuming both life forms and technology alike, it falls to an anti-hero mercenary and bounty hunter to pilot a mighty prototype starfighter in hopes of locating the virus' origin, saving civilization and earning a massive payday in the process!

Set in the distant future, Söldner-X: Himmelsstürmer is a fast and furious shoot’em up presented in 2.5D side-scrolling style with a pumping soundtrack, seamlessly blending old-school gameplay inspirations with fresh modern innovations.

Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype Definitive Edition

A side-scrolling shooter sensation returns, bigger and bolder than ever before! Blending traditional arcade gameplay with scorching HD visuals and rocking audio presentation, Söldner-X 2: Final Prototype Definitive Edition is laser-focused on bringing everything the genre is known for into the current generation, from its sophisticated sci-fi narrative to strategic weapon juggling and rewarding power-up mechanics inspired by genre classics.

Dynamic score-linked difficulty, a challenge mode that rewards skillful performance with bonus features, devastating limit attacks and a pumping soundtrack with 30 original music pieces are just the beginning. Online scoreboards, stunning weapon and boss effects, rebalanced difficulty and a new gallery mode are now included. This is the ultimate realization of Söldner-X 2, fully revised and reborn!

70070000035112.name: Fit My Cat Pawsome Rooms Edition
70070000035112.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000035112.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000035120.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!

Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

70070000035128.name: Muv-Luv Unlimited : The Day After ULTIMATE COLLECTION
70070000035128.intro: A decades-long story of humanity’s fight against extinction. ‘Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After’ Episodes 00–03 now available in a bundle!
70070000035128.description:
■ Bundle Contents
• Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After Episode:00 REMASTERED
• Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After Episode:01 REMASTERED
• Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After Episode:02 REMASTERED
• Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After Episode:03 REMASTERED

◇ ‘What is “Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After”?’
A spin-off title of the Muv-Luv series, continuing from “Muv-Luv” and “Muv-Luv Alternative”.
Veering into a different future than the anime-adapted “Muv-Luv Alternative”, this series stems from “Muv-Luv Unlimited”.
After protagonist Shirogane Takeru sees the heroine escape Earth in “Muv-Luv Unlimited”, this story portrays the people left behind on Earth who nonetheless keep battling against their fate of extinction.

• Episode:00
The human evacuation plan to the Barnard’s Star system was carried out, and five days after the massive gravitational anomaly caused by humanity’s desperate counteroffensive, Operation Babylon, those left behind on Earth were still fighting to survive.
A small group of survivors gathered aboard the stranded U.S. aircraft carrier JFK, struggling to find a safe place to live.
That day, U.S. Marine Second Lieutenant Wilbert D. Collins, on a reconnaissance mission, received a faint distress signal and headed toward its source.

• Episode:01
The massive gravitational anomaly caused by Operation Babylon turned Earth into a world of death.
In Tacoma, part of the U.S.-administered Seattle Imperial Lease Territory—one of the last habitable regions for humanity—stood Imperial Japanese Army Lieutenant Tatsunami Hibiki.
Day after day, he fought to defend Seattle against the relentless BETA assaults.
With food supplies dwindling and ammunition nearly exhausted, Hibiki continued his desperate fight to stay alive.

• Episode:02
To solve the food crisis that had worsened Seattle’s public order, the Empire began construction of a food production plant.
However, on its first day of operation, the facility was taken over by unknown forces, and Supreme Commander Koubuin Yuuhi went missing.
To rescue the Commander and neutralize the terrorists, Hibiki’s War Dog Squad launched an assault on the plant, now turned into a battlefield.

• Episode:03
The war between Japan, the United States, Canada, and France—sparked by the food crisis—temporarily subsided, but the core issue remained unresolved.
A devastated Earth, the looming threat of the BETA, the power struggles between nations, and the everyday people caught in the middle.
What path will Hibiki, now a hero of the Empire, choose?

70070000035137.name: Cozy Land Undead Neighborhood
70070000035137.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000035137.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

This bundle includes Zombie DLC.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000035139.name: Kanjozoku Game レーサー - Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator Games: Midnight Velocity
70070000035139.intro: Hit the streets, drift through traffic, and rule Osaka at high speed.
70070000035139.description:
Hit the streets of Osaka in style with this exclusive bundle! Experience the thrill of street racing and give your vehicles a sharp new style. Whether you’re drifting, racing, or escaping high-speed chases, this bundle gives you the edge to become the ultimate street legend.

This bundle includes:
1. Kanjozoku Game レーサー – Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator Games
Experience 90s Osaka Kanjo illegal street racing with legendary JDM cars. Customize engines, body, suspension, and vinyls. Compete in time attacks, drift challenges, high-speed police chases, and climb the racer’s ladder to become the top street legend.

2. Kanjozoku Game レーサー - Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator Games: New Rim (DLC)
Upgrade your ride with a set of custom rims featuring unique spokes designs. Enhance both style and handling, perfect for drift sessions, car meets, and high-speed races. Show off your legendary setup and leave competitors in the dust.

With this bundle, you’ll have everything you need to start strong, tune your car, climb the rankings, and rule the streets like a true Kanjozoku racer.

70070000035145.name: Car Flipper Simulator 2024 - Car Mechanic, Wash, Car Sale: Wheels of Profit
70070000035145.intro: Build your garage, flip cars, and accelerate your way to tycoon status.
70070000035145.description:
Take your first steps into the exciting world of car trading and dealership management. Experience the thrill of buying, selling, and flipping cars while growing your own automotive empire from the ground up. With extra capital and all the tools you need at your disposal, you can make bold moves, invest in rare vehicles, and accelerate your rise to the top of the car market.

This bundle includes:
1. Car Flipper Simulator 2024 – Car Mechanic, Wash, Car Sale 
Experience the full game where you buy, sell, and trade cars, manage your dealership, and grow from a small lot into a thriving automotive empire. Build your inventory, attract buyers, and master the art of car flipping.

2. Car Flipper Simulator 2024 - Car Mechanic, Wash, Car Sale: Money Boost
Jumpstart your business with $100,000 added to your in-game balance. Invest in rare vehicles, expand your lot, and accelerate your rise to becoming the ultimate car dealer from day one.

With this bundle, you’ll have everything you need to start strong, trade smart, and dominate the car market like a true tycoon.

70070000035159.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Night Ops
70070000035159.intro: Survive the chaos, master your weapons, conquer the mission.
70070000035159.description:
Enter the ultimate tactical experience with this bundle, bringing together the base game and additional content that enhances both your equipment and your tactical capabilities. Face intense firefights, adapt your strategy, and prepare for every mission with upgraded tools and gear.

Bundle Includes:
• BODY CAM SHOOTER (Base Game): An ultra-realistic first-person shooter where you take on the role of a tactical operator facing aggressive, armed enemies. Fight across two unique maps, use different weapon types, and rely on strategy and quick decision-making to survive intense encounters.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Skin Upgrade (DLC)
Customize your AR-15 with a new tactical material inspired by real special forces equipment. This weapon skin adds a sleek, professional look designed for operators who want their gear to match their precision and readiness in the field.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Night Vision Mode (DLC)
Gain a crucial advantage in darker environments with the Night Vision feature. Spot enemies hidden in the shadows, move with greater awareness, and approach each mission with improved tactical vision.

Prepare your gear, sharpen your tactics, and step into every mission ready for the challenge ahead.

70070000035178.name: Oblivion Dreams: Journey Edition
70070000035178.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000035178.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 64 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.

70070000035192.name: ONLY UP! REMASTER: Skin Your Character
70070000035192.intro: Rise through impossible heights and turn every leap into a personal triumph.
70070000035192.description:
Reach new heights and challenge yourself in the remastered vertical adventure! Navigate ever-changing platforms, tackle tricky ledges, and leap across gaps as you test your reflexes and precision to the limit. Every jump brings excitement, challenge, and the thrill of climbing higher than ever before.

Bundle Includes:
ONLY UP! REMASTER
The full game with challenging vertical progression, precision platforming, immersive worlds, and intense replayability. Explore diverse, dynamic environments that evolve as you climb, master fluid parkour mechanics, and test your reflexes across endless vertical challenges.

ONLY UP! REMASTER: Climb in Style
With this DLC, it is now possible to customize your characters. Choose from a variety of styles—whether sleek, bold, or completely unique—to make your character reflect your personality on every jump and platform, adding a personal touch to your ascent while keeping the core gameplay intact.

Take your climb further, make every jump uniquely yours, and experience the ultimate vertical adventure in style.

70070000035208.name: Bowling Fever Power Edition
70070000035208.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000035208.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-30 new bowling ball styles

70070000035209.name: Run Sausage Run!: Poison Edition
70070000035209.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000035209.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 3 new skins (Beekeeper, Firefly, Toxic)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000035213.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 GOTY Edition
70070000035213.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000035213.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

12 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000035214.name: Magin: The Rat Project Stories - Essence Edition
70070000035214.intro: Magin is a story-driven deckbuilding adventure game
70070000035214.description:
In addition to Magin: The Rat Project Stories the Essence Edition contains the following DLC:
- Comic Book
- Additional VFX for Cards
- Digital Artbook
- Original Soundtrack
- The story of "Essence" and its usage
- Supporter Main Menu

FEATURES:
- A dark & mysterious setting with a story elements being told in a comic-like panels
- Deckbuilder Combat, where you build your deck as the story progresses
- Double-sided, emotion-infused essence cards
- The Essence Mechanic, which influences both, the story and combat
- A Storyline that is affected by your choices

70070000035216.name: Pawbay: Cozy Strays
70070000035216.intro: Cause chaos in Pawbay... and don’t forget your silly hat
70070000035216.description:
Slip into the paws of a mischievous little cat and turn Pawbay — a cozy seaside town — upside down. Climb rooftops, sneak through alleys, and pounce your way through a charming world where curiosity always leads to chaos. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op and become the town’s most unforgettable menace.

Now, add some flair! Dress up in new silly hats to spread smiles (and a little chaos) in true feline fashion.

Features:
• Play as a nimble, trouble-loving cat
• Solo or local 2-player co-op adventure
• Explore every street, rooftop, and hidden spots
• Stir up hilarious trouble with pranks and mischief
• Put silly hat on and shake up Pawbay

70070000035226.name: Moto Rush GT Comprehensive Edition
70070000035226.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000035226.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Grip Collection #1 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 4 new motorbikes (each with special colors)
- New colors for the rest of motorbikes
- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- 8 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000035227.name: Hole io: Gold Edition
70070000035227.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000035227.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Gold Edition features:
- 8 maps with different things to swallow 
- 27 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000035231.name: Adrenaline Rush 4‑Pack
70070000035231.intro: Have fun with this pack of 4 amazing games.
70070000035231.description:
• Pure Chase 80's: is pure arcade, pure speed, pure adrenaline.

• Tower of Babel: If you carry the spirit of a runner in your veins, here you will face the challenge of conquering the summits of the Towers of Babel, crossing worlds as diverse as they are unpredictable.

• Xtreme club racing: Drive at the limit through lands where nature unleashes its fury. Face wild obstacles that tear into your path — from tornadoes ripping across the horizon to forces determined to stop you — and fight your way to the finish line against a world that refuses to let you pass.

• Final light, The prison: Hidden powers forged the ghost prison S‑313, trapping tortured souls after decades of conspiracy and cruelty. Freeing them means descending into a hostile, shifting world filled with darkness, relentless challenges, and colossal bosses. A Metroidvania experience with a rogue‑like spirit that marks the beginning of an even deeper saga of conspiracies.

70070000035232.name: All‑Stars 4‑Game Collection
70070000035232.intro: Have fun with this pack of 4 amazing games.
70070000035232.description:
• YellowPips, wild west apocalyptic: Build and manage your own Wild West town—resources, shops, farms, and even a train station to keep it alive. When the Outlaw Rot virus unleashes a zombie apocalypse, you’ll have to defend the settlement from hordes and colossal bosses while continuing to expand it. Survive this chaos and you’ll unlock a frantic arcade mode where every run is a bloody race for perfection.

• Tower of Babel: If you carry the spirit of a runner in your veins, here you will face the challenge of conquering the summits of the Towers of Babel, crossing worlds as diverse as they are unpredictable.

• Final light, The prison: Hidden powers forged the ghost prison S‑313, trapping tortured souls after decades of conspiracy and cruelty. Freeing them means descending into a hostile, shifting world filled with darkness, relentless challenges, and colossal bosses. A Metroidvania experience with a rogue‑like spirit that marks the beginning of an even deeper saga of conspiracies.

• Sportitions'24: Fun sports for the whole family with a variety of the most extravagant athletes.

70070000035233.name: Adrenaline Overload Bundle
70070000035233.intro: Have fun with this pack of 4 amazing games.
70070000035233.description:
• Pure Chase 80's: is pure arcade, pure speed, pure adrenaline.

• Burn! SuperTrucks: It's a super truck simulator with the peculiarity that when you have an accident, it puts you back in time just before the crash.

• Boost Zero: a tribute to classic anti‑gravity racing arcades, where excitement and speed merge in futuristic, adrenaline‑filled competitions.

• Xtreme club racing: Drive at the limit through lands where nature unleashes its fury. Face wild obstacles that tear into your path — from tornadoes ripping across the horizon to forces determined to stop you — and fight your way to the finish line against a world that refuses to let you pass.

70070000035238.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Upgrade Edition
70070000035238.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000035238.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle and Food Truck Tycoon New Levels #1 with:

- 45 new levels to explore

70070000035240.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Platinum Edition
70070000035240.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000035240.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Landon Phil DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Jonathan DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Maverick DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 3 legendary boxers with their unique equipment and a bonus of 63000 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!
