Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000035243.name: Football Legends 2025 Diamond Edition
70070000035243.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70070000035243.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

This bundle includes base game, Team Pack #2 and Team Pack #3 with:
- 6 new teams

70070000035245.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Discovery Edition
70070000035245.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000035245.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

-2 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000035249.name: Pool Fever Upgrade Edition
70070000035249.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000035249.description:
Pool Fever brings the classic game right to your Nintendo Switch™, perfect for beginners and pool sharks alike! 

Pool Fever offers a fun, accessible, and realistic billiards experience. With stunning 3D graphics and intuitive gameplay, you’ll feel like you’re playing in your favorite bar or pool hall. Whether you want to play in solo mode or challenge a friend in 2-player local multiplayer – either way, the table is set for hours of entertainment.

Choose from 10 different table designs, 15 unique cues, and 5 custom cue balls to create your perfect game setup. With three difficulty levels, you'll always have a challenge no matter your skill level.

So, chalk your cue, line up your shot, and sink the 8-ball - it’s game time!

Features:

10 different table designs 
15 unique cues sticks
5 custom cue balls 
3 difficulty levels
Play solo or in 2-player local multiplayer
Realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #4 with:

-5 new pool table designs
-5 new pool  cues designs

70070000035253.name: Softly Placed Fantasy Collection
70070000035253.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70070000035253.description:
Step into the world, where mundane tasks turn into little adventures and ordinary items provide so much joy. See everything around you in bright, new, vibrant colors and make things even more beautiful by adding fun patterns. Wake up your inner child and find the happiness in little things.
 
Each level of the game consists of a unique challenge, providing fresh, yet relaxing gameplay, that will make you curious for what’s coming next.  

This bundle includes the Fantasy Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
-40 unique cozy puzzle levels
-Gameplay consisting of different types of challenges
-Beautiful, vibrant visuals, where everyday items turn into something magical
-Relaxing, cheerful soundtrack 
-Inspiring, nostalgic atmosphere
-Variety of puzzles exercising different parts of the brain

70070000035255.name: My Little Haven Pets Lover Collection
70070000035255.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70070000035255.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

This bundle includes the Pets Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70070000035257.name: Piano: Learn and Play Harmony Edition
70070000035257.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000035257.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes four Song Packs DLCs.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000035261.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley—Honeyglow Woods Edition
70070000035261.intro: Explore the Honeyglow Woods, and reconnect with Disney's Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore and Piglet in a brand-new Adventure Pack!
70070000035261.description:
This bundle includes the Disney Dreamlight Valley base game; the new Adventure Pack, Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods; and 10,000 Moonstones. 

Disney Dreamlight Valley is a hybrid between a life-sim and an adventure game rich with quests, exploration, and engaging activities featuring Disney and Pixar friends, both old and new. Once an idyllic land, Dreamlight Valley was a place where Disney and Pixar characters lived in harmony -- until the Forgetting. Night Thorns grew across the land and severed the wonderful memories tied to this magical place. With nowhere else to go, the hopeless inhabitants of Dreamlight Valley retreated behind locked doors in the Dream Castle. Now it's up to you to discover the stories of this world and bring the magic back to Dreamlight Valley! 

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods is a brand-new Adventure Pack for Disney Dreamlight Valley, perfect for newcomers to the Valley or seasoned Dreamlight players. Befriend 3 beloved Winnie the Pooh Characters, explore and decorate 4 brand-new areas, and solve puzzles in the mysterious Everoak Tree. Reconnect with childlike curiosity, rediscover the joys of friendship with a playful game of Pooh Sticks, and bring a touch of honey to your Valley as you perfect the art of beekeeping, which unlocks dozens of new crafting recipes!


Meet Friends Old and New

Deep within Dreamlight Valley lies the Honeyglow Woods, where you once spent lazy afternoons with long-lost friends.  Rediscover this idyllic place, and you’ll quickly find Winnie the Pooh, radiating with optimism even on the gloomiest days. Nearby, the courageous Piglet is ready to face his fears, and the thoughtful Eeyore quietly accepts the Woods' melancholy... though a little cheering up would be most welcome!
This whimsical world isn't just about reconnecting with old friends; you'll also be making new ones. Befriend a delightful family of colorful hedgehogs, ready to join you on your adventures.


A Touch of Sweetness

At the heart of the Honeyglow Woods lies its golden secret: honey! Learn the art of beekeeping, crafting Busy Bees’ Houses and placing them among vibrant flowers to gather Golden Honey. Use it to create whimsical Honeyglow Furniture, bake delicious treats, and unlock new recipes. You'll soon be spreading a little sweetness to every corner of the Valley.


The Mystery of the Everoak Tree

The Everoak Tree stands tall in the middle of the Woods, surrounded by four entirely unique, enchanting areas. Wander through Drowsybloom Acre, venture into the blooming Braveheart Grove, wade through the delightfully swampy Gloommeadow, and step into the Nectar Apiary and its giant honeycombs. As you restore each area and uncover the secrets within the Everoak Tree, you'll mend the land and unravel the mystery at the heart of the Honeyglow Woods.


A brand-new mini-game!

Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods includes a brand-new mini-game you can play with all your Villagers: Pooh Sticks, inspired by the game as it appears in classic Winnie the Pooh stories! To play Pooh Sticks, find a bridge in the Gloommeadow and gather four Villagers. Each will choose an object and drop it over the bridge downstream. Whoever's object reaches the finish line on the river first wins! Pooh Sticks is a wholesome new way of creating lasting friendship bonds with your friends and neighbors in the Valley.

70070000035263.name: TMNT: Splintered Fate and Metalhead
70070000035263.intro: Pick up both the base game and the Metalhead Character DLC for a bodacious savings!
70070000035263.description:
Unleash the Turtles and their friends in a quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan!

In Splintered Fate, brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay on both Campaign and Arcade modes. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.

METALHEAD CHARACTER DLC
- New playable character: Metalhead, first fully-ranged hero
- 5 new artifacts

Metalhead explodes onto the scene ready to add some missile mayhem to the Turtles' arsenal! Take down enemies at range before they pose a threat. Kick off his journey with 5 brand new Artifacts to explore.

With thrilling combat and endless challenges, Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

70070000035268.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 26 The World's Game Edition
70070000035268.description:
EA SPORTS FC™ 26 The World’s Game Edition includes:

- 3,000 Season Points

- One Gold Starting XI Pack, with 11 untradeable Rare Gold Player Items (1 Goalkeeper, 4 Defenders, 3 Midfielders, 3 Attackers) rated 84 or higher, with at least one guaranteed 86+ rated player.

Three Player Picks (all untradeable) from a selection of EA SPORTS FC™ 26 FUT™ campaigns:
- 1 of 5 Elite Campaign Players rated 90–93 OVR §
- 1 of 5 ICON or Hero Players rated 90–94 OVR §§
- 1 of 12 International TOTS Players rated up to 95 OVR §§§

The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC™ 26.

Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26. The latest update introduces a brand-new international tournament mode featuring 48 national teams, alongside new authentic stadiums to play in. Take on international-themed Manager Live Challenges, and step into Player Career with new international ICONs and Heroes.
Play your way with an overhauled gameplay experience shaped by community feedback, Manager Live Challenges that deliver fresh scenarios throughout the season, and new Archetypes inspired by greats of the game.

Put your dream squad to the test in Football Ultimate Team™ with new Live Events and Tournament modes, as well as a refreshed Rivals and Champs experience.
Experience The World’s Game like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 26, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 20,000+ authentic players.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

70070000035287.name: Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Complete Edition
70070000035287.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000035287.description:
Love cooking games? Manage 9 distinct kitchens, craft over 500 dishes, and rise to culinary stardom across 1000+ fast-paced levels in Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire. Customize your home, unlock trophies, and bring the heat!

From street food to sushi, each kitchen will test your time-management skills as you work to satisfy impatient customers and hit your goals. But it’s not all about the kitchens—customize and upgrade your home to showcase your achievements, unlock trophies, and build a true empire!

Perfect for players of all ages, this game offers fast-paced fun that’s easy to pick up, but tough to master. Can you handle the heat and build your own cooking empire?

Key Features:

9 Unique Cuisines: Master a range of cooking styles and menus.
500+ Dishes: A global selection of recipes to perfect.
1000+ Levels: Challenge yourself with increasingly complex kitchens.
Home Customization: Upgrade your furniture and earn trophies to showcase your progress.
Fun & Fast-Paced: Simple to play, with endless hours of culinary excitement!

This bundle contains base game, DLC#2- Cozy Living, DLC#3- Creative Desk and Restaurant Tycoon: My Cooking Empire - Kebab Bar Tycoon, with:
- new set of furniture for your Living Room!
- an elegant desk, a comfortable chair, and other accessories that let you create your dream office!
- whole additional restaurant - Kebab Bar

70070000035290.name: Snooker Fever Upgrade Edition
70070000035290.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000035290.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game and Expansion Pack #4 with:

five stylish table designs and five new cue options.

70070000035293.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Patrol Command
70070000035293.intro: Patrol the borders, uncover hidden contraband, and master every challenge.
70070000035293.description:
Step into the demanding role of a border officer and equip yourself with everything needed to secure the frontier. Face smugglers, make split-second decisions, and manage high-stakes encounters in a highly realistic simulation.

Bundle Contents:
1. Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Experience the full game, patrolling meticulously designed borders, inspecting vehicles, verifying documents in real time, and tackling diverse missions where every choice shapes the outcome.

2. Military Gear DLC – Add authenticity to your patrol with a military camouflage skin for gloves and sleeves, blending style and practicality during intense inspections and high-pressure operations.

3. Red Camo Ops DLC – Make your presence felt with a bold red camouflage knife skin, perfect for experienced officers who enforce the law with precision and authority.

Step into the field fully equipped, enhance your visual immersion, and enforce the law like a true Border Patrol professional.

70070000035299.name: Pixel Cafe Definitive Edition
70070000035299.intro: From kitchen chaos to cozy moments
70070000035299.description:
Step behind the counter and take on the challenge of serving up delicious meals and perfectly brewed coffee in this fast-paced, classic cooking game. Work your way through 10 unique cafes, each with its own style and demands, as you master recipes, upgrade your equipment, and keep your customers happy. 

Outside the kitchen, bring new life to Grandma’s old house by decorating it with fun furniture and personal touches. Along the way, you’ll uncover a heartfelt story of friendships, family, and finding your place in a city full of contrasts. Whether you’re here for the cooking or the story, Pixel Cafe delivers an adventure full of charm and challenges.

This bundle includes base game, Bedroom Touches, Kitchen Touches and Bedroom Touches #2 with:

A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
A new style for the Radio Nightstand
A different variant for the Refrigerator
An updated Oven and Stove design
A new look for the Sink
An alternative style for the Bar
A simple variant for the Bed
An alternative design for the Lamp
Also, mix things up with 6 new wallpapers suitable for any room!

70070000035307.name: Hentai Portrait Emerald Evenings
70070000035307.description:
Enter Hentai Portrait- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.

Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Portrait offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This game includes the DLC Portraits Pack 3.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000035309.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Emerald Edition
70070000035309.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000035309.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Viking Nom who triggers a powerful long turbo boost shortly after the race begins!
- Wind Nom who gives a big running speed boost to keep you ahead!
- Droid Nom who triggers a medium turbo boost a few seconds after the race starts!
- Iron Nom who gives you a 30-second shield right at the start!
- Electro Nom who eliminates one other runner!
- Goldie Nom who gets more exp than any other Nom!
- X Nom who gives you a big boost when climbing and running on walls!
- Visor Nom who eliminates two other racers right at the start of the race!
- 8000 gold to buy new Noms!

NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Grab friends or family and jump into the same race on one screen. Chase the lead, pull off last-second comebacks, and see who really is the fastest runner among you!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000035311.name: Midnight Drifter-Drift Racing Car Racing Driving Simulator 2023 Speed Games: Streets of Drift
70070000035311.intro: Take on every race, perfect every drift, and upgrade your fleet for total street domination.
70070000035311.description:
Step into the world of Midnight Drifter, where high-speed drifting, tight corners, and night street races await. Feel the adrenaline, push your skills to the limit, and experience the thrill of being a true street racing legend.

Bundle includes:
1. Midnight Drifter-Drift Racing Car Racing Driving Simulator 2023 Speed Games: Explore night streets, compete in multiple races, and perform insane drifts. Customize your cars, upgrade their performance, and fine-tune every detail for maximum control and style.

2. New Car DLC: A brand-new JDM car is added to your garage, offering enhanced handling, speed, and drift potential. Upgrade and customize it to expand your garage and unlock new ways to dominate the streets.

Hit the streets and become the ultimate drift master!

70070000035314.name: Johnny Trigger: Gold Edition
70070000035314.intro: Looking for definitive action? Here’s Johnny!
70070000035314.description:
Johnny Trigger - International Man of Mayhem!

This bundle includes:
- Johnny Trigger
- Johnny Trigger: Avenger DLC
- Johnny Trigger: Hunter DLC

Features:
• 2 new skins: Avenger and Hunter
• 2 new weapons: Hurricane and Tri-Shot Bow
• 1500 additional gemms to buy other currencies
• 35000 additional money to buy or draw weapons and skins in shops
• 75 additional puzzles to unlock more comic graphics
• 25 additional keys to open locked doors in base

Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends.

Do you have what it takes to bring down the underground world of the mafia?
“Less talk, more bullets” - that’s Johnny’s motto as he runs, jumps, spins, slides and keeps on shooting till every bad guy’s bitten the dust.

Dive straight in and get shooting! Johnny Trigger’s short but immensely satisfying levels make it the perfect action game to fill a short break.
And if you’ve got a little more time, there’s so much to collect and a new challenge round every corner.

So what are you waiting for? Those bad guys aren’t going to beat themselves, you know.

70070000035327.name: Car Racing Highway Driving Simulator, Real Parking Driver Sim Speed Traffic Deluxe 2022 – Expanded Racing
70070000035327.intro: Overtake traffic, push your limits, and feel the thrill of speed.
70070000035327.description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of high-speed driving, thrilling traffic challenges, and endless open roads. Whether you’re a casual driver or a racing enthusiast, this bundle delivers nonstop action and adrenaline.

What’s included:
1. Car Racing Highway Driving Simulator, real parking driver sim speed traffic deluxe 2022 (Base Game)
Drive over 30 cars, from racing machines to off-road SUVs, across a vast open-world environment. Navigate smart traffic systems, day and night cycles, bridges, tunnels, and challenging highways. Upgrade your vehicles, tune performance, and push your skills to the limit.

2. Car Racing Highway Driving Simulator, Real Parking Driver Sim Speed Traffic Deluxe 2022 – Vehicle Boost (DLC)
Expand your garage with powerful B-M8, designed for speed, precision, and thrilling highway action. If you already own this vehicle, you will receive a reward of $62,000 in in-game currency.

Take the wheel, hit the highway, and experience the excitement, speed, and challenges of high-performance driving!

70070000035333.name: Cute Finders Special Edition
70070000035333.intro: Your mission starts now! Objective? Find the subtle, silly, and sneaky differences between the two images displayed!
70070000035333.description:
Step into beautifully cluttered rooms, each one a delightful package of cozy furniture, vibrant decor, and cute animals just doing their things, and look close! Can you spot the missing carpet? Different plant? Cute bunny being replaced by a cat? 

Just remember: be prepared for the unexpected! The elements in the same level vary each playthrough and our special Endless Level is designed to keep you guessing... endlessly. Boredom is not an option! 

This bundle includes the Cozy Collector DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
-30 cozy levels + 1 endless level.
-800 room variants.
-560 cute pieces of furniture, decorations and animals variants.
-Adorable art style you can never get tired of. 
-Relaxing music, allowing you to unwind after a long day. 
-Cognitive training gameplay, boosting your focus and perceptiveness.

70070000035342.name: Megabonk Smash: Nightmare Arena
70070000035342.intro: Fight smarter, evolve faster, and dominate every wave of enemies.
70070000035342.description:
Dive into a chaotic pixel adventure! In this bundle, battle endless waves of enemies, collect glowing crystals, evolve your powers, and face brutal bosses on a cursed pixel island. Every second counts — survive, smash everything, and rise as the ultimate pixel warrior.

Bundle Includes:
Megabonk Smash (Base Game):
- Intense arena combat with melee, ranged, and fireball attacks.
- Progression and upgrades: collect crystals, unlock skills, and evolve each run.
- Adaptive enemies and powerful bosses that test your survival instincts.
- Interactive pixel world: destructible objects, hidden secrets, and dynamic lighting effects.

Megabonk Smash: Misty Madness (DLC):
- A mysterious pink mist blankets the arena, changing visibility and combat dynamics.

Are you ready to face the chaos? Survive, evolve, and smash everything!

70070000035344.name: Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business – Modern Market
70070000035344.intro: Build your supermarket empire and dominate the retail world.
70070000035344.description:
Take control of your supermarket and build a thriving grocery empire. Manage every detail of your store — from designing layouts and choosing products to keeping shelves stocked, supervising staff, and satisfying customers. Make smart business decisions, adapt to market trends, and grow your initial store into a successful retail chain.

This bundle includes:
• Full Game – Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
Design, manage, and expand your very own supermarket. Customize the layout, stock the products customers love, supervise your staff, and navigate the challenges of running a busy retail store. Grow from a small shop into a thriving supermarket empire, mastering both strategy and business management along the way.

• City Style Upgrade DLC
Add a modern and stylish touch to your supermarket and its surroundings. Customize delivery trucks, revitalize sidewalks with vibrant colors, and give roads a polished city look to create a professional urban environment that enhances your store’s presence.

• Shop Redesign DLC
Completely transform the interior and exterior of your supermarket. Experiment with colors and styles to create a unique atmosphere, make your store stand out from competitors, and attract more customers with a fresh and memorable design.

Take charge, create your perfect store, and watch your supermarket empire flourish!

70070000035350.name: Peaceful Fishing Story + Tropical Island Pack Set
70070000035350.intro:
Relax and unwind.
Enjoy a slow life all your own, spent fishing at your own pace.
70070000035350.description:
A gentle, laid-back life begins in a village surrounded by nature.
Cast your line into rivers, lakes, and the open sea, and enjoy fishing whenever the mood strikes.
Spend peaceful days getting to know the village's charming residents and soaking in a calming, heartwarming atmosphere.

Get Peaceful Fishing Story and the Tropical Island Pack together in a great-value bundle!
Enjoy a relaxing fishing life!

70070000035357.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.21
70070000035357.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the twenty-first additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Harbor Towns of the World
- Fruit Dessert Collection
- Mystic Forest Maidens: The Digital Canvas 6
- [Moving] Wild Animals

70070000035359.name: Sheriff Park Ranger: Park Protector
70070000035359.intro: Every shift counts — make your mark as the ultimate park ranger.
70070000035359.description:
Step into the shoes of a dedicated park ranger and experience the thrill of protecting the wilderness. Patrol vast forests, scenic highways, and hidden trails while responding to emergencies, stopping offenders, rescuing animals, and handling unpredictable situations that will test your skills and instincts.

What’s Included in This Bundle:
1. Sheriff Park Ranger - Explore an expansive national park, drive authentic ranger vehicles, use real tools, manage dynamic day-night and weather cycles, and progress through increasingly difficult missions. Progress, upgrade, and customize your ranger to tackle tougher missions.
2. Sheriff Park Ranger: Cash Boost - Get a head start with 200 in-game currency to ppgrade ranger tools, vehicles, and gear faster.

Enhance your ranger experience with extra resources and take full control of your patrols. With this bundle, you’re ready to face the wilderness, protect its inhabitants, and conquer every challenge the park throws your way.

70070000035371.name: Ecchi Breaker: Strong Edition
70070000035371.intro: Break the blocks and meet strong women.
70070000035371.description:
Focus and get ready to play. Each hit brings you closer to what lies behind the blocks, and the prize for winning has never looked so good.

Focus, control your shots, and watch the tension rise with each block you destroy. But be careful... too many misses and the moment may slip away.

Features:
- 48 strong girls waiting to be discovered
- Sensual music and satisfying effects
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- A feast for the eyes

Take up the challenge.

70070000035373.name: Waterpark Simulator 25: Park Builder
70070000035373.intro: Expand your park, upgrade facilities, and create lasting memories.
70070000035373.description:
Take charge of your very own waterpark and turn it into the ultimate summer destination. Build thrilling slides, relaxing pools, and vibrant leisure zones while keeping your visitors happy and your park running smoothly. Make smart decisions, expand your attractions, and create an unforgettable experience for every guest.

This bundle includes:
• Waterpark Simulator 25
Design, build, and manage your dream waterpark. Customize rides, pools, food stands, and leisure areas while overseeing staff, maintaining facilities, and attracting more visitors. Grow your park from a small summer getaway into a thriving, bustling destination.

• Waterpark Simulator 25: Bonus Funds
Get an instant boost with 2000 in-game currency, giving you the resources to expand faster, upgrade attractions, or enhance guest amenities. Use these extra funds to take your park to the next level and bring your ultimate summer vision to life.

Build, expand, and create a waterpark that will keep visitors coming back all season long!

70070000035394.name: Coloring Book: Animals Edition - 90 drawings
70070000035394.intro: Create the most impressive coloring book, alone or together (up to 4 artists) ! This Bundle contains over 90 drawings!
70070000035394.description:
This Bundle contains:
● “Coloring Book” base game
● "Ocean Animals" with 30 pictures of sea animals and underwater treasures
● "Family & Home" with 30 pictures of happy homes of your fluffy friends
● "Farm Life" with 30 pictures of oldest human friends hanging around the farm

70070000035395.name: Cup Heroes: Diamond Bag Bundle
70070000035395.intro: Join the adventure fully loaded with 2,560 diamonds!
70070000035395.description:
Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen! 

How to Play: 
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles. 
- Save the Queen: Your ultimate goal is to rescue the Queen who has been captured by evil forces. 
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and gems to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges. 

Features: 
- Premium Currency: Use 2,560 Diamonds to unlock new heroes, purchase keys to open exclusive chests, obtain high-rarity gear, and gain a powerful edge in battle.
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team. 
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes. 
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game. 
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen. 
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience. 
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests to earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!

70070000035399.name: Float Survival Simulator - Ocean Survivor: Survival Challenge
70070000035399.intro: Sharks, storms, and open waters—can you survive the ocean challenge?
70070000035399.description:
Dive into the ultimate ocean survival experience! Stranded in the middle of a vast and unforgiving sea, you must gather resources, defend your raft, and turn a fragile platform into a thriving floating base. This bundle enhances your adventure with additional content that strengthens your raft and transforms the atmosphere of your journey.

Bundle Includes:
1. Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor (Base Game) - Survive on a fragile raft, gather resources, craft tools, expand your floating base, and defend yourself against ocean dangers while exploring distant islands.

2. Building Materials Expansion DLC – Upgrade your raft with stronger building materials designed to withstand the harsh conditions of the open sea.

3. Skybox Overhaul DLC – Experience the ocean like never before with a redesigned skybox that brings a richer and more immersive atmosphere to your adventure.

Gather, build, explore, and survive as you transform a simple raft into the ultimate ocean sanctuary.

70070000035402.name: Magic Cats Pots Premium Edition
70070000035402.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This game includes the DLCs Spring Pack, Frame Pack and Traditional Pack.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!

Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000035403.name: Cozy Tiny Home Extended Edition
70070000035403.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000035403.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes Cat Pack 1 and Floor & Wallpaper DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000035404.name: Pocket Nook Summer Purrty Edition
70070000035404.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000035404.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

This game includes the Cat&Dog and Summer Tiki Party DLCs.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000035405.name: Mini Market Design Dream Theater
70070000035405.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000035405.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes Cinema, Furniture Material Collection 1 and Furniture Material Collection 2 DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000035406.name: Cozy Memory Shining Star Edition
70070000035406.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000035406.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 3 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000035407.name: BMX CITY RUN: Urban Stunts
70070000035407.intro: Push your limits, master every stunt, and own the city streets.
70070000035407.description:
Hit the streets, master every trick, and take your BMX skills to the next level in the most thrilling ride of your life. Navigate rooftops, parks, and urban landscapes, perform jaw-dropping stunts, and push your limits as you explore every corner of the city. Show off your individuality with bikes that reflect your personality and make every ride an unforgettable adventure.

This bundle includes:
- Full Game: BMX CITY RUN – Explore exciting locations, perform daring tricks, unlock new bikes, and master realistic BMX physics. Customize your character and bike to match your style and skill.
- DLC: Bike Styles – Unlock a full set of randomized bike customizations, giving your rides endless style possibilities. Each ride is a new look, making your stunts and BMX adventures even more fun.

Jump, spin, and ride your way to fame—extreme cycling has never looked this good!

70070000035411.name: The Coma: Sehwa Complete Edition
70070000035411.description:
The Coma: Recut
After spending all night studying for the last day of Sehwa High’s final exams, Youngho has an eerie dream. He arrives at school the next morning and learns someone tried to commit suicide in school the night before. Despite this, class goes on! Youngho drifts asleep during the final only to wake and find himself trapped in the school at night. The only problem is... he’s not alone. You can run. You can hide. Can you survive while piecing together the nightmarish mystery of Sehwa High?

The Coma 2B: Catacomb
Youngho’s second adventure begins. With only the faint hope of escaping from the horrors within the mirror dimension, Youngho collects the pages of Yaesol’s notes to find the location of a powerful relic sword that can be used against the Vicious Sister. Things get complicated when an unwanted invader comes to the mirror dimension, and a new character with ties to Yaesol appears in order to help Youngho. Will Youngho be able to solve the mystery behind the huge facility beneath Dokaebi Market and defeat the Vicious Sister?

The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
Mina Park, a student of Sehwa High and Youngho's childhood friend, awakens at night in Sehwa High. It isn’t long before she realizes that something is amiss. The once-familiar school where she spends her evenings studying looks twisted by something dark and sinister. She finds herself pursued by someone, or something, that looks eerily like her English teacher. To survive, Mina must venture beyond the boundaries of her school and into the surrounding district. There, she will encounter strange creatures, mysterious strangers, and uneasy allies.

The Coma 3: Bloodlines 
The Coma 3: Bloodlines is a 2D run-and-hide horror adventure where you must escape threatening puppets and shadow monsters while gathering clues, solving problems, and unraveling the mystery surrounding the chaos that the three main characters have been thrust into.

70070000035413.name: Pyramid Quest - Bundle
70070000035413.intro: Pyramid Quest is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games.
70070000035413.description: As an adventurer, explore dangerous pyramids and battle mummies and skeletons. In each level, find the three pieces of an artifact to advance to the next section. Hidden treasures, gold, and diamonds await you as you overcome obstacles or discover hidden rooms.

70070000035445.name: Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance - Epic Fury
70070000035445.intro: Everything you need to win the skies.
70070000035445.description:
Your journey to becoming a true ace begins in the skies!
Take control of powerful aircraft and experience fast-paced aerial combat across diverse environments. This bundle gives you the complete experience, combining the full game with additional aircraft to expand your combat options and playstyle.

 What’s included in the bundle:

1. Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance 
 The full game puts you in the cockpit of advanced fighter jets, featuring multiple game modes, dynamic missions, and intense aerial battles. Customize your aircraft, adapt your tactics, and face increasingly challenging enemies across varied locations.

2. Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance – Su-57 Felon & F-15 Eagle 
 Gain access to two advanced jets and enhance your fleet with new performance and combat possibilities. Use these aircraft to approach missions differently and improve your overall strategy in the air.

This bundle delivers the full aerial combat experience along with expanded aircraft options, giving you more control, more variety, and more ways to dominate every mission.

70070000035447.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball Premium Collection
70070000035447.description:
Embark on a pinball journey on 6 authentic classics inspired by the biggest brands in entertainment with the Williams™ Pinball Premium Collection! Play them as arcade-perfect simulations in their original form or as remastered video game experiences enhanced with animated toys.

This bundle includes:

- Indiana Jones™: The Pinball Adventure
- The Addams Family™
- Star Trek™: The Next Generation
- The Twilight Zone
- Monster Bash
- The Creature From The Black Lagoon

70070000035453.name: QQQbeats!!! + Touhou Arrangements Pack Vol.1 Bundle
70070000035453.intro: Includes the Base Game & Popular Touhou Hits!
70070000035453.description:
"QQQbeats!!!" is a brand-new puzzle game that combines simple bubble shooting with easy-to-play rhythm game mechanics. Enjoy the excitement to the fullest by making the most of each character's unique personality!

■ Includes

- QQQbeats!!! Base Game
- Touhou Arrangement Pack Vol.1


■There are three playable modes!
There are three playable modes, so you can enjoy the game solo or with friends, both online and offline!

- STORY
This is the STORY mode, where you can play at your own pace by yourself.
Clearing stages unlocks new characters and songs.

- VERSUS
VERSUS mode lets you enjoy 1-on-1 competitive play.
You can play online in "Ranked Match," "Casual Match," or "Private Match."
There are also "Local Battles" and "Shared Battles" for offline play, as well as "COM Battles" where you can practice against the computer at your own pace.
Enjoy playing in your favorite style as much as you like!

- DUOps
DUOps is a cooperative play mode where you team up with friends to battle against enemies.
You can enjoy it casually both online and offline.
Clearing stages rewards you with even more in-game currency, "BeatCoin."


■ Featured Songs

A packed lineup featuring hit anime and pop songs, virtual singers, VTubers, Touhou arrangements, and more!
A total of 67 songs!

- Hai Yorokonde / Kocchi no Kento
- Show / Ado
- MIXED NUTS / OFFICIAL HIGE DANDISM
- Tell Your World / livetune feat. Hatsune Miku
- Mesmerizer / 32ki
- Charles / Balloon
- BIBBIDIBA / Hoshimachi Suisei
- Say! Fanfare! / Shirakami Fubuki
- HUGE W / Mori Calliope
- Bad Apple!! feat. nomico / Masayoshi Minoshima
- Night of Knights / Knight of Nights / beatMARIO(COOL&CREATE)
- Charismatic Purgatory Goddess / Shinra-Bansho
- Re：End of a Dream (long ver.) / uma vs. Morimori Atsushi
- Cheatreal / t+pazolite
- Big Daddy / USAO


■Collaborations with popular talents and characters have also been realized!

Popular talent and characters from virtual singers, Touhou Project, and VTubers make a sudden appearance!

Included in the base game:
- Miku Hatsune
- Teto Kasane
- Reimu Hakurei
- Marisa Kirisame
- Shirakami Fubuki
- Mori Calliope


■Touhou Arrangements Pack Vol.1
Here are the included songs:
- Help me, ERINNNNNN!! / beatMARIO(COOL&CREATE)
- Mischief Sensation / Shinra-Bansho
- Who Killed U.N.Owen / Liz Triangle
- Yukemuri TamaOnSen II / TamaOnSen
- Scarlet Police on Ghetto Patrol 24PM / Shichijo Lettuce Group
- Melody! / R-Note (Yellow Zebra)

70070000035454.name: Ecchi Numbers: Second Edition
70070000035454.intro: Fill her grid and reveal the picture.
70070000035454.description:
Think you’ve got the skills to go all the way? Fill in the right positions and slowly clear away the puzzle—revealing more than just your brainpower.

Every number brings you closer to the full picture. Get it right, and you’ll uncover a beautiful picture waiting just beneath the surface... but one wrong move and you might just ruin the mood.

Features:
- 52 beautiful girls looking for company
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Take your time, plan your moves, and finish strong.

70070000035459.name: Cute Puppy Academy: Dream Island
70070000035459.intro: Run your own puppy academy and make every day special!
70070000035459.description:
Welcome two charming new companions to your academy! This bundle brings together two unique and lovable breeds, each full of personality, curiosity, and playful energy.

Train your adorable Beagle and clever Basenji as they learn new tricks and grow into happy, well-behaved pups. Keep them healthy and cheerful with regular feeding, grooming, and plenty of cuddles after a busy day of fun.

Head out on exciting walks through a vibrant park filled with mini-games, activities, and hidden surprises waiting to be discovered together.

As your academy continues to grow, expand it with new kennels, toys, and upgraded training areas to create the perfect environment for every puppy in your care.

This bundle includes two delightful DLCs:
Beagle Training Pack and Basenji Training Pack.

70070000035460.name: Cat & Friends Memory Fluffy Finders
70070000035460.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70070000035460.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 2 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70070000035461.name: Soapy Tales Cloud Nine Edition
70070000035461.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70070000035461.description:
Suddenly, you wake up as a ghost, with no memories. Your good and bad deed count is perfectly even, so you need to go back to Earth to earn your redemption. 
Rediscover your past life and relive touching memories while attending to family business.

Soapy Tales combines doing relaxing chores with elements of time and space management. Complete the tasks, upgrade your skills, and unveil the story of your life in the midst of pastel, soapy bubbles!

This bundle include Cloud Baby Blue DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- First-person point of view gameplay. 
- Cozy, nostalgic atmosphere.
- Relaxing music. 
- Skill tree and artifacts to unlock.

70070000035465.name: My Cozy Aquarium: Decorator Pack
70070000035465.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000035465.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle includes the Glowing Decoration, Antique Decoration and Prehistoric Decoration DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000035466.name: Brain Boost Buddies Mind-Speed Mayhem
70070000035466.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70070000035466.description:
In Brain Boost Buddies, kids can flip and match cute animal cards - from smiling puppies to fluffy bunnies - while training their memory and concentration skills.

Parents will love it too! The game helps develop focus, logic, and patience in a calm, positive way. Plus, players can easily choose the right difficulty level to make the challenge just right for every age.

This bundle includes the Covers Pack, Cards Pack 1 and Cards Pack 2 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Adorable animal cards that make learning fun
- Different difficulty levels for all ages
- Improves memory, focus, and attention skills
- Bright, colorful visuals designed for kids
- Relaxing and cheerful background music
- Perfect for family playtime and early learning

70070000035489.name: Bun Buns: Complete Edition
70070000035489.intro: Don’t let your buns hop out the basket! Drop, merge, and stack your pastries to bake the biggest, most delicious treat!
70070000035489.description:
Get ready to bake your heart out! Combine fluffy buns, watch them grow into mouth-watering pastries, and push your skills to the limit in this physics-based puzzle challenge.

Use clever power-ups to escape sticky situations and keep burnt dough under control. Timing and placement are everything! One wrong move, and your perfect bake could crumble!

Travel through charming bakeries, each bringing new twists and challenges to master. How big can your ultimate bun get?

Features:
- 4 maps with unique basket shapes
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode to bake together with friends!
- 18 new hairstyles, 4 outfits, 4 hats and 4 accessories!
- Handy power-ups to save your run!
- Fully customizable baker with cute outfits
- A warm and cozy aesthetic

Bake yourself a fresh high score!

70070000035495.name: Freaky Trip Ultra Extended
70070000035495.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000035495.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

This bundle includes the Cooking Pack, Camp Pack, Hobby Pack and Sports Pack DLCs.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000035499.name: 3-in-1 Animated Jigsaws Bundle
70070000035499.intro: Three video jigsaw puzzle games in one great value collection!
70070000035499.description:
Animated Jigsaws are short videos as jigsaw puzzles that reveal a moving image as they are pieced together. Play the jigsaw puzzles alone or team up with friends and finish them together!

The following three games are included, each with 10 video jigsaw puzzles.
* Beautiful Japanese Scenery
* Wild Animals
* Japanese Women

An easy-to-use interface such as separating edge and inner pieces makes solving puzzles fun and relaxing.

Features:
Three games in one bundle!
10 video jigsaw puzzles in each game, with 30 in total.
One secret puzzle in Japanese Women. Can you find it?
Solve puzzles with friends in multiplayer for up to 4 players
Easy-to-play traditional jigsaw puzzle
Selection of three background colors
3 sizes for each puzzle: 60, 240 and 240 pieces
Saves time spent completing each puzzle and each size
Separate edge and inner pieces
Each piece snaps into place for stress-free experience
Ability to snap individual pieces together
Save a puzzle half way and continue later
Selection of music to choose from

70070000035500.name: Jurassic Fossil & Mine Exploration Bundle
70070000035500.intro: 3 Massive Simulators. 1 Ultimate Bundle. Endless Progress.
70070000035500.description:
Get ready for the most addictive digging and mining collection on Nintendo Switch™ ! This action-packed bundle combines three powerful simulator adventures where every block broken, every fossil discovered, and every treasure unearthed brings you closer to greatness.

Start your journey beneath the sands of Egypt in an epic excavation adventure. Search ancient underground sites, uncover dinosaur fossils, restore legendary skeletons, upgrade professional tools, and reveal secrets buried for millions of years.

Enter the world of satisfying mining progression where every strike matters. Break through layers of stone, collect ores, gather rare minerals, sell your loot, and upgrade your machines to build a true mining empire. Relaxing, rewarding, and impossible to put down.

Descend into deep underground caverns full of gemstones, hidden riches, and valuable resources. Manage your earnings, improve scanners, strengthen tools, dig faster, go deeper, and become the ultimate treasure hunter.

Whether you love simulators, progression systems, relaxing gameplay, or rewarding upgrades — this bundle delivers hundreds of satisfying moments in one incredible package.

Why You’ll Love It:
- 3 complete simulator games in one bundle
- Mining, excavation, fossils, treasures, progression
- Huge upgrade systems and rewarding growth
- Relaxing yet addictive gameplay loops
- Perfect for handheld and TV play
- Endless digging, collecting, and discovery
- Great value with massive replayability

Dig deeper. Earn more. Discover everything. Become unstoppable.

70070000035526.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION
70070000035526.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

This bundle includes the main game of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World and four packs of additional content, plus a selection of items to help raise stronger monsters.

[Bundle Contents]
- DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World main game
- DLC 4-ITEM SET, which includes:
     - The Mega Mole Hole
     - Monster Marathons
     - Metallic Ring
     - Scout Run VIP Card
- "Way of the Wrangler" DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION Purchase Bonus, which includes:
     - 1x Necklace of Animation
     - 10x Beastie Bites
     - 10x Seeds of Skill
- 48 hours of early access

70070000035538.name: Red Wings: American Aces Bundle
70070000035538.intro: Prove yourself in exciting aerial battles and make a name for your squad as the best aces of WWI.
70070000035538.description:
Red Wings: American Aces Bundle grants you an access to a set of unique Heavy Metal and Legendary skins for several planes. 

 Red Wings: American Aces puts you in the pilot’s seat of a nostalgic, action-packed arcade shooter illustrated in a fun comic-book style with a gaming mode for every occasion—local or online, solo or multiplayer. Prove yourself in exciting aerial battles and make a name for your squad as the best aces of WWI!  

A Multiplayer Must-play

Do you believe in the strength of the squadron? Choose a map and game mode and gather your pilots to play in a team of up to five players against other squads in online multiplayer. Prefer flying solo and plucking others out of the sky? There’s game modes for that too! Compete with up to nine other pilots and fly to the top of the scoreboard. Local co-op is available for smaller fighter groups of one or two pilots for a much more ace-to-ace experience in various customizable game modes, including a campaign mode with 30 missions.

Become an Ace of the Sky

Rack up skill points for completed missions to upgrade your pilot progression skill tree and add to your arsenal. Strategize and rearrange your points depending on the mission and ensure you emerge from every dogfight victorious.

Rise to the Challenge

The clouds hide many dangers, there’s more than just enemy pilots waiting up there! Thunderstorms will blast your skill cooldowns, while sandstorms can make visibility spiral to near zero. To make things even more interesting, you’ll encounter other challenges such as missions where you’ll only be able to take out enemies with barrel rolls, planes that release a gas that will block your view when you least expect it, and more! 

Key Features:

- Fly online—Test your skills against a max of 9 other players in Last Man Standing, Score Battle, or Time Battle modes or gather your squad of up to 5 pilots and battle other squads in Elimination, Time Team Battle, or Score Team Battle modes
- Fly locally—Play custom games in 3 different modes (Score Battle, Time Battle, and Hide n’ Seek (2 players only)) solo against AI or against another player 
- Complete 30 missions in campaign mode—relive the aerial dogfights of WWI and encounter all manner of unexpected challenges (available in local co-op for 1-2 players)
- Upgrade your pilot progression skill tree—develop your pilot skills and rearrange points depending on the mission at hand
- Pilot 15 different warplanes, each with unique skins—stand out in the heat of battle with a plane your enemies won’t soon forget

70070000035565.name: Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER: Drift Master
70070000035565.intro: Take control of every drift and turn every race into a performance.
70070000035565.description:
Step into the world of high-speed racing and Japanese car culture fully prepared for the road ahead. This bundle gives you everything you need to begin your journey with a strong foundation, combining the complete game experience with an additional financial boost to help you progress faster from the very beginning.

What’s included:
1. Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER
Experience intense drifting, drag races, deep car customization, and challenging tracks inspired by Japanese car culture. Build your cars, refine your driving skills, and take on challenging tracks with more freedom and flexibility as you explore drifting and drag racing at its core.

2. Hashiriya Drifter-Car Racing,Drift,Drag REMASTER: Extra Funds
Receive an additional 200,000 in-game currency to accelerate your progression, upgrade faster, and build competitive cars early on.

Start stronger, progress faster, and enjoy the complete experience with a significant early advantage.

70070000035571.name: TCG Card Market Simulator: Market Control
70070000035571.intro: Build your shop, master the market, and grow your trading card empire.
70070000035571.description:
Step into the world of trading cards and grow your own successful shop. Build, manage, and expand your business by stocking booster packs, setting prices, customizing your store, and attracting collectors while adapting to the ever-changing TCG market.

Bundle Includes:
1. TCG Card Market Simulator – Take control of your card shop from the ground up. Manage inventory, open packs, organize tournaments, customize your store layout, hire staff, and follow market trends to develop a profitable and growing TCG business.

2. TCG Card Market Simulator: Exterior Customization – Enhance your store’s exterior with unique graffiti designs. Choose different styles to give your shop a distinctive identity and make it stand out to customers and passersby.

3. TCG Card Market Simulator: Balance Boost – Start with an additional 2,500 in-game cash to support your early progress. Invest in stock, expand your shop, and improve your strategy to grow faster.

Turn your small card shop into a thriving trading card destination and establish yourself as a top TCG entrepreneur.

70070000035577.name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories Drawing Pack
70070000035577.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000035577.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes Personal Boards 8 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000035579.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Lunar Edition
70070000035579.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000035581.name: Hentai Frames Eventful Evenings
70070000035581.description:
Enter Hentai Frames- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Frames offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This game includes the DLC Portraits Pack 3, which expands your puzzle collection with 6 new illustrations.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000035583.name: Ultimate Moto Bike Simulator: Special Edition
70070000035583.intro: Master each terrain, improve your handling, and push beyond every limit.
70070000035583.description:
Experience a  motocross journey that combines high-speed action, skill-based riding, and diverse environments into one cohesive and engaging package. This bundle challenges your reflexes as you navigate demanding tracks, adapt to different terrains, and improve with every ride.

Bundle includes:
1. Ultimate Moto Bike Simulator – a high-octane motocross game featuring realistic physics, multiple environments, challenging tracks, and progression systems that test your riding skills across forests, deserts, arctic zones, and beyond.
2. Ultimate Moto Bike Simulator: New Bike – Bike Stratos Strike is added to your garage, expanding your lineup of available rides and giving you an additional option to use across all terrains. If you have previously purchased Bike Stratos Strike separately, the equivalent value will be reimbursed.

Take on every track, refine your skills, and enjoy a more complete motocross experience with expanded content and greater freedom of choice.

70070000035587.name: ONLY UP! CARS: Rise & Climb
70070000035587.intro: Master every climb and push your limits beyond the edge.
70070000035587.description:
Start your journey with everything you need to climb higher and progress faster. This bundle brings together the core experience and an added resource boost designed to help you progress more smoothly right from the start. Build, upgrade, and push your limits while having extra support to unlock vehicles, improve performance, and take on more challenging vertical tracks with greater ease.

This bundle includes:
1. ONLY UP! CARS – Take on extreme vertical tracks, unlock and customize a variety of vehicles, and master realistic physics as you climb higher and higher.
2. ONLY UP! CARS: Bonus Coins – Receive 30,000 coins to unlock vehicles faster, apply upgrades, and enhance your progression from the start.

Gain a stronger foundation, accelerate your progress, and enjoy a more dynamic experience as you rise toward the top.

70070000035598.name: Pokémon™ Champions + Starter Pack
70070000035598.intro: Enjoy in-game extras with this Starter Pack bundle
70070000035598.description:
The Pokémon™ Champions + Starter Pack bundle* includes storage space for 50 additional Pokémon, 30 Teammate Tickets, and 50 Training Tickets. You’ll also get the “Battle! (Trainer Battle)” song featured in the Pokémon: Let’s Go, Pikachu! and Pokémon: Let’s Go, Eevee! games!

Battle for the title of Pokémon Champion in the city of Frontier!

Battle with Pokémon, including with Mega-Evolved Pokémon like Mega Dragonite, against other players in the Pokémon™ Champions game—one of the games used for official Pokémon Video Game Championship events! These single and double battles use familiar mechanics from previous Pokémon series games such as Pokémon types, Abilities, and moves, enabling the rich and varied battle strategies you may already know and love.

Compete online** in Ranked Battles against players from near and far, or try Casual Battles for some easygoing fun. You can also have Private Battles with just your friends and family***.

Recruit Pokémon to join your team and train them to hone their skills

Before you venture into the world of Pokémon battles, try finding Pokémon to fight alongside you! Once per day, you can recruit Pokémon on a trial basis and use them in battle to see if they’re a good fit for your style. Once you’ve found a match, use your in-game Victory Points (VP) to bring Pokémon on to your team permanently.

You can also use your VP to train the permanent members of your Pokémon squad. Hone their Attack, Defense, and other stats, and even alter their Abilities and moves to try out different strategies in battle!

Team up with partner Pokémon from other Pokémon series games with Pokémon HOME

Pokémon Champions will be compatible with Pokémon HOME****, the cloud service for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 and Nintendo Switch systems, and compatible mobile devices. That means, in addition to the Pokémon partners available in Pokémon Champions, you can also team up with certain Pokémon brought over from Pokémon GO and other games in the Pokémon RPG series. In fact, by storing a Chesnaught, Delphox, Greninja, or Eternal Flower Floette you befriended during the Pokémon Legends: Z-A game in Pokémon HOME and bringing them to Pokémon Champions as visitors, you can obtain their corresponding Mega Stones from your in-game mailbox in Pokémon Champions!

Download a free update for improved graphics on the Nintendo Switch 2 system

Get a free update with visual improvements for Pokémon Champions when playing on Nintendo Switch 2! An internet connection is required to download the update.

70070000035603.name: Idle Devils(Ultimate Edition)
70070000035603.intro: This version includes the base game of “Idle Devils” along with four DLCs featuring brand-new characters.
70070000035603.description:
Game Base:
Enter a chaotic world, collect demon girls, and build the strongest demon squad! As your power keeps growing every moment, are you ready to become the next Demon Lord?

Game Features:
  10 characters, 220 skills, 180 talents, over 400 pieces of equipment, and 200+ affixes. Plus endless stage challenges that never stop! 

  Idle gameplay: Enjoy a relaxing and casual idle experience that truly helps you unwind. Even when you're away, your demons keep fighting, making you stronger nonstop. 

  Rich loot system: In battle, defeating enemies gives you a chance to drop equipment. Gear varies in quality based on stage level and loot level. Higher-quality gear comes with more affixes, and you may even roll exclusive affixes to greatly boost your power! 
 

Please update the game to the latest version first. After installing the DLC, restart the game and complete her story missions to recruit her into your squad.

DLC 1:
 This is a warrior-type demon. Balanced in both offense and defense. She comes with brand-new skill trees and talent trees, and has the ability to weaken enemies.


DLC 2:
 This is a damage-dealing demon who excels at both charming enemies and using unique methods to heal allies. As for everything about her, you'll have to discover it yourself.


DLC 3:
 Samael, the “Angel of Death” in the heavens, has always been loyal. She follows divine will, bringing the dying to Heaven or Hell. One day, she encountered someone protected by “Divine Light” and failed to take their soul. Upon returning, she was harshly blamed by God. Even after telling the truth, she received no understanding—only harsher punishment. Her loyalty turned into anger, and when Lucifer rebelled, she raised the banner of defiance.

Samael’s skills are highly explosive. She burns her own life to convert it into attack power, using powerful execution abilities to send the dying straight to Hell.


DLC 4:
 As someone with immense power, she possesses deep wisdom and unique ideas. She begins to question God’s decisions and the workings of the world, standing equal to the heavens and the divine.

Lucifer’s abilities revolve around “Omnipotence.” Her skills and talents are truly unique, offering highly flexible and diverse combinations that allow her to handle any situation.

70070000035604.name: FATE: Reawakened - Prometheus Bundle
70070000035604.intro: Get the complete FATE: Reawakened experience, including the base game and its DLC!
70070000035604.description:
This Bundle Includes:

FATE: Reawakened

Reawaken the critically acclaimed FATE games like never before! Play all 4 classic dungeon crawler titles with enhanced graphics as you battle through challenging procedurally generated dungeons, learn powerful spells, and fish to your heart’s content. Your FATE awaits!


FATE: Reawakened – Prometheus DLC

Enter the portal to a lost realm enshrouded in eternal nightfall. This is Prometheus, a city once blessed by the gods but has now been all but abandoned by them. Battle through a new dungeon and corrupted marble face creatures born of the shadow and the god Erebos Reclaim the stolen Golden Flame— because in FATE, your journey never truly ends.

70070000035617.name: Fit My Cat Purrfect Rooms Edition
70070000035617.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000035617.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?
