Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

This bundle includes Rooms Pack 2 DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000035618.name: My Summer Drive: Survival Drive
70070000035618.intro: Manage resources, master mechanics, survive the wild.
70070000035618.description:
Step into a world where every decision matters, from building your vehicle piece by piece to managing survival in a vast rural landscape. This bundle is designed to give you a complete and enhanced starting experience, combining the core gameplay with an early advantage.

What the bundle includes:
1. My Summer Drive (Base Game) – Build your car from scratch, manage resources, and survive in a realistic environment where attention to detail and smart choices are essential.
2. My Summer Drive: Budget Boost (DLC) – Receive an additional 5,000$ to accelerate your progress, upgrade your vehicle faster, and improve your overall early-game experience.

Start your adventure with the right tools, a stronger foundation, and everything you need to shape your journey from the very beginning.

70070000035622.name: Neko Bento Ultimate Edition
70070000035622.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000035622.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes Homes Pack and New Levels 1 DLCs.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000035627.name: Subway Simulator - Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games: Underground Operator
70070000035627.intro: Maintain control, respect the schedule, and master each journey.
70070000035627.description:
Step into the underground world of Subway Simulator, where you take control of powerful trains, navigate complex routes, and build your career as a professional subway driver. Travel across multiple cities, explore a wide variety of stations, and progress through 100 levels with increasing difficulty as you refine your driving skills.

This bundle includes:
• Subway Simulator – Underground Train Ride Station Ultimate Driving Games - The core experience where you drive trains across 4 cities, choose from multiple available trains, and complete a wide range of routes while advancing through progressively challenging levels.
•  New Color Train Pack DLC - Express your creativity with a wide palette of vibrant colors. Customize your train to match your unique style and transform every journey into a visually striking ride through the underground world.
• Express Voyager Train DLC - Add a high-speed modern train designed for efficiency and performance, bringing new routes and more demanding driving scenarios.
• Urban Speed DLC - Hop into the driver’s seat of the Metroliner Express, a sleek and powerful train built for speed and smooth operation, enhancing your subway experience with improved performance and modern design.

An expanded collection of trains, customization options, and new driving experiences designed to enrich your journey through the underground world and provide more variety, depth, and progression as you build your career as a subway driver.

70070000035628.name: Hentai Session Ultimate Edition
70070000035628.intro: Relax and enjoy completing beautiful picture puzzles piece by piece.
70070000035628.description:
Welcome to Hentai Session, a relaxing puzzle experience full of color, style, and charm. Take your time to assemble vivid illustrations featuring elegant and expressive characters. Each completed puzzle unlocks a detailed image designed with care and creativity in your collection.


Enjoy the satisfying flow of gameplay, soft background music, and cozy atmosphere that make each session a moment of calm and focus. Whether you’re here to unwind or to challenge your observation skills, it’s the perfect way to relax and have fun.

This bundle include Portraits Pack 1, 2 and 3 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 puzzles to complete
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle assembly
- High-quality illustrations full of detail
- Gentle music and relaxing atmosphere
- Gallery mode to view completed works
- Perfect for a calm and focused gameplay session

70070000035629.name: Musical Vibes RX: Total Vibes Vol. 5
70070000035629.intro: Get ready to move with Musical Vibes RX, a new dance game you can play using Joy-Con™ controllers or your smartphone camera connected to your Nintendo Switch™ console!
70070000035629.description:
Musical Vibes RX: Total Vibes Vol. 5 includes the base game Musical Vibes RX and 7 additional songs, all previously released and now offered together at a lower price than if purchased separately.

Musical Vibes RX is the new version of Musical Vibes, the first-ever dance game to let players use the camera of their smartphone connected to a console. Originally released in June 2023, the original broke new ground, and now RX takes the experience even further!

Dance Hands-Free with Incredible Moves!
Groove to fantastic music and master exciting new dance moves with full-body tracking powered by advanced AI technology. Put the controller down, your smartphone camera does the tracking. Just follow the beat!

Track Your Progress
Stay motivated with the built-in calorie counter that provides an estimated calorie burn during your game session.

Included Songs (12)

"Velvet Nights" by Vénna — K-Pop

"Club Reverie" by Naya Luz Feat. J-Rhyme – R&B  

"Magnetic Pulse" by Vénna feat. Jinseo — K-Pop

"Pretty Boy" by Clara Solane — R&B

"Platinum Dreams" by NARAE SOLIS — K-Pop

"Champion Sound (Remix)" by SIZZLA feat. TURBULENCE — Dancehall

"Noche de Brillo" by LINA RIKO — Reggaeton

"Embrace Your Light" by NINA RAY — Pop

"Party" by FIVEEBEATZ — Amapiano

"Victory Lap" by Cipher Blaze feat Lila Brooks — Hip Hop

"Queen Of The Night" by Elara Mae - K-Pop

"Lost and Found" by Lyra Rin - K-Pop

More tracks are planned for future updates! 

Multiplayer Fun
• Up to 4 players can join the fun with Joy-Con™ controllers.
• Up to 2 players can dance together using smartphone camera tracking.

Customize Your Experience
Personalize your avatar with fun outfits and choose from a variety of vibrant venues to match your style and mood!

Enhance Your Dance Floor
Own a Philips Hue smart lighting system? Connect it to transform your space into a dazzling concert venue with lights that react to the music!

More Than Dance
Feeling less energetic? Switch to Rhythm Game Mode, where you can press the correct direction on your controller in time with the beat—perfect for playing on the go!

Exciting Updates to Come!
Stay tuned for more tracks and features coming soon.

70070000035655.name: Ecchi Oppai: Fearless Edition
70070000035655.intro: Think you've got an eye for oppai?
70070000035655.description:
Meet cute girls who need your help finding their hearts. Think fast and don't get distracted, or you'll lose them forever.

Choose from a selection of pictures and help these girls find what they're looking for. If you're good enough, you'll even get a reward.

Features:
- Over 185 pictures of girls who need your help
- Local multiplayer mode for you and your friends
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Can you find your way into their hearts?

70070000035661.name: My Cozy Room Cozy Living Pack
70070000035661.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000035661.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes the Cottagecore, Mediterranean, and Chic DLCs.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000035673.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition
70070000035673.description:
Pre-Orders‡ of EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition will include:

- Up to 7 days Early Access
- Season 1 Premium Pass
- Career Dynamic OVR Pre-season Boost

Ultimate Edition also features:
- 6,000 FC Points over 3 months††
- FUT™ Player Evo slot
- 5 Manager Live Challenge Creation Slots
- 5-Star Senior Scout in Manager Career

Plus all Standard Edition Career and The Grounds‡‡ content.

†† You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by August 1, 2027 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 26, 2027, you will not receive any FC Points.

‡‡The Grounds mode, including Clubs, only available on Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.

70070000035705.name: Recycling Station Simulator: Eco Operations
70070000035705.intro: Build, manage, and expand your recycling operation.
70070000035705.description:
Step into the world of recycling management and start building your own industrial empire. From scavenging raw materials to running a fully optimized recycling station, this bundle provides a smoother and more dynamic start to your journey.

What’s included in the bundle:
1. Recycling Station Simulator (Base Games) - Step into the role of an entrepreneur and build a recycling business from the ground up. Manage equipment, hire workers, negotiate contracts, and make strategic financial decisions to grow your operation into a full-scale industrial empire.

2. Recycling Station Simulator: Budget Booster (DLC) - This DLC adds 5000 in-game currency to help you kickstart and expand your recycling operations. Gain extra funds to invest in equipment, hire workers, upgrade your base, and accelerate your progress as you grow your business.

Build smarter, grow faster, and turn a small operation into a thriving enterprise!

70070000035708.name: Club Sports Collection Definitive Edition
70070000035708.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000035708.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch™!
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #2, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #3 and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #4 with:

- 15 brand-new dart designs

70070000035711.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Ultra Edition
70070000035711.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000035711.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #2, Custom Cruisers #4 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-3 new skins for each Buggy

70070000035717.name: Hentai Vision Ultimate Edition
70070000035717.description:
Enter Hentai Vision - a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Vision offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This game includes Portraits Pack 1, Portraits Pack 2, and Portraits Pack 3 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000035718.name: Piano: Learn and Play Grand Edition
70070000035718.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000035718.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes 5 DLCs containing new songs.

Key Features:
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000035720.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Definitive Edition
70070000035720.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000035720.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Expansion Pack #3 and Expansion Pack #4 with:
10 new queues
10 new pool table designs
15 new snooker table designs

70070000035722.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Quest Edition
70070000035722.intro: Your train crashed! Find your friends and rebuild your home!
70070000035722.description:
Your friends are scattered across the city, and the rail network is in pieces! Draw colored tracks, reconnect the railroads, and guide trains back to their stations to find your lost buddies and bring everyone home.

With each rescue, your hometown slowly recovers, but the puzzles get trickier. Tunnels, crossroads, and clever obstacles will test your logic and creativity as you invent new routes, solve mind-bending challenges, and restore order to the railways.

Features:
- 1000+ handcrafted logic puzzles!
- 60 extra-large levels full of challenges!
- Tricky mechanics like gates, crossroads, and obstacles.
- Multiple solutions that reward creative thinking!
- Optional hints to help you through tougher levels.
- A beautiful city full of life waiting to be restored!

Choo Choo! Next station is never-ending fun!

70070000035725.name: Tank vs Tank Discovery Edition
70070000035725.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000035725.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint #3 and War Paint #4 with:

-8 unique tank skins and 8 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000035727.name: Feathered Adventurer Edition
70070000035727.description: The Feathered Adventurer Edition includes The Day I Became a Bird, as well as the OST and Art book.

70070000035729.name: Ship of Fools - Completely Foolish Edition
70070000035729.description:
The Completely Foolish Edition of Ship of Fools contains the Base Game, as well as all released Fool Packs. Bursting at the hulls with fun (and Fools) it's the pinnacle of co-op seafaring excellence.

The Completely Foolish Edition contains:

Ship of Fools Base Game
Deep Sea Duo Pack
Water Garden Duo Pack
Golden Bay Duo Pack
Thunder Tide Duo Pack

70070000035734.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack
70070000035734.intro: Flex your skills to the banging tunes in our Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack!
70070000035734.description:
Featuring SIX new Rhythm Rifts by Kawai Sprite:
- "Blammed"
- "Stress"
- "Darnell"
- "Ugh"
- "Senpai"

As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift: 
- "Dad Battle"

Each Friday Night Funkin' Rhythm Rift features:
- One half of the world's greatest couple AKA Girlfriend OR Boyfriend
- Background visualizer with custom particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

70070000035741.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection Season 4
70070000035741.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection + Summer 2 + Independence Day + Christmas 2 + Autumn 2

70070000035750.name: "GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS" + "Touhou Project Arrangements Music Pack" Set
70070000035750.intro: A bundle that lets you purchase “GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS” and the DLC “Touhou Project Arrangements Music Pack” together.
70070000035750.description:
This bundle includes the following main game and DLC.

"GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS"
■An Overwhelming Fusion of Music and Visuals
Groove Coaster is a rhythm game where you play along while racing down tracks that twist and turn to the music.

With dynamic sound and light effects, you’ll feel completely immersed—as if you’ve stepped into a world of music and are performing right inside it!

■Enhanced Visuals
For the first time in the series, the gameplay screen features a full horizontal layout, letting the world of music fill your entire view!

Visual expression has been greatly improved, and some songs even include scenes using the original music videos!

■Two Play Styles to Choose From
You can select from two different play styles to match your skill level!
Basic: Enjoy the game casually with four types of notes—perfect for beginners.
Advanced: Challenge yourself with nine types of notes—ideal for rhythm game veterans and fans of the classic series who want a deeper, more rewarding experience!

■Fully Voiced "Story Mode" Featuring a Star-Studded Cast
For the first time in the series, enjoy a luxurious, fully voiced Story Mode!

Centered around two protagonists, Sendou Kakeru and Himekawa Aria, a rich cast of characters—including classmates, teachers, and rivals from other schools—join the story.

The journey begins as they aim for victory in the "Groove Coaster" tournament, a futuristic sport where players perform while racing along the tracks...

Main Characters
- Sendou Kakeru(Voice: Kawashima Reiji/ Theme Song Artist: Somari)
- Himekawa Aria(Voice: Sakura Ayane/ Theme Song Artist: 40mP)
- Fwuff (Voice: Shirakami Fubuki / Theme Song Artist: NayutalieN)
- Sharsha (Voice: Sakura Miko / Theme Song Artist: Satsuki & Karasuyasabou)

■Includes Many Popular Songs from Anime, Vocaloid, and More!
In addition to original tracks, the game features a wide variety of popular songs from various genres!
- Idol / YOASOBI
- Bling-Bang-Bang-Born / Creepy Nuts
- Hai Yorokonde / Kocchi no Kento
- BOW AND ARROW / Yonezu Kenshi
- Demons Banquet / Tomonari Sora
- Good-Bye Declaration / Chinozo
- KING / Kanaria
- Mesmerizer / Satsuki
- God-ish / PinocchioP
- Lagtrain / inabakumori
- Override / Yoshida Yasei
- ROKI / Mikito P
- Kyu-kurarin / Iyowa
- Bibbidiba / Hoshimachi Suisei
- Catcher in the Ui / Shigure Ui
- Heart Pie Dancehall / HIMEHINA
…and many other popular songs included!


"Touhou Project Arrangements Music Pack"
This DLC adds 6 popular Touhou Project arrangement songs.

This pack includes the following content.
■ Songs (6 tracks)
- March of the Broken Doll / Girls Logic Observatory
- Marisa Stole the Precious Thing / ARM(IOSYS)
- Guru ☆ Nation / Shinra-Bansho
- Help me, ERINNNNNN!! / beatMARIO
- Scream out! / A-One
- Necromantic / Akatsuki Records

All songs can be enjoyed immediately in "Performance" mode once the DLC is installed, and some tracks will also be added as challenge songs to certain stages in "Story" mode.

Now, let’s ride the groove of the future!

70070000035753.name: Cooking Arena Legendary Edition
70070000035753.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000035753.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon", "Food Truck Tycoon Asian Cuisine" and "Breakfast Bar Tycoon".

70070000035762.name: Urban Flow Add-on Edition
70070000035762.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000035762.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Streets Supplement #2 and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    New challenge mode offers medals - no more star system in challenge mode! You have to pass the challenge bar to pass the challenge mode stages.
•    20 new stages!
•    10 new vehicles

70070000035767.name: Knights & Guns Pro Edition
70070000035767.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000035767.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1,  Armor Pack #2 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 8 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000035768.name: Paint For Kids Little Artist Edition
70070000035768.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000035768.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones. 

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes Additional Board 1 DLC.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use

70070000035775.name: Outbreak Zombie Survival Collection
70070000035775.intro: Four worlds. One goal: survive the end.
70070000035775.description:
Survive across four intense worlds where danger never stops.
Fight, explore, and endure in a complete survival action collection.

The Outbreak Zombie Survival Collection brings together four action-packed experiences combining FPS combat, zombie survival, and sci-fi challenges into one bundle.

From deep space missions to infected cities and relentless zombie attacks, every game tests your skills, reflexes, and ability to stay alive under pressure.

Travel to Mars and face hostile environments in Mission Mars, where survival depends on exploration and endurance.

Enter a collapsing city in OUTBREAK FALL: BIOHAZARD, a fast-paced first-person shooter filled with aggressive infected enemies and constant danger.

Hold your ground in Zombie Gorge: Survival Defense, defending against waves of relentless attackers in a high-pressure survival scenario.

Fight through chaos in Liquidation Zombie Apocalypse, where action and survival collide in a world overrun by the undead.

Each game delivers a unique survival experience with different gameplay styles, environments, and challenges.

• Four full games in one bundle
• FPS combat, defense gameplay, and survival mechanics
• Zombie outbreaks and sci-fi environments
• Constant action and escalating threats
• Optimized performance for Nintendo Switch™

No matter the world…
survival is never guaranteed.

70070000035798.name: Softly Placed Special Edition
70070000035798.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70070000035798.description:
Step into the world, where mundane tasks turn into little adventures and ordinary items provide so much joy. See everything around you in bright, new, vibrant colors and make things even more beautiful by adding fun patterns. Wake up your inner child and find the happiness in little things.
 
Each level of the game consists of a unique challenge, providing fresh, yet relaxing gameplay, that will make you curious for what’s coming next.  

This bundle includes the Cats Pack and Fantasy Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
-40 unique cozy puzzle levels
-Gameplay consisting of different types of challenges
-Beautiful, vibrant visuals, where everyday items turn into something magical
-Relaxing, cheerful soundtrack 
-Inspiring, nostalgic atmosphere
-Variety of puzzles exercising different parts of the brain

70070000035802.name: My Little Haven Special Edition
70070000035802.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70070000035802.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

This bundle includes Art Pack and Pets Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70070000035803.name: Cozy Land Extended Edition
70070000035803.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000035803.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

This bundle includes the Ice Age, Wild West Set 1 and 2, Zombie, and Science and Fantasy Set 1 and 2 DLCs.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000035807.name: Memory For Kids Card Mania Edition
70070000035807.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000035807.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes Back Cards DLC.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels

70070000035821.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Aviation Control
70070000035821.intro: Take off with ambition and transform into a global aviation leader!
70070000035821.description:
Take control of a small airline company and transform it into a global cargo empire. Begin with modest resources, pilot a variety of aircraft, manage your business strategically, and navigate through dynamic weather conditions across multiple airports around the world.

Bundle Includes:
1. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business - Experience a detailed aviation and business simulation where you build and expand your own cargo airline. Manage hangars, upgrade aircraft, and complete diverse delivery missions ranging from routine shipments to high-value cargo.

2. Flight Simulator Delivery – Business Expansion - This DLC grants you your first hangar to kickstart your operations. If all hangars are already owned, you will receive in-game currency instead, allowing you to invest in aircraft upgrades, expand your cargo capacity, or develop your business further.

3. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business - Powerlift Cargo - This DLC enables you to handle larger and heavier deliveries, increasing your operational capabilities. If you already own the aircraft, you will receive in-game currency compensation to continue expanding and upgrading your fleet.

Build, upgrade, and manage your way to success as you take your aviation business to new heights.

70070000035877.name: Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner: Extreme Driving
70070000035877.intro: Master every terrain and push your driving skills to the limit.
70070000035877.description:
Take your off-road experience further with this bundle designed to enhance progression, improve performance, and give you more control over every journey. Prepare to face challenging terrain with better tools and greater flexibility.

What’s included:
1. Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner
Step into a realistic off-road driving experience where you’ll navigate harsh environments, from muddy swamps to dense forests. Choose powerful 4x4 vehicles, upgrade their performance, and test your driving skills across demanding terrains and dynamic conditions. Complete missions, overcome obstacles, and push your limits as you explore increasingly difficult routes.

2. Mudness Offroad Car Simulator Runner: Financial Boost
This DLC adds 100,000 silver to your account. Use it to purchase new vehicles, upgrade existing ones, and improve your performance to better handle tough terrain and challenging missions.

With stronger vehicles and extra resources, you’re better equipped to explore, upgrade, and take on increasingly demanding off-road challenges.

70070000035885.name: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Trilogy
70070000035885.intro: Face your fear. Uncover the truth. Complete the nightmare.
70070000035885.description: The True Fear: Forsaken Souls Trilogy bundle brings together all three chapters of the acclaimed psychological horror saga - an unforgettable journey through mystery, trauma, and the darkness that hides in plain sight.

70070000035886.name: Noir Crime Bundle – Mafia, Mystery & Investigation
70070000035886.intro: Play both sides of the crime world.
70070000035886.description:
Explore a world of crime, investigation, and high-risk decisions. This bundle delivers two unique experiences set in a noir atmosphere where every move affects how events unfold. You move between investigation and criminal activity, exploring environments filled with hidden details, dangerous characters, and situations that require both strategy and quick thinking.  Each game offers its own perspective, allowing you to experience both sides of a world driven by power, control, and survival.

1. Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator
Take on the role of a detective investigating a complex case in a city filled with corruption and hidden agendas. Search for clues, explore detailed locations, and uncover information that others are trying to keep hidden. Use your tools to analyze evidence and unlock new paths while moving carefully through environments where danger is always close. Your decisions influence how the story develops, affecting characters, relationships, and the final outcome. Every choice shapes your path and determines how the truth is revealed.

2. Noir Mafia Simulator: 1960s American Crime
Step into the criminal underworld and take part in high-risk operations across multiple locations. Plan your approach, choose how to execute each job, and adapt to situations that can quickly change. Each mission requires awareness and control, whether you move quietly or take a more direct approach. Handle unexpected challenges, avoid law enforcement, and build your reputation as you progress through increasingly demanding scenarios. 

From uncovering hidden truths to taking control of dangerous operations, this bundle offers a complete experience across two different paths. Noir Crime Bundle – Mafia, Mystery & Investigation delivers a mix of strategy, action, and decision-making in a world where every move matters.

70070000035887.name: Food And Hotel Simulator Bundle: Road Cafe & Motel Business & Street Food
70070000035887.intro: Start playing and gain business experience in various fields. Learn as you go, and don’t be afraid to make mistakes. It will help you in the future!
70070000035887.description:
Motel Business Simulator
Welcome guests from all walks of life and make your motel the talk of the town. From cozy rooms to irresistible amenities, create a memorable stay that keeps travelers coming back for more. Make it stylish, make it special - watch your reputation grow!
Step into the shoes of a Motel manager and master every aspect of hospitality. Balance front desk service, housekeeping, and guest satisfaction while upgrading your property. You'll need to think fast and plan smart to stay ahead of the competition.
Motel Business Simulator is a management game where you run and grow a roadside motel. Maintain rooms, cater to guests' needs, and manage your supplies to keep operations running smoothly and costs low.

Street Food Restaurant Owner
You don't need Mishelin Star to create the best restaurant in the world. Who says street food can't be delicious? 
Open a real street food restaurant in your city and make it a legend. It's all for your beloved customers and let everyone come and find something tasty. Make this place trendy and watch your business grow! 
Take on the role of a street food entrepreneur and master the art of food preparation, customer service and efficient management. From sourcing fresh ingredients to designing workflows. You'll need strategic planning and quick decision-making to grow your business and keep your customers happy.
Street Food Restaurant Owner is a cooking game that puts you in charge of a street food cafe. Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, and manage your ingredients wisely to avoid waste. 
Your reputation is everything - manage your food stall, serve delicious meals and impress customers to build your brand. Every satisfied customer boosts your reputation and unlocks upgrades and new recipes. But beware - one mistake can ruin your reputation.

Road Cafe Simulator
Help tired travelers and create for them the most cozy tourist restaurant. Let every stop at your establishment become a real feast! 
In Road Cafe Simulator puts you right in the middle of the action in the role of a roadside cafe owner. Start your own road cafe, serve appetizing dishes and turn your humble stall into the hottest hotspot in town. It's all about great food, satisfied customers and growing your business.
Master the art of cooking, customer service and efficient café management. Purchase the freshest ingredients, create well-oiled workflows and make quick strategic decisions to keep orders flowing and customers coming back.
Every dish you serve and every customer you impress builds your reputation. But be careful - one misstep can cost you everything. Modernize your kitchen, discover new recipes and turn your sidewalk café into a local legend. The road to success is hot - are you ready to take the heat?

70070000035893.name: Escape the Backrooms: BODYCAM – Survival
70070000035893.intro: Stay aware, because the darkness is never truly empty.
70070000035893.description:
Face pure terror in an endless maze where reality twists and danger hides in every corner. In a world where nothing feels stable, survival depends on awareness, quick reactions, and the ability to adapt to constantly changing environments.

What’s included in this bundle:
1. Escape the Backrooms: BODYCAM
Experience intense psychological horror through a bodycam perspective that enhances immersion and tension. Navigate shifting levels, face lethal and unpredictable enemies, and rely on your instincts to stay alive.

2. Escape the Backrooms: BODYCAM – Eternal Flashlight
In your inventory, a flashlight with infinite battery life will be added. If a flashlight is already owned, it will automatically be upgraded to use an unlimited power source, ensuring continuous lighting.

Every step forward can lead to discovery—or to something far more dangerous. Are you ready to face what lies in the dark?

70070000035900.name: Prison Life Sim 2025 - Survival: Advanced Edition
70070000035900.intro: Balance risk, build influence, and endure the pressure.
70070000035900.description:
Step into a experience that combines the base game and additional cosmetic content designed to enhance your journey from the start. Progress through challenging environments, manage your resources, and make strategic choices as you develop your path forward.

What’s included:
1. Prison Life Sim 2025 - Survival
A realistic first-person simulation where you experience the challenges of prison life. Manage resources, interact with inmates and guards, take on missions, engage in stealth and combat mechanics, and adapt to a strict system where every decision can impact your survival and progression

2. Prison Life Sim 2025 - Survival: Character Style
A visual customization add-on that enhances your character’s appearance with painted nails. This cosmetic feature adds a subtle but distinctive detail, allowing you to personalize your character.

Experience a deeper sense of immersion as you progress, make decisions that shape your path, and refine your character’s presence while adapting to the challenges ahead.

70070000035905.name: Build A Queen: Pirate Edition
70070000035905.intro: Showcase your looks on the catwalk and compete in thrilling fashion battles!
70070000035905.description:
Step into the world of glamour and style with Build A Queen! The ultimate fashion game where you can become a doll maker and create your dream queen!

Become a virtual fashion designer and let your creativity shine! Choose your model and dive into a project makeover. Design everything: from stunning hairstyles and flawless makeup to the hottest outfits and fabulous accessories! This is your chance to build a sweet doll with your unique style.

Features:
- Build YOUR Queen: shape your characters body with stunning or monstrous makeover choices!
- Dress to impress: customize hairstyles, makeup, outfits, and accessories.
- Get a boyfriend: outstyle your rival and win his heart!
- Walk the runway: showcase your look in fashion battles and catwalk challenges.
- 2 new victory dances: Celebrate your win with Gagnam Style and Robot Moves!
- New boyfriend skin: Turn your boyfriend into a Pirate - true king of the seas!

Will you make the right choices to win and become the ultimate Fashion Queen?

70070000035909.name: Fight For America: Zap Edition
70070000035909.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000035909.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- New weapons: Unleash the ultimate energy with the Zap Gun!
- Extra coins: Boost your campaign with 4000 coins to upgrade your weapons, turrets, and base
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000035912.name: Kanjozoku 2 – Drift Car Games: Drift Legends
70070000035912.intro: Perfect your drift, dominate rivals, own the road.
70070000035912.description:
Step into the ultimate world of street racing and feel the thrill of high-speed drifting! This bundle gives you everything you need to become a true master of the Kanjo streets.

Bundle Includes:
1. Kanjozoku 2 – Drift Car Games (Base Game)
Explore the underground streets inspired by the 90s Osaka racing scene. Drive authentic JDM cars, fully customize them—from engine and suspension to body and vinyls—and master drifting on every corner.

2. Kanjozoku 2 - Drift Car Games: Money Boost (DLC)
Kickstart your progress with 250,000 in-game resources, giving you the freedom to upgrade and tune your cars faster. Enhance performance, fine-tune your ride, and stay ahead of every rival from the very start.

Take control of the streets, push your cars to their limits, and experience the ultimate thrill of high-speed racing like never before.

70070000035918.name: Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter — Shadow Warfare
70070000035918.intro: Darkness is just the beginning. How far will you go to stay alive?
70070000035918.description:
The apocalypse doesn’t wait — and neither should you. This bundle brings together the complete Warzone Chronicles experience, combining the base game with two atmospheric DLC packs that push the tension even further.

Bundle Includes:
1. Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter
Fight for your life in an abandoned building overrun by relentless waves of the undead. Uncover hidden weapons, manage scarce resources, and survive as long as you can — all wrapped in a gritty, VHS-soaked atmosphere that makes every moment feel raw and desperate.

2. Warzone Chronicles: Interior Essentials Pack
The building you thought you knew just got more dangerous. New furniture, objects, and interior details reshape the battlefield, forcing you to rethink your routes, your cover, and your survival strategy from the ground up.

3. Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter - Haunted Interiors
The ruins now carry the weight of everything that happened here. Disturbing new layers of décor — scattered remnants, damaged details, haunting traces of chaos — make every room feel heavier and every hallway feel like a trap.

One abandoned building. How long can you last?

70070000035924.name: Viking Colony Builder Valhalla: Age of Glory
70070000035924.intro: Conquer lands, build empires, and write your own saga.
70070000035924.description:
Lead your Viking clan to glory with everything you need to build, expand, and conquer from the very first moment. This bundle combines the full game experience with a golden advantage that sets you apart from the very start.

This bundle includes:
1. Viking Colony Builder Valhalla - Build and expand your Viking settlement, trade with rival clans, defend your colony, and lead your warriors into epic battles. Hunt, gather, raid, and conquer as you forge your legacy and guide your people toward prosperity and greatness.

2. Viking Colony Builder Valhalla: Golden Start - At the beginning of every new game, 150 gold coins are added to your treasury. Invest in equipment, construct key buildings sooner, and strengthen your colony before the first threats arrive — giving you the edge your rivals never had.

Your Viking saga begins stronger than ever. The gold is ready. The glory awaits.

70070000035927.name: Arcade Pack
70070000035927.description:
Jump into classic arcade-style action with the Arcade Pack, a collection of three exciting games inspired by retro machines and fast-paced gameplay. Test your reflexes, aim, and control skills across space battles, air hockey duels, and precision landings.

Air Hockey

Experience the fast and competitive fun of air hockey. Slide the puck across the table, block incoming shots, and score goals against your opponent in quick, high-speed matches. Easy to play, but hard to master.

Alien Invasion

Defend against waves of attacking aliens in this 3D space shooter inspired by classic arcade invader games. Move, aim, and fire as enemies descend from space. Each level gets faster and more intense, pushing your reaction speed to the limit.

Moon Lander

Take control of a landing craft and carefully guide it to the surface of the moon. Use precise thrust and timing to land safely without crashing. Balance speed, fuel, and control to complete each mission successfully.

Three arcade challenges in one pack means triple the action and endless replay fun.
The Arcade 3 Pack is perfect for players who love classic gameplay, quick rounds, and high-score challenges.

70070000035928.name: Sports Games
70070000035928.description:
Get ready for nonstop action with the Ultimate Sports Games pack, featuring three exciting games that bring competition, skill, and fun together in one bundle. Whether you love team sports or fast reflex challenges, this pack has something for everyone.

Baseball

Step up to the plate and experience the thrill of baseball. Pitch, hit, and run your way to victory as you compete in fast-paced matches that test your timing and precision. Perfect for players who enjoy strategy and teamwork.
 
Soccer

Feel the energy of the world’s most popular sport. Pass, shoot, and score amazing goals as you take control of your team and compete in exciting soccer matches. Quick thinking and good coordination will help you lead your team to win.

Table Tennis

Challenge your reflexes with the speed and excitement of table tennis. React fast, aim carefully, and outplay your opponent in intense rallies. This game is perfect for players who love quick action and skill-based competition.
All three games in one pack means more fun, more challenges, and more ways to play.
The Ultimate Sports Game Pack is perfect for friends, family, or anyone who loves sports and competition.

70070000035929.name: Love Too Easily Bundle
70070000035929.intro: This bundle lets play both title 'Love Too Easily' and 'Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha' of the interactive romantic comedy series 'Love Too Easily'.
70070000035929.description:
<Love Too Easily>

In Love Too Easily, the main character wakes up with only a partial memory of her night out with friends. Her hangover has left many memories blank, but she knows someone has kissed her! But who…?

Interact with the story by helping the main character make choices, complete tasks in the form of mini-games, and most importantly, find hints about the night out.


[Synopsis]
Just when the main character, Yeonwoo, is getting tired of ambiguous flirts and lukewarm romances, she finds herself waking up to a romantic mystery, the memory of a kiss, but not much more. Who was it, and what else happened last night?

The kiss was good, and Yeonwoo is feeling love-stuck. The problem is that she doesn't know who she kissed. She’s itching to figure it out.

Meet up with the three guys from the night before to get clues.
The romance outcome of Yeonwoo depends on your choices and detective work.

[A story made with your own choices]
Where to go, who to talk to, how to answer, etc., all determine how the story progresses including the hints you can collect.
Depending on how specific the hint is, the success of your reasoning of the situation is determined and can have a significant impact on the ending.
The process of trying to find out who she kissed will change each time you play.
Experience all 11 main endings and other hidden endings!


[Well-timed clicks will have different results]
Watch out for the quick time event (QTE) button appearing in the game!
Each QTE will have a different result depending on your success or failure. A different video sequence will follow depending on the results.


[Mini-games that flow with the story]
Enjoy mini-games that are relevant to the main character and the progress of the story.
The clues obtained when finishing a mini-game can be used later on and might have an impact on the hidden ending.



[You're the one I kissed last night!]
As you overcome the obstacles and complications in figuring out who you’ve kissed, put together the info you have and make a final verdict on which boy it was. Use your reasoning to prove it!

Will Yeonwoo be able to find out who she actually kissed, and will that get her to the ending she wants?

<Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha>

[Story]

"That night… did we just clink our glasses?"

You were living the life of an ordinary delivery man, and one day you get scammed by your only friend and end up taking over a failing, debt-ridden Pocha.

Wait... but why are there so many pretty girls at this Pocha?!


[About]

A story shaped entirely by your choices, 'Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha' is an FMV simulation game where the story unfolds in a Pocha with five attractive girls.

Become the owner of a Pocha and win over the affection of the girls you like to find your true love!

Pick the right choices to raise affection levels, and show your feelings with thoughtful gifts!

[Characters]

Five girls, each with her own charm and personality!

Who will you choose?

●Adorable Pocha part-timer: Choi Sol (Lee Heeru)

Overflowing with cuteness—the bright and bubbly mascot of the Pocha!

“Good morning, boss!”

●Pocha regular/writer: Anna (Shin Jiwon/Johyun)

Professional and elegant… yet secretly a goofy heavy drinker!

“Can you be the main character of my story?”


●Heartwarming first love classmate: Sarang (Yang Seul)

A first love with its secret innocence..!
“How.. have you been? Finally, we meet again..”


●Famous streamer: Gain (Oh Yeonha)

Bright, bubbly, and impossible to ignore on camera!
“Then let’s drop the formalities—call me your girl, oppa~”


●Proud indie band singer: Nana (Eun Daha)

Cool, sharp, and fiercely independent—like a desert fox.
“What..? So?”

70070000035938.name: Hentai Portrait Ultimate Edition
70070000035938.description:
Enter Hentai Portrait- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Portrait offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This game includes the DLC Portraits Pack 1, Portraits Pack 2 and Portraits Pack 3, which expands your puzzle collection with 6 new illustrations.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000035953.name: Cop Car Police Simulator Chase - Car games simulator & driving: Duty Officer
70070000035953.intro: Officer, patrol, and protect: the streets are in your hands.
70070000035953.description:
The city never sleeps — and neither does the job. Pursue suspects on foot or by car with lights flashing and sirens blaring, investigate crime scenes, interrogate witnesses, and collect crucial evidence.

Bundle Includes:
1. Cop Car Police Simulator Chase - Car games simulator & driving
Step into the uniform of a US police officer and take on the streets of a large, living city. Record traffic accidents, chase suspects, arrest criminals, investigate crime scenes, and keep your district safe. Get behind the wheel of three realistically recreated police vehicles, respond to emergencies, and enforce the law — one shift at a time.

2. Cop Car Police Simulator Chase: Capital Boost
Hit the streets with 10,000 already loaded onto your balance. Invest in your career, unlock new opportunities, and get ahead faster — because the best officers always come prepared.

One officer. One mission. The city needs you.

70070000035957.name: Synth Riders: Complete Music Collection
70070000035957.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future with 81 amazing songs!
70070000035957.description:
Play all night with the Complete Collection including Synth Riders and all music packs, featuring hits from Lady Gaga, Dua Lipa, Gorillaz, and more!

Save big on base game including 28 songs and 53 add-on songs. Upcoming add-ons not included.

THIS EDITION INCLUDES THE FOLLOWING ITEMS:
• Synth Riders - base game
• Dua Lipa Music Pack
• Lady Gaga Music Pack
• Gorillaz Music Pack
• Crypt of the NecroDancer Music Pack
• Current Waves Music Pack
• 80s Mixtape Side A Music Pack
• 80s Mixtape Side B Music Pack
• Synthwave Essentials 3 Music Pack
• Monstercat Music Pack

70070000035961.name: Synth Riders + Crypt of the NecroDancer Music Pack
70070000035961.intro: Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future with 33 amazing songs!
70070000035961.description:
Save by purchasing this bundle including Synth Riders and Crypt of the NecroDancer Music Pack!

THIS EDITION FEATURES:
• Synth Riders - base game (28 tracks)
• Danny Baranowsky - "Disco Descent"
• Danny Baranowsky - "Konga Conga Kappa"
• Danny Baranowsky - "Rhythmortis"
• Danny Baranowsky - "Fungal Funk"
• Danny Baranowsky - "Styx and Stones"

70070000035967.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000035967.description:
This product is a bundle that includes the FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE base game along with the Magitek & Grimoire Deluxe Pack, which contains an item that transforms your chocobo's appearance into magitek armor, an item exclusive to this pack that unlocks a certain character's Fel Meteor Limit Burst, and useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.

Digital Deluxe Edition Contents:   
▼ FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Base Game  
▼ Magitek & Grimoire Deluxe Pack  
　 Pack Contents: 
　 • Magitek Armor Key x1 
　 • Archwitch’s Grimoire x1 
　 • Mastery Ring x1 
　 • Tent x5 
　 • Mist Potion x5 
　 • Mist Ether x5 
　 • Phoenix Down x5 
　 • Remedy x3 

*After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. 
*The chocobo’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Armor Key “ON” under the Items section of the main menu.

70070000035984.name: Subway Simulator 2025 - City Train: Urban Ride
70070000035984.intro: Command the trains, serve the passengers, and keep the city moving.
70070000035984.description:
The city runs on precision, dedication, and the steady hand of a skilled operator. From peak-hour pressure to peaceful midnight journeys, every second demands precision, patience, and absolute control.

This bundle includes:
1. Subway Simulator 2025 - City Train
Take your place in the operator’s seat and guide the lifeline of the city through an ever-evolving underground network. Feel the rumble beneath the rails as you navigate an ever-evolving urban network.

2. Subway Simulator 2025 - City Train: New Style (DLC)
A bold visual upgrade that transforms the appearance of the train benches into a bold, striking red that stands out against the familiar underground backdrop.

The city is waiting. The cabin is ready. Journey begins!

70070000035987.name: Bowling Fever Ultra Edition
70070000035987.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000035987.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-30 new bowling ball styles

70070000035997.name: Cottonville Fashion Vibes Edition
70070000035997.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000035997.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes High Couture Outfits Pack and Japan 90s Outfits Pack DLCs.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000035999.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Definitive Edition
70070000035999.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000035999.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

9 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000036004.name: The Treflik Family Cozy Stories Pack
70070000036004.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000036004.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes two additional episodes: "Happy Family" and "A Visit".

70070000036005.name: Football Legends 2025 Platinium Edition
70070000036005.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70070000036005.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

This bundle includes base game, Team Pack #1 and Team Pack #3 with:
- 6 new teams

70070000036012.name: Hidden in my Paradise + Hidden around the World Bundle
70070000036012.intro: Two cozy hidden-object adventures with decoration where you can create & share your own levels online.
70070000036012.description:
Hidden in my Paradise

Hidden in My Paradise is a cozy hidden-object and decoration game where creativity and discovery go hand in hand. Explore charming scenes, find hidden objects, and arrange them to create your own little paradises.

Help Laly and her fairy companion Coronya complete relaxing missions, decorate beautiful locations, and share your creations with players around the world.

Hidden around the World

In Hidden Around the World, Laly and Coronya embark on a new adventure across famous cities inspired by real places. Explore hand-drawn locations, find hidden objects, complete cozy missions, and decorate charming scenes.

Create your own levels, share them online, and play creations made by other players as you travel the world one cozy destination at a time.

70070000036020.name: Primitive Life Simulator: Prehistoric Journey
70070000036020.intro: Build shelters, gather resources, and guide your tribe to safety.
70070000036020.description:
Discover prehistoric life and prepare your tribe for survival! This bundle lets you experience the adventure of early human life while giving your tribe a strategic advantage to grow faster and face the challenges of the wild.

This bundle includes:
1. Primitive Life Simulator (Game) – Travel back in time and experience life in humanity’s earliest days. Hunt, gather resources, build shelters, and develop your tribe to survive the wild. Explore the environment, discover rare resources, and adapt to changing climates to ensure the prosperity of your community.

2. Primitive Life Simulator: Survival Boost (DLC) – Receive extra resources to help your tribe grow faster and overcome challenges more easily. This DLC provides a strategic advantage to strengthen your position in the prehistoric world.

Prepare your tribe, explore the wild, and become a true leader!

70070000036026.name: Moto Rush GT Pro Edition
70070000036026.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000036026.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 4 new motorbikes (each with special colors)
- New colors for the rest of motorbikes
- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- 8 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000036032.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Add-on Edition
70070000036032.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Neon Strike and Expansion Pack #2 with:

• With the Expansion Pack you can fight and survive the zombie apocalypse in a brand new game mode!

Unlock 3 powerful weapons to use them in the DLC and base game to improve your scores.
Play new maps or revisit old ones with new weapons.
Fill your gallery and cabinet with new models and medals.

• Want some more reliable and tested guns for your collection? With this expansion, you'll get: 
- SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
- UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
- SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000036033.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Definitive Edition
70070000036033.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000036033.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #2, Pizza Bar Tycoon Multiplayer Mode and Food Truck Tycoon New Levels #1 with:

- 20 new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon
- 45 new levels for Food Truck Tycoon
- local multiplayer gameplay mode for Pizza Bar Tycoon

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000036036.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Elite Edition
70070000036036.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000036036.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

-3 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000036038.name: Retro Collection: 3 in 1
70070000036038.intro: Three timeless classics. Endless retro fun.
70070000036038.description:
Retro Collection: 3 in 1 brings together three iconic puzzle and arcade experiences in one nostalgic bundle: Minesweeper Classic, Lines 98 Classic, and Mr. Stackman.

Challenge your logic in Minesweeper, where every move counts as you uncover tiles and avoid hidden mines. Plan ahead in Lines 98 Classic, aligning colored balls to clear the board and chase high scores. Test your timing and precision in Mr. Stackman, stacking blocks higher and higher without letting them fall.

With simple controls, clean visuals, and instantly recognizable gameplay, this collection delivers pure, pick-up-and-play fun. Whether you're solving, matching, or stacking, each game offers quick sessions and addictive replayability.

Rediscover the golden age of casual gaming - three classics, one bundle, endless challenges.

70070000036040.name: CybeRage: Shock & Thunder Edition
70070000036040.intro: Survive endless waves of alien creatures and crush the heart of the infestation!
70070000036040.description:
"Phy embarks on a secret mission to an abandoned planet infested by a hostile hivemind. With the help of her partner Lizz and General Eral, she dives into the depths of the infestation and learns the dark truth behind its origins. Help her find the heart of the hive and put an end to this evergrowing threat.
