Kill hordes of nasty bugs and use the experience gained to strengthen your arsenal and body with cybernetic enchantments. The hive will adapt and send more powerful enemies to stand in your way. Shoot them down with your army of drones, or slash them to pieces with your blade and stop the hivemind from growing even stronger!

Features:
- Engaging story: Accompany Phy in her quest against the hive
- Side stories: Explore 2 new metro lines and discover unique locations
- Immersive world: Experience 29 hand-crafted cyberpunk levels
- High-tech arsenal: 12 fighter drones to upgrade and evolve
- Melee weapons: 7 powerful swords with unique active abilities
- Rogue-lite progression: Unlockable permanent augments
- Contracts: Complete tasks to earn credits

Will you help Phy defeat the hive and save the cyber age from impending doom?"

70070000036041.name: Sayonara Wild Hearts + Lorelei and the Laser Eyes Bundle
70070000036041.intro: Save on these great games from Simogo when you purchase the bundle!
70070000036041.description:
Sayonara Wild Hearts is a dreamy arcade game about riding motorcycles, skateboarding, dance battling, shooting lasers, wielding swords, and breaking hearts at 200 mph.

A woman, summoned by an eccentric man to participate in a project in an old hotel somewhere in central Europe, becomes embroiled in a game of illusions, increasingly dangerous and surreal in Lorelei and the Laser Eyes.

70070000036042.name: Simulator Mega Pack – Fishing, Soldier, Bear, Shark & Truck Mechanic
70070000036042.description:
Five different worlds. Five completely different experiences. One bundle.

Step into a variety of roles and explore gameplay that ranges from calm and relaxing to intense and action-driven. Whether you're deep underwater, out in the wild, on a mission, or working hands-on with machines, each game offers its own pace, challenges, and style.

Switch between survival, strategy, and skill-based gameplay as you explore environments, complete tasks, and improve your abilities. Every experience brings something new, keeping gameplay varied and engaging across all five titles.

What’s included in the bundle:


1. Shark Simulator: Ocean Predator Survival
 Control a powerful ocean predator, hunt for survival, and explore a dynamic underwater world.

2. Fishing Pro Simulator
 Enjoy a more relaxed pace while exploring different fishing locations and improving your technique.

3. Bear Simulator: Ragnarok’s Rise Survival
 Survive in the wild, explore nature, and adapt to environmental challenges.

4. USA Army Soldier Simulator
Step into military training and build the skills needed for real combat situations. Take on missions that test your focus, precision, and ability to react under pressure as you progress and improve with every task.

5. Truck Mechanic Sim 2025
 Repair, upgrade, and restore vehicles while handling detailed mechanical tasks.

From action and survival to exploration and hands-on work, this bundle brings together multiple styles of gameplay in one place.

Simulator Mega Pack – Fishing, Soldier, Bear, Shark & Truck Mechanic offers variety, progression, and different ways to play, all in a single package.

70070000036043.name: Snooker Fever Super Edition
70070000036043.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000036043.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

- 10 stunning new table designs
- 5 sleek cue styles

70070000036046.name: Magic Cats Pots Summer Porcelain
70070000036046.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This bundle includes Summer DLC.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000036047.name: Pocket Nook Adventures Edition
70070000036047.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000036047.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

This bundle includes Summer Tiki Party and Fantasy DLCs.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000036048.name: Cozy Tiny Home Cat Collection 2
70070000036048.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000036048.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes Cat Pack 2 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000036052.name: Cozy Gardener Simulator: Bloom & Glow
70070000036052.intro: Create a world where flowers, friends, and fun bloom together.
70070000036052.description:
Step into a world full of charm, warmth, and cozy adventures. Care for your town, nurture beautiful gardens, and enjoy relaxing.T his bundle brings what you need to make your gardening experience truly special.

Bundle includes:
1. Cozy Gardener Simulator - Grow vegetables and flowers in your very own garden, tend flower beds, and keep the town beautiful. Help townsfolk with small requests, build friendships, and discover heartwarming stories Enjoy a peaceful, stress-free gardening experience filled with simple joys.

2. Cozy Gardener Simulator: Bloom Hammer - Transform your trusted Hammer into a unique golden-colored tool skin Add elegance and warmth to every gardening task, from mowing lawns to caring for flowers.

Make your garden shine, every task feel special, and your town more beautiful than ever.

70070000036056.name: Gladiators Simulator : The Champions of Liberty – Rise to Legend
70070000036056.intro: Train your gladiators, equip them with powerful gear, and rise to legend.
70070000036056.description:
Step into the fierce world of ancient Rome, where gladiators fight for survival and freedom, and the crowd demands blood and glory. Experience the intensity of the arena, managing your fighters and making strategic choices to rise through the ranks.

This bundle includes:
Gladiators Simulator : The Champions of Liberty
Train your gladiators, face rival fighters and deadly beasts, and lead them to victory in epic battles. Upgrade weapons, armor, and skills to dominate the arena and earn the crowd’s admiration.

Gladiators Simulator : The Champions of Liberty – Coins of Glory
Receive 2500 coins to instantly strengthen your champions and enhance your arena. Equip your fighters with better gear and prepare for even greater challenges.

Every battle and every coin brings you closer to legend, forging champions whose names will echo through the sands of the arena.

70070000036061.name: Instant Family Fun Bundle
70070000036061.description:
INSTANT SPORTS All-Stars

In INSTANT SPORTS All-Stars, you can play a variety of feel-good activities directly inspired by All-American favorite sports! 

• Experience America through 8 sports and activities... Baseball, American soccer, hockey, basketball, bowling, shooting and soccer... And don't forget the Burger Tower! Try to be the best on every fields!
• 3 environments - the warm atmosphere of a stadium, the energy of the city and the heat of western... - to triple your enjoyment! Travel without even getting off your couch... but still get some "exercise"! 
• 24 ways to extend the fun! Specific rules for each activity in each environment make every single sport session a real discovery! 
• Dream up to 4 players: INSTANT SPORTS All-Stars is extremely easy to play with simplified controls or even motion controls on Nintendo Switch™. From your little brother to your grandmother to your friends, everyone can play INSTANT SPORTS All-Stars and have INSTANT fun! 
• A ton of collectibles to customize your character: hats, tops, bottoms and more... No room for fashion faux pas!

INSTANT Chef Party

No matter if you like French, Italian or Mexican cuisine, cook your way up to the top! In INSTANT Chef Party, you will have to compete with up to 4 players in a series of mini-games themed around food and cook. Be ready to enjoy serving, cooking, harvesting, doing dish-washing and many more activities in coop or versus your friends & family!

And guess what..? No cooking skills are required... except, maybe, for toasting marshmallows!

• Salty or Sweety? Choose between our 2 mouth-watering boards to start your gaming session !
• Select your avatar among 6 budding cooks : Maï, Luc, Giovanni, Sidney, Pedro & Sarah ! And don’t let the chef’s hat impress you!
• Roll the - spicy, hopeless, salty,… - dices and move forward or…not! Our whimsical dices might provoke some unwanted reactions!
• Challenge up to 4 buddies in user-friendly and funny various mini-games thanks to the motion-gaming technology!
• "Chance" cards, “coop” or “one versus all” mode ... everything is here to spice up your game!
• Be the fastest, be the most skillful ... but to be the Star of our Show, you’ll have to finish first to our run, in INSTANT Chef Party!

70070000036062.name: Maximum Sports Gold Collection
70070000036062.description:
34 Sports Games - World Edition 

34 Sports Games – World Edition is the ultimate game that brings together 34 different sports in one game! Challenge your family or friends and may the best player win!

100 in 1 Game Collection

100 in 1 Game Collection is a gigantic compilation of 100 arcade games that blend classic arcade games with fresh concepts. Score as much as you can, then improve and challenge yourself to get all stars in solo or with your friends! 

30 Sports Games in 1

Discover a multitude of games: whether you love football, basketball, archery, or even bowling, you'll find all your favorite sports here!
Travel around the globe! You can go ski jumping on desert dunes, engage in boxing matches in the middle of a volcano, or kayak through caves.

70070000036065.name: inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000036065.description:
inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy, narrative-driven slice-of-life game with light simulation elements, centered on human connection and everyday moments.

Play as Makoto Hayakawa, a college student spending her summer behind the counter of a small-town convenience store, in a colorful world inspired by early 1990s Japan.

Your days are shaped by simple, tactile actions. You stock shelves, tidy displays, and prepare the store for customers, not to optimize numbers, but to settle into a comforting rhythm. Between tasks, you explore the store and its surroundings, notice tiny details, and connect with regulars whose lives gently intertwine with yours.

Through branching conversations and meaningful choices, your interactions shape relationships and reveal intimate stories of a close-knit neighborhood.

Key Features
A Cozy, Routine-Driven Store Experience

Engage in light storekeeping activities like stocking items, organizing shelves, and ordering goods. These moments create a calming flow that supports exploration and storytelling rather than complex management.

Narrative Focused Interactions
Experience branching dialogue and meaningful choices as you learn about the lives, routines, and secrets of your customers.

Nostalgic Early 1990s Atmosphere
Immerse yourself in a Japan-inspired setting with soft visuals, warm lighting, and lovingly crafted details that evoke comfort and familiarity.

Capsule Toy Surprises
Collect and discover charming capsule toys from the store’s gachapon machine. Each capsule holds a small surprise, adding moments of delight and curiosity to your daily routine and inviting you to uncover every little treasure inside.

Soothing ASMR Inspired Soundscape
Enjoy a peaceful ASMR-like soundscape filled with subtle everyday sounds that enhance relaxation and presence.

The Yojoki Masters Supporters Pack DLC contains:

• Three new costumes for Makoto (Matcha, Assam, Darjeeling)
• Yojoki Masters Manga (can be read inside the game)

70070000036098.name: Spy Guy Hidden Objects Poland
70070000036098.intro: Discover puzzles and hidden objects on maps of Poland!
70070000036098.description:
Explore Poland with Spy Guy as you search for hidden objects!
Spy Guy travels the length and breadth of Poland. He’ll visit many Polish cities, such as Gdańsk, Poznań, and Sopot, and explore the entire Polish coastline along the Baltic Sea. 
Over 600 hidden objects await you, with 120 levels on each map and 3 game modes.

70070000036100.name: Oblivion Dreams: Pathways Edition
70070000036100.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000036100.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 64 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.

70070000036115.name: Mini Market Design Chalkboard Chic
70070000036115.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000036115.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes School, Furniture Material Collection 3 and Furniture Material Collection 4 DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000036116.name: Pets and Friends Cuties Bundle
70070000036116.intro: Create your dream sticker album with an extra set of cozy cuties.
70070000036116.description: Discover the amazing world of animals, flowers and cozy objects with which to create an amazing sticker album. Plus, you'll learn interesting facts about animals, put together puzzles and exercise your brain with the Memory game. The set additionally includes a pack of new cuties to add variety to your album.

70070000036117.name: Cozy Memory Big Dreamers Pack
70070000036117.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000036117.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes the Covers Pack, Cards Pack 1, Cards Pack 2 and Cards Pack 3 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000036119.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Master Edition
70070000036119.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000036119.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #3, Custom Cruisers #4 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-3 new skins for each Buggy

70070000036121.name: My Cozy Aquarium: Prehistoric Extended Pack
70070000036121.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000036121.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle includes the Prehistoric Fish Pack & Aquarium DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000036122.name: Spy Guy Memory Abstraction Bundle
70070000036122.description: A classic memory game with a fun twist! Try your hand at it and keep your eyes peeled! How good is your memory? Test yourself in our game!

70070000036125.name: Club Sports Collection Elite Edition
70070000036125.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000036125.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #1, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #3 and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #4 with:

- 15 brand-new dart designs

70070000036126.name: Tank vs Tank Elite Edition
70070000036126.intro: Battle of the Tanks: Aim, Ready.... Fire!
70070000036126.description:
Enter the battlefield in "Tank vs Tank", an explosive clash of steel titans. 

This isn't just a game; it's war. Life and death hang in the balance, demanding your full attention. Every decision, from the drive to the deadly aim, could mean the difference between victory and defeat. Outwit, outshout, and outlast your opponents to ensure it's them, not you, who bite the dust.

Your choices are crucial - every move, every shot counts towards victory or defeat.

Enhance your tank with cutting-edge upgrades and face off against cunning opponents.

Use the vast arsenal at your disposal, make each shot your path to glory.

Ready your cannon, refine your tactics, and enter the battle. 

Victory awaits the bold – are you prepared to claim it?


This bundle includes base game, War Paint #1, War Paint #3 and War Paint #4 with:

-12 unique tank skins and 12 country flags, allowing you to customize your armored vehicles.

70070000036128.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Elite Edition
70070000036128.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000036128.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #3 and Expansion Pack #4 with:
5 new queues
15 new pool table designs
15 new snooker table designs

70070000036132.name: Yojoki Masters Supporters Pack
70070000036132.intro: The Yojoki Masters Supporters Pack DLC contains:
70070000036132.description:
• Three new costumes for Makoto (Matcha, Assam, Darjeeling)
• Yojoki Masters Manga (can be read inside the game)

70070000036133.name: Zombie Defense: Emerald Edition
70070000036133.intro: Reinforce the barricades, pick up a weapon and destroy the approaching wave of zombies!
70070000036133.description:
Hundreds of hungry zombies are coming for you... Fortify and expand your base, upgrade your weapons and build more turrets because the battle for survival has just begun!

This bundle includes:
- Zombie Defense
- Zombie Defense: Flamethrower
- Zombie Defense: Laser Katana
- Zombie Defense: Banana
- Zombie Defense: Thunder Hammer

Discover new zones, expand your base, try out various types of weapons, place traps or even jump into the tank and sweep the zombies out of your sight with a cannon to secure your base!

Features:
- Armored yellow worrior skin, which gives you +5% to damage and +5% to fire rate
- Blue warrior skin, which gives you +10% to movement speed
- Monkey skin, which gives you +10% to fire rate
- Wonderful female skin, which gives you +10% to damage
- new powerful weapons: Flamethrower, Laser Katana, Banana and Thunder Hammer
- 1000 additional gems to spend on weapons, upgrades and skins
- extreme zombie waves
- various locations with new bases to expand
- large selection of short- and long-range weapons
- co-operative multiplayer mode for two players
- zombies with different abilities
- bosses among the horde
- weapon, turret, character, drone, trap and barricade upgrades
- combat drone
- character skins
- bonus Arena level, where the longer you survive, the bigger the rewards you get!
- endless game mode, where you can shoot as many zombies as you want

Unlock a combat drone that will help you deal with the horde or invite your friend to play in co-op multiplayer mode! Work together to defeat different types of zombies, from those that explode or spit acid to the ones that can freeze you!

If you want to take on a bigger challenge then jump into the endless mode where the zombie waves never end!

Don't wait, run and shoot! Otherwise you will become one of them...

70070000036146.name: Brain Boost Buddies Focus Frenzy
70070000036146.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70070000036146.description:
In Brain Boost Buddies, kids can flip and match cute animal cards - from smiling puppies to fluffy bunnies - while training their memory and concentration skills.


Parents will love it too! The game helps develop focus, logic, and patience in a calm, positive way. Plus, players can easily choose the right difficulty level to make the challenge just right for every age.

This bundle includes Card Pack 3 DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Adorable animal cards that make learning fun
- Different difficulty levels for all ages
- Improves memory, focus, and attention skills
- Bright, colorful visuals designed for kids
- Relaxing and cheerful background music
- Perfect for family playtime and early learning

70070000036152.name: Pirate Simulator – Corsair Skull & Sails: Sea Adventure
70070000036152.intro: Lead, fight, survive, and write your own pirate saga.
70070000036152.description:
Your crew faces ancient curses, deadly rivals, and relentless battles—but now your legend grows stronger. Every voyage becomes unforgettable as your ship reflects your crew’s legacy, combining epic story, brutal combat, and stunning visual style in this bundle.

This bundle includes:
1. Pirate Simulator – Corsair Skull & Sails (Full Game) – Experience the epic story, naval and on-foot combat, unique sea charts, and challenging encounters.

2. Pirate Simulator – Corsair Skull & Sails: Elite Crew (DLC) – Customize your ship with vibrant colors and ornate decorations, making every battle and voyage a statement of prestige.

Set sail, customize your ship, and prove your crew’s legend on every wave. The seas await your command—will you rise as the ultimate captain?

70070000036154.name: Freaky Trip Tidy Time
70070000036154.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000036154.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

This bundle includes Cleaning Pack DLC.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000036157.name: Soapy Tales Mint Dreams Edition
70070000036157.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70070000036157.description:
Suddenly, you wake up as a ghost, with no memories. Your good and bad deed count is perfectly even, so you need to go back to Earth to earn your redemption. 
Rediscover your past life and relive touching memories while attending to family business.

Soapy Tales combines doing relaxing chores with elements of time and space management. Complete the tasks, upgrade your skills, and unveil the story of your life in the midst of pastel, soapy bubbles!

This bundle include Mint And Chocolate Bars DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- First-person point of view gameplay. 
- Cozy, nostalgic atmosphere.
- Relaxing music. 
- Skill tree and artifacts to unlock.

70070000036158.name: Cat & Friends Memory Velvet Varmint
70070000036158.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70070000036158.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.

This bundle includes Back Cards and Cards Pack 2 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70070000036162.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Season 4
70070000036162.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number + Landscapes 2 + Under The Sea 2 + Flowers and Butterflies 2 + Landscapes 3

70070000036164.name: Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor: Dawn of Titans
70070000036164.intro: Survive, evolve, and rise as the ultimate predator in a world ruled by dinosaurs.
70070000036164.description:
Thrive in a prehistoric adventure where every decision shapes your destiny. Face ancient challenges, evolve your dinosaurs, and conquer the wild.

This bundle includes:
1. Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor – Explore 10 immersive chapters, survive in dynamic biomes, and lead iconic dinosaurs from Compsognathus to Tyrannosaurus Rex. Customize, upgrade, and thrive in the prehistoric world!

2. Dinosaur RPG - Dino Survival Simulator Survivor: Survivor’s Treasure - Receive 1,000,000 bones and 10,000 gold to supercharge your evolution, unlock premium upgrades, and dominate the ancient lands.

Unearth ancient mysteries, conquer epic challenges, and rise as the ultimate predator in this evolution experience!

70070000036168.name: SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off – Kelp City Bundle
70070000036168.intro: This bundle includes the full SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off base game plus the new Kelp City DLC, bringing together the complete fast-paced cooking game
70070000036168.description:
Flip patties, serve hungry customers, and get cooking with SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off – Kelp City Bundle!

This bundle includes the full SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off base game plus the new Kelp City DLC, bringing together the complete fast-paced cooking and restaurant time-management experience in one delicious package!

Cook your way through iconic locations from the SpongeBob universe as you grill Krabby Patties, prepare tasty dishes, and race against the clock to keep customers happy. With the new Kelp City DLC, your cooking adventure expands beyond Bikini Bottom with new restaurants, new challenges, and new characters to serve.

Whether you're a fan of cooking games, restaurant simulators, or chaotic time-management gameplay, this bundle is the best way to experience SpongeBob’s ultimate cooking adventure.

What’s Included in the Bundle

SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off (Base Game)

Jump into a fast-paced restaurant cooking game set in the world of SpongeBob SquarePants.

Cook and serve delicious dishes across Bikini Bottom

Master time-management cooking gameplay

Upgrade and customize your kitchen equipment

Serve familiar characters from the SpongeBob universe

New Kelp City DLC

Take the culinary chaos to the big city!

The new Kelp City DLC expands your adventure with new locations, new challenges, and even more cooking action.

Explore the restaurants of Kelp City

Meet new customers and characters

Tackle fresh cooking challenges and recipes

Expand your restaurant management adventure

Why Get the Bundle?

The complete SpongeBob cooking game experience

Includes base game + Kelp City DLC

Perfect for fans of cooking games and restaurant simulators

Grab your spatula, fire up the grill, and start serving the hungriest customers under the sea in SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off – Kelp City Bundle!

70070000036169.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - DeathShroud Edition
70070000036169.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000036169.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - DeathShroud DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS A LEGENDARY BOXER
Receive the legendary DeathShroud with his unique equipment and a bonus of 21500 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2 allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000036171.name: Candivity: Snow & Sand Edition
70070000036171.intro: Don't let the sweets get outside the dome. Merge them together, and make the biggest candy!
70070000036171.description:
You're about to dive into a sugary adventure! Combine sweets, and prepare yourself for a sugar overload!

This bundle includes:
- Candivity
- Candivity: Under Water DLC
- Candivity: North Pole DLC

NEW VERSUS MODE!
Race to merge the biggest candy while using clever tactics to slow down your opponent. Unleash tricky power-ups, and prove who’s the ultimate candy master!

Gather extraordinary powers that can save you from any sticky situation. Mix them up, and you might create something even more powerful!

Journey through worlds full of surprises. Each has its own set of challenges. Can you master them all and merge the largest sweet?

Features:
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode for you and your friend!
- Versus mode to sabotage your friends!
- 4 maps: Under Water, North Pole and 2 standard maps
- New animal characters and accessories
- Fully customizable name and character
- Awesome, game-changing power-ups!
- An adorably sweet aesthetic

Sweeten your day with a new high score!

70070000036177.name: Unboxing: Cozy Home Simulator Deluxe Edition
70070000036177.description:
Step into a world of warmth and comfort in Unboxing Cozy Home Simulator, where every corner reflects your style and personality. Unpack, organize, and decorate your dream home with soft, inviting touches — from fluffy couches and plush rugs to candles, plants, and cozy blankets. Create spaces for relaxation, reflection, or intimate gatherings, and watch your home come alive with personality and charm.

This bundle includes the main title and the Design Pack DLC, offering a variety of stylish new furniture and decor items to elevate every room. From trendy accessories to cozy essentials, this DLC helps you perfect your home and add personal touches that make every space even more inviting. Transform your home into the ultimate retreat, where comfort and creativity meet seamlessly.

Relax, design, and enjoy the ultimate cozy home experience.

70070000036192.name: Firefighter:Car Fire Truck Sim Driving 2022 Simulator: Firehouse Challenge
70070000036192.intro: Step into the firetruck, respond to emergencies, and save every life.
70070000036192.description:
Step into the high-stakes world of firefighting, where every second counts and every decision can save lives. With this bundle, you’ll not only face thrilling missions but also gain the resources to enhance your firehouse, upgrade your gear, and take your firefighting career to the next level.

This bundle includes:
1. Firefighter: Car Fire Truck Sim Driving 2022 Simulator – Experience the adrenaline of responding to emergencies across a bustling city, from industrial zones to suburban neighborhoods. Drive realistic fire trucks, navigate challenging streets, and use authentic firefighting equipment to battle intense fires.

2. Firefighter:Car Fire Truck Sim Driving 2022 Simulator: Rescue Funds – Adds 50,000 to your balance for upgrading equipment, improving your firehouse, and boosting your firefighting skills. Be prepared for every emergency and tackle missions more effectively.

Gear up, jump into the driver’s seat, and experience the ultimate firefighting adventure where every call counts and every mission can make the difference between disaster and survival!

70070000036208.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Tactical Assault
70070000036208.intro: Take command of elite forces and dominate every hostile encounter.
70070000036208.description:
Step into the world of high-stakes tactical operations and experience the ultimate SWAT missions! Take command of your elite team, navigate intense firefights, and save hostages in critical situations. Every decision, every shot, and every maneuver counts as you prove your skills under pressure.

Bundle Includes:
1. Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions (Full Game) – Lead your squad of specialists, strategize your approach, and tackle high-risk operations with precision and courage. Immerse yourself in first-person action and become the hero every mission needs.

2. Advanced Scope (DLC) – Upgrade your Automatic Rifle III with the Sight 2 scope for sharper accuracy, faster target acquisition, and greater control in the heat of combat. Take on hostile environments with confidence and precision.

3. Combat Gloves (DLC) – Equip the exclusive Skin 6 tactical gloves, showcasing elite skill and tactical superiority. Already own the gloves? Receive $2,500 in in-game currency to enhance your arsenal and stay mission-ready.

Command your team, upgrade your gear, and face the most dangerous operations with confidence. Master every challenge and prove that when the stakes are highest, you are the one they call.

70070000036226.name: Neko Bento Sashimi Edition
70070000036226.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000036226.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes Backgrounds Pack DLC.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000036228.name: Hentai Frames Ultimate Edition
70070000036228.description:
Enter Hentai Frames- a refined puzzle experience where sensual art meets serene gameplay. Uncover stunning portraits of feminine allure, each crafted with emotion, elegance, and vivid detail. As you assemble each image, you reveal not just a masterpiece, but a moment of quiet admiration.


Soft background music and a soothing atmosphere turn every moment into quiet focus and satisfaction. Whether you’re looking to unwind or simply admire the art you complete, Hentai Frames offers a peaceful escape into a world of charm and creativity.

This bundle includes the Portraits Pack 1, Portraits Pack 2 and Portraits Pack 3 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Over 30 beautiful images to discover and assemble
- Smooth, intuitive puzzle system - focus on the art, not the mechanics
- High-quality visuals rich in color, emotion, and detail
- Relaxing background music that sets a calm, immersive mood
- Gallery mode - revisit and admire your completed artworks anytime
- Perfect for quiet, focused sessions of visual satisfaction

70070000036229.name: The Smurfs Little Artist Edition
70070000036229.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000036229.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 7 and Personal Boards 8 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000036230.name: Fit My Cat Ultra Special Edition
70070000036230.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000036230.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

This bundle includes Rooms Pack 1 and Rooms Pack 2 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000036231.name: My Cozy Room Pet Lovers Pack
70070000036231.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000036231.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes the Cats and Dogs DLCs.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000036236.name: Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator: Summer Challenges
70070000036236.intro: Master survival and explore hidden corners of your village.
70070000036236.description:
Step into the serene life of a Scandinavian village and embrace the challenges of summer. Expand your crafting, improve your village, and enjoy extra challenges that make summer life in the countryside even more rewarding.

Bundle Includes:
1. Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator (Base Game) - Build cozy huts, craft essential tools, hunt and fish for food, and manage your character’s needs. Complete quests, interact with locals, and master the daily rhythms of village life as you explore forests, lakes, and fields in a fully interactive open world.

2. Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator: Bonus Funds (DLC) - Boost your village life with $5000 in bonus funds. This bonus gives you the freedom to enjoy the full Nordic summer experience while mastering survival and completing quests.

Create, explore, and survive. The Nordic countryside is yours to master this summer.

70070000036240.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Infection Protocol
70070000036240.intro: Inspect, decide, and survive in a world on the brink of collapse.
70070000036240.description:
As the outbreak spreads beyond containment, every decision at the border becomes critical. Take full control of a high-risk border zone in a world on the brink of a zombie outbreak — now with an enhanced visual atmosphere that transforms every moment of your duty.

Bundle Includes:
1. Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
Take command of a critical border checkpoint in a world overwhelmed by a zombie outbreak. Inspect incoming civilians, identify infections, and make fast, life-or-death decisions to keep the zone under control.

2. Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Visual Horizon
Change the entire mood of the quarantine zone with an exclusive skybox. This visual upgrade adds a new atmospheric layer that makes every shift at the checkpoint feel more intense and immersive.

Stay in control. Trust your judgment. Experience the quarantine like never before.

70070000036243.name: CARD SHOP GAME STORE - TCG SIMULATOR: Trading Experience
70070000036243.intro: Build your store, grow your business, and shape your trading empire.
70070000036243.description:
Step into the world of trading cards and build your own successful business from the ground up — now with a unique visual upgrade that gives your shop a true street identity. Grow your business into the ultimate destination for card game fans — all while your shop stands out with bold graffiti-inspired visuals.

This bundle includes:
1. CARD SHOP GAME STORE - TCG SIMULATOR
Buy rare packs, open boosters, negotiate with customers, and develop your store into a paradise for collectors and trading card game enthusiasts.

2. CARD SHOP GAME STORE - TCG SIMULATOR: Urban Style
This DLC adds a bold graffiti to the building, making your store more distinctive and visually appealing.

Make your store legendary in the world of trading cards.

70070000036245.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Frontline Strike
70070000036245.intro: Gear up, take the frontline, and show that every mission is yours to win.
70070000036245.description:
Prepare for intense action and tactical battles, where every decision, shot, and movement can decide the outcome. Experience fast-paced combat, team-based strategy, and high-stakes missions like never before.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter: Engage in fast-paced tactical combat, earn points, and lead your squad to victory. Master diverse maps, choose from a massive arsenal, and test your tactical skills in every high-stakes mission.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands: Change the appearance of your hands and gloves to a sleek, military-inspired green for ultimate immersion.

Face the chaos, outsmart your enemies, and rise as the ultimate operative.

70070000036249.name: Planet of Lana II - Supporter Edition
70070000036249.description:
Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey with Lana and her loyal companion Mui.

Planet of Lana II Supporter Edition Includes

Planet of Lana II
As greed and power divide the tribes of their home planet, Lana and her little companion, Mui, must stand together against the forces reshaping their world – struggling not just for survival, but for the soul of their home.

Planet of Lana II Supporter Pack
The Planet of LanaII Supporter Pack lets you step deeper into Lana and Mui’s world. Enjoy a digital art book and the Novo Language Companion, a guide to the game’s language.

70070000036264.name: Cooking Arena Discovery Edition
70070000036264.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000036264.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Burger Chef Tycoon" and "Breakfast Bar Tycoon".

70070000036268.name: Knights & Guns Add-on Edition
70070000036268.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000036268.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1,  Armor Pack #3 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 8 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000036271.name: Urban Flow Enhancement Edition
70070000036271.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000036271.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, London Rules, Winter Expansion Pack and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    40 new stages!
•    7 new vehicles (withthe firetruck and snow plow!)
•    Enjoy the winter theme and new music!

70070000036277.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Wild Waters
70070000036277.intro: Survive the swamp, craft your raft, and adapt to the wild waters.
70070000036277.description:
Deep within the swamp’s endless waters, where danger hides beneath every ripple and survival depends on instinct, every decision shapes your chance to endure another day. Your raft is more than shelter — it’s your only chance of survival.

This bundle includes:
1. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
Build and expand your floating survival base in a dangerous swamp. Gather resources, craft tools, fish for food, purify water, and defend yourself against crocodiles while turning your raft into a livable sanctuary.

2. Survival Float Simulator: Fishing & Crafting Tools Update
Upgrade your survival tools with improved fishing rods and enhanced hooks. Enjoy better efficiency, increased range, and smoother mechanics that improve your resource gathering and survival gameplay.

3. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Tool Textures
Enhances the visual quality of essential tools like the hammer and axe with improved textures, adding more detail and realism to your crafting and building experience.

Your journey is defined by what you build, what you risk, and what you survive.

70070000036279.name: Hole io: Emerald Edition
70070000036279.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000036279.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Emerald Edition features:
- 11 maps with different things to swallow 
- 51 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000036312.name: Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines - Challenge Edition
70070000036312.intro: Your train crashed! Find your friends and rebuild your home!
70070000036312.description:
Your friends are scattered across the city, and the rail network is in pieces! Draw colored tracks, reconnect the railroads, and guide trains back to their stations to find your lost buddies and bring everyone home.

With each rescue, your hometown slowly recovers, but the puzzles get trickier. Tunnels, crossroads, and clever obstacles will test your logic and creativity as you invent new routes, solve mind-bending challenges, and restore order to the railways.

Features:
- 1000+ handcrafted logic puzzles!
- 60 extra-large levels full of challenges!
- Tricky mechanics like gates, crossroads, and obstacles.
- Multiple solutions that reward creative thinking!
- Optional hints to help you through tougher levels.
- A beautiful city full of life waiting to be restored!

Choo Choo! Next station is never-ending fun!

70070000036317.name: Kabuto Park + Minami Lane - Bundle
70070000036317.intro: Enjoy Kabuto Park and Minami Lane with this bundle!
70070000036317.description:
Enjoy summer in Kabuto Park! Catch the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this tiny bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier little friends.

Kabuto Park is a cute and short bug collection game. Spend a month as Hana, a little girl on summer vacation. Catch the best bugs and level them up, choose your team carefully and fight other kids to become the Summer Beetle Battles champion.

--------

Welcome to Minami Lane! Build your own street in this tiny cozy, casual management sim.

Minami Lane is a small, wholesome management game set on a Japanese-inspired street. Create and manage your own street, make sure everyone is happy, and watch the villagers live their lives!

70070000036322.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Stellar Edition
70070000036322.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000036335.name: Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny: Prank Experience
70070000036335.intro: More ways to prank, explore, and cause trouble in Granny’s house.
70070000036335.description:
Step into the chaotic world, where you play as a mischievous cat turning Granny’s quiet home into a playground of destruction, pranks, and unpredictable fun. Explore freely, interact with everything, and outsmart Granny in a light-hearted chaos-driven experience.

This bundle includes:
1. Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny (Full Game)
Become a mischievous cat in Granny’s house. Explore rooms, trigger interactive objects, hide from Granny, and create playful chaos using stealth and creativity.

2. Evil Cat Simulator vs Granny: Chaos Splash (DLC)
Adds a paint can item that increases Granny’s stress level when used and leaves colorful paw prints behind the player for a short duration, making every prank more chaotic and visually dynamic.

The house is no longer peaceful — and now your mischief reaches a whole new level.

70070000036347.name: SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING: Master Edition
70070000036347.intro: Ready your vessel for the most profitable hauls in the deep blue.
70070000036347.description:
Command the high seas and turn a humble fishing operation into a dominant maritime empire. This bundle provides the complete simulation experience along with the financial leverage needed to conquer the unpredictable power of the ocean.

This edition includes:
1. SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING (Base Game)
Master the art of commercial fishing in a world where every decision matters. You will navigate coastal waters using realistic ship handling and manual navigation, all while battling dynamic weather, shifting currents, and raging storms.

2. SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING: Growth Capital (DLC)
Give your career an financial boost of 5,000 coins added to your treasury. Use these funds to upgrade your fuel capacity, invest in processing stations or purchase the advanced equipment necessary to survive the ocean’s harshest moods.

Will you become a legendary master of the sea trade or let the ocean claim your dreams?

70070000036358.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.22
70070000036358.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the twenty-second additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Beautiful Lakes of the World
- Little Songbirds
- Tiny Forest Mushrooms
- [Moving] Beautiful Nightscapes of the World

70070000036359.name: Game & Console Supermarket GOLD EDITION
70070000036359.description:
Build, expand, and dominate the world of gaming retail in the ultimate business simulator experience. In Game & Console Supermarket: Business Simulator, you’ll take control of your own store — managing inventory, setting prices, and creating the perfect shopping destination for gamers.

This bundle includes Main Title, License Discovery DLC and Money Bonus DLC which takes your journey even further. Unlock exclusive game licenses and rare console editions to attract collectors and hardcore fans, while a powerful financial boost helps you scale faster than ever. Expand your assortment, optimize your strategy, and stay ahead of the competition with premium content that gives your business the edge.

From humble beginnings to a full-scale gaming empire — every decision matters. Will you rise to the top?

70070000036362.name: Coffee Talk Tokyo - Deluxe Edition
70070000036362.description:
Coffee Talk Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

In a city of paper and steel, as large as a country, a small café gives humans and fantasy people a cosy place to be. Brew the right order for your customers as they seek refuge from the sweltering Tokyo summer heat and share heartfelt stories to chill lo-fi beats.

Set in Tokyo, a city where old and new coexist, this newest game in the Coffee Talk franchise brings back familiar elements with new twists.

New Cafe, New Customers
Coffee Talk Tokyo once again places you behind the counter of a chill coffee shop. But while the feeling is familiar, the customers and their stories are new. They include:

 Kenji, the traditional kappa salaryman, striving to find meaning and a way forward after retirement.
 Vin, the Barista's assistant coping with a fractured past and the daily consequences of a previous disaster.
 Ayame, a happy-go-lucky but recently deceased It girl, struggling to make sense of her new (after)life.

Lo-fi Beats Soundtrack by Andrew "AJ" Jeremy
The composer for Coffee Talk and Coffee Talk Episode 2, AJ, returns once again with new tracks to set the lo-fi soundscape and chill atmosphere.

Say it with Stencils
Elevate your latte art with sprinkle stencils. Easily create beautiful latte art by sprinkling a powdery design on a customer's drink, then make it your own by adding milk and etching.

Master of Tomodachill
Engage with your customers on the social network Tomodachill. Learn more about their stories and help them discover the truth they're seeking or make life-changing connections

DELUXE EDITION FEATURES:

- Seattle Prologue Chapter
- 10 Additional in-game City Pop tracks
- Digital Artbook

70070000036370.name: ONLY UP! REMASTER: Peak Challenge
70070000036370.intro: Climb higher in a world that gets harder with every step.
70070000036370.description:
Push your limits in an intense climb where every step upward becomes more challenging than the last. Precision, focus, and determination are essential as the height increases and the atmosphere around you constantly transforms.

Bundle Includes:
ONLY UP! REMASTER
Climb through increasingly difficult environments filled with tricky platforms, narrow paths, and demanding precision challenges. Your goal is simple: keep going up, no matter the risk of falling.

ONLY UP! REMASTER: Beyond the Sky
Enhances every level with unique dynamic skyboxes. Each stage features a different sky, creating a fresh and immersive climb every time.

A relentless climb defined by patience, skill, and persistence, where the world above is always changing.

70070000036374.name: Bowling Fever Master Edition
70070000036374.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000036374.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #3, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-30 new bowling ball styles

70070000036375.name: Football Legends 2025 Complete Edition
70070000036375.intro: Play. Score. Win. Become a Football Legend!
70070000036375.description:
Football Legends 2025 brings the thrill of the world’s most popular sport to your Nintendo Switch™!

Step onto the pitch and experience pure football excitement across multiple game modes and stadiums.

Play a Quick Match for instant action — perfect for a fast-paced challenge alone or with friends in local multiplayer.

Want more control? Choose the Single Match mode to select your favorite team, stadium, weather, and time of day — and compete head-to-head with friends or AI opponents.

Take on the ultimate challenge in Tournament Mode, where 16 elite teams battle for glory. Only the best can lift the trophy!

Multiple stadiums, each offering customizable weather conditions — from sunny afternoons to rainy nights under the floodlights.

Get ready to kick off, score spectacular goals, and become a true Football Legend!

This bundle includes base game, Team Pack #1, Team Pack #2 and Team Pack #3 with:
- 9 new teams

70070000036379.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Elite Edition
70070000036379.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000036379.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #3 and expansion pack #4 with:

9 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000036381.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Prime Edition
70070000036381.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000036381.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #3 with:

- set of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000036387.name: Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition
70070000036387.intro: Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on September 29!
70070000036387.description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in the Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition, featuring unique cosmetics, pre-order cosmetics, and DLC 1+2 (when released)! Journey through unexplored lands in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds. Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day. The challenges will be tougher than ever, so face them solo or with up to 4 players in online or couch co-op. With a crisis upon us, will you and your friends rise to meet it?

70070000036388.name: Hunter Simulator : Wild Hunting – Wild Instinct
70070000036388.intro: Face realistic wildlife behavior in a constantly changing world.
70070000036388.description:
Step into the heart of the wilderness and experience the thrill of the ultimate hunt. This bundle combines the full hunting adventure with exclusive equipment upgrades designed to improve both your firepower and style in the wild. Explore breathtaking environments, track elusive prey, and prepare for every expedition with premium bonus content.

This bundle includes:
1. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting (Base Game)
Enter a vast open world filled with forests, mountains, lakes, and open plains, where every hunt is a test of skill, patience, and strategy. Track a wide variety of wildlife with realistic animal AI, adapt to changing weather conditions, and customize your weapons and gear as you progress through the ultimate hunting experience.

2. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Elite Weapon (DLC)
Enhance your arsenal with the powerful Savatimp 8 rifle, a precision-crafted weapon built for long-range accuracy and exceptional stopping power. If you already own this weapon, you will receive 1400 in-game currency instead.

3. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Tactical Gloves (DLC)
Complete your hunting gear with an exclusive gloves skin that adds a unique look to your hunter while improving the overall feel of your adventure. If you already own the gloves, you will receive their equivalent coin value instead, allowing you to invest in other gear and upgrades.

Sharpen your aim, gear up, and make every hunt an unforgettable adventure in the wild.

70070000036405.name: Piano: Learn and Play Tiny Tunes Pack
70070000036405.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000036405.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes Song Pack 9 DLC containing new songs.

Key Features:
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000036411.name: Cozy Land Sweet Streets
70070000036411.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000036411.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

This bundle includes Candy DLC.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
