- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000036412.name: Softly Placed Sci-Fi Collection
70070000036412.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70070000036412.description:
Step into the world, where mundane tasks turn into little adventures and ordinary items provide so much joy. See everything around you in bright, new, vibrant colors and make things even more beautiful by adding fun patterns. Wake up your inner child and find the happiness in little things.
 
Each level of the game consists of a unique challenge, providing fresh, yet relaxing gameplay, that will make you curious for what’s coming next.  

This bundle includes Sci-Fi Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
-40 unique cozy puzzle levels
-Gameplay consisting of different types of challenges
-Beautiful, vibrant visuals, where everyday items turn into something magical
-Relaxing, cheerful soundtrack 
-Inspiring, nostalgic atmosphere
-Variety of puzzles exercising different parts of the brain

70070000036413.name: Heist Simulator 2025: Shadow Ops
70070000036413.intro: Move through shadows and control every situation silently.
70070000036413.description:
Step into the world of high-stakes planning and precision execution where every decision can determine success or failure. Prepare carefully, adapt to every situation, and complete missions with greater control and awareness.

This bundle includes:
1. Heist Simulator 2025 (Base Game)
Enter a thrilling world of strategic planning and stealth-based operations where you take on the role of a skilled thief. Plan your heists with precision, choose the right tools, and execute flawless strategies to outsmart security systems and law enforcement.

2. Heist Simulator 2025: Urban Light (DLC)
Upgrade your equipment with a powerful flashlight designed to improve visibility in dark and challenging environments. With stronger illumination and improved materials, this tool helps you navigate tight spaces, detect important details, and maintain better awareness during stealth missions.

Combine strategy, stealth, and upgraded tools to master every operation and become a true expert in the art of heists.

70070000036434.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Dead Zone
70070000036434.intro: Manage the flow of survivors while leading an elite force against the infection.
70070000036434.description:
Take control of critical border procedures and face constant pressure where every decision matters. Step into a high-stakes environment where order and survival depend on precision and responsibility.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine lockdown simulator: Zombie border
Manage a quarantine border during a global outbreak. Inspect incoming survivors, identify potential infections, and make rapid decisions that can prevent the spread of the virus.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Elite Skins
Introduces visual enhancements that update the appearance of soldiers and scientists, giving the quarantine zone a refreshed and more immersive identity.

Prepare to be the last line of defense with a team that looks and acts like a true elite force.

70070000036438.name: Snooker Fever Elite Edition
70070000036438.intro: The classic pool experience, right at home!
70070000036438.description:
Discover the perfect balance of strategy and skill in Snooker Fever.  This game brings the classic snooker experience to the Nintendo Switch™, whether you're a seasoned snooker player or just picking up a cue for the first time.

With 10 beautifully crafted tables, customizable cues, and CPU opponents that keep you on your toes, every game feels fresh. Take on the challenge solo or invite a friend for some local competition. Focus on sinking that perfect shot, while the stunning 3D visuals capture the atmosphere of a real snooker hall.

Snooker Fever has all the tools you need to master the game, enjoy some friendly competition, and just have a great time.

Key Features:

10 different tables 
15 custom cues 
3 levels of opponents
Local multiplayer 
Smooth controls and realistic 3D graphics

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #3 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

- 15 stunning new table designs
- 5 sleek cue styles

70070000036441.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Elite Edition
70070000036441.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000036441.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1, Pizza Bar Tycoon Multiplayer Mode and Food Truck Tycoon New Levels #1 with:

- 20 new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon
- 45 new levels for Food Truck Tycoon
- local multiplayer gameplay mode for Pizza Bar Tycoon

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000036443.name: Wukong Black Legend: Mythic Legacy
70070000036443.intro: Combat evolves around you, becoming more unpredictable with every step.
70070000036443.description:
Step into a myth-inspired world where fast-paced combat and exploration define every moment. Intense battles, powerful abilities, and constant challenges shape your journey through a dangerous and legendary realm.

What the content includes:
Wukong Black Legend
Experience a dynamic action-adventure where you fight through dangerous enemies using close and ranged combat. Explore detailed levels, master your skills, and uncover secrets hidden across a world full of mythic encounters and constant threats.

Wukong Black Legend: Hero’s Weapon (DLC)
Enhance your combat experience with a brand-new weapon, upgraded attack effects, and improved visual feedback. Every strike feels heavier and more impactful, bringing extra intensity and variety to every fight.

A deeper combat experience awaits, where every battle feels more powerful, more dynamic, and more satisfying from start to finish.

70070000036448.name: Moto Rush GT Add-on Edition
70070000036448.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000036448.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack, Grip Collection #3 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 4 new motorbikes (each with special colors)
- New colors for the rest of motorbikes
- New colors for gloves
- Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
- 8 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000036475.name: Poop & Scoop: Just Crow Things + Cleaning Up!
70070000036475.description:
==== Just Crow Things ==== 
You're a little crow trying to prove herself to the world. Make new animal friends, poop on unsuspecting hoomans, and steal all the shiny trinkets! Each level is a little sandbox full of fun items to discover and puzzles to solve, while leaving a bit of chaos behind. Why? Just caws!

==== Cleaning Up! ==== 
Turn huge messes into sparkling spaces! Feel the satisfaction of restoring them to order with your super-powered cleaning tools. This is a short and simple game about the joy of tidying up!

70070000036476.name: Rain on Your Parade + Cleaning Up!
70070000036476.description:
=== Rain on Your Parade === 
Rain on Your Parade is a slapstick comedy game where you play as a mischievous cloud. Play across a wide range of levels while unlocking new abilities and mechanics that get progressively more ridiculous. Make new friends and help them too - it's an adorable schadenfreude game!

=== Cleaning Up! ===
Make mountains of trash disappear in seconds, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning messy spaces into organized and clean environments. This is a short, stress-free cozy game to unwind with, and spark some joy.

70070000036478.name: Pixie Plates: Complete Edition
70070000036478.intro: A magical cooking adventure full of charm and tasty treats!
70070000036478.description:
Whisk up delicious dishes, slide them onto a plate, add the perfect toppings, and serve them to a parade of adorable fantasy customers!

Prepare delightful food and drinks, from decorated pastries and lovely desserts to warm soups, colorful refreshments, and other tasty specialties. Every order needs the right ingredients and finishing touches before it is ready for your magical guests.

Things can get wonderfully busy in the kitchen! Watch your cooking stations carefully, keep drinks from spilling over, and make smart use of every plate as new customers arrive with fresh requests. Leave food cooking for too long or let a drink overflow, and you will have to toss it in the bin and start again. With more hungry customers arriving and several orders waiting at once, there is always something exciting happening behind the counter!

Journey across 6 enchanting worlds, with 10 levels in each one. Every world brings its own atmosphere, charming customers, and themed dishes and drinks to discover!

Features:
- Prepare and serve a delicious variety of fantasy-inspired food and drinks
- Explore all 6 unique worlds!
- Create every order step by step by cooking, plating, and adding toppings
- Meet adorable customers including pixies, frogs, and other whimsical creatures
- Play through 60 delightful levels!
- Keep your kitchen running smoothly while managing plates and multiple orders
- Immerse yourself in a bright and whimsical fairy-tale setting

A world of sweet creations and enchanting customers is always ready for the next order!

70070000036481.name: Paper io 2: Platinum Edition
70070000036481.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000036481.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- 59 skins which also change the look of your terrain
- 18 new funny hats to wear
- custom game with 72 various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000036483.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Gold Edition
70070000036483.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000036483.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Viking Nom who triggers a powerful long turbo boost shortly after the race begins!
- Wind Nom who gives a big running speed boost to keep you ahead!
- Droid Nom who triggers a medium turbo boost a few seconds after the race starts!
- Iron Nom who gives you a 30-second shield right at the start!
- 4000 gold to buy new Noms!

NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Grab friends or family and jump into the same race on one screen. Chase the lead, pull off last-second comebacks, and see who really is the fastest runner among you!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000036485.name: Bun Buns: Cute Edition
70070000036485.intro: Don’t let your buns hop out the basket! Drop, merge, and stack your pastries to bake the biggest, most delicious treat!
70070000036485.description:
Get ready to bake your heart out! Combine fluffy buns, watch them grow into mouth-watering pastries, and push your skills to the limit in this physics-based puzzle challenge.

Use clever power-ups to escape sticky situations and keep burnt dough under control. Timing and placement are everything! One wrong move, and your perfect bake could crumble!

Travel through charming bakeries, each bringing new twists and challenges to master. How big can your ultimate bun get?

Features:
- 3 maps with unique basket shapes
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode to bake together with friends!
- 9 new hairstyles, 2 outfits, 2 hats and 2 accessories!
- Handy power-ups to save your run!
- Fully customizable baker with cute outfits
- A warm and cozy aesthetic

Bake yourself a fresh high score!

70070000036488.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Enhancement Edition
70070000036488.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Weaponry Upgrade, Elite Arsenal and Expansion Pack #2 with:

-PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm 
-FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation 
-SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy 
-RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design 
-BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west 
-SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle 
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000036491.name: Skyline Bowling: Split Edition
70070000036491.intro: Strike out the competition and become the ultimate bowling champ! Ready to roll?
70070000036491.description:
Get ready for an action-packed challenge where every strike brings you closer to victory! Join friends or family in up to four-player matches, compete in thrilling tournaments against top bowlers from across the lanes, and bowl in amazing alleys with cool views. Only the best players make it to the final rounds – will you be the one holding the trophy?

Features:
• Premium gear - Choose from 3 new pieces of gear with powerful buffs!
• Powerful Balls - Equip 3 new bowling balls with unique trails and more power!
• Extra currency - Get 50K coins and 5K gems to buy and upgrade your gear!
• Local multiplayer - Compete against your friends and family in matches for up to 4 players!
• Motion Controls - Feel like you're truly bowling with motion controls that respond to every move!
• Exciting Tournaments - Compete in rounds and aim for the finals, where only the best bowlers make it.
• Customize Your Character - Personalize your bowler with cool gear, such as gloves and shoes.
• Challenging Arenas - Unlock amazing new alleys with fun twists as you level up.
• Powerful Skills - Use active and passive skills to boost your chances of winning!

Skyline Bowling isn’t just about throwing the ball; it’s about using the right gear and clever strategies! Boost your skills with special gear like gloves that give your ball extra spin or shoes that make it roll faster. Choose from different bowling balls, and earn experience to unlock new tournaments and amazing bowling alleys with fun surprises! Collect skills to help you get even more strikes. Are you ready to bowl your way to the top?

Get ready to roll, aim, and strike your way to victory in Skyline Bowling!

70070000036498.name: My Cozy Room Extended Edition
70070000036498.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000036498.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes Bakery DLC.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000036503.name: Amanda the Adventurer Trilogy Bundle
70070000036503.intro: Complete the Amanda the Adventurer trilogy
70070000036503.description:
Step into the world of Amanda the Adventurer in this trilogy bundle that twists the beloved childrens tv shown into something sinister. Amanda the Adventurer follows Riley Park and their journey begins in the attic of their late Aunt Kate’s home, where a stack of strange VHS tapes featuring the cheerful Amanda and her sidekick Wooly. What starts as forgotten children’s programming soon turners into something much deeper. 

Amanda the Adventurer 2 picks up directly after the first game and follows Riley Park, who after her fateful experience with the tapes, travels to the Kensdale Public Library to investigate the company behind the disappearances, and Amanda herself. Meanwhile, Amanda is aware of Riley's presence and is doing everything to find a way to free herself from the prison that holds her. 

In Amanda the Adventurer 3, the thrilling conclusion to Riley Park’s journey comes to an end. Will they discover the truth behind the ongoing mysteries surrounding Amanda and Hameln?

70070000036504.name: 4 in 1 Sports Bundle Vol 2
70070000036504.intro: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!
70070000036504.description:
This pack includes the games:

-Grand Prix Rock ´N Racing
-9-Ball Pocket
-Ping Pong Up
-World Soccer Pinball

70070000036512.name: Splash of Color: Nature Edition
70070000036512.intro: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!
70070000036512.description:
Piece together bright, colorful images by swapping tiles and solving lively puzzles. Watch patterns shift, colors click into place, and pictures slowly reveal themselves as you play. Jump in, make a few swaps, and watch the colors come together.

Features:
- 48 puzzles big and small for you to solve
- Simple and satisfying swap puzzle mechanics.
- A lively and colorful aesthetic!

Watch the colors fall into place!

70070000036514.name: READY OR DIE: MP5 ULTIMATE EDITION
70070000036514.description:
Experience the definitive tactical simulation. The MP5 Ultimate Edition combines the intense, high-stakes realism of Ready or Die with the legendary precision of the world's most iconic submachine gun.

This all-in-one package equips you with the complete base game and the MP5 Tactical Entry DLC, ensuring your unit is prepared for the most volatile operations from day one. In environments where chaos is the only constant, the Ultimate Edition provides the perfect balance of modern tactics and classic firepower.

What's Included:
READY OR DIE (Base Game): Lead your elite tactical unit through high-tension missions, hostage rescues, and unpredictable raids where every decision carries weight.

MP5 TACTICAL ENTRY DLC: Gain immediate access to the H&K MP5, the gold standard for close-quarters battle (CQB). Master its legendary reliability and surgical accuracy.

Ultimate Features:
The Operator's Choice: Utilize a weapon system designed for maximum mobility and minimal collateral damage.

Complete Tactical Freedom: Tackle missions your way—whether utilizing the MP5’s compact frame for rapid room clearing or deploying advanced tactical gear to secure the perimeter.

Uncompromising Realism: From ballistic penetration to authentic weapon handling, this edition delivers the most immersive SWAT experience available.

Do not leave your survival to chance. Master the chaos with the ultimate tactical toolkit.

STAY CALM. STAY PRECISE. BE READY.

70070000036525.name: Chained Climb Together: Ultimate Heights
70070000036525.intro: A journey where every step is shared and every mistake is costly.
70070000036525.description:
Begin your ascent into a world where every step matters and every move can make the difference between falling and rising. This bundle delivers a complete climbing experience focused on teamwork, precision, and overcoming extreme vertical challenges.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Chained Climb Together
Step into an intense climbing adventure where you are bound by mystical chains to your companion. Coordinate every movement as you scale towering mountains, navigate dangerous terrains, and master unique mechanics that test both skill and teamwork in a fully online experience.

2. Chained Climb Together: Skybound Environment (DLC)
Transform your journey with a breathtaking new skybox that redefines the atmosphere of every climb. Dynamic skies and enhanced environmental visuals create a more immersive and visually striking ascent from base to peak.

3. Chained Climb Together: New Rope (DLC)
Upgrade your climbing experience with a redesigned rope that improves control, responsiveness, and visual style. Enjoy smoother handling and a stronger connection as you tackle the most challenging cliffs.

Push your limits, trust your partner, and rise above every obstacle — the summit awaits.

70070000036551.name: Dunhero Deluxe Edition
70070000036551.intro: Forge a new adventure every time you play – in DunHero, you make the rules!
70070000036551.description:
DunHero is a fast-paced fantasy action roguelite where no two runs are ever the same.

Choose your hero

Pick from 28 unique playable classes. Each hero starts with different gear, abilities, and strengths. Grow stronger with every run, unlock powerful upgrades, and experiment with builds that match your playstyle – or try something completely new!

Begin your journey

Explore 8 dangerous worlds, each filled with unique enemies and challenging bosses. Procedurally generated maps ensure every adventure feels fresh and unpredictable. Along the way, discover over 600 powerful items and rare cards that let you craft devastating combinations and become the ultimate hero of the realm.

Every run is different.
Every choice matters.
Become the legend of DunHero.

This bundle includes Legend in Sound DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Procedurally generated maps.
- 28 playable classes.
- 80+ Rare Cards gained from leveling up.
- 8 worlds with their own bosses and enemies.

70070000036555.name: Family Chess Ocean Blue Pack
70070000036555.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000036555.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes Ocean Blue Chessboard DLC.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000036563.name: "GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS" + "VTuber Music Pack" Set
70070000036563.intro: A bundle that lets you purchase “GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS” and the DLC “VTuber Music Pack” together.
70070000036563.description:
This bundle includes the following main game and DLC.

"GROOVE COASTER FUTURE PERFORMERS"
■An Overwhelming Fusion of Music and Visuals
Groove Coaster is a rhythm game where you play along while racing down tracks that twist and turn to the music.

With dynamic sound and light effects, you’ll feel completely immersed—as if you’ve stepped into a world of music and are performing right inside it!

■Enhanced Visuals
For the first time in the series, the gameplay screen features a full horizontal layout, letting the world of music fill your entire view!

Visual expression has been greatly improved, and some songs even include scenes using the original music videos!

■Two Play Styles to Choose From
You can select from two different play styles to match your skill level!
Basic: Enjoy the game casually with four types of notes—perfect for beginners.
Advanced: Challenge yourself with nine types of notes—ideal for rhythm game veterans and fans of the classic series who want a deeper, more rewarding experience!

■Fully Voiced "Story Mode" Featuring a Star-Studded Cast
For the first time in the series, enjoy a luxurious, fully voiced Story Mode!

Centered around two protagonists, Sendou Kakeru and Himekawa Aria, a rich cast of characters—including classmates, teachers, and rivals from other schools—join the story.

The journey begins as they aim for victory in the "Groove Coaster" tournament, a futuristic sport where players perform while racing along the tracks...

Main Characters
- Sendou Kakeru(Voice: Kawashima Reiji/ Theme Song Artist: Somari)
- Himekawa Aria(Voice: Sakura Ayane/ Theme Song Artist: 40mP)
- Fwuff (Voice: Shirakami Fubuki / Theme Song Artist: NayutalieN)
- Sharsha (Voice: Sakura Miko / Theme Song Artist: Satsuki & Karasuyasabou)

■Includes Many Popular Songs from Anime, Vocaloid, and More!
In addition to original tracks, the game features a wide variety of popular songs from various genres!
- Idol / YOASOBI
- Bling-Bang-Bang-Born / Creepy Nuts
- Hai Yorokonde / Kocchi no Kento
- BOW AND ARROW / Yonezu Kenshi
- Demons Banquet / Tomonari Sora
- Good-Bye Declaration / Chinozo
- KING / Kanaria
- Mesmerizer / Satsuki
- God-ish / PinocchioP
- Lagtrain / inabakumori
- Override / Yoshida Yasei
- ROKI / Mikito P
- Kyu-kurarin / Iyowa
- Bibbidiba / Hoshimachi Suisei
- Catcher in the Ui / Shigure Ui
- Heart Pie Dancehall / HIMEHINA
…and many other popular songs included!


"VTuber Music Pack"
This pack includes the following content.

■ Songs (6 tracks)
- Carnivorous Plant / RIM
- Ahoy!! We are Houshou Pirates / Houshou Marine
- CapSule / Mori Calliope x Hoshimachi Suisei
- Born to be "BAU"DOL☆★ / FUWAMOCO
- SHUKUSEI!! RORI GAMI REKUIEMU☆ / Shigure Ui
- Kiss Kitsune / HIMEHINA

All songs can be enjoyed immediately in "Performance" mode once the DLC is installed, and some tracks will also be added as challenge songs to certain stages in "Story" mode.

Now, let’s ride the groove of the future!

70070000036579.name: Airport Contraband Police Bundle - Border Patrol: Tactical Control
70070000036579.intro: Take control of airport security and stop contraband before it crosses the line.
70070000036579.description:
Step into the high-pressure world of airport security where every inspection can stop a major smuggling operation. Every mission becomes more challenging, requiring focus, precision, and quick decision-making.

1. Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol (Base Game)
Take on the role of an airport police officer responsible for maintaining security and preventing illegal goods from crossing borders. Perform passenger checks, inspect luggage, use advanced detection equipment, and uncover hidden contraband through careful observation and investigation.

2. Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol: New Skybox (DLC)
Enhance your airport experience with an upgraded sky environment exclusive to airport locations. This DLC introduces a new skybox with improved lighting, atmosphere, and visual depth, making the airport feel more realistic and immersive during all operations.

Experience the intensity of airport border control combined with a refined visual atmosphere that makes every operation more immersive, realistic, and engaging.

70070000036591.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® VII: Brush and Blade Collection
70070000036591.description:
Brush and Blade Collection* includes**:
• 2 new leaders: Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Yi Sun-sin
• 4 new civilizations: Heian Japan, Sengoku Japan, Goryeo, Joseon
• 4 new Wonders: Mireuksa, Nirayama Reverberatory Furnace, Seongsan Ilchulbong, Nachi Falls

Explore new possibilities for your personalized empire with the post-launch paid add-on content of the Brush and Blade Collection! Embody two new leaders: Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Yi Sun-sin. Lead four new civilizations: Heian Japan, Sengoku Japan, Goryeo, and Joseon. Discover the majesty of four new Wonders: Mireuksa, Nirayama Reverberatory Furnace, Seongsan Ilchulbong, and Nachi Falls.

70070000036597.name: Rubber Duck Race Simulator: Turbo Ducks
70070000036597.intro: Fast ducks. Fierce competition. Endless races.
70070000036597.description:
Start your racing adventure with a stronger advantage and enjoy a more rewarding progression experience from the very beginning. This bundle combines base game with extra in-game support to help you move forward faster and unlock more content with ease.

The bundle includes:
1. Rubber Duck Race Simulator - Dive into fast-paced duck racing action across dynamic tracks filled with shifting currents, unexpected obstacles, and exciting shortcuts. Compete in endless races, complete daily challenges, and unlock a variety of unique ducks, each with different styles and abilities.

2. Rubber Duck Race Simulator: Bonus Coins - This DLC adds 1000 coins to accelerate your progress. Use your bonus to unlock new ducks, purchase upgrades, and access additional customization options.

Enjoy the racing experience with added value that lets you unlock more, progress quicker, and have even more fun in every race.

70070000036601.name: Dead by Daylight: 10th Anniversary Edition
70070000036601.description:
Dead by Daylight’s 10th Anniversary Edition is here, and there’s no better time to kick off another decade of horror, action, and multiplayer thrills. 
Featuring 5 Killers and 5 Survivors, this packed edition is the perfect place to begin your journey into The Fog. 
Killers
The Ghostface
The Deathslinger
The Oni
The Unknown
The Knight

Survivors
Sable Ward
Mikaela Reid
Yui Kimura
Vittorio Toscano
Zarina Kassir

+ 6 DLC exclusive items.

70070000036604.name: My Little Haven Walls Collection
70070000036604.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70070000036604.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

This bundle includes Walls Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70070000036606.name: The Treflik Family New Neighbours Edition
70070000036606.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000036606.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes two additional episodes: "New Neighbour" and "A House Within A House".

70070000036611.name: Cottonville Global Style Collection
70070000036611.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000036611.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack and Japan 90s Outfits Pack DLCs.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!

Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000036615.name: Dead by Daylight: Jason Edition
70070000036615.description:
Summer camps, hockey masks, and machetes have never been the same... 

Dead by Daylight: Jason Edition features the base game and the Jason Chapter, which brings the legendary horror icon into The Fog. 

This Edition also features Two Chapter exclusives: the Hockey Mask Badge and the Misty Cabin Banner.

70070000036632.name: Bodycam Stray Kitty Gold Edition
70070000036632.intro: Turn every yard into your playground.
70070000036632.description:
Step into the paws of a mischievous stray cat and experience a world where every moment is an opportunity for fun, chaos, and discovery. Explore lively urban backyards, complete playful tasks, interact with other cats, and turn ordinary surroundings into your personal playground.

This bundle includes main title and Skyfall Paradise DLC which not only lets you live the carefree life of a curious feline but also transforms how your adventure feels. With a brand-new skybox included, the world above you comes alive in fresh and atmospheric tones — from bright and cheerful to calm and magical — adding a whole new layer of immersion to every jump, dig, and stroll.

70070000036634.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Supreme Edition
70070000036634.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000036634.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers, Custom Cruisers #2, Custom Cruisers #3 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-4 new skins for each Buggy

70070000036648.name: Pocket Nook Deluxe Edition
70070000036648.intro: Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!
70070000036648.description:
Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!


Start with a simple room, then turn it into something unique. Place a bed, a desk, or a plant — you may rotate and reposition items however you like — it’s all flexible!


There’s no need to stress or rush yourself — take your time and enjoy the relaxing vibe of Pocket Nook but also be prepared to savor before-and-after transformations.

This bundle includes Summer Tiki Party, Fantasy and Cat & Dog DLCs.

Features you may find:
- 65 wallpapers — choose wisely, it’s a thing that catches the attention quickly.
- 80+ styles to embellish the most forgotten part of a room - FLOOR!
- 150+ furniture options to choose from and infinite possibilities.
- 100+ items to decorate your space with —  you name it!
- 20+ ways to lighten the room — lighting is key!
- 32 outdoor elements to fill every pixel of empty space.
- 32 characters ready to live in a place created by an architectural genius mind!
- Cozy pixel art — nice to look at, nicer to relax in.
- Various cozy tunes to choose from — just enough to get into the relaxing vibe.

Cute graphics, endless options, a lot of fun — that’s what awaits you in Pocket Nook, everyone’s welcomed!

70070000036649.name: Critical Strike Modern - SWAT Shooter Ops: Tactical Edition
70070000036649.intro: Every second counts, when pressure is at its highest level.
70070000036649.description:
Experience intense modern SWAT operations where precision, timing, and strategy decide every outcome. Step into high-risk missions across global locations and take control of elite tactical scenarios where every decision can change the course of the operation.

The bundle includes:
1. Critical Strike Modern - SWAT Shooter Ops (Base Game)
Take on the role of an elite SWAT operative deployed in dangerous global hotspots. Complete varied missions such as hostage rescues, bomb defusal, intelligence gathering, and tactical assaults. Use stealth, gadgets, and smart positioning to overcome intelligent enemies and dynamic mission challenges.

2. Critical Strike Modern - SWAT Shooter Ops: Tactical Funds (DLC)
This DLC adds 1500 in-game currency to your account, helping you adjust your loadout faster, unlock equipment earlier, and improve your overall tactical flexibility from the start of your missions.

Prepare, adapt, and execute. Every mission is a test of skill, and every move defines your success.

70070000036652.name: Magic Cats Pots Seasons Edition
70070000036652.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This bundle includes Spring and Summer DLCs.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000036671.name: Heave Ho + Heave Ho 2 Bundle
70070000036671.description:
This bundle includes Heave Ho and Heave Ho 2.

Heave Ho
Heave Ho is a riotous multiplayer party game for up to four players in couch co-op and versus play. Reach out, get a grip, and swing to victory — or meet your messy end!

Heave Ho 2
The bedlam is back, and now it's online too. Grab and swing through all-new weird and wonderful worlds with up to four players in online and local co-op and versus play.

Take your partners by the hand (or head) and swing your ungainly chain from platform to pillar and beyond. Let go at the wrong moment and meet your splattery end, but a solid grip and pro swinging will take you over the finish line in sweet harmony!

70070000036675.name: Bag Fight: Speed Up Edition
70070000036675.intro: Pack your bags and blast into adventure!
70070000036675.description:
This deckbuilding roguelite puts inventory management into the heart of every run. Build a backpack full of weapons, armor, and healing items, carefully arranging your gear to create a setup that can carry you through battle after battle.

This bundle includes the Newman Pack DLC, which unlocks 2X Game Speed, the new character Newman, the Blaster weapon, and an Ascension passive that gives you a chance to throw a holographic weapon during battle!

Unlock new gear, strengthen your build, and discover better ways to use your limited space as you progress. Merge weapons to create stronger versions, fine-tune your loadout, and adapt your backpack for every challenge ahead.

Features:
- Inventory Management: Move items around to optimize your build!
- Merging: Combine items into stronger versions!
- 2X Game Speed: Speed up your runs and jump into the action faster!
- New Character: Newman, equipped with the Blaster weapon and an Ascension passive that gives you a chance to throw a holographic weapon!
- Unique Characters: Meet a colorful cast of heroes
- Progression: Upgrade your bag and loadout!
- Epic Adventures: Explore diverse fantasy worlds
- Customization: Equip awesome skins for your heroes and items!
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to earn extra resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master!

Your backpack is your build. Make every slot count.

70070000036677.name: Bag Fight: Gem Chest Edition
70070000036677.intro: Pack your bags and power up with 2000 Gems!
70070000036677.description:
This deckbuilding roguelite puts inventory management into the heart of every run. Build a backpack full of weapons, armor, and healing items, carefully arranging your gear to create a setup that can carry you through battle after battle.

This bundle includes the Chest of Gems, which gives you 2000 Gems - premium currency you can use to unlock new heroes, purchase chips, skins, and awesome offers in the black market, or gain a powerful edge during battles!

Unlock new gear, strengthen your build, and discover better ways to use your limited space as you progress. Merge weapons to create stronger versions, fine-tune your loadout, and adapt your backpack for every challenge ahead.

Features:
- Inventory Management: Move items around to optimize your build!
- Merging: Combine items into stronger versions!
- Chest of Gems: Receive 2000 Gems to unlock heroes, purchase chips, skins, and black market offers, or gain an edge in battle!
- Unique Characters: Meet a colorful cast of heroes
- Progression: Upgrade your bag and loadout!
- Epic Adventures: Explore diverse fantasy worlds
- Customization: Equip awesome skins for your heroes and items!
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to earn extra resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master!

Your backpack is your build. Make every slot count.

70070000036681.name: Little Strays 2: Legacy Edition
70070000036681.intro: A Small Cat. A Silent World. A Lasting Legacy.
70070000036681.description:
Play as a brave stray cat on a journey to rescue lost kittens, help other strays, and bring hope back to a forgotten city. Sneak past dangerous dogs, avoid swarms of insects, explore abandoned places, and uncover secrets hidden across ruined streets, flooded sewers, old factories, and forgotten laboratories.

Play solo or team up with a friend in local 2-player co-op. Share supplies, solve puzzles together, and protect each other from lurking threats.

The world may be overrun… but courage still meows in the dark. 

Little Strays 2: Legacy Edition includes the full game plus two add-ons: an expanded ambient soundtrack and atmospheric fur color variations for your stray cat.

FEATURES:
• Full game plus 2 add-ons included
• Solo play or local 2-player co-op
• Explore a ruined city full of secrets and dangers
• Rescue kittens and help other strays survive
• Sneak, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly threats
• Seven story-driven levels with hidden areas
• Expanded ambient soundtrack
• 5 fur color variations for your stray cat

70070000036683.name: Club Sports Collection Legendary Edition
70070000036683.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000036683.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #1, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #2 and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #4 with:

- 15 brand-new dart designs

70070000036687.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Legendary Edition
70070000036687.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000036687.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Expansion Pack #4 with:
10 new queues
10 new pool table designs
15 new snooker table designs

70070000036688.name: Ecchi Crush: Complete Edition
70070000036688.intro: One hot match leads to another.
70070000036688.description:
Ready to line things up and see where it leads? Match colorful pieces, chain together juicy combos, and clear the board to reveal a gorgeous surprise waiting underneath.

Every move clears a little more of the picture. Keep crushing tiles, breaking through tougher boards, and revealing beautiful girls piece by piece. The deeper you go, the hotter it gets... so stay sharp and keep the matches coming.

Features:
- Complete collection of beautiful women to reveal
- Unique music for every girl
- Simple and engaging match-3 gameplay
- Satisfying combos and challenging stages
- A treat for your eyes

Your crush is waiting for you.

70070000036689.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Road King
70070000036689.intro: Survive the traffic, and conquer the open highway.
70070000036689.description:
Strap yourself in and experience the ultimate high-speed driving challenge across busy city highways filled with intense traffic and nonstop action. This bundle delivers the full racing experience, combining realistic driving physics, fast-paced competition, and deep vehicle customization for endless replayability.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator
Take control of powerful cars, master tight traffic lanes, and push your reflexes to the limit as you race toward dominance. Every decision on the road matters — one mistake can change everything, while perfect control leads to victory.

2. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Turbo Boost
Kickstart your racing progress instantly with an extra $50,000 of in-game cash. Use it to upgrade your cars, unlock premium vehicles, and enhance performance to gain a competitive edge.

3. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Drive in Color
Customize your garage with vibrant new paint styles including bold blue, striking pink, and sleek turquoise. Stand out on the highway, express your driving identity, and make every race visually unique while tearing through traffic at full speed.

From high-speed chases to precision driving, this bundle gives you everything you need to build your racing legacy in a dynamic and immersive world.

70070000036696.name: Bigfoot Hunting: Into the Wild
70070000036696.intro: In the wild, every moment carries risk, and every shadow could be a threat.
70070000036696.description:
Step deeper into the untamed forest where survival is never guaranteed and every shadow may hide something watching you. Track, survive, and adapt as the environment above reshapes the fear below.

This bundle includes:
1. Bigfoot Hunting – Hunt or be hunted as you track the legendary Bigfoot through unpredictable terrain. Manage limited resources, use advanced survival tools, and react to dynamic events where danger can appear at any moment.
2. Bigfoot Hunting: New Horizon – Redefine the atmosphere of your journey with a completely new sky visual that replaces the game’s original sky. The forest feels more alive, more unpredictable, and far more intense as the sky itself becomes part of the experience.

Every hunt feels different when the world above you refuses to stay the same.

70070000036700.name: ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Final Corridor
70070000036700.intro: Every corridor hides something you were never meant to see.
70070000036700.description:
Enter a relentless nightmare where escape is never guaranteed and every shadow hides a new fear. This bundle delivers the complete Backrooms experience, combining psychological horror, survival mechanics, and powerful upgrades that change how you face the unknown. Explore deeper, see clearer, and fight harder as the maze twists around you.

Bundle Includes:
• ESCAPE – BACKROOMS HORROR (Base Game) - Navigate endless corridors of damp carpets and flickering lights, where no path is safe and no corner is predictable. Hide, survive, and endure as disturbing creatures stalk you through a constantly shifting maze. Use your camcorder strategically, adapt to eerie environments, and try to hold onto your sanity as the Backrooms grow darker with every step.

• ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Eternal Light (DLC) - Push back the darkness with a flashlight that never fades. This upgrade ensures you are never left helpless in the shadows, allowing you to explore further and uncover hidden dangers with constant visibility. What was once unknown is now revealed—but not everything you see will bring comfort.

• ESCAPE – BACKROOMS HORROR: Unlimited Camera Vision (DLC) - See beyond the limits of darkness with a night vision camera that never runs out of power. Observe what lurks in the unseen corners and navigate the maze with greater awareness. But be careful—some truths are more terrifying when fully visible.

• ESCAPE - BACKROOMS HORROR: Arm Yourself (DLC) - Take control of your survival with a pistol added to your arsenal. With limited ammunition and constant danger, every shot becomes a critical decision. Confront the horrors head-on or use your weapon as a last resort in a world where every second counts.

Push forward into the unknown, trust your instincts, and do whatever it takes to escape — if escape is even possible.

70070000036709.name: 4 in 1 Sports Bundle Vol 3
70070000036709.intro: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!
70070000036709.description:
This pack includes the games:

-Rock ´N Racing Off Road DX
-Golf Up
-Darts Up
-Touchdown Pinball

70070000036715.name: Cozy Memory Sunny Day Edition
70070000036715.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000036715.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 4 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000036716.name: Brain Boost Buddies Ultimate Booster
70070000036716.intro: Get ready for a fun and friendly brain workout! Fun, educational, and full of adorable friends - Brain Boost Buddies is perfect for the whole family!
70070000036716.description:
In Brain Boost Buddies, kids can flip and match cute animal cards - from smiling puppies to fluffy bunnies - while training their memory and concentration skills.


Parents will love it too! The game helps develop focus, logic, and patience in a calm, positive way. Plus, players can easily choose the right difficulty level to make the challenge just right for every age.

This bundle includes Covers Pack, Cards Pack 1, Cards Pack 2 and Cards Pack 3 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Adorable animal cards that make learning fun
- Different difficulty levels for all ages
- Improves memory, focus, and attention skills
- Bright, colorful visuals designed for kids
- Relaxing and cheerful background music
- Perfect for family playtime and early learning

70070000036717.name: Soapy Tales Extended Edition
70070000036717.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70070000036717.description:
Suddenly, you wake up as a ghost, with no memories. Your good and bad deed count is perfectly even, so you need to go back to Earth to earn your redemption. 
Rediscover your past life and relive touching memories while attending to family business.

Soapy Tales combines doing relaxing chores with elements of time and space management. Complete the tasks, upgrade your skills, and unveil the story of your life in the midst of pastel, soapy bubbles!

This bundle includes Mint And Chocolate Bars and Cloud Baby Blue DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- First-person point of view gameplay. 
- Cozy, nostalgic atmosphere.
- Relaxing music. 
- Skill tree and artifacts to unlock.

70070000036718.name: Freaky Trip Ultra Premium
70070000036718.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000036718.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

This bundle includes Cooking Pack, Camp Pack, Hobby Pack, Sports Pack, Space Pack, and Cleaning Pack DLCs.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000036719.name: Mini Market Design Popcorn Palace
70070000036719.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000036719.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes Furniture Material Collection 3, Furniture Material Collection 4, and Cinema DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000036720.name: Cat & Friends Memory Pet Paradise
70070000036720.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70070000036720.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.

This bundle includes Cards Pack 1 and Cards Pack 2 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70070000036727.name: Barbarous: Survivor's Quest - Complete Edition
70070000036727.intro: Battle the horde and survive the quest!
70070000036727.description:
The land is overrun by hungry orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and other dangerous creatures, and only the strongest will last! Fight through wave after wave of enemies, face powerful bosses, and upgrade your hero to become unstoppable.

Every run is a new challenge! Choose your upgrades wisely and shape your build as you progress. Open treasure chests, gather experience, and stay in the fight as the enemy waves grow stronger.

Barbarous: Survivor's Quest Complete Edition includes the base game and all DLC, giving you even more ways to survive the horde. Explore the Northern Reaches, the Badlands, and the Mages Guild, meet Gwen, Rogz, and Varizz, and discover new weapons and abilities that bring even more variety to every run.

Improve your stats, unlock powerful weapons, and collect valuable rewards as you carve your way through the chaos!

Features:
- Fight waves of orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and more
- Explore 3 additional maps with extreme difficulty: Northern Reaches, Badlands, and Mages Guild
- Meet 3 new brave characters: Rogz, Gwen, and Varizz
- Discover 3 new powerful weapons: Lute Axe, Fist of the North, and Eye of the Void
- Shape your build with many weapons and items
- Face powerful bosses and earn valuable rewards
- Upgrade and evolve your gear!
- Power up and become the ultimate hero

How long can you survive before the horde overwhelms you?

70070000036732.name: THIEF LIFE SIMULATOR: Dark Ops
70070000036732.intro: Every shadow hides a perfect opportunity for you.
70070000036732.description:
Step into a world of stealth, tension, and precision where every move can make the difference between success and failure. This bundle enhances your experience with improved tools and deeper immersion for high-stakes missions.

The bundle includes:
1. THIEF LIFE SIMULATOR (Base Game) - Step into a living, breathing city where stealth, timing, and strategy decide everything. Break into houses, garages, and luxury locations, avoid surveillance, and steal valuable items without leaving a trace. Every action matters as you build your path from small-time thief to professional infiltrator.

2. THIEF LIFE SIMULATOR: New Flashlight (DLC) - Improve your visibility in dark environments with a powerful upgraded flashlight featuring enhanced lighting and improved materials. Navigate tighter spaces, spot important details faster, and complete stealth missions with greater precision and awareness.

Enhance your strategy, improve your tools, and take full control of every mission in the shadows.

70070000036733.name: EnjoyUp‘s 3 in 1
70070000036733.intro: Enjoy 3 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!

70070000036743.name: Castles and Manors - Escape Room Bundle
70070000036743.intro:
Two escape room games are included! 
Secrets of Blackrock Manor - Escape Room and Secrets of Velendar Castle - Escape Room.
70070000036743.description:
This bundle includes two escape room games:

*Secrets of Blackrock Manor - Escape Room
*Secrets of Velendar Castle - Escape Room

SECRETS OF BLACKROCK MANOR - ESCAPE ROOM
Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...

SECRETS OF VELENDAR CASTLE - ESCAPE ROOM
Imprisoned without explanation, you must escape Velendar Castle and uncover the truth behind the King’s wrath.
Solve intricate puzzles, explore the castle, discover why everything was taken from you and what the King truly wants.
As the secrets of the Five Elven Realms unfold, you’ll face a choice that will decide their fate.

70070000036744.name: Ancient and Arcane - Escape Room Bundle
70070000036744.intro:
Five escape room games included!
Pyramids and Aliens, Mystic Academy, Between Time, Secrets of Blackrock Manor and Secrets of Velendar Castle.
70070000036744.description:
This bundle includes five escape room games:

*Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
*Mystic Academy: Escape Room
*Between Time: Escape Room
*Secrets of Blackrock Manor: Escape Room
*Secrets of Velendar Castle: Escape Room

PYRAMIDS AND ALIENS: ESCAPE ROOM
Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid to find your missing mentor. As an intrepid explorer, solve puzzles, investigate clues, and unravel the pyramid's secrets. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?

BETWEEN TIME: ESCAPE ROOM
You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you must travel through time, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles to obtain untold treasures. Will you come back alive?

SECRETS OF BLACKROCK MANOR - ESCAPE ROOM
Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...

SECRETS OF VELENDAR CASTLE - ESCAPE ROOM
Imprisoned without explanation, you must escape Velendar Castle and uncover the truth behind the King’s wrath.
Solve intricate puzzles, explore the castle, discover why everything was taken from you and what the King truly wants.
As the secrets of the Five Elven Realms unfold, you’ll face a choice that will decide their fate.

70070000036745.name: Escape Room Marathon
70070000036745.intro: This bundle includes eight escape room games!
70070000036745.description:
This bundle includes eight escape room games:

*Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room
*Mystic Academy: Escape Room
*Palindrome Syndrome: Escape Room
*Tested on Humans: Escape Room
*Between Time: Escape Room
*Regular Factory: Escape Room
*Secrets of Blackrock Manor: Escape Room
*Secrets of Velendar: Escape Room

Embark on an archaeological adventure inside an ancient pyramid to find your missing mentor. As an intrepid explorer, solve puzzles, investigate clues, and unravel the pyramid's secrets. Spoiler: it was not built by humans!

MYSTIC ACADEMY: ESCAPE ROOM
Today is the day of your final exam to become a wizard. Within this enchanting escape room, you'll navigate a wizardry school, unravel puzzles, master new spells, and put your magical skills to the ultimate test. The question remains: Will you emerge triumphant?

PALINDROME SYNDROME: ESCAPE ROOM
You wake up in a spaceship with no memories. In this escape room with a sci-fi setting you will have to investigate your past solving different puzzles. Will you escape?

TESTED ON HUMANS: ESCAPE ROOM
You are the test subject. In this dark environment escape room, you have to solve various puzzles to escape from the research center where you are trapped. Will you escape?

BETWEEN TIME: ESCAPE ROOM
You are going to steal a time machine. In this escape room, you must travel through time, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles to obtain untold treasures. Will you come back alive?

REGULAR FACTORY: ESCAPE ROOM
You don't work in a regular assembly line. In this escape room, you will investigate what is really being manufactured in a secret factory, explore mysterious places and solve puzzles. Will you discover the truth?

SECRETS OF BLACKROCK MANOR: ESCAPE ROOM
Find the hidden fortune of Blackrock Manor. Discover the truth about the family deaths. In this mysterious Escape room, you will have to solve puzzles to find the hidden vault with the treasure. But you will find much more...

SECRETS OF VELENDAR CASTLE - ESCAPE ROOM
Imprisoned without explanation, you must escape Velendar Castle and uncover the truth behind the King’s wrath.
Solve intricate puzzles, explore the castle, discover why everything was taken from you and what the King truly wants.
As the secrets of the Five Elven Realms unfold, you’ll face a choice that will decide their fate.

70070000036746.name: Complete Sweetheart Set
70070000036746.intro: Build your farm in Zephyr Town and breathe new life into the once-famous bazaar
70070000036746.description:
Add these cute couples outfits to your wardrobe, each inspired by one of Zephyr Town's eligible bachelors or bachelorettes.

*The Bachelor Sweetheart Set and the Bachelorette Sweetheart Set are also both sold separately. Be careful not to purchase any items twice.

This set includes:

◆Bachelor Sweetheart Set
- Teacher's Ensemble
   A sensible outfit based on Jules

- Café Threads
   A relaxed outfit based on Derek

- Wanderer's Robes
   A durable outfit based on Lloyd

- Atelier Wear
   An artsy outfit based on Gabriel

- Elegant Regalia
   A grand outfit based on Samir

- Kitty-Cat Gi
   A breathable outfit based on Arata

◆Bachelorette Sweetheart Set
