*Outfits can be changed by using the mirror or dresser in your house.
*DLC will be accessible in-game after progressing to the necessary point in the story.
*The outfits included in the Complete Sweetheart Set can be worn regardless of avatar gender.

70070000036749.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection Season 5
70070000036749.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection + Summer 2 + Independence Day + Christmas 2 + Autumn 2 + Halloween 2

70070000036753.name: Run Sausage Run!: Platinum Edition
70070000036753.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000036753.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 9 new skins (Angler, Country Girl, Hunter, Beekeeper, Firefly, Toxic, Painter, Policeman, Prisoner)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000036756.name: Fight For America: Gold Edition
70070000036756.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000036756.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- New weapons: Golden Amcar and Zap Gun
- Extra coins: Boost your campaign with 8000 coins to upgrade your weapons, turrets, and base
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000036772.name: STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026: Online Rise
70070000036772.intro: Create, grow, and evolve through every stage of your journey.
70070000036772.description:
Step into the world of digital content creation, where every decision shapes your path, and every moment contributes to your growth. Manage your daily routine, develop your channel, and build your identity in a constantly evolving online environment.

This bundle includes:
1. STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026 - Experience the full creator simulation, where you build your career from the ground up and navigate the challenges of online fame.

2. STREAMER SIMULATOR 2026: Balance Rise - Start with improved early conditions that provide a more flexible and comfortable beginning to your journey.

Start your journey and see how far you can go in the digital world!

70070000036778.name: Ultimate 4x4 Offroad Trucks :Car Racing Driving Simulator 2022 - Extreme Ride
70070000036778.intro: More speed. More strength. More offroad mastery.
70070000036778.description:
Get ready for your ultimate offroad journey with a powerful combination of driving challenge and instant progression. This bundle gives you everything you need to dominate extreme terrain from the very beginning.

What the bundle includes:
1. Ultimate 4x4 Offroad Trucks :Car Racing Driving Simulator 2022
Experience intense offroad driving across massive open-world environments filled with steep hills, dynamic weather conditions, and challenging tracks. Drive powerful 4x4 vehicles, explore three unique worlds, complete missions, and test your skills in realistic physics-based gameplay with full vehicle customization and damage system.

2. Ultimate 4x4 Offroad Trucks :Car Racing Driving Simulator 2022 - Driver Fortune (DLC)
An instant boost of 2000000 added to your in-game balance. Use these funds to unlock new vehicles faster, upgrade performance, expand your garage, and customize your rides to handle even the toughest offroad challenges.

Take control, upgrade faster, and push your driving experience beyond limits with this complete bundle.

70070000036781.name: Little Paws: Kitty Cat GOLD EDITION
70070000036781.intro: A cozy adventure full of charm and wonder!
70070000036781.description:
Embark on a heartwarming journey with adorable kitties in Little Paws: Kitty Cat Simulator, a relaxing adventure filled with exploration, discovery, and playful charm. Travel across the world, from lively city streets to peaceful beaches and snowy mountaintops, collecting fish, uncovering secrets, and enjoying delightful interactions along the way.

This bundle includes main title and Cute Friend DLC  which adds an extra touch of cuteness to your adventure. Give your kitty a fresh and adorable new look, making every moment even more charming as you explore, play, and relax in cozy environments around the globe.

Discover new places, express your style, and enjoy the ultimate cozy cat experience.

70070000036788.name: Cooking Arena Elite Edition
70070000036788.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000036788.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon", "Burger Chef Tycoon" and "Breakfast Bar Tycoon".

70070000036791.name: Knights & Guns Enhancement Edition
70070000036791.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000036791.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Armor Pack #1 and Armor Pack #4 with:
- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 8 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000036794.name: Barista Life Simulator 2026: Café Owner
70070000036794.intro: Turn a simple café into a living success story.
70070000036794.description:
Step into the world of coffee entrepreneurship and experience the full journey of building and managing your own café. From crafting high-quality drinks to expanding your business and improving your setup, every moment brings new challenges and opportunities for growth.

The bundle includes:
Barista Life Simulator 2026 
 Take control of your café’s future, develop your skills, and shape a space that reflects your vision and style. Learn to balance daily operations, serve customers, and gradually turn a small coffee shop into a thriving business.

Barista Life Simulator 2026: Capital Boost
 This DLC provides 500 added to your in-game balance, giving you more flexibility from the very beginning of your café journey.

Start your journey and build the coffee shop you’ve always imagined.

70070000036796.name: Urban Flow Luxury Edition
70070000036796.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000036796.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Winter Expansion Pack, Streets Supplement and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    20 new stages!
•    12 new vehicles (withthe firetruck and snow plow!)
•    Enjoy the winter theme and new music!

70070000036799.name: The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass
70070000036799.intro: The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass includes two story expansions bundled at a discount.
70070000036799.description:
The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass includes two story expansions bundled at a discount. Experience mysterious new conflicts, intriguing quests, strange new locations, outlandish weapons, devious characters, and additional ways to aid or defy the Board of Halcyon in two new narrative expansions for the darkly-humorous, critically-acclaimed, and award-winning sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division.

•	The Outer Worlds: Peril on Gorgon. Investigate the dark secrets of one of the most ambitious scientific undertakings in Halcyon: the development and synthesis of Adrena-Time, a drug intended to improve the productivity of workers across the colony.
•	The Outer Worlds: Murder on Eridanos. Venture to the skies of Eridanos and unravel the grandest murder mystery in the Halcyon colony! Everyone is a suspect in this peculiar whodunit after Rizzo’s hired spokesperson, the famous Halcyon Helen, winds up dead.

A copy of The Outer Worlds on the same platform is required to play expansion pass content. 

---
The Outer Worlds: Peril on Gorgon
ESRB RATING: Mature 17+
Blood and Gore
Intense Violence
Strong Language
Use of Drugs

70070000036803.name: Let's Sing 2022
70070000036803.description:
Give it your all and become the superstar you were meant to be with a playlist that features current hits as well as classics that guarantee a blast from the past. Lady Gaga with “Stupid Love”, Shawn Mendes & Justin Bieber with “Monster”, Ariana Grande with “Positions”, Jason Derulo & Jawsh 685 with “Savage Love (Laxed – Siren Beat)” or Billie Eilish with “everything I wanted” are just some of the smash hits featured in the latest entry into the Let’s Sing series. If you want to travel back in time instead, how about the Backstreet Boys with “Everybody (Backstreet’s Back)” or The White Stripes with “Seven Nation Army”? 

Sing your heart out!

• Your favourite Karaoke game on the next generation of gaming!
• 30 new songs, mixing current chart breakers and all-time classics!
• Eight thrilling Game Modes
• Prove that you're the best singer in our Legend singleplayer mode. Earn stars and beat the bosses to claim the throne!
• No mic at hand? It doesn't matter - with the Let's Sing Mic app, you can turn your smartphone into a microphone in no time at all
• Singleplayer experience and online leaderboards!
• Co-op modes for up to eight players!
• More songs on the in-game store!

70070000036804.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey - Deluxe Edition
70070000036804.intro: Join Trey on an adventure to regain his lost memories and uncover the lost secrets in the land of Talea!
70070000036804.description:
Embark on an epic journey across Talea with the Deluxe Edition, a special bonus pack filled with items, supplies, and companion rewards to aid adventurers as they rediscover forgotten memories.

Includes: 

- 	Exclusive furniture for the Anispace 
-	Lost variant Lampecko
-	50 standard Bilia
-	10 Lost Bilia
-	20 Velox Bilia
-	10 Memostones
-	25 Balance Buddies
-	25 Magicharms
-	25 pieces of Thick Fur
-	5 Mewaii Holo Cards
-	5 Vortail Holo Cards
-	5 Ozelash Holo Cards
-	5 Salabel Holo Cards
-	5 Queccha Holo Cards 
-	1 Katamos Holo Cards
-	1 Arct-Rex Holo Card

70070000036816.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker - Decorator’s Dream Edition
70070000036816.intro: This bundle comes with our visual novel and every decoration pack we have to offer, so you can decorate your inn, the Drowsy Dragon, to your heart’s content.
70070000036816.description:
With this bundle you get our visual novel "Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker" and the two decoration packs  "Drowsy Druid" and "Wondrous Wizard".

Dive into the role of the Tavernkeep, the owner of The Drowsy Dragon, a small quayside bar in a little, bleary portside town on the coast of Borkam. Meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

With all decoration packs you can decorate your inn, the Drowsy Dragon, to your heart’s content: Whether you desire a few more potted plants or you’re desperately craving an orb to ponder—it’s yours to decide.

70070000036817.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker - Tavern Decoration Pack
70070000036817.intro: This bundle comes with every decoration pack we have to offer, so you can decorate your inn, the Drowsy Dragon, to your heart’s content.
70070000036817.description:
With this bundle you get the two decoration packs  "Drowsy Druid" and "Wondrous Wizard". So you can decorate your inn, the Drowsy Dragon, to your heart’s content: Whether you desire a few more potted plants or you’re desperately craving an orb to ponder—it’s yours to decide.

This bundle doesn't include the base game Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker. Its content requires the base game in order to play.

70070000036818.name: The Smurfs Creative Board Pack
70070000036818.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000036818.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 9 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000036824.name: Wingspan: Bird Packs Season Pass
70070000036824.intro: Grow your collection over time and enjoy even more variety in your avian flock.
70070000036824.description:
This is the first Bird Packs Season Pass for Wingspan. Each pack, designed by Wingspan fans, adds 25 beautiful bird cards with unique powers connected to a different part of the world, along with an exclusive player portrait.

By buying the Season Pass, you get all of the Bird Packs as soon as they release at a lower price!

Expand your wildlife preserve with new birds from regions featured in the game. With Wingspan: Bird Packs Season Pass, you’ll get:
1. Wingspan Bird Pack: British Birds
2. Wingspan Bird Pack: Additional Asian Avians
3. Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Canada
4. Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe
5. Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of New Zealand
6. Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of the U.S.A.

Grow your collection over time and enjoy even more variety in your avian flock.

70070000036860.name: Neko Bento Extended Edition
70070000036860.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000036860.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes Backgrounds Pack and Homes Pack DLCs.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000036861.name: Cozy Tiny Home Ultimate Edition
70070000036861.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000036861.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes Floor & Wallpaper, Cat Pack 1, and Cat Pack 2 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000036862.name: Memory For Kids Forest Fellowship Edition
70070000036862.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000036862.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes Cards Pack 1 DLC.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels

70070000036865.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Operation Frontline
70070000036865.intro: Outsmart, outplay, and outgun the opposing enemy team.
70070000036865.description:
Step into the heart of modern tactical warfare where precision, teamwork, and strategy decide every outcome. This bundle enhances your overall experience with improved visuals that elevate immersion across all battlefield locations, making every encounter feel more cinematic and impactful.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Engage in intense tactical combat as part of an elite squad in high-stakes 5v5 matches. Work together to eliminate the enemy team’s score while defending your own, using strategy, coordination, and skill. Choose from a wide range of weapons, adapt to different maps, and master fast-paced firefights where every move counts.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter: Battlefield Sky – Upgrade the visual atmosphere of every map with an improved skybox system. Experience more immersive and dynamic skies across all locations, adding depth, realism, and cinematic intensity to every battle without altering core gameplay.

Prepare your squad, sharpen your tactics, and enter a redefined battlefield where every detail enhances the fight.

70070000036875.name: Fit My Cat Out of the Box Edition
70070000036875.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000036875.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

This bundle includes Boxes Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000036876.name: Paint For Kids First Steps Edition
70070000036876.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000036876.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones. 

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes Additional Board 2 DLC.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use

70070000036890.name: BODY CAM SHOOTER: Complete Warfare
70070000036890.intro: Think fast, move smarter, survive longer in combat.
70070000036890.description:
Step into a high-intensity tactical experience where every encounter demands precision, awareness, and quick decision-making. Face aggressive, reactive enemies across detailed environments and adapt your strategy to survive fast-paced combat situations.

Bundle Includes:
• BODY CAM SHOOTER (Base Game):
A highly immersive tactical shooter experience focused on realism, tension, and skill-based combat. Fight across two unique maps, use different weapon types, and rely on strategy and quick decision-making to survive intense encounters.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Tactical Pistol Skin (DLC):
Equip a unique pistol skin that adds a bold visual upgrade while maintaining full tactical realism during combat.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Skin Upgrade (DLC):
Customize your AR-15 with a detailed tactical finish inspired by real-world special forces equipment for a more professional field appearance.

• BODY CAM SHOOTER: Night Vision Mode (DLC):
Gain a tactical advantage in low-light environments with enhanced visibility, allowing for improved enemy detection and stealth-based strategies.

Push your limits, refine your tactics, and experience combat where every detail matters.

70070000036901.name: Cipheur - Season 5
70070000036901.description: Cipheur + Quotes Pack 2 + Quotes Pack 3 + Uncommon Words 2 + Proverbs 2 + Last Words 2

70070000036905.name: Water Blast Shooter - Wet Gun: Champion Choice

70070000036907.name: POLICE BORDER CONTRABAND PATROL SIMULATOR: Control Duty
70070000036907.intro: Every shift brings new pressure, risk, and responsibility.
70070000036907.description:

70070000036912.name: Basketball Legends 24: Pulse of Glory
70070000036912.intro: Every match is a step toward becoming a legend.

Step into the world of legendary basketball where iconic players, intense matches, and high-level competition define every moment. Experience fast-paced gameplay, strategic depth, and the thrill of building your own path to greatness on the court.

Take your first step toward greatness and shape your legacy on the court.

70070000036919.name: The Grinch: 2 in 1 Game Collection
70070000036919.description:
Enjoy both games from the series The Grinch.

Incudes:
The Grinch: Christmas Adventures

The Grinch has had a wonderful, awful idea – steal all the presents in Who-ville, using gadgets like his stealthy Santa costume and Candy Cane Lasso. Help him sneak around, freeze creatures with snowballs, and learn the meaning of Christmas along the way, in this festive platformer!

HAVE AWFULLY GOOD FUN – Sneak and steal presents as the Grinch and his dog Max.

UNLOCK GRINCHY GADGETS – Solve puzzles to gain abilities! Throw snowballs, disguise as Santa, use a Candy Cane Lasso or a Jumping Jetpack, and more!

GET IN THE SPIRIT – The Grinch wants to stop Christmas, but you can help his heart grow three sizes! 

EXPERIENCE A CLASSIC – With visuals inspired by Dr. Seuss’s book and controls for young players.


The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas 

Every Who in Who-ville is jingling, singing, and celebrating. And this time, the Grinch can’t wait to join them! With a heart three sizes bigger, he’s determined to prove he’s changed by decorating the most spectacular Christmas tree ever. 

Play as the Grinch and leap through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle. Overcome platforming challenges and master grinchy gadgets, from the Rocket Skates to the Snowball Maker.  

Adventure solo or in co-op as you explore the world with Max from the Grinch’s Cave to Who-ville, outsmarting mischievous adversaries along the way. 

Make it a merry day in the land and show the Whos your Christmassy spirit. 

BRING CHEER TO THE WHOS: Embark on a festive journey to craft the most spectacular Christmas tree and decorate Who-ville Square. 

EXPLORE VIBRANT WORLDS: Swing, smash and Jumbo-Jump your way through the Grinch’s Cave, Mt. Crumpit, Who-wood and merry Who-ville. 

UNLEASH GRINCHY GADGETS: Take on every challenge with the help of the Rocket Skates, the Jetpack, the Snowball Maker, and more… 

CO-OP TO SAVE CHRISTMAS: Play solo as the Grinch, or team up with a friend as Max to help you. 

AN ADVENTURE FOR EVERYONE: Embark on a whimsical journey inspired by the original books, offering intuitive mechanics and challenges accessible to all.

70070000036933.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Season 5

Border control operations demand peak vigilance and sharp tactical intuition. This bundle assembles the complete experience of life as a frontier officer—from meticulous vehicle inspections and real-time document verification to high-speed pursuits and moral choices that define a career.

Bundle Contents:
1. Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Detect hidden contraband, manage traffic at urban entry points, and use advanced equipment to stop illegal activities in a world full of daily challenges and high-risk encounters.

2. Military Gear (DLC) – A military camouflage skin for gloves and sleeves, designed to improve the visual authenticity of your character’s uniform and provide that tactical edge needed during intense border operations.

Step into duty, refine your tactics, and outsmart the smugglers. The border is waiting!

70070000036980.name: Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance - Complete Air Combat Bundle
70070000036980.description:

Engage in intense dogfights, complete high-risk missions, and adapt to constantly changing battle conditions. The added aircraft gives you greater flexibility in the air, allowing you to react faster, maneuver more efficiently, and maintain control in critical moments.

Bundle includes:
* Fighter Aces: Sky Dominance (Base Game)
* Elite Hornet Pack

With improved agility and sharper handling, this bundle is ideal for players who prefer fast reactions and aggressive aerial tactics.

70070000036983.name: Raptor Evolution: Gold Edition
70070000036983.description:
Take control of a mighty dinosaur in a post-apocalyptic world on a quest to recover its stolen eggs.

Smash through environments, gather resources, and hunt grotesque human-mutants to evolve and grow stronger. Use what you collect to rebuild bridges, restore paths and push deeper into a world filled with danger and mystery. 

Explore vast landscapes, uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying bosses standing between you and your lost brood.

Features:
- Unleash powerful evolution form with Infermadon and Celestosaurus skins
- Break everything: destroy environments and leave nothing standing
- Use advanced technology: encounter futuristic machines that will aid your survival
- Engage in fierce battles: hunt down mutants and monstrous creatures
- Meet various enemies: take on diverse foes with unique behaviors
- Lead your warriors: command other beasts and dominate the wasteland

Will you survive and recover your eggs?

70070000036986.name: Maze: Path of Light - Oasis Edition
70070000036986.intro: Discover a universe of mazes in one mesmerizing game.
70070000036986.description:
Embark on a relaxing yet mind-bending journey through thousands of uniquely designed mazes. From classic square puzzles to complex circular, triangular, and even hexagonal labyrinths - experience a truly diverse and enchanting experience.

Features:

- Satisfying puzzles: Enjoy a peaceful session with small mazes, or test your skills on advanced ones
- Unique Shapes: Explore mazes shaped like fish, guitars, trees, and more!
- Beautiful Design: Vivid colors and soothing music create a visually and emotionally engaging experience

Choose your path through combinations of maze shapes, sizes, and game modes. Whether you're looking for a calming puzzle break or a strategic challenge, there's something here for every mood.

Unlock constellations of puzzles, discover secret paths, and lose yourself in the ultimate maze adventure.

70070000036988.name: Until Then: Deluxe Edition
70070000036988.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:

- Until Then 
- Until Then Afterimages DLC

In a world still recovering from catastrophe, Mark Borja and his friends navigate the joys and woes of another year of high school. Wake up in a typical teenage bedroom, practice piano, race to meet homework deadlines, and build (and burn) relationships, as you reminisce about the daily insecurities of high school life. 

That is, until a fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life. People disappear and memories prove unreliable. Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.

Play Out Your Own Adventure
Meet a diverse and achingly familiar cast of characters to converse with in person, over text, and through email. Get to know them, build relationships, flunk group projects, and watch how their individual personal stories unfold alongside yours.

Investigate the Setting through Everyday Technology
Explore the depths of social media where your likes and comments may pose consequences. Scroll through social posts, emails, webpages, and more on your in-game smartphone, where you might discover hints and clues about the people and world around you. Chat with your friends, classmates, and even strangers. 

Explore Themes of Love, Loss, and Friendship
Tackle philosophical issues as the main character. Make mistakes and difficult choices. Will Mark stand up for his friends and be there when they need him or will he let them down? Can he heal his wounds by letting go of the past? Decide for yourself how Mark grows and strives to do better throughout the story. 

Play Addictively Mundane Minigames
Insert a flash drive—oh wait, wrong way—nope, it was right the first time. Fight your friend for more fishballs at the food stand outside. Get in the groove to pay for the jeepney. Lose yourself in little games you find yourself playing in everyday life.

Immerse Yourself in a Cinematic Visual Experience
Witness an intriguing narrative uniquely presented in eye-catching hand-drawn pixel art and immerse yourself in the warm colors and music of a world trying to move on from tragedy.  Characters, landscapes, and props blend in 3D. Shadows, reflections, and lighting set the tone in a lovingly crafted experience. 

Experience a World Inspired by Philippine Locations and Culture
Traverse Philippine-inspired landscapes in search for the truth. From the heart of the bustling capital to long bus rides past grass fields and coast towns, explore the world of Until Then set in a fictional version of the Philippines. Interior spaces are shaped by the mannerisms of the locals, setting the scene for a recent past.

70070000037000.name: Cozy Land Deluxe Edition
70070000037000.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000037000.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000037004.name: Softly Placed Extended Edition
70070000037004.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.

2. Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing: Elite Supercar
Add the feared “ShadowStorm” to your garage - a vehicle that stands at the peak of the racing hierarchy. This extra machine offers superior performance stats and a distinct visual style, ensuring you lead the pack in every showdown.

The asphalt is calling and the neon city never sleeps. Take the wheel and leave your mark on the streets!

70070000037024.name: Supermarket & Clothing Store Simulator
70070000037024.intro:

Grow your stores.
Become a retail legend.

Expand your businesses, unlock new products, and attract more customers.
Enjoy relaxing yet rewarding retail simulation gameplay.

Can you become the ultimate shop owner and build the perfect retail empire?

70070000037043.name: Vice Thief Simulator: 80s Nostalgia – Criminal Dynasty
70070000037043.intro: More than a thief—be an artist of the night.
70070000037043.description:
Master the art of the heist with the definitive collection designed for those who want the full, immersive experience of the 1980s criminal underworld. It is time to become a legend in a decade where style and danger go hand in hand.

What’s in this Bundle:
1. Vice Thief Simulator: 80s Nostalgia
Step into the shoes of a cunning thief in a vibrant metropolis where every locked door is an opportunity and every police siren is a test of your reflexes. Survival depends on your ability to distract the law and lose yourself in a maze of backalleys during high-speed chases fueled by driving synth beats.

2. Vice Thief Simulator: 80s Nostalgia – Glow Horizon
Elevate the visual impact of your operations with this aesthetic upgrade that replaces the standard sky with a custom-built horizon designed to amplify the retro-futuristic vibe.

The city doesn’t forgive mistakes, but it certainly rewards the bold—are you ready to claim your throne?

70070000037045.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Outbreak Edition
70070000037045.intro: Evolve your checkpoint. Secure your future.
70070000037045.description:
The world is falling into chaos, and your intuition is the only thing standing between safety and a total outbreak. Secure the perimeter and enhance your efficiency with these upgrades. From life-or-death decision-making to technical tool enhancements, every resource is now at your disposal to ensure the infection stops at the gate.

Bundle Includes:
• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
The core experience where you manage a high-stakes border. Use UV lights, thermometers, and sharp judgment to separate the living from the infected, knowing that one wrong decision can ignite chaos.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Infection Detection
Take your defense to the next level with an upgraded temperature scanner. The new purple-pink hue provides enhanced visual clarity, making it easier than ever to detect subtle fevers and hidden signs of infection.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Frontline Upgrade
Update the visual identity of your checkpoint with a new exterior container skin. This update reflects the evolving situation at the border, signaling that while the area is under control, the level of alert has reached a new peak.

One wrong choice costs lives. How long can you maintain control?

70070000037047.name: Tavern Talk and Dreamwalker Bundle
70070000037047.intro: In this bundle you get the cozy visual novel Tavern Talk and the prequel Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker: Gather rumors, serve magical drinks, and meet adventurers on a life-changing quest.
70070000037047.description:
In this bundle you get the cozy visual novel Tavern Talk and the prequel Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker:

In Tavern Talk you are the owner of the Wayfarer’s Inn, a popular watering hole in the fantasy land of Asteria. But you’re no ordinary barkeep: The drinks you serve can change your customer’s destiny forever. You can also turn the rumours you hear at work into intrepid quests for your patrons!

Befriend a colourful cast of adventurers as they brag about their latest triumph. Give each patron what they need and help them find a place that feels like home. And when they return from their mighty quests, they’ll bring back trinkets you can use to decorate your tavern. Your choices shape the snug interior of the Wayfarer’s Inn!

Beyond the walls of this cosy tavern, a world-threatening danger is brewing. Every quest, rumour and conversation is intertwined with the ultimate fate of the land.

----------

Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker plays 36 years before the events of Tavern Talk, where you dive into the role of the Tavernkeep. You are the owner of The Drowsy Dragon, a small quayside bar in a little, bleary portside town, and you have a special ability: You can mix magical drinks that can alter the fate of your guests. Mix unique drinks from a wide ensemble of magical potions—but be aware: There is more than one solution! 

As you listen to stories brimming with the spirit of adventure, you sit within the cozy walls of your tavern and pick up rumors to turn them into quests. Some of them are old sailor’s yarn, so sort them thoroughly before sticking them up the wall! 

As you meet new and familiar faces, all seems well. Your establishment is flourishing and friendships are made. All until something starts brewing on the horizon, something that’s going to twist your brightest dreams into your darkest nightmares.

This bundle includes:
• Full Game – Supermarket Owner Simulator: Business
The core management experience where you design your dream supermarket from the ground up. Choose the layout, personalize the shopping experience, manage your inventory, supervise staff, and navigate a highly competitive retail world to grow your initial store into a thriving chain.

• Cash Bonus DLC
This operational expansion grants you an immediate in-game currency boost of €1000, allowing you to bypass early-game limitations, stock premium products instantly, and expand your infrastructure without delay.

• City Style Upgrade DLC
This visual DLC allows you to customize the city surroundings by changing the delivery truck to a sleek black, transforming the gray sidewalk into a vibrant eye-catching orange, and darkening the main road for a modern, refined urban feel.

This exclusive expansion allows you to freely change the color schemes of both the interior walls and the exterior facade, giving you the power to instantly transform your store’s vibe and stand out from the competition.

Take complete control of your store and dominate the competitive retail landscape.

- Puzzle Book: Foxes Pack
- Puzzle Book: Special Square Pack

Speaking of everyone, you can adjust the difficulty by selecting the number of fragments per puzzle - from 6 to as much as 150! It’s a great title for both children and adults. Add peaceful music that plays in the background and you’ve got a great, relaxing afternoon.

Hungry for some competition? Or you just want to assemble pieces with friends or family? Try co-op mode! Just share a Joy-Con™ with another person and start doing puzzles together.

Features:
- 50 different puzzles to solve, divided into themes
- Each stage has 6 difficulties - from 6 pieces to 150
- Beautiful arts created by various artists
- Play solo or with a friend in co-op mode
- Use the touchscreen or Joy-Con™ controller

70070000037074.name: Aquapark io: Cool Edition
70070000037074.intro: Race with your friends on waterslides and jump into the pool for victory!
70070000037074.description:
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or enjoy sliding solo. Prove that you are the fastest of them all!

This bundle includes:
- Aquapark io
- Aquapark io: Animals DLC
- Aquapark io: Movie Stars DLC

Features:
- 14 large maps with slides
- 48 funny skins, 11 floaties, 13 gliders
- multiplayer mode up to 4 players on one screen!
- opening packs with random skins
- spawning mysterious powerups during the game
- catchy holiday music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Slide down the huge waterslide which spirals down from the sky, overtake your friends, push them off the track or use powerups to gain an adventage. The funniest part is that you can actually jump off the track at any moment and try to land on a lower level overtaking everyone in an instant!

70070000037076.name: My Horse Stories: Stylish Edition
70070000037076.intro: Get ready to make unforgettable memories and experience the beauty of the countryside like never before!
70070000037076.description:
Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ!

This bundle includes:
- My Horse Stories
- My Horse Stories: Fancy DLC
- My Horse Stories: Summer DLC

Features:
• Choose which horse out of 4 will become your best friend!
• Make the most of the horse story summer - become a horse racing champ!
• Train every day with your horse till you're ready to compete in international horse races
• Compete in exciting horse story racing competitions around the world! - Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps!
• Dress up like a champion in over 80 various clothes and change your hairstyles!
• Take good care of your horse: feed, groom, and dress him with over 70 accessories!
• Spend an additional 500 gems to buy clothes, energy, missing items for building improvements, and more!
• Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won't let you off easy. Upgrade your horse-story farm and build new facilities.
• Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC, but your plans have changed. You're sent to middle-of-nowhere Kentucky to spend the summer with your grandma on a star-stable horse farm.

Soon, you realize that this summer adventure holds untold potential! The horse farm becomes your heaven, and with each passing day, you grow closer to your loyal companion - a graceful horse with whom you'll weave your own unique horse-riding tale!

To rise above the competition and conquer the racetracks, you must train tirelessly, immersing yourself in the art of horsemanship. Your dedication will bring you face-to-face with rival stars and formidable opponents who will test your skills and determination. You and your horse will form an unbreakable bond through intense training sessions, setting the stage for legendary horse-riding tales that will be whispered for years to come!

But it's not all about intense races and fierce rival stars. In the tranquil moments between training, you'll find solace in the stars' stable horses - majestic creatures that inspire awe and joyfully fill your heart. Take the time to nurture and care for them because their well-being is crucial to your success. Pamper them with love, groom their silky manes, and dress them in dazzling saddles that reflect their extraordinary beauty.

You better make the most of it! Dress in cowgirl boots, dress up your new pet horse, start racing like a champion, and make it a horse story to remember!

70070000037079.name: Uboat Attack: Double Attack Edition
70070000037079.intro: Rise through the ranks and become a legendary commander!
70070000037079.description:
Dive into tactical naval warfare against enemy fleets!

Get behind the guns of a submarine and lead it into thrilling battles against formidable enemy convoys! Use your torpedoes to sink enemy armadas and rise through the ranks to become an admiral of the U-boat fleet.

This bundle includes:
- Uboat Attack
- Uboat Attack: Zeppelin DLC
- Uboat Attack: Cloverfield DLC

Features:
• Two new powerful ships: Cloverfield and Zeppelin!
• A big supply crate: 15000 hammers, and extra torpedos to strengthen your forces!
• A new airstrike ability to destroy the enemy forces
• Variety of authentic ships: Track and destroy real warships with precision
• Realistic damage effects: Experience intense combat scenarios with diverse damage types
• Three game modes: Engage in naval battles, liberate territories, or complete as many missions as possible
• Upgrades and ammunition: Enhance your submarine's stats and equip it with various types of missiles
• Boosters: Gain an edge over your enemies with boosters like armor, air support, instant reload, thermal vision, and more
• Bonus missions: Look up and destroy all enemy planes
• Stunning graphics and locations: Immerse yourself in the game with realistic visuals
• Intuitive controls: Navigate and aim with ease using simple, responsive controls

Explore underwater areas of arctic wastelands, canyons, abyss, and sunken temples to get a tactical advantage in war and prepare an ambush!

Engage in marine events, tactical missions, and naval challenges to earn valuable resources. Dominate the seas and showcase your naval prowess!

Are you ready for the ultimate naval warfare simulator?

70070000037083.name: Ecchi Memories: Complete Edition
70070000037083.intro: Let the bras hit the floor!
70070000037083.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 39 beautiful girls (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000037084.name: Deer & Boy - Deluxe Edition
70070000037084.description:
In this poetic cinematic platformer, a runaway boy meets a fawn. As their bond grows, so do their abilities and the emotional weight of their journey, where silence speaks louder than words.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Deer & Boy
- Deer & Boy - Artbook
- Deer & Boy - Soundtrack

Spoiler alert! This product contains some spoilers regarding Deer & Boy's story.

70070000037087.name: Bowling Fever Epic Edition
70070000037087.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000037087.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-40 new bowling ball styles

70070000037090.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Legendary Edition
70070000037090.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000037090.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #4 with:

9 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000037098.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Super Edition
70070000037098.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000037098.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #4 with:

-2 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000037100.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Legendary Edition
70070000037100.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000037100.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #2 and Food Truck Tycoon New Levels #1 with:

- 40 new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon
- 45 new levels for Food Truck Tycoon

70070000037106.name: Moto Rush GT Enhancement Edition
70070000037106.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000037106.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Full Garage , Grip Collection #1 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 13 new vehicles—including an ATV and bicycle!
- 16 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000037108.name: nOS new Operating System Wallpapers Collection 1
70070000037108.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000037108.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here! 

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes the Wallpapers Pack 1 DLC.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game

70070000037111.name: Cipheur - Season 6
70070000037111.description: Cipheur + Quotes Pack 2 + Quotes Pack 3 + Uncommon Words 2 + Proverbs 2 + Last Words 2 + Stupid Laws 2

70070000037113.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Luxury Edition
70070000037113.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Weaponry Upgrade, Target Acquired and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm 
- FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation 
- SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy 
- RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition 
- SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements 
- SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
- SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology 
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000037125.name: Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare – Treasure Hunter
70070000037125.intro: Outlast every savage horde hidden within the deep jungle.
70070000037125.description:
Kickstart your journey to the top of the leaderboards! Equip yourself with the best gear from your very first run and show the islands what a true champion can do with a fully funded arsenal. Become an unstoppable force of nature!

What’s Included:
Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare
 Step into the boots of an elite mercenary, where the environment is as deadly as the enemies. This isn’t just a shooter; it’s a high-speed tactical dance across an ever-changing archipelago.

Scorpion Champions: Island Warfare – Power Surge
 This DLC delivers 15,000 Crystals directly to your inventory, acting as your personal strategic safety net. Use this wealth to forge your legend, alter your gear, and purchase the tech required to survive the infinite loops.

Load your wallet. Load your gun. Dominate the archipelago.

70070000037134.name: Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit – Grand Pursuit
70070000037134.intro: Drive elite police units and showcase your status on duty.
70070000037134.description:
Take control of high-speed patrol vehicles and dominate the asphalt with an exclusive visual upgrade included. Not only will you hunt down reckless drivers, smugglers, and high-speed fugitives across dangerous city streets, but you will also leave an unforgettable mark on the highway.

What is included:
1. Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit
 Your mission is to restore justice by hunting down high-speed fugitives, smugglers, and reckless drivers across sprawling highways and intense urban environments.

2. Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit – Custom Nitro
This DLC replaces the standard pursuit booster appearance, transforms the physical shape and model of your exhaust smoke, and introduces a smooth, real-time color transition across a shifting palette every time you engage the nitro.

Enhance your tactical presence across the asphalt, project absolute law enforcement authority, and ensure the long arm of the law is seen from miles away.

70070000037162.name: Urban Jungle Complete Edition
70070000037162.intro: Use luscious plants to turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle.
70070000037162.description: Urban Jungle is a charming and relaxing simulation game that invites you to transform ordinary apartments into a lush, green haven by placing delightful plants with savvy. But no worries, you won’t have to deal with watering or pest control – the plants just need a good spot, and that's enough to create to comfiest and coziest home of them all. Oh, and don’t forget to pet your cat!

70070000037169.name: My Little Haven Deluxe Edition
70070000037169.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70070000037169.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

This bundle includes Arts Pack, Pets Pack and Walls Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70070000037192.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Savage Hunter
70070000037192.intro: Refine your predatory instincts in the ancient world.
70070000037192.description:
Step into a dangerous ancient world ruled by colossal beasts, where every decision impacts your survival. Traverse diverse habitats and conquer rival predators using your enhanced profile assets.

Bundle Includes:
1. Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG (Base Game): Live the life of legendary dinosaurs across contrasting regions like volcanic zones, dry plains, and lush forests. Complete dangerous hunting missions, face unpredictable natural challenges, and guide multiple species through a captivating evolutionary progression.

2. Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Hunter Balance (DLC): Maximize your evolutionary potential and accelerate your journey through an unforgiving ancient world. This DLC directly transfers 500 points into your active in-game balance, giving you an immediate advantage in the struggle for survival.

Outmatch rival predators and survive harsh wilderness missions!

70070000037194.name: Cottonville Pistachio Dreams Edition
70070000037194.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000037194.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes Pistachio Room DLC.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000037195.name: Farm2 +
70070000037195.intro:
Take care of your own farm with a variety of crops.
Survive in the Nordic lands, grow crops, raise animals, produce goods, and prosper.
70070000037195.description:
Face unimaginable challenges as you deal with demanding customers—and mischievous crows trying to eat your crops! Explore a wide range of culinary recipes using the products you grow on your grandparents’ farm.

Take care of the animals and even catch some fish, giving yourself a chance to relax—especially when a recipe goes wrong and burns in the pot.

And don’t forget to end your day resting under the very trees you planted yourself.

+

Choose your character and manage the daily life of a Viking! Plant and harvest a variety of crops, feed your animals, and sell livestock or loot to expand and improve your farm.

Gather resources to grow: mine gold, chop trees for wood, and use a pickaxe to collect stone. Manage production carefully and keep your character well-fed to stay strong throughout your journey.

Raise and care for animals such as chickens, horses, sheep, pigs, and cows. Encounter legendary creatures from Norse mythology, including Sleipnir, Eikthyrnir, Fenrir, and Jörmungandr. In your fields, cultivate carrots, mushrooms, corn, turnips, cabbage, and wheat to keep your farm productive and thriving.

+

Wash your farmhouse.

70070000037196.name: 31 Full Games for Everyone
70070000037196.intro: Discover a special collection of 31 games, bringing together a diverse lineup of genres and experiences for every type of player
70070000037196.description:
From classic platformers and challenging puzzle games to action-packed adventures, arcade classics, cozy experiences, strategy, hack and slash, roguelite, exploration, metroidvania, survival, simulation, tetris-style game, and precision platformers, there’s something for everyone.

A carefully curated selection packed with variety, challenge, and fun, all in one incredible game bundle.

Toroom
.cat Milk

Cat in a Jam: City Secrets
.cat
Roots
Dragon of Illusion

70070000037214.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Crescent Edition
70070000037214.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000037226.name: OFC - Ultimate Fighting Club: Path to Glory
70070000037226.intro: Fight your way to the top and claim the ultimate championship belt.
70070000037226.description:
Step into the ruthless world of no-holds-barred tournaments, where the only rule is victory. This bundle brings together the raw, high-intensity action and a new wave of aggression with an expanded fighter roster.

Bundle Includes:
1. OFC – Ultimate Fighting Club (Full Game): Real-world tournament intensity, deep upgrade mechanics, and brutal no-holds-barred combat. Master punches, kicks, and defense while upgrading your fighter’s vital stats.
2. OFC - Ultimate Fighting Club: Born to Fight: A new fighter has entered the club - Tyler Phoenix. Utilize his specific speed, strength, and unique tactical abilities to overwhelm the opposition.

Your path to glory is waiting. Are you ready to rule the cage?

70070000037240.name: My Cozy Aquarium: Extended Decorator Pack
70070000037240.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000037240.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle includes Antique Decoration, Glowing Decoration, Prehistoric Decoration, and Prehistoric Fish Pack & Aquarium DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000037266.name: Magic Cats Pots Extended Edition
70070000037266.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This bundle includes Frame Pack, Spring, and Summer DLCs.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000037267.name: The Treflik Family Platinum Edition
70070000037267.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000037267.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes four additional episodes: "New Neighbour", "A House Within A House", "Happy Family", and "A Visit".

70070000037271.name: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Trucker Life
70070000037271.intro: Rule the American highways and upgrade your fleet ahead of schedule.
70070000037271.description:
Experience the trucking journey across the highways of America! Explore dynamic cities, deliver cargo on schedule and reate a vehicle that reflects your style and improves performance on the road.

What’s included in the bundle:
1. Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver
Navigate industrial hubs, tight suburban corners, and massive highways. As a professional driver, your mission is to deliver diverse cargo safely and on schedule, expanding your business and sharpening your skills along the way.

2. Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver: Cargo Legends
Fuel your ambitions with 75,000 coins for limitless garage customization and engine tuning.

Load up your truck, fine-tune your performance, and leave your mark on the open road!

70070000037273.name: Egypt City Builder: Pharaoh’s Legacy
70070000037273.intro: Protect your loyal citizens from sudden devastating disasters.
70070000037273.description:
Step onto the fertile banks of the Nile as a fully funded pharaoh, ready to shape history from your very first move. Establish an untouchable desert superpower with the starting foundation. You will lead your citizens through sandstorms, floods, and political intrigue.

Bundle Includes:
1. Egypt City Builder - Experience the full depth of ancient city management, citizen progression, and tactical combat. Build, gather resources, and command your armies across fertile oases and harsh deserts.

2. Egypt City Builder: Ancient Find - Fill your vaults with 100 gold coins. Use this boost to construct vital homes, marketplaces, and majestic temples without waiting for harvest cycles.

Command your craftsmen, inspire your priests, arm your warriors, and banish the terrors of the desert.

70070000037296.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Epic Edition
70070000037296.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037296.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers, Custom Cruisers #2, Custom Cruisers #4 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-4 new skins for each Buggy

70070000037301.name: Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor – Sovereign Waters
70070000037301.intro: Claim your territory on the unpredictable open water.
70070000037301.description:
Embark on the definitive open-world maritime journey where every single wave brings a test of endurance and every horizon holds new mysteries. Stranded on a fragile wooden platform with nothing but a simple hook, you must conquer the endless blue.

Bundle Includes:
1. Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor (Base Game) – Master all core mechanics including gathering floating resources, crafting vital tools, filtering clean water, and cooking fresh fish to stay energized.

2. Shark Upgrade DLC – Defend your floating home against a relentless stalker that now features an entirely upgraded look and a unique material, making every close encounter visually intense.

3. Skybox Overhaul DLC – Navigate the treacherous waters beneath a breathtaking, completely redesigned skybox that brings unprecedented visual depth and realism to the day and night cycles.

Guard your floating fortress from the deep, look up at the stunningly realistic horizon, and prove that you have the vigilance required to tame the infinite ocean.

70070000037303.name: Club Sports Collection Diamond Edition
70070000037303.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037303.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #1, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #2 and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #3 with:

- 15 brand-new dart designs

70070000037309.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Diamond Edition
70070000037309.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037309.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!
