Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Expansion Pack #3 with:
5 new queues
10 new pool table designs
15 new snooker table designs

70070000037310.name: Mini Market Design Curriculum Couture
70070000037310.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000037310.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes Wallpaper Collection, Floor Design Collection, and School DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000037312.name: Cozy Memory Ultimate Edition
70070000037312.intro: Improve your focus and concentration in the most delightful memory game!
70070000037312.description:
Have you been looking for a game that is delightfully relaxing and charming, and at the same time improves your memory and concentration? Immerse yourself in Cozy Memory, where each card challenges and delights your mind. Here, memory training is pure pleasure!


Playing memory games regularly keeps your mind sharp and lifts your mood. But that’s not all – Cozy Memory’s charming hand-painted cards are a true feast for the eyes


Going a step beyond traditional memory puzzle rules, Cozy Memory also lets you choose the difficulty level to ensure satisfaction whether you're a memory expert or a beginner.

This bundle includes Covers Pack, Cards Pack 1, Cards Pack 2, Cards Pack 3, and Cards Pack 4 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Various levels of difficulty.
- Cozy illustrations with adorable animals.
- Colorful amusing covers.
- Relaxing music.

70070000037313.name: Only Up - Parkour Game: Peak
70070000037313.intro: Break the barrier, master the physics, and rule the sky!
70070000037313.description:
Launch your high-altitude adventure with a massive resource advantage! Reach the stratosphere faster than ever before with this bundle. Conquer every height, test your balance and master the art of vertical movement.

What’s Included in This Bundle:
• Only Up - Parkour Game (Base Game): Scale your way through 5 uniquely designed, surreal low-poly environments. Your journey begins on chaotic city streets, but as you climb higher, the world twists into a dreamlike playground.
• Only Up - Parkour Game: Coin Boost (DLC): Skip the early grind with 20,000 extra coins deposited directly into your active store balance, to spend on premium items, parachutes, and flight gear.

Don’t just climb—dominate the skies. The peak won’t wait.

70070000037314.name: Hole io: Construction Edition
70070000037314.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000037314.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Construction Edition features:
- 7 maps with different things to swallow 
- 20 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000037318.name: Who tells your story Fantasy Bundle
70070000037318.intro: Even more ways to create stories!
70070000037318.description:
Unfinished stories call for more adventures and fun! Let your imagination run wild with new inspirations, characters, and events!
Tell your story with an additional set of fantasy-themed pictograms! Let the world of fairy tales, dragons, and goblins come to life in your story!

70070000037320.name: Freaky Trip Wellness Week
70070000037320.intro: Go through untypically typical places and solve totally absurd riddles on your rescue mission.
70070000037320.description:
Put your imagination to the test and go on a freaky rescue trip. Help rescue Salcy’s beloved cockapoo from unknown danger in which she was sure to find herself . In Freaky Trip you will encounter many logical puzzles, which you can find everywhere. Watch your surroundings carefully and use everything that might be helpful – even if it seems unusual.


(NON)OBVIOUS SOLUTIONS
In this game, puzzles are not as easy as they might look like – as everything around you. Think outside the box, be unpredictable, and succeed on every level, to be an egg forward. Remember that sometimes the most unbelievable answers are the right ones. Try all possibilities and ask for help if you are stuck at any point.


FREAKY CHARACTERS
Meet surprising characters on your journey with Salcy, but don’t even bother to think if they are real – they somehow are. Try to help them and they will return the favor. Hey, have you seen this big buffalo merchant behind the tree? No? That’s weird, I'm sure it was standing there…


CARTOON GRAPHICS
Falling into the world of Freaky Trip is much easier thanks to colorful and cartoon graphics. Progress through this twisted story and watch how the riddles surprise you and make you laugh with every second. 

This bundle includes Self Care Pack DLC.

Key features:
- Humorous and totally absurd point-and-click adventure
- 14 various levels with a commonly uncommon story behind
- Entertaining characters and locations
- Exciting soundtrack

70070000037325.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Emerald Edition
70070000037325.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000037325.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - El Loco DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Masaru DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Jonathan DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Maverick DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Landon Phil DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 5 legendary boxers - El Loco, Masaru, Jonathan, Maverick and Landon Phil with their unique equipment and a bonus of 106 000 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2: Remastered allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000037331.name: Firefighters Simulator 2026: Critical Response
70070000037331.intro: When the alarm sounds, respond with absolute tactical and operational power.
70070000037331.description:
In the high-stakes world of emergency response, seconds cost lives and the right budget changes everything. Command your station with absolute confidence, take calculated risks, and watch your department grow at lightning speed under your expert leadership.

Bundle Includes:
ㆍFirefighters Simulator 2026 – Step into the boots of a frontline hero and take full control over every aspect of a growing rescue precinct. From authentic firefighting mechanics and vehicle operations to customizing gear, managing crew resources, and deploying to diverse, high-stakes missions, every life-saving decision rests on your shoulders.

ㆍFirefighters Simulator 2026: Emergency Budget – Fuel your management strategy with $5,000 credited directly to your station’s in-game account. Use this massive cash cushion to bypass the early-game budget grind, invest heavily in modern truck upgrades, or unlock top-tier hazmat suits and tools without worrying about the bottom line.

Step onto the frontline fully funded, fully equipped, and ready to save lives.

70070000037340.name: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse Midnight Edition
70070000037340.intro: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation
70070000037340.description:
This product contains the full game, Digital Sound & Art Gallery, as well as 3 bonus in-game items.

[Overview]
・Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse
・Digital Sound & Art Gallery
・Bonuses (In-game items) x3
└ Trevor Style Costume
└ Sypha Style Costume
└ Family's Grace（Relic）

Medieval Paris, Where the Tolling Bells Herald the End
1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.
Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

Satisfying Whip Action
Castlevania's iconic whip action is more satisfying than ever!
Crack your whip to move around freely like a trapeze artist!
Master the whip mechanics and be creative to pounce on your prey like a wolf in fast-paced combat!

Diverse Bosses and the Arcana System
Face-off against legendary bosses including Death, Medusa and Carmilla in addition to enigmatic new bosses such as Joan of Arc.
Once defeated, bosses are sealed into Rose's tarot cards, turning them into Arcana - use their skills to cast spells and obtain unique special actions

Customize Your Battle Style with Weapons and Relics
Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.
Combine equipment you discover through exploration to create your own playstyle!

Iconic Castlevania Atmosphere, Reimagined in New Stages
From iconic Gothic aesthetics to vivid, refined visuals, the game presents a fresh take on the world of Castlevania.
Explore maps filled with both new features and familiar elements inspired by classic Castlevania titles.

70070000037348.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Checkpoint Overlord
70070000037348.intro: Dominate your border shifts and master every inspection.
70070000037348.description:
Immerse yourself completely in a world devastated by the undead outbreak.  Take on the high-stakes role of a frontline guard, manage the intense flow of survivors, and make critical decisions to stop the infection.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Inspect arrivals, analyze symptoms, manage the quarantine zone, and defend the human safe haven from constant zombie threats. Every decision you make carries immense weight, and every survival protocol depends on your alertness.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Frontline Gear
This DLC changes the appearance of your character’s hands, allowing you to inspect documents, handle security tools, and neutralize quarantine threats with a brand-new style.

Prepare your post, look the part of an elite officer, and do whatever it takes to keep the infection contained behind the quarantine wall.

70070000037356.name: TCG Card Market Simulator: Marketplace
70070000037356.intro: Build your ultimate trading card empire and dominate the market!
70070000037356.description:
Step into the ultimate card shop simulation experience with everything you need to dominate the market and stand out from the competition. Build, style, and accelerate your trading card empire from the ground up.

Bundle Includes:
1. TCG Card Market Simulator – Stock booster packs, open rare cards for your personal collection, set pricing strategies, track market trends, and organize epic tournaments to attract trading card enthusiasts.

2. TCG Card Market Simulator: Skybox Upgrade – Replace the original backdrop with a stunning, scenic new skybox that completely revitalizes your shop’s environment and enhances the trading atmosphere.

3. TCG Card Market Simulator: Exterior Customization – Express your unique style by transforming your storefront walls with vibrant, original graffiti artwork to catch everyone’s eye and create a memorable community hub.

4. TCG Card Market Simulator: Balance Boost – Your balance grows by 2500 cash, providing the resources to expand faster and smarter.

Your store, your rules, your empire. Fill your shelves, transform your space, and claim your place at the top of the TCG market!

70070000037360.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection Season 6
70070000037360.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection + Summer 2 + Independence Day + Christmas 2 + Autumn 2 + Halloween 2 + Spring 2

70070000037361.name: Voxelgram Complete Bundle
70070000037361.intro: Get Both Voxelgram Games in One Bundle. 500+ 3D Nonograms to Solve!
70070000037361.description:
This pack includes the games:
- Voxelgram
- Voxelgram 2

70070000037368.name: BACKROOMS POOLS GOLD EDITION
70070000037368.intro: Face the unknown in the endless pools!
70070000037368.description:
Step into a disorienting and eerie world where every corridor feels alive and every shadow hides a secret. In Backrooms Pools, navigate vast pools of murky water, shifting walls, and echoing footsteps as you try to uncover what lurks in the darkness. Every turn deepens the tension and tests your courage.

This bundle includes main title and BACKROOMS POOLS: MONSTERS BELOW DLC, taking your nightmare further. Explore even deeper submerged corridors and face two terrifying new creatures that haunt the watery depths. Will you escape unscathed, or become just another shadow in the endless maze?

Survive, explore, and confront the horrors that wait beneath the surface.

70070000037369.name: Soapy Tales Sweet Honey Edition
70070000037369.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70070000037369.description:
Suddenly, you wake up as a ghost, with no memories. Your good and bad deed count is perfectly even, so you need to go back to Earth to earn your redemption. 
Rediscover your past life and relive touching memories while attending to family business.

Soapy Tales combines doing relaxing chores with elements of time and space management. Complete the tasks, upgrade your skills, and unveil the story of your life in the midst of pastel, soapy bubbles!

This bundle includes Teddy Bear And Honey DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- First-person point of view gameplay. 
- Cozy, nostalgic atmosphere.
- Relaxing music. 
- Skill tree and artifacts to unlock.

70070000037370.name: Cat & Friends Memory Cloud Nine Companions
70070000037370.intro: Cozy family game with the cutesy animal friends - train yours eye and brain , and see who remembers best!
70070000037370.description:
In Cat & Friends Memory, you’ll flip and match adorable animal cards - from playful kittens to cheerful puppies - while training your memory and having fun together.


Challenge yourself or play with family to see who remembers best! The relaxing atmosphere, simple controls, and colorful visuals make every round a cheerful brain workout you’ll love coming back to.

This bundle includes Back Cards, Cards Pack 1 and Cards Pack 2 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Adorable animal cards full of charm and color
- Train your memory while having fun
- Great for solo play or friendly family matches
- Adjustable difficulty for every skill level
- Bright, cozy visuals and relaxing music
- A perfect way to unwind and keep your mind sharp

70070000037387.name: Cooking Arena Definitive Edition
70070000037387.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000037387.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Food Truck Tycoon- Asian Cuisine", "Burger Chef Tycoon" and "Breakfast Bar Tycoon".

70070000037391.name: Knights & Guns Luxury Edition
70070000037391.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000037391.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Armor Pack #2 and Armor Pack #4 with:
- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 8 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000037392.name: Urban Flow Throne Edition
70070000037392.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000037392.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

This bundle includes base game, Winter Expansion Pack, Streets Supplement #2 and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    20 new stages!
•    12 new vehicles (withthe firetruck and snow plow!)
•    Enjoy the winter theme and new music!

70070000037411.name: Gods With Guns - Deluxe Edition
70070000037411.intro: Gods With Guns + DLC Children of Loki + DLC Primordial Giants + DLC Samurai Spirit
70070000037411.description: Gods With Guns + DLC Children of Loki + DLC Primordial Giants + DLC Samurai Spirit

70070000037419.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.23
70070000037419.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the twenty-third additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Cuddly Little Animals
- Cozy Cafe Sweets
- Enchanting Underwater World
- [Moving] Journey Through France

70070000037428.name: Bun Buns: Cozy Edition
70070000037428.intro: Don’t let your buns hop out the basket! Drop, merge, and stack your pastries to bake the biggest, most delicious treat!
70070000037428.description:
Get ready to bake your heart out! Combine fluffy buns, watch them grow into mouth-watering pastries, and push your skills to the limit in this physics-based puzzle challenge.

Use clever power-ups to escape sticky situations and keep burnt dough under control. Timing and placement are everything! One wrong move, and your perfect bake could crumble!

Travel through charming bakeries, each bringing new twists and challenges to master. How big can your ultimate bun get?

Features:
- 3 maps with unique basket shapes
- Online leaderboards to show off your skills!
- Co-op mode to bake together with friends!
- 9 new hairstyles, 2 outfits, 2 hats and 2 accessories!
- Handy power-ups to save your run!
- Fully customizable baker with cute outfits
- A warm and cozy aesthetic

Bake yourself a fresh high score!

70070000037433.name: Splash of Color: Mandala Edition
70070000037433.intro: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!
70070000037433.description:
Piece together bright, colorful images by swapping tiles and solving lively puzzles. Watch patterns shift, colors click into place, and pictures slowly reveal themselves as you play. Jump in, make a few swaps, and watch the colors come together.

Features:
- 48 puzzles big and small for you to solve
- Simple and satisfying swap puzzle mechanics.
- A lively and colorful aesthetic!

Watch the colors fall into place!

70070000037435.name: FISHING SIMULATOR 2025: Elite Fishing
70070000037435.intro: Escape to pristine waters and test your patience against the deep.
70070000037435.description:
Explore a calm, rewarding simulation where patience is key, but your gear choices are entirely unrestricted. Invest in professional rods, specialized hooks, and high-performance bait from day one, and perfect your approach for nimble trout or aggressive pike without any economic pressure.

Included in this bundle:
1. Fishing Simulator 2025 (Game) – Master the unique behaviors of multiple fish species, adapt to changing weather conditions, and find your perfect quiet spot along the water’s edge. Every cast is a new opportunity to test your patience and refine your technique in a living, breathing ecosystem.

2. FISHING SIMULATOR 2025: Big Catch (DLC) – Boost your fishing adventure with $5,000 cash. Invest in high-tier reels, specialized lines, and advanced bait combinations, allowing you to tailor your strategy to any target fish.

Don’t wait for the perfect bite—be ready for it! Your perfect quiet spot is waiting.

70070000037444.name: Farm Land: Best Friends Edition
70070000037444.intro: Start your farming adventure! Take care of the plants, watch them grow and harvest the crops!
70070000037444.description:
Your quest is simple... sow the seeds, harvest the crops, sell your products to the merchants and expand your farm to become the best farmer you can be!

This bundle includes:
- Farm Land
- Farm Land: Kitten
- Farm Land: Puppy

Features:
- unlock kitten and puppy that will follow you wherever you go!
- unlock active bonuses that increase: coins collected from merchants by 25% or  items collected in the barn by 30%
- get 500 extra gems to spend on: unlocking random characters, an instant rain event or a harvest upgrade
- build well-functioning farms on 4 maps
- unlock over 50 cool skins!
- play with a friend on a split screen in local multiplayer mode
- harvest apples, wheat, tomatoes, eggplants and all your favorite fruits and vegetables
- play many mini-games involving animals
- hire workers to help you plant and harvest your crops
- expand your farm by buying more land
- ride a bike to speed up movement around your giant farm
- fast travel with your boat and double your income

Take part in other very satisfying activities. Go fishing, milk all the cows, shear the sheep and much more!

If you need a little help on the farm, invite a friend to play together on the split screen! Put on your funny skins, hop on your bikes and share the responsibilities.

Are you ready for country life?

70070000037454.name: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Master Edition
70070000037454.intro: Smart infrastructure investments, optimized flight routes, and absolute market control.
70070000037454.description:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling world of air transportation as the inheritor of a small airline company left to you by a distant relative. From humble beginnings at a small airport to building a global aviation logistics empire — incredible adventures, challenges, and opportunities await to shape your destiny.

Bundle Includes:
1. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business – Explore diverse locations, from small regional airports to bustling metropolitan hubs. Discover over 10 unique airports worldwide, each with distinct architecture and business development potential.

2. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cash Cargo – Unlock an impressive $350,000 in-game currency bonus as soon as you enter to invest in top-tier aircraft, enhance your hangar facilities, and expand your business reach.

3. Flight Simulator Delivery – Business Expansion – Receive the first hangar right from the start to establish a solid foundation to expand your fleet and operations. If you already own it, you will instead be granted $80,000 in in-game currency.

4. Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business - Powerlift Cargo – Receive the Heavy Lift Carrier aircraft along with a dedicated aircraft slot — your gateway to transporting larger and heavier cargo across the globe. If you already own it, you will receive $525,000 in compensation instead.

Are you ready to transform a single-engine plane into a global aviation powerhouse?

70070000037459.name: Backrooms: Exit from Supermarket GOLD EDITION
70070000037459.intro: Lost in the supermarket of nightmares
70070000037459.description:
Enter a nightmarish version of the ordinary in survival horror experience. Trapped inside an endless, eerie supermarket, you must explore abandoned aisles, solve cryptic puzzles, and search for an escape while something unseen stalks your every move. Flickering lights, shifting spaces, and a constant sense of dread turn every step into a test of survival.

This bundle includes the main title and the Backrooms: Exit from Supermarket Creepy Music DLC, intensifying the horror with a deeply unsettling soundtrack. Experience distorted ambient sounds, eerie supermarket jingles, and reactive audio that follows your every move, amplifying the tension with every step. The deeper you go, the more the sound itself becomes part of the nightmare.

Stay quiet, stay alert, and try to escape before the darkness and the sound consume you.

70070000037463.name: Stick Combat - Fighting Platformer: Warrior
70070000037463.intro: Dominate every stickman arena and push your combat potential past.
70070000037463.description:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate stickman challenge with the definitive action-platformer experience. Every leap across dangerous hazards is a calculated risk, driven forward by the relentless drive to conquer the world’s deep secrets.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Stick Combat - Fighting Platformer
As a stickman warrior, use your skills and wits to survive attacks, unlock doors, and conquer increasingly difficult levels. Master combat, utilize weapons, and navigate hazards using environmental objects. Embark on an epic adventure through diverse environments and uncover the world’s secrets.

2. Stick Combat - Fighting Platformer: Power Up
Face the ultimate test of survival with adding two extra hearts to your health bar. With this vital protection, you can absorb severe damage from hidden traps, heavy enemy strikes, and explosive hazards without losing your momentum.

Do not just survive the gauntlet—dominate every trap and conquer the world’s deepest secrets!

70070000037466.name: Frost Survival – Winter: Deep Frost
70070000037466.intro: Adapt to the freezing mountain climate and outlast the most dangerous predators.
70070000037466.description:
Immerse yourself in the ultimate sub-zero challenge with the definitive winter survival experience. Every step through the deep drifts is a calculated risk, driven forward by the desperate search for a missing friend.

Bundle Includes:
• Frost Survival - Winter
Experience the complete story-driven progression across a beautiful but deadly snowy mountain and forest world. Track dangerous wildlife, gather vital resources, and discover scattered notes to unlock new survival recipes.

• Frost Survival – Winter: Energy Surge
Enjoy a permanent fifty percent reduction in energy drain for all running, jumping, sprinting, and attacking. This DLC allows you to navigate the deepest snow drifts and scale steep mountain peaks with twice the physical efficiency.

Do not just struggle to survive the winter—dominate it.

70070000037476.name: The Smurfs Creative Edition
70070000037476.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000037476.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes Personal Boards 7, Personal Boards 8, and Personal Boards 9 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000037477.name: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000037477.intro: Get the Digital Deluxe Edition bundled with the Original Soundtrack!
70070000037477.description:
You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you...

SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the lives of Saeko, a girl with mysterious abilities, and the little people she has shrunk to the size of her thumb.
Experience Saeko's and the little people's fates in the day and at night, through two separate game systems with different art styles.

You are Rin, the latest addition to the little people. Under Saeko’s protection, you spend your days in her desk drawer together with the other little people.
But don't let your guard down. Saeko has some...interesting hobbies, to say the least.

・Stunning and unique visuals drawn in two different styles of pixel art
・A world filled with brutal allure inspired by many strange tales, beginning with Fueti Shizue’s work
・An original game system which forces players to make difficult choices and live with the consequences
・A soundtrack heavily influenced by future garage and breakcore, composed by the developer himself
・The deepest journey into a developer’s proclivities in indie game history

[The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the Original Soundtrack]
Original soundtrack by developer kyp.
A collection of tracks that bring back to life the everyday world inside that drawer.

70070000037510.name: Urban Jungle + Sticky Business
70070000037510.intro: Urban Jungle and Sticky Business bundled together.
70070000037510.description:
Urban Jungle: Urban Jungle is a charming and relaxing simulation game that invites you to transform ordinary apartments into a lush, green haven by placing delightful plants with savvy.

Sticky Business: Experience the joy of running your own cozy small business: Create stickers, pack orders and hear your customers’ stories. Time to build the cutest shop on the internet!

70070000037516.name: Ecchi Breaker: Playful Edition
70070000037516.intro: Break the blocks and meet strong women.
70070000037516.description:
Focus and get ready to play. Each hit brings you closer to what lies behind the blocks, and the prize for winning has never looked so good.

Focus, control your shots, and watch the tension rise with each block you destroy. But be careful... too many misses and the moment may slip away.

Features:
- 48 strong girls waiting to be discovered
- Sensual music and satisfying effects
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- A feast for the eyes

Take up the challenge.

70070000037526.name: Fit My Cat Ultra Deluxe Edition
70070000037526.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000037526.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

This bundle includes Rooms Pack 1, Rooms Pack 2, and Boxes Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000037527.name: My Cozy Room Platinum Edition
70070000037527.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000037527.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes 16 DLC packs filled with cozy decorations, stylish furniture, and charming customization options. Expand your My Cozy Room experience with plenty of new items, create even more unique interiors, and make every room feel warm, personal, and full of character.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000037529.name: Neko Bento Platinum Edition
70070000037529.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000037529.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes New Levels 1, New Levels 2, and Backgrounds Pack DLCs.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000037530.name: Memory For Kids Special Edition
70070000037530.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000037530.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes Back Cards and Cards Pack 1 DLCs.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels

70070000037531.name: Paint For Kids Beginner Artist Edition
70070000037531.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000037531.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones. 

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes Additional Board 1 and Additional Board 2 DLCs.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use

70070000037532.name: Ecchi Uncover: Beauty & Pleasure Edition
70070000037532.intro: Will you let these gorgeous girls blow you away?
70070000037532.description:
Traverse through a field of mines to uncover beautiful girls hiding within. Tread carefully, and you might just stumble on a different pair of bombs.
Features:
- Over 148 enticing pictures of girls with or without clothes
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes
Prepare for an explosion of emotions!

70070000037538.name: Bowling Fever Hyper Edition
70070000037538.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000037538.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #3, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-40 new bowling ball styles

70070000037539.name: Oblivion Dreams: Apocalypse Edition
70070000037539.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000037539.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 64 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.

70070000037541.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Diamond Edition
70070000037541.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000037541.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1, expansion pack #2 and expansion pack #3 with:

9 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000037543.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Superior Edition
70070000037543.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000037543.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #3 with:

-2 sets of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000037545.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Diamond Edition
70070000037545.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000037545.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #2 and Pizza Bar Tycoon Multiplayer Mode with:

- 40 new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon
- local multiplayer gameplay mode for Pizza Bar Tycoon

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000037548.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Charged Edition
70070000037548.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000037548.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Droid Nom who triggers a medium turbo boost a few seconds after the race starts!
- Iron Nom who gives you a 30-second shield right at the start!
- 2000 gold to buy new Noms!

NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Grab friends or family and jump into the same race on one screen. Chase the lead, pull off last-second comebacks, and see who really is the fastest runner among you!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000037550.name: Moto Rush GT Luxury Edition
70070000037550.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000037550.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Full Garage, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 13 new vehicles—including an ATV and bicycle!
- 16 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000037553.name: Ecchi Memories: Reina Edition
70070000037553.intro: Let the bras hit the floor!
70070000037553.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 8 beautiful girls with impressive proportions (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000037554.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Throne Edition
70070000037554.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Weaponry Upgrade, Neon Strike and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm 
- FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation 
- SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy 
- SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
- UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
- SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000037561.name: Paper io 2: Busy Edition
70070000037561.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000037561.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- 29 skins which also change the look of your terrain
- 6 new funny hats to wear
- custom game with 54 various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000037562.name: Ecchi Crush: Summer Edition
70070000037562.intro: One hot match leads to another.
70070000037562.description:
Ready to line things up and see where it leads? Match colorful pieces, chain together juicy combos, and clear the board to reveal a gorgeous surprise waiting underneath.

Every move clears a little more of the picture. Keep crushing tiles, breaking through tougher boards, and revealing beautiful girls piece by piece. The deeper you go, the hotter it gets... so stay sharp and keep the matches coming.

Features:
- A quartet of beautiful women with a clock display
- Unique music for every girl
- Simple and engaging match-3 gameplay
- Satisfying combos and challenging stages
- A treat for your eyes

Your crush is waiting for you.

70070000037563.name: nGolf Birthday Play Pack
70070000037563.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000037563.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes Colorful Golf Balls 7 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000037564.name: Pixie Plates: Hot Edition
70070000037564.intro: A magical cooking adventure full of charm and tasty treats!
70070000037564.description:
Whisk up delicious dishes, slide them onto a plate, add the perfect toppings, and serve them to a parade of adorable fantasy customers!

Prepare delightful food and drinks, from decorated pastries and lovely desserts to warm soups, colorful refreshments, and other tasty specialties. Every order needs the right ingredients and finishing touches before it is ready for your magical guests.

Things can get wonderfully busy in the kitchen! Watch your cooking stations carefully, keep drinks from spilling over, and make smart use of every plate as new customers arrive with fresh requests. Leave food cooking for too long or let a drink overflow, and you will have to toss it in the bin and start again. With more hungry customers arriving and several orders waiting at once, there is always something exciting happening behind the counter!

Journey across 4 enchanting worlds, with 10 levels in each one. Every world brings its own atmosphere, charming customers, and themed dishes and drinks to discover!

Features:
- Prepare and serve a delicious variety of fantasy-inspired food and drinks
- Explore all 4 unique worlds!
- Create every order step by step by cooking, plating, and adding toppings
- Meet adorable customers including pixies, frogs, and other whimsical creatures
- Play through 40 delightful levels!
- Keep your kitchen running smoothly while managing plates and multiple orders
- Immerse yourself in a bright and whimsical fairy-tale setting

A world of sweet creations and enchanting customers is always ready for the next order!

70070000037570.name: Piano: Learn and Play Prestige Edition
70070000037570.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000037570.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes Song Pack 4, Song Pack 5, Song Pack 6, Song Pack 7, and Song Pack 9 DLCs.

Key Features:
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000037573.name: Cook For Love Lyon Pack
70070000037573.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000037573.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes Lyon DLC.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000037577.name: Barbarous: Survivor's Quest - Spell Edition
70070000037577.intro: Battle the horde and survive the quest!
70070000037577.description:
The land is overrun by hungry orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and other dangerous creatures, and only the strongest will last! Fight through wave after wave of enemies, face powerful bosses, and upgrade your hero to become unstoppable.

Every run is a new challenge! Choose your upgrades wisely and shape your build as you progress. Open treasure chests, gather experience, and stay in the fight as the enemy waves grow stronger.

Improve your stats, unlock powerful weapons, and collect valuable rewards as you carve your way through the chaos!

Features:
- Fight waves of orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and more
- Explore an additional map with extreme difficulty: Mages Guild
- Meet a new brave character: Varizz
- Discover a new powerful weapon: Eye of the Void
- Shape your build with many weapons and items
- Face powerful bosses and earn valuable rewards
- Upgrade and evolve your gear!
- Power up and become the ultimate hero

How long can you survive before the horde overwhelms you?

70070000037579.name: Bartender Simulator & Fast Food Van Simulator 2026
70070000037579.description:
Two jobs. Constant pressure. No room for mistakes.
This bundle puts you in the middle of two fast-moving environments where everything depends on how well you manage time, orders, and workflow. Whether you're behind the bar or inside a food truck, every second pushes you to stay focused and in control.

Both experiences are built around real-time actions, where you prepare, serve, and react without pause. The pace increases quickly, forcing you to think ahead, stay organized, and handle multiple tasks at once. Success isn’t just about speed — it’s about doing everything right under pressure.

Bartender Simulator 2026

Take control of a busy bar where orders never stop coming. Mix drinks, follow recipes, and manage multiple customers at once while keeping everything running smoothly.
Work faster and cleaner with each shift, improve your setup, and adapt as the pace increases. Staying focused and organized becomes essential as every small mistake can slow you down.

Fast Food Van Simulator 
Run your own food truck in a fast-paced street environment where timing and accuracy are everything. Prepare meals, manage orders, and keep customers satisfied as demand keeps growing.
Upgrade your equipment, improve efficiency, and optimize your workflow to handle more orders without losing control. Every decision affects how well you perform.

Two different environments. One constant challenge — stay in control.
Bartender Simulator & Fast Food Van Simulator 2026 delivers a dynamic simulation experience where speed, precision, and smart decisions define your success.

70070000037580.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS - Deluxe Edition
70070000037580.description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS
• Season Pass 
- 6 playable characters and customization items, including uniforms
• Season Pass Bonus
- Ball Customization: Black Ball

The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

• New and Improved Gameplay
Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

• A Soccer World That is Bigger Than Before!
Featuring 22 national teams, over 110 playable characters, and more than 150 cutscenes highlighting moves on the pitch! Previously unseen teams from the manga and original teams and characters clash in glorious, meticulous animation. The excitement of these once-in-a-lifetime moments has never been higher!

• Experience the New Storylines based on the World Youth Arc supervised by Yoichi Takahashi
Pick up where the first game left off and follow Tsubasa as he takes on formidable new rivals in the thrilling story based on the World Youth arc.
Discover expanded storylines overseen by the original creator, Yoichi Takahashi, and witness powerhouse nations clash as they chase international glory.
Step onto the pitch in the NEW STARS ROUTE, create your own custom player, join the Japanese national team, and fight alongside Tsubasa on the road to world victory.

• Powerful and Inspiring Music
Tadayoshi Makino (SpinSolfa), praised for his moving BGM tracks from the previous title, brings over 100 energized tracks to this iteration. Dare to compete with this exhilarating compilation of melodies perfectly suited to the high-octane action of Captain Tsubasa, the king of sports of anime, as Tsubasa and his teammates give their all on the pitch for the ultimate victory.

*This product is the Deluxe Edition. Other editions are available, so be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Season Pass DLC contents will be released by August 2027. Additional details will be provided at a later date.

70070000037581.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS - Ultimate Edition
70070000037581.description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS
• Season Pass 
- 6 playable characters and customization items, including uniforms
• Season Pass Bonus
- Ball Customization: Black Ball
• Ultimate Pack
- 5 alternate uniforms
- 3 alternate ball customizations
- 2 goal celebrations
- 2 Main Menu themes featuring one original illustration by Yoichi Takahashi and one game exclusive illustration
- 2 early unlock powerful move cards: Neo Drive Shot & Neo Tiger Shot

The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

• New and Improved Gameplay
Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

• A Soccer World That is Bigger Than Before!
Featuring 22 national teams, over 110 playable characters, and more than 150 cutscenes highlighting moves on the pitch! Previously unseen teams from the manga and original teams and characters clash in glorious, meticulous animation. The excitement of these once-in-a-lifetime moments has never been higher!

• Original Story Scenario Supervised by Yoichi Takahashi
Experience new, thrilling Captain Tsubasa scenarios featured in the World Youth arc. Enjoy Story Mode from the sidelines with an original scenario supervised by the original author, Yoichi Takahashi. Test your mettle with the NEW STARS ROUTE, where you can play as a member of the Japanese national team. Explore alternate side-stories which supplement the World Youth arc, and watch the exploits of rival nations in their quest for glory.

• Powerful and Inspiring Music
Tadayoshi Makino (SpinSolfa), praised for his moving BGM tracks from the previous title, brings over 100 energized tracks to this iteration. Dare to compete with this exhilarating compilation of melodies perfectly suited to the high-octane action of Captain Tsubasa, the king of sports of anime, as Tsubasa and his teammates give their all on the pitch for the ultimate victory.

*This product is the Ultimate Edition. Other editions are available, so be careful of duplicate purchases.
*Season Pass DLC contents will be released by August 2027. Additional details will be provided at a later date.

70070000037596.name: Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter – Hardcore Survival
70070000037596.intro: Master the chaos of virtual warfare as you face the nightmare lurking in darkness.
70070000037596.description:
Survival isn’t just about shooting—it’s about adaptation. This bundle pushes the boundaries of Warzone Chronicles to their limit, plunging you into a desolate, decaying world where every shadow hides a threat.

This bundle includes:
1. Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter — Engage in a brutal struggle for survival against relentless zombie waves, presented through a gritty, authentic VHS lens.

2. WARZONE CHRONICLES - Night Vision DLC — Master the darkness. Navigate pitch-black corridors and gain a tactical edge where visibility is the difference between life and death.

3. Warzone Chronicles: Interior Essentials Pack — Rediscover the arena. New furniture and interior objects transform the abandoned complex into a complex, unpredictable labyrinth.

4. Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter - Haunted Interiors — Witness the decay. Experience a deeper level of dread with disturbing new environmental details that make every hallway feel claustrophobic and hauntingly real.

The ruins are waiting. How long can you survive before the abyss claims you?

70070000037600.name: BUS SIM 25 - CITY SIMULATOR: Pure Driving
70070000037600.intro: Step into the cabin. Command the streets like a pro.
70070000037600.description:
Step into the cabin and enjoy the ultimate driving escape. Take control of the streets, manage your fleet, and experience the full open-world simulator with an enhanced visual twist.

This Bundle Includes:
1. BUS SIM 25 - CITY SIMULATOR (Base Game): Master authentic bus driving, create custom routes, manage your fleet of diesel and electric buses, and grow your business from a rookie driver to a transport tycoon.

2. BUS SIM 25 - CITY SIMULATOR: Urban Sky (DLC): Change the mood of the city with a atmospheric alternative sky dome designed to elevate your gameplay aesthetics.

Are you ready to build your empire under a whole new sky?

70070000037605.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Extended Edition
70070000037605.description:
No matter if it's your first time playing poker, or you’re a seasoned veteran, with this game you will sharpen your skills and experience the thrill of winning big at the poker table! 

You can play with AI or up to 6 players in local multiplayer mode. There are five difficulty levels, and lots of customisation features: 

- Custom Blinds
- Round time limit
- Shop with over 20 different tables, floors and table materials 
- 10 card artwork styles to choose from
- Player avatars

… and more! Check it out and enjoy a crash course in probability, psychology, and game theory.


This bundle contains main title and Cards Set #1, with:

- 1 new set of averses and reverses for cards

70070000037609.name: Street Basketball Extended Edition
70070000037609.description:
Put your dueling instincts to the test in one-on-one matches!

Choose from multiple characters with their signature ability shots.
Pick their looks from the list of available outfits.
Make them better players by improving their stats!

Challenge your mates in one-on-one local multiplayer mode! 

Shoot, block, shove and dunk your way through tournaments to unlock additional characters.

The must-have game for all basketball lovers!

GAME FEATURES:

* 19 different characters with their own signature ability shots and unique looks
* Two different single player modes (League and Challenge)
* COMPETE 1-ON-1 IN LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MODE (Versus)
* Improve your character by leveling up and upgrading their stats
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* 36 achievements to complete
* 10 statistics to track your progress and beat

This bundle contains main title and Street Style Kit #1,  with:

- 1 new set of jersey, shorts and boots

70070000037614.name: Cozy Land Green Valley
70070000037614.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000037614.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

This bundle includes Nature DLC.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000037617.name: Ants Empire Colony – Wild Sandbox
70070000037617.intro: Dominate the forest floor or become predator food.
70070000037617.description:
Step into the shoes of a brave ant and unlock your ultimate potential. Face countless challenges, push past normal physical limits, and rebuild your ruined colony

This bundle includes:
1. Ants Empire Colony – A unique sandbox-style adventure across a massive, reactive map. Collect, build, fight, and complete 11 tactical missions to restore your empire.

2. Ants Empire Colony: Power Surge – Boost your ant’s potential! This DLC doubling your stamina and turns you into a relentless force against nature and enemies alike.

Fuel your ambition, push past physical limits, and become the legendary savior the colony desperately needs.

70070000037621.name: Softly Placed Deluxe Edition
70070000037621.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70070000037621.description:
Step into the world, where mundane tasks turn into little adventures and ordinary items provide so much joy. See everything around you in bright, new, vibrant colors and make things even more beautiful by adding fun patterns. Wake up your inner child and find the happiness in little things.
 
Each level of the game consists of a unique challenge, providing fresh, yet relaxing gameplay, that will make you curious for what’s coming next.  

This bundle includes Fantasy Pack and Sci-Fi Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
-40 unique cozy puzzle levels
-Gameplay consisting of different types of challenges
-Beautiful, vibrant visuals, where everyday items turn into something magical
-Relaxing, cheerful soundtrack 
-Inspiring, nostalgic atmosphere
-Variety of puzzles exercising different parts of the brain

70070000037626.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Combat
70070000037626.intro: Breathe the combat. Mask your movement. Take command.
70070000037626.description:
Dive into a gritty, adrenaline-fueled military experience where squad coordination and lightning-fast reflexes mean the difference between victory and defeat. Modern warfare requires absolute precision, tactical awareness, and the right gear.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Engage in intense, points-based military combat across dynamic maps with a massive arsenal of over 20 weapons.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Green Armour – A specialized HUD overlay that brings clearer, faster visual feedback to your protection status in the heat of battle.

3. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands – Complete your soldier look with camouflage green hands and gloves built for modern warfare.

Outsmart your rivals, outlast the enemy, and step onto the battlefield looking like a true elite operative. Will you answer the call?

70070000037635.name: Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions – Warfare Battle
70070000037635.intro: Enter dark corridors, breach heavy barriers, and regain operational control.
70070000037635.description:
When dealing with dangerous counter-terrorism scenarios and armed threats across the globe, standard equipment is rarely enough. To survive these intense urban combat zones, teams must back up their strategic planning with reliable, top-tier equipment, including high-performance weaponry, advanced optics, and specialized field gear.

Bundle Includes:
1. Critical Strike Shooter: SWAT Rescue Missions (Full Game) – This tactical simulation focuses on high-risk counter-terrorism operations and specialized hostage rescue scenarios. Every deployment tests structural navigation, positional discipline, and tactical execution across volatile high-pressure zones where there is zero margin for error.

2. Unleash the New Rifle (DLC) –  Immediate availability of the powerful Automatic Rifle III provides a massive advantage in critical sectors. If you own this weapon,  you’ll receive its value in in-game currency.

3. Advanced Scope (DLC) – Enhanced visual precision arrives through the Sight 2 high-definition scope, built for the Automatic Rifle III. This attachment delivers sharper target acquisition and superior control, ensuring clear sightlines during intense room-clearing operations.

4. Combat Gloves (DLC) – Seamless integration of the elite Skin 6 tactical gloves serves as a visual indicator of discipline and professional status. If this apparel item is already owned, an alternative allocation of $2,500 in-game currency is issued instead.

Establish perimeter dominance, execute flawless breach protocols, and secure the objective under the most volatile conditions.

70070000037644.name: Battle Pixel: Arena Master
70070000037644.intro: High-octane pixel warfare starts here. Are you ready?
70070000037644.description:
You’re heading into a high-stakes combat zone with zero margin for error — where only lightning-fast decisions, dead-eye aim, and clever positioning lead to the top. But skill alone isn’t enough when the zone shrinks, you need the financial backing to fund your firepower and unlock elite hardware right from the start.

What’s Included:
1. Battle Pixel — Experience intense, fast-paced first-person combat against real players and bots. Drive vehicles, outrun the shrinking zone, and fight for the top spot.

2. Battle Pixel: Arsenal Capital — Fund your firepower with a tactical 3,000 cash boost. Buy favorite weapon builds, or access rare character customization options.

Maximize your focus on survival while your combat bankroll is fully covered!

70070000037652.name: Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight - Adrenaline Rush
70070000037652.intro: Dominate every checkpoint and leave a massive visual statement in your wake.
70070000037652.description:
Take your first leap into the world of extreme aerosports and make sure the whole world is watching your descent. Master distinct flight dynamics, and conquer daredevil gaps over snowy peaks.
