What’s inside this bundle:
• Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight (Full Game):
Strap into your wingsuit and leap from dizzying heights, carving through clouds and cliffs with unmatched precision. Diving through urban canyons, or skimming across desert plateaus, the sky is your playground—and your challenge.

• Skydiving Simulator: Wingsuit Flight - Color Burst (DLC):
Head straight to the shop and equip three premium colors for your smoke effect to paint the atmosphere during your dives.

The air is freezing, the height is dizzying, and the void is calling. Are you ready to dive into the void with ultimate flair?

70070000037671.name: Collector's Cove Summer Pack Edition
70070000037671.description:
All aboard! Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish on your quest to become a Named Collector! 

Get ready for the beach with the Collector's Cove Summer Pack!
This outfit collection will let you enjoy the tropical sun in style.
This pack features five breezy cosmetics for your animal companion and five sun-kissed additions for your character.

70070000037676.name: Family Chess Prime Edition
70070000037676.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000037676.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes Ocean Blue Chessboard and Black & White Chessboard DLCs.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000037689.name: nOS new Operating System Ultra Platinum
70070000037689.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000037689.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here! 

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes Wallpapers Pack 1, Screensaver Clock, Icon Themes, Long Cat, and Sudoku DLCs.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game

70070000037697.name: Ashwood Valley Ocean Dreams Pack
70070000037697.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000037697.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

Unlock new quest, character, outfits and change the look of your room with Cozy Comforts Style, Sunny Summer Style, Draco's Nook, Luna's Nook and Seaside Stories DLCs included in this bundle.

This bundle includes Aqua Nook DLC.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70070000037708.name: Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter: Frontline Survivor
70070000037708.intro: Where the sky turns black, the hunt begins.
70070000037708.description:
Dive into the dangerous world of extreme meteorology, where every split-second decision determines your survival. Confront unpredictable storm cells, devastating gale-force winds, and rapid atmospheric shifts designed to test both your reflexes and your tactical planning.

What’s Included:
1. Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter
Take control of powerful chase vehicles, deploy advanced tracking sensors, and intercept terrifying tornadoes across vast, dynamic landscapes.

2. Storm Chasing Sim 2025 - Tornado Hunter: Budget Boost
An instant injection of 2,000 coins credited directly to the in-game wallet, giving full creative freedom in the garage.

Maximize your vehicle’s performance, secure elite meteorological tech, and conquer the storm. Are you ready to outrun the chaos?

70070000037712.name: Club Sports Collection Silver Edition
70070000037712.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037712.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #1 and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #2 with:

- 10 brand-new dart designs

70070000037721.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Silver Edition
70070000037721.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037721.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Expansion Pack #2 with:
5 new queues
5 new pool table designs
10 new snooker table designs

70070000037744.name: Cooking Arena Advanced Edition
70070000037744.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000037744.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon" and "Pizza Bar Tycoon".

70070000037746.name: My Little Haven Floors Collection
70070000037746.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70070000037746.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

This bundle includes Floor Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70070000037747.name: Cottonville Legendary Edition
70070000037747.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000037747.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack, Japan 90s Outfits Pack, Love Outfits Pack, and Pistachio Room DLCs.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000037748.name: Knights & Guns Throne Edition
70070000037748.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000037748.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2, Armor Pack #3 and Armor Pack #4 with:
- 10 new levels for you to bring back the peace
- 8 new armors to help you on your quest
- New enemies for that extra little kick

70070000037750.name: Urban Flow Enhanced Edition
70070000037750.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000037750.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, London Rules, Streets Supplement and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    10 new vehicles
•    The new rules and 10 new stages await you

70070000037754.name: Pets and Friends Cookies Bundle
70070000037754.description:
Pets and Friends: Cookies Bundle is a cozy sticker album that lets you create your own charming collages inspired by the cookies and cakes. Arrange unique compositions, decorate beautiful pages, and design delightful artworks filled with adorable animals and sunny decorations.

Enjoy relaxing gameplay perfect for long summer evenings, express your creativity, and have fun with additional mini-games. Along the way, you’ll also discover interesting animal facts that make every moment in the game even more special.

70070000037770.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Hyper Edition
70070000037770.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037770.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

Dive into 12 off-road tracks
Take on 3 worldwide racing challenges
Unlock and upgrade 4 powerful buggies
Experience dynamic racing modes

Gear up to skid, drift, and accelerate over breathtaking turns and leaps. Are you up for making your mark and racing towards triumph? 

Jump into the driver's seat in Buggy Off-Road Racing and turn the whole world into your racing arena.

This bundle includes base game, Custom Cruisers #1, Custom Cruisers #3, Custom Cruisers #4 and Custom Cruisers #5 with:

-4 new skins for each Buggy

70070000037772.name: ESCAPE BACKROOMS PREMIUM EDITION
70070000037772.intro: There's no hiding from something that is you.
70070000037772.description:
Experience the full nightmare.
This bundle includes the base game and the ESCAPE BACKROOMS: DARKNESS HORROR CHARACTER REPLICAS DLC, expanding the horrors hidden within the endless parking garage. Explore its shifting concrete labyrinth, uncover unsettling mysteries, and survive encounters with intelligent entities that mimic your every move.
As reality bends and familiar surroundings become increasingly hostile, you'll face a terrifying question: if your greatest enemy looks exactly like you, can you still trust yourself?
Step into the complete survival horror experience where every choice matters, every shadow hides a threat, and escape is never guaranteed.

70070000037779.name: Gray War Conflict: Warfare Strategy
70070000037779.intro: Isolation becomes a lethal weapon when you are unprepared.
70070000037779.description:
Deploy into a relentless combat environment where every corner holds a new threat and strategy is your greatest weapon. Adapt to unpredictable battlefield conditions, coordinates your movements, and experience a hardcore simulation designed for fans of pure tactical action.

1. Gray War Conflict — Dive into the core tactical experience. Infiltrate hostile territories, engage in intense firefights, and adapt to harsh environments in a brutal struggle for control. Every mission demands strategy, precise movement, and absolute focus as you face complex tactical challenges.

2. Gray War Conflict: Hostile Gear — Personalize your infantry loadout with a premium visual design. This DLC provides a distinct aesthetic finish for your Assault Rifle, allowing you to showcase your elite status while operating in the field.

With no backup and no second chances, make sure you are ready for the raw action ahead. Step into the conflict zone and dominate every encounter.

70070000037784.name: ESCAPE BACKROOMS DARK EDITION
70070000037784.intro: A place where directions lose meaning.
70070000037784.description:
Welcome to the ultimate parking garage horror experience.

Explore an endless abandoned parking structure where reality slowly unravels around you. Search for clues, solve unsettling puzzles, and navigate twisting corridors while an unseen threat lurks nearby.

This bundle includes the base game and the ESCAPE BACKROOMS: DARKNESS HORROR NEW TRACKS DLC, adding new areas to explore, additional levels, hidden passages, and a haunting new soundtrack that deepens the atmosphere of fear and uncertainty.

The deeper you venture, the stranger the garage becomes. Every corner hides a mystery, every path leads further into the unknown, and escape is never guaranteed.

Will you find a way out - or become another lost soul trapped within the endless maze?

70070000037785.name: DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter Heavy Weapons Bundle
70070000037785.intro: The city falls, the dead rise—your survival is all that matters.
70070000037785.description:
Everything you need to survive the chaos.

Your fight for survival begins in a city overrun by the undead. Take control of powerful weapons and face relentless waves of enemies in fast-paced combat scenarios. This bundle delivers the complete experience, combining the full game with additional firepower to expand your combat options and playstyle.

What’s included in the bundle:
1. DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter (Base Game)
The full game throws you into intense survival combat against endless waves of zombies. Explore dangerous zones, collect resources, upgrade your weapons, and adapt your strategy to survive increasingly difficult encounters.

2. DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter – Multi Rocket Launcher Pack 
Gain access to a powerful rocket launcher designed for high-impact situations. Use explosive firepower to clear groups of enemies and take control of overwhelming moments during combat.

This bundle combines the full survival experience with enhanced weaponry, giving you more power, more control, and more ways to fight back against the chaos.

70070000037788.name: DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter: Sci-Fi Arsenal Bundle
70070000037788.intro: The city falls, the dead rise—your survival is all that matters.
70070000037788.description:
Everything you need to dominate the fight.

Your survival begins in a city overrun by the undead, where every encounter pushes your limits. This bundle delivers the complete experience (base game + DLC), combining the full game with additional sci-fi firepower to expand your combat options and playstyle.

What’s included in the bundle:

1. DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter (Base Game)The full game throws you into intense survival combat against relentless waves of enemies. Explore dangerous zones, collect resources, upgrade your weapons, and adapt your strategy to survive increasingly difficult encounters.

2. DeadZone: Survival Ops Zombie Shooter: Sci-Fi Shotgun Pack Gain access to a powerful close-range shotgun designed for high-impact situations. Perfect for tight encounters, it allows you to eliminate threats quickly and maintain control under pressure.

This bundle combines the full survival experience with enhanced weaponry, giving you more power, more flexibility, and more ways to fight back against the chaos.

70070000037817.name: Bowling Fever Max Edition
70070000037817.intro: Fire up "Bowling Fever" and be carried away by the emotions!
70070000037817.description:
Immerse yourself in the world of bowling with Bowling Fever!

Test your skills in countless game modes, visit amazingly realistic 3D locations, play fantastic mini-games and discover dozens of new bowling balls and pins!

Need a hand? Various power-ups and boosts will help you to meet the challenges.

A bowling game has never been this exciting!

- Fantastic bowling alleys from around the world.
- Fantastic 20+ balls, pins and lanes to show off!
- Multiple mini-games to complete.
- Multiple game modes to play!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #2, expansion pack #3, expansion pack #4 and expansion pack #5 with:

-40 new bowling ball styles

70070000037837.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: VA-11 Hall-A Music Pack
70070000037837.intro: Get lost in the cyberpunk soundscape of the OFFICIAL VA-11 Hall-A Music Pack!
70070000037837.description:
Featuring FIVE new Rhythm Rifts by Garoad:
- Digital Drive
- Every Day is Night
- Drive Me Wild
- Welcome to VA-11 Hall-A

As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift: YLIAD. Available now for everyone!

Each VA-11 Hall-A Rhythm Rift features:
- Your favourite moody bartender, Jill Stingray, OR your favorite adorable android, Dorothy Haze
- Background visualizer with custom particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

Buying any song from this Music Pack also unlocks custom VA-11 Hall-A items to equip in your Rift Profile!

70070000037838.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: UNDERTALE Music Pack
70070000037838.intro: Re-experience one of gaming's most iconic soundtracks with the OFFICIAL UNDERTALE Music Pack!
70070000037838.description:
Featuring SIX new Rhythm Rifts by Toby Fox:
"Hopes and Dreams"
"Death by Glamour"
"Bergentrückung / Asgore"
"Battle Against a True Hero"
"Megalovania"

As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift: "Spider Dance". Available now for everyone!

Each UNDERTALE Rhythm Rift features:
- A member of the NecroDancer cast in their favorite UNDERTALE cosplay
- Background visualizer with custom particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

Buying this Music Pack also unlocks custom UNDERTALE items to equip in your Rift Profile!

There are no dogs in this Music Pack, sorry.

70070000037846.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Silver Edition
70070000037846.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000037846.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1 and Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #2 with:

- 40 new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon

70070000037850.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Silver Edtion
70070000037850.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000037850.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #2 with:

6 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000037853.name: Motorbikes Pro 2025 Upgrade Edition
70070000037853.intro: Feel the Speed, Own the Track!
70070000037853.description:
Get behind the wheel in Motorbikes Pro 2025 and experience the excitement of high-speed racing! With stunning graphics and intuitive controls, this game is perfect for racers of all ages. 

This thrilling racing game puts you right in the driver’s seat of fast-paced Motorbikes racing action. Feel the rush as you speed through corners, overtake opponents, and navigate each twist and turn of the track with precision. Accessible, fun, and incredibly addictive!

Choose your car, perfect your timing, and race your way to glory. The track is calling, and the thrill of victory is just one race away!

This bundle includes base game and expansion pack #4 with:

-1 set of premium skins for motorbikes

70070000037869.name: Moto Rush GT Throne Edition
70070000037869.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000037869.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Full Garage, Grip Collection #3 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 13 new vehicles—including an ATV and bicycle!
- 16 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000037880.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Enhanced Edition
70070000037880.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Target Acquired, Elite Arsenal and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition 
- SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements 
- SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
- SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology 
- RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design 
- BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west 
- SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle 
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000037891.name: BACKROOMS EXIT PREMIUM EDITION
70070000037891.description:
Enter the complete supermarket nightmare.

This bundle includes the base game and the Backrooms: Exit from Supermarket Recordings Simulator DLC, delivering the full horror experience of an endless supermarket where reality slowly falls apart. Wander through deserted aisles, solve cryptic puzzles, and search for an escape while unseen dangers lurk beyond the flickering lights.

The included DLC expands the mystery with additional radio broadcasts, survivor recordings, distress calls, and hidden messages scattered throughout the store. Each new transmission reveals fragments of the supermarket's dark history, offering clues, warnings, and unsettling discoveries.

Explore deeper, uncover more secrets, and piece together the truth behind a place that was never meant to be understood.

Will the recordings help you escape - or draw you further into the nightmare?

70070000037902.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Primal Instinct
70070000037902.intro: Pure tracking, maximum intensity. Master the wild!
70070000037902.description:
Step into the heart of the wild, where breathtaking landscapes meet the ultimate tracking challenge. Traverse vast open worlds, from dense forests to towering mountain ranges, as you track elusive prey in an unforgiving environment.

This bundle includes:
1. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting (Base Game)
Dive into a hyper-realistic hunting simulation where every decision counts and the wilderness responds to your every move. Navigate through beautifully detailed environments, master realistic weapon mechanics, and outsmart adapting wildlife behaviors.

2. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Weapon Upgrade (DLC)
Gear up for your next adventure with a powerful new weapon - Regmintona 070, a versatile and reliable shotgun designed for close-range encounters and unmatched stopping power. If you already own this weapon, you will receive its full in-game value as compensation.

3. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Elite Weapon (DLC)
Take your hunt to the next level with the elite Savatimp 8 weapon. This precision rifle is crafted specifically for long range, maximum accuracy, and increased efficiency against top predators. If you have previously unlocked this weapon, you will receive 1400 in-game currency instead to invest in ammunition or other equipment.

4. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Tactical Gloves (DLC)
Upgrade your style and strategy on the field. This DLC grants you an exclusive skin for your hunting gloves, offering a unique cosmetic customization option. If you already own this item, you will receive its equivalent coin value instead, giving you total flexibility to manage your resources.

Put on your tactical gear, choose your weapon, and write your own legacy in the deep forest. The wilderness is waiting for you!

70070000037928.name: Tavern Owner Simulator: Master Tycoon
70070000037928.intro: Turn a modest tavern into a highly profitable business empire.
70070000037928.description:
Master the art of medieval hospitality. Build your tavern from the ground up, balance your books, and lead a perfectly coordinated, elite-styled workforce to local fame and massive profits.

Included Content:
1. Tavern Owner Simulator – The full base game experience where you take control of every detail of a medieval pub. Design your custom layouts, buy decorations, manage finances, and build a bustling hub from scratch.

2. Tavern Owner Simulator: Elite Workers – The complete visual upgrade that swaps standard employee looks for premium historical skins. This content introduces unique uniforms for your bartenders, chefs, and servers to match your tavern’s style.

Take full control of your business strategy, transform the visual presence of your workforce, and secure your place as the most prestigious tavern tycoon in the medieval world.

70070000037932.name: Ashwood Valley Gold Edition
70070000037932.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000037932.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

This bundle includes Cozy Comforts Style, Sunny Summer Style, Draco's Nook, Luna's Nook, Seaside Stories, and Aqua Nook DLCs.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70070000037946.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Gem Vault Edition
70070000037946.intro: Ignite your path to mastery with 1000 gems!
70070000037946.description:
FROM ONE FIREBALL TO UNSTOPPABLE POWER
Aim your shot, release the flame, and blast through anything that stands in your path! Begin as a young fireball fighter training in an ordinary room, breaking simple objects to build your strength. Home appliances, computers, motorcycles, cars, massive buildings - every target brings you closer to true fireball mastery.

BURN THROUGH BIGGER AND TOUGHER TARGETS
Grow stronger, upgrade your stats, and take on bigger, tougher, and crazier targets. Boost your Fireball Power, Stamina, Stamina Recovery, and more to turn every shot into pure destruction. When you are ready, enter special challenges with a target and a time limit. Destroy the required number of objects before the countdown ends to earn rewards and unlock the next stage!

MORE POWER WITH EVERY UPGRADE
Gather powerful fireballs, stylish costumes, ancient relics, and loyal pets. Upgrade fireballs to increase your Fireball Power, Gold Acquisition, and Exp Acquisition. Strengthen costumes to improve your Stamina and Recovery. Refine relics for mighty stat bonuses that make every blast even more devastating.

COMMAND YOUR PET COMPANIONS
Create a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills. Bring up to 3 pets into action and let them attack alongside you while boosting your power. Their skills add another layer of strength to every stage, turning your fireball training into a true team effort.

POWER UP WITH 1000 GEMS
Start your journey with 1000 gems and use them to open fireball, costume, and relic boxes, buy pet tickets for opening pet boxes, upgrade power ups, activate boosters, or exchange them for coins. Build your power, unlock more upgrades, and keep pushing toward the next stage!

FEATURES:
• Fireball Action - Aim, charge, and launch explosive fireball attacks!
• Destruction Progression - Start with simple targets, then work your way up to vehicles and massive buildings
• 1000 Gems Included - Use gems to open boxes, buy pet tickets, upgrade power ups, activate boosters, or exchange them for coins
• Deep Upgrades - Upgrade your character, fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets to keep growing stronger
• Stylish Costumes - Wear costumes to boost your Stamina and Stamina Recovery
• Powerful Relics - Collect relics to gain stat boosts for Fireball Power, Stamina, Gold, Exp, and others
• Pet Companions - Build a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills
• Timed Challenges - Destroy the required number of targets before the countdown ends to unlock the next stage
• Daily Missions and Achievements - Complete tasks and claim extra rewards
• Special Events - Break the Gold Safe for coins and enter the World Championship to win gems
• Addictive Progression - Keep upgrading, unlocking, and destroying bigger targets

End as the legend who can destroy anything!

70070000037950.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Complete Edition
70070000037950.intro: Strengthen your path toward becoming a true fireball legend
70070000037950.description:
FROM ONE FIREBALL TO UNSTOPPABLE POWER
Aim your shot, release the flame, and blast through anything that stands in your path! Begin as a young fireball fighter training in an ordinary room, breaking simple objects to build your strength. Gather powerful fireballs, stylish costumes, ancient relics, and loyal pets. Upgrade fireballs to increase your Fireball Power, Gold Acquisition, and Exp Acquisition. Strengthen costumes to improve your Stamina and Recovery. Refine relics for mighty stat bonuses that make every blast even more devastating.

LET THE FIREBALLS FLY ON THEIR OWN
With Permanent Auto Fire unlocked, your fireballs are launched automatically during regular stages, helping you destroy targets, earn coins, and build strength without aiming every shot manually. You can turn Auto Fire off in the Boosters tab if you want to return to manual control. Auto Fire does not work during Challenges, so you will still need to prove your skill when it is time to unlock the next stage.

COMMAND LIGHT AND DARK ALPHA PETS
Add Griffith and Rath to your pet collection and strengthen your team with powerful Alpha Pets from the Light and Dark Families. Griffith boosts the passive skills of all Light Family pets and comes with an active skill that increases Stamina Recovery, helping you keep the fireballs flying longer. Rath boosts the passive skills of all Dark Family pets and comes with an active skill that increases Fireball Power, helping you hit harder and destroy targets faster.

FEATURES:

• Destruction Progression - Start with simple targets, then work your way up to vehicles and massive buildings
• Permanent Auto Fire - Let your fireballs launch automatically during regular stages
• Griffith Alpha Pet - Add a powerful Light Family pet that boosts Light Family passive skills and increases Stamina Recovery
• Rath Alpha Pet - Add a fierce Dark Family pet that boosts Dark Family passive skills and increases Fireball Power
• Deep Upgrades - Upgrade your character, fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets to keep growing stronger

70070000037964.name: Battle Royal - Battlegrounds Call MP7 Deluxe Bundle
70070000037964.intro: Where Survival is Earned, Victory is Inherited.
70070000037964.description:
Jump into the complete experience (base game + DLC) with a loadout built for speed and aggressive gameplay. This bundle is made for players who stay in motion, react instantly, and take control under pressure.

Drop into intense matches, gather gear, and adapt to a shrinking battlefield where every second counts. Survival depends on how fast you think and how well you react.

With the MP7 Arsenal Expansion included, you gain access to a weapon built for rapid engagements and close combat efficiency. Move quickly, engage faster, and maintain control in dynamic situations where hesitation means defeat.

Stay ahead, stay mobile, and take control of every fight.More speed. More pressure. More opportunities to win.

70070000037965.name: Battle Royal - Battlegrounds Call VAL Complete Bundle
70070000037965.intro: Where Survival is Earned, Victory is Inherited.
70070000037965.description:
Precision changes everything.

Get the full experience (base game + DLC) and shape your strategy from the very start. This bundle is built for players who want more control over every encounter, combining core survival gameplay with a precision-focused upgrade.

Jump into high-pressure matches, gather gear, and adapt to a constantly changing battlefield. Every decision matters as the zone closes in and the number of opponents drops.

With the added VAL Silent Strike DLC, you unlock a new way to approach combat — more controlled, more precise, and more strategic. Choose your engagements carefully, position yourself wisely, and eliminate threats on your own terms.

Whether you prefer direct fights or calculated moves, this bundle gives you the flexibility to adapt and stay ahead.
More options. Better control. Smarter plays.

70070000037974.name: Buggy Off-Road Racing Max Edition
70070000037974.intro: The Ultimate Dirt Track Challenge on your Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037974.description:
Get ready to fuel up for the ultimate off-road thrill with Buggy Off-Road Racing! Dive into this exhilarating journey as you navigate through the wild landscapes of the USA, Europe, and Asia. It's all about high-octane races where your bravery and skills are in the spotlight.

70070000037977.name: Club Sports Collection Superior Edition
70070000037977.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037977.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals. Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #1 and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #3 with:

- 10 brand-new dart designs

70070000037979.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Superior Edition
70070000037979.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000037979.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Expansion Pack #3 with:

10 new pool table designs
10 new snooker table designs

70070000038000.name: Chained Climb Together: Mountain Explorer
70070000038000.intro: Control your movement or lose your progress.
70070000038000.description:
Take on the ultimate mountain-climbing challenge, where teamwork, precision, and determination are the keys to success. Navigate dangerous vertical landscapes, overcome demanding obstacles, and master the unique chain mechanics that connect you to your climbing partner on the journey to the summit.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Chained Climb Together
Embark on a challenging climbing adventure where every movement matters. Explore diverse mountain environments, master unique chain mechanics, and work together to conquer towering peaks.

2. Chained Climb Together – Player Reskin (DLC)
Customize your character with a brand-new appearance and stand out during every climb with a fresh visual style.

3. Chained Climb Together: New Rope (DLC)
Upgrade your rope with a redesigned version featuring a new look and improved handling characteristics for your mountain adventures.

Climb higher, personalize your journey, and conquer every challenge standing between you and the summit.

70070000038008.name: Squirrel Madness: Epic Shooter
70070000038008.intro: Master your weapons, strengthen your defenses, and save the tree.
70070000038008.description:
Enter a chaotic city battle where a brave squirrel must protect a magical tree from relentless waves of enemies. Combine action-packed combat, powerful weapons, and strategic upgrades as you fight to preserve the enchanted home you created.

Bundle Features:
1. Squirrel Madness - Step into the role of a fearless squirrel defending a magical tree from city forces determined to destroy it. Battle through intense waves of enemies, use unique weapons, restore your tree, and survive increasingly dangerous attacks.

2. Squirrel Madness: Nut Boost - An instant resource upgrade featuring 500 nuts added to your in-game balance. Use these resources to unlock upgrades, improve your weapons, and gain the advantage needed to strengthen your defenses.

Protect your magical tree, defeat every enemy wave, and become the ultimate guardian of nature.

70070000038031.name: Werewolf Hunter - Survive The Howl: Survival
70070000038031.intro: Face the night, survive the hunt, and overcome the darkness.
70070000038031.description:
Step into the terrifying wilderness, where every encounter with the darkness could be your last. Hunt, survive, and adapt as you face relentless werewolves and unpredictable threats in a hostile environment built to test your limits.

Bundle Includes:
1. Werewolf Hunter - Survive The Howl
Experience an intense first-person survival game where you explore a dark, atmospheric wilderness, battle intelligent werewolves, use tactical tools, and adapt to unpredictable events in order to survive the night.

2. Werewolf Hunter - Survive The Howl: Damage Barrier
Adds an additional shield bar with 100 starting units that absorbs damage before health. The shield regenerates like health and integrates with consumables, providing deeper survivability and tactical defense options.

Face the horror, master your survival tools, and endure the howl.

70070000038032.name: The Smurfs Storyboard Pack
70070000038032.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000038032.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 10 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000038041.name: Car Heist Simulator - Thief Mechanic: Street Crime
70070000038041.intro: Step into the city’s underworld and take control of every operation.
70070000038041.description:
Enter the world of high-risk car theft where planning, precision, and timing decide everything. Improve your efficiency, strengthen your preparation, and take on more challenging targets as you rise through the criminal underworld.

Bundle Includes:
Car Heist Simulator - Thief Mechanic
1. Experience a detailed car theft simulation where every mission requires strategy, stealth, and skill. Infiltrate secure areas, disable security systems, avoid detection, and steal high-value vehicles in increasingly complex heists.

2. Car Heist Simulator - Thief Mechanic: Cash Boost
Gain 1000 added directly to your in-game balance. Use this boost to upgrade your equipment, unlock new tools, and gain an early advantage in your criminal career.

Take control of your path, execute flawless heists, and become the most skilled car thief in the city.

70070000038046.name: Wine Factory Simulator: Winery Manager
70070000038046.intro: Build your vineyard, craft exceptional wines, and grow your legacy.
70070000038046.description:
Step into the rewarding world of winemaking, where every decision shapes the future of your vineyard and winery. Cultivate grape varieties, manage production, refine your techniques, and create exceptional wines that attract customers from near and far.

Bundle Includes:
1. Wine Factory Simulator - Grow and manage your own vineyard, harvest grapes, oversee fermentation and aging, and transform simple ingredients into outstanding wines. Develop your winery, welcome visitors, and establish your reputation as a master winemaker.

2. Wine Factory Simulator: Starter Capital - Includes an additional $1500 added directly to your in-game balance. Use these resources to expand your vineyard, improve production capabilities, and accelerate the growth of your winery.

Turn your passion into a thriving business and create a legacy that will stand the test of time.

70070000038065.name: Cooking Arena Infinite Edition
70070000038065.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000038065.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Food Truck Tycoon Asian Cuisine" and "Pizza Bar Tycoon".

70070000038070.name: Knights & Guns Enhanced Edition
70070000038070.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000038070.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Armor Pack #1, Armor Pack #2 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 5 new armors to help you on your quest

70070000038071.name: Urban Flow VIP Edition
70070000038071.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000038071.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, London Rules, Streets Supplement #2 and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    10 new vehicles
•    The new rules and 10 new stages await you

70070000038079.name: Memory For Kids Fuzzy Friends Edition
70070000038079.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000038079.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes Cards Pack 2 DLC.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels

70070000038089.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Superior Edition
70070000038089.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000038089.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #3 with:

6 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000038113.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Superior Edition
70070000038113.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000038113.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1 and Pizza Bar Tycoon Multiplayer Mode with:

- 20 new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon
- local multiplayer gameplay mode for Pizza Bar Tycoon

NOTE: to play the Multiplayer Mode DLC, each player will need their own set of Joy-Con™ or an additional Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller.

70070000038116.name: Fit My Cat Feline Frenzy Edition
70070000038116.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000038116.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

This bundle includes the Cats Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000038117.name: Moto Rush GT Enhanced Edition
70070000038117.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000038117.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Grip Collection #1, Grip Collection #2 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 12 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000038121.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope VIP Edition
70070000038121.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Elite Arsenal, Neon Strike and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design 
- BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west 
- SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle 
- SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
- UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
- SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000038123.name: Neko Bento Futomaki Edition
70070000038123.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000038123.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes the Boxes Pack DLC.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000038125.name: Paint For Kids Cozy Canvas Edition
70070000038125.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000038125.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones. 

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the Additional Board 3 DLC.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use

70070000038129.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Biohazard Defense
70070000038129.intro: Master the checkpoint, enforce the law, and survive the pressure.
70070000038129.description:
Step into the role of a border guard, where every decision can determine the fate of the quarantine zone. Inspect incoming survivors, detect signs of infection, and manage critical situations under constant pressure as the outbreak spreads beyond control. Monitor behavior, analyze symptoms, and act quickly to prevent any breach that could endanger the entire region.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Take control of a critical border checkpoint during a global zombie outbreak. Inspect individuals, identify infection risks, and make fast decisions to protect the safe zone from contamination. Balance caution and speed as you decide who may pass, who must be isolated, and who poses an immediate threat.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Security Gear
Enhances the appearance of your clothing scanner and temperature scanner with a new visual design, improving the look of your inspection tools without changing their functionality.

Stay alert, stay accurate, and hold the line against the outbreak.

70070000038133.name: Terraformers Collection
70070000038133.description: This bundle includes Terraformers and its 3 DLCs: New Frontiers, Megastructures, and Independence.

70070000038136.name: All about the Spy Guy
70070000038136.description:
Discover a world of adventure, puzzles, and learning with the ultimate Spy Guy game bundle! This collection includes four exciting titles designed for children, combining fun gameplay with educational activities that help develop observation skills, memory, and knowledge about the world.

The bundle includes:
• Spy Guy Europe – travel across Europe, visit famous cities and landmarks, and learn about the continent’s geography while solving hidden object challenges.
• Spy Guy Hidden Objects Deluxe Edition – put your observation skills to the test by searching for hundreds of hidden items across detailed and colorful scenes.
• Spy Guy Memory – train your memory and concentration through engaging card-matching challenges and memory-based puzzles.
• Spy Guy Animals Junior – discover the fascinating world of animals through educational activities and child-friendly puzzles.

The Spy Guy Bundle combines entertainment and learning, helping children develop important cognitive skills such as observation, memory, logical thinking, and general knowledge about animals and geography. With colorful visuals, intuitive gameplay, and a variety of challenges, it is the perfect choice for young explorers and the whole family.

Key Features:
• 4 games in one bundle
• Hidden object gameplay that enhances observation skills
• Memory and concentration training activities
• Learn about animals and European geography
• Child-friendly gameplay suitable for young players
• A fun and educational experience for the whole family

Join Spy Guy on an exciting adventure and discover the world through play!

70070000038162.name: Succubus Sexy Devils: Hellbound Desire
70070000038162.intro: Survive the fire, destroy the horde. Claim the throne.
70070000038162.description:
Brutal action and high-end style meet in the deepest levels of the abyss.  Evolving weapons, supernatural portals, and a stunning look define the path through every single twisted arena.

Bundle Includes:
1. Succubus Sexy Devils - Experience the entire supernatural adventure, jump through portals, and destroy nightmarish hordes.
2.  Succubus Sexy Devils: Abyss Outfit - Upgrade the wardrobe with a brand-new appearance designed for ultimate temptation and power.

Prepare to face the nightmarish hordes with absolute power and unmatched style.

70070000038169.name: Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Grand Destruction
70070000038169.intro: Face wild bosses and prove who owns these streets.
70070000038169.description:
Dive into a massive, destructible metropolis as the ultimate shark predator, unleash your super abilities, and tear through the streets in first-class style. Destroy the city, smash epic bosses, and abduct characters—all while sporting the freshest look in the entire urban jungle.

What the bundle includes:
1. Tralalero Tralala Simulator - Free your inner shark and create total chaos in a sprawling city. Turn the entire city into your personal, chaotic playground.
2. Tralalero Tralala Simulator: Fancy Predator - Upgrade your footwear with a completely new, high-end material and texture.

Are you ready to claim your crown, crush the meta, and prove you’re the top predator capable of bringing this massive world to its knees?

70070000038174.name: Animal Buddies - Party Beasts: Ultimate Party
70070000038174.intro: More tasks, more tracks, infinite party vibes.
70070000038174.description:
Step into a refreshed delivery arena with a 90s twist! Guide your favorite animal buddies through objective-based tasks, customize their looks, and dominate the leaderboards.

What’s Included in This Bundle:
1. Animal Buddies - Party Beasts (Base Game): The full chaotic adventure featuring survival battles, flag-capturing missions, character customization, and global leaderboards.

2. Animal Buddies - Party Beasts: Vintage Overhaul (DLC): A playful visual twist that replaces standard boxes in the “Loader” level with a collection of vintage, analog televisions.

Load up on nostalgia, customize your beasts, and let the wild adventures begin!

70070000038177.name: Skater Bunny Simulator: Pro Skater
70070000038177.intro: Become a true legend of the board and the streets.
70070000038177.description:
Jump into a colorful skateboarding adventure where style, creativity, and skill come together. Master exciting tricks, customize your bunny and skateboard, and explore vibrant locations as you build your reputation as a legendary skater.

Bundle Includes:
1. Skater Bunny Simulator – Experience a charming skateboarding simulator featuring intuitive controls, challenging missions, deep customization, and a world full of exciting tricks and unforgettable locations.

2. Skater Bunny Simulator: Skate Capital – Includes an additional $1000 added directly to your in-game balance, providing extra flexibility for customization, upgrades, and expanding your skateboarding experience.

Personalize your journey, perfect your skills, and enjoy even more ways to become the ultimate skater bunny.

70070000038182.name: Rain World: Slugcat's Lifecycle Edition
70070000038182.intro: The story of the slugcats, packaged together in this Complete bundle of the base game of Rain World and its two expansions, Rain World: Downpour and Rain World: The Watcher!
70070000038182.description:
You are a slugcat. The world around you is full of danger, and you must face it – alone. Separated from your family in a devastating flood, you will need to find food and shelter between terrifying torrential downpours which threaten to drown all life. Climb through the ruins of an ancient civilization, evade the jaws of vicious predators, and discover new lands teeming with strange creatures and buried mysteries. Find your family before something makes a meal of you!

Rain World: Downpour is a DLC expansion of Rain World. Take control of five new characters with new abilities in this vast, redefined world. Slugcats have adapted to the harsh conditions alongside evolved predators! Survive new environmental conditions, dangers and explore uncharted territory.

Rain World: The Watcher is a DLC expansion of Rain World. Journey beyond to something, somewhere only ever glimpsed. When the world beneath your feet cracks and crumbles, will you hold on to all you once knew? Or dive into the unknown?

70070000038205.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – No Limits
70070000038205.intro: The highway is your racetrack—leave the traffic in the dust.
70070000038205.description:
Experience the thrill of high-speed racing with realistic car physics that make every turn and drift feel authentic. Stunning graphics bring the world to life, immersing you in the white-knuckled action where one wrong move can send you spinning out of control.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator
Gear up, choose from a variety of sleek city cruisers to high-octane supercars, dive into unique game modes, and master the art of precision driving under pressure.

2. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator - New Car in Garage
Turbocharge your career with an ultimate head start! This grants you the Quantum Thunder Racer—a cutting-edge machine built for pure speed and style (or its equivalent in in-game cash if you already own it) to burn rubber and rise through the ranks even faster.

3. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Turbo Boost
Boost your racing career instantly with an extra $50,000 in cash! Fuel your speed addiction by upgrading your ride, unlocking premium cars, and customizing your vehicles to get ahead of the competition.

4. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Drive in Color
Add a fresh look to your garage with a burst of vibrant color! Unlock three eye-catching paint jobs for your vehicles—bold blue, striking pink, and sleek turquoise—to turn heads and set yourself apart from the crowd.

Can you maintain your focus under pressure? Prove it and dominate the streets like never before!

70070000038216.name: Jump Up 3D: Mini Basketball – Arena Masters
70070000038216.intro: Take the shot, climb the world. Pure arcade power.
70070000038216.description:
Master the art of the trampoline jump, climb the global leaderboards, and let the automatic randomizer decide your high-flying style. It’s the definitive way to play, offering maximum value and infinite replayability.

Bundle Highlights:
1. Jump Up 3D: Mini Basketball 
Jump, aim, and score in spectacular style with simple, engaging gameplay and global leaderboards.

2. Jump Up 3D: Mini Basketball – New Style 
Expand your customization menu with an exclusive line of brand-new, high-flying outfits.

Upgrade your performance, defy predictability, and get ready for showtime!

70070000038222.name: Club Sports Collection Super Edition
70070000038222.intro: Five club classics. One game. Endless fun on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000038222.description:
Club Sports Collection – Your All-In-One Lounge Experience!

Step into the ultimate game lounge — right on your Nintendo Switch
Club Sports Collection brings together the world’s favorite bar and club games in one stylish, realistic experience.

Challenge yourself or your friends in thrilling matches of pool, snooker, darts, bowling, and foosball — all recreated with authentic physics, intuitive controls, and stunning 3D visuals.
