Whether you’re sinking the 8-ball, striking for a perfect 300, hitting the bullseye, or scoring the winning goal, every game feels true-to-life and packed with fun!

Customize tables, cues, darts, balls, and more to create your perfect setup. Play solo to master your precision, or invite friends for exciting local multiplayer duels.

Features:

* Five classic club games: Pool, Snooker, Darts, Bowling & Foosball
* Realistic physics and immersive 3D graphics
* Single-player and local multiplayer modes
* Dozens of customization options for cues, balls, boards, and tables
* Smooth Joy-Con™ controls for a natural gameplay feel

Grab your Joy-Con, step up to the table, and prove your skills —
Club Sports Collection turns your Nintendo Switch into the ultimate social playground!

This bundle includes base game, Darts Fever Stylish Precision #1 and Darts Fever Stylish Precision #4 with:

- 10 brand-new dart designs

70070000038224.name: Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle Super Edition
70070000038224.intro: Two Classics, One Cue – Master Pool & Snooker on Nintendo Switch™!
70070000038224.description:
Cue Up the Fun – Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle!

Get ready to master the table in Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle — the ultimate cue-sports experience on your Nintendo Switch!

Enjoy both the fast-paced excitement of pool and the strategic precision of snooker, all in one complete and immersive game.

With intuitive controls, smooth physics, and stunning 3D visuals, Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle perfectly recreates the atmosphere of real pool and snooker halls — anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re practicing perfect shots or enjoying friendly matches with friends, this game guarantees realistic gameplay, smooth controls, and endless entertainment.

Features:

* Two complete cue-sports games in one pack
* Realistic 3D graphics and physics
* Local multiplayer for head-to-head fun
* Multiple tables, cues, and cue balls to unlock and customize
* Smooth, accessible gameplay for beginners and pros alike

Chalk your cue, line up your shot, and rule the table!

The Pool & Snooker Fever: 2 in 1 Bundle is your all-in-one ticket to cue-sports perfection on Nintendo Switch.

This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #1 and Expansion Pack #4 with:

5 new queues
10 new pool table designs
10 new snooker table designs

70070000038241.name: nGolf Ultra Deluxe
70070000038241.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000038241.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes the Moon Swing, Western Fairways, Colorful Golf Balls 1, Colorful Golf Balls 2, Colorful Golf Balls 3, Colorful Golf Balls 4, Colorful Golf Balls 5, Colorful Golf Balls 6, and Colorful Golf Balls 7 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000038247.name: Hotel Business Simulator: Grand Hotel
70070000038247.intro: Master the economy, outsmart the competition, and claim your empire.
70070000038247.description:
Dive deep into the exciting world of hotel management, where every choice you make shapes your empire. From a basic bed and breakfast to a world-class luxury resort, you’ll be the brains behind the ultimate hospitality business.

What’s Inside the Bundle:
• Hotel Business Simulator - Transform a humble spot into a luxurious resort, decorate rooms, manage your economy, and build your hotel empire from scratch. You will need to cater to your guests’ unique whims from check-in to check-out, set room rates wisely to maximize profits, and keep every space spotless to ensure a flawless reputation and earn those coveted high star ratings.

• Hotel Business Simulator: Cozy Basement - Give your personal manager room a complete visual makeover. Swap your standard look for a raw, industrial basement interior, creating the perfect underground sanctuary to retreat to after a busy day.

Step into your newly redesigned headquarters, and show the world that you have what it takes to run a flawless hotel empire.

70070000038248.name: Cook For Love Prime Edition
70070000038248.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000038248.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes the Powder Red Blender, Colorful Stove, Wooden Fridge, and Lyon DLCs.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000038250.name: Piano: Learn and Play Virtuoso Collection
70070000038250.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000038250.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the Song Pack 8 and Song Pack 9 DLCs.

Key Features:
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000038259.name: Cozy Land Ultimate Edition
70070000038259.intro: Creating the city of your dreams is at your fingertips in Cozy Land!
70070000038259.description:
Have you ever tried to make your own city? in Cozy Land, doing so is a piece of cake! This sandbox game lets you choose from 9 different base templates on which you can create a cafe corner, a theatre heaven, an incredible amusement park, and many more!


Cozy Land has over 400 unique decorations for your city, which include big houses and trees, but also sprinkle in some nature like small flowers.


Every part of this city can be hand-placed by you. Whether you prefer a busy main square or a cozy little corner with horses and cows - Cozy Land’s got it all!

This bundle includes multiple DLC packs for Cozy Land, bringing together fan-favorite themes such as Ice Age, Wild West, Fantasy, Candy, Nature, and many more. Enjoy a huge variety of decorations and customization options in one complete collection.

Features:
- 9 land templates to start your city on.
- Over 400 decorations and buildings to place.
- Adorable bouncy animals ready to populate your farm or building roofs.
- Create a cute city or a little agricultural heaven!
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

70070000038260.name: Softly Placed Ultimate Edition
70070000038260.intro: Unleash the childlike wonder and find the magic in everyday life! Place, fit, fill, cook, connect, and train your brain in the cutest possible way.
70070000038260.description:
Step into the world, where mundane tasks turn into little adventures and ordinary items provide so much joy. See everything around you in bright, new, vibrant colors and make things even more beautiful by adding fun patterns. Wake up your inner child and find the happiness in little things.
 
Each level of the game consists of a unique challenge, providing fresh, yet relaxing gameplay, that will make you curious for what’s coming next.  

This bundle includes the Cats Pack, Fantasy Pack, and Sci-Fi Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
-40 unique cozy puzzle levels
-Gameplay consisting of different types of challenges
-Beautiful, vibrant visuals, where everyday items turn into something magical
-Relaxing, cheerful soundtrack 
-Inspiring, nostalgic atmosphere
-Variety of puzzles exercising different parts of the brain

70070000038278.name: Barbarous: Survivor's Quest - Hex Edition
70070000038278.intro: Battle the horde and survive the quest!
70070000038278.description:
The land is overrun by hungry orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and other dangerous creatures, and only the strongest will last! Fight through wave after wave of enemies, face powerful bosses, and upgrade your hero to become unstoppable.

Every run is a new challenge! Choose your upgrades wisely and shape your build as you progress. Open treasure chests, gather experience, and stay in the fight as the enemy waves grow stronger.

Improve your stats, unlock powerful weapons, and collect valuable rewards as you carve your way through the chaos!

Features:
- Fight waves of orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and more
- Explore an additional map with extreme difficulty: Northern Reaches
- Meet a new brave character: Gwen
- Discover a new powerful weapon: Fist of the North
- Shape your build with many weapons and items
- Face powerful bosses and earn valuable rewards
- Upgrade and evolve your gear!
- Power up and become the ultimate hero

How long can you survive before the horde overwhelms you?

70070000038285.name: Pawbay: Cat Chaos
70070000038285.intro: A tiny cat, a sunny town, and a whole lot of playful trouble!
70070000038285.description:
Slip into the paws of a mischievous little cat and turn the cozy seaside town of Pawbay upside down. Climb rooftops, sneak through alleyways, and pounce your way through a charming world where curiosity always leads to chaos. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op and become the town’s most unforgettable troublemaker.

Give your playful feline a fresh new look with fashionable sunglasses, then head back into town to spread smiles, stir up a little trouble, and unleash chaos in true cat fashion.

Features:
• Play as a nimble cat who loves causing trouble
• Enjoy the adventure solo or in local 2-player co-op
• Explore every street, rooftop, and hidden corner
• Create hilarious chaos with pranks and mischief
• Wear silly sunglasses and shake up Pawbay

70070000038299.name: Bag Fight: Handful Edition
70070000038299.intro: Pack your bags and power up with 50 Gems!
70070000038299.description:
This deckbuilding roguelite puts inventory management into the heart of every run. Build a backpack full of weapons, armor, and healing items, carefully arranging your gear to create a setup that can carry you through battle after battle.

This bundle includes the Chest of Gems, which gives you 50 Gems - premium currency you can use to unlock new heroes, purchase chips, skins, and awesome offers in the black market, or gain a powerful edge during battles!

Unlock new gear, strengthen your build, and discover better ways to use your limited space as you progress. Merge weapons to create stronger versions, fine-tune your loadout, and adapt your backpack for every challenge ahead.

Features:
- Inventory Management: Move items around to optimize your build!
- Merging: Combine items into stronger versions!
- Chest of Gems: Receive 50 Gems to unlock heroes, purchase chips, skins, and black market offers, or gain an edge in battle!
- Unique Characters: Meet a colorful cast of heroes
- Progression: Upgrade your bag and loadout!
- Epic Adventures: Explore diverse fantasy worlds
- Customization: Equip awesome skins for your heroes and items!
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to earn extra resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master!

Your backpack is your build. Make every slot count.

70070000038308.name: Family Chess Grass Green Pack
70070000038308.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000038308.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Grass Green Chessboard DLC.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000038319.name: Cooking Arena Grand Edition
70070000038319.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000038319.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon", "Food Truck Tycoon Asian Cuisine" and "Pizza Bar Tycoon".

70070000038321.name: Knights & Guns VIP Edition
70070000038321.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000038321.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Armor Pack #1, Armor Pack #3 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 5 new armors to help you on your quest

70070000038323.name: Urban Flow Omega Edition
70070000038323.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000038323.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, Streets Supplement, Streets Supplement #2 and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    15 new vehicles

70070000038324.name: Idle Immortal(Deluxe Edition)
70070000038324.intro: This edition includes the base game and two DLCs.
70070000038324.description:
Build a Chinese fantasy sect, recruit disciples, and forge the ultimate squad for ascension! Are you ready to walk the path to immortality as a true Sect Master?

Base Game:
+ Idle Gameplay: Enjoy a relaxing idle experience designed to help you unwind. Even while you are away, your sect keeps battling, growing stronger, and moving closer to ascension. 

+ Squad Building: Recruit from 16 playable characters. Each character has unique talents, classes, and skills. Bring in the disciples you need and freely build your own squad. 

+ Character Growth: Each character can choose one of six different cultivation paths. They can also practice different cultivation techniques to gain unique bonuses. Even characters of the same class can grow into completely different builds. 

+ Explore the World: Journey across the land, discover other sects and factions, and advance the story. Gather resources for personal cultivation and sect development. Encounter random events and uncover unexpected treasures. 

+ Sect Management: While exploring the world, you will also manage your own sect. Earn reputation and sect resources to upgrade and expand your home base. Build different sect facilities to continuously produce useful items. A powerful sect will help you go further on the path to immortality.


DLC 1：
There are many rumors about why the ethereal Xuan Nü appeared. Some say she came by Heaven’s mandate to save the Great Fire; others say she drifted here because of a conflict between divine beliefs; or perhaps she carries an even greater, unspeakable secret. Whatever the truth may be, she seems to share some common goals with the Heir of Formlessness. If you can earn Xuan Nü’s trust and aid, you will surely gain an unmatched and powerful ally on your path to immortality!

Skill Introduction:
Voidbreaker
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: Deals additional self-element damage based on the target’s lost HP.

Heaven-Earth Rectification
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to the single enemy character with the lowest HP.

Primordial Revelation
When dealing hit damage: Has a chance equal to a certain percentage of her Crit Rate to double the damage.

Mandate to Slay Evil
When landing a kill: Deals non-elemental damage to all enemy characters equal to a certain percentage of the overflow damage.


DLC 2：
Seven Stars Pavilion is an ancient sect deeply versed in the stars and the movements of heaven and earth. In an ancient age beyond record, Seven Stars Pavilion was founded in the northern part of the continent—a place better suited for observing the heavens. The Seven-Star Diviners are the core members of Seven Stars Pavilion. Their study of the starry heavens has reached perfection, allowing them to command the great power of the stars for their own use.

Skill Introduction:
Star Essence
Deals self-element damage based on Attack to a single enemy character.
On Lucky Hit: additionally restores a certain amount of Mana.

Seven-Star Soul Suppression
Summons 7 Star Pieces. Each Star Piece deals self-element damage based on Attack to a random single enemy character.

Starry Array
When triggering Lucky Hit:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Starry Array】 to the target, lasting until the end of the wave.

Astral Divination 
After casting Ultimate:
Applies 10 stacks of 【Astral Divination】 to self, lasting until the end of the wave.

70070000038326.name: Cup Heroes: Diamond Satchel Bundle
70070000038326.intro: Join the adventure fully loaded with 1120 diamonds!
70070000038326.description:
Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen! 

How to Play: 
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles. 
- Save the Queen: Your ultimate goal is to rescue the Queen who has been captured by evil forces. 
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and gems to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges. 

Features: 
- Premium Currency: Use 1120 Diamonds to unlock new heroes, purchase keys to open exclusive chests, obtain high-rarity gear, and gain a powerful edge in battle.
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team. 
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes. 
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game. 
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen. 
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience. 
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests to earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!

70070000038328.name: ROUTE16 COLLECTION
70070000038328.intro:
The classic car-chase maze series returns!
3 high-octane action games in one.
70070000038328.description:
ROUTE16 COLLECTION includes ROUTE16R in addition to two classic titles from the 1980s ROUTE16 series.

The ROUTE16 series is a thrilling car chase action experience where you control your beloved car, MAD X, collecting all items while evading relentless enemy cars and monsters.

ROUTE16R:
The legendary ROUTE16 returns as a brand-new title!
This time, MAD X-R isn’t just about escaping-fight back with customization and transformation to defeat incoming enemies in high-speed chase action.

- Customize and transform into a robot! Intense battle system
Use the money collected in stages to freely customize MAD X-R. Upgrade fuel, speed, and combat performance before heading into battle. 
Collide with enemies to transform into a powerful robot form and use enhanced stats and SP items to defeat both minor enemies and powerful bosses.

- Series-first! Up to 4-player local multiplayer
Enjoy multiplayer for the first time in the series. Compete to capture flags in a high-speed chase action experience with friends and family.
*Local multiplayer only.

ROUTE16:
ROUTE16 is the original title in the series, first released as an arcade game in 1981.
Its defining feature is the seamless switching between two modes:
Maze Mode, which displays a zoomed-in view of the labyrinth, and Radar Mode, which shows the entire stage composed of 16 mazes.
As the foundation of the series, this title captures the core gameplay that made ROUTE16 so unique.

ROUTE16TURBO:
ROUTE16TURBO is the sequel to ROUTE16, released in 1985.
Take control of your beloved machine, MAD X, and recover the stolen money from the evil Kanharoo Gang.
Building on the original system, the game features enhanced visuals and a variety of unique maze layouts.
The turbo system allows you to accelerate using fuel, adding a new layer of strategy to the high-speed chase action.
This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.

70070000038334.name: WorldNeverland - Elnea Kingdom: Starter Edition
70070000038334.description:
Start your new life in Elnea Kingdom with the perfect essentials!
This Starter Edition includes the full base game along with two of the most popular DLCs, giving you ultimate freedom in character customization and comfortable exploration right from the beginning.

[Bundle Contents]
- WorldNeverland - Elnea Kingdom (Full Game)
- Cosmetics Set (Magical Makeup, Hair Catalog)
- High Speed Anklet Set (Anklet of Light, Anklet of Hermes)

*How to access your DLC items:
Once purchased, these items will be permanently unlocked and available to acquire at any time from the following in-game shops:
- Cosmetics Set: Fashion Store (Castle St.)
- High Speed Anklet Set: Caravan Co. (Old Town Riverside)

70070000038337.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Advanced Edition
70070000038337.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000038348.name: nOS new Operating System Wallpapers Collection 2
70070000038348.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000038348.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here! 

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes the Wallpapers Pack 2 DLC.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game

70070000038349.name: Clay&Cats Watering Can Pack
70070000038349.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000038349.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed. 

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that! 

This bundle includes the Watering Can DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each 
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire

70070000038371.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Deluxe Edition
70070000038371.description:
No matter if it's your first time playing poker, or you’re a seasoned veteran, with this game you will sharpen your skills and experience the thrill of winning big at the poker table! 

You can play with AI or up to 6 players in local multiplayer mode. There are five difficulty levels, and lots of customisation features: 

- Custom Blinds
- Round time limit
- Shop with over 20 different tables, floors and table materials 
- 10 card artwork styles to choose from
- Player avatars

… and more! Check it out and enjoy a crash course in probability, psychology, and game theory.

This bundle contains main title and Cards Set #2, with:

- 1 new set of averses and reverses for cards

70070000038374.name: Street Basketball Deluxe Edition
70070000038374.description:
Put your dueling instincts to the test in one-on-one matches!

Choose from multiple characters with their signature ability shots.
Pick their looks from the list of available outfits.
Make them better players by improving their stats!

Challenge your mates in one-on-one local multiplayer mode! 

Shoot, block, shove and dunk your way through tournaments to unlock additional characters.

The must-have game for all basketball lovers!

GAME FEATURES:

* 19 different characters with their own signature ability shots and unique looks
* Two different single player modes (League and Challenge)
* COMPETE 1-ON-1 IN LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MODE (Versus)
* Improve your character by leveling up and upgrading their stats
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* 36 achievements to complete
* 10 statistics to track your progress and beat

This bundle contains main title and Street Style Kit #2,  with:

- 1 new set of jersey, shorts and boots

70070000038377.name: Make It Cozy! Cats Pack
70070000038377.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70070000038377.description:
Welcome to Make It Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

This bundle includes the Cats DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay

70070000038380.name: Solid Void - Nonogram Triple Pack
70070000038380.intro:
Three Nonogram Puzzle Games In One
The ultimate nonogram collection for puzzle fans.
70070000038380.description:
Experience the first three entries in the Solid Void franchise of Nonogram puzzles in one package! This bundle includes every puzzle, from the simple to the complex, from Solid Void - Nature Puzzles, Solid Void Art Nonograms, and Solid Void - Topsy Turvy World.

Each game expands upon the core Nonogram formula through a unique two-step puzzle adventure, perfect for cozy gaming sessions and mental training. Start by solving the logical Nonogram grid, and then test your creative side by completing the jigsaw puzzle.

Only by solving both will you uncover the full image at the end as your ultimate reward for your puzzle mastery!

Pick between nature images, classic works of art, or the classic work of Pieter Bruegel the Elder. Each game in the bundle contains over 250 individual puzzles that scale in difficulty, ensuring a full and challenging experience for all players.

Featuring calming music to soothe the mind as you take on increasingly difficult puzzles, the Solid Void bundle is the perfect way to keep your brain sharp with a fresh spin on your favorite puzzle formula!

Whether you're a beginner or a pro, this is the perfect puzzle bundle to improve your thinking skills!

70070000038386.name: Spot THEM all!
70070000038386.description:
**Spot them All** is a special bundle featuring two complete games: **Spot the Cat** and **Spot the Spy Guy**!

Put your observation skills and reflexes to the test in fast-paced games focused on finding matching symbols. Every pair of cards has exactly one symbol in common – your goal is to spot it as quickly as possible!

In **Spot the Cat**, you'll explore a colorful world filled with adorable cats and charming illustrations. In **Spot the Spy Guy**, you'll step into the shoes of a detective, searching for hidden clues and uncovering mysterious symbols.

**Bundle Features:**

* Two complete games in one package.
* Simple rules and engaging gameplay for players of all ages.
* A fun way to train your reflexes, focus, and observation skills.
* Colorful visuals and hundreds of symbols to discover.
* Perfect for fans of puzzles and hidden-object challenges.

Take on the challenge and see how quickly you can find the matching symbols in **Spot them All**!

70070000038387.name: Garfield Kart Road 67 - 2 in 1
70070000038387.description:
This bundle contains:
- Garfield Kart Furious Racing
- Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift

70070000038388.name: Agatha Christie's Deadly Voyages - 2 in 1
70070000038388.description:
Discover the Agatha Christie games through this bundle of 2 games including : 

Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile
Agatha Christie - The Murder on the Orient Express

70070000038389.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 1 & 2
70070000038389.description:
This bundle contains:
- Gear.Club Unlimited
- Gear.Club Unlimited 2

70070000038394.name: Wukong Black Legend: Chosen Dynasty
70070000038394.intro: Born for battle, bound by legacy. Write your own myth.
70070000038394.description:
Step into a world full of mysteries, dangers, and challenges — only the brave will make it to the end. Master dynamic sword combat, capture enemy projectiles, and solve smart puzzles to uncover hidden rewards.

What the content includes:
Wukong Black Legend
Engage in high-stakes dynamic combat where you must constantly switch between close-quarters sword slashes and long-range archery. Search every corner of detailed maps for hidden chests, resources, and cryptic puzzles that test your wits.

Wukong Black Legend: Nightfall Descends
Removes the default, standard gray sky across all levels and replaces it with a beautiful, deep midnight canopy. The dark environment adds a layer of mystery and intensity to the exploration, making every hidden clue feel like a true midnight secret.

Are you ready to prove your courage, unravel the mysteries, and become a legend under the starlight?

70070000038402.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Killzone
70070000038402.intro: Outsmart, outgun, and outlast every single opponent in your way.
70070000038402.description:
Lock and load for the definitive tactical shooter experience. Gain complete visual clarity in the heat of battle, adapt to changing combat zones, and secure everything you need to lead your team to victory.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Step into the heart of intense, fast-paced combat. Lead your elite squad through tactical 5v5 battles, utilize a massive arsenal of over 20 weapons, and protect your team’s 1000-point pool to claim victory.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Green Armour – Enhance your combat awareness with a fresh green-colored armour interface. Designed for better visibility and readability during intense firefights, it helps you track your protection status at a glance.

3. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Battlefield Sky – Elevate your immersion with upgraded, dynamic skyboxes across all maps. This complete atmospheric overhaul brings a new visual tone and tension to every combat environment, making every mission feel even more epic.

Answer the call, perfect your strategy, and lead your squad to victory with unmatched tactical style!

70070000038406.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Warzone Starter Pack
70070000038406.description:
Everything you need to take flight.

Start your journey with the complete experience (base game + DLC) and gain immediate access to additional aircraft that expand your combat potential from the very beginning.

What’s included in the bundle:

• AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault (Base Game)Take control of a cutting-edge jet and dive into fast-paced aerial combat across dynamic environments. Complete missions, upgrade your aircraft, and master different game modes while facing increasingly difficult enemies.

•AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Warzone Falcons A10 & F2 Unlock two advanced jets and expand your fleet with new capabilities. Choose between different combat approaches and adapt your strategy for every mission.

This bundle delivers a complete aerial combat experience with added flexibility, giving you more control, more variety, and more ways to dominate the skies.Take off stronger and push your limits in every battle.

70070000038407.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Heavy Strike Edition
70070000038407.description:
More firepower. More control. More ways to dominate.

Step into the complete experience (base game + DLC) and take your aerial combat to the next level. This bundle combines the core game with additional strike fighters, giving you more options from the very start.

What’s included in the bundle:

• AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault (Base Game)Pilot advanced jets across diverse environments, complete missions, and upgrade your aircraft while facing fast-paced aerial combat challenges.

• AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Dual Strike Fighters SU15 & F16 Unlock two powerful strike fighters and expand your fleet with new capabilities.Adapt your tactics and approach each mission with greater flexibility.

This bundle enhances your overall experience with more aircraft variety, allowing you to handle every situation with improved control and confidence.Enter the skies fully equipped and ready for any challenge.

70070000038408.name: AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Stealth Warfare Bundle
70070000038408.description:
Precision changes the outcome.

Experience the complete package (base game + DLC) and take a more tactical approach to aerial combat. This bundle combines the core game with stealth-focused aircraft, giving you more control over how you engage every mission.

What’s included in the bundle:

• AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault (Base Game)Engage in fast-paced aerial combat across diverse environments. Complete missions, upgrade your jets, and master different modes while facing increasing threats in the skies.

•AirJet Fighter : Sky Assault Stealth Vanguard Pack SU57 & SAAB JAS 39 Unlock two advanced stealth aircraft and expand your fleet with new tactical possibilities. Approach combat with precision, control, and smarter positioning. 

This bundle gives you more flexibility, more control, and more ways to approach every battle — whether you strike fast or stay unseen.Take control of the skies your way.

70070000038411.name: Cozy Tiny Home Japanese Collection
70070000038411.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000038411.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes the Japan DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000038413.name: Stuff it! Fruits Pack
70070000038413.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000038413.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!

This bundle includes the Fruits DLC.

What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?

70070000038418.name: My Little Haven Ultimate Edition
70070000038418.intro: Step into the beautiful dream world and help your toy friends settle into their miniature cozy homes!
70070000038418.description:
The core My Little Haven is about arranging furniture and decorating rooms to make them perfect for the adorable toy inhabitants. Each resident you meet has unique tastes and requests, challenging your interior design skills!

•Fulfill Wishes: residents will have specific requirements, such as needing certain floor or wall color.
•Design freely! While meeting their basic needs, you have complete freedom to style the room however you like. 
•Unlock décor. Expand your catalog of decorations by discovering exclusive new items scattered across the dream islands!
•Don't just decorate the inside! Customize the exterior look of the toy houses to make the whole world sparkle.
•Visit distinct, beautiful miniature islands.
•Experience the magic! All ocharacters are brought to life with delightful, stop-motion-style animations, adding a unique, handcrafted feel to your decorating adventure.

This bundle includes the Arts Pack DLC, Pets Pack DLC, Walls Pack DLC, and Floor Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 5 unique islands to explore with 3 houses to decorate each.
- Avatar choice: you can play as a boy or girl. 
- Wholesome, family friendly atmosphere.
- Gameplay filled with creative challenges. 
- Cozy, relaxing music.

70070000038420.name: Cottonville Cotton Candy Clouds Edition
70070000038420.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000038420.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes the Cotton Candy Room DLC.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000038424.name: Dreamscapes: The Full Journey
70070000038424.intro: Immerse yourself in two atmospheric hidden-object adventures full of puzzles, dream worlds, and dark secrets.
70070000038424.description:
Experience Laura’s complete story in an atmospheric hidden-object adventure bundle full of puzzles, dream worlds, and dark secrets.

In Dreamscapes – The Sandman, Laura falls into an inexplicable sleep. To save her, you must delve into her subconscious, explore dream worlds, solve puzzles, and confront the dark power of the Sandman.

In Dreamscapes – Nightmare’s Heir, the nightmare returns: Two years later, Laura’s boyfriend Tim falls into a coma—and once again, the Sandman is pulling the strings behind the scenes.

Discover fantastical dreamscapes, solve tricky puzzles, and face a sinister story full of secrets, memories, and dark magic.

• A modern blend of point-and-click adventure and hidden object gameplay
• Explore exciting locations and experience a captivating story
• Solve a variety of hidden object scenes and mini-games
• 2 game modes each (normal and advanced)
• Each includes a bonus chapter

70070000038425.name: My Cozy Room Feline Art Pack
70070000038425.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000038425.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes the Cats Art DLC.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000038437.name: My Cozy Aquarium Ultimate Edition
70070000038437.intro: Build your dream tank and fill it with finned friends!
70070000038437.description:
Feed your finned pals, polish their glassy castle, and keep the waters sparkling—because happy fish = happy you! Collect 300+ quirky swimmers, unlock magical tanks, play cozy mini‑games, and decorate your perfect underwater paradise.


Purchase surprise packs filled with delightful fish companions and nurture them through immersive, relaxing mini-games. Feed your fish with care, maintain the perfect water temperature, clean the air filters to ensure healthy conditions, and gently scrub aquarium walls to keep your aquatic heaven crystal clear.

As your fish grow, you'll experience the joy of raising them from tiny swimmers into magnificent adults. Sell your matured fish to earn coins, enabling you to expand your underwater paradise further.

Discover and collect over 320 beautifully quirky fish species – each with charming and whimsical designs. Enhance your aquariums with vibrant decorations and upgraded fish food, unlocking even more cozy, aesthetic possibilities.

Each out of the four tanks will offer different fish packages, inspired by real life fish but with a magical twist on them. 
Start with one tank, then unlock wild and wacky aquariums packed with magical fish and quirky surprises. Decorate, upgrade, and try not to laugh when your fish act like they own the place.

This bundle includes the Antique Decoration DLC, Glowing Decoration DLC, Prehistoric Decoration DLC, Toy Decoration DLC, and Prehistoric Fish Pack & Aquarium DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Four themed aquariums full of charm and fishy chaos.
- Relaxing mini-games with a silly twist.
- Over 320 fish to collect—some cuter, some weirder, all awesome.
- Tons of decorations to splash your style across the tank.
- Cozy idle gameplay where even cleaning feels fun.

70070000038438.name: Turmoil - All You Can Drill
70070000038438.description:
Turmoil offers players a visually charming, tongue-in-cheek take on the simulation genre inspired by the 19th century oil rush in North America.

Get a taste of the rush and rivalry of the time as you earn your way to become a successful oil entrepreneur. As you make money digging up and selling oil, the town will grow along with you.

Lease land at the town auction and search for oil. Build a rig, create an efficient pipe network and bring up the oil to store it in silos. Sell the oil at the best times to maximize profits. Then buy essential upgrades in town to cope with rock, gas and ice. Acquire more town shares than your competitors in a bid to become the new mayor.

"The Heat Is On" DLC is included in this version! Start anew with a brand new campaign with tons of oil to dig up and convert into cash. Discover a new town, new oil-rich maps, new resources, new drilling mechanics, new people, new treasures… New everything! A real All You Can Drill buffet!

• A campaign where you build your rags-to-riches oil baron career and beat your rivals
• Includes Expert mode and extra DLC campaign "The Heat is On", totalling 16+ hours of gameplay
• Dozens of upgrades and new tools to improve your oil mining operations
• Meet the town’s characters in the saloon and make shady business deals
• Play single game mode to get one of literally millions of procedurally generated levels and earn as much as you can in one year
• Lease land at the town auction and search for oil using a dowser, mole or scanner
• Maximize your profits by using natural gas to boost the oil price
• Outbid your competitors at the stock auction
• Laid-back acoustic soundtrack and stylized graphics
• Play with a controller or on touchscreen!

70070000038450.name: Om Nom: Run 2 - Platinum Edition
70070000038450.intro: Ready, set, dash! Join the omtastic Om Nom Run 2 challenge and prove you’re the speedster champion.
70070000038450.description:
Have you got what it takes to dodge all the obstacles and outpace the competition? Time to find out!

RECEIVE PREMIUM NOMS AND EXTRA GOLD
Leave the competition in the dust using new content:
- Droid Nom who triggers a medium turbo boost a few seconds after the race starts!
- Iron Nom who gives you a 30-second shield right at the start!
- Viking Nom who triggers a powerful long turbo boost shortly after the race begins!
- Wind Nom who gives a big running speed boost to keep you ahead!
- Electro Nom who eliminates one other runner!
- Goldie Nom who gets more exp than any other Nom!
- 6000 gold to buy new Noms!

NEW MULTIPLAYER MODE FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS!
Grab friends or family and jump into the same race on one screen. Chase the lead, pull off last-second comebacks, and see who really is the fastest runner among you!

RACE THROUGH EXCITING LOCATIONS
Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you dash through thrilling and challenging locations full of traps and setbacks that will test your skills to the limit.

AVOID AND DODGE OBSTACLES
Navigate through the course with lightning speed, skillfully avoiding and dodging obstacles that stand between you and victory. Show off your reflexes and maneuver your way to success!

BE THE FIRST TO COMPLETE THE RACE
Race to be the first to cross the finish line! Feel the adrenaline rush as you outpace your opponents and emerge victorious. It’s not just a race; it’s a quest for glory!

FIND THE FASTEST ROUTES TO VICTORY
With thousands of possible paths, the choice is yours! Strategize and discover the fastest routes to secure your place at the top. Unleash your inner speed demon and leave your competition in the dust!

Get ready for an omtastic challenge that will put your speed and skills to the ultimate test.

70070000038454.name: Paper io 2: Emerald Edition
70070000038454.intro: Conquer all the maps solo or beat your friends in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players!
70070000038454.description:
Paint the map in your own color, eliminate your opponents, get the highest score and take over the Paper io world.
Compete in a fierce battle and become a champion!

Features:
- as many maps as there are countries in the world
- multiplayer mode up to 8 players on one screen!
- 63 skins which also change the look of your terrain
- 22 new funny hats to wear
- custom game with 76 various shaped maps
- powerups spawning during the game
- catchy music
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Glide over the white space or your friends territory and create connection back to your own color to claim that area. Watch out! When you move outside of your color, your tail is exposed to attack and you can be eliminated by others.

Use your strategic skills and powerups to attack and claim all of the white space that was previously owned by other players!

70070000038457.name: The Treflik Family King Edition
70070000038457.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000038457.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes the Treflik Is King episode.

70070000038471.name: Magic Cats Pots Ultimate Edition
70070000038471.description:
Step into a cozy world where fixing broken porcelain is full of surprises! In this fun puzzle game, you’ll put together teapots, cups, and plates—and sometimes, you’ll find a magical moving porcelain cat hidden inside!

This bundle includes the Spring, Summer, Frame Pack, Pot Pack, and Traditional Pack DLCs.

Features:
- Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Fit pieces together to fix up broken porcelain items like teapots, cups, and plates.
- 126 Different Puzzles: Tons of unique pieces to restore, each with its own charm.
- Hidden Magical Cats: Sometimes a piece will surprise you with a cute, moving porcelain cat inside!
- Choose Your Challenge: Play at your own pace with three difficulty levels—from easy to tricky.
- Never the Same Puzzle: Each puzzle is different, so you’ll always get a fresh challenge every time you play.
- Replay for More Fun: After completing a level, replay it for a new twist!


Fix, discover, and enjoy the magic of cats—one puzzle at a time!

70070000038472.name: Cozy Tiny Home Mini Decorator Edition
70070000038472.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000038472.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes the Cat Pack 1, Cat Pack 2, Floor & Wallpaper, and Japan DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000038473.name: Mini Market Design Inspiration Installation
70070000038473.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000038473.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the School and Cinema DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000038475.name: Soapy Tales Rainbow Delight Edition
70070000038475.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70070000038475.description:
Suddenly, you wake up as a ghost, with no memories. Your good and bad deed count is perfectly even, so you need to go back to Earth to earn your redemption. 
Rediscover your past life and relive touching memories while attending to family business.

Soapy Tales combines doing relaxing chores with elements of time and space management. Complete the tasks, upgrade your skills, and unveil the story of your life in the midst of pastel, soapy bubbles!

This bundle includes the Rainbow Lady Birds DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- First-person point of view gameplay. 
- Cozy, nostalgic atmosphere.
- Relaxing music. 
- Skill tree and artifacts to unlock.

70070000038485.name: Mounted Knights Battle : Medieval Warrior Honor Simulator – Supreme Combat
70070000038485.intro: Ride confidently into the fray and conquer the grand arena.
70070000038485.description:
True chivalry requires both the courage to face adversaries and the preparation to withstand their heaviest blows. The path to eternal renown is a lifelong pursuit, demanding exceptional battlefield readiness and a steadfast defense within the grand arena.

Included Content:
- Mounted Knights Battle : Medieval Warrior Honor Simulator
Dive into an authentic tournament simulation where you customize a unique warrior, manage a trusted steed, and make crucial narrative choices across bustling medieval cities. Wave your flag high and test your reflexes in high-stakes jousting matches.

- Mounted Knights Battle : Medieval Warrior Honor Simulator - Elite Gear
This expansion delivers the specialized Armor No. 7 plate protection set directly to your inventory to maximize tournament defense. If this specific armor set is already present in your collection, the system automatically replaces it by granting 4,727 Coins as fallback compensation.

Prepare the armory, tighten the saddle, and ride confidently toward a legendary destiny.

70070000038523.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection Season 7
70070000038523.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection + Summer 2 + Independence Day + Christmas 2 + Autumn 2 + Halloween 2 + Spring 2 + Winter 2

70070000038531.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Dark
70070000038531.intro: Every corridor hides a new nightmare.
70070000038531.description:
The Backrooms are darker, deadlier, and more unpredictable than ever—but with the right equipment, every mystery becomes easier to uncover. Experience relentless bodycam horror and gain the ultimate advantage with unlimited night vision.

What’s included in this bundle:
1. Escape the Backrooms: BODYCAM
Enter a terrifying maze where reality constantly shifts and survival is never guaranteed. Fight hostile enemies, complete cryptic objectives, record vital clues with your camcorder, and explore ever-changing environments as you search for a way out.

2. Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Night Ops
Receive a Night Vision Camera equipped with an unlimited battery, allowing you to explore the darkest areas without interruption. If you already own a Night Vision Camera, it will be automatically upgraded with infinite battery power, ensuring your most valuable survival tool is always ready.

Step into the darkness with confidence, uncover secrets hidden beyond the light, and survive the Backrooms with your camera powered every step of the way.

70070000038532.name: Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Heavy Routes
70070000038532.intro: Master the highways and dominate the logistics industry.
70070000038532.description:
Start your trucking career with everything you need to build a successful transport company. Explore Europe’s highways, complete rewarding deliveries, and gain a valuable financial boost to expand your business from the very beginning.

Bundle Includes:
1. Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Experience the life of a professional truck driver as you travel across Europe, transport valuable cargo, customize your vehicles, complete challenging contracts, and grow your logistics company through smart planning and skilled driving.
2. Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver – Road to Success – Adds $75,000 to the in-game account, helping accelerate company growth and future investments. Invest in better trucks, purchase essential upgrades, unlock new opportunities, and expand your transport business with a powerful financial head start.

Take the wheel, grow your fleet, and build one of Europe’s most successful trucking empires.

70070000038538.name: MYSIDE REALITY: Lost Reality
70070000038538.intro: Enter deeper, understand less, but feel everything more intensely.
70070000038538.description:
Step into a mysterious digital world where reality bends, choices matter, and every encounter with Mira brings new questions. Explore an immersive narrative experience filled with secrets, emotional tension, and unexpected revelations.

This bundle includes:
1. MYSIDE REALITY - An atmospheric first-person adventure where the boundaries between virtual and real begin to blur. Meet Mira, a mysterious girl who claims to seek connection—but nothing is as simple as it seems. Explore strange environments, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden beneath shifting realities.

2. MYSIDE REALITY: Cozy Style - Enhances Mira’s appearance with a completely new outfit. This visual update gives the mysterious companion a refreshed style, adding subtle variety to every scene and interaction without altering the core story.

Experience the journey with a renewed visual touch while uncovering the secrets of a world that is far from what it seems.

70070000038543.name: Twofold: The Perfect Circle Collection
70070000038543.intro: The complete Twofold story, following two journeys through college life.
70070000038543.description:
Experience the complete story of Twofold with The Perfect Circle Collection, featuring both Twofold: First Snow and Twofold. Follow two interconnected stories about love, friendship, and self-discovery as its cast navigates college life, personal struggles, and the bonds that connect them.

Twofold: The Perfect Circle Collection includes:

•	Twofold: First Snow: Follow college student Allison Merlo through a linear story detailing her first year of school away from her family. Isolated and directionless, she finds her way forward with help from Eileen Turner, an art student who, while otherwise cold and distant, extends a warm hand to her.

•	Twofold: Taking place a year after Twofold: First Snow, Twofold follows the story of Olive Penn, a college student at risk of failing out of college due to numerous outside factors. The leaders of the campus art and writing clubs, Caprice Shiften and Millie Clarke, offer to help them to the best of their abilities, but accepting either offer will undoubtedly put Olive in the middle of a conflict between the two women. Still, it's the only option Olive has. Twofold features two core paths to travel down, focusing on Caprice, Millie and their respective clubs. There are also side paths to explore, focusing on building friendships with the various club members.

70070000038544.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Deluxe Service Pack
70070000038544.description: Bundle together some deluxe DLC with this Deluxe Service Pack! Included: the DIgital Soundtrack/Artbook App and an N.A. Color Pack based on your console!

70070000038545.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Ultimate Service Pack
70070000038545.description: Get the most out of your Disgaea Mayhem DLC with this Ultimate Service Pack, which bundles together the Fun Weapon Pack, Digital Soundtrack/Artbook App, N.A. Color Pack, and the Bonus Story: Catastrophe Flan Arc content!

70070000038546.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000038546.description: The Disgaea Mayhem - Digital Deluxe Edition is packed with more chaos than you can throw a Prinny at. In addition to the base game, you'll get access to the Digital Soundtrack/Artbook App and the N.A. Color Pack!

70070000038547.name: Disgaea Mayhem - Ultimate Edition
70070000038547.description: You'll want for nothing with Disgaea Mayhem - Ultimate Edition! That's because it comes with the base game, the Bonus Story: Catastrophe Flan Arc DLC, the Digital Soundtrack/Artbook App, the Fun Weapon Pack, and the N.A. Color Pack!

70070000038567.name: Car Detailing & Wash Simulator : Luxury Car Cleaner – Luxury Garage
70070000038567.intro: Restore, polish, and perfect the world’s finest vehicles.
70070000038567.description:
Build the ultimate luxury car detailing business and transform every vehicle into a showroom masterpiece. Grow your workshop, master professional cleaning techniques, and enjoy an extra financial boost that helps your business expand even faster.

This bundle includes:
1. Car Detailing & Wash Simulator : Luxury Car Cleaner
Experience premium car detailing as you clean, polish, and restore exotic supercars, luxury sedans, and rare collector vehicles. Upgrade your equipment, unlock advanced services, satisfy demanding clients, and turn your workshop into the city’s most prestigious luxury car care center.

2. Car Detailing & Wash Simulator : Luxury Car Cleaner – Growth Fund
Adds 2,500 to your in-game balance, providing additional funds for new equipment, workshop upgrades, and faster business progression. Strengthen your detailing operation and reach new milestones with greater financial flexibility.

Take your workshop to the next level and establish yourself as the premier luxury car detailing specialist.

70070000038583.name: Raccoon Adventure: Animal City Simulator 3D Farm Super Deluxe – Wildlife Experience
70070000038583.intro: More wildlife, more discovery, more adventure.
70070000038583.description:
Embark on a playful open-world adventure where curiosity, exploration, and a little mischief lead to unforgettable discoveries. Explore lively neighborhoods, forests, and parks while enjoying an even richer world filled with new wildlife to encounter.

This bundle includes:
• Raccoon Adventure: Animal City Simulator 3D Farm Super Deluxe: Experience life as a clever raccoon in a vibrant open world packed with exploration, scavenging, puzzles, and humorous adventures. Search for food, outsmart humans, unlock new abilities, complete missions, and uncover hidden secrets scattered throughout the neighborhood.

• Raccoon Adventure: Animal City Simulator 3D Farm Super Deluxe – New Species: Expands the game world with three new animal species, bringing greater variety to your adventures. Discover fresh wildlife as you explore forests, parks, and suburban areas, making every journey feel more dynamic and alive.

Explore, discover, and enjoy an even more vibrant world where every adventure brings something new to find.

70070000038588.name: SCREAM AND STEEL - Horror Story Shooter: Lost Below
70070000038588.intro: Search the darkness. Survive the nightmare.
70070000038588.description:
Descend into a terrifying world where darkness hides deadly secrets and every locked door brings you closer to the truth—or to your end. Search for clues, solve mysterious puzzles, and confront relentless horrors as you fight to escape a nightmare that grows more dangerous with every step.

Bundle Includes:
1. SCREAM AND STEEL - Horror Story Shooter
Wake up trapped in a terrifying basement, search for passwords, solve puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and survive against relentless enemies in an immersive first-person horror experience.

2. SCREAM AND STEEL - Horror Story Shooter: Light the Way
Adds a flashlight and a candle to aid your exploration. The flashlight illuminates your path until you pick up the pistol, after which it is automatically replaced, and it disappears upon death.

Step into the darkness fully prepared, uncover every secret, and fight for your survival until the very end.

70070000038592.name: SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE: Shadow Operation
70070000038592.intro: Become the sniper every operation depends on.
70070000038592.description:
Become the ultimate long-range marksman in a realistic modern warfare experience where patience, precision, and tactical planning are the keys to survival. Complete dangerous missions across vast environments, eliminate high-value targets, and customize your equipment to match every operation.

Bundle Includes:
1. SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE – Experience realistic sniping across expansive battlefields, complete challenging missions, customize your equipment, and rely on skill, stealth, and precision to accomplish every objective.

2. SNIPER WARRIOR ELITE: Ready to Fire – A powerful precision rifle together with six exclusive weapon skins, allowing you to expand your arsenal and customize your weapon’s appearance throughout your missions.

Take your position, steady your aim, and complete every mission with the equipment of an elite marksman.

70070000038606.name: Cooking Green Zen Pack
70070000038606.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000038606.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

This bundle includes the Green Zen Set DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out 
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000038608.name: Street Basketball Premium Edition
70070000038608.description:
Put your dueling instincts to the test in one-on-one matches!

Choose from multiple characters with their signature ability shots.
Pick their looks from the list of available outfits.
Make them better players by improving their stats!

Challenge your mates in one-on-one local multiplayer mode! 

Shoot, block, shove and dunk your way through tournaments to unlock additional characters.

The must-have game for all basketball lovers!

GAME FEATURES:

* 19 different characters with their own signature ability shots and unique looks
* Two different single player modes (League and Challenge)
* COMPETE 1-ON-1 IN LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MODE (Versus)
* Improve your character by leveling up and upgrading their stats
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* 36 achievements to complete
* 10 statistics to track your progress and beat

This bundle contains main title and Street Style Kit #3, with:

- 1 new set of jersey, shorts and boots

70070000038613.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Premium Edition
70070000038613.description:
No matter if it's your first time playing poker, or you’re a seasoned veteran, with this game you will sharpen your skills and experience the thrill of winning big at the poker table! 

You can play with AI or up to 6 players in local multiplayer mode. There are five difficulty levels, and lots of customisation features: 

- Custom Blinds
- Round time limit
- Shop with over 20 different tables, floors and table materials 
- 10 card artwork styles to choose from
- Player avatars

… and more! Check it out and enjoy a crash course in probability, psychology, and game theory.

This bundle contains main title and Cards Set #3, with:

- 1 new set of averses and reverses for cards

70070000038616.name: The Smurfs Studio Edition
70070000038616.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000038616.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 7, Personal Boards 8, Personal Boards 9, and Personal Boards 10 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000038618.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Upgrade Edition
70070000038618.description:
