No matter if it's your first time playing poker, or you’re a seasoned veteran, with this game you will sharpen your skills and experience the thrill of winning big at the poker table! 

You can play with AI or up to 6 players in local multiplayer mode. There are five difficulty levels, and lots of customisation features: 

- Custom Blinds
- Round time limit
- Shop with over 20 different tables, floors and table materials 
- 10 card artwork styles to choose from
- Player avatars

… and more! Check it out and enjoy a crash course in probability, psychology, and game theory.

This bundle contains main title and Cards Set #4, with:

- 1 new set of averses and reverses for cards

70070000038622.name: Tokyo Racer X: Drift Core
70070000038622.intro: Master the streets and prove your skill in every race.
70070000038622.description:
Enter the underground world of Tokyo street racing and push your driving skills to the limit. Race through neon-lit streets, master precision drifting, and compete against rival crews in high-stakes battles where every second counts. Build your reputation, refine your driving style, and prove you have what it takes to dominate the city’s most dangerous roads.

Bundle Includes:
- Tokyo Racer X – Dive into the intense world of street racing in Tokyo, where skill, timing, and control decide every outcome. Compete in races, challenge rival crews, and rise through the ranks of the underground scene.
- Tokyo Racer X: JDM Legend – Adds a powerful Nissan Skyline R34 directly to your garage, built for speed, precision, and drifting control, giving you a strong edge in every race.

Take control of the streets, master every corner, and become a legend of Tokyo’s underground racing world.

70070000038627.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Deluxe Edition
70070000038627.intro: Arcade Beat 'Em Up Action in the World of AMC's The Walking Dead
70070000038627.description:
FIGHT THE DEAD. SURVIVE THE STREETS.
The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival challenges you to intense arcade brawling in the unforgiving world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and unlockable Negan while fighting through walker-infested tunnels, devastated settlements, and hostile strongholds packed with explosive encounters. Face Alexandria’s most ruthless foes, the Saviors led by Negan, along with overwhelming waves of Walkers as you unleash crushing combos, signature weapon attacks, and devastating finishers in a relentless battle for survival.

INSPIRED BY THE STORY YOU KNOW. 
Based on the events of the All Out War storyline, fight through a campaign that reimagines the Saviors conflict that features walkers, threats, and surprises pulled from across the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. You’ll explore familiar environments from the show - including the Sanctuary, Hilltop, Alexandria – enhanced by dynamic set pieces, environmental hazards, and intense, story-driven moments.

ICONIC SURVIVORS. ICONIC WEAPONS.
Step into the boots of legendary characters from The Walking Dead, each with a unique fighting style, stats, and signature abilities inspired by the series. Rick’s magnum, Michonne’s katana, and Daryl’s trusty crossbow are all ready for battle.

The Deluxe Edition includes The Arcade Apocalypse Pack:
•        2 Weapon Skins - Bloody Lucille, Tactical Magnum
•        1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick 
•        The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
•        HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
•        Digital Soundtrack

GAME FEATURES:
•        Hard-Hitting Arcade Beat ’Em Up Combat
Use brutal melee abilities, crowd-clearing ranged attacks, or a mix of the two in fast-paced skirmishes. Enjoy responsive, crisp, and satisfying fighting gameplay while exploring the apocalypse.

•        Overwhelming Walker Swarms & Ruthless Enemies
Battle through creeping armies of the undead and dangerous members of The Saviors that force you to adapt, assess threats, and fight for every inch of ground.

•        Face Iconic Bosses
Take on powerful, fan-favorite walkers like Winslow, the Well Walker, and more. The Saviors provide their own challenges as you throw down with Negan and Simon in intense, multi-phase boss battles that test your skill, strategy, and survival instincts.

•        Replayable Arcade Challenge
Master each character’s moveset and tackle multiple difficulty levels in an experience built for repeat runs and escalating challenges. Or jump in with an optional Easy Mode for casual play.

70070000038631.name: Street Basketball Upgrade Edition
70070000038631.description:

70070000038633.name: The Legend Of Fireball: Beasts Edition
70070000038633.intro: Master fireball destruction with two legendary Alpha Pets by your side!
70070000038633.description:
FROM ONE FIREBALL TO UNSTOPPABLE POWER
Aim your shot, release the flame, and blast through anything that stands in your path! Begin as a young fireball fighter training in an ordinary room, breaking simple objects to build your strength. Home appliances, computers, motorcycles, cars, massive buildings - every target brings you closer to true fireball mastery.

BURN THROUGH BIGGER AND TOUGHER TARGETS
Grow stronger, upgrade your stats, and take on bigger, tougher, and crazier targets. Boost your Fireball Power, Stamina, Stamina Recovery, and more to turn every shot into pure destruction. When you are ready, enter special challenges with a target and a time limit. Destroy the required number of objects before the countdown ends to earn rewards and unlock the next stage!

MORE POWER WITH EVERY UPGRADE
Gather powerful fireballs, stylish costumes, ancient relics, and loyal pets. Upgrade fireballs to increase your Fireball Power, Gold Acquisition, and Exp Acquisition. Strengthen costumes to improve your Stamina and Recovery. Refine relics for mighty stat bonuses that make every blast even more devastating.

COMMAND LIGHT AND DARK ALPHA PETS
Griffith and Rath join your pet collection, strengthening your team with powerful Alpha Pets from the Light and Dark Families. Griffith boosts the passive skills of all Light Family pets and comes with an active skill that increases Stamina Recovery, helping you keep the fireballs flying longer. Rath boosts the passive skills of all Dark Family pets and comes with an active skill that increases Fireball Power, helping you hit harder and destroy targets faster.

FEATURES:
• Fireball Action - Aim, charge, and launch explosive fireball attacks!
• Destruction Progression - Start with simple targets, then work your way up to vehicles and massive buildings
• Griffith Alpha Pet - Add a powerful Light Family pet that boosts Light Family passive skills and increases Stamina Recovery
• Rath Alpha Pet - Add a fierce Dark Family pet that boosts Dark Family passive skills and increases Fireball Power
• Deep Upgrades - Upgrade your character, fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets to keep growing stronger
• Stylish Costumes - Wear costumes to boost your Stamina and Stamina Recovery
• Powerful Relics - Collect relics to gain stat boosts for Fireball Power, Stamina, Gold, Exp, and others
• Pet Companions - Build a team of Light and Dark Family pets with active and passive skills
• Timed Challenges - Destroy the required number of targets before the countdown ends to unlock the next stage
• Daily Missions and Achievements - Complete tasks and claim extra rewards
• Special Events - Break the Gold Safe for coins and enter the World Championship to win gems
• Addictive Progression - Keep upgrading, unlocking, and destroying bigger targets

End as the legend who can destroy anything!

70070000038635.name: City Bus Simulator: Transport Manager
70070000038635.intro: Deliver passengers on time and maintain order across a growing transport network.
70070000038635.description:
Build and manage your own transportation company while taking on realistic city driving challenges. Complete routes, expand your fleet, and keep your operations running smoothly across a living urban environment.

This bundle includes:
1. City Bus Simulator – Experience realistic bus driving with mission-based routes, Free Ride mode, fleet management, and vehicle upgrades as you build your transport company.
2. City Bus Simulator: New Wheels – Adds the Martopolo Double-Decker Bus to your fleet. If you already own this bus, you will instead receive 290,000 in-game currency as compensation.

Grow your fleet and shape the future of your transportation company.

70070000038646.name: Cipheur - Season 7
70070000038646.description: Cipheur + Quotes Pack 2 + Quotes Pack 3 + Uncommon Words 2 + Proverbs 2 + Last Words 2 + Stupid Laws 2 + Last Words 3

70070000038649.name: Mini Wheels Racers - Turbo Toy Playground: Speed Journey
70070000038649.intro: Drift, jump, and race without limits.
70070000038649.description:
Step into a colorful toy-car racing universe filled with vibrant playground tracks, dynamic obstacles, and fast-paced competition. Race through imaginative environments, upgrade your vehicles, and unlock new worlds as you progress through an exciting and playful driving experience designed for fun and creativity.

Bundle Includes:
1. Mini Wheels Racers - Turbo Toy Playground  
Race through imaginative playground-inspired tracks, master dynamic courses full of loops and jumps, customize your toy cars, and compete against AI opponents in a fun and energetic racing experience.

2. Mini Wheels Racers - Turbo Toy Playground: Green Fortune
1,000 Leaves added to your in-game balance, providing extra resources to unlock new content, upgrade vehicles, and accelerate your overall progression.

Start stronger, race faster, and enjoy more freedom as you explore every colorful track the game has to offer.

70070000038655.name: Hole io: Platinum Edition
70070000038655.intro: Show who is the biggest black hole in the entire universe!
70070000038655.description:
Choose your favorite skin, eat, grow and stay alive. 
Compete in multiplayer mode with up to 4 players or eat it all by yourself.

Hole io: Platinum Edition features:
- 9 maps with different things to swallow 
- 36 animated skins to make your black hole look cooler
- 2 multiplayer modes up to 4 players on one screen!
- endless mode where you swallow things falling from the sky
- powerups spawning during the game
- collecting themed stickers
- easy controls so anyone can play
- simple rules and lots of fun!

Grow by swallowing everything in front of you, whether it be garbage cans, fire hydrants or cars. Get large enough to consume even bigger objects or other players. Eat until nothing and no one is standing in your way!

70070000038662.name: Fight For America: Diamond Edition
70070000038662.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000038662.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- New weapons: Golden Amcar, Flamethrower, Grenade Launcher, Zap Gun, Snowball Launcher and Blizzard
- Extra coins: Boost your campaign with 13000 coins to upgrade your weapons, turrets, and base
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000038676.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026: Retail Story
70070000038676.intro: Manage the chaos of retail and turn it into profit.
70070000038676.description:
Step into the world of retail management and transform a small local shop into a thriving modern supermarket. Handle daily operations, design your store layout, manage stock, set prices, and serve customers efficiently while expanding your business step by step. Every decision shapes your growth, from product selection to store upgrades and long-term strategy.

This bundle includes:
1. Supermarket Simulator 2026
Manage every aspect of your store, from stocking shelves and pricing goods to expanding your supermarket and optimizing customer service. Build and grow your retail business into a successful operation.

2. Supermarket Simulator 2026: Success Fund
Instantly adds 2,000 to your in-game balance, providing extra resources to upgrade your store, purchase inventory, and support early business growth.

Grow your supermarket, make smart decisions, and build a retail business that keeps customers coming back every day.

70070000038679.name: Fit My Cat Ultra Ultimate Edition
70070000038679.intro: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all
70070000038679.description:
Imagine a cardboard box. Is it shaped to fit one to two fluffy felines? What about five? What about twenty?

Fit My Cat presents you with many cute kitties that all wish to sit where they deem fit. That being said, we're running out of space and we are seriously looking for a cat organizer. If you could spare a moment or two to make that happen we would be grateful.

Every single one of them is trained and well-equipped for some spatial management – pick them up and rotate them as you see fit.

Just so you're aware, some boxes might come with yarn balls or entire cathouses – but that will not prevent those spunky kitties from trying to get inside.

Test your skills and show the world that herding cats is where fun begins!

This bundle includes Cat's Puzzle Pack 1, Cat's Puzzle Pack 2, Cat's Puzzle Pack 3, New Floor Pack, Rooms Pack 1, Rooms Pack 2, Boxes Pack, and Cats Pack DLCs.

KEY FEATURES
- Over 90 pawesome levels of cardboard boxes, ready to be filled with fluff
- Tons of purrfect cats of varying shapes, colors, and sizes
- Meowtastic soundtrack

70070000038680.name: Neko Bento Legendary Edition
70070000038680.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000038680.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes Homes Pack, Backgrounds Pack, and Boxes Pack DLCs.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000038686.name: Memory For Kids Extended Edition
70070000038686.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000038686.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes Back Cards, Cards Pack 1, and Cards Pack 2 DLCs.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels

70070000038690.name: Paint For Kids Art Enthusiast Edition
70070000038690.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000038690.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones. 

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes Additional Board 1, Additional Board 2, and Additional Board 3 DLCs.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use

70070000038730.name: Piano: Learn and Play Masterpiece Edition
70070000038730.intro: Wow everyone. Become a pianist in just a few moments.
70070000038730.description:
Become a modern Mozart with Piano: Learn and Play, the best piano learning app for Nintendo Switch™.

Well-known and beloved melodies

Nursery rhymes or other popular songs make time more enjoyable for children around the world. Sing and play with family, friends or at school.

A marvel of modernity

A small, handy musical instrument that you can take anywhere you want. Relax and immerse yourself in the sounds.

A magical experience

Music develops memory, motor skills and improves concentration. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes Song Pack 1, Song Pack 2, Song Pack 3, Song Pack 4, Song Pack 5, Song Pack 6, Song Pack 7, Song Pack 8, and Song Pack 9 DLCs.

Key Features:
- 8 familiar, simple songs
- free play mode
- learning mode
- mini arcade piano game
- different tempo

70070000038735.name: Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle Super Edition
70070000038735.intro: A series of great cooking games in one brand-new collection!
70070000038735.description:
Cook tons of delicious meals from all over the world and become the best chef in the city!

Cook hundreds of tasty dishes with all the possible kitchen appliances and countless ingredients! 
Try it all: coffee makers, juice machines, pizza ovens, frying pans, fryers and ice cream machines. 

Upgrade and decorate your restaurants to attract more clients. 

Upgrade your kitchen appliances and ingredients to cook tasty dishes faster and earn more money!

This comprehensive collection includes three great cooking games: Food Truck Tycoon, Burger Chef Tycoon and Pizza Bar Tycoon!

Features:
* More than 100 dishes to serve 
* 3 unique locations
* More than 200 levels to explore
* Countless upgrades
* Unlock new items to upgrade your kitchen appliances, interiors and ingredients
* 100+ achievements to gain

This bundle includes Cooking Tycoons - 3 in 1 Bundle, Pizza Bar Tycoon New Levels #1 and Food Truck Tycoon New Levels #1 with:

- 20 new levels for Pizza Bar Tycoon
- 45 new levels for Food Truck Tycoon

70070000038741.name: Moto Rush GT VIP Edition
70070000038741.intro: Ultimate motorbike racing experience for all ages!
70070000038741.description:
Racers, beware! 

Fast-paced, polished and dynamic motorbike racing now on Nintendo Switch™!

One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con™ Motorbike!

Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

A unique mix of endless and arcade racing game featuring countless hours of fun!

IN MOTO RUSH GT YOU WILL FIND:

• Over 100 levels to beat!
• Endless racing experience
• 12 customizable motorbikes
• Toy-Con™ Motorbike support
• Race against time, ghost opponents or try various challenges! 
• Motion Controls – play by rotating your console!
• Play with the Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller
• Support all play styles - TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode, Toy-Con™ Motorbike
• Experience 4 different game modes 
• Weather and day-cycle effects: rain, night, storm! 
• Experience beautifully designed roads around the world

This bundle includes base game, Grip Collection #1, Grip Collection #3 and Grip Collection #4 with:

- 12 pairs of state-of-the-art racing gloves, crafted for the ultimate grip and control.

70070000038743.name: Cook For Love Provence Pack
70070000038743.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000038743.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes the Provence DLC.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000038745.name: S.N.I.P.E.R. - Hunter Scope Omega Edition
70070000038745.description:
In S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope you will shoot, you will fight, and you will win!

Play S.N.I.P.E.R., the latest sniping game where you aim, fight and destroy virtual enemies. Try different types of missions, inspired both by classic rail shooters and modern cover shooters. Fight your way out during day and night, destroy evil forces and unlock new weapons and power-ups.

Game includes:
15+ STAGES
30+ WEAPONS
30+ GALLERY ITEMS
60+ SPECIAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

Become a hunter, mount your scope, and fight for our freedom!

This bundle includes base game, Target Acquired, Neon Strike and Expansion Pack #2 with:

- RIF-16-DOT rifle: a high-tech rifle with a dot sight for quick target acquisition 
- SN-200-FOR sniper rifle: a powerful and accurate sniper rifle for long-range engagements 
- SN-300-FFD sniper rifle: a versatile sniper rifle for special assignments
- SN-400-SKY sniper rifle: a sleek design combined with cutting-edge technology 
- SHG-12-AQA: an aquatic-themed shotgun, with a blast like an ocean wave
- UZ-90-CLD: a frosty Uzi, delivering a cool demise
- SN-1200-NEO: a sniper rifle straight out of a neon dream, precision only matched by its glowing elegance.
- FMS-1-G rifle

Conquer your enemies in the wild west style!

70070000038746.name: Formula Racing Pro 2026 Super Edition
70070000038746.intro: Push Beyond Limits – The Future of Racing Starts Now!
70070000038746.description:
Push Beyond Limits – Rule the Race!

Get ready for the next generation of speed in Formula Racing Pro 2026! Experience the ultimate adrenaline rush as you take on faster cars, smarter rivals, and brand-new circuits inspired by the world’s most iconic tracks.

With enhanced graphics, improved physics, and dynamic weather, every lap feels more real than ever. Master your racing line, react to changing track conditions, and fight for the top spot in intense head-to-head battles.

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, Formula Racing Pro 2026 delivers pure racing excitement — accessible, fast, and endlessly thrilling!

Tune your car, chase the podium, and prove you’re the fastest driver on the grid. The future of racing starts now!

This bundle includes base game, expansion pack #1 and expansion pack #4 with:

6 stunning new liveries for your race cars, adding style and personality to your high-speed adventures.

70070000038748.name: nGolf Feline Course Pack
70070000038748.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000038748.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes the Colorful Golf Balls 8 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000038752.name: Clay&Cats Tray Pack
70070000038752.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000038752.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed. 

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that! 

This bundle includes the Tray DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each 
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire

70070000038776.name: Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator – Speed Pursuit
70070000038776.intro: Every upgrade brings you closer to becoming the ultimate champion.
70070000038776.description:
Experience the thrill of quarter-mile drag racing as you build, tune, and race powerful dragsters on challenging dirt tracks. Master every launch, optimize your vehicles for maximum performance, and climb the ranks through intense competitions where precision and preparation make all the difference.

Bundle Includes:
Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator
  Build your drag racing career, tune powerful dragsters, compete on challenging dirt tracks, master realistic racing mechanics, and prove yourself in high-speed quarter-mile competitions.

Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator – Workshop Boost 
  This DLC grants 70 Upgrade Points to enhance your vehicles, unlock upgrades, and customize various aspects of the game, giving you greater flexibility as you develop your racing career.

Upgrade your machines, perfect every run, and become the driver every rival fears on the road to drag racing glory.

70070000038806.name: Food Truck Business Simulator: Urban Kitchen
70070000038806.intro: Build your dream food truck and serve the city with confidence.
70070000038806.description:
Build your dream food truck business from the ground up and turn a simple vehicle into a thriving mobile restaurant. Renovate your truck, create delicious recipes, explore the city, and satisfy hungry customers while overcoming the daily challenges of running a successful business.

Bundle Includes:
• Food Truck Business Simulator – Renovate and customize your food truck, create a unique menu, drive through busy city streets, and grow your culinary business by serving customers and unlocking new opportunities.
• Food Truck Business Simulator: Revenue Boost – Instantly adds 5,000 to your in-game balance, giving you additional funds to upgrade your truck, purchase equipment, expand your menu, and accelerate your business growth.

Invest wisely, expand your business, and become the city’s most successful food truck entrepreneur.

70070000038812.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator: Rescue Operations
70070000038812.intro: Become the hero every emergency needs.
70070000038812.description:
Step into the role of a frontline firefighter and face extreme emergencies where every second counts. Respond to dangerous fires, rescue civilians, and prove your skills across a city filled with unpredictable crises.

Bundle Includes:
1. Firefighting Rescue Simulator - Take control of elite firefighters as you drive powerful fire trucks, respond to emergency calls, and battle intense blazes across multiple cities. Complete missions, unlock new vehicles, and adapt to day and night conditions while saving lives in high-pressure scenarios.

2. Firefighting Rescue Simulator: Duty Outfit - Enhances your firefighter’s appearance with a new and improved protective suit. This upgraded uniform replaces the standard outfit, offering a more modern and professional look while maintaining full immersion in every rescue mission.

Gear up, stay focused, and become the hero your city depends on.

70070000038819.name: Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge: Street Ride
70070000038819.intro: Ride fast, deliver faster, look sharper.
70070000038819.description:
Step into the fast-paced world of urban delivery skating, where speed, skill, and style define every run. Navigate busy city streets, perform smooth skateboarding tricks, and complete challenging delivery missions across a vibrant metropolis full of movement and obstacles.

Bundle Includes:
1. Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge – Become a professional delivery skater, master city navigation, perform tricks, and complete time-based missions while dodging traffic and exploring a dynamic urban environment.
2. Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge: Skate Style – A brand-new skateboard color that lets you personalize your ride and express your style while delivering across the city streets.

Ride fast, deliver on time, and make every run uniquely yours with a fresh new look.

70070000038836.name: Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025: Power Wheels
70070000038836.intro: Turn every stunt into an unforgettable performance.
70070000038836.description:
Jump into an action-packed driving experience where speed, precision, and creativity come together across spectacular stunt arenas. Perform breathtaking jumps, conquer impossible tracks, unlock new rewards, and expand your garage with an additional high-performance vehicle built for your next challenge.

This bundle includes:
1. Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025 - Drive an incredible selection of sports cars, racing machines, classic vehicles, and police cars as you conquer extreme stunt tracks filled with massive ramps, loops, and gravity-defying obstacles. Complete exciting missions, unlock rewards, and prove yourself as the ultimate stunt driver.
2. Car Stunt Hero Simulator 2025: Racing Spirit - The Brugacci Kipon is available to claim in the Car Shop. Expand your garage with a powerful new vehicle and put its performance to the test across challenging stunt arenas, daring jumps, and high-speed courses.

Expand your garage, conquer every stunt, and keep pushing your driving skills to the limit.

70070000038851.name: Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Lost Kingdoms
70070000038851.intro: Command powerful dragons and overcome every obstacle.
70070000038851.description:
Embark on an epic dragon adventure where powerful monsters, dangerous realms, and magical abilities await. Explore vast worlds, hatch legendary dragons, master aerial combat, and strengthen your journey with additional mana that lets you unleash your abilities more often during every battle.

This bundle includes:
• Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Take control of powerful dragons as you explore dangerous realms, battle fearsome monsters, unlock mysterious portals, hatch new dragons with unique abilities, and collect the keys needed to continue your legendary adventure.

• Dragons Legacy : Monsters Lair – Dragon’s Blessing – Increases your dragon’s maximum mana by 100, allowing you to use magical abilities more frequently, stay in battle longer, and face powerful enemies with greater confidence.

Explore new realms, unleash devastating magic, and lead your dragon to victory in every adventure.

70070000038860.name: Ashwood Valley Magical Moments Pack
70070000038860.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000038860.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

This bundle includes the Mystic Nook DLC.

Key Features
- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70070000038861.name: Family Chess Exquisite Edition
70070000038861.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000038861.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Ocean Blue Chessboard, Black & White Chessboard, Grass Green Chessboard, Pink Bubble Gum Chessboard, Emerald Green Chessboard, Wisdom Chessboard, Winter White Chessboard, and Grandmaster Chessboard DLCs.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000038882.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Digital Deluxe Version
70070000038882.intro: A remake of Romancing SaGa 3! Choose from eight heroes in this turn-based RPG.
70070000038882.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

The Digital Deluxe version is a purchasable set that comes with the Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United base game and the following digital bonuses.

■Digital Deluxe Version Content

Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United base game

Original Version Outfit Swap Pack for the Eight Protagonists
　
Button Badges
　・A set of eight button badges containing pixel art of the eight protagonists

SaGa Franchise Battle Music 10 Pack
　・Toggle between iconic battle themes from throughout the SaGa franchise.

Additional Formation Pack
　・Imperial Cross
　・Fanged Assault
　・Divine Wall

Trading Game Item Pack
　・Item: Sinon Pub Contract
　・Additional Property: Sinon Pub
　・Additional group Tech: The Pride of Sinon

War Mode Item Pack
　・Item: Treatise on Goblin Tactics
　・Formation: Goblin Offense
　・Tactic: Intimidation

■Digital Deluxe Preorder Bonus
72 hour early access

* After the content has been downloaded, players may check the content of the Original Version Outfit Swap Pack for the Eight Protagonists and SaGa Franchise Battle Music 10 Pack by opening the game and navigating to the Main Menu > Options > Bonuses section.
* The Button Badges of the Eight Protagonists, Additional Formation Pack, Trading Game Item Pack, and War Mode Item Pack can be obtained from a treasure chest in Loanne or the port of Myules after starting the game.
* Items available in this set are also available for individual purchase. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate purchases.
* This product must be updated to the latest version to be enjoyed.

70070000038892.name: Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Gold Edition
70070000038892.intro: Take the fight to the next level with a remaster of award winning Real Boxing™ 2. Train hard, fight harder. Prove your worth in the career and multiplayer mode.
70070000038892.description:
Discover a whole new world of combat sports games. As a newbie boxer, challenge experienced opponents and try to win and score a KO! Explore the world of boxing and make your way to the top. You can become the boxing champion, the best warrior of all time! So get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and try to climb to the top.

This bundle includes: 
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Maverick DLC
- Real Boxing 2: Remastered - Landon Phil DLC

Become the ultimate champion! Use jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them into devastating combos.

PLAY AS LEGENDARY BOXERS
Receive 2 legendary boxers - Maverick and Landon Phil with their unique equipment and a bonus of 43 000 experience points right from the start!

REMASTERED VERSION
A brand new challenge awaits you as the game has been rebalanced for a fresh and fair boxing experience. With better effects and improved graphics you can feel like you're boxing for real!

CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING
Before you KO your opponent, you need to improve your fighting skills! Adjust your boxer's stats to match your playstyle and level up quickly to unlock new abilities that will help you in fights to come! Use powerful boosts to make your dream come true. Get ready - a KO is in the air!

PLAY MINI-GAMES
Train your fighter in exciting mini games that reflect real life boxers’ training and develop your character! You need to leave a lot of sweat in your training hall to be a champion. No one said it would be an easy challenge!

CREATE YOUR DREAM BOXER
Real Boxing 2: Remastered allows you to customize your fighter! Choose your outfit, get a new tattoo and even change your haircut. Adjust all the aspects of the fighter’s body, from mass and muscle sculpture to nose shape.

DRESS TO IMPRESS
As in all fighting sports, it's best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown with style, so gear up - equip a pair of boots, trousers and gloves that fit your style and knock down your opponents with your looks alone.

BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Take on challenging opponents! Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah, he's there. A real stone golem? You bet. Defeat them all and claim their epic gear!

Join the club, create your boxer, and start your boxing career. Get ready to punch, and punch hard! Discover what you’re made of, and climb to the top!

70070000038899.name: Pixie Plates: Royal Edition
70070000038899.intro: A magical cooking adventure full of charm and tasty treats!
70070000038899.description:
Whisk up delicious dishes, slide them onto a plate, add the perfect toppings, and serve them to a parade of adorable fantasy customers!

Prepare delightful food and drinks, from decorated pastries and lovely desserts to warm soups, colorful refreshments, and other tasty specialties. Every order needs the right ingredients and finishing touches before it is ready for your magical guests.

Things can get wonderfully busy in the kitchen! Watch your cooking stations carefully, keep drinks from spilling over, and make smart use of every plate as new customers arrive with fresh requests. Leave food cooking for too long or let a drink overflow, and you will have to toss it in the bin and start again. With more hungry customers arriving and several orders waiting at once, there is always something exciting happening behind the counter!

Journey across 4 enchanting worlds, with 10 levels in each one. Every world brings its own atmosphere, charming customers, and themed dishes and drinks to discover!

Features:
- Prepare and serve a delicious variety of fantasy-inspired food and drinks
- Explore all 4 unique worlds!
- Create every order step by step by cooking, plating, and adding toppings
- Meet adorable customers including pixies, frogs, and other whimsical creatures
- Play through 40 delightful levels!
- Keep your kitchen running smoothly while managing plates and multiple orders
- Immerse yourself in a bright and whimsical fairy-tale setting

A world of sweet creations and enchanting customers is always ready for the next order!

70070000038901.name: Hex Park - Master Bundle
70070000038901.intro:
One bundle. Endless brainteasers.
Master every puzzle in Hex Park
with the complete game and DLC.
70070000038901.description:
Welcome to Hex Park – Master Bundle, the complete puzzle experience that includes both the Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Master DLC.

Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, trigger satisfying chain reactions, clear obstacles, and solve each board in as few moves as possible. Easy to learn yet delightfully challenging to master, Hex Park offers relaxing, strategic gameplay that's impossible to put down.

The base game introduces a colorful world of handcrafted puzzles featuring clever mechanics like keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Once you've mastered those challenges, continue your journey with Hex Park: Master DLC, adding 75 brand-new handcrafted levels designed to test your planning, precision, and puzzle-solving skills with even more intricate layouts and clever combinations of mechanics.

Need a little help? Handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill can get you unstuck without taking away the satisfaction of solving each puzzle. With no timers and no pressure, you can enjoy every challenge at your own pace.

Why you'll love Hex Park – Master Bundle:

• Includes the complete Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Master DLC
• 75 additional handcrafted Master DLC levels
• Clever mechanics including keys, locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more
• Strategic gameplay that's easy to learn and rewarding to master
• Helpful tools that keep the challenge fair and fun
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers or pressure
• Achievements and cloud save support

Whether you're discovering Hex Park for the first time or looking to conquer every challenge, Hex Park – Master Bundle is the definitive way to experience the complete Hex Park adventure.

70070000038911.name: OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter: Battlefront
70070000038911.intro: Prepare for victory before the first shot is fired.
70070000038911.description:
Enter the battlefield with immersive bodycam action, realistic tactical gameplay, and even more ways to personalize your operator. Complete intense combat missions, master authentic weapon handling, coordinate with your team, and customize your appearance with a collection of new tactical skins.

Bundle Features:
1. OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter
Experience realistic first-person combat through an immersive bodycam perspective. Fight in intense multiplayer battles, use advanced tactical equipment, master authentic weapon mechanics, and customize your operator as you complete challenging missions across dynamic battlefields.

2. OpsCam - Body Cam Shooter: Urban Camo
Adds 11 new skins, giving you more ways to customize your operator and create a unique appearance for every mission. Refresh your loadout with new cosmetic options and stand out during every deployment.

Gear up, personalize your operator, and take on every mission with confidence and style.

70070000038920.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Tactical Commander
70070000038920.intro: Humanity’s survival depends on who you let through.
70070000038920.description:
The world is on the brink of collapse, and you are the final line of defense. Step into the boots of a border checkpoint commander and decide who enters, who is quarantined, and who must be eliminated, backed by enhanced technology and a spectacular visual backdrop.

Bundle Includes:
• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
Manage scarce resources, inspect complex documentation, and use military-grade gear to process crowds. You must balance speed with extreme caution—letting a single infected individual pass means instant chaos.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Infection Detection
This DLC upgrades your standard temperature scanner with a high-contrast purple-pink thermal glow. It allows you to scan travelers faster, spot hidden fevers instantly, and detect subtle, early-stage symptoms that the naked eye would miss.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Visual Horizon
This DLC replaces the standard, repetitive skybox with a dynamic, beautifully eerie new horizon. The shifting clouds and ominous lighting react to the grim reality of the border, turning every critical choice into a cinematic moment.

Equip your checkpoint with the best tools, change your view, and see how long you can survive the outbreak!

70070000038928.name: nOS new Operating System Extended Edition
70070000038928.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000038928.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here! 

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes the Screensaver Clock, Icon Themes, Long Cat, Sudoku, Wallpapers Pack 1, and Wallpapers Pack 2 DLCs.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game

70070000038932.name: Run Sausage Run!: Emerald Edition
70070000038932.intro: The most exciting sausage race in the world! Let the bodies hit the floor in a ketchup bath!
70070000038932.description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

This edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels and tasty powerups
- fresh sausage pack of 12 new skins (Angler, Country Girl, Hunter, Beekeeper, Firefly, Toxic, Painter, Policeman, Prisoner, Caveman, Teacher, Witch)

Choose your sausage and run for your life! This race is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

70070000038941.name: Tangram Collection Season 4
70070000038941.description: Tangram Collection + Gem Puzzle Pack + F Shape Puzzle Pack + Other T Puzzle Pack + Tangram Collection Heart

70070000038946.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival – Into the Wild
70070000038946.intro: Build your shelter, master the wilderness, and survive.
70070000038946.description:
Explore the wild, gather resources, and create your own path through a dangerous open-world wilderness. Master survival skills, build your shelter, craft essential equipment, and adapt to the challenges of nature while gaining access to a useful new tool for your journey.

Bundle Includes:
- Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival (Full Game)
Survive in a vast wilderness filled with exploration, danger, and opportunities. Gather resources, hunt, fish, craft tools, build shelters, and develop your skills as you create your own haven in the heart of nature.

- Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival – Shelter Builder
Adds the Hammer directly to your inventory, providing immediate access to a useful tool for construction and crafting. Improve your building experience and continue expanding your survival base with greater efficiency.

Gather, craft, build, and overcome every challenge as you shape your own future in the wilderness.

70070000038949.name: Stuff It! Special Edition
70070000038949.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000038949.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!

This bundle includes the Kids' Playground, Livingroom Chaos, Sweet Tooth, Sports Mania, Garden Clear-out, and Fruits DLCs.

What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?

70070000038951.name: My Cozy Room Special Edition
70070000038951.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000038951.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes various My Cozy Room DLCs, featuring wallpaper collections, floor designs, themed decoration packs, and additional room customization content.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000038955.name: Cash Guardian: Collector Operation “Capital Defense” – Armored Duty
70070000038955.intro: Drive, defend, and succeed in high-risk operations.
70070000038955.description:
Step into the dangerous world of armored cash transportation and take on the responsibility of protecting valuable cargo across a busy metropolis. Complete high-risk missions, navigate challenging routes, defend against threats, and build your reputation as a professional collector with additional resources to support your operations.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Cash Guardian: Collector Operation “Capital Defense” (Base Game)
Become an armored car collector and take on intense missions transporting money, gold, and precious valuables through a dangerous city environment. Drive armored vehicles, choose your collector, use defensive equipment, and complete challenging operations where every decision matters.

2. Cash Guardian: Collector Operation “Capital Defense” – Extra Capital (DLC)
Adds 50,000 to your in-game balance, providing additional resources to improve your operations, upgrade your equipment, and prepare for more demanding collection missions.

Protect the cargo, overcome every threat, and become the ultimate guardian of the city’s most valuable transports.

70070000038957.name: Cottonville Extended Edition
70070000038957.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000038957.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes the High Couture Outfits Pack, Holidays Outfits Pack, Japan 90s Outfits Pack, Love Outfits Pack, Pistachio Room, and Cotton Candy Room DLCs.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000038958.name: Make It Cozy! Summer Pack
70070000038958.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70070000038958.description:
Welcome to Make It Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

This bundle includes the Summer Collection DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay

70070000038959.name: Galactic Warfare Collection
70070000038959.intro: Face the ultimate threat in a ruthless shoot ’em up
70070000038959.description:
Space Dragons

Choose your spaceship and defeat the alien threat coming from the Moon. Fight your way through by crushing, smashing, and blowing up hostile aliens that are taking control of powerful Earth weapons and military technology. Find the entity controlling the threat and make it explode in blood.

Space Dragons is a classic horizontal shoot ’em up game where you can choose different ships with unique characteristics and abilities to destroy tons of invading aliens. Throughout the adventure, you will face powerful bosses and explosive enemies. Get upgrades for your ship, weapons, and more to carve your way through the fleshy and bloody path that awaits you in Space Dragons.

Features:

Local multiplayer
11 fun and complete stages
A large arsenal of weapons awaits you in vast scenarios
Cumulative upgrades each time you finish a stage, allowing different combinations
11 epic and frantic boss encounters
Beautiful hand-drawn and animated pixel art characters and environments
Various enemies with different attacks and transformations
Execute enemies and bosses to gain upgrades and score points
Extremely frantic and explosive gameplay
Each boss has a transformation

Red Titans

RED TITANS is a single-player vertical shoot ’em up. You must put an end to the threat by creating a strategy with the available resources. You will need great skill since there are no continues, although you will be able to recover lives at certain moments.

You are the best pilot, a survivor. This is your last mission and everything will be decided. But in the middle of the mission, strange ships appear. A greater threat has arrived and the conflict begins to change course. You are no longer fighting for a nation; this is the beginning of something much bigger, and you are the first line of defense without even knowing it.

FEATURES:

6 frantic stages
5 epic bosses at the end of each stage
Beautiful hand-drawn pixel art environments
Retro 3:4 resolution (vertical shoot ’em up)
A challenging path with no continues

70070000038975.name: Deadliest Catch - Ocean Boat Driving & Fishing 2022 Simulator: Deep Waters
70070000038975.intro: Conquer the ocean and build your fishing legacy.
70070000038975.description:
Take on the harsh waters of the Bering Sea and experience the challenges of professional crab fishing. Navigate unpredictable storms, manage your equipment, search for valuable catches, and build your reputation as a skilled captain while expanding your fleet with a powerful new ship.
Bundle Includes:

  Deadliest Catch - Ocean Boat Driving & Fishing 2022 Simulator
Step into the role of a crab catcher and captain your own fishing vessel across the dangerous waters of Alaska. Operate realistic onboard equipment, search for crab-rich areas, manage fishing quotas, and face the challenges of the sea as you work to become the best in the industry.

  Deadliest Catch - Ocean Boat Driving & Fishing 2022 Simulator: Sea Vessel
Adds the Meteor MKII ship to your fleet, providing a powerful new vessel for your fishing expeditions. If the ship has already been purchased, you will receive 200,000 in-game currency as compensation.

Set sail, overcome the toughest conditions, and build your legacy as a legendary crab catcher.

70070000038988.name: The Treflik Family Legendary Edition
70070000038988.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000038988.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes the following episodes: Cure for Treflinka, New Neighbour, A House Within A House, Happy Family, A Visit, and Treflik Is King.

70070000038997.name: Ecchi Numbers: Fourth Edition
70070000038997.intro: Fill her grid and reveal the picture.
70070000038997.description:
Think you’ve got the skills to go all the way? Fill in the right positions and slowly clear away the puzzle—revealing more than just your brainpower.

Every number brings you closer to the full picture. Get it right, and you’ll uncover a beautiful picture waiting just beneath the surface... but one wrong move and you might just ruin the mood.

Features:
- 52 beautiful girls looking for company
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Take your time, plan your moves, and finish strong.

70070000039020.name: Cloverpit Unholy Edition Bundle
70070000039020.description:
CloverPit: Unholy Edition bundles the base game and all its updates with the DLC Unholy Fusion, which introduces - among other additions  - the powerful Surgery Machine, a grotesque device that lets you fuse charms into a single, more powerful one.

About CloverPit:

CloverPit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!

Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.

About Unholy Fusion DLC:

CloverPit drags players back into their cell with its first expansion DLC, Unholy Fusion. Exploit the grotesque Surgery Machine to fuse charms into more powerful ones. Discover 30 unique charm fusions and push your builds further with new memory cards, synergies, modifiers, and abilities - and break the game all over again.

70070000039042.name: Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre – Wild Arsenal
70070000039042.intro: Master your aim and conquer every showdown.
70070000039042.description:
Step into the unforgiving Wild West, where every duel is a test of skill, courage, and lightning-fast reflexes. Hunt dangerous outlaws, earn bounty rewards, explore lively frontier towns, and build the ultimate arsenal as you fight your way toward legendary status.

This bundle includes:
• Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre
Become a fearless gunslinger, engage in intense duels, explore the frontier, earn bounties, upgrade your weapons, and prove you’re the fastest shot in the West.
• Cowboy Duel: Red Wild West Massacre – Frontier Revolver
Strengthen your arsenal with Pistol #6. If you already own this weapon, you’ll automatically receive a refund of $1,160 in in-game currency instead.

Draw faster, shoot straighter, and carve your name into Wild West history with every showdown.

70070000039060.name: Cozy Tiny Home Capibara Collection
70070000039060.intro: Welcome to Cozy Tiny Home, a warm and heart-melting decorating game where you can design the most adorable spaces imaginable - and fill them with sweet animal friends!
70070000039060.description:
Step into a pastel paradise where creativity meets comfort. In Cozy Tiny Home, every item tells a story - from soft cushions and glowing lamps to shelves packed with memories. Whether you’re decorating a snug study, a sunny living room, or a peaceful bedroom, each space becomes your own cozy retreat filled with charm, color, and serenity.


Relax and express yourself through endless decorating possibilities. Combine cute furniture, cheerful plants, and playful accessories to make your dream home come alive with warmth and personality. With cuddly cats, curious bunnies, and plenty of smiles, every moment feels like a cozy hug!

This bundle includes the Capibara Pack DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Build and decorate your own cozy rooms in a cute, pastel world
- Invite adorable cats, bunnies, and other fluffy friends to share your space
- Hundreds of lovely furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to mix and match
- Soft, relaxing music and soothing atmosphere for pure comfort
- Endless creativity — design your dream home your way
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, and relaxing design games

70070000039064.name: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Patrol & Pursuit
70070000039064.intro: Patrol smarter, inspect deeper, and enforce the law.
70070000039064.description:
Take command of the border in the most complete law enforcement experience, where every inspection, pursuit, and decision can determine the fate of your checkpoint. Search vehicles for hidden contraband, verify documents, track down smugglers, and protect the frontier in a realistic border control simulation.

Bundle Contents:
1. Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024 – Patrol the border, inspect vehicles, verify documents, uncover smuggling operations, and enforce the law across a dynamic and realistic frontier.

2. Red Camo Ops (DLC) – Customize your equipment with an exclusive red camouflage knife skin designed for officers on the frontline.

3. Frontier Skies (DLC) – Transform the visual atmosphere of the border with an enhanced skybox that makes every patrol more immersive.

Face every inspection with confidence, enhance your equipment, and experience the frontier at its best as you defend the border against every threat.

70070000039079.name: Silent Mist: Deep Nightmare
70070000039079.intro: The nightmare is only beginning to unfold around you.
70070000039079.description:
Descend into a haunting world where every step through the fog brings new mysteries, terrifying encounters, and the constant struggle to survive. Explore abandoned locations, uncover the truth behind your forgotten past, evade unseen horrors, and strengthen your chances of survival with improved awareness during every encounter.

Bundle Includes:
1. Silent Mist – Experience a psychological horror adventure filled with shifting environments, dynamic fog, hidden threats, scarce resources, and a gripping mystery that unfolds as you search for the truth.
2. Silent Mist: Survivor’s Armor – Adds an armor indicator, allowing you to monitor your current protection and stay better prepared as you face the dangers lurking within the mist.

Uncover the secrets hidden beyond the fog, stay prepared for every encounter, and fight to survive until the very end.

70070000039091.name: Soapy Tales Ultimate Edition
70070000039091.intro: What if your story started in the afterlife?
70070000039091.description:
Suddenly, you wake up as a ghost, with no memories. Your good and bad deed count is perfectly even, so you need to go back to Earth to earn your redemption. 
Rediscover your past life and relive touching memories while attending to family business.

Soapy Tales combines doing relaxing chores with elements of time and space management. Complete the tasks, upgrade your skills, and unveil the story of your life in the midst of pastel, soapy bubbles!

This bundle includes the following DLCs: Cloud Baby Blue, Mint And Chocolate Bars, Teddy Bear And Honey, and Rainbow Lady Birds.

KEY FEATURES: 
- First-person point of view gameplay. 
- Cozy, nostalgic atmosphere.
- Relaxing music. 
- Skill tree and artifacts to unlock.

70070000039092.name: Additional Puzzle Pack Set Vol.24
70070000039092.description:
This special set includes all four titles from the twenty-fourth additional puzzle pack for "Jigsaw Masterpieces 2". The set includes the following titles:
- Beautiful Old Towns
- Colorful Japanese Icons
- Radiant Floral Arrangements
- [Moving] Nature's Palette

70070000039095.name: Speedway Turbo: Car Racing Challenge – Winning Line
70070000039095.intro: Build your dream garage and race toward victory.
70070000039095.description:
Experience the thrill of high-speed stock car racing and build your path to championship success with additional resources to accelerate your career. Race across detailed tracks, master realistic driving mechanics, customize your vehicles, and strengthen your garage as you compete for victory.

Bundle Includes:
1. Speedway Turbo: Car Racing Challenge 
Take part in an exciting single-player racing experience featuring licensed tracks, realistic physics, a rewarding career mode, and a wide selection of customizable vehicles. Improve your driving skills, outpace your rivals, and climb the ranks on your way to becoming a racing champion.

2. Speedway Turbo: Car Racing Challenge – Racing Capital (DLC)
Adds 135,000 to your in-game balance, providing additional resources to purchase new vehicles, upgrade your garage, and prepare for even more demanding races.

Expand your garage, invest in your racing future, and compete for victory on every track.

70070000039103.name: Cooking Gold Edition
70070000039103.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000039103.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

This bundle includes the following DLCs: Green Dragon Set, Animal Set, Japanese Set, Floral Set, Cooking: Viva la Pizza!, and Green Zen Set.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out 
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000039104.name: Mini Market Design Design Den
70070000039104.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000039104.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the following DLCs: Furniture Material Collection 1, Furniture Material Collection 2, Furniture Material Collection 3, School, and Cinema.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000039116.name: Noir Mafia Simulator: 1960s American Crime – Dark Empire
70070000039116.intro: Build your criminal empire and stay ahead of the law.
70070000039116.description:
Enter the dangerous world of organized crime in 1960s America, where every heist demands careful planning, quick thinking, and flawless execution. Infiltrate banks, museums, police stations, and mafia hideouts using stealth or overwhelming force, negotiate with hostages, evade relentless police pursuits, and build your reputation as one of the city’s most feared criminals.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Noir Mafia Simulator: 1960s American Crime 
Plan and execute thrilling heists across multiple locations, choose your own approach, and survive in an authentic 1960s criminal underworld.

2. Noir Mafia Simulator: 1960s American Crime – Endless Pursuit
Increase your stamina by 5x, allowing longer sprints, smoother escapes, and greater freedom during every mission.

Plan the perfect robbery, outsmart the authorities, and use your enhanced endurance to escape with the loot before the city closes in.

70070000039120.name: Formula Legends & Formula e Bundle
70070000039120.intro: Get Formula Legends and the official Formula E: Electric Evolution DLC in one bundle—featuring authentic electric motorsport racing and high-speed open-wheel competition.
70070000039120.description:
Discover the ultimate evolution of open-wheel racing with the Formula Legends: Electric Evolution Bundle, including Formula Legends and the official Formula E: Electric Evolution DLC.

Experience high-speed competition in Formula Legends, then step into the future of motorsport with Formula E: Electric Evolution, featuring officially licensed Formula E racing, advanced electric performance, and new racing challenges.

This bundle includes both the base game and DLC for the complete Formula Legends experience.

70070000039131.name: The Wandering Village: Onbu Edition
70070000039131.intro: The Wandering Village is a city-building simulation game on the back of a giant, wandering creature. Build your settlement and form a symbiotic relationship with the colossus. Will you survive
70070000039131.description:
In a world where mysterious plants are spreading all over the earth, emitting toxic spores as they grow, a small group of survivors seeks shelter on the back of a giant, wandering creature they call 'Onbu'.
Become their leader, build their settlement and form a symbiotic relationship with Onbu to survive together in this hostile, yet beautiful post-apocalyptic world.

Build your village
A functioning village is the basis of your survival. Build your settlement and expand it over Onbu’s back. Plan production chains and optimise them to utilise the limited space as efficiently as possible. Create a society that can overcome any challenge.

Live on the creature’s back
Living on the back of another organism comes with its own set of challenges. Will you live in symbiosis, bond with Onbu and survive on mutual trust? Or will you become a parasite, only aiming to ensure a better life for your villagers? The choice is yours.

Discover different biomes
Continuously adapt your village as you travel through a multitude of different biomes, each with its unique climate zones, opportunities and threats. Scout your environments and send out foraging missions to gather rare resources and ancient artefacts. 

Research new technologies
Remnants of the old world hold knowledge that has long been forgotten, but can be unearthed by your villagers. Find and research these technologies, but use them wisely, as progress can be a double-edged sword.

Survive the wastelands
Ensure the survival of both your villagers and your Onbu, even though poisonous spores, merciless weather, bloodsucking parasites and many more challenges mean that the odds are often stacked against you.

Embark on an adventure with five exciting new looks for your Onbu.
The Onbu Skin Pack contains the following new skins:
- Azurda, the Cold Fire
- Aloba, Desert Sovereign
- Kizu, the Golden
- Makthaja of the Jungle
- Ourodon, the Amphibian
Skins only affect visual appearance and have no impact on gameplay.

70070000039140.name: Ashwood Valley Extended Edition
70070000039140.intro: A magical sibling, a fluffy curse, and a valley full of curious creatures to befriend.
70070000039140.description:
Your sibling is a cat now. Time to fix that.

In Ashwood Valley, you’ll step into the shoes of either Luna or Draco – two magical siblings whose spell-casting mishap opens a portal to a vibrant world… and turns one of them into a cat. Now, it’s up to you to restore a ruined cottage, befriend quirky creatures, and uncover the secrets of the enchanted valley to break the curse.


Grow magical plants, explore changing seasons, complete odd quests for chocolate-loving mayors or cheese-obsessed dwarves, and pet all the wild animals you can find – even the strawberry cows!


With cozy farming, whimsical characters, and hand-animated pixel art, Ashwood Valley is a charming adventure about family, friendship, and a lot of fluff.

This bundle includes the following DLCs: Cozy Comforts Style, Sunny Summer Style, Draco's Nook, Luna's Nook, Seaside Stories, Aqua Nook, and Mystic Nook.

Key Features
