- Farming with a magical twist: Grow seasonal crops, forage for rare ingredients like cinnamon, and tend a garden that changes with the seasons.
- Befriend and transform animals: Pet, feed, and discover hidden forms like mushroom chickens or beetroot cows.
- Choose your hero: Play as Draco or Luna, and try to reverse the feline curse on your sibling.
- Restore and decorate: Fix up your cozy cottage, clear out cobwebs, patch the floor, and make it feel like home again.
- Quirky characters and cozy quests: Help unique NPCs like Olaf the sailor-fisherman and Emma the chocoholic mayor with their oddball tasks.
- A living valley across seasons: Explore a colorful pixel-art world that transforms with spring blossoms, autumn leaves, and snowy winters.

70070000039150.name: Bag Fight: Gem Satchel Edition
70070000039150.intro: Pack your bags and power up with 100 Gems!
70070000039150.description:
This deckbuilding roguelite puts inventory management into the heart of every run. Build a backpack full of weapons, armor, and healing items, carefully arranging your gear to create a setup that can carry you through battle after battle.

This bundle includes the Satchel of Gems, which gives you 100 Gems - premium currency you can use to unlock new heroes, purchase chips, skins, and awesome offers in the black market, or gain a powerful edge during battles!

Unlock new gear, strengthen your build, and discover better ways to use your limited space as you progress. Merge weapons to create stronger versions, fine-tune your loadout, and adapt your backpack for every challenge ahead.

Features:
- Inventory Management: Move items around to optimize your build!
- Merging: Combine items into stronger versions!
- Satchel of Gems: Receive 100 Gems to unlock heroes, purchase chips, skins, and black market offers, or gain an edge in battle!
- Unique Characters: Meet a colorful cast of heroes
- Progression: Upgrade your bag and loadout!
- Epic Adventures: Explore diverse fantasy worlds
- Customization: Equip awesome skins for your heroes and items!
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to earn extra resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master!

Your backpack is your build. Make every slot count.

70070000039151.name: Formula Legends Deluxe Edition
70070000039151.intro: The most complete Formula Legends experience yet. Get the base game plus all currently released DLC in one package.
70070000039151.description:
Experience the evolution of Formula racing in one complete package. The Deluxe Edition includes the full Formula Legends base game along with all currently released DLC, expanding your journey across multiple eras of cars and circuits.

Race through iconic track variations, adapt to changing layouts across decades, and take on new challenges inspired by the sport’s rich history. Whether you're chasing leaderboard times or building your career, this is the definitive way to experience Formula Legends today.

This bundle includes:
-Formula Legends (Base Game)
-All currently available DLC packs
-Additional classic tracks and layout variations
-Expanded modes, challenges, and time trials

Note: This bundle includes all content released at this time. Additional DLC may be released separately in the future.

70070000039161.name: Cozy Bundle: 450+ Coloring Pages & Goodies + All Stickers, Palettes & Whiteboards
70070000039161.description:
If you want the full cozy library in one place, the Cozy Bundle unlocks everything — so you can move from quick, easy doodle pages to mindful mandalas, from cute everyday scenes to blocky 3D voxel models, whenever the mood strikes.

What’s inside:

* 450+ coloring pages
* 33 themed collections
* 40 voxel 3D models to color
* All sticker packs (110 stickers total)
* All palettes (192 colors total)
* 20 whiteboards for drawing freely (quick doodles, sketches, and calm creative play)

Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
* Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
* Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages. 

Cozy Pages is your pocket of calm: cute, cozy and always ready when you need a little break.

70070000039173.name: Pawbay: Proud Parents
70070000039173.intro: Be the cat your parents hoped for!
70070000039173.description:
A cat's life
Explore Pawbay by taking on important feline duties, from mail delivery to catching pigeons, as you impress (or infuriate!) the town's citizens. Dress up your cat, explore the town and adventure alone or in local co-op. 

Cat parkour!
Climb onto rooftops, jump between clotheslines and find hidden shortcuts using simple controls and forgiving movement that keeps the adventure accessible for everyone.

Now dressed for the job
Dress up by combining fur patterns with unlockable hats and face accessories. Whether you put on a police cap or a chef's hat, the town will get to see you're a mature cat!

A busy schedule!
How much work is in a cat's day? Steal fish, find the most luxurious furniture to scratch, and show off in cat races, as you discover ways to impress the locals and keep up with a feline's busy life!
• Explore a lively town, getting in the way of or assisting its citizens
• Dress up by combining fur patterns with unlockable hats and face accessories
• Work alone or add an extra set of paws in local co-op
• Explore the town freely or try to complete the challenge list for each area!

70070000039185.name: Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter: Bonebreaker
70070000039185.intro: More weapons, more chaos, more ragdoll fun.
70070000039185.description:
Enter a world of unpredictable chaos, where every battle turns into a hilarious physics-driven spectacle. Face endless waves of creepy mannequins, experiment with different weapons, and survive the most ridiculous encounters filled with wild reactions and unexpected moments.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter 
Blast through endless mannequin waves, enjoy hilarious ragdoll physics, customize your arsenal, and create unforgettable moments of destruction.

2. Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter: Edge of Chaos
Replace the default baseball bat with a powerful axe, giving your melee combat a fresh style and a stronger impact with every swing.

Jump into the chaos, upgrade your equipment, and experience even more ridiculous battles as you take on waves of unpredictable mannequins.

70070000039189.name: Coloring Book: Gold Edition
70070000039189.intro: Create the most impressive coloring book, alone or together with up to 4 artists!
70070000039189.description:
BRING YOUR CREATIVITY TO LIFE
Choose a picture, pick your favorite colors from the palette, and start creating! Coloring Book: Gold Edition combines the base game with two additional content packs, giving you even more drawings, themes, and creative possibilities.

Explore a wide variety of fun pictures, experiment with different tools, or use a blank canvas to create something completely original. Color on your own or invite family and friends to join you. Up to 4 players can work on the same picture at the same time, making it a great choice for creative play together.

DRESS UP FOR A COLORFUL PARTY
Discover exciting pictures filled with costumes and fantastic characters. Color brave pirates, cowboys, firefighters, police officers, princesses, knights, elves, and many more. Try different color combinations and design the perfect outfit for every celebration.

EXPLORE A UNIVERSE OF COLORS
Set off on a creative journey through space. Bring planets, spaceships, aliens, and unusual cosmic adventures to life with your digital brushes. Meet funny characters, discover imaginative worlds, and create your own colorful version of the universe.

Whether you want to create colorful masterpieces, spend time with your family, or simply relax after a busy day, Coloring Book: Gold Edition lets you enjoy creativity at your own pace.

Features:
- 120 pictures to color across a wide variety of themes
- Blank canvas for your own creations
- A palette of 130 colors
- 9 useful coloring and drawing tools
- A special brush that keeps colors inside the outlines
- Local multiplayer for up to 4 players
- Touch screen and Joy-Con™ controller support
- An album for saving and viewing your creations

Perfect for children, families, and adults looking for a relaxing creative activity.

70070000039204.name: Spy Guy Hidden Objects Back to School
70070000039204.intro: Get ready for an exciting adventure that combines fun, learning, and sharp observation skills!
70070000039204.description:
Explore beautifully illustrated worlds inspired by fantasy lands and famous European destinations while searching for over 800 hidden objects. Every colorful scene is packed with surprises, encouraging players to stay focused, think logically, and pay attention to the smallest details.

Whether you're discovering ancient landmarks, wandering through magical realms, or enjoying a family gaming session, every level offers a rewarding mix of entertainment and education.

Features:

-Over 800 hidden objects to discover
-Beautiful hand-crafted, colorful locations
-Encourages observation, concentration, and logical thinking
-Explore fantasy worlds and iconic European destinations
-Perfect for players of all ages and family-friendly gameplay

Learn while you play and make every adventure a new discovery with the Back to School Bundle!

70070000039205.name: The Smurfs Whiteboard Pack
70070000039205.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000039205.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 11 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000039206.name: Who tells your story Detective Bundle
70070000039206.intro: Even more ways to create stories!
70070000039206.description:
Unfinished stories call for more adventures and fun! Let your imagination run wild with new inspirations, characters, and events!
Tell your story with an additional set of detective-themed pictograms!

70070000039212.name: 4 Action Hits Collection
70070000039212.intro: Four action hits - one massive dose of action!
70070000039212.description:
Get ready for four action-packed games where every battle plays by different rules! Build powerful defenses, master your backpack, unleash devastating fireballs and survive relentless hordes of monsters.

FORTRESS MERGE
Build, merge, and defend your fortress against waves of dangerous enemies. Place units, turrets, barricades, and heroes, strengthen your defenses, and adapt your strategy to survive increasingly challenging battles.

The included Claire Pack DLC adds the playable hero Claire and a permanent x2 Game Speed option!

BAG FIGHT
Turn your backpack into the ultimate battle setup! Collect weapons, armor, and useful items, arrange them carefully, merge gear into stronger versions, and create powerful builds to overcome every challenge.

With the included Newman Pack DLC, you can play as Newman. Use his unique Blaster, take advantage of his special passive ability, and speed things up with x2 Game Speed!

THE LEGEND OF FIREBALL
Train your fireball skills and blast your way through everything in your path. Upgrade your stats, collect powerful fireballs, costumes, relics, and pets, and take on increasingly massive targets on your journey to legendary mastery.

The included Rath DLC expands your pet collection with a powerful Alpha Pet from the Dark Family!

MONSTER SURVIVORS
Face endless waves of terrifying creatures and fight to stay alive. Upgrade your survivors, unlock devastating abilities, collect powerful artifacts, and challenge massive bosses as every run pushes you further into the monster-filled apocalypse.

Four different games, four different ways to battle - choose your challenge and jump into the action!

70070000039214.name: Splash of Color: Lagoon Edition
70070000039214.intro: Fill the world with color one puzzle at time!
70070000039214.description:
Piece together bright, colorful images by swapping tiles and solving lively puzzles. Watch patterns shift, colors click into place, and pictures slowly reveal themselves as you play. Jump in, make a few swaps, and watch the colors come together.

Features:
- 48 puzzles big and small for you to solve
- Simple and satisfying swap puzzle mechanics.
- A lively and colorful aesthetic!

Watch the colors fall into place!

70070000039227.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Infection Control
70070000039227.intro: Survival depends on every choice you make.
70070000039227.description:
Enter a world consumed by a dangerous outbreak, where every decision at the quarantine border can determine the survival of an entire region. As the last line of defense, inspect survivors, identify infected individuals, manage quarantine zones, and respond to sudden zombie threats while working under constant pressure.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Control the quarantine zone, inspect incoming survivors, make critical decisions, and defend humanity against the spread of infection.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Elite Skins
Give soldiers and scientists a renewed visual identity with upgraded appearances that enhance the atmosphere of the outbreak.

3. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Frontline Gear
Customize your guard’s equipment and refresh your view with a new hand and gear skin for every mission.

Protect the border, manage the crisis, and face the outbreak with enhanced style as you fight to keep the last safe zone alive.

70070000039235.name: Wukong Black Legend: Dragon Soul
70070000039235.intro: Fight, explore, and become the hero of your own legend.
70070000039235.description:
Enter a world of hidden secrets, dangerous enemies, and challenging puzzles where every step tests your courage and determination. Master dynamic combat, uncover forgotten mysteries, explore ancient locations, and enhance your journey with a striking new appearance that sets your hero apart.

What the content includes:
Wukong Black Legend
Explore mysterious environments, solve clever puzzles, engage in fast-paced sword and bow combat, uncover hidden treasures, and overcome dangerous enemies on your path to becoming a legend.

Wukong Black Legend: Warrior Skin
Transform your hero with a redesigned appearance featuring a bold red-themed outfit and a unique back tattoo, giving every battle and every adventure a distinctive new style.

Uncover every secret, embrace your new identity, and forge your legend through every challenge that lies ahead.

70070000039237.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps: Deluxe Edition
70070000039237.intro: Explore Bluey's world like never before!
70070000039237.description:
"Here Come the Grannies" bonus digital content
Janet and Rita are back -- and this time they've got wheels. Watch out, young'uns, the grannies are on the move!

More Dress-Ups!
New outfits for Bluey and Bingo to try on.

Digital Art Book:
Exclusive artwork and concept art from the making of Bluey's Happy Snaps

Explore Bluey's world like never before!
Play, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for Real Life.

Say Cheese!
Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Travel around Bluey's hometown of Brisbane as you snap photos of the games you play, chase bin chickens and uncover hidden surprises. Each snapshot is saved to your own scrapbook, where you can keep your best moments.

Fun for Everyone
A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose, while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. Hang out with Muffin, Chloe, Winton and more of Bluey's friends wherever you go, play with loads of toys and jump into games from the show, like Shadowlands and Magic Cauldron. 

Play for Real Life
Packed with tips that turn game time into play for Real Life time! Find new ways to play with everyday things in the world around you, turning cushion forts and cardboard boxes into the next big adventure. Explore, play and discover in the game, then take it off the screen and keep the fun going.

Snap, Capture, and Collect
Build your scrapbook one snap at a time. Every photo unlocks stickers inspired by the friends, wildlife, and games you come across. Arrange these stickers, paint them however you like, and dress up Bluey and Bingo with costumes you unlock along the way.

70070000039241.name: Neko Bento Superb Edition
70070000039241.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000039241.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes the New Levels 1, New Levels 2, New Levels 3, Homes Pack, Backgrounds Pack, and Boxes Pack DLCs.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000039243.name: Memory For Kids Paws & Pals Edition
70070000039243.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000039243.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes the Cards Pack 3 DLC.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels

70070000039244.name: Clay&Cats Special Edition
70070000039244.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000039244.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed. 

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that! 

This bundle includes the Watering Can and Tray DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each 
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire

70070000039246.name: nGolf Competitive Golfist Edition
70070000039246.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000039246.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes the Colorful Golf Balls 1, Colorful Golf Balls 2, Colorful Golf Balls 3, Colorful Golf Balls 4, Colorful Golf Balls 5, Colorful Golf Balls 6, Colorful Golf Balls 7, Colorful Golf Balls 8, Moon Swing, and Western Fairways DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000039247.name: Cook For Love Special Edition
70070000039247.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000039247.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes the Powder Red Blender, Colorful Stove, Wooden Fridge, Lyon, and Provence DLCs.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000039248.name: Cowboys vs Zombies GOLD EDITION
70070000039248.intro: Run fast, shoot faster, survive longer!
70070000039248.description:
Step into a brutal overrun by the undead in Cowboys vs Zombies, a fast-paced roguelike action experience where survival depends on your skill, strategy, and firepower. 

Every run is a new challenge. Combine abilities, upgrade your gear, and choose loyal pets to support you in battle, each bringing their own unique strengths to the fight. Face dangerous elites and powerful bosses that will push your reflexes and tactics to the limit as you carve your path through the apocalypse.

This bundle includes the main title, the Killer Guns DLC, the Gold Rush DLC, and the Western Duo DLC, delivering even more firepower, rewards, and characters to your adventure. Gain access to powerful new weapons to dominate the battlefield, earn a massive coin boost to upgrade your arsenal faster, and recruit two additional cowboys ready to ride into danger. With these additions, you’ll have more ways than ever to customize your playstyle, strengthen your build, and survive the relentless undead threat.

Load your weapons, saddle up, and prove you have what it takes to reclaim the frontier from the dead.

70070000039253.name: Highway Legends GOLD EDITION
70070000039253.description:
Feel the adrenaline of unstoppable speed in Highway Legends, a high-octane driving experience where every road becomes a test of reflexes, control, and courage. Race through breathtaking environments, from dense urban highways to vast open landscapes, dodging traffic and pushing your limits in a constant pursuit of perfection on asphalt.

Customize and upgrade a powerful fleet of high-performance vehicles, each built for speed, style, and precision. Master intense highway runs where every decision matters and every second counts as you carve your path toward becoming a true road legend.

This bundle includes the main title, the Triple Threat on Street DLC, and the Road to Riches DLC, giving you access to three elite high-performance cars and a massive coin boost to accelerate your progression. Expand your garage, enhance your vehicles, and unlock new levels of customization and power to dominate every stretch of road.

Push the pedal to the metal, outdrive the competition, and become the ultimate Highway Legend.

70070000039270.name: BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 - OPS OPERATION
70070000039270.intro: Enter every firefight with a refined tactical edge.
70070000039270.description:
Step into the role of an elite operative and experience modern combat through the immersive perspective of a body camera. Complete high-risk missions, eliminate hostile threats, secure critical objectives, and enhance your loadout with a premium weapon appearance that brings a fresh tactical style to every operation.

Bundle Includes:
- BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025: Experience realistic bodycam gameplay, complete tactical missions, use advanced firearms and equipment, coordinate under pressure, and prove your skills across intense modern combat scenarios.
- BODYCAM SHOOTER 2025 – Tactical Skin: Customize your weapon with a premium new appearance, giving your loadout a distinctive tactical style while preserving its original performance.

Deploy with confidence, personalize your equipment, and dominate every mission!

70070000039274.name: Car Parking Legends DELUXE EDITION
70070000039274.intro: Master the art of perfect parking.
70070000039274.description:
Step into the world of precision driving and creativity in Car Parking Legends, where mastering the art of parking is only the beginning. Explore a rich driving experience filled with detailed car handling, deep customization, and engaging game modes that challenge both your skill and imagination. From tight urban spaces to complex parking scenarios, every challenge pushes you closer to becoming a true parking master.

Customize your vehicles with a wide range of upgrades, visual modifications, and performance tweaks. Personalize your driver with unique outfits and accessories, and choose from a diverse lineup of cars, each offering distinct handling and driving feel. Whether you're progressing through Career Mode, taking on the role of a parking attendant, or freely exploring a lively city, every drive offers something new.

This bundle includes the main title and the Ultimate Riders DLC, introducing two expert drivers with unique skills and fresh challenges designed to test your precision to the limit. Navigate advanced parking zones, overcome new obstacles, and refine your technique with these highly skilled characters by your side.

Park with style, drive with precision, and become a true legend of the lot.

70070000039278.name: Fear or Evil : Nightmare Horror Scary Game Phobia Simulator Hunter Games – Lost Investigation
70070000039278.intro: Explore abandoned places and survive what awaits.
70070000039278.description:
Step into a terrifying mystery where every detail hides a secret and every decision can determine your survival. Explore abandoned locations, investigate strange events, collect clues, and uncover the truth behind the horrors waiting in the darkness.

Bundle Includes:
1.Fear or Evil : Nightmare Horror Scary Game Phobia 2023 Simulator Hunter Games
Experience a story-driven horror investigation where you must explore mysterious locations, analyze clues, and uncover the truth behind a disturbing mystery.

2. Fear or Evil : Nightmare Horror Scary Game Phobia Simulator Hunter Games – Extra Life
Increase your character’s health by 50 HP and gain additional endurance to help you survive longer during your terrifying journey.

Explore carefully, think like an investigator, and face the darkness with enhanced survival as you search for the truth hidden within the nightmare.

70070000039281.name: WEB FISHING – Relax and Fish: Angler’s Journey
70070000039281.intro: Find your perfect catch and enjoy the journey.
70070000039281.description:
Escape to peaceful waters and enjoy a rewarding fishing experience with additional resources to help you progress from the very beginning. Explore scenic locations, discover a wide variety of fish species, upgrade your equipment, and take on relaxing yet rewarding challenges while building your collection of impressive catches.

Bundle Includes:
WEB FISHING – Relax and Fish
Explore beautiful fishing locations, catch unique fish, complete challenges, and upgrade your gear as you become a master angler.

WEB FISHING – Relax and Fish: Golden Catch
Add 10,000 coins to your in-game balance and upgrade your rods, reels, and equipment even faster.

Cast your line, enjoy every peaceful moment on the water, and make every fishing trip even more rewarding with extra coins ready to spend.

70070000039287.name: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Platinum Edition
70070000039287.description:
TMNT: Splintered Fate with 5 DLCs. Brawl through NYC in TMNT: Splintered Fate with 4 playable hero DLCs, the Junkyard level, and Samurai Armor Pack.

This bundle includes:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam DLC
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Metalhead Character DLC
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Alopex Character DLC
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Slash Character DLC
TMNT: Splintered Fate - Samurai Armor Pack

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate
Unleash the Turtles in a roguelike quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam
Casey Jones joins the fight in this fast-paced, action-packed DLC! Battle through the Junkyard, face new enemies and bosses, and collect new powerful artifacts.

Metalhead Character DLC
Play as the loveable, locked and loaded Metalhead! As Splintered Fate's first fully ranged character, he comes with a unique gameplay style to complement the Turtles. Fire his blasters, transform into a spinning missile frenzy, and lob landmines to stop enemies in their tracks. Metalhead has an affinity with our new (free!) Robotics Powers.

Alopex Character DLC
Alopex wields her kama with deadly accuracy and speed while facing her troubled past as Karai's sister-in-arms. Explore 5 new Artifacts while playing through a brand new story line as the mysterious mutant arctic fox.

Slash Character DLC
Add Slash to the lineup– he’s big, he’s powerful, and he…loves candy? Use his claw and sheer strength to take down anyone in the way. Play with 5 new Artifacts while stomping through enemies with this latest playable character in TMNT: Splintered Fate.

Samurai Armor Pack
Samurai armor for TMNT: Splintered Fate playable characters.

70070000039297.name: Paint For Kids Play & Learn Edition
70070000039297.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000039297.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones. 

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the Additional Board 4 DLC.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use

70070000039300.name: TMNT: Splintered Fate and Slash Character DLC
70070000039300.description:
Unleash the Turtles and their friends in a quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan!


In Splintered Fate, brace yourself for fast-paced, roguelike action where no two runs are the same. With randomized power-ups, room layouts, and boss modifiers, the excitement never ends. Take control of all four Turtles, each wielding unique powers, and team up with friends for bodacious co-op gameplay on both Campaign and Arcade modes. Explore iconic NYC locations, upgrade your Turtle powers, and prepare to face off against formidable enemies.


SLASH CHARACTER DLC
 - 5 new artifacts
 - New playable character: Slash


Add Slash to the lineup– he’s big, he’s powerful, and he…loves candy? Use his claw and sheer strength to take down anyone in the way. Play with 5 new Artifacts while stomping through enemies with this latest playable character in TMNT: Splintered Fate.


With thrilling combat and endless challenges, Splintered Fate promises to keep you engaged in the FIGHT, ADAPT, REPEAT portal loop. Be ready to restore peace to the city!

70070000039313.name: Solo Shift! + Late Night Pack Set
70070000039313.intro:
From cash register to fryer—you've got to manage it all!
Take on waves of customers all by yourself!
70070000039313.description:
Run a convenience store solo in this frantic action game!
Dash around the store handling tasks while customers keep pouring in!

Play co-op as a worker and support robot team!
Split up tasks and work together strategically!

"Solo Shift!" and the "Late Night Solo Shift Pack" are now available as a downloadable content bundle!

70070000039326.name: Wrap Shop Simulator: Chef Legend
70070000039326.intro: Create, serve, and grow your ultimate food adventure.
70070000039326.description:
Start your journey as a street chef and experience the excitement of managing your own food truck. Buy ingredients, create delicious recipes, serve customers, upgrade your equipment, and build your reputation as you work toward becoming the best chef in town.

Bundle Includes:
1. Wrap Shop Simulator (Base Game)
Run your own food truck, prepare tasty dishes, manage supplies, satisfy customers, and grow your culinary business from a small kitchen into a successful food empire.

2. Wrap Shop Simulator: Business Boost (DLC)
An additional 1,000 coins are added to your in-game balance, allowing you to purchase ingredients, improve equipment, and unlock new possibilities for your food truck.

Cook, serve, and expand your business with everything you need to create unforgettable meals and become a true culinary legend.

70070000039337.name: Float Survival Simulator - Ocean Survivor: Storm Survivor
70070000039337.intro: Build your raft, conquer the ocean, and survive every wave.
70070000039337.description:
Face the endless ocean with the ultimate survival experience. Gather resources, expand your raft, defend yourself from relentless sharks, explore mysterious islands, and craft everything you need to stay alive.

Bundle Includes:
1. Float Survival Simulator: Ocean Survivor (Base Game) – Collect resources, craft essential tools, build and expand your raft, fish, cook, explore islands, and survive the dangers of the open sea.

2. Building Materials Expansion DLC – Reinforce your raft with stronger building materials designed to improve durability and withstand the harsh conditions of the ocean.

3. Shark Upgrade DLC – Face a completely redesigned shark with a unique new appearance that makes every encounter more immersive and visually intense.

4. Skybox Overhaul DLC – Experience breathtaking new skies with a redesigned skybox that adds atmosphere, depth, and immersion to every journey across the ocean.

Strengthen your raft, embrace the beauty and danger of the open sea, and take on every challenge with enhanced visuals and improved building possibilities.

70070000039348.name: Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat – Survivor
70070000039348.intro: Survive terrifying encounters and reveal forgotten secrets.
70070000039348.description:
Enter the abandoned city of Pripyat as an investigative reporter determined to uncover the truth behind the horrors hidden within the exclusion zone. Search for supplies, battle terrifying mutants, survive deadly encounters, and explore abandoned locations.

This Bundle Includes:
  Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat
Investigate the mysteries of Chernobyl, manage your survival, fight terrifying enemies, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins of Pripyat.

  Chernobyl: Escape from Pripyat – Hands Style
Refresh your first-person experience with a redesigned pair of gloves, bringing a distinctive new visual style to every exploration, investigation, and combat encounter.

Survive the unknown, reveal the truth behind the exclusion zone, and experience every step of your investigation with a renewed tactical appearance.

70070000039358.name: Chained Climb Together: Higher Ground
70070000039358.intro: Rise above the dangers and conquer the world above.
70070000039358.description:
Take on the ultimate climbing challenge and experience a thrilling journey where teamwork, precision, and coordination decide your success. Scale dangerous mountains, overcome difficult obstacles, master chain mechanics, and reach new heights alongside your companions.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Chained Climb Together
Climb massive mountains, navigate challenging terrains, and work together with your companions to overcome obstacles in a unique online cooperative adventure.

2. Chained Climb Together: Skybound Environment (DLC)
Transform the world around you with a redesigned skybox that adds breathtaking views and a new atmosphere to every mountain ascent.

3. Chained Climb Together – Player Reskin (DLC)
Customize your character with a new visual style and stand out as you climb through dangerous landscapes with your team.

4. Chained Climb Together: New Rope (DLC)
Upgrade your climbing experience with a refreshed rope design that adds a new visual appearance and enhances your journey to the summit.

Challenge the heights, strengthen your teamwork, and conquer every mountain with an enhanced climbing experience.

70070000039360.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack
70070000039360.description:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles. 

Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans. 

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition

Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

70070000039378.name: Ecchi Breaker: Action Edition
70070000039378.intro: Break the blocks or break her heart.
70070000039378.description:
Grab your paddle and get ready to aim, bounce, and break your way to a gorgeous reveal. Every hit brings you closer to what’s hidden behind and the satisfaction of a perfect clear has never looked this good.

Keep your focus, control your shots, and watch as the tension builds with every block you destroy. But be careful… miss too many, and the moment might slip away.

Features:
- 66 stunning girls waiting to be revealed
- Sensual music and satisfying effects
- Addictive arcade-style gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Keep your balls in play, and break through to your reward.

70070000039380.name: Family Chess Sky Blue Pack
70070000039380.intro: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.
70070000039380.description:
Pick your favorite

Choose one of the heros and challenge other players in this family-friendly version of Chess. Thanks to the cartoony graphics, this variation can be enyojed by people of all ages.

Hone your skills

If you want to improve on your own, try out one of five difficulty options and play with an NPC. Find your favorite opening and improve with every game. If you are looking for a real challenge try out the expert mode.

This bundle includes the Sky Blue Chessboard DLC.

Key features
- local multiplayer
- family friendly
- balanced gameplay
- charming aesthetic
- invigorating music track

70070000039381.name: nOS new Operating System Wallpapers Collection 3
70070000039381.intro: Engage the newest Nintendo Switch™ experience. Transform your favorite console into an amazing, and surprisingly small personal computer.
70070000039381.description:
A revolution has come!

Enjoy every awesome feature of the nOS. Draw, write, calculate, organize your day and play around at your convenience. All the tools you need are here! 

You have the power

Brighten up your day and customize the nOS to suit your every need. Find your favorite setup and create the fantastic user experience you deserve.

This bundle includes the Wallpapers Pack 3 DLC.

Key features:
- Splendid customization options
- Reliable tools (Notepad, Scetchbook, Day Planner)
- Brilliant design
- A charming puzzle game

70070000039386.name: Gorilla Jungle King Simulator: Jungle Paradise
70070000039386.intro: Explore, survive, and dominate the world of the jungle.
70070000039386.description:
Enter the wild world of Gorilla Jungle King Simulator and experience the journey of becoming the true Alpha. Survive the dangers of the jungle, build your gorilla pack, protect your allies, gather resources, and prove your strength through every challenge.

The Bundle Includes:
1. Gorilla Jungle King Simulator - Lead your gorilla pack through a dangerous jungle, search for resources, defend your territory, face predators and rivals, and rise as the king of the wild.
2. Gorilla Jungle King Simulator: New Skies - Transform the jungle atmosphere with a new green morning skybox, creating a brighter and more immersive environment during your survival journey.

Build your legacy, protect your pack, and experience the jungle kingdom with an enhanced visual atmosphere.

70070000039395.name: Stuff it! Backery Pack
70070000039395.intro: Shove it, stack it, sort it out!
70070000039395.description:
Welcome to a world of crazy organizers, explosive makeup bags, and kitchen shelves barely holding on under the weight of random stuff! In Stuff It, there’s only one rule: everything has to fit... somewhere!


Your mission? To cram the most absurd combinations of items into tight spaces. Hairbrushes, colorful hairdryers, giant ladles, way too many trinkets, and even rubber duckies - all waiting for your master-level packing skills!


Each level throws you into a totally new challenge - bizarre shapes, unruly objects, and sometimes things you don’t even remember ever owning. But don’t panic! Use your superpower of organizing, make some room, and... stuff it!

This bundle includes the Bakery DLC.

What’s in store?
- Over 105 levels of chaos to conquer!
- Special modes (Easy, Medium, Hard) unlocked after completing the game - for those who  love a challenge!
- Dozens of colorful items - from kitchen gear to beauty products!
- Relaxing, feel-good music to help you focus… even when everything is falling out!
- Wacky graphics that bring every drawer item to life!
- Funny effects and reactions - because every win deserves a fanfare (and confetti)!

Don’t ask where that giant spoon came from - just find a spot for it!

Stuff It - because who said cleaning can't be epic?

70070000039396.name: Make It Cozy! Deluxe Edition
70070000039396.intro: Unleash your creativity in a cutest possible way!
70070000039396.description:
Welcome to Make It Cozy!

Create the sweetest little home and share it with the cutest animal friends imaginable!

Step into a charming world filled with soft colors, cozy corners, and adorable companions waiting to move in. Design dreamy bedrooms, sunny living rooms, peaceful reading nooks, relaxing bathrooms, and magical outdoor spaces — then watch them come to life with playful kittens, a curious fox, a cheerful penguin, a tiny hedgehog, and many other fluffy friends.

Every room is a place where memories are made. Arrange comfy furniture, decorate with lovely plants, hang cute decorations, and create warm spaces where your animal companions can feel safe, happy, and loved. Whether you prefer a pastel paradise, a cozy cottage, or something wonderfully unique, your imagination is the only limit.

Relax, decorate, and enjoy the gentle atmosphere as your tiny residents explore the home you've created just for them. Every smile, nap, and playful moment makes your cozy world feel even more magical.

This bundle includes the Cats and Summer Collection DLCs.

KEY FEATURES: 
- Design and decorate adorable cozy homes and beautiful outdoor spaces
- Meet charming animal residents including kittens, foxes, penguins, hedgehogs, bunnies, and more
- Hundreds of cute furniture pieces, plants, and decorations to personalize every room
- Warm pastel visuals and relaxing music that create a peaceful atmosphere
- Endless creative freedom to build your dream cozy retreat
- Watch your lovable animal friends enjoy and explore their new home
- Perfect for players who love cozy vibes, cute animals, creativity, and relaxing gameplay

70070000039398.name: Cottonville Soft Lavender Edition
70070000039398.intro: Watch your beautiful garden grow, dye fabrics, and turn them into beautiful clothing.
70070000039398.description:
Create, farm, and style your way to success in Cottonville!
Welcome to Cottonville – a cozy dress-up and farming sim where creativity blossoms and fashion takes root! Run your own sewing atelier, grow essential crops, and craft stylish outfits for a charming cast of characters.


A Fresh Start in Cottonville
After leaving the hustle of Friglight, you arrive in peaceful Cottonville to take over a small family sewing shop. Start fresh, grow your business, and build a new life—one stitch at a time.


Customize Your Character
Express yourself! Choose from 18 hair colors, 15 hairstyles, and a variety of eye shapes, mouths, lashes, eyebrows, and skin tones. Dress your character in a wide range of outfits that grow with your fashion journey.


From Farming to Fashion
Cultivate cotton, linen, and bamboo—then harvest natural dyes from flowers to create fabrics in 7 vibrant colors. Craft materials, unlock new sewing patterns, and design custom outfits that reflect your unique style.


Run Your Atelier
Take charge of your boutique with over 60 sewing patterns and 120+ total clothing variations. Listen to customer requests, mix and match fabrics, and tailor outfits that reflect their personalities—from winter sweaters to breezy summer styles.

This bundle includes the Lavender Room DLC.

Features:
- 60+ sewing patterns with multiple color variants (120+ total!)
- 3 farmable crops and 7 dye colors to craft your own fabrics
- Fully customizable character with a wide selection of features
- A charming story about starting over and finding creativity in a cozy town
- Unique customers and outfit requests that evolve with your boutique
- Dive into 60+ hours of fashion-filled farming and storytelling!


Grow crops, craft clothes, and chase your fashion dreams—Cottonville awaits you!

70070000039399.name: My Cozy Room Foodie Lover Edition
70070000039399.intro: Create your dream room and make it truly yours
70070000039399.description:
My Cozy Room is a relaxing sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own spaces. Choose from 11 different room shapes and sizes to create unique spaces—your dream bedroom, a cozy living room, a stylish kitchen, or even a playful kids' room. 


With over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, plus more than 30 wallpaper and flooring patterns, you’ll have everything you need to craft the perfect look. Whether you're a kid or just love makeover and sandbox games, My Cozy Room is the ideal place to unleash your creativity and have fun! 

This bundle includes the Fast Food DLC.

Features: 
- 11 unique room shapes and sizes to choose from.
- Over 500 furniture and decoration items to explore.
- 30+ wallpaper and flooring patterns for a personal touch.
- Design spaces like bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.
- Perfect for kids and fans of makeover and sandbox games.
- Relaxing and creative gameplay for all ages.

Start decorating your cozy dream room today!

70070000039403.name: Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery – Highway Driver
70070000039403.intro: Take on every delivery and become the ultimate driver.
70070000039403.description:
Build your trucking career in Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery, where every route brings new challenges across busy city streets and demanding off-road terrain. Complete delivery missions, upgrade your vehicles, and master realistic truck handling as you grow your transport business.

This Bundle Includes:
• Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery
Drive powerful cargo trucks, complete a wide variety of delivery missions, earn rewards, unlock new vehicles, and prove your skills across diverse environments.

• Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery – Urban Makeover
Refresh the appearance of your first truck with a vibrant pink paint design, giving your vehicle a distinctive new style throughout every delivery.

Take on every route, expand your trucking career, and enjoy every mile with a fresh new visual upgrade.

70070000039409.name: Flipper & Unboxing House 2-in-1
70070000039409.description:
Build, renovate, decorate, and organize with the ultimate home design collection.
This bundle includes two games, each offering its own unique take on creating beautiful living spaces.
Restore neglected houses in Fix & Flip Dream House by renovating interiors, choosing new finishes, placing furniture, and transforming outdated properties into stunning modern homes. Then continue your creative journey in Unboxing: Cozy Home Simulator, where you'll unpack belongings, organize every room, and decorate warm, inviting spaces filled with personality and charm.
Whether you enjoy large-scale home renovations or the relaxing satisfaction of organizing and decorating cozy interiors, this bundle offers countless hours of creative gameplay. Design stylish rooms, personalize every detail, and experience two relaxing home-building adventures in one complete collection.

70070000039410.name: Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A Bundle (Game + DLC)
70070000039410.intro: Live the life of a Pokémon Trainer and help protect the peace in Lumiose City!
70070000039410.description:
Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z, and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place.

Catch, battle, and Mega Evolve—all in real time!

Step onto the battlefield and command your Pokémon directly—there are no turns! For the first time in the Pokémon RPG series, Trainers and their Pokémon can both move around in real-time battles, and your Pokémon will unleash their moves when you tell them to.

Harness the power of Mega Evolution! Unleash your Pokémon’s hidden energy to temporarily transform its appearance, enhance its capabilities, and perhaps even change its type. Use this power wisely and try to overcome your toughest challenges, like those posed by the rampaging Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon across Lumiose City.

Compete in the Z-A Royale when night falls—or battle with other players in the Z-A Battle Club

You’re invited to join the Z-A Royale, a competition for Pokémon Trainers to test their skills and determine who’s strongest. Each night, a battle zone for the competition will appear. Prepare yourself by spending the day catching and training Pokémon, then venture into the battle zone to take on other Trainers.

You can also test your skills against friends or Trainers around the world in the Z-A Battle Club. Take on up to three other Trainers at once, locally* or online**, in frenetic real-time battles!

Venture into Hyperspace Lumiose for the next chapter of your adventure!

Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a place known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the Mythical Pokémon Hoopa has the power to transform them into portals so you can travel there! Hoopa needs your help to do it, though: team up with the mysterious and talented baker, Ansha, to gather Berries and make donuts that will awaken Hoopa’s power and grant you and your Pokémon a variety of useful effects.

Once you’re in Hyperspace Lumiose, join the Mega Evolution successor, Korrina, and Team MZ to investigate its mysteries. Just be sure you’re ready—this otherworldly version of Lumiose City can be a threatening place. The Pokémon here are different, and sometimes rare, with hyperspace levels that can make their total levels exceed the normal limit of 100.

It looks like your story with Team MZ isn’t over yet—continue your journey in Hyperspace Lumiose in the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Mega Dimension DLC, after completing the main game!

70070000039411.name: Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Bundle (Game + DLC)
70070000039411.intro: Live the life of a Pokémon Trainer and help protect the peace in Lumiose City—enhanced for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!
70070000039411.description:
Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z, and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place.

And with performance upgrades for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system, you’ll experience Lumiose City like never before: with enhanced resolution and frame rates!

You can also test your skills against friends or Trainers around the world in the Z-A Battle Club. Take on up to three other Trainers at once, locally* or online**, in frenetic real-time battles!

70070000039412.name: Car Sales & Parking Bundle
70070000039412.description:
Build your automotive empire and prove your skills behind the wheel with the ultimate driving and dealership collection.
This bundle includes two games that let you experience both sides of the automotive world. Build a successful car dealership by buying, selling, upgrading, and expanding your business, then put your vehicles to the test in a rewarding parking simulator packed with challenges, customization, and progression.
Grow your showroom, unlock new cars, expand your garage, and master increasingly demanding driving objectives. Whether you're negotiating the perfect deal, customizing your favorite vehicles, or aiming for flawless parking, every achievement brings you one step closer to becoming a true automotive expert.
From running a thriving dealership to perfecting every maneuver, this collection delivers hours of satisfying simulation, progression, and driving fun.

70070000039413.name: Big Survival Collection 3-in-1
70070000039413.intro: Face the unknown, escape the impossible.
70070000039413.description:
Test your instincts across three unique adventures where every decision can mean the difference between survival and failure.

This bundle includes three games, each delivering a different challenge. Escape from a heavily guarded prison using patience and clever planning, survive aboard a crippled ship abandoned after a brutal pirate attack, and investigate a mysterious hospital where reality itself cannot be trusted.

Every experience places you under constant pressure. Search for vital resources, solve environmental challenges, uncover hidden secrets, and make difficult decisions while facing unpredictable dangers. Whether you're managing scarce supplies, plotting the perfect escape, or carefully observing your surroundings for subtle anomalies, success depends on your ability to stay calm, think ahead, and adapt to changing situations.
Blending survival, stealth, exploration, and psychological horror, this collection offers three distinct stories united by one common theme: overcoming impossible odds. Every location presents new threats, every objective demands careful planning, and every victory feels earned.

Do you have what it takes to survive, escape, and uncover the truth?

70070000039464.name: The Treflik Family Girl's Night Edition
70070000039464.intro: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.
70070000039464.description:
Experience the original adventures of the Treflik Family. Get ready for a wholesome journey through childhood. A new Nintendo Switch™ children's show is here!

VALUABLE LIFE LESSONS

Get to know these adorable characters and watch them learn valuable friendship, respect, honesty, and tolerance.

A COLORFUL WORLD

Journey through your favorite adventures of The Treflik Family. Put your spin on these stories through the Coloring Book section and give them your unique look.

This bundle includes the Girl's Night DLC.

70070000039468.name: SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL: Wild Waters
70070000039468.intro: Survive the waves and conquer the endless deep sea.
70070000039468.description:
Enter a dangerous ocean adventure, where every wave brings new threats and every decision can determine your survival. Navigate unpredictable waters, protect your ship from relentless shark attacks, gather resources, and fight to stay afloat in a hostile environment.

This Bundle Includes:
1. SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL
Survive the endless ocean, manage your ship, collect resources, and defend yourself against a massive shark while facing storms, hazards, and unpredictable challenges.
2. SHARK SIEGE - TOGETHER SURVIVAL: Ocean Vessel
Expand your ocean adventure with a brand-new ship, giving you a fresh vessel to explore dangerous waters and continue your battle for survival.

Take on the deep sea, overcome every threat, and experience your survival journey with an upgraded maritime adventure.

70070000039496.name: The Long Desert Drive: Forgotten World
70070000039496.intro: Explore the endless desert and uncover the secrets left behind.
70070000039496.description:
Experience the mystery and challenges of the desert in The Long Desert Drive. Wake up with no answers, rely on your old car, gather resources, and travel through an unpredictable world filled with danger, secrets, and unexpected encounters.

Bundle Includes:
The Long Desert Drive ‒ Explore the vast desert, scavenge for supplies, upgrade your vehicle, and uncover the mystery behind a silent world while fighting to survive every mile.

The Long Desert Drive: Survival Knife ‒ Give your survival knife a fresh new appearance with an updated skin and inventory icon, adding a unique style to one of your most important tools.

Continue your journey through the desert, overcome every challenge, and experience survival with an enhanced visual upgrade.

70070000039517.name: Cup Heroes: Beginner Merge Bundle
70070000039517.intro: Power up your gear and climb the rarity ranks!
70070000039517.description:
Begin your adventure with Cup Heroes and a helpful collection of Coins, Diamonds, Rare Keys, and Epic Keys!

Step into the whimsical world of Cup Heroes, where everyday cups turn into mighty heroes on an epic quest to save their beloved Queen!

How to Play:
- Control Your Heroes: Navigate your heroes through various obstacles and puzzles.
- Save the Queen: Your goal is to rescue the Queen, who has been captured by evil forces.
- Unlock and Upgrade Characters: Collect coins and diamonds to unlock a diverse cast of characters, each with unique abilities. Upgrade their skills to make them even more powerful and adaptable to different challenges.

Features:
- Premium Currency: Use 250 Diamonds to unlock new heroes, purchase keys to open exclusive chests, obtain high-rarity gear, and gain a powerful edge in battle
- Base Currency: Use 1500 Coins to upgrade your gear and permanent stats
- Rare Keys: Open 25 rare crates containing Common, Uncommon, or Rare gear
- Epic Keys: Open 10 epic crates containing Uncommon, Rare, or Epic gear
- Merge Gear: Merge identical items to create stronger versions and unlock new bonuses
- Unique Characters: Meet a colourful cast of cup heroes, from the brave Knight Cup to the cunning Ninja Cup. Each character brings their own special skills and personality to the team
- Epic Adventures: Explore various enchanting worlds, from mystical forests to fiery volcanoes. Every level is a new adventure filled with hidden secrets and dangerous foes
- Challenging Puzzles: Test your brain with mind-bending puzzles that require clever solutions. Use your heroes’ abilities to overcome obstacles and progress through the game
- Exciting Battles: Engage in thrilling combat with evil minions and powerful bosses. Use your heroes’ special moves and teamwork to defeat enemies and save the Queen
- Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy stunning, colourful graphics that bring the world of Cup Heroes to life. Each scene is meticulously designed to enhance your gaming experience
- Daily Quests: Log in every day to participate in limited-time quests and earn multiple resources
- Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn but hard to master

Your Cup Heroes are waiting for you to lead them to victory!

70070000039524.name: Fight For America: Cold Edition
70070000039524.intro: Gear up, soldier - it’s time to reclaim freedom!
70070000039524.description:
America has fallen into enemy hands. It’s up to you to fight back! Build your defenses, rally your firepower, and lead the charge to take the nation back - state by state, battle by battle.

Strategically deploy turrets, unleash devastating machine guns, and adapt your tactics to survive relentless enemy waves and towering bosses. Every victory pushes the front lines forward and brings you one step closer to restoring freedom across the land.

Earn cash from every fallen foe, upgrade your weapons, and unlock powerful new gear to hold the line. Each liberated state strengthens your army and opens up new challenges, enemies, and rewards. With every push and every win, you’re shaping the future of a free America!

Features:
- Tower defense-inspired gameplay with intense tactical action
- New weapons: Bring the cold to the front lines with the Snowball Launcher and Blizzard!
- Extra coins: Boost your campaign with 2500 coins to upgrade your weapons, turrets, and base
- Tons of guns, turrets, and upgrades to build your unstoppable defense
- Ruthless enemies and bosses to test your strategy and reflexes
- Dozens of states and countries to liberate, each with unique challenges and rewards
- Strategic progression system. Earn resources, upgrade gear, and conquer!

Take back the land. Rebuild the nation. Fight For America!

70070000039526.name: Speedway Legends Premium Edition
70070000039526.description:
Push your limits and dominate the asphalt in Speedway Legends: Overdrive Racing, a high-octane experience where speed, precision, and style define your legacy. Master intense modes like Drift, Circuit, and Time Attack, unleash powerful Overdrive boosts, and build the ultimate racing machine to outpace every rival.

This bundle includes the main title and the Money Boost DLC, giving you an instant cash injection to accelerate your journey to the top. Upgrade your cars, fine-tune performance, unlock powerful vehicles, and customize your ride with ease. Gain the advantage you need to compete at the highest level and leave your rivals behind.

Strap in, hit the gas, and become the legend every racer fears.

70070000039529.name: Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun – Pixel Warrior
70070000039529.intro: Survive the pixel apocalypse and fight endless zombie waves.
70070000039529.description:
Enter the blocky world, where relentless zombie hordes, dangerous bosses, and challenging missions await around every corner. Explore ruined locations, collect valuable resources, upgrade your equipment, and fight to survive in an action-packed pixel adventure.

Bundle Includes:
1. Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun (Base Game)
Battle endless waves of zombies, explore dangerous environments, complete rewarding quests, defeat powerful bosses, and build your arsenal as you fight for survival.

2. Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun – Coin Boost (DLC)
Receive an additional 500 coins added to your in-game balance, giving you extra resources to upgrade your equipment and support your progress throughout the adventure.

Face the undead, strengthen your arsenal, and survive the blocky apocalypse with extra resources ready to spend.

70070000039538.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Survival Quest
70070000039538.intro: Build, battle, and thrive in crocodile territory.
70070000039538.description:
Face the untamed wilderness of the swamp with the ultimate Survival Float Simulator collection. Build and expand your raft, gather resources, craft equipment, catch fish, purify water, defend yourself against dangerous crocodiles, and transform a simple floating shelter into a thriving sanctuary.

This bundle includes:
1. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
Explore dangerous swamp waters, craft essential equipment, expand your raft, gather resources, fish for survival, and defend yourself against deadly crocodiles.

2. Survival Float Simulator: Fishing & Crafting Tools Update
Improve your survival with upgraded fishing and grappling tools featuring better performance, durability, and precision.

3. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Legendary Arms
Equip redesigned versions of the sword, spear, and club with striking new visuals inspired by the mysterious swamp.

4. Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build: Tool Textures
Refresh the look of your essential tools with enhanced hammer and axe textures for a more immersive crafting and building experience.

Strengthen your raft, upgrade your equipment, and master every challenge as you fight to survive the dangers hidden within the swamp.

70070000039539.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Combo Edition
70070000039539.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000039542.name: POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR: City Patrol
70070000039542.intro: Make your officer truly stand out during every mission.
70070000039542.description:
Step into the role of a police officer, where every decision shapes your career and every mission tests your skills. Train at the shooting range, patrol the city, respond to dangerous situations, and maintain order while building your reputation as a trusted officer.

Bundle Includes:
POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR – Experience the life of a police officer, complete various missions, develop your skills, unlock new equipment, and make choices that influence the city around you.

POLICE OFFICERS SIMULATOR: Patrol Style – Change your character’s appearance with a new visual style, giving your officer a refreshed look as you continue your patrols and protect the city.

Take on new challenges, uphold justice, and experience your police career with an updated appearance.

70070000039545.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS - Season Pass
70070000039545.description:
The CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS Season Pass includes:

• DLC Character Pack 1
Includes 2 playable characters, 9 move cards, 4 uniforms, 10 customization items, and more!
• DLC Character Pack 2

• DLC Character Pack 3

- Ball Customization: Black Ball

*Season Pass DLC contents will be released by August 2027. Additional details will be provided at a later date.
*This product includes content sold individually and within the Deluxe & Ultimate Editions. Please be aware of duplicate purchases.

70070000039580.name: EXSTETRA - Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000039580.intro: A fantasy RPG where a kiss can save the world.
70070000039580.description:
This special bundle includes the main game Exstetra together with the following content:
• Exstetra - Item Set
• Exstetra - Rune Set
----------------------------
Exstetra follows the story of Ryoma, a high school student chosen to become a Prisma, the savior destined to protect Amejia, a Tokyo fused with another world and doomed to destruction.
During his journey, Ryoma meets future Prisma Knights who share the same mission. By awakening their powers with a kiss, he joins them on an adventure to save two worlds.

◆ STORY ◆
Kiss her...
It is the only way to save two worlds from ruin.
Amejia was born from the fusion of Tokyo and another realm. As the chosen Prisma, Ryoma fights to prevent the extinction of both worlds.
Find the friends who were drawn into Amejia and awaken their hidden powers as Prisma Knights through the power of a kiss.
The only way to save the world is a kiss.

◆ WORLD ◆
Amejia is a transformed version of Tokyo that has merged with another world.
Featuring artwork inspired by Tokyo Fantasy, it offers a beautiful yet haunting world unlike any other.
Explore reimagined locations such as Shibuya and Akihabara.

◆ DUNGEON ◆
Mysterious labyrinths stretch across Amejia.
Battle monsters, solve puzzles, discover treasure, gather materials, and explore dangerous dungeons as you venture ever deeper.
Collect equipment and resources, strengthen your party, and press onward toward the deepest reaches of each labyrinth.

◆ BATTLE ◆
The only way to save the world is a kiss!
Fight alongside the Prisma Knights in strategic turn-based battles.
Form a party of up to four characters, choose formations and skills, and adapt your tactics to every encounter.
An Auto-Battle feature is also available.

• Ex Skills
As a Prisma, Ryoma can absorb Ex, the energy that powers this world, by defeating enemies.
Share Ex with Prisma Knights through a kiss to awaken their strength and unleash powerful Ex Skills.

• Party Formation and Affinity
Up to four characters can participate in battle.
Team composition and relationships with allies both play important roles, so strengthen your bonds with a variety of companions.

• Enchant System
Combine skills attached to weapons, armor, and accessories to create customized battle strategies.
Gather materials, enhance your equipment, and prepare for powerful enemies.

*This product is based on Exstetra, originally released in 2013. Some features and specifications may differ from the original version.*

70070000039750.name: Ecchi Memories: Blair Edition
70070000039750.intro: Let the bras hit the floor!
70070000039750.description:
Why don't we play a little game to jog your memory? Impress the girls, and they might show you a bit of their "personality" ;)

Match the cards within the time limit in this bra-dropping memory game. It gets harder the further you get... If you can do it in time, you'll see something your eyes will never forget.

Features:
- 8 beautiful girls with impressive proportions (clothes optional)
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- A treat for your eyes

Enjoy an unforgettable experience and make some ecchi memories.

70070000039758.name: Pixel Cross Stitch: Miniatures Season 1
70070000039758.description: Pixel Cross Stitch: Miniatures + Pixel Cross Stitch: Miniatures - Flowers 2

70070000039766.name: AKIBA LOST: Digital Deluxe Edition
70070000039766.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70070000039766.description:
This Digital Deluxe Edition includes the full game, soundtrack, drama movie, costumes, and more!

Contents
- AKIBA LOST (Full Game)
- AKIBA LOST - Original Soundtrack
- AKIBA LOST - Drama Movie
- Pixel Character Costume Set A (Shinjo, Wakana, Aoi, Moe)
- Pixel Character Costume Set B (Shinjo, Kokone, Chihiro, Yukimi)


Game
Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “The Akiba Vanishing”. 
Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. 
But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?
AKIBA LOST is a live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice.

Cast:
Hiromitsu Kitayama / Game Creator: Daiki Shinjo
Sayuri Matsumura / Maid: Aoi Shinjo
Momoko Tanabe / Game Streamer: Yukimi Kurahashi

Drama Movie

Pixel Character Costume Set
