70070000039775.name: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Defense Protocol
70070000039775.intro: Manage the checkpoint and survive the chaos beyond the border.
70070000039775.description:
Step into a world on the edge of collapse, where every person crossing the border could be a survivor or a hidden threat. Use advanced screening tools, analyze clues, manage limited resources, and make critical decisions to prevent the spread of infection.

Bundle Includes:
• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
Take control of a dangerous border checkpoint, inspect incoming survivors, detect infections, manage supplies, and make difficult choices that determine the fate of those trying to enter.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Frontline Upgrade
Change the exterior appearance of the checkpoint container with a new color design, giving the border location a refreshed visual identity that reflects the rising tension and changing conditions.

• Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint – Visual Horizon
Replace the standard skybox with a unique atmosphere featuring redesigned skies, clouds, and lighting effects that create a more immersive experience during every inspection.

Maintain control, investigate every arrival, and protect the remaining survivors as the world fights against the outbreak.

70070000039781.name: Chained Up Together: Above the Clouds
70070000039781.intro: Climb higher, work together, and overcome every challenge.
70070000039781.description:
Enter a world where teamwork is the key to survival. Bound by an unbreakable chain, you and your partner must overcome deadly traps, solve challenging puzzles, battle dangerous enemies, and rely on perfect coordination to conquer every obstacle.

The Bundle Includes:
1.Chained Up Together – Work together through dangerous environments, master the unique chain mechanics, overcome challenging puzzles, and survive against relentless enemies in a cooperative adventure where every move matters.

2. Chained Up Together: Mystic Dragon – Add a majestic dragon to the center of the main location, where it rests atop a rock before periodically taking flight and returning to its perch, creating a more immersive and dynamic world.

Face every challenge, trust your partner, and experience your adventure beneath the watchful eyes of a legendary dragon.

70070000039787.name: Survival Zombie: Into the Apocalypse
70070000039787.intro: Face the undead and build a future in a broken world.
70070000039787.description:
Fight to survive in a ruthless world overrun by the undead, where every decision can mean the difference between life and death. Explore dangerous locations, gather valuable resources, craft essential equipment, build your defenses, and strengthen your main camp with a new house that gives your base an expanded look.

This Bundle Includes:
• Survival Zombie (Game) – Explore abandoned cities, forests, and bunkers, gather resources, craft weapons and shelters, face evolving zombie hordes, and make difficult choices as you fight to survive.
• Survival Zombie: Safe Haven (DLC) – Add a new house to the default Camp location, expanding your main base with a permanent structure that enhances your survival experience.

Strengthen your camp, prepare for every expedition, and continue your fight against the undead with an upgraded home base.

70070000039788.name: Cozy Unpacking Collection
70070000039788.description:
Create, decorate, and relax with a collection designed for players who love cozy spaces and creative freedom.
This bundle includes three complete games, each offering a unique way to transform ordinary places into warm, inviting environments. Design the perfect workspace, organize and decorate charming homes, and celebrate the holiday season by creating a beautifully decorated Christmas tree in magical festive settings.
Arrange furniture, place decorations, personalize every corner, and experiment with countless layouts at your own pace. Whether you're building a productive creative studio, unpacking and organizing a dream home, or filling the air with holiday spirit, every experience encourages creativity without pressure or time limits.

70070000039789.name: Flight Simulator 2026 Collection
70070000039789.description:
Take to the skies with a collection built for aviation enthusiasts, adrenaline seekers, and anyone who has ever dreamed of flying.

This bundle includes three complete flight experiences, each offering a unique perspective on the freedom of the open sky. Master realistic aircraft, sharpen your piloting skills through challenging flight missions, race against the clock across demanding aerial courses, and experience the unforgettable thrill of skydiving from breathtaking heights.

From precise takeoffs and smooth landings to high-speed checkpoint races and heart-pounding freefall, every adventure rewards skill, confidence, and determination. Unlock new aircraft, improve your abilities, customize your equipment, and explore diverse environments as you continue your journey through the world of aviation.

70070000039790.name: Escape Backrooms Collection
70070000039790.description:
Step into a collection of psychological horror experiences where familiar places become endless nightmares and every path leads deeper into the unknown.

This bundle includes two horror adventures, each challenging you to escape vast, surreal environments that defy logic and reality. Explore flooded labyrinths shrouded in silence, wander through an abandoned parking garage where every level feels the same, solve unsettling puzzles, and search for a way out while an unseen presence follows your every move.

As you push forward, ordinary surroundings slowly twist into impossible spaces filled with tension, mystery, and constant uncertainty. Every corridor invites exploration, every decision carries risk, and every new discovery raises more questions than answers.

70070000039806.name: Murders on the Yangtze River Deluxe Edition
70070000039806.description:
Deluxe Edition includes the following content:
- Base Game
- Ink & Gold Elegance Outfit Collection
- Mistveil Detective Outfit Collection

Murders on the Yangtze River is a Chinese-style side-scrolling detective adventure game developed by OMEGAMES STUDIO.
There is no such thing as a perfect crime — only clues that have yet to be discovered.

- Every Trace Leaves a Mark -

Set in the turbulent era of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China, where ancient and modern, Eastern and Western cultures collided and intertwined, you will step into the role of the protagonist and become entangled in an unavoidable conspiracy.

Seemingly unrelated events gradually lead you toward a massive mystery and the secrets hidden behind your own identity.

A lie is simply a fact disguised in another form. Can you uncover the truth hidden beneath layers of deception and piece together the final answer from a series of intertwined cases?

- A Meticulously Crafted Logic-Based Mystery -

During your journey, you will encounter a series of bizarre and perplexing cases. To uncover the truth behind each incident and identify the culprit, you will need to:

Explore different locations as the story unfolds, searching for every hidden clue and subtle detail.

Investigate crime scenes, collect evidence, and question witnesses.

Even uncover contradictions and loopholes hidden within the testimonies you have gathered...

- Intricate Cases with Twists and Turns -

The seemingly unrelated cases that occur across different locations are, in fact, connected by countless threads to the greater mystery surrounding the protagonist.

Behind every case lies an ingenious method of crime and a deeply moving motive.

Every ordinary person carries their own complicated past, with countless hidden conflicts and entangled relationships.

Can you unravel every layer of the mystery, discover the ultimate truth behind the grand case, and complete your journey of revenge?

- A Breathtaking Chinese Ink Painting World -

Follow a beautifully unfolding ink-wash scroll as you travel through the landscapes of China over a century ago.

Sail across Dongting Lake and encounter the historic Yueyang Tower once again;

Travel along the Yangtze River and explore the steampunk-inspired Hanyang Iron Works;

Wander through the misty waterways and elegant scenery of Jiangnan in Yangzhou;

Step into the dazzling streets of Shanghai’s foreign concessions and experience the city's retro modernity from a century ago...

Every scene is carefully crafted like a living painting, inviting you to experience local cultures, explore historical landscapes, and solve mysteries across different regions.

- Meticulously Researched Historical and Cultural Design -

The game's world, art style, and environments are based on extensive research from museum archives, historical photographs, and discussions with experts in history and culture.

The story is built upon real historical backgrounds, recreating the architecture, landscapes, and social atmosphere of China over a hundred years ago.

From carefully researched character costumes to authentic everyday objects, every detail is designed to immerse you in the rich historical and cultural atmosphere of the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China.

70070000039819.name: Toy Cowboy Royale : RPG Dragon’s Challenge – Frontier Hero
70070000039819.intro: Expand your arsenal and become a stronger warrior.
70070000039819.description:
Experience the magical world, where brave cowboys, powerful dragons, and epic adventures await. Explore colorful landscapes, complete challenging quests, defeat dangerous enemies, and upgrade your abilities as you fight to become the ultimate hero.

Bundle Includes:
Toy Cowboy Royale : RPG Dragon’s Challenge
Embark on an exciting RPG adventure, explore a fantasy toy world, battle legendary dragons, discover treasures, and master unique abilities to prove your bravery.

Toy Cowboy Royale : RPG Dragon’s Challenge – New Arsenal
Add an axe as an additional weapon, giving your cowboy a powerful new option for close combat and helping you face enemies with greater strength.

Prepare for epic encounters, expand your equipment, and continue your quest to become the greatest hero of the realm.

70070000039823.name: Auto Sport Racing Simulator: Deluxe Legends Bundle
70070000039823.intro: Speed, control, and pure racing focus.
70070000039823.description:
Take your racing experience further with a bundle focused on control, precision, and progression. This package combines the base game with additional vehicles designed to enhance your performance across different tracks and race types.
Compete in diverse environments, refine your driving skills, and upgrade your vehicles to match your style. The added content introduces new ways to approach each race, giving you more flexibility and control in high-speed situations.

Bundle includes:
* Auto Sport Racing Simulator (Base Game)
* Auto Sport Racing Simulator – R34 Legends Pack

Designed for consistency and performance, this bundle gives you the tools to stay in control and compete at your best in every race.

70070000039824.name: Auto Sport Racing Simulator: Ultimate Z Edition
70070000039824.intro: Speed, control, and pure racing focus.
70070000039824.description:
A complete racing setup built for versatility and control.

This bundle combines the core racing experience with additional vehicles that shift the focus toward agility and precision. From high-speed sections to technical corners, every track challenges you to adapt and stay in control.

With access to both the full game and the Z Street Edition content, you gain more options, more variety, and more ways to approach each race. Adjust your driving style, refine your technique, and handle every scenario with confidence.

Bundle includes:
* Auto Sport Racing Simulator (Base Game)
* Auto Sport Racing Simulator – Z Street Edition

Built for drivers who want flexibility and control, this bundle expands your racing experience without slowing the pace.

70070000039828.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Ready to Survive
70070000039828.intro: Explore deeper, fight harder, and survive every encounter.
70070000039828.description:
Description: 
Step into the terrifying world with everything you need to improve your chances of survival. Explore an endless maze filled with deadly enemies, disturbing mysteries, and shifting environments where every decision matters.

What’s included in this bundle:
1. Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM 
Explore the endless Backrooms through an immersive bodycam perspective, complete dangerous objectives, uncover hidden secrets, and fight to survive against relentless enemies.

2. Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Armed Survivor
This DLC adds a pistol loaded with 7 rounds and 200 reserve rounds. If you already own a pistol, its ammunition is automatically updated to 7/200, preparing you for the dangers ahead.

Stay alert, conserve your ammunition, and fight your way through the horrors hidden within the endless Backrooms.

70070000039836.name: Baseball Card Shop Simulator: Card Trading
70070000039836.intro: Become the destination for every baseball card collector.
70070000039836.description:
Turn your passion for baseball cards into a thriving business. Manage your own card shop, stock booster packs and rare collectibles, attract loyal customers, and grow your business through smart investments and careful strategy.

The bundle includes:
1. Baseball Card Shop Simulator – Build and customize your own card shop, manage inventory, set prices, organize tournaments, and grow your business into the ultimate destination for baseball card collectors.

2. Baseball Card Shop Simulator: Retail Boost – A 3,000 bonus at the beginning of every new game, allowing you to expand your inventory, improve your store, and accelerate your path to success.

Grow your collection, build your reputation, and create the ultimate baseball card shop with a stronger start every time.

70070000039844.name: Anime Waifu Simulator GOLD EDITION
70070000039844.description:
Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Japanese gardens in Anime Waifu Simulator: Sakura Garden. Surrounded by blooming sakura trees, flowing streams, and tranquil ponds, craft your perfect retreat filled with elegance, peace, and charm. Decorate your space with traditional elements like bamboo, stone lanterns, and koi fish, while enjoying relaxing moments with your charming waifus.

This bundle includes the main title, the Girls Passion DLC, and the Sakura Coin Pack DLC, adding even more depth to your garden experience. Unlock new waifus with unique personalities, heartfelt stories, and stylish outfits, and use Sakura Coins to acquire exclusive decorations, rare items, and beautiful accessories. Enhance every corner of your garden, making it a truly magical and immersive sanctuary.

Relax, bond, and create a Japanese-inspired paradise where every detail reflects your vision of beauty and tranquility.

70070000039853.name: All-Star Supermarket Simulator Gold Edition
70070000039853.intro: Build your store with style and sound!
70070000039853.description:
Step into a nostalgic shopping experience with All-Star Supermarket Simulator: Vinyl Vibes, where retro charm meets smooth gameplay. Browse aisles filled with classic vinyl tunes, manage your store, and enjoy a unique atmosphere inspired by vintage style and iconic beats. Every moment becomes a musical journey as you build and customize your ultimate supermarket.

This bundle includes the main title, the Coin Flip DLC, and the Storage Pack DLC, giving you everything you need to enhance your experience. Get an instant coin boost to expand faster, upgrade your setup, and unlock new possibilities, while storage solutions let you organize and showcase your growing vinyl collection with flair. Create a supermarket that sounds as good as it looks.

Feel the rhythm, build your space, and turn every session into a groove-filled adventure.

70070000039863.name: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder - Grand Construction
70070000039863.intro: Build the city while expanding your construction empire.
70070000039863.description:
Create your own construction empire experience. Manage construction projects across the city, operate a wide range of heavy machinery, complete challenging contracts, and expand your company from a small contractor into an industry leader.

Bundle Includes:
Construction Sim: City and Road Builder
Build roads, bridges, and large-scale infrastructure, operate realistic construction machinery, complete diverse contracts, and develop a successful construction company.

Construction Sim: City and Road Builder - Business Boost
This DLC adds 5,00 in-game currency to invest in equipment, expand your fleet, and take on larger construction projects sooner.

Lay the foundation for success, grow your business with confidence, and build the future one project at a time.

70070000039875.name: CONTRABAND BORDER POLICE SIMULATOR – Border Officer
70070000039875.intro: Search, investigate, and protect every border crossing.
70070000039875.description:
Take on the responsibilities of a border officer experience. Examine travel documents, investigate suspicious vehicles, uncover hidden contraband, arrest criminals, and make difficult decisions that shape your career.

What’s Included:
1. CONTRABAND BORDER POLICE SIMULATOR (Base Game) – Inspect passports and vehicles, uncover hidden contraband, search suspicious belongings, arrest smugglers, and maintain security while balancing duty and integrity.

2. CONTRABAND BORDER POLICE SIMULATOR: Elite Knife (DLC) – Equip a redesigned knife with a fresh new appearance, giving one of your essential patrol tools a distinctive look during every border inspection.

Protect the border, enforce the law, and carry out every inspection with upgraded equipment and confidence.

70070000039896.name: AKIBA LOST: Original Soundtrack & Pixel Character Costume Set
70070000039896.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70070000039896.description:
The AKIBA LOST Original Soundtrack features 31 in-game background music tracks.
In addition to the 22 tracks featured in the television drama, this soundtrack also includes original compositions for the game by Tsukasa Masuko.

70070000039897.name: AKIBA LOST: Drama Movie & Pixel Character Costume Set
70070000039897.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70070000039897.description:
Includes all six episodes of the TV drama broadcast on Nippon TV, one of Japan's leading nationwide television networks!
Experience the world of AKIBA LOST through a unique live-action experience that offers a different perspective from the game.

Also included are the in-game Pixel Character Costume Sets!
The set includes Shinjo in his school days, along with costumes for Kokone, Chihiro, and Yukimi.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?

70070000039917.name: Business Simulator Collection
70070000039917.intro: Build your empire from the ground up.
70070000039917.description:
Take on two hands-on business adventures where restoration, management, and smart investments are the keys to success.
Restore a neglected hotel from the ground up. Clear out damaged rooms, renovate floors, walls, and ceilings, choose furniture and decorations, welcome guests, and expand your property as your business grows. Improve your tools, unlock new rooms, and transform an abandoned building into a successful hotel.
Then enter the world of car dealing. Search auctions for promising vehicles, compete for the best deals, repair and restore your purchases, and sell them for profit. Customize and expand your showroom, manage your budget, negotiate with customers, and build your reputation as your collection of vehicles and your dealership continue to grow.
With two distinct management experiences, this bundle lets you renovate, customize, trade, expand, and build your way toward success - whether you're creating the perfect hotel or running your own car empire.

70070000039918.name: Strays & Wild West Collection
70070000039918.intro: Survive, explore, reach to the top.
70070000039918.description:
Three unforgettable adventures, three completely different challenges.
Fight your way through a zombie-infested Wild West, where relentless hordes, powerful bosses, unique characters, weapons, perks, and loyal companions await. Build your ultimate combination of abilities, explore cursed frontier locations, and survive increasingly dangerous battles.
When the guns fall silent, switch to a quieter adventure and become a curious little cat exploring a luxurious hotel. Wander through cozy interiors, sneak into different areas, jump across furniture, discover hidden corners, and complete playful tasks from a unique feline perspective.
And when you're ready for a real test of patience, take control of a fearless kitty in a challenging vertical climbing adventure. Jump from object to object, climb higher, master precise movements, and try to reach the top without losing your progress.
From battling zombie hordes to peaceful hotel exploration and precision-based climbing, this bundle brings together three unique experiences united by one thing - every adventure has its own way to challenge.

70070000039919.name: Nightmare Roulette Pack
70070000039919.description:
Enter two horror experiences where places hide something deeply disturbing.
In one nightmare, a seemingly ordinary office becomes a place of isolation and paranoia. Spend a long, silent night wandering through empty corridors and familiar workspaces as reality slowly begins to shift. Everything looks normal - but the longer you stay, the harder it becomes to trust your surroundings.
In the second experience, luxury and terror collide in a cursed royal hall. Trapped for six nights with an ever-growing debt, you must rely on a sinister slot machine to survive. Manage your luck, collect powerful artifacts, make risky deals with a mysterious entity, and gamble your way toward freedom while something in the darkness watches your every move.
Two different nightmares, two dangerous situations, and one common rule: the longer you stay, the stranger things become.

70070000039927.name: Hex Park - Ultra Bundle
70070000039927.intro:
One bundle. Endless brainteasers.
Master every puzzle in Hex Park
with the complete game and DLC.
70070000039927.description:
Welcome to Hex Park – Ultra Bundle, the complete puzzle experience that includes both the Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Ultra DLC.

Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, trigger satisfying chain reactions, clear obstacles, and solve each board in as few moves as possible. Easy to learn yet delightfully challenging to master, Hex Park offers relaxing, strategic gameplay that's impossible to put down.

The base game introduces a colorful world of handcrafted puzzles featuring clever mechanics like keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Once you've mastered those challenges, continue your journey with Hex Park: Ultra DLC, adding 75 brand-new handcrafted levels designed to test your planning, precision, and puzzle-solving skills with even more intricate layouts and clever combinations of mechanics.

Need a little help? Handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill can get you unstuck without taking away the satisfaction of solving each puzzle. With no timers and no pressure, you can enjoy every challenge at your own pace.

Why you'll love Hex Park – Ultra Bundle:

• Includes the complete Hex Park base game and Hex Park: Ultra DLC
• 75 additional handcrafted Ultra DLC levels
• Clever mechanics including keys, locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more
• Strategic gameplay that's easy to learn and rewarding to master
• Helpful tools that keep the challenge fair and fun
• Relaxing gameplay with no timers or pressure
• Achievements and cloud save support

Whether you're discovering Hex Park for the first time or looking to conquer every challenge, Hex Park – Ultra Bundle is the definitive way to experience the complete Hex Park adventure.

70070000039937.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Ancient Survival
70070000039937.intro: Evolve, adapt, and dominate the prehistoric wilderness.
70070000039937.description:
Enter a dangerous ancient world where survival depends on adaptation, strength, and instinct. Experience the adventure as you explore hostile environments, face powerful creatures, complete challenging missions, and evolve through the prehistoric era.

Bundle Includes:
1. Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG (Base Game): Explore forests, plains, waterfalls, and volcanic regions while controlling legendary dinosaurs, improving your abilities, completing survival challenges, and fighting to become the strongest creature of the prehistoric age.

2. Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG: Jurassic Style (DLC): Refresh the appearance of three AI-controlled dinosaurs with redesigned skins, adding more visual variety to your prehistoric encounters.

Adapt, survive, and explore a world of ancient dangers with new creature appearances and an enhanced prehistoric experience.

70070000039944.name: Pharmacy Store Simulator: Retail Success
70070000039944.intro: Manage your store and create the perfect shopping experience.
70070000039944.description:
Create and grow your own successful pharmacy while managing inventory, setting prices, expanding your business, and serving customers every day. Enhance your management experience with a redesigned pharmacy that gives your store a fresh new appearance as your business continues to grow.

This Bundle Includes:
• Pharmacy Store Simulator – Build and manage your own pharmacy, stock shelves with medicines and essential products, expand your business, optimize your store, and serve customers while maximizing profits.

• Pharmacy Store Simulator: Shop Style – Transform the appearance of your pharmacy with a completely redesigned store, giving your business a fresh visual style throughout every working day.

Grow your pharmacy, welcome more customers, and enjoy managing your business in a refreshed retail environment.

70070000039949.name: Barbarous: Survivor's Quest - Gold Edition
70070000039949.intro: Battle the horde and survive the quest!
70070000039949.description:
The land is overrun by hungry orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and other dangerous creatures, and only the strongest will last! Fight through wave after wave of enemies, face powerful bosses, and upgrade your hero to become unstoppable.

Every run is a new challenge! Choose your upgrades wisely and shape your build as you progress. Open treasure chests, gather experience, and stay in the fight as the enemy waves grow stronger.

Improve your stats, unlock powerful weapons, and collect valuable rewards as you carve your way through the chaos!

Features:
- Fight waves of orcs, skeletons, ghosts, rats, and more
- Explore 2 additional maps with extreme difficulty: Northern Reaches and Mages Guild
- Meet 2 new brave characters: Gwen and Varizz
- Discover 2 new powerful weapons: Fist of the North and Eye of the Void
- Shape your build with many weapons and items
- Face powerful bosses and earn valuable rewards
- Upgrade and evolve your gear!
- Power up and become the ultimate hero

How long can you survive before the horde overwhelms you?

70070000039950.name: Puzzle Book: Gold Edition
70070000039950.intro: If you’re missing the magic of doing jigsaw puzzles, then you’ve come to the right place!
70070000039950.description:
Puzzle Book: Gold Edition offers 55 different puzzles to solve, divided into themes - from fantasy to dinosaurs. Arts for this game were made by artist specialized in various styles. They are beautiful paintings of creatures and landscapes or simpler drawings for kids. There is something for everyone!

Speaking of everyone, you can adjust the difficulty by selecting the number of fragments per puzzle - from 6 to as much as 150! It’s a great title for both children and adults. Add peaceful music that plays in the background and you’ve got a great, relaxing afternoon.

Hungry for some competition? Or you just want to assemble pieces with friends or family? Try co-op mode! Just share a Joy-Con™ with another person and start doing puzzles together.

Features:
- 55 different puzzles to solve, divided into themes
- Each stage has 6 difficulties - from 6 pieces to 150
- Beautiful arts created by various artists
- Play solo or with a friend in co-op mode
- Use the touchscreen or Joy-Con™ controller

70070000039957.name: Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Battlefield Heroes
70070000039957.intro: Master every weapon and overcome every enemy force.
70070000039957.description:
Enter a world of intense military combat , where every battle demands precision, teamwork, and strategy. Fight alongside your squad in high-stakes 5v5 encounters, explore dynamic combat zones, and use a powerful arsenal to overcome enemy forces.

Bundle Features:
1. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER – Engage in tactical team battles, master a wide selection of weapons, and lead your squad through challenging firefights across diverse environments. Every decision matters as you fight to secure victory.

2. Call of Warfare - FPS MODERN SHOOTER: Tactical Hands – Customize your operator’s appearance with military-inspired camouflage green hands and gloves. Add a realistic soldier style to your character and bring a fresh tactical look to every encounter.

3. Call of Warfare - FPS Modern Shooter: Battlefield Sky – Upgrade the visual atmosphere of every map with a redesigned skybox. Experience more dynamic combat environments with refreshed skies and a more immersive war zone.

Prepare for battle, refine your tactics, and experience modern warfare with enhanced customization and visuals.

70070000039985.name: Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Wild Expedition
70070000039985.intro: Discover breathtaking environments and unforgettable hunts.
70070000039985.description:
Step into the wild and take on the ultimate hunting challenge with a complete experience designed for every aspiring hunter. Explore vast landscapes, track different animals, customize your equipment, and test your skills in realistic hunting environments.

This bundle includes:
1. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting (Base Game)
Explore diverse ecosystems, track wildlife, use customizable gear, adapt to changing conditions, and experience the excitement of a realistic hunting adventure.

2. Hunter Simulator: Wild Hunting – Extra Capital (DLC)
1,000 in-game coins added directly to your balance, giving you additional resources to improve your equipment, prepare for expeditions, and enhance your hunting journey.

Prepare your gear, explore the wilderness, and take on every hunt with a stronger start and greater possibilities.

70070000039986.name: FOUNTAINS: Extended Edition
70070000039986.intro: This is a bundle containing the base game FOUNTAINS and the DLC Shattered Shape
70070000039986.description:
The Fountain of Youth is unearthed - but the One Kingdom hides far more than one secret. Face brutal, precise soulslike combat across a sprawling, interconnected world, then descend into the forsaken Vainlands with Shattered Shape, where new foes, weapons, skills and a new land await.

This bundle contains everything you need to conquer the One Kingdom.

- Full soulslike action-RPG + Shattered Shape expansion
- A seamless, labyrinthine world - now even more sprawling with the uncharted southern Vainlands
- New enemies, weapons, and armor to master alongside the base arsenal
- Uncover the entire truth of the Usurper's Prophecy, start to finish

70070000039996.name: Ecchi Secrets: Past & Future Edition
70070000039996.intro: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls
70070000039996.description:
Secrets lie beneath the covers... avoid enemies and uncover pictures of beautiful girls posing exclusively for you.

Discovering the truth is never easy... the more tempting the secrets, the greater the challenges you'll face. Unravel all the mysteries to uncover what the girls are hiding, and prepare yourself for plenty of alluring photos along the way.

Features:
- Over 62 pictures of beautiful girls in enticing outfits to reveal
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes

70070000039998.name: Weird Heroes: Jump & Fun Bundle
70070000039998.intro: Action, puzzles, and gravity-defying jumps! Join four unusual heroes in one crazy and fun platforming bundle.
70070000039998.description:
Get ready for the craziest and most fun action-platforming combo! Weird Heroes: Jump & Fun Bundle brings together four of the most unusual protagonists in gaming in one unrepeatable collection. Warp gravity in a prehistoric clay world with Crosak, defend the mafia's city against space invaders in Timothy vs the Aliens, discover an underground world full of lights and shadows in Naught, and lead a wild squad of flightless birds in Flying Soldiers. 

Jump, shoot, solve puzzles, and experience four unique adventures filled with humor and challenges!

Crosak
Turn your world around and join Crosak on his Jurassic adventure in a multi-gravity playdough universe. Play solo or with a friend and rescue the cavemen from the mighty Double G.

Timothy vs the Aliens
Gangsters don't share their city with anyone, especially not aliens! Control Timothy in this open-world platforming adventure. Defend the monochrome streets of Little Fish City by blasting colorful alien invaders. Drive classic cars, slow down time, and show them who is the King of the town.

Naught + Additional Content
Test your skills, take control of the environment, and guide Naught through deep underground labyrinths full of challenges, hidden places and secrets. Enjoy the complete adventure with the included additional content: “Edahi & Dohai” and “Sudagi.”

Flying Soldiers
Get ready to command an odd squad of fun birds and devise a plan to bring them safe and sound to the end of the battlefield. An outlandish puzzle game that will challenge your mind to make these greenhorn recruits into brave soldiers.

70070000039999.name: Escape + Rooms Horror Bundle
70070000039999.intro: Wake up in your worst nightmare and fight to keep your sanity with this ultimate bundle combining survival horror and escape room.
70070000039999.description:
Two relentless horror experiences set to push you to your absolute limits. Get ready for an adrenaline overdose with this spine-chilling bundle featuring two terrifying titles that blend escape room mechanics with classic survival horror. Explore, solve, and above all, survive—your life hangs by a thread in every single corner.

Escape from Umbra
Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight. Solve the enigmas and move unseen to escape Umbra’s domain.

Oxide Room 104
A bone-chilling body-horror game with escape room gameplay. Bad decisions have brought Matthew to this terrifying motel. Now it’s up to you to decide how to escape - will you make it out alive?

70070000040001.name: CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival – Silent Factory
70070000040001.intro: Survive the nightmare hiding inside the forgotten factory.
70070000040001.description:
Step into the abandoned chocolate factory, where eerie corridors, sinister puzzles, and terrifying entities await. Explore forgotten rooms, uncover disturbing secrets, collect mysterious candies, and fight to survive as you make your way through the factory’s dark and twisted world.

The bundle includes:
1. CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival
Explore a haunting chocolate factory, solve intricate puzzles, collect precious candies, and survive the malevolent entities lurking in the shadows.
2. CANDYLAND: Sweet Survival – Ammo Boost
Adds 100 bullets, providing extra ammunition for encounters with the horrors hidden throughout the factory.

Uncover the secrets of the forgotten factory, face the horrors within, and fight your way through the darkness with extra ammunition at your side. Are you ready to survive CANDYLAND?

70070000040004.name: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga Bundle
70070000040004.intro: Two RPG/Action Adventure games. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights and beautiful pixel-art scenery.
70070000040004.description:
Silverwind Saga:
Rynna has arrived on one of Shalnor's most dangerous islands. Once a haven for tourism, now the island is abandoned due to the presence of the Slime Queen. To prove her worth, our young Elven hero has to overcome the challenges of the island by finding powerful weapons and items to use against the hordes of monsters in challenging gauntlet-style combat encounters.

Silvewind Saga 2:
An evil Necromancer has brought ruin upon an already dangerous island.

It's up to Rynna to fight her way through hordes of monsters and undead beings, and defeat the Necromancer and his minions and free the souls of those who have been trapped in the world of the living.

70070000040005.name: Car & Moto Simulator Bundle : Racing & Driving
70070000040005.intro:
Feel the engine. Hear the world.
Every road becomes a story — 
...and you’re the one behind the wheel.
70070000040005.description:
Street Racing Simulator EVO : Car & Moto
Are you ready to take the wheel and experience the most realistic and exhilarating driving simulation on handheld? Street Racing EVO, developed by Ovilex, is here to redefine your expectations of car and motorcycle racing games. With its stunning visuals, immersive gameplay, and endless customization options, this game is a must-play for any driving enthusiast.

What Makes Street Racing Simulator EVO Stand Out?
Unmatched Realism and Highly Detailed Vehicles
Every car and motorcycle is crafted with precision, featuring intricate interiors and exteriors that bring your ride to life.

Dual Thrills: Cars & Motorcycles
Whether you’re a fan of high-performance sports cars or the agility of motorcycles, Street Racing EVO has it all. Race through challenging terrains on two wheels or dominate the streets in your customized dream car.

Thrilling Challenges
Engage in high-speed races, evade police chases, and complete adrenaline-pumping challenges. Test your driving skills and prove you’re the best on the road.

Multiple Race Types to Choose From
Compete in Sprint, Time Attack, Speed Camera, Average Speed, Drag, and Top Speed races. Take your skills to the track for endless racing excitement.

Stunning Graphics
Experience breathtaking visuals that bring the game world to life. From scenic rural roads to vibrant cityscapes, every environment is designed to immerse you in the ultimate driving adventure.

Why You’ll Love Street Racing EVO
Immersive Gameplay
The combination of realistic vehicle dynamics, first-person POV, and dynamic environments creates an experience that feels truly authentic.
Something for Everyone
Whether you’re into street racing, police pursuits, or simply cruising through an open world, this game caters to all types of players.

Car Simulator : Driving School
Car Simulator : Driving School puts you behind the wheel and lets you become a true master of the road! Explore vast open regions inspired by real-world locations, drive an impressive collection of cars across multiple categories, and take on a wide variety of driving challenges — all powered by realistic handling and immersive driving conditions.

Choose from 50 detailed vehicles, including hatchbacks, sedans, coupes, SUVs, supercars, and hypercars. Complete 75 unique missions, race on 3 dedicated tracks, or enjoy Free Ride mode across all maps. Customize your car inside and out with paint options, bodykits, interior trims, and more.

Features:

• 50 cars to choose from, including 11 hatchbacks, 8 sedans, 10 coupes, 7 SUVs, 9 supercars, and 5 hypercars
• 8 open regions inspired by real locations: Washington, Chicago, Madrid, Montreal, Arizona Countryside, Texas Highway, European Countryside, and Europe Highway
• 75 missions ranging from beginner driving lessons to advanced challenges
• 3 Race Tracks plus Free Ride mode available on all maps
• Extensive vehicle customization, including exterior paint, bodykits, wheels, interior trims, and more
• 4 selectable driving conditions: Daytime, Nighttime, Dusk, and Rain
• Realistic driving physics and detailed vehicle interiors
• Explore, practice, race, or simply cruise — the choice is yours

Become the ultimate driver with Car Simulator : Driving School!

70070000040006.name: Best Hits Fun Collection 10 in 1 Bundle
70070000040006.intro: This 10-in-1 Best Hits bundle is perfect for players of all ages and interests! You'll find everything you want to play in this one-of-a-kind bundle!
70070000040006.description:
Vikings Pinball
Fun pinball style battles. Attack the military camps of the holy Roman Empire and crush the legionaries. Choose the right trajectories to inflict as much damage as possible.  Shoot down enemies, blow up barrels and collect coins. Free the map from these lazybones!

Sled Riders
Jump into the most fun sled race game! Get ready for snowy tracks, each one special and full of surprises. Race through Snowflake City or over Frost Mountain - every race is an adventure!
Make your Racer look cool with fun outfits and hats. Pick a bright suit or a cute snowman costume to stand out in the snow.
Choose your sled! Race with friends in exciting races that are easy to play but hard to win. You'll get new outfits and sleighs the more you race.
So grab your controller, pick your sled, and let's race!

Fridge Escape
Everyone wants to eat you! Open the refrigerator door and run away. Avoid obstacles so you don't lose speed. 
Jump over stools, slip under chairs and run onto tables.   
Remember that a very hungry person is running after you and you can't stop. 
Collect coins and choose fun skins for each new run. Make big jumps, take sharp turns and find shortcuts. The main thing is not to stop and run!

Forest Cafe
It's time to take care of cute animals and build a cozy cafe for them in a forest clearing. Get everything ready for the reception. Add various tasty dishes and drinks to the menu. 
Set the work so that no one has to wait in line for too long, or the animals will get upset. Hire and train staff. Make your cafe the most popular in the forest!  

Race Track Maniacs
Experience racing like never before! Feel the adrenaline as you race through the best tracks, mastering every turn and straightaway with precision. It's not just about speed - it's about control and strategy. 
Navigate sharp turns, push your limits, and feel the rush of high-speed competition. The racetrack is your playground - conquer it, own it, and become a true racing champion!

Be A Bee
Honey isn't just a sweet treat. It's a whole new world, and you can be a part of the delicious bee life. Build your hive. Explore new green zones to gather resources and produce honey. It's not as easy as it seems at first. But it's worth a try!
Add more hives for the families of bees to keep them comfortable. This is the right way to grow your bee empire and reach new worlds! Enjoy the rewards of your hard work. 

Crowd Run
Being a hero isn't easy. Use all your skills to protect people from the hordes. Stay alert to keep everyone safe.  
Use all available weapons to cause as much damage as possible. Clear the all levels from the danger and keep your fortress safe. Shoot. Reload. And shoot again. Repeat.   

Save The Doge 
Solving the puzzles and saving the little puppies is the best way to spend your time.  
Draw the lines accurately, so the angry bees can't even touch our beloved dog. Each level is a new challenge for your brain and skills. Find the best solutions in every puzzle. The bees are so annoying. Keep them away as much as possible!      

Save The Doge 2
New challenging levels are here! Solve the puzzles and save the little puppies. This is still the best way to spend your time!   
You still have to draw the lines so the angry bees can't even touch the puppy. All new levels will challenge your brain and skills. Still find the best solution in each level. The bees won't stop until they reach the goal. Keep them away as long as you can!       

Skull Pirates: Adventures
Ahoy, buddy! Get ready for an exciting adventure! Board your pirate ship to explore mysterious islands and find hidden treasures. But beware! Dangerous torpedoes from enemy submarines and rival pirates are out to sink your ship.
You are the captain trying to find your way to new islands. Customize your ship, navigate the deep waters, and face all the challenges of the pirate life. Use your skills to stay alive as long as possible and collect trophies for your skills.

70070000040007.name: Island Survival Deluxe Bundle: Craft, Build, Grow
70070000040007.intro: Survive the wilderness, explore the unknown, and build your way home.
70070000040007.description:
Face the ultimate island survival challenge across two intense adventures where resourcefulness, exploration, and preparation are the keys to staying alive. Gather essential materials, craft tools, build shelters, hunt for food, and adapt to dangerous environments as you search for a way back to civilization.

Bundle Includes:
1. Island Survival: Craft, Build, Grow – Survive on a remote Atlantic island after a devastating shipwreck. Explore diverse landscapes, gather resources, craft essential equipment, build shelters, hunt for food, and manage your health, hunger, thirst, and stamina while searching for a way to escape.

2. Island Survival 2026: Craft, Build, Grow – Take survival even further with expanded island and underwater exploration. Search beaches, jungles, reefs, and shipwrecks, manage limited oxygen, gather materials, and construct a boat piece by piece to uncover your path home.

Explore dangerous islands, master essential survival skills, and build your escape across two challenging survival experiences.

70070000040012.name: TOUHOU Spell Bubble + Scarlet Devil Land Song Pack Set
70070000040012.intro: An online puzzle game with Touhou Project arrangements, and popular DLC in one set!
70070000040012.description:
Get "TOUHOU Spell Bubble" and "Scarlet Devil Land Music Pack" DLC!

▼TOUHOU Spell Bubble
An easy-to-play puzzle and rhythm game in one, a new kind of rhythm action puzzle game! Play against a total of 20 characters and a total of 65 Touhou Project arrangements!

▼Scarlet Devil Land Song Pack
・Hitorishizuka / Yuuhei Satellite

70070000040014.name: QQQbeats!!! + Character Pack Flandre Scarlet Bundle
70070000040014.intro: A bundle that includes the base game and Character Pack Flandre Scarlet!
70070000040014.description:
"QQQbeats!!!" is a brand-new puzzle game that combines simple bubble shooting with easy-to-play rhythm game mechanics. Enjoy the excitement to the fullest by making the most of each character's unique personality!

■ Included in the bundle:
- QQQbeats!!! base game
- Character Pack Flandre Scarlet

[QQQbeats!!! base game]
There are three playable modes, so you can enjoy the game solo or with friends, both online and offline!

■ STORY
This is the STORY mode, where you can play at your own pace by yourself.

■ VERSUS
VERSUS mode lets you enjoy 1-on-1 competitive play.
You can play online in "Ranked Match," "Casual Match," or "Private Match."
There are also "Local Battles" and "Shared Battles" for offline play, as well as "COM Battles" where you can practice against the computer at your own pace.

■ DUOps
DUOps is a cooperative play mode where you team up with friends to battle against enemies.
You can enjoy it casually both online and offline.

■ Featured Songs(75 total)
