- Mori Calliope


[Character Pack Flandre Scarlet]
■ Playable Character
- Flandre Scarlet

70070000040015.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number: Season 6
70070000040015.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number + Landscapes 2 + Under The Sea 2 + Flowers and Butterflies 2 + Landscapes 3 + Simple Patterns 2 + Mythical Monsters

70070000040041.name: Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms: Haunted Maze
70070000040041.intro: Solve puzzles, survive dangers, and find your way out.
70070000040041.description:
Enter a terrifying world of endless corridors, hidden dangers, and mysterious environments where every step brings new challenges. Search for clues, solve puzzles, avoid deadly creatures, and find your way through the backrooms while keeping the darkness under control.

Bundle Includes:
 Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms
Explore seven dangerous levels filled with puzzles, traps, and terrifying enemies. Collect resources, unlock new areas, and use your survival skills to escape the endless maze.

 Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms: Survival Boost
Upgrade your exploration experience with a flashlight that never runs out of battery, allowing you to keep your path illuminated as you search for secrets and navigate through dark environments.

Face the unknown, uncover hidden mysteries, and survive the backrooms with a constant source of light by your side.

70070000040045.name: Trucking School: Truck Simulator Driving 2025 – Driving Master
70070000040045.intro: Take control of the road and shape your own trucking journey.
70070000040045.description:
Step into the driver’s seat and begin your journey toward becoming a professional truck driver. Master realistic truck handling, complete challenging training courses, learn advanced driving techniques, and take control of powerful vehicles across a variety of realistic driving scenarios.

Bundle Includes:
Trucking School: Truck Simulator Driving 2025
Learn to handle heavy trucks through comprehensive lessons, challenging courses, realistic physics, and progressive training. Customize your vehicles, improve your driving skills, and work toward mastering every aspect of professional truck handling.

Trucking School: Truck Simulator Driving 2025 – Road Fund
Adds 40,000 in-game currency to support your progress and give your trucking career a valuable financial boost.

Take on demanding courses, sharpen your skills, and build your path toward becoming a confident professional truck driver.

70070000040050.name: Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector – Restoration Crew
70070000040050.intro: Restore abandoned stations and bring the galaxy back to life.
70070000040050.description:
Take on the ultimate space restoration mission with a bundle that combines satisfying cleanup gameplay and a fresh cosmetic upgrade. Wash away alien contamination, recover valuable artifacts, explore abandoned space stations, and complete every mission with equipment that stands out.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector (Base Game)
Step into the role of a futuristic cleaning android and restore abandoned space stations after alien invasions. Blast away alien slime, collect hidden treasures, unlock new locations, and uncover the mysteries of deep space.

2. Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector – Cleanup Style (DLC)
Refresh your equipment with a new color for your water gun, giving your essential cleaning tool a stylish new appearance throughout every mission.

Clean, explore, and restore the galaxy with a fresh new look for your trusted equipment.

70070000040079.name: Hole Digging Simulator 2025: Treasure Hunter
70070000040079.intro: Unearth forgotten treasures hidden deep underground.
70070000040079.description:
Experience the digging adventure with a fresh visual atmosphere that changes the way you explore beneath the surface. Search through layers of earth, uncover rare treasures, collect valuable discoveries, and enjoy a new environment enhanced by rain and a unique sky.

Bundle Includes:
1. Hole Digging Simulator 2025 - Grab your shovel and explore the underground world filled with hidden treasures, forgotten relics, and mysterious discoveries. Upgrade your equipment, dig deeper, sell valuable finds, and uncover the secrets waiting beneath the ground.

2. Hole Digging Simulator 2025: Rainy Digging - Add a new weather experience with falling rain and a unique skybox replacement that transforms the look and atmosphere of your digging adventures.

Explore new conditions, discover hidden valuables, and continue your journey beneath a completely refreshed sky.

70070000040086.name: VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival – Explorer’s Journey
70070000040086.intro: Explore the unknown. Conquer the impossible.
70070000040086.description:
Venture into the mysterious Void, where every journey brings new discoveries, dangerous encounters, and endless opportunities to shape your adventure. Explore ever-changing landscapes, build and upgrade your vessel, and survive in a world filled with hidden secrets.

This bundle includes:
• VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival
Explore the mysterious Void, build and upgrade your sailing vessel, gather resources, battle dangerous enemies, and uncover the hidden mysteries of a world that is constantly changing. Customize your ship, improve your equipment, and survive an adventure filled with exploration and discovery.

• VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival – Vivid Arsenal
Enhance your adventure with a unique visual upgrade. While equipped, your bow and arrows will feature a smooth animated RGB effect, seamlessly transitioning through the entire color spectrum to make every shot stand out.

Whether you’re uncovering the secrets of the Void or facing its greatest dangers, this collection offers the complete adventure with an exclusive visual enhancement to make your journey even more memorable.

70070000040089.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Feral Edition
70070000040089.intro: Forge your destiny, defend your Clan, and live the life of a true Warrior Cat.
70070000040089.description:
Sharpen your claws and your look. 

Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles. Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.

AN ORIGINAL STORY
Embark on a brand-new journey with iconic cats and locations from the Warrior Cats franchise. 

CREATE YOUR OWN WARRIOR CAT
Using the robust cat creator, name and create your very own Warrior Cat. 

The Feral Edition includes The Prophecy Pack:

The Prophecy Pack includes:
•        8 Accessories to use in the cat creator 
•        12 Wearable accessories 
•        Cel-shaded characters skin
•        4 cat poses poses for photo mode
•        4 photo mode effects

GAME FEATURES:
* 3 Game types: Prophecy Mode, Defender Mode, Skirmish Mode.
Prophecy Mode - Four original stories about the trials and tribulations of Clan life. 
Defender mode -  Test how long you can last while battling all of the game’s fiercest enemies in a single run.
Skirmish mode -  Battle other players online asynchronously.
* Create your own unique Warrior Cat with millions of possible customization combinations.
* 6 iconic locations from the book series: ThunderClan territory, RiverClan territory, ShadowClan territory, WindClan territory, The Moonpool and The Island.
* Turn-based combat system with up to 3 versus 3 battles. 
* 75 unique combat moves to discover and unlock.
* Interact with 9 cats from the beloved book series.
* Battle a large variety of enemies including badgers, vicious foxes, imposing Dobermanns, rival Clan cats and many more. 
* Track and hunt birds, rabbits, squirrels and other prey.
* Visit your friend's camp online asynchronously. 
* You can also help friends with by crafting items or gifting them necessary resources and materials.
* No two playthroughs are the same as characters, quests and stories are procedurally generated.

70070000040096.name: Banana-Clicker: Rush Master
70070000040096.intro: Collect faster, progress further, and enjoy more rewards.
70070000040096.description:
Jump into the hilarious world and experience a fun-filled clicking adventure where every tap brings you closer to building the biggest banana collection. Collect unique bananas, discover exciting designs, and enjoy a faster progression with enhanced clicking power.

This bundle includes:
1. Banana-Clicker 
Click your way through a fun collection journey, discover rare bananas, unlock unique collectibles, and grow your banana kingdom with every action.

2. Banana-Clicker: Click Power
 Activate the double-click feature, making each click count twice and allowing you to collect bananas faster while progressing more efficiently.

Boost your clicking power, expand your collection, and become the ultimate banana collector with a faster and more rewarding experience.

70070000040114.name: Wizards Owl: Magic Delivery – Magical Quest
70070000040114.intro: Every flight brings a new magical discovery.
70070000040114.description:
Experience the magical adventure as you soar across a world of wizards, ancient mysteries, and breathtaking landscapes. Deliver important messages, overcome dangerous challenges, and enjoy a refreshed visual experience with a unique new sky that makes every journey through the enchanted realm even more memorable.

This Bundle Includes:
1. Wizards Owl: Magic Delivery
Become a determined owl working for the wizarding mail service, explore magical environments, overcome dangerous obstacles, uncover hidden secrets, and help protect the realm from the dark witch Mara.

2. Wizards Owl: Magic Delivery – Mystic Horizon
Replace the default sky with a unique custom skybox that gives the magical world a fresh new atmosphere while preserving the original gameplay experience.

Explore new horizons, embrace the magic above, and continue your adventure beneath an enchanting new sky.

70070000040121.name: Mini Market Design Interior Illumination
70070000040121.intro: Build your dream market and welcome your customers!
70070000040121.description:
Mini Market Design is a creative sandbox game where you can design and decorate your very own mini market. With 8 unique store layouts, you have the freedom to create the perfect shopping experience—arrange shelves, add stylish displays, and choose decorations that suit your vision.


Explore around 510 different furniture and decor items, and set the mood with beautiful wallpapers and flooring. Enjoy 9 floor styles and 18 wallpaper patterns right from the start, and expand your options to 18 floor styles and 27 wallpaper patterns with DLC. Whether you’re new to design games or a decorating pro, Mini Market Design is your chance to let your creativity run free!

This bundle includes the School, Cinema, Furniture Material Collection 4, Wallpaper Collection, and Floor Design Collection DLCs.

Features:
- 8 distinct mini market layouts to choose from.
- Around 510 furniture and decoration items.
- 9 flooring and 18 wallpaper patterns (18 floors and 27 wallpapers with DLC!).
- Design a welcoming space for your customers.
- Relaxing, creative gameplay for all ages.
- Ideal for fans of design and decorating games.

70070000040126.name: Cooking Year of the Horse Pack
70070000040126.intro: Run the best restaurant in the middle of the city, complete orders, learn new recipes, and improve your cooking skills.
70070000040126.description:
Run your own restaurant and prepare the most iconic Japanese dishes and traditional drinks. Take orders, prepare meals, decorate your restaurant and develop your cooking skills each day.


DO THE COOKING BY THE BOOK…
Your kitchen has all the necessary equipment and ingredients you will need to prepare the most delicious sushi. Follow and complete each step from your to-do list while choosing from many available kinds of fish, vegetables and spices and adding them depending on the client's wish.


…AND CUSTOMIZE TO YOUR HEART’S CONTENT
Earn money from the orders and customize the interior of your restaurant in Cooking. After each order you will earn enough money to either upgrade your equipment or purchase new decorations. Enjoy new chairs, tables, plants and utensils.


Become a master of composing the perfect sushi. Be precise and use the exact amount of ingredients such as soy sauce or rice. Mix ingredients with passion and follow each step with maximum precision to become a master of Cooking!

This bundle includes the Year of the Horse Set DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- Upgrades that will help you prepare meals faster
- You can learn to make your own sushi!
- A total of 32 unique ingredients like fish, vegetables that NEVER run out 
- Many decorations to choose from!
- Step-by-step recipes
- 6 unique sushi recipes like Hosomaki or Uramaki and relaxing tea

70070000040127.name: Fortress Merge: Lightning Speed Edition
70070000040127.intro: Bring the thunder and defend your fortress at twice the speed!
70070000040127.description:
MERGE, BUILD, AND DEFEND
Your fortress is under attack! Choose and place buildings, merge matching ones to make them stronger, and prepare for waves of monsters. Build structures that train knights, horsemen, archers, and mages, while all kinds of turrets and barricades attack or slow down enemies as they approach. Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, and even stronger foes that appear as you progress. Adapt your setup to each threat and prepare for mighty bosses that can quickly break through a weak defense.

MAKE EVERY TILE COUNT
Space is limited, so plan your fortress carefully. Clear trees to open new tiles, decide where to place buildings that train different units, and find the best spots for barricades and turrets. Use every tile wisely, leave enough room to place and merge buildings, and create a layout that balances attack and defense.

CONTROL THE BATTLE SPEED
Activate permanent x2 Game Speed to face enemy waves twice as fast. Switch x2 Game Speed On or Off at any time and control how quickly the action unfolds.

LEAD HEROES INTO ACTION
Deploy one of four unique heroes to support your army. Upgrade their stats, equip powerful gear, and make use of their combat skills and permanent boosts.

UNLEASH THE STORM
Claire joins the roster with a permanent Mighty boost that increases the damage of all units by 10%. Her Thunder Storm damages and slows every enemy within its range, helping your defenses regain control when a wave becomes overwhelming.

FEATURES:
• Permanent x2 Game Speed - Speed up enemy waves and switch the feature On or Off at any time
• Units and Defenses - Build structures that produce different units or protect your fortress
• Strategic Placement - Clear trees, manage limited space, and balance offense with defense
• Merge and Upgrade - Combine matching buildings to create stronger structures
• Lead Your Heroes - Choose from 4 unique heroes, equip powerful gear, and use their combat skills
• Powerful Enemies - Face skeletons, slimes, dragons, giants, bosses, and unexpected threats
• Upgrade Choices - Gain experience and choose new bonuses as you progress
• Gold Management - Protect gold mines and spend your earnings on building rerolls
• 3 Challenge Modes - Test your strategy in Grand Battle, Boss Fight, and Hero Battle
• Varied Battlefields - Adapt your fortress to different environments, obstacles, and layouts

Lead your forces, prove your strategic skills, and build a kingdom no enemy can conquer - now at twice the speed!

70070000040137.name: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Speed & Success
70070000040137.intro: More speed, more cars, and more ways to win.
70070000040137.description:
Take your high-speed racing experience to the next level with everything you need to jump ahead of the competition. Navigate busy highways, dodge traffic at incredible speeds, and build your dream garage faster with a generous cash bonus that gives you more freedom from the very beginning.

This bundle includes:
1. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Choose from a variety of vehicles, master realistic driving physics, weave through dense traffic, complete exciting racing challenges, and prove yourself as the ultimate highway driver.

2. Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator – Driver’s Fortune – Adds $100,000 to your in-game balance, giving you additional funds to purchase vehicles and accelerate your racing career.

Expand your garage, unlock new opportunities, and conquer every road with the advantage of a powerful cash boost.

70070000040142.name: Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Horror
70070000040142.intro: Explore deeper into the maze without losing your way.
70070000040142.description:
Descend into the endless nightmare with the definitive survival horror experience. Explore ever-changing corridors, uncover disturbing secrets, complete mysterious objectives, and fight for survival against relentless enemies.

This Bundle Includes:
• Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM
Experience a realistic bodycam horror adventure where every decision, every sound, and every encounter could determine your fate.

• Escape the Backrooms: BODYCAM – Eternal Flashlight
Receive a flashlight with unlimited battery life, or automatically upgrade your existing flashlight with infinite power.

• Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM: Night Ops
Unlock a Night Vision Camera with unlimited battery power, or upgrade your existing one to provide endless night vision throughout your journey.

Survive longer, explore deeper, and face the horrors of the Backrooms with the equipment needed to keep the darkness under control.

70070000040150.name: Ecchi Uncover: Guilty Pleasure Edition
70070000040150.intro: Will you let these gorgeous girls blow you away?
70070000040150.description:
Traverse through a field of mines to uncover beautiful girls hiding within. Tread carefully, and you might just stumble on a different pair of bombs.
Features:
- Over 148 enticing pictures of girls with or without clothes
- Sensual music and sound effects 
- Simple and engaging gameplay
- Easy and difficult levels
- A treat for your eyes
Prepare for an explosion of emotions!

70070000040156.name: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling – Port Life
70070000040156.intro: Manage the harbor and master every challenge ahead.
70070000040156.description:
Take charge of a busy cargo terminal where precision, planning, and teamwork keep every operation running smoothly. Load and unload massive shipments, operate specialized machinery, and enjoy a refreshed visual atmosphere with a unique new sky that enhances every shift at the harbor.

Bundle includes:
Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling
Manage every aspect of a modern cargo port by operating cranes, forklifts, and tugboats, performing technical inspections, maintaining equipment, and keeping the terminal running efficiently through changing day and night conditions.

Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling – Dockside Skies
Replaces the default sky with a unique custom skybox, giving the harbor a fresh new appearance while preserving the original gameplay experience.

Operate beneath a brand-new horizon, enjoy an enhanced dockside atmosphere, and keep every shipment moving on schedule.

70070000040167.name: The Smurfs Creative Studio Edition
70070000040167.intro: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!
70070000040167.description:
Welcome to The Smurfs: Colorful Stories, a place where your creativity and imagination lead to creating unique tales. Visit their village like you are one of them and experience amazing adventures - Smurfs can’t wait to meet you!


ALL CHARACTERS IN ONE PLACE
You don’t have to worry you will miss your favourite Smurfette or Grouchy Smurf. They all gathered here, so you can get to know each one of them, while they tell you their stories. Just relax and take a look at what they have prepared for you.


MULTIPLE TOOLS
In order to make every story personal, the game offers a lot of tools to choose from. You decide what color, brush size, or tool type to use. Try to mix different options to achieve a surprising effect. 

This bundle includes the Personal Boards 7, Personal Boards 8, Personal Boards 9, Personal Boards 10, and Personal Boards 11 DLCs.

KEY FEATURES:
- All your favourite blue creatures!
- 14 categories full of drawings
- Unlimited options for creating your personal story
- Cartoon type soundtrack

70070000040179.name: Car Parking - Garage Simulator: Driving Legends
70070000040179.intro: Push your driving skills beyond every limit.
70070000040179.description:
Experience realistic parking challenges, thrilling drifts, street races, and detailed vehicle customization while expanding your garage with even more visual options. Master every driving mode, explore a vast city, and customize your favorite supercars to match your style.

Bundle Includes:
Car Parking - Garage Simulator 
Drive luxury supercars, master challenging parking scenarios, compete in street races, and customize every vehicle to your liking.

Car Parking - Garage Simulator: Fresh Look
4 exclusive vehicle colors, available at the top of the paint selection menu for quick and convenient access.

Take your garage to the next level with expanded customization options and create a collection that stands out on every road.

70070000040187.name: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection Season 8
70070000040187.description: Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number Seasons Collection + Summer 2 + Independence Day + Christmas 2 + Autumn 2 + Halloween 2 + Spring 2 + Winter 2 + Easter

70070000040196.name: 4x4 TRUCK OFFROAD CAR DRIVER – Ultimate Expedition Bundle
70070000040196.intro: Turn every offroad challenge into an unforgettable adventure.
70070000040196.description:
Take on challenging offroad environments as you explore swamps, hills, muddy paths, and rugged trails while searching for lost car parts and unlocking powerful vehicles. Put your driving skills to the test as you navigate unforgiving landscapes and overcome demanding obstacles.

Bundle Includes:
• 4x4 TRUCK OFFROAD CAR DRIVER 
Explore challenging offroad maps, recover lost car parts, and unlock powerful vehicles as you navigate swamps, hills, and rugged trails.

• 4x4 TRUCK OFFROAD CAR DRIVER – Expedition Classic Pack 
Add a new vehicle Hummer H2 to your collection and take on the wilderness with another capable ride built for offroad exploration.

Push your driving skills further, conquer demanding trails, and make every offroad journey an adventure.

70070000040200.name: Memory For Kids Deluxe Edition
70070000040200.intro: Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorful cards to improve their memory skills. Let them become masters of their own minds.
70070000040200.description:
Memory for Kids improves on the classic formula of memory games. It allows you to increase the difficulty level at your own pace and customize the challenges to your liking. 

Our brains are the most important tools of the 21st century. Do your child a favor and give them a gift that will help them realize their full potential.

This bundle includes the Back Cards, Cards Pack 1, Cards Pack 2, and Cards Pack 3 DLCs.

Key features:
- Improves memory
- Cute cards
- Adjustable difficulty level
- Relaxing music
- 20 card designs
- 18 difficulty levels

70070000040201.name: Neko Bento Tempura Edition
70070000040201.intro: Your perfect, cat-themed lunchbox puzzle is here!
70070000040201.description:
Bored with the food you take to work every day? Do you wish it was more… meowtastic?


Neko Bento will let you put together your own, perfect lunchbox. Here, your food will be made by a hardworking cat-chef, and fitting in all the snacks will require your puzzle-solving skills.


To prepare you to pack as much food as you can in the tiniest space possible, you’ll have to put your thinking cap on. Onigiri snacks, plumpy tomatoes, and adorable octopus sausages - you’ll be able to pack these and so many more into your bento. They’re all in a cute visual style, too - hopefully, no one will feel bad about eating them!


With every level, your lunchbox’s size and its supposed contents will change. You can expect more (or less) space, different snacks (hello tofu!), and new obstacles in the form of rice pulps or balls. This is one filling meal!


No worries about the amount of lunchbox levels, they will last you for a while. Each new level will be just a bit harder - but that’s no issue for a professional bento packer! After all, no one wants to leave a tasty meal in the fridge and wait for them to get home.

This bundle includes the Food Pack DLC.

Key Features:
- Over 90 different bento levels to conquer!
- 29 different pawsome snacks to pack!
- Music that ranges from relaxing lofi hip hop to more energetic funk!
- Cute and sweet-looking graphics that will conquer your heart… and your tastebuds!
- An adorable and skilled cat chef - the cook of these snacks!

70070000040212.name: Mine Clicker - Base Craft Building Game: Lost Islands
70070000040212.intro: Explore, build, and thrive. Craft your own success.
70070000040212.description:
Build, explore, and shape your own thriving world in a relaxing sandbox adventure where every click brings new opportunities. Gather resources, expand your island, and create the ultimate automated base while enjoying an enhanced visual experience.

This bundle includes:
1. Mine Clicker - Base Craft Building Game
Gather resources, craft powerful tools, construct your base, and unlock new islands filled with unique opportunities. Explore a vibrant 3D world, automate your production, and grow your settlement at your own pace.

2. Mine Clicker - Base Craft Building Game: New Horizons
Transform the look of your world with an exclusive skybox. Replace the default sky with a unique visual backdrop that creates a fresh atmosphere and makes every exploration, building session, and adventure even more immersive.

Build your dream base, uncover new possibilities, and experience your island from a whole new perspective.

70070000040226.name: Paint For Kids Master Edition
70070000040226.intro: Awaken your child's imagination with Paint for Kids.
70070000040226.description:
Paint for Kids, the best app made especially for kids on Nintendo Switch™ will let you create both simple, ordinary, and professional paintings - from drawings of your favorite cartoon characters to landscapes.

Many possibilities for the creation

Use crayons, a brush, or spray paint. Paint and draw your beloved animals, Christmas cards, or portraits. Enjoy an extraordinary personal gallery of your masterpieces and delight your loved ones. 

A magical experience

Drawing improves the ability to concentrate, develops eye-hand coordination, and contributes to the consolidation of a correct writing grip. With its total power, you will awaken your child's creativity and sensitivity to beauty.

This bundle includes the Additional Board 1, Additional Board 2, Additional Board 3, and Additional Board 4 DLCs.

Key features:
- Basic and versatile tools in different sizes
- Mixed colors with smooth gradients in between
- Tuned for Kids
- Unprecedented ease of use

70070000040227.name: Cook For Love La Côte d'Azur Pack
70070000040227.intro: Win the hearts of Parisians with your cooking, discover delicious recipes, and become a chef worthy of working onboard the Orient Express.
70070000040227.description:
DELICIOUS ADVENTURE
Cook For Love is a cozy cooking game where you’ll be in the shoes of Clement – a young Frenchman, who gets hired at a popular Parisian restaurant. With the help of a recipe book, you will be able to cook unique dishes of varying complexity and conquer the world’s taste buds!


FROM NOVICE TO MAESTRO
Clement starts his mentorship under Jean-Luc Chatillone – a culinary legend… currently onboard the Orient Express. Even though he’s away, Jean-Luc’s recipe book lands in Clement’s hands.

You will be cooking with various kitchen appliances and using many different ingredients. With over 40 available recipes you have your path laid out in front of you – now it’s time to roll up your sleeves and cook until you earn the title of a true chef.


RECIPES FOR JOYFUL LIFE
As you learn how to cook new dishes you also earn reputation points, which in turn level up your chef experience. New recipes will be unlocked on the way and they will get more complex (and more delicious) as you go.

After everything’s ready there will be a final test… will the critics grant you the Golden Spoon, young chef?

Cook For Love is a look into the past of Grandma Rose’s husband – Clement, before he met his wife on the Orient Express. While this is not a prequel to Tell Me Your Story, it’s a look at the youth of these two lovebirds from another perspective.

This bundle includes the La Côte d'Azur DLC.

HIGHLIGHTS:
- Over 40 various recipes to master…
- …and delicious pictures to look at.
- Cozy and stressless vibes.
- Learning how to make some of the most well-known recipes.
- Get to know Clement better long before he met Rose.
- Beautiful, hand-drawn art style with bright colors.
- English, Korean and Japanese subtitles and UI

70070000040228.name: nGolf Classy Tartan Pack
70070000040228.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70070000040228.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!

This bundle includes the Colorful Golf Balls 9 DLC.

KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70070000040248.name: Clay&Cats Sugar Bowl Pack
70070000040248.intro: You'll forget about the rest of the world with the most satisfying hobby - repairing cute cat pots!
70070000040248.description:
Give yourself over to the ultimate relaxation! Clay&Cats will make you feel good in a way you didn't know you needed. 

Your task is simple - assemble adorable, cat-themed pottery to its full glory. Put back together pawesome vases, purrfect plates, and kittiful bowls. Don't worry about the timers and sweating to pass the challenge - take all the time getting the pieces together and enjoy the satisfying way they click into the right places. Can't get cozier than that! 

This bundle includes the Sugar Bowl DLC.

KEY FEATURES: 
- 9 categories with 14 levels of pure joy in each 
- Lo-fi music providing good vibes for the hours of playing
- Satisfying gameplay that soothes your nervous system
- Tons of adorable, furry troublemakers to admire

70070000040270.name: Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – Battlefield Legacy
70070000040270.intro: Command your forces and turn strategy into victory.
70070000040270.description:
Step into the role of a battlefield commander and experience intense strategy shaped by realistic physics. Build your army, manage your resources, deploy diverse units, and adapt your tactics as every battle unfolds in real time.

Bundle Includes:
1.Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator
Craft strategic formations, command diverse forces, and overcome challenging scenarios where every decision can determine the outcome. Experience dynamic battlefields, realistic physics, and countless tactical possibilities as you lead your army toward victory.

2. Warfront Tactics: Battlefield Chronicles Battle Simulator – Military Capital
Adds 1,000 in-game currency to your balance, providing extra resources to support your campaign and expand your strategic possibilities.

Plan your moves, strengthen your forces, and adapt to the chaos of war. Take command of the battlefield and prove that your strategy can turn every challenge into victory.

70070000040278.name: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Border Control
70070000040278.intro: Guard the border, inspect every arrival, and face the outbreak head-on.
70070000040278.description:
Step into the role of a border guard in a world overwhelmed by a devastating zombie outbreak. Inspect survivors, assess suspicious symptoms, manage quarantine procedures, and make critical decisions as you work to prevent infection from spreading beyond the restricted zone.

What this bundle contains:
1. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
Take control of a dangerous quarantine border, inspect incoming survivors, detect signs of infection, manage the isolation zone, and make difficult decisions under constant pressure.

2. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Frontline Gear
Adds a new visual appearance for the player’s hands, refreshing your first-person view throughout your shifts.

3. Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border – Security Gear
Changes the appearance of the clothing scanner and temperature scanner, giving your inspection equipment a distinctive new look.

Stay vigilant, keep the quarantine zone under control, and face every shift with a refreshed visual setup as the last line of defense against the outbreak.

70070000040285.name: Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy – Cats on Delivery
70070000040285.intro: Deliver fish, overcome obstacles, and do it with extra feline charm.
70070000040285.description:
Take on a whimsical cooperative platforming adventure where teamwork, timing, and clever navigation are the keys to success. Transport fish through imaginative environments filled with obstacles, traps, secret paths, and unexpected challenges while exploring colorful worlds inspired by chocolate factories, frozen confectioneries, and enchanted forests.

This Bundle Includes:
1.Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy
Control one or two characters as you coordinate movements, navigate conveyor belts, icy slides, and other hazards, and work toward flawless deliveries. Discover hidden routes, master unique level mechanics, unlock achievements, and put your platforming skills to the test across a variety of creative stages.

2. Meow Delivery: Fish Frenzy – Cute Cat
The DLC adds an exclusive character skin featuring an adorable orange tabby kitten with bright blue eyes and an expressive surprised or startled look.

Take on every delivery, discover new paths, and enjoy the adventure with a fresh feline style by your side.

70070000040311.name: Cynthia: Hidden in the Moonshadow - Infinite Edition
70070000040311.description:
A third-person stealth adventure game focused on the story of Moonshadow Huntress Cynthia Stranborg. Take control of the young adept and learn new stealth skills during your journey. Find out what happened in her home village and follow your own path to rescue the ones you love the most. Travel through Tesana Valley to find a hidden fragment of an artifact to enhance your bow. The Dark Power is coming from the north. You need to destroy the source of this power before it's too late. You are the last one who can reach that destination. At the very least you have to try, for your loved ones!

Key features:
- Stylized and colorful world.
- Fully voiced emotional story.
- Stealth mechanics, arrow crafting, climbing sequences and light puzzle solving.
- A short story-driven game (to finish in one evening).
- Several alternative outfits to unlock throughout the game.
- A dedicated photo mode with multiple options to modify poses, camera effects, stickers, facial expressions, etc.

70070000040318.name: Oblivion Dreams: Community Edition
70070000040318.intro: Peek into visions of forgotten worlds and reassemble what remains.
70070000040318.description:
Piece together mysterious fragments of imaginary worlds, where silence reigns and beauty hides beneath decay. Each puzzle draws you deeper into the desolation — will you uncover what remains, or fade into oblivion?

Features:
- Over 64 atmospheric images inspired by dystopian dreams and wasteland landscapes.
- Simple yet captivating swap puzzle mechanics.
- Multiple difficulty levels to test your focus and patience.
- Immersive ambient soundtrack to enhance the somber mood.

Every solved puzzle uncovers another fragment of a dream long forgotten.

70070000040326.name: Puzzle Galaxy: Complete Bundle - 622 puzzles
70070000040326.intro: A complete bundle for those who never get tired of jigsaw puzzles!
70070000040326.description:
Embark on a relaxing journey through a galaxy of beautiful illustrations, breathtaking photographs, and special video puzzles that come to life once completed.

Puzzle Galaxy: Complete Bundle brings together 622 jigsaw puzzles from the entire series. Explore outer space and steampunk worlds, meet adorable animals, admire peaceful landscapes, discover intricate mandalas, and piece together nostalgic scenes filled with warmth and memories.

With such a wide variety of styles and subjects, there is always something new to assemble. Choose a quick and simple puzzle or take on a more challenging picture with up to 150 pieces.

Features:
- 622 jigsaw puzzles in one complete collection
- A wide range of themes, including animals, fantasy, nature, art, space, nostalgic scenes, and more
- Beautiful illustrations, photographs, and special video puzzles
- Single-player and multiplayer modes for up to 2 players
- Choose from 6, 15, 28, 40, 56, 60, 96, or 150 pieces

Take your time, find your focus, and enjoy hundreds of calming puzzle-solving moments.

70070000040352.name: "GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!!"+DLC"Touhou Project Arrangements Pack 1" Set
70070000040352.intro: A 112-Track Music Game Packed with Popular Songs for Exhilarating Group Fun, Bundled with DLC Adding 10 Touhou Project Arrangement Tracks!!!!
70070000040352.description:
This bundle includes the full version of "GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!!" and the DLC "Touhou Project Arrangements Pack 1".

▼"GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!!"
■Rhythm Game x Roller Coaster!!!!
Ride a roller coaster of sound with simple controls, and get grooving in this exhilarating rhythm game!

■Exhilarating active controls!!!!
With Active Controls, you can play by shaking the Joy-Con™ controllers. Experience the groove in a variety of songs, only possible on Nintendo Switch™!
You can also play with Standard Controls, using the buttons and control sticks!

■Groove together!!!!
Play together with up to 4 friends and family members in Play With Others mode!
In this mode you can choose from two types of play. In Casual Versus, players of any ability level can enjoy the game together, and in Hardcore Versus, players compete to show off their true skill!

■A huge line-up of popular music!!!!
A massive 112-track line-up featuring J-pop hits like “Lemon” and “U.S.A.,” anime songs, Vocaloid and Touhou Project arrangements, as well as popular original songs from the Groove Coaster series!

■Choose from a fabulous cast of characters!!!!
Featuring characters from VTubers and Vocaloid, to the Touhou series and more! These characters will feature in songs, as avatars and game navigators, and appear throughout various scenes!

You can even switch to the vocals of guest VTubers in certain songs!


▼DLC"Touhou Project Arrangements Pack 1"
A DLC pack for GROOVE COASTER WAI WAI PARTY!!!! that includes 10 songs, navigators, and avatars from Touhou Project.

This pack includes the following content.
■Song Pack (10 songs)
- Hitorishizuka
- Cirno's Perfect Math Class
- Burnt Black, the End of Frozen Beauty
- Epicurus' Rainbow Can No Longer Be Seen
- 7 days a week
- The Maid and the Pocket Watch of Blood
- tete+a+tete
- Mischievous Sensation
- And Then There Were None
- Saishuu Kichiku Imouto Flandre S *Locked

■Navigator
- Sakuya
- Frandre

■Avatar
- CIRNO(2D)
- SAKUYA(3D)
- REMILIA(3D)
- FRANDRE(2D)

*Some content will be unlocked via missions after downloading.

70070000040376.name: Medieval Supermarket Simulator Gold Edition
70070000040376.description:
Step into the bustling world of medieval trade in Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator, where every decision shapes your destiny as a merchant. Buy and sell goods, from freshly baked bread to rare exotic treasures, expand your shop, and win the hearts of the kingdom’s residents. Grow from a humble stall into a legendary trading empire in a beautifully stylized medieval world.

This bundle includes the main title and the Coin Pack DLC, giving you an instant boost of extra coins to accelerate your shop’s growth. Upgrade your inventory, improve your store layout, and unlock new trading opportunities faster than ever. With these resources at your fingertips, you’ll be able to expand efficiently and establish your dominance in the kingdom’s marketplace.

Build, trade, and become the ultimate medieval merchant.

70070000040393.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil Deluxe Edition
70070000040393.intro: A deluxe edition of the Touhou Koumakyou shooting game, bundled with an app featuring over 30 tracks in total composed and arranged by ZUN
70070000040393.description:
In addition to the main Touhou Koumakyou game, this edition includes "Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player," which lets you listen to over 30 tracks in total from the New Classic and Classic versions of Touhou Koumakyou.

"Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic Soundtrack Player" is an application for Nintendo Switch™. Launch the application to view and listen to the content.

A standard edition containing only the main game is also available. Please take care not to purchase the same content twice.

・About This Game
Touhou Koumakyou from the Touhou makes its debut on Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch 2.
Take control of Reimu the shrine maiden or Marisa the magician as you set out to resolve an incident threatening Gensokyo.

The New Classic version features upgraded high-resolution visuals, with every BGM track arranged by ZUN. It also introduces a new mode, where you can take on the game with unlimited lives.

You can also play the Classic version, which perfectly preserves the original 2002 gameplay.
*All text in the Classic version is in Japanese.

This product is for the Nintendo Switch™. It can also be played on the Nintendo Switch 2 , but a separate Nintendo Switch 2 -exclusive version, “Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil,” is also available.
Save data and downloadable content are not compatible between the two versions. Please check carefully to avoid duplicate or mistaken purchases.
Please note that there is no Nintendo Switch 2 Edition or Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack for this title.

70070000040398.description:
